Translation: 14. "Spare parts" refer to items, including engines, that are installed in aircraft for maintenance or replacement purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定规定的权利，以便缔约另一方指定空运企业在附件规定的航线上建立和经营国际航班（以下简称“协议航班”）。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement for the purpose of enabling the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party to establish and operate international air services (hereinafter referred to as "the agreed services") on the routes specified in the Annex.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在缔约另一方领土内本协定规定航线上的地点经停，以便上下来自或者前往缔约一方领土的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (3) To make stops at points in the territory of the other Contracting Party on the specified routes of this Agreement for the purpose of embarking or disembarking international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail originating from or destined for the territory of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内地点载运前往或者来自第三国国际业务的权利，由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: III. The right of an airline designated by one Contracting Party to carry international traffic to or from a third country at points within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方有权以书面方式向缔约另一方指定一家或多家空运企业，在规定航线上经营协议航班，并且有权撤消或更改上述指定。
Translation: 1. Either Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one or more air transport enterprises to operate agreed services on the specified routes, and shall have the right to withdraw or alter such designations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权应属于该缔约方或者其国民。
Translation: II. The substantial ownership and effective control of an airline designated by either Contracting Party shall be vested in that Contracting Party or its nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约另一方航空当局可要求缔约一方指定空运企业向其证明，该指定空运企业有资格履行缔约另一方航空当局通常合理地适用于国际航班经营的法律和规章所规定的条件与义务。
Translation: 3. The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party to demonstrate that such airline(s) is qualified to fulfill the conditions and obligations prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party to the operation of international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 四、在不违反本条第二款和第三款规定的情况下，缔约另一方在收到上述指定通知后，应立即给予该指定空运企业以适当的经营许可，不应无故迟延。
Translation: 4. Without prejudice to the provisions of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article, the other Contracting Party shall, upon receipt of the aforementioned designation notice, promptly grant the designated airline the appropriate operating authorization without undue delay.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业一经获得许可，即可在上述许可规定的日期，按照本协定的有关规定开始经营协议航班。
Translation: V. Once an air transport enterprise designated by a Contracting Party has been authorized, it may commence operation of the agreed services on the date specified in such authorization in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （三）该指定空运企业在其他方面没有按照本协定规定的条件经营。
Translation: (3) The designated airline fails to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under this Agreement in other aspects.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款规定的撤销、暂停或者附加条件必须立即执行，以防止该指定空运企业进一步违反法律和规章，上述权利只能在与缔约另一方磋商后方可行使。
Translation: 2. Unless the revocation, suspension or imposition of conditions specified in paragraph 1 of this Article must be implemented immediately to prevent the designated airline from further violations of laws and regulations, the aforementioned rights may only be exercised after consultation with the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方关于从事国际运营的航空器进出其领土或者在其领土内运行和航行的法律和规章，应适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业进出该缔约一方领土或者在该缔约一方领土内运行和航行的航空器。
Translation: 1. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, operation within, and departure from its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services shall apply to the aircraft of the air transport enterprise designated by the other Contracting Party upon their entry into, operation within, and departure from the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方关于旅客、机组、行李、货物或者邮件进出其领土或者在其领土内停留的法律和规章，例如关于入境、放行、移民、护照、海关和检疫的法律和规章，应适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业进出该缔约一方领土或者在该缔约一方领土内停留的航空器所载运的旅客、机组、行李、货物或者邮件。
Translation: 2. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, departure from or stay within its territory of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo or mail, such as those pertaining to immigration, clearance, emigration, passports, customs and quarantine, shall apply to the passengers, crew, baggage, cargo or mail carried by the aircraft of the designated air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party while entering into, departing from or staying within the territory of the said Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方关于航空器方面的其他法律和规章以及有关民用航空方面的其他规定，应适用于在其领土内运营协议航班的缔约另一方指定空运企业。
Translation: III. The other laws and regulations of one Contracting Party concerning aircraft and other provisions relating to civil aviation shall apply to the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party operating agreed services within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对直接过境、不离开为直接过境而设的机场区域的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，只采取简化的控制措施。
Translation: IV. Simplified control measures shall be applied only to passengers, luggage, goods, and mail in direct transit who do not leave the airport area designated for direct transit.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方指定空运企业应享有公平均等的机会在规定航线上经营协议航班。
Translation: 1. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities to operate the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在经营协议航班方面，缔约一方指定空运企业应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益，以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线或者航段上经营的航班。
Translation: II. In operating the agreed services, the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services which the latter provides on the same routes or sections thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班应以合理的载运比率提供足够的运力，以便满足缔约双方领土之间的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输需要。
Translation: 3. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall offer sufficient capacity at reasonable load factors for the agreed services to meet the traffic demands for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail between the territories of the two Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （三）联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The operational requirements of connecting flights.

Query_Text_cn: 一、运力、班次和机型应由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: 1. Capacity, frequency, and aircraft type shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、指定空运企业的地面服务业务，应依照缔约另一方的法律和规章进行。
Translation: II. The ground handling services designated for air transport enterprises shall be conducted in accordance with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应授予缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内，直接或通过其自行选择的持有执照的代理人进行航空运输销售的权利。
Translation: III. Each Contracting Party shall grant to the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party the right to engage in the sale of air transportation within its territory, either directly or through licensed agents of its own choice.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业可根据运输需求申请在规定航线上进行加班飞行。
Translation: IV. The designated airline(s) of either Contracting Party may apply for extra flights on the specified routes based on traffic demand.

Query_Text_cn: 加班飞行的申请至迟应在距计划加班飞行之日3天前向缔约另一方航空当局提出，获准后方可飞行。
Translation: Applications for extra-section flights shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party no later than 3 days prior to the scheduled date of such flights, and the flights may only be operated after approval is obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业应在距经营任何协议航班之日60天前，向缔约另一方航空当局提交计划的班期时刻表，以获取批准。
Translation: V. The designated airline of one Contracting Party shall submit the proposed flight schedule for any agreed service to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party for approval no later than 60 days prior to the intended operation of such flights.

Query_Text_cn: 该班期时刻表应包含航班类型、使用的航空器、班期时刻和任何其他相关信息。
Translation: The flight schedule should include the type of flight, aircraft used, timetable, and any other relevant information.

Query_Text_cn: 这应同样适用于任何随后的变化。
Translation: This shall equally apply to any subsequent changes.

Query_Text_cn: 经该航空当局批准，在特殊情况下可缩短此时限。
Translation: This time limit may be shortened under special circumstances with the approval of the aviation authority.

Query_Text_cn: 一、规定航线上的协议航班的运价应在合理的水平上制定，适当照顾到一切有关因素，包括经营成本、合理利润和航班特点（如速度和舒适水平）以及其他空运企业的航班在规定航线任何航段上的运价。
Translation: 1. The tariffs for agreed services on specified routes shall be established at reasonable levels, duly taking into account all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, and the characteristics of the service (such as speed and standards of comfort), as well as the tariffs of other airlines for any section of the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价，应由缔约双方指定空运企业商定，如有必要和可能，可与在相同航线或者航段上经营航班的其他空运企业进行磋商。
Translation: 2. The tariffs referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties, and, where necessary and possible, may be subject to consultation with other airlines operating on the same route or section thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 商定的运价至少应在距计划采用之日60天前提交各自航空当局，经缔约双方航空当局批准后生效。
Translation: The agreed tariffs shall be submitted to the respective aeronautical authorities at least 60 days before the proposed date of introduction and shall take effect after approval by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如缔约双方指定空运企业就运价未能达成协议，缔约双方航空当局应通过磋商，确定运价。
Translation: 3. If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on tariffs, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall determine the tariffs through consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如缔约双方航空当局未能根据本条第二款就提交的任何运价的批准达成协议，或者未能根据本条第三款就任何运价的确定达成协议，则应根据本协定第十八条规定提交缔约双方解决。
Translation: 4. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach agreement on the approval of any tariff submitted pursuant to paragraph 2 of this Article, or on the determination of any tariff pursuant to paragraph 3 of this Article, the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties for settlement in accordance with the provisions of Article XVIII of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方应在其领土内为缔约另一方指定空运企业经营的协议航班提供主用机场、备用机场和航行设施及相关服务，包括通信、导航、气象服务以及其他辅助设施和服务。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall provide in its territory the main airports, alternate airports, and air navigation facilities and related services, including communications, navigation, meteorological services, and other auxiliary facilities and services, for the operation of the agreed services by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场和航行设施，应按照缔约另一方有关当局规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party using the airports and air navigation facilities of the other Contracting Party shall be charged at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the competent authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 这些费率不应高于其他国家任何空运企业在缔约另一方领土内使用类似机场和航行设施和服务所适用的费率。
Translation: These rates shall not be higher than those applicable to any other foreign airline for the use of similar airports and air navigation facilities and services in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条资料的提供缔约一方航空当局应根据缔约另一方航空当局的要求，向其提供审议缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上协议航班的运力所合理需要的统计资料，这些资料应包括确定该指定空运企业协议航班的运输业务量所需的全部资料。
Translation:
Article 10 Provision of Data  
The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide statistical data reasonably required for reviewing the capacity of the agreed services operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the specified routes. Such data shall include all information necessary to determine the traffic volume of the agreed services performed by the designated airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: 一、为了在规定航线上经营协议航班，缔约一方指定空运企业有权在对等的基础上在缔约另一方领土内设立常驻代表机构。
Translation: 1. For the purpose of operating the agreed services on the specified routes, the designated airline of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish a permanent representative office in the territory of the other Contracting Party on the basis of reciprocity.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内代表机构的工作人员应为缔约任何一方的国民。
Translation: The staff of the representative offices of the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管如此，缔约一方指定空运企业应有权根据缔约另一方有关入境、居留和雇佣的法律和规章，在缔约另一方领土内派驻和保留提供现有航班所需的代表人员和管理、技术、营运人员以及其他经理级的专家人员，包括第三国国民。
Translation: Nevertheless, the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right to station and maintain in the territory of the other Contracting Party, in accordance with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party relating to entry, residence and employment, the representatives and managerial, technical, operational and other specialist staff, including nationals of third countries, required for the provision of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业协议航班上的机组人员应为该缔约一方国民。
Translation: 2. The crew members of the designated airline of either Contracting Party on the agreed services shall be nationals of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方指定空运企业如欲在其协议航班上雇用任何其他国籍的机组人员，应事先取得缔约另一方的批准。
Translation: If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to employ crew members of any other nationality on its agreed services, it shall obtain prior approval from the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的航空器进入缔约另一方领土时，该航空器及该航空器上的正常设备、零备件（包括发动机）、燃料、油料（包括液压油、润滑油）和机上供应品（包括食品、饮料和烟草），应在对等的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用，但这些设备和物品应留置在该航空器上直至重新运出。
Translation: I. When an aircraft of an airline designated by one Contracting Party enters the territory of the other Contracting Party for the operation of agreed services, such aircraft, together with its normal equipment, spare parts (including engines), fuel, oils (including hydraulic fluids and lubricants), and supplies on board (including food, beverages, and tobacco), shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees, and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis, provided such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft until re-exported.

Query_Text_cn: （二）运入缔约另一方领土的为维护或者检修指定空运企业飞行协议航班的航空器的零备件（包括发动机）。
Translation: (2) Spare parts (including engines) brought into the territory of the other Contracting Party for the maintenance or repair of aircraft used by the designated air transport enterprise in operating the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条第一、二款所述设备和物品，经缔约另一方海关当局同意后，可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: III. The equipment and items referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 这些设备和物品应受缔约另一方海关当局监管或控制直至重新运出，或者根据该缔约另一方的海关法规另作处理。
Translation: Such equipment and materials shall remain under the supervision or control of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party until re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the customs laws and regulations of that other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业和另一家或者多家在缔约另一方领土内享有同样税费免纳待遇的空运企业订有合同，在缔约另一方领土内向其租借或者转让本条第一、二款所述设备和物品的，则也应适用本条第一、二款的豁免规定。
Translation: IV. The exemptions provided for in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall also apply where an airline designated by one Contracting Party has concluded an agreement with one or more airlines enjoying the same exemptions from taxes, duties, fees and charges in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the lease or transfer in the territory of the other Contracting Party of the equipment and supplies mentioned in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土的自用且不超出合理范围的宣传材料以及打印客票和货运单，应在对等的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation: V. Printed publicity materials for self-use within reasonable limits, as well as passenger tickets and cargo waybills brought into the territory of the other Contracting Party by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party, shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 六、直接过境的行李、货物和邮件，除提供服务的费用外，应在对等的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation: VI. Baggage, goods, and mail in direct transit shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees, and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis, except for service fees.

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的常驻代表机构人员如系缔约一方国民，其取得的工资、薪金和其他类似报酬，应在对等的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: 7. The salaries, wages and other similar remuneration earned by the personnel of the permanent representative offices of the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party, provided they are nationals of the former Contracting Party, shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业在互惠的基础上，有权将在缔约另一方领土内取得的收入扣除支出的结余部分汇至缔约一方领土。
Translation: 1. The designated airline of either Contracting Party shall have the right, on a reciprocal basis, to remit to the territory of the Contracting Party that designated it the surplus of revenues over expenditures earned in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述收入结余部分的汇兑应用可兑换货币，并按汇兑当日适用的有效汇率进行结算。
Translation: II. The foreign exchange for the remaining portion of the aforementioned income shall be conducted in convertible currencies and settled at the applicable effective exchange rate on the day of conversion.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应为缔约另一方指定空运企业在其领土内的收入结余部分的汇兑提供便利，并应及时协助该空运企业办理有关手续。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall facilitate the conversion and remittance of the surplus revenues earned by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party in its territory, and shall promptly assist such airline in completing the relevant formalities.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方重申，为保护民用航空安全免遭非法干扰行为而相互承担的义务，构成本协定不可分割的组成部分。
Translation: I. Both Contracting Parties reaffirm that their mutual obligations to protect the safety of civil aviation against acts of unlawful interference constitute an integral part of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应特别遵守1963年9月14日在东京签订的《关于在航空器内的犯罪和其他某些行为的公约》、1970年12月16日在海牙签订的《关于制止非法劫持航空器的公约》、1971年9月23日在蒙特利尔签订的《关于制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为的公约》的规定。
Translation: The Contracting Parties shall particularly observe the provisions of the Convention on Offences and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft, signed in Tokyo on 14 September 1963, the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft, signed in The Hague on 16 December 1970, and the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation, signed in Montreal on 23 September 1971.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方应根据请求相互提供一切必要的协助，防止非法劫持航空器和其他危及航空器及其旅客、机组、机场和航行设施安全的非法行为，以及危及民用航空安全的任何其他威胁。
Translation: II. The Contracting Parties shall, upon request, provide each other with all necessary assistance to prevent unlawful seizure of aircraft and other unlawful acts jeopardizing the safety of aircraft, their passengers and crew, airports, and air navigation facilities, as well as any other threats to the safety of civil aviation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方在其相互关系中，应遵守国际民用航空组织制定的、作为《国际民用航空公约》附件并对缔约双方均适用的航空保安标准和建议措施。
Translation: 3. The Contracting Parties shall, in their mutual relations, comply with the aviation security standards and recommended practices established by the International Civil Aviation Organization as Annexes to the Convention on International Civil Aviation and applicable to both Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应要求在其领土内注册的航空器经营人和主要营业地或者永久居住地在其领土内的航空器经营人以及在其领土内的机场经营人遵守上述航空保安规定。
Translation: Both contracting parties shall require aircraft operators registered in their respective territories, those whose principal place of business or permanent residence is within their territories, as well as airport operators within their territories, to comply with the aforementioned aviation security provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约双方同意，可要求上述航空器经营人在进出缔约另一方领土或者在缔约另一方领土内停留时遵守缔约另一方规定的本条第三款所述的航空保安规定。
Translation: 4. Both Contracting Parties agree that the operator of the aforementioned aircraft may be required to comply with the aviation security provisions specified in paragraph 3 of this Article when entering, leaving, or staying within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方保证在其领土内采取足够有效的措施，在登机或者装机前和在登机或者装机时，保护航空器的安全，并且在登机或者装机前，对旅客、机组、行李、货物和机上供应品进行检查。
Translation: Both contracting parties shall ensure the implementation of adequate and effective measures within their respective territories to safeguard the security of aircraft prior to and during boarding or loading, as well as to conduct inspections of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and onboard supplies before boarding or loading.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方对缔约另一方提出的为对付特定威胁而采取合理的特殊保安措施的要求，应给予同情的考虑。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall give sympathetic consideration to any request from the other Contracting Party for reasonable special security measures to address specific threats.

Query_Text_cn: 五、当发生非法劫持航空器事件或者以劫持航空器相威胁，或者发生其他危及航空器及其旅客、机组、机场或者航行设施安全的非法行为时，缔约双方应相互协助，提供联系的方便并采取其他适当的措施，以便迅速、安全地结束上述事件或者威胁。
Translation: V. In the event of an unlawful seizure of aircraft or threat thereof, or any other unlawful act endangering the safety of aircraft, their passengers and crew, airports or air navigation facilities, the Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and taking other appropriate measures to promptly and safely terminate such incidents or threats.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方可随时要求就缔约另一方在航行设施、飞行机组、航空器和航空器运行方面所维持的安全标准进行磋商。
Translation: 1. Either Contracting Party may at any time request consultations concerning the safety standards maintained by the other Contracting Party in respect of air navigation facilities, flight crew, aircraft, and aircraft operations.

Query_Text_cn: 磋商应在上述要求之日起三十天内举行。
Translation: Consultations shall be held within thirty days from the date of the above-mentioned request.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果在磋商之后，缔约一方发现缔约另一方未能有效地维持和管理第一款所述的、满足根据《国际民用航空公约》当时所制定的标准的安全标准，缔约一方应告知缔约另一方调查结果以及为符合国际民航组织的标准应采取的必要步骤。
Translation: II. If, following consultations, one Contracting Party finds that the other Contracting Party has failed to effectively maintain and administer the safety standards referred to in paragraph 1, which meet those established at that time under the Convention on International Civil Aviation, the former shall inform the latter of its findings and the necessary steps required to conform to the standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约另一方应在商定的期限内采取适当的改正行动。
Translation: The other contracting party shall take appropriate corrective actions within the agreed time frame.

Query_Text_cn: 三、根据公约第十六条，缔约双方进一步同意，缔约一方空运企业经营或者代表该缔约一方空运企业经营的进出缔约另一方领土航班的航空器在缔约另一方领土内时，缔约另一方的授权代表可对其进行检查，但应避免对航空器运行造成不合理的延误。
Translation: III. In accordance with Article 16 of the Convention, the Contracting Parties further agree that the authorized representatives of one Contracting Party may inspect the aircraft operated by or on behalf of the air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party in the territory of the former Contracting Party during flights to or from such territory, provided that such inspection shall not cause unreasonable delay to the operation of the aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管有公约第三十三条的义务，此项检查的目的是查验相关的航空器文件、机组执照的有效性，以及航空器的设备和航空器的条件是否符合根据公约当时所制定的标准。
Translation: Notwithstanding the obligations under Article 33 of the Convention, the purpose of such inspection is to verify the validity of the relevant aircraft documents, the licenses of the crew, and whether the equipment of the aircraft and the condition of the aircraft conform to the standards established under the Convention at that time.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如必须采取紧急行动以确保空运企业的运营安全，缔约一方保留立即暂停或修改缔约另一方一家或多家空运企业的经营许可的权利。
Translation: 4. In case urgent action is essential to ensure the operational safety of air transport enterprises, either Contracting Party reserves the right to immediately suspend or modify the operating authorization of one or more air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 五、一旦采取行动的依据不复存在，缔约一方根据上述第四款采取的任何行动应予停止。
Translation: V. Any action taken by a Party under paragraph IV above shall be terminated once the basis for such action ceases to exist.

Query_Text_cn: 六、关于第二款，如果确定缔约一方在商定的时间期限届满时仍然未能符合国际民航组织的标准，应将情况通报国际民航组织秘书长。
Translation: VI. Regarding paragraph 2, if it is determined that a Contracting Party still fails to meet the standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization upon the expiration of the agreed time period, the matter shall be reported to the Secretary-General of the International Civil Aviation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 如果随后情况得以圆满解决，也须将此通告国际民航组织秘书长。
Translation: If the situation is subsequently resolved satisfactorily, this must also be notified to the Secretary-General of the International Civil Aviation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条证件和执照的承认缔约一方应承认缔约另一方颁发或者核准的用于在规定航线上经营协议航班的有效适航证、合格证和执照，但是颁发或者核准上述证件和执照的标准，应相当于或者高于根据公约随时制定的最低标准。
Translation:
Article 16 Recognition of Certificates and Licenses  

Each Contracting Party shall recognize the valid certificates of airworthiness, certificates of competency, and licenses issued or validated by the other Contracting Party for the operation of agreed services on the specified routes, provided that the standards under which such certificates or licenses are issued or validated are equal to or above the minimum standards established from time to time under the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方或其航空当局应本着密切合作的精神，经常互相磋商，以确保本协定及其附件的各项规定得到实施和满意遵守。
Translation: 1. The Contracting Parties or their aeronautical authorities shall consult each other from time to time in a spirit of close cooperation to ensure the implementation of and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of this Agreement and its Annexes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方如认为需要修改本协定的任何规定，可要求与缔约另一方以会晤或者书面形式进行磋商，该磋商应在要求之日起60天内开始。
Translation: II. If either Contracting Party deems it necessary to amend any provision of this Agreement, it may request consultations with the other Contracting Party either through a meeting or in writing. Such consultations shall commence within 60 days from the date of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 商定的任何修改应在完成宪法或者其他必需的程序后，通过外交换文确认后生效。
Translation: Any agreed modifications shall take effect upon confirmation through diplomatic notes after the completion of constitutional or other necessary procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 三、仅与附件航线表和谅解备忘录的规定有关的修改，可由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: III. Modifications solely related to the provisions of the attached route schedule and memorandum of understanding may be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 该修改一经双方航空当局批准即可生效。
Translation: The amendment shall take effect upon approval by the aviation authorities of both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如缔约双方对本协定的解释或者实施发生争端，可先由缔约双方航空当局通过谈判磋商解决。
Translation: 1. In the event of any dispute between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the dispute shall first be resolved through consultations and negotiations between their respective aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如缔约双方航空当局不能就上述争端达成协议，缔约双方应通过外交途径予以解决。
Translation: II. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on the dispute mentioned above, the Contracting Parties shall settle the dispute through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条终止缔约一方可随时通过外交途径书面通知缔约另一方其终止本协定的决定。
Translation:
Article 19 Termination  
Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party in writing through diplomatic channels of its decision to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定应在缔约另一方收到通知之日起12个月后终止，除非在期满前缔约双方协议撤回该通知。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate 12 months after the date of receipt of the notification by the other Party, unless the notification is withdrawn by mutual agreement before the expiration of that period.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条登记本协定或者对本协定的任何修改应向国际民用航空组织登记。
Translation: Article 20: This Agreement and any amendments thereto shall be registered with the International Civil Aviation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条生效缔约双方应当相互书面通知已完成协定生效所必需的国内法律程序。本协定自后一份通知收到之日起生效。
Translation:
Article 21 Entry into Force  
The Contracting Parties shall notify each other in writing upon completion of their respective domestic legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement. This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of receipt of the latter notification.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经其各自政府正式授权，在本协定上签字，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, duly authorized by their respective Governments, have signed this Agreement in witness whereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于二○○七年七月二十三日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Beijing on 23 July 2007 in duplicate in the Chinese, Arabic and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: （三）缔约任何一方指定空运企业在任何或者所有飞行中，可自行决定不经停规定航线上的任何地点，但协议航班应在指定该空运企业的缔约一方领土内始发和终止。
Translation: (3) The designated airline(s) of either Contracting Party may, at its discretion, omit any point(s) on the specified route(s) on any or all flights, provided that the agreed services originate and terminate within the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: 第一条一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线(以下称为“规定航线”)上经营定期航班(以下称为“协议航班”)的权利。
Translation:
Article 1  

1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights to operate scheduled air services (hereinafter referred to as "the agreed services") on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "the specified routes").

Query_Text_cn: 二、在遵守本协定规定的情况下,经缔约一方指定的空运企业(以下称为“指定空运企业”)在规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点经停,上下前往或来自缔约一方领土的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: II. Subject to the provisions of this Agreement, the aircraft of an airline designated by one Contracting Party (hereinafter referred to as the "designated airline") operating the agreed services on the specified routes shall have the right to make stops at points on the specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of taking on and discharging international traffic in passengers, baggage, cargo and mail destined for or coming from the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 行使规定航线上缔约另一方领土内的通航地点和中间经停点之间的业务权问题,应遵守本协定附件有关规定。
Translation: The exercise of traffic rights between points in the territory of the other Contracting Party on specified routes and at intermediate stopping points shall be subject to the relevant provisions of the Annex to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应将其指定空运企业开航协议航班的日期,至迟在开航六十天以前通知缔约另一方。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party no later than sixty (60) days prior to the date of inauguration of the agreed services by its designated airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、缔约一方有权指定一家空运企业,在本协定附件规定航线上经营协议航班,并经由外交途径将这一指定通知缔约另一方。
Translation:
Article 2  
1. Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate one airline to operate the agreed services on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement and shall notify the other Contracting Party of such designation through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在遵守本条第二款规定的情况下,缔约另一方在收到上述通知后,应立即给予缔约一方指定空运企业以适当的经营许可。
Translation: 3. Subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, the other Contracting Party shall, upon receipt of such notification, promptly grant the appropriate operating authorization to the designated airline(s) of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方航空当局(本协定中,“航空当局”一词,中国方面指中国民用航空总局；西班牙王国方面指交通运输部民用航空局)可要求缔约另一方指定空运企业向其表明,该空运企业有资格履行根据法律和规定所制订的条件,这些法律和规定系该航空当局在经营国际航班方面通常合理地予以实施的。
Translation: IV. The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party (in this Agreement, the term "aeronautical authorities" means, in the case of the People's Republic of China, the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China; and in the case of the Kingdom of Spain, the Directorate General of Civil Aviation under the Ministry of Transport) may require an airline designated by the other Contracting Party to demonstrate that it is qualified to meet the conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied by such aeronautical authorities to the operation of international air services.

Query_Text_cn: (三)如该空运企业在其他方面没有按照本协定规定的条件经营。
Translation: (3) If the airline fails to operate in accordance with the conditions stipulated in this Agreement in other aspects.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留和运行的法律和规定,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规定,均适用于缔约另方一指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article 4 The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, exit from, and stay and operation within its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as those relating to the entry into, exit from and stay within its territory of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo and mail, shall apply to the aircraft, crew and passengers, baggage, cargo and mail carried by the designated air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party within the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方应及时向缔约另一方提供上述有关的法律和规定的资料。
Translation: Each contracting party shall promptly provide the other party with relevant information on the aforementioned laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草),如这些设备和物品留置在飞机上直至再次运出或在缔约另一方领土内航段上使用,在进出缔约另一方领土时,应豁免任何关税、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation:
Article 5  

1. Aircraft operated in international air services by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party, as well as their regular equipment, spare parts, fuels, lubricants, and aircraft stores (including food, beverages, and tobacco) retained on board such aircraft, shall be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other similar charges upon entering or leaving the territory of the other Contracting Party, provided such equipment and items remain on board until re-exported or used on flights within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (三)为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的出境飞机供应的燃料和润滑油,即使这些燃料和润滑油系供在加注的缔约一方内的航段上使用。
Translation: (3) The supply of fuel and lubricants to aircraft of the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party for flights on agreed services, even when such fuel and lubricants are to be used on the sectors of the route within the territory of the Contracting Party where they are taken on board.

Query_Text_cn: 三、留置在缔约一方指定空运企业飞机上的机上正常设备、物资和供应品,只能在缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: III. The normal equipment, materials, and supplies on board an aircraft of a designated air transport enterprise of one Contracting Party may only be unloaded within the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 在缔约另一方领土内卸下的上述物品和运入缔约另一方领土内的物品应交上述当局监管,并不得在缔约另一方领土内转售或移作他用,直至再次运出,或根据海关规定另作处理。
Translation: The aforementioned items unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party and those transported into the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be placed under the supervision of the aforementioned authorities and shall not be resold or diverted for other purposes within the territory of the other Contracting Party until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with customs regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对过境缔约任何一方领土的旅客,只能采取非常简单的控制措施。
Translation: IV. Only very simple control measures may be applied to passengers in transit through the territory of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 直接过境的行李和货物应豁免关税和其他类似税捐。
Translation: Baggage and goods in direct transit shall be exempt from customs duties and other similar charges.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、缔约一方应在其领土内为缔约另一方指定空运企业提供在规定航线上所用的机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 6  

1. Each Contracting Party shall provide, within its territory, the airports and alternate airports required by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for use on the specified routes, as well as the necessary communications, navigation, meteorological, and other auxiliary services essential for the operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 具体办法由缔约双方航空当局另行商定。
Translation: The specific measures shall be separately agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设备、技术服务和导航设备、应按照缔约另一方有关当局规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party using the airports, equipment, technical services and navigational facilities of the other Contracting Party shall be charged at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the competent authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此项费率不应高于其他国家空运企业通常所付的费率。
Translation: This rate shall not exceed the normal rates paid by air transport enterprises of other countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班方面,应享有合理平等的机会。
Translation:
Article 7  
1. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在经营协议航班时,应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益,以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线或航段上提供的航班。
Translation: 2. When operating the agreed services, the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services provided by the latter on the same routes or sectors.

Query_Text_cn: 三、经营规定航线有关的班次、机型、班期时刻以及业务代理和地面服务事项,应由缔约双方指定空运企业协商确定。
Translation: III. The operation of scheduled flights on the specified routes, including flight frequency, aircraft type, schedule, and matters related to business agency and ground services, shall be determined through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如此协议的班次、机型和班期时刻应经各自的航空当局同意。
Translation: The schedules, aircraft types, and flight timings under this agreement shall be subject to approval by the respective aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班,应满足当前和预计到的、来自或前往指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输要求。
Translation: 4. The agreed services provided by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties shall meet the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party that has designated the airline.

Query_Text_cn: (三)联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The operational needs of interline flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条一、在以下各款中,“运价”指为运输旅客、行李和货物所支付的价格以及采用这些价格的条件,包括代理和提供其他附属服务的价格和条件,但不包括运输邮件的报酬或条件。
Translation:
Article 8  

1. For the purposes of this Article, "tariff" means the prices to be paid for the carriage of passengers, baggage and cargo and the conditions under which those prices apply, including prices and conditions for agency and other auxiliary services, but excluding remuneration or conditions for the carriage of mail.

Query_Text_cn: 二、规定航线上缔约一方领土和缔约另一方领土间所采用的运价应由缔约双方指定空运企业进行协商。
Translation: II. The tariffs to be charged between the territory of one Contracting Party and the territory of the other Contracting Party on the specified routes shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 此种运价,应在合理的水平上制定,适当考虑到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation: Such fares shall be established at reasonable levels, taking due account of all relevant factors, including operating costs, a reasonable profit, and the fares of other air carriers.

Query_Text_cn: 三、协议的运价至少应在其预定实行之日九十天以前,提交各自航空当局批准。
Translation: III. The tariffs of the agreement shall be submitted to the respective aeronautical authorities for approval at least ninety days before the proposed effective date.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下,经上述当局商定,这一期限可予缩短。
Translation: Under special circumstances, this period may be shortened upon agreement by the aforementioned authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、上述运价按本条第三款规定提交后三十天内,如缔约双方航空当局均未提出异议,应被认为已经批准。
Translation: 4. The above fares shall be deemed approved if neither aeronautical authority of the Contracting Parties raises any objection within thirty days after submission in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 如按第三款规定缩短提交期限,缔约双方航空当局可协商,如有异议必须通知的期限应少于三十天。
Translation: If the submission period is shortened pursuant to paragraph 3, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties may consult, and the period for notification in case of any objection shall be no less than thirty days.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如未能根据本条第二款规定就运价达成协议,或如在本条第四款规定适用的期限内,缔约一方航空当局对根据第二款规定所商定的运价,向缔约另一方航空当局发出异议通知,缔约双方航空当局应设法相互协商,确定运价。
Translation: 5. If no agreement can be reached on tariffs in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article, or if, within the period specified in paragraph 4 of this Article, the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party notify the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party of their objection to the tariffs agreed upon under paragraph 2, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to consult each other to determine the tariffs.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款规定向其提交的任何运价,或根据本条第五款就运价的确定达成协议,此项分歧应根据本协定第十五条规定予以解决。
Translation: VI. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph 3 of this Article, or on the determination of a tariff under paragraph 5 of this Article, such dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article XV of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 七、在新运价制定以前,根据本条各项规定制定的运价仍应有效。
Translation: VII. Until the new tariffs are established, the tariffs previously set in accordance with the provisions of this Article shall remain in effect.

Query_Text_cn: 然而,不能因为本款规定而使该项运价在其应该已经失效之日起十二个月以后仍然有效。
Translation: However, this provision shall not cause the rate to remain in effect for more than twelve months after the date on which it would otherwise have expired.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内经营国际运输所得的收入,缔约另一方应准予按正式比价结汇。
Translation: Article 9 The income derived from international transport operations by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be allowed to be converted into foreign exchange at the official rate of exchange.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约双方间的支付按特别协定进行,则应按这项协定办理。
Translation: If payments between the Contracting Parties are governed by a special agreement, such agreement shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条缔约一方航空当局应按缔约另一方航空当局的要求,向其提供为检查缔约另一方指定空运企业协议航班所提供的运力而合理地需要的统计资料。
Translation: Article 10 The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide statistical data reasonably required for the examination of the capacity provided by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party on the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 这些资料应包括所有为确定上述企业在协议航班上运输的业务量所必需的资料。
Translation: These materials shall include all necessary information for determining the business volume transported by the aforementioned enterprises on the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构。
Translation:
Article 11  
1. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish representative offices in the territory of the other Contracting Party at the points on the specified routes for the operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国公民和西班牙王国公民,其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: The personnel representing the agencies shall be citizens of the People's Republic of China and the Kingdom of Spain, with the number to be agreed upon by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构人员必须遵守驻在国的现行法律和规章。
Translation: Representatives of institutions must comply with the current laws and regulations of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应设法保证在其领土内的缔约另一方指定空运企业的协议航班所用的飞机、器材和其他财产的安全。
Translation: III. Each Contracting Party shall endeavor to ensure the safety of the aircraft, equipment and other property employed by the designated air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party for its agreed services within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的空勤组成员,应为该缔约方公民。
Translation: IV. The aircrew members of the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party operating on the specified routes shall be nationals of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约一方颁发或核准的尚未失效的适航证、合格证和执照,缔约另一方应承认其有效,以便经营本协定附件规定的航线和航班,但颁发或核准这些证件或执照的条件应同于或高于根据缔约双方各自法律和规定可能制定的最低标准。
Translation: Article 12 The certificates of airworthiness, certificates of competency and licenses issued or validated by one Contracting Party and still in force shall be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party for the purpose of operating the agreed services on the specified routes, provided that the requirements under which such certificates or licenses were issued or validated are equal to or above the minimum standards which may be established pursuant to the laws and regulations of each Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 但是,缔约一方保留权利,拒绝承认缔约另一方颁发给其公民的、供在缔约一方领土内飞行的合格证和执照的有效性。
Translation: However, a Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse to recognize the validity of certificates and licenses issued to its citizens by the other Contracting Party for flights within the territory of the former.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条一、如缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约另一方领土内发生事故或遇险,缔约另一方应指示其有关当局立即通知缔约一方航空当局,并应对上述飞机上的空勤组和旅客提供必要的援助。
Translation:
Article 13  
1. In the event of an accident or emergency involving an aircraft of a designated airline of one Contracting Party occurring in the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall direct its competent authorities to immediately notify the aeronautical authorities of the former Contracting Party and shall render necessary assistance to the crew and passengers of such aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: (六)将调查结果书面通知缔约一方航空当局。
Translation: (6) Notify the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Party in writing of the findings.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约双方应本着密切合作的精神,经常相互协商,以保证实施和满意地遵守本协定及其附件的各项规定。
Translation: Article 14 The Contracting Parties shall, in a spirit of close cooperation, consult each other regularly to ensure the implementation of and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of this Agreement and its annexes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条缔约双方如对本协定的解释或实施发生争端,应首先指示其各自的航空当局通过谈判予以解决。
Translation: Article 15 In the event of any dispute between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, they shall first instruct their respective aeronautical authorities to resolve it through negotiation.

Query_Text_cn: 如上述当局不能达成协议,此项争端应通过外交途径解决。
Translation: If the aforementioned authorities fail to reach an agreement, the dispute shall be resolved through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条缔约一方如认为需要修改或补充本协定或其附件的任何规定,可要求同缔约另一方协商,此项协商可在缔约双方航空当局之间进行,可采取会晤或通信方式进行,并应在提出要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation: Article 16 If either Contracting Party considers it necessary to modify or supplement any provision of this Agreement or its Annexes, it may request consultation with the other Contracting Party. Such consultation may be conducted between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties, either through meetings or correspondence, and shall commence within sixty days from the date of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 按此商定的修改或补充,经缔约双方以外交换文确认后生效。
Translation: Any such agreed amendments or supplements shall enter into force upon confirmation through an exchange of diplomatic notes between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条缔约一方可随时将终止本协定的愿望通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 17 Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its desire to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约另一方接到通知之日起十二个月后终止,如在期满前,上述通知已经撤销,并取得缔约另一方同意后,则本协定继续有效。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the notification, unless the notification is withdrawn before the expiration of the said period and with the consent of the other Contracting Party, in which case this Agreement shall continue in force.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条本协定在缔约双方履行了各自的法律手续并以外交换文相互通知后生效。
Translation: Article 18 This Agreement shall enter into force upon the completion of the respective legal procedures by both Contracting Parties and mutual notification through diplomatic notes.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七八年六月十九日在北京签订，共两份，每份都用中文、西班牙文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Beijing on June 19, 1978, in duplicate, each copy being written in Chinese, Spanish and English, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 中国境内一点——若干中间经停点——西班牙境内一点。
Translation: a point in China – several intermediate points – a point in Spain.

Query_Text_cn: 以上航线所列地点须经缔约双方航空当局协议。
Translation: The above-mentioned points on the routes shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 西班牙境内一点——若干中间经停点——中国境内一点。
Translation: From a point in Spain—via several intermediate stops—to a point in China.

Query_Text_cn: 以上航线所列地点须经缔约双方航空当局协议。
Translation: The points on the above routes shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、业务权关于缔约一方指定航空企业在中间经停点和缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点之间行使业务权问题，由缔约双方航空当局协商确定。
Translation:
II. Traffic Rights  
The exercise of traffic rights by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party between points of intermediate stop and points on the specified routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be determined through consultation between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、不经停的权利缔约双方指定航空企业在规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停规定航线上的任何中间经停点，但应尽早相互通知。
Translation:
III. Right of Non-Stop Flight  
The aircraft operated by the designated airlines of either Contracting Party on the agreed services along the specified routes shall have the right to fly without landing at any intermediate point on the designated routes, provided that prior notification is given to each other at the earliest opportunity.

Query_Text_cn: (五)根据公法或合同给予特许权持有者一段时间的合法地位的商业特许权,包括勘探或采掘和提炼自然资源的特许权。
Translation: (v) Business franchises granted under public law or contract that confer a legally protected status for a specified period, including concessions for the exploration, extraction, or refining of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“投资者”在中华人民共和国方面,系指经中国政府核准进行投资的任何公司、其他法人或中国公民。
Translation: II. The term "investor" means, with respect to the People's Republic of China, any company, other juridical person or Chinese citizen approved by the Chinese government to make investments.

Query_Text_cn: 在瑞典方面,系指符合瑞典法律规定的瑞典公民,及所在地在瑞典境内或由瑞典公民或瑞典企业控制的任何法人。
Translation: On the Swedish side, it refers to Swedish citizens in accordance with Swedish laws, as well as any legal entities located within Sweden or controlled by Swedish citizens or Swedish enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、缔约各方应始终保证公平合理地对待缔约另一方投资者的投资。
Translation: Article 2(1) Each Contracting Party shall at all times ensure fair and equitable treatment of the investments by investors of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约任何一方的投资者在缔约另一方境内的投资所享受的待遇,不应低于第三国投资者的投资所享受的待遇。
Translation: II. The treatment accorded to investments made by investors of either Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall not be less favorable than that accorded to investments made by investors of any third state.

Query_Text_cn: 三、尽管有本条第二款的规定,缔约一方如已同其他国家缔结关于组织关税同盟或自由贸易区的协议,则应有给予该协议参加国投资者的投资以更优惠待遇的自由。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, a Contracting Party that has concluded an agreement with another country or countries on the establishment of a customs union or free trade area shall have the freedom to accord more favorable treatment to investments by investors of the states parties to such agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方也有按在本协定签字前同其他国家缔结的双边协议规定,给予其他国家投资者的投资以更优惠待遇的自由。
Translation: Either Contracting Party also reserves the right to accord, under bilateral agreements concluded with other countries prior to the signing of this Agreement, more favorable treatment to investments made by investors of such other countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条一、缔约任何一方对缔约另一方投资者在其境内的投资,只有为了公共利益,按照适当的法律程序,并给予补偿,方可实行征收或国有化,或采取任何类似的其他措施。补偿的目的,应使该投资者处于未被征收或国有化相同的财政地位。征收或国有化不应是歧视性的。
Translation:
Article 3  

1. Neither Contracting Party shall expropriate or nationalize investments made in its territory by investors of the other Contracting Party, or take any other similar measures, except for public purposes, in accordance with due process of law, and against compensation. The compensation shall aim to place the investor in the same financial position as if the expropriation or nationalization had not occurred. Such expropriation or nationalization shall not be discriminatory.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿不应无故迟延,而且应是可兑换的,并可在缔约国领土间自由转移。
Translation: Compensation shall not be unduly delayed, be convertible, and freely transferable between the territories of the Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款规定也适用于投资的日常收入,以及清算时的清算款项。
Translation: 2. The provisions of the first paragraph shall also apply to the ordinary income derived from investments and the proceeds from liquidation.

Query_Text_cn: (四)在缔约一方境内因某项投资而被允许工作的缔约另一方公民的收入。
Translation: (iv) The income of citizens of one Contracting Party who are permitted to work in the territory of the other Contracting Party in connection with an investment.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条如果缔约一方根据其对缔约另一方境内的某项投资所做的保证，向某投资者支付了款项，缔约另一方即应承认缔约一方该投资者的任何权利或请求权转让给了缔约一方，并承认缔约一方对任何上述权利或请求权的代位。但不应损害缔约一方根据第六条所享有的各项权利。
Translation:
Article 5  
If a Contracting Party makes a payment to an investor under a guarantee it has granted in respect of an investment in the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall recognize the transfer of any right or claim of such investor to the former Contracting Party, as well as the subrogation of the former Contracting Party to any such right or claim. However, such recognition shall not prejudice the rights of the former Contracting Party under Article 6.

Query_Text_cn: 代位所涉及的请求权，应扣除原投资者对缔约另一方可能负有的任何债务。
Translation: The claim involved in subrogation shall be deducted by any debts that the original investor may owe to the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、缔约双方在解释或执行本协定中所发生的争端，应尽可能通过缔约双方政府谈判解决。
Translation:
Article 6  
1. Any dispute arising between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement shall, as far as possible, be settled through negotiations between the Governments of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果谈判未能解决争端，则应根据缔约任何一方的要求，将争端提交仲裁庭。
Translation: II. If the dispute is not resolved through negotiations, it shall be submitted to an arbitral tribunal at the request of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、仲裁庭应据案单独设立，缔约双方各委任一名仲裁员，再由两名仲裁员协商推举一名第三国国民，并由缔约双方政府委任为仲裁庭首席促裁员。
Translation: III. An arbitral tribunal shall be established for each case. Each Contracting Party shall appoint one arbitrator, and the two arbitrators shall jointly nominate a national of a third state as the presiding arbitrator of the tribunal, who shall be appointed by the governments of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 促裁员应在缔约任何一方通知缔约另一方希将争端提交仲裁庭之后两个月内委任，首席仲裁员应在三个月内委任。
Translation: The conciliator shall be appointed within two months after one Contracting Party notifies the other Contracting Party of its intention to submit the dispute to an arbitral tribunal, and the presiding arbitrator shall be appointed within three months.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果第三款规定的期限未得到遵守，又无任何其他安排，缔约任何一方可以请求联合国秘书长进行必要的委任。
Translation: 4. If the time limit specified in paragraph 3 is not observed and no other arrangement is made, either Contracting Party may request the Secretary-General of the United Nations to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 如果联合国秘书长是缔约任何一方国民，或不能履行上述职能，则请求负责法律事务的联合国副秘书长进行必要的委任。
Translation: If the Secretary-General of the United Nations is a national of any party to the treaty or is otherwise unable to perform the aforementioned functions, the request shall be made to the Under-Secretary-General for Legal Affairs of the United Nations for the necessary appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 五、仲裁庭应根据多数票做出裁决，该裁决应具有拘束力。
Translation: V. The arbitral tribunal shall render its award by a majority vote, which shall be final and binding.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约各方应承担本国仲裁员和法律顾问在仲裁活动中的费用。首席仲裁员及其它费用由缔约双方平均负担。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall bear the costs of its own arbitrator and legal counsel in the arbitration proceedings. The fees of the presiding arbitrator and other expenses shall be equally shared by both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭可以对费用作出不同的规定。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal may make a different ruling on costs.

Query_Text_cn: 在其他方面，仲裁庭可以制定自己的程序。
Translation: In other respects, the arbitral tribunal may lay down its own procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条本协定的任何规定均不应损害根据国内法或国际法而对缔约一方公民或公司在缔约另一方境内的权益所产生的权利或利益。
Translation: Article 7 Nothing in this Agreement shall prejudice any right or interest of a citizen or company of either Contracting Party accruing under domestic law or international law in respect of any assets in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条本协定应适用于1979年7月1日以后的所有投资。
Translation: Article 8 This Agreement shall apply to all investments made after July 1, 1979.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条一、本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation:
Article 9  
1. This Agreement shall enter into force upon signature.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定有效期为15年,如在最初的14年终了后,缔约任何一方未以书面通知缔约另一方拟终止本协定,则本协定应继续有效,在缔约另一方收到终止协定通知一年后,终止通知即应生效。
Translation: II. This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 15 years. If neither Contracting Party notifies the other in writing of its intention to terminate the Agreement at the end of the initial 14 years, the Agreement shall continue in force. The termination notice shall take effect one year after its receipt by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对于在终止本协定通知生效之日前进行的投资,第一至第八条的规定应从终止本协定通知生效之日起继续有效15年。
Translation: III. For investments made prior to the effective date of the notice of termination of this Agreement, the provisions of Articles I to VIII shall remain in force for a period of 15 years from the effective date of such notice.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于1982年3月29日在北京签订,共两份,每份都用中文、瑞典文和英文写成,三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Beijing on March 29, 1982, in duplicate in the Chinese, Swedish and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: (六)“非运输业务性经停”,指目的不在于装上或卸下旅客、行李、货物或邮件的降停。
Translation: (6) "Non-traffic stop" means a landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail.

Query_Text_cn: 二、航线表是本协定的组成部分,对本协定的援引,除另有规定外,均包括对航线表的援引。
Translation: II. The Route Schedule forms an integral part of this Agreement. Unless otherwise specified, any reference to this Agreement shall include reference to the Route Schedule.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定中规定的权利,以便缔约另一方指定空运企业在本协定航线表所规定的航线(以下称为“规定航线”)上建立和经营国际航班(以下称为“协议航班)。
Translation:
Article 2  
1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement for the purpose of enabling the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party to establish and operate international air services (hereinafter referred to as "the agreed services") on the routes specified in the Route Schedule annexed to this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "the specified routes").

Query_Text_cn: (三)在缔约另一方领土内本协定航线表规定航线上的地点经停,以便上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (3) To make stops at the points on the specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of embarking and disembarking international passengers, baggage, cargo and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条第二款的规定不应被认为是给予缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内为取酬或出租而装上旅客、行李、货物或邮件运往该缔约另一方领土内另一地点的权利。
Translation: 3. The provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article shall not be deemed to confer on the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party the right to take on, in the territory of the other Contracting Party, passengers, baggage, cargo or mail carried for remuneration or hire and destined for another point in the territory of that other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条一、缔约各方有权以书面向缔约另一方指定一家空运企业,以便在规定航线上经营协议航班。
Translation:
Article 3  

1. Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one airline for the operation of agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在违反本条第三和第四款规定的情况下,缔约另一方在收到上述指定通知后,应不迟延地给予缔约一方指定空运企业以适当的经营许可。
Translation: II. In the event of a violation of the provisions of paragraphs 3 and 4 of this Article, the other Contracting Party shall, upon receipt of the aforementioned designation notice, without delay grant the appropriate operating authorization to the designated airline of the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约另一方航空当局可要求缔约一方指定空运企业向它证明,该空运企业有资格履行该航空当局根据法律和规章所制定的,正常和合理地适用于经营国际航班的条件。
Translation: 3. The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the designated airline of one Contracting Party to demonstrate that it is qualified to fulfill the conditions normally and reasonably applied by such authorities, in accordance with their laws and regulations, to the operation of international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如缔约另一方对缔约一方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权是否属于指定该空运企业的缔约方或其国民的情况有疑义,缔约另一方有权不给缔约一方指定空运企业以本条第二款所述的经营许可,或取消此项经营许可。
Translation: 4. If the other Contracting Party has doubts as to whether the principal ownership and effective control of an airline designated by one Contracting Party are vested in the Contracting Party designating the airline or its nationals, the other Contracting Party shall have the right to withhold or revoke the operating authorization referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article from the airline designated by the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 五、一旦按本协定第十一条的指定所制定的运价对协议航班生效,根据本条第一和第二款的规定经指定和获准的空运企业即可开始经营协议航班。
Translation: V. Once the tariffs established in accordance with the designation under Article XI of this Agreement become effective for the agreed services, the designated and authorized airlines may commence operation of the agreed services in compliance with the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 或(二)如该空运企业在其他方面没有按照本协定规定的条件经营。
Translation: or (2) if the air carrier fails to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under this Agreement in other respects.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款所述的暂停或规定必要条件必须立即执行,以防止进一步违反上述法律和规章,这种权力只能在与缔约另一方协商后方可行使。
Translation: II. Unless the suspension or imposition of necessary conditions referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article must be implemented immediately to prevent further violations of the aforementioned laws and regulations, such authority may only be exercised after consultation with the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规章,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规章,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和该机所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article 5 The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, exit from, and stay and navigation within its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as those relating to the entry into, exit from, and stay within its territory of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo and mail, shall apply to the aircraft, crew and the passengers, baggage, cargo and mail carried by such aircraft of the air transport enterprise designated by the other Contracting Party while in the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (七)如载运货物,应携带货物舱单和详细的货物申报单。
Translation: (7) If carrying cargo, the vessel shall be equipped with a cargo manifest and a detailed cargo declaration.

Query_Text_cn: 二、为了经营本协定所规定的航线和航班,缔约一方应承认缔约另一方颁发或核准的仍然有效的适航证、合格证和执照,但颁发或核准这类证件或执照的条件应不低于在国际航空运输方面通常采用的最低标准。
Translation: II. For the operation of the agreed services on the specified routes, each Contracting Party shall recognize the certificates of airworthiness, certificates of competency and licenses still in force issued or validated by the other Contracting Party, provided that the conditions under which such certificates or licenses were issued or validated meet the minimum standards generally applied in international air transport.

Query_Text_cn: 三、尽管有前款规定,缔约一方对缔约另一方或第三国发给该方任一国民的本条第一款(三)项所述的执照和证书,在该方领土上空飞行方面,保留拒绝承认的权利。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the preceding provisions, each Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse recognition, for flights above its territory, of the licenses and certificates specified in paragraph 1(c) of this Article issued to any of its nationals by the other Contracting Party or a third country.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土上空飞行协议航班的飞机的空勤组成员,应是缔约一方的国民。
Translation: IV. The crew members of the aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the agreed services in the airspace of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方指定空运企业如欲雇佣其他国籍的空勤组成员飞行协议航班,须通过外交途径事先取得缔约另一方的同意。
Translation: If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to employ aircrew members of other nationalities to operate the agreed services, it shall obtain prior consent from the other Contracting Party through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条一、如缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约另一方领土内遇险或发生事故,缔约另一方应立即采取实际可行的援助措施,并迅即将遇险或发生事故的情况以及所采取的援助措施通知缔约一方的航空当局和指定空运企业。
Translation:
Article 7  
1. In the event that an aircraft of a designated airline of one Contracting Party is in distress or meets with an accident in the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter Contracting Party shall promptly take all practicable measures to provide assistance and shall immediately notify the aeronautical authorities and the designated airline of the former Contracting Party of the circumstances of the distress or accident and the assistance measures taken.

Query_Text_cn: (五)将调查报告送交缔约另一方航空当局。
Translation: (v) Submit the investigation report to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条一、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草),在进出缔约另一方领土时,应豁免一切关税、检验费和其他类似费用,但上述设备和供应品应留置在飞机上,直至再次运出或在缔约另一方领土内的航段上使用。
Translation:
Article 8  
1. The aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party, together with their regular equipment, spare parts, fuel, lubricants, and supplies (including food, beverages, and tobacco) retained on board such aircraft, shall be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other similar charges upon entering or leaving the territory of the other Contracting Party, provided that such equipment and supplies remain on board the aircraft until re-exported or used on flights within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (三)为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的出港飞机加注的燃料和润滑油,即使这些燃料和润滑油系供在加注的缔约一方领土内的航段上使用。
Translation: (3) The supply of fuel and lubricants to the aircraft of the designated air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party for flights on agreed services, even when such fuel and lubricants are to be used on the portion of the journey performed over the territory of the Contracting Party where they are taken on board.

Query_Text_cn: 三、留置在缔约一方指定空运企业飞机上的机上正常设备、物资和供应品,经缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: III. The normal equipment, materials and supplies on board the aircraft of a designated air transport enterprise of one Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条一、缔约各方应在其领土内,指定主用机场和备用机场,供缔约另一方指定空运企业经营规定航线使用,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article IX  

1. Each Contracting Party shall designate, within its territory, primary and alternate airports for use by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party in operating the agreed services on the specified routes, and shall provide the necessary communications, navigation, meteorological, and other auxiliary services required for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 具体安排由缔约双方主管当局另行商定。
Translation: The specific arrangements shall be separately agreed upon by the competent authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设备、技术服务和导航设备,应按照缔约另一方主管当局规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party using the airports, equipment, technical services and navigational facilities of the other Contracting Party shall be charged at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the competent authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此类费率不应高于其他空运企业对类似服务通常所付的费率。
Translation: Such rates shall not be higher than those normally paid by other air carriers for similar services.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条一、缔约各方指定空运企业,对于在缔约一方领土内装上而在缔约另一方领土内卸下的协议航班业务量(反之亦然),应享有公平和平等的载运机会,而在缔约另一方领土内上下前往和来自航线上地点的业务应被看作是辅助性的。
Translation:
Article 10  
1. The designated airlines of each Contracting Party shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities to carry traffic on agreed services loaded in the territory of one Contracting Party and unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party (and vice versa), while traffic embarked or disembarked in the territory of the other Contracting Party to or from points on the route shall be regarded as ancillary.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方指定空运企业在提供运力载运在缔约另一方领土内装上而在规定航线上地点卸下的业务(反之亦然),应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业在该种业务方面的基本利益,以免不适当地影响后者在该方面的利益。
Translation: When a designated airline of one Contracting Party provides capacity for the carriage of traffic embarked in the territory of the other Contracting Party and disembarked at points on the specified routes (and vice versa), it shall take into account the primary interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party in such traffic, so as not to unduly affect the latter's interests therein.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班,应与公众对这些航班的要求保持密切的关系。
Translation: II. The agreed services provided by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties shall bear a close relationship to the public requirements for such services.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应将提供足够的运力,以满足载运在指定空运企业的缔约方领土内上下的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的需要,作为其主要目标。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall regard the provision of adequate capacity to meet the traffic demands for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo and mail taken on board or discharged in the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline as a primary objective.

Query_Text_cn: (三)在考虑了当地和地区航班后,该航线所通过地区的业务需要。
Translation: (3) The operational needs of the regions traversed by the route, taking into account local and regional flights.

Query_Text_cn: 五、初期运力的提供应在协议航班开航前由缔约双方商定。
Translation: V. The initial capacity provision shall be agreed upon by both Contracting Parties prior to the commencement of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 此后,运力的提供应由缔约双方航空当局随时商讨,对商定的运力作任何改变应以换文确认。
Translation: Thereafter, the provision of capacity shall be subject to consultation between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties from time to time, and any changes to the agreed capacity shall be confirmed by an exchange of notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条一、缔约各方指定空运企业所经营的协议航班的运价,应在合理的水平上制定,适当考虑到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理利润、航班特点,以及其他空运企业在同一航线或航段上的运价。
Translation:
Article 11  
1. The tariffs to be charged by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties for agreed services shall be established at reasonable levels, duly taking into account all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, characteristics of service, and the tariffs charged by other airlines on the same route or segment thereof.

Query_Text_cn: (一)上述运价,应由缔约双方指定空运企业商定。
Translation: (a) The above tariffs shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 经商定的运价,在生效之前,应提交各自的航空当局批准。
Translation: The agreed-upon tariffs shall be submitted to the respective aeronautical authorities for approval before they come into effect.

Query_Text_cn: (二)如缔约双方指定空运企业未能就运价达成协议,或缔约任一方航空当局对于根据本条第二款(一)项规定向其提交的运价不予批准,缔约双方航空当局应努力就适当的运价达成协议。
Translation: (2) If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on a tariff, or if the aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party do not approve the tariff submitted to them pursuant to paragraph (1) of this Article, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to reach agreement on an appropriate tariff.

Query_Text_cn: (三)如缔约双方航空当局未能根据本条第二款(二)项规定就运价达成协议,此项争端根据本协定第十五条的规定解决。
Translation: (3) If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on tariffs under paragraph (2)(ii) of this Article, the dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 15 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (四)在根据本条各项规定制定新运价以前,现行运价应继续有效。
Translation: (4) The current tariffs shall remain in force until new tariffs are established in accordance with the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约各方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内经营国际运输所得的收支余额,缔约另一方应予按照其外汇规定,以官方比价结汇。
Translation: Article 12 The balance of income and expenditure derived from the operation of international transport by the designated airlines of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be settled in accordance with the foreign exchange regulations of the latter Contracting Party at the official rate of exchange.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条一、缔约一方指定空运企业有权在缔约另一方领土内在本协定附件规定航线上的地点设立和开办办事处,配备自己的工作人员,以及指定任何销售代理和地面服务代理。
Translation:
Article 13  
1. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish and operate offices in the territory of the other Contracting Party at the points specified in the Annex to this Agreement, to staff such offices with their own personnel, and to appoint any sales agents and ground handling agents.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方指定空运企业应在互惠基础上给予或享有此种权利。
Translation: The designated airlines of both contracting parties shall be granted or enjoy such rights on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 办事处人员应是缔约方的国民,其人数,除在当地雇用的人员外,应由缔约双方主管当局商定。
Translation: The personnel of the office shall be nationals of the Contracting Parties, and their number, excluding locally recruited staff, shall be agreed upon by the competent authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 办事处人员应遵守驻在国的法律和规章。
Translation: Office personnel shall comply with the laws and regulations of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应根据其国内法律和规章,向缔约另一方指定空运企业的代表机构提供协助和便利,并采取必要的措施,确保燃料供应以及该指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内经营协议航班所使用的飞机、零备件、正常设备和其他财产的安全,如同为其自己的指定空运企业所采取的措施那样。
Translation: 2. Each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its national laws and regulations, provide assistance and facilities to the representative offices of the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party, and take necessary measures to ensure the security of fuel supplies, aircraft, spare parts, regular equipment, and other properties used by the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party in operating the agreed services within its territory, in the same manner as those provided for its own designated air transport enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约一方航空当局应在缔约另一方航空当局提出要求时,向其提供定期的或其他的统计资料,这些资料是审议缔约一方指定空运企业在协议航班上提供的运力情况时可能合理地需要的。
Translation: Article 14 The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide periodic or other statistical data that may reasonably be required for reviewing the capacity provided by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 这些资料应包括确定该空运企业在协议航班上已完成的业务量所需的全部资料。
Translation: These materials shall include all data necessary to determine the business volume completed by the air transport enterprise on the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条一、缔约双方航空当局应本着紧密合作的精神,根据需要随时协商,以保证本协定各项规定的实施。
Translation:
Article 15  
1. The aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall consult each other from time to time as necessary in a spirit of close cooperation to ensure the implementation of the provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如缔约双方对本协定的解释和实施发生争端,应本着友好合作和互相谅解的精神,通过谈判予以解决。
Translation: II. In the event of any dispute between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, it shall be resolved through negotiations in the spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条如缔约任一方认为有必要修改本协定任何条款,应要求与缔约另一方进行磋商。
Translation: Article 16 If either Contracting Party deems it necessary to amend any provision of this Agreement, it shall request consultations with the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此类磋商可在双方航空当局之间进行,并应在提出要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation: Such consultations shall be conducted between the aeronautical authorities of both parties and shall commence within sixty days from the date of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 经商定的任何修改应在通过外交换文确认后生效。
Translation: Any agreed modifications shall take effect upon confirmation through diplomatic notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条本协定签字后,于互换外交照会之日生效。
Translation: Article 17 This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of exchange of diplomatic notes following its signature.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条缔约任何一方可随时将终止本协定的意图通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 18 Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 在缔约另一方通知之日起十二个月后本协定即告终止，除非在这一期限届满前经缔约双方协议，撤销了终止通知。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date of notification by the other Contracting Party, unless the notice of termination is withdrawn by mutual agreement before the expiration of this period.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九八O年六月二十六日在北京签订，共两份，每份都用中文、泰文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Beijing on June 26, 1980, in duplicate, each copy being written in Chinese, Thai and English, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 如对中文和泰文文本产生不同的解释，以英文文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy between the Chinese and Thai texts, the English text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条人的范围本协定适用于缔约国一方或者同时为双方居民的人。
Translation:
Article 1 Persons Covered  
This Agreement shall apply to persons who are residents of one or both of the Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定适用于由缔约国一方或其地方当局对所得征收的税收，不论其征收方式如何。
Translation: 1. This Agreement shall apply to taxes on income imposed by a Contracting State or its local authorities, irrespective of the manner in which they are levied.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对全部所得或某项所得征收的税收，包括对来自转让动产或不动产的收益征收的税收以及对企业支付的工资或薪金总额征收的税收，应视为对所得征收的税收。
Translation: II. Taxes on total income or on elements of income, including taxes on gains from the alienation of movable or immovable property, as well as taxes on the total amounts of wages or salaries paid by enterprises, shall be regarded as taxes on income.

Query_Text_cn: （以下简称“荷兰税收”）。
Translation: (hereinafter referred to as "Dutch Taxation").

Query_Text_cn: 四、本协定也适用于本协定签订之日后征收的属于新增加的或者代替现行税种的相同或者实质相似的税收。
Translation: IV. This Agreement shall also apply to any identical or substantially similar taxes that are imposed after the date of signature of this Agreement in addition to, or in place of, the existing taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方主管当局应将各自税法发生的重要变动通知对方。
Translation: The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall notify each other of any significant changes in their respective tax laws.
