Article 2 Scope of Application of the Agreement  

1. This Agreement shall apply only to investments made in accordance with the laws, regulations, and procedures of the Contracting Party receiving the investment.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在上款规定的范围内，本协定适用于缔约一方的投资者于1979年7月1日之后在缔约另一方领土内所进行的投资。
Translation: II. Within the scope stipulated in the preceding paragraph, this Agreement shall apply to investments made by investors of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party after July 1, 1979.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条投资的保护缔约一方应依照其法律和法规始终确保缔约另一方投资者的投资享有公平的待遇。
Translation:
Article 3 Protection of Investments  

Each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its laws and regulations, consistently ensure fair and equitable treatment for investments made by investors of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条最惠国条款一、缔约任何一方对于缔约另一方投资者根据本协定规定在其领土内的投资或收益所给予的待遇,在同样情况下,不应低于其给予任何第三国投资者的投资或收益的待遇。
Translation:
Article IV Most-Favored-Nation Treatment  

1. Neither Contracting Party shall accord to investments or returns of investors of the other Contracting Party in its territory treatment less favorable than that which it accords to investments or returns of investors of any third state under like circumstances, in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述待遇,不包括缔约一方依照有关关税同盟、自由贸易区或其他形式的地区合作、经济联盟、避免双重征税和边境贸易的协议而给予第三国投资者的投资或收益的待遇。
Translation: II. The aforementioned treatment shall not include the treatment accorded to investments or returns of investors of a third state by either Contracting Party under agreements relating to any customs union, free trade zone, other forms of regional cooperation, economic union, avoidance of double taxation or frontier trade.

Query_Text_cn: (三)给予补偿。
Translation: (3) Provide compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、补偿款额的支付不应无故迟延,并使用可兑换的货币和自由转移。
Translation: II. The payment of compensation shall not be unduly delayed and shall be made in a convertible currency and freely transferable.

Query_Text_cn: (四)与投资有关的缔约另一方被雇佣的国民的收入。
Translation: (4) Income of nationals of the other Contracting Party employed in connection with investments.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应根据其批准的合同允许缔约另一方投资者从其领土内自由转移作为投资一部分的动产。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with the contracts it has approved, permit investors of the other Contracting Party to freely transfer movable property forming part of their investments from its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条汇率本协定第五条和第六条第一款所述的转移,应依照转移之日接受投资的缔约一方的官方汇率进行。
Translation:
Article 7 Exchange Rate  
Transfers referred to in Article 5 and paragraph 1 of Article 6 of this Agreement shall be effected at the official exchange rate prevailing on the date of transfer in the territory of the Contracting Party receiving the investment.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条代位如缔约一方根据担保向其投资者支付了款项,在不损及本协定第九条规定的该缔约一方权利的情况下,缔约另一方应承认投资者的权利或所有权转让给了该缔约一方,并承认该缔约一方对权利或所有权的代位。
Translation:
Article 8 Subrogation  

If a Contracting Party makes a payment to its investor under a guarantee, the other Contracting Party shall, without prejudice to the rights of the first Contracting Party under Article 9 of this Agreement, recognize the transfer of any right or claim of the investor to the first Contracting Party, as well as the subrogation of the first Contracting Party to such right or claim.

Query_Text_cn: 但代位的权利或所有权不得超过原投资者的权利或所有权。
Translation: However, the subrogated rights or ownership shall not exceed those originally held by the investor.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条缔约双方间的争端一、缔约双方对本协定的解释或适用所发生的争端,应尽可能通过外交途径解决。
Translation:
Article 9 Disputes Between the Contracting Parties  
1. Any dispute arising between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall, as far as possible, be settled through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如缔约双方之间的争端在6个月内通过外交途径未得解决,应缔约任何一方的要求应提交仲裁庭。
Translation: II. If a dispute between the Contracting Parties cannot be settled through diplomatic channels within six months,it shall,at the request of either Party,be submitted to an arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应自收到仲裁要求后的两个月内各委派一名仲裁员,该两名仲裁员推举一名与缔约双方均有外交关系的第三国国民,经缔约双方批准,委任为首席仲裁员。
Translation: Both contracting parties shall each appoint one arbitrator within two months from the date of receipt of the request for arbitration. The two arbitrators shall jointly select a third-country national who maintains diplomatic relations with both contracting parties as the presiding arbitrator, subject to the approval of both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 首席仲裁员应在两名仲裁员委派之日起两个月内予以委任。
Translation: The presiding arbitrator shall be appointed within two months from the date of the appointment of the two arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如在本条第三款规定的期限内未能作出必要的委派,且无其他任何约定,缔约任何一方可请求国际法院院长作出必要的委派。
Translation: 4. If the necessary appointments are not made within the time limit specified in paragraph 3 of this Article and in the absence of any other agreement, either Contracting Party may request the President of the International Court of Justice to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 如院长是缔约任何一方的国民或因其他原因不能履行此项职责,则应请求副院长作出必要的委派。
Translation: If the President is a national of either Contracting Party or is otherwise unable to discharge such functions, the Vice-President shall be requested to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 如副院长是缔约任何一方的国民或也不能履行此项职责,则应请求非缔约任何一方国民的国际法院资深法官作出必要的委派。
Translation: If the Vice-President is a national of either Contracting Party or is otherwise unable to discharge this function, the necessary appointment shall be made by the senior judge of the International Court of Justice who is not a national of either Contracting Party upon request.

Query_Text_cn: 五、仲裁庭应自行确定其程序。
Translation: 5. The arbitral tribunal shall determine its own procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭以多数票作出裁决。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal rendered its award by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 裁决是终局的,对缔约双方均有拘束力。
Translation: The award shall be final and binding upon both contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 应缔约任何一方的要求,仲裁庭应说明其裁决所依据的理由。
Translation: At the request of either contracting party, the arbitral tribunal shall state the reasons on which its award is based.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约双方各自承担其委派的仲裁员的费用。
Translation: VI. Each Contracting Party shall bear the costs of the arbitrator it appoints.

Query_Text_cn: 首席仲裁员的费用和仲裁庭的有关费用将由缔约双方平均承担。
Translation: The fees of the presiding arbitrator and the relevant costs of the arbitral tribunal shall be borne equally by both contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条执行情况的审查一旦需要,缔约双方代表应举行会议审查本协定的执行情况。
Translation:
Article 10 Review of Implementation  
When necessary, representatives of both contracting parties shall convene meetings to review the implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 会议应根据缔约任何一方的建议,通过外交途径于协商所同意的时间和地点举行。
Translation: The meeting shall be held through diplomatic channels at a time and place agreed upon through consultation, upon the proposal of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条生效、期限和终止一、本协定将自缔约双方相互通知已完成本协定生效所需的各自法律程序之日起30天后生效。
Translation:
Article 11 Entry into Force,Term and Termination  
1. This Agreement shall enter into force 30 days after the date on which the Parties have exchanged notifications confirming the completion of their respective domestic legal procedures necessary for its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定有效期为15年。
Translation: II. This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 15 years.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，本协定将继续有效直至缔约一方书面通知缔约另一方终止本协定之日起12个月期满为止。
Translation: Thereafter, this Agreement shall remain in force until the expiration of twelve months from the date on which either Contracting Party notifies the other Contracting Party in writing of its intention to terminate the Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对于本协定终止之日前所进行的投资，本协定第一条至第十条的规定自本协定终止之日起10年内仍然有效。
Translation: III. For investments made prior to the termination of this Agreement, the provisions of Articles 1 to 10 shall remain in force for a period of 10 years from the date of termination of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定经各自政府正式授权代表签署，以昭信守。
Translation: This Agreement is signed by the duly authorized representatives of their respective governments in witness whereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于1984年9月4日在北京签订，正本共两份，每份均用中文、芬兰文和英文写成。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on September 4, 1984, in duplicate in the Chinese, Finnish and English languages, each text being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 三种文本具有同等效力，如发生解释的分歧，以英文本为准。
Translation: The three texts are equally authentic. In case of divergence of interpretation, the English text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条缔约任何一方在其法律和法规的规定范围内，对希望进入其领土内与投资有关的缔约另一方投资者的雇员的入境和居留申请，予以善意的考虑。
Translation: Article 1 Each Contracting Party shall, within the framework of its laws and regulations, give sympathetic consideration to applications for entry and residence by employees of investors of the other Contracting Party who wish to enter and stay in its territory in connection with an investment.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、如投资者认为本协定第五条的征收措施不符合采取措施的缔约一方的法律，应投资者的请求，该缔约一方有管辖权的法院应审查上述措施。
Translation: Article 2(1) Where an investor considers that the expropriation measure taken by one Contracting Party under Article 5 of this Agreement is inconsistent with the laws of that Contracting Party, the competent court of that Contracting Party shall, at the request of the investor, review the said measure.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如投资者对其被征收的投资财产的补偿款额有异议，投资者和采取征收措施的缔约一方应为在6个月内达成补偿款额协议进行协商。
Translation: II. If an investor disputes the amount of compensation for its expropriated investment property, the investor and the Contracting Party that has taken the expropriation measure shall negotiate with a view to reaching an agreement on the compensation amount within six months.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如在上款规定的期限内，协商的双方未获一致，应投资者的请求，由采取征收措施的缔约一方有管辖权的法院或国际仲裁庭对补偿款额予以审查。
Translation: 3. If no agreement is reached between the parties concerned within the period specified in the preceding paragraph, the amount of compensation shall, at the request of the investor, be reviewed by a competent court or an international arbitral tribunal of the Contracting Party taking the expropriation measures.

Query_Text_cn: 四、上述国际仲裁庭将逐案单独设立。
Translation: IV. The aforementioned international arbitral tribunal shall be established on a case-by-case basis.

Query_Text_cn: 争议双方各委派一名仲裁员，该两名仲裁员推举第三名仲裁员任首席仲裁员。
Translation: Each party to the dispute shall appoint one arbitrator, and the two arbitrators thus appointed shall jointly select a third arbitrator as the presiding arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: 自一方收到另一方要求将争议提交仲裁之日起的两个月内委派仲裁员，4个月内委任首席仲裁员。
Translation: Each party shall appoint an arbitrator within two months from the date of receiving the other party's request for arbitration, and the presiding arbitrator shall be appointed within four months.

Query_Text_cn: 如在上述规定的期限内未能作出委派，且无其他约定，任何一方可请求斯德哥尔摩商会仲裁院作出委派。
Translation: If no appointment is made within the time period specified above and there is no other agreement, either party may request the Arbitration Institute of the Stockholm Chamber of Commerce to make the appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭将参照1965年3月18日在华盛顿签署的《关于解决国家和他国国民之间投资争端公约》自行确定其程序。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall determine its own procedure in accordance with the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States, signed at Washington on March 18, 1965.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭以多数票作出裁决，裁决是终局的，具有拘束力，并可按国内法执行。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall render its award by a majority vote, which shall be final and binding and enforceable under domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 应任何一方的要求，仲裁庭应说明其裁决所依据的理由。
Translation: At the request of either party, the arbitral tribunal shall state the reasons upon which its award is based.

Query_Text_cn: 双方各自承担其委派的仲裁员的费用。
Translation: Each party shall bear the costs of the arbitrator it appoints.

Query_Text_cn: 首席仲裁员的费用和仲裁庭的其他有关费用将由争议双方平均承担。
Translation: The fees of the presiding arbitrator and other relevant expenses of the arbitral tribunal shall be equally borne by both parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条除非另有协议，投资者和接受投资的缔约一方之间的其他投资争议，应依照接受投资的缔约一方的法律和法规通过当地救济手段解决。
Translation: Article 3 Unless otherwise agreed, any other investment dispute between an investor and a Contracting Party receiving the investment shall be resolved in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Contracting Party receiving the investment through local remedies.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条如缔约一方的投资者在第三国的公司中有重要利益，而该公司又在缔约另一方的公司中有重要利益，该缔约另一方如对上述第三国公司在其领土内的投资财产采取征收措施时，应对缔约一方的有关投资者适用本协定第五条的规定。
Translation: Article 4 If an investor of one Contracting Party holds a substantial interest in a company of a third state, and such company in turn holds a substantial interest in a company of the other Contracting Party, the latter Contracting Party, when taking expropriation measures against the investment assets of the aforementioned third-state company within its territory, shall apply the provisions of Article 5 of this Agreement to the relevant investor of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 但征收补偿的规定，只有当该公司或其所属第三国无资格行使要求补偿的权利或该国放弃要求补偿的权利时，方可适用。
Translation: However, the provisions on expropriation compensation shall apply only when the company or the third country to which it belongs is not entitled to exercise the right to claim compensation or when the country waives such right.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条如果缔约一方的法律和法规对缔约另一方投资者投资的待遇较本协定更为优惠，应从优适用。
Translation: Article 5 If the laws and regulations of one Contracting Party provide more favorable treatment to investments by investors of the other Contracting Party than this Agreement, the more favorable provisions shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书于1984年9月4日在北京签订，正本共两份，每份均用中文、芬兰文和英文写成。
Translation: This Protocol is signed in Beijing on September 4, 1984, in duplicate in the Chinese, Finnish and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: （五）法律或依法订立的合同授予的权利，包括勘探、探测、提炼或开发自然资源的特许权。
Translation: (v) Rights conferred by law or under contract, including concessions to explore for, extract, or exploit natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: 作为投资的财产形式发生任何变化都不影响其作为投资的性质，除非此变化与投资所在缔约方的立法相悖。
Translation: Any change in the form of investment assets shall not affect their character as investments, provided that such change is not in conflict with the legislation of the Contracting Party where the investment is made.

Query_Text_cn: 本款第（一）、（二）项所指缔约一方自然人或法律实体应依照缔约另一方的法律和法规在其领土上进行投资。
Translation: The natural persons or legal entities of one Contracting Party referred to in subparagraphs (1) and (2) of this Article shall make investments in the territory of the other Contracting Party in accordance with its laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“收益”一词系指一定期限内，由投资产生的各种款项，如利润、特许权使用费或利息等。
Translation: 3. The term "returns" refers to amounts yielded by an investment over a given period, such as profits, royalties, or interest.

Query_Text_cn: 投资产生的收益及再投资收益，应与投资受到同等保护。
Translation: The returns on investment and the proceeds from reinvestment shall be accorded the same protection as the investment itself.

Query_Text_cn: 四、“领土”一词系指缔约任何一方的领土（包括领海），以及根据缔约任何一方法律和国际法，在其领海以外拥有勘探、开发海床和底土资源及海底以上水资源的主权权利的任何区域。
Translation: 4. The term "territory" refers to the territory (including territorial waters) of either Contracting Party, as well as any area beyond its territorial waters over which it has sovereign rights for the exploration and exploitation of seabed, subsoil resources, and the waters above, in accordance with its domestic laws and international law.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约任何一方应努力鼓励和保护缔约另一方投资者在其领土内的投资，以促进合作。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall endeavor to encourage and protect investments made by investors of the other Contracting Party within its territory, so as to promote cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约任何一方应依照其法律和法规接受此类投资。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall accept such investments in accordance with its laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约任何一方应依据国际法原则，给予缔约另一方投资者在其领土内的投资以公正和公平的待遇，该待遇在法律上和事实上都不应受到阻碍。
Translation: 1. Either Contracting Party shall accord to investments made by investors of the other Contracting Party in its territory fair and equitable treatment in accordance with the principles of international law, which shall not be impaired in law or in fact.

Query_Text_cn: 各种对生产和经营手段进行限制的不平等待遇，各种对产品在国内外销售进行限制的不平等待遇，以及其他具有类似效果的措施。
Translation: Various discriminatory treatments that impose restrictions on production and operational means, various discriminatory treatments that limit the sale of products domestically and internationally, as well as other measures with similar effects.

Query_Text_cn: 而出于安全、公共秩序、卫生、道德和环境保护等原因采取的措施不应被视作障碍。
Translation: Measures taken for reasons of safety, public order, health, morality, or environmental protection shall not be considered as obstacles.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应依据其国内法律善意审查缔约另一方的自然人投资者为在缔约另一方领土内投资而提出的入境、居留、工作、交通等方面的申请。
Translation: III. Each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its domestic laws, examine in good faith applications submitted by natural investors of the other Contracting Party for entry, residence, work, transportation and other related matters for the purpose of making investments in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、依照其法律法规的规定，缔约一方应给予缔约另一方的投资者在其领土内的投资及与投资相关活动不低于其给予本国投资者的待遇，或不低于其给予任何第三国投资者的待遇，如果此待遇更为优惠。
Translation: 1. In accordance with the provisions of its laws and regulations, each Contracting Party shall accord to investors of the other Contracting Party, with respect to their investments and activities associated with such investments in its territory, treatment no less favorable than that accorded to its own investors or to investors of any third country, whichever is more favorable.

Query_Text_cn: 二、但是，本条前款所述的最惠国待遇不包括缔约一方根据其参加或被吸收加入的自由贸易区、关税同盟、共同市场或其它形式的地区经济组织的规定而给予第三国投资者的优惠。
Translation: II. However, the most-favored-nation treatment referred to in the preceding paragraph of this Article shall not include the preferences granted by one Contracting Party to investors of a third country pursuant to the provisions of the free trade zone, customs union, common market or other forms of regional economic organizations in which it participates or is admitted.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条给予的待遇不包括缔约一方根据避免双重征税协定或其他税务安排给予第三国投资者的优惠。
Translation: III. The treatment granted under this Article shall not include preferences accorded by a Party to investors of a third country under an agreement for the avoidance of double taxation or other tax arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约任何一方投资者在缔约另一方领土上的投资，享有充分、全面的保护和安全。
Translation: 1. Investments made by investors of either Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall enjoy full and comprehensive protection and security.

Query_Text_cn: （三）采取措施时给予适当补偿。
Translation: (3) Providing appropriate compensation when taking measures.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条第二款所述的补偿，应等于采取征收或征收为公众所知的前一刻被征收投资的价值。
Translation: III. The compensation referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall be equivalent to the value of the expropriated investment immediately before the expropriation was taken or became publicly known.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿自征收之日起到付款之日按正常市场利率计算利息。
Translation: Interest shall be calculated at the prevailing market rate from the date of expropriation to the date of payment.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿的支付不应不合理地延迟，并应自由转移。
Translation: Compensation payments shall not be unreasonably delayed and shall be freely transferable.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方投资者在缔约另一方领土内的投资如因战争或武装冲突、革命、国家紧急状态、叛乱、暴动、骚乱、恐怖活动等原因遭受损失的，缔约另一方给予其在恢复原状、损害赔偿、补偿或其它解决方面的待遇，应不低于给予本国投资者或者任何第三国投资者中较优的待遇。
Translation: If an investor of one Contracting Party suffers losses in its investments in the territory of the other Contracting Party due to war or armed conflict, revolution, state of emergency, insurrection, riot, civil commotion, terrorist acts, or other similar events, the latter Contracting Party shall accord to such investor treatment, as regards restitution, indemnification, compensation, or other settlement, no less favorable than that which it accords to its own investors or to investors of any third state, whichever is more favorable.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方的投资者在缔约另一方的领土内进行投资，缔约另一方应允许该投资者自由转移与投资有关的款项。
Translation: A Contracting Party shall permit investors of the other Contracting Party to freely transfer payments related to their investments within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 转移应依照缔约方法律和法规进行，并应符合这些法律和法规所规定的手续和义务要求。
Translation: Transfers shall be conducted in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Contracting Parties and shall comply with the procedures and obligations stipulated therein.

Query_Text_cn: (六)报酬。
Translation: (6) Remuneration.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述转移应以可自由兑换的货币按照转移当日接受投资缔约一方通行的市场汇率进行。
Translation: II. Such transfers shall be made in a freely convertible currency at the prevailing market exchange rate of the host Contracting Party on the date of transfer.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在没有外汇市场的情况下，使用的汇率应为最近的相关货币与特别提款权之间的汇率。
Translation: 3. In the absence of a foreign exchange market, the exchange rate to be used shall be the most recent rate between the relevant currency and the special drawing right.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如国际收支出现特别困难，缔约方可以按照国际货币基金组织协定规定的标准和要求对自由转移暂时进行限制，并符合公正、无歧视、诚信的标准。
Translation: 4. In the event of serious balance-of-payments difficulties, a Party may temporarily impose restrictions on free transfers in accordance with the standards and requirements of the Articles of Agreement of the International Monetary Fund, provided that such measures are applied fairly, without discrimination, and in good faith.

Query_Text_cn: 如果缔约一方或其指定的机构根据其对在缔约另一方领土内的投资所柞的担保，向其投资者进行了支付，则缔约一方或其指定机构在与投资者同等的范围内，代位行使该投资者的权利或执行该投资者的请求权，并承担其与投资相关的义务。
Translation: If a Contracting Party or its designated agency makes a payment to its investor under a guarantee it has granted in respect of an investment in the territory of the other Contracting Party, the former Contracting Party or its designated agency shall, to the extent of such payment, be subrogated to the rights or claims of that investor and shall assume the obligations related to the investment.

Query_Text_cn: 如根据缔约一方国内法律，或根据缔约双方间现有或将来订立的除本协定以外的国际法义务制定的一般或特别法规，可给予缔约另一方投资者的投资比本协定更为优惠的待遇，该法规只要更加优惠，就将优于本协定。
Translation: If, under the domestic laws of either Contracting Party, or under general or specific regulations established by existing or future international legal obligations between the Contracting Parties other than this Agreement, investments by investors of the other Contracting Party are accorded treatment more favorable than that provided for by this Agreement, such more favorable treatment shall prevail over this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方和缔约另一方投资者之间的各种投资争议应尽可能通过双方友好协商解决。
Translation: 1. Any investment dispute between an investor of one Contracting Party and the other Contracting Party shall be settled, as far as possible, through amicable consultations between the two parties.

Query_Text_cn: “解决投资争端国际中心”的仲裁程序，依据1965年3月18日在华盛顿开放签字的《解决国家和他国国民之间投资争端公约》，进行仲裁解决，但前提是有关投资者在提交国际仲裁前，用尽该缔约方法律和法规所规定的国内行政复议程序。
Translation: The arbitration proceedings of the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID) shall be conducted in accordance with the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States, which was opened for signature in Washington on March 18, 1965, provided that the concerned investor exhausts the domestic administrative review procedures stipulated by the laws and regulations of the contracting party before submitting to international arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 三、仲裁裁决具有强制效力，不可再行起诉或使用其它非(($罕决国家和他国国民之间投资争端公约》规定的解决方式。裁决按照缔约方国内法予以执行。
Translation: III. Arbitral awards shall have binding force and shall not be subject to appeal or any other remedy except those provided for in the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States. The awards shall be enforced in accordance with the domestic laws of the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 四、仲裁过程中或执行仲裁裁决时，与争议有关的缔约一方不能以投资者已通过保险获得部分或者全部补偿为由提出杭辫。
Translation: IV. During the arbitration process or the enforcement of an arbitral award, a Contracting Party involved in the dispute shall not invoke the defense that the investor has received partial or full compensation through insurance.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定生效后，同样适用于在协定生效前由缔约一方投资者在缔约另一方领土内按照其法律法规进行的投资。
Translation: This Agreement shall also apply to investments made by an investor of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party in accordance with its laws and regulations prior to the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、对本协定的解释或适用所产生的争议，应通过外交途径解决。
Translation: 1. Any dispute arising from the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall be resolved through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果争议在缔约任何一方提出之日起六个月内未能解决，根据缔约任何一方的要求，争议可提交仲裁庭解决。
Translation: II. If the dispute is not resolved within six months from the date it is raised by either Contracting Party, it may, at the request of either Party, be submitted to an arbitral tribunal for settlement.

Query_Text_cn: (三)所有仲裁员应在缔约一方向缔约另一方表示拟将争议提交仲裁之日起两个月内被任命。
Translation: (3) All arbitrators shall be appointed within two months from the date on which one Party notifies the other Party of its intention to submit the dispute to arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果仲裁庭未能在前款第(三)项规定的期限内组成，缔约双方间又无其它约定，缔约任何一方可邀请国际法院院长做出必要的任命。
Translation: IV. If the arbitral tribunal is not constituted within the period specified in paragraph (3) of the preceding Article and there is no other agreement between the Contracting Parties, either Contracting Party may request the President of the International Court of Justice to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 如果国际法院院长是缔约任何一方的国民，或由于其它原因不能履行此项任命，应请国际法院中非缔约方国籍的最资深副院长履行此项任命。
Translation: If the President of the International Court of Justice is a national of either Contracting Party or is otherwise unable to perform this appointment, the most senior Vice-President of the International Court of Justice who is not a national of either Contracting Party shall be invited to make the appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 五、仲裁庭自行决定其程序，并应依照本协定以及普遍承认的国际法原则作出裁决。
Translation: V. The arbitral tribunal shall determine its own procedure and render its award in accordance with this Agreement and the generally recognized principles of international law.

Query_Text_cn: 六、仲裁庭的裁决应以多数票作出。
Translation: VI. The arbitral tribunal shall render its award by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 裁决是终局的，对缔约双方均有构束力。
Translation: The award shall be final and binding upon both contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 应缔约任何一方的请求，仲裁庭应对裁决进行解释。
Translation: At the request of either Contracting Party, the arbitral tribunal shall provide an interpretation of the award.

Query_Text_cn: 除非在特殊情况下仲裁庭另有安排，否则仲裁程序费用，包括仲裁员的费用，由缔约双方平均分摊。
Translation: Unless the arbitral tribunal decides otherwise under exceptional circumstances, the costs of the arbitral proceedings, including the fees of the arbitrators, shall be borne equally by the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定自收到缔约双方完成其各自国内法律程序的后一方书面通知之日后第三十天开始生效。
Translation: This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of receipt of the latter written notification by which the Contracting Parties have completed their respective domestic legal procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定有效期为十年。
Translation: This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of ten years.

Query_Text_cn: 如果缔约任何一方未在期满前一年通过外交途径书面通知终止本协定，则本协定在此期限后继续有效。
Translation: If either Contracting Party fails to give written notice of termination through diplomatic channels at least one year prior to the expiration of this Agreement, the Agreement shall remain in force thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: 对本协定终止之日前所做出的投资，本协定第一条至第十二条的规定应自协定终止之日起继续适用十年。
Translation: For investments made prior to the termination of this Agreement, the provisions of Articles 1 to 12 shall continue to apply for a period of ten years from the date of termination.

Query_Text_cn: 由双方政府正式授权其各自代表签署本协定，以昭信守。
Translation: This Agreement is signed by the duly authorized representatives of both governments in witness whereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于2005年11月21日在塔那那利佛签仃，一式两份，每份均用中文和法文写成，两种文本同等作准。
Translation: The present Agreement was signed in Tananarive on 21 November 2005, in duplicate in the Chinese and French languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: （以下简称“塔吉克税收”）。
Translation: (hereinafter referred to as "Tajik Tax").

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何按照缔约国一方现行法律成立的法人、合伙企业或团体。
Translation: 2. Any legal person, partnership, or association constituted under the current laws of either Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、成立地、实际管理机构所在地，或者其他类似的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人，并且包括该缔约国和其地方当局。
Translation: 1. For the purposes of this Agreement, the term "resident of a Contracting State" means any person who, under the laws of that State, is liable to tax therein by reason of domicile, residence, place of incorporation, place of effective management, or any other criterion of a similar nature, and also includes that State and any political subdivision or local authority thereof.

Query_Text_cn: （一）建筑工地，建筑、装配或安装工程，或者与其有关的监督管理活动，但仅以该工地、工程或活动连续12个月以上的为限。
Translation: (1) A construction site, or construction, assembly or installation project, or supervisory activities in connection therewith, but only where such site, project or activities last for more than 12 consecutive months.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约国一方企业通过雇员或雇用的其他人员在缔约国另一方提供劳务，包括咨询劳务，但仅以该性质的活动（为同一项目或相关联的项目）在任何12个月中连续或累计超过183天的为限。
Translation: (2) An enterprise of a Contracting State shall be deemed to provide services, including consultancy services, in the other Contracting State through employees or other personnel engaged by it, but only where such activities (for the same project or connected projects) continue for a period or periods aggregating more than 183 days within any 12-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第六款规定的独立地位代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权以该企业的名义签订合同并经常行使这种权力，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构，除非这个人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第四款的规定。按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: V. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2, where a person—other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies—is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State and has, and habitually exercises, in that State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise, that person shall be deemed to constitute a permanent establishment of the enterprise in the first-mentioned State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise, unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which, if exercised through a fixed place of business, would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约国一方企业仅通过按常规经营本身业务的经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者任何其他独立地位代理人在缔约国另一方进行营业，不应认为在该缔约国另一方设有常设机构。
Translation: 6. An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that other State through a broker, general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status, provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business.

Query_Text_cn: 船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆不应视为不动产。
Translation: Ships, aircraft, road or rail vehicles shall not be regarded as immovable property.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方企业以船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆经营国际运输业务所取得的利润，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: 1. Profits derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the operation of ships, aircraft, road or rail vehicles in international traffic shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款规定也适用于参加合伙经营、联合经营或者参加国际经营机构取得的利润。
Translation: 2. The provisions of paragraph 1 shall also apply to profits derived from participation in a partnership, joint venture, or international business entity.

Query_Text_cn: （二）使用、保存或出租用于运输货物或商品的集装箱（包括拖车和运输集装箱相关的设备）取得的利润。
Translation: (2) Profits derived from the use, storage, or leasing of containers (including trailers and related transport equipment) for the transportation of goods or commodities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些利息也可以在该利息发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果利息受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的8%。
Translation: II. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 8 percent of the gross amount of the interest.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第二款的规定，发生于缔约国一方而支付给缔约国另一方的政府、地方当局、中央银行或者任何完全由政府拥有的金融机构的利息，或者发生于缔约国一方而由缔约国另一方的政府、地方当局、中央银行或者任何完全由政府拥有的金融机构担保或保险的贷款而支付的利息，应在首先提及的缔约国一方免税。
Translation: III. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2, interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to the government, local authorities, central bank or any financial institution wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State, or interest paid in respect of loans guaranteed or insured by the government, local authorities, central bank or any financial institution wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State, shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些特许权使用费也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果特许权使用费受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过特许权使用费总额的8%。
Translation: II. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State. But if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 8% of the gross amount of the royalties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“特许权使用费”一语是指使用或有权使用任何文学、艺术或科学着作，包括电影影片的版权，任何专利、商标、设计或模型、计划、秘密配方或秘密程序所支付的作为报酬的各种款项；或者有关工业、商业或科学经验的信息所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: III. The term "royalties" as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as consideration for the use of, or the right to use, any copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work including cinematograph films, any patent, trade mark, design or model, plan, secret formula or process, or for information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience.

Query_Text_cn: 三、转让缔约国一方企业从事国际运输的船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆，或者转让属于经营上述船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆的动产取得的收益，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: III. Gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of ships, aircraft, road or railway vehicles operated in international traffic, or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships, aircraft, road or railway vehicles, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、转让第一款至第四款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国一方征税。
Translation: V. Gains derived from the alienation of any property other than that referred to in paragraphs I to IV shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十六条、第十八条、第十九条、第二十条和第二十一条的规定外，缔约国一方居民因受雇取得的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，除在缔约国另一方从事受雇的活动以外，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 1. Subject to the provisions of Articles 16, 18, 19, 20 and 21, salaries, wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment shall be taxable only in that State unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条上述规定，在缔约国一方企业经营国际运输的船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆上从事受雇活动取得的报酬，可以在该缔约国征税。
Translation: III. Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article, remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship, aircraft, road or rail vehicle operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State may be taxed in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，按照缔约国双方的文化协议或安排，从事第一款所述活动取得的所得，如果对该国的访问完全或实质上由缔约国任何一方公共资金或者政府资金所资助，在从事上述活动的缔约国一方应免予征税。
Translation: III. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2, income derived from activities referred to in paragraph 1 shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State in which such activities are performed if the visit to that State is wholly or substantially supported by public or government funds of either Contracting State pursuant to a cultural agreement or arrangement between the Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方政府或其地方当局对履行政府职责向其提供服务的个人支付退休金以外的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 1.(1) Salaries,wages and other similar remuneration,other than pensions,paid by a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or authority in the discharge of functions of a governmental nature shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方政府或其地方当局支付或者从其建立的基金中支付给向其提供服务的个人的退休金和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 2. (1) Pensions and other similar remuneration paid by a Contracting State or a local authority thereof, or out of funds created by it, to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or authority shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于向缔约国一方政府或其地方当局举办的事业提供服务取得的薪金、工资、退休金和其他类似报酬。
Translation: III. The provisions of Articles 15, 16, 17, and 18 shall apply to salaries, wages, pensions, and other similar remuneration derived in respect of services rendered to an enterprise carried on by the government of a Contracting State or a local authority thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 一、任何个人是、或者在紧接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，仅为在该缔约国一方的大学、学院、学校或为该缔约国一方政府承认的教育机构和科研机构从事教学、讲学或研究的目的，而停留在该缔约国一方，对其由于教学、讲学或研究取得的报酬，该缔约国一方应自其第一次到达之日起，三年内免予征税。
Translation: 1. Any individual who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned Contracting State solely for the purpose of teaching, lecturing or conducting research at a university, college, school or other educational or scientific research institution recognized by the government of that Contracting State shall be exempt from tax in that Contracting State on remuneration for such teaching, lecturing or research for a period not exceeding three years from the date of his first arrival in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款的规定不适用于并非为了公共利益，而主要是为了某人或某些人的利益从事研究取得的所得。
Translation: II. The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not apply to income derived from research carried out not in the public interest but primarily for the benefit of a specific person or persons.

Query_Text_cn: 如果一个学生是或者在紧接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，仅由于接受教育的目的，而停留在该缔约国一方，对其为了维持生活或接受教育的目的收到的来源于该缔约国一方以外的款项，该缔约国一方应免予征税。
Translation: If a student who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State solely for the purpose of his education receives payments from sources outside that State for the purpose of his maintenance or education, such payments shall be exempt from tax in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、构成缔约国一方企业设在缔约国另一方的常设机构营业财产部分的动产为代表的财产，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: II. Property represented by movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国一方企业经营国际运输的船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆，或附属于经营上述船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆的动产为代表的财产，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: 3. Profits derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the operation of ships, aircraft, road or rail vehicles in international traffic, or from movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships, aircraft, road or rail vehicles, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （一）中国居民从塔吉克斯坦取得的所得，按照本协定规定在塔吉克斯坦缴纳的税额，可以在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。
Translation: (1) The tax paid in Tajikistan in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement on income derived by a resident of China from Tajikistan may be credited against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在塔吉克斯坦取得的所得是塔吉克斯坦居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，并且该中国居民公司拥有支付股息公司股份不少于20%的，该项抵免应考虑支付该股息公司就该项所得缴纳的塔吉克斯坦税收。
Translation: (2) Where the income derived from Tajikistan is dividends paid by a resident company of Tajikistan to a resident company of China, and the Chinese resident company owns no less than 20% of the shares of the company paying the dividends, the tax credit shall take into account the Tajikistan tax paid by the company paying the dividends on such income.

Query_Text_cn: 2.从对该居民的财产征收的税额中扣除等于在中国缴纳的财产税数额。
Translation: 2. Deduct from the tax levied on the resident's property an amount equal to the property tax paid in China.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，该项扣除在任何情况下，应不超过可以在中国征税的所得或财产在扣除前计算的那部分塔吉克斯坦所得税或财产税数额。
Translation: However, the amount of such deduction shall in no case exceed that part of the Tajikistan income tax or property tax, as computed before the deduction is given, which is attributable to the income or property that may be taxed in China.

Query_Text_cn: （二）按照本协定的任何规定，塔吉克斯坦居民取得的所得或拥有的财产在塔吉克斯坦免予征税的，塔吉克斯坦在计算该居民其余所得或财产的税额时，可以对免税的所得或财产予以考虑。
Translation: (2) Where income derived or property owned by a resident of Tajikistan is exempt from tax in Tajikistan under any provision of this Agreement, Tajikistan may nevertheless take into account the exempted income or property in calculating the amount of tax on the resident's remaining income or property.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如有人认为，缔约国一方或者双方所采取的措施，导致或将导致对其的征税不符合本协定的规定时，可以不考虑各缔约国国内法律的补救办法，将案情提交本人为其居民的缔约国主管当局，或者如果其案情属于第二十五条第一款，可以提交本人为其国民的缔约国主管当局。
Translation: 1. Where a person considers that the actions of one or both of the Contracting States result or will result for him in taxation not in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement, he may, irrespective of the remedies provided by the domestic law of those States, present his case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident or, if his case comes under paragraph 1 of Article 25, to that of the Contracting State of which he is a national.

Query_Text_cn: 为有助于达成协议，双方主管当局的代表可以进行会谈，口头交换意见。
Translation: To facilitate the conclusion of an agreement, representatives of the competent authorities of both sides may hold meetings to exchange views orally.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换可以预见的与执行本协定的规定相关的信息，或与执行缔约国双方或其地方当局征收的各种税收的国内法律相关的信息，以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限。
Translation: 1. The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall exchange such information as is foreseeably relevant for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or for the administration or enforcement of their domestic laws concerning taxes of every kind imposed by either Contracting State or its local authorities, insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方根据第一款收到的任何信息，都应和根据该国国内法所获得的信息一样作密件处理，仅应告知与第一款所指税种有关的评估、征收、执行、起诉或上诉裁决有关的人员或当局（包括法院和行政部门）及其监督部门。
Translation: 2. Any information received by a Contracting State under paragraph 1 shall be treated as confidential in the same manner as information obtained under the domestic laws of that State and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities (including courts and administrative bodies) concerned with the assessment or collection of, the enforcement or prosecution in respect of, or the determination of appeals in relation to, the taxes referred to in paragraph 1, or to their oversight authorities.

Query_Text_cn: （二）本协定生效年度的次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度中对所得征收的其他税收和对财产征收的税收。
Translation: (2) Other taxes on income and taxes on property levied for taxable years beginning on or after January 1 of the year following the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）终止通知发出年度的次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度中对所得征收的其他税收和对财产征收的税收。
Translation: (2) Other taxes on income and taxes on property levied for taxable years beginning on or after January 1 of the year following the issuance of the termination notice.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于2008年8月27日在杜尚别签订，一式两份，每份均用中文、塔吉克文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Dushanbe on August 27, 2008, in duplicate in the Chinese, Tajik, and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 塔吉克斯坦共和国方面指交通和通讯部，或者指受权执行该部目前所行使的任何职能的任何个人或者机构。
Translation: The Republic of Tajikistan refers to the Ministry of Transport and Communications, or any individual or institution authorized to perform any functions currently exercised by the said ministry.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“协定”，指本协定及其附件以及根据本协定第十九条（修改）规定对本协定及其附件的任何修改。
Translation: II. "Agreement" refers to this Agreement and its annexes, as well as any amendments to this Agreement and its annexes made in accordance with Article XIX (Amendment) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“空运企业”，指提供或者经营国际航班的任何航空运输企业。
Translation: 3. "Air carrier" means any air transport enterprise that provides or operates international flights.

Query_Text_cn: 四、“指定空运企业”，指根据本协定第三条（空运企业的指定和许可）规定经指定和许可的空运企业。
Translation: 4. "Designated Air Carrier" means an air carrier designated and authorized in accordance with the provisions of Article III (Designation and Authorization of Air Carriers) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 五、“航空器”，指民用航空器。
Translation: V. "Aircraft" refers to civil aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 六、“航班”，指以航空器从事旅客、行李、货物或者邮件公共运输的任何定期航班。
Translation: VI. "Flight" means any scheduled air transport service performed by aircraft for the public carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo or mail.

Query_Text_cn: 七、“国际航班”，指飞经一个以上国家领土上空的航班。
Translation: 7. "International flight" refers to a flight that passes through the airspace over the territory of more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: 八、“非运输业务性经停”，指目的不在于上下旅客、行李、货物或者邮件的任何经停。
Translation: 8. "Non-traffic stop" means any stop where the purpose is not to take on or discharge passengers, baggage, cargo or mail.

Query_Text_cn: 十、“运价”，指运输旅客、行李和货物所采用的价格和价格条件，包括提供代理和其他附属服务的价格和价格条件，但不包括运输邮件的价格和价格条件。
Translation: 10. "Tariff" means the prices and terms of carriage applied to the transport of passengers, baggage and cargo, including the prices and terms for agency and other ancillary services, but excluding those for the transport of mail.

Query_Text_cn: 十一、“航线表”，指本协定附件规定的航线表或者根据本协定第十九条（修改）规定修改的航线表。
Translation: 11. "Route Schedule" means the route schedule specified in the Annex to this Agreement or as modified in accordance with Article XIX (Modification) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 十二、“规定航线”，指航线表规定的航线。
Translation: 12. "Designated route" refers to the route specified in the route schedule.

Query_Text_cn: 十三、“公约”，指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签字的《国际民用航空公约》，包括根据该公约第九十条通过的附件及根据该公约第九十条和第九十四条对附件和公约的任何修改、并且已经缔约双方接受的这些附件和对公约及附件的修改。
Translation: XIII. "Convention" means the Convention on International Civil Aviation, opened for signature at Chicago on 7 December 1944, including any Annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention and any amendment of the Annexes or the Convention under Articles 90 and 94 thereof, insofar as those Annexes and amendments are accepted by both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定规定的权利，以便缔约一方指定空运企业在本协定规定航线上建立和经营国际航班（以下称为“协议航班”）。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement for the purpose of enabling the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party to establish and operate international air services on the routes specified in this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "the agreed services").

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内地点载运前往或者来自第三国国际业务的权利，由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: III. The right of a designated airline of one Contracting Party to embark or disembark traffic destined for or coming from a third country at points in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约另一方航空当局可要求缔约一方指定空运企业向其证明，该指定空运企业有资格履行缔约另一方航空当局通常合理地适用于国际航班经营的法律和规章所规定的条件与义务。
Translation: 3. The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the designated airline of one Contracting Party to demonstrate that it is qualified to fulfill the conditions and obligations prescribed by the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party to the operation of international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 一、运力、班次、机型和班期时刻应由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: 1. Capacity, frequency, aircraft type, and flight schedules shall be determined through consultation between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业可根据运输需要申请在规定航线上进行加班飞行。
Translation: II. The designated airline of either Contracting Party may apply for extra flights on the specified routes as required by operational needs.

Query_Text_cn: 加班飞行的申请至迟应在距计划加班飞行之日3天前向缔约另一方航空当局提出，获准后方可飞行。
Translation: Applications for extra-section flights shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party no later than 3 days prior to the scheduled date of such flights, and the flights may only be operated after approval is obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业适用于本协定规定的协议航班的运价，应在合理的水平上制定，适当照顾到一切有关因素，包括经营成本、合理的投资回报、合理利润、航班特点（如速度和舒适水平）、用户利益以及其他空运企业在规定航线的任一航段上的运价。
Translation: I. The tariffs to be charged by an airline designated by one Contracting Party for the agreed services covered by this Agreement shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being paid to all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable return on investment, reasonable profit, characteristics of service (such as standards of speed and accommodation), the interests of users, and the tariffs charged by other airlines on any section of the specified route.

Query_Text_cn: 二、拟采用的运价至少应在距计划采用之日60天前提交双方民航当局批准。
Translation: II. The proposed tariffs shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of both Parties for approval at least 60 days prior to the intended effective date.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下，可由双方航空当局达成协议，缩短上述期限。
Translation: Under special circumstances, the above period may be shortened by mutual agreement between the aeronautical authorities of both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、上述运价申请可予快速批准。
Translation: III. The above freight rate application may be granted expedited approval.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本条第二款，如果缔约双方自提交之日起30天内未表示不予批准，该运价应被认为已获批准。
Translation: Under paragraph 2 of this Article, if the Contracting Parties do not indicate disapproval within 30 days from the date of submission, the tariff shall be deemed approved.

Query_Text_cn: 如果根据第二款规定缩短提交运价的期限，双方航空当局可同意通知不批准的期限少于30天。
Translation: If the period for filing tariffs is shortened pursuant to paragraph 2, the aeronautical authorities of both Parties may agree to reduce the period for notifying disapproval to less than 30 days.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果缔约一方航空当局通知缔约另一方航空当局不批准缔约另一方指定空运企业拟采用的运价，则缔约双方航空当局应努力达成协议，确定运价。
Translation: IV. If the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party notify the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party of their disapproval of the tariffs proposed by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to reach agreement on the tariffs.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果缔约双方航空当局未能根据本条第二款就提交的运价达成协议，或者未能根据本条第四款就运价的确定达成协议，此项争端应根据本协定第十八条（争端的解决）规定予以解决。
Translation: V. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach agreement on any tariff submitted pursuant to paragraph 2 of this Article, or fail to determine the tariff pursuant to paragraph 4 of this Article, such dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article XVIII (Settlement of Disputes) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 六、根据本条规定制定的运价应在新运价制定前继续适用。
Translation: VI. The tariffs established in accordance with this Article shall continue to apply until new tariffs are determined.

Query_Text_cn: 但是本款未允许该运价自原到期之日起沿用的期限超过12个月。
Translation: However, this provision does not permit the continuation of such rates beyond 12 months from their original expiration date.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条资料的提供缔约一方航空当局应根据缔约另一方航空当局的要求，向其提供审议缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上协议航班的运力所合理需要的统计资料，这些资料应包括确定该指定空运企业协议航班的运输业务量所需的全部资料。
Translation:
Article 10 Provision of Data  

The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide statistical data reasonably required for the review of the capacity of the agreed services operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the specified routes. Such data shall include all information necessary to determine the traffic volume of the agreed services performed by the designated airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: 一、为了在规定航线上经营协议航班，缔约一方指定空运企业有权在对等的基础上在规定航线上的缔约另一方领土内的地点设立常驻代表机构。
Translation: 1. For the operation of agreed services on the specified routes, the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish resident representative offices in the territory of the other Contracting Party at points on the specified routes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内设立常驻代表机构的工作人员应遵守缔约另一方的法律和规章。
Translation: II. The staff of the permanent representative offices established by the designated airlines of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall comply with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应为缔约另一方指定空运企业的常驻代表机构及其工作人员有效地经营协议航班提供必要的协助和方便。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall provide the necessary assistance and facilities for the effective operation of the agreed services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party, including its permanent representative offices and staff.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土的客票、货运单和宣传品，应在互惠的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation: V. Passenger tickets, cargo waybills, and promotional materials brought into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees, and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的常驻代表机构的办公用品、自用车辆，用于机场内的专用车辆或者用于运送机组人员及其行李的客车型车辆（不包括小轿车）以及包括零备件在内的计算机订座系统和通信设备，在进入缔约另一方领土时，应在自用合理数量范围内和互惠的基础上免纳关税以及其他进口环节的税收。
Translation: VI. The office supplies, self-use vehicles (excluding sedans), dedicated vehicles for use within airports or passenger-type vehicles for transporting crew members and their luggage, as well as computer reservation systems and communication equipment including spare parts, of the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party stationed in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from customs duties and other import-related taxes within reasonable quantities for self-use and on a reciprocal basis upon entry into the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 八、缔约一方指定空运企业经营协议航班在缔约另一方领土内取得的收入、利润，应在互惠的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: VIII. The income and profits derived by a designated airline of one Contracting Party from the operation of agreed services in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 九、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的财产，应在互惠的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: IX. The property of a designated airline of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 十、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的常驻代表机构人员如系该缔约一方国民，其取得的工资、薪金和其他类似报酬，应在互惠的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: X. The salaries,wages and other similar remuneration paid by a designated airline of one Contracting Party to its employees who are nationals of that Contracting Party and stationed in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应特别遵守1963年9月14日在东京签订的《关于在航空器内的犯罪和其他某些行为的公约》、1970年12月16日在海牙签订的《关于制止非法劫持航空器的公约》、1971年9月23日在蒙特利尔签订的《关于制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为的公约》的规定、1988年2月24日在蒙特利尔签订的《制止在用于国际民用航空机场发生的非法暴力行为的议定书》以及缔约双方均加入的任何其他与航空保安有关的国际法律文件。
Translation: The Contracting Parties shall specifically comply with the provisions of the Convention on Offences and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft signed in Tokyo on September 14, 1963, the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft signed in The Hague on December 16, 1970, the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation signed in Montreal on September 23, 1971, the Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports Serving International Civil Aviation signed in Montreal on February 24, 1988, as well as any other international legal instruments related to aviation security to which both Contracting Parties are parties.

Query_Text_cn: 磋商应在收到要求之日起30天内进行。
Translation: Consultations shall be held within 30 days of receipt of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果在磋商之后，缔约一方发现缔约另一方未能有效地维持和管理第一款所述的、满足根据公约当时所制定的标准的安全标准，缔约一方应告知缔约另一方调查结果以及为符合国际民航组织的标准应采取的必要步骤。
Translation: II. If, after consultation, one Contracting Party finds that the other Contracting Party has failed to effectively maintain and manage the safety standards referred to in paragraph 1, which meet the then-established criteria under the Convention, the former shall inform the latter of its findings and the necessary steps to be taken to comply with ICAO standards.

Query_Text_cn: 若缔约另一方未能在15天内或者双方商定的更长的期限内采取适当措施，则缔约一方可适用本协定第四条（许可的撤销、暂停或者附加条件）。
Translation: If the other Party fails to take appropriate measures within 15 days or within a longer period agreed upon by both Parties, the first Party may apply Article IV (Revocation, Suspension, or Imposition of Conditions on Licenses) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、尽管有公约第三十三条规定的义务，缔约双方同意，缔约一方空运企业经营或者代表该缔约一方空运企业经营的进出缔约另一方领土航班的航空器在缔约另一方领土内时，在不造成该航空器运营不合理延误的情况下，缔约另一方的授权代表可有权登机和在航空器周围进行检查，以便检验有关航空器和机组人员证件的有效性以及航空器及其设备的外观条件（在本条中称为“停机坪检查”）。
Translation: III. Notwithstanding the obligations under Article 33 of the Convention, the Contracting Parties agree that, when an aircraft operated by or on behalf of an air transport enterprise of one Contracting Party is within the territory of the other Contracting Party for flights to or from that territory, the authorized representatives of the other Contracting Party shall have the right to board and inspect the aircraft and its surroundings without causing unreasonable delay to its operation, for the purpose of verifying the validity of the relevant aircraft and crew documents and the apparent condition of the aircraft and its equipment (referred to as "ramp inspection" in this Article).

Query_Text_cn: （二）对当时根据公约规定的安全标准缺乏有效的保持和实施的严重关注，为了公约第三十三条的目的，执行停机坪检查的缔约一方航空当局应有权自行认定，向该航空器或者机组颁发或者核准有效的证件或者执照的要求，或者航空器运营的要求，不等同于或者低于根据芝加哥公约规定的最低标准。
Translation: (2) Serious concerns regarding the ineffective maintenance and implementation of safety standards as stipulated by the Convention at that time. For the purposes of Article 33 of the Convention, the aeronautical authorities of a Contracting Party conducting ramp inspections shall have the authority to determine at their discretion whether the requirements under which certificates or licenses in respect of that aircraft or its crew were issued or rendered valid, or the requirements for the operation of the aircraft, are not equal to or below the minimum standards established pursuant to the Chicago Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果根据上述第三款对缔约一方空运企业经营或者代表该缔约一方一家或多家空运企业经营的航空器进行停机坪检查时，遭到一家或多家空运企业代表的拒绝，缔约另一方可自行推断得出第四款中的严重关注以及相应的决定。
Translation: V. If, during a ramp inspection conducted pursuant to paragraph III above on an aircraft operated by an air carrier of one Contracting Party or on behalf of one or more air carriers of that Contracting Party, the representatives of one or more air carriers refuse such inspection, the other Contracting Party may infer the serious concerns and corresponding determinations specified in paragraph IV.

Query_Text_cn: 六、无论是出于停机坪检查，或一系列的停机坪检查，或停机坪检查遭拒绝，或磋商或其他原因，如果缔约一方航空当局认为，为了空运企业的运营安全有必要立即采取行动，缔约一方保留暂停或更改缔约另一方一家或者多家空运企业的经营许可的权利。
Translation: VI. In the event that the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party consider it necessary to take immediate action for the operational safety of an airline, whether due to ramp inspections, a series of ramp inspections, refusal of ramp inspections, consultations, or any other reason, that Contracting Party reserves the right to suspend or modify the operating authorization of one or more airlines of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约一方按照上述第二款或者第六款采取的任何行动，一旦采取行动的依据不复存在，应予停止。
Translation: 7. Any action taken by a Contracting Party pursuant to paragraph 2 or 6 above shall be terminated once the basis for such action ceases to exist.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条证件和执照的承认缔约一方应承认缔约另一方颁发或者核准的用于在规定航线上经营协议航班的有效适航证、合格证和执照，但是颁发或者核准上述证件或者执照的标准，应相当于或者高于根据国际民用航空公约随时制定的最低标准。
Translation:
Article 16 Recognition of Certificates and Licenses  

Each Contracting Party shall recognize the valid certificates of airworthiness, certificates of competency, and licenses issued or validated by the other Contracting Party for the operation of agreed services on the specified routes. However, the standards under which such certificates or licenses are issued or validated shall be equal to or above the minimum standards established from time to time pursuant to the Convention on International Civil Aviation.

Query_Text_cn: 这种磋商应尽早开始，除非另有协议，至迟应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起60天内进行。
Translation: Such consultations shall begin as early as possible and, unless otherwise agreed, no later than 60 days after the receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方如认为需要修改本协定或者其附件的任何规定，可随时要求与缔约另一方以会晤或者书面形式进行磋商，并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起90天内开始，除非缔约双方同意延长这一期限。
Translation: 1. If either Contracting Party considers it necessary to amend any provision of this Agreement or its annexes, it may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party either through a meeting or in writing. Such consultations shall commence within 90 days from the date the other Contracting Party receives the request, unless both Parties agree to extend this period.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定应在缔约另一方收到通知之日起12个月后终止，除非在期满前经缔约双方协议撤回该通知。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate 12 months after the date of receipt of the notification by the other Contracting Party, unless the notification is withdrawn by mutual agreement before the expiration of that period.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条生效本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation:
Article 23 Entry into Force  
This Agreement shall enter into force upon signature.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于二○○七年一月十五日在北京签订，一式两份，每份均用中文、塔吉克文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Beijing on January 15, 2007, in duplicate in the Chinese, Tajik and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 1．缔约任何一方指定空运企业在任何或者所有飞行中，可自行决定不经停规定航线上的任何地点并可自行决定飞行航线的组合，但协议航班应在指定该空运企业的缔约一方领土内始发和终止。
Translation: 1. The designated airline(s) of either Contracting Party may, at its discretion, omit any point(s) on the specified route(s) in any or all flights and combine different flight paths, provided that the agreed services originate and terminate within the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: 2．缔约双方指定空运企业在上述航线上行使第五业务权，应由双方航空当局商定。
Translation: 2. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall exercise fifth freedom traffic rights on the specified routes, subject to mutual agreement by their respective aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: (七)“非运输业务性经停”一词,指任何目的不在于上下旅客、行李、货物或邮件的降停。
Translation: (vii) The term "non-traffic stop" means any landing for any purpose other than the taking on or discharging of passengers, baggage, cargo or mail.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线(以下称为“规定航线”)上建立和经营定期航班的权利。
Translation:
Article 2  
1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights to establish and operate scheduled air services on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "the specified routes").

Query_Text_cn: 二、在不违反本协定规定的情况下,缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机,经缔约另一方民航当局同意后,可沿该当局规定的航路不降停地飞越缔约另一方领土,或在该领土内作非运输业务性经停。
Translation: 2. Without prejudice to the provisions of this Agreement, the aircraft of an airline designated by one Contracting Party may, with the approval of the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party and in accordance with the routes prescribed by such authorities, fly across the territory of the other Contracting Party without landing or make non-traffic stops in the said territory.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在遵守本协定规定的情况下,缔约一方指定航空运输企业的飞机,在规定航线上飞行协议航班时,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点降停,上下前往或来自缔约一方领土和前往或来自缔约双方领土之间的经停点的以及缔约双方领土以外规定地点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: 3. Subject to the provisions of this Agreement, the aircraft of the designated air transport enterprises of one Contracting Party shall, while operating the agreed services on the specified routes, have the right to make stops at the points on the specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of taking on and discharging passengers, baggage, cargo and mail destined for or coming from the territory of the first Contracting Party, as well as for points between the territories of both Contracting Parties and for points beyond the territories of both Contracting Parties as specified.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机,在缔约另一方境内飞行时,必须遵守缔约另一方关于航路和国境走廊的规定。
Translation: IV. The aircraft of an airline designated by one Contracting Party shall, while operating in the territory of the other Contracting Party, comply with the regulations of the latter concerning air routes and border corridors.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方应将其指定空运企业开始在规定航线上经营协议航班的日期,至迟在开航之前六十天通知缔约另一方。
Translation: 5. Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party no later than sixty days prior to the commencement of operations of the designated airline(s) on the agreed services along the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约一方指定空运企业如欲在规定航线上作加班或包机飞行,该缔约方民航当局应向缔约另一方民航当局提出申请,获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: VI. If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to operate extra flights or charter flights on the specified routes, the civil aviation authority of that Contracting Party shall submit an application to the civil aviation authority of the other Contracting Party and may only operate such flights after obtaining approval.

Query_Text_cn: 此项申请应在飞机起飞七十二小时以前提出。
Translation: This application must be submitted at least seventy-two hours before the scheduled departure of the aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条一、中华人民共和国政府指定“中国民用航空总局国际业务局”,菲律宾共和国政府指定“菲律宾航空公司”,为各该方经营规定航线上协议航班的空运企业。
Translation:
Article 3  
1. The Government of the People's Republic of China designates the "International Business Division of the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China," and the Government of the Republic of the Philippines designates "Philippine Airlines," as the airline(s) of each Party to operate the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权,必须属于该缔约方。
Translation: II. The substantial ownership and effective control of an airline designated by either Contracting Party must be vested in that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业如不遵守缔约另一方的法令规章,不按照本规定及其附件所规定的条件经营时,缔约另一方有权暂停该空运企业行使本协定第一条规定的权利。
Translation: 3. If a designated airline of one Contracting Party fails to comply with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party or operates in violation of the conditions prescribed in this Agreement and its Annex, the other Contracting Party shall have the right to suspend the exercise of the rights specified in Article 1 of this Agreement by such airline.

Query_Text_cn: 但在通常情况下,应在同该缔约一方协商后方可行使这种权利。
Translation: However, as a general rule, such rights shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条一、与经营协议航班有关的班次、机型、班期时刻以及相互业务代理和相互在本国领土内提供地面服务等事项,应由缔约双方指定空运企业协商确定。
Translation:
Article 4  

1. Matters related to the operation of agreed services, including flight frequencies, aircraft types, schedules, mutual business agency arrangements, and the provision of ground handling services within each other's territory, shall be determined through consultations between the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 协议的班次、机型和班期时刻应经缔约双方各自民航当局批准。
Translation: The frequency, aircraft type, and schedule of flights shall be approved by the respective civil aviation authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班,应以载运由指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内始发或以该领土为终点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件为主要目的。
Translation: II. The agreed services operated by the designated airlines of each Contracting Party shall have as their primary objective the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo and mail originating in or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party that has designated the airline.

Query_Text_cn: 对在第三国领土内规定航线上的经停点上下的旅客、行李、货物和邮件,应在不违反上述主要目的的情况下适当载运。
Translation: Passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail embarked or disembarked at stopping points on designated routes within the territory of a third country shall be appropriately carried without prejudice to the aforementioned primary purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在经营协议航班时,缔约一方指定空运企业应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益,以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线或其航段上所提供的航班。
Translation: 3. When operating the agreed services, the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services provided by the latter on the same routes or sections thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一、协议航班上所采用的运价(指运输旅客、行李和货物所收取的费用以及适用此种费用的条件),应在合理的水平上制定,适当照顾到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理利润、航班特点以及在相同或相等航线或航段上经营定期航班的其他空运企业的运价。
Translation:
Article 5  

1. The tariffs to be charged by the designated airlines of either Party for carriage to or from the territory of the other Party shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being paid to all relevant factors, including cost of operation, reasonable profit, characteristics of service and the tariffs of other airlines for any part of the specified route.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方领土之间的运价,由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并至迟应在拟议实行之日六十天前,提交各自民航当局批准,在特殊情况下,经双方民航当局同意,这一期限可予缩短。
Translation: II. The tariffs for carriage between the territories of the Contracting Parties shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of both Parties and submitted for approval to their respective aeronautical authorities at least sixty (60) days before the proposed date of introduction. In special cases, this period may be shortened with the consent of both aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如指定空运企业对任何运价不能达成协议,或缔约一方民航当局对缔约双方指定空运企业间协议的任何运价不予批准,缔约双方民航当局应设法协议一项适当的运价。
Translation: 3. If the designated airlines cannot agree on any tariff, or if the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party do not approve any tariff agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties, the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties shall endeavor to determine an appropriate tariff by mutual agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 四、在新运价实行以前,根据本条各项规定制定的运价仍应有效。
Translation: 4. Prior to the implementation of the new tariffs, the tariffs established in accordance with the provisions of this Article shall remain valid.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、缔约一方应在本国为缔约另一方指定空运企业的飞机指定供经营规定航线使用的机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的航行、通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 6  

1. Each Contracting Party shall designate airports and alternate airports within its territory for use by the aircraft of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party in operating the agreed services on the specified routes, and shall provide the necessary navigation, communication, navigation aid, meteorological, and other auxiliary services required for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 具体办法由缔约双方民航当局协商确定。
Translation: The specific measures shall be determined through consultation between the civil aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场和技术服务,应按照缔约另一方规定的合理的费率付费。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party using the airports and technical services of the other Contracting Party shall be charged at reasonable rates prescribed by the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 此项费率不应高于其他国家空运企业通常所付的费率。
Translation: This rate shall not exceed the rates normally paid by air transport enterprises of other countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及其留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草等),在进出缔约另一方领土时,缔约另一方应免除任何关税、检验费和其他类似税捐。
Translation:
Article 7  

1. Aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the agreed routes, together with their regular equipment, spare parts, fuel, oil, lubricants, and aircraft stores (including food, beverages, and tobacco) retained on board such aircraft, shall be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other similar charges upon entering or leaving the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 但除经缔约另一方海关当局同意,此类物品不得卸下飞机,如果卸下,卸下部分应交该海关当局监管。
Translation: However, unless agreed by the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party, such articles shall not be unloaded from the aircraft, and if unloaded, the unloaded portion shall be placed under the supervision of the said customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内加注或装上飞机供规定航线飞行所耗用的燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品、应免除关税、检验费和其他类似税捐。
Translation: Article 2. The fuel, lubricants, spare parts, regular equipment and aircraft stores taken on board by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party for use in the operation of the agreed services shall be exempt from customs duties, inspection fees and other similar taxes and charges.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土纯供在规定航线上飞行的飞机使用的机上正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草等),亦应免除关税、检验费和其他类似税捐,上述物品经缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: III. The normal airborne equipment, spare parts, fuels, oils, lubricants, and aircraft stores (including food, beverages and tobacco, etc.) introduced into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party, solely for use in the operation of the agreed services, shall also be exempt from customs duties, inspection fees and other similar charges. Such items may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 遇此情况,上述物品应由该海关当局监管,不得在缔约另一方领土内转售或移作他用,直至重新运出,并应按缔约另一方的规定缴纳保管费用。
Translation: In such cases, the aforementioned goods shall be placed under the supervision of the customs authorities and shall not be resold or diverted for other purposes within the territory of the other Contracting Party until re-exportation, with storage fees payable in accordance with the regulations of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其国境和在其领土内停留、运行的法令规章,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其国境和在其领土内停留的法令规章,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article 8 The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the entry into, departure from and sojourn within its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as those pertaining to passengers, crew, baggage, cargo and mail entering into, departing from or sojourning within its territory, shall apply to the aircraft, crew and the passengers, baggage, cargo and mail carried by the designated air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party within the territory of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构。
Translation:
Article 9  
1. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish representative offices in the territory of the other Contracting Party at the points on the specified routes for the operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国或菲律宾共和国公民,其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并经缔约双方有关当局批准。
Translation: The personnel representing the agency shall be nationals of either the People's Republic of China or the Republic of the Philippines, with the number to be agreed upon by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by the competent authorities of both Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构人员必须遵守驻在国的现行法令规章。
Translation: Representatives of institutions must comply with the current laws and regulations of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应保障缔约另一方指定空运企业的代表机构和工作人员的安全并提供协助和便利,以及保护在其领土内经营协议航班所用的飞机、器材和其他财产的安全。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall ensure the safety of the representative offices and personnel of the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party, provide assistance and facilities, and protect the safety of the aircraft, equipment, and other property used for operating the agreed services within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内因载运旅客、行李、邮件和货物而得的收支余额,缔约另一方应允许缔约一方以汇款时的官方市场比价用美元自由结汇。
Translation: Article 10 Each Contracting Party shall permit the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party to freely remit the balance of receipts earned in its territory from the transport of passengers, baggage, mail and cargo, at the official exchange rate prevailing at the time of remittance in US dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约双方间的支付按专门协议办理,则执行该协议。
Translation: Where payments between the Contracting Parties are governed by a special agreement, such agreement shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: (九)总申报单。
Translation: (9) General Declaration Form.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方的上述(一)、(二)、(三)、(四)、(五)项有效证件,缔约另一方应予承认。
Translation: The aforementioned valid documents under items (1), (2), (3), (4), and (5) of one Contracting Party shall be recognized by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的空勤组成员,应分别为本国公民。
Translation: 2. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall employ crew members who are nationals of their respective countries for flights operated on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 八、将调查结果书面通知缔约一方。
Translation: 8. Notify a Contracting Party of the findings in writing.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条缔约双方应密切合作,互相支持,保证本协定正确实施。
Translation: Article 13 The Contracting Parties shall cooperate closely and support each other to ensure the proper implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 如对本协定的解释和实施发生分歧,缔约双方指定空运企业或缔约双方有关主管当局应本着友好合作、互相谅解的精神直接协商解决。
Translation: In the event of any disagreement concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties or the competent authorities concerned shall resolve the issue through direct consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding.

Query_Text_cn: 如不能达成协议,缔约双方应通过外交途径解决。
Translation: If no agreement can be reached, the contracting parties shall resolve the matter through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约一方如认为需要修改或补充本协定或其附件的任何条款,可随时向缔约另一方提出协商,此项协商应在缔约另一方接到建议之日起六十天内进行。
Translation: Article 14 If either Contracting Party deems it necessary to amend or supplement any provision of this Agreement or its annexes, it may at any time propose consultations to the other Contracting Party. Such consultations shall be held within sixty days from the date the other Contracting Party receives the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定或其附件的任何修改或补充,应经缔约双方换文确认后生效。
Translation: Any amendment or supplement to this Agreement or its annexes shall enter into force upon confirmation through an exchange of notes between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation: Article 15 This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方可随时将终止本协定的愿望通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its desire to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约另一方接到通知之日起十二个月后终止，如在期满前，缔约一方提出撤销上述通知，并取得缔约另一方同意后，则本协定继续有效。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the notification, unless prior to the expiry of such period, the notifying Contracting Party withdraws the said notification with the consent of the other Contracting Party, in which case this Agreement shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七九年七月八日在北京签订，共两份，每份都用中文、菲律宾文和英文写成，叁种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Beijing on July 8, 1979, in duplicate in the Chinese, Filipino and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 所得税（以下简称“乌干达税收”）。
Translation: Income tax (hereinafter referred to as "Ugandan tax").
