Query_Text_cn: (三)在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点经停,以上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (c) To make stops at points in the territory of the other Contracting Party on the specified routes for the purpose of embarking and disembarking international passengers, baggage, cargo and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的一点与该领土内另一点间,无权装载旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: 3. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall not have the right to take on passengers, baggage, cargo or mail in the territory of the other Contracting Party for discharge at another point within the same territory.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方应将其指定空运企业开航协议航班的日期,提前六十天通知缔约另一方。
Translation: 4. Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party at least sixty days in advance of the date designated by its appointed airline for the commencement of agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条一、缔约一方有权向缔约另一方通过外交照会指定一家空运企业,以便在本协定附件规定航线上经营协议航班。
Translation:
Article 3  
1. Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate, by diplomatic note to the other Contracting Party, one airline for the operation of agreed services on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 或(三)如该空运企业没有按照本协定规定的条件经营。
Translation: or (3) if the air carrier fails to operate in accordance with the conditions stipulated in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款所述的取消、暂停或规定条件必须立即执行,以防止进一步违反法律和规定,否则这种权利只能在与缔约另一方协商方可行使。
Translation: 2. Unless the cancellation, suspension or imposition of conditions referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article must be implemented immediately to prevent further violations of laws and regulations, such rights may only be exercised after consultation with the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规定,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其国境和在其领土内停留的法律和规定,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article 5 The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the entry into, departure from and navigation within its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as those pertaining to passengers, crew, baggage, cargo and mail entering, leaving or transiting its territory, shall apply to the aircraft, crew and the passengers, baggage, cargo and mail carried by the air transport enterprise designated by the other Contracting Party while in the territory of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方应及时向缔约另一方提供上述有关的法律和规定的资料。
Translation: Each contracting party shall promptly provide the other contracting party with the relevant laws and regulations mentioned above.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及其留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,在进出缔约另一方领土时,缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免任何关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation:
Article 6  

1. Aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the agreed routes, together with their regular equipment, spare parts, fuel, oil, lubricants, and aircraft stores retained on board such aircraft, shall be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other charges on entering or leaving the territory of the other Contracting Party, on the basis of reciprocity.

Query_Text_cn: 上述物品,经缔约另一方海关当局同意后方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: The aforementioned items may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the consent of its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业根据缔约另一方的规定,在缔约另一方领土内为其飞机加注和配备供飞行规定航线使用的燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall, in accordance with the regulations of the other Contracting Party, be exempted from customs duties, inspection fees and other charges on fuel, lubricants, consumable technical supplies and aircraft stores introduced into or taken on board in the territory of the other Contracting Party for use in the operation of the agreed services, on the basis of reciprocity.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土纯供在规定航线上飞行的飞机使用的机上正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,缔约另一方亦应在互惠基础上豁免关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall also exempt from customs duties, inspection fees and other charges, on a reciprocal basis, the normal airborne equipment, spare parts, fuels, oils, lubricants and aircraft stores introduced into the territory of the other Contracting Party by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party solely for use in the operation of the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条第一款所述在缔约另一方领土内卸下的物品以及本条第三款所述运入缔约另一方领土的物品,应由缔约另一方海关当局监管,按该海关当局的规定缴纳保管费用,并不得在缔约另一方领土内转售或移作他用,直至重新运回或根据上述海关当局规定另作处理。
Translation: 4. The goods unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party as referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article and the goods transported into the territory of the other Contracting Party as referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article shall be under the supervision of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party, subject to storage fees as prescribed by such customs authorities, and shall not be resold or diverted for other purposes within the territory of the other Contracting Party until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the regulations of the aforementioned customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条对缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机所载的、直接过境缔约另一方领土的旅客、行李、货物,缔约另一方至多采取非常简化的控制措施。
Translation: Article 7 For passengers, baggage and cargo carried on aircraft of an air transport enterprise designated by one Contracting Party on the agreed services and in direct transit across the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall apply no more than very simplified control measures.

Query_Text_cn: 上述直接过境的行李和货物,应豁免关税和其他类似税收。
Translation: The aforementioned luggage and goods in direct transit shall be exempt from customs duties and other similar charges.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条一、缔约一方应在其领土内,为缔约另一方指定空运企业指定供经营规定航线所使用的机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 8  
1. Each Contracting Party shall, within its territory, designate airports and alternate airports for use by the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party for operating the agreed services on the specified routes, and shall provide the necessary communications, navigation, meteorological, and other auxiliary services required for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设备和技术服务,应按照缔约另一方有关当局规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party using the airports, equipment and technical services of the other Contracting Party shall be charged at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the competent authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班时,应享有公平合理的机会。
Translation:
Article IX  
1. The designated airlines of each Contracting Party shall enjoy fair and reasonable opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: (三)联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The operational needs of interline flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条一、缔约一方指定空运企业对前往或来自缔约另一方领土的运输所收取的运价,应在合理的上制定,适当照顾到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation:
Article 10  
1. The tariffs to be charged by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party for carriage to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being paid to all relevant factors, including operating costs, a reasonable profit, and the tariffs of other airlines.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价,应先由缔约双方指定空运企业协议。
Translation: 2. The tariffs referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall first be agreed upon between the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按此协议的运价至少应在其拟议实行前六十天提交缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: III. The tariffs under this agreement shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties for approval at least sixty days prior to their proposed date of introduction.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下,经上述当局协议,这一时限可予缩短。
Translation: Under special circumstances, this time limit may be shortened upon agreement by the aforementioned authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如缔约双方指定空运企业未能根据本条第二款规定就运价达成协议,或缔约一方航空当局对根据第二款规定所协议的运价,向缔约另一方航空当局发出异议通知,缔约双方航空当局应设法相互商议,确定运价。
Translation: 4. If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on tariffs pursuant to paragraph 2 of this Article, or if one aeronautical authority notifies the other of its objection to the tariffs agreed under paragraph 2, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to determine the tariffs through mutual consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款规定向其提交的任何运价,或根据本条第四款就运价的确定达成协议,此项分歧应按照本协定第十七条规定予以解决。
Translation: 5. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph 3 of this Article or on the determination of tariffs under paragraph 4, such dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内经营国际运输所得收入,缔约另一方应在互惠的基础上豁免所得税和其他一切税收,并应准予结汇。
Translation: Article 11 The income derived by the designated airline of one Contracting Party from the operation of international air transport in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from income tax and all other taxes on a reciprocal basis, and shall be permitted to be remitted abroad.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约一方航空当局应按缔约另一方航空当局的要求,向后者提供缔约另一方指定空运企业在协议航班上所载来自或前往缔约另一方领土的业务统计。
Translation: Article 12 The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide the latter with traffic statistics concerning the carriage by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party on the agreed services of traffic originating in or destined for the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国和阿拉伯叙利亚共和国公民,其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: The personnel representing the agencies shall be nationals of the People's Republic of China and the Syrian Arab Republic, with the number to be agreed upon by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约一方指定空运企业的空勤组成员在飞行协议航班时,缔约另一方应允其凭有效护照人境,无需办理签证,但在机场停留时间不得超过二十四小时,并应搭乘同一飞机离境。
Translation: Article 14 When the crew members of an airline designated by one Contracting Party operate the agreed services into the territory of the other Contracting Party, they shall be exempt from visa requirements upon presentation of valid passports, provided that their stay at the airport does not exceed twenty-four hours and they depart on the same aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方每年应向缔约另一方提供一次上述空勤组成员的名单,但可随时提交上述名单的更改。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall provide the other Contracting Party once a year with a list of the aforementioned aircrew members, but may submit changes to such list at any time.

Query_Text_cn: (八)总申报单。
Translation: (h) General Declaration Form.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方颁发的证件和执照,缔约另一方应承认其有效。
Translation: Certificates and licenses issued by one Contracting Party shall be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条一、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约另一方领土内发生事故时,缔约另一方应指示其有关当局立即将事故详细情况通知缔约一方航空当局,并应对上述飞机上的空勤组和旅客提供必要的援助。
Translation:
Article XVI  
1. In the event of an accident involving an aircraft of a designated airline of one Contracting Party occurring in the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall direct its competent authorities to immediately notify the aeronautical authorities of the former Contracting Party of the details of the accident and shall render necessary assistance to the crew and passengers of the said aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: (六)将调查结果书面通知缔约一方航空当局。
Translation: (6) Notify the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Party in writing of the findings.

Query_Text_cn: 有关上述调查活动的费用由境内发生事故的缔约方负担。
Translation: The costs related to the aforementioned investigation activities shall be borne by the contracting party in whose territory the incident occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条缔约双方应密切合作,互相支持,保证本协定正确实施。
Translation: Article 17 The Contracting Parties shall cooperate closely and support each other to ensure the proper implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧,缔约双方指定空运企业应本着友好合作、互相谅解的精神直接协商解决,如不能达成协议,应由缔约双方航空当局协商解决,如仍不能达成协议,缔约双方应通过外交途径解决。
Translation: In the event of any disagreement concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to resolve the matter through direct consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding. If no agreement can be reached, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall seek to resolve the issue through consultations. Should such consultations fail to produce a settlement, the dispute shall be resolved through diplomatic channels between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条缔约一方如认为需要修改或补充本协定的任何条款或其附件,可随时要求与另一方进行协商,此项协商应于缔约另一方接到要求之日起六十天内进行。
Translation: Article 18 If either Contracting Party deems it necessary to amend or supplement any provision of this Agreement or its annexes, it may request consultations with the other Party at any time. Such consultations shall be held within sixty days from the date the other Contracting Party receives the request.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定或其附件的任何修改或补充,经缔约双方以外交换文确认后生效。
Translation: Any amendment or supplement to this Agreement or its annexes shall enter into force upon confirmation through an exchange of diplomatic notes between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条本协定的附件和有关换文是本协定的组成部分。
Translation: Article 19 The annexes and related exchanges of notes to this Agreement constitute an integral part thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条缔约一方可随时将终止本协定的意愿通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 20 Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约另一方接到通知之日起十二个月后终止,如在期满前,缔约一方提出撤销上述通知,并取得缔约另一方同意后,则本协定继续有效。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the notification, unless the notice is withdrawn by mutual consent of the Contracting Parties before the expiration of such period, in which case the Agreement shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条本协定自外交换文中规定之日起生效。在外交换文中应声明已履行缔约各方的法律所要求的手续。
Translation: Article 21 This Agreement shall enter into force on the date specified in the exchange of notes, which shall confirm that the legal requirements of each Contracting Party for its entry into force have been fulfilled.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七五年十一月十日在大马士革签订，共两份，每份都用中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成。叁种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Damascus on November 10, 1975, in duplicate, each copy being written in Chinese, Arabic and English. All three texts are equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定第一条（一）中的“国防部”改为“运输部”。
Translation: The term "Ministry of Defense" in Article 1(1) of this Agreement shall be amended to "Ministry of Transport."

Query_Text_cn: 缔约任何一方指定空运企业在规定航线上提供的协议航班，应在其领土内的一点始发。
Translation: The agreed services provided by the designated airline(s) of either Contracting Party on the specified routes shall originate in the territory of that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、不经停的权利缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停规定航线上的任何中间经停点和延伸点，但应尽早相互通知。
Translation:
II. Right of Non-Stop Operations  
The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties may operate agreed services on the specified routes without landing at any intermediate or beyond points along the designated routes, provided that prior notification is given to each other as early as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 三、专包机和加班飞行（一）缔约一方指定空运企业如欲飞行前往或来自缔约另一方领土的专机和包机，缔约一方航空当局应向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，由其向本国有关当局办理许可和答复。
Translation:
III. Special and Extra Section Flights  
(1) If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to operate special or charter flights to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party, the aeronautical authorities of the former shall submit an application to the aeronautical authorities of the latter, who shall process the request with their relevant national authorities for approval and response.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约一方指定空运企业如在规定航线上作加班飞行，在通常情况下，应在飞机起飞四十八小时前向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，并在获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: (2) If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to operate extra flights on the specified routes, it shall, as a general rule, submit an application to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party at least 48 hours prior to the departure of the aircraft and may only operate such flights after obtaining approval.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国政府和缅甸联邦政府关于两国边界问题的协定*（注*：1960年1月28日签订于北京并于1960年5月14日生效。
Translation: Agreement Between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Union of Burma on the Question of the Boundary Between the Two Countries*(Signed in Beijing on January 28,1960 and entered into force on May 14,1960.)

Query_Text_cn: 第一条缔约双方同意立即成立由双方同等人数的代表所组成的联合委员会，并且责成该委员会根据本协定的规定，商谈解决本协定第二条所列的有关中缅边界的各项具体问题，进行勘察边界和树立界桩的工作，起草中缅边界条约。联合委员会定期地在中缅两国的首都或者中缅两国的其他地点举行会议。
Translation: Article 1 The Contracting Parties agree to set up forthwith a Joint Committee composed of an equal number of representatives from each side and to charge this Committee with the task of holding consultations in accordance with the provisions of the present Agreement to settle the specific questions concerning the boundary between China and Burma enumerated in Article II of the present Agreement, to carry out surveys of the boundary and erect boundary markers and to draft a Sino-Burmese Boundary Treaty. The Joint Committee shall hold regular meetings in the capitals of the two countries or at other places in the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 一、自尖高山起到中缅边界西端终点的全部未定界，除片马、古浪、岗房地区以外，遵照传统的习惯线定界，也就是说，从尖高山起沿着以太平江、瑞丽江、怒江、独龙江为一方和恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭向北，直到在靖丹和木刻戛之间跨越独龙江的地方，然后继续沿着以独龙江和察隅河为一方和除独龙江以外的全部伊洛瓦底江上游支系为另一方的分水岭，直到中缅边界西端的终点为止。
Translation: 1. The entire undemarcated boundary from the Twekang Mountains to the western terminus of the China-Myanmar border, with the exception of the Pianma, Gulang, and Gangfang areas, shall be delineated in accordance with the traditional customary line. That is to say, starting from the Twekang Mountains, it shall follow the watershed between the Taiping River, Ruili River, Nu River, and Dulong River on one side and the Nmai Hka River on the other, proceeding northward to the point where it crosses the Dulong River between Jingdan and Mukega. It shall then continue along the watershed between the Dulong River and Zayu River on one side and all the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River (excluding the Dulong River) on the other, until reaching the western terminus of the China-Myanmar border.

Query_Text_cn: 联合委员会将派出由双方同等人数的人员组成的联合勘察队，沿着上述分水岭进行勘察，以确定这一段边界线的具体位置，并且树立界桩。
Translation: The Joint Committee shall dispatch a joint survey team composed of an equal number of personnel from both sides to conduct surveys along the aforementioned watershed in order to determine the specific location of this section of the boundary line and to erect boundary markers.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缅甸政府同意将属于中国的片马、古浪、岗房地区归还中国。
Translation: 2. The Myanmar government agreed to return the Pianma, Gulang, and Gangfang regions, which belong to China, to Chinese sovereignty.

Query_Text_cn: 至于归还给中国的这个地区的面积，由联合委员会根据缅甸政府和中国政府分别在1957年2月4日和1957年7月26日提出的并且用地图标明的建议，商谈确定。
Translation: As for the area to be returned to China,it shall be determined through consultations by the Joint Committee based on the proposals submitted by the Governments of Myanmar and China on February 4,1957 and July 26,1957 respectively,as indicated on the maps.

Query_Text_cn: 联合委员会在确定归还给中国的这个地区的面积以后，将派出由双方同等人数的人员组成的联合勘察队，实地勘察这一段边界线的具体位置，并且树立界桩。
Translation: Upon determining the area to be returned to China, the Joint Committee will dispatch a joint survey team composed of an equal number of personnel from both sides to conduct on-site surveys of the specific location of this boundary section and erect boundary markers.

Query_Text_cn: 三、为了废除缅甸对南碗河和瑞丽江汇合处的、属于中国的猛卯三角地区（即南碗指定区）所保持的“永租”关系，中国政府同意把这个地区移交给缅甸，成为缅甸联邦领土的一部分。
Translation: 3. In order to abolish the "perpetual lease" relationship maintained by Myanmar over the Mengmao Triangular Area (i.e., the Namwan Assigned Tract) at the confluence of the Namwan River and the Shweli River, which belongs to China, the Chinese government agreed to transfer this area to Myanmar, making it part of the territory of the Union of Myanmar.

Query_Text_cn: 作为交换，缅甸政府同意，把班洪部落和班老部落在1941年6月18日中英两国政府换文划定的、从南定河和南帕河汇合处到南段已定界第一号界桩为止的边界线以西的辖区划归中国，成为中国领土的一部分。
Translation: In exchange, the Burmese government agreed to cede to China the territories of the Banhong and Banlao tribes located west of the boundary line delineated in the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments on June 18, 1941—from the confluence of the Namting and Nampha Rivers to Boundary Pillar No. 1 of the demarcated southern section—thereby incorporating these areas as part of Chinese territory.

Query_Text_cn: 至于划归中国的这些地区的面积，中国政府和缅甸政府分别在1957年7月26日和1959年6月4日提出了用地图标明的建议。
Translation: As for the area of these territories to be transferred to China, the Chinese and Burmese governments submitted their respective proposals marked on maps on July 26, 1957 and June 4, 1959.

Query_Text_cn: 两国政府的建议中互相一致的地区，肯定划归中国。
Translation: The areas where the proposals of the two governments coincide shall unquestionably be assigned to China.

Query_Text_cn: 两国政府的建议中关于班洪部落的辖区有出入的地区，由联合委员会派出双方同等人数的人员组成的小组实地查明该地区是否属于班洪部落管辖，以便确定该地区是否移交中国。
Translation: The area where discrepancies exist between the two governments' proposals regarding the jurisdiction of the Banhong tribe shall be investigated on-site by a team composed of an equal number of personnel from both sides dispatched by the Joint Committee, to ascertain whether the area falls under the administration of the Banhong tribe and thus determine whether it should be transferred to China.

Query_Text_cn: 划归中国的班洪部落和班老部落辖区的面积这样确定以后，联合委员会将派出由双方同等人数的人员组成的联合勘察队，实地勘察这一段边界线的具体位置，并且树立界桩。
Translation: After the areas of the Banhong and Banlao tribes to be assigned to China are thus determined, the Joint Committee shall dispatch a joint survey team composed of an equal number of personnel from both sides to conduct an on-site survey of the specific location of this section of the boundary line and to erect boundary markers.

Query_Text_cn: 四、从南定河和南帕河汇合处到南段已定界第一号界桩为止的一段边界，除本条第三款所规定的调整以外，按照1941年6月18日中英两国政府的换文定界，联合委员会将派出由双方同等人数的人员组成的联合勘察队，沿着这一段边界线进行定界、标界和树立界桩的工作。
Translation: IV. The boundary from the confluence of the Nam Ting and Nam Hka Rivers to Boundary Pillar No. 1 of the demarcated southern section shall, except for the adjustments specified in paragraph 3 of this Article, be fixed in accordance with the delimitation as stated in the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British Governments of June 18, 1941. The Joint Committee shall dispatch a joint survey team composed of an equal number of personnel from both sides to carry out the work of delimitation, demarcation, and erection of boundary pillars along this section of the boundary line.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条缔约双方同意，联合委员会在解决本协定第二条中所列的有关中缅边界的现存问题以后，将负责起草中缅边界条约，其中不仅将包括本协定第二条所提到的各段边界，而且将包括过去已经划定、无需加以更改的各段边界。
Translation: Article III The two Contracting Parties agree that, after the settlement of the existing questions concerning the Sino-Burmese boundary as enumerated in Article II of the present Agreement, the Joint Committee will be responsible for drafting a Sino-Burmese boundary treaty, which will cover not only the sections of the boundary as mentioned in Article II of the present Agreement, but also the sections which have hitherto not been delimited. The draft boundary treaty will then be submitted to the two Governments for ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 新的边界条约经两国政府签订和生效后，将代替一切旧的有关两国边界的条约和换文。
Translation: The new boundary treaty, once signed and entered into force by the governments of both countries, shall supersede all previous treaties and exchanges of notes concerning the boundary between the two nations.

Query_Text_cn: 中国政府根据一贯反对外国特权和尊重其他国家主权的政策，声明放弃1941年6月18日中英两国政府换文所规定的、中国参加经营缅甸炉房矿产企业的权利。
Translation: In accordance with its consistent policy of opposing foreign privileges and respecting the sovereignty of other countries, the Chinese Government hereby declares the relinquishment of its right to participate in the operation of the Bawdwin Mines in Burma, as stipulated in the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British Governments on June 18, 1941.

Query_Text_cn: （一）本协定须经批准，批准书应尽速在仰光交换。
Translation: 1. This Agreement shall be subject to ratification and the instruments of ratification shall be exchanged at Yangon as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: （二）本协定在互换批准书以后立即生效，到两国政府将签订的中缅边界条约生效时自动失效。
Translation: (2) This Agreement shall enter into force immediately upon the exchange of instruments of ratification and shall automatically terminate upon the entry into force of the Sino-Burmese Boundary Treaty to be concluded by the two Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 1960年1月28日订于北京，共两份，每份都用中文和英文写成，中、英两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Done at Beijing on January 28, 1960, in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: ３．外国企业所得税（包括地方所得税）。
Translation: 3. Foreign Enterprise Income Tax (including local income tax).

Query_Text_cn: ３．财产收益税。
Translation: 3. Capital Gains Tax.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定也适用于本协定签订之日后缔约国任何一方增加或者代替本条第一款所列税种的相同或者实质相似的税收。
Translation: II. This Agreement shall also apply to any identical or substantially similar taxes which are imposed by either Contracting State after the date of signature of this Agreement in addition to, or in place of, the taxes referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方主管当局应将各自税法所作的变动通知对方。
Translation: The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall notify each other of any changes made to their respective tax laws.

Query_Text_cn: （九）“主管当局”一语，在中国方面是指财政部税务总局或其授权的代表；在联合王国方面是指国内收入局或其授权的代表。
Translation: (9) The term "competent authority" means, in the case of China, the Commissioner of the State Taxation Administration or his authorized representative, and in the case of the United Kingdom, the Commissioners of Inland Revenue or their authorized representative.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方在实施本协定时，对于未明确定义的用语，除上下文另有规定的以外，应当具有该缔约国关于适用本协定税种的法律所规定的含义。
Translation: 2. As regards the application of this Agreement by a Contracting State, any term not defined therein shall, unless the context otherwise requires, have the meaning which it has under the laws of that State concerning the taxes to which this Agreement applies.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该国法律，由于住所、居所、总机构、实际管理机构所在地，或者其它类似的标准，在该国负有纳税义务的人。
Translation: I. For the purposes of this Agreement, the term "resident of a Contracting State" means any person who, under the laws of that State, is liable to tax therein by reason of domicile, residence, place of head office, place of effective management, or any other criterion of a similar nature.

Query_Text_cn: （四）如果其同时是两个国家的国民，或者不是任何一国的国民，缔约国双方主管当局应通过协商解决。
Translation: (4) If he is a national of both Contracting States or of neither of them, the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall settle the question by mutual agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、由于本条第一款的规定，除个人外，同时为缔约国双方居民的人，应认为是其经营的实际管理机构所在国的居民。
Translation: III. Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article a person other than an individual is a resident of both Contracting States, then it shall be deemed to be a resident of the State in which the place of effective management of its business is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果这些人在缔约国一方设有其经营的实际管理机构，在缔约国另一方设有其总机构，缔约国双方主管当局应协商确定该公司为本协定中缔约国一方的居民。
Translation: However, if such persons have the place of effective management of their business in one Contracting State and the head office of their business in the other Contracting State, the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall by mutual agreement determine the State of which the company shall be deemed to be a resident for the purposes of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （七）勘探或开发自然资源所使用的装置或设施。
Translation: (g) Equipment or installations used for the exploration or exploitation of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: 三、建筑工地，建筑、装配或安装工程，仅以连续六个月以上的为常设机构。
Translation: 3. A construction site, or construction, assembly or installation project constitutes a permanent establishment only if it lasts for more than six consecutive months.

Query_Text_cn: （六）专为本款第（一）项至第（五）项活动的结合所设的固定营业场所，如果由于这种结合使该固定营业场所全部活动属于准备性质或辅助性质。
Translation: (vi) a fixed place of business used solely for the combination of activities referred to in subparagraphs (a) to (e), provided that the overall activity of the fixed place of business resulting from such combination is of a preparatory or auxiliary character.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有本条第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权并经常行使这种权力代表该企业签订合同，除适用本条第六款的独立代理人以外，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在缔约国一方设有常设机构。除非这个人的活动仅限于本条第四款的规定，即使是通过固定营业场所进行活动，按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: V. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, where a person is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State and has, and habitually exercises, an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise, that person shall be deemed to constitute a permanent establishment of the enterprise in the first-mentioned Contracting State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise, unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 of this Article which, if exercised through a fixed place of business, would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph, except where such person is an independent agent to whom paragraph 6 applies.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约国一方企业仅通过按常规经营本身业务的经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者任何其他独立代理人在缔约国另一方进行营业，不应认为在该缔约国另一方设有常设机构。
Translation: VI. An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that other State through a broker, general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status, provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果这个代理人的活动全部或几乎全部代表该企业，不应认为是本款所指的独立代理人。
Translation: However, an agent shall not be considered an independent agent as referred to in this paragraph if the activities of such agent are conducted wholly or almost wholly on behalf of that enterprise.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条第一款的规定适用于从直接使用、出租或者任何其它形式使用不动产取得的所得。
Translation: 3. The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall apply to income derived from the direct use, letting, or use in any other form of immovable property.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条第一款和第三款的规定也适用于企业的不动产所得和用于进行独立个人劳务的不动产所得。
Translation: Article 4 The provisions of paragraph 1 and paragraph 3 of this Article shall also apply to income from immovable property of an enterprise and to income from immovable property used for the performance of independent personal services.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该企业通过设在该另一国的常设机构在该另一国进行营业，其利润可以在该另一国征税，但应仅以属于该常设机构的利润为限。
Translation: If the enterprise carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein, the profits of the enterprise may be taxed in that other State but only so much of them as is attributable to that permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 二、从属于本条第三款的规定，缔约国一方企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在该另一国进行营业，如果该常设机构是一个独立和分设的企业，在相同和相似的情况下从事相同或相似活动，并完全独立地同其所隶属的企业进行交易，该常设机构在缔约国各方可能得到的利润应属于该常设机构。
Translation: II. Subject to the provisions of paragraph 3 of this Article, where an enterprise of a Contracting State carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein, if such permanent establishment were a separate and independent enterprise engaged in the same or similar activities under the same or similar conditions and dealing wholly independently with the enterprise of which it is a permanent establishment, the profits which it might be expected to make in each Contracting State shall be attributed to that permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 三、确定常设机构的利润时，应允许扣除其进行营业发生的各项费用，包括行政和一般管理费用，不论其发生于该常设机构所在国或者其它任何地方。
Translation: 3. In determining the profits of a permanent establishment, there shall be allowed as deductions all expenses incurred for the purposes of the business, including executive and general administrative expenses, whether incurred in the country in which the permanent establishment is situated or elsewhere.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，常设机构使用专利或者其它权利支付给企业总机构或该企业其它办事处的特许权使用费、报酬或其它类似款项，具体服务或管理的佣金，技术服务的报酬，或者借款给该常设机构的利息（银行企业除外），都不作任何扣除（属于偿还代垫实际发生的费用除外）。
Translation: However, no deduction shall be allowed for royalties, fees, or other similar payments in respect of the use of patents or other rights paid by a permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices, nor for commissions for specific services performed or for management activities, nor for fees for technical services, nor for interest on money lent to the permanent establishment (except in the case of a banking enterprise), unless such payments represent reimbursement of actual expenses incurred.

Query_Text_cn: 同样，在确定常设机构的利润时，对于该常设机构从企业总机构或该企业其它办事处取得的专利或其它权利的特许权使用费、报酬或其它类似款项，具体服务或管理的佣金，技术服务的报酬，或者借款给该企业总机构或该企业其它办事处的利息（银行企业的除外），也不考虑（属于偿还代实际发生的费用除外）。
Translation: Similarly, in determining the profits of a permanent establishment, no account shall be taken of royalties, fees, or other similar payments received by the permanent establishment from the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices for the use of patents or other rights, specific services or management commissions, remuneration for technical services, or interest on loans to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices (except in the case of banking enterprises), unless such payments represent reimbursement of actual expenses incurred.

Query_Text_cn: 五、不应仅由于常设机构为企业采购货物或商品，将利润归属于该常设机构。
Translation: V. No profits shall be attributed to a permanent establishment merely because it purchases goods or merchandise for the enterprise.

Query_Text_cn: 一、以船舶或飞机经营国际运输的利润，应仅在企业实际经营管理机构所在缔约国征税。
Translation: 1. Profits derived from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果船运企业的实际经营管理机构设在船上，应以船舶母港所在缔约国为所在国；或者如果没有母港，应以船舶经营者为居民的缔约国为所在国。
Translation: II. If the actual management and operation of a shipping enterprise is conducted on board a ship, the Contracting State in which the home harbor of the ship is located shall be deemed as the country of residence; or if there is no home harbor, the Contracting State in which the operator of the ship is a resident shall be deemed as the country of residence.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条规定也适用于参加合伙经营、联合经营或者参加国际经营机构的利润。
Translation: 3. The provisions of this Article shall likewise apply to profits from participation in a partnership, a joint venture, or an international business entity.

Query_Text_cn: （二）同一人直接或间接参与缔约国一方企业和缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本。
Translation: (2) The same person participates directly or indirectly in the management, control, or capital of an enterprise of one Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 在上述任何一种情况下，两个企业之间的商业或财务关系不同于独立企业之间的关系。因此，由于这些情况而没有取得的任何利润，可以计入该企业的利润内，并据以征税。
Translation: In any of the above circumstances, the commercial or financial relations between the two enterprises differ from those that would exist between independent enterprises. Consequently, any profits that would have accrued but for those conditions may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国另一方居民从缔约国一方居民公司取得的股息，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation: 1. Dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些股息也可以在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国，按照该国的法律征税。但是，如果该项股息的受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过该股息总额的百分之十。
Translation: II. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State. But if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“股息”一语应具有按照支付股息公司是其居民的缔约国的税法含义，并应包括按该税法视同股息或分配的任何项目。
Translation: 3. The term "dividends" as used in this Article shall have the meaning which it has under the tax laws of the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and shall include all items which are treated as dividends or distributions under such tax laws.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条第二款的规定，不应影响对公司支付股息前的利润所征收的公司利润税。
Translation: 4. The provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article shall not affect the taxation of the company in respect of the profits out of which the dividends are paid.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如股息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国另一方，通过设在该另一国的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该另一国的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付股息的股份与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用本条第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: V. The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends, being a resident of a Contracting State, carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident through a permanent establishment situated therein, or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein, and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，应视具体情况适用第七条或第十五条的规定。
Translation: In such cases, the provisions of Article 7 or Article 15 shall apply as appropriate depending on the specific circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约国一方居民公司从缔约国另一方取得利润或所得，该另一国不得对该公司支付的股息征收任何税收。但支付给该另一国居民的股息或者据以支付股息的股份与设在该另一国的常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的除外。对于该公司的未分配的利润，即使支付的股息或未分配的利润全部或部分是发生于该另一国的利润或所得，该另一国也不得征税。
Translation: VI. Where a company which is a resident of a Contracting State derives profits or income from the other Contracting State, that other State may not impose any tax on the dividends paid by the company, except insofar as such dividends are paid to a resident of that other State or insofar as the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or a fixed base situated in that other State. Nor may that other State impose any tax on the undistributed profits of the company, even if the dividends paid or the undistributed profits consist wholly or partly of profits or income arising in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国另一方居民取得的发生于缔约国一方的利息，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation: 1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些利息也可以在该利息发生的缔约国，按照该国的法律征税。
Translation: II. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果该项利息的受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的百分之十。
Translation: However, if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the interest.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条第二条的规定，发生在缔约国一方而为缔约国另一方政府、行政区、地方当局、该缔约国另一方中央银行或该政府的任何机构取得的利息；或者为该缔约国另一方的其他居民取得的利息；其债权是由该缔约国另一方政府、行政区、地方当局、该缔约国另一方中央银行或该政府的任何机构提供资金、担保或保险的，应在该缔约国一方免税。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2,interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to the Government of the other Contracting State,a political subdivision,a local authority,the Central Bank of that other Contracting State or any agency thereof,or to any other resident of that other Contracting State in respect of loans or credits financed,guaranteed or insured by the Government of that other Contracting State,a political subdivision,a local authority,the Central Bank of that other Contracting State or any agency thereof,shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条“利息”一语是指从各种债权取得的所得，不论其有无抵押担保或者是否有权分享债务人的利润；特别是从公债、债券或者信用债券取得的所得，包括其溢价和奖金。但不包括按照本协定第十条的规定视为分配的任何项目。
Translation: 4. The term "interest" as used in this Article means income from debt-claims of every kind, whether or not secured by mortgage and whether or not carrying a right to participate in the debtor's profits, and in particular, income from government securities and income from bonds or debentures, including premiums and prizes attaching to such securities, bonds or debentures. However, this term does not include any item which is treated as a dividend under the provisions of Article 10 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果利息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在该利息发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该另一国的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该另一国的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该利息的债权与该常设机构或者固定基地有实际联系的，不适用本条第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: V. The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the interest, being a resident of a Contracting State, carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises through a permanent establishment situated therein, or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein, and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如果支付利息的人为缔约国一方政府、行政区、地方当局和该国居民，应认为该利息发生在该国。
Translation: VI. If the person paying the interest is the government of a Contracting State, a political subdivision, a local authority or a resident of that State, the interest shall be deemed to arise in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当支付利息的人不论是否为缔约国一方居民，在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付该利息的债务与该常设机构或者固定基地有联系，并由其负担这种利息，上述利息应认为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在国。
Translation: However, where the person paying the interest, whether a resident of a Contracting State or not, has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the indebtedness on which the interest is paid was incurred, and such interest is borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base, then such interest shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 七、由于支付利息的人与受益所有人之间或者他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，支付的利息数额，不论什么原因，超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于后来提及的数额。
Translation: VII. Where, owing to a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person, the amount of the interest paid exceeds, for whatever reason, the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship, the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the latter amount.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，对该支付款项的超出部分，仍应按各缔约国的法律征税，但应适当考虑本协定的其它规定。
Translation: In such a case, the excess part of the payment shall remain taxable according to the laws of each Contracting State, due regard being had to the other provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国另一方居民取得的发生于缔约国一方的特许权使用费，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation: 1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些特许权使用费也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该国的法律征税。
Translation: II. However, these royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State.

Query_Text_cn: （一）在本条第三款第（一）项所述的特许权使用费的情况下，该项特许权使用费总额的百分之十。
Translation: (1) In the case of royalties referred to in subparagraph (a) of paragraph 3 of this Article, 10 percent of the gross amount of the royalties.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在本条第三款第（二）项所述的特许权使用费的情况下，该项特许权使用费调整数额的百分之十。
Translation: (2) In the case of royalties referred to in subparagraph (b) of paragraph 3 of this Article, 10 percent of the adjusted amount of such royalties.

Query_Text_cn: 在该项中，“调整数额”是指特许权使用费总额的百分之七十。
Translation: Under this item, the "adjusted amount" refers to seventy percent of the total royalty fees.

Query_Text_cn: （二）使用、有权使用工业、商业、科学设备所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: (2) Various payments made as remuneration for the use of, or the right to use, industrial, commercial, or scientific equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果特许权使用费受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在该特许权使用费发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该另一国的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该另一国的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该特许权使用费的权利或财产与该常设机构和固定基地有实际联系的，不适用本条第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: IV. The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the royalties, being a resident of a Contracting State, carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the royalties arise through a permanent establishment situated therein, or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein, and the right or property in respect of which the royalties are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果支付特许权使用费的人是缔约国一方政府、行政区、地方当局和该国居民，应认为该特许权使用费发生在该缔约国。
Translation: 5. Where the payer of the royalties is the government of a Contracting State, a political subdivision, a local authority or a resident of that State, the royalties shall be deemed to arise in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当支付特许权使用费的人不论是否为缔约国一方居民，在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付该特许权使用费的义务与该常设机构或者固定基地有联系，并由其负担这种特许权使用费，上述特许权使用费应认为发生于该常设机构或者固定基地所在国。
Translation: However,where the payer of the royalties,whether or not a resident of a Contracting State,has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the obligation to pay the royalties was incurred,and such royalties are borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base,then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 六、由于支付特许权使用费的人与受益所有人之间或他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，支付的特许权使用费数额，不论什么原因，超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于后来提及的数额。
Translation: VI. Where, owing to a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person, the amount of the royalties paid exceeds, for whatever reason, the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship, the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国另一方居民取得的发生于缔约国一方的技术费，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation: 1. Technical fees arising in a Contracting State and derived by a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些技术费也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该国的法律征税。
Translation: II. However, such technical fees may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, in accordance with the laws of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果该项技术费的受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过技术费调整数额的百分之十。
Translation: However, if the beneficial owner of the technical service fee is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10% of the adjusted amount of the technical service fee.

Query_Text_cn: 在本款中，“调整数额”是指技术费总额的百分之七十。
Translation: In this clause,"adjusted amount" means seventy percent of the total technical fee.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“技术费”一语是指技术、监督管理、咨询服务，包括使用或有权使用有关工业、商业、科学经验的情报，作为报酬支付给任何人的款项。但不包括支付给第十六款提及的从事非独立个人劳务的雇用人员的款项。
Translation: 3. The term "technical fees" as used in this Article means payments of any kind to any person in consideration for technical, supervisory, or consultancy services, including the use of or the right to use information concerning industrial, commercial, or scientific experience. However, such term does not include payments made to employees referred to in paragraph 6 who perform non-independent personal services.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果技术费受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在技术费发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该另一国的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该另一国的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，该项技术费与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用本条第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: IV. If the beneficial owner of the technical fees is a resident of a Contracting State and carries on business in the other Contracting State where the technical fees arise through a permanent establishment situated therein, or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein, and the technical fees are effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of paragraph 1 and 2 shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果支付技术费的人是缔约国一方政府、行政区、地方当局或该国居民，应认为该技术费发生在该国。
Translation: 5. If the payer of the technical fee is the government, administrative region, local authority, or a resident of a Contracting State, the technical fee shall be deemed to arise in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当支付技术费的人不论是否为缔约国一方居民，在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付技术费的义务与该常设机构或固定基地有联系，并由其负担这种技术费，上述技术费应认为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在国。
Translation: However, where the person paying the technical fees, whether or not a resident of a Contracting State, has a permanent establishment or fixed base in a Contracting State, and the obligation to pay the technical fees is connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base and borne by it, such technical fees shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 六、由于支付技术费的人与受益所有人之间或他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，支付的技术费数额，不论什么原因，超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于后来提及的数额。
Translation: VI. Where, owing to a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person, the amount of the technical fees paid exceeds, for whatever reason, the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship, the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the latter amount.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用本条第二款规定外，发生于缔约国一方的财产收益，该国根据其国内法律的规定，可以征税。
Translation: 1. Subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from immovable property situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State in accordance with its domestic laws.

Query_Text_cn: 二、转让从事国际运输的船舶或飞机，以及属于经营上述船舶、飞机的不动产以外的财产取得的收益，应仅在该企业实际经营管理机构所在的缔约国征税。
Translation: 2. Gains derived from the transfer of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic, or of property other than immovable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft, shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十三条的规定外，缔约国一方居民由于专业性劳务或者其它独立性活动取得的所得，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: 1. Subject to the provisions of Article 13, income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from professional services or other independent activities shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在有关会计年度中，在缔约国另一方停留连续或累计超过一百八十三天。
Translation: (2) Staying in the other Contracting State for a period or periods exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in the relevant fiscal year.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，该另一国可以对其在该国进行活动取得的所得征税。
Translation: In such circumstances, the other country may tax the income derived from activities carried on within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十七条、第十九条、第二十条、第二十一条和第二十二条的规定以外，缔约国一方居民因受雇取得的薪金、工资和其它类似报酬，除在缔约国另一方受雇的以外，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 1. Subject to the provisions of Articles 17, 19, 20, 21 and 22, salaries, wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment shall be taxable only in that State unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条第一款和第二款的规定，受雇于经营国际运输的船舶或飞机而取得的报酬，可以在企业实际经营管理机构所在缔约国征税。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 四、虽有本条第一款和第二款的规定，缔约国一方国民由于为从事国际航空运输飞机经营的该缔约国企业提供服务，作为派驻在缔约国另一方的官员或者职员取得的薪金、工资和其它类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: IV. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, salaries, wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an officer or employee in respect of services rendered to an enterprise of that Contracting State engaged in the operation of aircraft in international traffic, who is seconded to the other Contracting State, shall be taxable only in the first-mentioned Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、虽有第十五条和第十六条的规定，缔约国一方居民，作为表演家，如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家、音乐家或者作为运动员，在缔约国另一方从事其个人活动取得的所得，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation:
Article 1  
Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 15 and 16, income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an entertainer, such as a theatre, motion picture, radio or television artiste, or a musician, or as a sportsman, from his personal activities as such exercised in the other Contracting State, may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、虽有第七条、第十五条和第十六条的规定，表演家或运动员从事其个人活动取得的所得，并非归属表演家或者运动员本人，而是归属于其他人，可以在这些表演家或运动员从事上述活动的缔约国征税。
Translation: II. Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7, 15 and 16, income derived by entertainers or sportspersons from their personal activities may be taxed in the Contracting State in which these activities are performed, if such income is not attributable to the entertainers or sportspersons themselves but to other persons.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条第一款和第二款的规定，按照缔约国双方的文化协定或安排，从事第一款所提及的上述活动取得的所得，如果完全或实质上由缔约国任何一方公共资金或者政府资金资助的对该国的访问，在从事上述活动的缔约国，应予免税。
Translation: III. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, income derived from the activities referred to in paragraph 1 shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State in which such activities are performed, provided that the visit to that State is wholly or substantially supported by public or government funds of either Contracting State under a cultural agreement or arrangement between the two Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 除适用第二十条第二款的规定以外，因以前的雇佣关系支付给缔约国一方居民的退休金和其它类似报酬，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: Except as provided in paragraph 2 of Article 20, pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of a Contracting State in consideration of past employment shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方政府、行政区或地方当局对向其提供服务的个人支付的退休金以外的报酬，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: 1. (1) Remuneration, other than pensions, paid by a Contracting State, its political subdivisions or local authorities to an individual in respect of services rendered to them shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: ２．不是仅由于提供该项服务，而成为该国的居民，该项报酬，应仅在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: 2. The remuneration shall be taxable only in the other Contracting State if it is not by reason solely of the provision of such services that the recipient becomes a resident of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方政府、行政区或地方当局支付的或者从其建立的基金中对向其提供服务的个人支付的退休金，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: 2.(1)Pensions paid by a Contracting State,its administrative division or local authority,or from funds established by them,to individuals in respect of services rendered to them shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第十六条、第十七条、第十八条和第十九条的规定，应适用于为缔约国一方政府、行政区和地方当局进行营业提供服务所取得的报酬和退休金。
Translation: 3. The provisions of Articles 16, 17, 18, and 19 shall apply to remuneration and pensions paid in respect of services rendered in the conduct of business for the government, administrative regions, or local authorities of a Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 任何个人在直接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，为在该缔约国一方的大学、学院、学校或其它公认的教育或者科研机构从事教学、讲学或研究的目的，停留在该缔约国一方，从其第一次到达该国之日起不超过三年的，该缔约国一方应对其由于教学、讲学或研究取得的报酬，免予征税。
Translation: Any individual who was a resident of one Contracting State immediately before visiting the other Contracting State and who, for the purpose of teaching, lecturing or conducting research at a university, college, school or other recognized educational or scientific institution in that other Contracting State, remains in that other State for a period not exceeding three years from the date of first arrival shall be exempt from tax in that other State on remuneration derived from such teaching, lecturing or research.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在该缔约国从事个人劳务的所得（企业学徒提供给其跟之学艺的人或合伙企业的劳务，或者实习生提供给其提供培训的人的劳务除外），在任何征税年度不超过一千镑英国货币或等值的中国货币。
Translation: (3) Income derived by a resident of the other Contracting State from the performance of personal services in that Contracting State (excluding services rendered by an apprentice to the person or partnership with whom he is training, or by a trainee to the person providing the training) shall not exceed one thousand pounds sterling or the equivalent in Chinese currency in any taxable year.

Query_Text_cn: 二、根据本条第一款，上述免税应仅在持续到完成接受教育或培训所需的合理或通常的时间内。任何人从该项接受教育或培训开始起超过五年的，不应享受第一款的优惠。
Translation: II. Pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article, the aforementioned tax exemption shall apply only for the reasonable or customary duration required to complete the education or training. No individual shall be entitled to the benefits under paragraph 1 if the period of such education or training exceeds five years from its commencement.

Query_Text_cn: （一）中国居民从联合王国取得的利润、所得或财产收益，按照本协定规定对该项利润、所得和财产收益缴纳的联合王国税收，应允许在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。
Translation: (1) The Chinese tax payable by a resident of China on profits, income or capital gains derived from the United Kingdom shall be allowed as a credit against the United Kingdom tax paid in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement in respect of such profits, income or capital gains.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，抵免额不应超过对该项利润、所得和财产收益按照中国税法和规章计算的中国税额。
Translation: However,the credit amount shall not exceed the Chinese tax payable on such profits,income or property gains as computed under China's tax laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: （二）从联合王国取得的所得是联合王国居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，同时该中国居民公司佣有支付股息公司股份不少于百分之十的，该项抵免应考虑支付该股息公司对于从中支付服息的利润缴纳的联合王国税收。
Translation: (2) Where the income derived from the United Kingdom is a dividend paid by a resident company of the United Kingdom to a resident company of China which owns not less than 10 percent of the shares of the company paying the dividend, the tax credit shall take into account the United Kingdom tax paid by the company paying the dividend in respect of the profits out of which the dividend is paid.

Query_Text_cn: （一）按照本协定，根据中国的法律，对来源于中国的利润、所得和财产收益，不论是直接缴纳或扣缴的中国税收（不包括在股息情况下，对从支付股息中利润缴纳的税收），应运许在根据中国税收计算的同一利润、所得或财产收益计算的联合王国税收中抵免。
Translation: (1) In accordance with the provisions of this Agreement, Chinese tax payable, whether directly paid or withheld, in respect of profits, income or gains arising in China (excluding, in the case of dividends, tax payable in respect of the profits out of which the dividends are paid) shall be allowed as a credit against United Kingdom tax computed by reference to the same profits, income or gains on which the Chinese tax is calculated.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在中国居民公司支付给联合王国居民公司利息，同时该联合王国居民公司直接或间接控制该支付股息公司至少百分之十选举权的情况下，该项抵免应考虑该公司从支付股息利润中缴纳的中国税收（除根据本款第（一）项的规定可以允许抵免的任何中国税收外）。
Translation: (2) Where a resident company of China pays interest to a resident company of the United Kingdom, and the latter directly or indirectly controls at least 10% of the voting power of the company paying the dividend, the credit shall take into account the Chinese tax paid by the company paying the dividend out of the profits from which the dividend is paid (in addition to any Chinese tax allowed to be credited under the provisions of subparagraph (1) of this paragraph).

Translation: (2) Other provisions that may be introduced in the future and agreed upon by the competent authorities of both Contracting States, which grant exemptions or reductions of a substantially similar nature, provided that such provisions are not subsequently amended or are only amended in minor respects without affecting their general character.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约国一方企业在该国已征税的利润，也包括在另一国企业的利润中，而且这些包括的利润是应计入该另一国企业的，企业之间所制订的条件又是独立企业之间在正常条件又是独立企业之间在正常条件下进行交易，包括在两个企业利润中的数额，在本条中应视为该缔约国一方企业来源于该另一国的所得，按照本条第一款或第二款的规定，相应地给予减免。
Translation: 5. Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方国民在缔约国另一方负担的税收或者有关条件，不应与该另一国国民在相同情况下，负担或可能负担的税收或者有关条件不同或比其更重。
Translation: 1. Nationals of a Contracting State shall not be subjected in the other Contracting State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which nationals of that other State in the same circumstances are or may be subjected.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国一方企业的资本全部或部分，直接或间接为缔约国另一方一个或一个以上的居民拥有或控制，该企业在该缔约国一方负担的税收或者有关条件，不应与该缔约国一方其它同类企业的负担或可能负担的税收或者有关条件不同或比其更重。
Translation: 3. Where the capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State is wholly or partly owned or controlled,directly or indirectly,by one or more residents of the other Contracting State,such enterprise shall not be subjected in the first-mentioned State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which other similar enterprises of that first-mentioned State are or may be subjected.

Query_Text_cn: 四、除适用第九条、第十一条第七款、第十二条第六款或第十三条第六款规定外，缔约国一方企业企业支付给缔约国另一方居民的利息、特许权使用费、技术费和其它款项，在确定该企业应纳税利润时，应与在同样情况下支付给该缔约国一方居民同样予以扣除。
Translation: IV. Query_Text_cn: 五、本条不应理解为缔约国任何一方在税收上仅给予本国居民个人的任何扣除、优惠和减税也必须给予并非该国居民的个人。
Translation: Article 5. This Article shall not be construed as obliging a Contracting State to grant to individuals who are not residents of that State any personal allowances, reliefs and reductions for taxation purposes which are granted only to individuals who are residents of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、当缔约国一方居民认为，缔约国一方或者双方的措施，导致或将导致对其不符合本协定规定的征税时，可以不考虑各国国内法律的补救办法，将案情提交本人为其居民的缔约国主管当局。
Translation: 1. Where a resident of a Contracting State considers that the actions of one or both of the Contracting States result or will result for him in taxation not in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement, he may, irrespective of the remedies provided by the domestic law of those States, present his case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国双方主管当局应通过协议设法解决在解释或实施本协定时发生的困难或疑义。
Translation: 3. The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve by mutual agreement any difficulties or doubts arising from the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国双方主管当局为达成本条第二款和第三款的协议，可以相互直接联系。

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换为实施本协定的规定所必需的情报，或缔约国双方关于本协定所涉及的税种的国内法律所必需的情报（以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限），特别是防止欺诈、偷漏税的情报。
Translation: 1. The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall exchange such information as is necessary for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or of the domestic laws of the Contracting States concerning taxes covered by this Agreement insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to this Agreement, in particular for the prevention of fraud or evasion of such taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 情报交换不受第一条的限制。
Translation: The exchange of intelligence is not subject to the restrictions outlined in Article 1.

Query_Text_cn: 所交换的情报应作密件处理，仅应告知与本协定所含税种有关的查定、征收、执行、起诉或裁决上诉的有关人员或当局（包括法院和行政管理部门）。
Translation: The exchanged information shall be treated as confidential and disclosed only to persons or authorities (including courts and administrative bodies) involved in the assessment, collection, enforcement, prosecution, or adjudication of appeals concerning the taxes covered by this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （三）提供泄漏任何贸易、经营、工业、商业、专业秘密、贸易过程的情报或者泄露会违反公共政策的情报。
Translation: (3) Providing information that discloses any trade, business, industrial, commercial, or professional secrets, trade processes, or information whose disclosure would be contrary to public policy.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定应不影响按国际法一般规则或特别协定规定的外交、常驻使团或领事成员的财政特权。

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第七款规定的独立代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权并经常行使这种权力以该企业的名义签订合同，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构。除非这个人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第四款的规定，按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。

Query_Text_cn: 六、虽有本条前面规定，缔约国一方的保险企业，除再保险以外，如果不是通过适用第七款的独立地位代理人而在缔约国另一方领域内收取保费或对位于该国领域内的风险进行保险，应认为在缔约国另一方构成常设机构。

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约国一方企业仅通过按常规经营本身业务的经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者任何其他独立代理人在缔约国另一方进行营业，不应认为在该缔约国另一方设有常设机构。
Translation: 7. An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that other State through a broker, general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status, provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该企业通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构在该缔约国另一方进行营业，其利润可以在该缔约国另一方征税，但应仅以属于该常设机构的利润为限。

Translation: Second,where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise of that State—and taxes accordingly—profits on which an enterprise of the other Contracting State has been charged to tax in that other State and the profits so included are profits which would have accrued to the enterprise of the first-mentioned State if the conditions made between the two enterprises had been those which would have been made between independent enterprises,then that other State shall make an appropriate adjustment to the amount of the tax charged therein on those profits.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如果利息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在利息发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该利息的债权与该常设机构或者固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款、第二款和第三款的规定。

Query_Text_cn: 七、如果支付利息的人为缔约国一方政府、其行政区、地方当局或该缔约国居民，应认为该利息发生在该缔约国。

Query_Text_cn: 八、由于支付利息的人与受益所有人之间或者他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，就有关债权所支付的利息数额超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于后来提及的数额。
Translation: VIII. Where, owing to a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person, the amount of the interest paid exceeds, for whatever reason, the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship, the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些特许权使用费也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果收款人是特许权使用费受益所有人，则所征税款不应超过特许权使用费总额的百分之十。缔约国双方主管当局应协商确定实施该限制税率的方式。
Translation: II. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State. But if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the royalties. The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall by mutual agreement settle the mode of application of this limitation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“特许权使用费”一语是指使用或有权使用文学、艺术或科学着作，包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片、磁带的版权，专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或秘密程序所支付的作为报酬的各种款项，或者使用或有权使用工业、商业、科学设备或有关工业、商业、科学经验的情报所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: 3. The term "royalties" as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of, or the right to use, any copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work including cinematograph films, or films or tapes used for radio or television broadcasting, any patent, trade mark, design or model, plan, secret formula or process, or for the use of, or the right to use, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment, or for information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience.

Query_Text_cn: 或为了通过卫星、电缆、光纤或同类技术向公众传输电视或无线广播，而使用或有权使用图像或声音，或两者兼而有之，而支付的任何形式的报酬。
Translation: or any form of remuneration paid for the use of, or the right to use, images or sounds, or both, for transmission to the public by satellite, cable, fiber optics, or similar technologies for television or radio broadcasting.

Query_Text_cn: “特许权使用费”一语还包括转让任何与生产、使用或销售有关的权利或财产取得的收益。
Translation: The term "royalties" also includes income derived from the transfer of any rights or property related to production, use, or sale.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果支付特许权使用费的人是缔约国一方政府、行政区、地方当局或该缔约国居民，应认为该特许权使用费发生在该缔约国。
Translation: 5. If the payer of the royalties is the government of a Contracting State, a political subdivision, a local authority, or a resident of that Contracting State, the royalties shall be deemed to arise in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当支付特许权使用费的人不论是否为缔约国一方居民，在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付该特许权使用费的义务与该常设机构或者固定基地有联系，并由其负担这种特许权使用费，上述特许权使用费应认为发生于该常设机构或者固定基地所在缔约国。
Translation: However,where the person paying the royalties,whether or not he is a resident of a Contracting State,has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the obligation to pay the royalties was incurred,and such royalties are borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base,then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 二、转让一个公司财产股份的股票取得的收益，该公司的财产又主要直接或者间接由位于缔约国一方的不动产所组成，可以在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 2. Gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of shares or comparable interests in a company, the property of which consists principally of immovable property situated in the other Contracting State, may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、转让第二款所述以外的代表缔约国一方居民公司参股的股票取得的收益，可以在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: III. Gains derived from the transfer of shares, other than those mentioned in paragraph 2, representing a participation in a company which is a resident of a Contracting State may be taxed in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、转让缔约国一方企业在缔约国另一方的常设机构营业财产部分的动产，或者缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方从事独立个人劳务的固定基地的动产取得的收益，包括转让常设机构（单独或者随同整个企业）或者固定基地取得的收益，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: 4. Gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of that State has in the other Contracting State, or of movable property pertaining to a fixed base available to a resident of that State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing independent personal services, including such gains from the alienation of such a permanent establishment (alone or together with the whole enterprise) or of such a fixed base, may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、转让从事国际运输的船舶或飞机，或者转让属于经营上述船舶、飞机的动产取得的收益，应仅在该企业为居民的缔约国征税。
Translation: V. Gains derived from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic, or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft, shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the enterprise is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 六、转让第十二条提到的或本条前面几款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国征税。
Translation: VI. Gains derived from the alienation of any property other than that referred to in Article XII and the preceding paragraphs of this Article shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: （一）在缔约国另一方为从事上述活动设有经常使用的固定基地。
Translation: (1) There is a fixed base regularly used in the other Contracting State for the performance of such activities.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在有关历年中在缔约国另一方停留连续或累计达到或超过一百八十三天。在这种情况下，该缔约国另一方可以仅对在该缔约国进行活动取得的所得征税。
Translation: (2) The individual has stayed in the other Contracting State for a period or periods exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in any twelve-month period commencing or ending in the fiscal year concerned. In such case, the other Contracting State may tax only the income derived from activities performed therein.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“专业性劳务”一语特别包括独立的科学、文学、艺术、教育或教学活动，以及医师、律师、工程师、建筑师、牙医师和会计师的独立活动。
Translation: 2. The term "professional services" includes especially independent scientific, literary, artistic, educational or teaching activities as well as the independent activities of physicians, lawyers, engineers, architects, dentists and accountants.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条上述规定，在缔约国一方企业经营国际运输的船舶或飞机上从事受雇的活动取得的报酬，应在该缔约国征税。
Translation: III. Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraphs of this Article, remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司的董事会或类似机构成员取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: 1. Directors' fees and other similar payments derived by a resident of a Contracting State in his capacity as a member of the board of directors or a similar organ of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司的高级管理职位的职员取得的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: 2. Salaries, wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of services rendered as a senior managerial employee of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方政府、行政区或地方当局对履行政府职责向其提供服务的个人支付退休金以外的薪金、工资或其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 1.(1) Salaries,wages and other similar remuneration,other than pensions,paid by a Contracting State,a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State,subdivision or authority shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方政府、行政区或地方当局支付或者从其建立的基金中支付给向其提供服务的个人的退休金，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 2.(1) Pensions paid by a Contracting State, its political subdivision or local authority, or out of funds created by them, to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State, subdivision or authority shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （二）但是，如果提供服务的个人是缔约国另一方居民，并且是其国民的，该项退休金应仅在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: (2) However, if the individual providing the services is a resident of the other Contracting State and is a national thereof, such pension shall be taxable only in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于向缔约国一方政府、行政区或地方当局举办的事业提供服务取得的薪金、工资或其他类似报酬和退休金。
Translation: III. The provisions of Articles 15, 16, 17, and 18 shall apply to salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration, as well as pensions, derived in respect of services rendered to an enterprise carried on by the government of a Contracting State, a political subdivision, or a local authority thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在紧接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民的教师和研究人员，主要是为了在该缔约国一方的大学、学院、学校或为该缔约国一方政府承认的其他教育机构或科研机构从事教学或科学研究的目的，停留在该缔约国一方，对其由于教学或研究取得的报酬，该缔约国一方应自其第一次到达之日起，三年内免予征税。
Translation: 1. Teachers and researchers who were residents of one Contracting State immediately before visiting the other Contracting State and who are present in that other State for the primary purpose of teaching or conducting research at a university, college, school, or other recognized educational or scientific institution therein, shall be exempt from tax in that other State on remuneration for such teaching or research for a period not exceeding three years from the date of their first arrival.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条不适用于不是为了公共利益而主要是为某个人或某些人的私利从事研究取得的所得。
Translation: 2. This Article shall not apply to income derived from research activities that are not conducted in the public interest but primarily for the private benefit of an individual or certain individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国一方居民取得的各项所得，凡本协定上述各条未作规定的，无论发生在何处，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Items of income of a resident of a Contracting State which are not expressly mentioned in the foregoing Articles of this Agreement shall be taxable only in that Contracting State, irrespective of where they arise.

Query_Text_cn: 一、从该居民所得征收的税额中抵免等于在缔约国另一方的所得税数额，但是该项抵免在任何情况下不应超过可以在缔约国另一方征税的所得在抵免前计算的那部分所得税税额。
Translation: 1. The tax paid by the resident shall be credited against the tax payable in the other Contracting State, but the amount of such credit shall not exceed the portion of tax calculated on income taxable in the other Contracting State prior to such credit.

Query_Text_cn: 二、从缔约国一方取得的所得是缔约国一方居民公司支付给缔约国另一方居民公司的股息，同时该缔约国另一方居民公司拥有支付股息公司不少于百分之十的股份，该项抵免应考虑支付该股息公司就该项所得缴纳的缔约国一方税收。
Translation: 2. Where income derived from a Contracting State is a dividend paid by a resident company of that Contracting State to a resident company of the other Contracting State, and the latter company owns not less than 10 percent of the shares of the company paying the dividend, the credit shall take into account the tax paid to the first-mentioned Contracting State by the company paying the dividend in respect of such income.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述主管当局如果认为所提意见合理，又不能单方面圆满解决时，应设法同缔约国另一方主管当局相互协商解决，以避免不符合本协定的征税。有关案情应在缔约国另一方应纳税之日或纳税申报之日（以晚一些的时限为准）起不超过四年半之内通知缔约国另一方主管当局。
Translation: 2. If the competent authority referred to above considers the objection to be justified and is unable to resolve the case unilaterally, it shall endeavor to settle the matter by mutual agreement with the competent authority of the other Contracting State, with a view to avoiding taxation not in accordance with this Agreement. The case must be presented to the competent authority of the other Contracting State within a period of four and a half years from the date on which the tax became due or the tax return was filed in that other Contracting State, whichever is later.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，达成的任何协议应自应纳税之日或纳税申报之日（以晚一些的时限为准）起不超过十年内予以实施。如果该缔约国另一方国内法允许，时限可以延长。
Translation: In such cases, any agreement reached shall be implemented within a period not exceeding ten years from the date on which the tax became due or the tax return was filed, whichever is later. This period may be extended if permitted under the domestic law of the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换为实施本协定的规定所需要的情报，或缔约国双方关于本协定所涉及的税种的国内法律的规定所需要的情报（以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限），特别是防止偷漏税的情报。
Translation: 1. The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall exchange such information as is necessary for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or of the domestic laws of the Contracting States concerning taxes covered by this Agreement, insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to this Agreement, in particular for the prevention of fraud or evasion of such taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国一方收到的情报应作密件处理，仅应告知与本协定所含税种有关的查定、征收、执行、起诉或裁决上诉的有关人员或当局（包括法院和行政管理部门）。
Translation: Information received by a Contracting State shall be treated as confidential and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities (including courts and administrative bodies) involved in the assessment, collection, enforcement, prosecution, or adjudication of appeals concerning the taxes covered by this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约国双方交换外交照会，确认已履行为本协定生效所必需的各自的法律程序之日起的第三十天开始生效。
Translation: This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of exchange of diplomatic notes between the Contracting Parties confirming the completion of their respective legal procedures necessary for its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定将适用于在协定生效年度的次年一月一日或以后开始的纳税年度中取得的所得。
Translation: This Agreement shall apply to income derived in taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January next following the year in which the Agreement enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，本协定对终止通知发出年度的次年一月一日或以后开始的纳税年度的所得停止有效。
Translation: In such cases, this Agreement shall cease to have effect with respect to income derived in taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January next following the year in which the notice of termination is given.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于二00五年九月十二日在墨西哥城签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、西班牙文和英文写成，所有文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Mexico City on September 12, 2005, in duplicate, with each copy written in Chinese, Spanish and English, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 如在解释上遇有分歧，以英文文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy in interpretation, the English text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 签订中华人民共和国政府和墨西哥合众国政府关于对所得避免双重征税和防止偷漏税的协定时，下列代表同意下列规定作为协定的组成部分。
Translation: The following representatives, in signing the Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the United Mexican States for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income, have agreed upon the following provisions as an integral part of the Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、关于“固定基地”一语为了税收目的，固定基地依照常设机构适用的原则处理。
