Translation: (2) An enterprise of a Contracting State shall be deemed to provide services, including consultancy services, in the other Contracting State through employees or other personnel engaged by it, but only where such activities continue (for the same project or a connected project) in that other State for a period or periods aggregating 183 days or more within any 12-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第六款规定的独立地位代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权以该企业的名义签订合同并经常行使这种权力，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构，除非这个人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第四款的规定。按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: V. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2, where a person (other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies) is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State and has, and habitually exercises, in that State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise, that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the first-mentioned State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise, unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which, if exercised through a fixed place of business, would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 船舶、飞机和公路车辆不应视为不动产。
Translation: Ships, aircraft, and road vehicles shall not be regarded as immovable property.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方企业的利润应仅在该缔约国一方征税，但该企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在缔约国另一方进行营业的除外。
Translation: 1. The profits of an enterprise of a Contracting State shall be taxable only in that State unless the enterprise carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在缔约国另一方进行营业，则其利润可以在缔约国另一方征税，但应仅以归属于该常设机构的利润为限。
Translation: If the enterprise carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein, its profits may be taxed in that other State but only so much of them as is attributable to that permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在确定常设机构的利润时，应当允许扣除其进行营业发生的各项费用，包括行政和一般管理费用，不论其发生于该常设机构所在缔约国一方还是其他地方。
Translation: 3. In determining the profits of a permanent establishment, there shall be allowed as deductions all expenses incurred for the purposes of the business, including executive and general administrative expenses, whether incurred in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment is situated or elsewhere.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方企业以船舶、飞机或公路车辆经营国际运输业务所取得的利润，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 1. Profits derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the operation of ships, aircraft or road vehicles in international traffic shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款规定也适用于参加合伙经营、联合经营或者参加国际经营机构取得的利润。
Translation: 2. The provisions of paragraph 1 shall also apply to profits derived from participation in a business partnership, joint venture, or international business organization.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果股息受益所有人作为缔约国一方居民，在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国另一方，通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付股息的股份与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: IV. The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends, being a resident of a Contracting State, carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident through a permanent establishment situated therein or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein, and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第二款的规定，发生于缔约国一方而由缔约国另一方的政府或地方当局、中央银行或者任何完全由政府拥有的金融机构贷款、担保或保险而支付的利息，应在首先提及的缔约国一方免税。
Translation: III. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2, interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to the government or local authority, central bank, or any financial institution wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State in respect of loans, guarantees, or insurance shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 以及2.缔约国双方主管当局随时可同意的，由土库曼斯坦政府完全拥有的任何机构。
Translation: and 2. any institution wholly owned by the Government of Turkmenistan as may be agreed upon by the competent authorities of both Contracting States at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 7.缔约国双方主管当局随时可同意的，由中国政府完全拥有的任何机构。
Translation: 7. Any institution wholly owned by the Chinese government as may be agreed upon by the competent authorities of both Contracting States at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如果利息受益所有人作为缔约国一方居民，在利息发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该利息的债权与该常设机构或者固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: VI. The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the interest, being a resident of a Contracting State, carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises through a permanent establishment situated therein or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein, and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base.

Query_Text_cn: 七、如果支付利息的人是缔约国一方政府、地方当局或缔约国一方居民，应认为该利息发生在该缔约国。
Translation: 7. If the person paying the interest is the government of a Contracting State, a local authority thereof, or a resident of a Contracting State, the interest shall be deemed to arise in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“特许权使用费”一语是指使用或有权使用文学、艺术或科学着作（包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片或磁带）的版权、专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或秘密程序所支付的作为报酬的各种款项，也包括使用或有权使用工业、商业、科学经验所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: 3. The term "royalties" as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of, or the right to use, any copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work (including cinematograph films, and films or tapes for radio or television broadcasting), any patent, trademark, design or model, plan, secret formula or process, or for the use of, or the right to use, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment, or for information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience.

Query_Text_cn: 三、转让由缔约国一方企业从事国际运输的船舶、飞机或公路车辆或者附属于上述船舶、飞机或公路车辆的动产取得的收益，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: 3. Gains derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the alienation of ships, aircraft or road vehicles operated in international traffic, or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships, aircraft or road vehicles, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、转让第一款至第四款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国一方征税。
Translation: V. Gains derived from the alienation of property other than that referred to in paragraphs I to IV shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，缔约国另一方可以仅对归属于该固定基地的所得征税。
Translation: In such a case, the other Contracting State may tax only the income attributable to that permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在任何12个月中，该缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方停留连续或累计达到或超过183天。
Translation: (2) The resident of one Contracting State stays in the other Contracting State for a period or periods exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in any twelve-month period commencing or ending in the fiscal year concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“专业性劳务”一语特别包括独立的科学、文学、艺术、教育或教学活动，以及医师、律师、工程师、建筑师、牙医师和会计师的独立活动。
Translation: 2. The term "professional services" includes especially independent scientific, literary, artistic, educational or teaching activities as well as the independent activities of physicians, lawyers, engineers, architects, dentists and accountants.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条上述规定，在缔约国一方企业经营国际运输的船舶、飞机或公路车辆上从事受雇活动取得的报酬，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article, remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship, aircraft or road vehicle operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方政府或地方当局向为履行政府职责提供服务的个人支付退休金以外的报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 1. (1) Remuneration, other than a pension, paid by a Contracting State or a political subdivision or local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or subdivision or authority shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方政府或地方当局支付或者从其建立的基金中支付给向其提供服务的个人的任何退休金，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 2.(1) Any pension paid by, or out of funds created by, a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or authority shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （二）但是，如果提供服务的个人是缔约国另一方居民，并且是其国民的，该项报酬应仅在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: (2) However, if the services are rendered by an individual who is a resident of the other Contracting State and is also a national thereof, the remuneration shall be taxable only in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如果一个学生是或者在紧接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，仅由于接受教育的目的，而停留在该缔约国一方，对其为了维持生活或接受教育的目的收到的来源于该缔约国一方以外的款项，该缔约国一方应免予征税。
Translation: 1. Where a student who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State solely for the purpose of his education receives payments from sources outside that State for the purpose of his maintenance or education, such payments shall be exempt from tax in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款所述学生取得未包括在第一款中的赠款、奖学金和劳务报酬的，在接受教育期间，该学生应与其所停留国居民享受同样的免税、减税或扣除优惠。
Translation: II. Students referred to in paragraph I who receive grants, scholarships, or remuneration for services not covered in that paragraph shall, during their period of education, enjoy the same exemptions, reductions, or deductions in respect of taxes as residents of the State in which they are temporarily residing.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第六条第二款规定的不动产所得以外的其他所得，如果所得收款人为缔约国一方居民，通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在该缔约国另一方进行营业，或者通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地在该缔约国另一方从事独立个人劳务，据以支付所得的权利或财产与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款的规定。
Translation: Article 6, paragraph 2 shall not apply to income other than that from immovable property where the recipient of such income, being a resident of a Contracting State, carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein, or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein, and the right or property in respect of which the income is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base.

Query_Text_cn: （一）根据本协定规定，土库曼斯坦居民取得的所得可以在中国征税的，土库曼斯坦应允许从该居民就该项所得缴纳的税收中抵扣相当于在中国缴纳的所得税额。
Translation: (1) Where income derived by a resident of Turkmenistan is taxable in China in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement, Turkmenistan shall allow as a deduction from the tax on the income of that resident an amount equal to the income tax paid in China.

Query_Text_cn: （二）根据本协定的任何规定，土库曼斯坦居民取得的所得在土库曼斯坦免予征税的，土库曼斯坦在计算该居民剩余所得的税收时仍可以考虑已免税所得。
Translation: (2) Where income derived by a resident of Turkmenistan is exempt from tax in Turkmenistan under any provision of this Agreement, Turkmenistan may nevertheless take into account the exempted income in calculating the amount of tax on the remaining income of that resident.

Query_Text_cn: （一）中国居民从土库曼斯坦取得的所得，按照本协定规定在土库曼斯坦缴纳的税额，可以在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。
Translation: (1) The tax paid in Turkmenistan by a resident of China in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement shall be allowed as a credit against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，抵免额不应超过对该项所得按照中国税法和规章计算的中国税收数额。
Translation: However,the credit shall not exceed the amount of Chinese tax computed on such income in accordance with the tax laws and regulations of China.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在土库曼斯坦取得的所得是土库曼斯坦居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，并且该中国居民公司拥有支付股息公司的股份不少于20%的，该项抵免应考虑支付股息的公司就该项所得缴纳的土库曼斯坦税收。
Translation: (2) Where the income derived from Turkmenistan is a dividend paid by a resident company of Turkmenistan to a resident company of China, and the Chinese resident company holds no less than 20% of the shares of the company paying the dividend, the tax credit shall take into account the Turkmenistan tax paid by the dividend-paying company on such income.

Query_Text_cn: 三、除适用第九条第一款、第十一条第八款或第十二条第六款的规定外，缔约国一方企业支付给缔约国另一方居民的利息、特许权使用费和其他款项，在确定该企业应纳税利润时，应像支付给该缔约国一方居民的一样，在相同情况下予以扣除。
Translation: III. Except where the provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 9, paragraph 8 of Article 11, or paragraph 6 of Article 12 apply, interest, royalties, and other payments made by an enterprise of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall, for the purpose of determining the taxable profits of such enterprise, be deductible under the same conditions as if they had been paid to a resident of the first-mentioned Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国一方企业的资本全部或部分、直接或间接为缔约国另一方一个或一个以上的居民拥有或控制，该企业在该缔约国一方负担的税收或者有关条件，不应与该缔约国一方其他同类企业负担或可能负担的税收或者有关条件不同或比其更重。
Translation: 4. Where the capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State is wholly or partly owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by one or more residents of the other Contracting State, such enterprise shall not be subjected in the first-mentioned State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which other similar enterprises of that first-mentioned State are or may be subjected.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换可以预见的与执行本协定的规定相关的信息，或与执行缔约国双方或地方当局征收的各种税收的国内法律相关的信息，以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限。
Translation: 1. The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall exchange such information as is foreseeably relevant for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or to the administration or enforcement of their domestic laws concerning taxes of every kind imposed by either Contracting State or its local authorities, insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方应以书面形式相互通知已完成本协定生效所必需的国内法律程序。
Translation: Both Contracting Parties shall notify each other in writing upon completion of their respective domestic legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）本协定生效年度的次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度中征收的其他税收。
Translation: (2) Other taxes imposed in taxable years beginning on or after January 1 of the year following the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定应保持有效直到缔约国一方终止本协定。
Translation: This Agreement shall remain in force until terminated by either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 在本协定生效之日起满5年后的任一年年底前6个月，缔约国一方可以通过外交途径书面通知缔约国另一方终止本协定。
Translation: Either Contracting Party may terminate this Agreement by giving written notice to the other Contracting Party through diplomatic channels at least six months before the end of any calendar year following the expiration of a period of five years from the date of its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: （二）终止通知发出年度的次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度中征收的其他税收。
Translation: (2) Other taxes levied for taxable years beginning on or after January 1 of the year following the issuance of the termination notice.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经各自政府正式授权，在本协定上签字，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, duly authorized by their respective governments, have signed this Agreement in witness thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于2009年12月13日在阿什哈巴德签订，一式两份，每份均用中文、土库曼文、俄文和英文写成，四种文本同等作准。如对文本的解释发生分歧，以英文本为准。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Ashgabat on December 13, 2009, in duplicate, each copy being written in Chinese, Turkmen, Russian and English, all texts being equally authentic. In case of divergence in the interpretation of the texts, the English text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条人的范围本协定适用于缔约国一方或者同时为双方居民的人。
Translation:
Article 1 Personal Scope  
This Agreement shall apply to persons who are residents of one or both of the Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: （以下称瑞士税收）。
Translation: (hereinafter referred to as Swiss taxes).

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何按照缔约国一方法律成立的法人、合伙企业或团体。
Translation: 2. Any legal person, partnership, or association established under the laws of either Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、成立地、实际管理机构所在地或者其他类似的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人，并且包括该缔约国及其行政区或地方当局。
Translation: 1. For the purposes of this Agreement, the term "resident of a Contracting State" means any person who, under the laws of that State, is liable to tax therein by reason of domicile, residence, place of incorporation, place of effective management or any other criterion of a similar nature, and also includes that State and any political subdivision or local authority thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 三、由于第一款的规定，除个人以外，同时为缔约国双方居民的人，应认为仅是其实际管理机构所在国家的居民。
Translation: III. Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph 1 a person other than an individual is a resident of both Contracting States, then it shall be deemed to be a resident only of the State in which its place of effective management is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 三、建筑工地，建筑、装配或安装工程，或者与其有关的监督管理活动，只有持续时间超过12个月的才构成常设机构。
Translation: III. A construction site, or construction, assembly or installation project, or supervisory activities in connection therewith, constitutes a permanent establishment only if it lasts more than 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: 四、虽有本条第一款、第二款和第三款的规定，“常设机构”一语还包括缔约国一方企业通过雇员或雇用的其他人员在缔约国另一方提供劳务，包括咨询劳务，但仅以该性质的活动（为同一项目或相关联的项目）在任何12个月中连续或累计超过183天的为限。
Translation: IV. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1, 2 and 3, the term "permanent establishment" shall also include the furnishing of services, including consultancy services, by an enterprise of a Contracting State through employees or other personnel engaged by the enterprise in the other Contracting State, but only where such activities continue (for the same project or a connected project) for a period or periods aggregating more than 183 days within any 12-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 六、虽有本条第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第七款规定的独立地位代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权以该企业的名义签订合同并经常行使这种权力，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构，除非这个人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第五款的规定。按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: VI. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2, where a person (other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 7 applies) is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State and has, and habitually exercises, in that State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise, that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the first-mentioned State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise, unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 5 which, if exercised through a fixed place of business, would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约国一方企业仅通过按常规经营本身业务的经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者任何其他独立地位代理人在缔约国另一方进行营业，不应认为在该缔约国另一方设有常设机构。但如果该代理人的活动全部或几乎全部代表该企业，则不应认为是本款所指的独立地位代理人。
Translation: 7. An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that other State through a broker, general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status, provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business. However, when the activities of such an agent are devoted wholly or almost wholly on behalf of that enterprise, he shall not be considered an agent of an independent status within the meaning of this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 八、缔约国一方的居民公司，控制或被控制于缔约国另一方的居民公司或者在该缔约国另一方进行营业的公司（不论是否通过常设机构），仅凭此项事实不能使任何一方公司构成另一方公司的常设机构。
Translation: 8. The fact that a company which is a resident of a Contracting State controls or is controlled by a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State or which carries on business in that other State (whether through a permanent establishment or otherwise) shall not of itself constitute either company a permanent establishment of the other.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果船运企业的实际管理机构设在船舶上，应以船舶母港所在缔约国为所在国；没有母港的，应以船舶经营者为其居民的缔约国为所在国。
Translation: 2. If the actual management institution of a shipping enterprise is located on a vessel, the Contracting State where the home port of the vessel is situated shall be deemed as the state of residence; in the absence of a home port, the Contracting State of which the operator of the vessel is a resident shall be deemed as the state of residence.

Query_Text_cn: （一）缔约国一方企业直接或者间接参与缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，或者（二）相同的人直接或者间接参与缔约国一方企业和缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，两个企业之间商业或财务关系的构成条件不同于独立企业之间商业或财务关系的构成条件，并且由于这些条件的存在，导致其中一个企业没有取得其本应取得的利润，则可以将这部分利润计入该企业的所得，并据以征税。
Translation: (1) Where an enterprise of a Contracting State participates directly or indirectly in the management, control or capital of an enterprise of the other Contracting State, or (2) the same persons participate directly or indirectly in the management, control or capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State, and in either case conditions are made or imposed between the two enterprises in their commercial or financial relations which differ from those which would be made between independent enterprises, then any profits which would, but for those conditions, have accrued to one of the enterprises, but, by reason of those conditions, have not so accrued, may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第二款的规定，缔约国一方居民公司支付的股息，如果受益所有人是缔约国另一方、其行政区或地方当局、缔约国双方主管当局通过相互协商同意的由缔约国另一方全资拥有的机构或基金，或其中央银行，缔约国一方应对该项股息免税。
Translation: III. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2, dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State shall be exempt from tax in that State if the beneficial owner is the other Contracting State, its political subdivisions or local authorities, an institution or fund wholly owned by the other Contracting State as agreed upon through mutual consultation by the competent authorities of both Contracting States, or its central bank.

Article 2 Scope of Application  
This Agreement shall apply to investments made by investors of either Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party in accordance with its laws and regulations, whether before or after the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 但是,本协定不适用于在本协定生效之前已发生的事件所引发的请求或者争议。
Translation: However, this Agreement shall not apply to any claims or disputes arising from events that occurred prior to its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条促进及许可一、缔约一方应在其领土内尽可能促进缔约另一方投资者的投资,并依据其法律法规许可该投资。
Translation:
Article 3 Promotion and Admission  

1. Each Contracting Party shall, within its territory, promote as far as possible the investments of investors of the other Contracting Party and admit such investments in accordance with its laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对于应当接受的在其领土内的投资,缔约一方应依据法律法规提供所有与该投资相关的必要许可和批准,包括对实施技术或行政援助的许可协议和合同的许可,以及投资者选择职员所需要的批准。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its laws and regulations, provide all necessary permits and approvals pertaining to investments within its territory that are to be admitted, including authorization for agreements and contracts related to the implementation of technical or administrative assistance, as well as approvals required for the employment of personnel selected by investors.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条保护及待遇一、缔约一方投资者的投资和收益在缔约另一方领土内应始终享受公正和公平的待遇,并享有完全的保护和安全。
Translation:
Article 4 Protection and Treatment  

1. Investments and returns of investors of either Contracting Party shall at all times be accorded fair and equitable treatment and shall enjoy full protection and security in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方不得以任何方式对该投资的管理、维持、使用、享有、扩大或处置采取不合理或歧视性的措施。
Translation: Neither Contracting Party shall in any way adopt unreasonable or discriminatory measures against the management, maintenance, use, enjoyment, expansion or disposal of such investment.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方在其领土内给予缔约另一方投资者的投资或收益的待遇不应低于其给予本国投资者的投资或收益的待遇(国民待遇)或者其给予任何第三国投资者的投资或收益的待遇(最惠国待遇),并从优适用。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall accord to investments or returns of investors of the other Contracting Party in its territory treatment no less favorable than that accorded to investments or returns of its own investors (national treatment) or to investments or returns of investors of any third state (most-favored-nation treatment), whichever is more favorable.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方在其领土内给予缔约另一方投资者管理、维持、使用、享有或处置其投资的待遇不应低于其给予本国投资者的待遇(国民待遇)或者其给予任何第三国投资者的待遇(最惠国待遇),并从优适用。
Translation: III. Each Contracting Party shall accord to investors of the other Contracting Party, with respect to the management, maintenance, use, enjoyment or disposal of their investments in its territory, treatment no less favorable than that accorded to its own investors (national treatment) or to investors of any third country (most-favored-nation treatment), whichever is more favorable.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果缔约一方根据建立自由贸易区、关税同盟或者共同市场的协议或者根据避免双重征税协议给予任何第三国以特别优惠,该缔约方没有义务将上述优惠给予缔约另一方的投资者。
Translation: IV. If a Contracting Party grants special preferences to any third country under an agreement establishing a free trade area, customs union, or common market, or under a double taxation avoidance agreement, it shall not be obligated to extend such preferences to investors of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (七)部分或全部的投资出售或清算收入,包括可能的投资增值。
Translation: (7) Proceeds from partial or full divestment or liquidation of investments, including potential capital appreciation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述转移应以可自由兑换的货币按照转移当日接受投资的一方通行的市场汇率不迟延地进行。
Translation: II. The aforementioned transfers shall be made in freely convertible currency at the prevailing market exchange rate of the recipient party on the date of transfer without undue delay.

Query_Text_cn: 若市场汇率不存在,则应符合支付时国际货币基金组织特别提款权同有关货币汇率折算得出的交叉汇率。
Translation: If no market exchange rate exists,the cross rate derived from the conversion between the IMF Special Drawing Rights and the relevant currency at the time of payment shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条征收及补偿一、除非是为了公共利益、在非歧视的基础上并给予补偿,缔约一方不得对缔约另一方投资者的投资直接或间接采取征收、国有化或其他任何有相同实质或相同效果的措施。
Translation:
Article VI Expropriation and Compensation  

1. Neither Contracting Party shall take any measures of expropriation, nationalization, or any other equivalent measures having the same nature or effect, directly or indirectly, against investments of investors of the other Contracting Party, unless such measures are taken for public purposes, on a non-discriminatory basis, and under due process of law, accompanied by payment of compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 该补偿应等于采取征收或即将采取的征收为公众所知的前一刻被征收投资的市场价值,以在先者为准。
Translation: The compensation shall be equivalent to the market value of the expropriated investment immediately before the expropriation or impending expropriation became publicly known, whichever is earlier.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿应当包括以正常商业利率计算的从征收发生日起到支付日之间的利息,应以可自由兑换的货币不迟延地支付,并应可自由转移。
Translation: Compensation shall include interest at a normal commercial rate from the date of expropriation until the date of payment, be paid without delay in a freely convertible currency, and be freely transferable.

Query_Text_cn: 受影响的投资者应有权根据征收方的法律要求该缔约方的司法机构或其他独立机构根据本款规定的原则迅速审查该案件和其投资的价值。
Translation: Affected investors shall have the right to require the judicial authorities or other independent bodies of the contracting party to promptly review the case and the value of their investment in accordance with the principles set forth in this paragraph, as legally required by the expropriating party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果缔约一方征收了在其领土的任一地区依据其有效法律设立或组建的公司财产,而缔约另一方投资者在该公司中拥有股份,则该缔约一方应在必要的限度内依法保证对该投资者适用本条第一款所规定的补偿。
Translation: II. If a Contracting Party expropriates the property of a company incorporated or constituted under its effective laws in any region of its territory, in which an investor of the other Contracting Party holds shares, the former Contracting Party shall, to the extent necessary and in accordance with its laws, ensure that the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article regarding compensation apply to such investor.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条损害补偿缔约一方投资者的投资如果在缔约另一方的领土内因战争或其它武装冲突、革命、全国紧急状态、叛乱、内乱或者任何其它类似事件遭受损失,该投资者应享受符合本协议第四条规定的待遇,从归还、赔偿、补偿或其它解决措施中受益。
Translation:
Article 7 Compensation for Damage  

If an investment of an investor of one Contracting Party suffers losses in the territory of the other Contracting Party due to war or other armed conflict, revolution, a state of national emergency, insurrection, civil disturbance, or any other similar event, such investor shall be accorded treatment consistent with the provisions of Article 4 of this Agreement and shall benefit from restitution, indemnification, compensation, or other settlement measures.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条其他承诺缔约一方应当遵守其对缔约另一方投资者在其领土内的投资所做出的特别承诺。
Translation:
Article 8 Other Commitments  
Each Contracting Party shall observe any special commitments it has made to investments by investors of the other Contracting Party in its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条更优惠条款如果缔约一方的立法或国际法规则给予缔约另一方投资者投资的待遇比本协定更优惠,则这种条款在其更优惠的范围内应比本协定优先适用。
Translation:
Article 9 More Favorable Provisions  
If the legislation of either Contracting Party or rules of international law grant investors of the other Contracting Party treatment more favorable than that provided under this Agreement, such provisions shall prevail over this Agreement to the extent that they are more favorable.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条代位原则如果缔约一方对其投资者在缔约另一方领土内的投资提供了非商业风险的财政担保,并据此对该投资者支付了赔偿金,缔约另一方应当承认该缔约一方按照代位原则取得了投资者的权利。
Translation:
Article 10 Subrogation  
If a Contracting Party has provided financial guarantee against non-commercial risks for investments made by its investors in the territory of the other Contracting Party and has made payment to such investors pursuant to the guarantee, the other Contracting Party shall recognize the transfer of the investors' rights to the former Contracting Party under the principle of subrogation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条缔约一方与缔约另一方投资者之间的争议一、为了解决缔约一方与缔约另一方投资者之间关于投资的争议,在不违反本协议第十二条(缔约双方间的争议)的前提下,争议双方应当进行磋商。
Translation:
Article 11 Disputes Between a Contracting Party and an Investor of the Other Contracting Party  

1. For the purpose of resolving disputes between a Contracting Party and an investor of the other Contracting Party concerning an investment, and without prejudice to Article 12 (Disputes Between the Contracting Parties), the disputing parties shall first seek to settle their dispute through consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果自书面请求磋商之日起6个月内上述磋商仍没有结果,投资者可以将争议提交给其投资所在的缔约方法院或者行政庭,或者将争议提交国际仲裁。
Translation: II. If no resolution is reached through the aforementioned consultations within six months from the date of the written request for consultation, the investor may submit the dispute to the courts or administrative tribunals of the contracting party where the investment is located, or refer the dispute to international arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: (一)依据1965年3月18日在华盛顿开放签署的《解决国家和他国国民之间投资争端公约》设立的“解决投资争端国际中心”,或者(二)根据《联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则》设立的专设仲裁庭,除非争议双方另有约定。
Translation: (i) the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes established pursuant to the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States opened for signature at Washington on 18 March 1965, or (ii) an ad hoc arbitral tribunal established under the Arbitration Rules of the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law, unless otherwise agreed by the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约方在此同意将投资争议提交给国际仲裁。
Translation: III. The Parties hereby agree to submit investment disputes to international arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果争议已经依据第二款规定提交给有关的缔约国适格法院,只有投资者从该国内法院撤回案件以后,该争议才能提交国际仲裁。
Translation: IV. If the dispute has been submitted to the competent court of the relevant Contracting Party in accordance with paragraph 2, it may only be submitted to international arbitration after the investor has withdrawn the case from the domestic court.

Query_Text_cn: 五、作为争议一方的缔约国在程序中无权以其豁免权或者投资者已经根据保险合同获得了部分或者全部损害赔偿的事实作为辩护。
Translation: V. A State Party involved as a party to the dispute shall not be entitled to raise as a defense its immunity or the fact that the investor has received partial or full compensation for damages under an insurance contract.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约一方不得通过外交途径解决一个已提交国际仲裁的争议,除非缔约另一方不遵守仲裁裁决。
Translation: 6. Neither Contracting Party shall pursue the settlement of a dispute already submitted to international arbitration through diplomatic channels, unless the other Contracting Party fails to comply with the arbitral award.

Query_Text_cn: 七、仲裁裁决是终局的,对争议双方均有约束力,并应当依据有关缔约方的法律被不迟延地执行。
Translation: VII. The arbitral award shall be final and binding upon both parties to the dispute and shall be enforced without delay in accordance with the laws of the relevant contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约双方的争议一、缔约双方对本协定条款的解释或适用所产生的争议应尽可能通过外交途径解决。
Translation:
Article 12 Disputes Between the Contracting Parties  
1. Any dispute arising from the interpretation or application of the provisions of this Agreement shall be settled, as far as possible, through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果双方在争议开始后6个月不能自行达成协议,应缔约一方的要求,争议应当提交三人仲裁庭。
Translation: 2. If the parties fail to reach an agreement within six months after the dispute arises, the dispute shall, at the request of either Contracting Party, be submitted to an arbitral tribunal of three members.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个缔约方应各任命一名仲裁员,该两名仲裁员应指定一名第三国国民作为主席。
Translation: Each Party shall appoint one arbitrator, and the two arbitrators shall designate a national of a third State as the chairman.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如果缔约一方未任命其仲裁员且在两个月内没有按照缔约另一方的请求任命仲裁员,根据该缔约方的请求,该名仲裁员应由国际法院院长任命。
Translation: III. If a Contracting Party fails to appoint its arbitrator and does not make such appointment within two months following the request of the other Contracting Party, the arbitrator shall be appointed by the President of the International Court of Justice at the request of the latter Party.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果两个仲裁员在被任命后两个月内不能就主席的选择达成一致,应缔约方的请求,主席应由国际法院院长任命。
Translation: 4. If the two arbitrators fail to agree on the selection of the chairperson within two months after their appointment, the chairperson shall, at the request of either party, be appointed by the President of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在本条第三、四款规定的情况下,如果国际法院院长不能履行此职责或是缔约一方国民时,则由副院长作出任命；如果副院长不能履行此职责或是缔约一方国民时,则由非缔约任何一方国民的国际法院最资深法官作出任命。
Translation: 5. In the cases referred to in paragraphs 3 and 4 of this Article, if the President of the International Court of Justice is unable to perform this function or is a national of one of the Contracting Parties, the appointment shall be made by the Vice-President; if the Vice-President is likewise unable to perform this function or is a national of one of the Contracting Parties, the appointment shall be made by the most senior judge of the International Court of Justice who is not a national of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 六、仲裁庭应根据缔约双方约定的其它条款自行制定其程序规则。
Translation: VI. The arbitral tribunal shall establish its own procedural rules in accordance with other terms agreed upon by the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方应各自负担其指派的仲裁员和出席仲裁程序的有关费用。
Translation: Each Party shall bear the costs of its appointed arbitrator and any expenses related to its participation in the arbitral proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 除非仲裁庭另有裁决,首席仲裁员的费用和其他费用应由缔约双方平均分担。
Translation: Unless the arbitral tribunal decides otherwise, the fees and expenses of the presiding arbitrator and other costs shall be borne equally by the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 七、仲裁裁决是终局的,对每一缔约方都有约束力。
Translation: VII. The arbitral award shall be final and binding upon each Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条最终条款一、缔约双方应当通过外交途径相互通知已完成协定生效必需的国内法律程序。
Translation:
Article 13 Final Provisions  
1. The Contracting Parties shall notify each other through diplomatic channels of the completion of their respective domestic legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协议自后一份通知收到之日起生效，有效期为10年。
Translation: This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of receipt of the latter notification and remain valid for a period of ten years.

Query_Text_cn: 除非缔约一方在有效期届满前6个月书面通知对方终止本协定，本协定应被视为以相同的条款顺延两年有效期，并依此法顺延。
Translation: Unless either Party notifies the other Party in writing of its intention to terminate this Agreement at least six months prior to the expiration of its validity, this Agreement shall be deemed automatically renewed for another two years under the same terms and conditions, and shall continue to be renewed thereafter in the same manner.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在本协定被正式通知终止的情况下，协定第一至十二条应对协定终止前的投资继续适用10年。
Translation: II. In the event of formal notification of termination of this Agreement, Articles 1 to 12 shall continue to apply to investments made prior to the termination for a period of ten years.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本协定替代了1986年11月12日在北京签署的《中华人民共和国政府和瑞士联邦政府关于相互促进和保护投资协定》。
Translation: III. This Agreement supersedes the Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Swiss Confederation on the Reciprocal Promotion and Protection of Investments, signed in Beijing on November 12, 1986.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经双方政府正式授权签署本协定，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, duly authorized by their respective governments, have signed this Agreement in witness thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于2009年1月27日在伯尔尼签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、法文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Bern on 27 January 2009 in duplicate, with each copy written in Chinese, French and English, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 如对文本的解释发生分歧，以英文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy in the interpretation of the text, the English version shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: （三）对第一款所述的任何不符措施的修正，但该修正不得增加此措施在修正前存在的不符程度。
Translation: (3) Any amendment to a non-conforming measure referred to in paragraph 1, provided that the amendment does not increase the level of non-conformity of the measure as it existed prior to the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 这些不符措施将被努力逐渐消除。
Translation: These non-conforming measures will be progressively eliminated.

Query_Text_cn: 为以上之目的，“措施”一词系指中华人民共和国所采取的普遍适用的措施，无论是否是法律、法规、规则、程序、决定或者行政行为的形式。
Translation: For the purposes set forth above, the term "measure" refers to any measure of general application taken by the People's Republic of China, whether in the form of laws, regulations, rules, procedures, decisions, or administrative actions.

Query_Text_cn: （二）只有转移符合中国关于外汇管制的法律法规规定的手续时，第五条第一款第七项才适用。
Translation: (2) The provisions of subparagraph (7) of the first paragraph of Article 5 shall apply only when the transfer complies with the procedures stipulated by Chinese laws and regulations on foreign exchange control.

Query_Text_cn: 如果中国法律有关条款不再要求上述手续，第五条的适用将不受上述限制。
Translation: If the relevant provisions of Chinese laws no longer require the aforementioned procedures, the application of Article 5 shall not be subject to the above restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在履行转移手续一般所需时间内完成的转移，应被视为第五条第二款所指的“没有迟延”。
Translation: II. Transfers completed within the time generally required for the completion of transfer formalities shall be deemed to have been made "without delay" as referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 5.

Query_Text_cn: 上述期间应从具有全部和真实文件和信息的相关要求被提交给相关外汇管理部门之日开始，并不得超过两个月。
Translation: The aforementioned period shall commence from the date when all complete and authentic documents and information required are submitted to the relevant foreign exchange administrative authorities and shall not exceed two months.

Query_Text_cn: 关于第十一条第二款一、当中华人民共和国政府作为争议一方时，可以要求相关投资者在将争议提交第十一条第二款规定的仲裁程序之前用尽中华人民共和国的法律法规规定的当地行政复议程序。
Translation: Regarding Article 11, Paragraph 2, Item 1: When the Government of the People's Republic of China is a party to a dispute, it may require the relevant investor to exhaust the local administrative reconsideration procedures prescribed by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China before submitting the dispute to the arbitration procedures stipulated in Article 11, Paragraph 2.

Query_Text_cn: 该复议程序不超过三个月。
Translation: The reconsideration procedure shall not exceed three months.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果第一条第二款第（三）项定义的投资者已经依据与第三国的投资协定中类似第十一条第二款的规定提交了仲裁请求，该投资者将无权依据本协定第十一条第二款再提交相同的请求。
Translation: II. If an investor as defined in subparagraph (3) of paragraph 2 of Article 1 has already submitted an arbitration claim under provisions similar to paragraph 2 of Article 11 in an investment agreement with a third country, such investor shall not be entitled to submit the same claim under paragraph 2 of Article 11 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 关于第十一条第三款关于缔约方同意将投资争议提交国际仲裁，双方认为该款规定优先于缔约方可能加入的关于投资争议解决的任何其它国际协定。
Translation: Regarding Article 11, Paragraph 3 on the submission of investment disputes to international arbitration by the contracting parties, both sides agree that this provision shall take precedence over any other international agreements on investment dispute settlement to which the contracting parties may accede.

Query_Text_cn: （五）法律或法律允许依合同授予的商业特许权，包括勘探、耕作、提炼或开发自然资源的特许权。
Translation: (v) Commercial concessions granted by law or under contract permitted by law, including concessions for the exploration, cultivation, extraction, or development of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: 作为投资的财产发生任何形式上的变化，不影响其作为投资的性质，只要该变化不违反接受投资一方的法律和法规。
Translation: Any change in the form of the invested property shall not affect its nature as an investment, provided that such change does not violate the laws and regulations of the investment-receiving party.

Query_Text_cn: （二）法律实体，包括根据缔约任何一方的法律设立或组建且住所在该缔约一方境内的公司、协会、合伙及其他组织。
Translation: (2) Legal entities, including companies, associations, partnerships, and other organizations established or incorporated under the laws of either Contracting Party and domiciled within the territory of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“收益”一词系指由投资所产生的款项，特别是，包括但不限于利润，股息，利息，资本利得，提成费，以及其他与投资相关的费用。
Translation: III. The term "returns" means the amounts yielded by an investment, particularly, though not exclusively, including profits, dividends, interest, capital gains, royalties and other fees related to the investment.

Query_Text_cn: 四、“活动”一词系指对所承认的投资的管理、维持、使用、享有和处置。
Translation: 4. The term "activity" refers to the management, maintenance, use, enjoyment, and disposal of the recognized investment.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约一方按照国际法为勘探、提炼、开发和保护自然资源而行使主权权利或管辖权的上述领土的领海外围海域。
Translation: (2) The outer maritime areas adjacent to the territorial sea of the aforementioned territories where a Contracting Party exercises sovereign rights or jurisdiction in accordance with international law for the exploration, extraction, exploitation, and conservation of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: 六、“缔约方的法律法规”系指中华人民共和国的法律和法规，以及俄罗斯联邦的法律和法规。
Translation: 6. "Laws and regulations of the Contracting Parties" shall mean the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China and those of the Russian Federation.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方应鼓励为缔约另一方的投资者在其领土内投资创造有利条件，并依照其法律和法规接受这种投资。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall encourage the creation of favorable conditions for investors of the other Contracting Party to make investments in its territory and shall admit such investments in accordance with its laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应根据其法律法规在其领土上对缔约另一方投资者的投资提供完全的保护。
Translation: 2. Each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its laws and regulations, accord full protection to the investments of investors of the other Contracting Party within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在不违反缔约方法律法规的情况下，缔约方应对在本国境内从事与投资相关的活动的缔约另一方的国民在提供签证和工作许可方面予以优惠考虑。
Translation: III. Without prejudice to the laws and regulations of the Contracting Parties, each Contracting Party shall give favorable consideration to nationals of the other Contracting Party engaged in investment-related activities within its territory regarding the issuance of visas and work permits.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方应保证在其领土内给予缔约另一方投资者的投资和与该投资相关的活动公平和平等的待遇。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall ensure fair and equitable treatment for investments made by investors of the other Contracting Party and activities associated with such investments within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 在不损害其法律法规的前提下，缔约方不得采取任何可能阻碍与投资相关的行为的歧视措施。
Translation: Without prejudice to its laws and regulations, no Party shall adopt any discriminatory measures that may impede investment-related activities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在不损害其法律法规的前提下，缔约一方应给予缔约另一方投资者的投资及与投资有关活动不低于其给予本国投资者的投资及与投资有关活动的待遇。
Translation: II. Without prejudice to its laws and regulations, each Contracting Party shall accord to investments and activities associated with such investments by investors of the other Contracting Party treatment no less favorable than that accorded to investments and associated activities by its own investors.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方给予缔约另一方投资者的投资及与投资有关活动的待遇，不应低于其给予任何第三国投资者的投资及与投资有关活动的待遇。
Translation: III. The treatment accorded by one Contracting Party to investments and activities associated with such investments of investors of the other Contracting Party shall not be less favorable than that accorded to investments and activities associated with such investments of investors of any third state.

Query_Text_cn: （三）俄罗斯联邦与前苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟国家之间的与本协定项下投资有关的协定。
Translation: (3) Agreements between the Russian Federation and states of the former Union of Soviet Socialist Republics concerning investments covered by this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 在世界贸易组织协议所包含的议题方面，本条第四款所述协定应符合前一缔约方在世界贸易组织中的承诺。
Translation: With respect to matters covered under the agreements of the World Trade Organization,the agreement referred to in paragraph 4 of this Article shall be consistent with the commitments undertaken by the former Party in the World Trade Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在不损害本协定第四、五、九条规定的前提下，缔约双方给予的待遇可以不高于缔约双方依据双方都加入了的与投资待遇相关的多边安排所给予的待遇。
Translation: V. Without prejudice to the provisions of Articles IV, V, and IX of this Agreement, the treatment accorded by either Contracting Party shall not be more favorable than that granted under any multilateral arrangement relating to investment treatment to which both Contracting Parties are parties.

Query_Text_cn: （三）给予补偿。
Translation: (3) Provision of compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述的补偿，应等于采取征收或征收为公众所知的前一刻被征收投资的市场价值，并适用两者中更早者。
Translation: II. The compensation referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be equivalent to the market value of the expropriated investment immediately before the expropriation was taken or became publicly known, whichever is the earlier.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿包括自征收之日起到付款之日按6月期美元借贷的伦敦同业借贷利率计算的利息。
Translation: Compensation includes interest calculated at the 6-month US dollar London Interbank Offered Rate from the date of expropriation until the date of payment.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿的支付不应迟延，并应以可自由兑换的货币进行。
Translation: Compensation shall be paid without undue delay and in a freely convertible currency.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方的投资者在缔约另一方领土内的投资，如果由于战争、国民骚乱、全国紧急状态或其他类似事件而遭受损失，缔约另一方对其恢复原状、赔偿、补偿或采取其他措施的待遇，不应低于它在相似的情况下给予本国或任何第三国投资者的待遇，并从优适用。
Translation: If an investor of one Contracting Party suffers losses in respect of its investment in the territory of the other Contracting Party due to war, civil unrest, national emergency or other similar events, the treatment accorded by the latter Contracting Party in respect of restitution, indemnification, compensation or other measures shall not be less favorable than that accorded to its own investors or investors of any third state under similar circumstances, and the more favorable treatment shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: （六）本协定第四、五条所规定的赔偿。
Translation: (6) Compensation as stipulated in Articles 4 and 5 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所规定的支付应根据缔约方的法律法规能够按兑换当日可适用的市场汇率自由兑换为任何可自由兑换的货币。
Translation: II. The payment stipulated in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be freely convertible into any freely convertible currency at the market exchange rate applicable on the date of exchange, in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、支付应当依据缔约方现行的外汇法律法规，不应迟延，并以可自由汇兑的货币进行。
Translation: III. Payments shall be made in accordance with the foreign exchange laws and regulations currently in force in the contracting parties, without delay, and in freely convertible currency.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如果缔约一方对其投资者在缔约另一方领土内投资的非商业风险规定了财政补偿，并据此对该投资者作了支付，缔约另一方应承认缔约一方依照法律或合法交易通过代位获得了该投资者所有的权利和请求权。
Translation: 1. If a Contracting Party has provided financial compensation to its investors for non-commercial risks related to their investments in the territory of the other Contracting Party and has made payments accordingly, the other Contracting Party shall recognize the transfer of all rights and claims of the investor to the first Contracting Party by virtue of law or through a lawful transaction under subrogation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、但是，通过代位获得的权利或者请求权不应超过该投资者原有的权利或者请求权，也不能损害缔约另一方已经获得的该投资者的原有权利或者请求权。
Translation: II. However, the rights or claims acquired through subrogation shall not exceed the original rights or claims of the investor, nor shall they prejudice the original rights or claims of the investor already obtained by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方对本协定的解释或适用所产生的任何争议，应尽可能通过外交途径协商解决。
Translation: 1. Any dispute arising from the interpretation or application of this Agreement between the Contracting Parties shall be settled, as far as possible, through diplomatic channels by means of consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、仲裁庭由3名仲裁员组成。
Translation: III. The arbitral tribunal shall be composed of three arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 该两名仲裁员应在其任命之日起2个月内共同选定一位缔约双方均认可的第三国国民担任首席仲裁员。
Translation: The two arbitrators shall jointly select a third-country national acceptable to both Contracting Parties as the presiding arbitrator within two months from the date of their appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭应按照本协定以及缔约双方都承认的国际法原则作出决定。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall make its decision in accordance with this Agreement and the principles of international law recognized by both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方与缔约另一方投资者之间产生的与投资相关的任何争议，应尽可能通过协商友好解决。
Translation: I. Any dispute arising between a Contracting Party and an investor of the other Contracting Party relating to investments shall, as far as possible, be settled amicably through consultations.

Query_Text_cn: （三）根据《联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则》设立的专设仲裁庭。
Translation: (3) An ad hoc arbitral tribunal established under the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules.

Query_Text_cn: 三、一旦投资者将争议提交给相关缔约方有管辖权的法院，或者提交给“中心”仲裁，或者提交给专设仲裁庭，其选择将是终局的。
Translation: III. Once an investor submits the dispute to a court of competent jurisdiction of the relevant Contracting Party, or to arbitration under the ICSID, or to an ad hoc arbitral tribunal, its choice shall be final.

Query_Text_cn: （三）国际法的规则和普遍接受的原则。
Translation: (3) The rules of international law and generally accepted principles.

Query_Text_cn: 五、仲裁裁决是终局的，对争议双方均有拘束力。
Translation: V. The arbitral award shall be final and binding upon both parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约各方应当依据本国法律和法规保证该裁决的执行。
Translation: The contracting parties shall ensure the enforcement of the award in accordance with their respective national laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 如果任何缔约一方的法律法规或缔约双方都已加入的现存的国际协定或双方在其后缔结的作为本协定补充的国际协定，含有使另一方投资者的投资享受比本协定的规定更优惠待遇的规定，则该规定在其更优惠的范围内应比本协定优先适用。
Translation: If the laws and regulations of either Contracting Party or any existing international agreement to which both Contracting Parties have acceded, or any subsequent international agreement concluded between them as a supplement to this Agreement, contains provisions that grant investments by investors of the other Party more favorable treatment than those stipulated herein, such provisions shall prevail over this Agreement to the extent that they are more favorable.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定应适用于缔约一方投资者自1985年1月1日起在缔约另一方境内作出的所有投资，但不适用本协定生效前引起的争议。
Translation: I. This Agreement shall apply to all investments made by investors of either Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party from January 1, 1985, but shall not apply to disputes arising prior to its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约任何一方应恪守其依据本协定与缔约另一方投资者就投资所作出的承诺。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall observe any commitment it has entered into with respect to investments of investors of the other Contracting Party in accordance with this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应当应缔约任何一方的要求对本协定的解释和适用事项进行磋商。
Translation: The Contracting Parties shall, at the request of either Party, hold consultations on matters concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约任何一方要求此种磋商时，缔约另一方应及时答复。
Translation: Either Contracting Party shall promptly respond when the other requests such consultations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定自缔约双方完成各自国内必要法律程序并以书面形式相互通知之日起下一个月的第一天开始生效。
Translation: 1. This Agreement shall enter into force on the first day of the month following the date on which the Contracting Parties have notified each other in writing of the completion of their respective domestic legal procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定有效期10年，此期限届满后，自动延长至下一个5年，除非缔约一方在每个5年有效期满之前至少12个月书面通知缔约另一方其终止本协定的意愿。
Translation: II. This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 10 years and shall be automatically extended for subsequent 5-year periods thereafter, unless either Party notifies the other Party in writing of its intention to terminate this Agreement at least 12 months prior to the expiration of each 5-year term.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对本协定终止之日前所作出的投资，本协定第一条至第十二条的规定应自本协定终止之日起继续适用10年。
Translation: III. For investments made prior to the termination of this Agreement, the provisions of Articles 1 to 12 shall continue to apply for a period of 10 years from the date of termination.

Query_Text_cn: 四、1990年7月26日签署的《中华人民共和国政府和苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟政府关于鼓励和相互保护投资协定》自本协定生效之日起在中华人民共和国和俄罗斯联邦之间自动终止。
Translation: IV. The Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments, signed on July 26, 1990, shall automatically terminate between the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation upon the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 五、本协定的议定书补充了本协定，并构成本协定的组成部分。
Translation: V. The protocols to this Agreement supplement this Agreement and form an integral part thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 由双方政府正式授权其各自代表签署本协定，以昭信守。
Translation: This Agreement is signed by the duly authorized representatives of both governments in witness whereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书于2006年11月9日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、俄文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Protocol was signed in Beijing on November 9, 2006, in duplicate in the Chinese, Russian and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 若文本解释发生分歧，以英文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy in the interpretation of the text, the English version shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除非缔约双方另行商定，本协定不适用于中华人民共和国香港特别行政区和中华人民共和国澳门特别行政区。
Translation: 1. Unless otherwise agreed by the Contracting Parties, this Agreement shall not apply to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China and the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China.

Query_Text_cn: 二、关于第三条中方注意到，关于本协定第三条第五款，俄罗斯联邦认为世界贸易组织《服务贸易总协定》属于与投资有关的多边安排范畴。
Translation:
II. Regarding Article 3  
China notes that concerning paragraph 5 of Article 3 of this Agreement, the Russian Federation considers the General Agreement on Trade in Services of the World Trade Organization to fall within the scope of multilateral arrangements related to investment.

Query_Text_cn: 三、关于第九条在投资者将本协定第九条所提及的争端递交该条第二款第二项和第二款第三项所规定的机构之前，作为争端一方的缔约方可以要求相关投资者用尽该缔约方法律法规所规定的国内行政复议程序。
Translation: III. With respect to Article 9, before an investor submits a dispute referred to in Article 9 of this Agreement to the institutions specified in subparagraph 2(b) or subparagraph 2(c) of that Article, the Contracting Party involved in the dispute may require the investor concerned to exhaust the domestic administrative reconsideration procedures stipulated by the laws and regulations of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （二）应当自行政复议机构受理投资者行政复议申请之日起不超过90天。
Translation: (2) The decision shall be made within no more than 90 days from the date the investor's administrative reconsideration application is accepted by the administrative reconsideration authority.

Query_Text_cn: （四）不应取代本协定第九条第二款第二项和第三项所提到的仲裁程序和机构。
Translation: (4) It shall not replace the arbitration procedures and institutions referred to in subparagraphs (ii) and (iii) of paragraph 2 of Article IX of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （九）“航线表”，指本协定所附的航线表或根据本协定第十六条的规定所修改过的航线表。
Translation: (ix) "Route Schedule" means the route schedule annexed to this Agreement or as amended in accordance with Article 16 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条授权一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定规定的权利，以使其指定空运企业能在航线表规定的航线上建立和经营国际航班（以下分别称为“规定航线”和“协议航班”）。
Translation:
Article 2 Grant of Rights  
1. Each Party grants to the other Party the rights specified in this Agreement to enable the designated airline(s) of the other Party to establish and operate international air services on the routes specified in the Route Schedule (hereinafter referred to as "specified routes" and "agreed services," respectively).

Query_Text_cn: （一）不降停飞越缔约另一方领土；（二）在上述领土内缔约双方航空当局协议的地点作非运输业务性经停；和（三）在航线表中规定的上述领土内的地点经停，以便上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
三、本条第二款的规定不应被认为是给予缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内为取酬或出租而装上旅客、行李、货物或邮件运往该缔约另一方领土内另一地点的权利。
Translation: 3. The provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article shall not be deemed to confer on the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party the right to take on, in the territory of the other Contracting Party, passengers, baggage, cargo or mail carried for remuneration or hire and destined for another point in the territory of that other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业如欲在规定航线上作加班或包机飞行，缔约一方航空当局应向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: IV. If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to operate extra-section flights or charter flights on the specified routes, the aeronautical authorities of that Contracting Party shall submit an application to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, and the flights may only be operated after obtaining approval.

Query_Text_cn: 此项申请应在飞机起飞七十二小时前提出。
Translation: This application must be submitted at least seventy-two hours before the scheduled departure of the flight.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条指定和许可一、缔约一方有权书面向缔约另一方指定一家空运企业，在航线表规定的航线上经营协议航班二、缔约各方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权应属于该缔约方或其国民。
Translation:
Article III Designation and Authorization  

1. Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one airline to operate the agreed services on the routes specified in the Route Schedule.  

2. Substantial ownership and effective control of the airline designated by each Contracting Party shall remain vested in such Contracting Party or its nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在不违反本条第一款规定的情况下，缔约另一方在收到上述指定后，应不延误地给予该空运企业以合适的经营许可。
Translation: 3. Without prejudice to paragraph 1 of this Article, the other Contracting Party shall, upon receipt of such designation, without delay grant to the designated airline the appropriate operating authorization.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约另一方航空当局可要求缔约一方指定空运企业向它证明，该空运企业有资格履行根据法律和规章所制定的条件，这些法律和规章是上述当局在经营国际航班方面所通常和合理地予以实施的。
Translation: IV. The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the designated airline of one Contracting Party to demonstrate that it is qualified to fulfill the conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied by the said authorities in the operation of international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条提供技术服务及其费率一、缔约一方应在其领土内指定供缔约另一方指定空运企业经营规定航线所使用的主用机场和备降机场，并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 5 Provision of Technical Services and Their Rates  
1. Each Contracting Party shall designate, within its territory, the main airports and alternate airports to be used by the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the agreed services on the specified routes, and shall provide the communications, navigation, meteorological, and other auxiliary services necessary for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场按缔约另一方有关当局所规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall pay for the use of airports of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the competent authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 这些费率不应高于从事国际航班飞行的缔约另一方本国空运企业使用类似设施和服务所付的费率。
Translation: These rates shall not be higher than those paid by the air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party engaged in international air services for the use of similar facilities and services.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业运入或代表该企业运入缔约另一方领土的只供飞行国际航班使用的燃油、润滑油、零备件、正常设备和机上供应品，或装上该企业飞机的上述物资，即使在装机的缔约方领土内的航段上使用，也应豁免所有税收和费用，包括缔约另一方领土内所征收的关税和检验费。
Translation: II. Fuel, lubricants, spare parts, regular equipment, and aircraft stores introduced into the territory of one Contracting Party by or on behalf of a designated airline of the other Contracting Party, or taken on board the aircraft of such airline and intended solely for use in the operation of international air services, shall be exempt from all taxes and charges, including customs duties and inspection fees imposed in the territory of the other Contracting Party, even when such supplies are used on sectors within the territory of the Party where they are taken on board.

Query_Text_cn: 三、留置在缔约任何一方飞机上的机上正常设备、零备件、机上供应品、燃料和润滑油，只能在缔约另一方海关当局同意后，方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。该当局可要求这些物品置于他们监管之下，直至再次运出，或按海关规定另作处理。
Translation: III. Normal aircraft equipment, spare parts, aircraft supplies, fuel, and lubricants retained on board the aircraft of either Contracting Party may only be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of its customs authorities. Such authorities may require these items to be placed under their supervision until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with customs regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约任何一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土的客票、货运单以及宣传品和小纪念品，应豁免一切关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: Article IV: All passenger tickets, waybills, promotional materials, and small souvenirs brought into the territory of the other Contracting Party by the designated air transport enterprises of either Contracting Party shall be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条财务规定缔约任何一方允许缔约另一方指定空运企业按正式比价，自由结汇该指定空运企业因运输旅客、行李、货物和邮件在缔约一方领土内所得的收支余额。
Translation:
Article 7 Financial Provisions  
Each Contracting Party shall permit the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party to freely transfer, at the official exchange rate, the balance of receipts and expenditures obtained by such designated airline(s) within the territory of the former Contracting Party in connection with the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约双方间的支付按一项专门协定办理，则该协定应适用。
Translation: Where payments between the Contracting Parties are governed by a special agreement, that agreement shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条豁免收入所得税和其他税收一、缔约一方指定空运企业经营协议航班所得的收入或利润，在缔约另一方领土内应豁免所得税或其他类似税收。
Translation:
Article 8 Exemption from Income Tax and Other Taxes  
1. The income or profits derived by the designated airline of one Contracting Party from the operation of agreed services shall be exempt from income tax and any other similar taxes in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业为经营协议航班而在缔约另一方领土内雇用的人员，如系缔约任何一方的国民，其因受雇而取得薪金、津贴或其他收入，在该领土内应豁免所得税或其他类似税捐。
Translation: II. The personnel employed by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the agreed services, if they are nationals of either Contracting Party, shall be exempt from income tax or other similar levies in that territory on salaries, allowances, or other income derived from their employment.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条入境和放行规章一、缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规章以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规章，均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和该机所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation:
Article IX Entry and Clearance Regulations  
1. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, stay within, and departure from its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as those pertaining to passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and mail entering, staying within, or leaving its territory, shall apply to the aircraft, crew, and the passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail carried by such aircraft of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party while in the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条运力规定一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班方面，应有公平均等的机会。
Translation:
Article 10 Capacity Provisions  

1. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、有关班次、机型、飞行时刻表、地面服务和关于经营协议航班的其他事项，应由缔约双方指定空运企业协商确定。
Translation: II. Matters relating to flight frequencies, types of aircraft, flight schedules, ground services, and other aspects concerning the operation of the agreed services shall be determined through consultation between the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如此协议的班次、机型应经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: The schedules and types of aircraft for such services shall be approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班时，应考虑缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益，以免不适当地影响后者在整条航线或其航段上经营的航班。
Translation: 3. In designating an airline to operate the agreed services on the specified routes, each Contracting Party shall take into consideration the interests of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services provided by the latter on the whole or part of the same routes.

Query_Text_cn: 四、指定空运企业提供的协议航班，其主要目的应是以合理的载运比率提供足够的运力，以满足当前和合理地预料到的，来自或前往指定该空运企业的缔约方领土的旅客、邮件和货物运输的需要。
Translation: IV. The agreed services provided by the designated air carrier shall have as their primary objective the provision, at a reasonable load factor, of capacity adequate to meet the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers, mail and cargo originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party that has designated the air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: （三）联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The operational needs of connecting flights.

Query_Text_cn: 五、初期运力的提供应在协议航班开航前由缔约双方商定。
Translation: V. The initial capacity provision shall be agreed upon by both Contracting Parties prior to the commencement of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，运力的提供应由缔约双方航空当局随时商讨，对商定的运力作任何改变应以换文确认。
Translation: Thereafter,the capacity to be provided shall be agreed from time to time between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties,and any changes to the agreed capacity shall be confirmed by an exchange of notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条资料和统计资料缔约任一方航空当局应根据缔约另一方航空当局的要求，向其提供审议缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上提供的运力时可能合理地需要的统计资料。
Translation:
Article 11 Data and Statistics  
Either aeronautical authority shall, upon request by the aeronautical authority of the other Contracting Party, furnish such statistical data as may be reasonably required to evaluate the capacity provided by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the specified route(s).

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条班期时刻表的批准一、缔约一方指定空运企业应不晚于在规定航线上开始飞行协议航班三十天前，将航班类别、机型和班期时刻表通知缔约另一方航空当局。
Translation:
Article 12 Approval of Schedules  
1. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall notify the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party of the flight category, aircraft type, and schedule no later than thirty (30) days prior to the commencement of agreed services on the specified route(s).

Query_Text_cn: 这一规定同样适用于此后的更改以及每一夏季和冬季时刻表。
Translation: This regulation also applies to subsequent amendments and each summer and winter timetable.

Query_Text_cn: 二、收到该班期时刻表的航空当局对该时刻表通常应予批准或提出修改意见。
Translation: II. The aviation authority receiving the schedule for the said flight period shall generally approve it or propose modifications.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，上述指定空运企业不得在上述航空当局批准该时刻表前开始经营航班。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall the designated air carrier commence operations on the agreed services before the schedule is approved by the said aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 这一规定同样适用于此后的更改。
Translation: This provision also applies to subsequent amendments.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条运价的制定一、任何协议航班的运价应在合理的水平上制定，适当考虑到一切有关因素，包括经营成本、合理的利润、航班特点（如速度和舒适水平），以及其他空运企业在规定航线任何航段上所收取的运价。
Translation:
Article 13 Establishment of Tariffs  
1. The tariffs for any agreed services shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being paid to all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, characteristics of service (such as standards of speed and accommodation), and the tariffs charged by other airlines for any part of the specified route.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价，应由缔约双方指定空运企业达成协议，在有必要和可能时，应与在该航线或其航段上经营的其他空运企业进行磋商。
Translation: 2. The tariffs referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties and, where necessary and possible, shall be subject to consultation with other airlines operating on the same route or section thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 达成协议的运价应经缔约双方航空当局的批准,并至少应在其拟议采用之日九十天前提交各自航空当局。
Translation: The agreed tariffs shall be approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties and shall be submitted to their respective aeronautical authorities at least ninety (90) days before the proposed date of their introduction.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如双方航空当局未能就批准根据本条第二款向其提交的任何运价达成协议，或未能根据第三款就运价的确定达成协议，这一问题应根据本协定第十七条规定提交缔约双方解决。
Translation: 4. If the aeronautical authorities of the two Parties fail to agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph 2 of this Article, or fail to determine a tariff in accordance with paragraph 3, this issue shall be referred to the Contracting Parties for settlement in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （九）总申报单。
Translation: (9) General Declaration.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方发给或核准的上述有效证件和执照，缔约另一方应予承认。
Translation: The valid certificates and licenses issued or approved by one Contracting Party shall be recognized by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （八）就事故结论和关于调查的书面报告，书面通知缔约一方。
Translation: (h) Provide written notification to a Contracting Party regarding the accident conclusions and the written report on the investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条协商一、缔约双方航空当局应在必要时互相交换意见，以确保紧密合作，并批准所有与执行本协定有关的事项。
Translation:
Article 16 Consultation  
1. The aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall, as necessary, exchange views to ensure close cooperation and approve all matters related to the implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方为了修改本协定或航线表，可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商。
Translation: 2. Either Contracting Party may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party for the purpose of amending this Agreement or the Route Schedule.

Query_Text_cn: 此项协商应在收到进行协商要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation: Such consultation shall commence within sixty days from the date of receipt of the request for consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 经协商达成的对本协定的任何修改，应在以外交换文陈明已根据各自国家法律履行了法律程序之日起生效。
Translation: Any agreed amendments to this Agreement shall enter into force on the date of exchange of diplomatic notes confirming that the legal procedures under their respective national laws have been completed.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如修改只涉及航线表，则应在缔约双方航空当局间进行协商。
Translation: 3. If the modification involves only the route schedule, it shall be subject to consultation between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 在上述当局就一项新的或经修改的航线表达成协议后，此项修改应在以外交换文确认后即行生效。
Translation: The modification shall take effect upon confirmation through an exchange of notes after the competent authorities concerned have reached an agreement on a new or revised route.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条争端的解决缔约双方应密切合作，互相支持，保证本协定的正确实施。
Translation:
Article 17 Settlement of Disputes  
The Contracting Parties shall cooperate closely and support each other to ensure the proper implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧，缔约双方主管当局应本着友好合作、互相谅解的精神直接协商解决。
Translation: In the event of any divergence in the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the competent authorities of both Contracting Parties shall resolve the matter through direct consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding.

Query_Text_cn: 此项协商应在收到进行协商要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation: The consultation shall commence within sixty days from the date of receipt of the request for consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 如不能在六十天内达成协议，缔约双方应通过外交途径解决。
Translation: If no agreement can be reached within sixty days, the contracting parties shall resolve the matter through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条终止缔约任一方可随时将其终止本协定的决定通知缔约另一方。
Translation:
Article 18 Termination  
Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its decision to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 通知发出后，本协定在缔约另一方收到终止通知之日起12个月后即告终止，除非缔约双方在期满前同意撤销该通知。
Translation: Upon issuance of such notice, this Agreement shall terminate 12 months after the date on which the notice is received by the other Party, unless the Parties agree to withdraw the notice prior to the expiration of this period.

Query_Text_cn: 在通知之日起十四天后，或将通知递交缔约另一方在缔约一方领土内的外交机构之日，该项通知应认为已被收到。
Translation: The notice shall be deemed to have been received fourteen days after the date of the notice or on the day when it is delivered to the diplomatic mission of the other Contracting Party in the territory of the one Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条标题本协定每条均冠以标题，只是为了查阅方便，而决非对本协定的范围或意图予以解释、限制或说明。
Translation:
Article 19 Headings  
The headings of the Articles of this Agreement are inserted for convenience of reference only and shall not be construed to interpret, limit or define the scope or intent of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条生效本协定自交换确认缔约双方已完成了各自法律程序的外交照会之日起生效。
Translation:
Article 20 Entry into Force  
This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of exchange of diplomatic notes confirming that the Contracting Parties have completed their respective legal procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 下列签字人，经其各自政府正式授权，已在本协定上签字，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned, being duly authorized by their respective Governments, have signed this Agreement in witness whereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于1983年5月3日在马斯喀特签字，正本共两份，每份都用中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Muscat on May 3, 1983, in duplicate in the Chinese, Arabic and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 如对中文和阿拉伯文文本的解释发生分歧，以英文文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy in the interpretation of the Chinese and Arabic texts, the English text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 中国境内一点——两个中间经停点——马斯喀特——两个以远点。
Translation: One point in China—two intermediate points—Muscat—two beyond points.

Query_Text_cn: 注：航班可以飞行规定航线上的两个中间经停点和两个以远点，但马斯喀特和上述地点间不得行使业务权。
Translation: Note: Flights may operate with two intermediate stops and two beyond points along the designated route, but no traffic rights shall be exercised between Muscat and the aforementioned points.

Query_Text_cn: 阿曼苏丹国境内一点——两个中间经停点——北京——两个以远点。
Translation: A point in the Sultanate of Oman—two intermediate points—Beijing—two beyond points.

Query_Text_cn: 注：航班可以飞行规定航线上的两个中间经停点和两个以远点，但北京和上述地点间不得行使业务权。
Translation: Note: Flights may operate with two intermediate stops and two beyond points along the designated route, but no traffic rights shall be exercised between Beijing and the aforementioned points.

Query_Text_cn: （一）缔约任一方指定空运企业在任何或所有飞行中，可以不经停规定航线上的任何或所有地点，但航班须在指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内始发和终止。
Translation: (1) The designated airline(s) of either Contracting Party may, on any or all flights, omit any or all points on the specified routes, provided that the flight originates and terminates within the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: （二）该指定空运企业应在开始飞行协议航班和以后更换班期时刻表前，指定上述两个中间经停点和两个以远点并提交缔约另一方航空当局批准。
Translation: (2) The designated air carrier shall designate the aforementioned two intermediate points and two beyond points and submit them to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party for approval before commencing the agreed flights and any subsequent changes to the flight schedule.

Query_Text_cn: 这些地点，每次飞行不必相同。
Translation: These locations need not be the same for each flight.

Query_Text_cn: 巴基斯坦政府特派外交部长佐勒菲卡·阿里·布托。
Translation: The Government of Pakistan has specially dispatched Foreign Minister Zulfikar Ali Bhutto.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条鉴于中国新疆和由巴基斯坦实际控制其防务的各个地区相接壤的边界从未正式划定，双方同意，这段边界以传统习惯边界线为基础，并参照自然地形，本着平等互利、友好合作的精神予以划定。
Translation: Article 1 The two Parties have agreed that the boundary between China's Sinkiang and the contiguous areas the defence of which is under the actual control of Pakistan shall be formally delimited in detail on the basis of the traditional customary boundary line including natural features and in a spirit of equality, mutual benefit and friendly cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: （一）自西北端的5630米高地（参考坐标大约为东经74°34′、北纬37°03′的一个山峰）起，边界线严格沿流入塔里木河水系的塔什科老干河诸支流为一方、流入印度河水系的洪札河诸支流为另一方的大分水岭，大体向东转东南行，穿过基里克达坂（达旺）、明铁盖达坂（山口）、卡前乃达坂（仅中方图上有此名），并且穿过木子吉里阿达坂（仅中方图上有此名）、帕皮克山口（仅巴方图上有此名），直到红其拉甫（尤特尔）达坂（山口）。
Translation: (1) From the 5,630-meter-high peak at the northwestern extremity (a mountain with approximate coordinates of 74°34′ east longitude and 37°03′ north latitude), the boundary strictly follows the major watershed separating the tributaries of the Tashkurgan River, which flows into the Tarim River system, on one side, and the tributaries of the Hunza River, which flows into the Indus River system, on the other. It generally runs eastward and then southeastward, passing through the Kilik Pass (Dawang), Mintaka Pass, Qaqanai Pass (marked only on Chinese maps), Muztagh Ata Pass (marked only on Chinese maps), and Papik Pass (marked only on Pakistani maps), until reaching the Khunjerab (Yutr) Pass.

Query_Text_cn: （二）边界线穿过红其拉甫（尤特尔）达坂（山口）以后，沿上述大分水岭大体南行，直到该达坂（山口）以南的一个峰顶；然后离开大分水岭，转沿一条大体东南向的山脊而行；该山脊系以阿克吉勒尕河（巴方图上的一条相当的无名小河）为一方、塔敦巴什河（吾甫浪河）和克里满河（吾甫浪吉勒尕河）为另一方的分水岭。
Translation: (2) From the Khunjerab (Yutr) Pass, the boundary line runs generally southward along the aforementioned major watershed to a peak south of the pass; it then departs from the major watershed and turns to follow a ridge running generally southeastward. This ridge serves as the watershed between the Akjilga River (a similarly unnamed small stream on the Pakistani map) on one side and the Tadumbash (Oprang) River and Kiliman (Oprangjilga) River on the other.

Query_Text_cn: 根据巴方图，边界线离此山脊东南端后，即连接什克干河或穆斯塔格河的锐角弯曲处。
Translation: According to the Pakistani map, the boundary line, after leaving the southeastern end of this ridge, connects to the acute angle bend of the Shaksgam River or the Mustagh River.

Query_Text_cn: （三）从上述地点起，边界线溯克勒青河（什克斯干河或穆斯塔格河）的河床中心线而上，至其与消布拉克代牙（星峡尔河或布拉尔杜河）的汇合处（参考坐标大约为东经76°02′、北纬36°26′）。
Translation: (3) From the aforementioned point, the boundary line ascends along the thalweg of the Keleqing River (Shaksgam River or Mustagh River) to its confluence with the Xiaobulake Daiya River (Shingshal River or Braldu River) (approximate reference coordinates: longitude 76°02′ east, latitude 36°26′ north).

Query_Text_cn: 根据巴方图，边界线从上述两河的汇合处起，升上相应的支脉、沿其山脊穿过6520米（21390英尺）高地，直到约东经75°57′、北纬36°03′接喀喇昆仑山脉大分水岭。
Translation: According to the Pakistani map, the boundary line starts from the confluence of the aforementioned two rivers, ascends the corresponding branch range, follows its ridge through the 6,520-meter (21,390-foot) high point, and connects to the main watershed of the Karakoram Range at approximately longitude 75°57′ east and latitude 36°03′ north.
