Query_Text_cn: （五）自此，边界线严格沿划分塔里木河水系和印度河水系的喀喇昆仑山脉大分水岭大体先向南后向东行，穿过东木斯塔山口（穆斯塔山口）、乔戈里峰（K2）的峰顶、布洛阿特峰的峰顶、加舒尔布鲁木山（8068）的山顶、因地拉科里山口（仅中方图上有此名）和特拉木坎力峰的峰顶，至东南端终点喀喇昆仑山口。
Translation: (v) From there, the boundary line strictly follows the main watershed of the Karakoram Range, which divides the Tarim River system from the Indus River system, generally running first southward and then eastward. It passes through the Dongmuztagh Pass (Mustagh Pass), the summit of Chogori (K2), the summit of Broad Peak, the summit of Gasherbrum I (8068), the Indirakoli Pass (a name found only on Chinese maps), and the summit of Teram Kangri, reaching its southeastern terminus at the Karakoram Pass.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述的全部边界线，已标绘在比例尺为一百万分之一的中方的中文图和巴方的英文图上，该图由双方签署，附入本协定。
Translation: II. The entire boundary line described in Paragraph 1 of this Article has been delineated on the Chinese-language map of the Chinese side and the English-language map of the Pakistani side, both at a scale of 1:1,000,000. These maps, signed by both Parties, are annexed to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、鉴于双方图上所显示的地形不尽相同，双方同意上述第一款所叙述的边界线位置和走向，应以实际地形为准，并将尽可能地由联合实地勘测加以确定。
Translation: III. In view of the discrepancies between the topographical features as shown on the maps of the two sides, it is agreed that the location and alignment of the boundary line described in Article I above shall be based on the actual terrain and shall, as far as possible, be determined by joint field surveys.

Query_Text_cn: 二、凡是以达坂（山口）为界的地点，以分水线为界。
Translation: II. For locations demarcated by mountain passes (cols), the boundary shall follow the watershed line.

Query_Text_cn: 一、双方同意尽速成立一个联合标界委员会。
Translation: 1. Both sides agreed to promptly establish a joint boundary demarcation committee.

Query_Text_cn: 每方将指派主席一人、代表一人或数人、顾问及技术人员若干人。
Translation: Each party shall appoint one chairperson, one or more representatives, and a number of advisers and technical personnel.

Query_Text_cn: （一）对本协定第二条所述的边界地区进行必要的实地勘察，以便在双方认为合适的地方，树立界桩，并且在联合制作的精确地图上画出边界线。
Translation: (1) Conduct necessary on-site surveys in the border areas described in Article 2 of this Agreement to erect boundary markers at locations deemed appropriate by both parties and delineate the boundary line on jointly prepared accurate maps.

Query_Text_cn: （二）草拟一项议定书，详细载明整个边界线的走向和全部界桩的位置，并且制印出标明界线和界桩位置的详图，附入该议定书。
Translation: (2) Draft a protocol detailing the alignment of the entire boundary line and the locations of all boundary markers, and produce detailed maps indicating the boundary line and the positions of the boundary markers to be annexed to the protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述议定书经两国政府代表签订后，即成为本协定的附件，该项详图将代替本协定的附图。
Translation: II. The aforementioned protocol, upon being signed by the representatives of the two governments, shall become an annex to this Agreement, and the detailed maps therein shall replace the attached maps of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在上述议定书签订后，联合标界委员会的任务即告终止。
Translation: III. Upon the signing of the aforementioned protocol, the mandate of the Joint Boundary Demarcation Committee shall be terminated.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条双方同意，两国间实际存在的边界划定以后，如果发生任何边界争议，应由双方通过友好协商，和平解决。
Translation: Article 5 The two Parties agree that after the settlement of the boundary question between the two countries, any dispute concerning the boundary shall be settled peacefully by the two Parties through friendly consultations.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条双方同意，在巴基斯坦和印度关于克什米尔的争议获得解决以后，有关的主权当局将就本协定第二条所述的边界，同中华人民共和国政府重新进行谈判，以签订一个正式的边界条约来代替本协定，该主权当局如系巴基斯坦，则在中华人民共和国和巴基斯坦将签订的正式边界条约中，应该保持本协定和上述议定书中的规定。
Translation: Article VI The two Parties have agreed that after the settlement of the dispute between Pakistan and India over Kashmir, the sovereign authority concerned will reopen negotiations with the Government of the People's Republic of China on the boundary as described in Article II of the present Agreement so as to sign a formal boundary treaty to replace the present Agreement, provided that in the event of that sovereign authority being Pakistan, the provisions of the present Agreement and of the aforesaid Protocol shall be maintained in the formal boundary treaty to be signed between the People's Republic of China and Pakistan.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation: Article 7 This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于1963年3月2日在北京签订，共两份，每份都用中文和英文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Beijing on March 2, 1963, in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: (七)“非运输业务性经停”,指目的不在于装上或卸下旅客、行李、货物或邮件的降停。
Translation: (g) "Non-traffic stop" means a landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers, baggage, cargo or mail.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线上建立和经营定期航班的权利,此类航线和航班以下分别称为“规定航线”和“协议航班”。
Translation:
Article 2  
1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights to establish and operate scheduled air services on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement. Such routes and services shall hereinafter be referred to as "specified routes" and "agreed services," respectively.

Query_Text_cn: (三)在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点经停,以便上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (c) To make stops at points in the territory of the other Contracting Party on the specified routes for the purpose of embarking and disembarking international passengers, baggage, cargo and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条一、缔约一方有权通过外交途径向缔约另一方指定一家在本协定附件规定航线上经营协议航班的空运企业。
Translation:
Article 3  

1. Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate, through diplomatic channels, an airline to operate the agreed services on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在不违反本条第二款规定的情况下,缔约另一方在收到上述指定后,应毫不延误地给予该空运企业以合适的经营许可。
Translation: 3. Upon receipt of such designation and without delay, the other Contracting Party shall grant the appropriate operating authorization to the designated airline, provided that the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article are complied with.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约另一方航空当局可要求缔约一方指定空运企业向它证明,该空运企业有资格履行根据法律和规章所制定的条件,这些法律和规章是上述当局在经营航班方面所通常和合理地予以实施的。
Translation: 4. The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party to demonstrate that it is qualified to fulfill the conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied by such authorities in the operation of international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 五、空运企业按照上述条件一经指定和批准,即可开始经营协议航班。
Translation: V. Once designated and approved under the aforementioned conditions, the air transport enterprise may commence operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规章,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规章,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和该机所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article 5 The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, departure from and stay within its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as those pertaining to passengers, crew, baggage, cargo and mail entering, leaving or transiting its territory, shall apply to the aircraft, crew and the passengers, baggage, cargo and mail carried by such aircraft of the air transport enterprise designated by the other Contracting Party while in the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、缔约任何一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机,以及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料(包括液压油)、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草),在进出缔约另一方领土时,应豁免一切关税、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation:
Article 6  

1. The aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of either Contracting Party on the agreed services along the specified routes, together with their normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, oils (including hydraulic fluids), lubricants, and aircraft stores (including food, beverages, and tobacco) retained on board such aircraft, shall be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other similar charges upon entering or leaving the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (三)在缔约一方领土内为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机加注的燃料、油料(包括液压油)和润滑油,即使这些燃料、油料(包括液压油)和润滑油系供在缔约一方领土内的航段上使用。
Translation: (3) Fuels, oils (including hydraulic fluids), and lubricants supplied within the territory of one Contracting Party for aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party on agreed services, even when such fuels, oils (including hydraulic fluids), and lubricants are to be used on a sector of the route within the territory of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条留置在缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机上的本协定第六条所指的机上正常设备、物资和供应品,经缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: Article 7 The normal equipment, materials and supplies referred to in Article 6 of this Agreement on board the aircraft of the designated airline of one Contracting Party operating the agreed services may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 遇此情况,上述物品应交缔约另一方海关当局监管,并应缴纳公平合理的保管费用,直至重新运出,或根据该海关当局规定另作处理。
Translation: In such cases, the aforementioned items shall be placed under the supervision of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party and shall be subject to fair and reasonable storage fees until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the regulations of the said customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条一、对缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机所载的直接过境缔约另一方领土的旅客、行李、货物和邮件,只需办理最少的手续。
Translation:
Article 8  
1. The aircraft of an airline designated by one Contracting Party operating the agreed services and carrying passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail in direct transit across the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be subject to only minimal formalities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、直接过境的行李、货物和邮件中需纳税的物品,应豁免关税和其他类似税捐或费用。
Translation: II. Articles subject to duty in baggage, goods and mail in direct transit shall be exempt from customs duties and other similar taxes or charges.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条一、缔约一方应在其领土内为缔约另一方指定空运企业指定供经营航线所使用的机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务,具体办法由缔约双方航空当局另行商定。
Translation:
Article 9  

1. Each Contracting Party shall designate airports and alternate airports within its territory for use by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the agreed services, and shall provide the necessary communications, navigational, meteorological, and other auxiliary services required for the operation of the agreed flights. The specific arrangements shall be separately agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设备和技术服务,应按缔约另一方有关当局所规定的公平合理的费率服务,应按缔约另一方有关当局所规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: II. When a designated airline of one Contracting Party uses the airports, equipment and technical services of the other Contracting Party, it shall be charged at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the competent authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 这些费率不应高于从事国际航班飞行的其他国家空运企业所付的费率。
Translation: These rates shall not be higher than those paid by air transport enterprises of other countries engaged in international flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条一、缔约双方指定空运企业在经营规定航线上的协议航班方面,应享有合理和平等的机会。
Translation:
Article 10  
1. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、有关班次、机型、飞行时刻表、加班飞行、运输章程、业务代理事项和其他经营协议航班的事项,应由缔约双方指定空运企业协商确定,并应经缔约双方各自的航空当局同意。
Translation: II. Matters concerning flight frequencies, aircraft types, flight schedules, extra flights, transportation regulations, business agency arrangements, and other operational aspects of the agreed services shall be determined through consultations between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and shall be subject to the approval of their respective aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在经营协议航班方面,缔约一方指定空运企业应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益,以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线或其航段上所提供的航班。
Translation: III. In operating the agreed services, the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services provided by the latter on the same route or any segment thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班,应与公众对规定航线上的运输需要保持密切的关系,其主要目的应是按合理的载运比率提供足够的运力,以满足当时和合理地预计到的、由指定空运企业的缔约方领土内始发或以该领土为终点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输需要。
Translation: IV. The agreed services operated by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties shall bear a close relationship to the requirements of the public for transportation on the specified routes. The primary objective shall be to provide adequate capacity to meet the current and reasonably anticipated demands for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo and mail originating in or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline, at a reasonable load factor.

Query_Text_cn: (三)联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The operational needs of interline flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条一、缔约一方指定空运企业对前往或来自缔约另一方领土的运输所收取的运价,应在合理的水平上制定,并适当照顾到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation:
Article 11  
1. The tariffs to be charged by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party for carriage to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being paid to all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, and the tariffs of other airlines.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价应由缔约双方指定空运企业商定。
Translation: 2. The tariffs referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如合适,应与在该航线或其航段上经营的其他空运企业进行协商。
Translation: If appropriate, consultation should be conducted with other air transport enterprises operating on the same route or segment thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 三、上述商定的运价至少应在其拟议实行之日九十天前提交缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: III. The agreed tariffs mentioned above shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties for approval at least ninety days prior to the proposed date of their introduction.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下,经上述当局协议,这一限期可予缩短。
Translation: Under special circumstances, this time limit may be shortened upon agreement by the aforementioned authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条第三款所述的批准必须明确地给予。
Translation: 4. The approval referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article must be explicitly granted.

Query_Text_cn: 如在根据本条第三款规定提交运价之日起三十天内,任何一方航空当局均未对运价提出异议,这些运价应认为已被批准。
Translation: If within thirty (30) days from the date of submission of tariffs in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article, neither aeronautical authority has raised objections to the tariffs, such tariffs shall be deemed approved.

Query_Text_cn: 如根据第三款的规定,缩短了提交期限,双方航空当局可以另行商定,通知异议的期限应少于三十天。
Translation: If the submission deadline is shortened pursuant to paragraph 3,the aeronautical authorities of both parties may mutually agree to reduce the period for notifying objections to less than thirty days.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如缔约双方指定空运企业未能根据本条第二款规定就运价达成协议,或缔约一方航空当局对根据本条第二款规定所商定的运价,向缔约另一方航空当局发出异议通知,缔约双方航空当局应设法相互协商,确定运价。
Translation: 5. If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on tariffs in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article, or if the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party notify the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party of their objection to the tariffs agreed upon under paragraph 2 of this Article, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to mutually consult and determine the tariffs.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款规定向其提交的任何运价达成协议,或未能根据本条第五款规定就运价的确定达成协议,此项分歧应按照本协定第十六条规定予以解决。
Translation: VI. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph 3 of this Article, or fail to determine a tariff under paragraph 5 of this Article, such disagreement shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article XVI of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 七、在新运价制定以前,根据本条各项规定制定的运价应继续有效。
Translation: VII. Until the new tariffs are established, the tariffs formulated in accordance with the provisions of this Article shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约一方给予缔约另一方指定空运企业以自由结汇其在缔约一方领土内的收支余额的权利。
Translation: Article 12 Each Contracting Party shall grant the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party the right to freely convert and remit its revenues and balances within the territory of the former.

Query_Text_cn: 此项结汇应以可兑换的货币,按结汇时采用的外汇比价办理。
Translation: The settlement of exchange shall be conducted in convertible currencies at the applicable exchange rate prevailing at the time of settlement.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条缔约一方航空当局应按缔约另一方航空当局的要求,向其提供缔约一方指定空运企业在协议航班上所载来自或前往缔约另一方领土的业务统计。
Translation: Article 13 The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide statistical data on the traffic carried by the designated airline(s) of the former Contracting Party on the agreed services to or from the territory of the latter Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线上的协议航班,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点设立代表机构。
Translation:
Article 14  

1. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish representative offices in the territory of the other Contracting Party at the points on the specified routes for the operation of agreed services on the designated routes.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国和/或大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国的国民,其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: The personnel representing the agency shall be nationals of the People's Republic of China and/or the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, the number of whom shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构人员应受驻在国的现行法律和规章的管辖。
Translation: Personnel of representative offices shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the existing laws and regulations of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约各方应采取一切必要的措施,为本条第一款所述的代表机构的建立和工作提供便利和协助。
Translation: II. The Contracting Parties shall take all necessary measures to facilitate and assist in the establishment and functioning of the representative offices referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应尽最大努力保护在其领土内的缔约另一方的空运企业的经营及其人员的安全。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall exert its utmost efforts to protect the operation of the air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party and the safety of their personnel within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的空勤组成员,应分别为本国国民。
Translation: 4. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall ensure that the flight crew members operating on the agreed routes are nationals of their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方指定空运企业如欲使用第三国国民作为飞行协议航班的空勤组成员,应通过外交途径事先取得缔约另一方同意。
Translation: If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to employ nationals of a third country as crew members for flights on the agreed services, it shall obtain prior consent from the other Contracting Party through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条缔约双方重申对危害航空器安全的行为或威胁的严重关切,因为这些行为或威胁危及人员或财产的安全,影响航班的经营,损害公众对民用航空安全的信心。
Translation: Article 15 The Contracting Parties reaffirm their grave concern over acts or threats that jeopardize the safety of aircraft, as such acts or threats endanger the security of persons and property, affect the operation of flights, and undermine public confidence in the safety of civil aviation.

Query_Text_cn: 为了防止劫机和破坏航空器、机场、导航设备,并使航空安全免遭威胁,缔约双方同意相互提供任何必要的援助。
Translation: To prevent hijacking and sabotage of aircraft, airports, and navigation equipment, and to safeguard aviation security from threats, the Contracting Parties agree to provide each other with any necessary assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 当发生劫机或破坏航空器、机场或导航设备的事件或威胁时,缔约双方应相互协助,提供联系的方便,使这种事件迅速而安全地结束。
Translation: In the event of a hijacking or an act or threat of sabotage against aircraft, airports, or navigation facilities, the Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications to ensure a swift and safe resolution of such incidents.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约一方要求为其航空器或旅客采取特殊安全保卫措施以对付某一威胁,缔约另一方对此应给予同情的考虑。
Translation: If one Contracting Party requests special security measures for its aircraft or passengers to counter a specific threat, the other Contracting Party shall give sympathetic consideration to such request.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条一、缔约双方应本着密切合作和相互支持的精神,保证本协定的各项规定的正确实施和满意的遵守。
Translation:
Article 16  
1. The Contracting Parties shall ensure the correct implementation and satisfactory observance of all provisions of this Agreement in a spirit of close cooperation and mutual support.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约任何一方可要求与缔约另一方进行协商,这一协商可以口头或书面进行,并应在收到要求之日起六十天内进行,除非缔约双方同意延长这一期限。
Translation: 2. Either Contracting Party may request consultations with the other Contracting Party. Such consultations may be conducted orally or in writing and shall take place within sixty days from the date of receipt of the request, unless the Contracting Parties agree to extend this period.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧。如合适,缔约双方指定空运企业本着友好合作和相互谅解的精神,设法直接通过协商予以解决。
Translation: 3. In the event of any disagreement concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to resolve the matter directly through mutual consultation in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding, where appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条一、缔约任何一方如认为需要修改或补充本协定或其附件的任何规定,可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商,这一协商可以口头或以书面进行,并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起六十天内进行,除非缔约双方同意延长这一期限。
Translation:
Article 17  

1. Either Contracting Party may, if it deems necessary, request consultations with the other Contracting Party at any time to amend or supplement any provision of this Agreement or its annexes. Such consultations may be conducted orally or in writing and shall commence within sixty (60) days from the date the other Contracting Party receives the request, unless both Parties agree to extend this period.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对协定的任何修改或补充在通过外交途径换文确认后生效,但本条第三款所规定的情况除外。
Translation: II. Any amendment or supplement to this Agreement shall enter into force upon confirmation through an exchange of diplomatic notes, except as provided for in paragraph 3 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方航空当局可协商对本协定的附件作出修改或补充,此项修改可临时实施,并应尽快通过外交途径换文予以确认。
Translation: III. The aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties may consult to amend or supplement the Annexes to this Agreement. Such amendments may be implemented provisionally and shall be confirmed as soon as possible through an exchange of diplomatic notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条缔约一方可随时将终止本协定的决定通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 18 Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its decision to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 在缔约另一方接到通知之日起十二个月后本协定即告终止,除非在这一期限未满前经缔约另一方同意,缔约一方撤回这一终止通知。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date on which the notice is received by the other Contracting Party, unless the notice of termination is withdrawn by one Contracting Party with the consent of the other before the expiration of this period.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation: Article 19 This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经其各自政府正式授权，已在本协定上签字为证。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, duly authorized by their respective Governments, have signed this Agreement as evidence thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七九年十一月一日在伦敦签订，共两份，每份都用中文和英文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in London on the first day of November 1979 in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 北京——拉瓦品第或卡拉奇——印度境内一个地点——海湾地区一个地点——德黑兰——布加勒斯特——雅典——罗马——苏黎世——法兰克福——巴黎——伦敦。
Translation: Beijing—Rawalpindi or Karachi—a location in India—a location in the Gulf region—Tehran—Bucharest—Athens—Rome—Zurich—Frankfurt—Paris—London.

Query_Text_cn: 注：（一）任何一次或所有飞行均可不经停任何一点或多点，但是，协议航班须在中国领土内的一点始发。
Translation: Note: (a) Any or all flights may omit stopping at any point or points, provided that the agreed services originate at a point within the territory of China.

Query_Text_cn: 应将不经停一事尽早通知联合王国指定空运企业。
Translation: The designated air transport enterprise of the United Kingdom should be notified at the earliest opportunity regarding the non-stop flight arrangement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）任何一次飞行所经停的缔约双方领土以外的中间经停点，不得多于两个。
Translation: (2) No more than two intermediate stops outside the territories of the Contracting Parties shall be made on any flight.

Query_Text_cn: （三）任何一次飞行在欧洲只能经停一个地点。
Translation: (3) No flight within Europe may have more than one stopover.

Query_Text_cn: 伦敦——罗马——德黑兰——巴林——迪拜——阿曼——科威特——拉瓦品第或卡拉奇——孟买——德里——加尔各答——北京。
Translation: London—Rome—Tehran—Bahrain—Dubai—Oman—Kuwait—Rawalpindi or Karachi—Mumbai—Delhi—Kolkata—Beijing.

Query_Text_cn: 注：（一）任何一次或所有飞行均可不经停任何一点或多点，但是，协议航班须在联合王国领土内的一点始发。
Translation: Note: (a) Any or all flights may omit stopping at any point or points, provided that the agreed services originate at a point in the territory of the United Kingdom.

Query_Text_cn: 应将不经停一事尽早通知中国指定空运企业。
Translation: The non-stop arrangement should be notified to the designated Chinese air carrier at the earliest opportunity.

Query_Text_cn: （三）任何一次飞行在海湾地区和印度分别只能经停一个地点。
Translation: (3) Each flight may only make one stopover in the Gulf region and one in India respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 二、不定期飞行缔约任何一方的任何空运企业可向缔约另一方有关当局提出要求，飞行前往或来自另一方领土的包机。
Translation:
II. Non-Scheduled Flights  
Any air transport enterprise of either Contracting Party may, upon application to the competent authorities of the other Contracting Party, operate charter flights to or from the territory of the other Party.

Query_Text_cn: 受理要求的当局应根据其包机规则，采用对等的原则，迅速考虑此项要求。
Translation: The competent authority receiving the request shall promptly consider it in accordance with the principle of reciprocity under its charter flight regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条、第六条、第七条、第九条、第十二条、第十四条第三、四款、第十五条。
在缔约一方的领土内，缔约另一方的投资者依据缔约一方的法律法规，并通过其实际拥有或控制的缔约一方的公司所作的投资应同样视为缔约另一方投资者所作的投资。
Translation: Investments made by investors of either Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party through companies that are actually owned or controlled by the former, in accordance with the laws and regulations of the latter, shall be accorded treatment as investments of investors of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （二）按照缔约一方的法律法规设立和组成，在该缔约方领土内具有住所的法律实体，包括公司、社团、合伙和其他组织。
Translation: (2) Legal entities established and constituted in accordance with the laws and regulations of one Contracting Party, having their seats within the territory of that Contracting Party, including corporations, associations, partnerships and other organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“收益”一词系指由投资所产生的款项，如利润、股息、利息、资本利得、提成费和其他合法收入。
Translation: III. The term "returns" means the amounts yielded by an investment, such as profits, dividends, interest, capital gains, royalties and other lawful income.

Query_Text_cn: 四、“领土”一词系指缔约一方的领土，包括领土、领海及其领空，以及缔约一方根据其国内法和国际法，在其领海以外行使主权和／或管辖权的专属经济区和大陆架。
Translation: 4. The term "territory" means the territory of either Contracting Party, including the territorial land, territorial sea and territorial airspace thereof, as well as the exclusive economic zone and continental shelf over which the Contracting Party exercises sovereignty and/or jurisdiction beyond its territorial sea in accordance with its domestic laws and international law.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方应鼓励在其境内投资的缔约另一方投资者，并为其创造有利条件，并依照其法律和法规接受这种投资。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall encourage investors of the other Contracting Party to make investments in its territory and create favorable conditions for such investments, which shall be admitted in accordance with its laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方投资者在缔约另一方境内的投资应享受持续的保护和安全。
Translation: 2. Investments made by investors of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall enjoy constant protection and security.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方不得对缔约另一方投资者在其境内投资的管理、维持、使用、享有和处分采取任何不合理的或歧视性的措施。
Translation: III. Neither Contracting Party shall adopt any unreasonable or discriminatory measures against the management, maintenance, use, enjoyment, or disposal of investments made by investors of the other Contracting Party within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方应依据其法律和法规，对在其境内从事与投资有关活动的缔约另一方国民获得签证和工作许可的申请给予善意的考虑。
Translation: IV. Each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its laws and regulations, give sympathetic consideration to applications for visas and work permits by nationals of the other Contracting Party who engage in activities related to investments within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方的投资者在缔约另一方的境内的投资应始终享受公平与公正的待遇。
Translation: 1. Investments made by investors of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall at all times be accorded fair and equitable treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应给予缔约另一方投资者在其境内的投资及与投资有关活动不低于其给予本国投资者的投资及与投资有关活动的待遇。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall accord to investments and activities associated with investments by investors of the other Contracting Party treatment no less favorable than that accorded to investments and associated activities by its own investors.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方给予缔约另一方投资者在其境内的投资及与投资有关活动的待遇，不应低于其给予任何第三国投资者的投资及与投资有关活动的待遇。
Translation: III. Each Contracting Party shall accord to investments and activities associated with such investments by investors of the other Contracting Party treatment no less favorable than that accorded to investments and associated activities by investors of any third State.

Query_Text_cn: （三）任何便利边境地区小规模贸易的安排。
Translation: (3) Any arrangements facilitating small-scale trade in border areas.

Query_Text_cn: （四）并且给予补偿。
Translation: (4) and compensation shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述的补偿，应等于采取征收或即将采取的征收为公众所知的前一刻被征收投资的市场价值，以在先者为准。
Translation: II. The compensation referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be equivalent to the market value of the expropriated investment immediately before the expropriation or impending expropriation became publicly known, whichever is earlier.

Query_Text_cn: 该价值的确定应根据普遍承认的估价原则。
Translation: The determination of such value shall be based on generally recognized valuation principles.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿应不迟延地支付，并应可有效地兑换和自由转移。
Translation: Compensation shall be paid without undue delay and be effectively realizable and freely transferable.

Query_Text_cn: 三、受影响的投资者应有权依据征收方的法律要求该缔约方的司法机构或其他独立机构根据本条条款的规定迅速审查该案件，包括其投资的价值和补偿的支付。
Translation: III. Affected investors shall have the right to request, under the laws of the expropriating Party, that the judicial or other independent authorities of that Party promptly review the case in accordance with the provisions of this Article, including the valuation of their investments and the payment of compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方的投资者在缔约另一方领土内的投资，如果由于缔约后者一方领土内的战争、全国紧急状态、起义、骚乱或其他相似情形而遭受损失，缔约后者一方在恢复、赔偿、补偿和其他解决措施方面给予该投资者的待遇不应低于其给予本国或任何第三国投资者待遇，并从优适用。
Translation: 1. Should an investor of one Contracting Party suffer losses in its investments in the territory of the other Contracting Party due to war, a state of national emergency, insurrection, riot or other similar events in the latter's territory, the latter Contracting Party shall accord to such investor treatment no less favorable than that accorded to its own investors or those of any third country with respect to restitution, indemnification, compensation and other remedial measures, and the most favorable treatment shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约另一方应给予该投资者恢复原状或补偿。
Translation: The other contracting party shall provide the investor with restitution or compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 由此导致的支付不应迟延，并可自由转移。
Translation: Payments resulting therefrom shall not be delayed and shall be freely transferable.

Query_Text_cn: （七）在缔约一方的境内从事与投资有关活动的外国雇员获得的收入。
Translation: (7) Income earned by foreign employees engaged in investment-related activities within the territory of one Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约任何一方应允许缔约另一方的投资者依据第四条和第五条获得的补偿和其他赔偿的自由转移。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall permit the free transfer of compensation and other payments obtained by investors of the other Contracting Party pursuant to Articles IV and V.

Query_Text_cn: 三、上述转移应以可自由兑换的货币按照转移当日接受投资的缔约一方通行的市场汇率不迟延地进行。
Translation: III. The aforementioned transfers shall be made in a freely convertible currency at the prevailing market exchange rate of the Contracting Party receiving the investment on the date of transfer without undue delay.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约前者一方或其指定机构有权在与投资者同等限度内代位行使该投资者的权利及进行索偿。
Translation: (2) The former contracting party or its designated agency shall have the right to exercise subrogation of the investor's rights and claims to the same extent as the investor.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方对本协定的解释或适用所产生的争议应尽可能通过外交途径协商解决。
Translation: 1. Any dispute arising from the interpretation or application of this Agreement between the Contracting Parties shall be settled as far as possible through consultations via diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如争议在六个月内不能解决，根据缔约任何一方的要求，应将争议提交专设仲裁庭解决。
Translation: II. If the dispute cannot be settled within six months, it shall be submitted, at the request of either party, to an ad hoc arbitral tribunal for resolution.

Query_Text_cn: 三、该仲裁庭由三名仲裁员组成。
Translation: III. The arbitral tribunal shall be composed of three arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 在随后的两个月内，该两名仲裁员应共同推举一名与缔约双方均有外交关系的第三国之国民为仲裁庭首席仲裁员。
Translation: Within the following two months, the two arbitrators shall jointly appoint a third arbitrator, who shall be a national of a third state having diplomatic relations with both Contracting Parties, as the presiding arbitrator of the tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果自收到要求仲裁的书面通知的四个月内尚未组成仲裁庭，又无任何其他协议，缔约任何一方可请求国际法院院长作出必要的指派，如院长是缔约任何一方国民，或因其他原因不能履行此项职责，则应请求非缔约任何一方国民的国际法院最资深法官作出必要的任命。
Translation: IV. If the arbitral tribunal has not been constituted within four months from the receipt of the written notice requesting arbitration, and in the absence of any other agreement, either Contracting Party may request the President of the International Court of Justice to make the necessary appointments. Should the President be a national of either Contracting Party or unable to discharge this function for any other reason, the most senior judge of the International Court of Justice who is not a national of either Contracting Party shall be requested to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭应根据本协定的规定和被普遍认可的国际法原则作出裁决。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall make its award in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement and the generally recognized principles of international law.

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约双方应负担各自指派的仲裁员和出席仲裁程序的有关费用。
Translation: 7. Each Contracting Party shall bear the costs of its appointed arbitrator and those related to its participation in the arbitration proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方投资者应将其与缔约另一方之间就其在缔约另一方境内投资产生的任何争议书面通知缔约另一方，该争议应尽可能由争议双方当事人友好解决。
Translation: 1. An investor of one Contracting Party shall notify in writing the other Contracting Party of any dispute arising from its investment in the territory of the other Contracting Party. Such dispute shall, as far as possible, be settled amicably between the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: （三）根据联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则设立的专设仲裁庭。
Translation: (3) An ad hoc arbitral tribunal established under the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules.

Query_Text_cn: 一旦该投资者将争议递交给作为争议一方的缔约方国内有管辖权的法院，或者“解决投资争端国际中心”，或者根据联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则设立的专设仲裁庭，则其三选一的选择将是终局的。
Translation: Once the investor submits the dispute to a competent court in the territory of the contracting party that is a party to the dispute, the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes, or an ad hoc arbitral tribunal established under the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules, its choice among these three options shall be final.

Query_Text_cn: 三、仲裁庭应适用作为争议当事方的缔约一方包括其冲突法规则在内的法律，本协定的规定以及被普遍接受的国际法原则。
Translation: III. The arbitral tribunal shall apply the law of the Contracting Party that is a party to the dispute, including its conflict-of-law rules, the provisions of this Agreement, and the generally accepted principles of international law.

Query_Text_cn: 四、仲裁庭的裁决是终局的，对争议当事双方具有拘束力。
Translation: IV. The arbitral award shall be final and binding upon both parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如果缔约任何一方的立法或缔约双方之间现存或在本协定后根据国际法设立的义务，含有使缔约另一方投资者的投资享受比本协定的规定更优惠待遇的规定，该规定在其更优惠的范围内应比本协定优先适用。
Translation: 1. If the legislation of either Contracting Party or existing obligations between the Contracting Parties, or those established hereafter under international law, contain provisions granting investments by investors of the other Contracting Party treatment more favorable than that provided for in this Agreement, such provisions shall, to the extent more favorable, prevail over this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约任何一方应恪守其就缔约另一方投资者在其境内的投资所承诺的任何义务。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall observe any obligation it has assumed with respect to investments of investors of the other Contracting Party in its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定应适用于缔约任何一方投资者在缔约另一方境内依照缔约另一方法律法规于本协定生效前或生效后作出的投资。
Translation: This Agreement shall apply to investments made by investors of either Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party in accordance with the laws and regulations of the latter, whether made before or after the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定替代并废止了一九九二年二月六日在马德里签订的《中华人民共和国与西班牙王国关于相互鼓励和保护投资协定》。
Translation: 1. This Agreement supersedes and terminates the Agreement between the People's Republic of China and the Kingdom of Spain on the Reciprocal Promotion and Protection of Investments, signed in Madrid on 6 February 1992.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定应适用在其生效之前或之后缔约任何一方投资者在缔约另一方领土内进行的所有投资，但是，不适用任何在本协定生效之前已经进入司法或仲裁程序的与投资有关的争议或请求。
Translation: II. This Agreement shall apply to all investments made by investors of either Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party, whether before or after its entry into force. However, it shall not apply to any investment-related disputes or claims that have already been submitted to judicial or arbitral proceedings prior to the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 该争议或请求应当继续依照本条第一款所述的一九九二年协定的规定解决。
Translation: The dispute or request shall continue to be resolved in accordance with the provisions of the 1992 Agreement referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方可以向缔约另一方提议就与本协定的解释、适用和执行有关的任何事宜进行磋商。
Translation: Either Contracting Party may propose to the other Party to hold consultations on any matter concerning the interpretation, application or implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约另一方应对此提议给予善意的考虑并给予适当的机会进行磋商。
Translation: The other contracting party shall give sympathetic consideration to this proposal and afford adequate opportunity for consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定自缔约双方完成各自国内必要法律程序并以书面形式相互通知之日起下一个月的第一天开始生效，有效期为十年。
Translation: 1. This Agreement shall enter into force on the first day of the month following the date on which the Contracting Parties have notified each other in writing of the completion of their respective domestic legal procedures, and shall remain in force for a period of ten years.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果缔约任何一方未在本条第一款规定的第一个有效期届满前一年书面通知缔约另一方终止本协定，本协定将继续有效。
Translation: II. If neither Contracting Party notifies the other in writing of its intention to terminate this Agreement at least one year before the expiration of the first period specified in paragraph 1 of this Article, this Agreement shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本协定第一个十年有效期届满后，缔约任何一方可随时终止本协定，但至少应提前一年书面通知缔约另一方。
Translation: III. Upon the expiration of the initial ten-year term of this Agreement, either Party may terminate it at any time by providing written notice to the other Party at least one year in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对本协定终止之日前所作出的投资，本协定第一条至第十三条的规定应自本协定终止之日起继续适用十年。
Translation: IV. The provisions of Articles I to XIII of this Agreement shall continue to apply for a period of ten years from the date of its termination to investments made prior to the termination of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于二○○五年十一月十四日在马德里签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、西班牙文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Madrid on 14 November 2005 in duplicate in the Chinese, Spanish and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 关于第一条投资收益和再投资应当享有和投资同等的保护。
Translation: With respect to the first provision, investment returns and reinvestments shall enjoy the same protection as the original investment.

Query_Text_cn: （三）对第（一）项所述的任何不符措施的修正，只要这种修正不增加该措施在修正前存在的不符程度。
Translation: (3) Any amendment to a non-conforming measure referred to in subparagraph (1), provided that the amendment does not increase the level of non-conformity of the measure as it existed prior to the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国将采取所有适宜措施逐渐消除这些不符措施。
Translation: The People's Republic of China will take all appropriate measures to progressively eliminate these non-conforming measures.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第三条并不要求缔约一方有将其依照税法只给予住所在本国境内的投资者的税收优惠、免税或减税待遇，扩大到住所在缔约另一方境内的投资者的义务。
Translation: Article 3, Paragraph 2 does not obligate a Contracting Party to extend the tax preferences, exemptions, or reductions granted under its tax laws exclusively to investors domiciled within its territory to those domiciled in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 关于第六条一、在中华人民共和国方面，本协定第六条第一款所指的转移，应当符合中国有关汇兑管制的法律和法规所规定的手续。
Translation:
Regarding Article 6  

1. With respect to the People's Republic of China, the transfers referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 6 of this Agreement shall comply with the procedures stipulated by the laws and regulations of China concerning foreign exchange control.

Query_Text_cn: 二、该手续不应解释为规避本协定中缔约方的承诺和义务的方式。
Translation: 2. This procedure shall not be interpreted as a means to circumvent the commitments and obligations of the Parties under this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在履行转移手续一般所需时间内完成的转移，应被视为第六条第三款所指的“没有迟延”。
Translation: III. Transfers completed within the time period generally required for the completion of transfer formalities shall be deemed to have been made "without delay" as referred to in paragraph 3 of Article VI.

Query_Text_cn: 上述期间应从具有全部必需文件的相关要求被提交之日开始，并不得超过两个月。
Translation: The aforementioned period shall commence from the date when the relevant request with all required documents is submitted and shall not exceed two months.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方在国际收支平衡发生困难的情况下，在公平、非歧视和善意的基础上，可以根据其作为国际货币基金协议的缔约方所作出的承诺采取管理措施。
Translation: IV. In the event of balance-of-payments difficulties, a Contracting Party may, on a fair, non-discriminatory, and good-faith basis, adopt management measures in accordance with its commitments as a party to the International Monetary Fund Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 关于第九条西班牙王国注意到中华人民共和国的声明，其要求有关的投资者将争议提交第九条第二款第（二）项和第（三）项所规定的仲裁程序之前应当用尽中华人民共和国的法律法规规定的当地行政复议程序。
Translation: Regarding Article 9, the Kingdom of Spain takes note of the statement by the People's Republic of China, which requires investors concerned to exhaust local administrative reconsideration procedures stipulated by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China before submitting disputes to the arbitration procedures specified in Article 9, paragraph 2, subparagraphs (ii) and (iii).

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国声明，完成该程序的最长期限为三个月。
Translation: The People's Republic of China declares that the maximum duration for completing this procedure shall not exceed three months.

Query_Text_cn: 由双方正式授权其各自代表签署本议定书，以昭信守。
Translation: This Protocol is signed by the duly authorized representatives of both Parties in witness whereof.

Query_Text_cn: （六）在一方境内根据其法律法规，按照租赁协议置于承租人支配之下的货物。
Translation: (6) Goods placed at the disposal of a lessee under a lease agreement within the territory of a Party in accordance with its laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 作为投资的财产发生任何形式上的变化，不影响其作为投资的性质，只要该变化符合接受投资一方的法律法规。
Translation: Any change in the form of the property as investment shall not affect its nature as investment, provided that such change is in compliance with the laws and regulations of the recipient of the investment.

Query_Text_cn: 2．经济实体，包括根据中华人民共和国的法律法规设立或组建且住所在华境内的公司、协会、合伙及其他组织，不论其是否营利也不论其为有限责任或无限责任。
Translation: 2. Economic entities, including companies, associations, partnerships, and other organizations established or formed under the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China with their domicile within China, regardless of whether they are for-profit or not and whether they have limited or unlimited liability.

Query_Text_cn: 2．法律实体，包括根据葡萄牙共和国的法律法规设立或组建且住所在葡境内的公司、协会、合伙及其他组织。
Translation: 2. Legal entities, including companies, associations, partnerships, and other organizations established or incorporated under the laws and regulations of the Portuguese Republic with their domicile in Portugal.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“收益”一词系指由投资所产生的款项，特别是，包括但不限于，利润、股息、利息、资本利得、提成费和其他合法收入。
Translation: 3. The term "returns" refers to the proceeds generated by investments, including but not limited to profits, dividends, interest, capital gains, royalties, and other lawful income.

Query_Text_cn: 如果上述投资收益被用于再投资，则再投资所产生的收益也应被视为与原始投资相关的收入。
Translation: If the aforementioned investment returns are reinvested, the proceeds generated from such reinvestment shall also be deemed as income related to the original investment.

Query_Text_cn: 四、“领土”一词系指一方根据国际法和其国内法拥有主权或管辖权的区域，包括领陆、领海及其领空，以及领海之外的海域，包括其海床和底土。
Translation: IV. The term "territory" refers to the areas over which a party has sovereignty or jurisdiction in accordance with international law and its domestic laws, including land territory, territorial sea and its airspace, as well as maritime areas beyond the territorial sea, encompassing their seabed and subsoil.

Query_Text_cn: 一、一方应鼓励另一方的投资者在其境内投资，并依照其法律和法规接受这种投资。
Translation: 1. Each Party shall encourage investors of the other Party to make investments in its territory and admit such investments in accordance with its laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、一方投资者在另一方境内的投资应享受持续的保护和安全。
Translation: II. Investments made by investors of one Party in the territory of the other Party shall enjoy constant protection and security.

Query_Text_cn: 三、一方不得对另一方投资者在其境内投资的管理、维持、使用、享有和处分采取任何随意的或歧视性的措施。
Translation: III. Neither Party shall adopt any arbitrary or discriminatory measures against the management, maintenance, use, enjoyment, or disposal of investments by investors of the other Party within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 四、一方应依据其法律和法规，对在其境内从事与投资有关活动的另一方国民获得签证和工作许可的申请给予善意的考虑。
Translation: IV. Each Party shall accord sympathetic consideration to applications for visas and work permits by nationals of the other Party engaged in investment-related activities within its territory,in accordance with its laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、一方的投资者在另一方的境内的投资应始终享受公平与公正的待遇。
Translation: I. Investors of one Party shall at all times be accorded fair and equitable treatment in the territory of the other Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、一方应给予另一方投资者在其境内的投资及与投资有关活动不低于其给予本国投资者的投资及与投资有关活动的待遇。
Translation: II. Each Party shall accord to investors of the other Party treatment no less favorable than that accorded to its own investors with respect to investments and activities associated with such investments within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 三、一方给予另一方投资者在其境内的投资及与投资有关活动的待遇，不应低于其给予任何第三国投资者的投资及与投资有关活动的待遇。
Translation: III. Each Party shall accord to investors of the other Party treatment no less favorable than that accorded to investors of any third country with respect to investments and activities associated with such investments within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: （三）为方便边境地区小额贸易的任何国际安排。
Translation: (3) Any international arrangement for the facilitation of small-scale trade in border areas.

Query_Text_cn: 三、受影响的投资者应有权依据征收方的法律要求该一方的司法机构或其他独立机构根据本条条款的规定迅速审查该案件，包括其投资的价值和补偿的支付。
Translation: III. Affected investors shall have the right to demand, under the laws of the expropriating Party, that the judicial or other independent authorities of that Party promptly review the case in accordance with the provisions of this Article, including the valuation of their investment and the payment of compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 一方的投资者在另一方境内的投资，如果由于战争或其他武装冲突、革命、全国紧急状态、或叛乱而遭受损失，另一方给予其在恢复原状、赔偿、补偿或其他有价值的补偿方面的待遇，不应低于其给予本国或任何第三国投资者的待遇。
Translation: Investors of one Party who suffer losses in the territory of the other Party due to war, other armed conflict, revolution, a state of national emergency, or insurrection shall be accorded treatment no less favorable by the other Party with respect to restitution, indemnification, compensation, or other valuable consideration than that accorded to its own investors or those of any third country.

Query_Text_cn: （七）另一方国民因从事与在另一方的境内投资相关的工作而获得的收入。
Translation: (7) Income derived by nationals of the other Party from employment related to investments within the territory of the other Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述转移应以可自由兑换的货币按照转移当日接受投资的一方通行的市场汇率不迟延地进行。
Translation: II. The aforementioned transfers shall be made in freely convertible currency at the prevailing market exchange rate of the recipient party on the date of transfer without undue delay.

Query_Text_cn: 若市场汇率不存在，则应符合支付时国际货币基金组织特别提款权同有关货币汇率折算得出的交叉汇率。
Translation: If no market exchange rate exists, the cross rate derived from the exchange rate between the IMF Special Drawing Rights and the relevant currency at the time of payment shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 如果一方或其指定的机构对其投资者在另一方境内的某项投资做了担保，并据此向投资者作了支付，另一方应承认该投资者的权利和请求权依照法律或合法交易转让给了前者一方或其指定机构，并承认前者一方或其指定机构对上述权利和请求权的代位。代位的权利不得超过该投资者的原有权利。
Translation: If one party or its designated institution has provided a guarantee for an investment made by its investor in the territory of the other party and has made payment to the investor accordingly, the other party shall recognize the transfer of the investor's rights and claims to the former party or its designated institution in accordance with the law or a valid transaction, and shall acknowledge the subrogation of the former party or its designated institution to such rights and claims. The subrogated rights shall not exceed the original rights of the investor.

Query_Text_cn: 关于因此种请求权的转让而支付的款项的转移，准用第六条。
Translation: The transfer of payments made in connection with the assignment of such claims shall be governed by Article 6.

Query_Text_cn: 一、双方对本协定的解释或适用所产生的争议，应尽可能通过外交途径协商解决。
Translation: 1. Any dispute arising from the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall be settled as far as possible through diplomatic consultations between the two Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果争议在六个月内未能协商解决，根据任何一方的要求，可将争议提交专设仲裁庭解决。
Translation: II. If the dispute is not resolved through consultation within six months, it may be submitted to an ad hoc arbitral tribunal at the request of either party.

Query_Text_cn: 自收到书面仲裁要求之日起两个月内，双方应各自任命一名仲裁员。
Translation: Within two months from the date of receiving the written request for arbitration, each party shall appoint one arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: 该两名仲裁员应共同选定一位与双方均有外交关系的第三国国民担任首席仲裁员。首席仲裁员的任命应在自前两名仲裁员任命之日起两个月内作出。
Translation: The two arbitrators shall jointly select a third-country national who maintains diplomatic relations with both parties to serve as the presiding arbitrator. The appointment of the presiding arbitrator shall be made within two months from the date of the appointment of the first two arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果仲裁庭未能在自收到书面仲裁申请之日起四个月内组成，双方间又无其他约定，任何一方可以提请国际法院院长作出必要的任命。
Translation: 4. If the arbitral tribunal has not been constituted within four months from the date of receipt of the written request for arbitration and there is no other agreement between the parties, either party may request the President of the International Court of Justice to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 如果国际法院院长是任何一方的国民，或由于其他原因不能履行此项任命，应请国际法院中非任何一方的国民也无其他不胜任原因的法官中资历最深者履行此项任命。
Translation: If the President of the International Court of Justice is a national of either party or is otherwise unable to discharge this function, the most senior member of the Court who is not a national of either party and is otherwise qualified shall be invited to perform the appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭应按照本协定以及可适用的国际法原则作出裁决。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall make its award in accordance with this Agreement and the applicable principles of international law.

Query_Text_cn: 裁决是终局的，对双方均有拘束力。
Translation: The award shall be final and binding upon both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 应任何一方的请求，仲裁庭应对其所作的裁决进行解释。
Translation: Upon the request of either party, the arbitral tribunal shall provide an interpretation of its award.

Query_Text_cn: 七、任何一方应承担其指定的仲裁员及出席仲裁程序的代表的费用。
Translation: 7. Each party shall bear the costs of its appointed arbitrator and the representatives attending the arbitration proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 首席仲裁员和仲裁庭的相关费用应由双方平均承担。
Translation: The fees of the presiding arbitrator and the arbitral tribunal shall be borne equally by both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、一方与另一方投资者之间就投资产生的任何争议，应尽可能由争议双方当事人友好解决。
Translation: 1. Any dispute arising from investments between an investor of one Party and an investor of the other Party shall, as far as possible, be settled amicably between the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: （三）根据联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则或者其他仲裁规则设立的专设仲裁庭。
Translation: (iii) An ad hoc arbitral tribunal established under the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules or other arbitration rules.

Query_Text_cn: 三、投资者将争议递交给上述三种机构的决定是终局的。
Translation: III. The investor's decision to submit the dispute to any of the aforementioned institutions shall be final.

Query_Text_cn: 四、专设仲裁庭作出的任何裁决都应是终局的，具有约束力。
Translation: IV. Any award rendered by the arbitral tribunal shall be final and binding.

Query_Text_cn: 依据本条第二款第（二）项所述公约的程序作出的裁决应是具有约束力的且只受公约规定的上诉或补救措施的影响。
Translation: The award rendered pursuant to the procedures set forth in the convention referred to in subparagraph (2) of paragraph 2 of this Article shall be binding and subject only to such appeal or remedies as are provided for in the convention.

Query_Text_cn: 裁决应根据国内法执行。
Translation: The ruling shall be enforced in accordance with domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如果任何一方的立法或双方之间现存或在本协定后根据国际法设立的义务，含有使另一方投资者的投资享受比本协定的规定更优惠待遇的规定，该规定在其更优惠的范围内应比本协定优先适用。
Translation: 1. If the legislation of either Party or existing or future international obligations between the Parties contain provisions entitling investments by investors of the other Party to treatment more favorable than that provided for under this Agreement, such provisions shall prevail to the extent that they are more favorable.

Query_Text_cn: 二、任何一方应恪守其就另一方投资者在其境内的投资所承担的任何其他义务。
Translation: II. Each Party shall observe any other obligations it has assumed with respect to investments of investors of the other Party in its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定应适用于任何一方投资者在另一方境内依照另一方法律法规于本协定生效前或生效后作出的投资，但不适用于本协定生效前已出现的与投资有关的争议。
Translation: This Agreement shall apply to any investment made by an investor of one Party in the territory of the other Party in accordance with the laws and regulations of the other Party, whether before or after the entry into force of this Agreement, but shall not apply to any investment-related disputes that arose prior to its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 无论双方之间是否存在外交或领事关系，本协定的规定都应适用。
Translation: The provisions of this Agreement shall apply irrespective of whether diplomatic or consular relations exist between the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一方可以向另一方提议就与本协定的解释、适用和执行有关的任何事宜进行磋商。
Translation: Either Party may propose consultations to the other Party on any matter concerning the interpretation, application or implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 另一方应对此提议给予善意的考虑并给予适当的机会进行磋商。
Translation: The other party shall give this proposal favorable consideration and afford appropriate opportunities for consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 附加的议定书应作为协定的组成部分。
Translation: The additional protocol shall form an integral part of the agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定自通过外交途径收到表明已完成此类生效所需国内程序的最后一个书面通知之日后第三十日起生效。
Translation: 1. This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of receipt of the last written notification through diplomatic channels indicating the completion of all necessary domestic procedures for its entry into effect.

Query_Text_cn: 二、一九九二年二月三日在里斯本签署的《中华人民共和国与葡萄牙共和国关于促进和相互保护投资协定》将在本协定生效后终止。
Translation: II. The Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Portuguese Republic on the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments, signed in Lisbon on February 3, 1992, shall terminate upon the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定有效期为十年。
Translation: 1. This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of ten years.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非任何一方在第一个十年有效期届满至少一年以前通过外交途径书面通知对方废除本协定的意愿，本协定将在不确定的五年内保持有效。
Translation: II. Unless either Party notifies the other through diplomatic channels in writing at least one year prior to the expiration of the initial ten-year term of its intention to terminate this Agreement, the Agreement shall remain in force for an indefinite period of five years.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本协定第一个十年有效期届满后，任何一方可随时终止本协定，但至少应提前一年通过外交途径书面通知另一方。
Translation: 3. After the initial ten-year validity period of this Agreement expires, either Party may terminate this Agreement at any time by providing at least one year's prior written notice to the other Party through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对在本协定终止之日前所作出的投资，本协定第一条至第十三条的规定应自本协定终止之日起继续适用十年。
Translation: IV. For investments made prior to the termination of this Agreement, the provisions of Articles 1 to 13 shall continue to apply for a period of ten years from the date of termination.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于二○○五年十二月九日在里斯本签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、葡文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Lisbon on 9 December 2005 in duplicate in the Chinese, Portuguese and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 若文本的解释发生分歧，以英文文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy in the interpretation of the text, the English version shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国和葡萄牙共和国关于促进和相互保护投资的协定的议定书值此中华人民共和国和葡萄牙共和国关于促进和相互保护投资的协定签字之际，双方正式授权的代表议定如下各项，作为该协定的组成部分。
Translation:
Protocol to the Agreement between the Portuguese Republic and the People's Republic of China on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments  

On the occasion of the signing of the Agreement between the Portuguese Republic and the People's Republic of China on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments, the duly authorized representatives of both Parties have agreed upon the following provisions, which shall constitute an integral part of the Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、关于第一条投资的收益和再投资的收益，享有同投资一样的保护。
Translation: 1. With respect to the returns from investments and the returns from reinvestments, they shall enjoy the same protection as the investments.

Query_Text_cn: （三）任何对这种不符措施的修改，但修改不能增加措施的不符程度。
Translation: (3) Any modification of such a non-conforming measure, provided that the amendment does not increase the level of non-conformity of the measure.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国将采取所有适当的措施逐渐地撤除这些不符合措施。
Translation: The People's Republic of China will take all appropriate measures to gradually eliminate these non-conforming measures.

Query_Text_cn: 一项投资的管理、维持、使用、享有和处分。
Translation: the management, maintenance, use, enjoyment, and disposal of an investment.

Query_Text_cn: 限制购买原材料或辅料、能源或燃料、生产设备或操作工具的不平等待遇及其它具有类似效果的措施。
Translation: Restrictions on the purchase of raw materials or auxiliary materials, energy or fuel, production equipment or operational tools that constitute unequal treatment, as well as other measures with similar effects.

Query_Text_cn: 因公共安全和秩序、公众健康或道德而采取的措施，不应视为第三条中的“待遇低于”。
Translation: Measures taken for public safety and order, public health, or morals shall not be considered as "treatment less favorable" under Article 3.

Query_Text_cn: （二）第三条并不要求一方有将其依照税法只给予住所在本国境内的投资者的税收优惠、免税或减税待遇，扩大到住所在另一方境内的投资者的义务。
Translation: (2) Article 3 does not obligate either party to extend the tax preferences, exemptions, or reductions granted under its tax laws exclusively to investors domiciled within its territory to investors domiciled in the other party's territory.

Query_Text_cn: （一）如果转移遵循关于外汇管理的中国现行法律和法规规定的相关手续，则第六条第一款第三项将适用。
Translation: (1) If the transfer complies with the relevant procedures stipulated by China's current laws and regulations on foreign exchange administration, the provisions of Article 6, Paragraph 1, Item 3 shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在履行转移手续一般所需时间内完成的转移，应被视为第六条第三款所指的“没有迟延”。
Translation: (2) Transfers completed within the time generally required for the completion of transfer formalities shall be deemed to have been made "without delay" as referred to in paragraph 3 of Article 6.

Query_Text_cn: 期间应从具有全部真实文件和信息的相关要求被提交至相关外汇管理部门之日开始，并不得超过两个月。
Translation: The period shall commence from the date when all required authentic documents and information are submitted to the relevant foreign exchange authorities and shall not exceed two months.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在此方面，中华人民共和国应当给予葡萄牙共和国投资者不低于其给予任何第三国投资者的待遇。
Translation: (3) In this regard, the People's Republic of China shall accord to investors of the Portuguese Republic treatment no less favorable than that accorded to investors of any third country.

Query_Text_cn: （四）该手续不得解释为规避本协定中一方的承诺和义务的方式。
Translation: (4) This procedure shall not be interpreted as a means to circumvent the commitments or obligations of either Party under this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （五）本协定第六条的规定不应影响任何一方作为国际货币基金组织成员国所享有的或可能享有的在汇兑限制方面的权利和义务。
Translation: Article 5 The provisions of Article VI of this Agreement shall not affect the rights and obligations of either Party as a member of the International Monetary Fund with respect to exchange restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: （六）如果贷款协议已在相关的外汇管理部门登记，则第一款第四项将适用。
Translation: (6) If the loan agreement has been registered with the relevant foreign exchange authorities, item 4 of the first paragraph shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （七）如果上述手续根据中国法律的相关规定不再被要求，第六条可以不受限制地适用。
Translation: (7) If the aforementioned procedures are no longer required under relevant provisions of Chinese law, Article 6 shall apply without restriction.

Query_Text_cn: （一）投资者已经根据中国法律把争议提交行政复议程序，（二）投资者把争议提交复议程序三个月后，争议仍然存在。
Translation: (i) The investor has submitted the dispute to administrative reconsideration procedures in accordance with Chinese law; or (ii) the dispute remains unresolved three months after the investor submitted it to reconsideration procedures.

Query_Text_cn: (一)“航空当局”,中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局,瑞士方面指联邦航空局,或在任一方面均指被授权行使目前指定给上述当局的职能的任何个人或机构。
Translation: (1) "Aeronautical authorities", in the case of the People's Republic of China, refers to the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China, and in the case of Switzerland, refers to the Federal Office of Civil Aviation, or in both cases, any person or body authorized to perform the functions currently exercised by the aforementioned authorities.

Query_Text_cn: (三)“航班”,指以飞机从事旅客、货物或邮件的公共运输的任何定期航班。
Translation: (3) "Flight" means any scheduled air transport service operated by aircraft for the public carriage of passengers, cargo or mail.

Query_Text_cn: (四)“国际航班”,指经过一个以上国家领土上空的航班。
Translation: (4) "International flight" refers to a flight that passes through the airspace over the territory of more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: (五)“空运企业”,指经营国际航班的任何航空运输企业。
Translation: (v) "Air carrier" means any air transport enterprise operating international flights.

Query_Text_cn: (六)“非运输业务性经停”,指任何目的不在于上下旅客、货物或邮件的降停。
Translation: (6) "Non-traffic stop" means any landing for a purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers, cargo or mail.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定附件一所规定的航线(以下简称“规定航线”)上经营定期航班(以下简称“协议航班”)的权利,以载运国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation:
Article 2  
1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in Annex 1 to this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the "specified routes") to operate scheduled air services (hereinafter referred to as the "agreed services") on the routes specified therein, for the purpose of carrying international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班时,在其季节性飞行时刻表经缔约另一方航空当局同意后,有权不降停飞越缔约另一方领土。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party, when operating the agreed services on the specified routes, shall have the right to fly across the territory of the other Contracting Party without landing, subject to the approval of its seasonal flight schedules by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点经停,以便上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (2) Make stops at points on the specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of embarking and disembarking international passengers, baggage, cargo and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业无权载运在缔约另一方领土内一地始发或中途分程并以该方领土内另一地为目的地的收费旅客、行李、货物和邮件,但该空运企业的人员、其家属和行李除外。
Translation: 4. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall not have the right to carry revenue traffic consisting of passengers, baggage, cargo and mail embarked or to be disembarked at a point in the territory of the other Contracting Party for another point in the same territory, except for the personnel of such airline(s), their dependents and baggage.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条一、缔约一方有权通过外交途径指定一家空运企业,以经营本协定附件一规定航线上的协议航班。
Translation:
Article 3  

1. Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate, through diplomatic channels, one airline to operate the agreed services on the routes specified in Annex I of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、接到指定照会的缔约方,在不违反本条第三、四款的情况下,应立即给予缔约另一方指定空运企业以必要的经营许可。
Translation: II. Upon receipt of such designation, the Contracting Party concerned shall, subject to the provisions of paragraphs III and IV of this Article, promptly grant to the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party the necessary operating authorizations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在接到本条第二款规定的经营许可后、即可在任何时候开始经营协议航班,但缔约一方至迟应在六十天前将其开始经营协议航班的日期通知缔约另一方。
Translation: III. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party may commence operation of the agreed services at any time after the operating authorization specified in paragraph 2 of this Article has been granted, provided that the Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party of the date of commencement of such operation no later than sixty days in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权,应属于指定该空运企业的缔约方或其公民。
Translation: 4. The substantial ownership and effective control of an airline designated by one Contracting Party shall be vested in the Contracting Party designating the airline or its nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业如不遵守缔约另一方的法令规章,或不按照本协定及其附件所规定的条件经营时,缔约另一方有权撤销经营许可,或暂停缔约一方指定空运企业行使本协定第二条规定的权利,或对行使这些权利规定它认为必要的条件。
Translation: V. If a designated airline of one Contracting Party fails to comply with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party, or operates in a manner inconsistent with the conditions prescribed in this Agreement and its Annex, the other Contracting Party shall have the right to revoke the operating authorization, or suspend the exercise of the rights specified in Article II of this Agreement by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party, or impose such conditions as it may deem necessary on the exercise of these rights.

Query_Text_cn: 但除非为了防止进一步违反法令规章必须立即采取上述措施外,在通常情况下应同缔约一方协商后方可行使这种权利。
Translation: However, unless immediate action is necessary to prevent further violations of laws and regulations, such rights shall generally be exercised only after consultation with the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条一、缔约双方指定空运企业在经营规定航线的协议航班方面,应享有公平均等的机会。
Translation:
Article 4  
1. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在经营协议航班时,应照顾到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益,以免不适当地影响后者在规定航线或其航段上提供的航班。
Translation: 2. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party when operating the agreed services, so as not to affect unduly the services provided by the latter on the specified routes or segments thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班,应与公众对规定航线上的运输需要保持密切的关系,并以提供足够的运力为其主要目的,以满足当前和合理地预计到的、由指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内始发或以该领土为终点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输要求。
Translation: III. The agreed services provided by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall bear a close relationship to the public demand for transportation on the specified routes. The primary objective shall be to provide adequate capacity to meet the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party that has designated the airline.

Query_Text_cn: (三)联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The operational needs of interline flights.

Query_Text_cn: 四、经营协议航班的条件和规定,应由缔约双方指定空运企业协议,并应经缔约双方各自的航空当局批准。
Translation: IV. The conditions and regulations governing the operation of agreed services shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and shall be subject to the approval of their respective aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约双方指定空运企业如对上述第四款所指问题不能达成协议,应由缔约双方航空当局解决。
Translation: V. If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on the issues referred to in paragraph IV above, the matter shall be resolved by the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一、缔约一方应在其领土内,为缔约另一方指定空运企业指定供经营规定航线所使用的机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 5  

1. Each Contracting Party shall, within its territory, designate airports and alternate airports for use by the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party in operating the agreed services, and shall provide the necessary communications, navigation, meteorological, and other auxiliary services required for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 具体办法按本协定附件二的规定办理。
Translation: The specific measures shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of Annex II to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设备和技术服务所缴纳的费率不应高于其他国家空运企业所缴的费率。
Translation: II. The rates charged to the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party for the use of airports, equipment and technical services in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall not be higher than those imposed on airlines of any other country.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及其留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草),在进出缔约另一方领土时,缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免任何关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation:
Article 6  

1. Aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the agreed routes, together with their regular equipment, spare parts, fuel, lubricants, and supplies (including food, beverages, and tobacco) retained on board such aircraft, shall be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other charges on entering or leaving the territory of the other Contracting Party, on the basis of reciprocity.

Query_Text_cn: (三)为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行国际航班的飞机加注的燃料和润滑油,即使这些燃料和润滑油系供在加注的缔约方境内的航段上使用。
Translation: (3) Fuels and lubricants supplied to aircraft of an airline designated by the other Contracting Party for use on international air services, even when such supplies are to be used on a segment of the flight within the territory of the Contracting Party where they are taken on board.

Query_Text_cn: 三、留置在缔约一方指定空运企业飞机上的机上正常设备、物资和供应品,经缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: III. The normal equipment, materials, and supplies on board the aircraft of a designated air transport enterprise of one Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the customs authorities of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 遇此情况,上述物品可交上述当局监管,并缴纳保管费用,直至重新运出,或根据该当局的规定另作处理。
Translation: In such cases, the aforementioned items may be placed under the supervision of the said authorities upon payment of custody fees until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the regulations of the said authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条一、缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其国境和在其领土内停留、航行的法令规章,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其国境和在其领土内停留的法令规章,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation:
Article VII  
1. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, exit from, and stay and navigation within its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as those pertaining to passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and mail entering into, exiting from, or staying within its territory, shall apply to the aircraft, crew, and the passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail carried by the designated air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party within the territory of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条对过境缔约一方领土、不离开为此目的而设的机场区域的旅客、行李和货物,只应采取非常简化的控制措施。
Translation: Article 8 Only highly simplified control measures shall be applied to passengers, baggage and cargo in transit through the territory of a Contracting Party without leaving the airport area designated for that purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的收入应豁免缔约另一方领土内的所得税,并应按正式比价准予结汇。
Translation: Article 9 The income derived by the designated airline of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from income tax in the territory of the other Contracting Party and shall be permitted to be converted into foreign exchange at the official rate of exchange.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条一、协议航班上所收取的运价,应在合理的水平上制定,适当地照顾到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理利润、航班特点以及在相同或相等航线或航段上经营定期航班的其他空运企业的运价。
Translation:
Article 10  
1. The tariffs charged on agreed services shall be established at reasonable levels, duly taking into account all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, characteristics of service, and the tariffs of other airlines operating scheduled air services on the same or similar routes or sectors.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协议航班的运价,由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并至迟应在拟议实行日期三十天前提交缔约双方航空当局同意。
Translation: 2. The tariffs for agreed services shall be established by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties through mutual consultation and shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties for approval no later than thirty (30) days before the proposed date of implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下,这一时限可予缩知,但须经上述航空当局同意。
Translation: Under special circumstances, this time limit may be shortened, subject to the approval of the aforementioned aviation authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 如指定空运企业对任何此种运价不能达成协议,或缔约一方航空当局对缔约双方指定空运企业间协议的任何运价感到不满,缔约双方航空当局应设法协议一项适当的运价。
Translation: If the designated airlines fail to agree on any such tariff, or if the aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party are dissatisfied with any tariff agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties, the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties shall endeavor to determine an appropriate tariff by mutual agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在新运价制定以前,根据本条各项规定的运价仍应有效。
Translation: III. Until the new freight rates are established, the rates stipulated under the provisions of this Article shall remain in effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条一、缔约一方指定空运企业有权在对等的基础上在缔约另一方境内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构,这些代表机构可包括商务、航行和技术人员。
Translation:
Article 11  
1. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right, on a reciprocal basis, to establish representative offices in the territory of the other Contracting Party at the points of call on the specified routes. Such representative offices may include commercial, operational, and technical personnel.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人数应由缔约双方空运企业间商定,并应经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: The number of representatives shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非另有协议,上述代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国或瑞士公民。
Translation: II. Unless otherwise agreed, the personnel of the aforementioned representative offices shall be citizens of either the People's Republic of China or Switzerland.

Query_Text_cn: 三、上述代表机构的人员必须遵守驻在国的法令和规定。
Translation: III. Personnel of the aforementioned representative institutions must comply with the laws and regulations of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方应向缔约另一方指定空运企业的代表机构和工作人员提供协助和便利。
Translation: 4. Each Contracting Party shall provide assistance and facilities to the representative offices and personnel of the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方应在可能范围内,保护缔约另一方空运企业在其领土内的经营安全。
Translation: V. Each Contracting Party shall, to the extent possible, ensure the operational security of the air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机,应具有本国国籍标志和登记标志。
Translation:
Article 12  
1. The aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the agreed routes shall bear its national and registration marks.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方颁发或核准的适航证、合格证和执照,在其有效期内,缔约另一方应承认其有效。
Translation: II. Certificates of airworthiness, certificates of competency and licenses issued or validated by one Contracting Party shall be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party for the period of their validity.

Query_Text_cn: 三、然而,对缔约另一方或其他任何国家颁发给或为缔约一方公民核准的、供在缔约一方境内飞行使用的合格证和执照,缔约一方保留拒绝承认其有效的权利。
Translation: III. However, each Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse to recognize the validity of certificates and licenses issued or validated by the other Contracting Party or any other country for its own nationals for flights within the territory of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机,应携带本协定附件二所述的证件。
Translation: IV. The aircraft designated by the air transport enterprise of one Contracting Party operating on the specified routes shall carry the documents specified in Annex II to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 五、关于运行和飞行安全方面的要求和程序,以及为遇险或业已失事的飞机提供援助的问题,应按本协定附件二的规定予以实施。
Translation: V. The requirements and procedures concerning operational and flight safety, as well as the provision of assistance to aircraft in distress or already involved in an accident, shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of Annex II to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 六、飞行规定航线的缔约一方指定空运企业的空勤组成员,应为该缔约方公民。
Translation: VI. The flight crew members of an air transport enterprise designated by one Contracting Party operating on the agreed routes shall be nationals of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约一方指定空运企业认为需要使用其他国籍的空勤人员在规定航线上驾驶飞机,应经缔约另一方同意。
Translation: If the designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to employ aircrew members of other nationalities to operate aircraft on the specified routes, it shall obtain the consent of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条缔约双方应密切合作,互相支持,保证本协定正确实施,如对本协定的解释或实施发生不同意见,缔约双方航空当局应协商解决,如仍不能达成协议,应由缔约双通过外交途径解决。
Translation: Article 13 The Contracting Parties shall cooperate closely and support each other to ensure the proper implementation of this Agreement. In the event of any divergence of views concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement, the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties shall seek to resolve the matter through consultation. Should such consultation fail to reach an agreement, the matter shall be settled through diplomatic channels between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条在有要求时,缔约双方航空当局应相互提供与协议航班所载运量有关的定期统计资料或其他类似资料。
Translation:
Article 14  
When requested, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall provide each other with periodic statistics or other similar information relating to the traffic carried on the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条一、缔约一方或其航空当局如认为需要修改或补充本协定的任何条款，可随时要求与缔约另一方或其航空当局进行协商，此项协商应于提出要求之日起六十天内进行。
Translation:
Article 15  
1.
