If either Contracting Party or its aeronautical authorities consider it necessary to modify or supplement any provision of this Agreement, they may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party or its aeronautical authorities. Such consultation shall be conducted within sixty (60) days from the date of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 在缔约双方互相通知业已履行其关于缔结国际协定和协定生效的必要法律手续后，本协定的修改即行生效。
Translation: The amendments to this Agreement shall enter into force upon mutual notification by the Contracting Parties that they have completed the necessary legal procedures for the conclusion of international agreements and the entry into force thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方航空当局可直接协议对本协定附件的修改。
Translation: II. The aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties may directly agree on amendments to the Annex of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 这些修改在上述航空当局相互通知予以确认后生效。
Translation: These amendments shall take effect upon mutual notification and confirmation by the aforementioned aviation authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条缔约一方可随时将其终止本协定的意愿通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 16 Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约一方发出通知十二个月后终止。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate upon the expiration of twelve months after the notification by either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 如在期满前缔约一方撤销上述通知，在取得缔约另一方同意后，本协定继续有效。
Translation: If either Contracting Party withdraws the aforementioned notice before its expiration, this Agreement shall remain in force upon obtaining the consent of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条本协定自签字之日起临时适用，在缔约双方相互通知业已履行其关于缔结国际协定和协定生效的必要法律手续后生效。
Translation: Article 17 This Agreement shall be applied provisionally from the date of signature and shall enter into force after the Contracting Parties have notified each other in writing that their respective necessary legal procedures for the conclusion of international agreements and the entry into force thereof have been completed.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七三年十一月十二日在伯尔尼签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、法文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Berne on November 12, 1973, in duplicate in the Chinese, French and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 如解释时有不同意见，以英文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy in interpretation, the English text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 附件一（一）中华人民共和国方面指定空运企业可以经营的航班的往返航班：中国境内的地点——卡拉奇或坎大哈或德黑兰——巴格达或大马士革或贝鲁特——安卡拉或开罗——雅典或地拉那或布加勒斯特——罗马或贝尔格莱德或维也纳——苏黎世和/或日内瓦——巴黎——经缔约双方航空当局协议的两个延伸点。（二）瑞士方面指定空运企业可以经营的航班的往返航线：瑞士境内的地点——维也纳或贝尔格莱德或雅典或伊斯坦布尔——贝鲁特或开罗或德黑兰或科威特——坎大哈或卡拉奇或拉瓦品第——孟买或德里——仰光——上海和/或北京——东京——经缔约双方航空当局协议的两个延伸点。
Translation:
Appendix I  
(1) The designated airlines of the People's Republic of China may operate the following round-trip routes:  
Points in China – Karachi or Kandahar or Tehran – Baghdad or Damascus or Beirut – Ankara or Cairo – Athens or Tirana or Bucharest – Rome or Belgrade or Vienna – Zurich and/or Geneva – Paris – two extension points as agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.  

(2) The designated airlines of Switzerland may operate the following round-trip routes:  
Points in Switzerland – Vienna or Belgrade or Athens or Istanbul – Beirut or Cairo or Tehran or Kuwait – Kandahar or Karachi or Rawalpindi – Bombay or Delhi – Rangoon – Shanghai and/or Beijing – Tokyo – two extension points as agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （三）缔约一方指定空运企业可根据其意愿，在飞行任何或所有航班时，不经停规定航线上任何或所有中间经停地点以及缔约另一方领土以远的地点。
Translation: (3) The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party may, at its discretion, omit any or all intermediate points on the specified route(s) and points beyond the territory of the other Contracting Party when operating any or all flights.

Query_Text_cn: 遇此情况，应尽早通知缔约另一方航空当局。
Translation: In such cases, the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party shall be notified as early as possible.

Query_Text_cn: （四）缔约一方指定空运企业如欲飞行前往或来自缔约另一方领土的专机和包机，缔约一方航空当局应向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，由缔约另一方航空当局对此申请给予有利的考虑并负责办理许可手续和答复。
Translation: (4) If the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party intends to operate charter flights to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party, the aeronautical authorities of the former Contracting Party shall submit an application to the aeronautical authorities of the latter Contracting Party, who shall give favorable consideration to such application and be responsible for processing the approval procedures and providing a response.

Query_Text_cn: （五）缔约一方指定空运企业如在规定航线上作加班飞行，在通常情况下，至少应在飞机起飞四十八小时前通知缔约另一方航空当局，并在获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: (5) If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to operate extra flights on the specified routes, it shall, under normal circumstances, notify the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party at least forty-eight hours prior to the departure of the aircraft and may only operate such flights after obtaining approval.

Query_Text_cn: 附件二一、一般规定缔约一方航空当局应为缔约另一方指定空运企业的飞机，提供在缔约一方境内飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航和其他服务。
Translation:
Annex II  
I. General Provisions  
The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall provide the aircraft designated by the air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party with the communications, navigation, and other services necessary for the operation of the agreed services within the territory of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 8.总申报单。
Translation: 8. General Declaration.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方的上述有效证件，缔约另一方应予承认。
Translation: The aforementioned valid documents of one contracting party shall be recognized by the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 4.飞行规则。
Translation: 4. Flight Rules.

Query_Text_cn: （二）上述资料如有更改或补充，应及时以航行通告形式通知缔约另一方指定空运企业。
Translation: (2) In the event of any changes or additions to the aforementioned materials, they shall be promptly notified to the designated airline of the other Contracting Party in the form of a Notice to Airmen (NOTAM).

Query_Text_cn: 紧急航行通告应先以适当方式传递，必要时应直接用无线电发给缔约另一方指定空运企业的有关飞机，并于事后以书面确认。
Translation: Urgent NOTAMs shall first be transmitted by appropriate means and, when necessary, directly by radio to the relevant aircraft of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party, followed by written confirmation thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: （三）航行资料和航行通告应采用英文。
Translation: (3) Aeronautical information and NOTAMs shall be provided in English.

Query_Text_cn: 航行通告的传递应采用国际通用的航行通告简语。
Translation: The transmission of Notices to Airmen (NOTAMs) shall employ internationally standardized NOTAM abbreviations.

Query_Text_cn: 3.备降机场的天气预报和天气报告。
Translation: 3. Weather forecasts and reports for alternate airports.

Query_Text_cn: 上述飞机在缔约另一方国境内飞行中如发生危险天气警报，缔约另一方航空当局应及时向飞机通报。
Translation: In the event of hazardous weather alerts during the flight of the aforementioned aircraft within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party shall promptly notify the aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 3.目的站、重要中间经停站和备降机场的天气预报和天气报告。
Translation: 3. Weather forecasts and reports for destination stations, key intermediate stops, and alternate airports.

Query_Text_cn: 上述飞机在缔约另一方国境内飞行中如发生危险天气警报，缔约另一方航空当局应及时向飞机通报。
Translation: In the event of hazardous weather alerts during the flight of the aforementioned aircraft within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party shall promptly notify the aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: （三）缔约双方航空当局在编制气象资料时，应使用英文明语或国际通用的气象电码。
Translation: (3) The aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall use plain English or internationally recognized meteorological codes when compiling meteorological data.

Query_Text_cn: （四）每次起飞前，起飞站气象台应向机长或其代表讲解天气，并提交飞行天气报告表。
Translation: (4) Before each takeoff, the meteorological station at the departure airport shall provide the captain or their representative with a weather briefing and submit the flight weather report form.

Query_Text_cn: 五、空中交通管制（一）飞行规定航线的缔约一方指定空运企业飞机的空勤组成员，应充分熟悉并严格遵守缔约另一方的空中交通管制程序。
Translation:
V. Air Traffic Control  
(1) Flight Regulations  
The flight crew members of the designated airlines of one Contracting Party shall be thoroughly familiar with and strictly comply with the air traffic control procedures of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （二）起飞前，机长或其代表应提出飞行计划，交起飞站的空中交通管制部门批准，并按批准的飞行计划实施飞行。
Translation: (2) Before takeoff, the captain or their representative shall submit a flight plan to the air traffic control unit at the departure airport for approval and conduct the flight in accordance with the approved plan.

Query_Text_cn: 在需要立即改变飞行计划但又来不及得有关空中交通管制部门的批准的紧急情况下，机长有权改变飞行计划，但应同时通知有关空中交通管制部门。
Translation: In emergency situations where an immediate change of flight plan is required but there is insufficient time to obtain approval from the relevant air traffic control authorities, the aircraft commander has the authority to alter the flight plan but must simultaneously notify the relevant air traffic control department.

Query_Text_cn: 有关空中交通管制部门应尽力予以协作，但机长应对此产生的后果负责。
Translation: The relevant air traffic control authorities shall endeavor to provide cooperation, but the aircraft commander shall be responsible for any consequences arising therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: （三）每次飞行前，缔约一方航空当局空中交通管制部门应以其掌握的情况，向机长或其代表讲解关于规定航线上起飞站、第一目的站和备降机场的最新航行通告，包括无线电通信设备、导航设备以及其他为安全飞行所需了解的情况。
Translation: (3) Prior to each flight, the air traffic control department of the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, based on the information available, brief the aircraft commander or their representative on the latest NOTAMs (Notices to Airmen) concerning the departure station, first destination, and alternate airports along the designated route. This includes details on radio communication facilities, navigation aids, and other essential information required for safe flight operations.

Query_Text_cn: 六、无线电通信导航服务（一）为了飞行规定航线，在两国间传递电报的办法和程序将由缔约双方航空当局协议。
Translation:
VI. Radio Communication and Navigation Services  
(1) For flights along designated routes, the methods and procedures for transmitting telegrams between the two countries shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机，应尽可能装有适合使用缔约另一方境内无线电通信导航服务的设备。
Translation: (2) The aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the specified routes shall, as far as possible, be equipped with radio apparatus suitable for the use of the communication and navigational services provided in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （四）机长应在规定的频率上与指定的空中交通管制部门保持不间断的双向通信联络。
Translation: (4) The pilot-in-command shall maintain continuous two-way communication with the designated air traffic control unit on the prescribed frequency.

Query_Text_cn: （五）缔约双方在陆空、平面通信中，采取英语和国际通用的航空Q简语。
Translation: (5) Both contracting parties shall use English and the internationally recognized aviation Q code in their land-air and surface communications.

Query_Text_cn: 8.将调查结果书面通知缔约一方。
Translation: 8. Notify the contracting party of the investigation findings in writing.

Query_Text_cn: “基金”是指协定建立的非洲发展基金。
Translation: "Fund" refers to the African Development Fund established under the Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: “银行”是指非洲发展银行。
Translation: "Bank" refers to the African Development Bank.

Query_Text_cn: “成员”是指银行的成员。
Translation: "Member" refers to a member of the bank.

Query_Text_cn: “参与者”是指银行和成为本协定参与者的任何国家。
Translation: "Participant" means any bank or country that becomes a participant to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: “参与国”是指银行之外的参与国。
Translation: "Participating countries" refers to participating countries other than the bank.

Query_Text_cn: “创始参与者”是指银行和按照第57条第1款成为参与者的每一参与国。
Translation: "Founding Participants" refers to banks and each participating country that becomes a participant in accordance with Article 57(1).

Query_Text_cn: “认缴额”是指参与者遵照第5、6或7条认徼的款额。
Translation: "Subscribed amount" refers to the amount of funds that participants commit to contribute in accordance with Articles 5,6 or 7.

Query_Text_cn: “记帐单位”是指具有0.81851265克纯金价值的记帐单位。
Translation: "Unit of account" refers to a unit with a value equivalent to 0.81851265 grams of fine gold.

Query_Text_cn: “自由兑换的货币”是指本基金与国际货币基金组织协商后确定的可以用于基金开展活动、充分地兑换为别种货币的某一参与者的货币。
Translation: "A freely usable currency" refers to a currency of a participant that the Fund, after consultation with the International Monetary Fund, determines to be convertible for the Fund's operations and can be fully exchanged into other currencies.

Query_Text_cn: “总裁”、“董事会”和“理事会”是分别指基金的总裁，董事会和理事会，就董事和理事而言，上述术语包括代理董事和理事行事的代董事和代理事。
Translation: The terms "President," "Board of Directors," and "Board of Trustees" refer to the President, Board of Directors, and Board of Trustees of the Fund, respectively. With respect to directors and trustees, the above terms include alternate directors and alternate trustees acting on their behalf.

Query_Text_cn: “地区的”是指位于非洲大陆上或非洲群岛上的。
Translation: "Regional" refers to areas located on the African continent or its archipelagos.

Query_Text_cn: 2、凡提到章、条、款和表时，指的是本协定的章、条、款、表。
Translation: 2. Any reference to chapters,articles,paragraphs and tables shall be construed as referring to the chapters,articles,paragraphs and tables of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3、冠于各章、条前的标题只是为了便于参考，不属于本协定的内容。
Translation: 3. The headings of the chapters and articles are inserted for convenience of reference only and do not form part of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条宗旨基金的宗旨在于帮助非洲发展银行对该银行成员的经济发展和社会发展及对促进特别是上述银行成员之间的合作(包括区域合作和次区域合作)及其日益增长的国际贸易作出有效的贡献。
Translation: The second objective of the Fund is to assist the African Development Bank in making effective contributions to the economic and social development of its member countries, as well as to fostering cooperation among them (including regional and sub-regional cooperation) and their growing international trade, particularly between the aforementioned Bank members.

Query_Text_cn: 它将在特惠条件下为对这种发展具有头等重要意义并能服务于这种发展的各种事业提供资金。
Translation: It will provide funding under preferential terms for various undertakings that are of paramount importance to such development and can serve its purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条参与1.基金的参与者是非洲发展银行和根据本协定条款将成为缔约方的那些国家。
Translation:
Article III Participation  
1. The participants in the Fund shall be the African Development Bank and those countries that become parties to this Agreement in accordance with its terms.

Query_Text_cn: 2.创始参与国是列于A表中的按第57条（1）成为本协定缔约方的那些国家。
Translation: 2. The original participating countries are those listed in Table A that have become Parties to this Agreement in accordance with Article 57(1).

Query_Text_cn: 3.非创始参与者的国家也可以在与本协定不相矛盾的情况下由理事会全体有选举权的肯定多数票通过的一致决议所决定的条件成为本协定的参与者和缔约方。
Translation: 3. Non-founding countries may also become participants and contracting parties to this Agreement under terms determined by a unanimous resolution adopted by an affirmative majority vote of all eligible members of the Council, provided such accession does not contradict the provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 这种参加将仅对联合国或联合国的任一专门机构的成员国或国际法院规章的缔约方开放。
Translation: Such participation shall be open only to States Members of the United Nations or of any of its specialized agencies, or parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 4.一个国家可以授权某一实体或机构作为自己的代表签署本协定，并在一切与本协定有关的事情上代表该国家，但对第55条中所提到的事项例外。
Translation: 4. A country may authorize an entity or institution to act as its representative in signing this Agreement and in all matters related thereto, except for those specified in Article 55.

Query_Text_cn: (iii)基金获得的其他资金来源,和(iv)来自基金的某些活动或其他方式所获得的资金。
Translation: (iii) other sources of funding obtained by the Fund, and (iv) funds derived from certain activities of the Fund or other means.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条银行的认缴款额银行应向基金支付一定款项的依照A表中在其名字前面开列的用记帐单位表达的资金数额,作为它的初始认缴资金由银行依此记在非洲发展基金的贷方。
Translation:
Article V: Bank's Subscription  
The Bank shall pay to the Fund an amount expressed in the unit of account specified opposite its name in Schedule A as its initial subscription, which shall be credited by the Bank to the African Development Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 用于此目的的支付应按第六条第2款所规定的参与国支付原始认缴额的条件进行。
Translation: Payments for this purpose shall be made on the same terms as the original subscriptions of participating countries as set forth in Article VI, Section 2.

Query_Text_cn: 银行此后可以按照它的董事会所决定、而与基金约定的条件,进行其他数额的认缴。
Translation: Thereafter,the bank may make additional subscriptions on such terms as its Board of Directors may determine and as agreed with the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条参与国的原始认缴额1.成为参与国时,每个参与国都应认缴指定它应缴的资金数额,这一认缴在此后被称为初始认缴额。
Translation:
Article 6 Original Subscriptions of Participants  
1. Upon becoming a Participant, each Participant shall subscribe to the amount allocated to it, which shall thereafter be referred to as its original subscription.

Query_Text_cn: 2.指定各创始参与国应缴的原始认缴额的数量将于A表中在其名字前面列出,以记帐单位表示,并可以用自由兑换的货币支付。
Translation: 2. The amount of the original subscription to be paid by each founding participant shall be set out opposite its name in Schedule A, expressed in terms of the unit of account and payable in freely convertible currencies.

Query_Text_cn: 出于运作需要,基金可以要求提前同时支付第二期和第三期付款或两者之一,但这种提前支付必须是各参与者出于完全自愿的。
Translation: For operational needs,the fund may request the advance payment of both the second and third installments or either of them,provided such early payment is made entirely voluntarily by all participants.

Query_Text_cn: 3.非创始参与者的参与国,其原始认缴额也应以记帐单位表示,并以可以自由兑换的货币支付。
Translation: 3. For non-founding participating countries, their initial subscriptions shall also be denominated in accounting units and paid in freely convertible currencies.

Query_Text_cn: 这些认缴额付款的数额和条件,由本基金依照第3条(3)的规定决定。
Translation: The amounts and terms of payment for these subscription amounts shall be determined by the Fund in accordance with the provisions of Section 3(3).

Query_Text_cn: 4.除非基金另有约定,每一参与国应保持其依本条所支付的货币的自由兑换性。
Translation: 4. Unless otherwise agreed by the Fund, each participating country shall maintain the free convertibility of the currency it has paid in accordance with this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 5.尽管存在本条的上述各项规定,如果出于预算或其他情况使推迟付款有必要时,各参与国可以推迟支付本条所要求的任何付款,但这一期间不得超过3个月。
Translation: 5.Notwithstanding the provisions of this Article,any participating country may defer any payment required under this Article if such deferral is necessitated by budgetary or other circumstances,provided that such deferral shall not exceed a period of three months.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条参与国的追加认缴额1.基金应该依据各创始参与者的原始认缴额的付款一览表和它自己的经营情况,在它认为适当的时候或其后相隔一定时间,对它的资金是否充足进行审查,如果认为必要,可以在基金决定的条件下批准各参与国普遍增加它们的认缴额。
Translation:
Article 7 Additional Subscriptions by Participating Countries  

1. The Fund shall, based on the payment schedules of the original subscriptions by founding participants and its own operational conditions, review the adequacy of its resources at such times and intervals as it deems appropriate. If deemed necessary, the Fund may approve a general increase in the subscriptions of participating countries under terms determined by the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管存在上述规定,基金可在任何时候批准普遍或个别的追加,但个别追加只以参与国提出请求者才予考虑。
Translation: Notwithstanding the above provisions,the Fund may approve general or individual additions at any time,provided that individual additions shall be considered only upon request by a participant.

Query_Text_cn: 2.当任何个别认缴额根据第1款被批准时,各参与国应享有在不低于第1款所规定,由基金会合理地决定的有利条件下认缴一定数额的资金,使其在参与国之间保持相应的选举权机会。
Translation: 2. When any individual subscription is approved under paragraph 1, each participating country shall have the right to subscribe an amount of funds under terms no less favorable than those reasonably determined by the Foundation as stipulated in paragraph 1, so as to maintain corresponding voting rights opportunities among participating countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条通讯的特权对待基金之官方通讯各参与国应赋予与它是其成员，的其他国际金融组织之官方通讯一样的待遇。
Translation:
Article 47 Privileged Treatment of Communications for the Fund  
The official communications of the Fund shall be accorded by each participant the same treatment as the official communications of other international financial institutions of which it is a member.

Query_Text_cn: 4.凡就第一款中的规定批准和决定认缴额的普遍追加时,应由参与者全部选举权的85%的多数通过。
Translation: 4. Any general increase in subscriptions approved and decided pursuant to the provisions of paragraph 1 shall require an 85% majority of the total voting power of the participants.

Query_Text_cn: 2.这样的合约应当在与基金的宗旨、运营和政策相一致的条件下进行,并且不使不适当的行政或财政负担强加于基金或银行身上。
Translation: 2. Such contracts shall be entered into under conditions consistent with the Fund's purposes, operations, and policies, and shall not impose undue administrative or financial burdens on the Fund or the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: 3.对技术援助拨款以外的约定,应在使基金有可能遵从第15条(4)和(5)要求的条件下进行。
Translation: 3. Commitments other than technical assistance grants shall be made subject to conditions that enable the Fund to comply with the requirements of Article 15(4) and (5).

Query_Text_cn: 4.当此类约定既非与成员国或参与国,也非与它们的一个代理者进行的,这样的约定应得到董事会以参与者全部选举权85%以上的多数票的批准。
Translation: 4. Where such arrangements are made neither with a member nor with an agency of a member or participant, they shall be subject to approval by the Board of Governors by a majority of 85 percent of the total voting power of the participants.

Query_Text_cn: 5.基金不应接受任何无特惠条件的贷款(为运营所需的临时性用款除外),不得在任何市场上借款、或作为借款人、保证人或以其他方式在任何市场上参与债券的发行,也不得为表明依第一款取得的贷款负债发行可流通或可转让的债券。
Translation: 5. The Fund shall not accept any loan without preferential terms (except for temporary operational financing needs), nor shall it borrow in any market, act as a borrower or guarantor, or otherwise participate in bond issuance in any market. It shall also not issue negotiable or transferable securities to indicate liabilities arising from loans obtained under paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条认缴额的支付基金得接受参与者或根据第33条指定的存放者(如果有的话)发行的票据、信用证或类似的债券作为由参与者依照第5、6、7条或第13条的规定交付而非其运营所需的认缴额的任何一部分。
Translation:
Article 9 Payment of Subscriptions  
The Fund may accept from any participant or depository designated under Article 33, if any, notes, letters of credit, or similar obligations in lieu of any part of a participant's subscription that is not required by the Fund for its operations under Articles 5, 6, 7, or 13.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管发行和接受此种票据,信用证和其他债券,参与者在第5、6、7条和第13条下的义务持续存在。
Translation: Notwithstanding the issuance and acceptance of such notes, letters of credit, and other instruments, the obligations of the participants under Articles 5, 6, 7, and 13 shall remain in full force and effect.

Query_Text_cn: 不论认缴额是以何种方式认缴的,基金得在切实可行的范围内、在合理期间、按比例地提取这些款项,以用于支付开销。
Translation: Regardless of the manner in which the subscription is made, the Fund shall, to the extent practicable and within a reasonable period of time, draw proportionally on these amounts to meet its expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条货币的使用1.无论是为了支付第5条和第6条(2)所规定的认缴额,还是为了依照第13条规定对上述认缴额进行保值而收取的货币,基金都可以为它的任何运作使用和兑换这些货币,而且可以在得到理事会批准的条件下将非运营所需的资金进行临时性的投资。
Translation:
Article 11 Use of Currencies  
1. The Fund may utilize and exchange any currencies received, whether for payment of subscriptions specified in Article 5 and Article 6(2) or for maintaining the value of such subscriptions pursuant to Article 13, in any of its operations. Furthermore, with the approval of the Council, the Fund may temporarily invest funds not required for operational purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为支付第六条(3)和第十七条(1)(2)款规定的认缴额,或按第13条的规定对认缴额进行保值,或作为第8条下的其他资金来源而收取的货币,对这些货币的使用,应受收取这些货币的条款和条件的制约,在收受第13条规定的货币的场合,其使用应受收取按第13条规定保值的货币的条款和条件的制约。
Translation: 2. The use of currencies received for the payment of subscriptions under Article VI, Section 3, and Article XVII, Sections 1 and 2, or for maintaining the value of subscriptions under Article 13, or as other sources of funds under Article 8, shall be subject to the terms and conditions on which they were received. In the case of currencies received under Article 13, their use shall be subject to the terms and conditions governing the receipt of currencies for maintaining the value of subscriptions under Article 13.

Query_Text_cn: 3.基金所收受的所有其他货币,基金都可以为它的任何运营工作自由使用和兑换,用于非基金运营所需而进行的临时性投资,则须经理事会的批准。
Translation: 3. The Fund may freely use and exchange all other currencies received by it for any of its operational purposes. However, temporary investments made for purposes other than the Fund's operational needs shall require the approval of the Board of Governors.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条货币的估价1.凡在本协定下,有必要把任何一种货币换算为另一种货币、几种货币或记帐单位时,这种估价应由本基金经与国际货币基金组织协商之后合理作出决定。
Translation:
Article XII Valuation of Currency  
1. Whenever it shall be necessary under this Agreement to value any currency in terms of another currency, several currencies, or a unit of account, such valuation shall be reasonably determined by the Fund after consultation with the International Monetary Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 这样确定的价值应当视为这种货币的合乎本约定的目的。
Translation: The value thus determined shall be deemed to be the value of such currency for the purposes of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条货币储备金价值的维持1.任何时候，当一参与国的货币在国际货币基金组织内的平价相对于记帐单位在降低，或者在基金看来，这种货币的汇兑价值在该参与国境内严重下降，该参与国应在一定时间内向基金交付一定数量的该国货币，使参与国根据第六条规定和本款规定缴入基金的这些数量的货币可以维持在认缴款时的水平上，不论这些货币是否以票据，信用证或根据第九条而接受的其他债券形式存在，只要这些货币不是一开始已被拨发殆尽或已兑换成别的货币。
Translation:
Article 13 Maintenance of the Value of Currency Reserves  

1. Whenever the par value of a participating country's currency in relation to the unit of account within the International Monetary Fund is reduced, or when, in the judgment of the Fund, the exchange value of such currency has significantly declined within the territory of that participating country, the said participating country shall, within a specified period, deliver to the Fund a certain amount of its currency. This is to ensure that the quantities of currency paid into the Fund by the participating country under Article 6 and this provision are maintained at the level of the original subscription, regardless of whether such currencies exist in the form of promissory notes, letters of credit, or other instruments accepted under Article 9, provided that these currencies have not been initially exhausted or converted into other currencies.

Query_Text_cn: 3.当国际货币基金组织把参与国的货币全部一致地作了更动，基金可以放弃本条的规定或宣告它的无效。
Translation: 3. The Fund may waive or declare this provision inoperative when it uniformly changes the currencies of all participant countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条资金的利用1.基金应为在成员国领土内促进经济和社会发展的工程项目与计划提供资金。
Translation:
Article 14 Utilization of Funds  
1. The Fund shall provide financing for projects and programs aimed at promoting economic and social development within the territories of member states.

Query_Text_cn: 基金应为那些其经济状况和前景要求按特惠条件为它们提供资金的成员国提供这种资金。
Translation: The Fund shall provide such financing to those members whose economic circumstances and prospects require the provision of funds on concessional terms.

Query_Text_cn: 2.基金提供的资金应用于就有关地区的需要而基金认为重要的优先项目的目的,而且除特殊情况外用于特定项目或项目群的开发,特别是用于为国家、地区或次要地区的计划项目,包括基金批准的国民发展银行或其他能再贷款的适当机构的各种特定项目提供资金。
Translation: 2. The funds provided by the Foundation shall be used for the purposes of priority projects deemed important by the Foundation in relation to the needs of the regions concerned and, except in special circumstances, shall be allocated to the development of specific projects or project groups. In particular, they shall be utilized to finance national, regional, or sub-regional planned projects, including various specific projects approved by the Foundation for national development banks or other appropriate institutions capable of relending.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条资金提供的条件1.除了在为某一国际的、地区的、或次要地区的组织提供资金的场合基金没有必要弄清楚个别成员国不会反对的情况外,基金将不给一成员国领土内的任何项目提供资金,如果该成员国对此持有异议的话。
Translation:
Article 15 Conditions for the Provision of Funds  
1. The Fund shall not finance any project in the territory of a member country if that country objects, except where the Fund is providing funds to an international, regional, or subregional organization and it is not necessary to ascertain that no individual member country opposes such financing.

Query_Text_cn: 2.(a)如果基金认为资金的提供可以在对接收方合理的条件下从其他来源获得者,基金将不提供这种资金。
Translation: 2.(a) The Fund shall not provide financing if it believes that such financing can be obtained from other sources on reasonable terms for the recipient.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在使资金是为某些实体而不是对成员国提供时,基金应采取一切必要措施确保资金提供的优惠利益只赋予在考虑了所有相关情况下应当获得全部或一部分这些优惠利益的成员国或其他实体。
Translation: (b) Where the provision of funds is made to certain entities rather than to Member States, the Fund shall take all necessary measures to ensure that the concessional benefits of such provision accrue solely to those Member States or other entities which, taking into account all relevant circumstances, should receive all or part of these benefits.

Query_Text_cn: 3.在提供资金之前,申请者应通过银行行长(总裁)提交一个合适的建议,银行行长总裁应在对该建议所做的一项研究的基础上,向基金的理事会提交一份推荐该资金授与的书面报告。
Translation: 3. Prior to the provision of funds, the applicant shall submit a suitable proposal through the bank's president (CEO), who shall, based on a study of the proposal, present a written report to the Fund's Board of Directors recommending the grant of funds.

Query_Text_cn: 要求提供的资金的各项款额必须用在特定的参与国或成员国境内。
Translation: The funds provided must be allocated specifically for use within the designated participating or member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 这种款项只能用于在参与国或成员国境内购买生产于参与国或成员国的货物,或由这些参与国或成员国提供的服务。
Translation: Such funds may only be used to purchase goods produced within participating or member states, or services provided by these participating or member states, within their respective territories.

Query_Text_cn: 而资金如果根据第八条的规定是从非参与国或非成员国的一个国家处获得的,该国领土也是可以利用这种资金采购货物的合适的地方,也可以是理事会决定在该条文下收取其他此类资金用于采购货物的合适来源。
Translation: If the funds are obtained from a country that is not a participant or member state under Article 8, its territory may also serve as an appropriate location for procuring goods with such funds, or as a suitable source for procuring goods with other such funds collected under this provision as determined by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: (b)采购货物应在合格的供应者之间展开国际竞争的基础上进行,除非理事会决定采用国际竞争是不合道理的。
Translation: (b) Procurement of goods shall be conducted on the basis of international competition among qualified suppliers unless the Board determines that such competition would be unreasonable.

Query_Text_cn: 6.在任何资金筹措活动下提供的资金,都应使接受者能够以此款项支付与项目相关的实际花销的费用。
Translation: 6. Under any fundraising activity, the funds provided shall enable the recipient to cover the actual expenses incurred in relation to the project.

Query_Text_cn: 8.基金不得进行再融资的活动。
Translation: 8. The fund shall not engage in refinancing activities.

Query_Text_cn: 而在收受者不是成员国时,基金应对工程项目或计划要为之服务的那地方的资金收受者和成员国所采取的有关自助措施同时加以注意。
Translation: When the recipient is not a member state, the Fund shall take into account both the self-help measures adopted by the recipient in the locality where the project or program is to serve and those taken by the member states.

Query_Text_cn: 11.基金应采取为确保本条文的有效适用所需采取的一切措施。
Translation: 11. The Fund shall take all measures necessary to ensure the effective application of this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条提供资金的形式和条件1.基金用第五、六、七条规定的资金来源和用这些资金的偿还款得来的收入进行的资金提供,应当采取借贷的方式。
Translation:
Article 16 Forms and Conditions of Funding  
1. Funding provided by the Fund from the sources specified in Articles 5, 6, and 7, as well as from income derived from repayments of such funds, shall be extended in the form of loans.

Query_Text_cn: 2.(a)以遵从上款规定为条件,基金提供资金应按合适的特惠条件进行。
Translation: 2.(a) Subject to compliance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph, the provision of funds by the Fund shall be conducted on appropriately concessional terms.

Query_Text_cn: (b)当借款者是一个成员国或是一个包括一个或多个成员国的政府间机构,基金在制定提供资金的条件时,应首先考虑该成员国或若干成员国(资金筹措正是为这些成员的利益而提供资金的经济状况和前景,同时,也应考虑到有关项目与计划的性质和要求。
Translation: (b) When the borrower is a member country or an intergovernmental institution that includes one or more member countries, the Fund shall, in determining the terms and conditions for providing financing, give primary consideration to the economic conditions and prospects of that member country or those member countries (for whose benefit the financing is provided), while also taking into account the nature and requirements of the relevant projects and programs.

Query_Text_cn: (c)成员国境内与发展相关的任何地区或分地区的代理机构或组织。
Translation: (c) Any regional or sub-regional agencies or organizations within the territory of Member States that are related to development.

Query_Text_cn: 凡借款者自己不是一个成员国,基金应要求它提供一个适当的政府担保或其他方式的担保。
Translation: Where the borrower is not itself a member,the Fund shall require it to provide a guarantee from an appropriate government or other assurances.

Query_Text_cn: 4.当考虑到为之提供资金的那个成员国或一些成员国的经济状况和前景,以及工程项目的性质和要求,基金认为在此范围内提供外汇是贷款所必需和合适的,基金可以使该成员国获得该工程项目在当地消费所需要的外汇。
Translation: 4. When taking into account the economic conditions and prospects of the member country or countries providing the funding, as well as the nature and requirements of the project, the Fund may deem it necessary and appropriate to provide foreign exchange within this scope for the loan. In such cases, the Fund may make foreign exchange available to the member country for the local expenditures required by the project.

Query_Text_cn: 5.贷款应以所贷用的货币偿还,或以基金决定的其他一种或几种可以自由兑换的货币偿还。
Translation: 5. Loans shall be repaid in the currency borrowed or in one or more freely convertible currencies as determined by the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 提供资金时还应该有一条件,要求这种行政和立法措施应该得到顺利维持,并且在基金与成员国之间如果发生争执,而这方面没有任何其他规定的,第五十三条的规定应该发生效力,一如成员国在第五十三条得以适用的情况下是协定的一个参与者一样。
Translation: When providing funds, it should also be a condition that such administrative and legislative measures be smoothly maintained. In the event of any dispute between the Fund and a member state where no other provisions apply, Article 53 shall take effect as if the member state were a participant to the agreement under circumstances where Article 53 is applicable.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条审查和评估对于已完成的由本基金资助的项目、计划和活动,应当进行一次全面的持续的审查,以便有助于理事会和总裁确定本基金实现自己的各项宗旨的有效性。
Translation:
Article 17 Review and Evaluation  
A comprehensive and ongoing review shall be conducted for completed projects, programs, and activities financed by the Fund to assist the Council and the President in assessing the effectiveness of the Fund in achieving its objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 总裁经理事会同意应为进行这一审查作出有关安排。
Translation: The president shall, with the approval of the board of directors, make relevant arrangements for conducting this review.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条与其他国际组织、其他机构和国家的合作本基金在推进其宗旨时,应谋求与其他国际组织,地区组织和次地区组织以及其他机构和国家的合作,且可以为上述合作达成若干约定,条件是未经协定参与者全部选举权的85%以上的多数票同意,基金不得与非成员国,非参与国或此类国家的一个机构达成上述合作的约定。
Translation:
Article 18 Cooperation with Other International Organizations, Institutions, and Countries  

In advancing its objectives, the Fund shall seek cooperation with other international organizations, regional and sub-regional organizations, as well as other institutions and countries. The Fund may enter into arrangements for such cooperation, provided that no arrangement shall be concluded with a non-member state, non-participating country, or an institution thereof without the approval of at least 85% of the total voting power of the participants to the arrangement.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条技术援助基金在推进其宗旨时,可以提供技术援助,但此类援助如果不是从特殊的技术援助补贴中提供的,或者不是靠为此目的可供基金利用的其他方式提供的,则援助通常应在需要偿还的基础上进行。
Translation: Article 19 In furtherance of its purposes, the Technical Assistance Fund may provide technical assistance, but such assistance shall normally be on a reimbursable basis unless it is provided from special technical assistance contributions or from other resources available to the Fund for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条杂项活动在本协定其他地方规定的权力之外,基金还可以进行与基金运作和经营相关,对于推进其宗旨必要和合乎需要的、且与本协定的规定相一致的其他活动。
Translation:
Article XX Miscellaneous Operations  
In addition to the powers specified elsewhere in this Agreement, the Fund may undertake such other activities as are necessary and appropriate to further its purposes, consistent with the provisions of this Agreement, in connection with the operation and conduct of its business.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条禁止政治性活动本基金、本基金的任何官员或代理基金进行活动的任何其他人员，都不得干涉任何成员国的政治事务，他们也不得在作出决定时受该成员国或其他成员国的政治特点的影响。
Translation:
Article XXI Prohibition of Political Activities  
The Fund, its officials, or any other person acting on behalf of the Fund shall not interfere in the political affairs of any member. Neither shall they be influenced in their decisions by the political character of the member or other members concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条基金的组织基金应设有一个董事会、一个理事会和一名董事长(总裁)。
Translation: Article 22 The organizational structure of a fund shall consist of a board of directors,a council and a chairman (president).

Query_Text_cn: 如果理事会认为有必要增加职员时,基金将由总裁依第30条第4款第5项的规定录用这些职员,以获得要增加的人员。
Translation: If the Board of Governors deems it necessary to increase the staff, the Fund shall recruit such additional personnel through the Managing Director in accordance with the provisions of Article 30, Section 4, Subsection 5.

Query_Text_cn: 权力1.基金的一切权力应赋予董事会。
Translation:
Power  
1. All powers of the Fund shall be vested in the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: (x)行使本协定明文指定赋予董事会的权力。
Translation: (x) To exercise the powers expressly conferred upon the Board of Directors by this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.董事会可在任何时候撤销委派授权给理事会的任何事项。
Translation: 3. The Board of Directors may at any time revoke any matters delegated to the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 组成1.银行的董事和代理董事将分别是基金的当然董事和代理董事。
Translation: Composition 1. The directors and alternate directors of the bank shall serve ex officio as the directors and alternate directors of the fund.

Query_Text_cn: 银行的行长将在必要时把这些董事和代理董事的名单提交给基金。
Translation: The bank's president will submit the list of these directors and alternate directors to the Fund when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 2.每个非银行成员的参与国将指定一名董事和一名代理董事,他们将按照指定国的意愿行事。
Translation: 2. Each non-bank member participating country shall appoint one director and one alternate director, who shall act in accordance with the instructions of the appointing country.

Query_Text_cn: 3.除非主任董事缺席,否则代理董事无投票权。
Translation: 3. Unless the managing director is absent, the proxy director shall have no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 4.只有在第六十条第4款规定的条件下,董事和代理董事的工作才得由基金支付酬金或其他开支。
Translation: 4. Only under the conditions stipulated in Article 60(4) may the work of directors and alternate directors be remunerated or otherwise reimbursed by the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 银行董事会主席是基金董事会的当然主席。
Translation: The chairman of the bank's board of directors is ex officio chairman of the fund's board.

Query_Text_cn: 2.董事会的年度会议将同银行董事会的年度会议一起举行。
Translation: 2. The annual meeting of the Board of Directors shall be held concurrently with the annual meeting of the bank's Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: 4.董事会可以通过规章建立一个程序,理事会可以以此程序在它认为此举明智的时候,就某一特定问题获得董事们的投票而无须召开董事会议。
Translation: 4. The Board of Directors may establish by regulation a procedure whereby the Council may, when it deems advisable, obtain the votes of directors on a specific issue without convening a board meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 5.董事会和在董事会授权范围内的理事会可以在对外处理基金业务必要和合适的情况下,建立一些辅助性的委员会。
Translation: 5. The Board of Directors and the Council, within the scope of their authorized powers, may establish auxiliary committees as necessary and appropriate for conducting the Fund's external business operations.

Query_Text_cn: 6.董事会和在董事会或本协定授权范围内的理事会可以制订一些对于处理基金业务必要和合适的与本协定精神一致的规章。
Translation: 6. The Board of Directors and, within the limits of authority delegated to it by the Board of Directors or this Agreement, the Council may adopt such regulations as are necessary and appropriate to conduct the business of the Fund and consistent with the spirit of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 职能在不损害第23条规定的董事会权力的前提下,理事会将负责指导基金的一般运作和经营。
Translation: Without prejudice to the powers of the Board under Article 23,the Council shall be responsible for directing the general operations and conduct of the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)遵照董事会的总的指示,作出关于个人贷款和在本协定下基金要提供的其他方式的资金援助的决定。
Translation: (ii) Make decisions regarding individual loans and other forms of financial assistance to be provided by the Fund under this Agreement, in accordance with the general directives of the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: (vii)依照为这些目的可能获得的资金来源,批准基金的预算,总的贷款计划和方针。
Translation: (vii) Approve the Fund's budget, overall lending program, and policies in accordance with the financial resources available for these purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 组成1.应成立一个由十二位理事组成的理事会。
Translation: 1. A council consisting of twelve directors shall be established.

Query_Text_cn: 2.协定参与国应根据B表选拨六位理事和六位代理事。
Translation: 2. Participating countries of the agreement shall select six directors and six alternate directors in accordance with Schedule B.

Query_Text_cn: 3.银行应从银行的理事会中根据B表指定六位理事和它们的代理事。
Translation: 3. The bank shall appoint six directors and their alternates from the bank's council in accordance with Schedule B.

Query_Text_cn: 4.基金的代理事可以出席理事会的一切会议,但,除非在其主任理事缺席的情况下,不得参与议事或投票。
Translation: 4. Alternate Directors of the Fund may attend all meetings of the Board of Directors but, unless acting in the absence of their Principal Director, shall not participate in deliberations or vote.

Query_Text_cn: 5.理事会应邀请银行的其他理事及其代理事作为观察员出席理事会的会议,任何这类银行的理事,或当其缺席时的代理事,都可以参与讨论任何有利于他在银行理事会中所代表的那个国家的建议项目。
Translation: 5. The Board of Governors shall invite the other governors of the Bank and their alternate governors to attend its meetings as observers. Any such governor of the Bank, or his alternate in his absence, may participate in the discussion of any proposal that is of particular interest to the country he represents on the Board of Governors.

Query_Text_cn: 6.(a)银行指定的理事的任职期是从他任职起,一直到其继任人按B表被指定并任职时为止。
Translation: 6.(a)The term of office of a director appointed by the Bank shall be from the date of his appointment until his successor is designated and assumes office in accordance with Schedule B.

Query_Text_cn: 如果银行指定的某理事停止成为银行的理事,则他也停止成为基金的理事。
Translation: If a director designated by the bank ceases to be a director of the bank, he shall also cease to be a director of the fund.

Query_Text_cn: (b)参与国选定的理事,任期为三年,但按照第七条第1款的规定,认缴额的普遍增加成为有效时,他的任期即行终止。
Translation: (b) Directors selected by participating countries shall serve for terms of three years, provided that their terms shall terminate when a general increase in subscriptions becomes effective under paragraph 1 of Article VII.

Query_Text_cn: 这样的理事可以连选连任一期或多期。
Translation: Such directors may be re-elected for one or more additional terms.

Query_Text_cn: 他们将持续任职至其继任人被选定并任职时为止。
Translation: They shall continue to hold office until their successors are elected and assume office.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这类理事的职任在任期未满时空出,这个空缺将由其前任有权为之投票的那个参与国或几个参与国选出新理事来填补空缺。
Translation: If the office of such a director becomes vacant before the expiration of the term, the vacancy shall be filled by the appointment of a new director by the participating country or countries that were entitled to vote for the predecessor.

Query_Text_cn: 该继任理事将在原理事的余下任期内继续任职。
Translation: The successor director shall serve for the remainder of the original director's term.

Query_Text_cn: (c)当一理事的职位出缺时,前任理事的代理人行使后者的权力,但无权任命另一代理人,但任命临时代理人在该前任代理人不能出席会议时代表他出席会议的情况除外。
Translation: (c) When a vacancy occurs in the office of a governor, the alternate of the former governor shall exercise the powers of the latter, but shall not have the right to appoint another alternate, except for the appointment of a temporary alternate to represent him in the event that the former alternate is unable to attend a meeting.

Query_Text_cn: (i)结果是理事不会因此发生什么变动,条件是一位理事如果停止享有表决权,则他的任期和他的代理事的任期也将即刻随之终止。
Translation: (i) The result is that no change will occur in the composition of the board, provided that if a director ceases to have voting rights, his term of office and that of his alternate shall terminate immediately.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)各参与国及其选定的理事们的表决权将从认缴额增加生效之日新认缴额或表决权可能发生的其他变动之日加以调整。
Translation: (ii) The voting rights of each participating country and its designated governors shall be adjusted from the effective date of the increase in subscriptions or from the date of any other changes that may occur to the new subscriptions or voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: (iii)如果一新的参与国将拥有表决权,它可以指定当时代表着一个或多个参与国的理事来代表它,并为它投票,一直到下一届参与国理事大选时为止。
Translation: (iii) If a new participating country is to have voting rights, it may designate governors then representing one or more participating countries to represent it and cast votes on its behalf until the next election of governors for participating countries.

Query_Text_cn: 8.理事及其代理事进行工作,基金不支付报酬或其他费用。
Translation: 8. No remuneration or other expenses shall be paid by the Fund to Directors or their alternates for their services.

Query_Text_cn: 无论何时,只要有四名理事要求开会,理事会主席就必须召开理事会会议。
Translation: Whenever four directors request a meeting, the chairman of the board must convene a board meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何理事会会议的法定人数是不少于有参与国全部选举权3/4。
Translation: 2. The quorum for any meeting of the Council shall be not less than three-fourths of all participating states with voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 选举权的理事总人数的大多数。
Translation: a majority of the total number of directors with voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条投票1.银行和参与国作为一个集团,应各自持有1000张票。
Translation:
Article 29 Voting  
1. The Bank and the participating countries as a group shall each have 1,000 votes.

Query_Text_cn: 2.每一同时是银行董事的基金会董事应该持有由银行通知基金会该董事可以持有的银行的比例票数,并进行这种投票。
Translation: 2. Each foundation director who is concurrently a bank director shall hold and cast the proportion of votes in the bank that the bank notifies the foundation such director is entitled to hold.

Query_Text_cn: 3.每一参与国应在参与国根据第六条规定所作的认缴额和参与国就第七条(1)和(2)批准的追加认缴额范围内同意作出的追加认缴的基础上参与国总票数中持有一定比例的票数份额。
Translation: 3. Each participating country shall hold a proportion of the total votes of the participating countries based on its subscription amount under Article 6 and any additional subscriptions approved by the participating countries pursuant to Article 7(1) and (2), within the limits of such subscriptions and additional subscriptions agreed to be made.

Query_Text_cn: 在董事会中进行投票,代表参与国的每一董事,应有权投他所代表的那个参与国的票。
Translation: In the Board of Directors, each director representing a participating country shall have the right to cast the vote of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 4.在理事会投票时,银行指派的理事将共拥有1000张票,各参与国选派的理事将共拥有1000张票。
Translation: 4. In Council voting, the directors appointed by the Bank shall collectively hold 1,000 votes, while the directors designated by participating countries shall jointly hold another 1,000 votes.

Query_Text_cn: 按B表第1部分赋予的票数。
Translation: Votes allocated under Part 1 of Schedule B.

Query_Text_cn: 一个或几个参与国选出的理事每个将拥有选举他出任的参与国或几个参与国所持有的票数。
Translation: Each director elected by one or several participating countries shall hold the votes of the participating country or countries that elected him.

Query_Text_cn: 代表一个参与国以上的一个理事可以分别投他所代表的参与国的票。
Translation: A governor representing more than one participating country may cast the votes of the countries he represents separately.

Query_Text_cn: 且(ii)如果一个非地区国家同时是或成为参与国或成员国,那么仅仅为了遵从本协定的宗旨,它将在各方面都不作为一个成员国来对待。
Translation: and (ii) if a non-regional State is or becomes a Participant or Member State at the same time, it shall not be treated as a Member State in any respect solely for the purpose of complying with the objectives of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 7.除了本协定其他地方的例外规定外,董事会或理事会所面临的一切事务应由参与国全部选举权的3/4的大多数决定之。
Translation: 7. Except as otherwise provided elsewhere in this Agreement, all matters before the Board of Directors or the Council shall be decided by a three-fourths majority of the total voting rights of the participating countries.

Query_Text_cn: 他是理事会的主席,但无投票权。
Translation: He is the chairman of the council but has no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 副理事仅在理事缺席时始有投票权。
Translation: A deputy director shall have the right to vote only in the absence of the director.

Query_Text_cn: (iv)根据需要,利用银行的官员、职员、机构、服务处所和设施来推进基金的业务,为确保和控制按第二十二条规定正当建立的机构、适当地配备职员和提供服务,对理事会负责。
Translation: (iv) Utilize, as necessary, the officers, staff, agencies, offices, and facilities of the Bank to advance the Fund's operations, and be accountable to the Board of Governors for ensuring and overseeing the proper establishment of institutions, appropriate staffing, and service provision in accordance with Article XXII.

Query_Text_cn: (v)根据基金可能的需要,聘用诸如顾问、专家之类的人员来基金会工作,亦可终止这类聘任。
Translation: (v) Engage or terminate the employment of consultants, experts, and other personnel as may be necessary for the Foundation's operations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.基金应是法律上独立于银行的不同实体。
Translation: 2. The fund shall be a legally independent entity separate from the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本协定中没有任何规定可使基金对银行的行为和债务负责,或银行对基金的行为和债务负责。
Translation: 3. Nothing in this Agreement shall render the Fund liable for the acts or obligations of the Bank,or the Bank liable for the acts or obligations of the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条存放处每一参与国应指定自己的中央银行或基金可以接受的其他金融机构作为基金可以保存参与国货币、或其他资产的储存处。
Translation:
Article 33 Depositories  
Each participating country shall designate its own central bank or another financial institution acceptable to the Fund as the depository where the Fund may hold the currency or other assets of the participating country.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条通讯渠道每一成员国应指定一个有权机关,使基金可以就任何因协定而产生的事项与之通讯联络。
Translation:
Article 34 Communication Channels  
Each Member State shall designate a competent authority with which the Fund may communicate on any matter arising from this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.依第1款的规定享有免税进口待遇的货物，除了按照批准豁免的参与国同意的条件，不得在准许豁免的参与国境内销售。
Translation: 3. Goods granted duty-free import treatment under paragraph 1 shall not be sold within the territory of the participating country granting the exemption, except under conditions agreed upon by the participating countries approving the exemption.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条出版报告书和提供信息1.基金应出版一份年度报告，包括一份对其帐目进行过审计的报表，并定期将有关它的财政状况的报表和说明其经营结果的收支汇总表，通报给各参与国和成员国。
Translation:
Article 35 Publication of Reports and Provision of Information  
The Fund shall publish an annual report containing an audited statement of its accounts and shall, at regular intervals, circulate to participating and member states statements on its financial position as well as summaries of its receipts and expenditures showing the results of its operations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.基金还可以出版为贯彻其宗旨它认为需要的其他报告书。
Translation: 2. The Fund may also publish such other reports as it deems desirable for the accomplishment of its purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 作为帐目结算的一部分，基金和该国可就基于该国认缴额将要支付给该国的资金数额及支付时间和支付货币达成协议。
Translation: As part of the settlement of accounts, the Fund and the country may agree on the amount, timing, and currency of payments to be made to the country based on its subscription.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条纯收入的分配在为提供储备金和意外费用给予应有的注意后，董事会应不时就如何分配纯收入作出决定。
Translation:
Article 36 Distribution of Net Income  
After making due provision for reserves and contingencies, the Board shall from time to time determine the distribution of net income.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条参与者的退会任何参与者均可通过向基金会总部办公室提交一份书面通知在任何时候退出基金会，退会生效之日是退会书面通知到达之日，或不超过收到书面通知后六个月的通知中具体注明之日。
Translation:
Article 37 Withdrawal of Participants  
Any participant may withdraw from the Foundation at any time by submitting a written notice to the Foundation's headquarters office. The withdrawal shall take effect on the date the written notice is received or on a later date specified in the notice, provided such date does not exceed six months after the receipt of the notice.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条中止参与资格1.一参与者如果不履行它对基金会的义务，基金则可通过董事会的决定，中止其参与资格。
Translation:
Article 38 Suspension of Participation Rights  
1. If a participant fails to fulfill its obligations to the Foundation, the Foundation may, by decision of the Board of Directors, suspend its participation rights.

Query_Text_cn: 被中止资格的参与者从中止之日起即自动停止作为参与者一年，除非董事会作出决定恢复其声誉地位。
Translation: A participant whose qualification is suspended shall automatically cease to be a participant for one year from the date of suspension, unless the Board decides to restore their reputational status.

Query_Text_cn: 2.参与资格被中止期间，参与者除享有退会权外，没有资格行使本协定规定的任何权力，但仍然负有原来的一切义务。
Translation: 2. During the period of suspension of participation, the participant shall not be entitled to exercise any rights under this Agreement except the right to withdraw, but shall remain bound by all original obligations.

Query_Text_cn: 除非本条另有规定，对于它对基金所承担的一切财政义务仍然负责，无论它是作为参与者、借款人、担保人还是其他情况。
Translation: Unless otherwise provided in this Article, it shall remain responsible for all financial obligations to the Fund, whether as a participant, borrower, guarantor, or otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 2.当一国停止为参与者时，基金与该国应着手进行帐目结算。
Translation: 2. When a country ceases to be a participant, the Fund and that country shall proceed to settle accounts.

Query_Text_cn: 用语“认缴额”在用于任何有关参与国时，为着本条和第40条的各项目的应认为既包括这些参与国的初始认缴额，也包括这些参与国的任何追加认缴额。
Translation: The term "subscription" when used in relation to any participant shall, for the purposes of this Article and Article 40, be deemed to include both the initial subscription of that participant and any additional subscriptions thereof.

Query_Text_cn: （ii）基金应将基于参与国认缴额而交付给基金的资金、或由此而来作为还本之用而在该国停止为参与国之日为基金所持有的资金，归还给该国，基金认为它在履行那时融资活动中的债务需要这笔资金者例外。
Translation: (ii) The Fund shall return to a participant the funds paid to the Fund on the basis of its subscription or derived therefrom as repayment of principal and held by the Fund on the day the participant ceases to be a participant, unless the Fund determines that it needs such funds to meet its liabilities in the conduct of its financing activities at that time.

Query_Text_cn: 这个份额应是借贷本金总额中如同参与国因认缴会费而交付，但没有按上述（ii）款退还给它的全部款额对比于全部参与者因认缴会费而交付的、应该已经化掉或基金认为在该国停止为参与国之日，基金在其融资活动中履行债务有需要的那全部金额中的比例的那种比例份额。
Translation: This share shall be in the same proportion to the total amount of the loan principal as the proportion that the total amount paid by the participating country as if it were contributing its subscription, but not refunded to it under subparagraph (ii) above, bears to the total amount paid by all participants as if they were contributing their subscriptions, which should have been utilized or which the Fund deems necessary for the fulfillment of its obligations in its financing operations on the date the country ceases to be a participating country.

Query_Text_cn: 这种分期付款应以基金收到的各种货币来支付，但基金依其自由裁量决定用该有关国家的货币支付者除外。
Translation: Such installments shall be payable in the various currencies received by the Fund, except when the Fund in its discretion decides to make payment in the currency of the country concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 或（2）该国停止为参与者之日，基金帐本上所显示的净资产中那一国认缴额与参与者全体认缴总数之比的那份金额。
Translation: or (2) the amount corresponding to the ratio of that country's subscription to the total subscriptions of all participants as shown in the Fund's books on the date the country ceases to be a participant.

Query_Text_cn: （vi）依此所需的一切计算将在基金合理决定的基础上进行。
Translation: (vi) All calculations required hereunder shall be made on such reasonable basis as the Fund may determine.

Query_Text_cn: 4.在任何情况下，都不得将本条款下欠该国的任何款项早于一国停止为参与者之日6个月内付给该国。
Translation: 4.Under no circumstances shall any amount due to a country under this Article be paid to that country earlier than six months after the date on which it ceases to be a participant.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在一国停止为参与国之日6个月内，基金如第40条的规定终止其运营，这个国家的一切权利即将依第四十条的规定来加以确定，这个国家将按第四十条的目的被视为基金的一个参与国，但它将没有投票权。
Translation: If, within six months after a country ceases to be a participant, the Fund terminates its operations in accordance with Article 40, all rights of that country shall be determined under the provisions of Article 40, and the country shall be treated as a participant of the Fund for the purposes of that Article but shall have no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条运营的终止及债务的清偿1.基金可以由董事会投票终止其运营。
Translation:
Article 40 Termination of Operations and Settlement of Debts  
1. The Fund may terminate its operations by a vote of the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: 银行或参与国依第37条退会构成基金运营的终止。
Translation: The withdrawal of a bank or participating country under Article 37 constitutes the termination of the fund's operation.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种运营终止之后，基金将立即停止一切活动，但那些属于有秩序地变卖、保存和维护基金资产和清偿债务进行的活动除外。
Translation: Upon such termination of operations, the Fund shall forthwith cease all activities, except those incidental to the orderly liquidation, preservation, and maintenance of its assets and the settlement of its obligations.

Query_Text_cn: 一直到这些债务最终得到清偿，资产最终得到分配之前，基金将继续存在，且基金与参与者在本约定日下的一切相互权利和义务应保持不受削弱，只是参与者不能被中止参与资格、参与者也不得退出基金会，并且不得象本条规定的那样对参与者进行资产分配。
Translation: The Fund shall continue to exist until such time as all debts are finally discharged and assets are ultimately distributed. All mutual rights and obligations between the Fund and the Participants under this Agreement shall remain unimpaired, except that no Participant may be suspended, withdraw from the Fund, or receive asset distributions as provided herein.

Query_Text_cn: 2.尽管存在第1款的规定，总裁有权也有责任在他认为豁免权有碍正义事业且可以在不损害基金利益的情况下放弃此权利时，放弃对任何职员（包括为基金承担任务的专家）享有的豁免权。
Translation: 2. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1, the President shall have the right and duty to waive the immunity of any official (including experts performing missions for the Fund) in any case where, in his opinion, the immunity would impede the course of justice and can be waived without prejudice to the interests of the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 3.以遵从上述规定和就给基金提供资金来源的规范为条件对基金资源的处置达成任何特殊约定，基金应按参与者支付的认缴额的比例将其资产分配给参与国。
Translation: 3. Subject to compliance with the aforementioned provisions and the regulations governing the funding sources of the Fund, any special agreements on the disposition of Fund resources shall be made. The Fund shall distribute its assets to participating countries in proportion to their paid-in contributions.

Query_Text_cn: 任何依本款上述规定进行的分配，就任何参与者而言，应以基金对这些参与者的所有债权都事先得到清偿为条件。
Translation: Any distribution made pursuant to the provisions of this paragraph shall, with respect to any participant, be conditional upon the prior satisfaction of all claims of the Fund against such participant.

Query_Text_cn: 这样的分配应在基金认为合理和公平的时间，以基金认为合理和公平的货币、以现金，或其他资产方式进行。
Translation: Such allocation shall be made at such time or times and in such currency or currencies, in cash or in other assets, as the Fund may deem reasonable and equitable.

Query_Text_cn: 对不同国家、进行的分配，就所分配的资产的类型和资产所表示的货币，不必取得一致。
Translation: Allocation among different countries does not require uniformity in the types of assets allocated or the currencies represented by those assets.

Query_Text_cn: 4.依本条或第39条收到基金所分配的资产的任何参与者，将享有与这些资产在分配前为基金所享有的同样的权力。
Translation: 4. Any participant receiving assets allocated by the Fund under this Article or Article 39 shall enjoy the same rights over such assets as the Fund enjoyed prior to their allocation.

Query_Text_cn: 每个参与国应将其为这种目的所采取的特定行动通知基金。
Translation: Each participating country shall notify the Fund of the specific measures it has taken for such purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 以及（iii）提起诉讼。
Translation: and (iii) initiating legal proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条法律诉讼1.基金对任何法律诉讼享有豁免权，但与基金依第八条行使获取贷款的权力有关或由此引起的诉讼除外，在这后一种情况下，对基金的诉讼行为可以在基金具有办事处或为接受公事送达或诉讼通知指定了代理机构或以其他方式同意被诉的国家或地区内具有司法管辖权的法院提起。
Translation:
Article 43 Legal Proceedings  

1. The Fund shall enjoy immunity from every form of legal process, except in cases arising from or related to the exercise of its borrowing powers under Article VIII. In such cases, action may be brought against the Fund only in a court of competent jurisdiction in the territory of a country or region where the Fund has an office, has appointed an agent for the purpose of accepting service of process or notice of proceedings, or has otherwise consented to be sued.

Query_Text_cn: 2.尽管存在第1款的规定，任何参与者或参与者的任何代理机构或辅助机构或直接或间接地为某一参与者或参与者的任何代理机构或辅助机构行事或从中获得赔偿的任何实体或个人都不得对基金提起诉讼。
Translation: 2. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1, no participant or any agency or instrumentality of a participant, nor any entity or individual acting directly or indirectly for or deriving claims from a participant or any agency or instrumentality thereof, may bring suit against the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 参与者可求助于在本协定和基金的章程、细则及规定中或与基金签订的合同中规定的特殊程序来解决基金与参与者之间的争端。
Translation: Participants may resort to special procedures set forth in this Agreement and the Fund's Articles, By-Laws, and regulations or in contracts concluded with the Fund to resolve disputes between the Fund and participants.

Query_Text_cn: 4.如果依靠本协定的任一条款基金不能享有对法律诉讼的豁免权，基金会，基金的财产和资产——不论它们位于何处或为谁所持有，在对基金作不利于他的最终判之前，仍然应免受任何形式的扣押、查封或强制执行。
Translation: 4. If the Fund is not entitled under any provision of this Agreement to immunity from legal proceedings, the Fund, its property and assets—wherever located and by whomsoever held—shall nevertheless remain immune from all forms of seizure, attachment or execution prior to the delivery of a final judgment against the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条档案的豁免权基金的档案，概而言之，凡属于它或它所持有的无论位于何处的所有文件，都是不可侵犯的。
Translation:
Article 45 Immunity of Archives  
The archives of the Fund shall be inviolable, encompassing all documents belonging to or held by it, wherever located.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条资产免受限制的自由依照本协定的条文，在为实现基金之目的和职能的必要的限度内，基金的全部财产和其他资产应免受任何形式的金融管制法律限制或延期偿付令的制约。
Translation:
Article 46 Freedom of Assets from Restrictions  
In accordance with the provisions of this Agreement, to the extent necessary for the achievement of the Fund's purposes and functions, all property and other assets of the Fund shall be free from restrictions, regulations, controls, or moratoria of any nature.

Query_Text_cn: （ii）当官员和职员不是本地人时，参与国给予他们的在移民管制，外国人登记要求和国内服役义务方面的豁免权及在外汇管制方面的便利，不应低于任何给予它所参加的其他国际金融机构中相应级别的代表，官员和职员的豁免权和便利。
Translation: (ii) When officials and staff members are not local nationals, the participating country shall grant them exemptions from immigration restrictions, alien registration requirements, and national service obligations, as well as facilities in respect of exchange control, no less favorable than those accorded to representatives, officials, and staff members of comparable rank of any other international financial institution in which the participating country is a member.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条免税权1.基金会以及它的资产，财产，收入，运营和交易应被免除一切直接税、官方使用的进出口货物将被免征一切关税和具有相同效力的税，基金会也将被豁免任何支付、扣缴和征集税款的义务。
Translation:
Article 49 Tax Exemption  
1. The Foundation, along with its assets, property, income, operations, and transactions, shall be exempt from all direct taxes. Official imports and exports shall be free from all customs duties and taxes of equivalent effect. The Foundation shall also be exempt from any obligation to pay, withhold, or collect taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 2.尽管存在第1款的规定，基金不得主张免除那些只是因提供服务而收费的赋税。
Translation: 2. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1, the Fund shall not claim exemption from any taxes which are no more than charges for public utility services.

Query_Text_cn: 4.基金付给总裁和职员，包括为基金承担任务的专家的工资和奖金，不得征税。
Translation: 4. No tax shall be levied on salaries and bonuses paid by the fund to its president, staff, or experts engaged in fund-related tasks.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十条基金的弃权1.本章规定的豁免权、免税权和特权是出于基金的利益制定的。
Translation:
Article 50 Waiver of Immunities by the Fund  
1. The immunities, exemptions and privileges provided in this Chapter are granted in the interests of the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会可以在它决定的条件和范围内，在它认为其行动将使基金的利益进一步增长的情况下，放弃本章提出的豁免权、免税权及特权。
Translation: The Council may, under the conditions and within the limits it determines, waive the immunities, exemptions, and privileges set forth in this Chapter when it deems such action would further the interests of the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十一条1.不论出自某一参与者、某一董事或理事会发出的任何对本协定进行修正的提议，应即通知董事会会长，由他把此提案递交董事会。
Translation:
Article 51  
1. Any proposal to amend this Agreement, whether initiated by a participant, a director, or the Council, shall be promptly notified to the Chairman of the Board, who shall submit the proposal to the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: 如果提出的修正案为董事会核准，则基金应用通知或电报的方式询问各参与者是否接受该修正案。
Translation: If the proposed amendment is approved by the board of directors, the fund shall inquire whether each participant accepts the amendment by means of notice or telegram.

Query_Text_cn: 在拥有85%选举权的四分之三的参与者接受了该修正案后，基金应通过发给参与者正式通知的方式确认这一事实。
Translation: The Fund shall confirm this fact by issuing an official notice to the participants after three-fourths of them, holding 85% of the voting rights, have accepted the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 除非董事会专门规定另一期限或日期，修正案应在本款所规定的正式通知下达日三个月后对全体参与者生效。
Translation: Unless the Board specifically prescribes another period or date, the amendment shall become effective for all participants three months after the date of the formal notice specified in this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条宗旨本协会的宗旨是为了帮助世界上欠发达地区的协会会员国促进经济发展，提高生产力，从而提高生活水平，特别是以比通常贷款更为灵活、在国际收支方面负担较轻的条件提供资金，以解决它们在重要的发展方面的需要，从而进一步发展国际复兴开发银行（以下简称银行）的开发目标并补充其活动。协会的一切决定，均应以本条规定为准则。
Translation:
**Article I Purpose**  

The purpose of the Association is to promote economic development, increase productivity, and thus raise standards of living in the less-developed areas of the world included within the Association's membership, in particular by providing finance to meet their important developmental requirements on terms which are more flexible and bear less heavily on the balance of payments than those of conventional loans, thereby furthering the developmental objectives of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (hereinafter referred to as the Bank) and supplementing its activities. All decisions of the Association shall be guided by the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 一、协会的创始会员国应是目前列入附录一中的银行会员国，并在本协定第十一条第二节第三款规定日期，或在此日期以前接受协会会员国资格者。
Translation: 1. The founding member countries of the Association shall be those countries listed in Appendix I that are Bank members on the date specified in Article XI, Section 2(c), or become Bank members prior to that date and accept membership in the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 二、银行的其他会员国，可按照协会规定的时间和条件，加入协会为会员国。
Translation: II. Other members of the Bank may become members of the Association in accordance with such terms and conditions as the Association may prescribe.

Query_Text_cn: 一、每个会员国在接受会员国资格时，应按分配给他的数额认缴股金。这种认股以下称为首次认股。
Translation: I. Each member country shall subscribe to the capital stock allocated to it upon acceptance of membership. Such subscription shall hereinafter be referred to as the initial subscription.

Query_Text_cn: 二、分配给每个创始会员国的首次认股金额，载明于附录一中会员国名下，以美元表示，此项美元以１９６０年１月１日美元的含金量和成色为准。
Translation: II. The initial subscription amount allocated to each founding member is specified in Appendix I under the name of the member, denominated in U.S. dollars based on the gold value and fineness of the U.S. dollar as of January 1, 1960.

Query_Text_cn: 以后每隔一年缴付百分之十二点五，直至缴足首次认股额的百分之十部分为止。
Translation: Thereafter, 12.5 percent shall be paid every subsequent year until the initial subscription amount of 10 percent is fully paid.

Query_Text_cn: 四、每个创始会员国首次认股的其余百分之九十部分，如系列入附录一第一部分的会员国，则应以黄金或可自由兑换的货币缴付。
Translation: IV. The remaining 90 percent of the initial subscription of each original member listed in Part I of Annex I shall be paid in gold or freely convertible currency.

Query_Text_cn: 列入附录一第二部分的会员国，则可用认股会员国的本国货币缴付。创始会员国首次认股的百分之九十部分应依照以下安排，分五期逐年缴付：第一期在协会按照第十一条第四节规定的日期开业后三十天内，或者在创始会员国成为协会会员国之日缴付，两者中以较晚的日期为准；第二期应在协会开业一年后缴付，以后每隔一年缴付一期，直至缴足首次认股额的百分之九十部分为止。
Translation: Member countries listed in Part II of Appendix I may make their payments in the national currency of the subscribing member country. Ninety percent of the initial subscription of each founding member shall be paid in five equal annual installments as follows: the first installment shall be paid within thirty days after the date on which the Association begins operations pursuant to Article XI, Section 4, or on the date on which the founding member becomes a member, whichever shall be later; the second installment shall be paid one year after the Association begins operations, and each succeeding installment shall be paid one year thereafter until ninety percent of the initial subscription has been paid.

Query_Text_cn: 五、协会对任何会员国根据前述第四款或根据第四条第二节规定缴付或应缴的本国货币，在本协会业务上不需要时，应接受该会员国政府，或者指定的存款机构所发行的票据或类似的债券以代替该会员国货币的任何部分。此种债券不得转让、不计利息、并按票面价值见票即付，在指定的存款机构存入协会的帐户内。
Translation: V. The Association shall accept from any member, in place of any part of the member's currency paid or payable by the member under the provisions of paragraph 4 of the preceding section or under Section 2 of Article IV, and not required by the Association in its operations, the notes or similar obligations issued by the government of the member or the depository designated by the member. Such notes or obligations shall be non-negotiable, non-interest-bearing, and payable at their face value on demand to the account of the Association in the designated depository.

Query_Text_cn: （二）一个会员国的货币，经该会员国同意，可在协会满意的条件下，兑换成其他会员国货币供协会业务需要者。
Translation: (2) The currency of any member may, with the consent of that member, be exchanged by the Association for the currencies of other members to the extent needed for the operations of the Association and on terms satisfactory to the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 七、除协会另外同意，附录一第一部分的每个会员国，对其按本节第四款作为可自由兑换的货币而缴付的货币，应保持其在缴付时同样的可兑换性。
Translation: VII. Each member country listed in Part I of Appendix I shall maintain the same convertibility for its currency paid under Section 4 of this Article as was applicable at the time of payment, unless otherwise agreed by the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 八、创始会员国以外的会员国，其首次认股的条件、金额以及相应的缴款办法，由协会按本条第一节第二款规定确定。
Translation: VIII. For member countries other than founding members, the terms and amounts of their initial subscriptions and the manner of payment of the corresponding subscriptions shall be determined by the Association in accordance with the provisions of Section 1(b) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节责任的限度会员国不因其为协会的会员，而对协会债务承担责任。
Translation:
Section 3 Limits of Liability  

No member shall be liable, by reason of its membership, for the obligations of the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 一、协会根据创始会员国首次认股缴款的完成情况，在它认为适当的时候，以及在其后大约每隔五年，应对其资金是否充足进行检查，如认为有必要时，可批准普遍增加认股额。但是虽有以上规定，协会仍可在任何时候批准普遍地或个别地增加认股。唯个别增加认股，只有在有关会员国申请时才予考虑。按本节规定所作的认股以下简称为追加认股。
Translation: 1. The Association shall review the adequacy of its resources at such times as it deems appropriate in light of the completion of initial subscriptions by founding members, and approximately every five years thereafter. If deemed necessary, it may approve a general increase in subscriptions. Notwithstanding the above, the Association may at any time approve general or individual increases in subscriptions, provided that individual increases shall only be considered upon request by the relevant member country. Subscriptions made under this section are hereinafter referred to as additional subscriptions.

Query_Text_cn: 二、按下列第三款规定，当追加认股获得批准时，批准认股的金额，以及有关认股的规定和条件，应由协会确定。
Translation: II. When additional subscriptions are approved pursuant to the provisions of paragraph 3 below, the amount of the subscription so approved and the terms and conditions relating thereto shall be determined by the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 三、追加认股一经批准，各会员国在协会合理确定的条件下，有机会认购一定数额的股份，使其能保持相应的投票权。但会员国并无必须认股的义务。
Translation:
III. Additional Subscriptions  
Once approved, each member country shall have the opportunity to subscribe to a specified amount of shares under conditions reasonably determined by the Association, so as to maintain its corresponding voting power. However, no member country is obligated to make such subscriptions.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本节一切规定，需经总投票权三分之二多数通过。
Translation: 4. All provisions of this section shall require approval by a two-thirds majority of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 一、协会在符合本协定规定所达成的协议条件下，可以作出安排接受任何一个会员国以其他会员国的货币作为其应付的首次认股或追加认股以外增加的补充资金，但是，除非协会确知其货币所涉及的会员国同意使用其货币作为补充资金，并同意其使用的条件，否则，协会不得作出任何此类安排。接受任何这类资金的安排，可包括有关资金收益的处理规定，以及提供资金的会员国停止其会籍或在本协会永远停止业务的情况下处理该项资金的规定。
Translation: 1. The Association may, under the terms of agreements conforming to the provisions of this Agreement, make arrangements to accept from any member country supplementary funds in the currency of another member country in addition to its initial or additional subscriptions. However, the Association shall not make any such arrangement unless it is satisfied that the member country whose currency is involved consents to the use of its currency as supplementary funds and agrees to the terms thereof. Arrangements for accepting any such funds may include provisions regarding the treatment of income derived from such funds, as well as provisions for the disposal of such funds in the event of the withdrawal of the contributing member country from membership or the permanent cessation of the Association's operations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协会应授予贡献资金的会员国一张“特别发展证书”，载明所贡献的资金的金额和货币类别，以及有关此项资金安排的条件。“特别发展证书”不带有任何选举权，并且只能转让给协会。
Translation: II. The Association shall issue to each member country contributing funds a "Special Development Certificate" specifying the amount and currency of the funds contributed, as well as the terms governing such fund arrangements. The "Special Development Certificate" shall not confer any voting rights and may only be transferred to the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本节所述各点不应排除协会按协议的条件接受会员国以其本国货币提供的资金。
Translation: III. Nothing in this Section shall preclude the Association from accepting, on such terms and conditions as may be agreed upon, funds provided by a member country in its own currency.

Query_Text_cn: 一、列入附录一第二部分的任何会员国的货币，不论其是否可以自由兑换，凡属按第二条第二节第四款规定以该会员国货币缴付其应缴的百分之九十部分而为协会所接受；以及由该款衍生作为本金、利息和其他费用而得到的该国货币，协会可将其用于支付在该会员国领土上所需的协会行政费用；并且，只要符合妥善的货币政策，也可用于支付在该会员国领土上所生产的、并为在该会员国领土内由协会资助的项目所需要的物资和劳务。
Translation: 1. Any currency of a member listed in Part II of Schedule I, whether or not freely convertible, which is received by the Association as payment of the ninety percent portion of its subscription pursuant to Section 2(b)(iv) of Article II, as well as any such currency derived therefrom as principal, interest, or other charges, may be used by the Association to meet its administrative expenditures in the territories of that member. Furthermore, provided it is consistent with sound monetary policy, such currency may also be used to finance the procurement of goods and services produced within the member's territories that are required for projects funded by the Association within those territories.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，当有关会员国的经济和金融状况，按该会员国与协会间的协议认定，已达到可靠程度时，该会员国货币应可自由兑换，或者可用于该会员国领土外由协会资助的项目。
Translation: Furthermore, when the economic and financial conditions of the member country concerned are determined, in accordance with an agreement between that member and the Association, to have reached a reliable level, the currency of that member shall be freely convertible or available for projects financed by the Association outside the territory of that member.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协会接受的除创始会员国首次认股以外的认股而缴付的货币，以及由该款衍生，作为本金、利息和其他费用而得到的货币，使用办法应受批准该认股时所规定的条件限制。
Translation: II. The currencies paid by the Association in respect of subscriptions other than initial subscriptions of original members, and the currencies derived therefrom as principal, interest, or other charges, shall be used in accordance with the terms specified at the time of approval of such subscriptions.

Query_Text_cn: 三、作为认股以外由协会接受的补充资金，以及由该款衍生，作为本金、利息和其他费用而得到的货币，其使用办法应以接受此项货币时的安排所规定的条件限制。
Translation: III. As supplementary funds accepted by the Association other than through share subscriptions, as well as currencies derived therefrom as principal, interest, or other charges, their utilization shall be subject to the conditions stipulated in the arrangements under which such currencies were accepted.

Query_Text_cn: 四、协会接受的所有其他货币，协会均可自由使用或兑换，不受其货币被使用或兑换的会员国的任何限制。但以上规定并不排除协会与协会提供资金的项目所在地会员国进行任何安排，限制协会使用与该项资助有关，作为本金、利息或其他费用而收到的该会员国的货币。
Translation: IV. The Association may freely use or exchange any other currencies received by it, without any restriction imposed by the member whose currency is being used or exchanged. However, the foregoing provisions shall not preclude the Association from entering into any arrangements with the member in whose territory a project financed by the Association is located, limiting the use by the Association of such member's currency received by the Association as principal, interest, or other charges in connection with such financing.

Query_Text_cn: 五、协会应采取适当步骤，保证由附录一第一部分所列会员国按第二条第二节第四款规定所缴付的部分股金，在合理的分段间隔时间内，协会应大致按比例地加以运用。但是，以黄金或认股会员国以本国货币以外的其他货币缴付的那部分认股款，可更加迅速地加以运用。
Translation: V. The Association shall take appropriate steps to ensure that the portions of subscriptions paid in by members listed in Part I of Schedule I pursuant to Section 2(b)(iv) of Article II are used by the Association at approximately the same rate over reasonable intervals of time. However, the portions of subscriptions paid in gold or in currencies other than the currency of the subscribing member may be used more rapidly.

Query_Text_cn: 一、当某一会员国的货币票面价值降低，或协会认为，某一会员国货币的外汇价值在其国境内已大为贬值时，则该会员国应在合理时间内，向协会增缴一笔本国货币，以便保持该会员国在认股时按第二条第二节第四款规定应缴付给协会的该国货币以及按本款规定所提供的货币数量的足够价值，不论所持有的这种货币是否是按第二条第二节第五款规定以票据的形式为协会所接受。但上述规定只限适用于该项货币还从未被支付过或兑换成另一会员国货币的那一部分。
Translation: I. When the par value of a member's currency is reduced, or when the foreign exchange value of a member's currency has, in the opinion of the Association, depreciated to a significant extent within that member's territories, the member shall pay to the Association within a reasonable time an additional amount of its currency sufficient to maintain the value, as of the time of subscription, of the amount of the member's currency paid in to the Association by the member under Article II, Section 2(d), and the amount of the member's currency furnished under the provisions of this Section, whether or not such currency is held in the form of notes accepted pursuant to Article II, Section 2(e). The foregoing provision shall apply only if, and to the extent that, such currency shall not have been initially disbursed or exchanged for the currency of another member.

Query_Text_cn: 二、当某一会员国的货币票面价值增值，或者协会认为，某一会员国的货币的外汇价值在该国境内已升高至可观程度时，协会应在合理时间内，退还给该会员国一笔该国货币，其数额等于本节第一款规定所适用的这种货币额增长的价值。
Translation: II. When the par value of a member's currency is increased, or the Association determines that the foreign exchange value of a member's currency has appreciated to a significant extent within its territories, the Association shall, within a reasonable period, refund to that member an amount of its currency equal to the increase in the value of the amount of such currency specified in Section 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 三、当国际货币基金组织对所有会员国货币票面价值作普遍按比例调整时，协会得放弃上述规定。
Translation: III. The Association may waive the aforementioned provisions when the International Monetary Fund makes a general proportional adjustment to the par values of the currencies of all member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 四、按本节第一款规定，为维持任何一种货币价值而加缴的金额，其可兑换和使用程度应与该项货币一样。
Translation: IV. Any additional payment made under paragraph 1 of this Section to maintain the value of any currency shall be convertible and usable to the same extent as that currency.

Query_Text_cn: 一、协会应提供资金以促进在协会会员国范围内世界上欠发达地区的发展。
Translation: 1. The Association shall provide funds to promote development in the world's least developed regions within its member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协会提供的资金，应用于协会根据有关地区需要情况，认为符合应予优先发展之目的。并且，除非有特殊情况，应用于具体项目。
Translation: II. The funds provided by the Association shall be used for purposes which the Association considers, on the basis of the needs of the area concerned, to be of high priority and, except in special circumstances, shall be used for specific projects.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如果协会认为，受款人可以合理条件从私人来源获得该项资金，或者可以由世界银行贷款方式提供时，协会即不应提供资助。
Translation: III. The Association shall not provide financing if it considers that the recipient can obtain the funds from private sources on reasonable terms or that the financing can be provided through a World Bank loan.

Query_Text_cn: 四、除非经一合格的委员会对贷款申请的优点仔细审核，提出推荐外，协会不应提供资助。每一合格的委员会，均应由协会指定，其中应包括代表审议中项目所在地（一或几个）会员国的（一或几个）理事提名的人员一人，以及协会的技术人员一或数人。要求委员会包括理事提名的人员这一点有适用于向公共的国际或区域性组织提供资金的情况。
