Translation: Article 7 In accordance with the laws and regulations of both Contracting Parties and on the basis of reciprocity, the designated airline of one Contracting Party shall, within sixty days after receiving the invoice, remit the payments due to the designated airline of the other Contracting Party to the designated bank account of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约对方领土内遇险或失事时,缔约对方应采取营救措施,并对旅客和空勤组提供援救,尽力保护飞机和机内装载物,同时立即通知缔约一方。
Translation: Article 8 In the event that an aircraft designated by one Contracting Party is in distress or meets with an accident in the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall take measures for search and rescue, provide assistance to the passengers and crew, make every effort to protect the aircraft and its load, and immediately notify the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 对于失事情况,缔约对方应负责调查,并将结果通知缔约一方。缔约一方可派员参加调查。
Translation: In the event of an accident, the other contracting party shall be responsible for conducting an investigation and notifying one contracting party of the results. One contracting party may send personnel to participate in the investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条缔约双方民航当局如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧,应本着友好合作的精神协商解决,如不能取得一致意见,则由缔约双方通过外交途径解决。
Translation: Article 9 In the event of any divergence of views between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the matter shall be resolved through friendly consultations in a spirit of cooperation. Should no agreement be reached, the dispute shall be settled through diplomatic channels between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条缔约一方如认为需要修改本协定或其附件时,可随时要求与缔约对方进行磋商,并应于缔约对方收到要求之日后六十天内开始。
Translation: Article 10 If either Contracting Party deems it necessary to amend this Agreement or its annexes, it may request consultations with the other Contracting Party at any time. Such consultations shall commence within sixty days from the date the other Contracting Party receives the request.

Query_Text_cn: 经双方达成协议的修改条款,在双方换文证实后生效。
Translation: The revised terms agreed upon by both parties shall enter into force upon confirmation through an exchange of notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条一、缔约一方或缔约一方指定空运企业如不遵守本协定的规定,缔约对方有权暂停或者撤销缔约一方指定空运企业行使本协定规定的权利。
Translation:
Article 11  
1. If a Contracting Party or its designated airline fails to comply with the provisions of this Agreement, the other Contracting Party shall have the right to suspend or revoke the rights granted under this Agreement to the designated airline of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方如欲终止本协定,可随时书面通知缔约对方,在缔约对方收到通知之日起六个月以后本协定即行终止。
Translation: II. Either Contracting Party may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving written notice to the other Contracting Party, and the Agreement shall cease to have effect six months after the date of receipt of such notice by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条本协定自一九七O年二月十五日起生效。
Translation: Article 12 This Agreement shall enter into force on February 15, 1970.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九六九年十一月七日在北京签订，共两份，每份都用中文和阿拉伯文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Beijing on November 7, 1969, in duplicate in the Chinese and Arabic languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 另附英文译本，供解释时参考。
Translation: An English translation is attached for reference during interpretation.

Query_Text_cn: 由中国的一点——经缔约双方协议的第三国的地点——伊拉克的巴格达和巴士拉——经缔约双方协议的其他第三国的地点。
Translation: From a point in China—a location in a third country agreed upon by both contracting parties—Baghdad and Basra in Iraq—to other locations in third countries as mutually agreed by the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 由伊拉克的一点——经缔约双方协议的第三国的地点——中国的广州和上海——经缔约双方协议的其他第三国的地点。
Translation: From a point in Iraq—a location in a third country agreed upon by both contracting parties—Guangzhou and Shanghai in China—to other locations in third countries as mutually agreed upon by both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约对方领土内一点至另一点间无业务权，不论此项业务的始发站或终点站为何地。
Translation: 3. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall not enjoy cabotage rights between any two points in the territory of the other Contracting Party, regardless of the origin or destination of such traffic.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机，至少应在规定航线上缔约对方境内的一点降停，但在规定航线上的其他各点可以飞越而不降停。
Translation: 4. The aircraft designated by one Contracting Party shall, at least at one point in the territory of the other Contracting Party on the specified route, make a stop, but may fly over other points on the specified route without landing.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国政府和伊拉克共和国政府愿在互相尊重领土完整和主权、互不侵犯、互不干涉内政、平等互利和和平共处的基础上,发展两国间的文化关系和文化事业上的合作,从而促进两国人民的相互了解和友好关系。为此,决定签订本协定。
Translation: The Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Iraq, desiring to develop cultural relations and cooperation in cultural affairs between the two countries on the basis of mutual respect for territorial integrity and sovereignty, non-aggression, non-interference in each other's internal affairs, equality and mutual benefit, and peaceful coexistence, thereby promoting mutual understanding and friendly relations between their peoples, have decided to conclude this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条缔约双方鼓励和支持两国大学教授、学者、政府文教部门的官员和文学、艺术、科学、教育、医药卫生等方面人士及学生和青年组织相互的访问、交流经验,并将促进由双方政府推荐的同上述各方面有关的相应机构之间的联系。
Translation: Article 1 The Contracting Parties shall encourage and support mutual visits and exchanges of experience between university professors, scholars, officials from government cultural and educational departments, as well as individuals in the fields of literature, art, science, education, medicine, and public health, along with students and youth organizations. They shall also facilitate connections between corresponding institutions recommended by both governments in the aforementioned areas.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条缔约双方互派留学生,并愿为此设置一定名额的奖学金。
Translation: Article 2 The two Contracting Parties shall exchange students and are willing to establish a certain number of scholarships for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 双方留学生应尊重接受国的学制。
Translation: Students from both countries shall respect the academic systems of their host countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条缔约双方对其在对方国家的留学生的文凭和学位均按照对方学制规定办理。
Translation: Article 3 Both contracting parties shall recognize the diplomas and degrees of students studying in each other's countries in accordance with the respective educational systems.

Query_Text_cn: 如一方没有学位制度,可照顾对方要求发给留学生必要的证件。
Translation: If one party does not have a degree system, it may accommodate the other party's request to issue necessary certificates for students studying abroad.

Query_Text_cn: 证件或学位评定的具体方法另在年度执行计划中商订。
Translation: The specific methods for credential or degree evaluation shall be separately agreed upon in the annual implementation plan.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条缔约双方互聘教授、学者、科学家赴对方进行短期讲学或长期任教。
Translation: Article 4: Both contracting parties shall mutually engage professors, scholars, and scientists to deliver short-term lectures or undertake long-term teaching assignments in each other's country.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约双方为了研究彼此国家的语言、文学和文化,将考虑在他们的大学和文化机构中设立学术讲座。
Translation: Article 5 The Contracting Parties shall consider establishing academic lectures in their universities and cultural institutions for the purpose of studying each other's languages, literature, and culture.

Query_Text_cn: 有关方法另在年度执行计划中商订。
Translation: The specific methods will be further discussed and agreed upon in the annual implementation plan.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条缔约双方鼓励双方体育团体之间的合作,派遣体育队或运动家进行相互访问和友谊比赛。
Translation: Article 6 The Contracting Parties shall encourage cooperation between their sports organizations and facilitate mutual visits and friendly matches by sports teams or athletes.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条缔约双方鼓励和支持两国间在新闻广播和电视方面的相互合作和新闻记者的相互访问,并相互派遣官方通讯社记者常驻对方国家。
Translation: Article 7 The Contracting Parties shall encourage and support mutual cooperation in the fields of press, radio and television as well as exchanges of visits between journalists, and shall reciprocally accredit resident correspondents of their official news agencies in each other's country.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条缔约双方鼓励双方艺术表演家和艺术表演团进行相互访问和演出。
Translation: Article 8 The Contracting Parties shall encourage mutual visits and performances by artists and art troupes from both sides.

Query_Text_cn: 、相互交换文物的多余原件或文物复制品,鼓励和支持考古学家相互访问和在对方国家举行短期展览会。
Translation: 1. Exchange duplicate cultural relics or replicas with each other, and encourage and support mutual visits by archaeologists and the organization of short-term exhibitions in each other's countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条缔约双方为实施本协定各派代表2人共同组成一个常设委员会,根据本协定的原则负责商订年度执行计划,并督促检查其执行情况。
Translation: Article 10: To implement this Agreement, both contracting parties shall each appoint two representatives to form a standing committee. This committee shall be responsible for negotiating and formulating annual implementation plans in accordance with the principles of this Agreement, as well as supervising and inspecting their execution.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条本协定经双方政府核准并相互通知后生效。
Translation: Article 11 This Agreement shall enter into force upon approval by both governments and mutual notification thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定经双方同意可以修改。
Translation: This Agreement may be amended by mutual consent of both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如一方要求停止执行本协定,须在六个月前书面通知对方。
Translation: Either party may request termination of this Agreement by providing written notice to the other party six months in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于1959年4月4日在巴格达签订。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Baghdad on April 4, 1959.

Query_Text_cn: 共两份,每份都用中文、阿拉伯文或英文写成,三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Two copies, each in Chinese, Arabic or English, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 在条文的解释上发生分歧的时候,以英文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy in the interpretation of the provisions, the English text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: ()通知联合国秘书长，由秘书长以其可以使用之一切适当通讯工具传播此项消息，毋稍稽延。
Translation: Notify the Secretary-General of the United Nations, who shall disseminate this message without delay through all appropriate means of communication at his disposal.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条如因意外事故、危难、紧急或非出于本意降落之结果，外空机人员在一缔约国管辖领域内降落，该缔约国应立即采取一切可能步骤援救此种人员，并提供一切必要协助，该缔约国应将所采步骤及其进展情形通知发射当局及联合国秘书长。
Translation: Article 2 In the event of an accident, distress, emergency or unintended landing resulting in the descent of personnel of a spacecraft within the territory under the jurisdiction of a Contracting State, that State shall immediately take all possible steps to rescue such personnel and render all necessary assistance. The State shall inform the launching authority and the Secretary-General of the United Nations of the steps taken and their progress.

Query_Text_cn: 如发射当局之协助有助于实现迅速援救，或对搜寻及援救行动之效力大有贡献，发射当局应与该缔约国合作，以求有效进行搜寻及援救行动。
Translation: Where the assistance of the launching authority would help to effect a prompt rescue or would contribute substantially to the effectiveness of search and rescue operations, the launching authority shall cooperate with the Contracting State with a view to the effective conduct of search and rescue operations.

Query_Text_cn: 此项行动应受该缔约国指挥管制，该缔约国应与发射当局密切并不断会商行事。
Translation: This operation shall be conducted under the direction and control of the said Contracting Party, which shall act in close and continuing consultation with the launching authority.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条如获悉或发现外空机人员已下降于公海上或不属任何国家管辖之任何其他地点，能提供协助之各缔约国应于必要时对搜寻及援救此种人员之行动提供协助，以确保其迅速获救。
Translation: Article 3: If a contracting party learns or discovers that the personnel of a spacecraft have descended on the high seas or in any other place not under the jurisdiction of any state, the contracting parties capable of rendering assistance shall, if necessary, extend support in the search and rescue operations for such personnel to ensure their prompt rescue.

Query_Text_cn: 各该国应将其所采步骤及其进展情形通知发射当局及联合国秘书长。
Translation: Each state shall inform the launching authority and the Secretary-General of the United Nations of the steps it has taken and of their progress.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条如因意外事故、危难、紧急或非出于本意降落之结果，外空机人员在一缔约国管辖领域内降落，或在公海上或不属任何国家管辖之任何其他地点发现，应将此种人员安全并迅速送交发射当局代表。
Translation: Article 4: In the event of an accident, distress, emergency, or unintended landing resulting in the descent of space personnel within the territory of a Contracting State, or their discovery on the high seas or in any other place not under the jurisdiction of any State, such personnel shall be safely and promptly returned to representatives of the launching authority.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一、缔约国于获悉或发现外空物体或其构成部分已于其管辖领域内，或在公海上，或在不属任何国家管辖之任何其他地点返回地球时，应通知发射当局及联合国秘书长。
Translation:
Article V  

1. Upon receiving information or discovering that a space object or its component parts have returned to Earth within its territory, on the high seas, or in any other place not under the jurisdiction of any State, the State Party shall notify the launching authority and the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国对发现外空物体或其构成部分之领域有管辖权者，如经发射当局请求并获得该当局如经请求而提出之协助，应采取其认为可行之步骤，寻获该物体或其构成部分。
Translation: 2. A Contracting Party which has jurisdiction over the territory on which a space object or its component parts are discovered shall, upon the request of the launching authority and with its assistance if so requested, take such steps as it considers practicable to recover the object or its component parts.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如经发射当局请求，在发射当局领域范围以外发现之射入外空物体或其构成部分应送还发射当局代表或留待发射当局代表处置；如经请求，在送还之前，该当局应先提出证明资料。
Translation: III. If requested by the launching authority, a space object or its component parts found beyond the territorial limits of the launching authority shall be returned to or held at the disposal of the launching authority's representatives. Such return or holding at the disposal of the launching authority's representatives shall, if requested, be subject to the presentation of proof prior to the return.

Query_Text_cn: 四、虽有本条第二项及第三项之规定，缔约国有理由相信在其管辖领域内发现或其于别处寻获之外空物体或其构成部分具为危险或毒害性质时，得将此情形通知发射当局，发射当局应立即采取有效步骤，于该缔约国指挥及管制下，消除可能之损害危险。
Translation: 4. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article, if a State Party has reason to believe that a space object or its component parts discovered in its territory or recovered by it elsewhere is of a hazardous or deleterious nature, it may so notify the launching authority, which shall immediately take effective steps, under the direction and control of the said State Party, to eliminate possible danger of harm.

Query_Text_cn: 五、为履行本条第二项及第三项下关于寻获及送还外空物体或其构成部分之义务所支付之费用应由发射当局承担。
Translation: V. The costs incurred in fulfilling obligations to recover and return a space object or its component parts under paragraphs 2 and 3 of this article shall be borne by the launching authority.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条本协定称"发射当局”谓负发射责任之国家或遇国际政府间组织负发射责任时，则指该组织，但该组织必须宣布接受本协定所规定之权利与义务，且该组织之多数会员国为本协定及关于各国探测及使用外空包括月球与其他天体之活动所应遵守原则之条约之缔约国。
Translation: Article 6 For the purposes of this Agreement, the term "launching authority" shall refer to the State responsible for launching, or in the case of an intergovernmental organization bearing responsibility for launching, that organization itself, provided that such organization declares its acceptance of the rights and obligations stipulated herein and that a majority of its member States are parties to this Agreement and to the Treaty on Principles Governing the Activities of States in the Exploration and Use of Outer Space, including the Moon and Other Celestial Bodies.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条一、本协定应听由所有国家签署。
Translation:
Article 7  

1. This Agreement shall be open for signature by all States.

Query_Text_cn: 凡在本协定依本条第三项发生效力前尚未签署之任何国家得随时加入本协定。
Translation: Any country which has not signed this Agreement prior to the date of its entry into force under paragraph 3 of this Article may accede to it at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定应由签署国批准，批准文件及加入文件应送交美利坚合众国，大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国及苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟政府存放，为此指定各该国政府为保管政府。
Translation: II. This Agreement shall be ratified by the signatory states, and the instruments of ratification and accession shall be deposited with the Governments of the United States of America, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, which are hereby designated as the depositary governments.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本协定应于五国政府，包括经本协定指定为保管政府之各国政府，交存批准文件后发生效力。
Translation: III. This Agreement shall enter into force upon the deposit of instruments of ratification by the governments of the five countries, including those governments designated as depositary governments under this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对于在本协定发生效力后交存批准或加入文件之国家，本协定应于其交存批准或加入文件之日发生效力。
Translation: IV. For any country that deposits its instrument of ratification or accession after the entry into force of this Agreement, the Agreement shall enter into force on the date of such deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 五、保管政府应将每一签署之日期，每一批准及加入本协定之文件存放日期，本协定发生效力日期及其他通知，迅速知照所有签署及加入国家。
Translation: V. The depositary government shall promptly inform all signatory and acceding states of the date of each signature, the date of deposit of each instrument of ratification or accession, the date of entry into force of this Agreement, and any other notifications.

Query_Text_cn: 六、本协定应由保管政府遵照联合国宪章第一百零二条规定办理登记。
Translation: VI. This Agreement shall be registered by the depositary government in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条本协定任何当事国得对本协定提出修正。
Translation: Article 8 Any Party to this Agreement may propose amendments to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 修正对于接受修正之每一当事国，应于多数当事国接受时发生效力，嗣后对于其余每一当事国应于其接受之日发生效力。
Translation: An amendment shall enter into force for each State Party accepting it upon acceptance by a majority of the States Parties and thereafter for each remaining State Party on the date of its acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本协定任何当事国得在本协定生效1年后以书面通知保管政府退出协定。
Translation: Article 9 Any Party to this Agreement may withdraw from it by written notification to the depositary government one year after the Agreement's entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 退出应自接获此项通知之日起1年后发生效力。
Translation: The withdrawal shall take effect one year after the date of receipt of such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条本协定应存放保管政府档库，其英文、俄文、法文、西班牙文及中文各本同一作准。
Translation:
Article 10  
This Agreement shall be deposited in the archives of the depositary government, with the English, Russian, French, Spanish, and Chinese texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 保管政府应将本协定正式副本分送各签署及加入国政府。
Translation: The depositary government shall transmit certified copies of this Agreement to all signatory and acceding governments.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，下列代表，各秉正式授予之权，谨签字于本条约，以昭信守。
Translation: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned, being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments, have signed this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 本条约共缮3份，于公历1968年4月22日订于华盛顿、伦敦及莫斯科。
Translation: This Treaty is drawn up in three copies, done at Washington, London and Moscow on the twenty-second day of April, one thousand nine hundred and sixty-eight.

Query_Text_cn: (a)“协定”系指本协定,包括它的附件,但不包括各条款的标题。
Translation: (a) "Agreement" means this Agreement, including its annexes but excluding the headings of its provisions.

Query_Text_cn: (n)“设计”和“研制”包括直接与卫星组织的宗旨有关的研究。
Translation: (n) "Design" and "development" include research directly related to the objectives of the satellite organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条卫星组织的建立(a)充分考虑到本协定序言中所提出的各项原则,各缔约国特此建立国际通信卫星组织“INTELSAT”,其主要宗旨是长久地继续并促进根据《临时协定》和《特别协定》的规定而建立起来的全球商业通信卫星系统空间段的设计、研制、建造、安装以及操作和维护等项活动。
Translation:
Article II  
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE SATELLITE ORGANIZATION  

(a) In order to achieve the end of a single global commercial communications satellite system as part of an improved global telecommunications network, the Parties hereby establish the International Telecommunications Satellite Organization "INTELSAT," the main purpose of which is to continue and carry forward on a definitive basis the design, development, construction, establishment, operation and maintenance of the space segment of the global commercial communications satellite system as established under the provisions of the Interim Agreement and the Special Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (b)每个缔约国或缔约国所指定的公营或私营电信机构将签署根据本协定而缔结的、并与本协定同时提供签署的《业务协定》。
Translation: (b) Each Contracting Party or the public or private telecommunications entity designated by it shall sign the Operating Agreement, which is concluded pursuant to this Agreement and opened for signature simultaneously therewith.

Query_Text_cn: 作为签字者的电信机构与指定它的缔约国之间的关系,应遵循其现行国内法律。
Translation: The relationship between the telecommunications entity as a signatory and the Contracting State that designated it shall be governed by the applicable domestic laws in force.

Query_Text_cn: (c)各电信主管部门与电信机构可根据其现行国内法律进行谈判,就按照本协定和《业务协定》所提供的电信信道的使用和向公众提供的业务项目、设施、收入的摊分以及有关的商业安排等问题,直接订立适当的业务协定。
Translation: (c) The respective telecommunications administrations and entities may, in accordance with their existing domestic laws, negotiate and directly conclude appropriate operating agreements concerning the use of telecommunications channels provided under this Agreement and the Operating Agreement, as well as the services offered to the public, facilities, revenue sharing, and related commercial arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条卫星组织的活动范围(a)在长久地继续并促进本协定第二条(a)款所述的全球商业卫星通信系统空间段的活动中,卫星组织的首要目标是提供高质量和可靠的商用国际公众电信业务所需的空间段,以使这种电信业务一视同仁地供世界所有地区使用。
Translation:
Article III Scope of INTELSAT Activities  
(a) In continuing and extending the global commercial satellite communications system space segment referred to in Article II(a) of this Agreement, the primary objective of INTELSAT shall be to provide space segment capable of delivering high-quality and reliable services required for international public telecommunications, ensuring such services are made available on a non-discriminatory basis to all regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)无宽频带地面设施连接的地区之间的国内公众电信业务。这些地区被特殊的自然障碍隔开,因而使在这些地区之间安装宽频带设施受到阻碍。但这须事先由签字者会议在考虑董事会的意见后予以批准。
Translation: (ii) Domestic public telecommunications services between areas without broadband terrestrial connections. These areas are separated by exceptional natural barriers, thereby impeding the installation of broadband facilities between them. However, such services must first be approved by the Signatory Assembly after considering the views of the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: (c)为实现首要目标而建立起来的卫星组织空间段,在卫星组织实现其首要目标的能力不受损害的情况下,也应一视同仁地供其他国内公众电信业务使用。
Translation: (c) The space segment established by the INTELSAT to achieve its primary objectives shall also be made available for other domestic public telecommunications services on a non-discriminatory basis, provided that INTELSAT's ability to fulfill its primary objectives is not impaired.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)所作的安排要从经济和技术观点上能够接受。
Translation: (ii) The arrangements made must be economically and technically acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: 但是不得因此而使卫星组织空间段的经济和有效的运转受到任何不利影响。
Translation: However, this shall not adversely affect the economic and efficient operation of the INTELSAT space segment.

Query_Text_cn: (f)根据本条(d)款的规定,将卫星组织空间段用于特别电信业务和根据本条(e)款规定提供与卫星组织空间段分立的其他卫星和附属设施,均需由卫星组织与申请者签署合同。
Translation: (f) The use of the INTELSAT space segment for specialized telecommunications services pursuant to paragraph (d) of this Article and the provision of separate satellites and associated facilities distinct from the INTELSAT space segment under paragraph (e) shall both require the execution of contracts between INTELSAT and the applicant.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本条(d)款的规定,特别电信业务使用卫星组织空间段和根据本条(e)款(iii)项规定向特别电信业务提供与卫星组织空间段分立的其他卫星或附属设施时,在制订计划阶段,均需按本协定第七条(c)款(iv)项的规定,由缔约国大会授权。
Translation: In accordance with the provisions of paragraph (d) of this Article, when special telecommunications services utilize INTELSAT space segment and when other satellites or ancillary facilities separate from INTELSAT space segment are provided for special telecommunications services under subparagraph (e)(iii) of this Article, authorization by the Assembly of Parties shall be required during the planning phase, as stipulated in Article VII(c)(iv) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 当特别电信业务对卫星组织空间段设施的使用,由于必须改变现有的或计划中的卫星组织空间段设施而需要增加费用时,或者,当特别电信业务按照(e)款(iii)项规定要求提供与卫星组织空间段分立的其他卫星或附属设施时,则一俟董事会将该建议的估计费用、可能获得的利润、所牵涉到的技术和其它问题以及对卫星组织原有业务和未来业务可能产生的影响详细地通知缔约国大会,即应要求缔约国大会按照本协定第七条(c)款(iv)项的规定予以授权。
Translation: When the use of INTELSAT space segment facilities for specialized telecommunications services necessitates additional costs due to modifications required for existing or planned INTELSAT space segment facilities, or when such services require the provision of separate satellites or ancillary facilities distinct from the INTELSAT space segment as stipulated in Article (e)(iii), the Assembly of Parties shall be called upon to grant authorization in accordance with Article VII(c)(iv) of this Agreement. This shall occur once the Board of Governors has provided the Assembly of Parties with detailed information on the estimated costs of the proposed service, potential revenues, technical and other issues involved, as well as the possible impact on INTELSAT's existing and future operations.

Query_Text_cn: 授权手续应在购买所需设施开始之前完成。
Translation: The authorization procedures should be completed before the commencement of purchasing the required facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 在予以授权之前,缔约国大会应以适当方式同与提供该项特别电信业务直接有关的联合国专门机构进行协商,或应保证已责成卫星组织进行了这种协商。
Translation: Before granting authorization, the Assembly of Parties shall consult in an appropriate manner with the relevant United Nations specialized agency directly concerned with the provision of the particular telecommunications service, or shall ensure that such consultation has been conducted by INTELSAT.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条法人身份(a)卫星组织具有法人身份。
Translation:
Article 4 Legal Status  
(a) The Satellite Organization shall possess legal personality.

Query_Text_cn: (iv)作为法律诉讼的当事者。
Translation: (iv) As a party to legal proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: (b)各缔约国应在其权限内采取必要的行动,以便依照本国法律实施本条各款。
Translation: (b) Each State Party shall take such measures as may be necessary, within its competence, to ensure the implementation of the provisions of this article in accordance with its domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条财务原则(a)卫星组织是卫星组织空间段和卫星组织获得的所有其他财产的所有者。
Translation:
Article 5 Financial Principles  
(a) The Satellite Organization shall be the owner of the INTELSAT space segment and all other property acquired by the Satellite Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 每一签字者在卫星组织的财务利益,等于把它的投资股份乘以按《业务协定》第七条的规定产生的评定额新得出的金额。
Translation: Each signatory's financial interest in the INTELSAT shall be equal to the amount arrived at by multiplying its investment share by the assessment established pursuant to Article 7 of the Operating Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (b)每个签字者所具有的投资股份应相当于它在按《业务协定》算出来的所有签字者对卫星组织空间段的全部使用量中所占的百分比,然而,签字者对卫星组织空间段的使用量即使为零,其投资股份也不应低于《业务协定》所规定的最低额。
Translation: (b) The investment share of each Signatory shall be equivalent to its percentage of the total utilization of the INTELSAT space segment by all Signatories as calculated under the Operating Agreement; provided, however, that a Signatory's investment share shall not be less than the minimum established in the Operating Agreement, even if its utilization of the INTELSAT space segment is zero.

Query_Text_cn: (c)每个签字者应按照《业务协定》进行投资,以筹集卫星组织的资金需求额,并可获得投资的退款和资本使用报酬金。
Translation: (c) Each signatory shall make investments in accordance with the Operating Agreement to meet INTELSAT's financial requirements and shall be entitled to reimbursement of its investment and compensation for the use of capital.

Query_Text_cn: (d)卫星组织空间段的所有使用者均应交付按照本协定和《业务协定》确定的使用费。
Translation: (d) All users of the INTELSAT space segment shall pay the utilization charges determined in accordance with this Agreement and the Operating Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 各种用途的空间段使用费的标准,对于要求使用该种空间段的所有申请者都应是相同的。
Translation: The standards for space segment usage fees across various applications shall be identical for all applicants requesting access to such space segments.

Query_Text_cn: (e)如经所有签字者一致同意,本协定第三条(e)款所指的其他分立的卫星和附属设施可以作为卫星组织空间段的一部分,由卫星组织出资并占有,如果未能取得一致同意,它们应与卫星组织空间段分开,并由那些需要者出资和占有。
Translation: (e) If unanimously agreed by all signatories, other separate satellites and associated facilities referred to in Article III(e) of this Agreement may form part of the INTELSAT space segment, financed and owned by INTELSAT. In the absence of such agreement, they shall be separate from the INTELSAT space segment and financed and owned by those requiring them.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下,卫星组织所制订的财务规定和条件应能使其偿付设计、研制、建造和提供这种卫星和附属设施直接所需的全部费用以及卫星组织一般行政费用的一个适当的部分。
Translation: Under such circumstances, the financial regulations and conditions established by the satellite organization shall enable it to cover all direct costs incurred in the design, development, construction, and provision of such satellites and ancillary facilities, as well as an appropriate portion of the organization's general administrative expenses.

Query_Text_cn: (iv)向董事会负责的执行局。
Translation: (iv) An Executive Board accountable to the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: (b)除本协定和《业务协定》另有规定外,任何机构不得擅自作出决定或采取行动去改变、废除、推迟或用其他方式干扰本协定或《业务协定》赋于另一机构的权力的行使和责任或职能的履行。
Translation: (b) Except as otherwise provided in this Agreement and the Operating Agreement, no institution shall make any decision or take any action that would alter, abrogate, suspend, or otherwise interfere with the exercise of powers, the performance of responsibilities, or the discharge of functions conferred by this Agreement or the Operating Agreement upon another institution.

Query_Text_cn: (c)缔约国大会、签字者会议和董事会均应在各自遵守本条(b)款的条件下,注意并恰当地考虑其他机构在行使本协定或《业务协定》赋于它的责任和职能时所作出的决议、建议或所表达的意见。
Translation: (c) The Assembly of Parties, the Meeting of Signatories and the Board of Directors shall each, in exercising their respective responsibilities and functions under this Agreement or the Operating Agreement, give due and proper consideration to resolutions, recommendations or views expressed by the other bodies in the performance of their responsibilities and functions under this Agreement or the Operating Agreement, while adhering to the provisions of paragraph (b) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条缔约国大会(a)缔约国大会由全体缔约国组成,是卫星组织的首要机构。
Translation:
Article 7 The Assembly of Parties  
(a) The Assembly of Parties, composed of all Parties, shall be the principal organ of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: (b)缔约国大会应审议对于卫星组织的作为主权国家的缔约国至关重要的问题。
Translation: (b) The Assembly of Parties shall deliberate on matters of critical importance to the sovereign states that are parties to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国大会有权审议与本协定所规定的卫星组织的原则、宗旨和活动范围相一致的卫星组织总政策和长远目标。
Translation: The Assembly of Parties has the authority to review the general policies and long-term objectives of the Organization, provided they are consistent with the principles, purposes, and scope of activities as stipulated in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本协定第六条(b)和(c)款,缔约国大会应对签字者会议或董事会向它提出的决议、建议和意见进行应有的和适当的审议。
Translation: In accordance with paragraphs (b) and (c) of Article VI of this Agreement, the Assembly of States Parties shall give due and proper consideration to resolutions, recommendations and opinions submitted to it by the Meeting of Signatories or the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: (xiv)行使根据本协定的规定在其权限内的任何其它权力。
Translation: (xiv) exercise any other powers within its competence as provided for in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (d)缔约国大会第一次普通会议应在本协定生效之日起的一年内由秘书长召开。
Translation: (d) The first ordinary meeting of the Conference of the Parties shall be convened by the Secretary-General within one year after the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 此后,每两年召开一次普通会议。
Translation: Thereafter, ordinary sessions shall be convened every two years.

Query_Text_cn: 但是缔约国大会还可在逐次会议上对下届会议时间另作决定。
Translation: However, the Conference of the States Parties may also decide on the timing of the next session at successive meetings.

Query_Text_cn: (e)(i)除本条(d)款规定的普通会议外,缔约国大会还可召开非常会议。非常会议或是应董事会根据本协定第十四或十六条规定所提出的要求,或是应得到包括申请国在内至少三分之一缔约国附议的一个或几个缔约国的要求得以召开。
Translation: (e)(i) In addition to the ordinary meetings provided for in paragraph (d) of this Article, the Conference of the Parties may hold extraordinary meetings. Such meetings shall be convened either at the request of the Board pursuant to the provisions of Article XIV or XVI of this Agreement, or upon the request of one or more Parties endorsed by at least one third of the Parties, including the requesting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)要求召开非常会议时,应申述会议的目的,并应以书面形式向秘书长或总干事提出申请,秘书长或总干事应按照缔约国大会关于召开此种会议的议事规则尽快地作出安排。
Translation: (ii) When requesting the convening of an extraordinary session, the purpose of the meeting shall be stated, and the request shall be submitted in writing to the Secretary-General or Director-General, who shall arrange for the session to be held as soon as possible in accordance with the rules of procedure of the Meeting of the States Parties concerning the convening of such sessions.

Query_Text_cn: (f)缔约国大会任何会议的法定人数应由大多数缔约国的代表组成。
Translation: (f) The quorum for any meeting of the Conference of the Parties shall consist of a majority of the representatives of the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 每个缔约国有一个表决权。
Translation: Each Contracting State shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 关于实质性问题的决定至少由出席并参加表决的三分之二缔约国代表赞成方能通过。
Translation: Decisions on matters of substance shall be made by a two-thirds majority of the representatives of States Parties present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 关于程序性问题的决定由出席并参加表决的缔约国代表的简单多数赞成方能通过。
Translation: Decisions on procedural matters shall be adopted by a simple majority of the representatives of States Parties present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 关于某一具体问题究竟是程序性问题还是实质性问题的争议,由出席并参加表决的缔约国代表的简单多数票决定。
Translation: Disputes over whether a specific issue is procedural or substantive shall be decided by a simple majority vote of the representatives of States Parties present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: (g)缔约国大会应采用自己的议事规则,其中包括选举其主席和其它官员的规定。
Translation: (g) The Conference of the States Parties shall adopt its own rules of procedure, including provisions governing the election of its President and other officers.

Query_Text_cn: (h)每一缔约国出席缔约国大会会议费用自理。
Translation: (h) Each State Party shall bear the costs of its participation in the meetings of the Conference of the States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 根据《业务协定》第八条的规定,缔约国大会的会议费用应由卫星组织的行政费开支。
Translation: In accordance with Article VIII of the Operating Agreement, the expenses of meetings of the Assembly of Parties shall be defrayed from the administrative budget of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条签字者会议(a)签字者会议应由所有签字者组成。
Translation:
Article 8 Meeting of Signatories  
(a) The Meeting of Signatories shall be composed of all signatories.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本协定第六条(b)和(c)款的规定,签字者会议应对缔约国大会或董事会提交给它的决议、建议和意见进行应有和适当的审议。
Translation: In accordance with the provisions of Article VI(b) and (c) of this Agreement, the Meeting of Signatories shall give due and proper consideration to resolutions, recommendations, and opinions submitted to it by the Assembly of States Parties or the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)根据本协定第十七条的规定,对本协定的修正案发表意见和提出建议。
Translation: (ii) To express views and make recommendations on amendments to this Agreement in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 hereof.

Query_Text_cn: (c)签字者会议第一次普通会议应根据董事会的要求,在本协定生效后九个月内由秘书长召开。
Translation: (c) The first ordinary meeting of the Conference of Signatories shall be convened by the Secretary-General within nine months after the entry into force of this Agreement, as requested by the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: 此后每一日历年度举行一次例会。
Translation: Thereafter, one regular session shall be held each calendar year.

Query_Text_cn: (d)(i)除本条(c)款规定的例会外,签字者会议还可召开非常会议,非常会议或是应董事会的要求,或是应得到包括申请者在内至少三分之一签字者附议的一个或几个签字者的要求才能召开。
Translation: (d)(i) In addition to the regular meetings provided for in paragraph (c) of this Article, a signatory meeting may also be convened as an extraordinary meeting. Such a meeting shall be held either at the request of the Board or upon the request of one or more signatories supported by at least one-third of the signatories, including the applicant.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)要求召开非常会议时,应申述会议的目的,并应以书面形式向秘书长或总干事提出申请,秘书长或总干事应按照关于召开签字者会议非常会议的议事规则尽快作出安排。
Translation: (ii) A request for an extraordinary meeting shall state the purpose of the meeting and shall be addressed in writing to the Secretary-General or Director-General, who shall arrange for the meeting to be held as soon as possible in accordance with the rules of procedure concerning the convening of extraordinary meetings of signatories.

Query_Text_cn: 非常会议的议程应仅限于召开该会议的目的。
Translation: The agenda of an extraordinary meeting shall be confined to the purpose for which it is convened.

Query_Text_cn: (e)签字者会议的任何会议的法定人数应由大多数签字者的代表组成。
Translation: (e) A quorum for any meeting of the Signatories shall consist of a majority of the representatives of the Signatories.

Query_Text_cn: 每个签字者有一个表决权。
Translation: Each signatory has one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 关于实质性问题的决定,至少由出席并参加表决的三分之二签字者代表赞成方能通过。
Translation: Decisions on substantive matters shall require a two-thirds majority vote of the representatives present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 关于程序性问题的决定由出席并参加表决的签字者代表的简单多数赞成方能通过。
Translation: Decisions on procedural matters shall be made by a simple majority of the signatories present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 关于某一具体问题究竟是程序性问题还是实质性问题的争议,由出席并参加表决的签字者代表的简单多数票决定。
Translation: Disputes over whether a specific issue is procedural or substantive shall be decided by a simple majority vote of the signatory representatives present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: (f)签字者会议应采用自己的议事规则,其中包括选举其主席和其他官员的规定。
Translation: (f) The Meeting of Signatories shall adopt its own rules of procedure, including provisions for the election of its chairperson and other officers.

Query_Text_cn: (g)每一签字者出席签字者会议费用自理。
Translation: (g) Each signatory shall bear its own expenses for attending the signatory meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 根据《业务协定》第八条的规定,签字者会议的会议费用应由卫星组织的行政费开支。
Translation: In accordance with Article 8 of the Operating Agreement, the meeting expenses of the Signatories' Meeting shall be covered by the administrative costs of the Satellite Organization.

Query_Text_cn: (iii)由至少五个按本款(i)和(ii)项不能派代表的、同属于一九六五年蒙特勒国际电信联盟全权代表大会所规定的地区之一的签字者组成的集体的一个代表,在此种情况下,则不论参加该集体的签字者的总投资股份为多少。
Translation: (iii) One representative from a group composed of at least five signatories that cannot be represented under subparagraphs (i) and (ii) of this paragraph and belong to the same region as defined by the 1965 Montreux Plenipotentiary Conference of the International Telecommunication Union, in which case the total investment shares of the signatories participating in such group shall not be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 但是这一类董事的名额,对于国际电信联盟所规定的地区中的任何一个,均不得超过二名,或者,对于其所规定的所有地区不得超过五名。
Translation: However, the number of such directors shall not exceed two for any one of the regions defined by the International Telecommunication Union, or five for all such regions.

Query_Text_cn: (b)(i)在本协定生效之日至第一次签字者会议期间,使一个签字者或签字者集体有资格派代表参加董事会的最低投资股份应当等于所有签字者最初投资股份数额递减顺序表中签字者投资股份的第十三位。
Translation: (b)(i) During the period from the entry into force of this Agreement until the first meeting of signatories, the minimum investment share that qualifies a signatory or group of signatories to be represented on the Board shall be equal to the thirteenth largest investment share among all signatories ranked in descending order of their initial investment shares.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)在本款(i)项所述时期以后,签字者会议应每年确定使一个签字者或签字者集体有资格派代表参加董事会的最低投资股份。
Translation: (ii) After the period referred to in subparagraph (i) of this paragraph, the Meeting of Signatories shall determine annually the minimum investment share which shall entitle a Signatory or group of Signatories to designate a representative to the Board.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的,签字者会议应考虑董事会需由约二十名董事(其中不包括按本条(a)款(iii)项规定所选定的董事)组成。
Translation: For this purpose,the meeting of signatories shall consider that the Board needs to consist of approximately twenty directors(excluding those selected pursuant to paragraph(a)(iii) of this Article).

Query_Text_cn: (A)在确定最低投资股份时,如董事会由二十、二十一或二十二名董事组成,则签字者会议所确定的最低投资股份应等于在当时有效的投资股份顺序表中,其位置与上次确定最低投资股份时所选定的签字者在上次有效顺序表中位置相同的签字者的投资股份。(B)在确定最低投资股份时,如董事会由二十二名以上董事组成,则签字者会议所确定的最低投资股份应等于在当时有效的投资股份顺序表中,其位置比上次确定最低投资股份时所选定的签字者在上次有效顺序表中的位置前一名的签字者的投资股份。(C)在确定最低投资股份时,如董事会是由少于二十名董事组成,则签字者会议所确定的最低投资股份应等于在当时有效的投资股份顺序表中,比上次确定最低投资股份时所选定的签字者在上次有效顺序表中的位置后一名的签字者的投资股份。
Translation:
(A) In determining the minimum investment share, if the Board consists of twenty, twenty-one, or twenty-two directors, the minimum investment share determined by the Meeting of Signatories shall be equal to the investment share of the signatory whose position in the then-current investment share ranking table corresponds to the position of the signatory selected during the last determination of the minimum investment share in the last effective ranking table.  

(B) In determining the minimum investment share, if the Board consists of more than twenty-two directors, the minimum investment share determined by the Meeting of Signatories shall be equal to the investment share of the signatory whose position in the then-current investment share ranking table is one place higher than that of the signatory selected during the last determination of the minimum investment share in the last effective ranking table.  

(C) In determining the minimum investment share, if the Board consists of fewer than twenty directors, the minimum investment share determined by the Meeting of Signatories shall be equal to the investment share of the signatory whose position in the then-current investment share ranking table is one place lower than that of the signatory selected during the last determination of the minimum investment share in the last effective ranking table.

Query_Text_cn: (iv)如果在采用本款第(iii)(B)项所规定的排列方法时,董事名额少于二十个；或者如果在采用本款第(iii)(C)项所规定的排列方法时,董事名额多于二十二个,则签字者会议应确定一个能更好地保证有二十个董事的投资股份。
Translation: (iv) If the number of directors is fewer than twenty when the arrangement method specified in subparagraph (iii)(B) of this paragraph is applied, or if the number of directors exceeds twenty-two when the arrangement method specified in subparagraph (iii)(C) of this paragraph is applied, the Meeting of Signatories shall determine an investment share that better ensures twenty directors.

Query_Text_cn: (v)在实施本款第(iii)和(iv)项的规定时,按照本条(a)款(iii)项选定的董事不应考虑在内。
Translation: (v) In implementing the provisions of subparagraphs (iii) and (iv) of this paragraph, directors selected pursuant to subparagraph (iii) of paragraph (a) of this Article shall not be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: (vi)在实施本款各项规定时,按照《业务协定》第六条(c)款(ii)项规定所确定的投资股份,应自该投资股份确定以后所举行的签字者会议的普通会议开会日开始生效。
Translation: (vi) In implementing the provisions of this paragraph, the investment shares determined pursuant to Article 6(c)(ii) of the Operating Agreement shall take effect from the opening date of an ordinary meeting of the Signatories held after such determination of investment shares.

Query_Text_cn: (c)每当一个签字者或签字者集体满足本条第(a)款(i)、(ii)或(iii)项所规定的派遣代表的条件时,该签字者或签字者集体就有资格派代表参加董事会。
Translation: (c) Whenever a Signatory or group of Signatories meets the conditions set forth in subparagraph (a)(i), (ii), or (iii) of this Article for designating a representative, such Signatory or group of Signatories shall be entitled to designate a representative to serve on the Board.

Query_Text_cn: 如系本条(a)款(iii)项中所述签字者集体,其派遣代表的资格应在执行局收到该集体的书面申请时生效,但是,在收到书面申请时,此类派遣代表参加董事会的集体的名额,应在尚未达到本条(a)款(iii)项所规定的有效限额时才有效。
Translation: In the case of a group of signatories referred to in paragraph (a)(iii) above, the qualification of its designated representative shall take effect upon receipt by the Executive Board of a written application from such group, provided that at the time of receipt, the number of groups designating representatives to serve on the Board shall not have reached the effective limit prescribed under paragraph (a)(iii) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在接到书面申请时,参加董事会的代表超过了本条(a)款(iii)项所规定的有效限额,则该签字者集体可以根据本条(d)款的规定,将自己的书面申请提交给签字者会议的下次例会作出决定。
Translation: If, at the time a written application is received, the number of representatives participating in the Board exceeds the effective limit specified in paragraph (a)(iii) of this Article, the collective signatories may, in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (d) of this Article, submit their written application to the next regular meeting of the Signatories' Conference for decision.

Query_Text_cn: (d)当本条(a)款(iii)项所述的一个或几个签字者集体提出要求时,签字者会议应每年决定这些集体中的哪个集体应当或继续派代表参加董事会。
Translation: (d) The Meeting of Signatories shall determine annually, upon the request of one or more collectives referred to in paragraph (a)(iii), which of these collectives shall or shall continue to be represented on the Board.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这种集体在国际电信联盟规定的一个地区中超过两个或在所有该种地区中超过五个,则签字者会议应首先选择按照本条(c)款规定业已提交书面申请的各地区中联合投资股份最高的集体。
Translation: If such collectives exceed two in any one region as defined by the International Telecommunication Union or five in all such regions, the Meeting of Signatories shall first select the collective with the highest joint investment share among those in each region that have submitted written applications pursuant to paragraph (c) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 如果按上述办法选定的集体少于五个,则应在不超过本条(a)款(iii)项规定的有效限额的情况下,按每个集体的联合投资股份的递减顺序,选择可以派遣代表的剩余集体。
Translation: If fewer than five collectives are selected by the above method, the remaining collectives eligible to send representatives shall be chosen in descending order of their respective joint investment shares, without exceeding the effective limit stipulated in paragraph (a)(iii) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (e)为了保证董事会内部工作的连续性,每个根据本条(a)款(i)、(ii)或(iii)项派遣代表的签字者或签字者集体,不论其投资股份由于投资股份的调整而发生什么变化,仍应单独地或作为集体的一部分继续派遣代表,直到根据本条(b)和(d)款作出新的决定为止。
Translation: (e) To ensure continuity in the internal work of the Board of Directors, each signatory or group of signatories that has appointed a representative under paragraph (a)(i), (ii), or (iii) of this Article shall continue to appoint such representative individually or as part of the group, regardless of any changes in their investment shares due to adjustments thereof, until a new decision is made pursuant to paragraphs (b) and (d) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 但是,如果根据本条的规定,一个或几个签字者退出某一签字者集体,致使这个集体没有资格派遣代表参加董事会,这个按本条(a)款(ii)或(iii)项规定所组成的集体则应停止派遣代表的资格。
Translation: However, if one or more signatories withdraw from a signatory group pursuant to this Article, thereby rendering the group ineligible to appoint a representative to the Board, the group constituted under paragraph (a)(ii) or (iii) of this Article shall cease to have the right to appoint a representative.

Query_Text_cn: (iii)无宽频带地面设备连接的地区之间的国内公众电信业务。这些地区被特殊的自然障碍物隔开,因而使在这些地区之间安装宽频带设备受到阻碍。但这须事先由签字者会议按照本协定第三条(b)款(ii)项的要求予以批准。
Translation: (iii) Domestic public telecommunications services between areas without broadband terrestrial connections. These areas are separated by exceptional natural barriers, thereby hindering the installation of broadband equipment between them. However, such services must be approved in advance by the Signatories' Meeting in accordance with the requirements of Article III(b)(ii) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (iv)任何董事的表决权不得超过在董事会中派有代表的所有签字者或签字者集体总表决权的40%。
Translation: (iv) No director shall have voting rights exceeding 40% of the total voting rights of all signatories or groups of signatories represented on the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: 如果一名董事的表决权超过总表决权的40%,则超过部分应在董事会的其它董事中均分。
Translation: If a director's voting rights exceed 40% of the total voting rights, the excess portion shall be equally distributed among the other directors on the board.

Query_Text_cn: (h)为了组成董事会并计算董事的表决权,按照《业务协定》第六条(c)款(ii)项算出的投资股份,应从投资股份算出以后签字者会议例会的第一天起开始生效。
Translation: (h) For the purpose of constituting the Board and calculating the voting power of Directors, the investment shares calculated in accordance with Article 6(c)(ii) of the Operating Agreement shall become effective from the first day of the ordinary meeting of the Signatories following such calculation.

Query_Text_cn: (i)董事会任何会议的法定人数,应由董事会的多数组成,该多数至少拥有在董事会中派有代表的所有签字者和签字者集体总表决权的三分之二；或者应是董事会所有人数减去三,在此种情况下,则不论他们所代表的表决权是多少。
Translation: (i) A quorum for any meeting of the Board of Directors shall consist of a majority of the members of the Board, provided that such majority holds at least two-thirds of the total voting power of all signatories and groups of signatories represented on the Board; or shall consist of all members of the Board minus three, in which case the quorum shall be valid irrespective of the voting power they represent.

Query_Text_cn: (j)董事会应努力作出一致同意的决定。
Translation: (j) The board of directors shall endeavor to reach decisions by consensus.

Query_Text_cn: (i)对于所有实质性问题,至少应获得四名董事的赞成票,这些董事应至少拥有在董事会中派有代表的所有签字者和签字者集体总表决权的三分之二；在计算表决权时,应将本条(g)款(iv)项所述超过部分的分配情况考虑在内；或者至少应获得董事会总人数减去三以后的所有人数的赞成票,在此情况下,则不论他们所代表的表决权是多少。
Translation: (i) For all substantive matters, approval shall require the affirmative vote of at least four Directors representing not less than two-thirds of the total voting power of all Signatories and groups of Signatories having Board representation; in calculating voting power, the allocation of excess pursuant to paragraph (g)(iv) of this Article shall be taken into account; or alternatively, the affirmative vote of a number of Directors equal to at least the total number of Directors minus three, in which case the voting power they represent shall not be considered.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)对于所有程序性问题,应由出席并参加表决的董事的简单多数决定,每个董事有一个表决权。
Translation: (ii) All procedural matters shall be decided by a simple majority of the directors present and voting, with each director having one vote.

Query_Text_cn: (k)关于某一具体问题究竟是程序性问题还是实质性问题的争议,应由董事会主席作出决定。
Translation: (k) Any dispute as to whether a specific issue is a procedural or substantive matter shall be determined by the Chairman of the Board.

Query_Text_cn: 主席的决定可以被出席并参加表决的董事的三分之二多数所废弃(每个董事有一个表决权)。
Translation: The decision of the Chairman may be overruled by a two-thirds majority of the directors present and voting (each director having one vote).

Query_Text_cn: (l)如果认为合适,董事会可以设立若干顾问委员会,以协助其履行职责。
Translation: (l) The Board may establish such advisory committees as it deems appropriate to assist in the performance of its duties.

Query_Text_cn: (m)董事会应采用自己的议事规则,其中包括主席和其它官员的选举方法等规定。
Translation: (m) The board of directors shall adopt its own rules of procedure, including provisions on the election of the chairman and other officers.

Query_Text_cn: 纵使本条(j)款已有规定,只要董事会认为合适,这种规则可规定选举官员的任何表决方法。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph (j), such rules may prescribe any method of voting for the election of officers as the Board deems appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: (n)董事会的第一次会议应按照《业务协定》附件的第二款的规定召开。
Translation: (n) The first meeting of the Board of Directors shall be convened in accordance with the provisions of Article 2 of the Annex to the Business Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 董事会应根据需要尽可能经常召开会议,至少每年四次。
Translation: The board of directors shall meet as often as necessary and at least four times a year.

Query_Text_cn: 职能(a)董事会应负责卫星组织空间段的设计、研制、建造、安装、操作和维护,并按照本协定、《业务协定》和缔约国大会依照本协定第七条规定可能在这方面作出的决定,负责开展卫星组织所承担的其他活动。
Translation: Function (a) The Board of Directors shall be responsible for the design, development, construction, establishment, operation and maintenance of the INTELSAT space segment and for any other activities which INTELSAT may undertake in accordance with this Agreement, the Operating Agreement and the decisions of the Assembly of Parties pursuant to Article VII of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)在它给缔约国大会和签字者会议的报告中,写进它对上述决议、建议和意见所采取的措施或所作的决定的情况及其采取这些措施或作出这些决定的理由。
Translation: (ii) Include in its reports to the Assembly of States Parties and the Meeting of Signatories the measures taken or decisions made regarding the aforementioned resolutions, recommendations, and opinions, along with the rationale for such measures or decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条总干事(a)执行局应由总干事领导,其组织机构须在本协定生效后六年之内建立起来。
Translation:
Article 11 The Director-General  
(a) The Executive Board shall be headed by a Director-General, whose organizational structure shall be established within six years after this Agreement enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: (b)(i)总干事是卫星组织的最高行政官员和合法代表,他在履行各项经营管理职能方面,直接向董事会负责。
Translation: (b)(i) The Director General shall be the chief executive officer and legal representative of the Satellite Organization and shall be directly accountable to the Board in the performance of all management functions.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)总干事应根据董事会的政策和指示行事。
Translation: (ii) The Director General shall act in accordance with the policies and directives of the Board.

Query_Text_cn: (iii)总干事由董事会任命,但需经缔约国大会确认。
Translation: (iii) The Director-General shall be appointed by the Board of Directors, subject to confirmation by the Conference of the States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 董事会可以提出理由自行罢免总干事。
Translation: The Board may dismiss the Director-General on its own initiative with stated reasons.

Query_Text_cn: (iv)在任命总干事和选用执行局的工作人员时,应首先考虑到必须确保道德、能力和效率的最高标准。
Translation: (iv) In the appointment of the Director-General and the selection of the staff of the Executive Board, paramount consideration shall be given to the necessity of securing the highest standards of integrity, competence, and efficiency.

Query_Text_cn: 总干事和执行局的工作人员,均应力戒与卫星组织的责任不相容的任何行为。
Translation: The Director-General and the staff of the Executive Board shall refrain from any action incompatible with their responsibilities to the satellite organization.

Query_Text_cn: (c)(i)长久性管理办法应与卫星组织的基本目标和宗旨、卫星组织的国际性以及在商用基础上提供高质量和可靠的电信设施的义务相一致。
Translation: (c)(i) The permanent management arrangements shall be consistent with the basic objectives and purposes of INTELSAT, its international character and its obligation to provide on a commercial basis high-quality and reliable telecommunications facilities.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)总干事应代表卫星组织同一个或多个有能力的电信机构订立合同,以便在可能的范围内最大限度地委托其实施技术和操作职能。
Translation: (ii) The Director General shall, on behalf of the Organization, enter into contracts with one or more competent telecommunications entities to the maximum extent feasible for the delegation of technical and operational functions.

Query_Text_cn: 赞比亚共和国方面指通讯与交通部长，或者指受权执行该部长目前所行使的职能的任何个人或者机构。
Translation: The Republic of Zambia refers to the Minister of Communications and Transport, or any individual or institution authorized to perform the functions currently exercised by the said Minister.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“公约”，指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签字的《国际民用航空公约》，包括对缔约双方均有效的、根据该公约第九十条规定通过的任何附件，以及根据该公约第九十条和九十四条对附件或者公约所作出的任何修改。
Translation: II. "Convention" means the Convention on International Civil Aviation, opened for signature at Chicago on 7 December 1944, including any Annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention and any amendment of the Annexes or the Convention under Articles 90 and 94 thereof, insofar as such Annexes and amendments are effective for both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“协定”，指本协定及其附件以及根据本协定第十八条规定对本协定和／或其附件的任何修改。
Translation: III. “Agreement” means this Agreement and its annexes, as well as any amendments to this Agreement and/or its annexes made in accordance with Article 18 hereof.

Query_Text_cn: 四、“空运企业”，指提供或者经营国际航班的任何航空运输企业。
Translation: 4. "Air carrier" means any air transport enterprise that provides or operates international flights.

Query_Text_cn: 五、“指定空运企业”，指根据本协定第三条规定经指定和许可的空运企业。
Translation: 5. "Designated airline" means an airline designated and authorized in accordance with the provisions of Article 3 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 六、“航班”，指以航空器从事旅客、行李、货物或者邮件公共运输的任何定期航班。
Translation: VI. "Flight" means any scheduled air transport service performed by aircraft for the public carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo or mail.

Query_Text_cn: 七、“国际航班”，指飞经一个以上国家领土上空的航班。
Translation: 7. "International flight" refers to a flight that passes through the airspace over the territory of more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: 八、“非运输业务性经停”，指目的不在于上下旅客、行李、货物或者邮件的任何经停。
Translation: 8. "Non-traffic stop" means any stop where the purpose is not to take on or discharge passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail.

Query_Text_cn: （一）就航空器而言，指该航空器在航线或者航段上可提供的商务载量。
Translation: (1) For aircraft, it refers to the commercial payload capacity available on a route or segment.

Query_Text_cn: （二）就航班而言，指飞行该航班的航空器的运力乘以该航空器在一定时期内在航线或者航段上所飞行的班次。
Translation: (2) For flights, it refers to the capacity of the aircraft operating the flight multiplied by the number of flights operated by that aircraft on the route or segment within a given period.

Query_Text_cn: 十、“运价”，指运输旅客、行李和货物所采用的价格和价格条件，包括提供代理和其他附属服务的价格和价格条件，但不包括运输邮件的价格和价格条件。
Translation: 10. "Tariff" means the prices and terms of carriage applied to the transport of passengers, baggage and cargo, including the prices and terms for the provision of agency and other ancillary services, but excluding those for the transport of mail.

Query_Text_cn: 十一、“航线表”，指本协定附件规定的航线表或者根据本协定第十八条规定修改的航线表。
Translation: 11. "Route Schedule" means the route schedule specified in the Annex to this Agreement or as amended in accordance with Article XVIII of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定规定的权利，以便缔约另一方指定空运企业在本协定航线表规定的航线上建立和经营国际航班（以下分别简称“协议航班”与“规定航线”）。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement for the purpose of establishing and operating international air services by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party on the routes specified in the Route Schedule of this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "the agreed services" and "the specified routes" respectively).

Query_Text_cn: （三）在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点经停，以便上下来自或者前往缔约一方领土的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (3) To make stops at points on the specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of embarking or disembarking international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail originating from or destined for the territory of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内地点载运前往或者来自第三国国际业务的权利，由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: III. The right of a designated airline of one Contracting Party to embark or disembark traffic destined for or coming from third countries at points within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方有权书面向缔约另一方指定一家或者多家空运企业，在规定航线上经营协议航班，并且有权撤销或更改上述指定。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one or more airlines to operate agreed services on the specified routes,and shall have the right to withdraw or alter such designations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方航空当局可要求缔约另一方指定空运企业向其证明，该指定空运企业有资格履行缔约一方航空当局通常合理地适用于国际航班经营的法律和规章所规定的条件与义务。
Translation: 3. The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party may require the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party to demonstrate that it is qualified to fulfill the conditions and obligations prescribed by the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied by the aeronautical authorities of the first Party to the operation of international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款规定的撤销、暂停或者附加条件必须立即执行，以防止该指定空运企业进一步违反法律和规章，上述权利只能在与缔约另一方磋商后方可行使。
Translation: 2. Unless the revocation, suspension or imposition of conditions specified in paragraph 1 of this Article must be implemented immediately to prevent the designated airline from further violations of laws and regulations, the aforementioned rights may only be exercised after consultation with the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方关于从事国际运营的航空器进出其领土或者在其领土内停留的法律和规章，应适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业进出该缔约一方领土或者在该缔约一方领土内的航空器。
Translation: 1. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party regarding the entry into, departure from, or stay within its territory of aircraft engaged in international operations shall apply to the aircraft of the designated air transport enterprise(s) of the other Contracting Party entering, departing from, or staying within the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方关于旅客、机组、行李、货物或者邮件进出其领土或者在其领土内停留的法律和规章，例如关于入境、放行、移民、护照、海关和检疫的法律和规章，应适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业进出该缔约一方领土或在该缔约一方领土内的航空器所载运的旅客、机组、行李、货物或者邮件。
Translation: II. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, stay within, and departure from its territory of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo or mail, such as those pertaining to entry, clearance, immigration, passports, customs and quarantine, shall apply to the passengers, crew, baggage, cargo or mail carried by the aircraft of the designated air transport enterprise(s) of the other Contracting Party while entering, within, or departing from the territory of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对直接过境、不离开为直接过境而设的机场区域的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，只采取简化的控制措施。
Translation: III. Simplified control measures shall be applied only to passengers, luggage, goods, and mail in direct transit who do not leave the airport area designated for direct transit.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方指定空运企业应享有公平均等的机会在规定航线上经营协议航班。
Translation: 1. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities to operate the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在经营协议航班方面，缔约一方指定空运企业应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益，以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线或者航段上经营的航班。
Translation: II. In the operation of agreed services, the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services which the latter provides on the same routes or sections thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方指定空运企业所提供的协议航班应与公众对规定航线的运输需求紧密联系，并应以合理的载运比率提供足够的运力作为其首要目标，以便满足缔约双方领土之间当前以及预期的旅客、货物和邮件的运输需要。
Translation: III. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall ensure that the agreed services provided under this Agreement are closely related to the public demand for transportation on the specified routes. Their primary objective shall be to offer adequate capacity at reasonable load factors, so as to meet the current and anticipated needs for the carriage of passengers, cargo, and mail between the territories of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、与经营协议航班有关的业务代理和地面服务事宜应由缔约双方指定空运企业商定，并经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: II. Matters pertaining to business agency and ground handling services related to the operation of agreed services shall be determined by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by their respective aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业可根据运输需求申请在规定航线上进行加班飞行。
Translation: III. The designated airline(s) of either Contracting Party may apply for extra flights on the specified routes based on traffic demand.

Query_Text_cn: 对加班飞行的申请至迟应在计划加班飞行之日3天前向缔约另一方航空当局提出，获该当局批准后方可飞行。
Translation: Applications for extra flights shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party no later than 3 days prior to the planned date of such flights and may only be operated after approval by the said authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价，应由缔约双方指定空运企业商定，如有必要和可能，可与在相同航线或者航段上经营航班的其他空运企业进行磋商。
Translation: 2. The tariffs referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties, and where necessary and possible, may be consulted with other airlines operating on the same route or sector.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如缔约双方指定空运企业就上述运价未能达成协议，缔约双方航空当局应通过磋商，确定运价。
Translation: 3. If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on the above-mentioned tariffs, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall determine the tariffs through consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如缔约双方航空当局未能根据本条第二款就运价的批准达成协议，或者未能根据本条第三款就运价的确定达成协议，则应根据本协定第十九条规定提交缔约双方解决。
Translation: 4. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach agreement on the approval of tariffs pursuant to paragraph 2 of this Article, or fail to determine tariffs pursuant to paragraph 3 of this Article, the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties for settlement in accordance with the provisions of Article 19 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方应在其领土内为缔约另一方指定空运企业经营的协议航班提供主用机场和备用机场，并应向该指定空运企业提供经营协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象服务及其他附属服务。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall, in its territory, designate primary and alternate airports for the agreed services operated by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party, and shall provide such airline(s) with the necessary communications, navigational, meteorological services and other auxiliary services required for the operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场（包括技术设备和其他设施与服务）、通信和航行设施，及其他附属服务应按照缔约另一方有关当局规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airports (including technical equipment and other facilities/services), communication and navigation aids, and ancillary services in the territory of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the competent authorities of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 这些费率不应高于运营国际航班的其他国家任何空运企业使用类似设备、设施和服务所适用的费率。
Translation: These rates shall not be higher than those applicable to any other foreign airline operating international services for the use of similar equipment, facilities, and services.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在进入缔约另一方领土时，缔约一方指定空运企业经营国际航班的航空器及该航空器上的正常设备、零备件（包括发动机）、燃料、油料（包括液压油、润滑油）和机上供应品（包括食品、饮料和烟草），应在对等的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用，但这些设备和物品应留置在该航空器上直至重新运出。
Translation: 1. Upon entry into the territory of the other Contracting Party, the aircraft operated by the designated air transport enterprises of one Contracting Party for international flights, along with their normal equipment, spare parts (including engines), fuel, oils (including hydraulic fluids and lubricants), and supplies on board (including food, beverages, and tobacco), shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees, and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis, provided that such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft until re-exported.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约另一方指定空运企业运入缔约一方领土的为维护或者检修运营国际航班的航空器的零备件（包括发动机）。
Translation: (2) Spare parts (including engines) brought into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the maintenance or repair of aircraft operating international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约另一方指定空运企业运入缔约一方领土的客票、货运单和宣传品，应在对等的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation: III. Passenger tickets, cargo waybills, and promotional materials brought into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees, and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条第一、二款所述设备和物品，经缔约另一方海关当局同意后，可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: IV. The equipment and items referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 这些设备和物品应受缔约另一方海关当局监管或控制直至重新运出，或者根据该缔约另一方的海关法规另作处理。
Translation: Such equipment and materials shall remain under the supervision or control of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party until re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the customs laws and regulations of that other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业和另一家在缔约另一方领土内享有同样税费免纳待遇的空运企业订有合同，在缔约另一方领土内向其租借或者转让本条第一、二款所述设备和物品的，则也应适用本条第一、二款的豁免规定。
Translation: V. If a designated airline of one Contracting Party has a contract with another airline enjoying the same exemption from duties, taxes, fees and charges in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the lease or transfer of the equipment and items mentioned in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the exemptions stipulated in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall also apply.

Query_Text_cn: 六、直接过境的行李、货物和邮件，除提供服务的费用外，应在对等的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation: VI. Baggage, goods, and mail in direct transit shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees, and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis, except for service fees.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业经营协议航班在缔约另一方领土内取得的收入、利润，应在对等的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: 1. The revenues and profits derived by a designated airline of one Contracting Party from the operation of agreed services in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的财产，应在对等的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: II. The property of the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的常驻代表机构人员如系该缔约一方国民，其取得的工资、薪金和其他类似报酬，应在对等的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: III. The salaries, wages and other similar remuneration obtained by the personnel of the permanent representative offices of the designated airlines of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party, provided they are nationals of the former Contracting Party, shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 一、为了在规定航线上经营协议航班，缔约一方指定空运企业有权在对等的基础上在规定航线上的缔约另一方领土内的通航地点设立常驻代表机构。
Translation: 1. For the operation of agreed services on the specified routes, the designated airline of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish a permanent representative office at the points of call within the territory of the other Contracting Party on the specified routes on the basis of reciprocity.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内设立的常驻代表机构的工作人员应为缔约任何一方的国民，其人数由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: II. The staff of the permanent representative offices established by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of either Contracting Party, with the number to be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 上述工作人员应遵守缔约另一方已生效的法律和规章。
Translation: The aforementioned personnel shall comply with the laws and regulations in force in the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业协议航班上的机组人员应为该缔约一方国民。
Translation: 4. The crew members of the designated airline of one Contracting Party operating the agreed services shall be nationals of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方指定空运企业如欲在其协议航班上雇用任何其他国籍的机组人员，应事先取得缔约另一方的批准。
Translation: If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to employ crew members of any other nationality on its agreed services, it shall obtain prior approval from the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方颁发或者核准有效的适航证、合格证和执照应在其有效期内被缔约另一方视为有效，但是颁发或者核准上述证件或者执照的标准，应相当于或者高于根据公约制定的最低标准。
Translation: 1. The certificates of airworthiness, certificates of competency and licenses issued or rendered valid by one Contracting Party and still in force shall be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party for the purpose of operating the agreed services, provided that such certificates or licenses were issued or rendered valid according to standards equivalent to or above the minimum standards established under the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，缔约另一方或者其他任何国家为了使缔约一方公民在该缔约一方领土上空飞行而颁发或者核准有效的合格证和执照，缔约一方保留拒绝承认的权利。
Translation: II. However, each Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse to recognize the validity of certificates and licenses issued or validated by the other Contracting Party or any other State for flights over its own territory by nationals of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业在对等的基础上，有权将在缔约另一方领土内取得的收入汇至指定该空运企业的缔约一方。
Translation: 1. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall, on the basis of reciprocity, have the right to remit to the Contracting Party designating such airline(s) the revenues obtained in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应为缔约另一方指定空运企业在其领土内的收入的汇兑提供便利，并应协助该空运企业办理有关手续。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall facilitate the transfer of revenues earned in its territory by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party and shall assist such airline in completing the relevant procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 一、根据国际法赋予的权利和义务，缔约双方重申，为保护民用航空安全免遭非法干扰行为而相互承担的义务，构成本协定不可分割的组成部分。
Translation: 1. In accordance with the rights and obligations conferred by international law, both Contracting Parties reaffirm that their mutual commitments to protecting civil aviation security against acts of unlawful interference constitute an integral part of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 在不限制国际法赋予的权利和义务的普遍性的情况下，缔约双方应特别遵守1963年9月14日在东京签订的《关于在航空器内的犯罪和其他某些行为的公约》、1970年12月16日在海牙签订的《关于制止非法劫持航空器的公约》、1971年9月23日在蒙特利尔签订的《关于制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为的公约》、1988年2月24日在蒙特利尔签订的《制止在用于国际民用航空机场发生的非法暴力行为的补充议定书》以及缔约双方均加入的任何其他民航保安方面的公约和议定书。
Translation: Without prejudice to the generality of the rights and obligations conferred by international law, the Contracting Parties shall in particular comply with the Convention on Offences and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft, signed at Tokyo on 14 September 1963, the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft, signed at The Hague on 16 December 1970, the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation, signed at Montreal on 23 September 1971, the Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports Serving International Civil Aviation, signed at Montreal on 24 February 1988, and any other conventions and protocols relating to civil aviation security to which both Contracting Parties are parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方应根据请求相互提供一切必要的协助，防止非法劫持民用航空器和其他危及航空器及其旅客和机组，机场和航行设施安全的非法行为，以及危及民用航空安全的任何其他威胁。
Translation: II. The Contracting Parties shall provide each other, upon request, with all necessary assistance to prevent unlawful seizure of civil aircraft and other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft, their passengers and crew, airports and air navigation facilities, as well as any other threat to the safety of civil aviation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方在其相互关系中，应遵守国际民用航空组织制定的、作为公约附件的航空保安规定。
Translation: 3. The Contracting Parties shall, in their mutual relations, comply with the aviation security provisions established by the International Civil Aviation Organization as annexes to the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应要求在其领土内注册的航空器经营人或者主要营业地或者永久居住地在其领土内的航空器经营人以及在其领土内的机场经营人遵守上述航空保安规定。
Translation: Both Contracting Parties shall require that aircraft operators registered in their respective territories, or whose principal place of business or permanent residence is within their territories, as well as airport operators within their territories, comply with the aforementioned aviation security provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方应告知缔约另一方其国内规章和措施与附件的航空保安标准之间的任何差异。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall inform the other Contracting Party of any differences between its national regulations and measures and the aviation security standards specified in the Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约任何一方可随时要求与缔约另一方就讨论上述差异立即进行磋商。
Translation: Either Contracting Party may at any time request immediate consultations with the other Contracting Party to discuss the aforementioned differences.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约各方同意，应要求上述航空器经营人在进出缔约另一方领土或者在缔约另一方领土内停留时遵守缔约另一方规定的上述第三款所述的航空保安规定。
Translation: IV. The Contracting Parties agree to require the operators of the said aircraft to comply with the aviation security provisions specified in paragraph III above when entering, leaving or staying within the territory of the other Contracting Party, as stipulated by that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方对缔约另一方提出的为应对特定威胁而采取合理的特殊保安措施的要求，应给予考虑。
Translation: Each Party shall give consideration to the request of the other Party for taking reasonable special security measures in response to specific threats.

Query_Text_cn: 五、当发生非法劫持民用航空器事件或者以劫持民用航空器相威胁，或者发生其他危及航空器及其旅客和机组，机场或者航行设施安全的非法行为时，缔约双方应相互协助，提供联系的方便并采取其他适当的措施，以便迅速、安全地结束上述事件或者威胁。
Translation: V. In the event of an unlawful seizure of a civil aircraft or a threat thereof, or any other unlawful act endangering the safety of such aircraft, its passengers and crew, airports or air navigation facilities, the Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and taking other appropriate measures to promptly and safely terminate such incident or threat.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约各方有权在收到通知60天内（或航空当局可能商定的较短期限），由其航空当局对航空器经营人在缔约另一方领土内执行、或者计划执行的从该缔约方领土抵离的航班的保安措施进行评估。
Translation: 6. Each Contracting Party shall have the right, within 60 days of receipt of notice (or such shorter period as may be agreed by the aeronautical authorities), for its aeronautical authorities to assess the security measures applied by an aircraft operator of the other Contracting Party in respect of flights arriving from or departing to the territory of the former Contracting Party, whether such flights are being or are intended to be operated in the territory of the latter Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 航空当局之间应就上述评估商定行政方面的安排并应不拖延地实施，以便确保迅速进行评估。
Translation: Aviation authorities shall agree on administrative arrangements for the above assessments and implement them without delay to ensure prompt evaluation.

Query_Text_cn: 七、如果缔约一方有合理的理由认为缔约另一方未能遵守本条的规定，该缔约方可以要求进行磋商。
Translation: 7. If a Party has reasonable grounds to believe that the other Party has failed to comply with the provisions of this Article, it may request consultations.

Query_Text_cn: 上述磋商须在收到缔约任何一方的要求15天内进行。
Translation: The aforementioned consultations shall be conducted within 15 days upon receipt of a request from either Party.

Query_Text_cn: 磋商开始15天内未能达成满意的协议，则构成扣留、撤销、暂停缔约另一方一家或者多家指定空运企业的许可或者对许可附加条件的依据。
Translation: If no satisfactory agreement is reached within 15 days of the commencement of consultations, it shall constitute grounds for withholding, revoking, suspending the authorization of one or more designated airlines of the other Party, or imposing conditions on such authorization.

Query_Text_cn: 当紧急情况证明有此需要，或者为防止进一步不遵守本条的规定，缔约一方可随时采取临时的行动。
Translation: A Party may take provisional measures at any time when the urgency of the situation so requires or to prevent further non-compliance with the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果在磋商之后，缔约一方发现缔约另一方未能有效地维持和管理第一款所述的、满足根据国际民用航空公约当时所制定的标准的安全标准，缔约一方应告知缔约另一方调查结果以及为符合国际民航组织的标准应采取的必要步骤。
Translation: II. If, following consultations, one Party finds that the other Party has failed to effectively maintain and administer the safety standards referred to in paragraph 1 in accordance with the standards established at that time under the Convention on International Civil Aviation, the former Party shall notify the latter of its findings and the necessary steps required to conform to the ICAO standards.

Query_Text_cn: 五、一旦采取行动的依据不复存在，缔约一方根据上述第四款采取的任何行动应予停止。
Translation: V. Any action taken by a Party under paragraph IV above shall be terminated once the basis for such action ceases to exist.

Query_Text_cn: 六、关于第二款，如果确定缔约一方在商定的时间期限届满时仍然未能符合国际民航组织的标准，应将情况通报国际民航组织秘书长。
Translation: VI. Regarding paragraph 2, if it is determined that a Contracting Party still fails to meet the standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization upon the expiration of the agreed time period, the matter shall be reported to the Secretary-General of the International Civil Aviation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条资料的提供缔约一方航空当局应根据缔约另一方航空当局的要求，向其提供审议缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上协议航班的运力所合理需要的统计资料，这些资料应包括确定该指定空运企业协议航班的运输业务量所需的全部资料。
Translation:
Article 17 Provision of Data  
The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide statistical data reasonably required for the review of the capacity of the agreed services operated by the designated airline(s) of the former Party on the specified routes. Such data shall include all information necessary to determine the traffic volume of the agreed services performed by the said designated airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方应本着密切合作和相互支持的精神，保证本协定各项规定得到正确的实施和满意的遵守。
