Translation: 1. The Contracting Parties shall ensure the correct implementation and satisfactory observance of all provisions of this Agreement in a spirit of close cooperation and mutual support.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方可随时要求与缔约另一方就本协定进行磋商。
Translation: 2. Either Contracting Party may request consultations with the other Contracting Party on this Agreement at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 这种磋商应尽早开始，除非另有协议，至迟应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起60天内进行。
Translation: Such consultations shall begin as early as possible and, unless otherwise agreed, no later than 60 days after the receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方如认为需要修改本协定或者其附件的任何规定，可随时要求与缔约另一方会晤或者书面形式在航空当局间进行磋商，并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起90天内开始，除非缔约双方同意延长这一期限。
Translation: 1. If either Contracting Party considers it necessary to modify any provision of this Agreement or its Annexes, it may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party either through a meeting or in writing between the aeronautical authorities. Such consultations shall commence within 90 days from the date of receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party, unless both Parties agree to extend this period.

Query_Text_cn: 二、经本条第一款所述磋商后对本协定或者其附件的任何修改，应通过外交途径换文确认后生效。
Translation: II. Any amendment to this Agreement or its annexes resulting from the consultations referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall enter into force upon confirmation through an exchange of diplomatic notes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如缔约双方航空当局不能就上述争端达成协议，缔约双方应通过外交途径予以解决。
Translation: II. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on the dispute mentioned above, the Contracting Parties shall settle the dispute through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条终止缔约一方可随时通过外交途径书面通知缔约另一方其终止本协定的决定。
Translation:
Article 21 Termination  
Either Contracting Party may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving written notice to the other Contracting Party through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定应在缔约另一方收到通知之日起12个月后终止，除非在此前缔约双方协议撤回该通知。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate 12 months after the date of receipt of the notification by the other Party, unless the notification is withdrawn by mutual agreement before that time.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条登记本协定以及对本协定的任何修改应向国际民用航空组织登记。
Translation: Article 22 The present Agreement and any amendments thereto shall be registered with the International Civil Aviation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条标题本协定每条的标题，仅为查阅方便，绝非对本协定条款的范围或者意图予以解释、限制或者说明。
Translation:
Article 23 Headings  
The headings of the articles in this Agreement are for convenience of reference only and shall not in any way interpret, limit, or describe the scope or intent of the provisions hereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条生效本协定自缔约双方通过外交途径相互通知已完成该协定生效所需的法律程序之日起生效。
Translation:
Article 24 Entry into Force  
This Agreement shall enter into force on the date on which the Contracting Parties notify each other through diplomatic channels that their respective domestic legal procedures required for its entry into force have been completed.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于2007年2月3日在卢萨卡签订，协定原本由中文和英文写成，两种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Lusaka on February 3, 2007, in the Chinese and English languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在任何或者所有飞行中，可不经停规定航线上的任何地点，但协议航班应在指定该空运企业的缔约一方领土内始发和终止。
Translation: 3. The designated airline(s) of either Contracting Party may omit any or all points on the specified routes, provided that the agreed services originate and terminate within the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: 一、“航空运输”，指为取酬或租赁目的，以航空器从事旅客、行李、货物和邮件单独或混合的公共运输。
Translation: I. "Air transport" refers to the public carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail, either separately or in combination, by aircraft for remuneration or hire.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“航空当局”，中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局，缅甸联邦方面指交通部民航局，或者双方均指受权执行该当局所行使职能的任何机构或者个人。
Translation: II. "Aeronautical authorities" means, in the case of the People's Republic of China, the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China, and in the case of the Union of Myanmar, the Department of Civil Aviation of the Ministry of Transport, or in both cases, any person or body authorized to perform the functions exercised by the said aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“协定”，指本协定及其附件以及对本协定及其附件的任何修改。
Translation: 3. "Agreement" means this Agreement and its annexes, as well as any amendments thereto.

Query_Text_cn: 四、“运力”：（一）就航空器而言，指该航空器在航线或者航段上可提供的商务载量。
Translation: IV. "Capacity": (1) With respect to an aircraft, refers to the commercial payload that the aircraft can provide on a route or segment.

Query_Text_cn: （二）就航班而言，指飞行该航班的航空器的运力乘以该航空器在一定时期内在航线或航段上所飞行的班次。
Translation: (2) For flights, it refers to the capacity of the aircraft operating the flight multiplied by the number of flights operated by that aircraft on the route or segment within a given period.

Query_Text_cn: 五、“公约”，指一九四四年十二月七日在芝加哥开放签字的《国际民用航空公约》，包括根据该公约第九十条通过的附件及根据该公约第九十条和第九十四条对附件或公约的任何修改，且上述附件和对公约及附件的修改已对缔约双方生效。
Translation: V. "Convention" means the Convention on International Civil Aviation, opened for signature at Chicago on December 7, 1944, including any Annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention and any amendment of the Annexes or the Convention under Articles 90 and 94 thereof, insofar as such Annexes and amendments are effective for both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 六、“指定空运企业”，指根据本协定第三条规定，经指定和许可的空运企业。
Translation: VI. "Designated Airline" means an airline which has been designated and authorized in accordance with the provisions of Article 3 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 七、“国内航空运输”，指在一国境内载运旅客、行李、货物和邮件去往同一国境内另一个地点的航空运输。
Translation: VII. "Domestic air transport" refers to the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo and mail by air from one place to another within the same country.

Query_Text_cn: 八、“ICA0”，指国际民用航空组织。
Translation: VIII. "ICAO" refers to the International Civil Aviation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 九、“国际航空运输”，指在一国境内载运旅客、行李、货物和邮件去往另一国的航空运输。
Translation: IX. "International air transport" refers to the carriage by aircraft of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail from the territory of one country to that of another.

Query_Text_cn: 十、“缔约方”，指正式同意受本协定约束的国家。
Translation: 10. "Party" means a country that has formally consented to be bound by this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 十一、“运价”，指空运企业，包括其代理人在空运旅客、行李和／或货物（不包括邮件）（包括与之相联的其他任何运输方式）所采用的任何客运价、货运价或费用，以及与这些客运价、货运价或费用有效性相关的价格条件。
Translation: 11. "Tariff" refers to any fare, rate, or charge applied by an air carrier, including its agents, for the air transportation of passengers, baggage, and/or cargo (excluding mail) (including any other connected modes of transportation), along with the conditions governing the applicability of such fares, rates, or charges.

Query_Text_cn: 十二、“领土”，指一国主权管辖下的陆地、与之毗连的领水及其以上的空域。
Translation: XII. "Territory" means the land, the contiguous territorial waters and the airspace above them under the sovereign jurisdiction of a State.

Query_Text_cn: 十三、“使用费”，指主管当局或经其许可向空运企业收取的、航空器、机组、旅客和货物使用机场场地或设施，或者航行设施，或者航空保安设施或服务，包括相关服务和设施的费用。
Translation: 13. "User charges" mean charges levied on air operators by the competent authorities or permitted by them for the use of airport premises or facilities, or air navigation facilities, or aviation security facilities or services, including related services and facilities, for aircraft, crew, passengers and cargo.

Query_Text_cn: 十四、“航班”、“国际航班”、“空运企业”和“非运输业务性经停”，分别采用公约第九十六条所述的定义。
Translation: 14. The terms "flight", "international flight", "air transport enterprise" and "non-traffic stop" shall have the meanings respectively assigned to them in Article 96 of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条授权一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定规定的权利，以便在航线表规定航线上经营国际航班。
Translation:
Article 2 Grant of Rights  

1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement for the purpose of operating international air services on the routes specified in the Route Schedule.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在本协定航线表规定航线上缔约另一方领土内的地点经停，以便单独地或者混合地载上和卸下来自或者前往缔约一方的国际旅客、货物或邮件。
Translation: (3) To make stops at points in the territory of the other Contracting Party on the routes specified in the Route Schedule of this Agreement for the purpose of taking on or discharging, separately or in combination, international passengers, cargo or mail originating from or destined for the territory of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、根据本协定第三条指定的空运企业以外的缔约一方空运企业，也可享有本条第二款第（一）和（二）项规定的权利。
Translation: III. Air carriers of one Contracting Party other than those designated under Article III of this Agreement may also enjoy the rights specified in subparagraphs (1) and (2) of paragraph 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 四、第二款的规定不得视为授予缔约一方指定空运企业为取酬目的在缔约另一方境内载运旅客、货物和邮件至该缔约另一方境内另一地点的权利。
Translation: 4. The provisions of paragraph 2 shall not be deemed to confer on the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party the right to take on board, in the territory of the other Contracting Party, passengers, cargo and mail carried for remuneration and destined for another point in the territory of that other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条指定和许可一、缔约一方有权书面向缔约另一方指定一家或多家空运企业，根据本协定经营协议航班，并且有权撤销或者更改上述指定。
Translation:
Article 3 Designation and Authorization  
1. Each Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Party one or more airlines to operate the agreed services under this Agreement, and to withdraw or alter such designations.

Query_Text_cn: （三）指定空运企业能够满足收到指定的缔约方通常适用于经营国际航班的法律和规章所规定的其他条件。
Translation: (3) The designated air transport enterprise is capable of meeting the other conditions prescribed by the laws and regulations normally applied to the operation of international air services by the designating Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、指定空运企业一经收到第二款的经营许可，即可在任何时间开始经营它被指定的协议航班，但是该空运企业应遵守本协定适用的规定。
Translation: III. Upon receipt of the operating authorization under paragraph 2, the designated airline(s) may commence operation of the agreed services at any time, provided that such airline(s) complies with the applicable provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （三）该指定空运企业未能满足收到指定的缔约方通常适用于经营国际航班的法律和规章所规定的其他条件。
Translation: (3) The designated airline fails to meet other conditions prescribed by the laws and regulations normally applied to the operation of international air services by the Party receiving the designation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非有必要立即采取行动以防止违反上述法律和规章，或者根据第七条或者第八条的规定在安全或者保安方面需要采取行动，本条第一款中所述的权利只能在双方航空当局按照本协定第十九条磋商后方可行使。
Translation: 2. Unless immediate action is essential to prevent infringement of the laws and regulations referred to above, or unless action is required on safety or security grounds under Article VII or VIII, the rights set forth in paragraph 1 of this Article may be exercised only after consultation between the aeronautical authorities of both Parties in accordance with Article XIX of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条法律的适用一、缔约一方关于从事国际航班的航空器进出其领土，或者在其领土内运行和航行的法律和规章，应适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业的航空器。
Translation:
Article 5 Application of Laws  

1. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into or departure from its territory by aircraft engaged in international air services, or to the operation and navigation of such aircraft within its territory, shall apply to the aircraft of the air transport enterprise designated by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方关于旅客、机组、行李和货物包括邮件进出其领土或者在其领土停留的法律和规章，例如关于入境、放行、移民、护照、海关、货币、健康和检疫的法律和规章，应适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业进出缔约一方领土或者在该领土内停留的航空器所载运的旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: II. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, stay in, and departure from its territory of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo and mail, such as those pertaining to entry, clearance, immigration, passports, customs, currency, health and quarantine, shall apply to the passengers, crew, baggage, cargo and mail carried by the aircraft of the designated air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party while entering, staying in or departing from the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方对与本国或其他空运企业从事类似国际航空运输的缔约另一方指定空运企业，在适用其移民、海关、检疫和类似规章时应一视同仁。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall apply its immigration, customs, quarantine, and similar regulations uniformly to the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party engaged in similar international air transport operations as those performed by its own or any other airline.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对直接过境的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，只采取简化的控制措施。
Translation: IV. Simplified control measures shall be applied only to passengers, luggage, goods and mail in direct transit.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条证件的承认一、为经营协议航班，缔约一方颁发或者核准并仍然有效的适航证、合格证和执照，缔约另一方应承认有效，但是颁发或者一核准有效的上述证件和执照的条件，应相当于或者高于根据公约制定的最低标准。
Translation:
Article 6 Recognition of Certificates  

1. For the operation of the agreed services, the certificates of airworthiness, certificates of competency, and licenses issued or validated by one Contracting Party and remaining valid shall be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party, provided that the conditions under which such certificates and licenses were issued or validated are equal to or above the minimum standards established pursuant to the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如缔约一方航空当局颁发给任何个人、或者指定空运企业、或者与经营协议航班航空器有关的上述第一款所述的执照或者证书的权利或者条件，与公约规定的最低标准有差异，并且该差异已向国际民航组织备案，缔约另一方可以要求双方航空当局进行磋商以澄清该做法。
Translation: II. If the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party issue licenses or certificates referred to in the first paragraph above to any individual, designated airline, or aircraft operating the agreed services under conditions or with privileges that differ from the minimum standards established by the Convention, and such differences have been filed with the International Civil Aviation Organization, the other Contracting Party may request consultations between the aeronautical authorities of both Parties to clarify the practice.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方授予缔约另一方国民的合格证和执照以便在缔约另一方领土上空飞行或在缔约另一方领土内着陆的航班，缔约另一方保留拒绝承认的权利。
Translation: III. Each Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse to recognize the certificates of competency and licenses granted to nationals of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of operating flights over or landing within the territory of the other Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条安全一、缔约一方可随时要求就缔约另一方保持的有关航空设施、机组、航空器以及航空器经营的安全标准进行磋商。
Translation:
Article 7 Safety  
1. Either Contracting Party may at any time request consultations regarding the safety standards maintained by the other Contracting Party concerning aviation facilities, crew, aircraft, and the operation of aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 二、磋商之后，如缔约一方发现缔约另一方在第一款所述领域里有效保持和实施的安全标准，未能符合当时根据《国际民用航空公约》制定的标准（7300号文件），则缔约一方应将该发现和为符合国际民航组织标准所应采取的必要措施通知缔约另一方。
Translation: II. If, after consultation, one Party finds that the other Party fails to maintain and effectively implement safety standards in the areas specified in paragraph 1 that conform to the standards then established under the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Document 7300), the former Party shall notify the latter of such findings and the necessary measures to be taken to comply with ICAO standards.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约另一方应在双方商定期限内采取适当的纠正措施。
Translation: The other contracting party shall take appropriate corrective measures within the mutually agreed period.

Query_Text_cn: 三、根据公约第十六条的规定而进一步协商同意，缔约一方空运企业或者代表该缔约一方空运企业运营的抵离缔约另一方领土航班的任何航空器，在缔约另一方领土内时，缔约另一方授权代表可在不造成该航空器运营不合理延误的情况下进行搜查。
Translation: III. Further consultations pursuant to Article 16 of the Convention have agreed that, when an aircraft of an air transport enterprise of one Contracting Party or operated on behalf of such enterprise arrives in or departs from the territory of the other Contracting Party, the authorized representatives of the other Contracting Party may, without causing unreasonable delay to the operation of the aircraft, conduct an inspection while the aircraft is within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管芝加哥公约第三十三条规定了义务，该搜查是为核查有关航空器文件和机组人员证件的有效性，以及航空器设备和条件符合当时根据公约制定的标准。
Translation: Although Article 33 of the Chicago Convention stipulates obligations, the inspection is conducted to verify the validity of aircraft documents and crew certificates, as well as to ensure that the aircraft's equipment and conditions comply with the standards established under the Convention at the time.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果缔约一方认为，为了空运企业的运营安全有必要立即采取行动，则该缔约一方有权立即暂停或变更缔约另一方一家或者多家空运企业的经营许可。
Translation: 4. If one Contracting Party deems it necessary to take immediate action for the operational safety of an air transport enterprise, it shall have the right to immediately suspend or modify the operating authorization of one or more air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 五、一旦采取行动的依据不再存在，缔约一方应停止按照上述第四款所采取的任何行动。
Translation: V. Once the basis for taking action no longer exists, a Party shall cease any measures adopted pursuant to paragraph IV above.

Query_Text_cn: 六、关于第二款，如果缔约一方在商定期限结束后仍不符合国际民航组织标准，则应将此情况通知国际民航组织秘书长。
Translation: VI. Regarding paragraph 2, if a Contracting Party still fails to meet the standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization after the agreed period, it shall notify the Secretary-General of the International Civil Aviation Organization of this situation.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条航空保安一、根据国际法规定的双方权利和义务，缔约双方重申，为保护民用航空安金免遭非法干扰而相互承担的义务，构成本协定不可分割的组成部分。在不限制国际法规定的普遍权利和义务的情况下，缔约双方应特别遵守一九六三年九月十四日在东京签订的《关于在航空器内的犯罪和其他某些行为的公约》、一九七○年十二月十六日在海牙签订的《关于制止非法劫持航空器的公约》、一九七一年九月二十三日在蒙特利尔签订的《关于制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为的公约》、一九八八年二月二十四日在蒙特利尔签订的《制止在用于国际民用航空机场发生的非法暴力行为的补充议定书》以及缔约双方加入的与航空保安有关的其他任何公约和议定书。
二、缔约双方应根据请求相互提供一切必要的协助，防止非法劫持民用航空器和其他危及航空器及其旅客、机组、机场和空中航行设施安全的非法行为，以及危及民用航空安全的任何其他威胁。
Translation: II. The Contracting Parties shall, upon request, provide each other with all necessary assistance to prevent unlawful seizure of civil aircraft and other unlawful acts jeopardizing the safety of such aircraft, their passengers and crew, airports, and air navigation facilities, as well as any other threats to the safety of civil aviation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方在其相互关系中，应遵守国际民用航空组织制定的、作为公约附件并且此类标准和建议措施对缔约双方均适用的航空保安规定。
Translation: 3. The Contracting Parties shall, in their mutual relations, comply with the aviation security provisions established by the International Civil Aviation Organization as Annexes to the Convention, insofar as such standards and recommended practices are applicable to both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约各方同意，可要求上述航空器经营人在进出缔约另一方领土或者在缔约另一方领土内停留时遵守缔约另一方要求的本条第三款所述的航空保安规定。
Translation: IV. The Contracting Parties agree that the operator of the aforementioned aircraft may be required to comply with the aviation security provisions specified in paragraph 3 of this Article, as stipulated by the other Contracting Party, when entering, leaving, or during its stay in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约各方保证在其领土内采取足够有效的措施保护航空器，并在登机或者装机前和在登机或者装机时，对旅客、机组、手提物品、行李、货物和机上供应品进行检查。
Translation: The Contracting Parties undertake to adopt adequate and effective measures within their territories to safeguard aircraft, and to conduct inspections of passengers, crew, hand luggage, baggage, cargo, and onboard supplies prior to and during boarding or loading.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方对缔约另一方提出的为对付特定威胁而采取任何合理的特殊保安措施的要求，应给予同情的考虑。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall give sympathetic consideration to any request from the other Contracting Party for the adoption of any reasonable special security measures to address specific threats.

Query_Text_cn: 五、当发生非法劫持民用航空器事件或者以劫持航空器相威胁，或者发生其他危及航空器及其旅客、机组、机场或者空中航行设施安全的非法行为时，缔约双方应相互协助，提供联系的方便并采取其他适当的措施，以便迅速、安全地结束上述事件或者威胁。
Translation: V. In the event of an unlawful seizure of a civil aircraft or a threat thereof, or any other unlawful act endangering the safety of such aircraft, its passengers, crew, airports, or air navigation facilities, the Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and taking other appropriate measures to promptly and safely terminate such incidents or threats.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条使用费一、缔约一方收费当局对缔约另一方指定空运企业使用其机场、航路和其他民航设施收取的费用，不应高于该缔约一方对其他国家指定空运企业使用类似航空器和相关设施从事类似国际经营时所收取的费用。
Translation:
Article 9 User Charges  

1. The charges imposed by the competent charging authorities of one Contracting Party on the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party for the use of airports, airways, and other civil aviation facilities shall not be higher than those imposed on the designated air transport enterprises of any other country for the use of similar aircraft and related facilities in similar international operations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约各方应鼓励其收费当局与使用收费当局提供的服务和设施的空运企业就使用费用进行协商，或者在可行的情况下，通过空运企业代表机构进行协商。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall encourage its charging authorities and the airlines using the services and facilities provided by the charging authorities to consult each other concerning charges, or where practicable, to do so through their representative organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 任何关于使用费用变动的建议，应给予使用者合理的通知，以使其能在变动之前发表意见。
Translation: Any proposed changes to usage fees should provide users with reasonable notice to allow them to voice their opinions before the adjustments take effect.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约各方可进一步鼓励其收费当局与用户就使用费用交换适当的信息。
Translation: The Contracting Parties may further encourage their charging authorities to exchange appropriate information with users regarding usage fees.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条关税一、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的航空器进入缔约另一方领土时，该航空器及该航空器上的正常设备、零备件（包括发动机）、燃料、油料（包括液压油、润滑油）和机上供应品（包括食品、饮料和烟草），应在互惠的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用。但这些设备和物品应留置在该航空器上直至重新运出。
Translation:
Article 10 Customs Duties  

1. Upon entering the territory of the other Contracting Party, the aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party for the agreed services, together with its normal equipment, spare parts (including engines), fuels, oils (including hydraulic fluids and lubricants), and supplies (including food, beverages, and tobacco) carried aboard, shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees, and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis, provided such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft until re-exported.

Query_Text_cn: （二）运入缔约另一方领土的为检修或者维护指定空运企业飞行协议航班的航空器的零备件（包括发动机）。
Translation: (2) Spare parts (including engines) brought into the territory of the other Contracting Party for the repair or maintenance of aircraft designated by the air transport enterprise for operating the agreed services under the flight agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条第一、二款所述设备和物品，经缔约另一方海关当局同意后，可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: III. The equipment and items referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 这些设备和物品应受缔约另一方海关当局监管直至重新运出，或者根据该缔约另一方的海关法规另作处理。
Translation: These equipment and items shall remain under the supervision of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party until re-exportation or disposal in accordance with the customs laws and regulations of that other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业和另一家或者多家在缔约另一方领土内享有同样税费免纳待遇的空运企业订有合同，在缔约另一方领土内向其租借或者转让本条第一、二款所述设备和物品的，则也应适用本条第一、二款的豁免规定。
Translation: IV. The exemptions provided for in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall also apply where an airline designated by one Contracting Party has concluded an agreement with one or more airlines enjoying the same exemptions from charges in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the lease or transfer in the territory of the other Contracting Party of the equipment and items mentioned in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土的客票、货运单和宣传品，应在互惠的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation: V. Passenger tickets, cargo waybills and publicity materials brought into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 六、直接过境的行李、货物和邮件，除提供服务的费用外，应在互惠的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation: VI. Baggage, goods, and mail in direct transit shall be exempt from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees, and other similar charges on a reciprocal basis, except for service fees.

Query_Text_cn: （二）采取措施，消除对缔约另一方指定空运企业的竞争地位造成不良影响的所有形式的歧视或不正当竞争的做法。
Translation: (2) Take measures to eliminate all forms of discrimination or unfair competitive practices that adversely affect the competitive position of the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条运力一、缔约双方指定空运企业投入协议航班的总运力，在经营开始前应经缔约双方航空当局协商同意或者批准，此后根据预测的运输需求加以确定。
Translation:
Article 12 Capacity  
1. The total capacity to be provided by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties on the agreed services shall be subject to mutual agreement or approval by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties prior to the commencement of operations, and shall thereafter be determined based on the forecasted traffic demand.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方指定空运企业经营协议航班的首要目标应以合理的载运比率提供足够的运力，满足缔约双方领土之间的运输需要。
Translation: II. The primary objective of the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties in operating the agreed services shall be to provide adequate capacity at reasonable load factors to meet the traffic requirements between the territories of the two Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约各方应允许缔约双方指定空运企业享有公平均等机会在双方领土之间经营协议航班，以求平等和互利。
Translation: III. Each Contracting Party shall allow the designated airlines of both Parties to enjoy fair and equal opportunities to operate agreed services between their respective territories, with a view to achieving equality and mutual benefit.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约各方及其指定空运企业应考虑缔约另一方及其指定空运企业的利益，以免不适当地影响后者经营的航班。
Translation: 4. The Contracting Parties and their designated air carriers shall take into account the interests of the other Contracting Party and its designated air carriers so as not to affect unduly the services operated by the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果在复审时，缔约双方不能就投入协议航班的运力协商一致，则缔约双方指定空运企业投入的运力不应超过先前商定的总运力（包括季节变化）。
Translation: V. If the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on the capacity to be operated on the agreed services during the review process, the capacity to be operated by the designated airlines of each Contracting Party shall not exceed the total capacity previously agreed upon (including seasonal variations).

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条运价一、缔约一方指定的一家或多家空运企业适用于本协定规定的航班的运价，应在合理的水平上制定，适当照顾到一切有关因素，包括用户利益、经营成本、航班特点、合理利润、其他空运企业的运价以及市场上其他商务考虑。
Translation:
Article 13 Tariffs  

1. The tariffs to be charged by one or more designated airlines of one Contracting Party for carriage under this Agreement shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being paid to all relevant factors including the interests of users, operating costs, characteristics of service, reasonable profit, tariffs of other airlines, and other commercial considerations in the market.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述运价如有可能，应由缔约双方指定空运企业商定，此前，如有要求，应与缔约双方各自的政府商讨，并且如可行，应与其他空运企业进行磋商。
Translation: 2. The above tariffs shall, if possible, be agreed upon by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties, after consultation, where required, with their respective governments and, where practicable, with other airlines.

Query_Text_cn: 如有可能，应利用适当的国际运价协调机制达成该协议。
Translation: Where possible, the agreement should be reached by utilizing appropriate international freight rate coordination mechanisms.

Query_Text_cn: 如不能达成任何多边或双边协议，则指定空运企业可自行制定运价。
Translation: If no multilateral or bilateral agreement can be reached, the designated air carrier may establish its own tariffs.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方可要求缔约双方指定空运企业通知或者备案拟从事的抵离其本国领土运输的运价。
Translation: 3. Either Contracting Party may require the designated airlines of both Parties to notify or file the tariffs intended to be charged for transportation to and from its own territory.

Query_Text_cn: 该通知或备案至少应在距计划采用运价之日六十天前进行。
Translation: The notice or filing shall be made at least sixty days prior to the planned implementation date of the tariff.

Query_Text_cn: 特殊情况下，这一时限可以缩短。
Translation: Under special circumstances, this time limit may be shortened.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约双方指定空运企业从事两国领土之间运输所采用的运价，应报经缔约双方批准。
Translation: 4. The tariffs to be charged by the designated airlines of either Contracting Party for carriage between the territories of the two Parties shall be subject to the approval of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方指定空运企业经营缔约另一方领土以及本协定规定的第三国领土之间的航班所采用的运价，应报经缔约另一方批准。
Translation: The tariffs to be charged by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party for carriage between the territory of the other Contracting Party and the third country territories specified in this Agreement shall be subject to the approval of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 五、上述第四款规定的运价的批准，缔约任何一方可明示地通知提交运价申请的空运企业。
Translation: 5. For the approval of tariffs specified in paragraph 4 above, either Contracting Party may explicitly notify the air transport enterprise that submitted the tariff application.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果缔约一方自提交之日起四十五天内，没有书面通知缔约另一方和／或相关空运企业不批准该缔约另一方空运企业的运价，该运价应被认为已获批准。
Translation: However, if a Contracting Party does not notify its disapproval of the tariff of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party to the other Contracting Party and /or the airline(s) concerned in writing within forty-five (45) days from the date of submission, such tariff shall be considered as approved.

Query_Text_cn: 如果根据第三款规定缩短提交运价的期限，缔约双方可协议相应缩短通知不批准的时限。
Translation: If the period for tariff filing is shortened pursuant to paragraph 3, the Contracting Parties may agree to correspondingly reduce the period for notifying disapproval.

Query_Text_cn: 除以下第六款的规定外，如缔约任何一方通知不批准，则此项运价不能生效。
Translation: Except as provided in paragraph 6 below, no such tariff shall take effect if disapproved by either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约一方可要求就缔约任何一方空运企业经营本协定规定的航班的任何运价进行磋商，包括已被通知不批准的运价。
Translation: VI. Either Contracting Party may request consultations on any tariff for flights operated by an airline of either Contracting Party under this Agreement, including tariffs that have been notified but not approved.

Query_Text_cn: 此类磋商应在收到上述请求之日起三十天内进行。
Translation: Such consultations shall be conducted within thirty days of receipt of the aforementioned request.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应协作，获取合理解决此问题所需的信息。
Translation: The contracting parties shall cooperate to obtain the information necessary for a reasonable resolution of this issue.

Query_Text_cn: 如果缔约双方达成协议，缔约双方应尽其所能使该协议生效。
Translation: If the contracting parties reach an agreement, they shall make every effort to bring it into effect.

Query_Text_cn: 如果没有达成协议，则应以任何不批准运价的决定为准。
Translation: If no agreement is reached, any decision not to approve the tariff shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 七、如果缔约双方不能解决有关第四款提及的运价问题，应根据本协定第二十条规定解决这一争端。
Translation: VII. If the Contracting Parties fail to resolve any issue concerning the tariffs referred to in paragraph 4, such dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 20 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 八、根据本条规定制定的运价应保持有效，除非该运价被有关空运企业撤销或直到一项新运价获得批准。
Translation: 8. Tariffs established in accordance with this Article shall remain in force unless withdrawn by the relevant air carrier or until a new tariff is approved.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条收入汇兑任何指定空运企业有权根据需求将当地取得的超过支出的收入兑换和汇至其本国。
Translation:
Article 14 Remittance of Earnings  
Any designated airline shall have the right to convert and remit to its own country the surplus of receipts over expenditures earned in the local currency, as required.

Query_Text_cn: 汇兑应允许以汇款当日适用的有效汇率进行，并且除了银行进行此类汇兑业务通常所收取的费用外，不应收取任何费用。
Translation: Exchange shall be permitted at the effective exchange rate applicable on the date of remittance, and no charges shall be imposed other than those normally levied by banks for such exchange transactions.

Query_Text_cn: 上述汇兑应符合该缔约一方外汇管制规章的规定。
Translation: The aforementioned exchange shall comply with the foreign exchange control regulations of the respective Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条代表机构一、缔约一方指定空运企业应在互惠的基础上，并根据缔约另一方有关入境、居留和雇佣的法律和规章，被准予在缔约另一方领土内派驻和保留其经营协议航班所需的代表及商务、营运和技术人员。
Translation:
Article 15 Representative Offices  
1. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall, on the basis of reciprocity and in accordance with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party relating to entry, residence, and employment, be permitted to establish and maintain in the territory of the other Contracting Party the representatives and commercial, operational, and technical personnel required for the operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 上述人员应在缔约任何一方或根据需要在缔约双方国民中选择。
Translation: The aforementioned personnel shall be selected from the nationals of either Contracting Party or, as required, from the nationals of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业可以选择本公司人员，或者使用在缔约另一方领土内经营、并获准在缔约另一方领土内提供此类服务的其他任何组织、公司或者空运企业的服务来满足上述工作人员的需求。
Translation: II. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party may choose to employ its own personnel or utilize the services of any other organization, company, or airline operating in the territory of the other Contracting Party and duly authorized to provide such services therein to meet the aforementioned personnel requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在遵守各自缔约方规定和规章的情况下，有权在缔约另一方领土内直接或者通过其指定的授权代理人从事航空运输销售业务。
Translation: III. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right, in compliance with the laws and regulations of the respective Contracting Party, to engage in the sale of air transportation directly or through its designated authorized agents in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条禁烟一、缔约各方应禁止或促使其空运企业禁止在其空运企业经营的缔约双方领土间的所有载运旅客的航班上吸烟。
Translation:
Article 16 Prohibition of Smoking  
1. Each Contracting Party shall prohibit or require its air carriers to prohibit smoking on all passenger flights operated by its air carriers between the territories of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 此项禁令应适用于航空器内的所有位置，并且应自旅客开始登机至旅客完成下机有效。
Translation: This prohibition shall apply to all locations within the aircraft and shall remain in effect from the commencement of passenger boarding until the completion of disembarkation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约各方应采取所有合理措施，确保其空运企业及其旅客、机组遵守本条规定，包括对违规进行适当处罚。
Translation: II. Each Contracting Party shall take all reasonable measures to ensure that its air carriers, passengers, and crew members comply with the provisions of this Article, including imposing appropriate penalties for violations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条统计资料缔约一方航空当局经要求，应向缔约另一方航空当局提供或者促使其指定的一家或多家空运企业提供定期或者其他合理要求的统计报告，以审议该缔约一方指定空运企业经营协议航班的运力投入情况。
Translation:
Article 17 Statistical Data  
The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request, furnish or cause their designated air carrier(s) to furnish to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party periodic or other reasonably required statistical reports to permit review of the capacity provided by the designated air carrier(s) of the first Contracting Party on the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条航班计划批准一、缔约一方指定空运企业至少应在协议航班经营前六十天向缔约另一方航空当局提交拟议的航班计划，以获取批准。
Translation:
Article 18 Approval of Flight Schedules  
1. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall submit the proposed flight schedule(s) to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party for approval at least sixty (60) days prior to the intended operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对于缔约一方指定空运企业希望在批准的协议航班时刻表外经营的加班，该空运企业必须事先获得缔约另一方航空当局的许可。
Translation: II. For any charter flights that a designated airline of one Contracting Party wishes to operate beyond the approved scheduled flights under the agreement, prior approval must be obtained from the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此类申请通常应至少在加班经营前十四个工作日提交。
Translation: Such applications should generally be submitted at least fourteen working days prior to the commencement of overtime operations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条协商一、缔约一方可随时要求就本协定的解释、适用、实施或修改或者本协定的遵守进行协商。
Translation:
Article 19 Consultation  

1. Either Contracting Party may at any time request consultations regarding the interpretation, application, implementation, or amendment of this Agreement, or compliance with its provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 二、这种协商可以会晤或书面方式进行，除非另有协议，应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation: II. Such consultations may be conducted either in meetings or in writing and, unless otherwise agreed, shall commence within sixty days from the date the other Party receives the request.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条争端的解决一、如缔约双方对本协定的解释或者适用发生争端，可先由缔约双方通过谈判友好协商解决。
Translation:
Article 20 Settlement of Disputes  
1. Any dispute between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall, as far as possible, be settled amicably through negotiations between the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如缔约双方航空当局不能就上述争端达成协议，缔约双方应通过外交途径予以解决。
Translation: II. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on the dispute mentioned above, the Contracting Parties shall settle it through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条修改一、缔约一方可随时要求与缔约另一方就现行协定及其附件的修改进行协商。
Translation:
Article 21 Amendments  
1. Either Contracting Party may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party regarding amendments to this Agreement and its annexes.

Query_Text_cn: 这种协商应在收到要求之日起六十日内开始，可以会晤或书面形式进行。
Translation: Such consultations shall commence within sixty days from the date of receipt of the request and may be conducted either in person or in writing.

Query_Text_cn: 二、任何修改应通过外交换文确认后生效。
Translation: II. Any amendments shall take effect upon confirmation through diplomatic notes.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对附件的任何修改，可由缔约双方航空当局达成书面协议，并应通过外交换文确认后生效。
Translation: III. Any amendments to the Annex may be made by written agreement between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties and shall take effect upon confirmation through an exchange of diplomatic notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条多边协定如果关于航空运输的多边协定对缔约双方生效，则应对现有协定作必要的修改以符合该多边协定的规定。
Translation:
Article 22 Multilateral Agreements  
In the event that a multilateral agreement concerning air transport becomes effective for both Contracting Parties, the existing agreement shall be amended as necessary to conform to the provisions of such multilateral agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条终止缔约一方可随时通过外交途径向缔约另一方书面通知其终止本协定的意愿。
Translation:
Article 23 Termination  
Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party in writing through diplomatic channels of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 该通知应同时通报国际民航组织。
Translation: The notice shall also be communicated to the International Civil Aviation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定应在缔约另一方收到通知之日起十二个月后终止，除非在期满前经协议撤回该通知。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date of receipt of the notification by the other Party, unless the notification is withdrawn by agreement before the expiration of that period.

Query_Text_cn: 如果缔约另一方未承认收到该通知，在国际民用航空组织收到该通知之日起十四天后，应视为缔约另一方已收到该通知。
Translation: If the other Contracting Party does not acknowledge receipt of the notification, it shall be deemed to have received the notification fourteen days after the date on which the International Civil Aviation Organization receives such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条向国际民航组织登记本协定以及对本协定的任何修改应由中华人民共和国政府向国际民用航空组织登记。
Translation: Article 24 The registration of this Agreement and any amendments thereto with the International Civil Aviation Organization shall be effected by the Government of the People's Republic of China.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条生效本协定自签字之日起生效，并取代一九五五年十一月八日签订的两国政府间航空运输协定。
Translation:
Article 25 Entry into Force  
This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of signature and shall supersede the Air Transport Agreement between the two governments signed on November 8, 1955.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经其各自政府正式授权，在本协定上签字，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, duly authorized by their respective Governments, have signed this Agreement in witness thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于二○○六年二月十四日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、缅文和英文写成，所有文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Beijing on February 14, 2006, in duplicate in the Chinese, Myanmar and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 如发生任何不一致情况，应以英文文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy, the English text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 2、就协议航班而言，指飞行该航班的航空器的运力乘以该航空器在一定时期内在一航线或者一航线航段上所飞行的班次。
Translation: 2. For scheduled flights, it refers to the capacity of the aircraft operating the flight multiplied by the number of flights operated by that aircraft on a specific route or route segment within a given period.

Query_Text_cn: （八）“运价”一词指运输旅客、行李和货物所采用的价格和价格条件，包括提供代理和其他附属服务的价格和价格条件，但不包括运输邮件的价格和价格条件。
Translation: (h) The term "tariff" means the prices and conditions governing the carriage of passengers, baggage and cargo, including the prices and conditions for agency and other auxiliary services, but excluding the prices and conditions for the carriage of mail.

Query_Text_cn: （九）“公约”，指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签字的《国际民用航空公约》，包括迄今为止仍有效的或缔约双方均采纳的、根据该公约第九十条规定通过的任何附件，以及根据该公约第九十条和九十四条规定对附件或者公约所作出的任何修改。
Translation: (ix) "Convention" means the Convention on International Civil Aviation, opened for signature at Chicago on 7 December 1944, and includes any Annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention and still in force, or any amendment of the Annexes or the Convention under Articles 90 and 94 thereof, insofar as such Annexes and amendments are in force for both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、附件构成本协定的一项组成部分。
Translation: II. The annexes constitute an integral part of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定规定的权利，以便其指定空运企业在本协定附件中规定的航线上建立和经营国际航班。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement for the purpose of enabling its designated airline(s) to establish and operate international air services on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 此种航班和航线以下分别称为“协议航班”和“规定航线”。
Translation: Such flights and routes shall hereinafter be referred to as "agreed flights" and "specified routes" respectively.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点经停，以便载运来自或者前往缔约一方领土的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (c) To make stops at points in the territory of the other Contracting Party on the specified routes for the purpose of carrying international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail to or from the territory of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，本条不授予第五种自由的业务权。
Translation: However, this Article does not grant the operating rights for the Fifth Freedom.

Query_Text_cn: （四）缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内地点载上和卸下前往或者来自第三国国际运输的权利，应由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: (4) The right of an airline designated by one Contracting Party to embark and disembark at points in the territory of the other Contracting Party traffic destined for or coming from third countries shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业无权在缔约另一方领土内两点之间载运业务。
Translation: 3. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall not be entitled to carry traffic between two points in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方有权书面向缔约另一方指定一家空运企业，以便在规定航线上经营协议航班。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one airline for the operation of agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权,应属于该缔约方。
Translation: II. The substantial ownership and effective control of an airline designated by either Contracting Party shall be vested in such Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方航空当局可要求缔约另一方指定空运企业向其证明，该指定空运企业有资格履行上述当局在经营国际航班方面正常和合理地实施的法律和规定。
Translation: 3. The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party may require the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party to demonstrate that it is qualified to fulfill the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied by the said authorities in the operation of international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 四、在不违反本条第二和第三款规定的情况下，缔约另一方在收到上述指定后，应毫不拖延地给予指定空运企业以适当的经营许可。
Translation: 4. Without prejudice to the provisions of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article, the other Contracting Party shall, upon receipt of such designation, grant without delay the appropriate operating authorization to the designated airline.

Query_Text_cn: 五、空运企业一经指定并获得许可，可以在任何时间开始经营协议航班，条件是根据本协定第十条和第十一条规定制定关于该航班的运价和班期时刻应该生效。
Translation: V. Once designated and authorized, an air carrier may commence operation of the agreed services at any time, provided that the tariffs and schedules for such services have been established in accordance with Articles X and XI of this Agreement and have become effective.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约一方指定空运企业可以使用从第三国租用的航空器在规定航线上经营协议航班，条件是在开始拟议经营至少30天之前，事先向缔约另一方航空当局提交通知。
Translation: VI. A designated airline of one Contracting Party may operate agreed services on the specified routes using aircraft leased from a third country, provided that prior notice is submitted to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party at least 30 days before commencing the proposed operations.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下，经上述当局同意，这一期限可以缩短。
Translation: Under special circumstances, this period may be shortened with the consent of the aforementioned authorities.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如该空运企业在其它方面没有按照根据本协定规定的条件经营。
Translation: (3) If the designated airline fails to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under this Agreement in other respects.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款所述的撤销、暂停或者附加条件必须立即执行，以防止进一步违反法律和规章，此种权利只能在与缔约另一方航空当局协商之后方可行使。
Translation: 2. Unless the revocation, suspension, or imposition of conditions referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article must be implemented immediately to prevent further violations of laws and regulations, such rights may only be exercised after consultation with the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此种在航空当局之间的协商应在要求之日起30天内开始。
Translation: Such consultations between aviation authorities shall commence within 30 days from the date of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业经营国际航班的航空器，以及留置在航空器上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料（包括液压油）、润滑油和机上供应品（包括食品、饮料和烟草），在进入缔约另一方领土时，应豁免关税、检验费和其它税捐或税收，但此种设备和物品应留置在航空器上直至重新运出。
Translation: 1. The aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on international air services, as well as their regular equipment, spare parts, fuels, oils (including hydraulic fluids), lubricants, and aircraft stores (including food, beverages, and tobacco) retained on board such aircraft, shall be exempt from customs duties, inspection fees, and other duties or taxes upon entering the territory of the other Contracting Party, provided such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft until re-exported.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业运入或者为其运入缔约另一方领土、或者在上述领土装上该指定空运企业航空器上的燃料、油料（包括液压油）、润滑油、零备件、正常设备和机上供应品应豁免全部税捐和费用，包括关税、检验费和缔约另一方领土内征收的其它税捐或税收，即使这些物品在装上飞机的缔约方的领土内部分航段上使用。
Translation: II. Fuel, oils (including hydraulic fluids), lubricants, spare parts, regular equipment, and aircraft stores introduced into the territory of one Contracting Party by or on behalf of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party, or taken on board its aircraft in that territory, shall be exempt from all duties, taxes, fees, and charges, including customs duties, inspection fees, and other national taxes or levies imposed in the territory of the other Contracting Party, even when such supplies are used on sections of the flight performed within the territory of the Party where they are taken on board.

Query_Text_cn: 上述的物品应置于海关监督或控制之下。
Translation: The aforementioned goods shall be placed under customs supervision or control.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业航空器上留置的机上正常设备、零备件、机上供应品和燃料、油料（包括液压油）和润滑油，只能在经缔约另一方海关当局同意之后方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下，该当局可以要求这些物品置于海关监督和控制之下直至重新运出或根据海关规定另作处理。
Translation: III. The normal equipment, spare parts, aircraft stores, fuel, oils (including hydraulic fluids), and lubricants retained on board the aircraft of the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the latter's customs authorities. Such authorities may require these items to be placed under their supervision and control until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with customs regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土的客票、货运单、班期时刻表、宣传材料和分发品应豁免关税、检验费和其它税捐或税收。
Translation: IV. Passenger tickets, cargo waybills, timetables, promotional materials, and distribution items brought into the territory of the other Contracting Party by the designated airline of one Contracting Party shall be exempt from customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes or levies.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的办事处为经营协议航班所需的家具、办公设备和通信设施、车辆应豁免关税和其它税捐或税收。
Translation: V. The offices of the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from customs duties and other taxes or levies on furniture, office equipment, communication facilities, and vehicles necessary for the operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方关于从事国际航班的航空器进出其领土或者在其领土内运行和航行的法律和规定，缔约另一方指定空运企业的航空器在进出缔约另一方领土或在该领土内时应予以遵守。
Translation: 1. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party regarding the entry into, exit from, or operation and navigation within its territory by aircraft engaged in international air services shall be complied with by the aircraft of the air transport enterprises designated by the other Contracting Party when entering, exiting, or operating within the territory of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方关于移民、海关和检疫的法律和规定在缔约另一方指定空运企业航空器承运的机组、旅客、行李、货物和邮件抵达、境内停留和离开缔约一方领土时应对其适用。
Translation: II. The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to immigration, customs, and quarantine shall apply to the crew, passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail carried by the aircraft of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party upon their arrival in, stay within, and departure from the territory of the former Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、直接过境缔约一方领土的旅客应只履行非常简化的手续。
Translation: III. Passengers in direct transit through the territory of one Contracting Party shall be subject to only very simplified formalities.

Query_Text_cn: 行李和货物，如直接过境，应豁免关税、检验费和其它税捐或费用。
Translation: Luggage and goods, if in direct transit, shall be exempt from customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes or charges.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业经营规定航线的航空器应具有国籍和登记标志和随机携带有关证件。
Translation: 1. The aircraft operated by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party on the specified routes shall bear its nationality and registration marks and carry the pertinent certificates on board.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方颁发或核准有效和未过期的适航证、合格证和执照，缔约另一方应承认其有效。
Translation: II. The competent authorities of one Contracting Party shall recognize as valid the certificates of airworthiness, certificates of competency and licenses issued or validated by the other Contracting Party and still in force.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方对为在其领土上空飞行而由缔约另一方授予其本国国民的合格证和执照保留拒绝承认的权利。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse to recognize the certificates and licenses granted to its own nationals by the other Contracting Party for the purpose of flight within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 一、根据国际法赋予各自的权利和义务，缔约双方重申为保护民用航空安全免遭非法干扰行为而相互承担的义务，构成本协定不可分割的组成部分。
Translation: I. In accordance with the rights and obligations conferred upon them by international law, the Contracting Parties reaffirm their mutual commitment to protecting civil aviation security against acts of unlawful interference, which constitutes an integral part of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方应特别遵守1963年9月14日在东京签订的《关于在航空器内的犯罪和犯有某些其他行为的公约》、1970年12月16日在海牙签订的《关于制止非法劫持航空器的公约》、1971年9月23日在蒙特利尔签订的《关于制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为的公约》和1988年2月24日在蒙特利尔签订的《制止在用于国际民用航空机场发生的非法暴力行为以补充1971年9月23日订于蒙特利尔的制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为公约的议定书》，以及对缔约双方均有约束力的任何其他关于航空保安的多边协定。
Translation: II. The Contracting Parties shall in particular observe the Convention on Offences and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft, signed at Tokyo on 14 September 1963, the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft, signed at The Hague on 16 December 1970, the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation, signed at Montreal on 23 September 1971, and the Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports Serving International Civil Aviation, supplementary to the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation, signed at Montreal on 23 September 1971, signed at Montreal on 24 February 1988, as well as any other multilateral agreement relating to aviation security binding upon both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方应根据要求相互提供一切必要的协助，防止非法劫持民用航空器的行为和其他危及航空器及其旅客和机组、机场和航行设施安全的非法行为，以及危及民用航空安全的任何其他威胁。
Translation: III. The Contracting Parties shall provide each other with all necessary assistance upon request to prevent acts of unlawful seizure of civil aircraft and other unlawful acts jeopardizing the safety of such aircraft, their passengers and crew, airports and air navigation facilities, as well as any other threats to the safety of civil aviation.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约双方在其相互关系中，应遵守国际民航组织制定的、作为公约附件并对缔约双方均适用的航空保安规定。
Translation: IV. The Contracting Parties shall, in their mutual relations, comply with the aviation security provisions established by the International Civil Aviation Organization as Annexes to the Convention and applicable to both Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应要求主要营业场所或永久居住地在其领土内的航空器经营人以及在其领土内的机场经营人遵守上述航空保安规定。
Translation: The Contracting Parties shall require aircraft operators whose principal place of business or permanent residence is within their territories, as well as airport operators within their territories, to comply with the aforementioned aviation security provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约双方同意，可以要求上述航空器经营人在进出缔约另一方领土或者在缔约另一方领土内停留时遵守缔约另一方规定的本条第四款所述的航空保安规定。
Translation: V. The Contracting Parties agree that the operator of the aforementioned aircraft may be required to comply with the aviation security provisions specified in paragraph IV of this Article when entering, leaving or staying in the territory of the other Contracting Party, as stipulated by that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约双方应保证在其领土内采取足够有效的措施保护航空器，并在登机或装机之前和登机或装机期间对乘客、机组、手提物品、行李、货物和机上供应品进行检查。
Translation: VI. Both Contracting Parties shall ensure that adequate and effective measures are taken within their respective territories to protect aircraft, and to screen passengers, crew, hand baggage, baggage, cargo, and aircraft supplies prior to and during boarding or loading.

Query_Text_cn: 当发生非法劫持民用航空器的事件或者以劫持航空器相威胁、或者发生其他危及航空器及其旅客、机组、机场或者航行设施安全的非法行为时，缔约双方应相互协助，提供联系的方便并采取其他适当的措施，以便迅速、安全地解决上述事件或者威胁。
Translation: In the event of an unlawful seizure of civil aircraft or a threat to seize an aircraft, or any other unlawful act endangering the safety of such aircraft, its passengers, crew, airports, or navigational facilities, both Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and taking other appropriate measures to promptly and safely resolve such incidents or threats.

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约一方对缔约另一方提出的为对付特定威胁而采取合理的特殊保安措施的要求，应给予同情的考虑。
Translation: 7. Each Party shall give sympathetic consideration to requests from the other Party for taking reasonable special security measures to address specific threats.

Query_Text_cn: 八、当发生非法劫持民用航空器的事件或者以劫持航空器相威胁、或者发生其他危及航空器及其旅客、机组、机场或者航行设施安全的非法行为时，缔约双方应相互协助，提供联系的方便并采取其他适当的措施，以便迅速、安全地解决上述事件或者威胁。
Translation: VIII. In the event of an unlawful seizure of civil aircraft or a threat thereof, or any other unlawful act endangering the safety of such aircraft, its passengers, crew, airports, or navigational facilities, both Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and taking other appropriate measures to ensure the prompt and safe resolution of such incidents or threats.

Query_Text_cn: 九、如果缔约一方有合理的理由认为缔约另一方未能遵守本条款的规定，该缔约方民航当局可以要求立即与另一方民航当局进行协商。
Translation: IX. If a Contracting Party has reasonable grounds to believe that the other Contracting Party has failed to comply with the provisions of this Article, the aeronautical authorities of that Contracting Party may request immediate consultations with the aeronautical authorities of the other Party.

Query_Text_cn: 如自缔约一方发出协商要求之日起1个月内未能达成满意的协议，则构成适用本协定第四条的依据。
Translation: If no satisfactory agreement is reached within one month from the date of the request for consultation by either Contracting Party, it shall constitute grounds for the application of Article IV of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 如应对严重的紧急事件需要，任何缔约方可在此1个月期限前采取临时的行动。
Translation: In the event of a severe emergency requiring immediate action, any Contracting Party may take provisional measures before the expiration of this one-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方可随时要求就缔约另一方在飞行机组、航空器及其运行方面的安全标准进行磋商。
Translation: 1. Either Contracting Party may at any time request consultations on the safety standards of the other Contracting Party concerning flight crews, aircraft, and their operations.

Query_Text_cn: 磋商应该在提出要求后30天内进行。
Translation: Consultations shall be held within 30 days after the request is made.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果在磋商之后，缔约一方发现缔约另一方未能有效地维持和管理至少等同于根据公约当时制定的任一方面最低的安全标准，缔约一方应通知缔约另一方其调查结果，以及为遵守这些最低标准应采取的必要步骤。缔约另一方应采取适当的改正行动。
Translation: II. If, following consultations, one Party finds that the other Party has failed to effectively maintain and administer at least the minimum safety standards established under the Convention at any given time in any respect, the former shall notify the latter of its findings and the necessary steps to be taken to comply with these minimum standards. The latter Party shall take appropriate corrective action.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约另一方未在15天或者双方同意的更长期间内采取适当行动，则构成适用本协定第四条的理由。
Translation: If the other contracting party fails to take appropriate action within 15 days or a longer period agreed upon by both parties, it shall constitute grounds for applying Article IV of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、尽管有公约第三十三条所规定的义务，双方同意缔约一方空运企业运营或代表一家空运企业经营的任何航空器在缔约另一方领土内时，可成为缔约另一方航空当局授权代表的检查对象，以便登机和在航空器周围查验航空器和机组人员证件的有效性以及航空器及其设备的外观条件（在此条中称为“机坪检查”），但该机坪检查不会导致不合理地延误航空器经营。
Translation: III. Notwithstanding the obligations under Article 33 of the Convention, the Parties agree that any aircraft operated by an airline of one Party or on behalf of an airline of one Party may, while in the territory of the other Party, be made subject to an inspection by authorized representatives of the aeronautical authorities of the other Party for the purpose of boarding and inspecting the aircraft and its surroundings to verify the validity of the aircraft and crew documents and the apparent condition of the aircraft and its equipment (referred to in this Article as "ramp inspection"), provided that such ramp inspection shall not cause unreasonable delay to the operation of the aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: （二）依据公约当时所制定的安全标准缺乏有效的维护和管理的严重关切，进行机坪检查的缔约方应依据公约第三十三条，自主决定有关该航空器或该航空器机组的证书或执照的颁发或者核准有效的要求，或者航空器运营的要求，不等同于或高于根据公约制定的最低标准。
Translation: (2) In cases of serious concern regarding the lack of effective maintenance and management of safety standards as established by the Convention at the time, the Contracting Party conducting the ramp inspection shall, in accordance with Article 33 of the Convention, independently determine whether the requirements for the issuance or validation of certificates or licenses pertaining to the aircraft or its crew, or the operational conditions of the aircraft, are not equal to or below the minimum standards prescribed under the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在缔约一方一家或多家空运企业的代表拒绝根据上述第三款对其经营或其代表的航空器进行机坪检查的情况下，缔约另一方可自行推断第四款所述的严重关切情形发生，并作出该条款提及的结论。
Translation: V. In the event that a representative of one or more air transport enterprises of one Contracting Party refuses a ramp inspection of their operations or the aircraft they represent pursuant to paragraph 3 above, the other Contracting Party may infer that the serious concerns referred to in paragraph 4 have arisen and draw the conclusions mentioned therein.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如果根据一次或一系列机坪检查的结果，或者因拒绝机坪检查、协商或者其他事项，缔约一方认为有必要立即采取行动以保证航空公司的运营安全，则其保留立即暂停或改变缔约另一方一家或多家空运企业经营许可的权利。
Translation: VI. If, based on the results of one or a series of ramp inspections, or due to refusal of ramp inspections, consultations, or other matters, one Contracting Party deems it necessary to take immediate action to ensure the operational safety of airlines, it reserves the right to immediately suspend or modify the operating authorizations of one or more air carriers of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 七、一旦采取行动的依据不再存在，缔约一方航空当局应停止根据上述第二款或者第六款规定的任何行动。
Translation: 7. In the event that the basis for the action taken no longer exists, the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall terminate any action taken pursuant to paragraph 2 or 6 above.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方应在其领土内指定缔约另一方指定空运企业为经营规定航线使用的固定机场和备用机场，并在其领土内向该空运企业提供经营协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其它辅助服务。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory the fixed and alternate airports to be used by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the agreed services, and shall provide such airline(s) with the necessary communications, navigational, meteorological and other auxiliary services required for the operation of the agreed flights within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 关于上述的具体安排可由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: The specific arrangements regarding the above may be determined through consultations between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设施和技术服务应按缔约另一方航空当局规定的公平和合理的费率收取费用。
Translation: II. The charges imposed on the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party for the use of airports, facilities, and technical services in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be fair and reasonable, in accordance with the rates established by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此种费率不应高于对其它国家空运企业经营国际航班使用类似设施和服务所收取的费率。
Translation: Such rates shall not be higher than those charged to air carriers of other countries operating international services for the use of similar facilities and services.

Query_Text_cn: 一、为了经营规定航线上的协议航班，缔约一方指定空运企业有权在对等的基础上在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的地点设立代表机构。
Translation: 1. For the operation of agreed services on the specified routes, the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish representative offices at points on the specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party on the basis of reciprocity.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的工作人员应遵守代表机构所在国有效的法律和规定。
Translation: The staff of representative offices shall comply with the laws and regulations in force in the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业派驻在缔约另一方领土内的代表机构的工作人员应为缔约任何一方国民，此种人员的数量由缔约双方航空当局按对等原则确定。
Translation: II. The staff of the representative offices designated by the air transport enterprises of one Contracting Party stationed in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of either Contracting Party, and the number of such personnel shall be determined by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties on the basis of reciprocity.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应尽最大实际可能保证缔约另一方指定空运企业的代表机构及其工作人员的安全和保护上述空运企业为经营协议航班而在其领土内的航空器、供应品和其它财产。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall, to the greatest extent practicable, ensure the safety and protection of the representative offices and personnel of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party, as well as the aircraft, supplies, and other property of such airline(s) within its territory for the operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方应尽最大实际可能向缔约另一方指定空运企业的代表机构及其工作人员提供有效地经营协议航班所必要的协助。
Translation: 4. Each Contracting Party shall, to the greatest extent practicable, provide the designated airline of the other Contracting Party and its representative offices and staff with all necessary assistance for the effective operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业进出缔约另一方领土的航班机组人员应为指定该空运企业的缔约方的国民。
Translation: V. The flight crew members of the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party operating into and out of the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of the Contracting Party designating the airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方指定空运企业如欲在进出缔约另一方领土的航班上雇佣任何其他国籍的机组人员，应事先取得缔约另一方的同意。
Translation: If a designated airline of one Contracting Party intends to employ crew members of any other nationality on flights to and from the territory of the other Contracting Party, it shall obtain prior approval from the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约一方指定空运企业依照缔约另一方相关法律和规定，有权在缔约另一方境内直接或自行通过代理人进行航空运输销售。
Translation: VI. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall have the right, in accordance with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party, to conduct sales of air transport directly or through its agents in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 指定空运企业有权进行航空运输销售，且任何人可自由使用其所在境内的货币或根据国内法律和规定任何可以自由兑换的货币购买此种运输。
Translation: Designated air carriers are authorized to conduct air transport sales, and any person may freely purchase such transportation using the currency of their country or any freely convertible currency as permitted by domestic laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方指定空运企业应享有公平均等的机会在规定航线上经营协议航班。
Translation: 1. The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities to operate the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在经营协议航班方面，缔约一方指定空运企业应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益，以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线或者航段上经营的航班。
Translation: II. In operating the agreed services, the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services which the latter provides on the same route or section thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班，应满足公众在规定航线上的运输需求，并且其首要目标应是以合理的载运比率提供足够的运力，以满足目前及可合理预期的来自或前往指定该空运企业的缔约一方领土的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输需求。
Translation: III. The agreed services operated by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties shall meet the public demand for transportation on the specified routes, with their primary objective being to provide adequate capacity at reasonable load factors to cater to the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party that has designated the airline.

Query_Text_cn: （三）联程航班经济经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The operational needs of code-share flights.

Query_Text_cn: 四、指定空运企业经营的运力与班次应由缔约双方航空当局在协议航班开航之前合理协商确定。
Translation: 4. The capacity and frequency of operations designated by the air transport enterprises shall be reasonably agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties prior to the commencement of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业为前往或来自缔约另一方领土的运输而收取的运价应在合理水平上制定，适当考虑一切有关因素，包括经营成本，合理的利润、航班特点和其它空运企业的运价。
Translation: 1. The tariffs charged by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party for carriage to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being paid to all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, characteristics of service and the tariffs of other airlines.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述的运价应首先在缔约双方指定空运企业之间商定，在需要和可能的情况下，与经营相同航线的全部和部分航段的其他空运企业协商。
Translation: 2. The tariffs referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall first be agreed upon between the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties and, where required and possible, in consultation with other airlines operating over the whole or part of the same route.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按此协议的任何运价至迟应于其拟议实施之日60天之前提交缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: III. Any tariff under this agreement shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties for approval no later than 60 days prior to the proposed effective date.

Query_Text_cn: 在某些情况下，经上述当局协议这一期限可以缩短。
Translation: In certain cases, this period may be shortened upon agreement by the aforementioned authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果一方航空当局未在提交之日30天内表示不批准，根据本条第三款，此运价应被视为已获批准。
Translation: 4. If an aeronautical authority does not indicate disapproval within 30 days from the date of submission, the tariff shall be deemed approved pursuant to paragraph 3 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果缔约双方指定空运企业不能达成协议，或如果缔约一方航空当局未能批准运价，缔约双方航空当局应努力通过谈判相互协议确定运价。
Translation: V. If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on tariffs, or if the aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party do not approve the proposed tariffs, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to determine the tariffs by mutual agreement through consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条提供统计资料缔约双方航空当局应按要求相互提供指定空运企业航空器有关在协议航班上运输业务的定期统计资料和类似情况。
Translation:
Article 14 Provision of Statistical Data  
The aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall, upon request, furnish each other with periodic statistics and similar information pertaining to the traffic carried by the designated air carriers' aircraft on the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方应给予缔约另一方指定空运企业，按其财政当局公布的官方汇率，以任何可自由兑换的货币，将上述指定空运企业在其境内因运输旅客、行李和货物所取得的收支余额汇出的权利。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall grant the designated air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party the right to remit, at the official exchange rate published by its financial authorities and in any freely convertible currency, the balance of revenues derived from the transport of passengers, baggage and cargo within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如缔约双方的支付体制按专门协定办理，该专门协定应适用。
Translation: II. Where the payment systems of the Contracting Parties are governed by a special agreement, such special agreement shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内取得的收入和利润应豁免全部税收。
Translation: 1. The income and profits derived by the designated airline of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的财产应豁免全部税收。
Translation: II. The property of the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业代表机构在缔约另一方领土内系该缔约方国民的工作人员的收入应豁免全部税收。
Translation: III. The income of personnel who are nationals of one Contracting Party and employed by the designated airline of that Party in the representative offices within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方应本着密切合作和相互支持的精神确保正确执行和满意地遵守本规定。
Translation: 1. The Contracting Parties shall ensure the correct implementation and satisfactory compliance with this provision in a spirit of close cooperation and mutual support.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方可要求与缔约另一方协商，此种要求可以口头或书面形式，并应在收到要求之日起60天内开始，除非缔约双方共同确定延长此期限。
Translation: II. Either Contracting Party may request consultations with the other Contracting Party. Such request may be made orally or in writing and shall commence within 60 days from the date of receipt of the request, unless the Contracting Parties jointly determine to extend this period.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如果关于解释或执行本协定出现意见分歧，缔约双方指定空运企业应本着友好合作和相互理解的精神直接通过协商解决，或者如果分歧的事务不在其职权范围之内，缔约双方航空当局应努力在它们之间解决分歧。
Translation: III. In the event of any disagreement concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties shall endeavor to resolve the matter directly through consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding. Should the issue fall outside their competence, the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties shall seek to settle the disagreement between themselves.

Query_Text_cn: 如果仍然不能取得解决办法，缔约双方应通过外交途径努力解决分歧。
Translation: If no solution can still be reached, the contracting parties shall endeavor to resolve their differences through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方应通过讨论或信函修改或修订本协定的任何规定。
Translation: 1. The Contracting Parties shall amend or revise any provision of this Agreement through discussions or correspondence.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协议的任何修改在通过外交照会确认后生效。
Translation: II. Any amendment to the Agreement shall enter into force upon confirmation through a diplomatic note.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对本协定附件的任何修改可在缔约双方航空当局之间商定。
Translation: III. Any amendments to the annexes of this Agreement may be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条终止缔约一方可随时将其终止本协定的决定通知缔约另一方。
Translation:
Article 20 Termination  
Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its decision to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 在此情况下，本协定将自缔约另一方收到通知之日起12个月后终止，除非终止通知在该期限失效前通过相互协议予以撤销。
Translation: In such case, this Agreement shall terminate 12 months after the date on which the notice is received by the other Party, unless the notice of termination is withdrawn by mutual agreement before the expiration of that period.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定取代两国政府1993年11月8日签订的《中华人民共和国政府和朝鲜民主主义人民共和国政府航空运输协定》。
Translation: I. This Agreement supersedes the Air Transport Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea signed on November 8, 1993.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方应当相互书面通知已完成协定生效所必需的国内法律程序。
Translation: 2. The Contracting Parties shall notify each other in writing of the completion of their respective domestic legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定自后一份通知发出之日生效。
Translation: This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of the latter notification.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于2008年6月17日在平壤签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、朝鲜文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Pyongyang on June 17, 2008, in duplicate, with each copy written in Chinese, Korean, and English, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约任何一方指定空运企业在任何或者所有飞行中，可自行决定不经停规定航线上的任何地点，但协议航班应在指定该空运企业的缔约一方领土内始发和终止。
Translation: 3. The designated airline(s) of either Contracting Party may, at its discretion, omit any point(s) on the specified route(s) in any or all flights, provided that the agreed services originate and terminate within the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline(s).

Query_Text_cn: 一、如果指定空运企业或其它空运企业希望经营前往或来自或经过缔约另一方领土的不定期飞行，可为此目的向缔约另一方航空当局申请。
Translation: 1. If a designated air carrier or any other air carrier intends to operate non-scheduled flights to, from, or via the territory of the other Contracting Party, it may apply to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party for such purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 上述当局应毫不拖延地根据其本国关于不定期飞行的规定予以办理。
Translation: The authorities concerned shall process the matter without delay in accordance with their national regulations on non-scheduled flights.

Query_Text_cn: 申请应在建议飞行之日至少3个工作日之前提出，在获得批准之后方可飞行。
Translation: Applications must be submitted at least three working days prior to the proposed flight date and may only proceed upon approval.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业可根据业务需求，申请在规定航线上经营加班飞行。
Translation: 2. The designated airline of either Contracting Party may apply to operate extra flights on the specified routes based on operational requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 此种飞行的申请应在上述飞行起飞至少3个工作日之前提交缔约另一方航空当局，在获得批准之后方可飞行。
Translation: Applications for such flights shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party at least 3 working days prior to the intended flight date and may only be operated after approval is obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条甲、1.缔约一方根据本协定给予缔约对方以在附件所列航线(以下简称规定航线)上从事定期航班飞行的权利。
Translation: Article 1, Section A, 1. Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement for the purpose of operating scheduled air services on the routes specified in the Annex (hereinafter referred to as "the specified routes").

Query_Text_cn: 2.上述定期航班飞行的权利是指在规定航线上载运缔约双方领土间以及与第三国领土间的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件的权利。
Translation: 2. The right to operate the scheduled flights referred to above shall be the right to carry international passengers, baggage, cargo and mail between the territories of the Contracting Parties and between the territories of third countries on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、根据互相尊重主权和领土完整的原则,规定航线经过缔约一方国界的空中进出口和在缔约一方领土上的航路空域,应由该缔约方规定。
Translation: B. In accordance with the principle of mutual respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, the air entry and exit points along the routes crossing the national boundaries of one Contracting Party and the airspace of the routes over the territory of one Contracting Party shall be prescribed by that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 为了飞行安全的需要,缔约一方并应为缔约对方指定适当的备降机场。
Translation: For the purpose of flight safety, each Contracting Party shall also designate appropriate alternate airports for the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 丁、缔约一方应提供缔约对方为飞行规定航线安全所需的通信、导航和其他附属服务。
Translation: Article D: Each Contracting Party shall provide the other Contracting Party with the communication, navigation, and other auxiliary services necessary for the safe operation of flights on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机,可以在其飞行中越过而不降停规定航线上的任何一点或多点。
Translation: The aircraft of an airline designated by either Contracting Party may, while operating on the specified route, fly over any point or points on the route without landing.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条甲、中华人民共和国政府指定“中国民用航空总局”为经营规定航线的空运企业,巴基斯坦政府指定“巴基斯坦国际航空公司”为经营规定航线的空运企业(以下简称指定空运企业)。
Translation: Article 2(a) The Government of the People's Republic of China designates the "General Administration of Civil Aviation of China" as the airline enterprise to operate the agreed services, and the Government of Pakistan designates "Pakistan International Airlines" as the airline enterprise to operate the agreed services (hereinafter referred to as the designated airline enterprises).

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约一方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权,应属于该缔约方的政府或公民。
Translation: B. The substantial ownership and effective control of an airline designated by either Contracting Party shall be vested in the government or nationals of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条甲、缔约双方指定空运企业经营规定航线的班次、班期时刻表和采用的机型,应由缔约双方指定空运企业在平等互利的基础上商定,并经缔约双方民航当局批准。
Translation: Article III A. The frequency, flight schedules and aircraft types to be operated by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties on the specified routes shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Parties on the basis of equality and mutual benefit, and shall be subject to the approval of the civil aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约一方应在开航前六十天通知缔约对方。
Translation: B. Either Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party sixty days prior to the commencement of navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条甲、缔约双方指定空运企业在经营规定航线时,在使用各项服务方面应享有公平均等的机会和待遇。
Translation: Article IV (A) The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities and treatment in the operation of the agreed services on the specified routes, including the use of all services.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方所提供的各项服务,即通信导航、气象资料的供应、机场的地面服务,应与其向本国指定空运企业所提供的相同。
Translation: The services provided by either contracting party, including communication and navigation, meteorological data supply, and airport ground services, shall be the same as those provided to its own designated air transport enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约双方应准许缔约双方指定空运企业使用民航电台传递有关航行的电报。
Translation: B. The Contracting Parties shall permit the designated airlines of both Parties to use civil aviation radio stations for transmitting telegrams related to flight operations.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方同意在陆空通报和平面通报中采用英语和国际间通用的航空Q简语的有关部分。
