Translation: The contracting parties agree to adopt English and the relevant parts of the internationally recognized aeronautical Q code in both aeronautical and surface communications.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条甲、规定航线上载运旅客、行李、货物所征收的运价,应制定在合理的水平上,并适当地照顾到一切有关因素,包括经营的成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation: Article 5 (a) The tariffs to be charged by the airlines designated by the Contracting Parties for carriage on the agreed services shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being paid to all relevant factors, including cost of operation, reasonable profit and the tariffs of other airlines.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方指定空运企业在共同或相等的航线或航段上的运价应有相同的最低水平。
Translation: The designated airlines of both contracting parties shall maintain identical minimum fare levels on identical or equivalent routes or segments.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、规定航线及其航段与缔约对方有关的运价,应由缔约双方指定空运企业议定一最低水平并报经缔约双方民航当局审查同意。
Translation: B. The tariffs for specified routes and their segments related to the other Contracting Party shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties at a minimum level and submitted to the respective civil aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties for review and approval.

Query_Text_cn: 双方空运企业间如对运价最低水平不能获致协议或不能获致缔约双方民航当局同意时,缔约双方应设法达成协议。
Translation: If the air transport enterprises of both parties fail to reach an agreement on the minimum fare levels or fail to obtain approval from the civil aviation authorities of the contracting parties, the contracting parties shall endeavor to reach an agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 在对运价最低水平作出任何新的决定以前,缔约双方已协议的运价最低水平应继续适用。
Translation: Before any new decision is made on the minimum freight rate level, the previously agreed minimum freight rate level between the contracting parties shall continue to apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条甲、1.缔约双方指定空运企业的飞机在规定航线上飞行时,应具有各该方为国际飞行所规定的国籍标志和登记标志、登记证、适航证、航行记录簿、无线电通信设备使用许可证、机组名单、旅客名单和货物、邮件的舱单。
Translation: Article 6 A.1. The aircraft designated by the air transport enterprises of the Contracting Parties, when operating on the specified routes, shall bear their respective nationality and registration marks, certificates of registration, airworthiness certificates, journey log books, radio station licenses, lists of crew members, passenger manifests and cargo and mail manifests, as prescribed for international flights by the respective Party.

Query_Text_cn: 空勤人员应具备其所属缔约一方发给或核准的有效执照和合格证明书。
Translation: Flight crew members shall possess valid licenses and certificates of competency issued or validated by the Contracting Party to which they belong.

Query_Text_cn: 2.缔约一方对缔约对方所发给或核准的上述有效文件应承认其有效。
Translation: 2. Each Contracting Party shall recognize the validity of the aforementioned valid documents issued or approved by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约双方指定空运企业的飞机在规定航线缔约对方领土上飞行时,其机长和其他空勤组成员应分别为各该国公民。
Translation: B. The aircraft of the designated airlines of either Contracting Party, while operating on the agreed routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party, shall have crew members whose captain and other members of the flight crew shall be nationals of the respective Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条缔约一方对缔约对方的飞机使用机场和航行设备征收的费用,不应高于其从事同样国际航线飞行的本国飞机所付的费率。
Translation: Article 7 The fees charged by one Contracting Party for the use of airports and air navigation facilities by aircraft of the other Contracting Party shall not be higher than those paid by its own aircraft engaged in similar international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 此项费率应予公布并通知缔约对方民航当局。
Translation: This rate shall be published and notified to the civil aviation authorities of the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条甲、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机应遵守缔约对方有关民航飞机从事国际飞行时入境、出境和在其领土内经营和航行的法令规章,以及关于禁区、限制区的法令规章。
Translation: Article VIII A. The aircraft designated by one Contracting Party shall comply with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party governing the entry, exit, and operation of civil aircraft engaged in international flights within its territory, as well as those pertaining to prohibited and restricted areas.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约一方现行的一切有关法令规章,如入境、出境、海关、护照、移民、防止疾病传播、检疫、飞机检查等,都适应于在其领土内的缔约对方飞机及所载运的空勤人员、旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: B. All current laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to entry, exit, customs, passports, immigration, prevention of disease transmission, quarantine, and aircraft inspection shall apply to the aircraft of the other Contracting Party, as well as to their crew members, passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail while within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方在执行上述法令规章时,应避免造成不必要的班期上的延误。
Translation: When implementing the aforementioned laws and regulations, each contracting party shall avoid causing unnecessary flight schedule delays.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条甲、缔约一方应协助解决缔约对方指定空运企业为经营规定航线在本国领土内所需航空燃油、油料、润滑油的供应。
Translation: Article IX A. Each Contracting Party shall assist in the provision of aviation fuel, oils, and lubricants required within its territory by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the agreed services.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约一方无法协助解决缔约对方所需的航空燃油、油料、润滑油的供应,应准许缔约对方指定空运企业运入所需的航空燃油、油料、润滑油。
Translation: If one Contracting Party is unable to assist in the supply of aviation fuel, oil, and lubricants required by the other Contracting Party, it shall permit the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party to import the necessary aviation fuel, oil, and lubricants.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约双方应各在其机场内对缔约对方飞机、航空燃油、油料、润滑油、器材和其他财产采取对本国空运企业同样的警卫安全措施。
Translation: B. Each Contracting Party shall provide, at its airports, the same security measures for the aircraft, aviation fuel, oils, lubricants, equipment, and other property of the other Contracting Party as it does for its own air transport enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条甲、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行规定航线的飞机和留置在飞机上的航空燃油、油料、润滑油、备换零件、正常设备、航空供应品,包括该飞机在对方领土内所使用或消耗的在内,在进入或离开缔约对方领土时,应豁免关税、检验费或类似税收和费用。
Translation: Article 10A: Aircraft operated by the designated air transport enterprises of one Contracting Party on the specified routes, along with the aviation fuel, oils, lubricants, spare parts, regular equipment, and aviation supplies retained on board—including those used or consumed within the territory of the other Party—shall be exempt from customs duties, inspection fees, or similar taxes and charges upon entry into or departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 免税的物品,须经缔约对方海关当局批准方得卸下,卸下后应在海关当局的监督下予以保管,直至重新启运为止。
Translation: Duty-free items may only be unloaded with the approval of the customs authorities of the other contracting party and shall be kept under customs supervision until re-exportation.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约一方指定空运企业,或缔约一方指定空运企业的代表向缔约对方领土运入纯供该指定空运企业飞机自用的航空燃油、油料、润滑油、备换零件、正常设备、航空供应品,缔约对方应准许其运入,并根据平等互惠原则豁免关税、检验费或类似的税收和费用。
Translation: B. The designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party, or their representatives, shall be permitted to import into the territory of the other Contracting Party aviation fuels, lubricants, spare parts, regular equipment, and aircraft stores solely for the use of the aircraft of such designated airline(s). The other Contracting Party shall grant such importation and, on the basis of reciprocity, exempt them from customs duties, inspection fees, or other similar taxes and charges.

Query_Text_cn: 此项物品并应由海关监督直至重新运出为止。
Translation: This item shall remain under customs supervision until it is re-exported.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条缔约一方给予缔约对方指定空运企业以规定航线在其领土内的经停站派驻代表和工作人员的权利。
Translation: Article 11 Each Contracting Party shall grant the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party the right to station representatives and staff at the agreed stopping points within its territory along the specified air routes.

Query_Text_cn: 此项代表和工作人员除当地雇佣者外,应分别为各该方的公民,缔约一方对缔约对方空运企业所设的代表机构应给予协助和便利。
Translation: This provision stipulates that representatives and staff members, except for locally hired personnel, shall be citizens of the respective parties. Each contracting party shall provide assistance and facilities to the representative offices established by the air transport enterprises of the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约一方应允许缔约对方指定空运企业,将在缔约一方领土内的收支余额,按照汇出日生效的官方牌价结汇为英镑。
Translation: Article 12 Each Contracting Party shall permit the designated air transport enterprises of the other Contracting Party to convert and remit in sterling, at the official exchange rate effective on the date of remittance, the balance of receipts accruing in its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条缔约双方应促使双方民航当局和指定空运企业保持联系,并保证在遵守本协定的原则和履行本协定的条款方面保持密切的合作。
Translation:
Article 13  
The Contracting Parties shall encourage their respective civil aviation authorities and designated air carriers to maintain contact and ensure close cooperation in adhering to the principles and fulfilling the provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约一方民航当局应使其指定空运企业尽速提出用以向缔约对方民航当局证明其能正确履行本协定各项规定的资料。
Translation: Article 14 The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall require its designated airline(s) to promptly submit to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party the documentation necessary to demonstrate compliance with the provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方并应使其指定空运企业向缔约对方民航当局提供每月运往和来自缔约对方领土的业务统计,并列明业务的起讫点。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall also require its designated airline(s) to provide the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party with monthly traffic statistics showing the origin and destination of traffic transported to and from the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条缔约一方或缔约一方指定空运企业如不履行本协定的条款,缔约对方可以扣留或撤销该缔约一方指定空运企业行使本协定所规定的开航的权利。
Translation:
Article 15  
If a Contracting Party or its designated airline fails to comply with the provisions of this Agreement, the other Contracting Party may suspend or revoke the operating authorization granted to the designated airline of the former Party under this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 此项行动应经缔约双方磋商后才可以采取。
Translation: This action may only be taken after consultation between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条关于班次、运价、运输章程、缔约双方指定的空运企业相互代理业务和提供服务,由缔约双方指定空运企业另行协议。
Translation: Article 16 Matters concerning flight schedules, tariffs, transport regulations, mutual agency business and service provisions between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall be separately agreed upon by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条甲、缔约一方应负责对在其领土内遇险的缔约对方的飞机提供可资利用的技术设备和采取实际可行的搜寻和营救措施；同时应准许缔约对方在缔约一方主管当局的管制下,采取情况上所需要的援助措施。
Translation:
Article 17A  
Each Contracting Party shall be responsible for providing available technical equipment and taking practicable search and rescue measures for aircraft of the other Contracting Party in distress within its territory. It shall also permit the other Contracting Party, under the control of the competent authorities of the former, to undertake such assistance measures as the circumstances may require.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机如在缔约对方领土内失事,致有死亡、重伤或显示飞机有重大损坏时,缔约对方应按其规章着手调查失事情形。
Translation: B. In the event of an accident involving an aircraft of an airline designated by one Contracting Party resulting in death, serious injury, or significant damage to the aircraft within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall, in accordance with its regulations, initiate an investigation into the circumstances of the accident.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方有权指派观察员出席调查；负责调查失事一方应将调查报告和结果通知对方。
Translation: Either Contracting Party shall have the right to appoint observers to be present at the inquiry, and the Party conducting the inquiry shall communicate the report and findings to the other Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条缔约一方如认为本协定的条款需加修改,可以要求缔约对方进行磋商。
Translation: Article 18 If either Contracting Party considers it necessary to amend any provision of this Agreement, it may request consultations with the other Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此项磋商应在提出要求之日起六十天内开始,经磋商而达成协议的新条款或修改后的条款应即生效。
Translation: The consultation shall commence within 60 days from the date of request, and any new or amended terms agreed upon through such consultation shall take effect immediately.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条缔约双方间一切有关本协定的附件和换文应视为本协定的组成部分,所有对本协定的引用亦应包括附件和换文。
Translation: Article 19 All annexes and exchanges of notes related to this Agreement between the Contracting Parties shall be deemed integral parts of this Agreement. Any reference to this Agreement shall also include its annexes and exchanges of notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条缔约双方如对本协定和有关换文及附件的解释或引用发生任何争执,应本着友好和互相谅解的精神协商解决。
Translation: Article 20: In the event of any dispute between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement and related exchanges of notes and annexes, it shall be resolved through consultations in a spirit of friendship and mutual understanding.

Query_Text_cn: 此项协商应在提出要求后六十天内举行。
Translation: Such consultations shall be held within sixty days after the request is made.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条本协定的条款自签字之日起生效。
Translation: Article 21 The provisions of this Agreement shall enter into force on the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定生效十二个月后,如缔约任何一方愿终止本协定,可以书面通知缔约对方。
Translation: Either Contracting Party may terminate this Agreement by giving written notice to the other Party twelve months after its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约对方收到此项通知之日起十二个月后终止。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date on which the other contracting party receives such notice.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九六三年八月二十九日在卡拉奇签订,共两份,每份都用中文和英文写成,两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement is signed in Karachi on the twenty-ninth day of August 1963 in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 由中国的一点经过或不经过第三国至巴基斯坦的达卡或拉合尔和卡拉奇再至第三国。
Translation: From a point in China, via or without transiting through a third country, to Dhaka or Lahore and Karachi in Pakistan, and then onward to a third country.

Query_Text_cn: 由巴基斯坦的一点经过或不经过第三国至中国的广州和上海再至第三国。
Translation: From a point in Pakistan via or without transiting a third country to Guangzhou and Shanghai in China, then onward to a third country.

Query_Text_cn: 、上述航线中所称第三国必须经缔约双方协商同意。
Translation: The third country referred to in the above routes must be mutually agreed upon by both contracting parties through consultation.

Query_Text_cn: “中国-巴基斯坦投资区”是指设立在巴基斯坦境内，经巴基斯坦政府投资委员会通告的，被批准的中国投资者的投资不低于40％的特殊工业区。
Translation: The "China-Pakistan Investment Zone" refers to a special industrial zone established within Pakistan, officially notified by the Board of Investment of the Pakistani government, where the approved investment by Chinese investors accounts for no less than 40%.

Query_Text_cn: “尽管有第八条的规定，缔约双方应为包括海尔-鲁巴经济区在内的中国-巴基斯坦投资区的建立提供便利。
Translation: "Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 8, the Contracting Parties shall facilitate the establishment of the China-Pakistan Investment Zone, including the Haier-Ruba Economic Zone."

Query_Text_cn: 本着促进双方经济利益的原则，中国和巴基斯坦应考虑降低或消除在包括海尔-鲁巴经济区在内的中国-巴基斯坦投资区生产的货物以及双方有出口兴趣的其他货物的关税。
Translation: In line with the principle of promoting mutual economic benefits, China and Pakistan should consider reducing or eliminating tariffs on goods produced in China-Pakistan investment zones, including the Haier-Ruba Economic Zone, as well as other goods of export interest to both sides.

Query_Text_cn: 关税减让或消除应是中国-巴基斯坦自由贸易协定附件一关税减让表的一部分。
Translation: Tariff reductions or eliminations should form part of the Annex I Tariff Schedule of the China-Pakistan Free Trade Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: “第五十六条（一）中国-巴基斯坦投资区一揽子优惠政策。
Translation: "Article 56 (1) The China-Pakistan Investment Zone Package of Preferential Policies."

Query_Text_cn: 为中国-巴基斯坦投资区的发展和区内投资者的利益，巴基斯坦应提供本补充议定书附件所列的一揽子优惠政策。
Translation: To promote the development of the China-Pakistan Investment Zone and safeguard the interests of investors within the zone, Pakistan shall provide the package of preferential policies listed in the annex to this supplementary protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本补充议定书应成为自由贸易协定的组成部分。
Translation: II. This Supplementary Protocol shall form an integral part of the Free Trade Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本补充议定书应根据自由贸易协定第七十九条和第八十一条的规定生效。
Translation: III. This Supplementary Protocol shall enter into force in accordance with the provisions of Article 79 and Article 81 of the Free Trade Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表经各自政府正式授权签署本补充议定书，以昭信守。本补充议定书于二零零八年十月十五日在北京签订，一式两份，每份均用中文和英文写成，两种文本同等作准。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, being duly authorized by their respective Governments, have signed this Supplementary Protocol in witness whereof. Done at Beijing on the fifteenth day of October two thousand and eight in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 1．免除经济区建设及工程项目所需资本设备（厂房、机器、设备和零部件）的进口海关关税和税收。
Translation: 1. Exempt imported capital equipment (including plants, machinery, equipment, and components) required for economic zone construction and engineering projects from customs duties and taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 2．经济区内项目自运营之日起5年内免征公司所得税。
Translation: 2. Projects within the economic zone shall be exempt from corporate income tax for five years from the date of commencement of operations.

Query_Text_cn: 本优惠亦应适用于经济区开发商。
Translation: This preferential treatment shall also apply to developers in the economic zone.

Query_Text_cn: 3．巴基斯坦国内其他地方享受的出口优惠政策也同样适用于经济区内生产的出口产品。
Translation: 3. Export incentives available elsewhere in Pakistan shall also be applicable to export products manufactured within the economic zones.

Query_Text_cn: 4．巴基斯坦联邦政府／机构将在经济区新址提供气、电和其他公用设施。
Translation: 4. The Federal Government/agencies of Pakistan will provide gas, electricity, and other utilities at the new site of the economic zone.

Query_Text_cn: 允许经济区开发商自备发电。
Translation: Economic zone developers are permitted to operate their own power generation facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 5．巴基斯坦省级政府负责修建通往经济区新址的道路。
Translation: 5. Provincial governments in Pakistan are responsible for constructing roads leading to new economic zones.

Query_Text_cn: 6．巴基斯坦投资委员会将在经济区内提供一站式服务。
Translation: 6. The Board of Investment in Pakistan will provide one-stop services within the economic zones.

Query_Text_cn: 7．为投资者在经济区提供上门服务，以完成所需的程序／手续。
Translation: 7. Provide door-to-door services for investors in the economic zone to complete the required procedures/formalities.

Query_Text_cn: 8．巴基斯坦投资委员会将为投资者提供免费的便利服务和指导。
Translation: 8. The Board of Investment of Pakistan will provide investors with free facilitation services and guidance.

Query_Text_cn: 9．在经济区内设立员工培训中心。
Translation: 9. Establish employee training centers within the economic zone.

Query_Text_cn: 10．在经济区内，只有中资比例达40％以上的项目或合资企业才能享受一揽子优惠政策。
Translation: 10. Within the economic zone, only projects or joint ventures with a Chinese capital ratio of at least 40% are eligible for the full package of preferential policies.

Query_Text_cn: 11．在经济区内建设干港为区内企业进出口提供便利。
Translation: 11. The construction of dry ports in the economic zone provides convenience for import and export activities of enterprises within the zone.

Query_Text_cn: 12．巴基斯坦省级政府将为海尔-鲁巴集团购买土地提供便利。
Translation: 12. The provincial government of Pakistan will facilitate land acquisition for the Haier-Ruba Group.

Query_Text_cn: 五、"蓄意破坏”系指针对核设施或使用、贮存或运输中的核材料采取的任何有预谋的行为，这种行为可通过辐射照射或放射性物质释放直接或间接危及工作人员和公众的健康与安全或危及环境。
Translation: V. "Sabotage" means any deliberate act directed against a nuclear facility or nuclear material in use, storage or transport which could directly or indirectly endanger the health and safety of personnel or the public or the environment through exposure to radiation or release of radioactive substances.

Query_Text_cn: 第一（一）条本公约的目的是在世界各地实现和维护对用于和平目的的核材料和核设施的有效实物保护，在世界各地预防和打击涉及这类材料和设施的犯罪以及为缔约国实现上述目的开展的合作提供便利。
Translation:
Article 1  
The purpose of this Convention is to achieve and maintain effective physical protection of nuclear material and nuclear facilities used for peaceful purposes worldwide, to prevent and combat crimes involving such material and facilities, and to facilitate cooperation among States Parties in achieving these objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约应适用于使用、贮存和运输中用于和平目的的核材料和用于和平目的的核设施，但本公约第三条和第四条以及第五条第四款应仅适用于国际核运输中的此种核材料。
Translation: 1. This Convention shall apply to nuclear material used for peaceful purposes while in use, storage or transport and to nuclear facilities used for peaceful purposes; provided, however, that Articles III and IV and paragraph 4 of Article V shall apply only to such nuclear material while in international nuclear transport.

Query_Text_cn: 二、一缔约国建立、实施和维护实物保护制度的责任完全在于该国。
Translation: II. The responsibility for establishing, implementing, and maintaining a physical protection system within a State Party rests entirely with that State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、除缔约国依照本公约所明确作出的承诺外，本公约的任何条款均不得被解释为影响一国的主权权利。
Translation: III. No provision of this Convention shall be interpreted as affecting the sovereign rights of a State, except for the commitments explicitly made by the Contracting States in accordance with this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 四、（一）本公约的任何条款均不影响国际法规定的，特别是《联合国宪章》的宗旨和原则以及国际人道主义法规定的缔约国的其他权利、义务和责任。
Translation: IV. (1) Nothing in this Convention shall affect the rights, obligations and responsibilities of States Parties under international law, in particular the purposes and principles of the Charter of the United Nations and international humanitarian law.

Query_Text_cn: （二）武装冲突中武装部队的活动（用语按照国际人道主义法理解）由国际人道主义法予以规定，不受本公约管辖；一国军事部队为执行公务而进行的活动由国际法其他规则予以规定，因此不受本公约管辖。
Translation: (2) The activities of armed forces during an armed conflict (as those terms are understood under international humanitarian law) are governed by international humanitarian law and do not fall within the scope of this Convention. Similarly, the activities undertaken by the military forces of a State in the exercise of their official duties are regulated by other rules of international law and are therefore not covered by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （三）本公约的任何条款均不得被解释为是对用于和平目的的核材料或核设施使用或威胁使用武力的合法授权。
Translation: (3) No provision of this Convention shall be interpreted as authorizing the lawful use or threat of force against nuclear material or nuclear facilities used for peaceful purposes.

Query_Text_cn: （四）本公约的任何条款均不宽恕不合法行为或使不合法行为合法化，或禁止根据其他法律提出起诉。
Translation: (4) Nothing in this Convention shall exonerate any illegal act or make it lawful, nor preclude prosecution under other laws.

Query_Text_cn: 五、本公约不适用于为军事目的使用或保存的核材料或含有此种材料的核设施。
Translation: V. This Convention shall not apply to nuclear material or nuclear facilities containing such material used or retained for military purposes.

Query_Text_cn: （四）减轻或尽量减少破坏所造成的放射性后果。
Translation: (4) Mitigate or minimize the radiological consequences of damage.

Query_Text_cn: （三）采取对核材料和核设施实物保护必要的其他适当措施。
Translation: (3) Adopt other appropriate measures necessary for the physical protection of nuclear materials and nuclear facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在履行第一款和第二款所规定的义务时，每一缔约国应在不妨碍本公约任何其他条款的情况下，在合理和切实可行的范围内适用以下"核材料和核设施实物保护的基本原则”。
Translation: III. In fulfilling the obligations under paragraphs 1 and 2, each State Party shall apply, without prejudice to any other provisions of this Convention and within the bounds of what is reasonable and practicable, the following "Fundamental Principles of Physical Protection of Nuclear Material and Nuclear Facilities."

Query_Text_cn: 国家责任一国建立、实施和维护实物保护制度的责任完全在于该国。
Translation:
National Responsibility  
The responsibility for establishing, implementing, and maintaining a physical protection system rests entirely with the state.

Query_Text_cn: 国际运输中的责任一国确保核材料受到充分保护的责任延伸到核材料的国际运输，直至酌情将该责任适当移交给另一国。
Translation: The responsibility of a state to ensure adequate protection of nuclear material extends to international transport, until such time as the responsibility is properly transferred to another state, as appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 法律和监管框架国家负责建立和维护管理实物保护的法律和监管框架。
Translation: The state is responsible for establishing and maintaining the legal and regulatory framework governing physical protection.

Query_Text_cn: 该框架应规定建立适用的实物保护要求，并应包括评估和许可证审批或其他授权程序的系统。
Translation: The framework shall establish applicable physical protection requirements and incorporate a system for evaluation and licensing or other authorization procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 该框架应包括对核设施和运输的视察系统，以核实适用要求和对许可证或其他授权文件的条件的遵守情况，并确立加强适用要求和条件的手段，包括有效的制裁措施。
Translation: The framework shall include a system of inspection for nuclear facilities and transport to verify compliance with applicable requirements and the conditions of licenses or other authorizing documents, as well as establish measures to strengthen such requirements and conditions, including effective sanctions.

Query_Text_cn: 主管部门国家应设立或指定负责实施法律和监管框架的主管部门，并赋予充分的权力、权限和财政及人力资源，以履行其所担负的责任。
Translation: The competent national authority shall establish or designate a responsible regulatory body with adequate powers,authority,and financial and human resources to fulfill its assigned responsibilities under the legal and regulatory framework.

Query_Text_cn: 国家应采取步骤确保国家主管部门与负责促进或利用核能的任何其他机构之间在职能方面的有效独立性。
Translation: The State shall take steps to ensure the effective independence in functions between the national competent authority and any other body responsible for promoting or utilizing nuclear energy.

Query_Text_cn: 许可证持有者的责任应当明确规定在一国境内实施实物保护各组成部分的责任。
Translation: The responsibilities of license holders shall be clearly defined regarding the implementation of physical protection components within a country's territory.

Query_Text_cn: 国家应确保实施核材料或核设施实物保护的主要责任在于相关许可证持有者或其他授权文件的持有者（如营运者或承运者）。
Translation: The state shall ensure that the primary responsibility for implementing physical protection of nuclear material or nuclear facilities rests with the relevant license holders or holders of other authorized documents (such as operators or carriers).

Query_Text_cn: 安全保卫文化所有参与实施实物保护的组织应对必要的安全保卫文化及其发展和保持给予适当优先地位，以确保在整个组织中有效地实施实物保护。
Translation: All organizations involved in implementing physical protection should accord appropriate priority to the necessary security culture, its development, and maintenance to ensure the effective implementation of physical protection throughout the organization.

Query_Text_cn: 威胁国家的实物保护应基于该国当前对威胁的评估。
Translation: The physical protection of a state against threats should be based on its current assessment of those threats.

Query_Text_cn: 分级方案实物保护要求应以分级方案为基础，并考虑当前对威胁的评估、材料的相对吸引力和性质以及与擅自转移核材料和破坏核材料或核设施有关的潜在后果。
Translation: The physical protection requirements of the graded approach shall be based on this approach and take into account current assessments of the threat, the relative attractiveness and nature of the material, and the potential consequences associated with the unauthorized removal of nuclear material or sabotage of nuclear material or nuclear facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 纵深防御国家对实物保护的要求应反映结构上的或其他技术、人事和组织方面的多层保护和保护措施的概念，敌方要想实现其目的必须克服或绕过这些保护层和保护措施。
Translation: The national requirements for physical protection should reflect the concept of in-depth defense,which entails multiple layers of structural,technical,personnel,and organizational protection and safeguards that adversaries must overcome or circumvent to achieve their objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 质量保证应当制定和实施质量保证政策和质量保证大纲，以确信对实物保护有重要意义的所有活动的特定要求都得到满足。
Translation: Quality assurance policies and programs shall be established and implemented to ensure that all specified requirements for activities significant to physical protection are met.

Query_Text_cn: 意外情况计划所有许可证持有者和有关当局应制定并适当执行应对擅自转移核材料、蓄意破坏核设施或核材料或此类意图的意外情况（应急）计划。
Translation: All licensees and relevant authorities shall develop and duly implement contingency (emergency) plans to address unauthorized removal of nuclear material, sabotage of nuclear facilities or nuclear material, or such attempts.

Query_Text_cn: 保密问题国家应就那些若被擅自泄露则可能损害核材料和核设施实物保护的资料制定保密要求。
Translation: States shall establish confidentiality requirements for information the unauthorized disclosure of which could compromise the physical protection of nuclear materials and facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、（一）本条的规定不适用于缔约国根据核材料的性质、数量和相对吸引力以及与任何针对核材料的未经许可行为有关的潜在放射性后果和其他后果以及目前根据对核材料威胁的评估而合理地确定无需接受依照第一款建立的实物保护制度约束的任何核材料。
Translation: IV. (1) The provisions of this Article shall not apply to any nuclear material which a State Party reasonably determines, based on its nature, quantity, relative attractiveness, potential radiological and other consequences associated with any unauthorized act involving such material, and current threat assessments regarding nuclear materials, does not require application of the physical protection regime established under paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: （二）应当按照谨慎的管理实践保护根据第（一）项不受本条规定约束的核材料。
Translation: (ii) Nuclear materials exempted under subparagraph (i) shall be protected in accordance with prudent management practices.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国应彼此直接或经由国际原子能机构指明并公开其与本公约事项有关的联络点。
Translation: 1. States Parties shall designate and make known to each other, either directly or through the International Atomic Energy Agency, their points of contact regarding matters pertaining to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国在核材料被偷窃、抢劫或通过任何其他非法方式获取或受到此种威胁时，应依照其国内法尽最大可能向任何提出请求的国家提供合作和协助，以追回和保护这种材料。
Translation: II. Each State Party shall, in accordance with its national law, provide as far as possible cooperation and assistance to any requesting State in the recovery and protection of nuclear material that has been stolen, robbed, or otherwise unlawfully obtained or is under such threat.

Query_Text_cn: 3.确保归还已追回的因上述事件被盗或丢失的核材料。
Translation: 3. Ensure the return of all recovered nuclear materials that were stolen or lost due to the aforementioned incident.

Query_Text_cn: 执行这种合作的方法应由各有关缔约国决定。
Translation: The method of implementing such cooperation shall be determined by the respective Contracting States concerned.

Query_Text_cn: （四）根据第（一）项至第（三）项进行合作的协调应通过外交或其他商定途径进行。
Translation: (4) Coordination of cooperation under items (1) to (3) shall be conducted through diplomatic or other agreed channels.

Query_Text_cn: 执行这种合作的方法应由有关缔约国在双边或多边的基础上决定。
Translation: The method of implementing such cooperation shall be determined by the States Parties concerned on a bilateral or multilateral basis.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国应酌情彼此直接或经由国际原子能机构和其他相关国际组织进行合作和磋商，以期获得对国际运输中核材料实物保护系统的设计、维护和改进方面的指导。
Translation: 4. States Parties shall, as appropriate, cooperate and consult directly or through the International Atomic Energy Agency and other relevant international organizations to obtain guidance on the design, maintenance, and improvement of physical protection systems for nuclear material in international transport.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约国可酌情与其他缔约国直接或经由国际原子能机构和其他相关国际组织进行磋商和合作，以期获得对国内使用、贮存和运输中的核材料和核设施的国家实物保护系统的设计、维护和改进方面的指导。
Translation: 5. States Parties may, as appropriate, consult and cooperate directly with other States Parties or through the International Atomic Energy Agency and other relevant international organizations to obtain guidance on the design, maintenance, and improvement of national physical protection systems for nuclear material and facilities in domestic use, storage, and transport.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国应采取符合其国内法的适当措施，以保护由于本公约的规定而从另一缔约国得到的，或通过参与为执行本公约而开展的活动而得到的任何保密信息的机密性。
Translation: 1. Each State Party shall adopt appropriate measures in accordance with its domestic law to protect the confidentiality of any confidential information obtained from another State Party pursuant to the provisions of this Convention, or acquired through participation in activities carried out for the implementation of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果缔约国向国际组织或本公约非缔约国提供保密信息，则应采取步骤确保此种信息的机密性得到保护。
Translation: If a State Party provides confidential information to an international organization or a non-State Party to this Convention,it shall take steps to ensure the protection of the confidentiality of such information.

Query_Text_cn: 从另一缔约国获得保密信息的缔约国只有得到前者同意后才能向第三方提供该信息。
Translation: A Contracting State that obtains confidential information from another Contracting State may provide such information to a third party only with the consent of the former.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约不应要求缔约国提供国内法规定不得传播的任何信息或可能危及本国安全或核材料或核设施的实物保护的任何信息。
Translation: II. This Convention shall not require a State Party to provide any information the dissemination of which is prohibited by its national law or any information that might jeopardize the security of the State or the physical protection of nuclear material or nuclear facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 2.明知该群体有意实施第（一）项至第（七）项所述违法犯罪行为。
Translation: 2. Being aware that the group intends to commit the criminal acts specified in items (1) through (7).

Query_Text_cn: 第十一（一）条为了引渡或相互司法协助的目的，第七条所述任何违法犯罪行为不得视为政治罪行、同政治罪行有关的罪行或由于政治动机引起的罪行。
Translation: Article 11(1) For the purpose of extradition or mutual legal assistance, none of the offenses set forth in Article 7 shall be regarded as a political offense, an offense connected with a political offense, or an offense inspired by political motives.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，就此种罪行提出的引渡或相互司法协助的请求，不可只以其涉及政治罪行、同政治罪行有关的罪行或由于政治动机引起的罪行为由而加以拒绝。
Translation: Therefore, requests for extradition or mutual legal assistance concerning such offenses shall not be refused solely on the grounds that they relate to political offenses, offenses connected with political offenses, or offenses inspired by political motives.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一（二）条如果被请求的缔约国有实质理由认为，请求为第七条所述违法犯罪行为进行引渡或请求为此种违法犯罪行为提供相互司法协助的目的，是为了基于某人的种族、宗教、国籍、族裔或政治观点而对该人进行起诉或惩罚，或认为接受这一请求将使该人的情况因任何上述理由受到损害，则本公约的任何条款均不应被解释为规定该国有引渡或提供相互司法协助的义务。
Translation:
Article 11(2)  
No provision of this Convention shall be interpreted as imposing an obligation to extradite or to provide mutual legal assistance if the requested Party has substantial grounds to believe that the request for extradition for offences set forth in Article 7 or for mutual legal assistance with respect to such offences has been made for the purpose of prosecuting or punishing a person on account of that person's race, religion, nationality, ethnic origin or political opinions, or that compliance with the request would cause prejudice to that person's position for any of these reasons.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三（一）条本公约的任何条款均不影响旨在加强核材料和核设施实物保护为和平目的进行的核技术转让。
Translation:
Article 13(1)  
No provision of this Convention shall be interpreted as affecting the transfer of nuclear technology for peaceful purposes that is undertaken to strengthen the physical protection of nuclear material and nuclear facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如果违法犯罪行为涉及在国内使用、贮存或运输中的核材料，而且被指控的违法犯罪嫌疑人和所涉核材料均仍在违法犯罪行为实施地的缔约国境内，或违法犯罪行为涉及核设施而且被指控的违法犯罪嫌疑人仍在违法犯罪行为实施地的缔约国境内，则本公约的任何条款均不应被解释为要求该缔约国提供有关因此种违法犯罪行为而提起刑事诉讼的信息。
Translation: III. If the offence involves nuclear material used, stored or transported within the territory of a State Party, and both the alleged offender and the nuclear material remain in the territory of the State Party where the offence was committed, or if the offence involves a nuclear facility and the alleged offender remains in the territory of the State Party where the offence was committed, no provision of this Convention shall be interpreted as requiring that State Party to provide information concerning criminal proceedings arising out of such an offence.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在2005年7月8日通过的修订案生效五年后，保存人应召开缔约国会议审查本公约的执行情况，并根据当时的普遍情况审查公约的序言、整个执行部分和附件是否仍然适当。
Translation: I. Five years after the entry into force of the amendment adopted on 8 July 2005, the Depositary shall convene a meeting of the States Parties to review the implementation of this Convention and to assess the continuing appropriateness of its preamble, the entire operative part and the annex in light of prevailing circumstances at that time.

Query_Text_cn: 2.自此以后,每隔至少5年,如大多数缔约国向保管人提出召开另一次同样目标会议的提案,得召开此种会议。
Translation: 2. Thereafter, at intervals of not less than five years, a further conference with the same objectives may be convened if a majority of the Contracting Parties so propose to the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: b/未在反应堆中辐照过的材料，或虽在反应堆中辐照过，但在无屏蔽1米距离处的辐射水平等于或小于1戈瑞／小时（100拉德／小时）的材料。
Translation: b. Materials that have not been irradiated in a reactor, or those that have been irradiated but exhibit a radiation level of 1 Gy/hour (100 rad/hour) or less at an unshielded distance of 1 meter.

Query_Text_cn: e/在辐照前根据其原始易裂变材料含量被列为一类和二类的其他燃料，虽在无屏蔽1米距离处的辐射水平超过1戈瑞／小时（100拉德／小时），但仍可降低一级。
Translation: Other fuel categorized as category I or II prior to irradiation based on its original fissile material content may be downgraded by one category, even if the radiation level at an unshielded distance of 1 meter exceeds 1 Gy/h (100 rad/h).

Query_Text_cn: 国际货币基金协定（1944年7月22日在布雷顿森林召开的联合国货币金融会议通过，1945年12月27日生效。1968年5月31日在经理事会第23—5号决议同意修改，自1969年7月28日生效。经1976年4月30日理事会第31—4号决议同意修改，自1978年4月1日起生效。
Translation: The Articles of Agreement of the International Monetary Fund (Adopted at the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference held in Bretton Woods on July 22, 1944, and entered into force on December 27, 1945. Amended by the Board of Governors Resolution No. 23-5 on May 31, 1968, effective as of July 28, 1969. Further amended by the Board of Governors Resolution No. 31-4 on April 30, 1976, effective as of April 1, 1978.)

Query_Text_cn: 一、国际货币基金组织根据原通过的本协定的规定及以后经修改的规定建立并开展业务活动。
Translation: I. The International Monetary Fund is established and shall operate in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement as originally adopted and subsequently amended.

Query_Text_cn: 二、为使基金进行业务与活动，在基金内分设普通帐户与特别提款权帐户。基金会员国有权参与特别提款权帐户。
Translation: II. To facilitate the operations and activities of the Fund, General and Special Drawing Rights Accounts shall be established within the Fund. Member countries of the Fund shall have the right to participate in the Special Drawing Rights Account.

Query_Text_cn: 三、除涉及特别提款权的业务活动应通过特别提款权帐户外，本协定所规定的业务与活动均应通过普通帐户办理，按本协定规定，普通帐户包含普通资金帐户，特别支付帐户和投资帐户。
Translation: III. Except for transactions involving Special Drawing Rights, which shall be conducted through the Special Drawing Rights Department, all operations and transactions authorized by this Agreement shall be conducted through the General Account. The General Account shall include the General Resources Account, the Special Disbursement Account, and the Investment Account as provided in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、通过设置一常设机构，便于国际货币问题的商讨与协作，以促进国际货币合作。
Translation: 1. Establishing a permanent institution to facilitate consultation and collaboration on international monetary issues, thereby promoting international monetary cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、便利国际贸易的扩大与平衡发展，以促进和维持高水平的就业和实际收入，以及所有会员国生产资源的发展，作为经济政策的首要目标。
Translation: 2. To facilitate the expansion and balanced growth of international trade, thereby promoting and maintaining high levels of employment and real income, as well as the development of productive resources in all member countries, as primary objectives of economic policy.

Query_Text_cn: 三、促进汇价的稳定，维持会员国间有秩序的外汇安排，并避免竞争性的外汇贬值。
Translation: III. To promote exchange rate stability, maintain orderly exchange arrangements among member countries, and avoid competitive currency devaluation.

Query_Text_cn: 四、协助建立会员国间经常性交易的多边支付制度，并消除妨碍世界贸易发展的外汇管制。
Translation: IV. To assist in the establishment of a multilateral system of payments in respect of current transactions between members and in the elimination of foreign exchange restrictions which hamper the growth of world trade.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在充分保障下，以基金的资金暂时供给会员国，使有信心利用此机会调整其国际收支的不平衡，而不致采取有害于本国的或国际的繁荣的措施。
Translation: V. To give confidence to members by making the Fund's resources temporarily available to them under adequate safeguards, thus providing them with opportunity to correct maladjustments in their balance of payments without resorting to measures destructive of national or international prosperity.

Query_Text_cn: 六、依据以上目标，缩短会员国国际收支不平衡的时间，并减轻其程度。基金的一切政策与决定，均应以本条所列宗旨为原则。
Translation: VI. In accordance with the above objectives, to shorten the duration and lessen the degree of disequilibrium in the international balances of payments of members. The policies and decisions of the Fund shall be guided by the purposes set forth in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节创造会员国凡参加联合国货币和金融会议的国家，其政府在１９４５年１２月３１日前接受会员席位的，皆为创始会员国。
Translation:
Section 1 Original Members  
All states which participated in the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference and whose governments accept membership by December 31, 1945, shall be original members.

Query_Text_cn: 第二节其他会员国其他国家的政府，依照基金理事会规定的日期和条件，这些条件包括认缴的条件，应依据适用于其他现有会员国的相同原则为基础。
Translation:
Section 2 Other Members  
The governments of other countries, on dates and terms prescribed by the Board of Governors, including terms relating to subscriptions, shall be admitted as members in accordance with the same principles applicable to other existing members.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节份额和认缴的支付对每一会员国将分配以特别提款权表示的份额。凡出席联合国货币和金融会议，在１９４５年１２月３１日前加入基金的会员国，其缴纳基金份额列于附录一。其它会员国的份额，由基金理事会决定。每一会员国的认缴额应等于其份额，并在适当的存款机构全部缴付给基金。
Translation:
Section 1. Quotas and Payment of Subscriptions  

Each member shall be assigned a quota expressed in special drawing rights. The quotas of members that attended the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference and joined the Fund before December 31, 1945, are set forth in Appendix I. The quotas of other members shall be determined by the Board of Governors of the Fund. Each member's subscription shall be equal to its quota and shall be paid in full to the Fund at the appropriate depository institution.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金应每隔一定时期（不超过五年）进行一次总检查，并在认为必要时，得提出调整会员国之份额。根据某一会员国的要求，基金如认为合适，也在任何其它时候考虑单独调整该国之份额。
Translation: 1. The Fund shall at intervals of not more than five years conduct a general review of quotas and, if it deems it appropriate, propose adjustments to the quotas of members. At the request of a member, the Fund shall also consider at any other time a proposal for an adjustment of that member's quota if it considers such action appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 二、基金可在任何时候提议给那些１９７５年８月３１日已是会员的国家，按照该日它们份额比例增加份额，累计数额不超过依第五条第十二节第六、九和十款从特别支付帐户转到普通资金帐户的金额。
Translation: 2. The Fund may at any time propose to those members that were members on August 31, 1975, increases in their quotas in proportion to their quotas on that date, provided that the cumulative increases do not exceed the amounts transferred from the Special Disbursement Account to the General Resources Account pursuant to Article V, Section 12(f), (i), and (j).

Query_Text_cn: 三、份额的任何变更，需经８５％的多数票通过。
Translation: 3. Any change in quotas shall require an 85 percent majority of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 四、未经会员国的同意，并出支付（除非依据本条第三节第二款可视作业已支付）不得改变该会员国的份额。
Translation: 4. No change shall be made in the quota of any member without its consent and payment (unless payment is deemed to have been made under Section 3(b) of this Article).

Query_Text_cn: 一、任何依本条第二节第一款同意增加其份额的会员国，应在基金规定的期限内以特别提款权支付增加部分中的２５％，但理事会可以规定，对所有会员国一样，也可全部或部分地用基金指定的其它会员国货币（经该会员国同意）或会员国本国货币支付。未参加特别提款权帐户的会员国应用基金指定的其它会员国货币（经该会员国同意）支付所增加份额中的一定比例（相当于参与国以特别提款权支付的比例），所增加份额的其余部分以会员国本国货币支付。基金所持有的一会员国货币，不能因此项规定下其它会员国的支付而超过依第五条第八节第二款第（二）项而须支付手续费的水平。
Translation: I. Any member country that agrees to increase its quota under Section 2(a) of this Article shall pay 25% of the increase in Special Drawing Rights within the period specified by the Fund, provided that the Board of Governors may prescribe that this payment may be made, uniformly for all member countries, in whole or in part in the currencies of other member countries designated by the Fund (with their consent) or in the member's own currency. A member country not participating in the Special Drawing Rights Account shall pay a portion of the increase (equivalent to the proportion paid by participating members in Special Drawing Rights) in the currencies of other member countries designated by the Fund (with their consent), with the remainder of the increased quota paid in the member's own currency. The Fund's holdings of a member's currency shall not, as a result of payments by other member countries under this provision, exceed the level at which charges would be payable under Article V, Section 8(b)(ii).

Query_Text_cn: 二、依本条第二节第二款同意增加其份额的各会员国，应被视作已向基金支付相当于其增加部分的认缴额。
Translation: II. Each member country that has consented to an increase in its quota under Section 2 of this Article shall be deemed to have paid to the Fund an amount equivalent to such increase.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如会员国同意减少其份额，基金应在６０天内将减少的部分退回该国。基金将以会员国的货币，一定数量的特别提款权或基金指定的其它会员国货币（经该会员国同意）支付，须避免基金持有的货币减少到新份额以下，但在特殊情况下，基金可以向该会员国支付其本国货币从而使基金持有的货币减少到新的份额以下。
Translation: 3. If a member agrees to a reduction of its quota, the Fund shall, within sixty days, pay to the member an amount equal to the reduction. The payment shall be made in the member’s currency, in special drawing rights, or in the currencies of other members specified by the Fund with their concurrence, provided that the Fund’s holdings of the member’s currency are not thereby reduced below the new quota. In exceptional circumstances, however, the Fund may make the payment in the member’s own currency, thereby reducing the Fund’s holdings of that currency below the new quota.

Query_Text_cn: 四、依上述第一款所作的任何决定，除有关期限和所有货币的规定外，需要总投票权的７０％的多数票通过。
Translation: 4. Any decision taken under paragraph 1 of this Article, except as otherwise specified therein, shall require a majority of 70 percent of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节用证券替代货币的办法基金如对于一会员国所应缴于普通资金帐户的本国货币的任何部分认为在业务上不需要时，应该受该会员国或其依照第十三条第二节所指定的存款机构发行的证券或同类负债凭证作为替代。此项证券应不能转让，无利息，按票面见票即付，在指定存款机构收入基金帐户内。此节不仅适用于会员国认缴的货币，而且对任何负欠基金的货币，或基金所获得之货币亦均适用，并应存入普通资金帐户。
Translation:
Section 4. Substitution of Securities for Currency  

Whenever the Fund deems any portion of a member’s currency held in the General Resources Account unnecessary for its operations, the Fund shall accept from the member, or from the depository designated by the member under Section 2 of Article XIII, securities or similar obligations denominated in the member’s currency in substitution for such currency. Such securities or obligations shall be non-negotiable, non-interest-bearing, and payable at their face value on demand by crediting the Fund’s account with the designated depository. This Section shall apply not only to currency subscribed by members but also to any currency due to the Fund or otherwise acquired by it, and such currency shall be held in the General Resources Account.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节会员国的一般义务鉴于国际货币制度的主要目的是提供一个便利国与国之间商品、劳务和资本的交流和保持经济健康增长的体制，鉴于主要目标是继续发展保持金融和经济稳定所必要的有秩序的基本条件，各会员国保证同基金和其它会员国进行合作，以保证有秩序的外汇安排，并促进一个稳定的汇率制度。
Translation:
Section 1 General Obligations of Members  
Recognizing that the essential purpose of the international monetary system is to provide a framework that facilitates the exchange of goods, services, and capital among countries and sustains sound economic growth, and that its principal objective is the continued development of the orderly underlying conditions necessary for financial and economic stability, each member undertakes to collaborate with the Fund and other members to ensure orderly exchange arrangements and to promote a stable system of exchange rates.

Query_Text_cn: （四）奉行同本节所规定的保证不相矛盾的外汇政策。
Translation: (iv) Pursuing foreign exchange policies that are not inconsistent with the guarantees set forth in this section.

Query_Text_cn: 一、各会员国应在本协定第二次修改日之后３０天内把它在履行本条第一节规定的义务方面打算采用的外汇安排通知基金，在外汇安排方面如有任何改变应及时通知基金。
Translation: 1. Each member shall notify the Fund, within thirty days after the date of the second amendment of this Agreement, of the exchange arrangements it intends to apply in fulfillment of its obligations under Section 1 of this Article, and shall notify the Fund promptly of any changes in its exchange arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: （三）会员国选择的其它外汇安排。
Translation: (c) Other exchange arrangements chosen by member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 三、为适应国际货币制度的发展，基金可以总投票权８５％的多数规定总的外汇安排，不限制各会员国根据基金的目的和本条第一节规定的义务选择外汇安排的权利。
Translation: III. To adapt to the evolution of the international monetary system, the Fund may, by an eighty-five percent majority of the total voting power, prescribe general exchange arrangements without restricting the right of members to choose their exchange arrangements in accordance with the purposes of the Fund and the obligations set forth in Section 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金应监督国际货币制度，以保证其有效实行，应监督各会员国是否遵守本条第一节规定的义务。
Translation: 1. The Fund shall oversee the international monetary system to ensure its effective operation and shall monitor the compliance of member countries with the obligations set forth in Section 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 二、为了履行上述第一款规定的职能，基金应对各会员国的汇率政策行使严密的监督，并应制定具体原则，以在汇率政策上指导所有会员国。各会员国应该向基金提供为进行这种监督所必要的资料，在基金提出要求时，应就会员国的汇率政策问题同基金进行磋商。基金制定的原则应该符合各会员国用以确定本国货币对其他会员国货币比价的合作安排，并符合一个会员国根据基金的目的和本条第一节规定选择的其它外汇安排。这些原则应该尊重各会员国国内的社会和政治政策，在执行这些原则时，基金应该对各会员国的境况给予应有的注意。
Translation: II. In order to fulfill the functions specified in Section 1 of this Article, the Fund shall exercise firm surveillance over the exchange rate policies of member countries and shall adopt specific principles for the guidance of all members with respect to those policies. Each member shall provide the Fund with the information necessary for such surveillance, and, when requested by the Fund, shall consult with it on the member's exchange rate policies. The principles adopted by the Fund shall be consistent with cooperative arrangements by which members maintain the exchange rates of their currencies in relation to the currencies of other members, as well as with other exchange arrangements of a member's choice consistent with the purposes of the Fund and Section 1 of this Article. These principles shall respect the domestic social and political policies of members, and in applying these principles the Fund shall pay due regard to the circumstances of members.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节平价在国际经济条件允许的情况下，基金得以总投票权８５％的多数票作出决定，实行一个在稳定但可调整的平价的基础上普遍的外汇安排制度。基金应在世界经济基本稳定的基础上作出决定，并为此目的应考虑价格变动和会员国的经济增长率。这项决定应根据国际货币制度的演变，特别是要考虑流动资金的来源，而且为了保证平价制度的有效实施，还要考虑使国际收支顺差国和逆差国都能采取迅速、有效和对称的调整行动的安排，以及对国际收支不平衡的干预和处理的安排。在作此决定时，基金应通知会员国附录的规定。
Translation:
Section 4. Par Values  

The Fund may, by an eighty-five percent majority of the total voting power, decide to establish a general system of exchange arrangements based on stable but adjustable par values, provided that the international economic conditions permit. The Fund shall make this determination on the basis of underlying stability in the world economy, taking into account price movements and the growth rates of member countries. Such a decision shall be made in light of the evolution of the international monetary system, with particular regard to sources of liquidity, and shall ensure the effective operation of the par value system by considering arrangements that enable both surplus and deficit countries to take prompt, effective, and symmetrical adjustment actions, as well as arrangements for the intervention in and management of balance of payments imbalances. In making this decision, the Fund shall notify member countries of the provisions of the Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 一、会员国根据本条对本国货币采取的行动应该被认为适用于该会员国根据第三十一条第二节第七款的规定接受本协定的所有领土的个别货币，除非会员国宣布，它的行动或者是仅仅针对宗主国的货币，或者仅仅针对一种或几种特定的个别货币，或者针对宗主国的货币和一种或几种特定的个别货币。
Translation: 1. Actions taken by a member under this Article with respect to its currency shall be deemed to apply to the separate currencies of all territories in respect of which the member has accepted this Agreement under Article XXXI, Section 2(g), unless the member declares that such actions relate either to the metropolitan currency alone, or only to one or more specified separate currencies, or to the metropolitan currency and one or more specified separate currencies.

Query_Text_cn: 二、基金根据本条采取的行动应该被认为是针对上述第一款里所提到的一个会员国的所有货币，除非基金另有具体宣布。
Translation: II. Actions taken by the Fund under this Article shall be deemed to apply to all the currencies of a member country referred to in paragraph I above, unless the Fund specifically declares otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节与基金往来的机构各会员国应由基金财政部、中央银行、平准基金会或其它类似的财政机关与基金往来，基金也只经由这些机关与会员国往来。
Translation:
Section 1. Agencies Dealing with the Fund  
Each member country shall deal with the Fund through its Treasury, central bank, stabilization fund, or other similar fiscal agency, and the Fund shall deal with members only through these agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除本协定另有规定外，基金的业务限于经会员国请求，以该国货币向基金普通资金帐户上的普通资金中购买特别提款权或其它会员国货币。
Translation: 1. Except as otherwise provided in this Agreement, operations on the account of the Fund shall be limited to transactions for the purpose of supplying a member, on the initiative of such member, with special drawing rights or the currencies of other members from the general resources of the Fund held in the General Resources Account.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如经请求，基金可决定提供符合于基金宗旨的金融和技术服务，包括对会员国所缴资金的管理。在提供此项金融服务所涉及的业务不属基金业务。在此分节项下的服务未经会员国同意不能加给其任何义务。
Translation: II. Upon request, the Fund may decide to provide financial and technical services consistent with its purposes, including the management of resources contributed by member countries. Operations involved in the provision of such financial services shall not be considered operations of the Fund. No obligations may be imposed on any member under this subsection without its consent.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金应对使用其普通资金，包括对备用安排或类似的安排制定出政策，也可对特殊的国际收支问题制定特殊的政策，以便协助会员国按照符合于基金宗旨的一定方式来解决其国际收支问题，并对暂时使用基金资金作出充分保障。
Translation: I. The Fund shall adopt policies on the use of its general resources, including policies on stand-by or similar arrangements, and may adopt special policies for particular balance of payments problems, to assist members in resolving their balance of payments difficulties in a manner consistent with the purposes of the Fund and to provide adequate safeguards for the temporary use of its resources.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在下列条件下会员国得以本国相当数额的货币向基金购买其它会员国货币。
Translation: II. Under the following conditions, a member country may purchase the currency of another member country from the Fund with an equivalent amount of its own currency.

Query_Text_cn: （一）会员国应根据本协定的规定及依该规定所制定的政策使用基金的普通资金。
Translation: (a) Members shall use the general resources of the Fund in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement and the policies adopted under them.

Query_Text_cn: （二）会员国应以其国际收支，储备状况或其储备变化等为理由提出购买的需要。
Translation: (2) Member countries shall justify their need to purchase based on their balance of payments, reserve position, or changes in reserves.

Query_Text_cn: （三）请购的数额系指在储备部分额度内的购买，或不致使基金所持有的购买国的货币超过其份额的２００％。
Translation: (c) The amount of the purchase refers to the acquisition within the reserve tranche or does not cause the Fund's holdings of the purchasing member's currency to exceed 200 percent of its quota.

Query_Text_cn: （四）基金在以前并未根据本条第五节、第六条第一节以及第二十六条第二节第一款宣布过，该请购会员国已无资格使用基金的普通资金。
Translation: (iv) The Fund has not previously declared under Section 5 of this Article, Section 1 of Article VI, or Section 2(a) of Article XXVI that the member requesting the purchase is ineligible to use the general resources of the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 三、基金应审查此项请购是否符合本协定的规定以及根据该规定所制定的政策。但会员国申请在储备部分额度的购买不须受审查。
Translation: III. The Fund shall examine a request to purchase to determine whether the proposed purchase would be consistent with the provisions of this Agreement and the policies adopted under them, except that a request for a purchase within the reserve tranche shall not be subject to challenge.

Query_Text_cn: 四、基金应制定有关选择所出售货币的政策和程序，要同会员国磋商，考虑到会员国的国际收支、储备状况、外汇市场的变化，以及在一段时间内改进在基金中的平衡地位的要求。假如一个会员国提出购买另一会员国的货币是因为希望获得其它会员国提供的相等数量的本国货币，该会员国应有权购买其它会员国的货币，除非基金按第七条第三节已通知其持有的货币已经稀少。
Translation: IV. The Fund shall adopt policies and procedures for the selection of currencies to be sold, in consultation with member countries, taking into account their balance of payments and reserve positions, developments in exchange markets, as well as the need to improve balances in the Fund over time. If a member country requests to purchase the currency of another member country because it wishes to obtain an equivalent amount of its own currency provided by that member, the requesting member shall have the right to purchase the currency of the other member, unless the Fund has notified under Section 3 of Article VII that the currency in question has become scarce.

Query_Text_cn: 五、（一）每个会员国应保证，从基金购买的其货币额是可以自由使用货币额或在购买时可以兑换成其选择的一种自由使用货币。两种货币间兑换使用的汇率等于按第十九条第七节第一款两者间的汇率。
Translation: 5. (1) Each member shall ensure that the amount of its currency purchased from the Fund is an amount of a freely usable currency or can be exchanged at the time of purchase for a freely usable currency selected by the member. The exchange rate between the two currencies shall be based on the rate for the two currencies established in accordance with Article XIX, Section 7(a).

Query_Text_cn: （二）每个会员国，其货币被从基金所购买，或者货币是被从基金购买的货币所换得，应和基金及其它会员国工作，从而使它的这些货币额在购买时能够兑换成其它会员国的可自由使用的货币。
Translation: (2) Each member whose currency is purchased from the Fund or whose currency is obtained in exchange for currency purchased from the Fund shall collaborate with the Fund and other members to enable such holdings of its currency to be exchanged, at the time of purchase, for the freely usable currencies of other members.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如按照上述第（一）项所购的是一种不能自由使用货币，应由其货币被购买的会员国进行兑换，除非该会员国和购买会员国同意采用另一种办法。
Translation: (3) If the purchase under (1) above is made in a currency that is not freely usable, it shall be exchanged by the member whose currency is purchased unless that member and the purchasing member agree on another procedure.

Query_Text_cn: （四）如一会员国从基金购买另一会员国的可自由使用货币，并希望在购买时兑换成另一种可自由使用货币，在该会员国的要求下应与另一会员国作出兑换。应按另一会员国选择的可自由使用货币进行兑换，汇率按照上述第（一）项的规定。
Translation: (iv) If a member purchases from the Fund the freely usable currency of another member and wishes to exchange it at the time of purchase into another freely usable currency, the exchange shall be made with the other member if requested by the purchasing member. The exchange shall be made for a freely usable currency selected by the other member at an exchange rate based on the provisions of (i) above.

Query_Text_cn: 六、基金应按制定的政策和程序，可同意按照本节规定提供给请购的参与国以特别提款权，而不是其它会员国货币。
Translation: VI. The Fund may, in accordance with established policies and procedures, agree to provide special drawing rights to participating countries requesting purchases under this Section instead of the currencies of other member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节放弃条件的办法基金得在保障本身利益的条件下，酌情放弃本条第三节第二款第（三）和（四）款所列的任何条件，特别是对过去一向不多用或不经常用基金普通资金的会员国。在放弃此项条件时，基金应考虑该申请国的周期性的或特殊的需要。基金并应考虑该国愿否提供基金认为是以保障其利益的可接受的资产作为担保，基金得要求提供此种担保作为放弃上述条件的交换条件。
Translation:
Section 4. Waiver of Conditions  
The Fund may, in safeguarding its own interests, waive any of the conditions prescribed in Section 3(b)(iii) and (iv) of this Article, especially in the case of members with a record of infrequent or limited use of the Fund’s general resources. In granting such a waiver, the Fund shall take into consideration the periodic or exceptional needs of the applicant member. The Fund shall also consider whether the member is willing to pledge to the Fund assets acceptable to it as security for the safeguarding of its interests, and may require such security as a condition for the waiver.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节使用基金普通资金资格的丧失当基金认为任何会员国使用基金普通资金的方式违反基金的宗旨时，即应向该国提出报告，阐明基金的意见，并规定一答复的适当期限。在提出报告后，基金可限制该国使用基金的普通资金。如在规定期限内该会员国对于基金的执行不予答复，或者答复不能令人满意，基金得继续限制其使用基金的普通资金，或者在给予该会员国适当的通知后，宣告该会员国丧失使用基金普通资金的资格。
Translation:
Section 5 Ineligibility to Use the General Resources of the Fund  

If the Fund finds that a member is using the general resources of the Fund in a manner contrary to the purposes of the Fund, it shall present to the member a report setting forth the views of the Fund and prescribing a suitable time for reply. After presenting such a report, the Fund may limit the use of its general resources by the member. If no reply is received from the member within the prescribed time, or if the reply received is unsatisfactory, the Fund may continue to limit the member's use of the general resources of the Fund or may, after giving reasonable notice to the member, declare it ineligible to use the general resources of the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金可接受参与国提供的特别提款权，兑换给相等金额的其它会员国货币。
Translation: I. The Fund may accept special drawing rights provided by participating countries and exchange them for an equivalent amount of the currencies of other member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在参与国的要求下，基金可提供给该国的特别提款权换回相等金额的其它会员国货币基金持有的会员国货币不能由于这些交易的结果而增加到超过本条第八节第二款第（二）项所规定要征收手续费的水平。
Translation: II. At the request of a participant, the Fund may provide SDRs to that participant in exchange for an equivalent amount of the currencies of other participants. The Fund's holdings of a participant's currency shall not be increased as a result of these transactions above the level at which a charge would be payable under Article VIII, Section 2(b)(ii).

Query_Text_cn: 三、基金按本节所提供或接受的货币应按照政策，考虑到本条第三节第四款或第七节第九款的原则，进行选择。只有在基金提供或接受的会员国货币，得到该会员国同意使用时，基金才能按此节进行交易。
Translation: III. The currencies provided or received by the Fund under this Section shall be selected in accordance with policies that take into account the principles set forth in Section 3(d) or Section 7(i) of this Article. The Fund may conduct transactions pursuant to this Section only if the member whose currency is provided or received by the Fund agrees to its use for such transactions.

Query_Text_cn: 一、会员国在任何时候有权购回基金所持有的该国货币额中按本条第八节第二款的规定要征收手续费的部分。
Translation: 1. A member shall have the right to repurchase at any time any part of the Fund's holdings of its currency in accordance with Article VIII, Section 2(b), which is subject to charges.

Query_Text_cn: 二、按本条第三节已进行购买的会员国，由于其国际收支和储备状况有所改善时，一般情况应购回因购买而被基金所持有的该国货币额中按本条第八节第二款规定要征收手续费的部分。假如根据基金制定的购回政策并在与会员国磋商后，基金向该会员国提出，由于其国际收支和储备状况有所改善而应该购回时，会员国应购回基金持有的这些货币。
Translation: II. A member that has made a purchase under Section 3 of this Article shall, as its balance of payments and reserve position improves, normally repurchase the portion of the Fund’s holdings of its currency subject to charges under Section 8(b)(ii) of this Article. If the Fund represents to a member, after consultation with it and in accordance with the Fund’s policies on repurchase, that the member should repurchase because of an improvement in its balance of payments and reserve position, the member shall repurchase the Fund’s holdings of its currency.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按本条第三节已进行购买的会员国，应在不超过自购买之日后的五年内，购回因购买而被基金所持有的该国货币额中按本条第八节第二款的规定要征收手续费的部分。基金可以规定会员国应从购买之日后三年起到五年止的期限内分期作出购回。基金可以总投票权８５％的多数票改变本分节定的购回期限。由此而规定的期限将适用于所有会员国。
Translation: 3. A member that has made a purchase in accordance with Section 3 of this Article shall repurchase, within a period not exceeding five years from the date of purchase, the amount of its currency held by the Fund that resulted from the purchase and is subject to charges under Section 8(b)(ii) of this Article. The Fund may prescribe that repurchase shall be made by a member in installments during the period beginning three years and ending five years after the date of purchase. The Fund may by an eighty-five percent majority of the total voting power change the repurchase periods prescribed in this subsection, and any periods so adopted shall apply to all members.

Query_Text_cn: 四、基金可以总投票权８５％的多数票规定一个不同于上述第三款而适用于所有会员国的购回期限，购回依据使用基金普通资金的特殊政策而使基金持有的货币。
Translation: 4. The Fund may, by a majority of eighty-five percent of the total voting power, prescribe a period for repurchase applicable to all members, which differs from that specified in paragraph 3 above, for currencies held by the Fund under special policies on the use of its ordinary resources.

Query_Text_cn: 五、会员国应根据基金以总投票权７０％多数票通过的政策，购回基金所持有的该国货币，基金持有的这些货币不是因购买的结果，但按本条第八节第二款第（二）项的规定属于要征收手续费的部分。
Translation: V. A member shall repurchase, in accordance with policies adopted by the Fund by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power, the Fund's holdings of its currency that are not acquired as a result of purchases but fall under the category of holdings subject to charges under Article VIII, Section 2(b)(ii).

Query_Text_cn: 六、如果作出决定，规定按使用基金普通资金的政策，在上述第三或第四款项下购回期限应比按政策执行中的期限减短，则该决定应仅适用于该决定生效之日后基金所得的持有额。
Translation: VI. If a decision is made prescribing that the periods for repurchase under the provisions of Section 3 or 4 of this Article shall be shorter than those in effect under the policies on the use of the Fund's general resources, such decision shall apply only to holdings acquired by the Fund after the effective date of the decision.

Query_Text_cn: 七、在会员国的要求下，基金可以延缓购回义务的日期，但不能超过上述第三或第四款项下的或依上述第五款基金规定政策下的最长期限。除非经基金以总投票权７０％的多数票决定，由于在规定日期偿还会给会员国造成额外的困难，因而延长购回（该项购回符合于暂时性使用基金普通资金）的期限是合理的。
Translation: VII. The Fund may, at the request of a member, postpone the date for the discharge of a repurchase obligation, but not beyond the maximum period prescribed under Section 3 or 4 of this Article or under policies adopted by the Fund under Section 5 of this Article, unless the Fund determines, by a 70 percent majority of the total voting power, that an extension beyond such maximum period is justified because discharge on the due date would result in exceptional hardship for the member, provided that such repurchase has been made in accordance with the temporary use of the Fund's general resources.

Query_Text_cn: 八、本条第三节第四款的基金政策，可以通过政策加以补充，即基金在和会员国磋商后，可以决定按本条第三节第二款出售基金所持有的、尚未根据第七节购回的该会员国货币不妨碍基金按本协定其它规定所允许基金采取的任何行动。
Translation: 8. The fund policy stipulated in Section 3, Article 4 of this provision may be supplemented by additional policies. Specifically, after consulting with member countries, the Fund may decide to sell the member country's currency held by the Fund—which has not been repurchased under Section 7—in accordance with Section 3, Article 2 of this provision, without prejudice to any other actions the Fund is permitted to take under other provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 九、所有依本节所作的购回，应使用特别提款权或基金指定的其它会员国货币。基金在制定会员国进行购回所需使用货币的政策和程序时，应考虑本条第三节第四款的原则。基金所持有的被用于购回的会员国货币，不能由于购回而增加到高出依本条第八节第二款第（二）项规定要征收手续费的水平。
Translation: IX. All repurchases under this Section shall be made with special drawing rights or in the currencies of other members specified by the Fund. In establishing the policies and procedures on the currencies to be used by members in making repurchases, the Fund shall consider the principles set forth in Section 3(d) of this Article. The currencies held by the Fund that are used for repurchases shall not include any which would increase the Fund’s holdings of the member’s currency above the level at which a charge would be payable under Section 8(b)(ii) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 十、（一）假如按上述第（一）项基金所指定的会员国货币不是自由使用货币，该会员国应保证进行购回的会员国在进行购回时可以它兑换成被指定货币的会员国所选择的自由使用货币。在此规定下的两种货币间兑换的汇率应等于按第十九条第七节第一款两者间的汇率。
Translation: 10.(a) If the currency of a member specified under (a) above is not a freely usable currency, the member shall ensure that the purchasing member can exchange the proceeds received at the time of purchase for a freely usable currency selected by the member whose currency is specified. The exchange between the two currencies shall take place at a rate equal to the exchange rate between them established in accordance with Section 7(a) of Article XIX.

Query_Text_cn: （二）每个会员国，其货币被基金指定用作购回的，应和基金及其它会员国合作，从而使进行购回的会员国在购回时，能用获得的指定货币，兑换成其它会员国的自由使用货币。
Translation: (2) Each member whose currency is designated by the Fund for repurchase shall cooperate with the Fund and other members to enable the member making the repurchase to obtain the designated currency in exchange for the freely usable currencies of other members at the time of repurchase.

Query_Text_cn: （三）上述第十款第（一）项下的兑换，应与被指定货币的会员国进行，除非该会员国和购回国间同意按另外的程序进行。
Translation: (3) Exchanges under (1) of this Article X shall be made with the member whose currency is designated, unless that member and the purchasing member agree to another procedure.

Query_Text_cn: （四）假如进行购回的会员国在购回时，希望获得基金按上述第一项所指定的其它会员国的自由使用货币，如其它会员国要求，它应按上述第十款第（一）项所提到的汇率，以可自由使用的货币，从其它会员国换得货币。基金可以在兑换时提供自由使用货币问题制定规章。
Translation: (iv) If a member purchasing repurchases wishes to obtain the freely usable currency of another member specified by the Fund under (i) above at the time of repurchase, it shall, if requested by the other member, exchange the freely usable currency obtained from the Fund for the currency of the other member at the exchange rate referred to in Section 10(a)(i). The Fund may adopt regulations governing the provision of freely usable currencies in such exchanges.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）基金对会员国用本国货币换购特别提款权或其它会员国货币应征收手续费，对储备部分额度的购买可比其它部分的购买征收较低的手续费，购买储备部分的手续费不能超过０．５％。
Translation: I. (1) The Fund shall levy charges on members' purchases of special drawing rights or other members' currencies with their own currencies, with the charges on purchases within the reserve tranche being lower than those on other purchases. The charge on reserve tranche purchases shall not exceed 0.5 percent.

Query_Text_cn: （二）基金对备用安排或类似的安排征收手续费。基金可以决定，安排的手续费应抵销按上述第（一）项对该安排项下的购买所征收的手续费。
Translation: (2) The Fund shall levy a charge on standby or similar arrangements. The Fund may decide that the charge on the arrangement shall be used to offset the charge levied on purchases under the arrangement pursuant to paragraph (1) above.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在除去上述第（一）项所提及的任何余额后超过了会员国持有份额的数额。在持有余额期间，手续费率应每隔一定时间而增高。
Translation: (b) Any portion in excess of the amounts mentioned in (a) above. The rate of charge shall rise at intervals during the period in which the holdings are maintained.

Query_Text_cn: 三、假如会员国不能按本条第七节所要求的进行购回，基金在和会员国就减少基金所持有的其货币进行磋商后，可对其所持有的、应当购回的该会员国货币征收基金认为合适的手续费。
Translation: 3. If a member fails to repurchase as required under Section 7 of this Article, the Fund, after consultation with the member on measures to reduce the Fund's holdings of its currency, may impose such charges as the Fund deems appropriate on the Fund's holdings of the member's currency that should have been repurchased.

Query_Text_cn: 四、应有总投票权７０％的多数票来决定上述第一和第二款项下的手续费率，它应对所有会员国一致，上述第三款亦同。
Translation: Fourth, the rates of charges under paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall be determined by a majority of seventy percent of the total voting power and shall apply uniformly to all members, and the same shall apply to paragraph 3 above.

Query_Text_cn: 五、会员国应以特别提款权支付所有的手续费，只有在特殊情况下，在基金与其它会员国磋商后，基金可允许该会员国以基金指定的其它会员国货币支付手续费，或者用本国货币。基金所持有的会员国的货币，不能因在此规定下其它会员国的支付结果而增加到超过依上述第二款第（二）项规定要征收手续费的水平。
Translation: V. Members shall pay all charges in special drawing rights, provided that in exceptional circumstances the Fund may permit a member to pay charges in the currencies of other members specified by the Fund, or in its own currency, after consultation with other members. The Fund's holdings of a member's currency shall not be increased as a result of payments by other members under this provision above the level at which charges would be levied in accordance with Section II, paragraph 2(b).

Query_Text_cn: 一、当下述第二或第三款所规定的份额比例超过基金普通资金帐户所持有的会员国货币的每日平均余额（不包括按第三十条第三款项下列作不包括项目的政策所获得的余额），基金应付给酬金。酬金率应由基金按总投票权７０％的多数票决定。对所有会员国均相同，并应不高于或低于第二十条第三节所定利率的４／５。在制定酬金率时，基金应考虑到第五条第八节第二款项下的手续费率。
Translation: I. When the percentage determined pursuant to (ii) or (iii) of Section 2 of this Article exceeds the average daily balances of a member’s currency held by the Fund in the General Resources Account (excluding any balances acquired under the policy on the use of the Fund’s general resources for the payment of charges applied before the date of the second amendment of this Agreement), the Fund shall pay remuneration on such excess. The rate of remuneration, which shall be determined by the Fund by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power, shall be the same for all members and shall not exceed four-fifths of the rate of interest under Article XX, Section 3. In determining the rate of remuneration, the Fund shall take into account the rates of charge under Article V, Section 8(b).

Query_Text_cn: （三）会员国自上述第二款第（一）项中适用的日期起，按第三条第三节第三款从基金所得到的货币或特别提款权的数额。
Translation: (c) The amount of currency or special drawing rights received by a member from the Fund under Article III, Section 3(c) from the applicable date specified in paragraph 2(a) above.

Query_Text_cn: （二）所有会员国均为１００％。
Translation: (2) All Member States account for 100%.

Query_Text_cn: 四、酬金应以特别提款权支付，除非基金或会员国决定以本国货币支付给会员国。
Translation: IV. Remuneration shall be paid in special drawing rights, unless the Fund or a member country decides to make payment to the member country in its own currency.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金在普通帐户所持有的资产价值以特别提款权表示。
Translation: I. The value of the assets held by the Fund in the General Account shall be expressed in terms of special drawing rights.

Query_Text_cn: 二、适用于本协定规定的有关会员国货币的计算，除第四条和附录三外，均应按照本条第十一节基金计算这些货币的汇率。
Translation: II. All computations relating to currencies of members for the purpose of applying the provisions of this Agreement, except Article IV and Schedule C, shall be at the rates at which the Fund computes these currencies in accordance with Section 11 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 三、为实行本协定规定，确定有关份额的货币金额计算，不应将特别支付帐户或投资帐户的货币包括在内。
Translation: III. For the purpose of implementing the provisions of this Agreement, the calculation of the monetary amounts pertaining to the relevant shares shall not include the currencies in the Special Payments Account or the Investment Account.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在普通资金帐户的会员国货币的价值，应依第十九条第七节第一款汇率折成特别提款权表示。
Translation: I. The value of a member's currency held in the General Resources Account shall be expressed in terms of special drawing rights on the basis of the exchange rate under Article XIX, Section 7(a).

Query_Text_cn: 二、基金按照本节变更其所持有的某会员国的货币额，应在基金和其它会员国进行业务活动中使用那种货币时进行，也可在基金决定的或会员国要求的其它时候进行。因变更而须向基金的支付，或基金向会员国的支付，应在变更之日后由基金决定的一个合理期限内进行，或在会员国要求的任何其它时候进行。
Translation: II. The Fund shall change the amount of its holdings of a member's currency pursuant to this Section either when conducting transactions with that currency in operations and transactions with other members, or at such other times as the Fund may decide or the member may request. Any payment due to the Fund or by the Fund as a result of such change shall be made within a reasonable period after the date of the change, as determined by the Fund, or at such other time as the member may request.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金在此节下的所有政策和决定，应遵守第八条第七节所规定的目标，和避免在黄金市场上管理价格或制订固定价格的目标。
Translation: 1. All policies and decisions of the Fund under this Section shall be consistent with the objectives set forth in Article VIII, Section 7, and with the objective of avoiding the management or the establishment of fixed prices in the gold market.

Query_Text_cn: 二、基金按下述第三、四款和第五款进行业务活动的决定，应经总投票权８５％的多数票同意。
Translation: II. Decisions of the Fund to conduct operations on the basis of provisions under Sections 3, 4, and 5 below shall require an 85 percent majority of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 三、基金在经该会员国磋商后，可以出售黄金换取该会员国的货币，但未经该会员国同意，不能因此项出售而使在普通资金帐户里基金所持有的该会员国的货币增加到超过本条第八节第二款第（二）项所规定要征收手续费的水平；但经会员国的要求，基金在出售时，将一部分兑换另一会员国的货币，所换的这部分可以防止这种增加。
Translation: 3. The Fund, after consultation with a member, may sell gold for the currency of that member and may agree with that member that the Fund is to pay no charges in respect of the sale, provided that the sale is not made from holdings of the member’s currency in the General Resources Account that are in excess of the level at which charges are payable under Section 8(b)(ii) of this Article. However, at the request of the member, the Fund may exchange, at the time of sale, part of the proceeds for the currency of another member, provided that such exchange does not result in an increase in the Fund’s holdings of the currency of the member whose currency is sold beyond the level at which charges are payable under Section 8(b)(ii) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 以一种货币兑换成另一会员国的货币，须经和该会员国协商后进行，并不得使基金持有的该会员国的货币增加到超过本条第八节第二款第（二）项规定要征收手续费的水平。基金在制定有关兑换的政策和程序时应考虑到本条第七节第九款所用的原则。依本协定向一会员国的出售，应按照每笔交易双方根据市场价格所协议的价格。
Translation: The conversion of one currency into that of another member country shall be conducted after consultation with that member country and shall not increase the Fund's holdings of the member's currency beyond the level at which a charge would be payable under Article VIII, Section 2(b)(ii). The Fund shall take into account the principles applied under Article VII, Section 9 in establishing policies and procedures for such conversions. Sales to a member country under this Agreement shall be made at a price agreed between the parties to each transaction based on market prices.

Query_Text_cn: 四、在基金按本协定进行的任何业务活动中，可以从会员国接受黄金，以代替特别提款权或货币。依本规定向基金的支付，应按照每笔业务交易双方根据在市场价格所协议的价格。
Translation: IV. In any operations conducted by the Fund under this Agreement, the Fund may accept gold from a member in lieu of special drawing rights or currency. Payments to the Fund under this provision shall be made at a price agreed for each transaction between the Fund and the member concerned, based on the market price.

Query_Text_cn: 五、基金可将在本协定第二次修改之日持有的黄金出售给在１９７５年８月３１日已经参加并且同意购买的会员国，并按这一天会员国份额所定的比例售给。假如基金打算为上述第六款第（二）项的目的而依据上述第三款出售黄金，可出售该部分黄金给同意购买的各发展中会员国，该部分黄金如依上述第三款出售会造成有多余，可按下述第六款第（三）项分配给会员国。按此规定出售黄金给按本条第五节宣布为无资格使用基金普通资金会员国，应在其恢复资格时再售给，除非基金决定提前售给。依本分节第五款出售给会员国的黄金应收取该会员国的货币，并按出售时以一特别提款权合０．８８８６７１克纯黄金等值的价格。
Translation: V. The Fund may sell gold to those members that were members on August 31, 1975 and that agree to buy it, in proportion to their quotas on that date, any gold held by it on the date of the second amendment of this Agreement. If the Fund intends to sell gold under Section 3 of this Article for the purposes of Section 6(b)(ii), it may sell such gold to those developing members that agree to buy it. If the portion of gold which would be sold under Section 3 of this Article to members cannot be sold under this provision, it may be sold to members under Section 6(c). Sales under this paragraph to a member that has been declared ineligible to use the general resources of the Fund under Section 5 of this Article shall be made only after the ineligibility has been terminated unless the Fund decides to make the sale sooner. The Fund shall accept payment in the member’s currency for gold sold under this paragraph at a price equivalent at the time of sale to one special drawing right per 0.888671 gram of fine gold.

Query_Text_cn: 六、黄金依上述第三款在任何时候出售其在第二次协定修改之日所持有的黄金时，应把出售收入按出售时以一特别提款权合０．８８８６７１克纯黄金等值存入普通资金帐户。除非基金按下述第七款决定用另外办法，任何多余部分应存于特别支付帐户。
Translation: VI. Whenever gold held by the Fund on the date of the second amendment of this Agreement is sold pursuant to paragraph 3 above, the proceeds of the sale shall be placed in the General Resources Account to the extent that such proceeds at the time of sale are equivalent to one special drawing right per 0.888671 gram of fine gold. Unless the Fund decides otherwise under paragraph 7 below, any excess shall be held in the Special Disbursement Account.

Query_Text_cn: （一）转入普通资金帐户，作本协定规定认可的、除本节以外的业务活动中立即使用。
Translation: (a) Transfer to the General Resources Account for immediate use in operations and transactions authorized under provisions of this Agreement other than this Section.

Query_Text_cn: （二）虽非本协定其它规定认可但符合基金宗旨的业务活动。在本分节第六款第（二）项下，对处于困境的发展中会员国可按特别的条件提供给国际收支上的援助。为此目的，基金应考虑到平均国民收入的水平。
Translation: (b) Operations that, although not authorized by other provisions of this Agreement, are consistent with the purposes of the Fund. Under this subsection (f)(ii), balance of payments assistance may be provided to developing member countries in difficulty on special terms. For this purpose, the Fund shall take into account the level of per capita income.

Query_Text_cn: （三）对１９７５年８月３１日为会员国的发展中会员国按其在这一天的份额的比例进行分配。基金按上述第（二）项的目的决定使用的资产部分，相当于这些会员国在分配之日的份额与同日所有会员国份额总数的比例。但依本规定对于按本条第五节宣布为无资格使用普通资金的会员国的分配，应在其资格恢复后才能进行，除非基金决定提前给予分配。按上述第（一）项使用资产的决定须经总投票权７０％的多数通过，按上述第（二）项、第（三）项所作的决定须经总投票权的８５％多数票通过。
Translation: (c) A distribution shall be made to those developing members that were members on August 31, 1975 in proportion to their quotas on that date. The assets to be distributed under (b) above shall be such proportion of the assets used for the purposes of (b) as the quotas on the date of distribution of the members receiving the distribution bear to the total of the quotas on that date of all members.
