No distribution shall be made to a member under this paragraph unless the member has been declared ineligible to use the general resources of the Fund under Section 5 of this Article, and the distribution shall not be made before the ineligibility has been removed unless the Fund decides to make an early distribution. A decision to use assets under (a) above shall be made by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power, and decisions under (b) and (c) above shall be made by an eighty-five percent majority of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 七、基金可经总投票权８５％的多数票决定，将上述第六款提及的部分剩余额转入投资帐户，按第十二条第六节第六款的规定使用。
Translation: 7. The Fund may,by a majority of eighty-five percent of the total voting power,decide to transfer a portion of the surplus mentioned in Section 6 of this Article to the Investment Account for use in accordance with the provisions of Section 6(f) of Article XII.

Query_Text_cn: 八、在按上述第六款规定未使用期间，基金可将在特别支付帐户持有的会员国货币投资于该会员国的可销售的债务，或国际金融机构的可销售债务，按上述第六款第（二）项所得到的投资和利息收入应存入特别支付帐户。未经其货币被用于投资的会员国同意，不得进行该项投资。基金只能对以特别提款权或用作投资的货币为单位的债务进行投资。
Translation: VIII. During any period when the holdings of a member’s currency in the Special Disbursement Account are not used in accordance with the provisions of Section 6 above, the Fund may invest such holdings in marketable obligations of that member or in marketable obligations of international financial institutions. Investments made pursuant to Section 6(ii) above and the income derived therefrom shall be placed in the Special Disbursement Account. No investment shall be made without the concurrence of the member whose currency is used for investment. The Fund shall invest only in obligations denominated in special drawing rights or in the currency used for investment.

Query_Text_cn: 九、从普通资金帐户支付的，有关特别支付帐户的行政管理费用，应不时地得到偿还，根据对此项费用合理的估计数，从特别支付帐户转拨到普通资金帐户内。
Translation: IX. Administrative expenses paid by the General Account in respect of the Special Disbursement Account shall be reimbursed to the General Account from the Special Disbursement Account from time to time, on the basis of reasonable estimates of such expenses.

Query_Text_cn: 十、特别支付帐户应在基金清理时终止，并可经总投票权７０％多数票在基金清理前终止。由于基金清理该帐户终止时，对该帐户内的任何资产应根据附录十一的规定予以分配。在基金清理前该帐户终止时，该帐户内的任何资产应转到普通资产帐户，在业务活动中立即使用。经总投票权７０％的多数票通过，基金可对特别支付帐户的管理制定出规章和条例。
Translation: X. The Special Disbursement Account shall be terminated upon liquidation of the Fund and may be terminated prior to liquidation of the Fund by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power. Upon termination of the Account because of liquidation of the Fund, any assets in the Account shall be distributed in accordance with the provisions of Schedule K. Upon termination of the Account prior to liquidation of the Fund, any assets in the Account shall be transferred to the General Resources Account for immediate use in the operations and transactions of the Fund. The Fund may adopt rules and regulations for the administration of the Special Disbursement Account by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除本条第二节规定的情况外，会员国不得使用基金普通资金作为大量或长期的资金输出之用。基金可以要求会员国实行管制，以防止对基金普通资金作如此使用。如会员国接到此项要求后不采取适当管制，基金可以宣布该会员国无资格使用基金资金。
Translation: 1. Except as provided in Section 2 of this Article, a member may not use the Fund's general resources to meet a large or sustained outflow of capital. The Fund may request a member to exercise controls to prevent such use of the general resources of the Fund. If the member fails to exercise appropriate controls after receiving such a request, the Fund may declare the member ineligible to use the Fund's resources.

Query_Text_cn: （一）会员国为了扩大出口或进行正常贸易，金融业或其它业务使用基金普通资金作必需的合理数额资本交易。
Translation: (i) Members may use the general resources of the Fund for capital transactions of reasonable amounts required to expand exports or engage in normal trade, banking, or other business activities.

Query_Text_cn: （二）会员国使用其自有资金作符合基金宗旨的资本移动。
Translation: (2) Member countries utilize their own funds for capital movements consistent with the Fund's purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 第二节资本转移的特殊规定会员国可以在储备部分额度内购买货币，作为资本转移之用。
Translation:
Section 2 Special Provisions for Capital Transfers  
A member country may purchase currency within the reserve tranche for the purpose of capital transfers.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节资本转移的管制会员国对国际资本转移得采取必要的管制，但这种管制，除第七条第三节第二款及第十四条第二节规定者外，不得限制日常交易的支付或者不适当地阻滞清偿债务的资金转移。
Translation:
Section 3 Control of Capital Transfers  

Members may exercise such controls as are necessary to regulate international capital movements, but no member may exercise these controls in a manner which will restrict payments for current transactions or which will unduly delay transfers of funds in settlement of commitments, except as provided in Section 2(b) of Article VII and Section 2 of Article XIV.

Query_Text_cn: （一）在基金与该会员国协议的期限和条件下，向该会员国提议借入稀少货币，或经该国同意，向境内或境外的其他来源借入稀少货币。但该会员国并无出借货币给基金或同意基金向其他来源借入的任何义务。
Translation: (a) To propose to the member country, under terms and conditions agreed upon with the Fund, to borrow the scarce currency or, with the consent of the member country, to borrow it from other sources either within or outside the territories of the member country. However, the member country shall not be under any obligation to lend its currency to the Fund or to consent to the Fund borrowing from other sources.

Query_Text_cn: （二）要求会员国（如该会员国是参与国）将其货币出售给基金，换回在普通资金帐户持有的特别提款权，并遵守第十九条第四节的规定。在以特别提款权补充时，基金应适当注意第十九条第五节指定参与国的原则。
Translation: (ii) Require a member (if the member is a participant) to sell its currency to the Fund for special drawing rights held in the General Resources Account, in accordance with the provisions of Article XIX, Section 4. When replenishing with special drawing rights, the Fund shall pay due regard to the principles of designation under Article XIX, Section 5.

Query_Text_cn: 第二节货币的普遍稀少基金如发现某种货币发生普遍稀少情形在发展时，应即通告各会员国，并提出报告，阐明稀少的原因，并建议解决的办法。
Translation:
Section 2. General Scarcity of Currency  
If the Fund finds that a general scarcity of a particular currency is developing, it shall promptly inform member countries and issue a report, explaining the causes of the scarcity and proposing measures to address it.

Query_Text_cn: 当准备此项执行时，稀少货币的当事国应派代表参加。
Translation: When preparing for this implementation, the country party to the scarce currency shall send representatives to participate.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如基金认为对于某会员国货币的需求明显地严重威胁基金供应该项货币的能力时，不论其已否按本条第二节规定发出报告，应即正式宣告该货币已经稀少。此后，对所存有和可收的该项稀少货币，应参酌各会员国的相对需要，总的国际经济形势及其它有关的考虑，进行分配。基金并应发出关于此项措施的执行。
Translation: 1. If the Fund deems the demand for a member country's currency to pose a significant and imminent threat to its ability to supply that currency, it shall formally declare such currency scarce, regardless of whether a report has been issued under Section 2 of this Article. Thereafter, all holdings and receipts of the scarce currency shall be allocated with reference to the relative needs of member countries, the general international economic situation, and other relevant considerations. The Fund shall also issue a statement regarding the implementation of such measures.

Query_Text_cn: 二、根据上述第一款所作的正式宣告，亦即是授权任何会员国，在与基金协商后，暂时限制稀少货币的自由汇兑。依照第四条和附录三，该会员国应有全权决定比项限制的性质。但此项限制，仅以使对稀少货币的需求能与该国已有或应有的供给相适应为限。一俟情况许可，应即尽速放宽或解除限制。
Translation: II. The formal declaration under the preceding paragraph shall operate as an authorization to any member, after consultation with the Fund, to impose temporary restrictions on the freedom of exchange operations in the scarce currency. In accordance with Article IV and Schedule C, the member shall have complete jurisdiction in determining the nature of such restrictions. However, such restrictions shall be only to the extent necessary to balance the demand for the scarce currency with the member's existing or anticipated supply. The restrictions shall be relaxed or removed as soon as conditions permit.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节限制的执行任何会员国依据本条第三节第二款的规定，对任何其它会员国货币施行限制时，应对其他会员国就此项限制措施所提的任何意见，尽量予以考虑。
Translation:
Section 4. Enforcement of Restrictions  
Any member imposing restrictions under the provisions of Section 3(b) of this Article on the currency of any other member shall give sympathetic consideration to any representations made by other members regarding such restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节其它国际协定对此项限制的效力各会员国同意不引用本协定未签订前与其他会员国所订任何协定内的义务，以免妨碍本条文规定的施行。
Translation:
Section 5 Effect of Other International Agreements on This Restriction  
The Members agree not to invoke obligations under any agreements entered into with other Members prior to the conclusion of this Agreement in a manner that would impede the application of the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节引言各会员国除承担本协定其他各条下的义务外，尚须履行本条规定的义务。
Translation:
Section 1 Introduction  
In addition to the obligations under other provisions of this Agreement, each Member shall also comply with the obligations set forth in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除第七条第三节第二款及第十四条第二节的规定外，各会员国未经基金同意，不得对国际经常往来的付款和资金转移施加限制。
Translation: I. Except as provided in Article VII, Section 3(b) and Article XIV, Section 2, no member shall, without the approval of the Fund, impose restrictions on the making of payments and transfers for current international transactions.

Query_Text_cn: 二、有关任何会员国货币的汇兑契约，如与该国按本协定所施行的外汇管理条例相抵触时，在任何会员国境内均属无效。此外，各会员国得相互合作采取措施，使彼此的外汇管理条例更为有效，但此项措施与条例，应符合于本协定。
Translation: II. Any exchange contract involving the currency of any member which is contrary to the exchange control regulations of that member maintained or imposed consistently with this Agreement shall be unenforceable in the territories of any member. In addition, members may, by mutual accord, cooperate in measures for the purpose of making the exchange control regulations of either member more effective, provided that such measures and regulations are consistent with this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节避免施行歧视性货币措施除本协定规定或基金准许者外，无论是在第四条或附录三规定的幅度之内或之外，任何会员国或第五条第一节所述之财政机关不得施行歧视性货币措施或多种货币汇率制。如在本协定生效前已经施行此项安排与措施，该有关会员国应与基金磋商逐步解除的办法，但其根据第十四条第二节规定而施行者不在此限。在该情况下得适用该条第三节的规定。
Translation:
Section 3 Avoidance of Discriminatory Currency Practices  

No member or fiscal agency referred to in Section 1 of Article V shall, except as provided in this Agreement or approved by the Fund, engage in any discriminatory currency arrangements or multiple currency practices, whether within or outside margins under Article IV or prescribed under the provisions of Schedule C. If such arrangements and practices were in effect prior to the date on which this Agreement entered into force, the member concerned shall consult with the Fund as to their progressive removal unless they are maintained or imposed under Section 2 of Article XIV, in which case the provisions of Section 3 of that Article shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （二）此项兑换系为支付经常性往来所必需。购买国得自行选用特别提款权支付（须遵守第十九条第四节规定）或者用该申请国的货币支付。

Query_Text_cn: （五）被要求购买的会员国由于其它原因，已经无资格用本国货币向基金购买其它国家的货币。
Translation: (v) The member country required to purchase is, for other reasons, no longer eligible to use its own currency to purchase the currencies of other countries from the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: （十二）如有官方的清算安排，关于商业及金融交易待清算的数额，及此项未清算款项拖欠的时间。
Translation: (12) If there are official clearing arrangements, the amounts to be cleared for commercial and financial transactions, and the duration of arrears for such uncleared payments.

Query_Text_cn: 联合国教育、科学及文化组织(以下简称教科文组织)大会于2003年9月29日至10月17日在巴黎举行的第32届会议，参照现有的国际人权文书，尤其是1948年的《世界人权宣言》以及1966年的《经济、社会及文化权利国际公约》和《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》，考虑到1989年的《保护民间创作建议书》、2001年的《教科文组织世界文化多样性宣言》和2002年第三次文化部长圆桌会议通过的《伊斯坦布尔宣言》强调非物质文化遗产的重要性，它是文化多样性的熔炉，又是可持续发展的保证，考虑到非物质文化遗产与物质文化遗产和自然遗产之间的内在相互依存关系，承认全球化和社会转型进程在为各群体之间开展新的对话创造条件的同时，也与不容忍现象一样，使非物质文化遗产面临损坏、消失和破坏的严重威胁，在缺乏保护资源的情况下，这种威胁尤为严重，意识到保护人类非物质文化遗产是普遍的意愿和共同关心的事项，承认各社区，尤其是原住民、各群体，有时是个人，在非物质文化遗产的生产、保护、延续和再创造方面发挥着重要作用，从而为丰富文化多样性和人类的创造性做出贡献，注意到教科文组织在制定保护文化遗产的准则性文件，尤其是1972年的《保护世界文化和自然遗产公约》方面所做的具有深远意义的工作，还注意到迄今尚无有约束力的保护非物质文化遗产的多边文件，考虑到国际上现有的关于文化遗产和自然遗产的协定、建议书和决议需要有非物质文化遗产方面的新规定有效地予以充实和补充，考虑到必须提高人们，尤其是年轻一代对非物质文化遗产及其保护的重要意义的认识，考虑到国际社会应当本着互助合作的精神与本公约缔约国一起为保护此类遗产做出贡献，忆及教科文组织有关非物质文化遗产的各项计划，尤其是“宣布人类口头遗产和非物质遗产代表作”计划，认为非物质文化遗产是密切人与人之间的关系以及他们之间进行交流和了解的要素，它的作用是不可估量的，于2003年10月17日通过本公约。
Translation:
The General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (hereinafter referred to as "UNESCO"), meeting in Paris from 29 September to 17 October 2003, at its 32nd session,

Referring to existing international human rights instruments, in particular to the Universal Declaration of Human Rights of 1948, the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights of 1966,

Considering the importance of the intangible cultural heritage as a mainspring of cultural diversity and a guarantee of sustainable development, as underscored by the UNESCO Recommendation on the Safeguarding of Traditional Culture and Folklore of 1989, by the UNESCO Universal Declaration on Cultural Diversity of 2001, and by the Istanbul Declaration adopted by the Third Round Table of Ministers of Culture in 2002,

Considering the deep-seated interdependence between the intangible cultural heritage and the tangible cultural and natural heritage,

Recognizing that the processes of globalization and social transformation, alongside the conditions they create for renewed dialogue among communities, also give rise, as does the phenomenon of intolerance, to grave threats of deterioration, disappearance and destruction of the intangible cultural heritage, in particular owing to a lack of resources for safeguarding such heritage,

Being aware of the universal will and the common concern to safeguard the intangible cultural heritage of humanity,

Recognizing that communities, in particular indigenous peoples, groups and, in some cases, individuals, play an important role in the production, safeguarding, maintenance and recreation of the intangible cultural heritage, thus helping to enrich cultural diversity and human creativity,

Noting the far-reaching work of UNESCO in establishing normative instruments for the protection of cultural heritage, in particular the Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage of 1972,

Noting further that no binding multilateral instrument exists as yet for the safeguarding of the intangible cultural heritage,

Considering that existing international agreements, recommendations and resolutions concerning the cultural and natural heritage need to be effectively enriched and supplemented by new provisions relating to the intangible cultural heritage,

Considering the need to raise awareness, especially among the younger generations, of the importance of the intangible cultural heritage and of its safeguarding,

Considering that the international community should contribute, together with the States Parties to this Convention, to the safeguarding of such heritage in a spirit of cooperation and mutual assistance,

Recalling UNESCO’s programmes relating to the intangible cultural heritage, in particular the Proclamation of Masterpieces of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity,

Considering the invaluable role of the intangible cultural heritage as a factor in bringing human beings closer together and ensuring exchange and understanding among them,

Adopts this Convention on this seventeenth day of October 2003.

Query_Text_cn: (四)开展国际合作及提供国际援助。
Translation: (4) Conducting international cooperation and providing international assistance.

Query_Text_cn: (一)“非物质文化遗产”，指被各社区、群体，有时是个人，视为其文化遗产组成部分的各种社会实践、观念表述、表现形式、知识、技能以及相关的工具、实物、手工艺品和文化场所。
Translation: (I) "Intangible cultural heritage" refers to various social practices, conceptual expressions, forms of representation, knowledge, skills, as well as related tools, artifacts, handicrafts, and cultural spaces that communities, groups, and in some cases individuals recognize as part of their cultural heritage.

Query_Text_cn: 这种非物质文化遗产世代相传，在各社区和群体适应周围环境以及与自然和历史的互动中，被不断地再创造，为这些社区和群体提供认同感和持续感，从而增强对文化多样性和人类创造力的尊重。
Translation: This intangible cultural heritage is passed down from generation to generation and is constantly recreated as communities and groups interact with their environment, nature, and history. It provides them with a sense of identity and continuity, thereby fostering respect for cultural diversity and human creativity.

Query_Text_cn: 在本公约中，只考虑符合现有的国际人权文件，各社区、群体和个人之间相互尊重的需要和顺应可持续发展的非物质文化遗产。
Translation: For the purposes of this Convention, only intangible cultural heritage that is compatible with existing international human rights instruments, as well as the requirements of mutual respect among communities, groups and individuals, and sustainable development will be considered.

Query_Text_cn: 5．传统手工艺。
Translation: 5. Traditional handicrafts.

Query_Text_cn: (三)“保护”指确保非物质文化遗产生命力的各种措施，包括这种遗产各个方面的确认、立档、研究、保存、保护、宣传、弘扬、传承(特别是通过正规和非正规教育)和振兴。
Translation: (c) "safeguarding" means measures aimed at ensuring the viability of the intangible cultural heritage, including the identification, documentation, research, preservation, protection, promotion, enhancement, transmission (particularly through formal and non-formal education) and revitalization of this heritage in all its aspects.

Query_Text_cn: (四)“缔约国”指受本公约约束且本公约在它们之间也通用的国家。
Translation: (d) "Contracting State" means a State bound by this Convention and for which the Convention is in force.

Query_Text_cn: (五)本公约经必要修改对根据第三十三条所述之条件成为其缔约方之领土也适用。
Translation: (V) This Convention shall apply, mutatis mutandis, to any territory for which it becomes a Contracting Party under the conditions set forth in Article 33.

Query_Text_cn: 在此意义上，“缔约国”亦指这些领土。
Translation: In this sense,"Contracting State" also refers to these territories.

Query_Text_cn: (二)影响缔约国从其作为缔约方的任何有关知识产权或使用生物和生态资源的国际文书所获得的权利和所负有的义务。
Translation: (2) Affect the rights and obligations of a State Party derived from any international agreement relating to intellectual property or the utilization of biological and ecological resources to which it is a party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、兹建立缔约国大会，下称“大会”。
Translation: 1. A Conference of the States Parties, hereinafter referred to as "the Conference," is hereby established.

Query_Text_cn: 大会为本公约的最高权力机关。
Translation: The Conference shall be the supreme authority of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、大会每两年举行一次常会。
Translation: 2. The Congress shall hold a regular session every two years.

Query_Text_cn: 如若它作出此类决定或政府间保护非物质文化遗产委员会或至少三分之一的缔约国提出要求，可举行特别会议。
Translation: Extraordinary sessions may be convened if it so decides, or at the request either of the Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage or of at least one-third of the States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、大会应通过自己的议事规则。
Translation: III. The Congress shall adopt its own rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 一、兹在教科文组织内设立政府间保护非物质文化遗产委员会，下称“委员会”。
Translation: 1. There is hereby established within UNESCO an Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage, hereinafter referred to as "the Committee".

Query_Text_cn: 在本公约依照第三十四条的规定生效之后，委员会由参加大会之缔约国选出的18个缔约国的代表组成。
Translation: After the entry into force of this Convention in accordance with Article 34, the Committee shall consist of representatives of 18 States Parties elected by the Conference of the States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在本公约缔约国的数目达到50个之后，委员会委员国的数目将增至24个。
Translation: II. The number of members of the Committee shall increase to 24 after the number of States Parties to the present Convention reaches 50.

Query_Text_cn: 一、委员会委员国的选举应符合公平的地理分配和轮换原则。
Translation: 1. The election of member states to the Committee shall comply with the principles of equitable geographical distribution and rotation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、委员会委员国由本公约缔约国大会选出，任期四年。
Translation: II. The members of the Committee shall be elected by the Conference of the States Parties to the present Convention for a term of four years.

Query_Text_cn: 三、但第一次选举当选的半数委员会委员国的任期为两年。
Translation: III. However, the term of office for half of the Committee members elected in the first election shall be two years.

Query_Text_cn: 这些国家在第一次选举后抽签指定。
Translation: These countries are designated by lot after the first election.

Query_Text_cn: 四、大会每两年对半数委员会委员国进行换届。
Translation: IV. The Conference shall renew half of its member states every two years.

Query_Text_cn: 五、大会还应选出填补空缺席位所需的委员会委员国。
Translation: V. The Conference shall also elect the member states required to fill any vacancies on the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 六、委员会委员国不得连选连任两届。
Translation: VI. Member States of the Committee shall not be eligible for immediate re-election for a second consecutive term.

Query_Text_cn: 七、委员会委员国应选派在非物质文化遗产各领域有造诣的人士为其代表。
Translation: VII. Each State Member of the Committee shall appoint as its representatives persons who are qualified in the various fields of the intangible cultural heritage.

Query_Text_cn: 2．按照第二十二条的规定提供国际援助。
Translation: 2. Provide international assistance in accordance with the provisions of Article 22.

Query_Text_cn: 一、委员会对大会负责。
Translation: I. The Committee shall be responsible to the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 它向大会报告自己的所有活动和决定。
Translation: It reports all its activities and decisions to the Congress.

Query_Text_cn: 二、委员会以其委员的三分之二多数通过自己的议事规则。
Translation: II. The Committee shall adopt its own rules of procedure by a two-thirds majority of its members.

Query_Text_cn: 三、委员会可设立其认为执行任务所需的临时特设咨询机构。
Translation: III. The Committee may establish such temporary ad hoc advisory bodies as it deems necessary for the performance of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 四、委员会可邀请在非物质文化遗产各领域确有专长的任何公营或私营机构以及任何自然人参加会议，就任何具体的问题向其请教。
Translation: IV. The Committee may invite any public or private body, as well as any natural person with recognized competence in the various fields of intangible cultural heritage, to attend its meetings for consultation on specific issues.

Query_Text_cn: 一、委员会应建议大会认证在非物质文化遗产领域确有专长的非政府组织具有向委员会提供咨询意见的能力。
Translation: I. The Committee shall recommend to the General Assembly the accreditation of non-governmental organizations with recognized competence in the field of intangible cultural heritage to provide advisory services to the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 二、委员会还应向大会就此认证的标准和方式提出建议。
Translation: II. The Committee shall also make recommendations to the General Assembly regarding the criteria and modalities for such certification.

Query_Text_cn: 一、委员会由教科文组织秘书处协助。
Translation: 1. The Committee shall be assisted by the Secretariat of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 二、秘书处起草大会和委员会文件及其会议的议程草案和确保其决定的执行。
Translation: II. The Secretariat prepares documents for the General Assembly and its committees, drafts their provisional agendas, and ensures the implementation of their decisions.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在第二条第(三)项提及的保护措施内，由各社区、群体和有关非政府组织参与，确认和确定其领土上的各种非物质文化遗产。
Translation: (2) Within the framework of the safeguarding measures referred to in Article 2(3), identify and define the various elements of intangible cultural heritage present in their territories, with the participation of communities, groups, and relevant non-governmental organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、为了使其领土上的非物质文化遗产得到确认以便加以保护，各缔约国应根据自己的国情拟订一份或数份关于这类遗产的清单，并应定期加以更新。
Translation: 1. In order to ensure the identification of intangible cultural heritage within its territory for safeguarding purposes, each State Party shall compile one or more inventories of such heritage, in accordance with its national circumstances, and shall update them periodically.

Query_Text_cn: 二、各缔约国在按第二十九条的规定定期向委员会提交报告时，应提供有关这些清单的情况。
Translation: II. States Parties shall include information on such lists in the reports they submit to the Committee periodically pursuant to Article 29.

Query_Text_cn: 3．建立非物质文化遗产文献机构并创造条件促进对它的利用。
Translation: 3. Establish institutions for intangible cultural heritage documentation and create conditions to facilitate its utilization.

Query_Text_cn: 4．非正规的知识传播手段。
Translation: 4. Informal knowledge dissemination methods.

Query_Text_cn: (三)促进保护表现非物质文化遗产所需的自然场所和纪念地点的教育。
Translation: (3) Promote education on the conservation of natural sites and memorial locations essential for the manifestation of intangible cultural heritage.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条社区、群体和个人的参与缔约国在开展保护非物质文化遗产活动时，应努力确保创造、延续和传承这种遗产的社区、群体，有时是个人的最大限度的参与，并吸收他们积极地参与有关的管理。
Translation:
Article 15 Participation of communities, groups and individuals  
Within the framework of safeguarding activities of the intangible cultural heritage, each State Party shall endeavor to ensure the widest possible participation of communities, groups and, where applicable, individuals that create, maintain and transmit such heritage, and to involve them actively in its management.

Query_Text_cn: 一、为了扩大非物质文化遗产的影响，提高对其重要意义的认识和从尊重文化多样性的角度促进对话，委员会应该根据有关缔约国的提名编辑、更新和公布人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。
Translation: I. In order to enhance the visibility of intangible cultural heritage, raise awareness of its significance, and foster dialogue that respects cultural diversity, the Committee shall compile, update, and publish the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity based on nominations submitted by the relevant States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、委员会拟订有关编辑、更新和公布此代表作名录的标准并提交大会批准。
Translation: II. The Committee shall formulate criteria for the compilation, updating, and publication of this Representative List and submit them to the General Assembly for approval.

Query_Text_cn: 一、为了采取适当的保护措施，委员会编辑、更新和公布急需保护的非物质文化遗产名录，并根据有关缔约国的要求将此类遗产列入该名录。
Translation: 1. To implement appropriate safeguarding measures, the Committee compiles, updates, and publishes the List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in Need of Urgent Safeguarding. It includes such heritage on this List upon the request of the concerned State Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、委员会拟订有关编辑、更新和公布此名录的标准并提交大会批准。
Translation: II. The Committee shall formulate standards for the compilation, updating and publication of this list and submit them to the General Assembly for approval.

Query_Text_cn: 三、委员会在极其紧急的情况(其具体标准由大会根据委员会的建议加以批准)下，可与有关缔约国协商将有关的遗产列入第一款所提之名录。
Translation: III. In cases of extreme urgency (the specific criteria for which shall be approved by the General Assembly upon the Committee's recommendation), the Committee may consult with the concerned State Party to inscribe the relevant heritage on the list mentioned in paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在缔约国提名的基础上，委员会根据其制定的、大会批准的标准，兼顾发展中国家的特殊需要，定期遴选并宣传其认为最能体现本公约原则和目标的国家、分地区或地区保护非物质文化遗产的计划、项目和活动。
Translation: On the basis of nominations by States Parties, the Committee shall select periodically, in conformity with criteria it has established and that have been approved by the General Assembly, and publicize national, subregional and regional programmes, projects and activities for the safeguarding of the heritage which it considers best reflect the principles and objectives of this Convention, taking into account the special needs of developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 二、为此，委员会接受、审议和批准缔约国提交的关于要求国际援助拟订此类提名的申请。
Translation: II. To this end, the Committee accepts, examines and approves applications submitted by States Parties requesting international assistance for the preparation of such nominations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、委员会按照它确定的方式，配合这些计划、项目和活动的实施，随时推广有关经验。
Translation: III. The Committee shall, in the manner it determines, facilitate the implementation of these plans, projects, and activities, and promptly disseminate relevant experiences.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本公约中，国际合作主要是交流信息和经验，采取共同的行动，以及建立援助缔约国保护非物质文化遗产工作的机制。
Translation: I. For the purposes of this Convention, international cooperation includes, inter alia, the exchange of information and experience, joint initiatives, and the establishment of a mechanism of assistance to States Parties in their efforts to safeguard the intangible cultural heritage.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在不违背国家法律规定及其习惯法和习俗的情况下，缔约国承认保护非物质文化遗产符合人类的整体利益，保证为此目的在双边、分地区、地区和国际各级开展合作。
Translation: II. The Contracting Parties recognize that the safeguarding of intangible cultural heritage is in the interest of humanity as a whole, provided it does not contravene national laws, customary law, or traditions. They undertake to cooperate for this purpose at the bilateral, subregional, regional, and international levels.

Query_Text_cn: (四)委员会认为必要的其他一切目的。
Translation: (iv) any other purposes deemed necessary by the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: (七)其它财政和技术援助形式，包括在必要时提供低息贷款和捐助。
Translation: (vii) Other forms of financial and technical assistance, including the provision of low-interest loans and grants when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 一、委员会确定审议国际援助申请的程序和具体规定申请的内容，包括打算采取的措施、必需开展的工作及预计的费用。
Translation: 1. The Committee shall establish procedures and specific requirements for reviewing international assistance applications, including the intended measures, necessary work to be undertaken, and estimated costs.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如遇紧急情况，委员会应对有关援助申请优先审议。
Translation: II. In the event of an emergency, the Committee shall prioritize the review of relevant assistance applications.

Query_Text_cn: 三、委员会在作出决定之前，应进行其认为必要的研究和咨询。
Translation: III. Before making a decision, the Committee shall conduct such studies and consultations as it deems necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 一、各缔约国可向委员会递交国际援助的申请，保护在其领土上的非物质文化遗产。
Translation: 1. Each State Party may submit to the Committee requests for international assistance aimed at safeguarding the intangible cultural heritage present in its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 二、此类申请亦可由两个或数个缔约国共同提出。
Translation: II. Such a request may also be jointly submitted by two or several Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 三、申请应包含第二十二条第一款规定的所有资料和所有必要的文件。
Translation: III. The application shall include all materials specified in the first paragraph of Article 22 and all necessary documents.

Query_Text_cn: 一、根据本公约的规定，国际援助应依据受援缔约国与委员会之间签署的协定来提供。
Translation: 1. International assistance under this Convention shall be provided in accordance with the agreement concluded between the requesting State Party and the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 二、受援缔约国通常应在自己力所能及的范围内分担国际所援助的保护措施的费用。
Translation: II. The recipient State Party shall, as a rule, bear a share of the costs of the protection measures for which international assistance is provided, to the extent of its own resources.

Query_Text_cn: 三、受援缔约国应向委员会报告关于使用所提供的保护非物质文化遗产援助的情况。
Translation: III. The recipient State Party shall report to the Committee on the utilization of the assistance provided for safeguarding intangible cultural heritage.

Query_Text_cn: 一、兹建立一项“保护非物质文化遗产基金”，下称“基金”。
Translation: 1. A "Fund for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage," hereinafter referred to as "the Fund," is hereby established.

Query_Text_cn: 二、根据教科文组织《财务条例》的规定，此项基金为信托基金。
Translation: II. In accordance with the provisions of the UNESCO Financial Regulations, this fund is established as a trust fund.

Query_Text_cn: 3．公营或私营机构和个人。
Translation: 3. Public or private institutions and individuals.

Query_Text_cn: (六)委员会制定的基金条例所许可的所有其它资金。
Translation: (6) All other funds as permitted by the fund regulations formulated by the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 四、委员会对资金的使用视大会的方针来决定。
Translation: IV. The Committee shall determine the use of funds in accordance with the guidelines set by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 五、委员会可接受用于某些项目的一般或特定目的的捐款及其它形式的援助，只要这些项目已获委员会的批准。
Translation: V. The Committee may accept general or special-purpose contributions and other forms of assistance for projects approved by it.

Query_Text_cn: 六、对基金的捐款不得附带任何与本公约所追求之目标不相符的政治、经济或其它条件。
Translation: VI. Contributions to the Fund shall not be subject to any political, economic or other conditions incompatible with the objectives pursued by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在不妨碍任何自愿补充捐款的情况下，本公约缔约国至少每两年向基金纳一次款，其金额由大会根据适用于所有国家的统一的纳款额百分比加以确定。
Translation: 1. Without prejudice to any voluntary supplementary contributions, States Parties to this Convention shall contribute to the Fund at least once every two years, with the amount determined by the Conference based on a uniform percentage applicable to all countries.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国大会关于此问题的决定由出席会议并参加表决，但未作本条第二款中所述声明的缔约国的多数通过。
Translation: Decisions of the Meeting of the Parties on this matter shall be adopted by a majority of the Parties present and voting that have not made the declaration referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，此纳款都不得超过缔约国对教科文组织正常预算纳款的百分之一。
Translation: In no case shall this contribution exceed one percent of the Contracting State's contribution to the regular budget of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 二、但是，本公约第三十二条或第三十三条中所指的任何国家均可在交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时声明不受本条第一款规定的约束。
Translation: II. However, any State referred to in Article 32 or Article 33 may, at the time of deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, declare that it does not consider itself bound by the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 三、已作本条第二款所述声明的本公约缔约国应努力通知联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事收回所作声明。
Translation: III. Any State Party to this Convention that has made a declaration under paragraph 2 of this Article shall endeavor to notify the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization of the withdrawal of such declaration.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，收回声明之举不得影响该国在紧接着的下一届大会开幕之日前应缴的纳款。
Translation: However, the withdrawal of the declaration shall not affect the contributions due from that country until the opening of the next ordinary session of the Conference following the date of the withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 四、为使委员会能够有效地规划其工作，已作本条第二款所述声明的本公约缔约国至少应每两年定期纳一次款，纳款额应尽可能接近它们按本条第一款规定应交的数额。
Translation: IV. In order to enable the Committee to plan its work effectively, contributions under paragraph 2 of this Article shall be paid on a regular basis, at least every two years, and should be as close as possible to the full amount assessed under paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 五、凡拖欠当年和前一日历年的义务纳款或自愿捐款的本公约缔约国不能当选为委员会委员，但此项规定不适用于第一次选举。
Translation: 5. No State Party to this Convention shall be eligible to be elected as a member of the Committee if it is in arrears in the payment of its compulsory contribution or voluntary donation for the current year and the previous calendar year(s). However, this provision shall not apply to the first election.

Query_Text_cn: 已当选为委员会委员的缔约国的任期应在本公约第六条规定的选举之时终止。
Translation: The term of office of a State Party already elected as a member of the Committee shall terminate at the time of the elections provided for in Article 6 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条基金的自愿补充捐款除了第二十六条所规定的纳款，希望提供自愿捐款的缔约国应及时通知委员会以使其能对相应的活动作出规划。
Translation:
Article 27 Voluntary supplementary contributions to the Fund  
In addition to the contributions specified in Article 26, Contracting Parties wishing to make voluntary contributions shall promptly inform the Committee to enable it to plan corresponding activities accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条国际筹资运动缔约国应尽力支持在教科文组织领导下为该基金发起的国际筹资运动。
Translation:
Article 28 International Fundraising Campaign  

States Parties shall endeavor to support international fundraising campaigns launched for the Fund under the auspices of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条缔约国的报告缔约国应按照委员会确定的方式和周期向其报告它们为实施本公约而通过的法律、规章条例或采取的其它措施的情况。
Translation:
Article 29 Reports by States Parties  
States Parties shall report to the Committee on the legislative, regulatory, or other measures they have adopted to implement this Convention, in the manner and at intervals determined by the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 一、委员会应在其开展的活动和第二十九条提及的缔约国报告的基础上，向每届大会提交报告。
Translation: 1. The Committee shall submit a report to each session of the Conference, based on its activities and the reports of States Parties referred to in Article 29.

Query_Text_cn: 二、该报告应提交教科文组织大会。
Translation: II. The report shall be submitted to the General Conference of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 一、委员会应把在本公约生效前宣布为“人类口头和非物质遗产代表作”的遗产纳入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。
Translation: 1. The Committee shall incorporate in the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity the items proclaimed "Masterpieces of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity" before the entry into force of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、把这些遗产纳入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录绝不是预设按第十六条第二款将确定的今后列入遗产的标准。
Translation: II. The inclusion of these heritages in the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity does not in any way pre-establish criteria for future inscriptions under paragraph 2 of Article 16.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在本公约生效后，将不再宣布其它任何人类口头和非物质遗产代表作。
Translation: III. No other Masterpieces of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity shall be proclaimed after the entry into force of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约须由教科文组织会员国根据各自的宪法程序予以批准、接受或核准。
Translation: 1. This Convention shall be subject to ratification, acceptance or approval by Member States of UNESCO in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 二、批准书、接受书或核准书应交存教科文组织总干事。
Translation: II. Instruments of ratification, acceptance or approval shall be deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 一、所有非教科文组织会员国的国家，经本组织大会邀请，均可加入本公约。
Translation: 1. Any State not a member of UNESCO may accede to this Convention upon invitation by the General Conference of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 二、没有完全独立，但根据联合国大会第1514(XV)号决议被联合国承认为充分享有内部自治，并且有权处理本公约范围内的事宜，包括有权就这些事宜签署协议的地区也可加入本公约。
Translation: II. Territories that are not fully independent but have been recognized by the United Nations under General Assembly Resolution 1514(XV) as enjoying full internal self-government, and are competent in matters covered by this Convention, including the authority to enter into agreements on such matters, may also accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 三、加入书应交存教科文组织总干事。
Translation: III. Instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条生效本公约在第三十份批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书交存之日起的三个月后生效，但只涉及在该日或该日之前交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书的国家。
Translation:
Article 34 Entry into Force  
This Convention shall enter into force three months after the date of deposit of the thirtieth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, but only with respect to States that have deposited their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession on or before that date.

Query_Text_cn: 对其它缔约国来说，本公约则在这些国家的批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书交存之日起的三个月之后生效。
Translation: For other Contracting States, this Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在构成联邦，但按照联邦立宪制无须采取立法手段的各个州、成员国、省或行政区的法律管辖下实施本公约的各项条款时，联邦政府应将这些条款连同其建议一并通知各个州、成员国、省或行政区的主管当局。
Translation: (2) In the case of a federal State, where the implementation of the provisions of this Convention falls under the jurisdiction of individual states, members, provinces, or administrative regions not required by the federal constitutional system to take legislative measures, the federal government shall communicate these provisions, along with its recommendations, to the competent authorities of the respective states, members, provinces, or administrative regions.

Query_Text_cn: 一、各缔约国均可宣布退出本公约。
Translation: 1. Any State Party may declare its withdrawal from the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、退约应以书面退约书的形式通知教科文组织总干事。
Translation: II. Withdrawal shall be effected by written notification addressed to the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 3.退约在收到退约通知书后十二个月生效。
Translation: 3. The withdrawal shall take effect twelve months after the receipt of the notification of withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 在退约生效日之前不得影响退约国承担的财政义务。
Translation: The financial obligations of the withdrawing state shall not be affected prior to the effective date of withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条保管人的职责教科文组织总干事作为本公约的保管人，应将第三十二条和第三十三条规定交存的所有批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书和第三十六条规定的退约书的情况通告本组织各会员国、第三十三条提到的非本组织会员国的国家和联合国。
Translation:
Article 37 Functions of the Depositary  
The Director-General of UNESCO, as the depositary of this Convention, shall notify all Member States of the Organization, the non-member States referred to in Article 33, and the United Nations of the deposit of all instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession provided for in Articles 32 and 33, and of any notifications of withdrawal specified in Article 36.

Query_Text_cn: 一、任何缔约国均可书面通知总干事，对本公约提出修订建议。
Translation: 1. Any Contracting State may propose amendments to this Convention by written notification to the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: 总干事应将此通知转发给所有缔约国。
Translation: The Director-General shall transmit this notification to all States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如在通知发出之日起六个月之内，至少有一半的缔约国回复赞成此要求，总干事应将此建议提交下一届大会讨论，决定是否通过。
Translation: If, within six months from the date of the notification, at least half of the Contracting Parties respond favorably to the request, the Director-General shall submit the proposal to the next session of the Assembly for discussion and decision on its adoption.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对本公约的修订须经出席并参加表决的缔约国三分之二多数票通过。
Translation: II. Any amendment to this Convention shall require a two-thirds majority vote of the States Parties present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对本公约的修订一旦通过，应提交缔约国批准、接受、核准或加入。
Translation: III. Any amendment to this Convention, once adopted, shall be submitted to the States Parties for ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对于那些已批准、接受、核准或加入修订的缔约国来说，本公约的修订在三分之二的缔约国交存本条第三款所提及的文书之日起三个月之后生效。
Translation: IV. For those States Parties that have ratified, accepted, approved or acceded to the amendment, the amendment to this Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of the instruments referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article by two thirds of the States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，对任何批准、接受、核准或加入修订的缔约国来说，在其交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日起三个月之后，本公约的修订即生效。
Translation: Thereafter, the amendment shall enter into force for any State that ratifies, accepts, approves or accedes to it three months after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 五、第三款和第四款所确定的程序对有关委员会委员国数目的第五条的修订不适用。
Translation: V. The procedures set forth in paragraphs 3 and 4 shall not apply to amendments to Article 5 regarding the number of members of the Committee concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 此类修订一经通过即生效。
Translation: Such revisions shall take effect immediately upon adoption.

Query_Text_cn: (二)但在与不受这些修订约束的任何缔约国的关系中，仍被视为未经修订之公约的缔约方。
Translation: (2) However, in its relations with any Contracting Party not bound by these amendments, it shall be considered as a Contracting Party to the unamended Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条有效文本本公约用英文、阿拉伯文、中文、西班牙文、法文和俄文拟定，六种文本具有同等效力。
Translation:
Article 39 Authentic Texts  
This Convention is drawn up in English, Arabic, Chinese, Spanish, French, and Russian, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条登记根据《联合国宪章》第一百零二条的规定，本公约应按教科文组织总干事的要求交联合国秘书处登记。
Translation:
Article 40 Registration  

In accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations, this Convention shall be registered with the Secretariat of the United Nations at the request of the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 保护和促进文化表现形式多样性公约（2005年10月20日联合国教育、科学及文化组织第三十三届会议通过2007年1月30日，中国常驻联合国教科文组织代表团向联合国教科文组织递交了批准书，《公约》将于2007年4月30日对中国生效。
Translation: Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions (Adopted at the 33rd Session of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization on October 20, 2005. On January 30, 2007, the Permanent Delegation of China to UNESCO submitted the instrument of ratification to UNESCO, and the Convention will enter into force for China on April 30, 2007.)

Query_Text_cn: （二十一）根据联合国教科文组织通过的有关文化多样性和行使文化权利的各种国际文书的条款，特别是2001年通过的《世界文化多样性宣言》，于2005年10月20日通过本公约。
Translation: (XXI) Adopts this Convention on 20 October 2005, in accordance with the provisions of the relevant international instruments adopted by UNESCO concerning cultural diversity and the exercise of cultural rights, in particular the Universal Declaration on Cultural Diversity of 2001.

Query_Text_cn: （九）本着伙伴精神，加强国际合作与团结，特别是要提高发展中国家保护和促进文化表现形式多样性的能力。
Translation: (9) Strengthen international cooperation and solidarity in the spirit of partnership, particularly by enhancing the capacity of developing countries to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: 一、尊重人权和基本自由原则只有确保人权，以及表达、信息和交流等基本自由，并确保个人可以选择文化表现形式，才能保护和促进文化多样性。
Translation:
I. Respect for Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms  
The protection and promotion of cultural diversity can only be ensured by upholding human rights and fundamental freedoms such as expression, information, and communication, as well as by guaranteeing individuals the freedom to choose cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: 任何人都不得援引本公约的规定侵犯《世界人权宣言》规定的或受到国际法保障的人权和基本自由或限制其适用范围。
Translation: No one may invoke the provisions of this Convention to infringe upon the human rights and fundamental freedoms set forth in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights or guaranteed by international law, or to limit their scope of application.

Query_Text_cn: 二、主权原则根据《联合国宪章》和国际法原则，各国拥有在其境内采取保护和促进文化表现形式多样性措施和政策的主权。
Translation:
II. Principle of Sovereignty  
In accordance with the Charter of the United Nations and the principles of international law, all states possess the sovereign right to adopt measures and policies within their territories to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: 三、所有文化同等尊严和尊重原则保护与促进文化表现形式多样性的前提是承认所有文化，包括少数民族和原住民的文化在内，具有同等尊严，并应受到同等尊重。
Translation:
III. The Principle of Equal Dignity and Respect for All Cultures  
The protection and promotion of the diversity of cultural expressions presuppose the recognition of equal dignity and respect for all cultures, including those of minorities and indigenous peoples.

Query_Text_cn: 四、国际团结与合作原则国际合作与团结的目的应当是使各个国家，尤其是发展中国家都有能力在地方、国家和国际层面上创建和加强其文化表现手段，包括其新兴的或成熟的文化产业。
Translation:
IV. Principle of International Solidarity and Cooperation  
The objective of international cooperation and solidarity should be to enable all countries, especially developing ones, to create and strengthen their means of cultural expression at local, national, and international levels, including their emerging or established cultural industries.

Query_Text_cn: 五、经济和文化发展互补原则文化是发展的主要推动力之一，所以文化的发展与经济的发展同样重要，且所有个人和民族都有权参与两者的发展并从中获益。
Translation:
V. The Principle of Complementary Economic and Cultural Development  
Culture is one of the primary drivers of development. Therefore, cultural development is as vital as economic growth, and all individuals and peoples have the right to participate in and benefit from both.

Query_Text_cn: 六、可持续发展原则文化多样性是个人和社会的一种财富。
Translation:
VI. The Principle of Sustainable Development  
Cultural diversity is an asset for both individuals and societies.

Query_Text_cn: 保护、促进和维护文化多样性是当代和后代的可持续发展的一项基本要求。
Translation: The protection, promotion and preservation of cultural diversity are essential requirements for sustainable development for both present and future generations.

Query_Text_cn: 七、平等享有原则平等享有全世界丰富多样的文化表现形式，所有文化享有各种表现形式和传播手段，是增进文化多样性和促进相互理解的要素。
Translation:
VII. Principle of Equal Enjoyment  
Equal access to the world's rich and diverse cultural expressions, with all cultures enjoying various forms of representation and means of dissemination, is essential for enhancing cultural diversity and fostering mutual understanding.

Query_Text_cn: 八、开放和平衡原则在采取措施维护文化表现形式多样性时，各国应寻求以适当的方式促进向世界其他文化开放，并确保这些措施符合本公约的目标。
Translation:
VIII. Principle of openness and balance  
When adopting measures to protect the diversity of cultural expressions, States shall endeavor to promote openness to other cultures of the world in an appropriate manner and ensure that such measures are in conformity with the objectives of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条公约的适用范围本公约适用于缔约方采取的有关保护和促进文化表现形式多样性的政策和措施。
Translation:
Article 3 Scope of Application  
This Convention applies to the policies and measures adopted by the Parties concerning the protection and promotion of the diversity of cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: （一）文化多样性。__UNDEF__“文化多样性”指各群体和社会借以表现其文化的多种不同形式。
Translation: (I) Cultural diversity. __UNDEF__ "Cultural diversity" refers to the manifold ways in which the cultures of groups and societies find expression.

Query_Text_cn: 这些表现形式在他们内部及其间传承。
Translation: These manifestations are passed down within and among them.

Query_Text_cn: 文化多样性不仅体现在人类文化遗产通过丰富多彩的文化表现形式来表达、弘扬和传承的多种方式，也体现在借助各种方式和技术进行的艺术创造、生产、传播、销售和消费的多种方式。
Translation: Cultural diversity is manifested not only in the diverse ways in which humanity's cultural heritage is expressed, enhanced and transmitted through a variety of cultural expressions, but also in the diverse modes of artistic creation, production, dissemination, distribution and consumption, regardless of the means and technologies used.

Query_Text_cn: （二）文化内容。__UNDEF__“文化内容”指源于文化特征或表现文化特征的象征意义、艺术特色和文化价值。
Translation: (2) Cultural Content. __UNDEF__ "Cultural Content" refers to symbolic meanings, artistic features, and cultural values that originate from or express cultural characteristics.

Query_Text_cn: （三）文化表现形式。__UNDEF__“文化表现形式”指个人、群体和社会创造的具有文化内容的表现形式。
Translation: (3) Cultural expressions. "Cultural expressions" refer to manifestations created by individuals, groups, and societies that bear cultural content.

Query_Text_cn: （四）文化活动、产品与服务。__UNDEF__“文化活动、产品与服务”是指从其具有的特殊属性、用途或目的考虑时，体现或传达文化表现形式的活动、产品与服务，无论他们是否具有商业价值。
Translation:
4) Cultural activities, goods and services.  
"Cultural activities, goods and services" refers to activities, goods, and services that, when considered from the perspective of their special attributes, uses, or purposes, embody or convey cultural expressions, regardless of whether they have commercial value.

Query_Text_cn: 文化活动可能以自身为目的，也可能是为文化产品与服务的生产提供帮助。
Translation: Cultural activities may serve as ends in themselves or as means to facilitate the production of cultural goods and services.

Query_Text_cn: （五）文化产业。__UNDEF__“文化产业”指生产和销售上述第（四）项所述的文化产品或服务的产业。
Translation: (V) Cultural Industries. __UNDEF__ "Cultural industries" refers to industries that produce and distribute cultural products or services as mentioned in item (IV) above.

Query_Text_cn: （六）文化政策和措施。__UNDEF__“文化政策和措施”指地方、国家、区域或国际层面上针对文化本身或为了对个人、群体或社会的文化表现形式产生直接影响的各项政策和措施，包括与创作、生产、传播、销售和享有文化活动、产品与服务相关的政策和措施。
Translation: (VI) Cultural policies and measures. __UNDEF__ "Cultural policies and measures" refer to policies and measures at the local, national, regional, or international levels that are either focused on culture as such or designed to have a direct impact on the cultural expressions of individuals, groups, or societies. These include policies and measures related to the creation, production, dissemination, distribution of, and access to cultural activities, goods, and services.

Query_Text_cn: （七）保护。__UNDEF__名词“保护”意指为保存、卫护和加强文化表现形式多样性而采取措施。
Translation:
(7) Protection.  
__UNDEF__The noun "protection" means taking measures to preserve, safeguard, and enhance the diversity of cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: 动词“保护”意指采取这类措施。
Translation: The verb "to protect" means to take such measures.

Query_Text_cn: （八）文化间性。__UNDEF__“文化间性”指不同文化的存在与平等互动，以及通过对话和相互尊重产生共同文化表现形式的可能性。
Translation: (VIII) Cultural Interality. __UNDEF__ "Cultural interality" refers to the existence and equal interaction of different cultures, as well as the possibility of generating shared cultural expressions through dialogue and mutual respect.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约方根据《联合国宪章》、国际法原则及国际公认的人权文书，重申拥有为实现本公约的宗旨而制定和实施其文化政策、采取措施以保护和促进文化表现形式多样性及加强国际合作的主权。
Translation: I. The Parties, in conformity with the Charter of the United Nations, the principles of international law and universally recognized human rights instruments, reaffirm their sovereign right to formulate and implement their cultural policies and to adopt measures to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions and to strengthen international cooperation to achieve the purposes of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、当缔约方在其境内实施政策和采取措施以保护和促进文化表现形式的多样性时，这些政策和措施应与本公约的规定相符。
Translation: II. When a Party implements policies and adopts measures to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions within its territory, such policies and measures shall be consistent with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 一、各缔约方可在第四条第（六）项所定义的文化政策和措施范围内，根据自身的特殊情况和需求，在其境内采取措施保护和促进文化表现形式的多样性。
Translation: 1. The Parties may, within the framework of their cultural policies and measures as defined in Article 4(6), adopt measures aimed at protecting and promoting the diversity of cultural expressions within their territory, taking into account their own particular circumstances and needs.

Query_Text_cn: （八）旨在加强媒体多样性的措施，包括运用公共广播服务。
Translation: (8) Measures aimed at enhancing media diversity, including the use of public broadcasting services.

Query_Text_cn: （二）获取本国境内及世界其他国家的各种不同的文化表现形式。
Translation: (2) Access to diverse cultural expressions within the country and in other parts of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约方还应努力承认艺术家、参与创作活动的其他人员、文化界以及支持他们工作的有关组织的重要贡献，以及他们在培育文化表现形式多样性方面的核心作用。
Translation: 2. The Parties shall also endeavor to recognize the essential contribution of artists, other persons involved in the creative process, cultural communities, and relevant organizations supporting their work, as well as their central role in nurturing the diversity of cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在不影响第五条和第六条规定的前提下，缔约一方可以确定其领土上哪些文化表现形式属于面临消亡危险、受到严重威胁、或是需要紧急保护的情况。
Translation: 1. Without prejudice to the provisions of Articles 5 and 6, a Party may determine the existence of special situations where cultural expressions on its territory are at risk of extinction, under serious threat, or otherwise in need of urgent safeguarding.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约方可通过与本公约的规定相符的方式，采取一切恰当的措施保护处于第一款所述情况下的文化表现形式。
Translation: II. The Parties may adopt all appropriate measures to protect cultural expressions in the situations referred to in paragraph 1, in a manner consistent with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约方应向政府间委员会报告为应对这类紧急情况所采取的所有措施，该委员会则可以对此提出合适的建议。
Translation: 3. The Parties shall report all measures taken to address such emergencies to the Intergovernmental Committee, which may then provide appropriate recommendations thereon.

Query_Text_cn: （三）共享和交流有关保护和促进文化表现形式多样性的信息。
Translation: (3) Sharing and exchanging information on the protection and promotion of the diversity of cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: （三）通过制定文化产业方面的教育、培训和交流计划，致力于鼓励创作和提高生产能力，但所采取的措施不能对传统生产形式产生负面影响。
Translation: (3) By formulating education, training and exchange programs in the cultural industry, efforts shall be made to encourage creation and enhance production capacity, provided that the measures taken do not negatively impact traditional forms of production.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条公民社会的参与缔约方承认公民社会在保护和促进文化表现形式多样性方面的重要作用。
Translation:
Article 11 Participation of Civil Society  
The Parties recognize the essential role of civil society in protecting and promoting the diversity of cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方应鼓励公民社会积极参与其为实现本公约各项目标所作的努力。
Translation: Parties shall encourage the active participation of civil society in their efforts to achieve the objectives of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （五）鼓励缔结共同生产和共同销售的协定。
Translation: (v) Encourage the conclusion of agreements for joint production and joint marketing.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条将文化纳入可持续发展缔约方应致力于将文化纳入其各级发展政策，创造有利于可持续发展的条件，并在此框架内完善与保护和促进文化表现形式多样性相关的各个环节。
Translation:
Article 13  
Integrating Culture into Sustainable Development  

Parties shall endeavor to integrate culture into their development policies at all levels, creating conditions conducive to sustainable development. Within this framework, they shall enhance all aspects related to the protection and promotion of the diversity of cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: 6.鼓励发达国家与发展中国家之间开展适当的协作，特别是在音乐和电影领域。
Translation: 6. Encourage appropriate collaboration between developed and developing countries, particularly in the fields of music and film.

Query_Text_cn: （二）通过在发展中国家开展信息、经验和专业知识交流以及人力资源培训，加强公共和私人部门的能力建设，尤其是在战略管理能力、政策制定和实施、文化表现形式的促进和推广、中小企业和微型企业的发展、技术的应用及技能开发与转让等方面。
Translation: (2) Strengthen capacity-building in both public and private sectors in developing countries through the exchange of information, experience, and expertise, as well as human resources training, particularly in strategic management capabilities, policy formulation and implementation, the promotion and dissemination of cultural expressions, the development of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and micro-enterprises, the application of technology, and skills development and transfer.

Query_Text_cn: （三）通过采取适当的鼓励措施来推动技术和专门知识的转让，尤其是在文化产业和文化企业领域。
Translation: (3) Promote the transfer of technology and expertise by adopting appropriate incentive measures, particularly in the cultural industries and cultural enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 3.提供其他形式的财政援助，比如提供低息贷款、赠款以及其它资金机制。
Translation: 3. Provide other forms of financial assistance, such as low-interest loans, grants, and other funding mechanisms.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条协作安排缔约方应鼓励在公共、私人部门和非营利组织之间及其内部发展伙伴关系，以便与发展中国家合作，增强他们在保护和促进文化表现形式多样性方面的能力。
Translation:
Article 15 Collaborative Arrangements  
The Parties shall encourage the development of partnerships among and within the public, private and non-profit sectors, in cooperation with developing countries, to enhance their capacities to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions.

Query_Text_cn: 这类新型伙伴关系应根据发展中国家的实际需求，注重基础设施建设、人力资源开发和政策制定，以及文化活动、产品与服务的交流。
Translation: Such new partnerships should focus on infrastructure construction, human resources development, policy formulation, as well as cultural activities and exchanges of products and services, in line with the actual needs of developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条对发展中国家的优惠待遇发达国家应通过适当的机构和法律框架，为发展中国家的艺术家和其他文化专业人员及从业人员，以及那里的文化产品和文化服务提供优惠待遇，促进与这些国家的文化交流。
Translation:
Article 16 Preferential Treatment for Developing Countries  
Developed countries shall provide preferential treatment through appropriate institutions and legal frameworks to artists, other cultural professionals and practitioners, as well as cultural goods and services from developing countries, so as to promote cultural exchanges with these nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条在文化表现形式受到严重威胁情况下的国际合作在第八条所述情况下，缔约方应开展合作，相互提供援助，特别要援助发展中国家。
Translation:
Article 17 International Cooperation in Situations of Serious Threat to Cultural Expressions  
In the circumstances referred to in Article 8, the Parties shall cooperate by providing assistance to each other, particularly to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 一、兹建立“文化多样性国际基金”（以下简称基金）。
Translation: I. The International Fund for Cultural Diversity (hereinafter referred to as "the Fund") is hereby established.

Query_Text_cn: （六）基金条例许可的所有其他资金来源。
Translation: (6) All other sources of funding permitted under the Fund Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 四、政府间委员会应根据缔约方大会确定的指导方针决定基金资金的使用。
Translation: IV. The Intergovernmental Committee shall determine the use of the Fund's resources in accordance with the guidelines established by the Conference of the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 五、对已获政府间委员会批准的具体项目，政府间委员会可以接受为实现这些项目的整体目标或具体目标而提供的捐款及其他形式的援助。
Translation: V. For specific projects already approved by the Intergovernmental Committee, the Committee may accept donations and other forms of assistance aimed at achieving the overall or specific objectives of these projects.

Query_Text_cn: 六、捐赠不得附带任何与本公约目标不相符的政治、经济或其他条件。
Translation: VI. Donations shall not be subject to any political, economic or other conditions incompatible with the objectives of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约方应努力定期为实施本公约提供自愿捐款。
Translation: 7. The Parties shall endeavor to provide voluntary contributions on a regular basis for the implementation of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约方同意，就有关文化表现形式多样性以及对其保护和促进方面的先进经验的数据收集和统计，开展信息交流和共享专业知识。
Translation: 1. The Parties agree to exchange information and share expertise on data collection and statistics concerning advanced practices related to the diversity of cultural expressions and their protection and promotion.

Query_Text_cn: 二、教科文组织应利用秘书处现有的机制，促进各种相关的信息、统计数据和先进经验的收集、分析和传播。
Translation: II. UNESCO should leverage the existing mechanisms of its Secretariat to facilitate the collection, analysis and dissemination of relevant information, statistical data and best practices.

Query_Text_cn: 三、教科文组织还应建立一个文化表现形式领域内各类部门和政府组织、私人及非营利组织的数据库，并更新其内容。
Translation: III. UNESCO should also establish a database covering various sectors, governmental organizations, private entities, and non-profit organizations in the field of cultural expressions, and regularly update its contents.

Query_Text_cn: 四、为了便于收集数据，教科文组织应特别重视申请援助的缔约方的能力建设和专业知识积累。
Translation: IV. To facilitate data collection, UNESCO shall place particular emphasis on capacity-building and the accumulation of expertise in the requesting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 五、本条涉及的信息收集应作为第九条规定的信息收集的补充。
Translation: V. The information collection involved in this Article shall serve as a supplement to that stipulated in Article IX.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约方承认，他们应善意履行其在本公约及其为缔约方的其他所有条约中的义务。
Translation: 1. The Parties recognize that they shall fulfill in good faith all their obligations under this Convention and all other treaties to which they are parties.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约方解释和实施其为缔约方的其他条约或承担其他国际义务时应考虑到本公约的相关规定。
Translation: (2) In interpreting and applying other treaties to which they are parties or other international obligations they have assumed, the Parties shall take into account the relevant provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约的任何规定不得解释为变更缔约方在其为缔约方的其他条约中的权利和义务。
Translation: 2. Nothing in this Convention shall be interpreted as altering the rights and obligations of the Parties under any other treaties to which they are parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条国际磋商与协调缔约方承诺在其他国际场合倡导本公约的宗旨和原则。
Translation:
Article 21 International Consultation and Coordination  
The Parties undertake to advocate the objectives and principles of this Convention in other international fora.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，缔约方在需要时应进行相互磋商，并牢记这些目标与原则。
Translation: To this end, the Parties shall consult with each other as necessary, bearing in mind these objectives and principles.

Query_Text_cn: 一、应设立一个缔约方大会。
Translation: I. A Conference of the Parties shall be established.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方大会应为本公约的全会和最高权力机构。
Translation: The Conference of the Parties shall be the plenary and supreme body of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约方大会全会每两年一次，尽可能与联合国教科文组织大会同期举行。
Translation: II. The Plenary Meeting of the Conference of the Parties shall be held every two years, as far as possible at the same time as the General Conference of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方大会作出决定，或政府间委员会收到至少三分之一缔约方的请求，缔约方大会可召开特别会议。
Translation: The Conference of the Parties may hold extraordinary sessions at its own discretion or upon the request of at least one third of the Parties submitted through the Intergovernmental Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约方大会应通过自己的议事规则。
Translation: 3. The Conference of the Parties shall adopt its own rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: （四）采取其认为有必要的其他措施来推进本公约的目标。
Translation: (d) Take any other measures it deems necessary to advance the objectives of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 一、应在联合国教科文组织内设立“保护与促进文化表现形式多样性政府间委员会”（以下简称政府间委员会）。
Translation: I. An Intergovernmental Committee for the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions (hereinafter referred to as the Intergovernmental Committee) shall be established within UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 政府间委员会由缔约方大会在本公约根据其第二十九条规定生效后选出的18个本公约缔约国的代表组成，任期四年。
Translation: The Intergovernmental Committee shall consist of representatives of 18 States Parties to this Convention, elected by the Conference of Parties for a term of four years after the Convention enters into force in accordance with its Article 29.

Query_Text_cn: 二、政府间委员会每年举行一次会议。
Translation: II. The Intergovernmental Committee shall meet once a year.

Query_Text_cn: 三、政府间委员会根据缔约方大会的授权和在其指导下运作并向其负责。
Translation: III. The Intergovernmental Committee shall operate under the authority and guidance of the Conference of the Parties, to which it is accountable.

Query_Text_cn: 四、一旦公约缔约方数目达到50个，政府间委员会的成员应增至24名。
Translation: IV. Once the number of Parties to the Convention reaches 50, the membership of the Intergovernmental Committee shall be increased to 24.

Query_Text_cn: 五、政府间委员会成员的选举应遵循公平的地理代表性以及轮换的原则。
Translation: V. The election of members of the Intergovernmental Committee shall be based on the principles of equitable geographical representation and rotation.

Query_Text_cn: （六）执行缔约方大会可能要求的其他任务。
Translation: (vi) Perform other tasks as may be required by the Conference of the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 七、政府间委员会根据其议事规则，可随时邀请公共或私人组织或个人参加就具体问题举行的磋商会议。
Translation: VII. The Intergovernmental Committee may, in accordance with its rules of procedure, invite public or private organizations or individuals to participate in consultation meetings on specific issues at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 八、政府间委员会应制定并提交缔约方大会核准自己的议事规则。
Translation: VIII. The Intergovernmental Committee shall establish and submit its own rules of procedure to the Conference of the Parties for approval.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国教科文组织秘书处应为本公约的有关机构提供协助。
Translation: I. The Secretariat of UNESCO shall provide assistance to the bodies concerned with this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、秘书处编制缔约方大会和政府间委员会的文件及其会议的议程，协助实施会议的决定，并报告缔约方大会决定的实施情况。
Translation: II. The Secretariat prepares documents for the Conference of the Parties and the Intergovernmental Committee,formulates agendas for their meetings,assists in implementing decisions made during these meetings,and reports on the implementation of decisions adopted by the Conference of the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、公约缔约方之间关于本公约的解释或实施产生的争端，应通过谈判寻求解决。
Translation: 1. Any dispute between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Convention shall be settled through negotiation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果有关各方不能通过谈判达成一致，可共同寻求第三方斡旋或要求第三方调停。
Translation: 2. If the parties concerned fail to reach an agreement through negotiations, they may jointly seek third-party mediation or request third-party conciliation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如果没有进行斡旋或调停，或者协商、斡旋或调停均未能解决争端，一方可根据本公约附件所列的程序要求调解。
Translation: III. If no conciliation or mediation has been conducted, or if consultations, conciliation, or mediation have failed to settle the dispute, either party may request mediation in accordance with the procedures set out in the Annex to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 相关各方应善意考虑调解委员会为解决争端提出的建议。
Translation: All parties concerned shall give good faith consideration to the recommendations for dispute settlement made by the conciliation commission.

Query_Text_cn: 四、任何缔约方均可在批准、接受、核准或加入本公约时，声明不承认上述调解程序。
Translation: IV. Any Contracting Party may, at the time of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession to this Convention, declare that it does not recognize the aforementioned conciliation procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 任何发表这一声明的缔约方，可随时通知教科文组织总干事，宣布撤回该声明。
Translation: Any Contracting Party that has made such a declaration may at any time notify the Director-General of UNESCO that it withdraws the declaration.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国教科文组织会员国依据各自的宪法程序批准、接受、核准或加入本公约。
Translation: 1. Member States of UNESCO shall approve, accept, ratify, or accede to this Convention in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 二、批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书应交联合国教科文组织总干事保存。
Translation: II. The instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession shall be deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 一、所有非联合国教科文组织会员国，但为联合国或其任何一个专门机构成员的国家，经联合国教科文组织大会邀请，均可加入本公约。
Translation: 1. Any State not a member of UNESCO but a member of the United Nations or of any of its specialized agencies may be invited to accede to this Convention by the General Conference of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 二、任何经联合国承认享有充分内部自治，并有权处理本公约范围内的事宜，包括有权就这些事宜签署协议，但按联合国大会第1514（XV）号决议没有完全独立的地区，也可以加入本公约。
Translation: II. Any territory which enjoys full internal self-government recognized by the United Nations and has competence over the matters governed by this Convention, including the authority to enter into agreements in respect thereof, but has not attained full independence in accordance with General Assembly resolution 1514 (XV), may also accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （二）如果这类组织的一个或数个成员国也是本公约的缔约国，该组织与这一或这些成员国应确定在履行公约规定的义务上各自承担的责任。__UNDEF__责任的分担应在完成第（三）项规定的书面通知程序后生效，该组织与成员国无权同时行使公约规定的权利。
Translation: (2) If one or more member states of such an organization are also parties to this Convention, the organization and the member state(s) concerned shall determine their respective responsibilities regarding the performance of obligations under the Convention. __UNDEF__ The allocation of responsibilities shall take effect after completing the written notification procedure specified in paragraph (3), and neither the organization nor its member states may concurrently exercise rights under the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，经济一体化组织在其权限范围内，行使与其参加本公约的成员国数目相同的表决权。
Translation: In addition, economic integration organizations shall exercise their right to vote within their spheres of competence with a number of votes equal to the number of their member states that are parties to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果其任何一个成员国行使其表决权，此类组织则不应行使表决权，反之亦然。
Translation: If any of its member states exercises its right to vote, such an organization shall not exercise the right to vote, and vice versa.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在各自承担的责任变更时，该经济一体化组织应将拟议的责任变更通知保管人，保管人应将此变更通报各缔约方。
Translation: 2. When there is a change in their respective responsibilities, the economic integration organization shall notify the depositary of the proposed change, and the depositary shall communicate this change to the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （四）已成为本公约缔约国的区域经济一体化组织的成员国在其没有明确声明或通知保管人将管辖权转给该组织的所有领域，应被推定为仍然享有管辖权。
Translation: (4) Member States of a regional economic integration organization that is a Party to this Convention shall be presumed to retain jurisdiction over all matters in respect of which they have not expressly declared or notified the depositary of the transfer of competence to the organization.

Query_Text_cn: （五）“区域经济一体化组织”，系指由作为联合国或其任何一个专门机构成员国的主权国家组成的组织，这些国家已将其在本公约所辖领域的权限转移给该组织，并且该组织已按其内部程序获得适当授权成为本公约的缔约方。
Translation: (v) "Regional economic integration organization" means an organization constituted by sovereign States members of the United Nations or of any of its specialized agencies to which those States have transferred competence in respect of matters governed by this Convention and which has been duly authorized, in accordance with its internal procedures, to become a Party to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 四、加入书应交存联合国教科文组织总干事处。
Translation: IV. Instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条联络点在成为本公约缔约方时，每一缔约方应指定第九条所述的联络点。
Translation:
Article 28  
Upon becoming a Party to this Convention, each Party shall designate the contact point referred to in Article 9.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约在第三十份批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书交存之日起的三个月后生效，但只针对在该日或该日之前交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书的国家或区域经济一体化组织。
Translation: 1. This Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of the thirtieth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, but only with respect to those States or regional economic integration organizations that have deposited their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession on or before that date.

Query_Text_cn: 对其他缔约方，本公约则在其批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书交存之日起的三个月之后生效。
Translation: For other Parties, this Convention shall enter into force three months after the date of deposit of their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 二、就本条而言，一个区域经济一体化组织交存的任何文书不得在该组织成员国已交存文书之外另行计算。
Translation: 2. For the purposes of this Article, any instrument deposited by a regional economic integration organization shall not be counted as additional to those deposited by its member States.

Query_Text_cn: （二）对于在构成联邦，但按照联邦立宪制无须采取立法手段的单位，如州、成员国、省或行政区的法律管辖下实施的本公约各项条款，联邦政府须将这些条款连同其关于采用这些条款的建议一并通知各个州、成员国、省或行政区等单位的主管当局。
Translation: (2) With respect to those articles of this Convention that come within the legislative jurisdiction of federal or non-unitary States Parties, the federal government shall bring such articles to the notice of the appropriate authorities of the constituent states, provinces, or cantons or other territorial entities of the federation, with a recommendation for their adoption.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约各缔约方均可宣布退出本公约。
Translation: 1. Any Party to this Convention may declare its withdrawal from the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、退约决定须以书面形式通知，有关文件交存联合国教科文组织总干事处。
Translation: II. The decision to withdraw shall be notified in writing, with the relevant documents deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 三、退约在收到退约书十二个月后开始生效。
Translation: III. Withdrawal shall take effect twelve months after receipt of the notification of withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 退约国在退约生效之前的财政义务不受任何影响。
Translation: The financial obligations of the withdrawing state prior to the withdrawal's effective date shall remain unaffected.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条保管职责联合国教科文组织总干事作为本公约的保管人，应将第二十六条和第二十七条规定的所有批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书和第三十一条规定的退约书的交存情况通告本组织各会员国、第二十七条提到的非会员国和区域经济一体化组织以及联合国。
Translation:
Article 32 Depositary Functions  
The Director-General of UNESCO, as the depositary of this Convention, shall notify all Member States of the Organization, the non-Member States and regional economic integration organizations referred to in Article 27, as well as the United Nations, of the deposit of all instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession specified in Articles 26 and 27, and of the notifications of withdrawal provided for in Article 31.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约缔约方可通过给总干事的书面函件，提出对本公约的修正。
Translation: 1. Any Party to this Convention may propose amendments to the Convention by written communication addressed to the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: 总干事应将此类函件周知全体缔约方。
Translation: The Director-General shall circulate such communications to all Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如果通知发出的六个月内对上述要求做出积极反应的成员国不少于半数，总干事则可将公约修正建议提交下一届缔约方大会进行讨论或通过。
Translation: If no fewer than half of the member states respond positively to the aforementioned requirements within six months of the notification, the Director-General may submit the proposed amendments to the Convention for discussion or adoption at the next Conference of the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对公约的修正须经出席并参加表决的缔约方三分之二多数票通过。
Translation: II. Amendments to the Convention shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority vote of the Parties present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对本公约的修正一旦获得通过，须交各缔约方批准、接受、核准或加入。
Translation: III. Any amendment to this Convention, once adopted, shall be submitted to all Parties for ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对于批准、接受、核准或加入修正案的缔约方来说，本公约修正案在三分之二的缔约方递交本条第三款所提及的文件之日起三个月后生效。
Translation: IV. For the Parties that have approved, accepted, ratified, or acceded to the amendment, the amendment to this Convention shall enter into force three months after the date on which two-thirds of the Parties have deposited the instruments referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，对任何批准、接受、核准或加入该公约修正案的缔约方来说，在其递交批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日起三个月之后，本公约修正案生效。
Translation: Thereafter, the amendment to this Convention shall enter into force three months after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession by any Party that has approved, accepted, approved or acceded to such amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 五、第三款及第四款所述程序不适用第二十三条所述政府间委员会成员国数目的修改。
Translation: V. The procedures set forth in paragraphs 3 and 4 shall not apply to amendments to the number of member States of the Intergovernmental Committee referred to in Article 23.

Query_Text_cn: （二）但在与不受修正案约束的任何缔约方的关系中，仍被视为未经修正的公约的缔约方。
Translation: (2) However, in relations with any Party not bound by the amendment, it shall be considered as a Party to the unamended Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条有效文本本公约用阿拉伯文、中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文制定，六种文本具有同等效力。
Translation:
Article 34 Authentic Texts  
This Convention is established in Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条登记根据《联合国宪章》第一百零二条的规定，本公约将应联合国教科文组织总干事的要求交联合国秘书处登记。
Translation:
Article 35 Registration  

In accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations, this Convention shall be registered with the Secretariat of the United Nations at the request of the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条调解委员会应争议一方的请求成立调解委员会。
Translation: Article 1 A conciliation committee shall be established upon the request of one of the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 除非各方另有约定，委员会应由5名成员组成，有关各方各指定其中2名，受指定的成员再共同选定1名主席。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed by the parties, the committee shall consist of five members, with each relevant party appointing two members, and the appointed members jointly selecting one chairperson.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条委员会成员如果争议当事方超过两方，利益一致的各方应共同协商指定代表自己的委员会成员。
Translation: Article 2 In cases where the disputing parties exceed two and certain parties share aligned interests, such parties shall jointly consult and designate committee members to represent them.

Query_Text_cn: 如果两方或更多方利益各不相同，或对是否拥有一致利益无法达成共识，则各方应分别指定代表自己的委员会成员。
Translation: If the interests of two or more parties differ,or if no consensus can be reached on whether they share common interests,each party shall separately designate committee members to represent itself.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条成员的任命在提出成立调解委员会请求之日起的两个月内，如果某一方未指定其委员会成员，联合国教科文组织总干事可在提出调解请求一方的要求下，在随后的两个月内做出任命。
Translation: If, within two months from the date of the request for the establishment of the conciliation commission, one of the parties has not made its appointment to the commission, the Director-General of UNESCO may, at the request of the other party, make such appointment within a further two-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条委员会主席如果调解委员会在最后一名成员获得任命后的两个月内未选定主席，联合国教科文组织总干事可在一方要求下，在随后的两个月内指定一位主席。
Translation:
Article 4 Chairperson of the Commission  
If the Conciliation Commission does not select a Chairperson within two months after the appointment of its last member, the Director-General of UNESCO may, at the request of either party, designate a Chairperson within the subsequent two-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条决定调解委员会根据其成员的多数表决票做出决定。
Translation: Article 5 Decisions of the mediation committee shall be made by a majority vote of its members.

Query_Text_cn: 除非争议各方另有约定，委员会应确定自己的议事规则。
Translation: Unless the parties to the dispute agree otherwise,the committee shall establish its own rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会应就解决争议提出建议，争议各方应善意考虑委员会提出的建议。
Translation: The Committee shall make recommendations for the resolution of disputes, and the parties concerned shall consider such recommendations in good faith.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条分歧对是否属于调解委员会的权限出现分歧时，由委员会作出决定。2005年12月9日订于巴黎，一式两份，均为正本，由联合国教科文组织大会第三十三届会议主席和联合国教科文组织总干事签署，并存放于联合国教科文组织的档案中，经核准的副本将分送第26条和27条提及的所有国家、地区和地区经济一体化组织以及联合国。
Translation:
Article 6 Disputes  
In case of disagreement as to whether the dispute falls within the competence of the Conciliation Commission, the Commission shall decide.  

Done in Paris on 9 December 2005, in duplicate in the authentic texts, signed by the President of the thirty-third session of the General Conference of UNESCO and by the Director-General of UNESCO, and deposited in the archives of UNESCO. Certified copies shall be transmitted to all the States, regions, and regional economic integration organizations referred to in Articles 26 and 27, as well as to the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 伯尔尼保护文学艺术作品公约（1886年9月9日于瑞士伯尔尼签订。1896年5月4日在巴黎补充完备，1908年11月13日在柏林修订，1914年3月20日在伯尔尼补充完备，1928年6月2日在罗马修订，1948年6月26日在布鲁塞尔修订，1967年7月14日在斯德哥尔摩修订，1971年7月24日在巴黎修订，1979年10月2日更改。1992年7月1日中华人民共和国全国人大常委会批准加入。声明根据附件第一条的规定，享有附件第二条和第三条规定的权利。本同盟各成员国，共同受到尽可能有效、尽可能一致地保护作者对其文学和艺术作品所享权利地愿望和鼓舞，承认一九六七年在斯德哥尔摩举行地修订会议工作的重要性，决定修订斯德哥尔摩会议通过的公约文本但不更动该公约文本第一至二十条和第二十二条至二十六条。
Translation: Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works (Signed in Berne, Switzerland, on September 9, 1886.
