Completed in Paris on May 4, 1896, revised in Berlin on November 13, 1908, completed in Berne on March 20, 1914, revised in Rome on June 2, 1928, revised in Brussels on June 26, 1948, revised in Stockholm on July 14, 1967, revised in Paris on July 24, 1971, and amended on October 2, 1979. Approved for accession by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China on July 1, 1992. A declaration was made to enjoy the rights provided in Articles 2 and 3 of the Appendix in accordance with the provisions of Article 1 of the Appendix.) The countries of the Union, being equally animated by the desire to protect, in as effective and uniform a manner as possible, the rights of authors in their literary and artistic works, recognizing the importance of the work of the Revision Conference held at Stockholm in 1967, have resolved to revise the Act adopted by the Stockholm Conference, while maintaining without change Articles 1 to 20 and 22 to 26 of that Act.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条适用本公约的国家为保护作者对其文学和艺术作品所享权利结成一个同盟。
Translation: The countries to which this Convention applies constitute a Union for the protection of the rights of authors in their literary and artistic works.

Query_Text_cn: 与地理、地形、建筑或科学有关的插图、地图、设计图、草图和立体作品。
Translation: Illustrations, maps, plans, sketches, and three-dimensional works related to geography, topography, architecture, or science.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本同盟各成员国得通过国内立法规定所有作品或任何特定种类得作品如果未以某种物质形式固定下来便不受保护。
Translation: 2. Each country of the Union may prescribe by domestic legislation that works in general or any specified categories of works shall not be protected unless they have been fixed in some material form.

Query_Text_cn: 3.翻译、改编、乐曲改编以及对文学或艺术作品得其他变动应得到与原作同等得保护，但不得损害原作得版权。
Translation: 3. Translations, adaptations, arrangements of music and other alterations of literary or artistic works shall be protected as original works without prejudice to the copyright in the original work.

Query_Text_cn: 4.本同盟各成员国对立法、行政或司法性质得官方文件以及这些文件得正式译本得保护由其国内立法确定。
Translation: 4. The protection of legislative, administrative or judicial official documents and their official translations in each member country of the Union shall be governed by its domestic legislation.

Query_Text_cn: 5.文学或艺术作品得汇编，诸如百科全书和选集，凡由于对材料得选择和编排而构成智力创作得，应得到相应得、但不损害汇编内每一作品得版权得保护。
Translation: 5. Compilations of literary or artistic works, such as encyclopedias and anthologies, which by reason of the selection and arrangement of their contents constitute intellectual creations, shall be protected as such, without prejudice to the copyright in each of the works forming part of such compilations.

Query_Text_cn: 6.本条所提到得作品在本同盟所有成员国内享受保护。次种保护系为作者及其权利继承人得利益而行使。
Translation: 6. The works referred to in this Article shall enjoy protection in all countries of the Union. Such protection shall be exercised for the benefit of the author and his successors in title.

Query_Text_cn: 7.在遵守本公约第七条第四款之规定得前提下，本同盟各成员国得通过国内立法规定其法律在何种程度上适用于实用艺术作品以及工业品平面和立体设计，以及此种作品和平面与立体设计受保护得条件。
Translation: 7. Subject to the provisions of Article 7(4) of this Convention, the countries of the Union may determine by domestic legislation the extent to which their laws shall apply to works of applied art and industrial designs and models, as well as the conditions under which such works, designs and models shall be protected.

Query_Text_cn: 但如在该国并不给予这种专门保护，则这些作品将作为艺术作品得到保护。
Translation: However, if such special protection is not granted in that country, these works shall be protected as artistic works.

Query_Text_cn: 8.本公约得保护不适用于日常新闻或纯属报刊消息性质得社会新闻。
Translation: 8. This Convention shall not apply to daily news or social news of a purely journalistic nature.

Query_Text_cn: 1.政治演说和诉讼过程中发言得言论是否全部或部分地排除于上条提供得保护之外，属于本同盟各成员国国内立法得范围。
Translation: 1. Whether political speeches and statements made in the course of legal proceedings are wholly or partially excluded from the protection provided by the preceding Article shall be a matter for legislation in each country of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 2.公开发表得讲课、演说或其他同类性质得作品，如为新闻报道得目的有此需要，在什么条件下可由报刊登载，进行广播或向公众传播，以及以第十一条之第一款得方式公开传播，也属于本同盟各成员国国内立法得范围。
Translation: 2. The conditions under which lectures, addresses, and other works of the same nature which are delivered in public may be reproduced by the press, broadcast, communicated to the public, or publicly disseminated in the manner provided for in Article 11(1), when such use is justified by the informatory purpose, shall be governed by the domestic legislation of the countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 3.然而，作者享有将上两款提到的作品汇编的专有权利。
Translation: 3. However, the author shall enjoy the exclusive right to compile the works referred to in the preceding two paragraphs.

Query_Text_cn: 2.非同盟任何成员国的国民但其惯常住所在一个成员国国内的作者，为实施本公约享有该成员国国民的待遇。
Translation: 2. Authors who are nationals of any country which is not a member of the Union but who have their habitual residence in a member country shall, for the purposes of this Convention, be treated in the same manner as nationals of that member country.

Query_Text_cn: 3."已出版作品”一词指得到作者同意后出版的作品，而不论其复制件的制作方式如何，只要从这部作品的性质来看，复制件的发行方式能满足公众的合理需要。戏剧、音乐戏剧或电影作品的表演，音乐作品的演奏，文学作品的公开朗诵，文学或艺术作品的有线传播或广播，美术作品的展出和建筑作品的建造不构成出版。
Translation: 3. The term "published works" refers to works that have been made available to the public with the consent of the author, regardless of the manner in which copies have been produced, provided that the availability of such copies is such as to satisfy the reasonable requirements of the public, given the nature of the work. The performance of a dramatic, musical or cinematographic work, the public recitation of a literary work, the communication by wire or the broadcasting of literary or artistic works, the exhibition of a work of art and the construction of an architectural work shall not constitute publication.

Query_Text_cn: 4.一个作品在首次出版后三十天内在两个或两个以上国家内出版，则该作品应视为同时在几个国家内出版。
Translation: 4. A work shall be considered as simultaneously published in several countries if it is published in two or more countries within thirty days after its first publication.

Query_Text_cn: (b)建造在本同盟某一成员国内的建筑作品或构成本同盟某一成员国内建筑物一部分的平面和立体艺术作品的作者。
Translation: (b) Authors of architectural works constructed in a member country of the Union or of artistic works incorporated in a building or other structure located in a member country of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 1.就享有本公约保护的作品而论，作者在作品起源国以外的本同盟成员国中享有各该国法律现在给予和今后可能给予其国民的权利，以及本公约特别授予的权利。
Translation: 1. In respect of works for which protection is conferred by this Convention, the author shall enjoy in countries of the Union other than the country of origin the rights which their respective laws now grant, or may hereafter grant, to their nationals, as well as the rights specially granted by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.享有和行使这些权利不需要履行任何手续，也不论作品起源国是否存在保护。
Translation: 2. The enjoyment and exercise of these rights shall not be subject to any formality and shall be independent of the existence of protection in the country of origin of the work.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，除本公约条款外，保护的程度以及为保护作者权利而向其提供的补救方法完全被要求给以保护的国家的法律规定。
Translation: Therefore, apart from the provisions of this Convention, the extent of protection and the means of redress afforded to the author to safeguard his rights shall be governed exclusively by the laws of the country where protection is claimed.

Query_Text_cn: 3.起源国的保护由该国法律规定。如作者不是起源国的国民，但其作品手公约保护，该作者在该国仍享有同本国作者相同的权利。
Translation: 3. The protection in the country of origin shall be governed by the laws of that country. If the author is not a national of the country of origin but his work is protected under the Convention, he shall enjoy in that country the same rights as national authors.

Query_Text_cn: (1)对于制片人总部或惯常住所在本同盟一成员国内的电影作品，以该国为起源国。
Translation: (1) For cinematographic works, the country of origin shall be the country where the producer has its headquarters or habitual residence within a member state of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: (2)对于建造在本同盟一成员国内的建筑作品或构成本同盟某一成员国建筑物一部分的平面和立体艺术作品，以该国为起源国。
Translation: (2) For architectural works constructed in a member country of the Union or for works of graphic or plastic art forming an integral part of a building located in a member country of the Union, that country shall be considered the country of origin.

Query_Text_cn: 1.任何非本同盟成员国如未能充分保护本同盟某一成员国国民作者的作品，成员国可对首次出版时系该非同盟成员国国民而又不在成员国内有惯常住所的作者的作品的保护加以限制。如首次出版利用这种权利，则本同盟其他成员国对由此而受到特殊待遇的作品也无须给予比首次出版国所给予的更广泛的保护。
Translation: 1. Any country outside the Union which fails to adequately protect the works of authors who are nationals of one of the countries of the Union may be subject to restrictions by member states regarding the protection of works whose authors are nationals of such non-member country and do not have their habitual residence in a member state at the time of first publication. If a country exercises this right, other countries of the Union shall not be required to grant broader protection to the works thus subjected to special treatment than that accorded by the country of first publication.

Query_Text_cn: 2.前款所规定的任何限制均不影响在此种限制实施之前作者在本同盟任一成员国出版的作品已经获得的权利。
Translation: 2. None of the restrictions provided for in the preceding paragraph shall affect rights acquired by an author in a work published in any country of the Union before such restrictions were put into effect.

Query_Text_cn: 3.根据本条对版权之保护施加限制的本同盟成员国应以书面声明通知世界知识产权组织总干事（以下称总干事），说明保护受到限制的国家以及这些国家国民的作者的权利所受的限制。总干事应立即向本同盟所有成员国通报该项声明。
Translation: 3. Any country of the Union which restricts the protection of copyright under this Article shall notify the Director General of the World Intellectual Property Organization (hereinafter designated as "the Director General") in a written declaration, specifying the countries in respect of which protection is restricted and the limitations to which the rights of authors who are nationals of those countries are subjected. The Director General shall immediately communicate this declaration to all countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 1.不受作者经济权利的影响，甚至在上述经济权利转让之后，作者仍保有要求其作品作者身份的权利，并有权反对对其作品的任何有损其声誉的歪曲、割裂或其他更改，或其他损害行为。
Translation: 1. Independently of the author's economic rights, and even after the transfer of the said rights, the author shall have the right to claim authorship of the work and to object to any distortion, mutilation or other modification of, or other derogatory action in relation to, the said work, which would be prejudicial to his honor or reputation.

Query_Text_cn: 2.根据以上第1款给予作者的权利，在其死后应至少保留到作者经济权利期满为止，并由被要求给予保护的国家本国法所授权的人或机构行使之。但在批准或加入本公约文本时其法律中未包括有保证在作者死后保护以上第一款承认的全部权利的各国，有权规定对这些权利中的某些权利在作者死后不予保留。
Translation: 2. The rights granted to the author in accordance with the preceding paragraph shall, after his death, be maintained at least until the expiry of the economic rights and shall be exercisable by the persons or institutions authorized by the legislation of the country where protection is claimed. However, those countries whose legislation, at the moment of their ratification of or accession to this Act, does not provide for the protection after the death of the author of all the rights set out in the preceding paragraph may provide that some of these rights shall cease to be maintained after his death.

Query_Text_cn: 3.为保障本条所承认的权利而采取的补救方法由被要求给予保护的国家的法律规定。
Translation: 3. The remedies for the protection of the rights recognized in this Article shall be governed by the laws of the country where protection is claimed.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本公约给予保护的期限为作者有生之年及其死后五十年内。
Translation: 1. The term of protection granted by this Convention shall be the life of the author and fifty years after his death.

Query_Text_cn: 2.但就电影作品而言，本同盟成员国有权规定保护期在作者同意下自作品公之于众后五十年期满，如自作品完成后五十年尚未公之于众，则自作品完成后五十年期满。
Translation: 2. However, in the case of cinematographic works, the member countries of this Union shall have the right to provide that the term of protection shall expire fifty years after the work has been made available to the public with the consent of the author, or, failing such an event within fifty years from the making of such a work, fifty years after the making.

Query_Text_cn: 3.至于不具名作品和假名作品，本公约给予的保护期自其合法公之于众之日起五十年内有效。但根据作者采用的假名可以毫无疑问地确定作者身份时，该保护期则为第一款所规定地期限。如不具名作品或假名作品的作者在上述期间内公开其身份，所适用的保护期为第一款所规定的保护期限。本同盟成员国没有义务保护有充分理由推定其作者已死去五十年的不具名作品或假名作品。
Translation: 3. As for anonymous and pseudonymous works, the term of protection granted by this Convention shall expire fifty years after the work has been lawfully made available to the public. However, when the pseudonym adopted by the author leaves no doubt as to his identity, the term of protection shall be that provided in paragraph 1. If the author of an anonymous or pseudonymous work discloses his identity during the above-mentioned period, the term of protection applicable shall be that provided in paragraph 1. The countries of the Union shall not be required to protect anonymous or pseudonymous works in respect of which it is reasonable to presume that their author has been dead for fifty years.

Query_Text_cn: 但这一期限不应少于自该作品完成之后算起的二十五年。
Translation: However, this term shall not be less than twenty-five years from the date of the work's completion.

Query_Text_cn: 5.作者死后的保护期和以上第二、三、四款所规定的期限从其死亡或上述各款提及事件发生之时开始，但这种期限应从死亡或所述事件发生之后次年的一月一日开始计算。
Translation: 5. The term of protection after the author's death and the periods specified in paragraphs 2, 3, and 4 above shall commence from the time of death or the occurrence of the events mentioned in those paragraphs, but such periods shall be calculated from January 1 of the year following the death or the occurrence of the said events.

Query_Text_cn: 6.本同盟成员国有权给予比前述各款规定更长的保护期。
Translation: 6. Member countries of the Union shall have the right to grant a term of protection longer than those provided for in the preceding paragraphs.

Query_Text_cn: 7.受本公约罗马文本约束并在此公约文本签署时有效的本国法律中规定了短于前述各款期限的保护期的本同盟成员国，有权在加入或批准此公约文本时维持这种期限。
Translation: 7. Any member country of the Union bound by the Rome Act of this Convention which provides for a term of protection shorter than those prescribed in the preceding paragraphs at the time of signing this Act shall have the right to maintain such duration upon acceding to or ratifying this Act.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，除该国家的法律另有规定者外，这种期限不得超过作品起源国规定的期限。
Translation: However, unless otherwise provided by the laws of that country, such term shall not exceed the term fixed in the country of origin of the work.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条之二前条的规定同样适用于版权为合作作者共有的作品，但作者死后的保护期应从最后死亡的作者死亡时算起。
Translation: Article 7-2: The preceding article shall apply mutatis mutandis to works whose copyright is jointly owned by co-authors, provided that the term of protection after the author's death shall be calculated from the time of death of the last surviving author.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条受本公约保护的文学艺术作品的作者，在对原作享有权利的整个保护期内，享有翻译和授权翻译其作品的专有权利。
Translation: Article 8 Authors of literary and artistic works protected by this Convention shall enjoy the exclusive right of making and of authorizing the translation of their works throughout the term of protection of their rights in the original works.

Query_Text_cn: 1.受本公约保护的文学艺术作品的作者，享有授权以任何方式和采取任何形式复制这些作品的专有权利。
Translation: 1. Authors of literary and artistic works protected by this Convention shall enjoy the exclusive right of authorizing the reproduction of these works in any manner or form.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本同盟成员国法律得允许在某些特殊情况下复制上述作品，只要这种复制不损害作品的正常使用也不致无故侵害作者的合法利益。
Translation: 2. The laws of countries of the Union may permit the reproduction of such works in certain special cases, provided that such reproduction does not conflict with a normal exploitation of the work and does not unreasonably prejudice the legitimate interests of the author.

Query_Text_cn: 3.所有录音或录象均应视为本公约所指的复制。
Translation: 3. All sound or visual recordings shall be considered reproductions within the meaning of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 1.从一部合法公之于众的作品中摘出引文，包括以报刊提要形式引用报纸期刊的文章，只要符合合理使用，在为达到目的的正当需要范围内，就属合法。
Translation: 1. It is lawful to quote excerpts from a legally published work, including the use of newspaper and journal articles in the form of press digests, provided that such use complies with fair practice and is justified by the purpose to be achieved.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本同盟成员国法律以及成员国之间现有或将要签订的特别协议得规定，可以合法地通过出版物、无线电广播或录音录象使用文学艺术作品作为教学得解说得权利，只要是在为达到目的的正当需要范围内使用，并符合合理使用。
Translation: 2. The laws of the countries of the Union and any existing or future special agreements between them may provide for the right to lawfully utilize literary or artistic works by way of publication, radio broadcast, or sound or visual recordings for the purpose of teaching or explanation, provided such use is compatible with fair practice and does not exceed the extent justified by the intended purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 3.前面各款提到得摘引和使用应说明出处，如原出处有作者姓名，也应同时说明。
Translation: 3. The extracts and uses mentioned in the preceding paragraphs shall indicate the source, and if the original source includes the author's name, it shall also be stated.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本同盟各成员国的法律得允许通过报刊、广播或对公众有线传播，复制发表在报纸、期刊上的讨论经济、政治或宗教的时事性文章，或具有同样性质的已经广播的作品，但以对这种复制、广播或有线传播并未明确予以保留的为限。
Translation: 1. The laws of the countries of the Union may permit the reproduction by the press, broadcasting, or communication to the public by wire of articles published in newspapers or periodicals on current economic, political, or religious topics, or of broadcast works of the same character, provided that such reproduction, broadcasting, or communication is not expressly reserved.

Query_Text_cn: 对违反这一义务的法律责任由被要求给予保护的国家的法律确定。
Translation: The legal liability for violating this obligation shall be determined by the laws of the country requested to provide protection.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在用摄影或电影手段，或通过广播或对公众有线传播报道时事新闻时，在事件过程中看到或听到的文学艺术作品在为报道目的正当需要范围内予以复制和公之于众的条件，也由本同盟各成员国的法律规定。
Translation: 2. It shall be a matter for legislation in the countries of the Union to determine the conditions under which literary and artistic works seen or heard in the course of current events may be reproduced and made available to the public by means of photography, cinematography, broadcasting, or wired transmission to the public, to the extent justified by the informatory purpose.

Query_Text_cn: （2）授权用各种手段公开播送其作品的表演和演奏。
Translation: (2) To authorize the public dissemination of performances and renditions of their works by any means.

Query_Text_cn: 2.戏剧作品或音乐戏剧作品的作者，在享有对其原作的权利的整个期间应享有对其作品的译作的同等权利。
Translation: 2. The author of a dramatic, dramatico-musical work shall enjoy, during the full term of his rights in the original work, the same rights with respect to translations thereof.

Query_Text_cn: （3）授权通过扩音器或其他任何传送符号、声音或图象的类似工具向公众传播广播的作品。
Translation: (3) Authorization to communicate the broadcast work to the public by loudspeaker or any other analogous instrument transmitting signs, sounds, or images.

Query_Text_cn: 2.行使以上第一款所指的权利的条件由本同盟成员国的法律规定，但这些条件的效力严格限于对此作出规定的国家。在任何情况下，这些条件均不应有损于作者的精神权利，也不应有损于作者获得合理报酬的权利，该报酬在没有协议情况下应由主管当局规定。
Translation: 2. The conditions for the exercise of the right referred to in the preceding paragraph shall be determined by the legislation of the country of the Union where protection is claimed. However, such conditions shall apply only in the countries which have imposed them. In no case shall these conditions prejudice the moral rights of the author, nor his right to obtain equitable remuneration which, in the absence of agreement, shall be fixed by competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 3.除另有规定外，根据本条的第一款的授权，不意味着授权利用录音或录象设备录制广播的作品。但本同盟成员国法律得确定一广播机构使用自己的设备并为自己播送之用而进行临时录制的规章。本同盟成员国法律也可以由于这些录制品具有特殊文献性质而批准由国家档案馆保存。
Translation: 3. Except where otherwise provided, the authorization granted under the first paragraph of this Article shall not imply authorization to record the broadcast work by means of instruments capable of fixing sounds or images. However, member countries of the Union may determine in their domestic laws the regulations concerning ephemeral recordings made by a broadcasting organization using its own facilities and for its own broadcasts. The national legislation of Union members may also authorize the preservation of such recordings in official archives on account of their exceptional documentary character.

Query_Text_cn: （1）授权公开朗诵其作品，包括用各种手段或方式公开朗诵。
Translation: (1) The right to authorize the public recitation of their works, by any means or process.

Query_Text_cn: （2）授权用各种手段公开播送其作品的朗诵。
Translation: (2) To authorize the public dissemination of the recitation of their works by any means.

Query_Text_cn: 2.文学作品作者在对其原作享有权利的整个期间，应对其作品的译作享有同等的权利。
Translation: 2. Authors of literary works shall enjoy the same rights in respect of translations of their works throughout the term of protection of their rights in the original works.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条文学艺术作品的作者享有授权对其作品进行改编、音乐改编和其他变动的专有权利。
Translation: Article 12 Authors of literary and artistic works shall enjoy the exclusive right to authorize adaptations, musical arrangements and other alterations of their works.

Query_Text_cn: 但这类保留及条件之效力严格限于对此作出规定的国家，而且在任何情况下均不得损害作者获得在没有协议情况下由主管当局规定的合理报酬的权利。
Translation: However, the effect of such reservations and conditions shall be strictly limited to the country which has made them and shall in no circumstances impair the author's right to obtain equitable remuneration fixed by the competent authority in the absence of agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 2.根据一九二八年六月二日在罗马和一九四八年六月二十六日在布鲁塞尔签订的公约第十三条第三款在本同盟成员国内录制的音乐作品的录音，自该国受本文本约束之日起的两年期限以内，可以不经音乐作品的作者同意在该国进行复制。
Translation: 2. In accordance with Article 13(3) of the Conventions signed at Rome on June 2, 1928, and at Brussels on June 26, 1948, sound recordings of musical works made in a member country of the Union may be reproduced in that country without the authorization of the author of the musical work for a period of two years from the date on which the said country becomes bound by this text.

Query_Text_cn: 3.根据本条第一、二款制作的录音制品，如未经有关方面批准进口，视此种录音为侵权录音制品的国家，可予扣押。
Translation: 3. Any sound recording produced in accordance with paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article may be seized by a country that regards such recordings as infringing sound recordings if imported without the approval of the relevant parties.

Query_Text_cn: （2）授权公开表演、演奏以及向公众有线传播经过如此改编或复制的作品。
Translation: (2) To authorize the public performance, playing, and wired transmission to the public of works thus adapted or reproduced.

Query_Text_cn: 2.根据文学或艺术作品制作的电影作品以任何其他艺术形式改编，在不妨碍电影作品作者授权的情况下，仍须经原作作者授权。
Translation: 2. The adaptation of cinematographic works derived from literary or artistic works into any other artistic form shall require authorization from both the author of the original work and the author of the cinematographic work, without prejudice to the latter's rights.

Query_Text_cn: 3.第十三条第一款的规定应不适用于电影。
Translation: 3. The provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 13 shall not apply to cinematographic works.

Query_Text_cn: 1.在不损害已被改编或复制的作品的版权的情况下，电影作品应作为原作受到保护。电影作品版权所有者享有与原作作者同等的权利，包括前一条提到的权利。
Translation: 1. Without prejudice to the copyright in any work which may have been adapted or reproduced, a cinematographic work shall be protected as an original work. The owner of copyright in a cinematographic work shall enjoy the same rights as the author of an original work, including the rights referred to in the preceding Article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.（a）确定电影作品版权的所有者，属于被要求给予保护的国家法律规定的范围。
Translation: 2.(a) The determination of the copyright owner of a cinematographic work shall be governed by the law of the country where protection is claimed.

Query_Text_cn: （b）然而，在其法律承认参加电影作品制作的作者应属于版权所有者的本同盟成员国内，这些作者，如果应允许参加此项工作，除非有相反或特别的规定，不能反对对电影作品的复制、发行、公开表演、演奏、向公众有线传播、广播、公开传播、配制字幕和配音。
Translation: (b) However, in those countries of the Union where legislation recognizes authors contributing to the making of a cinematographic work as right holders, such authors may not object to the reproduction, distribution, public performance, communication to the public by wire, broadcasting, public communication, or the subtitling or dubbing of texts of the cinematographic work, unless otherwise or specially stipulated, provided their participation in the work is authorized.

Query_Text_cn: （c）为适用本款b项，上面提到的应允形式是否应是一项书面合同或一项相当的文书，这一问题应由电影制片人总部或惯常住所所在的本同盟成员国的法律加以规定。然而被要求给予保护的本同盟成员国的法律得规定这一应允应以书面合同或相当得文书的形式。法律作出此种规定的国家应以书面声明通知总干事，并由后者将这一声明立即通知本同盟所有其他成员国。
Translation: (c) For the purposes of subparagraph (b) of this Article, whether the form of consent referred to above should be a written contract or a comparable document shall be determined by the legislation of the country of the Union where the producer of the cinematographic work has his headquarters or habitual residence. However, the legislation of the country of the Union where protection is claimed may provide that such consent shall be given in the form of a written contract or a comparable document. Countries making such a provision shall notify the Director General by means of a written declaration, who shall immediately communicate this declaration to all other countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （d）"相反或特别的规定”指与上述应允有关的任何限制性条件。
Translation: (d) "Contrary or special provision" means any restrictive conditions related to the aforementioned undertaking.

Query_Text_cn: 3.除非本国法律另有规定，本条第二款b项之规定不适用于为电影作品创作的剧本、台词和音乐作品的作者，也不适用于电影作品的主要导演。但本同盟成员国中其法律并未规定对电影导演适用本条第二款b项者，应以书面声明通知总干事，总干事应将此声明立即转达本同盟所有其他成员国。
Translation: 3. Unless the national legislation provides otherwise, the provisions of paragraph 2(b) shall not apply to authors of scenarios, dialogue and musical works created for the making of the cinematographic work, or to the principal director thereof. However, those countries of the Union whose legislation does not contain rules providing for the application of the said paragraph 2(b) to such director shall notify the Director General by means of a written declaration, who shall immediately communicate this declaration to all the other countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 1.对于艺术作品原作和作家与作曲家的手稿，作者或作者死后由国家法律所授权的人或机构享有不可剥夺的权利，在作者第一次转让作品之后对作品进行的任何出售中分享利益。
Translation: 1. For original works of art and manuscripts of writers and composers, the author or the person or institution authorized by national law after the author's death shall enjoy an inalienable right to share in the proceeds from any sale of the work subsequent to its first transfer by the author.

Query_Text_cn: 2.只有在作者本国法律承认这种保护的情况下，才可在本同盟的成员国内要求上款所规定的保护，而且保护的程度应限于被要求给予保护的国家的法律所允许的程度。
Translation: 2. The protection referred to in the preceding paragraph may be claimed in a country of the Union only if the legislation of the country of which the author is a national recognizes such protection, and to the extent permitted by the law of the country where protection is claimed.

Query_Text_cn: 3.分享利益之方式和比例由各国法律确定。
Translation: 3.The method and proportion of benefit-sharing shall be determined by the laws of respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 1.受本公约保护的文学艺术作品的作者，只要其名字以通常方式出现在该作品上，在没有相反证据的情况下，即视为该作品的作者并有权在本同盟成员国中对侵犯其权利的人提起诉讼。即使作者采用的是假名，只要根据作者的假名可以毫无疑问地确定作者的身份，本款也同样适用。
Translation: 1. The author of literary and artistic works protected by this Convention shall, in the absence of proof to the contrary, be regarded as such and consequently entitled to institute infringement proceedings in countries of the Union where his name appears on the work in the usual manner. This provision shall be applicable even where such name is a pseudonym, provided the pseudonym adopted by the author leaves no doubt as to his identity.

Query_Text_cn: 2.以通常方式在电影作品上署名的自然人或法人，除非有相反的证据，即推定为该作品的制片人。
Translation: 2. In the absence of proof to the contrary, the natural person or legal entity whose name appears on a cinematographic work in the usual manner shall be presumed to be the producer of such work.

Query_Text_cn: 3.对于不具备作品和以上第一款所述情况以外的假名作品，如果出版者的名字出现在作品上，在没有相反证据的情况下，该出版者即视为作者的代表，并以此资格有权维护和行使作者的权利。当作者公开其身份并证实其为作者时，本款的规定即停止适用。
Translation: 3. For pseudonymous works that do not constitute works or fall outside the circumstances described in the first paragraph above, if the publisher's name appears on the work, in the absence of proof to the contrary, that publisher shall be deemed to represent the author and shall, in that capacity, be entitled to protect and enforce the author's rights. The provisions of this paragraph shall cease to apply when the author reveals his identity and establishes his claim to authorship.

Query_Text_cn: 4.（a）对作者的身份不明但有充分理由推定该作者是本同盟某一成员国国民的未出版的作品，该国法律得指定主管当局代表该作者并有权维护和行使作者在本同盟成员国内之权利。
Translation: 4.(a) In respect of unpublished works where the identity of the author is unknown, but where there is every ground to presume that he is a national of a country of the Union, the legislation of that country may designate the competent authority which shall represent the author and shall be entitled to protect and enforce his rights in the countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （b）根据本规定而指定主管当局的本同盟成员国应以书面声明将此事通知总干事，声明中写明被指定的当局全部有关情况。总干事应将此声明立即通知本同盟所有其他成员国。
Translation: (b) Any country of the Union which designates an authority under this provision shall notify the Director General by means of a written declaration giving full particulars of the authority so designated. The Director General shall at once communicate such declaration to all other countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 1.对作品的侵权复制品，在作品受法律保护的本同盟成员国应予扣押。
Translation: 1. Infringing copies of a work shall be liable to seizure in any country of the Union where the work enjoys legal protection.

Query_Text_cn: 2.上款规定同样适用于来自对某作品不予保护或停止保护的国家的复制品。
Translation: 2. The provisions of the preceding paragraph shall equally apply to copies originating from a country which does not protect the work or has ceased to protect it.

Query_Text_cn: 3.扣押应按各国法律实行。
Translation: 3. Detention shall be implemented in accordance with the laws of each country.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条如果本同盟任何成员国的主管当局认为有必要对于任何作品或制品的发行、演出、展出，通过法律或条例行使许可、监督或禁止的权力，本公约的条款绝不应妨碍本同盟各成员国政府的这种权力。
Translation:
Article 17  
The provisions of this Convention shall in no way affect the right of the Government of each country of the Union to permit, control, or prohibit, by legislation or regulation, the circulation, presentation, or exhibition of any work or production in respect of which the competent authority deems it necessary to exercise such right.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本公约适用于所有在本公约开始生效时尚未因保护期满而在其起源国进入公有领域的作品。
Translation: 1. This Convention shall apply to all works which, at the moment of its coming into force, have not yet fallen into the public domain in their country of origin through the expiry of the term of protection.

Query_Text_cn: 2.但是，如果作品因原来规定的保护期已满而在被要求给予保护的国家已进入公有领域，则该作品不再重新受保护。
Translation: 2. However, if a work has fallen into the public domain in the country where protection is claimed due to the expiry of the term of protection previously granted, that work shall not be protected anew.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本原则应按照本同盟成员国之间现有的或将要缔结的有关特别公约所规定的条款实行。在没有这种条款的情况下，各国分别规定实行上述原则的条件。
Translation: 3. This principle shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions stipulated in existing or future special conventions concluded among the member countries of the Union. In the absence of such provisions, each country shall determine the conditions for implementing the aforementioned principle.

Query_Text_cn: 4.新加入本同盟时以及因实行第七条或放弃保留而扩大保护范围时，以上规定也同样适用。
Translation: 4. The above provisions shall likewise apply upon accession to this Union and when the scope of protection is extended as a result of the application of Article 7 or the abandonment of reservations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条如果本同盟成员国的本国法律提供更广泛的保护，本公约条款不妨碍要求适用这种规定。
Translation:
Article 19  
The provisions of this Convention shall not preclude the right to claim the application of any more extensive protection afforded by the national laws of a country of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条本同盟各成员国政府保留在它们之间签订给予作者比本公约所规定的更多的权利，或者包括不违反本公约的其他条款的特别协议的权力。凡符合上述条件的现有协议的条款仍然适用。
Translation: Article 20: The Governments of the countries of the Union reserve the right to enter into special agreements among themselves, insofar as such agreements grant to authors more extensive rights than those granted by the Convention, or contain other provisions not contrary to this Convention. The provisions of existing agreements which satisfy these conditions shall remain applicable.

Query_Text_cn: 1.有关发展中国家的特别条款载于附件。
Translation: Special provisions concerning developing countries are set forth in the annex.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在符合第二十八条第一款b项规定的前提下，附件构成本文本的组成部分。
Translation: 2. Subject to compliance with the provisions of subparagraph (b) of paragraph 1 of Article 28, the annexes constitute an integral part of this text.

Query_Text_cn: 1.（a）本同盟设一大会，由受第二十二至二十六条约束的本同盟成员国组成。
Translation: 1.(a) The Union shall have an Assembly consisting of the countries of the Union bound by Articles 22 to 26.

Query_Text_cn: （b）每一国家的政府由一名代表作为其代表，并可由若干名副代表、顾问及专家协助之。
Translation: (b) The government of each country shall be represented by one delegate and may be assisted by deputy delegates, advisers, and experts.

Query_Text_cn: （c）每个代表团的费用由指派它的政府负担。
Translation: (c) The expenses of each delegation shall be borne by the government appointing it.

Query_Text_cn: （13）行使成立产权组织的公约所赋予它的并为它所接受的权利。
Translation: (13) To exercise the rights conferred upon it by the Convention establishing WIPO and accepted by it.

Query_Text_cn: （b）对于还涉及产权组织管理的其他同盟的问题，大会在了解到产权组织协调委员会的意见后作出决定。
Translation: (b) For questions concerning other Unions administered by WIPO, the Assembly shall make its decision after considering the opinion of the WIPO Coordination Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 3.（a）大会每一成员国有一票。
Translation: 3. (a) Each member of the Conference shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: （b）大会成员国的半数构成法定人数。
Translation: (b) Half of the member states of the General Assembly shall constitute a quorum.

Query_Text_cn: （c）尽管有b项的规定，如开会时出席国家不足半数，但相当或多于大会成员国三分之一，则可作出决定；除有关大会程序之决定外，大会的决定须具备下列条件方可执行：国际局将上述决定通知未出席大会的成员国，请它们在上述通知之日起三个月内用书面投票或弃权。如果在期满时，用这样方式投票或弃权的国家的数目达到开会时法定人数的欠缺数目，同时已获得必要的多数，上述决定即可执行。
Translation: (c) Notwithstanding the provisions of subparagraph (b), if at any session the number of representatives is less than half but equal to or more than one-third of the number of member countries of the Assembly, the Assembly may make decisions; however, all decisions of the Assembly, except those concerning its own procedure, shall take effect only if the following conditions are fulfilled. The International Bureau shall communicate the said decisions to the member countries of the Assembly which were not represented and shall invite them to express in writing their vote or abstention within a period of three months from the date of the communication. If, at the expiration of this period, the number of countries having thus expressed their vote or abstention attains the number of countries which was lacking for attaining the quorum in the session itself, such decisions shall take effect provided that at the same time the required majority still obtains.

Query_Text_cn: （d）除第二十六条第二款规定的情况外，大会的决定以投票数三分之二的多数通过。
Translation: (d) Except as provided in paragraph 2 of Article 26, decisions of the General Assembly shall be made by a two-thirds majority of the votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: （e）弃权不视为投票。
Translation: (e) Abstention shall not be counted as a vote.

Query_Text_cn: （f）一名代表只能代表一国，也只能以该国名义投票。
Translation: (f) Each representative may represent only one country and may vote only in the name of that country.

Query_Text_cn: （g）非大会成员国的本同盟成员国以观察员身份参加会议。
Translation: (g) Non-member states of the Union that are members of this Alliance may attend meetings as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 4.（a）大会每二年举行一届常会，由总干事召集，除特殊情况外，与产权组织的全体大会在同时同地举行。
Translation: 4.(a) The Assembly shall meet in ordinary session once every two years upon convocation by the Director General and, in the absence of exceptional circumstances, during the same period and at the same place as the General Assembly of WIPO.

Query_Text_cn: （b）大会在执行委员会的要求下或大会成员国四分之一的国家的要求下，由总干事召集应举行特别会议。
Translation: (b) Extraordinary sessions of the General Conference shall be convened by the Director-General at the request of the Executive Board or upon the demand of one-fourth of the member states of the General Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 5.大会通过其议事规则。
Translation: 5. The Conference adopts its rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 1.大会设执行委员会。
Translation: 1. The Congress shall have an Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 2.（a）执委会由大会在其成员国中选出的国家组成。此外，产权组织所在地的国家除第二十五条第七款b项的情况外，在执委会中有一当然席位。
Translation: 2. (a) The Executive Committee shall be composed of the countries elected by the Assembly from among its member countries. In addition, the country on whose territory the Organization has its headquarters shall, subject to the provisions of Article 25(7)(b), have an ex officio seat on the Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: （b）执委会每一成员国政府有一名代表作为其代表，可由若干名副代表、顾问及专家协助之。
Translation: (b) Each government of a member state of the Executive Committee shall be represented by one delegate, who may be assisted by alternate delegates, advisers, and experts.

Query_Text_cn: 3.执委会成员国数目为大会成员国数目的四分之一。在计算席位时，以四相除剩下的余数不计算。
Translation: 3. The number of Executive Committee member states shall be one-fourth of the number of member states of the General Assembly. In calculating the seats, any remainder resulting from division by four shall be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: 4.在选派执委会成员国时，大会要适当考虑按地区公平分配和保证使可能签订有关本同盟的特别协议的国家参加执委会的必要性。
Translation: 4. In electing the members of the Executive Committee, the Assembly shall have due regard to an equitable geographical distribution and to the need for countries party to the Special Agreements which may be established in relation with the Union to be among the countries constituting the Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 5.（a）执委会成员国的任期自它们当选的该届大会闭会时起至大会下届常会闭会时止。
Translation: 5.(a) The term of office for members of the Executive Board shall commence at the close of the session of the General Conference at which they are elected and shall end at the close of the next ordinary session of the General Conference.

Query_Text_cn: （b）执委会的成员国重新当选的数目最多不得超过三分之二。
Translation: (b) No more than two-thirds of the members of the Executive Committee may be re-elected.

Query_Text_cn: （c）大会制定执委会成员国选举和可能重新当选的程序。
Translation: (c) The Congress shall establish the procedures for the election and possible re-election of member states to the Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: （2）向大会提交有关总干事草拟的本同盟的计划草案和二年期预算草案的建议。
Translation: (2) To submit to the General Assembly proposals concerning the draft program and biennial budget of the Union prepared by the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: （6）履行在本公约范围内赋予它的其他一切任务。
Translation: (6) To perform all other functions assigned to it under the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对于还涉及产权组织管理的其他同盟的问题，执行委员会在了解到产权组织协调委员会的意见后作出决定。
Translation: (b) For issues also concerning other unions administered by WIPO, the Executive Committee shall make a decision after considering the opinion of the WIPO Coordination Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 7.（a）执委会在总干事的召集下，每年举行一届常会，尽可能与产权组织协调委员会同时同地举行。
Translation: 7.(a) The Executive Committee shall hold an ordinary session once a year, convened by the Director General, preferably at the same time and place as the Coordination Committee of WIPO.

Query_Text_cn: (b)执委会在总干事倡议下，或是应执委会主席或四分之一成员国的要求，由总干事召集举行特别会议。
Translation: (b) The Executive Board shall convene special sessions at the initiative of the Director-General or upon the request of the Chairperson of the Board or one quarter of its member states.

Query_Text_cn: 8.(a)执委会每一成员国有一票。
Translation: 8.(a) Each member of the Executive Board shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: (b)执委会成员国的半数构成法定人数。
Translation: (b) Half of the members of the Executive Committee shall constitute a quorum.

Query_Text_cn: (c)决议以投票数中简单多数票作出。
Translation: (c) Decisions shall be made by a simple majority of votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: (d)弃权不视为投票。
Translation: (d) Abstentions shall not be counted as votes.

Query_Text_cn: (e)一名代表只能代表一国，也只能以该国名义投票。
Translation: (e) Each representative may represent only one country and vote solely in the name of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 9.非执委会成员国的本同盟成员国以观察员身份参加其会议。
Translation: 9. Member countries of the Union that are not members of the Executive Committee may attend its meetings as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 10.执行委员会通过其议事规则。
Translation: 10. The Executive Board shall adopt its rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 1.(a)本同盟的行政工作由国际局负责，该局接替与保护工业产权国际公约设立的同盟局合并的本同盟局的工作。
Translation: 1.(a) The administrative tasks of the Union shall be performed by the International Bureau, which shall succeed the Bureau of the Union established by the Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property upon the merger of the two Bureaus.

Query_Text_cn: (b)国际局负担本同盟各机构的秘书处的工作。
Translation: (b) The International Bureau performs the secretarial functions of the organs of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: (c)产权组织总干事是本同盟最高官员并代表本同盟。
Translation: (c) The Director General of WIPO is the highest official of the Union and represents it.

Query_Text_cn: 2.国际局汇集并出版有关保护版权的资料，本同盟每一成员国应尽快将有关保护版权的所有新法律及官方文件通知国际局。
Translation: 2. The International Bureau shall compile and publish information concerning the protection of copyright. Each country of the Union shall promptly communicate to the International Bureau all new laws and official texts concerning the protection of copyright.

Query_Text_cn: 3.国际局出版一种月刊。
Translation: 3. The International Bureau publishes a monthly periodical.

Query_Text_cn: 4.国际局应本同盟各成员国之请求，向它们提供有关保护版权问题的资料。
Translation: 4. The International Bureau shall, upon request by any member country of the Union, furnish it with information on matters concerning the protection of copyright.

Query_Text_cn: 5.国际局从事各项研究并提供有利于保护版权的服务。
Translation: 5. The International Bureau conducts research and provides services conducive to the protection of copyright.

Query_Text_cn: 6.总干事及由他指派的任何工作人员均可出席大会、执委会、其他各种专家委员会或工作组的会议，但无表决权。总干事或由他指派的一名工作人员为这些机构的当然秘书。
Translation: 6. The Director-General and any staff member designated by him may attend the meetings of the General Conference, the Executive Board, and other expert committees or working groups, but without the right to vote. The Director-General or a staff member designated by him shall serve as the ex officio secretary of these bodies.

Query_Text_cn: 7.(a)国际局根据大会指示和与执委会合作，筹备修订除第二十二至二十六条外的公约条款的会议。
Translation: 7.(a) The International Bureau shall, under the direction of the Assembly and in cooperation with the Executive Committee, prepare for conferences to revise the provisions of the Convention other than Articles 22 to 26.

Query_Text_cn: (b)国际局可就筹备修订会议征询政府间组织和非政府间国际性组织的意见。
Translation: (b) The International Bureau may consult intergovernmental organizations and international non-governmental organizations regarding the preparation of the revision conference.

Query_Text_cn: (c)总干事和由他指派的人员可参加这些会议的审议，但无表决权。
Translation: (c) The Director-General and the persons designated by him may participate in the deliberations of these meetings without the right to vote.

Query_Text_cn: 8.国际局执行交付给它的所有其他工作。
Translation: 8. The International Bureau shall carry out all other tasks entrusted to it.

Query_Text_cn: 1.(a)本同盟有自己的预算。
Translation: 1.(a) The Union has its own budget.

Query_Text_cn: (b)本同盟的预算包括本同盟本身的收入及支出，它对各同盟共同开支预算的缴款，以及在情况需要时，交给产权组织会议预算支配的款项。
Translation: (b) The budget of the Union shall include the income and expenditure of the Union itself, its contribution to the budget of expenses common to the Unions, and, where applicable, the sum made available to the budget of the Conference of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: (c)不专属本同盟而同样属于产权组织管理的其他一个或几个同盟的开支，视为各同盟的共同开支。本同盟在共同开支中所占份额视这些开支与它的关系而定。
Translation: (c) Expenditures not exclusively attributable to this Union but also to one or more other unions administered by the Organization shall be considered as common expenditures of the unions. The share of this Union in such common expenditures shall be proportionate to the relevance of these expenditures to it.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本同盟预算的确定须考虑到与其他由产权组织管理的同盟的预算相协调的要求。
Translation: 2. The determination of the budget of this Union shall take into account the requirement of coordination with the budgets of other unions administered by WIPO.

Query_Text_cn: ⑸租金、利息及其他杂项收入。
Translation: (5) Rent, interest, and other miscellaneous income.

Query_Text_cn: (b)除以前已经指明者外，每个国家在交存其批准书或加入书时，须说明它希望被列入哪一级。也可以改变级别。如果某一成员国希望降低其级别，它应在某一届常会期间将此事通知大会。这一变动自该届会议后的那一日历年开始时生效。
Translation: (b) Except as previously specified, each country shall, at the time of depositing its instrument of ratification or accession, declare the class in which it wishes to be listed. It may also change its classification. If a Member State desires to lower its class, it shall notify the Assembly during one of its regular sessions. Such a change shall take effect at the beginning of the calendar year following that session.

Query_Text_cn: (c)每个国家每年会费数额在所有国家每年向本同盟交付的会费总数中所占比例，同它所在的那一级的单位数在全部国家的单位总数中所占比例相同。
Translation: (c) The annual contribution of each country shall constitute the same proportion of the total sum of annual contributions to the Union by all countries as the number of its units in the class to which it belongs bears to the total number of units of all countries.

Query_Text_cn: (d)会费应于每年1月1日支付。
Translation: (d) Contributions shall be paid on 1 January each year.

Query_Text_cn: (e)逾期未缴纳会费的国家，如拖欠总数达到或超过过去整整两年内它应缴纳的会费数，则不得行使它在本同盟任何机构中的表决权。但如该机构认为这种拖欠系由于非常及不可避免之情况，则可允许该国保留行使其表决权。
Translation: (e) A member state that has failed to pay its contributions within the stipulated period shall have no vote in any of the bodies of the Union if the total amount of its arrears equals or exceeds the amount of the contributions due from it for the preceding two full years. However, any such member state may be permitted to retain its vote if the body concerned is satisfied that the failure to pay is due to exceptional and unavoidable circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: (f)如在新的会计年度开始前还未通过预算，则可按照财务条例规定的手续将前一年的预算延期实行。
Translation: (f) If the budget has not been approved before the start of the new fiscal year, the previous year's budget may be extended in accordance with the procedures stipulated in the financial regulations.

Query_Text_cn: ⒌国际局代表本同盟提供的服务应得收入的数额由总干事确定，总干事向大会和执委会就此提出报告。
Translation: 5. The amount of the fees and charges due for services rendered by the International Bureau in respect of the Union shall be fixed by the Director General, who shall report thereon to the Assembly and the Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: ⒍(a)本同盟拥有一笔由每一成员国一次付款组成的周转基金。如基金不足，由大会决定增加。
Translation: 6(a) The Union shall have a working capital fund constituted by a single payment made by each member country. If the fund becomes insufficient, an increase shall be decided by the Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: (b)每个国家对上述基金的首次付款数以及追加数应按基金成立或决定增加当年该国缴纳会费数的比例。
Translation: (b) The initial and additional contributions of each country to the aforementioned fund shall be made in proportion to its assessed contribution for the year in which the fund is established or the decision to increase it is made.

Query_Text_cn: (c)付款的比例及方式由大会根据总干事的提议并征求产权协调委员会意见后决定。
Translation: (c) The proportion and method of payment shall be determined by the Assembly upon the proposal of the Director General and after consultation with the Coordination Committee of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ⒎(a)与产权组织所在地的国家签订的会址协定规定，如周转基金不足，可由该国垫款。垫款数和垫款条件由该国和产权组织每次分别签订协定。在该国承诺垫付款项期间，该国在执委会中占有一席当然席位。
Translation: 7.(a) The headquarters agreement concluded with the country where WIPO is located stipulates that, in the event of insufficient working capital, an advance may be made by that country. The amount and terms of such advances shall be determined by separate agreements between that country and WIPO on each occasion. During the period when the country undertakes to provide advances, it shall hold an ex officio seat on the Coordination Committee.

Query_Text_cn: (b)a项所指国家和产权组织均有权以书面通知方式废止提供垫款的保证。这种废止自通知提出那一年底起三年后生效。
Translation: (b) Both the State referred to in subparagraph (a) and the Organization shall have the right to denounce the obligation to furnish advances by means of a written notification. Such denunciation shall take effect three years after the end of the year in which the notification was made.

Query_Text_cn: ⒏根据财务条例规定的方式，帐目审计由大会同意指派的一个或几个本同盟成员国或外聘审计员担任。
Translation: 8. The auditing of the accounts shall be carried out by one or more of the Member States of the Union or by external auditors, as provided in the financial regulations, who shall be designated with the approval of the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: ⒈所有大会成员国，执委会或总干事均可提出修改第二十二、二十三、二十四、二十五条及本条的建议。这些建议由总干事在提交大会审查前至少六个月通知大会成员国。
Translation: 1. Any proposal to amend Articles 22, 23, 24, 25, and the present Article may be initiated by any member country of the Assembly, the Executive Committee, or the Director General. Such proposals shall be communicated by the Director General to the member countries of the Assembly at least six months before they are submitted for consideration by the Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: ⒉第一款所指的各条的修改应由大会通过，通过需要投票数的四分之三；但对第二十二条及本款的任何修改需经投票数的五分之四通过。
Translation: 2. Amendments to the articles referred to in paragraph 1 shall be adopted by the General Assembly with a three-fourths majority of the votes cast; provided that any amendment to Article 22 and to this paragraph shall require a four-fifths majority of the votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: ⒊第一款所提各条的任何修改，至少要在总干事收到在修改通过时为大会成员国的四分之三国家根据它们各自的宪法批准修改的书面通知一个月后才能生效。以这种方式接受的这些条款的修改对修改生效时为大会成员国的所有国家或其后成为成员国的国家具有约束力；但任何增加本同盟成员国财务义务的修改只对那些已通知表示接受这类修改的国家有约束力。
Translation: Any amendment to the provisions referred to in paragraph (1) shall enter into force one month after written notifications of acceptance, effected in accordance with their respective constitutional processes, have been received by the Director General from three-fourths of the countries members of the Assembly at the time the amendment was adopted. Any amendment thus accepted shall bind all the countries which are members of the Assembly at the time the amendment enters into force or which become members thereafter, provided that any amendment increasing the financial obligations of countries of the Union shall bind only those countries which have notified their acceptance of such amendment.

Query_Text_cn: ⒈本公约可进行修订，以便使之得到改善，从而使本同盟体制臻于完善。
Translation: 1. This Convention may be revised with a view to introducing improvements designed to perfect the system of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: ⒉为此目的，可相继在本同盟一个成员国内举行同盟成员国代表的会议。
Translation: 2. For this purpose, meetings of representatives of the member countries of the Union may be held successively in one of the countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: ⒊除第二十六条有关修改第二十二至二十六条的规定外，所有对本文本的修订，包括附件的修订，均需投票数全体一致通过。
Translation: 3. Except for amendments to Articles 22 to 26 as stipulated in Article 26, all revisions to this text, including amendments to its annexes, shall require unanimous approval by the total number of votes.

Query_Text_cn: ⒈(a)凡签署此公约文本的任何本同盟成员国均可批准此公约文本，如尚未签署，则可加入本公约。批准书或加入书交存总干事处。
Translation: 1.(a) Any member country of the Union that has signed this Convention text may ratify it, and any member country that has not signed may accede to it. Instruments of ratification or accession shall be deposited with the Director General.

Query_Text_cn: (b)本同盟任何成员国在其批准书或加入书中均可声明其批准或加入不适用第一至二十一条及附件；但如该国已根据附件第六条第一款作出声明，则它在上述文件中可只声明其批准或加入不适用于第一至二十条。
Translation: (b) Any country of the Union may declare, in its instrument of ratification or accession, that its ratification or accession shall not apply to Articles 1 to 21 and the Appendix; provided that, if such country has previously made a declaration under Article VI(1) of the Appendix, it may only declare in its instrument that its ratification or accession does not apply to Articles 1 to 20.

Query_Text_cn: (c)凡根据b项已声明其批准或加入对该项所提到的条款不发生效力的本同盟任何成员国可在其后任何时候声明将其批准或加入的效力扩大到这些条款。这一声明交存总干事处。
Translation: (c) Any country of the Union which has declared in accordance with subparagraph (b) that its ratification or accession does not apply to the provisions referred to in that subparagraph may at any later time declare that it extends the effect of its ratification or accession to those provisions. Such a declaration shall be deposited with the Director General.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵法国、西班牙、大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国、美利坚合众国已受到1971年7月24日在巴黎修订过的世界版权公约的约束。
Translation: (2) France, Spain, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and the United States of America are bound by the Universal Copyright Convention as revised at Paris on July 24, 1971.

Query_Text_cn: (b)a项提到的生效，对于至少在生效前三个月交存批准书或加入书但未按第一款b项作过声明的本同盟成员国具有效力。
Translation: (b) The entry into force referred to in subparagraph (a) shall be effective for those countries of the Union which, at least three months before such entry into force, have deposited their instruments of ratification or accession and have not made a declaration under subparagraph (b) of paragraph (1).

Query_Text_cn: (c)就b项对之不适用的已批准或加入此公约文本而未按照第一款b项作过声明的所有本同盟成员国而言，第一至二十一条及附件在总干事通知该批准书或加入书交存之日后三个月生效，除非交存文件中注明有更晚的日期。在后一情况下，第一至二十一条及附件则在注明的日期对该国生效。
Translation: (c) For all States party to the Paris Act which have not made a declaration under paragraph (1)(b), Articles 1 to 21 and the Appendix shall take effect three months after the notification by the Director General of the deposit of their instruments of ratification or accession, unless a later date is indicated in the instrument deposited. In the latter case, Articles 1 to 21 and the Appendix shall take effect with respect to that State on the date thus indicated.

Query_Text_cn: (d)a至c项的规定不影响附件第六条的适用。
Translation: (d) The provisions of subparagraphs (a) to (c) shall not affect the application of Article VI of the Annex.

Query_Text_cn: ⒊对不管是否按照第一款b项作过声明而批准或加入此公约文本的任何本同盟成员国，第二十二至三十八条在总干事通知已交存批准书或加入书之日后三个月生效，除非交存文件中注明有更晚的日期。在后一情况下，第二十二至三十八条则在注明的日期对该国生效。
Translation: 3. For any country of the Union which ratifies or accedes to this Act with or without a declaration made under paragraph (1)(b), Articles 22 to 38 shall enter into force three months after the date on which the Director General has notified the deposit of the instrument of ratification or accession, unless a subsequent date has been indicated in the instrument deposited. In the latter case, Articles 22 to 38 shall enter into force with respect to that country on the date thus indicated.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国和缅甸联邦边界条约*（注*：1960年10月1日签订于北京并于1961年1月4日生效。
Translation: Boundary Treaty Between the People's Republic of China and the Union of Burma*(Signed in Beijing on October 1,1960,and entered into force on January 4,1961.)

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国主席特派国务院总理周恩来；缅甸联邦总统特派总理吴努。
Translation: The President of the People's Republic of China has appointed Premier Zhou Enlai as his Special Envoy; the President of the Union of Burma has appointed Premier U Nu as his Special Envoy.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国同意按照一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文来划定从南帕河和南定河汇合处到南卡江和南永河汇合处的一段边界，但是本条约第二条和第三条规定的调整除外。
Translation: The People's Republic of China agrees to delimit the section of the boundary from the confluence of the Nam Hpa and Nam Ting Rivers to the confluence of the Nam Kha and Nam Yong Rivers in accordance with the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British Governments on June 18, 1941, subject to the adjustments stipulated in Articles II and III of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条鉴于中缅两国的平等友好关系，双方决定废除缅甸对属于中国的猛卯三角地（南碗指定区）所保持的“永租”关系。
Translation: Article 2 In view of the equal and friendly relations between China and Myanmar, the two parties have decided to abolish the "perpetual lease" status maintained by Myanmar over the Mengmao Triangular Area (Namwan Assigned Tract) belonging to China.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到缅甸方面的实际需要，中国方面同意把这个地区（面积约为220平方公里，85平方英里，如附图所标明）移交给缅甸，成为缅甸联邦领土的一部分。
Translation: Taking into account the actual needs of the Myanmar side, the Chinese side agrees to transfer this area (approximately 220 square kilometers or 85 square miles, as indicated in the attached map) to Myanmar, making it part of the territory of the Union of Myanmar.

Query_Text_cn: 作为交换，同时为了照顾历史关系和部落的完整，缅甸方面同意把按照一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文的规定属于缅甸的班洪、班老部落辖区（面积约为189平方公里，73平方英里，如附图所标明）划归中国，成为中国领土的一部分。
Translation: In exchange, and in consideration of historical ties and tribal integrity, the Burmese side agreed to transfer the Banhong and Banlao tribal areas (covering approximately 189 square kilometers or 73 square miles, as delineated in the attached map) to China, which had been designated as part of Burma under the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments on June 18, 1941, thereby incorporating them into Chinese territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条为了便于双方各自的行政管理，照顾当地居民的部落关系和生产、生活上的需要，双方同意对一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文划定的界线中的一小段，做一些公平合理的调整，把永和寨和龙乃寨划归中国，把羊柏寨、班孔寨、班弄寨和班歪寨划归缅甸，使这些骑线村寨不再被边界线所分割。
Translation:
Article III  
In order to facilitate the respective administrative management of both sides, accommodate the tribal relations of local residents, and meet their production and livelihood needs, the two parties agree to make fair and reasonable adjustments to a small section of the boundary line as delineated in the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments on June 18, 1941. Specifically, Yonghezhai and Longnaizhai shall be incorporated into China, while Yangbaizhai, Bankongzhai, Banlongzhai, and Banwaizhai shall be incorporated into Myanmar, thereby ensuring that these straddling villages are no longer divided by the boundary line.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条中国政府根据一贯反对外国特权和尊重其他国家主权的政策，声明放弃一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文规定的、中国参加经营缅甸炉房矿产企业的权利。
Translation: Article 4: In accordance with its consistent policy of opposing foreign prerogatives and respecting the sovereignty of other countries, the Government of the People's Republic of China hereby renounces its right of participation in the operation of the Bawdwin Mines in Burma as provided in the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British Governments on June 18, 1941.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约双方同意，从尖高山到中缅边界西端终点的一段边界，除片马、古浪、岗房地区以外，按照传统的习惯线定界，也就是从尖高山起，沿着以太平江、瑞丽江、怒江、西靖丹以上的独龙江为一方、恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭向北，直到在西靖丹以西独龙江南岸的一点，由此跨过独龙江，然后继续沿着以西靖丹以上的独龙江和察隅河为一方和除西靖丹以上的独龙江以外的全部伊洛瓦底江上游支系为另一方的分水岭，直到中缅边界西端终点为止。
Translation: Article V The two Contracting Parties agree that the section of the boundary from the尖高山 to the western extremity of the Sino-Burmese boundary, except for the Pianma, Gulang and Gangfang areas, shall be fixed along the traditional customary line. That is to say, starting from the尖高山, the boundary line runs northwards along the watershed between the Taiping River, the Ruili River, the Nu River and the Dulong River above the Xijingdan on the one side and the Nmai Hka River on the other side, until it reaches a point on the southern bank of the Dulong River west of the Xijingdan. From there, it crosses the Dulong River and then continues to follow the watershed between the Dulong River above the Xijingdan and the Zayu River on the one side and all the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River except the Dulong River above the Xijingdan on the other side, until it reaches the western extremity of the Sino-Burmese boundary.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条缔约双方确认，从尖高山到南帕河和南定河汇合处以及从南卡江和南永河汇合处到中缅边界东南端终点南腊河和澜沧江（湄公河）汇合处的两段边界，过去已经划定，无需加以更改，界线如本条约附图所标明。
Translation: Article VI The two Contracting Parties confirm that the two sections of the boundary from the尖高山 to the confluence of the Nam Hpa and Nam Ting Rivers and from the confluence of the Nam Kha and Nam Yung Rivers to the southeastern extremity of the Sino-Burmese boundary at the confluence of the Nam Lha River and the Lancang River (Mekong River) have already been delimited and require no change, with the boundary line as delineated in the maps attached to this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: （1）从尖高山（木浪凸）起，界线沿着以太平江（大盈江）、龙川江（瑞丽江）、怒江（萨尔温江）为一方，恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭向北转东南再向东北行，经过水城山口（马赤伊车特山口）、班瓦山口、大沙明山、派赖山口（耶冒隆古基特山口）、茨竹山口（拉桂山口），到楚衣大河（楚衣和大河）源头。
Translation: (1) From the summit of Jian Ga Shan (Mu Lang Tu), the boundary runs along the watershed between the Taiping River (Daying River), Longchuan River (Ruili River), and Nu River (Salween River) on one side and the Nmai Hka River on the other, turning northward, then southeastward, and finally northeastward. It passes through the Shuicheng Pass (Machiyichite Pass), Banwa Pass, Dashaming Mountain, Pailai Pass (Yemaolonggujite Pass), and Cizhu Pass (Lagui Pass), reaching the source of the Chuyi Dahe (Chuyihe Dahe).

Query_Text_cn: （2）从楚衣大河源头起，界线沿楚衣大河西北行，到该河和从北面流来的该河一支流的汇合处，即沿该支流北行，到以片马河（唐恰因河）的支流为一方、王克河（莫库河）及其支流楚衣大河为另一方的分水岭上的一点，转沿该分水岭西行，经马赤洛瓦底（2423公尺，7950英尺），再转北到片马寨以西穿过片马河，沿山脊北行，经鲁克桑坂山并穿过干河（康好河）到吴中河（瓦索考河），然后沿吴中河西行到该河和小江（瑙漳卡河）汇合处，再溯小江北上，到该江和大巴底河（保德河）汇合处。
Translation: (2) From the source of the Chuyi Dahe River, the boundary line runs northwest along the Chuyi Dahe River to the confluence of this river and one of its tributaries flowing from the north. It then proceeds north along this tributary to a point on the watershed separating the tributaries of the Pianma River (Tangqia Yin River) on one side and the Wangke River (Moku River) along with its tributary, the Chuyi Dahe River, on the other. From there, the boundary turns westward along this watershed, passing through Machiluo Wadi (2,423 meters, 7,950 feet), then turns north to cross the Pianma River west of Pianma Village. It continues north along the mountain ridge, traversing the Luksangban Mountain and crossing the Gan River (Kanghao River) to reach the Wuzhong River (Wasuo Kao River). The boundary then follows the Wuzhong River westward to its confluence with the Xiaojiang River (Nao Zhangka River), and ascends the Xiaojiang River northward to its junction with the Dadadi River (Baode River).

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线经过岗房寨以北，大体向东再向东南，沿着以小巴底河（泡西河）、吴中河为一方、大巴底河为另一方的分水岭，直到怒江和恩梅开江分水岭上的一点。
Translation: From this point, the boundary runs north of Gangfangzhai, generally eastward and then southeastward, following the watershed between the Xiaobadi River (Paoxi River) and Wuzhong River on one side and the Dabadi River on the other, until it reaches a point on the watershed between the Nu River and the Nmai Hka River.

Query_Text_cn: （3）从怒江和恩梅开江分水岭上的上述一点起，界线沿着以怒江、西靖丹以上的独龙江为一方、恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭大体向北，经过加俄都山口（沙燕山口）、沙拉山口、鸣克山口（纳开山口）、泥自谷山口（吉吉萨拉山口）、考赤萨拉山口、琼吉山口、麻古赤山口后，再向北大体转西行，经阿弄山口、麦瓦山口、邦唐山（邦唐拉孜）、容朗山口、阿拉拉孜到土色邦拉孜。
Translation: (3) From the aforementioned point on the watershed between the Nujiang River and the Nmai Hka River, the boundary line runs generally northward along the watershed separating the Nujiang River and the Dulong River upstream of Xijingdan on one side and the Nmai Hka River on the other, passing through the Jia'edu Pass (Shayan Pass), Sala Pass, Mingke Pass (Nakai Pass), Nizigu Pass (Jijisala Pass), Kaochisala Pass, Qiongji Pass, and Maguchi Pass. It then turns generally westward, continuing through the Along Pass, Maiwa Pass, Bangtang Mountain (Bangtang Lazi), Ronglang Pass, and Alalazi to Tuse Banglazi.

Query_Text_cn: （4）从土色邦拉孜起，界线沿山脊大体西北行，经2892公尺高地和2140．3公尺高地，到西靖丹以西独龙江南岸的一点，由此跨过独龙江，到独龙江和它的北边一支流的汇合处，然后沿山脊向西北，到扛丹拉孜（龙戛旁）。
Translation: (4) From the Tuse Bong La, the boundary line runs generally northwestward along the mountain ridge, passing through the 2,892-meter high point and the 2,140.3-meter high point, to a point on the south bank of the Dulong River west of Xijingdan. From there, it crosses the Dulong River to the confluence of the Dulong River and its northern tributary, then proceeds northwestward along the mountain ridge to the Gangdan La (Lungkapang).

Query_Text_cn: （5）从扛丹拉孜起，界线沿着以西靖丹以上的独龙江为一方和伊洛瓦底江上游支系（不包括西靖丹以上的独龙江）为另一方的分水岭大体向北再西北行，经过萨拉山口、聪惹山口（阿曼三山口）到宇朗山口。
Translation: (5) From Gangdan Lazi, the boundary runs generally northward and then northwestward along the watershed between the Dulong River above Xijingdan on one side and the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River (excluding the Dulong River above Xijingdan) on the other, passing through the Sala Pass, Congre Pass (Aman San Pass), and reaching the Yulang Pass.

Query_Text_cn: （6）从宇朗山口起，界线沿着以察隅河为一方和伊洛瓦底江上游支系为另一方的分水岭大体向西南行，经过贡拉山口到中缅边界西端终点。
Translation: (6) From the Yulang Pass, the boundary line runs generally southwestward along the watershed between the Chayu River on one side and the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River on the other, passing through the Gongla Pass to the western terminus of the China-Myanmar boundary.

Query_Text_cn: （1）从尖高山起，界线沿着以太平江上游支系、勐戛河、大巴江上游支系为一方、恩梅开江下游支系为另一方的分水岭大体向西南，经大丫口（陇牵克特），转西北到小雀丫口（大巴枯克特）。
Translation: (1) From the summit of Jian-Gao Mountain, the boundary follows the watershed between the tributaries of the Taiping River's upper reaches, the Mengga River, and the upper tributaries of the Daba River on one side, and the lower tributaries of the Enmei Kai River on the other, generally trending southwestward. It passes through Dayakou (Longqian Kete), then turns northwest to Xiaoqueyakou (Daba Kukete).

Query_Text_cn: （2）从小雀丫口起，界线顺大巴江、勐戛河，再溯石竹河（巴乃卡，上游名卡同卡），到石竹河源头。
Translation: (2) From Xiaoque Yakou, the boundary line follows the Daba River and the Mengga River, then ascends the Shizhu River (Banai Ka, known upstream as Katong Ka) to its source.

Query_Text_cn: （3）从石竹河源头起，界线沿着以勐来河为一方、巴窑卡河、玛琍卡河、南山河为另一方的分水岭向西南转西，到拉沙河源头。
Translation: (3) From the source of the Shizhu River, the boundary runs southwest then west along the watershed between the Menglai River on one side and the Bayaoka River, Malika River, and Nanshan River on the other, until reaching the source of the Lasha River.

Query_Text_cn: （4）从拉沙河源头起，界线顺拉沙河、溯穆雷江和羯羊河（既阳江），经马脖子（阿路克特），顺南奔江南下，到南奔江和太平江汇合处，再溯太平江东行，到太平江和枯利河汇合处以西的小山梁和太平江相遇处。
Translation: (4) From the source of the Lasha River, the boundary line follows the Lasha River upstream along the Mulei River and the Jieyang River (also known as the Jiyang River), passes through the Horse's Neck (Alukete), descends along the Nanben River southward to the confluence of the Nanben River and the Taiping River, then proceeds eastward along the Taiping River until it meets the small ridge west of the confluence of the Taiping River and the Kuli River.

Query_Text_cn: （5）从太平江和上述小山梁相遇处起，界线沿着以枯利河、户撒河（南撒河）、南碗河的支流为一方、枯利河以西的太平江支流为另一方的分水岭到邦千山（板凳山）。
Translation: (5) From the junction of the Taiping River and the aforementioned small ridge, the boundary runs along the watershed between the tributaries of the Kuli River, the Husa River (Nansa River), and the Nanwan River on one side, and the tributaries of the Taiping River west of the Kuli River on the other side, up to Mount Bangqian (Benchang Mountain).

Query_Text_cn: （6）从邦千山起，界线向南接金跌河，然后顺该河和南洼河（乓岭河），到曼允海寨东南、弄沙寨以北南洼河南岸一点，然后以直线向西南，转南行，到南洒河（曼丁河），从此顺过去划定界线时南洒河的河道到该河和南碗河汇合处，再顺当时南碗河的河道到该河道和当时瑞丽江的河道汇合处。
Translation: (6) From Mount Bangqian, the boundary line runs southward to the Jindie River, then follows this river and the Nanwa River (Bangling River) to a point on the southern bank of the Nanwa River southeast of Manyunhaizhai Village and north of Longshazhai Village. It then proceeds southwestward in a straight line, turning southward to the Nansa River (Manding River). From there, it follows the former course of the Nansa River as demarcated at the time to the confluence of this river and the Nanwan River, and then follows the former course of the Nanwan River to its junction with the former course of the Ruili River.

Query_Text_cn: （7）从过去划定界线时南碗河和瑞丽江的河道汇合处到瑞丽江和畹町河（南阳河）汇合处，界线的位置如本条约附图所示。
Translation: (7) From the confluence of the former course of the Nanwan River and the Ruili River to the confluence of the Ruili River and the Wanting River (Nanyang River), the boundary line follows the position as shown in the attached map to this treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线溯过去划定界线时畹町河的河道和卫上河，然后转西北沿南遮河（南色河）一支流到和南遮河汇合处，从此溯南遮河东行，经青树丫口，再沿勐龙河和过去划定界线时勐古河（南戈河）的河道，溯南开河和南邦瓦河，经一丫口，然后沿曼辛河[南棒河，上游名南跌河（南勒普河）]，到和怒江汇合处，从此溯怒江东行直到和地界沟（南扪河）相遇处。
Translation: From this point, the boundary follows the original alignment along the course of the Wanting River and the Weishang River, then turns northwest along a tributary of the Nanzhe River (Nanse River) to its confluence with the Nanzhe River. From there, it ascends the Nanzhe River eastward, passes through the Qingshu Yakou, and continues along the Menglong River and the original boundary alignment of the Menggu River (Nange River). It then ascends the Nankai River and the Nanbangwa River, traverses a yakou, and follows the Manxin River [Nanbang River, whose upper reaches are known as the Nandie River (Nanlepu River)] to its confluence with the Nu River. From this junction, the boundary ascends the Nu River eastward until it meets the boundary ditch (Nanmen River).

Query_Text_cn: （8）从怒江和地界沟相遇处起，界线向南沿地界沟而行，然后沿以勐棒河（南朋河上游）为一方、怒江的支流为另一方的分水岭向西南转南到炮楼山。
Translation: (8) From the confluence of the Nujiang River and the Dijiegou, the boundary line runs southward along the Dijiegou, then turns southwest and south along the watershed between the Mengbang River (the upper reaches of the Nanpeng River) on one side and the tributaries of the Nujiang River on the other, until it reaches the Paolou Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: （9）从炮楼山起，界线向东南沿瓦窑沟、麦地河南面的坡岭、板桥河和小鹿场河（新寨沟）而行，直到小鹿场河的源头。
Translation: (9) From Mount Paolou, the boundary runs southeast along Wayao Gully, the southern slopes of Maidi River, Banqiao River, and Xiaoluchang River (Xinzhai Gully) until reaching the headwaters of Xiaoluchang River.

Query_Text_cn: 从该河的源头直到南帕河和南定河汇合处，界线的位置如本条约附图所示。
Translation: From the source of the river to the confluence of the Nam Pa and Nam Ting Rivers, the boundary line follows the course as depicted in the attached map of this treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 然后，界线溯南定河东行约四公里（约三英里）后，即向东南沿公母大山（来兴山）西北山坡到公母大山山顶。
Translation: Then, the boundary line runs eastward along the south bank of the He River for approximately four kilometers (about three miles), before turning southeast along the northwestern slope of Gongmu Mountain (Laixing Mountain) to its summit.

Query_Text_cn: （10）从公母大山山顶起，界线向东南沿恭勐河（南涝沙河）一支流，到和从东南流来的另一支流汇合处，再溯后一支流到马落寨西北的一点。
Translation: (10) From the summit of Gongmu Dashan, the boundary runs southeast along a tributary of the Gongmeng River (Nam Lao Sha River) to its confluence with another tributary flowing from the southeast, then ascends the latter tributary to a point northwest of Maluo Village.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线以直线到马落寨西南一点，再以直线穿过云兴河（南大河）的一条支流，到上述支流和云兴河另一支流汇合处以东的仙人山，然后再沿云兴河上述两条支流的分水岭而行，到其中西面支流的源头，再沿勐林山脊向西转西南，到勐林山山顶。
Translation: From this point, the boundary runs in a straight line to a point southwest of Malozhai, then in a straight line across a tributary of the Yunxing River (South Great River) to Xianren Mountain east of the confluence of the aforementioned tributary and another tributary of the Yunxing River. It then follows the watershed between the two aforementioned tributaries of the Yunxing River to the source of the western tributary, turns westward and then southwestward along the ridge of Menglin Mountain, and reaches the summit of Menglin Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线沿南板河向东转东南行，到该河和从西南流来的在垭口寨东北面的一支流汇合处，溯该支流西南行，到垭口寨东北一点，从此转南，经过垭口寨以东的一点，穿过垭口寨南面的南板河一支流，即折向西行，到招保寨（达克莱诺）稍东的南衣河源头。
Translation: From there, the boundary turns eastward and then southeastward along the Nanban River until its confluence with a tributary flowing from the southwest northeast of Yakouzhai. It then ascends this tributary southwestward to a point slightly northeast of Yakouzhai. From there, it turns southward, passing a point east of Yakouzhai, crosses a tributary of the Nanban River south of Yakouzhai, and then turns westward to the headwaters of the Nanyi River slightly east of Zhaobaozhai (Dakelainuo).

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线沿南衣河、南模河南行，再转东沿南滚河、巧克河而行，到巧克河的东北源头。
Translation: From then on, the boundary runs southward along the Nan Yi River and the Nan Mo River, then turns eastward along the Nan Gun River and the Qiao Ke River until it reaches the northeastern source of the Qiao Ke River.

Query_Text_cn: （11）从巧克河的东北源头起，界线沿着以南滚河上游支系为一方、巧克河的南面支流和南丁河（南屯河）为另一方的分水岭向南转东而行，到羊柏寨西侧一点，向东经过羊柏寨以北100公尺处，再向东直到一小河在上述分水岭上的源头，然后沿山脊东行到勐董河（南董河，上游名大董河）一支流的源头，再沿该支流向东转东北行到和勐董河另一从东南流来的支流的汇合处，从此沿该支流到勐董河和龙达小河（南浪河）之间的分水岭上的该支流源头。
Translation: (11) From the northeastern source of the Chok River, the boundary runs southward and then eastward along the watershed between the upper tributaries of the Nangun River on one side and the southern tributaries of the Chok River and the Nanding River (Nantun River) on the other, reaching a point west of Yangbai Village. It then proceeds eastward, passing 100 meters north of Yangbai Village, and continues eastward to the source of a small stream on the aforementioned watershed. From there, it follows the ridge eastward to the source of a tributary of the Mengdong River (Nandong River, known upstream as the Dadong River), then turns northeast along this tributary to its confluence with another tributary of the Mengdong River flowing from the southeast. From this point, it follows the latter tributary to its source on the watershed between the Mengdong River and the Longda Stream (Nanlang River).

Query_Text_cn: 然后界线向东穿过分水岭到龙达小河的源头，再沿该河而行，到该河和从北面流来的支流汇合处，再沿该支流向北，然后穿过岗宾脑山脊上的一点，沿一河谷大体东行，穿过龙达小河一支流的两个分支流的汇合处，转向东北，到以勐董河为一方，南马河为另一方的分水岭，直到1941．8公尺（6370英尺）高地。
Translation: Then the boundary runs eastward along the watershed to the source of the Ronda Stream, follows this stream downstream to its confluence with a tributary flowing from the north, proceeds northward along this tributary, crosses a point on the Gambinau Ridge, and continues generally eastward along a valley. It passes through the confluence of two branches of a tributary of the Ronda Stream, turns northeastward, and reaches the watershed between the Mengdong River on one side and the Nanma River on the other, extending up to the 1,941.8-meter (6,370-foot) high point.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线沿着以勐董河、腊勐河（南勐河）、黑河、库杏河（南卡蓝河）、南卡镐河（南项河）为一方，南马河为另一方的分水岭，向东转南再转西北，直到来劳寨西北该分水岭上的一点。
Translation: From then on, the boundary follows the watershed between the Mengdong River, Lameng River (Nam Meng River), Hei River, Kuxing River (Nankalan River), and Nankagao River (Nanxiang River) on one side, and the Nanma River on the other, turning eastward, then southward, and finally northwestward until reaching a point on the watershed northwest of Lailao Village.

Query_Text_cn: （12）从来劳寨西北上述分水岭上的一点起，界线顺最近的南卡镐河支流而下，然后顺南卡镐河到其和从西南流来的支流的汇合处，再溯该支流大体向西南，到该支流在2180公尺（7152英尺）高地东北、离该高地最近的源头，然后在上述高地东南150公尺（492英尺）处穿过山脊，转南到发源于上述高地最近的南弄河（南洒克河）一支流的源头，然后沿该支流到和南弄河汇合处，再沿南弄河、南锡河、南卡江，到南卡江和南永河汇合处，再溯南永河而上，到其源头。
Translation: (12) From the point on the watershed ridge northwest of Laozhai, the boundary follows the nearest tributary of the Nankago River downstream, then proceeds along the Nankago River to its confluence with a tributary flowing from the southwest. It then ascends this tributary generally southwestward to its source closest to the northeast of the 2,180-meter (7,152-foot) highland. Crossing the ridge 150 meters (492 feet) southeast of the aforementioned highland, it turns south to the source of the nearest tributary of the Nanlong River (Nansake River) originating from the said highland. The boundary then follows this tributary to its confluence with the Nanlong River, continues along the Nanlong River, Nanxi River, and Nankajiang River to the confluence of the Nankajiang and Nanyong Rivers, and finally ascends the Nanyong River to its source.

Query_Text_cn: （13）从南永河源头起，界线向东南到纳乌河和南配河（南亚河）的分水岭，再沿该分水岭大体向东，继沿纳乌河，到和南来河的汇合处，再沿纳乌河和南来河的分水岭而行，到昂朗山（洛昂朗）山脊，向北沿山脊到昂朗山山顶，再大体向东沿山脊穿过南洞基克河，然后沿着以拉定河（会缺台河）以北的南垒河西岸的支流和南腊河（南马河的支流）为一方、拉定河以南的南垒河西岸的支流为另一方的分水岭而行，到邦顺山（洛邦顺）山顶。
Translation: (13) From the source of the Nanyong River, the boundary runs southeast to the watershed between the Nawu River and the Nanpei River (Nanya River), then generally eastward along this watershed, continuing along the Nawu River to its confluence with the Nanlai River. It then follows the watershed between the Nawu River and the Nanlai River to the ridge of Mount Anglang (Luo Anglang), turns north along the ridge to the summit of Mount Anglang, and proceeds generally eastward along the ridge, crossing the Nandongjike River. Thereafter, it follows the watershed between the tributaries on the west bank of the Nanlei River north of the Lading River (Hui Que Tai River) and the Nanla River (a tributary of the Nanma River) on one side, and the tributaries on the west bank of the Nanlei River south of the Lading River on the other, until reaching the summit of Mount Bangshun (Luo Bangshun).

Query_Text_cn: （14）从邦顺山山顶起，界线大体向东沿着拉定河、南垒河、过去划定界线时南乐河的河道、南卧河（南卜河），到南卧改乃山（洛外南）上的南卧河源头。
Translation: (14) From the summit of Bangshun Mountain, the boundary runs generally eastward along the Lading River, the Nanlei River, the former demarcation course of the Nanle River, and the Nanwo River (Nanbu River), up to the source of the Nanwo River on Nanwo Gainai Mountain (Luowai South).

Query_Text_cn: （15）从南卧改乃山上的南卧河源头起，界线大体向东沿着以南腊河（南垒河的支流）、南派河、南西河（南霍河）为一方、南品河、南卯河、南西板河为另一方的分水岭而行，到三面坡（洛三勐）。
Translation: (15) From the source of the Nam Ngum River on the Nam Ngum Mountain, the boundary generally runs eastward along the watershed between the Nam La River (a tributary of the Nam Loei River), Nam Phai River, and Nam Si River (Nam Houay River) on one side, and the Nam Ping River, Nam Mao River, and Nam Siphan River on the other, reaching San Mian Po (Lao Sam Mong).

Query_Text_cn: （16）从三面坡起，界线大体向东北，到南览河西岸的一点，然后顺该河而下，到南览河南岸的鸠那山脚，再大体东南行，经过灰令亮（灰莫秋）、拉地、南孟号到麦牛栋，再大体向东北行，穿过龙曼当，到灰腊小河，再沿该河向北行，到该河和南览河汇合处。
Translation: (16) From Sanmianpo, the boundary line runs generally northeastward to a point on the west bank of the Nanlan River, then follows the river downstream to the foot of Jiuna Mountain on the southern bank of the Nanlan River. It then proceeds generally southeastward, passing through Huilingliang (Huimoqiu), Ladi, and Nanmenghao to Mainiudong. From there, it continues generally northeastward, crossing Longmandang to reach the Huila Stream, then follows the stream northward to its confluence with the Nanlan River.

Query_Text_cn: 然后，界线向东转南沿南览河、南桔河（南舍河）、南甲河（回洒河），到垒连底法山。
Translation: Then, the boundary turns eastward and southward along the Nanlan River, Nanju River (Nanshe River), and Nanjia River (Huisa River), reaching Mount Leiliandifa.

Query_Text_cn: 然后界线沿南摩特河（南麦河）、南洞河、南达河，到悻岗垒山（马行拱山）。
Translation: Then the boundary follows the Namot River (Nam Mai River), Nam Dong River, and Nam Ta River up to Mount Xinggang Lei (Mount Mahang Gong).

Query_Text_cn: （17）从悻岗垒山起，界线向东沿着以南阿河及其上游支系为一方、南洛河（包括其支流南黑河）为另一方的分水岭而行，直到广变乃山顶。
Translation: (17) From the peak of Xigang Leishan, the boundary runs eastward along the watershed between the Nan'a River and its upper tributaries on one side and the Nanluo River (including its tributary Nanhei River) on the other, until it reaches the summit of Guangbiannai Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: （18）从广变乃山顶起，界线大体向东北沿回勒河（南勒河）、过去划定界线时南阿河的河道而行，到南阿河和澜沧江（湄公河）汇合处，即顺澜沧江而下，直到中缅边界东南端终点南腊河和澜沧江汇合处止。
Translation: (18) From the summit of Guangbiannai Mountain, the boundary line generally runs northeastward along the Huile River (Nanle River) and the former course of the Nana River as demarcated in previous boundary delineations, proceeding to the confluence of the Nana River and the Lancang River (Mekong River). It then follows the Lancang River downstream until reaching the southeastern terminus of the China-Myanmar boundary at the junction of the Nanla River and the Lancang River.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条所述的两国全部边界线以及双方在联合勘察时所树立的临时分界标志的位置，标明在本条约所附的二十五万分之一的全线图和某些地区的五万分之一的地图上。
Translation: III. The entire boundary line between the two countries as described in this Article, together with the locations of all temporary boundary markers erected during the joint survey, is indicated on the 1:250,000-scale full-line map and the 1:50,000-scale maps of certain areas attached to this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条缔约双方同意，凡是以河流为界的地段，不能通航的河流以河道中心线为界，能够通航的河流以主要航道（水流最深处）的中心线为界，如果界河改道，除双方另有协议外，两国的边界线维持不变。
Translation: Article 8 The Contracting Parties agree that for boundary sections demarcated by rivers, the central line of the river course shall be the boundary line for non-navigable rivers, while the central line of the main channel (the deepest watercourse) shall serve as the boundary for navigable rivers. In the event of a river changing its course, unless otherwise agreed by both Parties, the boundary line between the two countries shall remain unchanged.
