Translation: This provision shall apply to ashes, which shall be kept by the cemetery registry until disposal in accordance with national wishes.

Query_Text_cn: 一俟情况允许，并至迟在战事结束之时，各坟墓登记处应通过第十六条第二项所指之情报局互相交换表册，载明坟墓之确实地点与标志以及有关该处埋葬的死者之详细情形。
Translation: As soon as circumstances permit, and at the latest at the end of hostilities, the Graves Registration Services shall exchange, through the Information Bureau mentioned in the second paragraph of Article 16, lists showing the exact location and markings of the graves, together with particulars of the dead interred therein.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条军事当局得号召居民以慈善精神，自愿在其指导下，收集与照顾伤者、病者。并对于响应此项号召之人予以必要之保护及便利。
Translation: Article 18. The military authorities may appeal to the charity of the inhabitants voluntarily to collect and care for, under their direction, the wounded and sick, granting to persons who have responded to this appeal the necessary protection and facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 倘敌方控制或再控制该地区，则对于上述之人亦应予以同样之保护及便利。
Translation: Should the enemy gain or regain control of the area, the aforementioned individuals shall likewise be accorded the same protection and facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 军事当局，即令在侵入或占领地区，亦应准许居民或救济团体自动收集与照顾任何国籍之伤者、病者。
Translation: Military authorities, even in invaded or occupied areas, shall permit inhabitants or relief societies to spontaneously collect and care for the wounded or sick of any nationality.

Query_Text_cn: 一般平民应尊重此种伤者、病者；尤不得施以暴行。
Translation: Civilians shall respect the wounded and sick, and shall refrain from any acts of violence against them.

Query_Text_cn: 任何人不得因看护伤者、病者而被侵扰或定罪。
Translation: No one shall be molested or convicted for having cared for the wounded or sick.

Query_Text_cn: 本条规定并不免除占领国对于伤者、病者给予身体上及精神上照顾之义务。
Translation: This provision does not relieve the Occupying Power of its obligation to provide physical and mental care for the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条医务部门之固定医疗所，及流动医疗队，在任何情况下不得被攻击，而应随时受冲突各方之尊重及保护。
Translation: Article 19 Fixed medical establishments and mobile medical units of the Medical Service may in no circumstances be attacked, but shall at all times be respected and protected by the Parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 倘落于敌方之手，在俘获国自身对于发现在该医疗所及医疗队之伤者、病者未能保证必需之照顾期中，其人员仍应有执行其任务之自由。
Translation: If they fall into the hands of the enemy, the personnel shall be free to carry out their duties as long as the capturing Power has not itself ensured the necessary care of the wounded and sick found in such establishments and units.

Query_Text_cn: 负责当局应保护上述医疗所及医疗队尽可能如此设置，以期不致因对军事目标之攻击而危及其安全。
Translation: The responsible authorities shall ensure that such medical units and mobile medical units are, as far as possible, situated in such a manner that attacks against military objectives cannot imperil their safety.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条1949年8月12日改善海上武装部队伤者病者及遇船难者境遇之日内瓦公约所保护之医院船，不得自陆上加以攻击。
Translation: Article 20: Hospital ships entitled to protection under the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of Wounded, Sick and Shipwrecked Members of Armed Forces at Sea of August 12, 1949, shall not be attacked from the land.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条医务部门之固定医疗所及流动医疗队应得之保护不得停止，除非此等组织越出其人道主义任务之外，用以从事有害于敌方之行为。
Translation: Article 21 The protection to which fixed medical establishments and mobile medical units are entitled shall not cease unless they are used to commit, outside their humanitarian duties, acts harmful to the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 惟如经给予相当警告，并依各个情形，指定合理之时限而警告仍被忽视时，始得停止保护。
Translation: Protection shall only be withdrawn after a due warning has been given and, depending on the circumstances, a reasonable time limit has been specified, yet the warning remains unheeded.

Query_Text_cn: (五)医疗所或医疗队或其人员扩展其人道主义的活动及于伤病平民之照顾。
Translation: (v) The medical establishment or medical unit or its personnel extend their humanitarian activities to the care of civilian sick and wounded.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条平时各缔约国及战事开始后冲突各方，均得在其领土内，于必要时在占领地内，设立医院地带及处所，加以适当的组织以便保护伤者、病者，及在该地带处所负责组织与管理工作以及照顾集中于该处人们之人员，俾免受战争影响。
Translation: Article 23 In time of peace, the High Contracting Parties and, after the outbreak of hostilities, the Parties to the conflict, may establish in their own territory and, if the need arises, in occupied areas, hospital zones and localities so organized as to protect the wounded and sick from the effects of war, as well as the personnel entrusted with the organization and administration of these zones and localities and with the care of the persons therein assembled.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事开始时，及其进行中，有关各方得缔结协定互相承认其所设立之医院地带及处所。
Translation: At the commencement of or during hostilities, the parties concerned may conclude agreements for the mutual recognition of the hospital and safety zones they have established.

Query_Text_cn: 各该国得为此目的实施本公约所附协定草案之规定，连同其所认为必要之修改。
Translation: Each State shall, for this purpose, implement the provisions of the draft agreement annexed to this Convention, together with such modifications as it deems necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 为便利此等医院地带及处所之设立与承认，保护国及红十字国际委员会当被邀从事斡旋。
Translation: To facilitate the establishment and recognition of such hospital zones and localities, the Protecting Powers and the International Committee of the Red Cross shall be invited to lend their good offices.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条专门从事寻觅、收集、运送、医治伤者、病者及预防疾病之医务人员，专门从事管理医疗队及医疗所之职员以及随军牧师，在一切情况下应受尊重与保护。
Translation: Article 24: Medical personnel exclusively engaged in the search for, collection, transport, or treatment of the wounded and sick, or in the prevention of disease, as well as staff exclusively assigned to the administration of medical units and establishments, and chaplains attached to the armed forces, shall be respected and protected in all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条武装部队中曾受特别训练以备于需要时充当医院勤务员、护士或辅助担架员，从事寻觅、收集、运送或诊疗伤者及病者之人员，如其执行任务时与敌人接触，或落于敌方之手，应同样受尊重与保护。
Translation: Article 25: Members of the armed forces specially trained to serve, if necessary, as hospital orderlies, nurses, or auxiliary stretcher-bearers in the search for, collection, transportation, or treatment of the wounded and sick shall likewise be respected and protected if they are carrying out these duties at the time they come into contact with the enemy or fall into its hands.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条凡经本国政府正式认可并核准之各国红十字会及其他志愿救济团体之员，如担任第二十四条所述人员同样之任务，则应与该条所述人员处于同样地位，但此类团体之人员应受军事法规之约束。
Translation: Article 26: Members of duly recognized and authorized national Red Cross societies and other voluntary relief organizations who perform the same duties as the personnel mentioned in Article 24 shall be placed on the same footing as the said personnel, provided that the members of such societies and organizations are subject to military laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 每一缔约国应将在其责任下准许从事协助其武装部队的正规医疗工作之各团体之名称，通知其他一方。此项通知，应于平时，或战事开始时，或战事进行中，但无论如何，在实际使用各该名称以前为之。
Translation: Each High Contracting Party shall notify the other Party of the names of the organizations under its authority authorized to engage in regular medical activities in support of its armed forces. Such notification shall be made in peacetime, at the outbreak of hostilities, or during the course of hostilities, but in any case before the actual use of such names.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条凡中立国认可之团体，必需经其本国政府之事先同意及有关冲突一方之核准，始得以其医疗人员及医疗队协助该冲突之一方。
Translation: Article 27 A recognized society of a neutral country can only lend the assistance of its medical personnel and units to a Party to the conflict with the prior consent of its own government and the authorization of the Party to the conflict concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 此项人员及此等医疗队应受该冲突一方之管制。
Translation: Such personnel and medical units shall be under the control of the party to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 该中立国应将此项同意通知接受协助国家之敌方。
Translation: The neutral state shall notify the opposing party of the state receiving assistance of such consent.

Query_Text_cn: 接受此项协助之冲突一方在利用之前，必须通知敌方。
Translation: The party to the conflict receiving such assistance must notify the adversary prior to its utilization.

Query_Text_cn: 此种协助在任何情况下不得视为对于冲突之干预。
Translation: Such assistance shall in no case be regarded as interference in the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 对于第一款所指之人员于离开其所属之中立国前，应发给第四十条所规定之身份证。
Translation: For the persons referred to in the first paragraph, an identity card as prescribed in Article 40 shall be issued before they leave the neutral country to which they belong.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条第二十四及二十六各条所指人员之落于敌方手中者，仅在战俘之健康状况精神需要以及人数上均有此要求时，方得留用之。
Translation: Article 28: The personnel referred to in Articles 24 and 26 who fall into enemy hands may only be retained if their health condition, mental needs, and numbers so require, and solely for the treatment of prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 因上述情形而留用之人员不得视为战俘。
Translation: Personnel retained under the above circumstances shall not be considered prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 但至少应享受1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约所规定之利益。
Translation: However, they shall at least benefit from the protections stipulated in the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12, 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 上项人员应在拘留国军事法规范围内，并在该国主管部门管辖下，本其职业之道义，继续为战俘，尤其属于其本国武装部队者，执行其医疗及精神任务。
Translation: The aforementioned personnel shall continue to carry out their medical and spiritual duties for prisoners of war, particularly those belonging to their own armed forces, within the framework of the detaining power's military regulations and under the jurisdiction of its competent authorities, adhering to the ethical principles of their profession.

Query_Text_cn: ()彼等应许其定期访问战俘营外之劳动队或医院中之战俘。
Translation: They shall be permitted to visit prisoners of war regularly at labor detachments or hospitals outside the prisoner-of-war camps.

Query_Text_cn: 拘留国应供给所需之交通工具。
Translation: The detaining power shall provide the necessary means of transport.

Query_Text_cn: ()关于每一战俘营中留用医务人员之职务上活动，由该营最高级医官对该营军事当局负责。
Translation: ()Regarding the professional activities of retained medical personnel in each prisoner-of-war camp, the senior medical officer of the camp shall be responsible to the camp's military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，在战事开始时，冲突各方应就医务人员相当等级之事取得协议，其中包括第二十六条所列团体之医务人员之等级。
Translation: For this purpose, at the outbreak of hostilities, the Parties to the conflict shall agree upon the corresponding ranks of the medical personnel, including that of the societies mentioned in Article 26.

Query_Text_cn: 上述医官及随军牧师有权直接与该营之军事及医务当局接洽有关职务之一切问题，该军事及医务当局应予彼等以有关此项问题之通讯所必需之便利。
Translation: The aforementioned medical officers and chaplains shall have the right to communicate directly with the military and medical authorities of the battalion on all matters pertaining to their duties. The said military and medical authorities shall afford them the necessary facilities for such correspondence.

Query_Text_cn: ()营中留用人员虽应服从内部纪律，但不得令其从事医疗或宗教任务以外之任何工作。
Translation: Personnel retained in the camps shall be subject to internal discipline, but shall not be required to perform any work other than medical or religious duties.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事中，冲突各方应制定关于可能时遣返留用人员之办法，并决定遣返之程序。
Translation: During hostilities, the parties to the conflict shall establish procedures for the possible repatriation of retained personnel and determine the modalities of such repatriation.

Query_Text_cn: 上述各规定并不解除拘留国对于战俘医疗及精神上之福利所应尽之义务。
Translation: The above provisions shall not relieve the Detaining Power of its obligations regarding the medical and spiritual welfare of prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条第二十五条所指人员落于敌方手中者，应为战俘，但于需要时应令其担任医务工作。
Translation: Article 29: Personnel referred to in Article 25 who fall into enemy hands shall be prisoners of war, but shall be employed on medical duties insofar as the need arises.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条非系第二十八条所规定之必需留用人员，一俟归路可通及军情许可，应将其送回其所属之冲突一方。
Translation: Article 30: Persons who are not required to be retained under the provisions of Article 28 shall be returned to the Party to the conflict to which they belong as soon as a route for their return is open and military considerations permit.

Query_Text_cn: 上述人员在等候回国期间，不应视为战俘，但至少应享受1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约所规定之利益。
Translation: The above-mentioned personnel, while awaiting repatriation, shall not be considered as prisoners of war but shall at least enjoy the benefits provided by the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12, 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等并应在敌方指挥下，继续执行其任务，尤以派其照顾其所同属冲突一方之伤者、病者为宜。
Translation: They shall also continue to carry out their duties under the direction of the enemy, particularly in caring for the wounded and sick belonging to the party to the conflict to which they themselves belong.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等出发时，应携带其所有行李、个人用品、贵重品及工具等。
Translation: Upon departure, they shall carry all their luggage, personal belongings, valuables, and tools.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条依第三十条规定，送回人员之选择，应不拘种族、宗教或政治意见之任何考虑，但宜按照其被俘日期之次序及身体健康之状况为之。
Translation: Article 31: The selection of persons to be repatriated under Article 30 shall be made without any adverse distinction based on race, religion or political opinion, and shall preferably be carried out according to the order of their capture and their state of health.

Query_Text_cn: 自战事开始时起，冲突各方得以特别协定，按照战俘之人数之比例及战俘营中此等人员之分配，决定留用人员之百分比。
Translation: From the outset of hostilities, the parties to the conflict may, by special agreement, determine the percentage of personnel to be retained based on the number of prisoners of war and their distribution in prisoner-of-war camps.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条第二十七条所指之人员落于敌方之手者，不得拘留。
Translation: Article 32 Persons designated in Article 27 who fall into the hands of the enemy shall not be detained.

Query_Text_cn: 除另有协议外，应许其返回本国，如其不可能，则一俟归路可通及军情许可，应准予返回其所服役之冲突一方的领土。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, they shall be permitted to return to their country, or, if this is not possible, to the territory of the Party to the conflict in whose service they were, as soon as a route for their return is open and military considerations permit.

Query_Text_cn: 等候释放期间，彼等应在敌方指导下，继续其工作，尤以担任看护其所服役之冲突一方之伤者、病者为宜。
Translation: While awaiting release, they shall continue their work under the direction of the opposing party and shall preferably be engaged in the care of the wounded and sick of the armed forces to which they belong.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等出发时，应携带其行李、个人用品、贵重品、工具、武器，并于可能时，其所有之交通工具。
Translation: Upon departure, they shall carry their luggage, personal belongings, valuables, tools, weapons, and, if possible, all their means of transportation.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方对于在其权力下之此种人员，应予以与本国武装部队相等人员同样之食物、居所、津贴及薪给。
Translation: The parties to the conflict shall provide the persons under their authority with the same food, accommodation, allowances, and pay as are granted to their own armed forces.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情形下，食物之质，量及种类均应足以维持上述人员之正常健康状况。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall the quality, quantity, and variety of food be less than sufficient to maintain the normal health of the aforementioned personnel.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条武装部队之流动医疗队落于敌方之手者，其器材应留作照顾伤者及病者之用。
Translation: Article 33 The material of mobile medical units of the armed forces which fall into the hands of the enemy shall be reserved for the care of wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 武装部队之固定医疗所的建筑物、器材及物资，应仍受战争法规之拘束，但在其为照顾伤者、病者所必需之期间，不得移作别用。
Translation: The buildings, equipment, and supplies of the fixed medical establishments of the armed forces shall remain subject to the laws of war, but shall not be diverted from their purpose as long as they are required for the care of the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 惟战地司令遇紧急军事需要时得使用之，但须彼等预订关于在该所疗养之伤者、病者的福利之办法。
Translation: Only the commander of the battlefield may use it in case of urgent military necessity, provided that they have made prior arrangements for the welfare of the wounded and sick being treated therein.

Query_Text_cn: 本条所指之器材与物资不得故意摧毁。
Translation: The equipment and materials referred to in this article shall not be deliberately destroyed.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条凡许予本公约的特权之各救济团体，其不动产与动产应视为私有财产。
Translation: Article 34 The movable and immovable property of relief societies entitled to the benefits of the present Convention shall be regarded as private property.

Query_Text_cn: 战争法规及惯例所承认之交战国征用权，仅在紧急需要的场合，并在对伤者、病者之福利已有保证后，始得行使。
Translation: The right of requisition recognized by the laws and customs of war may only be exercised in cases of urgent necessity and after ensuring the welfare of the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条伤者及病者或医疗设备之运输队，应与流动医疗队受同样之尊重及保护。
Translation: Article 35: Convoys of vehicles or hospital trains transporting wounded and sick civilians or medical equipment shall be respected and protected in the same manner as mobile medical units.

Query_Text_cn: 此项运输队或车辆如落于敌方手中时，应受战争法规之拘束；但以俘获该项运输或车辆之冲突一方在一切情形下，应保证照顾其所载运之伤者、病者为条件。
Translation: Such medical transports or vehicles, if they fall into enemy hands, shall be subject to the laws of war; provided that the capturing party shall in all cases ensure the care of the wounded and sick they transport.

Query_Text_cn: 文职人员及由征用所得之一切运输工具应受国际法一般规则之拘束。
Translation: Civilian personnel and all means of transport obtained through requisition shall be subject to the general rules of international law.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条对于医务飞机，即专用以搬移伤者、病者，及运送医务人员及设备之飞机，不得袭击，而在各有关交战国间所特别约定之高度、时间及航线飞行时，应受各交战国之尊重。
Translation: Article 36: Medical aircraft, exclusively employed for the removal of the wounded and sick and for the transport of medical personnel and equipment, shall not be attacked. They shall be respected by all belligerents when flying at heights, times and on routes specifically agreed upon between the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 此项飞机在其上下及两侧面应显明标以第三十八条所规定之特殊标志，以及其本国国旗。
Translation: The aircraft shall bear the distinctive marks prescribed in Article 38, as well as its national flag, clearly displayed on its upper, lower, and both lateral surfaces.

Query_Text_cn: 并应备有战事开始时或战事进行中经各交战国间同意之任何其他标志或识别方法。
Translation: and shall also be provided with any other markings or means of identification that may be agreed upon between the belligerents at the outbreak or during the course of hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 除另有协议外，在敌人领土或敌人占领地上空之飞行应予禁止。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, flight over enemy territory or territory occupied by the enemy shall be prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 医务飞机应服从一切降落命令。
Translation: Medical aircraft shall comply with all landing orders.

Query_Text_cn: 如被令降落，而需要检查时，则经过检查后，该机载其乘员得继续航行。
Translation: If ordered to land and subject to inspection, the aircraft and its occupants shall be allowed to continue their journey after the inspection.

Query_Text_cn: 非自愿降落于敌人领土或敌人占领地时，机内之伤者、病者及飞行人员应为战俘。
Translation: In the event of an involuntary landing in enemy territory or territory occupied by the enemy, the wounded, sick, and aircrew members on board shall be considered prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 医务人员应按第二十四条及以下各条待遇之。
Translation: Medical personnel shall be entitled to the treatment specified in Article 24 and the following provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条冲突各方之医务飞机，在本条第二款规定之拘束下，得在中立国之领土上空飞行，必要时，得在该国领土降落，或用以为停留站。
Translation: Article 37 Medical aircraft of parties to the conflict may fly over the territory of neutral States, land thereon in case of necessity, or use it as a port of call, subject to the provisions of the second paragraph below.

Query_Text_cn: 该项飞机之飞越上述领土，应预先通知各中立国，并服从一切水陆降落之命令。
Translation: The flight of such aircraft over the said territories shall be notified in advance to the neutral Powers and shall comply with all orders to land, whether on land or water.

Query_Text_cn: 仅在冲突各方与有关中立国特别约定之航线、高度及时间飞行时，始免受袭击。
Translation: Aircraft shall be immune from attack only when flying along routes, at heights and at times specifically agreed upon between the belligerents and the neutral Powers concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 但中立国对于医疗飞机之飞越其领土或在其领土降落，得规定条件或限制。
Translation: However, neutral states may impose conditions or restrictions on the flight of medical aircraft over their territory or their landing therein.

Query_Text_cn: 此项可能的条件与限制对于冲突各方应一律适用。
Translation: The potential terms and conditions shall apply equally to all parties involved in the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 除中立国与冲突各方另有协议外，凡经地方当局之同意由医务飞机运至中立国领土之伤者、病者，如国际法有此要求，应由中立国以适当方式予以拘留，俾彼等不能再行参加战斗。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed between the neutral power and the parties to the conflict, wounded and sick who are brought by medical aircraft to neutral territory with the consent of the local authorities shall, if required by international law, be detained by the neutral power in such a manner as to prevent them from again taking part in hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 医院收容与拘禁之费用应由其所依附之国负担。
Translation: The expenses for hospital accommodation and detention shall be borne by the country to which they are attached.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条为对瑞士表示敬意，白底红十字之旗样，系将其联邦国旗翻转而形成者，留作武装部队医务部门之标志与特殊记号。
Translation: Article 38: As a tribute to Switzerland, the emblem of a red cross on a white ground, formed by reversing the federal colors of that country, is retained as the distinctive sign and special symbol of the medical service of armed forces.

Query_Text_cn: 但各国如已采用白底红新月或白底红狮与日以代替红十字之标志者，此等标志亦为本公约规定所承认。
Translation: However, the emblem of the red crescent on a white ground or the red lion and sun on a white ground shall be equally recognized under the provisions of the present Convention if already adopted by a country as a distinctive sign in place of the red cross.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条在军事主管当局之指导下，上项标志应标明于旗帜、臂章，及医务部门所使用之一切设备上。
Translation: Article 39 Under the direction of the competent military authority, the emblem shall be displayed on the flags, armlets, and on all equipment employed in the Medical Service.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条第二十四、二十六、二十七各条所指之人员，应在左臂佩带由军事机关发给并盖印而具有特殊标志之防水臂章。
Translation: Article 40: The personnel referred to in Articles 24, 26, and 27 shall wear on the left arm a waterproof armlet bearing a distinctive emblem, issued and stamped by the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 此种人员除应携带第十六条所述之身份牌外，应另携带具有此项特殊标志之特种身份证。
Translation: In addition to the identity tags specified in Article 16, such personnel shall carry a special identity card bearing this distinctive emblem.

Query_Text_cn: 此证应有防水之效能，并具有适当的尺寸以便携带于衣袋内。
Translation: This certificate shall be waterproof and of appropriate dimensions for convenient carrying in a pocket.

Query_Text_cn: 其上应用本国文字，至少载明持用者之姓名、出生日期、等级、番号，并应注明其以何种身份享受本公约之保护。
Translation: It shall bear the name, date of birth, rank and service number of the bearer, in the national language, and shall state in what capacity the bearer is entitled to the protection of the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 该证应附有本人像片，及其签字或指纹，或二者俱备。
Translation: The certificate shall bear the likeness of the holder, and his signature or fingerprint, or both.

Query_Text_cn: 该证并应加盖军事当局之钢印。
Translation: The certificate shall also bear the official seal of the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 同一武装部队所使用之身份证应式样一致，并尽可能使各缔约国之武装部队使用类似的式样。
Translation: The identity cards used by the armed forces of the same Party shall be of a uniform pattern, and the armed forces of the different Parties shall, as far as possible, use similar patterns.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方可参照本公约所附之示范格式。
Translation: The parties to the conflict may refer to the model format attached to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事开始时，冲突各方应互相通知其所采用之式样。
Translation: At the outset of hostilities, the parties to the conflict shall mutually notify each other of the distinctive emblems they have adopted.

Query_Text_cn: 在可能范围内，身份证至少应制备两份，其中一份存于本国。
Translation: Within the possible scope, at least two copies of the identity document should be prepared, with one copy stored domestically.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下对上述人员不得剥夺其符号或身份证，或佩带臂章之权利。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall the above-mentioned personnel be deprived of their insignia or identity cards, or the right to wear armlets.

Query_Text_cn: 如遇遗失时得领取身份证副本或补领符号。
Translation: In case of loss, a duplicate or replacement symbol of the ID card may be obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 此项臂章由军事当局盖印发给。
Translation: This armband is issued with the seal of the military authority.

Query_Text_cn: 此种人员所佩带之军事证明文件，应注明其所受之特别训练，其所担任任务之临时性以及佩带臂章之权利。
Translation: The military identification documents carried by such personnel shall specify their special training, the temporary nature of their assigned duties, and their entitlement to wear armbands.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条本公约特殊旗帜之悬挂仅限于依本公约应受尊重之医疗队及医疗所，并须经军事当局同意。
Translation: Article 42 The distinctive flag of the Convention may be flown only over medical units and establishments entitled to respect under the Convention and with the consent of the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 流动医疗队与固定医疗所，均得加悬其所属冲突一方之国旗。
Translation: Mobile medical units and fixed medical establishments shall be marked by the flag of the party to the conflict to which they belong.

Query_Text_cn: 但落于敌方手中之医疗队，除本公约之旗帜外，不得悬挂其他任何旗帜。
Translation: However, medical units falling into enemy hands may not display any flag other than that of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方，于军情许可下，应采取必要之步骤，使标明医疗队所之特殊标志易为敌方海陆空军所辨识，以避免任何敌对行动之可能。
Translation: The Parties to the conflict shall, whenever military considerations permit, take the necessary steps to make the distinctive emblems indicating medical units and establishments visible to the enemy's land, air, and naval forces, in order to avoid the possibility of any hostile action.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条属于中立国之医疗队经获准依照第二十七条所规定之条件协助一交战国者，在该交战国欲利用第四十二条所给予之特许时，除悬挂本公约之旗帜外，应加悬该交战国之国旗。
Translation: Article 43: A medical unit belonging to a neutral country that has been authorized to assist a belligerent under the conditions stipulated in Article 27 shall, when the said belligerent avails itself of the privilege granted by Article 42, display the flag of that belligerent alongside the flag of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 除受负责军事当局相反的命令之拘束外，此等医疗队得于一切情况下悬挂其本国国旗，即使其落于敌方手中。
Translation: Unless subject to contrary orders from the responsible military authorities, such medical units may fly their national flag under all circumstances, even if they fall into enemy hands.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条除本条下列各款所列情形外，白底红十字标志及"红十字”字样，或"日内瓦十字”字样，不论在平时或战时，只能用以标明或保护本公约及规定类似事项之其他公约所保护之医疗队及医疗所，以及其人员与器材。
Translation: Article 44: Except for the cases specified in the following paragraphs of this Article, the emblem of the red cross on a white ground and the words "Red Cross" or "Geneva Cross," whether in peacetime or wartime, may be used only to indicate or protect medical units and establishments covered by the present Convention and by other conventions providing for similar matters, as well as their personnel and equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 对于使用第三十八条第二款提及之标志之国家，本规定应适用于该项标志。
Translation: For countries using the emblem referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 38, this provision shall apply to such emblem.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条所指之各国红十字会及其他救济团体仅在本款所指范围内有权使用给予本公约之保护之特别标志。
Translation: The national Red Cross societies and other relief agencies referred to in Article 26 shall have the right to use the distinctive emblem conferring the protection of the present Convention only within the limits specified in this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，各国红十字会（红新月、红狮与日）在平时依照其本国法律，得使用红十字名义及标志，以从事其他符合国际红十字大会所定之原则之活动。
Translation: In addition, national Red Cross (Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun) societies may, in peacetime and in accordance with their domestic laws, use the name and emblem of the Red Cross to carry out other activities consistent with the principles laid down by the International Conference of the Red Cross.

Query_Text_cn: 此项标志应用比较小的尺寸，并不得置于臂章或屋顶上。
Translation: This mark shall be applied in a smaller size and must not be placed on armbands or rooftops.

Query_Text_cn: 国际红十字组织及其正式委派之人员，不论何时均得使用白底红十字之标志。
Translation: The International Red Cross and its duly authorized personnel may use the emblem of a red cross on a white ground at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 作为一种例外措施，本公约之标志，得依照本国内法律并经本国红十字会（红新月、红狮与日）之一的明白许可，于平时得用以辨别用作救护车之车辆及标明专为免费治疗伤者、病者之救护站所在地。
Translation: As an exceptional measure, the emblem of this Convention may, in peacetime and in accordance with national legislation, be used with the express permission of one of the national Red Cross (Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun) societies to identify vehicles employed as ambulances and to mark the location of aid stations exclusively engaged in providing free treatment to the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条冲突各方应通过其总司令保证以上条款之详细执行，并依照本公约之一般原则规定预料不到之事件。
Translation: Article 45 The conflicting parties shall, through their commanders-in-chief, ensure the detailed execution of the foregoing provisions and provide for unforeseen cases in conformity with the general principles of the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条对于本公约所保护之伤者、病者、工作人员、建筑物或设备之报复行为，均予禁止。
Translation: Article 46: Reprisals against the wounded, sick, personnel, buildings or equipment protected by the Convention are prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条各缔约国在平时及战时应在各该国尽量广泛传播本公约之约文，尤应在其军事，并如可能时在公民教育计划中，包括本公约之学习，俾本公约之原则为全体人民，尤其武装战斗部队、医务人员及随军牧师所周知。
Translation: Article 47 The High Contracting Parties undertake, in time of peace as in time of war, to disseminate the text of the present Convention as widely as possible in their respective countries, and, in particular, to include the study thereof in their programmes of military and, if possible, civil instruction, so that the principles thereof may become known to the entire population, especially to the armed fighting forces, the medical personnel and the chaplains.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条条缔约国应通过瑞士联邦委员会，在战时则通过保护国，互相通知本公约之正式译文，及其所采用以保证实施本公约之法律与规则。
Translation: Article 48: The High Contracting Parties shall communicate to one another through the Swiss Federal Council and, during hostilities, through the Protecting Powers, the official translations of the present Convention, as well as the laws and regulations which they may adopt to ensure its application.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条各缔约国担任制定必要之立法，俾对于本身犯有或令人犯有下条所列之严重破坏本公约之行为之人，处以有效之刑事制裁。
Translation: Article 49 The High Contracting Parties undertake to enact any legislation necessary to provide effective penal sanctions for persons committing, or ordering to be committed, any of the grave breaches of the present Convention defined in the following Article.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国有义务搜捕被控为曾犯或曾令人犯此种严重破坏本公约行为之人，并应将此种人，不分国籍，送交各该国法庭。
Translation: Each Contracting Party is obligated to search for persons alleged to have committed or ordered to commit such grave breaches of the present Convention and shall bring such persons, regardless of their nationality, before its own courts.

Query_Text_cn: 该国亦得于自愿时，并依其立法之规定，将此种人送交另一有关之缔约国审判，但以该缔约国能指出案情显然者为限。
Translation: The country may also, at its discretion and in accordance with its legal provisions, surrender such persons to another concerned Contracting Party for trial, provided that the latter can present a prima facie case.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国应采取必要之措施，以制止下条所列严重破坏本公约之行为以外之一切违反本公约之规定之行为。
Translation: Each State Party shall take the necessary measures to suppress all acts contrary to the provisions of the present Convention other than the grave breaches defined in the following article.

Query_Text_cn: 在一切情况下，被告人应享有适当的审讯及辩护之保障。此种保障，不得次于1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约第一百零五条及其以下各条所规定者。
Translation: In all circumstances, the accused shall be entitled to a fair trial and defense. Such guarantees shall not be less than those provided under Article 105 and subsequent provisions of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12, 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 故意杀害，酷刑或不人道待遇，包括生物学实验，故意使身体及健康遭受重大痛苦或严重伤害，以及无军事上之必要，而以非法与暴乱之方式，对财产之大规模的破坏与征收。
Translation: Willful killing, torture or inhuman treatment, including biological experiments; willfully causing great suffering or serious injury to body or health; and extensive destruction and appropriation of property, not justified by military necessity and carried out unlawfully and wantonly.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十一条任何缔约国不得自行推卸，或允许任何其他缔约国推卸，其本身或其他缔约国所负之关于上条所述之破坏公约行为之责任。
Translation: Article 51 No High Contracting Party shall be allowed to absolve itself, or any other High Contracting Party, of any liability incurred by itself or by another High Contracting Party in respect of breaches referred to in the preceding Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十二条经冲突之一方之请求，应依有关各方所决定之方式，进行关于任何被控违犯本公约的行为之调查。
Translation: Article 52 At the request of any party to the conflict, an investigation shall be instituted,in a manner to be agreed upon by the parties concerned,into any alleged violation of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如关于调查程序不能获致协议，则各方应同意选定一公断人，由其决定应遵行之程序。
Translation: If no agreement can be reached on the investigation procedures, the parties shall agree to appoint an arbitrator to determine the procedures to be followed.

Query_Text_cn: 违约行为一经确定，冲突各方应使之终止，并应迅速加以取缔。
Translation: Once a breach is confirmed, the parties involved shall cease such actions and promptly suppress them.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十三条除按本公约有权使用者之外，一切个人、公私团体、商号或公司，不论其使用之目的及采用之日期为何，使用"红十字”或"日内瓦十字”之标志或名称以及其他仿冒之标志或名称，无论何时均应禁止。
Translation:
Article 53:   
The use by private individuals, societies, firms or companies, other than those entitled thereto under the present Convention, of the emblem or the designation "Red Cross" or "Geneva Cross", or of any other sign or designation constituting an imitation thereof, whatever the object of such use, and irrespective of the date of its adoption, shall be prohibited at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 因为依采用翻转的联邦国旗而对瑞士表示之敬意，及瑞士国徽与本公约之特殊标志之间可以发生之混淆，任何私人、团体或商号，不论系作为厂标或商标，或此种厂标商标之一部分，或出于违反商业信义的目的，或在可以伤害瑞士国家情感之情况下，使用瑞士国徽，或仿冒此项国徽标志，无论何时，均应予禁止。
Translation: In view of the homage paid to Switzerland by the adoption of the reversed federal colors, and the possibility of confusion between the Swiss coat of arms and the distinctive emblem of this Convention, the use by private individuals, associations, or firms, whether as a trade mark or as part thereof, or for purposes contrary to commercial honesty, or in circumstances capable of wounding Swiss national sentiment, of the Swiss coat of arms or of any imitation thereof, shall be prohibited at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 但未参加1929年7月27日日内瓦公约之各缔约国对于早已使用前款规定之各种符号标志者，得限期令其停止使用。此项期限自本公约生效之日起，不得超过三年。但此种使用，在战时，不得视为系受本公约之保护。
Translation: However, for Contracting Parties that did not participate in the Geneva Convention of July 27, 1929, and have already used the symbols or signs specified in the preceding provisions, a time limit may be set for their discontinuation. This time limit shall not exceed three years from the date of entry into force of the present Convention. Nevertheless, such use shall not, in time of war, be considered as conferring the protection of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 本条第一款所规定之禁止事项，亦适用于第三十八条第二款所指之标志及符号，但不影响其过去使用所获得之权利。
Translation: The prohibitions set forth in the first paragraph of this Article shall also apply to the emblems and signs referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 38, without prejudice to any rights acquired through their prior use.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十四条各缔约国，若其立法尚未完备，应采取必要之措施，以便随时防止及取缔第五十三条所规定之各种滥用行为。
Translation: Article 54: Each Contracting State, if its legislation is not yet complete, shall take the necessary measures to prevent and suppress at all times the various abuses specified in Article 53.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十五条本公约以英文及法文订立。
Translation: Article 55 This Convention is established in English and French.

Query_Text_cn: 两种文字之约文具有同等效力。
Translation: Both language versions of the instrument shall be equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应准备本公约之俄文及西班牙文之正式译文。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall prepare official translations of this Convention in Russian and Spanish.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十六条本公约以本日为订立之日期，至1950年2月12日为止，凡参加1949年4月21日日内瓦会议各国，以及未参加该次会议，但系1864年、1906年或1929年救济战地军队伤者病者之日内瓦公约之缔约国，均可签字。
Translation: Article 56 The present Convention is established this day and shall remain open for signature until 12 February 1950 by the Powers represented at the Conference which opened at Geneva on 21 April 1949, as well as by the Powers not represented at that Conference which are parties to the Geneva Conventions of 1864, 1906 or 1929 for the Relief of the Wounded and Sick in Armies in the Field.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十七条本公约应尽速批准，其批准书应交存于伯尔尼。
Translation: Article 57 This Convention shall be ratified as soon as possible, and the instruments of ratification shall be deposited at Berne.

Query_Text_cn: 每一批准书交存时，应予登记，并由瑞士联邦委员会将该项登记之证明的抄本分送业经签字或通知加入本公约之各国。
Translation: Each instrument of ratification shall be recorded upon deposit, and the Swiss Federal Council shall transmit certified copies of such record to all States that have signed or acceded to the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十八条本公约在至少两国批准书交存后六个月发生效力。
Translation: Article 58 This Convention shall enter into force six months after the deposit of at least two instruments of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 嗣后，本公约对于每一缔约国自其批准书交存后六个月发生效力。
Translation: Thereafter, this Convention shall enter into force for each Contracting State six months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十九条在各缔约国间之关系上，本公约代替1864年8月22日、1906年7月6日及1929年7月27日之各公约。
Translation: Article 59: In the relations between the Contracting Parties, this Convention replaces the Conventions of August 22, 1864, July 6, 1906, and July 27, 1929.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十条本公约自生效之日起，任何未签字本公约之国家均得加入。
Translation: Article 60 Any State which has not signed this Convention may accede to it from the date on which the Convention comes into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十一条本公约之加入应以书面通知瑞士联邦委员会，自加入之通知收到之日起六个月后发生效力。
Translation: Article 61 Accession to this Convention shall be effected by written notification addressed to the Swiss Federal Council and shall take effect six months after the date of its receipt.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将此项加入通知所有业经签字或加入本公约之国家。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall communicate this addition to all states that have signed or acceded to the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十二条第二条及第三条所载之情况应使在战事开始或占领之前或后，冲突各方所交存之批准书及加入之通知立即生效。
Translation: Article 62 The situations provided for in Articles 2 and 3 shall give immediate effect to ratifications deposited and accessions notified by the Parties to the conflict, either before or after the beginning of hostilities or occupation.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将其从冲突各方收到之任何批准书或加入之通知，以最迅速方法通告之。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall promptly notify all parties to the conflict of any instruments of ratification or accession it receives.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十三条每一缔约国得自由退出本公约。
Translation: Article 63 Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention at its discretion.

Query_Text_cn: 退约须用书面通知瑞士联邦委员会，并由该委员会转告所有缔约国政府。
Translation: Withdrawal shall be effected by a written notification addressed to the Swiss Federal Council, which shall transmit it to the governments of all the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 退约须于通知瑞士联邦委员会后一年发生效力。
Translation: The denunciation shall take effect one year after the notification has been received by the Swiss Federal Council.

Query_Text_cn: 但如缔约国于作退约通知时已卷入冲突，则其退约须待至和议成立后，并在有关本公约所保护之人员之释放及遣返之工作完毕后，始能生效。
Translation: However, if the denouncing Power is engaged in a conflict at the time of its notification of denunciation, the denunciation shall not take effect until peace has been concluded and until the operations connected with the release and repatriation of the persons protected by the present Convention have been terminated.

Query_Text_cn: 退约仅对该退约国有效，但并不减轻冲突各方依国际法原则仍应履行之义务，此等原则系产自文明人民间树立之惯例，人道法则与公众良心之要求。
Translation: Denunciation shall be effective only with respect to the denouncing State, and shall in no way impair the obligations which the Parties to the conflict remain bound to fulfill under the principles of international law, as they result from the usages established among civilized peoples, from the laws of humanity, and the dictates of the public conscience.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十四条瑞士联邦委员会应将本公约在联合国秘书处登记，并应将其所接获之所有关于本公约之批准、加入及退约通知联合国秘书处。
Translation: Article 64 The Swiss Federal Council shall register this Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations and shall notify the Secretariat of all ratifications, accessions and denunciations received in respect of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，下列签署人于交存全权证书后，签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned, having deposited their full powers, have signed this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 1949年8月12日以英文法文订于日内瓦。
Translation: Done at Geneva this twelfth day of August 1949, in the English and French languages.

Query_Text_cn: 正本应交存于瑞士联邦委员会之档案中。
Translation: The original shall be deposited in the archives of the Swiss Federal Council.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将证明之抄本送交每一签字及加入之国家。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall transmit certified copies to each signatory and acceding State.

Query_Text_cn: （德、美、阿根廷、奥匈、比、玻利维亚、巴西、保加利亚、智利、中国、哥伦比亚、古巴、丹麦、多米尼加、厄瓜多尔、西班牙、法国、英国、希腊、危地马拉、海地、意大利、日本、卢森堡、墨西哥、门的内哥罗、挪威、巴拿马、巴拉圭、荷兰、秘鲁、波斯、葡萄牙、罗马尼亚、俄国、萨尔瓦多、塞尔维亚、暹罗、瑞典、瑞士、土耳其、乌拉圭、委内瑞拉等各缔约国元首称呼略。
Translation: (Germany, the United States, Argentina, Austria-Hungary, Belgium, Bolivia, Brazil, Bulgaria, Chile, China, Colombia, Cuba, Denmark, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Spain, France, Great Britain, Greece, Guatemala, Haiti, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, Mexico, Montenegro, Norway, Panama, Paraguay, the Netherlands, Peru, Persia, Portugal, Romania, Russia, El Salvador, Serbia, Siam, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, Uruguay, Venezuela, etc. [Titles of the Heads of State of the respective Contracting Parties omitted.])

Query_Text_cn: 1993年7月15日，钱其琛外长致函该法院秘书长，通知我恢复在该法院的活动；该法院秘书长于1993年11月22日复函认可，其复函日期视为我加入该两公约之日期。
Translation: On July 15, 1993, Foreign Minister Qian Qichen sent a letter to the Secretary-General of the Court, notifying China's resumption of activities therein. The Secretary-General acknowledged this in a reply dated November 22, 1993, which is deemed the date of China's accession to the two conventions.

Query_Text_cn: （各全权代表名单略。
Translation: (List of plenipotentiary representatives omitted.)

Query_Text_cn: 第一条为了在各国关系中尽可能防止诉诸武力，各缔约国同意竭尽全力以保证和平解决国际争端。
Translation:
Article 1  
The High Contracting Parties solemnly declare in the names of their respective peoples that they condemn recourse to war for the solution of international controversies and renounce it as an instrument of national policy in their relations with one another.  

The High Contracting Parties agree that the settlement or solution of all disputes or conflicts, of whatever nature or of whatever origin they may be, which may arise among them, shall never be sought except by pacific means.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条各缔约国同意,遇有严重分歧或争端,如情势允许,在诉诸武力之前应请求一个或几个友好国家进行斡旋或调停。
Translation: Article II The Contracting Parties agree that, in the event of serious differences or disputes, they shall, if circumstances permit, request one or more friendly nations to offer their good offices or mediation before resorting to the use of force.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条不论有无此项请求,各缔约国认为,由一个或几个与争端无关的国家在情势许可的情况下,主动向争端当事国家提供斡旋或调停,是有益的和可取的。
Translation: Article III: The Contracting Parties agree that it is desirable and beneficial for one or more states not involved in the dispute to offer mediation or good offices on their own initiative, when circumstances permit, regardless of whether such a request has been made.

Query_Text_cn: 与争端无关的国家,即使在敌对过程中,也有权提供斡旋或调停。
Translation: States not involved in a dispute have the right to offer mediation or good offices, even during hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 争端的任一方绝对不能将此项权利的行使视为不友好的行为。
Translation: Under no circumstances should either party to the dispute regard the exercise of this right as an unfriendly act.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条调停者的作用在于协调对立的要求并平息争端各国之间可能发生的不满情绪。
Translation: The role of the fourth mediator is to reconcile opposing demands and mitigate potential grievances that may arise among nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一俟争端的一方或调停者本身宣布他所建议的和解办法未被接受时,调停者的职能即告终止。
Translation:
Article 5  
The functions of the mediator terminate when one of the parties to the dispute or the mediator himself declares that the proposed settlement has not been accepted.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条斡旋和调停,无论出自争端国的请求,或出自与争端无关的国家的主动,都只具有建议的性质,绝无拘束力。
Translation: Article 6: Mediation and conciliation, whether initiated at the request of the disputing parties or undertaken voluntarily by a state not involved in the dispute, shall be of a purely advisory nature and in no way binding.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条接受调停,除非有相反的协议,并不具有中止、推迟或阻碍动员或其他战争准备措施的作用。
Translation: Article 7: The acceptance of mediation shall not, unless otherwise agreed, have the effect of suspending, delaying, or impeding mobilization or other measures of war preparation.

Query_Text_cn: 如调停发生在敌对行为开始后,除非有相反的协议,进行中的军事行动无须停止。
Translation: If mediation occurs after the commencement of hostilities, ongoing military operations need not cease unless otherwise agreed.

Query_Text_cn: 遇有足以危及和平的严重纠纷时，争端各国各自选择一国并赋予与另一方所选择的国家进行直接联系的使命，以防止和平关系的破裂。
Translation: In the event of a serious dispute likely to endanger peace, each of the disputing parties shall choose a state and entrust it with the mission of establishing direct contact with the state chosen by the other party, in order to prevent the rupture of peaceful relations.

Query_Text_cn: 此项使命的期限，除有相反的协议，不得超过三十天。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, the duration of this mission shall not exceed thirty days.

Query_Text_cn: 在此期限内，争端各国停止有关争端问题的任何直接联系，此项争端应视为已全部移交各调停国。调停国必须尽一切努力以解决纠纷。遇有和平关系确已破裂时，这些国家均负有利用一切机会以恢复和平的共同任务。
Translation: Within this period, the disputing nations shall cease all direct communication regarding the matter in dispute, which shall be considered as wholly referred to the mediating powers. The mediating powers must exert every effort to resolve the dispute. In the event of an actual rupture of peaceful relations, these nations share the common duty to utilize all opportunities for the restoration of peace.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条凡属既不涉及荣誉,也不影响基本利益,而仅属对于事实问题意见分歧的国际性争端,各缔约国认为,由未能通过外交途径达成协议的各方在情势许可的情况下,成立一国际调查委员会,通过公正和认真的调查,以澄清事实,从而促进此项争端的解决,将是有益的和可取的。
Translation: Article IX The Contracting Powers consider it useful and desirable that, in disputes of an international nature involving neither honor nor vital interests and arising from a difference of opinion on points of fact, the parties who have not been able to come to an agreement by means of diplomacy should, as far as circumstances allow, institute an International Commission of Inquiry to facilitate a solution of these disputes by elucidating the facts by means of an impartial and conscientious investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条国际调查委员会由争端各方通过一项专约组成。
Translation: Article 10 The International Commission of Inquiry shall be constituted by special agreement between the parties in dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 调查专约规定需要审查的事实,并规定委员会组成的方式和时间以及委员的权限。
Translation: The special agreement of inquiry shall specify the facts to be examined and define the manner and time for the constitution of the commission and the extent of the powers of the commissioners.

Query_Text_cn: 在需要时,专约也规定委员会的会址以及可否迁移到另一地方,委员会使用的语言和委员会准许对它使用的语言,以及各方应提交关于陈述事实的日期,总之,各方同意的一切条件。
Translation: Where necessary, the Convention also specifies the seat of the commission and whether it may be moved to another location, the languages to be used by the commission and those it may authorize for its proceedings, as well as the dates by which the parties shall submit statements of facts—in short, all conditions agreed upon by the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如各方认为有必要任命助理员,则调查专约应规定任命的方式及其职权的范围。
Translation: If the parties deem it necessary to appoint assistants, the convention of inquiry shall specify the method of their appointment and the scope of their functions.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条如调查专约没有规定委员会的会址,委员会应设在海牙。
Translation: Article 11 If the convention of inquiry does not specify the seat of the commission, it shall be established at The Hague.

Query_Text_cn: 会址一经确定,除非当事各方同意,委员会不得变更。
Translation: Once the venue is determined, the committee shall not change it unless agreed upon by the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 如调查专约未规定使用的语言,则由委员会予以规定。
Translation: If the language to be used is not specified in the convention of inquiry, it shall be determined by the commission.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条调查委员会的组成,除另有规定外,应遵照本公约第四十五条和第五十七条的规定。
Translation: Article 12 The composition of the investigation committee shall, unless otherwise provided, comply with the provisions of Articles 45 and 57 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条委员或助理员因死亡、退休或因故出缺,应按照其任命的方式予以补缺。
Translation: Article 13 In the event of a vacancy among the members or assistants due to death, retirement, or any other cause, the vacancy shall be filled in the same manner as the original appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条当事各方有权任命特派人员出席调查委员会,其任务是代表本方并作为各方和委员会之间的中间人。
Translation: Article 14 The parties concerned shall have the right to appoint special representatives to attend the investigation committee, whose task is to represent their respective parties and act as intermediaries between the parties and the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 此外,各方有权聘请由它们指派的顾问或律师向委员会陈述它们的理由和维护它们的利益。
Translation: In addition, each party has the right to engage advisors or lawyers appointed by them to present their arguments and safeguard their interests before the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条常设仲裁法院国际事务局应作为设在海牙的各调查委员会的秘书处,并将其办公处所和工作人员供缔约各方使用,以便于调查委员会进行工作。
Translation: Article 15 The International Bureau of the Permanent Court of Arbitration shall serve as the secretariat for the commissions of inquiry established in The Hague, placing its premises and staff at the disposal of the Contracting Parties to facilitate the work of such commissions.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条如委员会设在海牙以外的地点,它应任命一秘书长,并以其办公处作为其秘书处。
Translation: Article 16 If the Commission is established elsewhere than at The Hague, it shall appoint a Secretary-General and establish his office as its Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书处受主席领导,其职责是为委员会会议作好必要的安排,作出记录,并在调查期间保管档案。此项档案随后将移交给海牙国际事务局。
Translation: The Secretariat, under the direction of the Chairman, is responsible for making necessary arrangements for the meetings of the Commission, keeping records, and maintaining the archives during the investigation. These archives will subsequently be transferred to the International Bureau at The Hague.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条为了促进调查委员会的组成和工作,各缔约国建议在各方未采纳其他规则前,下列规则将适用于调查的程序。
Translation:
Article 17  
To facilitate the constitution and work of the commission of inquiry, the Contracting Parties recommend that, in the absence of any other procedure agreed upon by the parties, the following rules shall apply to the conduct of the inquiry.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条委员会应规定调查专约或本公约中未曾规定的程序的细节,并安排有关处理证据的一切手续。
Translation: Article 18 The Commission shall prescribe the details regarding the procedure not covered by the special agreement or the present Convention and shall arrange all the formalities required for dealing with the evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条调查应听取双方意见。
Translation: Article 19 Investigations shall hear the opinions of both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 在规定的日期,当事每一方应向委员会和另一方送达事实的说明书,如果有的话。在一切情况下,应送达它认为对判定真相有用的文件、证件和资料,以及它希望出庭作证的证人和鉴定人的名单。
Translation: On the prescribed date, each party shall submit to the Commission and the other party a statement of facts, if any. In all cases, it shall submit the documents, certificates, and materials it deems useful for determining the truth, as well as a list of witnesses and experts it wishes to call to testify.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条委员会有权在当事国同意下,临时迁移到它认为对此种调查方法有用的地方,或派一位或几位委员到那里。
Translation: Article 20 The Commission shall have the authority to temporarily relocate, with the consent of the States Parties concerned, to any place it deems useful for such investigative methods, or to dispatch one or more of its members there.

Query_Text_cn: 但必须取得进行此项调查的所在地国家的许可。
Translation: However, permission must be obtained from the country where the investigation is to be conducted.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条每一项调查和对现场的调查应在当事国代理人或律师出席下或在他们已被正式传唤以后进行。
Translation: Article 21 Each investigation and on-site inspection shall be conducted in the presence of the agent or counsel of the party concerned or after they have been duly summoned.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条委员会有权要求当事国一方或另一方提供它认为有益的那些解释或资料。
Translation: Article 22 The Committee shall have the authority to request either party to the dispute to provide such explanations or information as it deems beneficial.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条当事各方应尽可能充分地向调查委员会提供一切必要的手段和便利,以使该委员会对有关事实获得完全的了解和正确的估计。
Translation: Article 23 The parties concerned shall furnish the investigation committee to the fullest extent practicable with all available means and facilities to enable it to gain a complete and accurate understanding of the relevant facts.

Query_Text_cn: 各方承允按照各自国内法掌握的方法以保证经委员会传唤的处于它们领土内的证人和鉴定人出席。
Translation: The Parties undertake to ensure the attendance of witnesses and expert witnesses within their respective territories who have been summoned by the Commission, employing the methods provided under their respective domestic laws.

Query_Text_cn: 如上述证人或鉴定人不能出席委员会,各方将安排他们到其所属国家的主管官员面前作出他们的证词。
Translation: If the aforementioned witnesses or experts are unable to appear before the Commission, the parties shall arrange for them to give their testimony before a competent official of their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条委员会如需在第三缔约国领土内办理各项通知书时,应直接向该国政府提出申请。
Translation: Article 24: If the Committee needs to serve any notices within the territory of a third state, it shall directly submit an application to the government of that state.

Query_Text_cn: 在现场进行采证,也应照此办理。
Translation: The same procedure shall apply to on-site evidence collection.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的而提出的申请应按照被申请国的国内法规定的方式办理。
Translation: Applications for this purpose shall be processed in the manner prescribed by the domestic law of the requested State.

Query_Text_cn: 申请书不得予以拒绝,除非被申请国认为此项申请在性质上有损于它的主权或安全。
Translation: The application shall not be refused unless the requested State considers that such application would be prejudicial to its sovereignty or security in nature.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会也始终有权通过该会所在地国来办理。
Translation: The Committee shall at all times have the right to proceed through the country in which it is located.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条证人和鉴定人应依照当事国的申请或委员会自己的动议予以传唤,并且在一切情况下,须通过上述人员所在地国政府传唤。
Translation: Article 25 Witnesses and experts shall be summoned at the request of the parties or by the Commission on its own initiative, and in all cases through the government of the country where they are located.

Query_Text_cn: 证人应在代理人和律师出席下按照委员会所规定的顺序,循序和分别作证。
Translation: Witnesses shall testify in the presence of agents and attorneys, in the order and sequence prescribed by the Commission, proceeding one by one.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条对证人的询问由主席主持。
Translation: Article 26 The questioning of witnesses shall be presided over by the chairperson.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会委员得向各证人提出他们认为适当的问题,以便对证词加以澄清或补充,或在弄清真实真相的必要限度内,了解与证人有关的任何问题。
Translation: Committee members may pose such questions to witnesses as they deem appropriate, either to clarify or supplement testimony, or to elicit any information pertaining to the witness within the necessary scope of ascertaining the truth.

Query_Text_cn: 当事国代理人和律师不得打断证人作证,也不得直接向证人提出任何质询,但可以请求主席向证人提出他们认为有益的补充性质的问题。
Translation: Agents and counsel of the parties concerned shall not interrupt the testimony of witnesses or directly pose any cross-examination to them, but may request the chairperson to ask supplementary questions they deem beneficial to the witness.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条证人作证不得读书面稿。
Translation: Article 27 Witnesses shall not read from written scripts when giving testimony.

Query_Text_cn: 但是,如果所证事实的性质有此必要,可经主席准许参阅笔记或文件。
Translation: However, if the nature of the facts to be proved so requires, reference may be made to notes or documents with the permission of the presiding officer.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条证人供词应当即作成记录并向证人宣读。
Translation: Article 28 The testimony of a witness shall be taken down in writing and read to him immediately.

Query_Text_cn: 证人得对记录作出他认为必要的修改和补充,并附录在他的证词之后。
Translation: The witness may make such modifications and additions to the record as he deems necessary, which shall be appended to his testimony.

Query_Text_cn: 证人的全部供词向证人宣读后,应要求证人签字。
Translation: After the witness's entire testimony has been read out to them, the witness shall be required to sign it.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条代理人有权在调查的过程中或结束时,用书面向委员会和当事另一方递交他们认为对判定真相有用的一切声明、要求或事实的摘要。
Translation: Article 29 Agents shall have the right to submit in writing to the Commission and the other party concerned any statements, claims, or summaries of facts they deem useful for determining the truth during or at the conclusion of the investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条委员会对决定的讨论不公开并须保守秘密。
Translation: Article 30 Deliberations of the Committee on decisions shall be conducted in private and remain confidential.

Query_Text_cn: 一切决定均由委员会以多数作出。
Translation: All decisions shall be made by the committee by majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 如一委员拒绝参加表决,应在记录中注明。
Translation: If a member refuses to participate in the voting, it shall be noted in the record.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条委员会会议不得公开,调查的记录和文件均不予发表,但依据委员会在当事各方的同意下作出的决定在外。
Translation: Article 31 Committee meetings shall not be held in public, and no records or documents of the investigation shall be published, except as otherwise decided by the Committee with the consent of the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条在当事各方提出一切解释和证据以及所有证人已提供证据后,主席即宣告调查结束,委员会休会,以便讨论和起草报告。
Translation: Article 32 After all parties have presented their explanations and evidence and all witnesses have testified, the Chair shall declare the investigation concluded. The Committee shall then adjourn to deliberate and draft its report.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条报告由委员会全体委员签署。
Translation: Article 33 The report shall be signed by all members of the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会如有一人拒绝签字,应在报告上注明,但报告仍然有效。
Translation: If any member of the committee refuses to sign the report, such refusal shall be noted therein, but the report shall remain valid.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条委员会的报告应在公开庭上宣读,当事各方代理人和律师应到场或经正式传唤。
Translation: Article 34 The report of the committee shall be read out at a public hearing, where the agents and counsel of the parties shall be present or duly summoned.

Query_Text_cn: 报告副本应送给当事各方。
Translation: Copies of the report shall be distributed to all parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条委员会的报告限于对事实的确认,绝对没有仲裁裁决的性质。
Translation: Article 35 The reports of the Commission shall be confined to a statement of facts and shall in no case have the character of an arbitral award.

Query_Text_cn: 对此项确认的效力全由各方自由决定。
Translation: The validity of this confirmation shall be entirely at the discretion of the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条每一方负担它自己的费用，并平均分担委员会的费用。
Translation: Article 36 Each Party shall bear its own costs and share equally the expenses of the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条国际仲裁的目的是由各国自己选择的法官并在尊重法律的基础上,解决各国之间的纠纷。
Translation: Article 37 The purpose of international arbitration is to resolve disputes between states through judges chosen by the states themselves and on the basis of respect for law.

Query_Text_cn: 请求仲裁即意味着承诺对裁决的诚意服从。
Translation: A request for arbitration implies a sincere commitment to abide by the award.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条凡属法律性质的问题,特别是有关解释或适用国际公约的问题,各缔约国承认仲裁是解决通过外交途径所未能解决的纠纷的最有效也是最公正的方法。
Translation: Article 38 The Contracting Parties recognize arbitration as the most effective and equitable method for resolving disputes of a legal nature, particularly those concerning the interpretation or application of international conventions, which have not been settled through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 因此,在关于上述问题的纠纷中,各缔约国在情势许可的情况下诉诸仲裁是可取的。
Translation: Therefore, in disputes concerning the aforementioned issues, it is advisable for the Contracting Parties to resort to arbitration where circumstances permit.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条仲裁专约是针对已经产生或最后可能产生的争端而缔结的。
Translation: Article 39: The arbitration convention is concluded specifically for disputes that have already arisen or may potentially arise in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 它可以包括任何争端或只包括某一类的争端。
Translation: It may cover any dispute or only certain categories of disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条不论一般条约或专门条约已明文规定各缔约国有诉诸仲裁的义务，各缔约国仍保留缔结新的一般的或专门的协定的权利，以便把强制仲裁扩大适用于各缔约国可能认为提交仲裁的一切案件。
Translation: Article 40: Whether general treaties or special conventions have expressly stipulated the obligation of the Contracting Parties to resort to arbitration, they retain the right to conclude new general or special agreements extending compulsory arbitration to all cases which they may consider suitable for submission to arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十一条为便利将通过外交途径未能解决的国际争端立即诉诸仲裁,各缔约国承允维持第一届和平会议所建立的常设仲裁法院,并按照本公约所载程序规则随时可以投诉和开庭,除非当事国另有相反的规定。
Translation: Article 41: With the object of facilitating an immediate recourse to arbitration for international differences which it has not been possible to settle by diplomacy, the Contracting Powers undertake to maintain the Permanent Court of Arbitration, as established by the First Peace Conference, accessible at all times and operating, in accordance with the rules of procedure laid down in the present Convention, unless the parties agree otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条常设仲裁法院对一切仲裁案件有管辖权,除非当事国之间另有成立特别法庭的协议。
Translation: Article 42 The Permanent Court of Arbitration shall have jurisdiction over all arbitration cases, unless the parties concerned have agreed to establish a special tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条常设仲裁法院设在海牙。
Translation: Article 43 The Permanent Court of Arbitration shall have its seat at The Hague.

Query_Text_cn: 它保管档案并处理一切行政事务。
Translation: It maintains archives and handles all administrative affairs.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国承允将它们之间达成的任何仲裁条件以及由特别法庭作出的有关裁决,以核证无误的副本尽速送交事务局。
Translation: The Contracting Parties undertake to communicate to the Bureau, as soon as possible, certified copies of any arbitration agreements concluded between them and of any awards rendered by special tribunals.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国还承允将载明执行仲裁法院裁决的法律、规章和文件送交事务局。
Translation: The Contracting Parties also undertake to communicate to the Bureau the laws, regulations, and documents specifying the execution of the decisions of the Court of Arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条每个缔约国各指定公认的精通国际法问题、享有最高道德声望并愿意接受仲裁人职责的著名人士至多四名。
Translation: Article 44 Each Contracting Party shall nominate not more than four eminent jurists of recognized competence in international law, enjoying the highest moral reputation and willing to accept the duties of arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 被选定的人士应列入法院成员名单,由事务局负责通知各缔约国。
Translation: The selected individuals shall be included in the list of court members, and the Secretariat shall notify all States Parties accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁人名单的任何变更,应由事务局通知各缔约国。
Translation: Any changes to the list of arbitrators shall be notified by the Secretariat to all Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 两个或几个国家可以协商共同选定一个或几个成员。
Translation: Two or more countries may negotiate and jointly select one or several members.

Query_Text_cn: 同一人士得由不同国家选定为成员。
Translation: The same individual may be selected as a member by different countries.

Query_Text_cn: 法院成员的任期为六年,期满可以连任。
Translation: The term of office for court members is six years, with the possibility of reappointment upon expiration.

Query_Text_cn: 遇有法院成员死亡或退休,应按照该人原任命的同样方式予以补缺,新任期为六年。
Translation: In the event of the death or retirement of a court member, the vacancy shall be filled in the same manner as the original appointment, with the new term lasting six years.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条当缔约国愿将它们之间发生的一项争端诉诸常设仲裁法院以求解决时,应在法院成员总名单中挑选仲裁人组成法庭以受理此项争端。
Translation:
Article 45  
When Contracting Parties agree to submit a dispute between them to the Permanent Court of Arbitration for settlement, they shall select arbitrators from the general list of the Court's members to constitute a tribunal for the adjudication of such dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 每一当事国任命两名仲裁人,其中只有一名可由本国国民充任或由该国从常设仲裁法院成员名单中选出一人充任,再由这些仲裁人共同选择一名公断人。
Translation: Each party shall appoint two arbitrators, only one of whom may be its national or chosen from among the members of the Permanent Court of Arbitration. These arbitrators shall then jointly select an umpire.

Query_Text_cn: 如票数相等,则公断人的选择应委托各当事国共同协议选定的第三国为之。
Translation: In case of an equality of votes, the choice of the umpire shall be entrusted to a third state selected by the agreement of the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 如对选择第三国问题未能达成协议,则每一当事国各自选定一不同的国家,并由这样选定的国家共同选出公断人。
Translation: If no agreement can be reached on the choice of a third country, each party shall select a different country, and the countries thus chosen shall jointly appoint an arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: 如在两个月内,这两个国家未能达成协议,则每一国各自从常设法院成员名单中提出候选人两名,但他们都不是当事国所任命的成员,并且不是任一当事国的国民。
Translation: If, within two months, the two countries fail to reach an agreement, each shall nominate two candidates from the list of members of the Permanent Court, provided that none of them shall be a member appointed by either party or a national of either party.

Query_Text_cn: 公断人应由按上述办法提出的候选人用抽签决定。
Translation: The arbitrator shall be determined by lot from among the candidates nominated in the manner prescribed above.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条法庭一经组成,当事国应将它们诉诸法院的决定、仲裁协定的文本以及仲裁人的姓名通知事务局。
Translation: Article 46 Once the tribunal is constituted, the parties shall notify the Bureau of their decision to resort to the court, the text of the arbitration agreement, and the names of the arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 事务局应立即将仲裁协定和法庭其他成员的姓名通知每一仲裁人。
Translation: The Bureau shall promptly notify each arbitrator of the arbitration agreement and the names of the other members of the tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁法庭于当事国规定的日期开庭。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal convenes on the date determined by the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 事务局为法庭开庭作出必要的安排。
Translation: The Bureau makes the necessary arrangements for court sessions.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭成员在执行职务或在外国期间,享有外交特权和豁免。
Translation: Members of the court shall enjoy diplomatic privileges and immunities in the performance of their duties or during their stay abroad.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条事务局被准许将其办公处所和工作人员提供缔约国,以供任何一个特定仲裁庭之用。
Translation: Article 47 The Secretariat shall be authorized to place its premises and staff at the disposal of any State Party for the use of a particular arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 如果当事国同意诉诸常设仲裁法院,则法庭的管辖范围可以在章程规定的条件内,扩大适用于非缔约国之间或缔约国和非缔约国之间的争端。
Translation: If the parties concerned agree to resort to the Permanent Court of Arbitration, the jurisdiction of the Court may, under the conditions stipulated in its statute, be extended to disputes between non-contracting states or between contracting states and non-contracting states.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条当两个或两个以上国家有可能发生严重争端时,各缔约国认为它们有义务提请这些国家注意常设仲裁法院是对它们敞开的。
Translation:
Article 48  
In case of a serious dispute arising between two or more Contracting Powers, the said Powers consider it their duty to remind the parties concerned that the Permanent Court of Arbitration is open to them.

Query_Text_cn: 为此,各缔约国声明,对争端各国提请注意本公约的规定,和为了和平的崇高利益而建议诉诸常设法院这一事实,只能被视为一种斡旋性质的行动。
Translation: To this end, the Contracting Parties declare that calling the attention of the parties to the dispute to the provisions of the present Convention and recommending recourse to the Permanent Court in the supreme interests of peace shall be regarded solely as acts of mediation.

Query_Text_cn: 在两国之间发生争端时,两国中任何一国始终可以向国际事务局递送照会,声明它愿意把争端付诸仲裁。
Translation: In the event of a dispute between the two countries, either party may at any time submit a note to the International Bureau of Affairs, declaring its willingness to refer the dispute to arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 事务局应立即把该声明通知另一国。
Translation: The Bureau shall promptly notify the other country of the statement.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条由各缔约国驻海牙的外交代表和荷兰外交大臣作为主席所组成的常设行政理事会负责指导和监督国际事务局。
Translation: Article 49 The Permanent Administrative Council, composed of the diplomatic representatives of the Contracting States accredited to The Hague and the Netherlands Minister for Foreign Affairs as President, shall have the direction and supervision of the International Bureau.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会决定它的程序规则以及一切其他必要的规则。
Translation: The Council shall determine its own rules of procedure and establish any other necessary regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应就一切可能发生的涉及法院工作的行政问题作出决定。
Translation: The Council shall make decisions on all possible administrative matters pertaining to the Court's operations.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会有全权处理事务局官员和雇员的任命、停职或撤职。
Translation: The Council has full authority to handle the appointment, suspension, or dismissal of officers and employees of the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会规定薪金和工资并控制总的开支。
Translation: The Council determines salaries and wages and controls overall expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 在正式召开的会议中有九个理事的出席即可使理事会的讨论发生效力。
Translation: The presence of nine directors at a duly convened meeting shall suffice to validate the council's deliberations.

Query_Text_cn: 决议案以多数票作出。
Translation: The resolution was adopted by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应把它所通过的各项规章立即通知各缔约国。
Translation: The Council shall promptly notify all Contracting Parties of any regulations it has adopted.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会并应把有关法院工作、行政事务和开支的年度报告提交各缔约国。
Translation: The Council shall also submit to the States Parties an annual report on the work of the Court, its administration and expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 该报告也包括各缔约国根据第四十三条第三款和第四款向事务局通知的文件的重要内容的摘要。
Translation: The report also includes summaries of the key contents of documents notified to the Bureau by States Parties pursuant to paragraphs 3 and 4 of Article 43.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十条事务局的费用应按照万国邮政联盟国际事务局所制定的比例，由各缔约国负担。
Translation: Article 50 The expenses of the Bureau shall be borne by the Contracting Parties in the proportion established for the International Bureau of the Universal Postal Union.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十一条为了促进仲裁的发展,各缔约国已就下列规则达成协议,这些规则将适用于仲裁程序,除非当事国另有协议。
Translation:
Article 51  
To promote the development of arbitration, the Contracting States have agreed upon the following rules, which shall apply to arbitral proceedings unless the parties concerned otherwise agree.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十二条诉诸仲裁的国家签订一项仲裁协定,其中规定争端的事由、任命仲裁人的日期、第六十三条所指的通知的次序和日期,以及每一方须预先存交的支付费用的数额。
Translation: Article 52: States resorting to arbitration shall conclude a special agreement specifying the subject matter of the dispute, the date for appointing arbitrators, the sequence and dates of notifications referred to in Article 63, as well as the amount each party must deposit in advance to cover costs.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁协定也规定任命仲裁人的方式,法庭可能具有的一切特别权力,法庭开庭的地点,法庭应使用的语言和准许在庭上使用的其他语言,总而言之,当事国间商定的一切条件。
Translation: The arbitration agreement also stipulates the method for appointing arbitrators, any special powers the tribunal may possess, the location of tribunal sessions, the language to be used by the tribunal and other languages permitted in proceedings—in short, all conditions agreed upon between the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十三条常设仲裁法院有权解决仲裁争端,如果当事国间商定将其提交它处理的话。
Translation: Article 53 The Permanent Court of Arbitration shall have jurisdiction to settle disputes submitted to it by agreement between the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约生效后缔结或续订的一般的仲裁条约所规定的争端。该条约对所有争端须订立一项仲裁协定,既未明示,也未暗示排除常设法院解决仲裁争端的权力。但如另一当事国声明,它认为争端不属于应归强制仲裁的范畴,则不能提交常设仲裁法院,除非仲裁条约赋予仲裁法庭对这一先决问题作出决定之权。
Translation: 1. Disputes arising from general arbitration treaties concluded or renewed after the entry into force of this Convention, provided that such treaties require the conclusion of a special agreement for all disputes and neither expressly nor implicitly exclude the jurisdiction of the Permanent Court over disputes concerning arbitration. However, such disputes shall not be submitted to the Permanent Court of Arbitration if the other party declares that it considers the dispute not to fall within the category of disputes subject to compulsory arbitration, unless the arbitration treaty confers upon the arbitral tribunal the power to decide this preliminary question.

Query_Text_cn: 二、一个国家由于另一国拖欠其国民的契约性债务,而向该国索偿所引起的争端,而为了解决争端,已接受仲裁。
Translation: II. A dispute arising from one country's claim against another due to the latter's default on contractual debts owed to its nationals, which has been submitted to arbitration for resolution.

Query_Text_cn: 如接受仲裁必须服从应以其他方式解决仲裁争端这一条件,则此项规定不能适用。
Translation: This provision shall not apply if the acceptance of arbitration is subject to the condition that the dispute shall be otherwise resolved.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十四条如出现前条规定的情况,则仲裁争端应由一个按照第四十五条第三至第六段的规定所指派的五个成员组成的委员会予以解决。
Translation: Article 54 In the event of the circumstances referred to in the preceding Article, the dispute shall be resolved by a committee composed of five members appointed in accordance with paragraphs 3 to 6 of Article 45.

Query_Text_cn: 第五名委员为委员会的当然主席。
Translation: The fifth member shall serve as the ex officio chair of the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十五条仲裁职责可授予由当事各国自行指定的,或由它们在本公约所建立的常设仲裁法院成员中所选择的一个或几个仲裁人。
Translation: Article 55: The duties of arbitration may be entrusted to one or more arbitrators designated by the parties themselves or chosen by them from among the members of the Permanent Court of Arbitration established under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如当事各方未能通过协议建立法庭,则按照第四十五条第三至第六段所规定的方式办理。
Translation: If the parties concerned fail to establish a tribunal by agreement, the matter shall be dealt with in accordance with the procedures set forth in paragraphs 3 to 6 of Article 45.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十六条如一国君主或国家元首被选为仲裁人,则仲裁程序由他决定。
Translation: Article 56 If a sovereign or head of state is chosen as arbitrator, the arbitral procedure shall be determined by him.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十七条公断人为法庭的当然庭长。
Translation: Article 57 The umpire shall serve as the ex officio presiding officer of the tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 如法庭未设公断人,则由法庭自己任命庭长。
Translation: If the court does not have an arbitrator, the court itself shall appoint the presiding judge.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十八条如按照第五十四条的规定,由一委员会解决仲裁争端,如无相反的协议,则由委员会本身组成法庭。
Translation: Article 58 If a dispute is referred to arbitration pursuant to Article 54, and in the absence of any contrary agreement, the tribunal shall be constituted by the committee itself.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十九条仲裁人中有一人死亡、退休或由于任何原因不能行使职务,则应按照其任命的方式予以补缺。
Translation: Article 59 In the event of the death, resignation, or inability to perform duties of any arbitrator for any reason, the vacancy shall be filled in the same manner as that in which the original appointment was made.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十条法庭应设在海牙,除非当事国另有选择。
Translation: Article 60 The Court shall sit at The Hague unless the parties otherwise agree.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭只能在第三国的同意下才能设在第三国。
Translation: Courts can only be established in a third country with the consent of that third country.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭庭址一经确定,除非经当事国同意,不得变更。
Translation: The seat of the court, once determined, shall not be altered without the consent of the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十一条如仲裁协定没有规定使用的语言,则由法庭决定。
Translation: Article 61 If the arbitration agreement does not specify the language to be used, the tribunal shall determine the matter.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十二条当事国有权任命特别代理人出席法庭,作为当事国和法庭间的中间人。
Translation: Article 62 The parties to the case shall have the right to appoint special agents to attend the court, acting as intermediaries between the parties and the court.

Query_Text_cn: 当事国还有权委托其聘请的辩护人或律师出庭为自己的权利和利益辩护。
Translation: The state party concerned also has the right to appoint defense counsel or lawyers to appear in court to defend its rights and interests.

Query_Text_cn: 常设仲裁法院的成员除代表任命他们为法院成员的国家外,不得行使代理人、辩护人或律师的职务。
Translation: Members of the Permanent Court of Arbitration may not act as agents, counsel, or advocates except on behalf of the countries that appointed them to the Court.

Query_Text_cn: 书面辩护和口头辩论。
Translation: Written pleadings and oral arguments.

Query_Text_cn: 当事国还附送该案中引用的一切文件和资料。
Translation: The state party also enclosed all the documents and materials cited in the case.

Query_Text_cn: 此项送达应直接地或通过国际事务局,按照仲裁协议所规定的次序和日期进行。
Translation: This service shall be effected directly or through the International Bureau, in accordance with the order and dates specified in the arbitration agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁协定所规定的日期,经当事国同意,或法庭认为对作出正确决定有必要时,予以延长。
Translation: The time limits fixed by the arbitration agreement may be extended by mutual consent of the parties or, if the tribunal deems it necessary for reaching a proper decision.

Query_Text_cn: 辩论是当事国在法庭上口头阐述其论据。
Translation: The presentation of arguments by the parties before the court takes place orally in the form of pleadings.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十四条任何一方所提出的一切文件应以经核证无误的副本送达另一方。
Translation: Article 64 All documents submitted by either party shall be served upon the other party in the form of certified copies.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十五条如无特殊情况,法庭只能在书面辩护结束后开庭。
Translation: Article 65 Unless under special circumstances, the court may only hold hearings after the conclusion of written pleadings.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十六条辩论由庭长主持。
Translation: Article 66 The presiding judge shall preside over the debate.

Query_Text_cn: 辩论只有在当事国同意下,按照法庭的决定才能公开进行。
Translation: Debates shall be conducted publicly only with the consent of the parties concerned and in accordance with the decision of the court.

Query_Text_cn: 辩论应载入庭长委任的书记所作成的记录内。
Translation: The debate shall be recorded in the minutes by the registrar appointed by the president.

Query_Text_cn: 此项记录须由庭长和书记之一签署；唯有此项记录才具有权威性。
Translation: This record must be signed by the presiding judge and one of the clerks; only this record shall be authoritative.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十七条书面辩护结束后,法庭有权拒绝讨论当事国一方未经另一方同意企图向法庭提出的一切新的文件和资料。
Translation: Article 67 Upon the closure of the written proceedings, the Court may refuse to accept any further documents or evidence that one party seeks to submit without the consent of the other party.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十八条法庭可以考虑当事国的代理人或顾问提请法庭注意的新的文件或资料。
Translation: Article 68 The Court may take into consideration new documents or materials brought to its attention by the agents or counsel of the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 在此情况下,法庭有权要求出示此项文件或资料,但必须通知对方。
Translation: In such circumstances, the court has the authority to require the production of such document or material, provided that the other party is duly notified.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十九条此外,法庭可要求当事国代理人出示一切文件并要求作出一切必要解释。
Translation:
Article 69  
Furthermore, the Court may call upon the agents of the parties to produce any documents and to supply any explanations deemed necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 如遇拒绝,法庭应予记录在案。
Translation: In case of refusal, the court shall record it in the case file.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十条当事国的代理人和辩护人得向法庭口头陈述他们认为对辩护他们的案件有益的一切论据。
Translation: Article 70 The agents and counsel of the parties may present orally to the Court all arguments they may consider useful to the defense of their case.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十一条他们有权提出异议和问题。
Translation: Article 71 They have the right to raise objections and questions.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭对这些问题的决定是最终的,以后不得进行任何讨论。
Translation: The court's decision on these matters shall be final and not subject to any further discussion.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十二条法庭成员有权向当事国代理人和辩护人提出问题,并要求他们对可疑之点作出解释。
Translation: Article 72 Members of the court shall have the right to put questions to the agents and counsel of the parties and to demand explanations from them on doubtful points.

Query_Text_cn: 在辩论过程中,法庭成员所提出的问题或意见均不能被视为整个法庭的意见或法庭成员的意见。
Translation: During the course of debate, any questions or opinions raised by members of the court shall not be deemed as the opinion of the entire court or of any individual member thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十三条法庭被授权宣布它有权解释在案件中所引用的仲裁协定和其他文件和资料,以及法律原则的适用问题。
Translation: Article 73 The court is empowered to declare its authority to interpret the arbitration agreements and other documents and materials cited in the case, as well as the application of legal principles.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十四条法庭有权作出处理本案的程序规则,确定当事国每一方结束辩论的形式、次序和日期,以及安排处理证据的一切手续。
Translation:
Article 74  
The Court shall have the power to lay down procedural rules for the case, determine the form, order, and time limits for the presentation of arguments by each party, and prescribe all arrangements for the handling of evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十五条当事国承允尽可能充分地向法庭提供对裁决争端所必要的一切资料。
Translation: Article 75 The parties undertake to supply the Tribunal as fully as possible with all information necessary for deciding the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十六条法庭需要在第三缔约国境内发出任何通知时,应直接向该国政府提出申请。
Translation: Article 76 Where the court needs to serve any notice in a third State, it shall directly apply to the government of that State.
