Query_Text_cn: 对于到该国现场收集证据而须采取的步骤也适用本条的规定。
Translation: The provisions of this Article shall also apply to the steps necessary for the collection of evidence in the territory of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的而提出的申请应由被申请国按照它的国内法所掌握的方式予以执行。
Translation: Applications made for this purpose shall be executed by the requested State in accordance with the procedures available under its domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 除非该国认为此项申请有损它的主权和安全,此项申请不得拒绝。
Translation: No such application shall be refused unless the country concerned considers that it would prejudice its sovereignty and security.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭始终有权通过法庭所在地的国家采取行动。
Translation: The court always has the authority to act through the state where the court is located.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十七条在当事国代理人和辩护人已全部提出支持他们诉讼的说明和证据后,庭长即宣告讨论结束。
Translation: Article 77 After the agents and counsel of the parties have completed their presentation of the case and evidence in support thereof, the President shall declare the hearing closed.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十八条法庭的审议不公开,并保守秘密。
Translation: Article 78 Deliberations of the court shall be conducted in private and kept confidential.

Query_Text_cn: 一切决定由法庭成员以多数票作出。
Translation: All decisions shall be made by a majority vote of the court members.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十九条仲裁裁决应叙明所依据的理由。
Translation: Article 79 An arbitral award shall state the reasons upon which it is based.

Query_Text_cn: 应由庭长和书记或履行书记职责的秘书签署。
Translation: It shall be signed by the presiding judge and the clerk or the secretary performing the duties of the clerk.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十条仲裁裁决应在当事国的代理人和辩护人到场或经正式传唤出庭的情况下,在公开庭上予以宣读。
Translation: Article 80 The arbitral award shall be read out in open court, with the agents and counsel of the parties present or duly summoned to attend.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十一条仲裁裁决经正式宣读并通知各当事国的代理人后,争端即获最终解决,不得上诉。
Translation: Article 81 The arbitral award, once formally pronounced and notified to the agents of the parties, shall definitively settle the dispute and shall not be subject to appeal.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十二条当事国之间在解释和实施裁决时可能发生的一切争端,除非有相反的协定,应提交作出裁决的法庭予以判决。
Translation: Article 82 Any dispute that may arise between the parties concerning the interpretation or implementation of the award shall, unless otherwise agreed, be submitted to the tribunal which rendered the award for decision.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十三条当事国可在仲裁协定中保留申请复审仲裁裁决的权利。
Translation: Article 83 The parties may reserve in the arbitration agreement the right to apply for a review of the arbitral award.

Query_Text_cn: 在此情况下,除非有相反的协定,申请应向作出裁决的法庭提出。
Translation: In such cases, unless there is an agreement to the contrary, the application shall be made to the court which rendered the decision.

Query_Text_cn: 提出申请的唯一理由只能是由于一个新事实的发现而它的性质对裁决本来有可能起决定性影响,且截至辩论结束时,法庭本身以及申请复审的当事国都不知道。
Translation: The sole ground for filing an application shall be the discovery of some fact of such a nature as to be a decisive factor, which fact was, when the judgment was given, unknown to the Court and also to the party claiming revision, provided that such ignorance was not due to negligence.

Query_Text_cn: 复审程序只有在法庭作出决定后才能开始。该项决定应以明文确认新事实的存在,承认它具有前款规定的性质,并宣告申请可据此予以接受。
Translation: The review procedure can only commence after the court has rendered a decision. Such decision shall expressly confirm the existence of new facts, recognize their nature as stipulated in the preceding paragraph, and declare the application admissible on that basis.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁协定规定作出复审申请的期限。
Translation: The arbitration agreement stipulates the time limit for filing a request for review.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十四条仲裁裁决只对争端各方具有拘束力。
Translation: Article 84 An arbitral award shall be binding only on the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 当涉及争端当事国以外的其他国家参加的某协定的解释问题时,前者应及时通知一切签署国。
Translation: When the interpretation of an agreement involving states other than the parties to a dispute is at issue, the former shall promptly notify all signatory states.

Query_Text_cn: 这些国家中每一国均有权参加诉讼。
Translation: Each of these states has the right to participate in the proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 如其中一国或几国行使了这一权利,则裁决中所包含的解释对它们也同样具有拘束力。
Translation: If one or several states exercise this right, the interpretation contained in the ruling shall also be binding upon them.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十五条每一当事国负担自己的费用，并平均分担法庭的费用。
Translation: Article 85 Each party shall bear its own costs and share equally the expenses of the Tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十六条为了便于对允许采取简易程序的争端运用仲裁制度,各缔约国采取以下规则,以便在没有其他协议并保留必要时适用第三章规定的条件下予以遵循。
Translation:
Article 86  
In order to facilitate recourse to arbitration for disputes where summary procedures are permissible, the following rules shall apply to all States Parties, in the absence of any other agreement and without prejudice to the application of the provisions of Chapter III where necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十七条争端每一方各任命一名仲裁人。
Translation: Article 87 Each party to the dispute shall appoint one arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: 由上述选定的两名仲裁人选出一名公断人。
Translation: The two arbitrators thus chosen shall select an umpire.

Query_Text_cn: 从这样提出的候选人中,用抽签决定公断人。
Translation: From the candidates thus proposed, the arbitrator shall be determined by lot.

Query_Text_cn: 公断人主持法庭。法庭的决定以多数票作出。
Translation: The arbitrator presides over the tribunal. The tribunal's decisions are made by majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十八条在没有事前协议的情况下,法庭一俟成立,应即规定双方各自提交案情的期限。
Translation: Article 88 In the absence of any prior agreement, the tribunal shall, upon its constitution, determine the time limits within which each party shall submit its case.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十九条每一方应由一名代理人出庭,作为法庭和指派他的政府之间的中间人。
Translation: Article 89 Each party shall be represented by an agent, who shall act as an intermediary between the Court and the government that appointed him.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十条诉讼程序全部以书面方式进行。
Translation: Article 90 All litigation procedures shall be conducted in writing.

Query_Text_cn: 但各方有权要求传唤证人和鉴定人出庭。
Translation: However, all parties have the right to request the summoning of witnesses and expert appraisers to appear in court.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭有权要求双方的代理人以及它认为有必要出庭的鉴定人和证人作出口头说明。
Translation: The court has the authority to require oral explanations from the representatives of both parties, as well as from expert witnesses and other witnesses it deems necessary to appear in court.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十一条本公约一经正式批准,即在缔约各国间代替1899年7月29日的和平解决国际争端公约。
Translation: Article 91 Upon its formal ratification, this Convention shall replace, as between the Contracting Powers, the Convention for the Pacific Settlement of International Disputes of July 29, 1899.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十二条本公约应尽速批准。
Translation: Article 92 This Convention shall be ratified as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应交存于海牙。
Translation: The instrument of approval shall be deposited at The Hague.

Query_Text_cn: 首批批准书的交存应作成正式记录并由各加入国的代表和荷兰外交大臣签署。
Translation: The deposit of the first instruments of approval shall be recorded in a formal procès-verbal signed by the representatives of the acceding States and the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands.

Query_Text_cn: 以后批准书的交存则以书面通知的方式通知荷兰政府并附交批准文件。
Translation: Subsequent deposit of instruments of ratification shall be notified to the Government of the Netherlands in writing, accompanied by the instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 首批批准书交存记录、前款提到的书面通知以及批准文件的经核证无误的副本,应由荷兰政府通过外交途径立即送交被邀请出席第二届和平会议的各国以及后来加入本公约的其他国家。
Translation: The instruments of the first deposit of ratifications, the written notifications mentioned in the preceding paragraph, and duly certified copies of the instruments of ratification shall be immediately transmitted by the Government of the Netherlands through diplomatic channels to the Powers invited to the Second Peace Conference, as well as to the other Powers which have adhered to the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 对前款所指的情况,荷兰政府应同时把它收到通知的日期转告上述各国。
Translation: In the case referred to in the preceding paragraph, the Government of the Netherlands shall inform the said States simultaneously of the date on which it received the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十三条曾经被邀参加第二届和平会议的非签署国可以加入本公约。
Translation:
Article 93  
Non-signatory states that were invited to participate in the Second Peace Conference may accede to the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 愿加入的国家应把它的意愿书面通知荷兰政府,同时向该国政府送交加入书,该加入书保存于荷兰政府的档案库。
Translation: Any state wishing to accede shall notify its intention in writing to the Government of the Netherlands and deposit its instrument of accession with the said Government, which shall keep it in its archives.

Query_Text_cn: 荷兰政府应将通知和加入书的经核证无误的副本,立即送交被邀出席第二届和平会议的所有其他国家,并注明收到通知的日期。
Translation: The Government of the Netherlands shall forthwith transmit to all the other Powers invited to the Second Peace Conference a duly certified copy of the notification as well as of the act of accession, specifying the date on which the notification was received.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十四条未被邀请出席第二届和平会议的国家加入本公约的条件,将由缔约各国在以后议定。
Translation: Article 94: The conditions under which States not invited to the Second Peace Conference may adhere to the present Convention shall be determined by the Contracting Powers at a later date.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十五条本公约对首批交存批准书的国家,于此项交存作成正式记录之日起六十天后生效；对以后批准或加入的国家,则于荷兰政府收到批准或加入通知之日起六十天后开始生效。
Translation: Article 95 This Convention shall enter into force on the sixtieth day following the date of deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession. For each State ratifying, accepting, approving or acceding to the Convention after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, the Convention shall enter into force on the sixtieth day after deposit by such State of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十六条如一缔约国要求退出本公约,则应以书面通知荷兰政府,由该国政府立即将通知的经核证无误的副本送交所有其他国家,并告知收到通知的日期。
Translation:
Article 96  
If a Contracting State wishes to denounce this Convention, it shall notify the Government of the Netherlands in writing. The latter shall promptly transmit a certified copy of the notification to all other States and inform them of the date of its receipt.

Query_Text_cn: 退出只对发出退出通知的国家,并于通知送达荷兰政府一年后生效。
Translation: Withdrawal shall take effect only for the notifying State and one year after the date of receipt of the notification by the Government of the Netherlands.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十七条由荷兰外交部保管的登记簿应载明按照第九十二条第三款和第四款交存批准书的日期以及收到加入通知（第九十三条第三款）或退出通知（第九十六条第一款）的日期。
Translation:
Article 97  
The register kept by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands shall record the dates of deposit of instruments of ratification under Article 92, paragraphs 3 and 4, as well as the dates of receipt of notifications of accession (Article 93, paragraph 3) or denunciation (Article 96, paragraph 1).

Query_Text_cn: 每一缔约国得查阅该登记簿并可要求提供核证无误的摘录。
Translation: Each Contracting Party may consult the register and may request certified extracts thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 各全权代表在本公约上签字，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned Plenipotentiaries have signed this Convention in witness thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 1907年10月18日订于海牙，正本一份，存于荷兰政府档案库，其经核证无误的副本通过外交途径分送给各缔约国。
Translation: Done at The Hague on the 18th day of October, 1907, in a single original, deposited in the archives of the Government of the Netherlands, and of which certified copies shall be transmitted through diplomatic channels to the Contracting Powers.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条本公约适用于位于各国领海以外，所有合法铺设的并在一个或多个缔约国领土、殖民地或占领地上岸的海底电缆。
Translation: Article 1 This Convention applies to all lawfully laid submarine cables located beyond the territorial waters of any State, which land in the territory, colony, or occupied territory of one or more Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条故意或因重大过失切断或损害海底电缆，导致电讯完全或部分中断或受阻的行为，均为应受惩罚的犯罪行为，但所施惩罚并不排除损害赔偿的民事诉讼。
Translation: Article 2: Any intentional or grossly negligent act of severing or damaging submarine cables, resulting in complete or partial interruption or obstruction of telecommunications, shall constitute a punishable offense. However, such punishment shall not preclude civil actions for damages.

Query_Text_cn: 本规定不适用于犯罪方只是为了救助其生命或其船舶的合法目的，在采取避免海底电缆断裂或损害的一切必要预防措施后，仍发生的海底电缆断裂或损害。
Translation: This regulation shall not apply to cases where the breaking or injury of a submarine cable occurs despite all necessary precautions having been taken by the offending party to avoid such break or injury, provided that the act was committed solely for the lawful purpose of saving their lives or their vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条各缔约国同意，在其允许海底电缆上岸时，尽可能在电缆的轨迹和范围方面，坚持适当的安全条件。
Translation:
Article 3  
The Contracting Parties agree that, in permitting submarine cables to land within their territories, they shall as far as possible adhere to proper safety conditions regarding the route and extent of such cables.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条某一电缆所有人如在铺设或修理其电缆时，造成另一电缆断裂或损害，应支付对此种断裂或损害进行必要修复的费用；但是，如果存在实施本公约第2条的理由，这种支付并不妨碍此种实施。
Translation: Article 4: If the owner of any cable, in the course of laying or repairing it, causes a break or injury to another cable, they shall bear the cost of the repairs necessary for such break or injury; provided that, if there exists a reason for the application of Article 2 of this Convention, such payment shall not prevent such application.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条从事铺设或修理海底电缆的船舶，必须遵守各缔约国为防止海上碰撞，经一致同意而已采用或将采用的有关信号规则。
Translation: Article 5 Ships engaged in laying or repairing submarine cables must comply with the signal rules concerning the prevention of collisions at sea, which have been or may be adopted by common agreement among the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 当从事电缆修理的某船悬挂有上述信号时，看见或能够看见此种信号的其他船舶应当驶离或至少与该船保持一海里的距离，以防干扰该船作业。
Translation: When a vessel engaged in cable repair displays the aforementioned signals, other vessels that see or are able to see such signals shall keep clear or maintain a distance of at least one nautical mile to avoid interfering with its operations.

Query_Text_cn: 渔具和渔网应同该船离开相同的距离。
Translation: Fishing gear and nets shall be kept at the same distance as the vessel's departure.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，应给予看见或能够看见某一悬挂上述信号的电缆铺设船的渔船不超过二十四小时的时间，使其能服从此种警告。在此期间内，不得在它们的作业途中设置障碍。
Translation: However, fishing vessels that have seen or could have seen a cable-laying vessel displaying the aforementioned signals shall be given no more than twenty-four hours to comply with such warning. During this period, no obstruction shall be placed in their course of operation.

Query_Text_cn: 电缆铺设船应尽可能迅速完成作业。
Translation: The cable-laying vessel should complete its operations as swiftly as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条船舶看见或能够看见用于指明正在铺设的电缆位置的浮标处于不良状态或已损坏时，应至少同该浮标保持四分之一海里的距离。
Translation: Article 6: When a vessel observes or is able to observe that buoys indicating the position of a cable being laid are in poor condition or damaged, it shall maintain a distance of at least one-quarter nautical mile from such buoys.

Query_Text_cn: 渔具和渔网应同该浮标离开相同的距离。
Translation: Fishing gear and nets should be kept at the same distance from the buoy.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条如船舶所有人能证明为避免损害海底电缆而牺牲了锚、网或任何其他渔具，则应由电缆所有人予以赔偿。
Translation: Article 7 If the shipowner can prove that anchors, nets, or any other fishing gear were sacrificed to avoid damaging the submarine cable, compensation shall be paid by the owner of the cable.

Query_Text_cn: 为获得此种赔偿，该船舶所有人在事故发生后，在可能的情况下，必须立即备妥由船员证言支持的陈述，以证明该事故。
Translation: To obtain such compensation, the shipowner must, as soon as possible after the incident, prepare a statement supported by crew testimony to substantiate the occurrence, where feasible.

Query_Text_cn: 船长必须在到达临时挂靠的第一个港口后二十四小时内，向主管当局提交声明。
Translation: The master must submit a declaration to the competent authority within twenty-four hours of arrival at the first port of call where the vessel makes a temporary stop.

Query_Text_cn: 该主管当局应向电缆所有人所属国的领事机构发出此种通知。
Translation: The competent authority shall issue such notification to the consular institution of the country to which the cable owner belongs.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条有权审理在船上发生的违反本公约的行为的法院，应当是该船所属国的法院。
Translation: Article 8 The courts competent to try offenses committed on board a vessel shall be those of the State to which the vessel belongs.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，认为，如果前款规定不能实施，各缔约国应根据本国的特殊法律或国际条约所确立的刑事管辖权的一般原则，阻止其国民或公民违反本公约的行为。
Translation: Furthermore, it is considered that if the provisions of the preceding paragraph cannot be implemented, each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with the general principles of criminal jurisdiction established by its domestic special laws or international treaties, prevent its nationals or citizens from engaging in acts that violate this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条针对本公约第2条、第5条和第6条规定的违反本公约的行为而进行的诉讼，应由国家或以国家的名义提起。
Translation: Article 9: Legal proceedings for violations of this Convention as stipulated in Articles 2,5,and 6 shall be instituted by the State or in the name of the State.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条违反本公约的证据，可以依据受诉法院所属国的法律所允许的各种保全证据的方法获取。
Translation: Article 10 Evidence of a breach of this Convention may be obtained through any means of evidence preservation permitted by the laws of the country to which the court hearing the case belongs.

Query_Text_cn: 当某一缔约国军舰或专门用于此目的船舶上的高级船员有理由确信某一非军舰的船舶违反本公约规定的措施时，可要求该船船长出示证明该船国籍的正式文件。
Translation: When a senior officer on a warship or other duly authorized ship of a Contracting Party has reasonable grounds to believe that a non-warship has violated the measures stipulated in this Convention, they may require the master of such ship to produce official documents proving the ship's nationality.

Query_Text_cn: 在出示的文件上应立即记录此种出示的概况。
Translation: A summary of such presentation shall be promptly recorded on the documents presented.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，上述高级船员可起草报告，而不论违法船舶的国籍如何。
Translation: In addition, the aforementioned senior officers may draft reports regardless of the nationality of the offending vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 报告应使用草拟此种报告的高级船员所属国使用的格式及文字。
Translation: The report shall be drawn up in the form and language prescribed by the country of the officer who is required to prepare it.

Query_Text_cn: 根据该国的法律，在该国可援用这些报告作为证据。
Translation: Under the laws of that country, these reports may be invoked as evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 被告人和证人有权使用其自己的文字，加进或使之加进他们认为适当的任何解释。
Translation: The accused and witnesses have the right to use their own language and to add, or have added, any explanations they deem appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 此种声明应经正式签字。
Translation: Such a declaration shall be duly signed.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条违反本公约的案件的诉讼程序和审理，应在现行法律或法规允许的范围内，简易地进行。
Translation: Article 11 The proceedings and trial of cases involving violations of this Convention shall be conducted expeditiously within the limits permitted by existing laws or regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条为保证实施本公约，特别是为了通过罚款或监禁或两者并用以惩罚可能违反本公约第2条、第5条和第6条规定的人员，各缔约国保证采取必要措施或建议各自的立法机构采取必要措施。注：美国法规编录在美国法典第47篇第2章第21-39节内。
Translation:
Article 12  
To ensure the implementation of this Convention, and in particular to penalize, by means of fines, imprisonment, or both, any person who may violate the provisions of Articles 2, 5, and 6 thereof, each Contracting Party undertakes to take the necessary measures or to propose to its legislative bodies the adoption of such measures.  

Note: U.S. regulations are codified in Title 47, Chapter 2, Sections 21-39 of the United States Code.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条各缔约国应相互交换各自国家已经颁布或此后可能颁布的有关本公约事宜的法律。
Translation:
Article 13  
The Contracting Parties shall exchange with one another the laws of their respective countries that have been or may hereafter be promulgated concerning matters covered by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条未参加本公约的国家，根据其要求，允许加入本公约。
Translation: Article 14: States not parties to this Convention shall be permitted to accede to it upon request.

Query_Text_cn: 加入通知应通过外交途径递交法兰西共和国政府，并通过该国政府通知其他签字国政府。
Translation: The notification of accession shall be transmitted through diplomatic channels to the Government of the French Republic and communicated by that Government to the other signatory Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条认为，本公约的各项规定毫不影响交战国的行动自由。
Translation: Article 15 stipulates that the provisions of this Convention shall in no way affect the freedom of action of belligerent parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条本公约应于各缔约国协议的日期生效。本公约从该日起保持五年有效。
Translation:
Article 16  
This Convention shall enter into force on the date agreed upon by the Contracting Parties and shall remain in force for a period of five years from that date.

Query_Text_cn: 在上述五年有效期限届满前十二个月内，如果没有缔约国递交欲使本公约效力终止的通知，则本公约将继续有效一年，此后每年如此。
Translation: If no Contracting State has given notice of its intention to terminate the Convention within twelve months before the expiry of the said five-year period, the Convention shall remain in force for a further year and so on thereafter year by year.

Query_Text_cn: 如果某一缔约国递交欲终止本公约效力的通知，该通知仅对该国有效。
Translation: If a Contracting State submits a notification to terminate the effect of this Convention, such notification shall be effective only for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条本公约须经批准。
Translation: Article 17 This Convention is subject to ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应尽快地在巴黎进行交换，并且最迟在一年内进行。
Translation: The instruments of ratification shall be exchanged in Paris as soon as possible and no later than within one year.

Query_Text_cn: 各国全权大使签署本公约，并已在本公约上盖章，以昭信守。
Translation: The Plenipotentiaries of the respective States have signed this Convention and affixed their seals thereto as a token of good faith.

Query_Text_cn: 根据第1条，为保护海底电缆而于今日缔结的本公约的规定，应适用于英国女王陛下的殖民地和占领地，但下列地方除外，即加拿大、纽芬兰、好望角、纳塔耳、新南威尔士、维多利亚、昆士兰、塔斯马尼亚、南澳大利亚、西澳大利亚、新西兰。
Translation: In accordance with Article 1, the provisions of this Convention, concluded today for the protection of submarine cables, shall apply to all colonies and possessions of Her Majesty the Queen of the United Kingdom, with the exception of the following places: Canada, Newfoundland, the Cape of Good Hope, Natal, New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Tasmania, South Australia, Western Australia, and New Zealand.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果英国女王陛下在巴黎的代表以某一上述殖民地或占领地的名义，已经向法国外交部长寄交了使本公约的规定适用于该地的通知，则本公约的规定适用于该地。
Translation: However, if the representative of Her Britannic Majesty in Paris has submitted a notification to the French Minister of Foreign Affairs on behalf of any of the aforementioned colonies or occupied territories, applying the provisions of this Convention to that territory, then the provisions of this Convention shall apply thereto.

Query_Text_cn: 殖民地可以加入加入本公约的每一上述殖民地或占领地，有权以与缔约国相同的方式退出本公约。
Translation: Any such colony or occupied territory referred to above that has acceded to this Convention shall have the right to withdraw from it in the same manner as the Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 某一殖民地或占领地欲退出本公约，应通过英国女王陛下在巴黎的代表向法国外交部长寄交此种退出通知。
Translation: Any colony or occupied territory wishing to withdraw from this Convention shall communicate such notice of withdrawal to the French Minister of Foreign Affairs through Her Britannic Majesty's representative in Paris.

Query_Text_cn: 关于制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为的公约（该公约于１９７１年９月２３日订于蒙特利尔，１９７３年１月２６日生效。我国于１９８０年９月１０日向美国政府交存加入书，同时声明：对公约第十四条第一款持有保留；台湾当局以中国名义对该公约的签署和批准是非法和无效的。本公约于１９８０年１０月１０日对我生效。
Translation: Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation (This Convention was concluded in Montreal on September 23, 1971, and entered into force on January 26, 1973. China deposited its instrument of accession with the Government of the United States of America on September 10, 1980, with a statement that it reserves the right not to be bound by paragraph 1 of Article 14 of the Convention, and that the signature and ratification of the Convention by the Taiwan authorities in the name of China are illegal and null and void. The Convention entered into force for China on October 10, 1980.)

Query_Text_cn: （）传送他明知是虚假的情报，从而危及飞行中的航空器的安全。
Translation: () transmits information he knows to be false, thereby endangering the safety of an aircraft in flight.

Query_Text_cn: （）是犯有或企图犯任何此种罪行的人的同犯。
Translation: () is an accomplice to any person who has committed or attempted to commit any such offense.

Query_Text_cn: 航空器强迫降落时，在主当局接管对该航空器及其所载人员和财产的责任前，应被认为仍在飞行中。
Translation: An aircraft shall be considered to be in flight from the moment of forced landing until the time when the competent authorities take over responsibility for the aircraft and for the persons and property on board.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，使用的期间应包括本条甲款所规定的航空器是在飞行中的整个时间。
Translation: In any event, the period of use shall include the entire duration during which the aircraft is in flight as stipulated in Clause A of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条各缔约国承允对第一条所指的罪行给予严厉惩罚。
Translation: Article III: Each Contracting Party undertakes to impose severe penalties for the offenses referred to in Article I.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约不适用于供军事、海关或警察用的航空器。
Translation: 1. This Convention shall not apply to aircraft used in military, customs or police services.

Query_Text_cn: （）罪行是在该航空器登记国以外的一国领土内发生的。
Translation: The offense was committed in the territory of a country other than the state of registry of the aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 三、尽管有本条第二款的规定，在第一条第一款（）、（）、（）和（）项所指情况下，如罪犯或被指称的罪犯是在该航空器登记国以外的一国领土内被发现，则本公约也应适用。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, in the cases referred to in subparagraphs (a), (b), (c) and (d) of paragraph 1 of Article 1, this Convention shall also apply if the offender or alleged offender is found in the territory of a State other than the State of registration of that aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 四、关于第九条所指的各国，在第一条第一款（）、（）、（）和（）项所指的情况下，如本条第二款（）项所指地点处于同一国家的领土内，而这一国家又是第九条所指国家之一，则本公约不应适用，除非罪行是在该国以外的一国领土内发生或罪犯或被指称的罪犯是在该国以外的一国领土内被发现。
Translation: 4. With respect to the States referred to in Article 9, in cases where the locations referred to in subparagraphs (a), (b), (c), and (d) of paragraph 1 of Article 1 are situated within the territory of the same State, and that State is one of those referred to in Article 9, this Convention shall not apply unless the offence is committed in the territory of another State or the alleged offender is found in the territory of another State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在第一条第一款（丁）项所指的情况下，只有在航行设备是用于国际航行时，本公约才适用。
Translation: V. In the case referred to in paragraph 1(d) of Article 1, this Convention shall apply only when the navigation equipment is used for international navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 六、本条第二、三、四和五款的规定，也适用于第一条第二款所指的情况。
Translation: VI. The provisions of paragraphs 2, 3, 4 and 5 of this Article shall also apply to the cases referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 1.

Query_Text_cn: （丁）罪行是针对租来时不带机组的航空器，或是在该航空器内发生的，而承租人的主要营业地，或如承租人没有这种营业地，则其永久居所，是在该国。
Translation: (d) The offense is committed against an aircraft leased without crew, or occurs within such an aircraft, and the lessee's principal place of business or, if the lessee has no such place of business, their permanent residence is in that state.

Query_Text_cn: 二、当被指称的罪犯在缔约国领土内，而该国未按第八条的规定将此人引渡给本条第一款所指的任一国家时，该缔约国应同样采取必要措施，对第一条第一款（）、（）和（）项所指的罪行，以及对第一条第二款所列与这些款项有关的罪行实施管辖权。
Translation: II. When the alleged offender is present in the territory of a State Party and that State does not extradite such person to any of the States referred to in paragraph 1 of this article pursuant to Article 8, the said State Party shall likewise take necessary measures to establish its jurisdiction over the offences set forth in Article 1, paragraph 1(a), (b), and (c), as well as over those offences listed in Article 1, paragraph 2 that are related to these provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本公约不排斥根据本国法行使任何刑事管辖权。
Translation: III. This Convention does not preclude the exercise of any criminal jurisdiction in accordance with national law.

Query_Text_cn: 一、罪犯或被指称的罪犯所在的任一缔约国在判明情况有此需要时，应将该人拘留或采取其他措施以保证该人留在境内。这种拘留和其他措施应符合该国的法律规定，但是只有在为了提出刑事诉讼或引渡程序所必要的期间内，才可继续保持这些措施。
Translation: 1. Any State Party in the territory of which the alleged offender is present shall, upon determining that the circumstances so warrant, take the necessary measures to detain the person or ensure their presence within its territory. Such detention or other measures shall be in accordance with the laws of that State, and may only be maintained for such time as is necessary to enable any criminal or extradition proceedings to be instituted.

Query_Text_cn: 二、该国应立即对事实进行初步调查。
Translation: II. The country should promptly conduct a preliminary investigation into the facts.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对根据本条第一款予以拘留的任何人，应向其提供协助，以便其立即与其本国最近的合格代表联系。
Translation: 3. Any person detained pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article shall be afforded assistance to contact immediately the nearest competent representative of his or her country.

Query_Text_cn: 四、当一国根据本条规定将某人拘留时，它应将拘留该人和应予拘留的情况立即通知第五条第一款所指国家和被拘留人的国籍所属国，如果认为适当，并通知其他有关国家。按照本条第二款规定进行初步调查的国家，应尽速将调查结果通知上述各国，并说明它是否意欲行使管辖权。
Translation: 4. When a State Party has taken a person into custody pursuant to this article, it shall immediately notify the States referred to in paragraph 1 of article 5 and, if it considers it appropriate, any other interested States, of the fact that such person is in custody and of the circumstances which warrant his detention. The State which makes the preliminary inquiry contemplated in paragraph 2 of this article shall promptly report its findings to the said States and shall indicate whether it intends to exercise jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条在其境内发现被指称的罪犯的缔约国，如不将此人引渡，则不论罪行是否在其境内发生，应无例外地将此案件提交其主管当局以便起诉。该当局应按照本国法律，以对待任何严重性质的普通罪行案件的同样方式作出决定。
Translation: Article 7 The Contracting State in whose territory the alleged offender is found shall, if it does not extradite him, be obliged, without exception whatsoever and whether or not the offence was committed in its territory, to submit the case to its competent authorities for the purpose of prosecution. Those authorities shall take their decision in the same manner as in the case of any ordinary offence of a serious nature under the law of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、前述罪行应看作是包括在缔约各国间现有引渡条约中的一种可引渡的罪行。缔约各国承允将此种罪行作为一种可引渡的罪行列入它们之间将要缔结的每一项引渡条约中。
Translation: 1. The aforementioned offenses shall be deemed extraditable offenses included in existing extradition treaties between the Contracting Parties. The Contracting Parties undertake to include such offenses as extraditable offenses in every extradition treaty to be concluded between them.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如一缔约国规定只有在订有引渡条约的条件下才可以引渡，而当该缔约国接到未与其订有引渡条约的另一缔约国的引渡要求时，可以自行决定认为本公约是对该罪行进行引渡的法律根据。引渡应遵照被要求国法律规定的其他条件。
Translation: 2. If a State Party makes extradition conditional on the existence of a treaty and receives a request for extradition from another State Party with which it has no extradition treaty, it may at its option consider this Convention as the legal basis for extradition in respect of such offences. Extradition shall be subject to the other conditions provided by the law of the requested State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约各国如没有规定只有在订有引渡条约下才可引渡，则在遵照被要求国法律规定的条件下，应承认上述罪行是它们之间可引渡的罪行。
Translation: 3. The Contracting States which do not make extradition conditional on the existence of a treaty shall recognize the aforementioned offences as extraditable offences between themselves, subject to the conditions provided by the law of the requested State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、为在缔约各国之间引渡的目的，每一罪行应看作不仅是发生在所发生的地点、而且也是发生在根据第五条第一款（）、（）和（丁）项要求实施其管辖权的国家领土上。
Translation: IV. For the purpose of extradition between Contracting States, each offense shall be regarded not only as having been committed in the place where it occurred but also as having been committed in the territories of the States required to establish their jurisdiction in accordance with subparagraphs (a), (b), and (d) of paragraph 1 of Article V.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条如缔约各国成立航空运输联营组织或国际经营机构，而其使用的航空器需要进行联合登记或国际登记时，则这些缔约国应通过适当方法在它们之间为每一航空器指定一个国家，该国为本公约的目的，应行使管辖权并具有登记国的性质，并应将此项指定通知国际民用航空组织，由该组织将上述通知转告本公约所有缔约国。
Translation: Article IX In the event that the Contracting States establish joint air transport operating organizations or international operating agencies, which operate aircraft not registered in any one State, those States shall, by appropriate means, designate for such aircraft a State among them which, for the purposes of this Convention, shall exercise jurisdiction and control over that aircraft as the State of registry and shall give notice thereof to the International Civil Aviation Organization, which shall communicate the notice to all Contracting States of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约各国应根据国际法和本国法，努力采取一切可能的措施，以防止发生第一条所指的罪行。
Translation: 1. The Contracting Parties shall, in accordance with international law and their national laws, endeavor to take all possible measures to prevent the commission of the offenses referred to in Article 1.

Query_Text_cn: 二、当由于发生了第一条所指的一种罪行，使飞行延误或中断，航空器、旅客或机组所在的任何缔约国应对旅客和机组继续其旅行尽速提供方便，并应将航空器和所载货物不迟延地交还给合法的所有人。
Translation: II. In the event of an offense specified in Article I causing delay or interruption to the flight, any Contracting State in which the aircraft, passengers, or crew are located shall facilitate the continuation of the journey of the passengers and crew as soon as practicable, and shall without delay return the aircraft and its cargo to the persons lawfully entitled to possession.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约各国对上述罪行所提出的刑事诉讼，应相互给予最大程度的协助。在任何情况下，都应适用被要求国的法律。
Translation: 1. The Contracting Parties shall afford one another the greatest measure of mutual assistance in connection with criminal proceedings brought in respect of the offences referred to above. In all cases, the law of the requested State shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款的规定，不应影响因任何其他双边或多边条约在刑事问题上全部地或部分地规定或将规定相互协助而承担的义务。
Translation: Article 2. The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not affect obligations under any other bilateral or multilateral treaty that wholly or partially governs or will govern mutual assistance in criminal matters.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条任何缔约国如有理由相信将要发生第一条所指的罪行之一时，应遵照其本国法向其认为是第五条第一款所指的国家，提供其所掌握的任何有关情况。
Translation: Article 12 Any Contracting State which has reason to believe that one of the offences specified in Article 1 will be committed shall, in accordance with its national law, furnish any relevant information in its possession to those States which it believes would be the States mentioned in paragraph 1 of Article 5.

Query_Text_cn: （）对罪犯或被称的罪犯所采取的措施，特别是任何引渡程序或其他法律程序的结果。
Translation: () Measures taken against criminals or alleged criminals, particularly the outcome of any extradition proceedings or other legal procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如两个或几个缔约国之间对本公约的解释或应用发生争端而不能以谈判解决时，经其中一方的要求，应交付仲裁。如果在要求仲裁之日起六个月内，当事国对仲裁的组成不能达成协议，任何一方可按照国际法院规约，要求将争端提交国际法院。
Translation: 1. If a dispute arises between two or more Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention and cannot be settled through negotiation, it shall, at the request of any one of the parties to the dispute, be submitted to arbitration. If, within six months from the date of the request for arbitration, the parties are unable to agree on the organization of the arbitration, any one of those parties may refer the dispute to the International Court of Justice by application in conformity with the Statute of the Court.

Query_Text_cn: 二、每个国家在签字、批准或加入本公约时，可以声明该国不受前款规定的约束。其他缔约国对于任何作出这种保留的缔约国，也不受前款规定的约束。
Translation: II. Any State may, at the time of signature, ratification or accession to this Convention, declare that it does not consider itself bound by the provisions of the preceding paragraph. Other Contracting States shall not be bound by the said provisions in respect of any Contracting State which has made such a reservation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按照前款规定作出保留的任何缔约国，可以在任何时候通知保存国政府撤销这一保留。
Translation: 3. Any State Party that has made a reservation in accordance with the preceding provisions may at any time notify the depositary government to withdraw such reservation.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约于１９７１年９月２３日在蒙特利尔开放，听任１９７１年９月８日到２３日在蒙特利尔举行的国际航空法会议（以下称为蒙特利尔会议）的参加国签字。１９７１年１０月１０日后，本公约将在莫斯科、伦敦和华盛顿向所有国家开放签字。在本公约根据本条第三款开始生效前未在本公约上签字的任何国家，可在任何时候加入本公约。
Translation: I. This Convention shall be open for signature at Montreal on 23 September 1971 by States participating in the International Conference on Air Law held at Montreal from 8 to 23 September 1971 (hereinafter referred to as the Montreal Conference). After 10 October 1971, the Convention shall be open to all States for signature in Moscow, London and Washington. Any State which does not sign this Convention before its entry into force in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article may accede to it at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约须经签字国批准。批准书和加入书应交存苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟、不大列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国以及美利坚合众国政府，这些政府被指定为保存国政府。
Translation: II. The present Convention shall be subject to ratification by the signatory States. The instruments of ratification and accession shall be deposited with the Governments of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and the United States of America, which are hereby designated as the depositary Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本公约应于参加蒙特利尔会议在本公约上签字的十个国家交存批准书后三十天生效。
Translation: III. This Convention shall enter into force thirty days after the deposit of instruments of ratification by ten States which have signed it at the Montreal Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对其他国家，本公约应于本条第三款规定生效之日，或在它们交存批准书或加入书后三十天生效，以两者中较晚的一个日期为准。
Translation: IV. For other States, this Convention shall enter into force on the date specified in paragraph 3 of this Article or thirty days after the deposit of their instruments of ratification or accession, whichever is the later.

Query_Text_cn: 五、保存国政府应迅速将每一签字日期、每一批准书或加入书交存日期、本公约开始生效日期以及其他通知事项通知所有签字国和加入国。
Translation: V. The depositary government shall promptly notify all signatory and acceding states of each date of signature, each date of deposit of an instrument of ratification or accession, the date of entry into force of this Convention, and any other notifications.

Query_Text_cn: 六、本公约一经生效，应由保存国政府根据联合国宪章第一百零二条和国际民用航空公约（１９４４年芝加哥）第八十三条进行登记。
Translation: VI. Upon its entry into force, this Convention shall be registered by the depositary government in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations and Article 83 of the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago, 1944).

Query_Text_cn: 一、任何缔约国可以书面通知保存国政府退出本公约。
Translation: 1. Any Contracting State may withdraw from this Convention by written notification to the depositary government.

Query_Text_cn: 二、退出应于保存国政府接到通知之日起六个月后生效。下列签字的全权代表，经各自政府正式授权在本公约上签字，以资证明。１９７１年９月２３日订于蒙特利尔，正本一式三份，每份都用英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文四种有效文本写成。
Translation:
II. Withdrawal shall take effect six months after the date on which the notification is received by the depositary Government.  

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned Plenipotentiaries, being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments, have signed this Convention.  

DONE at Montreal this twenty-third day of September, one thousand nine hundred and seventy-one, in three originals, each being equally authentic in the English, French, Russian and Spanish languages.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条各缔约国承诺在一切情况下尊重本公约并保证本公约之被尊重。
Translation:
Article 1  
The High Contracting Parties undertake to respect and to ensure respect for the present Convention in all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条于平时应予实施之各项规定之外，本公约适用于两个或两个以上缔约国间所发生之一切经过宣战的战争或任何其他武装冲突，即使其中一国不承认有战争状态。
Translation: In addition to the provisions which shall be implemented in peacetime, the present Convention shall apply to all cases of declared war or of any other armed conflict which may arise between two or more of the High Contracting Parties, even if the state of war is not recognized by one of them.

Query_Text_cn: （丁）未经具有文明人类所认为必需之司法保障的正规组织之法庭之宣判而遽行判罪及执行死刑。
Translation: (d) The pronouncement of guilt and execution of the death penalty without judgment pronounced by a regularly constituted court affording all the judicial guarantees which are recognized as indispensable by civilized peoples.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条在冲突或占领之场合，于一定期间内及依不论何种方式，处于非其本国之冲突之一方或占领国手中之人，即为受本公约保护之人。
Translation: Article 4: Persons protected by the Convention are those who, at a given moment and in any manner whatsoever, find themselves, in case of a conflict or occupation, in the hands of a Party to the conflict or Occupying Power of which they are not nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 不受本公约拘束之国家之人民即不受本公约之保护。
Translation: Persons of States not bound by this Convention shall not be protected under it.

Query_Text_cn: 凡在交战国领土内之中立国人民及共同作战国人民，在其本国尚有通常外交使节驻在控制彼等之国家时，不得认为被保护人。
Translation: Neutral nationals and nationals of co-belligerent states within the territory of a belligerent shall not be regarded as protected persons so long as their own state maintains normal diplomatic representation in the state exercising control over them.

Query_Text_cn: 惟本公约第二部之各项规定，如第十三条所划定，其适用范围较广。
Translation: However, the provisions of Part II of this Convention, as delineated in Article XIII, have a broader scope of application.

Query_Text_cn: 凡受1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约，或1949年8月12日改善海上武装部队伤者病者及遇船难者境遇之日内瓦公约，或1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约保护之人，不得认为本公约意义内之被保护人。
Translation: Persons protected by the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of August 12, 1949, or by the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of Wounded, Sick and Shipwrecked Members of Armed Forces at Sea of August 12, 1949, or by the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12, 1949, shall not be considered as protected persons within the meaning of the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条凡冲突之一方深信在其领土内之个别被保护人确有危害该国安全之活动之嫌疑，或从事该项活动，而本公约之各项权利与特权若为该个人行使将有害该国安全时，该个人即不得要求此等权利与特权。
Translation: Article 5 Where, in the territory of a Party to the conflict, an individual protected person is definitely suspected of or engaged in activities hostile to the security of the State, such individual shall not be entitled to claim such rights and privileges under the present Convention as would, if exercised in the favour of such individual, be prejudicial to the security of such State.

Query_Text_cn: 在占领地内个别被保护人如系因间谍或破坏分子，或因确有危害占领国安全之活动嫌疑而被拘留者，在绝对的军事安全有此要求之情况下，其人应即认为丧失在本公约下之通讯权。
Translation: In the occupied territory, any protected person who is detained as a spy or saboteur, or as a person under definite suspicion of activity hostile to the security of the Occupying Power, shall, in cases where absolute military security so requires, be regarded as having forfeited rights of communication under the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 惟在每种情形下，此等人仍应受人道待遇，且在受审判时，不应剥夺本公约规定之公平正常的审判之权利。
Translation: In each case, such persons shall nevertheless be treated with humanity and, in the event of trial, shall not be deprived of the rights to a fair and regular trial as prescribed by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 又应斟酌个别情况尽早在合于该国或占领国之安全时给予彼等以被保护人依本公约所享有之全部权利与特权。
Translation: Consideration should also be given to individual cases, granting them as early as possible, consistent with the security of the country or occupying power, all the rights and privileges accorded to protected persons under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条本公约应于第二条所述之任何冲突或占领开始时适用。
Translation: Article 6 This Convention shall apply from the outset of any conflict or occupation mentioned in Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 在冲突各方之领土内，本公约之适用，于军事行动全面结束时应即停止。
Translation: The application of this Convention within the territories of the parties to the conflict shall cease immediately upon the general close of military operations.

Query_Text_cn: 第一至十二、二十七、二十九至三十四、四十七、四十九、五十一、五十二、五十三、五十九、六十一至七十七、一百四十三条。
被保护人之释放、遣返、或安置，若在上述各期限以后实现者，则在其实现之期间，彼等仍应继续享受本公约之利益。
Translation: The release, repatriation, or resettlement of protected persons, if effected after the aforementioned deadlines, shall continue to benefit from the provisions of this Convention during the period of such implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条于第十一、十四、十五、十七、三十六、一百零八、一百零九、一百三十二、一百三十三及一百四十九各条明文规定之协定之外，各缔约国对其认为需另作规定之一切事项，得订立特别协定。
Translation: Article 7: In addition to the agreements expressly provided for in Articles 11, 14, 15, 17, 36, 108, 109, 132, 133, and 149, the Contracting Parties may conclude special agreements on any matters they deem necessary to regulate separately.

Query_Text_cn: 是项特别协定不得对于本公约关于被保护人所规定之境遇有不利的影响，亦不得限制本公约所赋予彼等之权利。
Translation: This special agreement shall not adversely affect the status of protected persons as defined by the present Convention, nor restrict the rights it confers upon them.

Query_Text_cn: 除在上述或后订之协定中有相反之明文规定，或冲突之一方对彼等采取更优待之措施外，被保护人在本公约对其适用期间应继续享受是项协定之利益。
Translation: Unless expressly provided otherwise in the above-mentioned or subsequent agreements, or unless more favorable measures are taken by one of the parties to the conflict, protected persons shall continue to benefit from such agreements during the period in which the Convention is applicable to them.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条在任何情况下，被保护人不得放弃本公约或上条所述之特别协定——如其订有是项协定——所赋予彼等权利之一部或全部。
Translation: Article 8: In no circumstances shall protected persons be compelled to renounce, in whole or in part, the rights secured to them by the present Convention or by the special agreements referred to in the foregoing Article, where such agreements exist.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约之适用应与保护国合作并受其监察。保护国之责任为维护冲突各方之利益。
Translation: Article 9 The application of this Convention shall be carried out with the cooperation and under the supervision of the Protecting Powers. The duty of the Protecting Powers shall be to safeguard the interests of the Parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，保护国在其外交或领事人员之外，得自其本国国民或其他中立国国民中指派代表。
Translation: For this purpose, the Protecting Power may, in addition to its diplomatic or consular personnel, appoint delegates from among its own nationals or those of other neutral states.

Query_Text_cn: 上述代表应经其执行任务所在国之认可。
Translation: The said representatives shall be accredited by the country where they perform their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方对于保护国之代表之工作应尽最大可能予以便利。
Translation: The parties to the conflict shall facilitate to the greatest extent possible the work of the representatives of the Protecting Powers.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条本公约之规定并不妨碍红十字国际委员会或其他公正的人道主义组织，在有关冲突各方之同意之条件下，从事保护与救济平民之人道主义活动。
Translation: Article 10 The provisions of the present Convention shall not prevent the International Committee of the Red Cross or other impartial humanitarian organizations from undertaking, with the consent of the Parties to the conflict concerned, humanitarian activities for the protection and relief of civilians.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条各缔约国得随时同意将根据本公约应由保护国负担之任务，委托于具有公允与效能之一切保证之组织。
Translation: Article 11 The High Contracting Parties may at any time agree to entrust the duties incumbent on the Protecting Power under the present Convention to an organization which offers all guarantees of impartiality and efficacy.

Query_Text_cn: 当受本公约保护之人，不拘为何原因，不能享受或已停止享受保护国或本条第一款所规定之组织的活动之利益时，则拘留国应请一中立国或此种组织担任依照本公约应由冲突各方指定之保护国所执行之任务。
Translation: When persons protected by the present Convention do not benefit or cease to benefit, no matter for what reason, by the activities of a Protecting Power or of an organization provided for in the first paragraph above, the Detaining Power shall request a neutral State or such an organization to undertake the functions performed under the present Convention by a Protecting Power designated by the Parties to a conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 任何中立国或任何组织经有关国家邀请或自愿提供服务而执行任务时，在行为上须对本公约所保护之人员所依附之冲突一方具有责任感，并须充分保证能执行其所负之任务，且能公允执行之。
Translation: Any neutral State or any organization invited by the Parties concerned or offering itself for these purposes shall be required to act with a sense of responsibility towards the Party to the conflict on which persons protected by the present Convention depend and shall give sufficient assurances of its capacity to undertake the required functions and to discharge them impartially.

Query_Text_cn: 凡本公约中提及保护国，亦适用于本条所指之代替组织。
Translation: Wherever a Protecting Power is mentioned in this Convention, it also applies to the substitute organization referred to in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 凡中立国人民处于占领地或交战国领土内而其本国并无通常外交代表驻在该国时，本条各项规定应对彼等适用。
Translation: The provisions of this Article shall apply to nationals of neutral States who are in occupied territory or in the territory of a belligerent State, provided that their State has no normal diplomatic representation in the State in whose hands they are.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条保护国认为于被保护人之利益适宜时，尤其遇冲突各方对于本公约之适用与解释意见有分歧时，应从事斡旋以期解决分歧。
Translation: Article 12 The Protecting Power shall, whenever it deems it advisable in the interests of protected persons, particularly in cases of disagreement between the Parties to the conflict as to the application or interpretation of the provisions of the present Convention, lend its good offices with a view to settling the disagreement.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，各保护国得应一方之请求，或主动向冲突各方建议，可能在适当选择之中立领土召开代表会议，被保护人之负责当局代表尤须参加。
Translation: To this end, the Protecting Powers may, if they deem it necessary, for instance at the request of one of the Parties, propose to the Parties to the conflict a meeting of their representatives, and in particular of the authorities responsible for protected persons, possibly on neutral territory suitably chosen.

Query_Text_cn: 各保护国得于必要时，提请冲突各方同意，特邀一中立国人员或红十字国际委员会委派之人员参加此项会议。
Translation: The Protecting Powers may, if necessary, invite the parties to the conflict to agree to the participation of a neutral person or a delegate of the International Committee of the Red Cross in such meetings.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条本公约第二部之规定，涉及冲突各国之全部人民，尤不得基于种族、国籍、宗教或政治意见而有所歧视，各规定之目的在于减轻战争所致之痛苦。
Translation: Article 13 The provisions of Part II of the present Convention cover the whole of the populations of the countries in conflict, without any adverse distinction based, in particular, on race, nationality, religion or political opinion, and are intended to alleviate the sufferings caused by war.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条各缔约国在平时，冲突各方在战事开始后，得在其领土内，并于必要时在占领地内，设立医院及安全地带与处所，加以适当的组织，使能保护伤者、病者、老者、十五岁以下儿童、孕妇、及七岁以下儿童之母亲，俾免受战争影响。
Translation: Article 14 In time of peace, the High Contracting Parties and, after the outbreak of hostilities, the Parties to the conflict, may establish in their own territory and, if the need arises, in occupied areas, hospital and safety zones and localities so organized as to protect from the effects of war the wounded and sick, the aged, children under fifteen, expectant mothers, and mothers of children under seven.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事开始时及其进行中，有关各方得缔结协定互相承认所设立之地带与处所。
Translation: At the outset and during the course of hostilities, the parties concerned may conclude agreements to mutually recognize the zones and localities established.

Query_Text_cn: 为便于医院与安全地带及处所之设立及承认，应请保护国及红十字国际委员会从事斡旋。
Translation: To facilitate the establishment and recognition of hospitals and safe zones and localities, the Protecting Powers and the International Committee of the Red Cross shall be invited to undertake mediation.

Query_Text_cn: （）不参加战事及虽居住在该地带内而不从事军事性工作之平民。
Translation: () civilians who do not participate in hostilities and, although residing in that zone, do not engage in military work.

Query_Text_cn: 如有关各国对于拟议之中立化地带之地理位置、管理、食物供给及监督均予同意，应由冲突各方之代表签定一书面协定，该协定应规定该地带之中立化之开始及期限。
Translation: If the countries concerned agree on the geographical location, administration, food supply, and supervision of the proposed neutralized zone, a written agreement shall be concluded by representatives of the parties to the conflict. This agreement shall specify the commencement and duration of the neutralization of the zone.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条伤者、病者、弱者以及孕妇应为特别保护与尊重之对象。
Translation: Article 16 The wounded, sick, infirm and expectant mothers shall be the object of particular protection and respect.

Query_Text_cn: 在军事的考虑许可时，冲突各方对于寻觅死者、伤者，协助遇船难者及其他冒严重危险之人，及保护彼等免遭抢动及虐待所采取之各项步骤应予以便利。
Translation: When military considerations permit, all parties to the conflict shall facilitate the steps taken to search for the dead and wounded, assist the shipwrecked and others exposed to grave danger, and protect them from pillage and ill-treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条冲突各方应尽力缔结局部协定以便将被包围地区内之伤者、病者、弱者、老者、幼童及产妇撤出，及使送往该地区之一切宗教之牧师、医务人员、医疗设备得以通过。
Translation:
Article 17  
The Parties to the conflict shall endeavor to conclude local agreements for the removal from besieged or encircled areas of wounded, sick, infirm, and aged persons, children and maternity cases, and for the passage of ministers of all religions, medical personnel, and medical equipment on their way to such areas.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条凡为照顾伤者、病者、弱者及产妇而组织之民用医院，在任何环境下，不得为攻击之目标，而应随时受冲突各方之尊重与保护。
Translation: Article 18 Civilian hospitals organized to provide care for the wounded, sick, infirm, and maternity cases may in no circumstances be the object of attack but shall at all times be respected and protected by the Parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方之国家，对所有民用医院应发给证书，证明各该医院系民用医院且其所占用之建筑物并未作依第十九条应剥夺其保护之任何用途。
Translation: The Parties to the conflict shall provide all civilian hospitals with certificates stating that they are civilian hospitals and that the buildings they occupy are not used for any purpose which would deprive them of protection in accordance with Article 19.

Query_Text_cn: 各民用医院均应标以1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约第三十八条所规定之标志，惟须经各该国认可。
Translation: All civilian hospitals shall be marked by means of the emblem provided for in Article 38 of the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field, subject to the approval of the respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 在军事的考虑许可之限度内，冲突各方应采取必要步骤，使标明民用医院之特殊标志能为敌方陆、空及海军清晰望见，以避免任何敌对行动之可能。
Translation: Within the limits of military considerations, parties to the conflict shall take the necessary steps to ensure that the distinctive emblems designating civilian hospitals are clearly visible to land, air, and naval forces of the enemy, in order to avoid the possibility of any hostile action.

Query_Text_cn: 鉴于医院临近军事目标不免遭受危险，故建议上述医院之位置应尽量远离该项目标。
Translation: Given that hospitals located near military targets are inevitably exposed to danger, it is recommended that the aforementioned medical facilities be situated as far away as possible from such objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条民用医院应得之保护不得停止，除非此项医院越出其人道主义任务之外，用以从事有害于敌方之行为。
Translation: Article 19: The protection to which civilian hospitals are entitled shall not cease unless they are used to commit acts harmful to the enemy, outside their humanitarian duties.

Query_Text_cn: 惟如经给予相当警告，并按个别情形规定合理时限而警告仍被忽视时，始得停止保护。
Translation: Protection shall be withdrawn only if adequate warning has been given and, after a reasonable period specified in each case, such warning remains unheeded.

Query_Text_cn: 如有武装部队伤病人员在前项医院疗养，或由该项战斗员卸下之小型武器及弹药尚未缴交主管机关之事实，不得视为有害敌方之行动。
Translation: The presence of wounded or sick members of armed forces in such hospitals, or the fact that small arms and ammunition taken from such combatants have not yet been handed over to the competent authority, shall not be considered as harmful to the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条经常专门从事民用医院工作及管理之人，包括从事搜寻、移送、运输与照顾伤病平民、弱者及产妇之人员，均应受尊重与保护。
Translation: Article 20: Persons regularly and exclusively engaged in the work and administration of civilian hospitals, including those engaged in the search for, removal, transportation, and care of wounded and sick civilians, the infirm, and maternity cases, shall be respected and protected.

Query_Text_cn: 上述人员在占领地及军事行动地带内执行任务时，应有证明其地位之身份证，上贴本人像片，并轧有负责当局之钢印，并应有在左臂佩带加盖印章之防水臂章，以资识别。
Translation: When carrying out their duties in occupied territories or zones of military operations, the aforementioned personnel shall be provided with identity cards certifying their status, bearing their photograph and embossed with the stamp of the responsible authority. They shall also wear a waterproof armband bearing an official stamp on the left arm for identification purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 此项臂章应由国家颁发，并须有1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约第三十八条所规定之标志。
Translation: This armband shall be issued by the state and must bear the distinctive emblem prescribed in Article 38 of the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field.

Query_Text_cn: 其他从事民用医院工作及管理之人员，若担任此类任务时，应受尊重与保护，并按照本条所规定之条件，佩带臂章。
Translation: Other personnel engaged in the operation and management of civilian hospitals, when assigned such duties, shall be respected and protected and shall wear armlets bearing the distinctive emblem under the conditions prescribed in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等之身份证上应注明其担任之任务。
Translation: Their identity documents shall specify the tasks they are assigned to perform.

Query_Text_cn: 各医院之管理当局应随时备有上述各项工作人员之最近名单，以供本国或占领国主管当局之用。
Translation: The management authorities of each hospital shall at all times maintain an up-to-date list of the aforementioned personnel for use by the competent authorities of their own country or the occupying power.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条凡运送伤病平民、弱者、产妇之陆地运输车队，陆地医院列车或海上之特备船只，均应与第十八条所规定之医院受同样之尊重与保护，此项车船，经各该国同意后，应标以1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约第三十八条所规定之特殊标志。
Translation: Article 21: Land convoys transporting wounded and sick civilians, the infirm, or maternity cases, land hospital trains, or specially equipped vessels at sea shall be accorded the same respect and protection as the hospitals specified in Article 18. Such vehicles and vessels, with the consent of the respective countries, shall be marked with the distinctive emblem prescribed in Article 38 of the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条凡专为移送伤病平民、弱者、产妇或运输医务人员、医疗设备之飞机，在有关冲突各方所特别约定之高度、时间、航线飞行时，应不受攻击而予以尊重。
Translation: Article 22: Aircraft exclusively employed for the removal of wounded and sick civilians, the infirm, maternity cases, or for the transport of medical personnel and equipment shall not be attacked but shall be respected when flying at heights, times and on routes specifically agreed upon between the Parties to the conflict concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 此项飞机得标以1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约第三十八条所规定之特殊标志。
Translation: This aircraft is marked with the distinctive emblem stipulated in Article 38 of the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field.

Query_Text_cn: 除非另有协定，飞越敌方领土或敌人占领地均所禁止。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, overflight of enemy territory or occupied areas is prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 此项飞机应服从降落命令。
Translation: This aircraft shall comply with landing instructions.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条各缔约国对于纯为另一缔约国平民使用之医疗与医院供应品，或宗教礼拜所需物品之一切装运物资，均应许其自由通过，即使该另一缔约国为其敌国。
Translation: Article 23: Each Contracting Party shall permit the free passage of all consignments of medical and hospital supplies, as well as objects necessary for religious worship, intended solely for civilians of another Contracting Party, even if the latter is its adversary.

Query_Text_cn: 对于供十五岁以下儿童、孕妇与产妇使用之主要食物、衣服及滋补剂之装运，亦应同样许其自由通过。
Translation: The same freedom of passage shall also apply to shipments of essential foodstuffs, clothing, and tonics intended for children under fifteen years of age, pregnant women, and nursing mothers.

Query_Text_cn: （）该项装运物资可自其目的地改运他处：（）管制可能无效，或（）由于上述各项物资代替当由敌方供给或生产之物品，或使生产此类物品所需之材料，工作或设备得以腾出，而可能予敌方军事努力或经济以确定之利益。
Translation: () The said shipment of supplies may be diverted from its destination to another location: () if the controls may prove ineffective, or () if such supplies, by substituting for items normally supplied or produced by the enemy, or by freeing up materials, labor, or equipment required for the production of such items, are likely to confer a definite benefit upon the enemy's military effort or economy.

Query_Text_cn: 凡允许本条第一款所述装运物资通过之国家，得要求在该项物资分发于受惠人时，应以由保护国就地监督为允许之条件。
Translation: Any country allowing the passage of the consignments referred to in the first paragraph of this Article may make such permission conditional on the distribution to the beneficiaries being made under the local supervision of the Protecting Power.

Query_Text_cn: 上述装运物资应尽速转送，而允许此等物资自由通过之国家应有权规定准许该项通过之技术方面的办法。
Translation: The aforementioned shipment of supplies shall be forwarded as expeditiously as possible, and the countries permitting their free passage shall have the right to prescribe the technical arrangements for such passage.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条冲突各方应采取必要措施，俾十五岁以下儿童因受战争影响成为孤儿或与家庭分离者，不致无人照管，并使彼等之扶养，宗教与教育之进行，在一切情形下均获便利。
Translation: Article 24 The parties to the conflict shall take the necessary measures to ensure that children under fifteen who are orphaned or separated from their families as a result of the war are not left unattended, and that their maintenance, religious and educational needs are facilitated in all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等之教育，应尽可能委托于具有相似的文化传统之人。
Translation: Their education should, as far as possible, be entrusted to those who share similar cultural traditions.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方应便利冲突期间此种儿童收容于中立国，此事应经保护国（如其有保护国）之同意，并有遵守第一款所述原则之适当保证。
Translation: The parties to the conflict shall facilitate the reception of such children in a neutral country for the duration of the conflict, with the consent of the Protecting Power, if there is one, and under due safeguards for the observance of the principles stated in the first paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方并应尽力设法使十二岁以下儿童均佩带身份牌，或用其他方式，以资识别。
Translation: All parties to the conflict shall endeavor to ensure that children under the age of twelve are provided with identification tags or other means of identification.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条冲突各方之领土内或其占领地内所有人们，应能将纯属个人性质的消息通知其在任何地方之家人，并接获其家人之此类消息。
Translation: Article 25 All persons in the territory of a Party to the conflict, or in a territory occupied by it, shall be enabled to give and to receive news of a strictly personal nature to or from members of their families, wherever they may be.

Query_Text_cn: 此项通讯应迅速传递，不得有不当之迟延。
Translation: This communication shall be transmitted promptly without undue delay.

Query_Text_cn: 如由于环境影响，难于或不可能由普通邮政互递家庭信件时，有关冲突各方应向中立媒介接洽，如第一百四十条所规定之中央事务所，并与之商定如何在可能最好的情况下保证其义务之履行，尤应取得各国红十字（红新月、红狮与日）会之合作。
Translation: In cases where environmental conditions make it difficult or impossible for ordinary postal services to exchange family correspondence, the Parties to the conflict shall approach a neutral intermediary, such as the Central Agency provided for in Article 140, and agree on how to ensure the fulfillment of their obligations under the most favorable conditions possible, particularly with the cooperation of the respective National Red Cross (Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun) Societies.

Query_Text_cn: 如冲突各方认为有限制家庭通讯之必要，该项限制只应限于能容任择二十五字之标准信纸之强制使用，及将寄发此项格式之信件每月限为一份。
Translation: Should the parties to the conflict deem it necessary to restrict family correspondence, such restriction shall be limited to the compulsory use of standard forms containing twenty-five freely chosen words and to the limitation of the number of such letters dispatched to one each month.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条冲突各方对于因战争致与家庭离散之人所为之调查，以期在可能时与其家庭重新联系或团聚者，应给予便利。
Translation: Article 26 The Parties to the conflict shall facilitate enquiries made by members of families dispersed owing to the war, with the object of renewing contact with one another and of meeting, if possible.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方尤应鼓励从事此项任务之组织之工作，但须此项组织能为其所接受并遵照其安全规则。
Translation: The parties to the conflict should particularly facilitate the work of organizations engaged in this task, provided that such organizations are acceptable to them and comply with their safety regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条被保护人之人身、荣誉、家庭权利、宗教信仰与仪式、风俗与习惯，在一切情形下均应予以尊重。
Translation: Article 27: The personal rights, honor, family rights, religious beliefs and practices, as well as the customs and traditions of protected persons shall be respected in all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 无论何时，被保护人均须受人道待遇，并应受保护，特别使其免受一切暴行，或暴行的威胁及侮辱与公众好奇心的烦扰。
Translation: At all times, protected persons shall be treated humanely and shall be protected, particularly against all acts of violence or threats thereof, as well as against insults and public curiosity.

Query_Text_cn: 妇女应受特别保护以免其荣誉受辱，尤须防止强奸、强迫为娼或任何形式的非礼之侵犯。
Translation: Women shall be accorded special protection against any attack on their honor, in particular against rape, enforced prostitution, or any form of indecent assault.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方对在其权力下之被保护人，在不妨有关其健康状况、年龄、性别之各项规定之条件下，应同样待遇之，尤不得基于种族、宗教或政治意见而有所歧视。
Translation: The Parties to the conflict shall treat all protected persons under their authority without any adverse distinction based, in particular, on race, religion, or political opinion, subject to the provisions concerning their state of health, age, and sex.

Query_Text_cn: 但冲突各方对被保护人得采取由于战争而有必要之管制及安全之措施。
Translation: However, the parties to the conflict may take such measures of control and security in regard to protected persons as may be necessary as a result of the war.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条对于被保护人不得利用其安置于某点或某地区以使该处免受军事攻击。
Translation: Article 28 The presence of a protected person may not be used to render certain points or areas immune from military operations.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条在冲突一方对于权力下之被保护人所受该国人员之待遇，该国均应负责，不论此项人员所负之个人责任如何。
Translation: Article 29 The Party to the conflict in whose hands protected persons may be shall be responsible for the treatment accorded to them by its agents, irrespective of any individual responsibility which may be incurred.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条被保护人应有向保护国、红十字国际委员会、彼等所在国之红十字（红新月、红狮与日）会，或能予以协助之任何组织提出申请之各种便利。
Translation: Article 30 Protected persons shall have every facility for making applications to the Protecting Powers, the International Committee of the Red Cross, the National Red Cross (Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun) Society of the country where they may be, or any other organization that might assist them.

Query_Text_cn: 上述各组织应由当局在根据军事或安全的考虑所定之范围内，予以上述目的所需之各种便利。
Translation: The aforementioned organizations shall be granted by the authorities such facilities as may be necessary for the fulfillment of their functions, within the limits imposed by military or security considerations.

Query_Text_cn: 于第一百四十三条所规定之保护国及红十字国际委员会代表之访问之外，各拘留国或占领国对于以给予被保护人精神协助或物资救济为目的之其他组织的代表之访问被保护人，应尽量予以便利。
Translation: In addition to the visits provided for in Article 143, the Detaining or Occupying Power shall facilitate, as much as possible, visits to protected persons by representatives of other organizations whose purpose is to give spiritual aid or material relief to such persons.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条对被保护人不得施以身体上或精神上之强迫，尤其不得借以从彼等或第三者取得情报。
Translation: Article 31: No physical or mental coercion shall be exercised against protected persons, in particular to obtain information from them or from third parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条各缔约国特别同意禁止各该国采取任何足以使其手中之被保护人遭受身体痛苦或消灭之措施。
Translation: Article 32 The High Contracting Parties specifically agree that each of them is prohibited from taking any measure of such a character as to cause the physical suffering or extermination of protected persons in their hands.

Query_Text_cn: 此项禁令不仅适用于谋杀、酷刑、体刑、残伤肢体及非为治疗被保护人所必需之医学或科学实验，并适用于文武人员施行之其他任何残酷措施。
Translation: This prohibition applies not only to murder, torture, corporal punishment, mutilation, and medical or scientific experiments not necessitated by the treatment of protected persons, but also to any other measures of cruelty committed by military or civilian personnel.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条被保护人无论男女不得因非本人所犯之行为而受惩罚。
Translation: Article 33 No protected person, whether male or female, shall be punished for an offense he or she has not personally committed.

Query_Text_cn: 集体惩罚及一切恫吓恐怖手段，均所禁止。
Translation: Collective punishment and all measures of intimidation or terrorism are prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 禁止掠夺。
Translation: No plundering.

Query_Text_cn: 禁止对被保护人及其财产采取报复行为。
Translation: Reprisals against protected persons and their property are prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条禁止作为人质。
Translation: Article 34: Taking hostages is prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条一切被保护人，在冲突开始时，或冲突进行中，希望离境者，除非其离去有违所在国之国家利益，均应有权离境。
Translation: Article 35 All protected persons who may desire to leave the territory at the outset of, or during a conflict, shall be entitled to do so, unless their departure is contrary to the national interests of the State.

Query_Text_cn: 此等人之离境申请应按照正常规定之手续予以决定，此项决定并应尽速为之。
Translation: The departure applications of such individuals shall be decided in accordance with normal procedures, and such decisions shall be made as expeditiously as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 凡获准离境之人得自行准备必须之旅费并携带相当数量之个人物品。
Translation: All persons granted permission to leave shall provide their own necessary travel expenses and carry a reasonable quantity of personal belongings.

Query_Text_cn: 如上述任何人之离境请求被拒绝时，彼应有权请求拘留国所指定之主管法庭或行政审议机关对此项拒绝从速重新考虑。
Translation: If the request for departure of any such person is refused, he shall be entitled to request that such refusal be promptly reconsidered by the competent court or administrative board designated by the detaining power.

Query_Text_cn: 除非安全理由所不许或关系人反对，一经保护国代表之请求，应即告以不准离境之理由，并应尽速检送不准离境之人的全体名单。
Translation: Unless prohibited by security reasons or objected to by the persons concerned, the reasons for prohibiting departure shall be promptly provided upon request by the representatives of the Protecting Power, and a complete list of all persons denied departure shall be furnished as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条依上条获准之离境，应在关于安全、卫生、保健及食物方面之妥善条件下实行之。
Translation: Article 36: Departures authorized under the preceding article shall be carried out under proper conditions of safety, hygiene, sanitation, and food supply.

Query_Text_cn: 一切有关离境之费用，自拘留国领土内之出境地点起，应由出境人目的地之国家担负，若出境人被收容于中立国，则该项费用应由受益人之本国负担。
Translation: All expenses related to departure, starting from the point of exit within the territory of the detaining power, shall be borne by the country of destination of the departing individual. If the individual is accommodated in a neutral country, such costs shall be covered by the home country of the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: 此项移动之施行细则，必要时，得由有关国家以特别协定决定之。
Translation: The detailed rules for the implementation of such movement may, where necessary, be determined by the states concerned through special agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 前项规定不得影响冲突各方间所订关于交换及遣返在敌方手中之人民之特别协定。
Translation: The preceding provisions shall not affect the validity of special agreements concluded between the Parties to the conflict concerning the exchange and repatriation of persons in enemy hands.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条凡被保护人在候审期间，或因受有剥夺自由之判决而被禁闭者，在其禁闭期间应受人道待遇。
Translation: Article 37 Any protected person who is under detention pending trial or is serving a sentence involving deprivation of liberty shall be treated with humanity during such confinement.

Query_Text_cn: 一经释放，彼等即得依照以上各条请求离境。
Translation: Upon release, they shall be permitted to depart the country in accordance with the aforementioned provisions.

Query_Text_cn: （五）十五岁以下儿童、孕妇、及七岁以下儿童之母亲，应与有关国家之人民受同等之优惠待遇。
Translation: (5) Children under the age of 15,pregnant women,and mothers of children under the age of seven shall be accorded the same preferential treatment as the nationals of the country concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条凡被保护人因战事影响而失去其收入之工作者，应予以寻觅有报酬之工作之机会。
Translation: Article 39 Any protected person who has lost his gainful employment as a result of the war shall be granted the opportunity to find paid work.

Query_Text_cn: 该项机会应与其所在国家之人民所享受之机会相等，但须受安全考虑及第四十条规定之限制。
Translation: Such opportunity shall be equal to that accorded to the nationals of the country concerned, subject to security considerations and the provisions of Article 40.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突一方对被保护人施行管制办法因而使其不能自行维持生活，尤以该人因安全原因不能寻觅在合理条件下之有报酬之工作时，该冲突国应保证维持其本人与受其赡养之生活。
Translation: When a Party to the conflict subjects protected persons to measures of control that result in their inability to support themselves, particularly when such persons are prevented, for reasons of security, from finding remunerated employment under reasonable conditions, the said Party shall ensure their support and that of their dependents.

Query_Text_cn: 各被保护人在任何情况下均得接受其本国、保护国，或第三十条所述之救济团体之津贴。
Translation: Protected persons shall in all circumstances be entitled to receive allowances from their own country, the Protecting Power, or the relief societies referred to in Article 30.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条被保护人仅得在与其所在之冲突国之人民同样限度内被强迫工作。
Translation: Article 40 Protected persons may be compelled to work only to the same extent as nationals of the Party to the conflict in whose territory they are.

Query_Text_cn: 如被保护人系属敌国国籍，则只能强迫其担任通常为保证人类食、住、衣、行及健康所必需之工作而与军事行动无直接关系者。
Translation: If the protected person is of enemy nationality, they may only be compelled to undertake work essential for ensuring the necessities of human life—such as food, shelter, clothing, transport, and health—provided such work has no direct connection with military operations.

Query_Text_cn: 在前两款所述之情形下，被强迫工作之被保护人应与本国工人享受同样工作条件及同样保障之利益，尤其关于工资、工作时间、衣服与设备、事先训练及工作上意外伤害与疾病之赔偿。
Translation: In the situations referred to in the preceding two paragraphs, protected persons compelled to work shall enjoy the same working conditions and the same safeguards as national workers, particularly in respect of wages, hours of labour, clothing and equipment, prior training, and compensation for occupational accidents and diseases.

Query_Text_cn: 上述各项规定如被违反，应允许被保护人按照第三十条行使其申诉之权利。
Translation: In the event of any violation of the above provisions, the protected person shall be entitled to exercise their right to appeal in accordance with Article 30.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十一条如被保护人所在之国家认为本公约所述之管制措施不足时，不得采行较第四十二及第四十三两条所定之指定居所或拘禁更为严厉之管制措施。
Translation: Article 41 If the country where the protected person is located deems the control measures specified in this Convention to be insufficient, it shall not adopt any control measures more severe than those of assigned residence or internment as provided for in Articles 42 and 43.

Query_Text_cn: 在适用第三十九条第二款之规定，于按照安置于他处指定居所之决定而须离开其原居所之人之场合时，拘留国应尽可能密切遵循本公约第三部第四编所定之福利标准。
Translation: In applying the provisions of the second paragraph of Article 39 to persons required to leave their habitual residence by virtue of a decision placing them in assigned residence elsewhere, the Detaining Power shall, as closely as possible, adhere to the standards of welfare set forth in Part III, Section IV of the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条对被保护人之拘禁或安置于指定居所，仅于拘留国之安全有绝对需要时方可施行。
Translation: Article 42: The internment or placing in assigned residence of protected persons may be ordered only if the security of the Detaining Power makes it absolutely necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 如有人通过保护国之代表，自动请求拘禁，而其处境使其采取此步骤为必要者，则其所在之国家应即予以拘禁。
Translation: If any person, through the representative of the Protecting Power, voluntarily requests internment, and if his situation renders such a step necessary, the country in which he is shall immediately intern him.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条任何被保护人被拘禁或被安置于指定居所者，有权请拘留国为该项目的所指定之主管法庭或行政审议机关对于该项举措尽速重新考虑。
Translation: Article 43 Any protected person who has been interned or placed in assigned residence shall be entitled to have such action reconsidered as soon as possible by an appropriate court or administrative board designated for that purpose by the Detaining Power.

Query_Text_cn: 如该项拘禁或安置于指定居所仍予维持时，该法庭或行政审议机关应定期，至少一年两次，对于案情予以审查，以期于环境许可时对于最初决定作有利之修正。
Translation: If such detention or placement in a designated residence is to be maintained, the court or administrative review body shall periodically, at least twice a year, review the case with a view to amending the initial decision favorably when circumstances permit.

Query_Text_cn: 除非有关之被保护人反对，拘留国应尽速将已被拘禁或已被指定居所之被保护人，及从拘禁或指定居所中已予释放之被保护人之姓名通知保护国。
Translation: Unless the protected persons concerned object, the Detaining Power shall, as soon as possible, communicate to the Protecting Power the names of any protected persons who have been interned or assigned to a residence, as well as the names of those released from internment or assigned residence.

Query_Text_cn: 本条第一款提及之法庭或行政审议机关之决定，亦应依同样条件之限制尽速通知保护国。
Translation: The decision of the court or administrative tribunal referred to in the first paragraph of this Article shall likewise be communicated to the Protecting Power under the same conditions and as promptly as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条适用本公约内提及之管制措施时，拘留国不得将事实上不受任何政府保护之难民仅依其法律上之敌国国籍而以敌侨待遇之。
Translation: Article 44: In applying the measures of control mentioned in the present Convention, the Detaining Power shall not treat as enemy aliens exclusively on the basis of their nationality de jure of an enemy State, refugees who do not, in fact, enjoy the protection of any government.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条被保护人不得移送于非本公约缔约国之国家。
Translation: Article 45 The protected person shall not be transferred to a State which is not a party to the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 本规定不得构成对于被保护人在战事结束后被遣返或其回到原居住国之障碍。
Translation: These provisions shall not constitute an obstacle to the repatriation of protected persons after the close of hostilities or to their return to their country of origin.

Query_Text_cn: 拘留国只能将被保护人移送至本公约之缔约国，并须于拘留国对于接受国家实施本公约之意愿与能力认为满意后行之。
Translation: The Detaining Power may only transfer protected persons to a State Party to the present Convention, and only after ensuring itself of the willingness and ability of the receiving State to apply the provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如被保护人在此种情况下被移送时，其在该接受国看管期间，实施本公约之责任即由该接受国担任之。
Translation: If the protected person is transferred under such circumstances, the responsibility for implementing this Convention shall be assumed by the receiving State during the period of his custody in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 但若该国在任何重要方面未能实行本公约之规定，则原移送国一经保护国通知，即应采取有效措施以纠正此种情况或要求将被保护人送还，此项要求必须照办。
Translation: However, if the country in question fails to carry out the provisions of the present Convention in any important respect, the Power on which the protected persons depend shall, upon being notified by the Protecting Power, take effective measures to correct the situation or shall request the return of the protected persons. Such a request must be complied with.

Query_Text_cn: 男女被保护人在任何情况下不得移送于因其政治意见或宗教有信仰恐惧迫害之理由之国家。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall a protected person be transferred to a country where he or she may have reason to fear persecution for his or her political opinions or religious beliefs.

Query_Text_cn: 本条各项规定亦不构成对于根据战事开始前所订之引渡条约，将被控违犯普通刑法之被保护人予以引渡之障碍。
Translation: The provisions of this Article shall not constitute an obstacle to the extradition of protected persons accused of offences against ordinary criminal law, in pursuance of extradition treaties concluded before the outbreak of hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条凡对被保护人实行之限制措施，其尚未撤销者，在战事结束后应尽速取消之。
Translation: Article 46 Any restrictive measures imposed on protected persons which have not been revoked shall be cancelled as soon as possible after the close of hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 影响彼等财产之限制措施，应按照拘留国之法律，于战事结束后尽速取消之。
Translation: Restrictive measures affecting their property shall be repealed as soon as possible after the close of hostilities, in accordance with the law of the Detaining Power.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条本公约所赋予在占领地内之被保护人之各项利益，均不得因占领领土之结果引起该地制度或政府之变更，或因被占领地当局与占领国所订立之协定，或因占领国兼并占领地之全部或一部，而在任何情况下或依任何方式加以剥夺。
Translation: Article 47: The benefits conferred by the present Convention on protected persons in occupied territory shall not be withdrawn under any circumstances or in any manner whatsoever on account of changes introduced into the institutions or government of the occupied territory, nor by any agreement concluded between the authorities of the occupied territory and the Occupying Power, nor by the annexation of the whole or part of the occupied territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条被保护人之非领土被占领的国家之人民者，得依第三十五条规定之限制，使用其离境权利，关于离境事项之决定，应按照占领国依该条所订之手续为之。
Translation: Article 48: Protected persons who are not nationals of the Power whose territory is occupied may avail themselves of the right to leave the territory under the conditions laid down in Article 35, and decisions in respect of their departure shall be taken in accordance with the procedure which that Power shall establish in accordance with the said Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条凡自占领地将被保护人个别或集体强制移送及驱逐往占领国之领土或任何其他被占领或未被占领之国家之领土，不论其动机如何，均所禁止。
