Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条1.经执行委员会预先审核并提出建议后,大会在秘书长提出的预算基础上确定本组织经费最高额。
Translation:
Article 23  
1. The General Assembly shall, upon prior examination and recommendation by the Executive Committee, determine the maximum amount of the Organization's expenditure based on the budget submitted by the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 2.大会须授权执行委员会在大会确定的范围内批准本组织年度经费。
Translation: 2. The General Assembly shall authorize the Executive Committee to approve the Organization's annual budget within the limits set by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条本组织之经费由大会确定之比例分担之。
Translation: Article 24 The expenses of the Organization shall be apportioned among the Member States in the proportion determined by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条本组织按联合国宪章第五十七条规定，与联合国建立关系。
Translation: Article 25 The Organization shall establish relations with the United Nations in accordance with Article 57 of the United Nations Charter.

Query_Text_cn: 凡属此种关系之协议须经三分之二会员国批准。
Translation: Any agreement of this nature shall require approval by two-thirds of the member states.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条1.本组织须与适宜的政府间组织建立有效的关系并紧密合作。
Translation:
Article 26  
1. The Organization shall establish effective relations and maintain close cooperation with appropriate intergovernmental organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 与这类组织建立正式协议须由执行委员会决定并由大会或通信方式获得三分之二会员国的批准。
Translation: The establishment of formal agreements with such organizations shall be decided by the Executive Committee and approved by a two-thirds majority of member states either at the General Assembly or through correspondence.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本组织可与非政府的国际组织，或经有关政府允许，与该国政府的或非政府的组织作出适当安排就本组织宗旨范围内事项进行磋商和合作。
Translation: 2. The Organization may make appropriate arrangements for consultation and cooperation with non-governmental international organizations or, subject to the consent of the government concerned, with national organizations, governmental or non-governmental, on matters within its competence.

Query_Text_cn: 3.经三分之二会员国批准，通过各自组织主管当局签订国际协定或作出双方可以接受的安排，本组织可以接受符合本组织宗旨但属于其它国际组织或机构的宗旨和活动，以及由此转移过来的职能、资财和义务。
Translation: 3. The Organization may, upon approval by two-thirds of its Member States and through the conclusion of international agreements by their respective competent authorities or by mutually acceptable arrangements, assume functions, resources, and obligations that align with its objectives but fall within the purposes and activities of other international organizations or agencies, along with any such transferred responsibilities.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条1.本组织在各会员领土上须享有为实现其宗旨和履行其职能所需的法律权力。
Translation:
Article 27  
1. The Organization shall enjoy in the territory of each of its Members such legal capacity as may be necessary for the fulfillment of its purposes and the exercise of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.（1）在本公约适用的各会员领土上，本组织须享有为实现其宗旨和履行其职能所需的特权和豁免权。
Translation: 2.(1) On the territories of all Members to which this Convention applies,the Organization shall enjoy such privileges and immunities as are necessary for the fulfillment of its purposes and the exercise of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: （2）本组织会员代表、官员、职员和执行委员会委员须享有同等特权和豁免权，以便独立地履行其与本组织有关的职能。
Translation: (2) Representatives of Members, officials, staff, and members of the Executive Committee of the Organization shall enjoy equal privileges and immunities to enable them to perform their functions related to the Organization independently.

Query_Text_cn: 3.在已加入1947年12月21日联合国大会通过的“专门机构特权和豁免权公约”的会员国领土上，此种法律权力、特权和豁免权须是该公约所规定的那些法律权力、特权和豁免权。
Translation: 3. In the territories of Member States that have acceded to the Convention on the Privileges and Immunities of the Specialized Agencies adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on December 21, 1947, such legal capacity, privileges, and immunities shall be those provided for in the said Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条1.秘书长须于大会审议前至少六个月，将本公约修正案文本通知本组织会员。
Translation:
Article 28  
1. The Secretary-General shall communicate the text of any proposed amendment to this Convention to all Members of the Organization at least six months before its consideration by the General Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 2.凡产生新义务的修正案，按本公约第十一条规定，由大会三分之二会员表决批准，并在三分之二会员国表示接受后，方对这些会员国生效。
Translation: 2. Any amendment involving new obligations shall be approved by a two-thirds majority vote of the Assembly in accordance with Article 11 of this Convention and shall come into force for those Member States that have accepted it upon acceptance by two-thirds of the Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，其余会员国表示接受此修正案时，则对它生效。
Translation: Thereafter, the amendment shall enter into force for any other Member State when it accepts it.

Query_Text_cn: 对于不负责自己国际关系的会员，由负责其国际关系的会员代为表示接受后，方能对它生效。
Translation: For a Member not responsible for its own international relations, acceptance on its behalf by the Member responsible for its international relations is required before it can take effect.

Query_Text_cn: 3.其它修正案，须经三分之二会员批准后，方能生效。
Translation: 3. Other amendments shall take effect only after being approved by two-thirds of the members.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条有关本公约解释和援用的问题和争端，不能通过协商或大会所解决者，除当事者同意采取其它方式解决外，须提交国际法院院长委派的独立仲裁员解决。
Translation: Article 29 Any dispute concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention that cannot be settled through negotiation or by the Conference shall, unless the parties to the dispute agree on another method of settlement, be referred for resolution to an independent arbitrator appointed by the President of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条1.任何会员得于书面通知本组织秘书长十二个月后退出本组织。
Translation:
Article 30  
1. Any member may withdraw from the Organization by giving twelve months' written notice to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须将此通知立即通告全体会员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall immediately communicate this notification to all Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本组织任何不负责自己国际关系的会员得由负责其国际关系之会员或其它当局向本组织秘书长提出书面通知十二个月后退出本组织。
Translation: 2. Any Member not responsible for the conduct of its international relations may withdraw from the Organization upon twelve months' written notice to the Secretary-General of the Organization by the Member or other authority responsible for its international relations.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须立即将退出通知书通告全体会员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall immediately notify all Member States of the notice of withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条任何会员如未能对本组织履行其财务义务或本公约规定的其它义务，大会可作出决议中止该会员行使和享受作为本组织会员的权利和特权，直至其履行财务义务和其它义务为止。
Translation: Article 31 If any Member fails to meet its financial obligations to the Organization or any other obligations under this Convention, the Assembly may, by resolution, suspend the exercise of the rights and privileges of membership until such financial and other obligations are fulfilled.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条本公约须由签字国批准,批准书交存美利坚合众国政府。
Translation: Article 32 This Convention shall be ratified by the signatory states, and the instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Government of the United States of America.

Query_Text_cn: （f）原则：公会的活动如与关系方面有关，公会应向他们提供有关其活动的资料，并应公布有关其活动的有意义的情报。
Translation: (f) Principle: Where a guild's activities pertain to relations, it shall provide relevant parties with information about its activities and disclose meaningful intelligence concerning its operations.

Query_Text_cn: 班轮公会或公会两个或两个以上使用船舶的运输商的团体，这些运输商在特定的地理范围内，在某一条或数条航线上提供运送货物的国际班轮服务，并在一项不论何种性质的协定或安排的范围内，按照划一的或共同的运费率及任何其他有关提供班轮服务的协议条件而经营业务。
Translation: A liner conference or conference is a group of two or more vessel-operating carriers that provide international liner services for the carriage of cargo on a particular route or routes within specified geographical limits and operate under an agreement or arrangement, whatever its nature, with uniform or common freight rates and any other agreed conditions regarding the provision of liner services.

Query_Text_cn: 国家航运公司某一国家的国家航运公司，是指其总管理处及其实际控制设在该国，并为该国有关当局或依照该国法律所如此承认的使用船舶的运输商。
Translation: The national shipping company of a country refers to a shipping operator that uses vessels, with its head office and actual control located in that country, and is recognized as such by the relevant authorities of that country or in accordance with its laws.

Query_Text_cn: 牵涉到两个或两个以上国家的合营事业所拥有和经营的航运公司，其权益的大部分为这些国家的公（或）私利益所拥有，而其总管理处及其实际控制设在这些国家中之一国，则可被这些国家的有关当局承认为国家航运公司。
Translation: Shipping companies owned and operated by joint ventures involving two or more nations, the majority of whose interests are owned by public (and/or) private interests of these nations, and whose principal place of business as well as effective control are situated in one of these nations, may be recognized by the competent authorities of these nations as national shipping companies.

Query_Text_cn: 第三国航运公司在两国之间使用船舶经营货运而并非该两国国家航运公司的运输商。
Translation: A third-country shipping company is a carrier that operates cargo transportation between two nations using vessels, rather than being the national shipping company of either country.

Query_Text_cn: 托运人为了运送对他有利益的货物而同一个公会或航运公司订立或表示愿意订立合约性或其他协议的个人或实体。
Translation: A shipper is an individual or entity that enters into or expresses willingness to enter into a contractual or other agreement with a conference or shipping company for the transportation of goods beneficial to them.

Query_Text_cn: 托运人组织促进、代表和保护托运人的利益，并为其所代表的托运人的国家的有关当局——如这些当局要这样做的话——承认其具有此种身份的会社或相等团体。
Translation: Shippers' organizations promote, represent, and protect the interests of shippers, and are recognized as such by the relevant authorities of the countries they represent—should these authorities choose to do so—as associations or equivalent bodies with such status.

Query_Text_cn: 公会承运的货物公会会员航运公司按照公会协议运输的货物。
Translation: Cargo carried by conference lines refers to goods transported by member shipping companies in accordance with conference agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 有关当局一个政府或由一个政府或国家立法指定来执行本守则中规定属于此种当局的任何职务的机构。
Translation: The competent authority refers to a government or an agency designated by a government or national legislation to perform any functions assigned to such authority under this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 促进贸易性运费率为了促进运输有关国家的非常规出口物而订定的运费率。
Translation: Promotional freight rates are established to facilitate the transportation of non-traditional export commodities from relevant countries.

Query_Text_cn: 特别运费率除促进贸易性运费率外，可由有关当事各方商订的优惠运费率。
Translation: Special freight rates, in addition to trade-promotional rates, may include preferential rates negotiated by the relevant parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条会籍1.任何国家的航运公司，在符合第1条第2款所定标准的条件下，都有权成为承运其国家对外贸易货物的公会的正式会员。
Translation:
Article 1 Membership  
1. Any shipping company of any country shall have the right to be a full member of a conference that carries the foreign trade cargoes of its country, provided it meets the standards set forth in paragraph 2 of Article 1.

Query_Text_cn: 不是公会任何航线上的国家航运公司的航运公司，在符合第1条第2款和第3款所定标准并遵守涉及第三国航运公司的第2条关于货载份额的规定的条件下，有权成为该公会的正式会员。
Translation: A shipping company that is not a national shipping line on any route of the conference shall have the right to become a full member of the conference, provided it meets the standards set out in Article 1, paragraphs 2 and 3, and complies with the provisions of Article 2 concerning cargo-sharing arrangements as they apply to shipping lines of third countries.

Query_Text_cn: 2.申请参加公会的航运公司应提出证据，证明其有能力和愿望，按照公会协议的规定，在公会营运范围内，长期地经营定期的、适当的和有效率的航运服务，只要符合本项的标准，也可以使用租船；保证遵守公会协议的一切条款，并应于公会协议中有此规定时，提出财务担保，以便在以后退会、会籍中断或被开除会籍时，能够履行未清偿的债务。
Translation: 2. Shipping companies applying for conference membership shall provide evidence of their ability and willingness to operate a regular, adequate, and efficient scheduled shipping service within the scope of the conference's operations on a long-term basis in accordance with the conference agreement. Chartered vessels may be used provided they meet these criteria. Applicants must undertake to comply with all terms of the conference agreement and, where stipulated therein, furnish financial security to ensure fulfillment of any outstanding obligations upon subsequent withdrawal, suspension, or expulsion from the conference.

Query_Text_cn: （e）该航运公司目前是否在相同的航线上参加别的公会经营范围以内的货运。
Translation: (e) Is the shipping company currently participating in cargo transportation on the same route within the scope of other conferences' operations?

Query_Text_cn: 以上各点不得用来阻止执行第2条内关于参加货载承运的规定。
Translation: None of the above shall be used to prevent the implementation of the provisions in Article 2 regarding participation in cargo carrying.

Query_Text_cn: 4.关于入会或重新入会的申请，公会应迅速作出决定并迅速通知申请人，无论如何不得迟于从申请之日起算六个月。
Translation: 4. The association shall make a prompt decision on any application for membership or readmission and shall promptly inform the applicant thereof, in any event no later than six months from the date of application.

Query_Text_cn: 公会如拒绝一个航运公司入会或重新入会，应同时以书面说明其拒绝的理由。
Translation: If a union refuses to admit or readmit a shipping company, it shall provide a written explanation for the refusal.

Query_Text_cn: 5.公会审查入会申请时，应考虑公会承运其货载的国家的托运人和托运人组织所表示的意见，并于有关当局要求时考虑它们的意见。
Translation: 5. When reviewing membership applications, the conference shall take into account the views expressed by shippers and shippers' organizations in the countries whose cargoes are carried by the conference, as well as consider their opinions when requested by the relevant authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 6.申请重新入会的航运公司，除第1条第2款所定的入会标准外，并应提出证据，证明业已依照第4条第1款和第4款的规定履行其义务。
Translation: 6. Shipping companies applying for re-admission shall, in addition to meeting the membership criteria set forth in Article 1(2), provide evidence demonstrating compliance with the obligations stipulated in Article 4(1) and (4).

Query_Text_cn: 公会可以特别查询该航运公司以前脱离公会的原因。
Translation: The conference may specifically inquire into the reasons for the shipping company's previous withdrawal from the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条参加货载承运1.被接纳为会员的任何航运公司，应在公会所经营的航线范围内享有航次和装货的权利。
Translation:
Article 2 Participation in Cargo Carriage  
1. Any shipping company admitted as a member shall enjoy the rights to voyages and cargo loading within the scope of the routes operated by the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 2.公会实行公摊制度时，在公摊制度的范围内参加货载承运的所有会员公司都有权参加该航线的公摊。
Translation: 2. When the conference implements a pooling system, all member companies participating in cargo carriage within the scope of the pooling arrangement are entitled to join the pool on that route.

Query_Text_cn: 3.为决定会员公司有权取得的货载承运份额起见，每一国的国家航运公司，不论公司数目多少，应被视为该国的一个单一的航运公司集团。
Translation: 3. For the purpose of determining the share of cargo each member company is entitled to carry, the national shipping companies of each country, regardless of their number, shall be regarded as a single group of shipping companies of that country.

Query_Text_cn: （b）倘有第三国的航运公司参加该航线的货载承运，它们有权获得运价和数量中一个相当大的部分，例如百分之二十。
Translation: (b) If shipping companies from a third country participate in the cargo transportation of this route, they shall be entitled to a significant share, such as 20 percent, of the freight rates and volume.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如公会承运其货载的任何国家，没有国家航运公司参加承运其货载，则按照第2条第4款规定由国家航运公司承运的货载份额，应在参加货运的各个会员公司之间按照它们各自的份额比例加以分配。
Translation: 5. If no national shipping company of a country whose cargo is carried by the Conference participates in the carriage of such cargo, the cargo share to be carried by national shipping companies under Article 2, paragraph 4 shall be allocated among the member companies participating in the cargo carriage in proportion to their respective shares.

Query_Text_cn: 6.如一国的国家航运公司决定不承运它们的全部货载份额，则它们货载份额中它们不承运的部分，应在参加承运的各个会员公司之间按照它们各自份额的比例加以分配。
Translation: 6. If a country's national shipping company decides not to carry its full share of cargo, the portion of its cargo share that it does not carry shall be allocated among the participating member companies in proportion to their respective shares.

Query_Text_cn: 7.如有关国家的国家航运公司不参加公会营运范围内的这些国家之间的营运，公会承运的这些国家之间的货载份额，应在参加的第三国会员公司之间通过商业谈判加以分配。
Translation: 7. If the national shipping lines of the countries concerned do not participate in the trade between those countries within the scope of the conference's operations, the share of cargo carried by the conference between those countries shall be allocated among the participating third-country member lines through commercial negotiations.

Query_Text_cn: 8.一个地区内的国家航运公司，即公会经营的航线的一端的公会会员，可以按照第2条第4款至第7款规定互相商定把分配给它们的货载份额在它们之间重新分配。
Translation: 8. National shipping lines of the countries within a geographical area, being members of a conference serving that area at one end, may agree to redistribute among themselves the cargo shares allocated to them in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 4 to 7 of Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 9.除遵守第2条第4款至第8款关于各个航运公司之间或各个航运公司集团之间货载份额的规定外，公会应按照公摊协议或货载分配协议中规定的时限以及公会协议所定的标准，定期审查公摊协议和货载分配协议。
Translation: 9. In addition to complying with the provisions of Article 2, paragraphs 4 to 8, regarding cargo-sharing arrangements among individual shipping companies or groups of shipping companies, a conference shall conduct regular reviews of pooling agreements and cargo-sharing agreements within the time limits specified therein and in accordance with the criteria established by the conference agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 10.本条的适用，应在本守则生效后尽速开始，并应在无论如何不得超过二年的过渡期间内完成，要考虑到每一有关航线的具体情况。
Translation: 10. The application of this Article shall commence as soon as possible after the entry into force of this Code and shall be completed within a transitional period not exceeding two years in any case, taking into account the specific circumstances of each relevant route.

Query_Text_cn: 11.公会会员航运公司有权以租船来履行它们对公会的义务。
Translation: 11. Member shipping lines of the conference shall have the right to employ chartered vessels to fulfill their obligations to the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 12.在没有公摊制度，但订有靠港、航次和/或其他方式的货载分配协议时，应适用第2条第1款至第11款所订的分配份额和修改份额的标准。
Translation: 12. Where there is no pool system but a cargo-sharing agreement exists for berth, voyage or otherwise, the allocation and revision criteria as provided in paragraphs 1 to 11 of Article 2 shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 13.公会没有公摊、靠港、航次或他种参加货载承运的协议时，为公会会员的任何一个国家航运公司集团可以要求按照第2条第4款的规定，对公会承运的它们两国之间的货载采用公摊办法，或者，它们可以要求调整航次，使这些航运公司有机会享有大体上与第2条第4款规定相同的权利，参加公会经营的这两国之间的货运。
Translation: 13. In the absence of pooling, port-sharing, voyage, or any other participation agreements in cargo carriage by the conference, a group of shipping companies from any member country of the conference may request the application of a pooling arrangement for cargo carried by the conference between their two countries, as stipulated in Article 2(4). Alternatively, they may seek an adjustment of voyages to enable these shipping companies to enjoy rights substantially equivalent to those provided under Article 2(4), thereby participating in the freight operations between the two countries managed by the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 任何这种要求应由公会予以考虑，并作出决定。
Translation: Any such request shall be considered and decided upon by the guild.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在公会会员之间不能就成立这种公摊制度或航次调整达成协议，则航线两端国家的国家航运公司集团，在决定成立这种公摊制度或航次调整时，应有过半数的投票权。
Translation: If no agreement can be reached among conference members on the establishment of such a pooling arrangement or sailing adjustment, the national shipping companies of the countries at both ends of the trade shall have a majority vote in deciding to establish such a pooling arrangement or sailing adjustment.

Query_Text_cn: 这个问题应在接到要求后六个月内予以决定。
Translation: This issue shall be decided within six months upon receipt of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 14.如公会营运的航线任何一端国家的国家航运公司之间对应否采用公摊办法的问题意见分歧时，它们可以要求在公会营运的范围内调整航次，使这些航运公司有机会享有大体上与第2条第4款规定相同的权利，参加公会经营的这两国之间的货运。
Translation: 14. In the event of a disagreement between national shipping lines of the countries at either end of a conference-operated route regarding the application of the pooling arrangement, they may request an adjustment of sailings within the scope of the conference's operations. This adjustment shall provide these shipping lines with the opportunity to enjoy rights substantially equivalent to those stipulated in Article 2, paragraph 4, thereby enabling their participation in the cargo transportation between the two countries under the conference's operation.

Query_Text_cn: 如公会承运其货载的国家之中，一国没有国家航运公司，另一国的国家航运公司可以提出同样的要求。
Translation: If one of the countries through which the cargo is carried does not have a national shipping company, the national shipping company of another country may make the same request.

Query_Text_cn: 公会应尽最大努力以满足此一要求。
Translation: The union shall make every effort to meet this requirement.

Query_Text_cn: 如此一要求未获满足，航线两端国家的有关当局都可以过问，并表示意见，以供有关当事各方的考虑。
Translation: If such a requirement is not met, the relevant authorities of the countries at both ends of the route may intervene and express their views for consideration by the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 如不能达成协议，争议应依照本守则所定程序解决。
Translation: If no agreement can be reached, the dispute shall be resolved in accordance with the procedures set forth in this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 15.为公会会员的其他航运公司，也可以要求采用公摊或航次协议，公会应依照本守则的有关规定加以考虑。
Translation: 15. Other shipping lines that are members of the conference may also request the adoption of pooling or sailing agreements, which the conference shall consider in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 16.公会应在任何公会公摊协议中规定适当措施，处理某项货载由于非因托运人供货延误的任何原因，致遭某会员公司拒运的事件。
Translation: 16. The conference shall stipulate appropriate measures in any pooling agreement to address instances where a shipment is rejected by a member company for reasons other than delays caused by the shipper's supply.

Query_Text_cn: 这些协议中应规定：在如不如此处理，货物将被拒运并被延误超出公会规定的时限的情形下，准许尚有未经预定舱位可供使用的船舶承运该批货物，甚至是超过该航运公司的货运分摊份额。
Translation: These agreements shall stipulate that vessels with unreserved cargo space available may carry the goods, even exceeding the shipping company's allocated freight share, in cases where failure to do so would result in cargo rejection and delays beyond the time limits set by the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 17.第2条第1至16款的规定关系到一切商品，不论其发源地、目的地或预定用途，但国防用途的军事装备不在此限。
Translation: 17. The provisions of paragraphs 1 to 16 of Article 2 apply to all goods, irrespective of their origin, destination, or intended use, with the exception of military equipment for defense purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 这些程序应保证表决规则不致妨碍公会的正常工作和航运服务，并应规定将以一致赞同作出决定的事项。
Translation: These procedures shall ensure that voting rules do not hinder the normal operations of the association and shipping services, and shall specify matters requiring unanimous agreement for decision-making.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，没有经过两国的国家航运公司的同意，不能对公会协议中规定的有关这两国间贸易方面的问题作出决定。
Translation: However, no decisions can be made on matters related to trade between the two countries as stipulated in the conference agreement without the consent of their respective national shipping companies.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条制裁1.除公会协议对退会期限另有规定外，为公会会员的航运公司有权在遵守公摊方案及（或）货载份额计划中关于退会规定的条件下，提出为期三个月的通知后，解除公会协议条款的约束而不受处罚，但应履行其公会会员义务至解除约束之日为止。
Translation:
Article 4 Sanction  
1. Unless the conference agreement provides otherwise regarding the notice period for withdrawal, a shipping line that is a conference member shall have the right to withdraw from the conference agreement without penalty by giving three months’ notice, subject to the terms of the pooling agreement and/or cargo-sharing arrangement governing withdrawal; provided, however, that such line shall fulfill its membership obligations until the date the withdrawal takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: 2.会员如有不遵守公会协议条款的重大事情，公会可以在按照公会协议的规定给予通知后，中断或开除其会籍。
Translation: 2. Should a member commit any material breach of the association's agreement,the association may suspend or terminate their membership upon giving notice in accordance with the provisions of the agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.开除或中断会籍，必须在书面提出有关理由并按照第Ⅵ章规定解决争议之后，方能生效。
Translation: 3. The expulsion or suspension of membership shall take effect only after the reasons have been presented in writing and any disputes resolved in accordance with the provisions of Chapter VI.

Query_Text_cn: 4.有关航运公司退会或被开除会籍时，应付清其至退会或被开除会籍之日为止公会尚未清偿的债务的应摊份额。
Translation: 4. In the event of a shipping company withdrawing from or being expelled from the association, it shall settle its proportionate share of the association's outstanding debts up to the date of withdrawal or expulsion.

Query_Text_cn: 航运公司在退会、中断会籍或开除会籍时，并不解除其本身根据公会协议所应负的债务或其对托运人的任何责任。
Translation: A shipping company's withdrawal, suspension, or expulsion from the conference does not release it from its obligations under the conference agreement or any liabilities to shippers.

Query_Text_cn: （c）在接到要求时，于不暴露有关当事方的基础上，向公会承运其货载的国家以及其航运公司为公会会员的国家的有关当局报告对于不当行为及（或）违反公会协议行为的申诉所采取的行动。
Translation: (c) Upon request, report to the relevant authorities of the countries where cargo is carried by the conference and where shipping companies are conference members the actions taken regarding complaints of misconduct and/or violations of conference agreements, without disclosing the identity of the parties involved.

Query_Text_cn: 2.航运公司和公会为打击不当行为和违反公会协议行为所作的努力，有权获得托运人和托运人组织的充分合作。
Translation: 2. Shipping companies and conferences are entitled to the full cooperation of shippers and shippers' organizations in their efforts to combat misconduct and breaches of conference agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条公会协议所有的公会协议，以及公摊、靠港和航次权利的协议和修正，或其他直接有关及影响这种协议的文件，都应在接到请求时，提供给其货载由公会承运的国家及其航运公司为公会会员的国家的有关当局。
Translation:
Article 6 Conference Agreements  
All conference agreements, as well as any agreements on apportionment, port calls, and voyage rights, or amendments thereto, and any other documents directly related to or affecting such agreements, shall be made available to the relevant authorities of countries whose cargo is carried by the conference and of countries whose shipping lines are members of the conference, upon request.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条忠诚信约1.为公会会员的航运公司有权与托运人订立并维持忠诚信约，其形式和内容由公会与托运人组织或托运人代表协商议定。
Translation:
Article 7 Loyalty Arrangements  
1. Shipping lines that are members of a conference shall have the right to enter into and maintain loyalty arrangements with shippers, the form and terms of which shall be negotiated and agreed upon between the conference and shippers' organizations or representatives.

Query_Text_cn: 这种信约应提供保障，明确规定托运人和公会会员的权利。
Translation: Such covenants shall provide safeguards, explicitly stipulating the rights of shippers and conference members.

Query_Text_cn: 这种信约应以契约制度或任何其他合法制度为基础。
Translation: Such commitments shall be based on contractual systems or any other legal systems.

Query_Text_cn: 2.不论签订何种忠诚信约，适用于忠诚托运人的运费率，应规定在适用于其他托运人运费率的一定百分比之内。
Translation: 2. Regardless of the type of loyalty agreement entered into, the freight rates applicable to loyal shippers shall be set within a specified percentage of the rates applicable to other shippers.

Query_Text_cn: 如两种费率之间的差数变动提高了对忠诚托运人的费率，则该差数变动只能在向该托运人提出为期一百五十天的通知后才能实行，或依照区域的惯例及（或）协议实行。
Translation: If the change in the difference between the two rates results in an increase to the rate for the loyal shipper, such change may only be implemented after providing the shipper with a one hundred and fifty-day notice, or in accordance with regional practices and/or agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 因运费率差数的变动而引起的争议，应按忠诚信约的规定予以解决。
Translation: Disputes arising from changes in freight rate differentials shall be resolved in accordance with the provisions of the Good Faith Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （a）托运人应对根据有关卖货契约条件由其掌握或由其分支公司或子公司或运输代理人掌握运输的货物承担责任，但托运人不得用规避、隐瞒或中间人的手法，企图违反忠诚信约，转移货物。
Translation: (a) The shipper shall be liable for goods transported under the terms of the relevant sales contract that are under its control or that of its branches, subsidiaries, or transport agents. However, the shipper shall not attempt to circumvent, conceal, or use intermediaries to violate the duty of good faith by diverting the goods.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如订有忠诚契约，契约内应明确规定赔偿金或违约金及（或）罚金的范围。
Translation: (b) If a loyalty agreement is stipulated, the scope of compensation, liquidated damages, and/or penalties shall be clearly defined within the agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 但公会会员公司得决定征收较低额的违约金或放弃征收违约金。
Translation: However, member companies of the association may decide to impose a lower penalty or waive the penalty altogether.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，托运人根据契约应付违约金的数目，不应超过对有关货物根据契约内规定费率计算的运费额。
Translation: In no event shall the amount of liquidated damages payable by the shipper under the contract exceed the freight calculated at the rate specified in the contract for the goods in question.

Query_Text_cn: （c）托运人在履行公会在忠诚信约中规定的条件后，应有权完全恢复忠诚地位。
Translation: (c) Upon fulfilling the conditions stipulated in the conference's loyalty agreement, the shipper shall be entitled to full reinstatement of loyalty status.

Query_Text_cn: （v）给予特免的条件。
Translation: (v) Conditions for granting exemptions.

Query_Text_cn: 4.如公会和托运人组织、托运人代表及（或）托运人对一项拟议忠诚信约的形式或内容发生争议，任何一方均可按照本守则所定适当程序将争议提付解决。
Translation: 4. If a dispute arises between the conference and shippers' organizations, shipper representatives, and/or shippers concerning the form or contents of a proposed loyalty agreement, any party may refer the dispute for settlement in accordance with the appropriate procedures specified in this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条特免1.公会应在忠诚信约的条款内规定，托运人请求特免时，应予迅速审查和作成决定；如扣留特免，应在对方请求时以书面说明理由。
Translation:
Article 8 Special Permission  
1. The agreement shall stipulate that when a shipper requests special permission, the association shall promptly review and make a decision thereon. If the special permission is withheld, the reasons shall be provided in writing upon request by the other party.

Query_Text_cn: 如公会未在忠诚信约规定的期间确认将为托运人的货物也在忠诚信约规定的期间内提供充分的舱位，托运人有权以任何船舶载运该项货物，而不受处罚。
Translation: If the association fails to confirm within the period stipulated in the loyalty contract that sufficient shipping space will be provided for the shipper's cargo within the same stipulated period, the shipper shall have the right to transport such cargo by any vessel without penalty.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对于需有最低货载限额才予弯靠的港口，如托运人虽已及时发出通知，而航运公司未来装货，或航运公司未于议定期间内答复，则托运人自然有权以任何可用船舶载运其货物，而不损及其忠诚地位。
Translation: 2. For ports requiring a minimum cargo load for vessel calls, if the shipper has duly issued a notice but the shipping company fails to load the goods or does not respond within the agreed period, the shipper shall retain the right to transport the goods by any available vessel without prejudice to its bona fide status.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条费率表及有关条件和（或）规章的获得费率表、有关条件、规章及其任何补充规定，遇有请求时应以合理收费提供给托运人、托运人组织和其他有关当事方，并应在航运公司及其代理人的办事处备供检查。
Translation:
Article 9 Availability of Tariffs, Relevant Conditions and/or Regulations  
Tariffs, relevant conditions, regulations, and any supplementary provisions shall, upon request, be made available to shippers, shippers' organizations, and other interested parties at a reasonable charge. They shall also be kept for inspection at the offices of shipping companies and their agents.

Query_Text_cn: 它们应载明与适用费率及运送货物有关的所有条件。
Translation: They shall specify all conditions relating to applicable rates and the carriage of goods.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条年度报告公会应就其活动向托运人组织或托运人代表提出年度报告，旨在提供他们所关心的一般报导，包括有关下列各事的资料：同托运人和托运人组织进行的协商，对申诉采取的行动，会员的变动，以及航线、费率及运输条件的重大变动。
Translation:
Article 10 Annual Report  
The conference shall submit an annual report on its activities to shippers' organizations or representatives of shippers, with the aim of providing general coverage of matters of concern to them, including information on the following: consultations with shippers and shippers' organizations, actions taken on complaints, changes in membership, and significant alterations in routes, rates, and terms of carriage.

Query_Text_cn: 遇有请求时，公会应向公会经营其货运各国的有关当局提送这种年度报告。
Translation: Upon request, the association shall submit such annual reports to the relevant authorities of the countries where it operates its freight services.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条协商机构1.在公会与托运人组织、托运人代表、及——可行时——托运人之间，应就共同关心的问题进行协商，有关当局愿意时，可为此目的指定上述各方。
Translation:
Article 11 Consultation Machinery  
1. Consultation shall take place between the liner conference and shippers' organizations, representatives of shippers, and—where practicable—shippers themselves on matters of common interest. Where appropriate, the relevant authorities may designate the aforementioned parties for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 此种协商应根据上述任何一方的请求随时举行。
Translation: Such consultations shall be held at any time upon the request of either of the above-mentioned parties.

Query_Text_cn: 有关当局如提出请求，应有权充分参加此种协商，但他们的参加并不意味着具有作出决定的作用。
Translation: The relevant authorities shall have the right to participate fully in such consultations upon request, but their participation shall not imply a decision-making role.

Query_Text_cn: （h）托运货物的提交，及有关通知备货情况的要求。
Translation: (h) Submission of consigned goods and requirements for notifications regarding stock preparation.

Query_Text_cn: 4.除本守则内另有规定外，协商应在作出最后决定以前举行。
Translation: 4. Unless otherwise provided in this Code, consultation shall take place before the final decision is made.

Query_Text_cn: 如欲对第11条第2和3款所述问题作出决定，应事先发出通知。
Translation: Decisions on matters referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3 of Article 11 shall be preceded by prior notice.

Query_Text_cn: 如不可能，则可在举行协商以前先作出紧急决定。
Translation: If not possible, an emergency decision may be made prior to holding consultations.

Query_Text_cn: 5.协商不得无故拖延，无论如何应在公会协议内规定的最长期限内开始，公会协议内如无此项规定，则应于收到协商提议后三十日内开始，但本守则内对期限另有规定时不在此限。
Translation: 5. Consultations shall not be unduly delayed and shall in any event commence within the maximum period specified in the conference agreement. If no such period is specified in the conference agreement, consultations shall commence within thirty days of receipt of the proposal for consultations, unless otherwise provided for in this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 6.进行协商时，有关各方应尽力供给有关情报，及时讨论并澄清问题，以寻求有关问题的解决。
Translation: 6. During consultations, the parties concerned shall endeavor to provide relevant information, promptly discuss and clarify issues in order to seek solutions to the matters in question.

Query_Text_cn: 有关各方应考虑彼此的意见和问题，力争达成符合其商业发展的协议。
Translation: All parties concerned should take into account each other's views and concerns, striving to reach an agreement that aligns with their commercial development.

Query_Text_cn: （b）班轮公会的营运成本，原则上应以船舶的往返航程估算，去程和回程视为一航程。
Translation: (b) The operating costs of liner conferences should, in principle, be estimated based on the round voyage of vessels, with the outbound and return trips considered as a single voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 在适用时，去程和回程应分开估算。
Translation: Where applicable, the outbound and return journeys should be estimated separately.

Query_Text_cn: （c）在确定特定货物的促进贸易性运费率及（或）特别运费率时，应考虑到在公会承运其货载的国家特别是发展中国家和内陆国家内这些货物的贸易情况。
Translation: (c) In determining the trade-promoting freight rates and/or special freight rates for specific goods, consideration shall be given to the trade conditions of these goods in the countries, especially developing and landlocked countries, whose cargo is carried by the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条公会运价表和运费率的分类1.公会运价表对相同情况的托运人不得有不公平的不同待遇。
Translation:
Article 13 Classification of Conference Tariffs and Freight Rates  
1. Conference tariffs shall not unfairly discriminate between shippers under similar circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 为公会会员的航运公司应严格遵守公会运价表及其他公布的当时有效文件内所订的费率、规则和条款，以及本守则所容许的任何特别安排。
Translation: Shipping companies that are members of the conference shall strictly adhere to the rates, rules, and terms stipulated in the conference tariff and other published documents in effect at the time, as well as any special arrangements permitted under this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 为了便于进行统计编纂和分析，应于可行时按照"国际贸易标准分类”、或"布鲁塞尔税则名目”、或可能为国际间采用的任何其他税则名目，在运价表上标明该项目的相应适当号码。
Translation: For the purpose of statistical compilation and analysis, it should be feasible to indicate in tariffs the appropriate corresponding number for each commodity under the "Standard International Trade Classification", the "Brussels Tariff Nomenclature", or any other tariff nomenclature which may be internationally adopted.

Query_Text_cn: 在可行范围内，运价表上商品的分类应同托运人组织及其他有关的国家和国际组织合作编定。
Translation: To the extent practicable, the classification of commodities in the tariff shall be established in cooperation with shippers' organizations and other relevant national and international organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条运费率的全面提高1.公会应将其实行全面提高运费率的意图至少于一百五十日前或依照区域惯例及（或）协议，通知托运人组织或托运人代表及（或）托运人，并于有此要求时通知公会经营其货运的各国有关当局，通知内应指明提高的幅度，实行的日期，以及提高运费率的理由。
Translation:
Article 14 General increase in freight rates  
1. The conference shall give notice of not less than 150 days, or according to regional practice and/or agreement, to shippers' organizations or representatives of shippers and/or shippers, as well as to the competent authorities of the countries where the conference operates, if requested, of its intention to implement a general increase in freight rates. Such notice shall indicate the extent of the increase, the date of implementation, and the reasons for the increase.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果本守则为此目的规定的任何当事方在接到通知后一个议定时期内提出要求，应根据本守则的有关条款，在不超过三十日的规定时期内，或者有关各方事先商定的时期内开始协商，协商的内容应该是拟议提高运费率的根据和数额，以及开始实行的日期。
Translation: 2. If any party specified in this Code for this purpose requests within an agreed period after receiving the notice, consultations shall commence in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Code within a stipulated period not exceeding thirty days or a period mutually agreed upon by the parties concerned. The consultations shall address the basis and amount of the proposed freight rate increase as well as the proposed effective date.

Query_Text_cn: 3.公会为促进协商，可以，或在本守则规定有权参加关于运费率全面提高的协商的任何当事一方提出请求时，于可行时在协商之前的合理时间，向参加的当事各方提交一份由著名的独立会计师提出的报告，内中载有公会认为需要提高运费率的有关费用和收入的全面分析，以供提出要求的当事一方接受它作为协商的基础之一。
Translation: 3. To facilitate negotiations, the conference may, or upon request by any party entitled under this Code to participate in negotiations on general freight rate increases, shall, where practicable and within a reasonable time prior to the negotiations, submit to the participating parties a report prepared by an independent accountant of repute. This report shall contain a comprehensive analysis of the relevant costs and revenues which, in the opinion of the conference, necessitate the freight rate increase, for acceptance by the requesting party as one of the bases for negotiation.

Query_Text_cn: 4.如果协商结果取得协议，运费率的提高，除非有关当事各方商定更迟的日期，应从依照第14条第1款发出的通知内指明的日期开始生效。
Translation: 4. If the consultation results in an agreement, the increase in freight rates shall take effect from the date specified in the notice issued under Article 14(1), unless the parties concerned agree on a later date.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如在依照第14条第1款发出通知后三十天内未能取得协议，在遵守本守则所规定程序的情形下，应按照第Ⅵ章，将问题立刻提交国际强制调解。
Translation: 5. If no agreement is reached within thirty days after the notice is issued under paragraph 1 of Article 14, the matter shall be promptly referred to international compulsory conciliation under Chapter VI, in compliance with the procedures prescribed by this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 调解人作出的建议，如经有关当事各方接受，应对它们具有约束力，并应于调解人建议内规定的日期起生效执行，唯须遵守第14条第9款的各项规定。
Translation: The recommendations of the conciliator, if accepted by the parties concerned, shall be binding upon them and shall be implemented from the date specified in the recommendations, subject to the provisions of paragraph 9 of Article 14.

Query_Text_cn: 6.在遵守第14条第9款规定的条件下，公会得在调解人作出建议之前实行全面提高运费率。
Translation: 6. Subject to the provisions of Article 14(9), the conference may implement a general increase in freight rates before the conciliator makes recommendations.

Query_Text_cn: 调解人在作出建议时应考虑到上述公会提高运费率的幅度，和已经实行的时期。
Translation: When making recommendations, the mediator shall take into account the extent of the freight rate increase proposed by the aforementioned association and the period during which it has already been implemented.

Query_Text_cn: 倘班轮公会拒绝调解人的建议，托运人和（或）托运人组织在作出适当的通知后，应有权认为他们不受同该公会缔结的、可能不许他们使用非公会航运公司的任何协议或其他契约的约束。
Translation: If liner conferences reject the mediator's proposal, shippers and/or shipper organizations, after giving appropriate notice, shall have the right to consider themselves no longer bound by any agreements or contracts with the conference which may prevent them from using non-conference shipping companies.

Query_Text_cn: 倘订有忠诚信约，托运人和（或）托运人组织应于三十天的期限内发出通知，声明他们认为他们不再受该信约的约束，该通知应自其中所述日期开始适用，并应为此目的在忠诚信约内规定不少于三十天及不多于九十天的期限。
Translation: In case of a Loyalty Agreement, the shipper and/or shipper organization shall give notice within a period of thirty days stating that they consider themselves no longer bound thereby. Such notice shall take effect from the date specified therein, and the Loyalty Agreement shall stipulate a period of not less than thirty days and not more than ninety days for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 7.应该付给托运人的、经公会积留的未还退款，不得因为托运人按照第14条第6款采取的行动而被公会扣留或没收。
Translation: 7. Any unrefunded balances due to shippers and retained by the conference shall not be withheld or confiscated by the conference due to actions taken by the shipper under Article 14(6).

Query_Text_cn: 8.如为公会会员的航运公司在某一航线上承运的某一国家的货物，主要是一种或几种基本商品，则对一种或一种以上商品的运费率提高，应即视为运费率的全面提高，适用本守则的各项有关规定。
Translation: 8. If a shipping company that is a member of the conference carries cargo of a particular country on a specific route, primarily consisting of one or several basic commodities, any increase in the freight rate for one or more of these commodities shall be deemed as a general increase in freight rates and shall be subject to all relevant provisions of this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 9.公会制定根据本守则生效的运费率的任何全面提高时，应订明最低限度的适用期间，但须计及关于附加费的规定，和关于因外汇率波动而导致的运费率调整的规定。
Translation: 9. When the conference decides on any general increase in freight rates that takes effect under this Code, it shall specify a minimum period of application, taking into account provisions regarding surcharges and adjustments to freight rates due to fluctuations in exchange rates.

Query_Text_cn: 运费率全面提高的适用期间，应该是依照第14条第2款进行协商时考虑的问题，但除非有关各方于协商时另有协议外，一次运费率全面提高的生效之日，与依照第14条第1款就下一次运费率的全面提高发出通知之日，两者之间的间隔期间最短不得少于十个月。
Translation: The applicable period for a general rate increase should be a matter for consideration during negotiations under Article 14(2). However, unless otherwise agreed by the parties concerned during such negotiations, the interval between the effective date of a general rate increase and the date of notice issued for the next general rate increase under Article 14(1) shall in no case be less than ten months.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条促进贸易性运费率1.公会应规定非传统出口商品的促进贸易性运费率。
Translation:
Article 15 Promotion of Trade Freight Rates  
1. Conferences shall establish promotional freight rates for non-traditional export commodities.

Query_Text_cn: 2.有关的托运人、托运人组织或托运人代表应向公会提出一切必要的和合理的资料，以证明促进贸易性运费率的需要。
Translation: 2. The relevant shippers, shippers' organizations, or shippers' representatives shall provide the conference with all necessary and reasonable information to demonstrate the need for promotional freight rates.

Query_Text_cn: 3.应当制定特别程序，规定应在收到这种资料之日起三十天内对促进贸易性运费率的申请作出决定，有关各方另有协议者不在此限。
Translation: 3. Special procedures shall be established, stipulating that decisions on applications for trade-facilitating freight rates shall be made within thirty days from the date of receipt of such materials, unless otherwise agreed by the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 这种程序，同对其他商品考虑能否减低运费率或免除其运费率提高的一般程序，二者之间应加以明确区分。
Translation: This procedure shall be clearly distinguished from the general procedure applicable to other commodities regarding the consideration of whether freight rates may be reduced or exempted from increases.

Query_Text_cn: 4.公会应向它承运其货载各国的托运人及（或）托运人组织提供同促进贸易性运费率申请的审议程序有关的资料，并遇有请求时提供给各该国政府及（或）其他有关当局。
Translation: 4. The conference shall provide shippers and/or shippers' organizations in the countries whose cargoes it carries, and, upon request, the governments and/or other appropriate authorities of those countries, with relevant information concerning the procedures for considering applications for promotional freight rates aimed at facilitating trade.

Query_Text_cn: 5.促进贸易性运费率的订定，除有关双方另有协议外，通常应以十二个月为期。
Translation: 5. The establishment of trade freight rates should be promoted, and unless otherwise agreed by the parties concerned, they should typically be set for a period of twelve months.

Query_Text_cn: 在满期之前，应根据有关托运人及（或）托运人组织的请求，对促进贸易性运费率作出审查，审查时应由托运人及（或）托运人组织根据公会的请求证明确有理由必须在头一个期间过后继续使用该运费率。
Translation: Before the expiry date, upon the request of the relevant shipper and/or shipper organization, promotional freight rates for trade facilitation shall be reviewed. During the review, the shipper and/or shipper organization shall, at the request of the conference, provide justification that it is indeed necessary to continue using such freight rates after the initial period.

Query_Text_cn: 6.公会审查促进贸易性运费率的申请时可以考虑到：虽然这项为非传统产品而要求的运费率应该促进该产品的出口，但对公会经营其货运的另一国家的相似产品的出口，不致在竞争上造成重大的不利情况。
Translation: 6. When reviewing applications for trade-related freight rates, the conference may take into account that while the requested rate for non-traditional products should promote their export, it should not create significant competitive disadvantages for the export of similar products from another country where the conference operates its shipping services.

Query_Text_cn: 7.按本守则第16条和第17条规定收取附加费或采用货币调整率时，促进贸易性运费率不构成例外。
Translation: 7. Trade-promoting freight rates shall not constitute an exception when surcharges are levied or currency adjustment factors applied in accordance with Articles 16 and 17 of this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 8.在公会营运航线上有关港口弯靠的每个公会会员航运公司应接受，不得无理拒绝，经公会规定促进贸易性运费率的货载的公平份额。
Translation: 8. Each member shipping company of the conference operating on the relevant route shall accept, without unjustified refusal, a fair share of cargo subject to the promotional freight rates stipulated by the conference at each port of call.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条附加费1.公会因费用的突然增加或异常增加或收益减少而收取的附加费，应视为临时性质。
Translation:
Article 16 Surcharges  
1. Any surcharge imposed by a conference due to sudden or abnormal increases in costs or a decline in revenues shall be regarded as temporary in nature.

Query_Text_cn: 上述附加费应随着所面临局势或条件的改善而减少，并应在促使其收取此项费用的局势或条件不再存在时立即撤销，但应遵守第16条第6款的规定。
Translation: The additional charge shall be progressively reduced as and when the conditions or circumstances which occasioned its imposition are improved and shall be eliminated immediately when such conditions or circumstances cease to exist, subject to the provisions of paragraph 6 of Article 16.

Query_Text_cn: 在开始征收附加费时即应指出这点，并应尽可能对足以导致附加费提高、减少或撤销的局势或条件变化加以说明。
Translation: This point shall be indicated when the surcharge is initially imposed, and any changes in the situation or conditions that may lead to an increase, reduction, or withdrawal of the surcharge should be explained as far as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对运往某一港口或由某一港口运出的货物征收的附加费，也应视为临时性的，应随着该港情况的改变同样予以增减或取消，但应遵守第16条第6款的规定。
Translation: 2. Surcharges imposed on cargoes destined for or originating from a specific port shall also be regarded as temporary and shall be adjusted, increased, reduced, or abolished correspondingly with changes in the conditions of that port, subject to the provisions of Article 16(6).

Query_Text_cn: 3.不论全面地或仅对某一港口收取附加费，均应事先发出通知，并根据要求由有关公会同直接受附加费影响且经本守则中规定有权参加协商的其他当事各方，按照本守则的程序进行协商，但由于当时局势必须立即征收附加费时，不在此限。
Translation: 3. Surcharges shall be imposed, whether on an all-inclusive basis or on specific ports, only after notice has been given and consultations have been held between the conferences concerned and other parties directly affected by the surcharges and entitled to participate in such consultations under this Code, in accordance with the procedures laid down herein, unless the urgency of the situation calls for immediate imposition.

Query_Text_cn: 在事先未经协商即行收取附加费的情况下，应根据要求于开始改收后尽早进行协商。
Translation: In cases where additional charges are imposed without prior consultation, negotiations shall be conducted as early as possible after the commencement of such charges upon request.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种协商之前，公会应提出它们所以认为应该收取附加费的资料。
Translation: Before such negotiations, the unions should present the data they consider justifies the imposition of surcharges.

Query_Text_cn: 4.除各方另有协议外，如第16条所述有关各方之间，于收到依照该条第3款规定发出的通知后十五天内，对于收取附加费问题不能达成协议时，则应按本守则所定有关解决争议的规定办理。
Translation: 4. Unless otherwise agreed by the parties concerned, if no agreement can be reached among the relevant parties referred to in Article 16 within fifteen days after the receipt of the notice issued in accordance with paragraph 3 of that Article regarding the imposition of surcharges, the matter shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of this Code governing the resolution of disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 除有关各方另有协议外，如在收到上述通知三十天后仍未解决争议时，则可以在争议未解决前先收取附加费。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed by the parties concerned, if the dispute remains unresolved thirty days after receipt of the aforementioned notice, additional charges may be levied prior to the resolution of the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如在特殊情况下未经第16条第3款所规定的事先协商即行收取附加费，又未能通过事后协商达成协议，则应按照本守则所定有关解决争议的规定办理。
Translation: 5. In exceptional circumstances where surcharges are imposed without prior consultation as stipulated in paragraph 3 of Article 16 and no agreement is reached through subsequent consultation, the matter shall be handled in accordance with the dispute resolution provisions set forth in this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 6.如因按照本守则的规定，就收取附加费的问题进行协商及（或）进行其他解决争议的程序，比依照第16条第3款规定发出的通知内所定收取附加费的日期延后，因而公会的会员航运公司有财务上的损失时，可以在取消附加费前延长一个相应的时期，以资补偿。
Translation: 6. If, due to negotiations or other dispute resolution procedures conducted in accordance with the provisions of this Code regarding the imposition of additional charges, the date set for collecting such charges in the notice issued under Article 16 (3) is delayed, resulting in financial losses to member shipping companies of the conference, the duration of the additional charges may be extended by a corresponding period before their cancellation as compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 相反地，公会收取的附加费，事后如经本守则所定的协商或其他程序，决定和同意其为不合理或超收时，则除另有协议外，如经有关当事各方提出要求，应于提出要求后三十日内将所收的款额或上述决定的超收数额退还给他们。
Translation: Conversely, if the surcharges collected by the association are subsequently determined and agreed through consultation or other procedures stipulated in this Code to be unreasonable or excessive, then, unless otherwise agreed, the amount collected or the excess amount as determined shall be refunded to the relevant parties within thirty days upon their request.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条货币变动1.外汇率变动，包括正式的贬值或增值，引起公会的会员航运公司在公会范围内营业的总营运费用及（或）收入的变动，为实行货币调整或变动运费率的正当理由。
Translation:
Article 17 Currency Changes  

1. Changes in exchange rates, including official devaluation or revaluation, resulting in variations in the total operating expenses and/or revenues of member shipping lines of the conference within the scope of the conference's operations, shall constitute valid grounds for implementing currency adjustments or changes in freight rates.

Query_Text_cn: 调整或变动应尽可能使有关会员公司总计起来不因调整或变动而有所损益。
Translation: Adjustments or changes shall be made in such a way that the member companies concerned will not, in the aggregate, suffer any loss or gain as a result.

Query_Text_cn: 调整或变动可以采取货币附加费或折扣的方式，也可采取运费率增减的方式。
Translation: Adjustments or changes may be implemented either through monetary surcharges or discounts, or by increasing or decreasing freight rates.

Query_Text_cn: 2.这种调整或变动应先行通知，如有区域惯例，通知应依区域惯例办理，并应由有关公会同直接受影响、且经本守则规定有权参加协商的其他当事各方，按照本守则的规定进行协商，但如因情况特殊必须立即适用货币调整或运费率变动时，不在此限。
Translation: 2. Such adjustments or changes shall be made only after prior notice, unless there are regional practices to the contrary, in which case notice shall be given in accordance with such practices. Consultations shall be held in accordance with the provisions of this Code between the conferences concerned and the other parties directly affected and entitled to participate in such consultations, unless there are special circumstances requiring immediate application of the currency adjustment or freight rate change.

Query_Text_cn: 如未经事先协商即行适用，应于其后尽速进行协商。
Translation: If applied without prior consultation, prompt consultation shall be conducted thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: 协商的主题应是货币调整或运费率变动的适用幅度和实施日期。并应依照第16条第4及第5款中有关附加费的各项规定进行协商。
Translation: The subject of negotiation shall be the applicable range and implementation date of currency adjustments or freight rate changes. Such negotiations shall be conducted in accordance with the provisions on surcharges stipulated in paragraphs 4 and 5 of Article 16.

Query_Text_cn: 这种协商应于宣布意图实行货币附加费或运费率变动之日起算十五日内举行并完成。
Translation: Such consultations shall be held and completed within fifteen days from the date of announcing the intention to impose a monetary surcharge or adjust freight rates.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如果在十五天内未能通过协商达成协议，则应按本守则所定有关解决争议的规定办理。
Translation: 3. If no agreement is reached through consultation within fifteen days, the dispute shall be resolved in accordance with the provisions of this Code governing dispute settlement.

Query_Text_cn: 4.第16条第6款的各项规定应在必要的调整后适用于本条述及的货币调整和运费率变动。
Translation: 4. The provisions of paragraph 6 of Article 16 shall apply, mutatis mutandis, to the currency adjustments and freight rate changes referred to in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条战斗船公会会员不得在公会营运的航线上使用战斗船驱逐非公会会员的航运公司，以达到排除、防止或减少竞争的目的。
Translation: Article 18: Members of the Fighting Vessel Conference shall not employ fighting vessels on routes operated by the Conference to drive out non-member shipping companies for the purpose of excluding, preventing, or reducing competition.

Query_Text_cn: 第19条服务的适应情况1.公会应采取必要的适当措施，保证其会员公司在所经营的航线上按需要班次提供定期的、足够的且有效的服务，并应为此作出安排，以尽可能避免航次过于集中或过于稀疏。
Translation:
Article 19 Service Adaptation  
1. The conference shall take such appropriate measures as may be necessary to ensure that its member lines provide regular, adequate, and effective services on the routes they operate, in accordance with the required frequency. Arrangements shall be made to avoid, as far as possible, excessive concentration or sparsity of sailings.

Query_Text_cn: 公会于安排航次时也应考虑到任何必要的特别措施，以适应货物数量的季节性变化。
Translation: The union shall also take into account any necessary special measures when scheduling voyages to accommodate seasonal fluctuations in cargo volume.

Query_Text_cn: 2.公会及本守则中规定有权参加协商的其他各方，包括愿意参加的有关当局，应经常检查对舱位的需要、服务的适应及适合情况，尤其是合理化和提高服务效率的可能性，并应在这方面保持密切合作，查明是由服务合理化而得的利益，应在运费率水平上得到公平的反映。
Translation: 2. The trade unions and other parties entitled to participate in consultations as stipulated in this Code, including relevant authorities willing to participate, shall regularly review the demand for shipping space, the adequacy and suitability of services, particularly the possibilities for rationalization and enhancing service efficiency. They shall maintain close cooperation in this regard, ensuring that benefits derived from service rationalization are fairly reflected in the freight rate levels.

Query_Text_cn: 3.对需有一定最低限额的货载才予弯靠的港口，其最低限额应在运价表内明确规定，托运人应就有无这些货物提出适当通知。
Translation: 3. For ports that require a minimum cargo volume for vessel calls, such minimum limits shall be clearly specified in the tariff schedule. Shippers shall provide appropriate notice regarding the availability of such cargo.

Query_Text_cn: 第20条公会总办事处公会通常应在其经营货运的国家设立其总办事处，但公会的会员航运公司另有协议者不在此限。
Translation:
Article 20 Principal Office of the Conference  
A conference shall normally establish its principal office in the country where it operates its freight services, unless otherwise agreed by the member shipping lines of the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 第21条代表公会应在其经营货运的所有国家内派驻当地代表，唯如有实际困难，可设区域性的代表。
Translation: Article 21: The representative trade union shall appoint local representatives in all countries where it operates freight services, provided that regional representatives may be designated in cases of practical difficulties.

Query_Text_cn: 各代表的姓名和地址应随时提供。这些代表应确保托运人及公会均能迅速获知彼此的意见，以便迅速作出决定。
Translation: The names and addresses of the representatives shall be readily available. These representatives shall ensure that both the shippers and the conference are promptly informed of each other's views to facilitate swift decision-making.

Query_Text_cn: 在公会认为适宜时，应授给代表作出决定的适当权力。
Translation: When the union deems it appropriate, appropriate authority shall be granted to the representatives to make decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第22条公会协议、参加货载承运协议和忠诚信约的内容公会协议、参加货载承运协议和忠诚信约，应与本守则内可以适用的各项要求相符，并可包含经协议的而与本守则并无抵触的其他规定。
Translation:
Article 22 Contents of Conference Agreements, Participation in Cargo-Carrying Agreements, and Loyalty Arrangements  
Conference agreements, participation in cargo-carrying agreements, and loyalty arrangements shall conform to all applicable requirements of this Code and may include such other provisions as may be agreed which are not inconsistent with this Code.

Query_Text_cn: （d）二个或二个以上公会之间。
Translation: (d) Between two or more trade unions.

Query_Text_cn: 在本章中，"当事一方”一词是指原先发生争议的当事各方和按照第34条（a）参加解决程序的第三方。
Translation: In this chapter, the term "party" refers to the original parties to the dispute as well as third parties participating in the resolution process under Article 34(a).

Query_Text_cn: 2.同属一国的航运公司之间以及同属一国的组织之间的争议，除非使本守则规定的施行造成严重困难，应在该国国内司法范围内予以解决。
Translation: 2. Disputes between shipping companies of the same country or between organizations of the same country shall be resolved within the domestic judicial system of that country, unless such resolution would seriously impede the implementation of the provisions stipulated in this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 3.争议各方应本着找到彼此满意的解决办法的意向，设法先通过交换意见或直接谈判来求得解决。
Translation: 3. The parties involved in the dispute should endeavor to seek a resolution through the exchange of views or direct negotiations, with the intention of finding a mutually satisfactory solution.

Query_Text_cn: （i）所提议的忠诚信约的形式和条款，上列各项争议，如未能通过交换意见或直接谈判予以解决，则经争议任何当事一方的请求，应依照本章的规定提交国际强制调解。
Translation: (i) If the disputes mentioned above cannot be resolved through the exchange of views or direct negotiations, any party to the dispute may, upon request, submit them to international compulsory conciliation in accordance with the provisions of this chapter regarding the form and terms of the proposed loyalty agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条1.调解程序根据争议当事一方的要求而开始。
Translation: Article 24(1) The mediation procedure shall be initiated upon the request of one party to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: （d）关于因汇率变动而改变运费率或征收货币调整费的争议，至迟应于第17条第3款规定的期限届满之日起五日内提出。
Translation: (d) Any dispute regarding adjustments to freight rates or the imposition of currency adjustment fees due to exchange rate fluctuations shall be raised no later than five days after the expiration of the period specified in Article 17(3).

Query_Text_cn: 3.第24条第2款的规定，对依照第25条第3款规定提交国际强制调解的争议不适用。
Translation: 3. The provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 24 shall not apply to disputes submitted for international compulsory conciliation under paragraph 3 of Article 25.

Query_Text_cn: 4.不属于第24条第2款所述争议的调解要求，可随进提出。
Translation: 4. Requests for mediation not covered by the disputes referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 24 may be submitted at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 5.第24条第2款规定的时限，可经双方协议延长。
Translation: 5. The time limit stipulated in paragraph 2 of Article 24 may be extended by mutual agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 6.调解的要求，如证明已在第24条第2款或第5款所述期限内用挂号信、电报或印字电报或用专人将要求送达对方，应视为已经正式提出。
Translation: 6. The requirement for mediation shall be deemed to have been formally made if it is proven that the request was delivered to the other party within the time limits specified in paragraph 2 or 5 of Article 24 by registered letter, telegram, telex, or personal service.

Query_Text_cn: 7.如未在第24条第2款或第5款所定期限内提出要求，公会的决定即为定案，争议的任何一方均不得对该项决定提出异议，依照本章进行诉讼。
Translation: 7. If no request is made within the time limit specified in paragraph 2 or 5 of Article 24, the decision of the association shall be final, and neither party to the dispute may challenge such decision, with litigation to proceed in accordance with this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 第25条1.如当事各方已协议第23条第4款（a）、（b）、（c）、（d）、（h）和（i）各项争议应通过该条所定以外的程序来解决，或对它们之间发生的某一特殊争议的调解程序达成协议，这些争议应在争议的任何一方提出要求时，按照他们协议的办法予以解决。
Translation:
Article 25  
1. If the parties concerned have agreed that disputes referred to in subparagraphs (a), (b), (c), (d), (h), and (i) of paragraph 4 of Article 23 shall be settled by procedures other than those provided for in that Article, or have reached agreement on conciliation procedures for a particular dispute arising between them, such disputes shall be settled in accordance with the agreed procedures upon the request of any party to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 确信，为此目的迫切需要采取适当措施。
Translation: It is certain that appropriate measures are urgently required for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: (3)如系植物，指附录一所列物种，或其任何可辨认的部分，或其衍生物和附录二、附录三所列物种及与附录二、附录三所指有关物种的任何可辨认的部分，或其衍生物。
Translation: (3) In the case of plants, it refers to species listed in Appendix I, any recognizable part thereof, or derivatives thereof; and species listed in Appendix II or III, any recognizable part thereof, or derivatives thereof related to the species referred to in Appendix II or III.

Query_Text_cn: 8."成员国”指本公约对之生效的国家。
Translation: 8. "Member State" means a country for which this Convention is in force.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条基本原则(一)附录一应包括所有受到和可能受到贸易的影响而有灭绝危险的物种，这些物种的标本的贸易必须加以特别严格的管理，以防止进一步危害其生存，并且只有在特殊的情况下才能允许进行贸易。
Translation: The second fundamental principle: (1) Appendix I shall include all species threatened with extinction which are or may be affected by trade. Trade in specimens of these species must be subject to particularly strict regulation to prevent further endangerment of their survival, and may only be authorized under exceptional circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为了使本款第1项中指明的某些物种标本的贸易能得到有效的控制，而必须加以管理的其它物种。
Translation: 2. Other species that must be regulated to ensure effective control of trade in specimens of certain species specified in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (三)附录三应包括任一成员国认为属其管辖范围内，应进行管理以防止或限制开发利用，而需要其他成员国合作控制贸易的物种。
Translation: (3) Appendix III shall include all species which any member State identifies as being subject to regulation within its jurisdiction for the purpose of preventing or restricting exploitation and which require the cooperation of other member States in trade control.

Query_Text_cn: (四)除遵守本公约各项规定外，各成员国均不应允许就附录一、附录二、附录三所列物种标本进行贸易。
Translation: (4) In addition to complying with the provisions of this Convention, member states shall not permit trade in specimens of species listed in Appendices I, II, and III.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条附录一所列物种标本的贸易规定(一)附录一所列物种标本的贸易，均应遵守本条各项规定。
Translation:
Article III Regulations on Trade in Specimens of Species Included in Appendix I  

(1) Trade in specimens of species included in Appendix I shall comply with the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (二)附录一所列物种的任何标本的出口，应事先获得并交验出口许可证。
Translation: (2) The export of any specimen of the species included in Appendix I shall require the prior grant and presentation of an export permit.

Query_Text_cn: 4.出口国的管理机构确认，该标本的进口许可证已经发给。
Translation: 4. The competent authority of the exporting country confirms that the import permit for the specimen has been issued.

Query_Text_cn: (三)附录一所列物种的任何标本的进口，均应事先获得并交验进口许可证和出口许可证，或再出口证明书。
Translation: (3) The import of any specimen of the species listed in Appendix I shall require the prior grant and presentation of an import permit and an export permit or re-export certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 3.进口国的管理机构确认，该标本的进口，不是以商业为根本目的。
Translation: 3. The importing country's management authority confirms that the import of the specimen is not fundamentally for commercial purposes.

Query_Text_cn: (四)附录一所列物种的任何标本的再出口，均应事先获得并交验再出口证明书。
Translation: (iv) Any re-export of specimens of species listed in Appendix I shall require prior grant and presentation of a re-export certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 3.再出口国的管理机构确认，任一活标本的进口许可证已经发给。
Translation: 3. The competent authority of the re-exporting country confirms that an import permit has been issued for any live specimen.

Query_Text_cn: (五)从海上引进附录一所列物种的任何标本，应事先获得引进国管理机构发给的证明书。
Translation: (v) Any specimen of a species included in Appendix I introduced from the sea shall be accompanied by a prior certificate issued by the Management Authority of the State of introduction.

Query_Text_cn: 3.引进国的管理机构确认，该标本的引进不是以商业为根本目的。
Translation: 3. The competent authority of the importing country confirms that the introduction of the specimen is not primarily for commercial purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条附录二所列物种标本的贸易规定(一)附录二所列物种标本的贸易，均应遵守本条各项规定。
Translation:
Article 4 Trade Regulations for Specimens of Species Listed in Appendix II  
(1) Trade in specimens of species included in Appendix II shall be subject to all the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (二)附录二所列物种的任何标本的出口，应事先获得并交验出口许可证。
Translation: (2) The export of any specimen of a species included in Appendix II shall require the prior grant and presentation of an export permit.

Query_Text_cn: 3.出口国的管理机构确认，任一出口的活标本会得到妥善装运，尽量减少伤亡，损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: 3. The competent authority of the exporting country confirms that any live specimen to be exported will be so prepared and shipped as to minimize the risk of injury, damage to health, or cruel treatment.

Query_Text_cn: (三)各成员国的科学机构应监督该国所发给的附录二所列物种标本的出口许可证及该物种标本出口的实际情况。
Translation: (3) The scientific authorities of each member state shall monitor the export permits issued by that country for specimens of species listed in Appendix II and the actual exportation of such specimens.

Query_Text_cn: 当科学机构确定，此类物种标本的出口应受到限制，以便保持该物种在其分布区内的生态系中与它应有作用相一致的地位，或者大大超出该物种够格成为附录一所属范畴的标准时，该科学机构就应建议主管的管理机构采取适当措施，限制发给该物种标本出口许可证。
Translation: When the scientific authority determines that the export of specimens of such species should be restricted to maintain that species at a level consistent with its role in the ecosystems where it occurs and well above the level at which that species might become eligible for inclusion in Appendix I, it shall advise the competent management authority of suitable measures to be taken to limit the grant of export permits for specimens of that species.

Query_Text_cn: (四)附录二所列物种的任何标本的进口，应事先交验出口许可证或再出口证明书。
Translation: (iv) The import of any specimen of the species included in Appendix II shall require the prior presentation of an export permit or a re-export certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (五)附录二所列物种的任何标本的再出口，应事先获得并交验再出口证明书。
Translation: (v) Any re-export of specimens of species listed in Appendix II shall require the prior grant and presentation of a re-export certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 只有符合下列各项条件时，方可发给再出口证明书。
Translation: The re-export certificate shall only be issued when all the following conditions are met.

Query_Text_cn: 2.再出口国的管理机构确认，任一活标本会得到妥善装运，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: 2. The competent authority of the re-exporting country confirms that each live specimen will be properly transported to minimize injury, health damage, or maltreatment.

Query_Text_cn: (六)从海上引进附录二所列物种的任何标本，应事先从引进国的管理机构获得发给的证明书。
Translation: (6) Any specimen of a species listed in Appendix II introduced from the sea shall be accompanied by a prior certificate issued by the management authority of the State of introduction.

Query_Text_cn: 2.引进国的管理机构确认，任一活标本会得到妥善处置，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: 2. The competent authority of the importing country confirms that any live specimen will be handled properly to minimize injury, harm to health, or cruel treatment.

Query_Text_cn: (七)本条第(六)款所提到的证明书，只有在科学机构与其他国家的科学机构或者必要时与国际科学机构进行磋商后，并在不超过一年的期限内将全部标本如期引进，才能签发。
Translation: (7) The certificate referred to in paragraph (6) of this Article shall only be issued when the Scientific Authority has consulted with the scientific authorities of other States involved and, where appropriate, international scientific authorities, and provided that the import of all specimens is completed within a period not exceeding one year.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条附录三所列物种标本的贸易规定(一)附录三所列物种标本的贸易，均应遵守本条各项规定。
Translation:
Article 5 Regulations on Trade in Specimens of Species Listed in Appendix III  

(1) Trade in specimens of species listed in Appendix III shall comply with the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (二)附录三所列物种的任何标本，从将该物种列入附录三的任何国家出口时，应事先获得并交验出口许可证。
Translation: (2) Any specimen of a species included in Appendix III shall require the prior grant and presentation of an export permit when exported from any State that has included that species in Appendix III.

Query_Text_cn: 2.出口国的管理机构确认，任一活标本会得到妥善装运，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: 2. The competent authority of the exporting country confirms that each live specimen will be properly transported to minimize injury, health impairment, or cruel treatment.

Query_Text_cn: (三)除本条第(四)款涉及的情况外，附录三所列物种的任何标本的进口，应事先交验原产地证明书。如该出口国已将该物种列入附录三，则应交验该国所发给的出口许可证。
Translation: (3) Except in the case of circumstances referred to in paragraph (4) of this Article, the import of any specimen of a species included in Appendix III shall require the prior presentation of a certificate of origin. In the case of export from a State which has included that species in Appendix III, an export permit issued by that State shall also be required.

Query_Text_cn: (四)如系再出口，由再出口国的管理机构签发有关该标本曾在该国加工或正在进行再出口的证明书，以此向进口国证明有关该标本的再出口符合本公约的各项规定。
Translation: (d) In the case of re-export, a certificate issued by the Management Authority of the State of re-export that the specimen was processed in that State or is being re-exported shall be provided to the importing country as evidence that the re-export of the specimen complies with the provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条许可证和证明书(一)根据第三条、第四条和第五条的各项规定签发的许可证和证明书必须符合本条各项规定。
Translation:
Article VI Licenses and Certificates  
(1) Licenses and certificates issued pursuant to the provisions of Articles III, IV, and V shall comply with the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (二)出口许可证应包括附录四规定的式样中所列的内容，出口许可证只用于出口，并自签发之日起半年内有效。
Translation: (II) The export license shall include the contents specified in the form set out in Appendix IV. The export license shall be used solely for export and shall remain valid for six months from the date of issuance.

Query_Text_cn: (三)每个出口许可证或证明书应载有本公约的名称，签发出口许可证或证明书的管理机构的名称和任何一种证明印鉴，以及管理机构编制的控制号码。
Translation: (3) Each export permit or certificate shall contain the title of this Convention, the name of the issuing administrative authority, any official stamp, and a unique control number assigned by the authority.

Query_Text_cn: (四)管理机构发给的许可证或证明书的副本应清楚地注明其为副本。除经特许者外，该副本不得代替原本使用。
Translation: (4) Copies of licenses or certificates issued by the administrative authority shall be clearly marked as copies. Except when specially authorized, such copies shall not be used in place of the originals.

Query_Text_cn: (五)交付每批标本，均应备有单独的许可证或证明书。
Translation: (v) Each batch of specimens delivered shall be accompanied by a separate license or certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (六)任一标本的进口国管理机构，应注销并保存出口许可证或再出口证明书，以及有关该标本的进口许可证。
Translation: (6) The management authority of any State importing any specimen shall cancel and retain the export permit or re-export certificate and any corresponding import permit presented in respect of that specimen.

Query_Text_cn: (七)在可行的适当地方，管理机构可在标本上盖上标记，以助识别，此类"标记”系指任何难以除去的印记，铅封或识别该标本的其他合适的办法，尽量防止无权发证者进行伪造。
Translation: (VII) Where appropriate and feasible, the management authority may affix a mark to specimens to facilitate identification. Such "marks" shall mean any indelible imprint, lead seal, or other suitable means of identifying the specimen designed to render forgery by unauthorized certificating authorities as difficult as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条豁免及与贸易有关的其他专门规定(一)第三条、第四条和第五条的各项规定不适用于在成员国领土内受海关控制的标本的过境或转运。
Translation:
Article 7 Exemptions and Other Special Provisions Relating to Trade  
(1) The provisions of Articles 3, 4, and 5 shall not apply to specimens in transit or transshipment within the territory of a Member State under customs control.

Query_Text_cn: (二)出口国或再出口国的管理机构确认，某一标本是在本公约的规定对其生效前获得的，并具有该管理机构为此签发的证明书。则第三条、第四条和第五条的各项规定不适用于该标本。
Translation: (ii) The specimen was acquired before the provisions of the Convention came into force in the exporting or re-exporting country, as certified by the competent authority of that country issuing a certificate to that effect. In such cases, the provisions of Articles III, IV, and V shall not apply to the specimen.

Query_Text_cn: (3)在野生状态中获得的这些标本出口前，该国应事先获得出口许可证。
Translation: (3) Prior to the export of specimens obtained from the wild, the country shall obtain an export permit in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 但管理机构确认，这些物种标本是在本公约的规定对其生效前获得的，则不在此限。
Translation: However, this shall not apply if the management authority confirms that the specimens of such species were acquired before the provisions of the Convention took effect for them.

Query_Text_cn: (四)附录一所列的某一动物物种的标本，系为了商业目的而由人工饲养繁殖的，或附录一所列的某一植物物种的标本，系为了商业目的，而由人工培植的，均应视为附录二内所列的物种标本。
Translation: (iv) Specimens of animal species listed in Appendix I that are bred in captivity for commercial purposes, or specimens of plant species listed in Appendix I that are artificially propagated for commercial purposes, shall be deemed to be specimens of species included in Appendix II.

Query_Text_cn: (五)当出口国管理机构确认，某一动物物种的任一标本是由人工饲养繁殖的，或某一植物物种的标本是由人工培植的，或确认它们是此类动物或植物的一部分，或是它们的衍生物，该管理机构出具的关于上述情况的证明书可以代替按第三条、第四条或第五条的各项规定所要求的许可证或证明书。
Translation: (V) When the management authority of the exporting country confirms that any specimen of an animal species has been bred in captivity or any specimen of a plant species has been artificially propagated, or confirms that they are part of such animals or plants or their derivatives, the certificate issued by the said authority regarding the above circumstances may substitute for the permits or certificates required under the provisions of Article III, IV, or V.

Query_Text_cn: (六)第三条、第四条和第五条的各项规定不适用于在本国管理机构注册的科学家之间或科学机构之间进行非商业性的出借、馈赠或交换的植物标本或其他浸制的、干制的或埋置的博物馆标本，以及活的植物材料，但这些都必须附以管理机构出具的或批准的标签。
Translation: (VI) The provisions of Articles III, IV, and V shall not apply to the non-commercial loan, donation, or exchange between scientists or scientific institutions registered with the national management authority of herbarium specimens, other preserved, dried, or embedded museum specimens, and live plant materials, provided that such specimens or materials are accompanied by a label issued or approved by the management authority.

Query_Text_cn: 3.管理机构已经确认，所有活的标本会得到妥善运输和照管，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: 3. The regulatory authorities have confirmed that all live specimens will be properly transported and cared for to minimize casualties, health impairments, or mistreatment.

Query_Text_cn: 2.规定对此类标本进行没收或退还出口国。
Translation: 2.It is stipulated that such specimens shall be confiscated or returned to the exporting country.

Query_Text_cn: (二)除本条第(一)款所规定的措施外，违反本公约规定措施的贸易标本，予以没收所用的费用，如成员国认为必要，可采取任何办法内部补偿。
Translation: (2) In addition to the measures specified in paragraph (1), specimens traded in violation of the provisions of this Convention shall be confiscated, and the expenses incurred may be subject to any internal compensatory measures deemed necessary by the Member State.

Query_Text_cn: (三)成员国应尽可能保证物种标本在贸易时尽快地通过一切必要的手续。
Translation: (c) Member States shall endeavor to ensure that specimens pass through any required formalities as expeditiously as possible during trade.

Query_Text_cn: 为便利通行，成员国可指定一些进出口岸，以供对物种标本进行检验放行。
Translation: To facilitate passage, member states may designate specific entry and exit ports for the inspection and clearance of species specimens.

Query_Text_cn: 各成员国还须保证所有活标本，在过境、扣留或装运期间，得到妥善照管，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: Member States shall also ensure that all living specimens are properly cared for during transit, detention, or shipment to minimize injury, health damage, or maltreatment.

Query_Text_cn: 2.该管理机构经与出口国协商后，应将标本退还该出口国，费用由该出口国负担，或将其送往管理机构认为合适并且符合本公约宗旨的拯救中心，或类似地方。
Translation: 2. After consultation with the exporting country, the Management Authority shall return the specimen to that country at its expense or send it to a rescue center or other place deemed appropriate by the Management Authority and consistent with the purposes of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3.管理机构可以征询科学机构的意见，或者，在其认为需要时，与秘书处磋商以加快实现根据本款第2项所规定的措施，包括选择拯救中心或其他地方。
Translation: 3. The management authority may consult scientific authorities or, when deemed necessary, engage with the Secretariat to expedite the implementation of measures stipulated in paragraph 2 of this Article, including the selection of rescue centers or other facilities.

Query_Text_cn: (五)本条第(四)款所指的拯救中心，是指由管理机构指定的某一机构，负责照管活标本，特别是没收的标本。
Translation: (5) The rescue center referred to in paragraph (4) of this Article means an institution designated by the Management Authority to care for live specimens, especially confiscated ones.

Query_Text_cn: 2.所发许可证或证明书的号码、种类，进行这种贸易的国家，标本的数量、类别，根据附录一、附录二、附录三所列物种的名称，如有要求，在可行的情况下，还包括标本的大小和性别。
Translation: 2. The number and type of the issued permit or certificate, the country involved in such trade, the quantity and category of specimens, the names of species listed in Appendix I, II, or III, and where requested and feasible, the size and sex of the specimens.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为执行本公约各项规定而采取的立法、规章和行政措施的双年度报告。
Translation: 2. Biennial reports on legislative, regulatory and administrative measures taken to implement the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (八)本条第(七)款提到的情况，只要不违反有关成员国的法律，应予公布。
Translation: (8) The circumstances referred to in paragraph (7) shall be made public, provided that this is not contrary to the laws of the Member State concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 2.一个或若干个科学机构。
Translation: 2. One or several scientific institutions.

Query_Text_cn: (二)一国在将其批准、接受、核准或加入的文书交付保存时，应同时将授权与其他成员国和秘书处联系的管理机构的名称，地址通知保存国政府。
Translation: (2) When depositing its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, a State shall simultaneously notify the depositary government of the name and address of the administrative authority authorized to communicate with other member States and the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: (三)根据本条规定所指派的单位名称，或授予的权限，如有任何改动，应由该成员国通知秘书处，以便转告其他成员国。
Translation: (3) Any changes in the names of the units designated or the powers granted under this Article shall be notified by the Member State concerned to the Secretariat for communication to other Member States.

Query_Text_cn: (四)本条第(二)款提及的任何管理机构，在秘书处或其他成员国的管理机构请求时，应将其图章、印记及其他用以核实许可证或证明书的标志的底样寄给对方。
Translation: (4) Any management authority referred to in paragraph (2) of this Article shall, at the request of the Secretariat or the management authority of another member country, submit to it specimens of the stamps, seals or other devices used to authenticate permits or certificates.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条与非公约成员国贸易向一个非公约成员国出口或再出口，或从该国进口时，该国的权力机构所签发的类似文件，在实质上符合本公约对许可证和证明书的要求，就可代替任一成员国出具的文件而予接受。
Translation:
Article 10 Trade with Non-Party States  
When exporting, re-exporting to, or importing from a non-Party State, similar documents issued by the competent authority of that State may be accepted in lieu of those required from a Party State, provided such documents substantially comply with the Convention's requirements for permits and certificates.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条成员国大会(一)在本公约生效两年后，秘书处应召集一次成员国大会。
Translation:
Article 11 Meeting of the States Parties  
(1) The Secretariat shall convene a meeting of the States Parties two years after the entry into force of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (二)此后，秘书处至少每隔两年召集一次例会，除非全会另有决定，如有1/3以上的成员国提出书面请求时，秘书处得随时召开特别会议。
Translation: (2) Thereafter, the Secretariat shall convene regular meetings at least biennially, unless otherwise decided by the plenary session. Special meetings may be convened at any time upon written request by more than one-third of the member states.

Query_Text_cn: 5.在适当的情况下，提出提高公约效力的建议。
Translation: 5. Where appropriate, propose recommendations to enhance the effectiveness of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (四)在每次例会上，各成员国可根据本条第(二)款的规定，确定下次例会召开的时间和地点。
Translation: (4) At each regular meeting, member states may determine the time and venue of the next regular meeting in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (2) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (五)各成员国在任何一次会议上，均可确定和通过本次会议议事规则。
