Such accession shall have effect only as between the acceding State and those Contracting States which have not raised an objection to the accession within twelve months after the receipt of the notification referred to in Article 22. Any such objection shall be notified to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. A State may also object to an accession at the time of its ratification, acceptance, or approval of the Convention subsequent to its accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条如果一国具有两个或两个以上领土单位，而在这些领土单位中适用不同的法律制度，该国家在签署、批准、接受、认可或加入时，得声明本公约应扩展适用于所有领土单位，或仅适用于其中的一个或一个以上领土单位，并得在任何时候提出另一项声明以修正该项声明。任何此类声明应通知荷兰王国外交部并应明确说明本公约适用的领土单位。如果国家未根据本条作出声明，则本公约应扩及适用于该国的所有领土。
Translation:
Article 29  
If a State has two or more territorial units in which different systems of law are applicable, it may, at the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, declare that this Convention shall extend to all its territorial units or only to one or more of them, and may modify this declaration by submitting another declaration at any time. Any such declaration shall be notified to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and shall expressly specify the territorial units to which the Convention applies. If a State makes no declaration under this Article, the Convention shall extend to all territorial units of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条本公约应在第二十七条述及的第三份批准书、接受书、认可书或加入书交存后，第三个历月的第一天起生效。
Translation: Article 30 This Convention shall enter into force on the first day of the third calendar month following the deposit of the third instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession referred to in Article 27.

Query_Text_cn: （三）对公约根据第二十九条扩及适用的领土单位，自该条中述及的通知作出后第三个历月的第一天起。
Translation: (3) For any territorial unit to which the Convention is extended pursuant to Article 29, on the first day of the third calendar month following the date of the notification referred to therein.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条任何缔约国可以正式书面通知本公约保存处，即荷兰王国外交部的方式废止本公约。该项废止于保存处收到该通知书之日或于通知书中规定的更晚的日期起六个月期满后的第一天起生效。
Translation: Article 31 Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention by a formal notification in writing addressed to the depositary of the Convention, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. The denunciation shall take effect on the first day of the month following the expiration of six months after the date of receipt of the notification by the depositary or on such later date as may be specified in the notification.

Query_Text_cn: （七）第三十一条述及的废止。下列经各自政府正式授权的代表在本公约上签署，以资证明。1985年7月1日订于海牙，以英文和法文写成，两种文本同属原本，并成一册，应存放于荷兰王国政府外交部档案库，其经核证无误的副本，应通过外交途径分送海牙国际私法会议第十五次会议时的会员国各一份。
Translation:
(7) The repeal referred to in Article 31.  

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned, being duly authorized by their respective Governments, have signed this Convention.  

DONE at The Hague on the first day of July 1985, in the English and French languages, both texts being equally authentic, in a single copy which shall be deposited in the archives of the Government of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, and of which a certified true copy shall be sent, through diplomatic channels, to each of the Member States of the Hague Conference on Private International Law at the date of its Fifteenth Session.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到文化财产实为构成文明和民族文化的一大基本要素，只有尽可能充分掌握有关其起源、历史和传统背景的知识，才能理解其真正价值。考虑到各国有责任保护其领土上的文化财产免受偷盗、秘密发掘和非法出口的危险，考虑到为避免这些危险，各国必须日益认识到其尊重本国及其他所有国家的文化遗产的道义责任。考虑到博物馆、图书馆和档案馆作为文化机构应保证根据普遍公认的道义原则汇集其收藏品，考虑到非法进出口文化财产和非法转让其所有权阻碍了各国之间的谅解，教科文组织的一部分职责就是通过向有关国家推荐这方面的各项国际公约以促进这一谅解，考虑到只有各国在国家和国际范围上进行组织，密切合作，才能有效保护文化遗产，考虑到教科文组织大会在1964年就此通过了一项建议，已收到关于禁止和防止非法进出口文化财产和非法转让其所有权的方法的各项进一步建议，这一问题业已作为第十九项议程项目列入本届会议议程，第十五届会议已决定就这一问题制订一项国际公约，在1970年11月14日通过本公约。
Translation:
Considering that cultural property constitutes one of the basic elements of civilization and national culture, and that its true value can be appreciated only in relation to the fullest possible information regarding its origin, history and traditional setting,  

Considering that it is incumbent upon every State to protect the cultural property existing within its territory against the dangers of theft, clandestine excavation, and illicit export,  

Considering that, to avert these dangers, it is essential for every State to become increasingly alive to the moral obligations to respect its own cultural heritage and that of all nations,  

Considering that museums, libraries and archives, as cultural institutions, should ensure that their collections are built up in accordance with universally recognized moral principles,  

Considering that the illicit import, export and transfer of ownership of cultural property impede understanding among nations, and that UNESCO is called upon to promote this understanding by recommending to interested States international conventions to this end,  

Considering that the protection of cultural heritage can be effective only if organized both nationally and internationally among States working in close co-operation,  

Considering that the General Conference of UNESCO has already adopted recommendations concerning the means of prohibiting and preventing the illicit export, import and transfer of ownership of cultural property,  

Considering that further steps need to be taken in this direction, including the preparation of an international convention,  

Having before it the nineteenth item on the agenda of the session concerning the preparation of a draft convention on the means of prohibiting and preventing the illicit import, export and transfer of ownership of cultural property,  

The General Conference, at its fifteenth session, having decided to prepare such a convention,  

Adopts this Convention on the fourteenth day of November 1970.

Query_Text_cn: 11.一百年以前的家具物品和古乐器。
Translation: 11. Furniture, artifacts, and antique musical instruments from a century ago.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条1.本公约缔约国承认文化财产非法进出口和所有权非法转让是造成这类财产的原主国文化遗产枯竭的主要原因之一，并承认国际合作是保护各国文化财产免遭由此产生的各种危险的最有效方法之一。
Translation:
Article 2  

1. The States Parties to this Convention recognize that the illicit import, export and transfer of ownership of cultural property is one of the main causes of the impoverishment of the cultural heritage of the countries of origin of such property, and that international co-operation constitutes one of the most efficient means of protecting each country's cultural property against all the dangers resulting therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为此目的，缔约国承担利用现有手段，特别是通过消除其根源、制止现有做法和帮助给予必要的补偿来反对这种做法。
Translation: 2. To this end, States Parties undertake to combat such practices by all available means, in particular by eliminating their root causes, putting an end to existing practices, and providing necessary redress to victims.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条本公约缔约国违反本公约所列的规定而造成的文化财产之进出口或所有权转让均属非法。
Translation:
Article III  
The import, export, or transfer of ownership of cultural property effected contrary to the provisions of this Convention by a State Party thereto shall be illicit.

Query_Text_cn: 5.经此类财产原主国主管当局的同意，作为赠送品而接收的或合法购置的文化财产。
Translation: 5. Cultural property received as gifts or legally acquired with the consent of the competent authorities of the country of origin of such property.

Query_Text_cn: 7.注意对任何种类的文化财产的失踪进行适当宣传。
Translation: 7. Ensure appropriate publicity regarding the disappearance of any type of cultural property.

Query_Text_cn: 1.发放适当证件，出口国将在该证件中说明有关文化财产的出口已经过批准。
Translation: 1. Issue appropriate documentation in which the exporting State shall specify that the export of the cultural property concerned has been authorized.

Query_Text_cn: 3.通过适当方法宣传这种禁止，特别要在可能出口或进口文化财产的人们中间进行宣传。
Translation: 3. Publicize such prohibitions through appropriate means, particularly among those who may export or import cultural property.

Query_Text_cn: 1.采取与本国立法相一致的必要措施防止本国领土内的博物馆及类似机构获取来源于另一缔约国并于本公约在有关国家生效后非法出口的文化财产。
Translation: 1. Take the necessary measures consistent with national legislation to prevent museums and similar institutions within their territories from acquiring cultural property originating in another State Party that has been illegally exported after the entry into force of this Convention in the States concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约对两国均已生效后，尽可能随时把自两国中的原主缔约国非法运出文化财产的建议通知该原主缔约国。
Translation: After this Convention has entered into force for both States concerned, the requesting State Party shall, as far as possible, inform the requested State Party of any proposal to illegally remove cultural property from the territory of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: （2）本公约对有关两个国家生效后，根据两国中的原主缔约国的要求，采取适当措施收回并归还进口的此类文化财产，但要求国须向不知情的买主或对该财产具有合法权利者给予公平的赔偿。
Translation: (2) After this Convention enters into force between the two States concerned, the original State Party may request the return of such imported cultural property and take appropriate measures to recover and return it, provided that the requesting State shall pay fair compensation to an innocent purchaser or to a person who has valid title to that property.

Query_Text_cn: 要求收回和归还失物必须通过外交部门进行，提出要求一方应提供使确定其收回或归还失物的要求的必要文件及其他证据，费用自理。
Translation: The recovery and return of lost property must be conducted through diplomatic channels, with the requesting party providing necessary documents and other evidence to substantiate their claim, at their own expense.

Query_Text_cn: 各方不得对遵照本条规定而归还的文化财产征收关税或其他费用。
Translation: No party shall impose customs duties or other charges on cultural property returned in accordance with the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 归还和运送文化财产过程中所需的一切费用均由提出要求一方负担。
Translation: All expenses involved in the return and transport of cultural property shall be borne by the requesting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条本公约缔约国承担对触犯上述第六条(2)和第七条(2)所列的禁止规定负有责任者予以惩处或行政制裁。
Translation: Article 8 The States Parties to this Convention undertake to impose penal or administrative sanctions on those responsible for breaches of the prohibitions set forth in Article 6(2) and Article 7(2) above.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约的任一缔约国在其文化遗产由于考古或人种学的材料遭受掠夺而处境危殆时得向蒙受影响的其他缔约国发出呼吁。
Translation: Article 9 Any State Party to this Convention whose cultural heritage is endangered by the looting of archaeological or ethnological materials may call upon other States Parties that are affected to take appropriate measures.

Query_Text_cn: 在此情况下，本公约缔约国承担参与协调一致的国际努力，以确定并实施必要的具体措施，包括对有关的特定物资的进出口及国际贸易实行管制。
Translation: In such circumstances, the States Parties to this Convention undertake to participate in a concerted international effort to identify and implement the necessary specific measures, including the control of imports, exports and international trade in the relevant specific materials.

Query_Text_cn: 在尚未达成协议之前，有关各国应在可能范围内采取临时性措施，以便制止对提出要求的国家的文化遗产造成不可弥补的损失。
Translation: Pending the conclusion of such agreements, the States concerned shall take provisional measures to the extent feasible to prevent irreparable damage to the cultural heritage of the requesting State.

Query_Text_cn: 1.通过教育、情报和防范手段，限制非法从本公约缔约国运出的文化财产的移动，并视各国情况，责成古董商保持一份记录，载明每项文化财产的来源、提供者的姓名与住址以及每项售出的物品的名称与价格，并须把此类财产可能禁止出口的情况告知该项文化财产的购买人，违者须受刑事或行政制裁。
Translation: 1. To restrain, by means of education, information and vigilance, the movement of cultural property illegally removed from any State Party to this Convention, and oblige antique dealers, subject to national legislation, to maintain a register recording the origin of each item of cultural property, names and addresses of the suppliers, description and price of each item sold, and to inform the purchaser of the cultural property of the possible export prohibition to which such property may be subject, with violations subject to criminal or administrative sanctions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.努力通过教育手段，使公众心目中认识到，并进一步理解文化财产的价值和偷盗、秘密发掘与非法出口对文化财产造成的威胁。
Translation: 2. Endeavor to raise public awareness and deepen understanding of the value of cultural property, as well as the threats posed by theft, clandestine excavation, and illegal export through educational means.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条一个国家直接或间接地由于被他国占领而被迫出口文化财产或转让其所有权应被视为非法。
Translation: Article 11 The export or transfer of ownership of cultural property imposed by a country occupying another country directly or indirectly shall be deemed illegal.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条本公约缔约国应尊重由其负责国际关系的领土内的文化财产，并应采取一切适当措施禁止并防止在这些领土内非法进出口文化财产和非法转让其所有权。
Translation:
Article XII  
The States Parties to this Convention shall respect cultural property situated within territories for which they are responsible internationally and shall take all appropriate measures to prohibit and prevent the illicit export, import, and transfer of ownership of such property in those territories.

Query_Text_cn: 4.承认本公约缔约国有不可取消的权利规定并宣布某些文化财产是不能让与的，因而据此也不能出口，若此类财产已经出口务须促使将这类财产归还给有关国家。
Translation: 4. Recognizing the inalienable right of each State Party to this Convention to classify and declare certain cultural properties as non-transferable, thereby prohibiting their exportation, and to secure the return of such properties to the relevant country should they have been exported.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条为防止非法出口、履行本公约所规定的义务，本公约各缔约国应在可能范围内为其负责保护文化遗产的国家机关提供足够的预算并在必要时为此目的设立一项基金。
Translation:
Article 14  
To prevent illicit export and fulfill the obligations under this Convention, each State Party shall, to the extent possible, provide adequate budgetary resources to its national authorities responsible for the protection of cultural heritage and, where necessary, establish a fund for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条在本公约对有关国家生效前，本公约之任何规定不应妨碍缔约国之间自行缔结有关归还从其原主国领土上不论以何种理由搬走之文化财产的特别协定，或制止它们继续执行业已缔结的有关协定。
Translation:
Article 15  
Nothing in this Convention shall prevent the States Parties thereto from concluding special agreements among themselves or from continuing to implement agreements already concluded regarding the restitution of cultural property removed, for whatever reason, from the territory of its country of origin, provided that such agreements are consistent with the provisions of this Convention prior to its entry into force for the States concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条本公约缔约国应在向联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会提交的定期报告中，提供它们已经通过的立法和行政规定和它们为实施本公约所采取的其它行动以及在此领域内取得的详尽经验的资料，报告的日期及方式由大会决定。
Translation: Article 16 States Parties to this Convention shall include in their periodic reports to the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, at the dates and in the form determined by the Conference, information on the legislative and administrative provisions they have adopted and other actions they have taken to implement this Convention, as well as detailed data on the experience acquired in this field.

Query_Text_cn: (3)协调和斡旋。
Translation: (3) Coordination and mediation.

Query_Text_cn: 2.联合国教育、科学及文化组织可以主动进行有关非法转移文化财产问题的研究并出版研究报告。
Translation: 2. The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization may initiate studies and publish reports on issues concerning the illicit transfer of cultural property.

Query_Text_cn: 3.为此，联合国教育、科学及文化组织可以请求任何非政府的主管组织予以合作。
Translation: 3. To this end, the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization may request the cooperation of any competent non-governmental organization.

Query_Text_cn: 4.联合国教育、科学及文化组织可以主动向本公约缔约国提出有关本公约的实施的建议。
Translation: 4. The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization may, on its own initiative, make proposals to the States Parties to this Convention concerning its implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 5.经对本公约的实施有争议的两个以上的本公约缔约国的请求，联合国教科文组织得进行斡旋，使它们之间的争端得到解决。
Translation: 5. At the request of two or more States Parties to this Convention that are in dispute over its implementation, UNESCO may offer its good offices to facilitate the settlement of such disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条本公约以英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文制定，四种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Article 18 This Convention is drawn up in English, French, Russian and Spanish, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条1.本公约须经联合国教育、科学及文化组织会员国按各国宪法程序批准或接受。
Translation:
Article 19  
1. This Convention shall be subject to ratification or acceptance by Member States of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 2.批准书或接受书，应交存联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事。
Translation: 2. Instruments of ratification or acceptance shall be deposited with the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条1.本公约应开放给非联合国教育、科学及文化组织成员但经本组织执行局邀请加入本公约的所有国家加入。
Translation:
Article 20  
1. This Convention shall be open to accession by all States not members of UNESCO that are invited to join by the Organization's Executive Board.

Query_Text_cn: 2.加入书交存联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事后，加入即行生效。
Translation: 2. The accession shall take effect upon the deposit of the instrument of accession with the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条本公约在收到第三份批准书、接受书或加入书后的三个月开始生效，但这只对那些在该日或该日之前业已交存其各自的批准书、接受书或加入书的国家生效。
Translation: Article 21 This Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of the third instrument of ratification, acceptance or accession, but only with respect to those States which have deposited their respective instruments of ratification, acceptance or accession on or before that date.

Query_Text_cn: 如有必要，缔约国须在批准、接受或加入之时或以前与这些领土的政府或其他主管当局进行磋商，以便保证本公约在这些领土的适用，并将本公约适用的领土通知联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事，该通知在收到之日起三个月生效。
Translation: Where necessary, the Contracting States shall, at the time of ratification, acceptance or accession or thereafter, consult with the governments or other competent authorities of these territories to ensure the application of this Convention therein. They shall notify the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization of the territories to which the Convention is applied, and such notification shall take effect three months after the date of its receipt.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条1.本公约之每一缔约国可以代表本国或代表由其负责国际关系的任何领土退出本公约。
Translation:
Article 23  
1. Any Contracting State to this Convention may denounce it on behalf of itself or on behalf of any territory for whose international relations it is responsible.

Query_Text_cn: 2.退约须以书面文件通知，该退约书交存联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事处。
Translation: 2. Denunciation shall be effected by a written instrument, which shall be deposited with the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事须将第十九条和二十条中规定的有关批准书、接受书和加入书的交存情况以及第二十二条和第二十三条分别规定的通知和退约告知本组织会员国、第二十条中所述的非本组织会员的国家以及联合国。
Translation:
Article 24  
The Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization shall inform the Member States of the Organization, the non-Member States referred to in Article 20, and the United Nations of the deposit of all instruments of ratification, acceptance, or accession provided for in Articles 19 and 20, as well as of the notifications and denunciations respectively specified in Articles 22 and 23.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条1.本公约可经联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会予以修正。
Translation:
Article 25  
1. This Convention may be amended by the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如大会通过一项全面或部分地修订本公约的新公约，则除非新公约另有规定，本公约在新的修订公约生效之日起停止一切批准、接受或加入。
Translation: 2. If the Conference adopts a new convention revising this Convention in whole or in part, then, unless the new convention otherwise provides, the present Convention shall cease to be open to ratification, acceptance or accession as from the date on which the new revising convention enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条经联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事的要求，本公约应按照《联合国宪章》第一百零二条的规定在联合国秘书处登记。1970年11月17日订于巴黎。
Translation: Article 26 At the request of the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, this Convention shall be registered with the Secretariat of the United Nations in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations. Done at Paris, this seventeenth day of November 1970.

Query_Text_cn: 两个正式文本均有大会第十六届会议主席和联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事的签名，将交存于联合国教育、科学及文化组织的档案库中。验证无误之副本将分送第十九条到第二十条所述之所有国家和联合国。以上乃1970年11月14日在巴黎召开的联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会第十六届会议正式通过之公约的作准文本。
Translation: Both authentic texts, bearing the signatures of the President of the Sixteenth Session of the General Conference and the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, shall be deposited in the archives of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization. Certified true copies shall be transmitted to all the States referred to in Articles 19 and 20, as well as to the United Nations. This is the authentic text of the Convention duly adopted by the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization at its sixteenth session, held in Paris on 14 November 1970.

Query_Text_cn: (c)“国际核运输”是指使用任何运输工具打算将一批核材料运至发货启运国国境以外的载运过程,从离开该国境内托运人设施开始,一直到抵达最后目的的国境内收受人设施为止。
Translation: (c) "International nuclear transport" means the carriage of a consignment of nuclear material by any means of transportation intended to go beyond the territory of the State where the shipment originates, from the time it leaves the shipper's facility in that State until it arrives at the recipient's facility in the State of ultimate destination.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条1．本公约应适用于国际核运输中的用于和平目的的核材料。
Translation:
Article 2  
1. This Convention shall apply to nuclear material used for peaceful purposes during international nuclear transport.

Query_Text_cn: 2．除第三条和第四条以及第五条第3款外，本公约亦应适用于国内使用、储存和运输中的用于和平目的的核材料。
Translation: 2. Except for Articles III and IV and paragraph 3 of Article V, this Convention shall also apply to nuclear material used, stored and transported domestically for peaceful purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 3．除缔约国在第2款所包括各条中就国内使用、储存和运输中的用于和平目的的核材料所明白作出的承诺外，本公约的任何规定不应解释为影响国家对国内使用、储存和运输这种核材料的主权权利。
Translation: 3. Except as expressly provided for in the commitments undertaken by States Parties under the provisions covered by paragraph 2 regarding nuclear material used for peaceful purposes in domestic use, storage and transport, nothing in this Convention shall be construed as affecting the sovereign rights of States over such nuclear material in domestic use, storage and transport.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条每一缔约国应在其国内法范围内采取符合国际法的适当步骤，以便尽可能切实保证其国境内的核材料，或装载在往来该国从事运输活动并属其管辖的船舶或飞机上的核材料，在进行国际核运输时，均按照附件一所列级别予以保护。
Translation: Article 3 Each State Party shall take appropriate steps within the framework of its national law and consistent with international law to ensure as far as practicable that, during international nuclear transport, nuclear material within its territory, or on board a ship or aircraft under its jurisdiction insofar as such ship or aircraft is engaged in the transport to or from that State, is protected at the levels set forth in Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条1．任何缔约国不应输出或批准输出核材料，除非该缔约国已经取得保证：这种核材料将于国际核运输中获有附件一所列级别的保护。
Translation:
Article 4  

1. No State Party shall export or authorize the export of nuclear material unless the State Party has received assurances that such material will be protected during international nuclear transport at the levels specified in Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 2．任何缔约国不应从非本公约缔约国输入或批准输入核材料，除非该缔约国已经取得保证：这种核材料将于国际核运输中获有附件一所列级别的保护。
Translation: 2. No State Party shall import or authorize the import of nuclear material from a State not party to this Convention unless it has obtained assurances that such material will be protected, during international nuclear transport, at the levels specified in Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 3．任何缔约国不应允许来自非本公约缔约国的核材料经由其陆地或内河航道，或经由其机场或海港，运至另一非本公约缔约国，除非该缔约国已经取得尽可能切实的保证：这种核材料将于国际核运输中获有附件一所列级别的保护。
Translation: 3. No State Party shall permit nuclear material from a State not party to this Convention to transit through its territory by land or inland waterways, or through its airports or seaports, to another State not party to this Convention unless the State Party has obtained assurances as far as practicable that such nuclear material will be protected during international nuclear transport at the levels specified in Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 4．每一缔约国应在其国内法范围内，对自该国某一地区经由国际水道或空域运至本国另一地区的核材料，给予附件一所列级别的实质保护。
Translation: 4. Each State Party shall, within the framework of its national law, afford nuclear materials being transported from one area of that State through an international waterway or airspace to another area of the same State the levels of physical protection specified in Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 5．负责按照第1至第3款规定取得核材料将获有附件一所列级别保护的保证的缔约国，应指明并予先通知核材料予期运经其陆地或内河航道或进入其机场或海港的各个国家。
Translation: 5. States Parties responsible for obtaining nuclear material pursuant to paragraphs 1 to 3, which shall receive guarantees of protection at the levels specified in Annex I, shall identify and notify in advance all countries through whose land or inland waterways the nuclear material is expected to transit or whose airports or seaports it is expected to enter.

Query_Text_cn: 6．第1款所述取得保证的责任，可经双方同意转由该项运输中的输入缔约国承担。
Translation: 6. The responsibility for obtaining the guarantee referred to in paragraph 1 may, by mutual agreement, be transferred to the importing State Party involved in the transport.

Query_Text_cn: 7．本条的任何规定绝不应解释为影响国家的领土主权和管辖权，包括对其领空和领海的主权和管辖权。
Translation: 7. Nothing in this Article shall be interpreted as affecting the territorial sovereignty and jurisdiction of States, including sovereignty and jurisdiction over their territorial airspace and waters.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条1．各缔约国应直接或经由国际原子能机构相互指明并公布各自负责实质保护核材料并在核材料未经许可而被移动、使用或变更或确实受到此种威胁时负责协调追回和对策行动的中央负责机构和联系单位。
Translation:
Article 5  
1. Each State Party shall identify and make known to other States Parties, directly or through the International Atomic Energy Agency, its central authority and point of contact responsible for the physical protection of nuclear materials, as well as for coordinating response and recovery efforts in cases of unauthorized removal, use, or alteration of such materials or credible threats thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 2．各缔约国在核材料被偷窃、抢劫或任何非法盗取或确实受到此种威胁时，应依照本国法律尽可能向任何提出请求的国家提供合作和协助，以追回和保护这种材料。
Translation: 2. Each State Party shall, in accordance with its national laws, provide cooperation and assistance to the maximum extent feasible to any requesting State in the recovery and protection of nuclear material that has been stolen, robbed, or otherwise unlawfully taken or is under credible threat thereof.

Query_Text_cn: （三）保证归还因上述事件而被偷走或遗失的核材料。
Translation: (3) Ensure the return of nuclear materials stolen or lost due to the aforementioned incidents.

Query_Text_cn: 3．各缔约国应于适当时彼此直接或经由国际组织进行合作和协商，以便就核材料国际运输实质保护制度的设计、维持和改进达成指导方针。
Translation: 3. Each State Party shall, as appropriate, cooperate and consult directly or through international organizations to establish guidelines for the design, maintenance, and improvement of a system of physical protection for the international transport of nuclear material.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条1.各缔约国应采取符合其国家法律的适当措施,以保护由于本公约的规定而从其他缔约国得到的或经由参与执行本公约的活动而得到的任何机密情报的机密性。
Translation:
Article 6  
1. Each State Party shall adopt such appropriate measures as may be in accordance with its national laws to protect the confidentiality of any confidential information received from another State Party or obtained through participation in activities carried out pursuant to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国如向国际组织提供机密情报,则应采取步骤,以确保此种情报的机密性获得保护。
Translation: Where a State Party provides confidential information to an international organization, steps shall be taken to ensure that the confidentiality of such information is protected.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本公约不要求缔约国提供任何按照国家法律不准揭露或任何危及有关国家的安全或核材料的实质保护的情报。
Translation: 2. This Convention does not require a State Party to provide any information the disclosure of which is prohibited by its national law or which would compromise the security of the State concerned or the physical protection of nuclear material.

Query_Text_cn: 和(g)参与(a)至(f)项所称任何罪行。
Translation: and (g) participates in any of the offenses referred to in items (a) to (f).

Query_Text_cn: 2.每一缔约国对本条所称罪行应按其严重性规定适当惩罚。
Translation: 2. Each State Party shall establish appropriate penalties for the crimes referred to in this article, commensurate with their gravity.

Query_Text_cn: (b)被控犯人是该国国民。
Translation: (b) The accused is a national of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 2.每一缔约国应同样采取必要措施,以便在被控犯人在该国领土内而该国未按第十一条规定将其引渡给第1款所述任何国家时,对这些罪行确立其管辖权。
Translation: 2. Each State Party shall likewise take such measures as may be necessary to establish its jurisdiction over such offences in cases where the alleged offender is present in its territory and it does not extradite him to any of the States mentioned in paragraph 1 of this article in accordance with Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约不排除按照国内法行使的任何刑事管辖权。
Translation: 3. This Convention does not exclude any criminal jurisdiction exercised in accordance with domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 4.除第1和第2款所述缔约国之外,任何缔约国亦可按照国际法,在该国于国际核运输中为输出国或输入国时,对第七条所称罪行确立其管辖权。
Translation: 4. In addition to the States Parties referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2, any State Party may also establish its jurisdiction over the offences set forth in Article VII in accordance with international law when it is the exporting or importing State involved in international nuclear transport.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条任何缔约国,如被控人在其领土内,当判明情况有此需要时,应按照本国法律采取适当措施,包括拘留以确保该犯在进行起诉或引渡时随传随到。
Translation: Article 9 Any Contracting State in whose territory the alleged offender is present shall, if it determines that the circumstances so require, take appropriate measures under its national law, including detention, to ensure the presence of the offender for the purpose of prosecution or extradition.

Query_Text_cn: 按照本条采取的措施,应立即通知需要按照第八条确立管辖权的国家,适当时并应通知所有其他有关国家。
Translation: Measures taken pursuant to this Article shall be promptly notified to the State required to establish jurisdiction under Article VIII and, where appropriate, to all other concerned States.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条任何缔约国,如被控犯人在其领土内,而该国不将该犯引渡,则应毫无例外并毫无不当延迟地将案件送交该国主管当局,以便按照该国法律规定的诉讼程序,提起公诉。
Translation: Article 10 Any Contracting State in whose territory the alleged offender is present and which does not extradite him shall, without exception whatsoever and without undue delay, submit the case to its competent authorities for the purpose of prosecution, through proceedings in accordance with the laws of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条1.第七条所称各项罪行应被视为属于缔约国之间任何现有引渡条约中可引渡的罪行。
Translation:
Article 11  
1. The offences referred to in Article 7 shall be deemed to be included as extraditable offences in any extradition treaty existing between States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国保证将各罪行列于彼此之间今后缔结的每一引渡条约内,作为可引渡罪行。
Translation: Each Contracting Party undertakes to include the offenses as extraditable crimes in every extradition treaty to be concluded hereafter between them.

Query_Text_cn: 2.以条约的存在为引渡条件的缔约国,如收到未与其订有引渡条约的另一缔约国提出的引渡要求,可以选择将本公约作为引渡各该罪行犯人的法律依据。
Translation: 2. A State Party whose extradition is subject to the existence of a treaty may, if it receives a request for extradition from another State Party with which it has no extradition treaty, consider this Convention as the legal basis for extradition in respect of the offences set forth therein.

Query_Text_cn: 引渡应符合被请求国法律所规定的其他条件。
Translation: Extradition shall comply with other conditions stipulated by the laws of the requested country.

Query_Text_cn: 3.不以条约的存在为引渡条件的缔约国应承认各该罪行是彼此之间可以引渡的罪行,但应符合被请求国法律所规定的各项条件。
Translation: 3. States Parties that do not make extradition conditional on the existence of a treaty shall recognize such offences as extraditable between themselves, subject to the conditions provided by the law of the requested State.

Query_Text_cn: 4.为了缔约国之间进行引渡的目的,每项罪行应被视为不仅发生于犯罪地点,而且也发生于需要按照第八条第1款确立其管辖权的缔约国领土内。
Translation: 4. For the purpose of extradition between States Parties, each offence shall be deemed to have been committed not only in the place where it occurred but also in the territory of a State Party required to establish its jurisdiction under paragraph 1 of Article 8.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条任何人因第七条所称任何罪行而被起诉时,应保证他在诉讼的所有阶段受到公平待遇。
Translation: Article 12 Any person who is prosecuted for any of the offenses referred to in Article 7 shall be guaranteed fair treatment at all stages of the proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条1.各缔约国对就第七条所称罪行提起的刑事诉讼应彼此提供最大程度的协助,包括提供其所掌握的并为诉讼所必需的证据。
Translation:
Article 13  
1. States Parties shall afford one another the greatest measure of mutual legal assistance in connection with criminal proceedings brought in respect of the offences set forth in Article 7, including the supply of all evidence at their disposal necessary for the proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 被请求国的法律应适用于一切场合。
Translation: The laws of the requested state shall apply in all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 2.第1款的规定不应影响任何其他处理或今后处理全部或部分刑事互助事宜的双边或多边条约下的义务。
Translation: 2. The provisions of paragraph 1 shall not affect obligations under any other bilateral or multilateral treaty governing, in whole or in part, mutual legal assistance in criminal matters.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条1.每一缔约国应将其执行本公约的法律和规章通知保管人。
Translation:
Article 14  

1. Each State Party shall notify the depositary of the laws and regulations it has adopted to implement this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 保管人应定期将此种情报传送所有缔约国。
Translation: The custodian shall periodically transmit such information to all States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对被控犯人提起公诉的缔约国,应尽可能首先将诉讼的最后结果通知直接有关的各国。
Translation: 2. The State Party that institutes prosecution against the accused shall, to the greatest extent possible, notify the directly concerned States of the final outcome of the proceedings in the first instance.

Query_Text_cn: 该缔约国还应将最后结果通知保管人,由他转知所有国家。
Translation: The said Contracting State shall also communicate the final outcome to the depositary, who shall transmit it to all States.

Query_Text_cn: 3.罪行与国内使用,储存或运输的用于和平目的的核材料有关,而被控犯人和核材料均仍在罪行于其境内发生的缔约国领土内时,本公约的任何规定不应被解释为要求该缔约国提供与因该罪行提起的刑事诉讼有关的情报。
Translation: 3. When the offence is related to nuclear material used, stored or transported domestically for peaceful purposes, and both the accused person and the nuclear material remain within the territory of the State Party where the offence was committed, none of the provisions of this Convention shall be interpreted as requiring that State Party to provide information concerning the criminal proceedings instituted with regard to such an offence.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条各附件构成本公约的组成部分。
Translation: Article 15 The annexes constitute an integral part of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条1.本公约生效5年后保管人应召开缔约国会议以审查公约的执行情况并根据当时的普遍局势审查公约的序言、整个执行部分和附件是否仍然适当。
Translation:
Article 16  
1. Five years after the entry into force of this Convention, the Depositary shall convene a meeting of the States Parties to review its implementation and to assess whether the preamble, the entire operative part, and the annexes remain appropriate in light of the prevailing circumstances at that time.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条1.两个或两个以上缔约国之间发生有关本公约的解释或适用的争端时,此等缔约国应进行协商以期用谈判方法或争端各方都可接受的任何其他和平解决争端方法来解决争端。
Translation:
Article 17  
1. In the event of a dispute between two or more States Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention, the Parties concerned shall engage in consultations with a view to settling the dispute through negotiation or any other peaceful means acceptable to all parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何这种性质的争端,如无法以第1款所规定方式解决,经争端任何一方的请求,应提交仲裁或提交国际法院裁决。
Translation: 2. Any dispute of this nature not resolved in the manner set forth in paragraph 1 shall, at the request of any party to the dispute, be referred to arbitration or to the International Court of Justice for settlement.

Query_Text_cn: 争端提交仲裁时,如果在提出请求仲裁之日起6个月内,争端各方不能就仲裁的组织达成协议,则任何一方可以请求国际法院院长或联合国秘书长任命1名或1名以上仲裁员。
Translation: If a dispute is submitted to arbitration and the parties to the dispute fail to agree on the organization of the arbitration within six months from the date of the request for arbitration, any party may request the President of the International Court of Justice or the Secretary-General of the United Nations to appoint one or more arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 如果争端各方提出的请求相互冲突,向联合国秘书长提出的请求应为优先。
Translation: If the requests submitted by the parties to the dispute are in conflict, the request submitted to the Secretary-General of the United Nations shall take precedence.

Query_Text_cn: 3.每一缔约国在签署、批准、接受或核准本公约或加入本公约时,得宣布该国不认为受第2款所规定的一项或两项解决争端程序的约束。
Translation: 3. Each State Party may, at the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, approval or accession to this Convention, declare that it does not consider itself bound by one or both of the dispute settlement procedures specified in paragraph 2.

Query_Text_cn: 其他缔约国对就第2款所规定的解决争端程序作出保留的缔约国,应不受此种程序的约束。
Translation: Other Contracting States shall not be bound by such procedures vis-à-vis a Contracting State that has made a reservation to the dispute settlement procedures specified in paragraph 2.

Query_Text_cn: 4.任何按照第3款作出保留的缔约国可随时通知保管人撤回该项保留。
Translation: 4. Any State Party that has made a reservation under paragraph 3 may at any time notify the depositary of the withdrawal of such reservation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条1.本公约应于1980年3月3日起在维也纳国际原子能机构总部和纽约联合国总部开放给所有国家签字,直至公约生效之日为止。
Translation:
Article 18  
1. This Convention shall be open for signature by all States at the Headquarters of the International Atomic Energy Agency in Vienna and at the Headquarters of the United Nations in New York from 3 March 1980 until its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本公约须经签字国批准、接受或核准。
Translation: 2. This Convention shall be subject to ratification, acceptance or approval by the signatory States.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约生效后,将开放给所有国家加入。
Translation: 3. After the entry into force of this Convention, it shall be open for accession by all States.

Query_Text_cn: 4.(a)本公约应开放给综合性或其他性质的国际组织和区域组织签字或加入,但以此种组织由主权国家组成并在本公约所处理事项上有权谈判、缔结和适用国际协定为限。
Translation: 4.(a) This Convention shall be open for signature or accession by international organizations of an intergovernmental or other nature, provided that such organizations are composed of sovereign States and have competence to negotiate, conclude, and apply international agreements with respect to matters governed by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (b)此种组织对其权限范围内的事项,应自行行使本公约赋予缔约国的权利和履行本公约对缔约国规定的责任。
Translation: (b) Such an organization shall exercise the rights and perform the obligations conferred upon States Parties by this Convention within the scope of its competence.

Query_Text_cn: (c)此种组织在成为本公约缔约国时,应将一份载明该组织成员国家以及本公约对该组织不适用的条款的声明,送交给保管人。
Translation: (c) Upon becoming a Contracting Party to this Convention, such an organization shall submit to the depositary a declaration specifying the member States of the organization and the provisions of the Convention that do not apply to it.

Query_Text_cn: (d)此种组织除了其成员国的表决权之外,不应拥有任何表决权。
Translation: (d) Such an organization shall have no voting rights except those of its member states.

Query_Text_cn: 5.批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书应交存于保管人。
Translation: 5. Instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession shall be deposited with the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条1.本公约应自第21份批准书、接受书或核准书交存保管人之日后的第30日起生效。
Translation:
Article 19  
1. This Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of deposit of the twenty-first instrument of ratification, acceptance or approval with the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对于在第21份批准书、接受书或核准书交存之日后批准、接受、核准或加入公约的国家,本公约应自该国交存其批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书后的第30日起生效。
Translation: 2. For a State that deposits an instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession after the deposit of the twenty-first instrument of ratification, acceptance or approval, this Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day after the date of deposit by such State of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条1.在不妨碍第十六条的情况下,任何缔约国得对本公约提出修正案。
Translation:
Article 20  
1. Without prejudice to Article 16, any Contracting Party may propose amendments to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 提议的修正案应提交给保管人,由他立即散发给所有缔约国。
Translation: The proposed amendment shall be submitted to the depositary, who shall promptly circulate it to all States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如果大多数缔约国请求保管人召开会议以审议提议的修正案,保管人应邀请所有缔约国出席这种会议,该会议最早在发出邀请30日后举行。
Translation: If a majority of the Contracting Parties request the depositary to convene a conference to consider the proposed amendment, the depositary shall invite all Contracting Parties to attend such a conference, which shall be held no earlier than 30 days after the issuance of the invitations.

Query_Text_cn: 在会议中以全体缔约国的2/3多数通过的任何修正案,应由保管人迅速发给所有缔约国。
Translation: Any amendment adopted by a two-thirds majority of all Contracting Parties at the meeting shall be promptly communicated by the depositary to all Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 2.修正案对于交存批准、接受或核准修正案书的每一缔约国,应自2/3缔约国将其批准书、接受书或核准书交存保管人之日后的第30日起生效。
Translation: 2. The amendment shall enter into force for each State Party that deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance or approval on the thirtieth day following the date on which two thirds of the States Parties have deposited their instruments of ratification, acceptance or approval with the Depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 其后,修正案对于任何其他缔约国,应自该缔约国交存其批准、接受或核准修正案书之日起生效。
Translation: Thereafter, the amendment shall enter into force for any other Contracting State on the date when that State deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance or approval of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条1.任何缔约国得用书面通知保管人退出本公约。
Translation:
Article 21  
1. Any Contracting State may withdraw from this Convention by written notification to the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 2.退出应于保管人收到通知之日后180日生效。
Translation: 2. The withdrawal shall take effect 180 days after the date of receipt of the notice by the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: (g)根据第二十一条作出的任何退出。
Translation: (g) Any withdrawal made in accordance with Article 21.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条本公约的阿拉伯文、中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文6种文本具有同等效力，原本应交国际原子能机构总干事保管，由其将本公约经证明无误的副本分送所有国家。
Translation: Article 23 The Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish texts of this Convention are equally authentic. The original of this Convention shall be deposited with the Director General of the International Atomic Energy Agency, who shall send certified copies thereof to all States.

Query_Text_cn: 下列签署人，经本国政府正式授权，在本公约上签字，以资证明。
Translation: The undersigned, being duly authorized by their respective Governments, have signed this Convention in witness thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约于1980年3月3日在维也纳和纽约开放签字。
Translation: This Convention was opened for signature in Vienna and New York on 3 March 1980.

Query_Text_cn: （c）第一类材料：除了储存于上述第二类材料所规定的设有保护地区外，出入口只准确定可信的人士出入，负责看守的警卫也要同适当的后援部队联系密切。
Translation: (c) Category I materials: Access shall be restricted solely to verified and trustworthy individuals, except when stored in protected areas as specified for Category II materials. Security personnel on duty must maintain close coordination with appropriate backup forces.

Query_Text_cn: 同时又应采取具体措施，侦察和防止任何袭击、擅自出入或擅自搬走材料的行为。
Translation: At the same time, concrete measures should be taken to detect and prevent any acts of assault, unauthorized access, or unauthorized removal of materials.

Query_Text_cn: 预先发出装运通知，内中说明运输方式、预期抵达时间、收货证明书。
Translation: Issue an advance shipping notice specifying the mode of transport, estimated time of arrival, and proof of delivery.

Query_Text_cn: 关于防止和惩处侵害应受国际保护人员包括外交代表的罪行的公约关于防止和惩处侵害应受国际保护人员包括外交代表的罪行的公约（该公约于1973年12月14日订于纽约，1977年2月20日生效。我国于1987年8月5日交存加入书，同时声明对公约第十三条第1款予以保留。本公约于1987年9月4日对我生效。
Translation: Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of Crimes against Internationally Protected Persons, including Diplomatic Agents (The Convention was adopted in New York on December 14, 1973, and entered into force on February 20, 1977. China deposited its instrument of accession on August 5, 1987, with a reservation to paragraph 1 of Article 13 of the Convention. The Convention entered into force for China on September 4, 1987.)

Query_Text_cn: ２．"嫌疑犯”是指有充分证据可以初步断定为犯有或参与第二条所列举的一项或数项罪行的人。
Translation: 2. "Suspect" refers to a person against whom there is sufficient evidence to determine, for preliminary purposes, that he or she has committed or participated in one or more of the crimes listed in Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: （Ｅ）参与任何这类攻击为从犯。
Translation: (E) Participating as an accomplice in any such attack.

Query_Text_cn: ２．每一缔约国应按照这类罪行的严重性处以适当的惩罚。
Translation: 2. Each State Party shall impose appropriate penalties commensurate with the gravity of such crimes.

Query_Text_cn: ３．本条第１款及第２款并不在任何方面减除缔约国依据国际法采取一切适当措施，以防止应受国际保护人员的人身、自由或尊严受其他侵害的义务。
Translation: 3. Nothing in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this article shall derogate in any way from the obligations of States Parties under international law to take all appropriate measures to prevent other attacks on the person, freedom or dignity of internationally protected persons.

Query_Text_cn: （Ｃ）所犯罪行是对因代表本国执行第一条所规定的职务而享有应受国际保护地位的人员所犯时。
Translation: (c) When the offense is committed against a person who enjoys internationally protected status under the provisions of Article 1 by virtue of their official duties representing their state.

Query_Text_cn: ２．每一缔约国应同样采取必要措施，于嫌疑犯在本国领土内而本国不依第八条规定将该犯引渡至本条第１款所指明的国家时，对这些罪行确定其管辖权。
Translation: 2. Each State Party shall likewise take such measures as may be necessary to establish its jurisdiction over these offences when the alleged offender is present in its territory and it does not extradite him pursuant to Article 8 to any of the States mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: ３．本公约并不排除依照国内法行使的刑事管辖权。
Translation: 3. This Convention does not exclude any criminal jurisdiction exercised in accordance with domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: （Ｂ）交换情报，并协调为防止这些罪行发生而采取的适当行政或其他措施。
Translation: (B) Exchange information and coordinate appropriate administrative or other measures to prevent the commission of such crimes.

Query_Text_cn: １．境内发生第二条所列举的任何罪行的缔约国如有理由相信嫌疑犯已逃离其领土，应将有关所发生罪行的一切事实及可以获得的一切关于嫌疑犯身份的情报，直接或经由联合国秘书长送达所有其他有关国家。
Translation: 1. Any Contracting State in whose territory any of the offenses enumerated in Article 2 has been committed, if it has reason to believe that the suspect has fled from its territory, shall communicate all pertinent facts regarding the offense committed and all available information concerning the identity of the suspect directly or through the Secretary-General of the United Nations to all other concerned States.

Query_Text_cn: ２．遇有对应受国际保护人员发生第二条所列举的任何罪行时，拥有关于受害人和犯罪情况的情报的任何缔约国应设法按照其国内法所规定的条件，充分和迅速地将此种情报递送该受害人代表执行职务的缔约国。
Translation: 2. Whenever any of the crimes listed in Article 2 is committed against a person entitled to international protection, any State Party that possesses information concerning the victim and the circumstances of the crime shall, in accordance with its domestic law, endeavor to transmit such information fully and promptly to the State Party on whose behalf the victim was exercising official functions.

Query_Text_cn: １．嫌疑犯所在地的缔约国确信情况有此需要时，应采取其国内法所规定的适当措施保证嫌疑犯留在其领土内，以便进行起诉或引渡。
Translation: 1. When the State Party in whose territory the suspect is located deems it necessary, it shall take appropriate measures under its domestic law to ensure the suspect remains within its territory for the purpose of prosecution or extradition.

Query_Text_cn: （ｅ）有关的应受国际保护人员充任官员或代理人的国际组织。
Translation: (e) International organizations whose officials or agents are protected persons under international law.

Query_Text_cn: （ａ）立即与其隶籍国，或有权保护其权利的其他国家，或如为无国籍人时经其请求而愿意保护其权利的国家距离最近的适当代表取得联络；（ｂ）并由该国代表前往探视。
Translation: (a) Immediately contact the nearest appropriate representative of the State of which they are nationals, or of the State entitled to protect their rights if they are stateless persons, or of the State which they request to protect their rights if they are stateless; (b) And arrange for a visit by the representative of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条缔约国于嫌疑犯在其领土内时，如不予以引渡，则应毫无例外，并不得不当稽延，将案件交付主管当局，以便依照本国法律规定的程序提起刑事诉讼。
Translation:
Article 7  
If a State Party in whose territory the alleged offender is present does not extradite him, it shall, without exception whatsoever and without undue delay, submit the case to its competent authorities for the purpose of prosecution, through proceedings in accordance with the laws of that State.

Query_Text_cn: １．在各缔约国之间的任何现行引渡条约未将第二条所列举的罪行列为应该引渡的罪的范围内，这些罪行应视为属于应该引渡的罪。缔约国承允将来彼此间所订的每一引渡条约中都将这些罪行列为应该引渡的罪。
Translation: 1. To the extent that any existing extradition treaties between the Contracting Parties do not include the offenses listed in Article 2 as extraditable crimes, such offenses shall be deemed to be included as extraditable offenses. The Contracting Parties undertake to include these offenses as extraditable crimes in every extradition treaty to be concluded between them in the future.

Query_Text_cn: ２．以订有条约为引渡条件的缔约国从未与该缔约国订立引渡条约的另一缔约国接到引渡要求时，如果决定引渡，得视本公约为对这些罪行进行引渡的法律根据。引渡须依照被要求国法律所规定的程序和其他条件办理。
Translation: 2. When a State Party whose extradition is subject to the existence of a treaty receives a request for extradition from another State Party with which it has no extradition treaty, it may consider this Convention as the legal basis for extradition in respect of such offenses. Extradition shall be subject to the procedural provisions and other conditions required by the law of the requested State.

Query_Text_cn: ３．不以订有条约为引渡条件的缔约国应承认这些罪行为彼此间应该引渡的罪，但须依照被要求国法律所规定的程序和其他条件办理。
Translation: 3. States Parties for which extradition is not conditional on the existence of a treaty shall recognize such crimes as extraditable offences between themselves, subject to the procedural provisions and other conditions required by the law of the requested State.

Query_Text_cn: ４．为便于各缔约国之间进行引渡起见，每一罪行应视为不但发生于实际犯罪地点，而且发生于依照第三条第１款规定必须确定其管辖权的国家的领土内。
Translation: 4. For the purpose of extradition between States Parties, each offense shall be deemed to have been committed not only in the place where it occurred but also in the territory of any State Party required to establish its jurisdiction under paragraph 1 of Article 3.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条任何人因第二条所列举的任何罪行而被提起诉讼时，应保证他在诉讼的一切阶段中受到公平待遇。
Translation: Article 9. Anyone charged with any of the crimes set forth in Article 2 shall be guaranteed fair treatment at all stages of the proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: １．各缔约国应就为第二条所列举的罪行提起的刑事诉讼彼此提供最大限度的协助，包括供给缔约国所有而为诉讼所必需的一切证据。
Translation: 1. Each State Party shall afford one another the greatest measure of mutual legal assistance in connection with criminal proceedings brought in respect of the offences set forth in Article 2, including the supply of all evidence at its disposal necessary for the proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: ２．本条第１款的规定不影响任何其他条约所载关于互相提供司法协助的义务。
Translation: 2. The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not affect obligations concerning mutual legal assistance under any other treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条对嫌疑犯提起刑事诉讼的缔约国应将诉讼的最后结果送达联合国秘书长。联合国秘书长应将这项资料转送其他缔约国。
Translation: Article 11 The State Party initiating criminal proceedings against an alleged offender shall communicate the final outcome of the proceedings to the Secretary-General of the United Nations. The Secretary-General shall transmit this information to the other States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 但本公约一缔约国不得对并非那些庇护条约缔约国的本公约另一缔约国援引那些条约。
Translation: However, no State Party to this Convention may invoke those treaties against another State Party to this Convention which is not a party to those asylum treaties.

Query_Text_cn: １．两个以上缔约国间在本公约的解释或适用上所发生的任何争端，如未经以谈判方式解决，经缔约国一方要求，应交付仲裁。如果自要求仲裁之日起６个月内当事各方不能就仲裁的组成达成协议，任何一方得依照国际法院规约提出请求，将争端提交国际法院处理。
Translation: 1. Any dispute between two or more Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention, if not settled by negotiation, shall, at the request of any one of the Parties to the dispute, be referred to arbitration. If, within six months from the date of the request for arbitration, the Parties to the dispute are unable to agree on the organization of the arbitration, any one of those Parties may refer the dispute to the International Court of Justice by application in conformity with the Statute of the Court.

Query_Text_cn: ２．各缔约国于签署或批准本公约或加入本公约时，得宣布不受本条第１款的拘束。对于提出这项保留的任何缔约国，其他缔约国亦不受本条第１款的拘束。
Translation: 2. Any State Party may, at the time of signature, ratification or accession to this Convention, declare that it does not consider itself bound by paragraph 1 of this Article. With respect to any State Party that has made such a reservation, other States Parties shall not be bound by paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: ３．依照本条第２款的规定提出这项保留的任何缔约国，得向联合国秘书长发出通知，随时撤回这项保留。
Translation: 3. Any State Party that has made a reservation in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article may at any time withdraw such reservation by notification addressed to the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条本公约应听由所有国家于１９７４年１２月３１日以前在纽约联合国总部签署。
Translation: Article XIV This Convention shall be open for signature by all States at United Nations Headquarters in New York until 31 December 1974.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条本公约须经批准。批准书应送交联合国秘书长保管。
Translation:
Article 15  
This Convention shall be subject to ratification. The instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条本公约应听由任何国家随时加入。加入书应送交联合国秘书长保管。
Translation:
Article 16  
This Convention shall be open to accession by any State at any time. Instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: １．本公约于第２２份批准书或加入书送交联合国秘书长保管后第３０天发生效力。
Translation: 1. This Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of deposit of the twenty-second instrument of ratification or accession with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: ２．对于在第２２份批准书或加入书交存后批准或加入本公约的国家，本公约应于该国批准书或加入书交存后第３０天发生效力。
Translation: 2. For any State ratifying or acceding to the Convention after the deposit of the twenty-second instrument of ratification or accession, the Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the deposit of its own instrument of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: １．任何缔约国均可以书面通知联合国秘书长退出本公约。
Translation: 1. Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention by written notification to the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: ２．退约应于联合国秘书长接到通知之日起６个月后发生效力。
Translation: 2. The withdrawal shall take effect six months after the date on which the notification is received by the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （ａ）依照第十四条对本公约的签署，依照第十五条和第十六条交存批准书或加入书，以及依照第十八条所作的通知；（ｂ）依照第十七条本公约发生效力的日期。
Translation:
(a) Signatures of this Convention under Article XIV, deposit of instruments of ratification or accession under Articles XV and XVI, and notifications made under Article XVIII;  
(b) The date on which this Convention enters into force pursuant to Article XVII.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条本公约正本应送交联合国秘书长保管，其中文、英文、法文、俄文及西班牙文各本同一作准，联合国秘书长应将本公约正式副本送致所有国家。为此，下列代表，各秉本国政府正式授予的权力，谨签字于１９７３年１２月１４日在纽约听由各国签署的本公约，以昭信守。
Translation:
Article 20 The original of this Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations, the texts in Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish being equally authentic. The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall transmit certified copies thereof to all States.  

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned, being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments, have signed this Convention, opened for signature at New York on the fourteenth day of December, one thousand nine hundred and seventy-three.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条缔约国确认灭绝种族行为，不论发生于平时或战时，均系国际法上的一种罪行，承允防止并惩治之。
Translation: Article 1 The Contracting Parties confirm that genocide, whether committed in time of peace or in time of war, is a crime under international law, and undertake to prevent and to punish it.

Query_Text_cn: (e)强迫转移该团体的儿童至另一团体。
Translation: (e) Forcibly transferring children of the group to another group.

Query_Text_cn: (e)共谋灭绝种族。
Translation: (e) Conspiracy to commit genocide.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条凡犯灭绝种族罪或有第三条所列其他行为之一者，无论其为依宪法负责的统治者，公务员或私人，均应惩治之。
Translation: Article 4: Persons committing genocide or any of the other acts enumerated in Article 3 shall be punished, whether they are constitutionally responsible rulers, public officials or private individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约国承允各依照其本国宪法制定必要的法律，以实施本公约各项规定，而对于犯灭绝种族罪或有第三条所列其他行为之一者尤应规定有效的惩治。
Translation: Article V: The Contracting Parties undertake to enact, in accordance with their respective Constitutions, the necessary legislation to give effect to the provisions of the present Convention and, in particular, to provide effective penalties for persons guilty of genocide or any of the other acts enumerated in Article III.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条凡被诉犯灭绝种族罪或有第三条所列其他行为之一者，应交由行为发生地国家的主管法院，或缔约国接受其管辖权的国际刑事法庭审理之。
Translation: Article 6 Persons charged with genocide or any of the other acts enumerated in Article 3 shall be tried by a competent tribunal of the State in the territory of which the act was committed, or by such international penal tribunal as may have jurisdiction with respect to those Contracting Parties which shall have accepted its jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条灭绝种族罪及第三条所列其他行为不得视为政治罪行，俾便引渡。
Translation: Article 7 Genocide and the other acts enumerated in Article 3 shall not be considered as political crimes for the purpose of extradition.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国承诺遇有此类案件时，各依照其本国法律及现行条约，予以引渡。
Translation: The Contracting Parties undertake to extradite in such cases, each in accordance with its own laws and existing treaties.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条任何缔约国得提请联合国的主管机关遵照联合国宪章，采取其认为适当的行动，以防止及惩治灭绝种族的行为或第三条所列任何其他行为。
Translation: Article VIII Any Contracting Party may call upon the competent organs of the United Nations to take such action under the Charter of the United Nations as they consider appropriate for the prevention and suppression of acts of genocide or any of the other acts enumerated in Article III.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条缔约国间关于本公约的解释、适用或实施的争端，包括关于某一国家对于灭绝种族罪或第三条所列任何其他行为的责任的争端，经争端一方的请求，应提交国际法院。
Translation: Article IX Disputes between the Contracting Parties relating to the interpretation, application or fulfilment of the present Convention, including those relating to the responsibility of a State for genocide or for any of the other acts enumerated in Article III, shall be submitted to the International Court of Justice at the request of any of the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条本公约载有下列日期：1948年12月9日；其中文、英文、法文、俄文及西班牙文各本同一作准。
Translation: Article 10 This Convention, of which the Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish texts are equally authentic, shall bear the date of 9 December 1948.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条联合国任何会员国及曾经大会邀请参加签订的任何非会员国，得于1949年12月31日前签署本公约。
Translation: Article 11 The present Convention shall be open for signature by any Member of the United Nations and by any non-member State which has been invited by the General Assembly to become a party thereto, until 31 December 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: The instrument of ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 1950年1月1日后，联合国任何会员国及曾接上述邀请的任何非会员国得加入本公约。
Translation: After January 1, 1950, any member state of the United Nations or any non-member state that has received the aforementioned invitation may accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 加入书应交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: Instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条任何缔约国得随时通知联合国秘书长将本公约适用于该缔约国负责办理外交的一切或任何领土。
Translation: Article 12 Any Contracting State may at any time notify the Secretary-General of the United Nations that the present Convention shall extend to all or any of the territories for the international relations of which it is responsible.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条秘书长应于收存批准书或加入书满20份之日，拟具备忘录一件，分送联合国各会员国及第十一条所规定的各非会员国1份。
Translation: Article 13 The Secretary-General shall, upon the deposit of the twentieth instrument of ratification or accession, draw up a procès-verbal and transmit copies thereof to all the Members of the United Nations and to all the non-member States referred to in Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约应自第20份批准书或加入书交存之日起，90日后发生效力。
Translation: This Convention shall enter into force 90 days after the deposit of the twentieth instrument of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约生效后的任何批准或加入，应于各该批准书或加入书交存后第90日起发生效力。
Translation: Any ratification or accession subsequent to the entry into force of this Convention shall take effect on the ninetieth day following the deposit of the relevant instrument of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条本公约自发生效力之日起10年内有效。
Translation: Article 14 This Convention shall remain in force for a period of ten years from the date of its entry into effect.

Query_Text_cn: 退约声明须在有效时期届满至少6个月前为之。退约应以书面通知联合国秘书长。
Translation: A notice of withdrawal must be made at least six months before the expiration of the current period. The withdrawal shall be notified in writing to the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条如因退约结果，致本公约的缔约国数目不满16国时，本公约应于最后的退约通知生效之日起失效。
Translation: Article 15 Should the number of Contracting Parties to this Convention fall below 16 as a result of denunciations, the Convention shall cease to be in force from the date on which the last of such denunciations takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条任何缔约国得随时以书面通知秘书长请求修改本公约。
Translation: Article 16 Any Contracting State may at any time request the amendment of this Convention by notifying the Secretary-General in writing.

Query_Text_cn: 大会对于此种请求，应决定采取何种步骤。
Translation: The Conference shall determine the steps to be taken in response to such requests.

Query_Text_cn: (f)依照第十六条所收到的通知。
Translation: (f) Notifications received pursuant to Article 16.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条本公约的正本应留存联合国档库。
Translation: Article 18 The original of this Convention shall be deposited in the archives of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约的正式副本应分送联合国各会员国及第十一条所规定的非会员国。
Translation: Certified copies of this Convention shall be transmitted to all Members of the United Nations and to the non-member States contemplated in Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条本公约应于生效之日，由联合国秘书长予以登记。
Translation: Article 19 This Convention shall be registered by the Secretary-General of the United Nations on the date of its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约各缔约国，决心采取行动以便在全面彻底裁军方面——包括禁止并消除一切种类大规模毁灭性武器在内——取得切实进展，并深信通过有效措施禁止化学和细菌（生物）武器的发展、生产和储存以及销毁这类武器将能促进在严格和有效国际监督下全面彻底裁军的实现。
Translation: The States Parties to this Convention, determined to act with a view to achieving effective progress towards general and complete disarmament, including the prohibition and elimination of all types of weapons of mass destruction, and convinced that the prohibition of the development, production and stockpiling of chemical and bacteriological (biological) weapons and their destruction, through effective measures, will facilitate the achievement of general and complete disarmament under strict and effective international control.

Query_Text_cn: 二、凡为了将这类物剂或毒素使用于敌对目的或武装冲突而设计的武器、设备或运载工具。
Translation: II. Any weapon, equipment, or means of delivery designed for the use of such agents or toxins for hostile purposes or in armed conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条本公约各缔约国承诺尽快但至迟应于本公约生效后9个月内,将其所拥有的或在其管辖或控制下的凡属本公约第一条所规定的一切物剂、毒素、武器、设备和运载工具销毁或转用于和平目的。
Translation:
Article II  
Each State Party to this Convention undertakes to destroy or divert to peaceful purposes, as soon as possible but not later than nine months after the entry into force of this Convention, all agents, toxins, weapons, equipment, and means of delivery specified in Article I of this Convention that are in its possession or under its jurisdiction or control.

Query_Text_cn: 在实施本条规定时,应遵守一切必要的安全预防措施以保护居民和环境。
Translation: In implementing the provisions of this Article, all necessary safety precautions shall be observed to protect residents and the environment.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条本公约各缔约国承诺不将本公约第一条所规定的任何物剂、毒素、武器、设备或运载工具直接或间接转让给任何接受者,并不以任何方式协助、鼓励或引导任何国家、国家集团或国际组织制造或以其他方法取得上述任何物剂、毒素、武器、设备或运载工具。
Translation:
Article III  
Each State Party to this Convention undertakes not to transfer, directly or indirectly, any of the agents, toxins, weapons, equipment or means of delivery specified in Article I to any recipient whatsoever, and not in any way to assist, encourage or induce any State, group of States or international organization to manufacture or otherwise acquire any of the agents, toxins, weapons, equipment or means of delivery referred to above.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条本公约各缔约国应按照其宪法程序采取任何必要措施以便在该国领土境内,在属其管辖或受其控制的任何地方,禁止并防止发展、生产、储存、取得或保有本公约第一条所规定的物剂、毒素、武器、设备和运载工具。
Translation: Article IV Each State Party to this Convention shall, in accordance with its constitutional processes, take any necessary measures to prohibit and prevent the development, production, stockpiling, acquisition or retention of the agents, toxins, weapons, equipment and means of delivery specified in Article I of this Convention, within its territory, under its jurisdiction or under its control anywhere.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条本公约各缔约国承诺,在解决有关本公约的目标所引起的或在本公约各项条款的应用中所产生的任何问题时,彼此协商和合作。
Translation: Article 5 The Contracting Parties to this Convention undertake to consult and cooperate with each other in resolving any problems that may arise in relation to the objectives of this Convention or in the application of its provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 本条所规定的协商和合作也可在联合国范围内根据联合国宪章通过适当国际程序进行。
Translation: The consultations and cooperation stipulated in this Article may also be conducted through appropriate international procedures within the framework of the United Nations in accordance with its Charter.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、本公约任何缔约国如发现任何其他缔约国的行为违反由本公约各项条款所产生的义务时,得向联合国安全理事会提出控诉。
Translation:
Article VI  
1. Any Contracting Party which finds that an act of another Contracting Party is in breach of obligations arising from the provisions of this Convention may lodge a complaint with the United Nations Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 这种控诉应包括能证实控诉成立的一切可能证据和提请安全理事会予以审议的要求。
Translation: Such a complaint shall include all possible evidence substantiating the claim and a request for its consideration by the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约各缔约国承诺,在安全理事全按照联合国宪章条款根据其所收到的控诉而发起进行的任何调查中,给予合作。
Translation: II. Each State Party to this Convention undertakes to cooperate in any investigation which the Security Council may initiate, in accordance with the provisions of the Charter of the United Nations, on the basis of complaints received by it.

Query_Text_cn: 安全理事会应将调查结果通知本公约各缔约国。
Translation: The Security Council shall communicate its findings to all States Parties to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条本公约各缔约国承诺,如果安全理事会断定由于本公约遭受违反而使本公约任何缔约国面临危险,即按照联合国宪章向请求援助的该缔约国提供援助或支持这种援助。
Translation: Article 7 Each State Party to this Convention undertakes to provide or support assistance, in accordance with the United Nations Charter, to any State Party which so requests, if the Security Council decides that such Party has been exposed to danger as a result of a violation of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条本公约中的任何规定均不得解释为在任何意义上限制或减损任何国家根据1925年6月17日在日内瓦签订的禁止在战争中使用窒息性、毒性或其他气体和细菌作战方法的议定书所承担的义务。
Translation: Article 8 Nothing in this Convention shall be interpreted as in any way limiting or detracting from the obligations assumed by any State under the Protocol for the Prohibition of the Use in War of Asphyxiating, Poisonous or Other Gases, and of Bacteriological Methods of Warfare, signed at Geneva on 17 June 1925.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约各缔约国确认有效禁止化学武器的公认目标,并为此目的承诺继续真诚地谈判,以便早日就禁止发展、生产、储存这类武器和销毁这类武器的有效措施,以及就有关为武器目的生产或使用化学剂所特别设计的设备和运载工具的适当措施,达成协议。
Translation:
Article IX  
The States Parties to this Convention affirm the recognized objective of the effective prohibition of chemical weapons and, to this end, undertake to continue negotiations in good faith with a view to reaching early agreement on effective measures for the prohibition of their development, production, stockpiling, and destruction, as well as on appropriate measures regarding equipment and means of delivery specifically designed for the production or use of chemical agents for weapons purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条一、本公约各缔约国承诺促进——并有权参与——尽可能充分地交换关于细菌(生物)剂和毒素使用于和平目的方面的设备、材料和科技情报。
Translation:
Article X  

1. Each State Party to this Convention undertakes to facilitate—and has the right to participate in—the fullest possible exchange of equipment, materials, and scientific and technological information for the use of bacteriological (biological) agents and toxins for peaceful purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 有条件这样做的各缔约国也应该进行合作,个别地或同其他国家或国际组织一起,在为预防疾病或为其他和平目的而进一步发展和应用细菌学(生物学)领域内的科学发现方面,作出贡献。
Translation: States Parties in a position to do so should also cooperate, individually or together with other States or international organizations, in contributing to the further development and application of scientific discoveries in bacteriological (biological) fields for the prevention of disease or for other peaceful purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在实施本公约时,应设法避免妨碍本公约各缔约国的经济或技术发展,或有关细菌(生物)的和平活动领域内的国际合作,包括关于按照本公约条款使用于和平目的的细菌(生物)剂和毒素以及加工、使用或生产细菌(生物)剂和毒素的设备方面的国际交换在内。
Translation: 2. In implementing this Convention, efforts shall be made to avoid hampering the economic or technological development of States Parties to the Convention or international cooperation in the field of peaceful bacteriological (biological) activities, including the international exchange of bacteriological (biological) agents and toxins and equipment for the processing, use or production of bacteriological (biological) agents and toxins for peaceful purposes in accordance with the provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条任何缔约国得对本公约提出修正案。
Translation: Article 11 Any Contracting State may propose amendments to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 修正案应自其为本公约多数缔约国所接受之时起,对接受修正案的各缔约国生效,此后,对其余各缔约国则应自其接受之日起生效。
Translation: The amendment shall enter into force for those States Parties that have accepted it on the date when a majority of the States Parties to this Convention have accepted it, and thereafter for each remaining State Party on the date when it accepts the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条本公约生效满5年后,或在这以前经本公约多数缔约国向保存国政府提出建议,应在瑞士日内瓦举行本公约缔约国会议,审查本公约的实施情况,以保证本公约序言的宗旨和各项条款——包括关于就化学武器进行谈判的条款——正在得到实现。
Translation:
Article 12  
Five years after the entry into force of this Convention, or earlier if proposed by a majority of States Parties to the Depositary Government, a conference of the States Parties shall be convened in Geneva, Switzerland, to review the operation of this Convention with a view to ensuring that the objectives set forth in the preamble and the provisions of the Convention, including those concerning negotiations on chemical weapons, are being realized.

Query_Text_cn: 此项审查应考虑到任何与本公约有关的科学和技术的新发展。
Translation: The review shall take into account any new scientific and technological developments relevant to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条一、本公约应无限期有效。
Translation:
Article XIII  

1. This Convention shall remain in force indefinitely.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约各缔约国如断定与本公约主题有关的非常事件已经危及其国家的最高利益,为行使其国家主权,应有权退出本公约。
Translation: 2. Any State Party to this Convention shall have the right to withdraw from the Convention if it determines that extraordinary events, related to the subject matter of the Convention, have jeopardized the supreme interests of its country, in the exercise of its national sovereignty.

Query_Text_cn: 该国应在3个月前将其退约一事通知本公约所有其他缔约国和联合国安全理事会。
Translation: The country should have notified all other States Parties to this Convention and the United Nations Security Council of its withdrawal three months in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 这项通知应包括关于它认为已危及其最高利益的非常事件的说明。
Translation: The notification shall include an explanation of the extraordinary events it considers to have jeopardized its supreme interests.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条一、本公约应开放供所有国家签署。
Translation:
Article 14  

1. This Convention shall be open for signature by all States.

Query_Text_cn: 未在本公约按照本条第三款生效前签署本公约的任何国家,得随时加入本公约。
Translation: Any State which has not signed this Convention before its entry into force in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article may accede to it at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约须经各签署国批准。
Translation: II. This Convention shall be subject to ratification by each signatory State.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书和加入书应交美利坚合众国、大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国和苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟三国政府保存,该三国政府经指定为保存国政府。
Translation: The instruments of ratification and accession shall be deposited with the Governments of the United States of America, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, which are hereby designated as the depositary Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本公约应在包括经指定为本公约保存国政府在内的22国政府交存批准书后生效。
Translation: III. The present Convention shall enter into force upon the deposit of instruments of ratification by twenty-two Governments, including the Government designated as the depositary Government.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对于在本公约生效后交存批准书或加入书的国家,本公约应自其批准书或加入书交存之日起生效。
Translation: IV. For any State that deposits its instrument of ratification or accession after the entry into force of this Convention, the Convention shall enter into force on the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 五、保存国政府应将每一签字的日期、每份批准书或加入书交存的日期和本公约生效日期,以及收到其他通知事项,迅速告知所有签署国和加入国。
Translation: V. The depositary government shall promptly inform all signatory and acceding States of the date of each signature, the date of deposit of each instrument of ratification or accession, the date of entry into force of this Convention, and the receipt of any other notifications.

Query_Text_cn: 六、本公约应由保存国政府遵照联合国宪章第一百零二条办理登记。
Translation: VI. This Convention shall be registered by the depositary government in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条本公约的英文、俄文、法文、西班牙文和中文五种文本具有同等效力,应保存在保存国政府的档案库内。
Translation: Article 15 This Convention, of which the English, Russian, French, Spanish and Chinese texts are equally authentic, shall be deposited in the archives of the depositary government.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约经正式核证的副本应由保存国政府分送各签署国和加入国政府。
Translation: Duly certified copies of this Convention shall be transmitted by the depositary Government to the Governments of the signatory and acceding States.

Query_Text_cn: 承认及执行外国仲裁裁决公约*（注*：该公约于1958年6月10日订于纽约，1959年6月7日生效。1986年12月2日第六届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第十八次会议决定我国加入；中华人民共和国政府于1987年1月22日交存加入书，该公约于1987年4月22日对我生效。
Translation: Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards* (Note: *Adopted in New York on June 10, 1958, and entered into force on June 7, 1959. The 18th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the Sixth National People's Congress decided on December 2, 1986 that China would accede to the Convention. The Government of the People's Republic of China deposited its instrument of accession on January 22, 1987, and the Convention entered into force for China on April 22, 1987.)

Query_Text_cn: （１）由于自然人或法人间的争执而引起的仲裁裁决，在一个国家的领土内作成，而在另一个国家请求承认和执行时，适用本公约。在一个国家请求承认和执行这个国家不认为是本国裁决的仲裁裁决时，也适用本公约。
Translation: (1) This Convention shall apply to the recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards made in the territory of a State other than the State where the recognition and enforcement of such awards are sought, arising out of differences between natural or legal persons. It shall also apply to arbitral awards not considered as domestic awards in the State where their recognition and enforcement are sought.

Query_Text_cn: （２）"仲裁裁决”不仅包括由为每一案件选定的仲裁员所作出的裁决，而且也包括由常设仲裁机构经当事人的提请而作出的裁决。
Translation: (2) "Arbitral awards" shall include not only awards made by arbitrators appointed for each case but also those made by permanent arbitral bodies to which the parties have submitted their dispute.

Query_Text_cn: （３）任何缔约国在签署、批准或者加入本公约或者根据第１０条通知扩延的时候，可以在互惠的基础上声明，本国只对另一缔约国领土内所作成的仲裁裁决的承认和执行，适用本公约。它也可以声明，本国只对根据本国法律属于商事的法律关系，不论是不是合同关系，所引起的争执适用本公约。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting State may, at the time of signing, ratifying or acceding to this Convention or when giving notification under Article 10 of its territorial extension, declare on the basis of reciprocity that it will apply the Convention only to the recognition and enforcement of awards made in the territory of another Contracting State. It may also declare that it will apply the Convention only to differences arising out of legal relationships, whether contractual or not, which are considered as commercial under its national law.

Query_Text_cn: （１）如果双方当事人书面协议把由于同某个可以通过仲裁方式解决的事项有关的特定的法律关系，不论是不是合同关系，所已产生或可能产生的全部或任何争执提交仲裁，每一个缔约国应该承认这种协议。
Translation: (1) Each Contracting State shall recognize an agreement in writing under which the parties undertake to submit to arbitration all or any differences that have arisen or may arise between them in respect of a defined legal relationship, whether contractual or not, concerning a subject matter capable of settlement by arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: （２）"书面协议”包括当事人所签署的或者来往书信、电报中所包含的合同中的仲裁条款和仲裁协议。
Translation: (2) "Written agreement" includes arbitration clauses and agreements contained in contracts as signed by the parties or in exchanged letters and telegrams.

Query_Text_cn: （３）如果缔约国的法院受理一个案件，而就这案件所涉及的事项，当事人已经达成本条意义内的协议时，除非该法院查明该项协议是无效的、未生效的或不可能实行的，应该依一方当事人的请求，令当事人把案件提交仲裁。
Translation: (3) If a court of a Contracting State is seized of a case in respect of which the parties have made an agreement within the meaning of this article, it shall, at the request of one of the parties, refer the parties to arbitration, unless it finds that the said agreement is null and void, inoperative or incapable of being performed.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条在以下各条所规定的条件下，每一个缔约国应该承认仲裁裁决有约束力，并且依照裁决需其承认或执行的地方程序规则予以执行。对承认或执行本公约所适用的仲裁裁决，不应该比对承认或执行本国的仲裁裁决规定实质上较烦的条件或较高的费用。
Translation: Article III Each Contracting State shall recognize arbitral awards as binding and enforce them in accordance with the rules of procedure of the territory where the award is relied upon, under the conditions laid down in the following articles. There shall not be imposed substantially more onerous conditions or higher fees or charges on the recognition or enforcement of arbitral awards to which this Convention applies than are imposed on the recognition or enforcement of domestic arbitral awards.

Query_Text_cn: （一）经正式认证的裁决正本或经正式证明的副本。
Translation: (1) The original of the duly authenticated award or a duly certified copy thereof.

Query_Text_cn: （二）第二条所提到的协议正本或经正式证明的副本。
Translation: (2) The original or duly certified copy of the agreement referred to in Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如果上述裁决或协议不是用裁决需其承认或执行的国家的正式语言作成，申请承认和执行裁决的当事人应该提出这些文件的此种译文。译文应该由一官方的或宣过誓的译员或一外交或领事代理人证明。
Translation: (3) If the said arbitral award or agreement is not made in the official language of the country in which recognition and enforcement are sought, the party applying for recognition and enforcement of the award shall produce a translation of these documents into such language. The translation shall be certified by an official or sworn translator or by a diplomatic or consular agent.

Query_Text_cn: （五）裁决对当事人还没有约束力，或者裁决已经由作出裁决的国家或据其法律作出裁决的国家的管辖当局撤销或停止执行。
Translation: (v) The award has not yet become binding on the parties, or has been set aside or suspended by a competent authority of the country in which, or under the law of which, that award was made.

Query_Text_cn: （二）承认或执行该项裁决将和这个国家的公共秩序相抵触。
Translation: (2) The recognition or enforcement of the award would be contrary to the public order of this country.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条如果已经向第五条（１）（五）所提到的管辖当局提出了撤销或停止执行仲裁裁决的申请，被请求承认或执行该项裁决的当局如果认为适当，可以延期作出关于执行裁决的决定，也可以依请求执行裁决的当事人的申请，命令对方当事人提供适当的担保。
Translation: Article 6 If an application for the setting aside or suspension of the award has been made to a competent authority referred to in article V(1)(e), the authority before which the award is sought to be relied upon may, if it considers it proper, adjourn the decision on the enforcement of the award and may also, on the application of the party claiming enforcement of the award, order the other party to give suitable security.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本公约的规定不影响缔约国参加的有关承认和执行仲裁裁决的多边或双边协定的效力，也不剥夺有关当事人在被请求承认或执行某一裁决的国家的法律或条约所许可的方式和范围内，可能具有的利用该仲裁裁决的任何权利。
