Translation: (1) The provisions of this Convention shall not affect the validity of multilateral or bilateral agreements concerning the recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards to which the Contracting States are parties, nor deprive any interested party of the right to avail himself of an arbitral award in the manner and to the extent allowed by the law or the treaties of the country where such award is sought to be relied upon.

Query_Text_cn: （２）１９２３年关于仲裁条款的日内瓦议定书和１９２７年关于执行外国仲裁裁决的日内瓦公约，对本公约的缔约国，在它们开始受本公约约束的时候以及在它们受本公约约束的范围以内失效。
Translation: (2) The 1923 Geneva Protocol on Arbitration Clauses and the 1927 Geneva Convention on the Execution of Foreign Arbitral Awards shall cease to have effect between the Contracting States of this Convention, from the date on which they become bound by this Convention and to the extent that they are bound by it.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本公约在１９５８年１２月３１日以前开放供联合国任何会员国，现在或今后是联合国专门机构成员的任何其它国家，现在或今后是国际法院规章缔约国的任何其他国家，或者经联合国大会邀请的任何其他国家的代表签署。
Translation: (1) This Convention shall be open for signature until 31 December 1958 by any Member State of the United Nations, by any other State which is or hereafter becomes a member of any specialized agency of the United Nations, by any other State which is or hereafter becomes a Party to the Statute of the International Court of Justice, or by any other State invited by the General Assembly of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （２）本公约须经批准，批准书应当交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: (2) This Convention is subject to ratification, and the instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （１）第八条所提到的一切国家都可以加入本公约。
Translation: (1) All States referred to in Article VIII may accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （２）加入本公约应当将加入书交存联合国秘书长处。
Translation: (2) Accession shall be effected by the deposit of an instrument of accession with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （１）任何国家在签署、批准或加入本公约的时候，都可以声明：本公约将扩延到国际关系由该国负责一切或任何地区。这种声明在本公约对该国生效的时候生效。
Translation: (1) Any State may, at the time of signature, ratification or accession, declare that this Convention shall extend to all or any of the territories for whose international relations it is responsible. Such a declaration shall take effect when the Convention enters into force for the State concerned.

Query_Text_cn: （２）在签署、批准或加入本公约之后，要作这种扩延，应该通知联合国秘书长，并从联合国秘书长接到通知之后九十日起，或从本公约对该国生效之日起，取其在后者生效。
Translation: (2) Any such extension shall be notified to the Secretary-General of the United Nations after the signing, ratification or accession, and shall take effect as from the ninetieth day following the receipt of such notification by the Secretary-General, or on the date of entry into force of the Convention for the State concerned, whichever is the later.

Query_Text_cn: （３）关于在签署、批准或加入本公约的时候，本公约所没有扩延到的地区，各有关国家应当考虑采取必要步骤的可能性，以便使本公约的适用范围能够扩延到这些地区；但是，在有宪法上的必要时，须取得这些地区的政府的同意。
Translation: (3) Regarding regions to which this Convention does not extend at the time of signature, ratification, or accession, the relevant states shall consider the possibility of taking necessary steps to extend the application of this Convention to such regions, provided that, where constitutional requirements exist, the consent of the governments of these regions shall be obtained.

Query_Text_cn: （一）关于属于联邦当局立法权限内的本公约条款，联邦政府的义务同非联邦制缔约国政府的义务一样。
Translation: (1) With respect to the provisions of this Convention that fall within the legislative jurisdiction of the federal authority, the obligations of the federal government shall be the same as those of Contracting States that are not federal.

Query_Text_cn: （二）关于属于联邦成员或省立法权限内的本公约条款，如果联邦成员或省根据联邦宪法制度没有采取立法行动的义务，联邦政府应当尽早地把这些条款附以积极的建议以唤起联邦成员或省的相应机关的注意。
Translation: (2) With respect to those provisions of this Convention that fall within the legislative jurisdiction of constituent states or provinces, where there is no obligation under the federal constitutional system for the constituent states or provinces to take legislative action, the federal government shall, as soon as possible, bring such provisions to the attention of the competent authorities of the constituent states or provinces, accompanied by favorable recommendations.

Query_Text_cn: （三）本公约的联邦国家缔约国，根据任何其他缔约国通过联合国秘书长而提出的请求，应当提供关于该联邦及其构成单位有关本公约任何具体规定的法律和习惯，以表明已经在什么范围内采取立法或其他行动使该项规定生效。
Translation: (3) A federal State Party to this Convention shall, at the request of any other State Party transmitted through the Secretary-General of the United Nations, supply information on the laws and practices of the federation and its constituent units regarding any specific provision of the Convention, indicating the extent to which effect has been given to that provision by legislative or other action.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本公约从第三个国家交存批准书或加入书之日后九十日起生效。
Translation: (1) This Convention shall enter into force on the ninetieth day following the date of deposit of the third instrument of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: （２）在第三个国家交存批准书或加入书以后，本公约从每个国家交存批准书或加入书后九十日起对该国生效。
Translation: (2) After the deposit of the third instrument of ratification or accession, this Convention shall enter into force for each State ninety days after the deposit of its instrument of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: （１）任何缔约国可以用书面通知联合国秘书长退出本公约。退约从秘书长接到通知之日后一年起生效。
Translation: (1) Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention by written notification to the Secretary-General of the United Nations. The denunciation shall take effect one year after the date of receipt of the notification by the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （２）依照第十条规定提出声明或者通知的任何国家，随时都可以通知联合国秘书长，声明从秘书长接到通知之日后一年起，本公约停止扩延到有关地区。
Translation: (2) Any State which has made a declaration or notification under Article 10 may at any time thereafter notify the Secretary-General of the United Nations that the Convention shall cease to extend to the territory concerned one year after the date of receipt of the notification by the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （３）对于在退约生效以前已经进入承认或执行程序的仲裁裁决，本公约应继续适用。
Translation: (3) The Convention shall continue to apply to arbitral awards in respect of which recognition or enforcement proceedings have been instituted before the denunciation takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约国除了自己有义务适用本公约的情况外，无权利用本公约对抗其他缔约国。
Translation: Article 14 A Contracting State shall not be entitled to rely on the provisions of this Convention against another Contracting State except to the extent that it is itself bound to apply the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （五）依照第十三条所规定的退约和通知。
Translation: (v) Withdrawal and notification as provided for in Article 13.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本公约的中、英、法、俄和西班牙各文本同等有效，由联合国档案处保存。
Translation: (1) This Convention, of which the Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish texts are equally authentic, shall be deposited in the archives of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （２）联合国秘书长应当把经过证明的本公约副本送达第八条所提到的国家。
Translation: (2) The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall transmit certified copies of this Convention to the States referred to in Article VIII.

Query_Text_cn: 或者（b）依据制约此种损害责任的国内法，核装置经营人应对此种损害负责，假如这种法律在各方面同巴黎公约或维也纳公约一样有利于可能遭受损害的人。
Translation: or (b) the operator of the nuclear installation is liable for such damage under the domestic law governing liability for such damage, provided that such law is in all respects as favorable to persons who may suffer damage as either the Paris Convention or the Vienna Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （a）对核装置本身或在其现场与该装置有关的已使用或将被使用的任何财产造成的损害，或者（b）在核事故发生时对载有有关核材料的运输工具造成的损害。因为核装置经营人对此种损害的赔偿责任，依据巴黎公约或维也纳公约的规定，或在第1条（b）款的情况下，依据该款所述的国内法中同样的规定而被免除，故他对此种损害不负赔偿责任。
Translation: (a) damage to the nuclear installation itself or to any property on the site thereof which is used or to be used in connection with such installation, or (b) damage to the means of transport upon which the nuclear material involved was carried at the time of the nuclear incident. The operator of the nuclear installation shall not be liable for such damage because his liability for such damage is excluded pursuant to the provisions of either the Paris Convention or the Vienna Convention or, in the case of paragraph (b) of Article 1, pursuant to similar provisions of the national law referred to therein.

Query_Text_cn: 2.但是，本条第1款的规定，并不影响任何人对有意造成损害的行为或不为引起的损害，所应承担的责任。
Translation: 2. However, the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not affect the liability of any person for damage caused by an act or omission intended to cause harm.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条本公约的任何规定，不影响核动力船舶经营人对有关该船的核燃料或放射性产物或产生的废料的核事故引起的损害所承担的赔偿责任。
Translation: Article 3 Nothing in this Convention shall affect the liability of the operator of a nuclear ship for nuclear damage caused by a nuclear incident involving the nuclear fuel of, or radioactive products or waste produced in, such ship.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条本公约将取代在其开放供签字期间，已生效或处于开放供签字、批准或加入状态的任何海上运输的国际公约，但以与本公约相抵触的为限。
Translation: Article 4 This Convention shall supersede any international conventions on maritime transport that have entered into force or are open for signature, ratification or accession during the period when this Convention is open for signature, but only to the extent of any inconsistency with this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，本条的规定，不影响本公约缔约国对非缔约国根据此种国际公约所承担的义务。
Translation: However, the provisions of this article shall not affect the obligations of any State Party to this Convention towards non-State Parties under such international conventions.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条1.本公约在1972年12月31日之前，在布鲁塞尔开放供签字，并在政府间海事协商组织（下称"本组织”）总部伦敦继续开放供签字。此后继续开放供加入。
Translation:
Article 5  
1. This Convention shall be open for signature in Brussels until 31 December 1972 and thereafter at the Headquarters of the Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization (hereinafter referred to as "the Organization") in London. It shall thereafter remain open for accession.

Query_Text_cn: （b）签字而有待批准，接受或核准，并随后批准，接受或核准，或者（c）加入。
Translation: (b) signature subject to ratification, acceptance, or approval, followed by ratification, acceptance, or approval; or (c) accession.

Query_Text_cn: 3.批准、接受、核准或加入本公约，应向本组织秘书长提交一份相应的正式文件。
Translation: 3. Instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条1.本公约自五个国家在公约上签字并对批准、接受或核准不作保留，或者向本组织秘书长提交批准、接受、核准或加入书之日起，九十天后生效。
Translation:
Article 6  
1. This Convention shall enter into force ninety days after the date on which five States have signed it without reservation as to ratification, acceptance or approval, or have deposited instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession with the Secretary-General of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对此后签署本公约并对批准、接受或核准不作保留，或提交批准、接受、核准或加入书的任何国家，本公约应自此种签署或文件提交之日起，九十天后生效。
Translation: 2. For any State that subsequently signs this Convention without reservation as to ratification, acceptance or approval, or deposits an instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, the Convention shall enter into force on the ninetieth day following the date of such signature or deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条1.任何缔约国可在本公约对其生效之日后的任何时候，退出本公约。
Translation:
Article 7  
1. Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention at any time after the date on which it enters into force for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 2.退出本公约，应向本组织秘书长提交一份相应的书面通知。
Translation: 2. Withdrawal from this Convention shall be effected by submitting a written notification to the Secretary-General of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 3.退出本公约，应自本组织秘书长收到该通知起一年后，或该通知中规定的更长期限后生效。
Translation: 3. Withdrawal from this Convention shall take effect one year after the date of receipt of the notification by the Secretary-General of the Organization or on such later date as may be specified in the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 4.尽管某一缔约国依照本条规定退出本公约，但对在退出生效以前发生的核事故造成的任何损害，本公约的规定仍然适用。
Translation: 4.Notwithstanding the withdrawal by a Contracting Party in accordance with this Article,the provisions of this Convention shall continue to apply to any damage caused by a nuclear incident occurring before the withdrawal takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条1.联合国对其有权管辖的地域，或者本公约的任何缔约国对由其负责国际关系的领土，可在任何时候书面通知本组织秘书长，声明本公约扩大适用于此种领土。
Translation:
Article 8  
1. The United Nations, in respect of any territory under its jurisdiction, or any Contracting Party to this Convention in respect of any territory for which it is responsible for international relations, may at any time by written notification to the Secretary-General of the Organization declare that this Convention shall extend to such territory.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本公约自本组织秘书长收到此种通知之日，或者该通知中规定的其他日期起，扩大适用于通知中指明的领土。
Translation: 2. This Convention shall extend to the territories specified in the notification from the date on which the Secretary-General of the Organization receives such notification or from such other date as may be specified therein.

Query_Text_cn: 3.按本条第1款规定作出声明的联合国或任何缔约国，可在本公约扩大适用于上述领土之后的任何时候，书面通知组织秘书长，声明本公约终止对通知中指明的领土的适用。
Translation: 3. Any declaration made under paragraph 1 of this Article by the United Nations or by any Contracting State may be withdrawn at any time by a notification in writing addressed to the Secretary-General of the Organization, declaring that the Convention shall cease to apply to the territory specified in the notification after its extension to such territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条1.修订或修正本公约的会议，可由本组织召开。
Translation:
Article 9  
1. A conference for the purpose of revising or amending this Convention may be convened by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2.经不少于三分之一的缔约国要求，本组织应召开本公约缔约国会议，对本公约进行修订或修正。
Translation: 2. Upon the request of no fewer than one-third of the States Parties, the Organization shall convene a conference of the States Parties to this Convention for the purpose of revising or amending it.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条缔约国可以对和巴黎公约或维也纳公约有效作出的保留相对应的部分作出保留。
Translation: Article 10: A Contracting State may formulate a reservation corresponding to any reservation validly made under the Paris Convention or the Vienna Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 保留可在签署、批准、接受、核准或加入时作出。
Translation: Reservations may be made at the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条1.本公约应由本组织秘书长保管。
Translation:
Article 11  
1. This Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: （v）按本公约第8条第1款规定对任何地域的扩大适用，和按该条第4款规定对上述地域扩大适用的终止，以及本公约扩大与扩大终止的日期。（b）将经核证无误的本公约副本分送所有签字国和已加入本公约的国家。
Translation:
(v) Any extension of the application of this Convention to a territory under paragraph 1 of Article 8, and the termination of such extension under paragraph 4 of the same Article, including the dates on which such extension and termination take effect.  

(b) The transmission of certified true copies of this Convention to all signatory States and to all States that have acceded to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约一经生效，本组织秘书长应根据联合国宪章第102条规定，将一份经核证无误的副本送交联合国秘书处，供登记和公布。
Translation: 3. Upon its entry into force, the Secretary-General of the Organization shall transmit a certified true copy of this Convention to the Secretariat of the United Nations for registration and publication in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条本公约正本一份，用英文和法文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation:
Article 12  
This Convention is established in a single original copy, drawn up in the English and French languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织秘书处应备妥俄文和西班牙文正式译本，并同经签署的正本一并保管。
Translation: The Secretariat of the Organization shall prepare official translations of the text in Russian and Spanish, which shall be kept together with the signed original.

Query_Text_cn: 1971年12月17日订于布鲁塞尔。
Translation: Done at Brussels on the 17th day of December 1971.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条各缔约国应保证在其国内法中包含这样的规定，即允许按照本公约的规定，对第5条所述的有关在其领土内即将建造或正在建造中的船舶的权利，在由该国设立或控制之下的一公开的官方登记册上进行登记。
Translation:
Article 1  
Each Contracting State shall ensure that its domestic law includes provisions permitting the registration, in a public official register established or controlled by that State, of rights relating to vessels under construction or to be constructed within its territory as specified in Article 5, in accordance with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 此种权利的登记，可限于那些建造完毕时，根据登记国国内法，类型和尺度符合海船登记的船舶。
Translation: The registration of such rights may be limited to ships that, upon completion of construction, meet the type and size requirements for registration as sea-going vessels under the domestic law of the registering State.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条缔约国可将此种权利的登记限于船舶为某一国外购买者而即将建造或正在建造的情况。
Translation: Article 2 A Contracting State may limit the registration of such right to cases where the vessel is to be or is being constructed for a foreign purchaser.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，上述规定不影响登记国国内法中限制外国人获得此种权利或控制船舶建造的任何规定。
Translation: However, the above provisions shall not affect any stipulations in the domestic laws of the registering country that restrict foreigners from acquiring such rights or controlling ship construction.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本公约的规定，关于任何船舶的国内法律地位的登记效力，由船舶即将建造或正在建造地的国家的法律确定。
Translation: In accordance with the provisions of this Convention, the effect of registration on the national legal status of any vessel shall be determined by the law of the country where the vessel is to be or is being constructed.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条有关在某一缔约国领土内即将建造或正在建造的船舶的权利，不得在其他任何缔约国登记。
Translation: Article 3: Rights pertaining to a vessel under construction or to be constructed in the territory of a Contracting State shall not be registered in any other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条当建造一艘特定船舶的合同已经生效或者建造者声明已决定以其自己的资金建造这样一艘船舶时，有关即将建造或正在建造的船舶权利的登记应予允许。
Translation: Article 4 Registration of rights concerning a ship to be constructed or under construction shall be permitted when the contract for the construction of a specific ship has taken effect or the builder declares that it has decided to construct such a ship with its own funds.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，国内法可将在船舶下水地点已安置龙骨或已完成类似的建造工程作为登记条件。
Translation: However, domestic law may stipulate that the keel has been laid or similar construction work has been completed at the place of launching as a condition for registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条即将建造或正在建造的船舶上的物权、抵押权和质权，经申请可以进行登记。
Translation: Article 5: Property rights, mortgages, and pledges on vessels under construction or to be constructed may be registered upon application.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，在不影响本公约规定的情况下，有关实施程序的各种事项，应受实施地国家的法律的调整。
Translation: However, without prejudice to the provisions of this Convention, all matters relating to the procedures for implementation shall be governed by the law of the State where such implementation takes place.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条建造中船舶上已登记的抵押权和质权为一方，此种船舶的留置权和滞留权为另一方，双方之间的排列顺序应依照适用于建造完毕后经登记的船舶的规则确定。
Translation: Article 7 The ranking between registered mortgages and pledges on a vessel under construction on the one hand,and liens and rights of retention on such vessel on the other hand,shall be determined in accordance with the rules applicable to registered vessels after completion of their construction.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条国内法可以规定建造中的船舶上登记的各种权利应适用于位于船厂辖区内，并已用标志或其他方法清楚标明将要安装在该船上的材料、机器和设备。
Translation: Article 8 Domestic law may provide that the various rights registered on a ship under construction shall apply to materials, machinery and equipment located within the shipyard premises and clearly marked or otherwise identified as intended for installation on that vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条根据某一缔约国法律在该缔约国登记的第5条所列的各种权利及由此获得的优先权，应在所有其他缔约国得到承认。
Translation: Article 9: The various rights listed in Article 5 and the priorities derived therefrom, which are registered in a Contracting State under its laws, shall be recognized in all other Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条除强制变卖情况外，未经权利拥有人书面同意，缔约国不应允许撤销第5条所列权利的登记。
Translation: Article 10 Except in cases of compulsory sale, a Contracting State shall not permit the deregistration of the rights listed in Article 5 without the written consent of the rights holder.

Query_Text_cn: 在某一缔约国正在建造或已建造完毕的船舶不应在另一缔约国登记，除非前者缔约国已签发证书，表明依据第5条登记的权利已撤销或在船舶登记之日该种权利将被撤销。
Translation: A vessel under construction or already constructed in one Contracting State shall not be registered in another Contracting State unless the former State has issued a certificate indicating that the right of registration under Article 5 has been withdrawn or will be withdrawn on the date of the vessel's registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条两个或两个以上缔约国之间就本公约的解释或适用问题发生的争议，如未能通过协商解决，应根据其中一国请求，提交仲裁。
Translation: Article 11 Any dispute between two or more Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention, if not settled by negotiation, shall be submitted to arbitration at the request of any one of them.

Query_Text_cn: 如自提交仲裁之日起六个月内，当事方仍未能就仲裁组织达成协议，任何一方可按照国际法院规约将争议提交国际法院解决。
Translation: If the parties fail to reach an agreement on the composition of the arbitral tribunal within six months from the date of submission for arbitration, either party may refer the dispute to the International Court of Justice in accordance with its Statute.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条1.每一缔约国可在签署、批准或加入本公约之时，声明其不受本公约第11条的约束。
Translation:
Article 12  
1. Each State Party may, at the time of signature, ratification or accession to this Convention, declare that it does not consider itself bound by Article 11 of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 对作出此种保留的任何缔约国而言，其他缔约国将不受本条的约束。
Translation: For any State Party making such a reservation, the other States Parties shall not be bound by this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何根据第1款作出保留的缔约国，可在任何时候通知比利时政府撤回该保留。
Translation: 2. Any Contracting State which has made a reservation under paragraph 1 may at any time withdraw such reservation by notification to the Belgian Government.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条本公约应对出席第十二届海洋法外交会议的各国开放供签字。
Translation:
Article 13  
This Convention shall be open for signature by all States participating in the Twelfth Diplomatic Conference on the Law of the Sea.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条本公约须经批准。批准书应交存比利时政府。
Translation:
Article 14  
This Convention shall be subject to ratification. The instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Government of Belgium.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条1.本公约自第五份批准书交存之日起三个月后生效。
Translation:
Article 15  
1. This Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对于在第五份批准书交存之后批准本公约的每一签字国，本公约在其批准书交存之日起三个月后生效。
Translation: 2. For each signatory ratifying this Convention after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification, the Convention shall enter into force three months after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条1.没有出席海洋法外交会议第十二届会议的任何国家、联合国成员国或任何专门机构的会员国，都可以加入本公约。
Translation:
Article 16  
1. This Convention shall be open to accession by any State that did not attend the Twelfth Session of the Diplomatic Conference on the Law of the Sea, any Member State of the United Nations, or any member of a specialized agency.

Query_Text_cn: 2.加入书应交存比利时政府。
Translation: 2. The instrument of accession shall be deposited with the Government of Belgium.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约应自加入国交存加入书之日起三个月对该加入国生效，但不得早于按第15条第1款规定的本公约的生效日期。
Translation: 3. This Convention shall enter into force for an acceding State three months after the date of deposit of its instrument of accession, but not earlier than the date of entry into force of the Convention as stipulated in paragraph 1 of Article 15.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条每一缔约国都有权在本公约对其生效以后任何时间退出本公约。
Translation: Article 17 Any State Party shall have the right to withdraw from this Convention at any time after its entry into force for that State Party.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，此种退出只在比利时政府收到此种通知之日一年后方生效。
Translation: However, such withdrawal shall take effect only one year after the date on which the Belgian Government receives the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条1.任何缔约国可在其签署、批准或加入本公约之时或此后任何时间，书面通知比利时政府，声明本公约适用于处于其主权之下或由其负责国际关系的领土。
Translation:
Article 18  
1. Any Contracting State may, at the time of signing, ratifying or acceding to this Convention or at any time thereafter, notify the Belgian Government in writing that this Convention shall extend to any territories under its sovereignty or for whose international relations it is responsible.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约自比利时政府收到此种通知之日起三个月后扩大适用于通知中所述的领土。
Translation: This Convention shall extend to the territories specified in the notification three months after the date on which the Belgian Government receives such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 2.按照本条第1款规定做出声明的任何缔约国，可在此后任何时间向比利时政府提交通知，声明本公约不再扩大适用于此种地域。
Translation: 2. Any Contracting State which has made a declaration under paragraph 1 of this Article may at any time thereafter notify the Belgian Government that the Convention shall cease to extend to such territory.

Query_Text_cn: 此种退出应自比利时政府收到此种通知之日一年后生效。
Translation: Such withdrawal shall take effect one year after the date on which the notification is received by the Belgian Government.

Query_Text_cn: 4.按照第17条规定收到的退出声明。
Translation: 4. Withdrawal declarations received in accordance with Article 17.

Query_Text_cn: 第20条本公约任何缔约国可在本公约对其生效三年之后或此后任何时间，请求召开会议，以修正本公约。
Translation: Article 20 Any Contracting State to this Convention may, three years after its entry into force for that State or at any time thereafter, request that a conference be convened for the purpose of amending this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 欲行使此项权利的任何缔约国，应通知比利时政府。经三分之一缔约国的同意，比利时政府应在此后六个月内召集会议。
Translation: Any Contracting State wishing to exercise this right shall notify the Belgian Government. Upon the request of one-third of the Contracting States, the Belgian Government shall convene a conference within six months thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: 经正式授权的全权代表，特签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: Duly authorized representatives have signed this Convention in witness thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 1967年5月27日订于布鲁塞尔，共一份，用法文和英文写成，两种文本具有同等效力，应存放于比利时政府档案库，经核证无误的副本由比利时政府颁发。
Translation: Done at Brussels on the 27th day of May 1967, in a single copy, in the French and English languages, both texts being equally authentic, to be deposited in the archives of the Belgian Government, with certified copies to be furnished by the Belgian Government.

Query_Text_cn: (8)"播送”是指播送者将接收信号传播给公众或任何一部分公众的操作。
Translation: (8) "Broadcasting" means the operation by which the broadcasting organization transmits the received signals to the public or any section thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条(一)各缔约国保证采取适当的措施，防止任何播送者在该国领土上或从该国领土上播送任何发射到或通过人造卫星但并非为了提供给他们的、载有节目的信号。
Translation: Article 2(1) Each Contracting State undertakes to take adequate measures to prevent any distributor from transmitting, within its territory or from its territory, any program-carrying signals emitted to or passing through a satellite that are not intended for their reception.

Query_Text_cn: 这种保证应当适用于以下情况，即起源组织是另一个缔约国的国民和播送的信号是接收信号。
Translation: This guarantee shall apply in cases where the originating organization is a national of another Contracting State and the transmitted signal is the received signal.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在任何缔约国内，实行第一款提到的措施方面有时间限制的话，其限制期限应当由该国国内法律规定。
Translation: (2) Where the measures referred to in paragraph 1 are subject to a time limit in any Contracting State, such duration shall be determined by the domestic legislation of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 此种期限应当在批准、接受或加入本公约的时候，或者，如果国内法律在此之后生效或修改，则在该项法律生效或修改六个月之内，书面通知联合国秘书长。
Translation: Such a period shall be notified in writing to the Secretary-General of the United Nations at the time of approval, acceptance or accession to this Convention, or, if the domestic law comes into force or is amended thereafter, within six months of the entry into force or amendment of such law.

Query_Text_cn: (三)第一款规定的保证不适用于播送从为其提供发射信号的那个播送者已经播出的信号中得来的接收信号。
Translation: (3) The guarantee stipulated in the first paragraph shall not apply to the transmission of signals received from a broadcaster who has already transmitted the signals provided by the originating broadcaster.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条如果由起源组织或以它的名义发射的信号是供一般公众从人造卫星直接接收的，则本公约将不适用。
Translation:
Article 3  
This Convention shall not apply where the signals emitted by or on behalf of the originating organization are intended for direct reception by the general public from a satellite.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条任何缔约国都不得被要求实行第二条第一款提到的措施，如果发射信号不是提供给他的某一播送者在其领土上播送的信号中：(1)载有发射信号所载的由时事报道所组成的节目的短小片断，但是仅限于这种片断系以提供情况为目的的合理范围内，或者(2)作为引用，载有发射信号所载节目的短小片断，只要这种引用符合正当的作法并且因其系以提供情况为目的而证明是合理的，或者(3)如果上述领土是一个根据联合国大会的惯例被认为是发展中国家的领土，载有发射信号所载节目，只要这种播送纯系出于教学(包括成人教育范围内的教学)或科学研究的目的。
Translation:
Article 4 No Contracting State shall be required to apply the measures referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 2 if the emitted signal is not intended for reception by a distributor in its territory whose broadcasts consist of signals that:  
(1) contain short excerpts of the program carried by the emitted signal, consisting of reports of current events, provided such excerpts are limited to the extent justified by the informatory purpose; or  
(2) incorporate, as quotations, short excerpts of the program carried by the emitted signal, provided such quotations are consistent with fair practice and are justified by the informatory purpose; or  
(3) if the territory in question is considered a developing country according to the practice of the United Nations General Assembly, carry the program transmitted by the emitted signal, provided such broadcasting is solely for the purpose of teaching (including instruction within the framework of adult education) or scientific research.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条对于本公约在某缔约国生效之前已经发射的任何信号，将不要求该缔约国实施本公约。
Translation: Article 5 No Contracting State shall be required to apply this Convention to any signals emitted before the entry into force of this Convention for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条对本公约作出的解释不得限制或妨碍任何国内法律或国际协定给予作家、演员、唱片制作者或广播组织的保护。
Translation: Article 6 No interpretation of this Convention shall restrict or prejudice the protection granted to authors, performers, producers of phonograms, or broadcasting organizations under any domestic laws or international agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条本公约不得被解释为限制任何缔约国为了控告垄断的弊病而执行本国法律的权利。
Translation: Article 7 This Convention shall not be construed as restricting the right of any Contracting State to enforce its national laws for the purpose of prosecuting the abuses of monopoly.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条(一)在遵循第二、第三两款的条件下，不允许对本公约作任何保留。
Translation: Article 8(1) No reservations to this Convention shall be permitted except in conformity with the conditions set out in paragraphs 2 and 3.

Query_Text_cn: (二)其国内法律在一九七四年五月二十一日有规定的任何缔约国，可以通过交存联合国秘书长的书面通知宣布，为了本国的目的，在第二条第一款中出现的"如果起源组织是另一个缔约国的国民”一语应当认为业已被"如果信号是从另一缔约国的领土上发射的”一语所代替。
Translation: (2) Any Contracting State whose domestic law, on May 21, 1974, so provides may, by a written notification deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations, declare that, for the purposes of its domestic law, the words "if the originating organization is a national of another Contracting State" appearing in paragraph (1) of Article 2 shall be considered as replaced by the words "if the signal is emitted from the territory of another Contracting State."

Query_Text_cn: (三)〈〉在一九七四年五月二十一日对通过电线电缆或其他类似的通讯渠道向公众中的用户传播载有节目的信号加以限制或拒绝给予保护的任何缔约国，可以通过交存联合国秘书长的书面通知宣布，在其国内法律限制或拒绝保护的范围和时期内，它将不对此种传播执行本公约。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting State which, as of May 21, 1974, limits or denies protection against the transmission of program-carrying signals to the public via wire, cable, or other similar communication channels may, by depositing a written notification with the Secretary-General of the United Nations, declare that it will not apply this Convention to such transmissions within the scope and duration of such limitations or denials under its domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 〈〉根据〈〉款已经向联合国秘书长交存了通知书的任何缔约国，应将其国内法律中使〈〉款的保留不再适用或范围限制更严的任何修改，在其生效六个月之内书面通知联合国秘书长。
Translation: Any State Party that has deposited a notification with the Secretary-General of the United Nations in accordance with paragraph [X] shall inform the Secretary-General in writing, within six months of their entry into force, of any amendments to its domestic law that render the reservation under paragraph [X] inapplicable or more restrictive in scope.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条(一)本公约应交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: Article 9(1) This Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约应于一九七五年三月三十一日之前向作为联合国会员国和与联合国有关的任何专门机构或国际原子能机构的成员国或国际法庭规约的参加国的任何国家开放签字。
Translation: This Convention shall be open for signature until 31 March 1975 by any State that is a Member of the United Nations or a member of any specialized agency related to the United Nations, or a member of the International Atomic Energy Agency, or a party to the Statute of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: (二)本公约须经签字国批准或接受。
Translation: (2) This Convention shall be subject to ratification or acceptance by the signatory States.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约将开放供第一款提到的任何国家加入。
Translation: This Convention shall be open for accession by any State referred to in paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: (三)批准书、接受书或加入书应交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: (3) Instruments of ratification, acceptance or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: (四)不言而喻，当某个国家参加本公约之时，它就应根据其国内法律使本公约各条款付诸实施。
Translation: (4) It goes without saying that when a country accedes to this Convention, it shall implement the provisions hereof in accordance with its domestic laws.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条(一)本公约应于第五份批准书、接受书或加入书交存三个月后生效。
Translation: Article 10(1) This Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification, acceptance or accession.

Query_Text_cn: (二)对第五份批准书、接受书或加入书交存后批准、接受或加入本公约的国家，本公约应在交存其证书三个月后生效。
Translation: (2) For each State ratifying, accepting or acceding to this Convention after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification, acceptance or accession, the Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of its instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条(一)任何缔约国可以通过向联合国秘书长交存书面通知宣布退出本公约。
Translation: Article 11(1) Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention by written notification addressed to the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: (二)退出公约应于收到第一款提到的通知之日十二个月后生效。
Translation: (2) The withdrawal shall take effect twelve months after the date of receipt of the notification referred to in paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条（一）本公约应当在一份由英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成的统一文本上签字，四种文字的文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Article 12 (1) This Convention shall be signed in a single original in the English, French, Russian and Spanish languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: （二）阿拉伯文、荷兰文、德文、意大利文和葡萄牙文的正式文本应当由联合国教育科学文化组织总干事和世界知识产权组织总干事与有关政府协商后制订。
Translation: (ii) The official texts in Arabic, Dutch, German, Italian and Portuguese shall be prepared by the Director-General of UNESCO and the Director-General of WIPO in consultation with the governments concerned.

Query_Text_cn: （5）退出公约通知书的接收。
Translation: (5) Receipt of notifications of withdrawal from the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （四）联合国秘书长应将两份经核证无误的本公约的副本发送第九条第一款提到的所有国家。
Translation: (4) The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall transmit two certified copies of this Convention to all States referred to in paragraph 1 of article IX.

Query_Text_cn: (二)伤者、病者及遇船难者应予收集与照顾。
Translation: (2) The wounded, sick, and shipwrecked shall be collected and cared for.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条遇有冲突各方之陆海军作战时，本公约之规定仅适用于在舰上之部队。
Translation: Article 4 In the event of hostilities between land and naval forces of belligerents, the provisions of the present Convention shall apply only to forces on board ship.

Query_Text_cn: 登陆之部队，应立即受1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约的规定之拘束。
Translation: The landing forces shall immediately be bound by the provisions of the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条中立国对于在其领土内所收容或拘禁之伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员与随军牧师及所发现之死者，应准用本约之规定。
Translation: Article 5 Neutral Powers shall apply, by analogy, the provisions of the present Convention to the wounded, sick, shipwrecked, medical personnel and chaplains who are received or interned in their territory, as well as to the dead found therein.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条于第十、十八、三十一、三十八、三十九、四十、四十三及五十三各条明文规定之协定之外，各缔约国对其认为需另作规定之一切事项，得订立特别协定。
Translation: In addition to the agreements expressly provided for in Articles 10, 18, 31, 38, 39, 40, 43, and 53, the Contracting Parties may conclude special agreements on all matters they deem necessary to regulate separately.

Query_Text_cn: 是项特别协定不得对本公约关于伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员或随军牧师所规定之境遇有不利的影响，亦不得限制本公约所赋予彼等之权利。
Translation: This special agreement shall in no way affect the status of the wounded, sick, shipwrecked, medical personnel or chaplains as defined by the present Convention, nor restrict the rights accorded to them thereunder.

Query_Text_cn: 除在上述协定或后订之协定中有相反之明文规定，或冲突之一方对彼等采取更优待之措施外，伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员及随军牧师，在本公约对其适用期间，应继续享受是项协定之利益。
Translation: Unless expressly provided to the contrary in the above-mentioned agreements or in subsequent agreements, or unless more favorable measures are taken by one of the Parties to the conflict, the wounded, sick, shipwrecked, medical personnel, and chaplains shall continue to enjoy the benefits of such agreements during the period in which the present Convention is applicable to them.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条在任何情况下，伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员及随军牧师不得放弃本公约或上条所述特别协定——如其订有是项协定——所赋予彼等之权利之一部或全部。
Translation: Article 7. In no circumstances may the wounded, sick, shipwrecked, medical personnel or chaplains renounce in part or in entirety the rights secured to them by the present Convention or by the special agreements referred to in the preceding Article, should such agreements exist.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条本公约之适用应与保护国合作并受其监察。保护国之责任为维护冲突各方之利益。
Translation: Article 8 The application of this Convention shall be carried out with the cooperation and under the supervision of the Protecting Powers. The duty of the Protecting Powers shall be to safeguard the interests of the Parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约之规定并不妨碍红十字国际委员会或其他公正的人道主义组织，在有关冲突各方之同意之条件下，从事保护与救济伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员及随军牧师之人道主义活动。
Translation: Article 9 The provisions of the present Convention shall not preclude humanitarian activities carried out by the International Committee of the Red Cross or other impartial humanitarian organizations, subject to the consent of the Parties to the conflict concerned, for the protection and relief of the wounded, sick, shipwrecked persons, medical personnel and chaplains.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条各缔约国得随时同意将根据本公约应由保护国负担之任务，委托于具有公允与效能的一切保证之组织。
Translation: Article 10 The High Contracting Parties may at any time agree to entrust to an organization which offers all guarantees of impartiality and efficacy the duties incumbent on the Protecting Powers under the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 当伤者、病者、遇船难者或医务人员及随军牧师，不拘为何原因，不能享受或已停止享受保护国或本条第一款所规定之组织的活动之利益时，则拘留国应请一中立国或此种组织担任依照本公约应由冲突各方指定之保护国所执行之任务。
Translation: When the wounded, sick, shipwrecked, or medical personnel and chaplains, for any reason whatsoever, are unable to benefit or have ceased to benefit from the activities of a Protecting Power or of an organization provided for in the first paragraph of this Article, the Detaining Power shall request a neutral State or such an organization to undertake the functions performed under the present Convention by a Protecting Power designated by the Parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条保护国认为于被保护人之利益适宜时，尤其遇冲突各方对于本公约之适用与解释意见有分歧时，就从事斡旋以期解决分歧。
Translation: Article 11 The Protecting Power shall, whenever it deems it advisable in the interests of protected persons, particularly in cases of disagreement between the Parties to the conflict as to the application or interpretation of the provisions of the present Convention, lend its good offices with a view to settling the disagreement.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，各保护国得因一方之请求，或主动向冲突各方建议，可能在适当选择之中立领土召开代表会议，负责管理伤者、病者、遇船难者之当局代表和医务人员与随军牧师之代表尤须参加。
Translation: To this end, the Protecting Powers may, if necessary, propose for approval by the Parties to the conflict a person belonging to a neutral Power, or delegated by the International Committee of the Red Cross, who shall be invited to take part in such a meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 各保护国得于必要时，提请冲突各方同意，特邀一中立国人员或红十字国际委员会委派之人员参加此项会议。
Translation: The Protecting Powers may, if necessary, invite the parties to the conflict to agree to the participation of a neutral person or a delegate of the International Committee of the Red Cross in such meetings.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条在海上受伤、患病或遇船难之下条所列武装部队人员或其他人员，在一切情况下，应受尊重与保护，而"船难”一词应了解为系指任何原因之船难，并包括飞机被迫降落海面或被迫自飞机上跳海者在内。
Translation: Article 12. Members of the armed forces and other persons mentioned in the following Article, who are wounded, sick or shipwrecked at sea, shall be respected and protected in all circumstances, the term "shipwreck" being understood to mean shipwreck from any cause and including forced landings at sea by or from aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突之各方对于在其权力下之此等人员，应予以人道之待遇与照顾，不得基于性别、种族、国籍、宗教、政治意见或其他类似标准而有所歧视。
Translation: All parties to the conflict shall treat humanely and provide care for persons under their authority, without any adverse distinction based on sex, race, nationality, religion, political opinion, or any other similar criteria.

Query_Text_cn: 尤其不得加以谋杀和消灭，施以酷刑或供生物学的实验，不得故意不给予医疗救助及照顾，亦不得造成使其冒传染病危险之情况。
Translation: In particular, they shall not be subjected to murder or extermination, torture or biological experiments, willful denial of medical care and attention, or exposure to conditions that endanger their health by exposing them to contagious diseases.

Query_Text_cn: (六)未占领地之居民，当敌人迫近时，未及组织成为正规部队，而立即自动拿起武器抵抗来侵军队者，但须彼等公开携带武器并尊重战争法规及惯例。
Translation: (vi) Inhabitants of a non-occupied territory who, on the approach of the enemy, spontaneously take up arms to resist the invading forces without having had time to form themselves into regular armed units, provided they carry arms openly and respect the laws and customs of war.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条交战国之一切军舰应有权要求交出军用医院船，属于救济团体或私人之医院船，以及商船、游艇或其他船只上之伤者、病者或遇船难者，不拘国籍，但须伤者与病者处于适合移动之情状，而该军舰具有必要的医治之适当设备。
Translation:
Article 14  
Any warship of a belligerent party shall have the right to demand the surrender of the wounded, sick, or shipwrecked persons on board military hospital ships, hospital ships belonging to relief societies or private individuals, as well as merchant vessels, yachts, or other craft, regardless of nationality, provided that the wounded and sick are in a fit state to be moved and that the warship has adequate medical facilities for their treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条如伤者、病者或遇船难者被收容于中立国军舰或军用飞机上，如国际法有此要求，应保证此等人员不再参加战争行动。
Translation: Article 15 If wounded, sick, or shipwrecked persons are taken on board a neutral warship or military aircraft, it shall be ensured, where required by international law, that they can take no further part in hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条在第十二条规定之限制下，交战国之伤者、病者及遇船难者之落于敌方手中者，应为战俘，并对之适用国际法有关战俘之规定。
Translation: Article 16 Subject to the provisions of Article 12, the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked of a belligerent who fall into enemy hands shall be prisoners of war, and the provisions of international law concerning prisoners of war shall apply to them.

Query_Text_cn: 俘获者得按情况决定是否便于扣留或送至俘获国之港口、中立国港口、甚或敌国领土内之港口。
Translation: Captors shall determine, as circumstances permit, whether it is expedient to detain the prize or send it to a port of the captor's country, a neutral port, or even a port in enemy territory.

Query_Text_cn: 如属最后一情形，被送回本国之战俘，在战争期间不得服役。
Translation: In the latter case, repatriated prisoners of war shall not serve again during the war.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条如中立国与交战国间无相反之协定，经地方当局之许可，在中立国港口登陆之伤者、病者或遇船难者，遇国际法有此要求时，应由中立国加以看守，务使彼等不能再参加战争行动。
Translation:
Article 17  
Where no contrary agreement exists between the neutral and belligerent states, wounded, sick, or shipwrecked persons who are landed in a neutral port with the consent of the local authorities shall, if required by international law, be detained by the neutral state in such a manner as to ensure they cannot again take part in hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 医院收容及拘禁费用应由伤者、病者或遇船难者所依附之国负担。
Translation: The costs of hospital accommodation and internment shall be borne by the Power on which the wounded, sick, or shipwrecked persons depend.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条每次战斗之后，冲突各方应立即采取一切可能之措施以搜寻并收集遇船难者、伤者与病者加以保护借免抢劫及虐待，而予以适宜之照顾，并搜寻死者而防其被剥劫。
Translation: Article 18 After each engagement, parties to the conflict shall, without delay, take all possible measures to search for and collect the shipwrecked, wounded and sick, to protect them against pillage and ill-treatment, to ensure their adequate care, and to search for the dead and prevent their being despoiled.

Query_Text_cn: 环境许可时，冲突各方应商定局部办法以便经由海路搬移被包围地区之伤者与病者，并使送往该地区之医疗与宗教人员及器材得以通过。
Translation: When circumstances permit, the conflicting parties shall agree on local arrangements for the evacuation by sea of the wounded and sick from besieged areas and for the passage of medical and religious personnel and equipment bound for such areas.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条冲突各方应尽速登记落于其手中之每一敌方遇船难者、伤者、病者或死者之任何可以证明其身份之事项。
Translation: Article 19 The Parties to the conflict shall record as soon as possible any particulars which may assist in identifying each shipwrecked, wounded, sick or dead person of the adverse Party who falls into their hands.

Query_Text_cn: 上述登记材料应尽速转送1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约第一百二十二条所述之情报局，该局应通过保护国及战俘中央事务所转达上述人员所依附之国。
Translation: The aforementioned registration materials shall be promptly transmitted to the Information Bureau as stipulated in Article 122 of the Geneva Convention Relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12, 1949. The Bureau shall then communicate the information to the countries to which the said persons belong through the Protecting Powers and the Central Prisoners of War Agency.

Query_Text_cn: 亦应搜集并通过该局转送死者尸体上所发现之双身份牌之一半，或整个身份牌如其系单身份牌，遗嘱或对于其最近亲属具有重要性之其他文件、金钱及一般具有实质价值或情感价值之物品。
Translation: They shall also collect and forward through that bureau one half of the double identity disc, or the whole identity disc if it is a single disc, wills or other documents of importance to the next of kin, money and in general all articles of an intrinsic or sentimental value found on the deceased.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条冲突各方应保证在情况许可下分别海葬死者之前，详细检查尸体，如可能时，经医生检查，以确定死亡，证明身份并便作成报告。
Translation: Article 20: The Parties to the conflict shall ensure that the dead are examined in detail, if possible by a medical examination, before burial at sea, to confirm death, establish identity, and enable a report to be made, whenever circumstances permit.

Query_Text_cn: 如用双身份牌者，则其一半应留在尸体上。
Translation: If a double identity tag is used, half of it shall remain with the body.

Query_Text_cn: 如死者运抵陆上时，则应适用1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约之规定。
Translation: If the deceased is brought ashore, the provisions of the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条冲突各方得呼吁中立国商船、游艇或其他中立国船只之船长以慈善精神收容与照顾伤者、病者或遇船难者于其船上，并收集死者。
Translation: Article 21 The parties to the conflict may appeal to the charity of commanders of neutral merchant vessels, yachts or other craft, to take on board and care for wounded, sick or shipwrecked persons, and to collect the dead.

Query_Text_cn: 响应此项呼吁之任何种类船只以及自动收集伤者、病者或遇船难者之船只，均应享受特别保护及为执行此项协助之便利。
Translation: All vessels responding to such calls, as well as those engaged in the automatic collection of the wounded, sick, or shipwrecked, shall enjoy special protection and facilities for the execution of such assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 但上述船只若有违反中立之行为，除非有相反之诺言，仍得予以拿捕。
Translation: However, if the aforementioned vessels engage in acts violating neutrality, they may still be seized unless there is a contrary promise.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条军用医院船即各国特别并专用以救助、医治并运送伤者、病者及遇船难者而建造或装备之船只，在任何情况下，不得加以攻击或拿捕，而应随时予以尊重与保护，但须于使用前十日，将该船之名称及其说明通知冲突各方。
Translation: Article 22: Military hospital ships, that is to say, ships built or equipped by the Powers specially and solely with a view to assisting the wounded, sick and shipwrecked, to treating them and to transporting them, may in no circumstances be attacked or captured, but shall at all times be respected and protected, provided that their names and descriptions have been notified to the Parties to the conflict ten days before those ships are employed.

Query_Text_cn: 通知书内必须载明之特征，应包括注册之总吨位，自船首至船尾之长度以及桅杆，烟囟之数目。
Translation: The notice must specify the following characteristics: the registered gross tonnage, the length from stem to stern, and the number of masts and funnels.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条岸上建筑物之应受1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约之保护者，应予以保护，免受海上之炮轰或攻击。
Translation: Article 23: Buildings on shore that are entitled to protection under the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field shall be safeguarded from naval bombardment or attack.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条各国红十字会及官方承认之救济团体或私人所使用之医院船，如经其所依附之冲突一方正式委任，并已遵照第二十二条关于通知之规定者，应享受与军用医院船同样之保护并应免予拿捕。
Translation: Article 24: Hospital ships utilized by National Red Cross Societies, by officially recognized relief societies, or by private individuals shall have the same protection as military hospital ships and shall be exempt from capture, provided they have been placed under the control of one of the parties to the conflict, with the consent of their own government, and in compliance with the provisions of Article 22 concerning notification.

Query_Text_cn: 此等船只，必须备有负责当局发给之证明书，载明该船只于装备及出发时已在该当局之管辖下。
Translation: Such vessels must be provided with a certificate issued by the competent authority, stating that the vessel was under the jurisdiction of the said authority at the time of its equipment and departure.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条各中立国之红十字会及官方承认之救济团体或私人所使用之医院船，如受冲突一方之管辖，经其本国政府之预先同意及该冲突一方之认可，并已遵照第二十二条关于通知之规定者，应享受与军用医院船同样之保护并免予拿捕。
Translation: Article 25: Hospital ships utilized by Red Cross societies, officially recognized relief societies, or private individuals of neutral countries, if placed under the control of one of the parties to the conflict with the prior consent of their own government and the authorization of such party, and having complied with the provisions of Article 22 concerning notification, shall enjoy the same protection as military hospital ships and shall be exempt from capture.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条第二十二、二十四及二十五各条提及之保护，适用于任何吨位之医院船及其救生艇，不论其活动地点何在。
Translation: Article 26: The protections mentioned in Articles 22, 24, and 25 shall apply to hospital ships of any tonnage and their lifeboats, wherever they may be operating.

Query_Text_cn: 但为保证最大限度之舒适与安全，冲突各方务须使用总吨位在二千吨以上之医院船，以运送远距离及在公海上之伤者、病者及遇船难者。
Translation: However, to ensure the utmost comfort and safety, the conflicting parties must use hospital ships with a gross tonnage of over 2,000 tons for transporting the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked over long distances and on the high seas.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条在第二十二及二十四各条所规定之同样条件下，国家用或官方承认之救济团体为沿海岸救生用之小型船只，在行动需要之许可范围，亦应予以尊重及保护。
Translation: Article 27: Under the same conditions stipulated in Articles 22 and 24, small vessels employed by the State or officially recognized relief societies for coastal lifesaving purposes shall likewise be respected and protected, to the extent required by operational necessity.

Query_Text_cn: 前项规定应尽可能适用于前述船只在其人道主义的任务上所专用之海岸固定设备。
Translation: The aforementioned provisions shall apply as far as possible to the fixed coastal installations exclusively used by the said vessels for their humanitarian missions.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条若在军舰上发生战斗，则病室应予以尊重，并尽可能予以保全。
Translation: Article 28 In the event of combat occurring on board a warship, the sick bay shall be respected and spared as far as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 病室及其设备应受战争法规之限制，在伤者与病者需要期中，不得改作其他用途。
Translation: Medical establishments and equipment shall be subject to the laws of war and shall not be diverted from their proper use as long as they are needed for the care of the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 但病室落于敌方司令之权力下，而该司令在保证对疗养中之伤者与病者予以适当之照顾后，于紧急军事需要时，得将病室改作他用。
Translation: However, the infirmary falls under the authority of the enemy commander, who, after ensuring proper care for the convalescing wounded and sick, may repurpose the infirmary for other uses in cases of urgent military necessity.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条凡泊于陷落敌方手中之港口之任何医院船，应准其离去该港。
Translation: Article 29 Any hospital ship that has fallen into enemy hands shall be permitted to leave the port.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条第二十二、二十四、二十五及二十七各条所述之船只应不拘国籍，对于伤者、病者及遇船难者予以救济与协助。
Translation: Article 30: The vessels described in Articles 22, 24, 25, and 27 shall, regardless of nationality, provide relief and assistance to the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国承诺不将此等船只作任何军事用途。
Translation: Each Contracting State undertakes not to use such vessels for any military purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 此等船只绝不得妨碍战斗员之行动。
Translation: Such vessels shall in no way hamper the movements of combatants.

Query_Text_cn: 在每次战斗中及战斗后，此等船只行动上所冒危险，自负其责。
Translation: In every battle and its aftermath, these vessels assume full responsibility for the risks incurred in their operations.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条冲突各方应有权管制及搜查第二十二、二十四、二十五及二十七各条提及之船只，并得拒绝其协助，命令其离去，指定其航线，控制其无线电及其他通讯工具之使用，如因情况之严重性有此必要时，并得扣留之，其期限自截留之时起，不超过七日。
Translation: Article 31 The Parties to the conflict shall have the right to control and search the vessels mentioned in Articles 22, 24, 25 and 27, and may refuse their assistance, order them off, prescribe their route, control the use of their wireless and other means of communication, and even detain them for a period not exceeding seven days from the time of interception, if the gravity of the circumstances so requires.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方得派员暂时驻在船上，其唯一任务应为保证根据上款规定所发布之命令均予执行。
Translation: The parties to the conflict shall place personnel temporarily on board the vessel, whose sole duty shall be to ensure that the orders issued in accordance with the provisions above are carried out.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方应尽可能将发给医院船船长之命令以该船长所了解之文字。
Translation: The parties to the conflict shall, whenever possible, transmit orders addressed to hospital ships in a language understood by the captain.

Query_Text_cn: 记录于该船航海日志。
Translation: Entered in the ship's log book.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方得单独或依特别协定，安置中立国视察员在其船上，该员等应检定本公约规定之严格遵行。
Translation: The parties to the conflict may, either individually or through special agreements, place neutral inspectors on their vessels. These inspectors shall verify strict compliance with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条第二十二、二十四、二十五及二十七各条所述之船只，就其在中立国港口停泊而言，不列为军舰。
Translation: Article 32: The vessels referred to in Articles 22, 24, 25, and 27 shall not be considered warships in terms of their stay in neutral ports.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条商船之改装为医院船者，在全部战事期间不能移作他用。
Translation: Article 33: Merchant vessels converted into hospital ships may not be diverted from their humanitarian purpose throughout the duration of hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条医院船及舰上病室应得之保护不得停止，除非此等船室越出其人道主义任务之外，用以从事有害于敌方之行为。
Translation: Article 34. The protection to which hospital ships and sick bays are entitled shall not cease unless they are used to commit acts harmful to the enemy outside their humanitarian duties.

Query_Text_cn: 惟如经给予相当警告，并依各个情形指定合理之时限而警告仍被忽视时，始得停止保护。
Translation: Protection shall be withdrawn only if adequate warning has been given and, where appropriate, a reasonable time limit has been specified, yet the warning remains unheeded.

Query_Text_cn: 医院船尤其不得备有或使用密码，为无线电或其他通讯方法之用。
Translation: Hospital ships shall not possess or utilize codes for their wireless or other means of communication.

Query_Text_cn: （五）运送专为医疗任务之用的设备及人员，而超过正常之需要。
Translation: (v) The transportation of equipment and personnel specifically for medical purposes exceeds normal requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 不论船上有无伤者及病者，在医院船上服务期间，不得被俘。
Translation: Regardless of whether there are wounded or sick persons on board, those serving on hospital ships shall not be captured during their service.

Query_Text_cn: 在需要照顾伤者及病者之期间，得继续执行其职务。
Translation: They may continue to perform their duties during the period required to care for the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 一俟管辖此项人员之总司令认为可行时，应将其送回。
Translation: They shall be sent back as soon as the Supreme Commander in charge of the matter considers it feasible.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等离船时得携带其私人财物。
Translation: They shall carry their personal belongings when disembarking.

Query_Text_cn: 但如发觉因战俘之医疗上及精神上之需要，须留用若干人员时，则应尽一切可能使其尽早登陆。
Translation: However, if it is determined that certain personnel must be retained due to the medical and psychological needs of prisoners of war, every effort shall be made to ensure their earliest possible disembarkation.

Query_Text_cn: 留用人员登陆后，即受1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约规定之拘束。
Translation: Upon landing, the retained personnel shall be bound by the provisions of the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条为此项目的而租用之船只，应准其运输专为医治武装部队之伤者与病者或防止疾病用之设备，但须将该船航行之事项通知敌国，并经其认可。
Translation: Article 38: Vessels chartered for that purpose shall be authorized to transport equipment intended exclusively for the treatment of wounded and sick members of armed forces or for the prevention of disease, provided that the particulars regarding their voyage have been notified to the adverse Power and approved by it.

Query_Text_cn: 敌国保留登船检查之权，但不得予以拿捕或截留其所载之设备。
Translation: The enemy state retains the right to board and inspect the vessel, but shall not seize or detain the equipment on board.

Query_Text_cn: 经冲突各方之协议，中立国观察员得驻在该项船只上，以检定所载之设备。
Translation: By agreement among the conflicting parties, neutral observers may be stationed on such vessels to verify the equipment on board.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，应准其自由检视此项设备。
Translation: For this purpose, they shall be permitted to freely inspect the equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条医务飞机，即专用以搬移伤者、病者及遇船难者以及运送医务人员与设备之飞机，不得为袭击之目标，而在有关冲突各方所特别约定之高度、时间及航线飞行时，应受冲突各方之尊重。
Translation: Article 39. Medical aircraft, that is to say, aircraft exclusively employed for the removal of wounded and sick and for the transport of medical personnel and equipment, shall not be attacked but shall be respected by the belligerents while flying at heights, times and on routes specifically agreed upon between the belligerents concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 此项飞机在其上下及两侧面，应显明标以第四十一条所规定之特殊标志，以及其本国国旗，并应备有战事开始时或战事进行中经冲突各方间同意之任何其他标志或识别方法。
Translation: The aircraft shall bear clearly marked distinctive emblems as prescribed in Article 41 on its upper, lower, and lateral surfaces, along with the national flag of its country. It shall also carry any other markings or means of identification agreed upon by the parties to the conflict at the commencement or during the course of hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 医务飞机应服从一切水陆降落之命令。
Translation: Medical aircraft shall comply with all orders to land on water or land.

Query_Text_cn: 如被令降落而需受检查时，则经过检查后，该机载其乘员得继续飞行。
Translation: If ordered to land for inspection, the aircraft and its occupants shall be permitted to continue their flight after the inspection.

Query_Text_cn: 非自愿降落于敌人领土或敌人占领地之陆上或水面时，伤者、病者及遇船难者以及飞行人员应为战俘。
Translation: When involuntarily landing on enemy territory or in enemy-occupied areas, whether on land or water, the wounded, sick, shipwrecked, and aircrew shall be considered prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 医务人员应按第三十六条及第三十七条两条待遇之。
Translation: Medical personnel shall be entitled to the benefits stipulated in Articles 36 and 37.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条冲突各方之医务飞机，在本条第二款规定之拘束下，得在中立国之领土上空飞行，必要时，得在该国领土降落，或用以为停留站。
Translation: Article 40 Subject to the provisions of the second paragraph, medical aircraft of Parties to the conflict may fly over the territory of neutral Powers, land thereon in case of necessity, or use it as a port of call.

Query_Text_cn: 该项飞机之飞越上述领土，应预先通知各中立国，并服从一切水陆降落之命令。
Translation: The flight of such aircraft over the aforementioned territories shall be notified in advance to the neutral states and shall comply with all orders to land on water or ground.

Query_Text_cn: 除中立国与冲突各方另有协议外，凡经地方当局之同意由医务飞机运至中立国领土之伤者、病者或遇船难者，如国际法有此要求，应由中立国以适当方式予以拘留，俾彼等不能再行参加战斗。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed between the neutral power and the parties to the conflict, wounded, sick, or shipwrecked persons transported by medical aircraft to neutral territory with the consent of the local authorities shall, where required by international law, be detained by the neutral power in such a manner as to ensure they cannot again take part in hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十一条在军事主管当局之指导下，白底红十字之标志应标明于旗帜、臂章及医务部门使用之所有设备上。
Translation: Article 41 Under the direction of the competent military authority, the emblem of the red cross on a white ground shall be displayed on the flags, armlets, and on all equipment employed in the Medical Service.

Query_Text_cn: 但各国如已采用白底红新月或白底红狮与日以代替红十字之标志者，此等标志亦为本公约规定所承认。
Translation: However, if a country has already adopted the emblem of a red crescent or a red lion and sun on a white ground instead of the red cross, such emblems shall also be recognized under the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条第三十六及三十七两条所指之人员，应在左臂佩带由军事机关发给并盖印而具有特殊标志之防水臂章。
Translation: Article 42: The personnel referred to in Articles 36 and 37 shall wear on their left arm a waterproof armlet bearing a distinctive emblem, issued and stamped by the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 此种人员除应携带第十九条所述之身份牌外，应另携带具有此项特殊标志之特种身份证。
Translation: In addition to the identity tags specified in Article 19, such personnel shall carry a special identity card bearing this distinctive emblem.

Query_Text_cn: 该证应附有本人像片，及其签字或指纹，或二者俱备。
Translation: The certificate shall bear the likeness of the holder, and his signature or fingerprint, or both.

Query_Text_cn: 如遇遗失时得领取身份证副本或补领符号。
Translation: In case of loss,a duplicate or replacement symbol of the ID card may be obtained.

Query_Text_cn: ()一切外表应为白色。
Translation: All exterior surfaces shall be white.

Query_Text_cn: ()在船身之两侧及其平面，应涂漆而显露可能最大之深红十字一个或多个，其位置以自海上及空中最易于望见者为宜。
Translation: On both sides of the hull and on its horizontal surfaces, one or more dark red crosses of the largest possible size shall be painted and displayed, positioned so as to be most clearly visible from the sea and air.

Query_Text_cn: 一切医院船应悬挂本国国旗，如属于中立国者并应悬挂其所受指挥的冲突一方之国旗，以资识别。
Translation: All hospital ships shall fly their national flag and, if they belong to a neutral state, shall also fly the flag of the party to the conflict under whose direction they are placed, for purposes of identification.

Query_Text_cn: 大桅杆上应在可能高处悬挂白底红十字旗。
Translation: A white flag with a red cross shall be hoisted as high as possible on the mainmast.

Query_Text_cn: 医院船之救生艇、海岸救生艇及医务部门所使用之一切小型船只均应漆成白色，并加画鲜明之深红十字，大体应遵照上述医院船识别之方法。
Translation: All lifeboats, coastal lifeboats, and small craft used by the medical service of hospital ships shall be painted white with a clearly marked dark red cross, generally following the identification methods specified above for hospital ships.

Query_Text_cn: 上述船艇，如欲于黑夜及可视度减少之时间保证其应得之保护，则应在其管辖之冲突一方的同意下，采取必要措施，务使其所漆颜色及特殊标志充分显明。
Translation: The aforementioned vessels, in order to ensure their entitled protection during hours of darkness or reduced visibility, shall, with the consent of the party to the conflict under whose jurisdiction they are placed, take the necessary measures to render their painting and distinctive emblems sufficiently visible.

Query_Text_cn: 依第三十一条暂时为敌人扣留之医院船，必须将其所服役或其所受指挥之冲突一方的旗帜降下。
Translation: Hospital ships detained under Article 31 must lower the flag of the party to the conflict in whose service or under whose direction they were placed.

Query_Text_cn: 海岸救生艇，如其经占领国同意，从被占领之基地继续活动，于离开该基地时，得准其继续悬挂其本国国旗连同白底红十字旗，但须先通知有关冲突各方。
Translation: Coastal rescue craft, if they continue to operate from occupied bases with the consent of the Occupying Power, may be permitted, when leaving those bases, to fly their national flag along with the Red Cross flag on a white ground, provided that prior notice thereof is given to the Parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 本条有关红十字之一切规定，应一律适用于第四十一条所列之其他标记。
Translation: All provisions of this Article concerning the red cross shall apply equally to the other emblems mentioned in Article 41.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方应随时设法达成相互的协议，俾使用其所有之最现代化方法，以便利各医院船之辨别。
Translation: The parties to the conflict shall endeavor to reach mutual agreements to employ the most modern methods available to facilitate the identification of hospital ships.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条除其他国际公约或有关冲突各方间另有协定外，第四十三条所指之特殊标志，无论平时或战时，只能用以标明或保护该条提及之船只。
Translation: Article 44: Except as otherwise provided by other international conventions or by agreement between the parties to the conflict, the distinctive emblem referred to in Article 43 may be used, whether in time of peace or war, only for indicating or protecting the ships mentioned in that Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条各缔约国，若其立法尚未完备，应采取必要之措施，以便随时防止及取缔第四十三条所规定关于特殊标志之任何滥用行为。
Translation: Article 45 Each Contracting State whose legislation is not yet adequate shall take the necessary measures to prevent and repress at all times any misuse of the distinctive signs referred to in Article 43.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条冲突各方应通过其总司令保证以上条款之详细执行，并依照本公约之一般原则规定预料不到之事件。
Translation:
Article 46  
The Parties to the conflict shall ensure, through their respective Commanders-in-Chief, the detailed execution of the foregoing provisions and provide for unforeseen cases in conformity with the general principles of the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条对于本公约所保护之伤者、病者、遇船难者、工作人员、船只或设备之报复行为，均予禁止。
Translation: Article 47: Reprisals against the wounded, sick, shipwrecked persons, personnel, vessels, or equipment protected under this Convention are prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条各缔约国在平时及战时应在各该国尽量广泛传播本公约之约文，尤应在其军事，并如可能时在公民教育计划中，包括本公约之学习，俾本公约之原则为全体人民，尤其武装战斗部队、医务人员及随军牧师所周知。
Translation: Article 48 The High Contracting Parties undertake, in time of peace as in time of war, to disseminate the text of the present Convention as widely as possible in their respective countries, and, in particular, to include the study thereof in their programmes of military and, if possible, civil instruction, so that the principles thereof may become known to the entire population, especially to the armed fighting forces, the medical personnel and the chaplains.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条各缔约国应通过瑞士联邦委员会，在战时则通过保护国，互相通知本公约之正式译文，及其所采用以保证实施本公约之法律与规则。
Translation: Article 49: The High Contracting Parties shall communicate to one another through the Swiss Federal Council and, during hostilities, through the Protecting Powers, the official translations of the present Convention, as well as the laws and regulations which they may adopt to ensure its application.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十条各缔约国担任制定必要之立法，俾对于本身犯有或令人犯有下条所列之严重破坏本公约之行为之人，处以有效的刑事制裁。
Translation: Article 50 The High Contracting Parties shall enact any legislation necessary to provide effective penal sanctions for persons committing, or ordering to be committed, any of the grave breaches of the present Convention defined in the following Article.

Query_Text_cn: 在一切情况下，被告人应享有适当的审讯及辩护之保障。此种保障，不得次于1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约第一百零五条及其以下各条所规定者。
Translation: In all circumstances, the accused shall be entitled to a fair trial and the guarantees essential for defence. Such guarantees shall in no case be less favourable than those provided under Article 105 and the following articles of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of 12 August 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十二条任何缔约国不得自行推卸，或允许任何其他缔约国推卸，其本身或其他缔约国所负之关于上条所述之破坏公约行为之责任。
Translation: Article 52 No High Contracting Party shall be allowed to absolve itself, or any other High Contracting Party, of any liability incurred by itself or by another High Contracting Party in respect of breaches referred to in the preceding Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十三条经冲突之一方之请求，应依有关各方所决定之方式，进行关于任何被控违犯本公约的行为之调查。
Translation: Article 53 At the request of a Party to the conflict, an inquiry shall be instituted, in such a manner as shall be agreed upon by the Parties concerned, into any alleged violation of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如关于调查程序不能获致协议，则各方应同意选定一公断人，由其决定应遵行之程序。
Translation: If no agreement can be reached on the investigation procedures, the parties shall agree to appoint an arbitrator who shall determine the procedures to be followed.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十四条本公约以英文及法文订立。
Translation: Article 54 This Convention is established in the English and French languages.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十五条本公约以本日为订立之日期，至1950年2月12日为止，凡参加1949年4月21日日内瓦会议各国，以及未参加该次会议，但系推行1906年日内瓦公约之原则于海战之1907年10月18日第十海牙公约缔约国，或1864年、1906年及1929年关于救济战地军队伤者病者之日内瓦公约之缔约国，均可签字。
Translation: Article 55. The present Convention is established this day and shall remain open for signature until February 12, 1950, by any country represented at the Conference which opened at Geneva on April 21, 1949, as well as by countries not represented at that Conference but which are parties to the Xth Hague Convention of October 18, 1907, for the adaptation to Maritime Warfare of the principles of the Geneva Convention of 1906, or to the Geneva Conventions of 1864, 1906, and 1929 for the relief of the wounded and sick in armies in the field.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十六条本公约应尽速批准，其批准书应交存于伯尔尼。
Translation: Article 56 This Convention shall be ratified as soon as possible, and the instruments of ratification shall be deposited at Berne.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十七条本公约在至少两国批准书交存后六个月发生效力。
Translation: Article 57 This Convention shall enter into force six months after the deposit of at least two instruments of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十八条在各缔约国间关系上，本公约代替推行1906年日内瓦公约之原则于海战之1907年10月18日第十海牙公约。
Translation: Article 58 In relations between the High Contracting Parties, this Convention replaces the Tenth Hague Convention of October 18, 1907, for the Adaptation to Maritime Warfare of the Principles of the Geneva Convention of 1906.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十九条本公约自生效之日起，任何未签字本公约之国家均得加入。
Translation: Article 59 Any State which has not signed this Convention may accede to it from the date on which it enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十条本公约之加入应以书面通知瑞士联邦委员会，自加入之通知收到之日起六个月后发生效力。
Translation: Article 60 Accession to this Convention shall be effected by written notification addressed to the Swiss Federal Council and shall take effect six months after the date of its receipt.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十一条第二条及第三条所载之情况应使在战事开始或占领之前或后，冲突各方所交存之批准书及加入之通知立即生效。
Translation: Article 61 The situations provided for in Articles 2 and 3 shall give immediate effect to ratifications deposited and accessions notified by the Parties to the conflict, whether before or after the beginning of hostilities or occupation.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十二条每一缔约国得自由退出本公约。
Translation: Article 62 Any Contracting State may withdraw from this Convention at its discretion.

Query_Text_cn: 但如缔约国于作退约通知时已卷入冲突，则其退约须待至和议成立后，并在有关本公约所保护之人员之释放及遣返之工作完毕后，始能生效。
Translation: However, if the denouncing Power is, at the time of making the notification, engaged in a conflict, the denunciation shall not take effect until peace has been concluded, and until after operations connected with the release and repatriation of the persons protected by the Convention have been terminated.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十三条瑞士联邦委员会应将本公约在联合国秘书处登记，并应将其所接获之所有关于本公约之批准、加入及退约通知联合国秘书处。
Translation: Article 63 The Swiss Federal Council shall register this Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations and shall notify the Secretariat of all ratifications, accessions and denunciations received in respect thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，下列签署人于交存全权证书后，签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned, having deposited their full powers, have signed this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 1949年8月12日以英文法文订于日内瓦。
Translation: Done at Geneva on 12 August 1949, in the English and French languages.

Query_Text_cn: 正本应交存于瑞士联邦委员会之档案中。
Translation: The original shall be deposited in the archives of the Swiss Federal Council.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将证明之抄本送交每一签字及加入之国家。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall transmit certified copies to each signatory and acceding State.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约签约各国，在海关合作理事会的主持下并经与联合国欧洲经济委员会和联合国教科文组织协商后召开会议。注意到国际贸易及其他各界代表所提建议，切望对货品在商业、技术、宗教、教育、科学、文化及慈善性质的展览会、交易会、会议或类似的活动事项中的展出品给予便利。
Translation:
The Contracting Parties to this Convention, meeting under the auspices of the Customs Co-operation Council and after consultation with the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe and the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization,  
Noting the proposals made by representatives of international trade and other interested circles,  
Desiring to facilitate the activities of commercial, technical, religious, educational, scientific, cultural or charitable exhibitions, fairs, meetings or similar events by granting facilities for the display of goods at such events,

Query_Text_cn: 但不包括私人为推销外货在商店或营业场所组织的展销会。
Translation: However, it does not include exhibitions organized by private individuals for the promotion of foreign goods in stores or business premises.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、"进口各税”一词指货物在进口时或因与进口有关应征的关税及其他各税，并应包括所有进口货应完的国内税和消费税，但不应包括数额与所供劳务成本相当，又不同于对国内产品的间接保护或对进口货的财政税收的规费及费用。
Translation: B. The term "import duties" refers to customs duties and all other duties and taxes imposed on, or in connection with, the importation of goods, including all internal taxes and excise duties chargeable on imported goods. However, it shall not include fees or charges commensurate with the cost of services rendered, which differ from indirect taxes imposed on domestic products for purposes of protection or fiscal revenue on imports.

Query_Text_cn: 、"暂准进口”一词指免征进口税，不受禁止或限制进口但须复出口的暂时进口。
Translation: The term "temporary admission" refers to the temporary importation free of import duties and exempt from import prohibitions or restrictions, subject to re-exportation.

Query_Text_cn: 丁、"理事会”一词指根据一九五零年十二月十五日在布鲁塞尔签订的"设立海关合作理事会公约”所设的机构。
Translation: Ding, “Council” means the body established by the Convention establishing a Customs Co-operation Council done at Brussels on 15 December 1950.

Query_Text_cn: 、"人”一词，除上下文另有规定者外，兼指自然人及法人。
Translation: The term "person," unless the context otherwise requires, includes natural persons and legal entities.

Query_Text_cn: 、拟供国际性会议、讨论会及大会用的收听翻译用具、录音机及具有教育、科学或文化性质的电影片等设备。
Translation: Equipment intended for international conferences, seminars, and assemblies, such as listening interpretation devices, recorders, and films of an educational, scientific, or cultural nature.

Query_Text_cn: 、经暂时进口国海关当局审定本公约所订应履行的条款。
Translation: b. Upon verification by the customs authorities of the country of temporary importation that the conditions stipulated in this Convention have been fulfilled.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、搬出活动事项的场所。
Translation: B. Venue for relocation activities.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条1、暂准进口货物应从其进口之日起的六个月内复运出口。
Translation: Article 4.1 Temporarily imported goods shall be re-exported within six months from the date of importation.

Query_Text_cn: 但暂时进口国的海关当局可以斟酌情况，尤其可以按活动事项的持续时间或性质限令货物在较短期限内复出口，但至少应准延长到该事项闭幕后一个月。
Translation: However, the customs authorities of the temporary importing country may, at their discretion—particularly based on the duration or nature of the event—require the goods to be re-exported within a shorter period, provided that this period is extended to at least one month after the conclusion of the event.

Query_Text_cn: 2、虽有本条第1款的规定，海关当局对以后将转移到另一活动事项中供展出或需用的上述货物应准其继续留在暂时进口国境内，但要遵守该国法规所定的条款，并保证货物在从进口之日起的一年内复出口。
Translation: 2. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1, the customs authorities shall permit the aforementioned goods intended for subsequent transfer to another event for exhibition or use to remain in the territory of the country of temporary importation, provided that the conditions stipulated by the national regulations are complied with and that the goods are re-exported within one year from the date of importation.

Query_Text_cn: 3、海关当局如认为有足够理由可在暂时进口国法规所定的时限内或者批准一段较本条第1及第2款规定的更长期限，或者延长其原有期限。
Translation: 3. The customs authorities may, if they deem it justified, either grant a period longer than that stipulated in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article or extend the original period within the time limits prescribed by the temporary importation regulations of the country.

Query_Text_cn: 4、当暂准进口货物因被查扣不能复出口时，除因私人诉讼被扣者外，本条所定的复出口规定在被扣期间应准缓期执行。
Translation: 4. Where temporarily imported goods cannot be re-exported due to seizure, the re-exportation requirements stipulated in this Article shall be suspended during the period of seizure, except in cases of seizure arising from private legal proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 、在官方监督下予以销毁，以免暂时进口国国库受到损失。
Translation: to be destroyed under official supervision to prevent loss to the treasury of the temporary importing country.

Query_Text_cn: 2、暂准进口的货物除复出口外，可以另行处理，特别当移充国内需用时，可按暂时进口国对从国外直接进口此类货物的法规规定和手续同样办理。
Translation: 2. Goods under temporary importation may be disposed of otherwise than by re-exportation, particularly when intended for domestic use, subject to the same regulations and formalities as those governing the direct importation of such goods from abroad in the country of temporary importation.

Query_Text_cn: (1)此项样品系国外免费提供并在展出期间专供免费分送给观众个人需用或消费的；(2)显系单价很小作广告样品用的；(3)不适于商业用途，且其每包容量显然较最小的零售包装为小的；(4)食品及饮料的样品虽未按上款(3)项规定的包装分发，但确系供活动事项中消费的；(5)货样的总值及总量，经进口国海关当局从活动事项的性质，参观人数和参加展出者的范围考虑，认为合理的。
(1)该项资料系国外免费供给，专为在该项活动期间向观众免费分送用的；(2)上述货物的总值和总量经进口国海关当局按活动事项的性质，参观人数，参加展出者的规模审核认为合理的。
Translation:
(1) The materials are provided free of charge from abroad and are exclusively intended for free distribution to the audience during the event;  
(2) The total value and quantity of the aforementioned goods have been reviewed and deemed reasonable by the customs authorities of the importing country, based on the nature of the event, the number of attendees, and the scale of participants.

Query_Text_cn: 2、本条第1款的规则不应适用于酒精饮料、烟叶制品及燃料。
Translation: 2. The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not apply to alcoholic beverages, tobacco products, or fuels.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条为了供召开的国际会议，代表会议或洽商会议内外的需用而进口的活页夹、档卷和其他文件，应准免征进口税并免去其禁止和限制进口。
Translation: Article 7: Loose-leaf binders, files, and other documents imported for use during or outside international conferences, delegate meetings, or negotiation meetings shall be exempt from import duties and free from import prohibitions and restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条每一缔约方应按本公约的规定，将应办的海关手续减至最低限度。
Translation: Article 8 Each Contracting Party shall reduce the customs formalities required to the minimum extent as stipulated in this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 有关的规章应尽早公布。
Translation: The relevant regulations should be promulgated as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条1、如缔约一方为了执行本公约所规定的关于批准给予便利的条款，要求缴付保证金时，其数额不应超过应征进口各税的十分之一。
Translation:
Article 9  
1. If a Contracting Party requires a deposit as security for the implementation of the provisions of this Convention concerning the granting of facilities, the amount shall not exceed one-tenth of the import duties and taxes chargeable.

Query_Text_cn: 2、上述缔约各方应按情况尽可能地接受该项活动事项的主办者或经海关认可的其他人所提供的总担保以代替本条第1款中所订的单项担保。
Translation: 2. The Contracting Parties concerned shall, as far as possible, accept a general security furnished by the organizer of the event or by any other person approved by the Customs in lieu of the individual security provided for in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条1、海关对任何活动事项中即将或已经展出或取用的货物其进口或复出口时的查验或结关应在可能和适当的情况下在该会会场办理。
Translation:
Article 10  
1. Customs inspection or clearance of goods imported or re-exported for display or use in any event activities, whether imminent or already undertaken, shall, where possible and appropriate, be conducted at the exhibition venue.

Query_Text_cn: 2、每一缔约方，在考虑到活动事项的重要性和规模大小应在可能和适当情况下为在该方领土内举办的活动事项，设立海关驻会场的临时办事处。
Translation: 2. Each Party shall, where possible and appropriate considering the importance and scale of the event, establish temporary customs offices at event venues within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 3、暂准进口的货物可通过经办此项业务的任何海关办事处成批或分批复出口，此项复出口不应限定在原进口地海关办理，但进口商为了获得简化手续的好处，自愿承诺在原进口地海关，办理复出口手续者除外。
Translation: 3. Goods under temporary importation may be re-exported in one or several consignments through any customs office handling such operations.
