Translation: a. The nominated bank acting on its nomination, the confirming bank (if any), and the issuing bank shall examine a presentation to determine, on the basis of the documents alone, whether or not the documents appear on their face to constitute a complying presentation.

Query_Text_cn: b．按指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)及开证行各有从交单次日起的至多五个银行工作日用以确定交单是否相符。
Translation: b. A nominated bank acting on its nomination, a confirming bank, if any, and the issuing bank shall each have a maximum of five banking days following the day of presentation to determine if a presentation is complying.

Query_Text_cn: 这一期限不因在交单日当天或之后信用证截止日或最迟交单日届至而受到缩减或影响。
Translation: This period shall not be curtailed or affected by the expiration of the credit or the latest presentation date on or after the date of presentation.

Query_Text_cn: c．如果单据中包含一份或多份受第十九、二十、二十一、二十二、二十三、二十四或二十五条规制的正本运输单据，则须由受益人或其代表在不迟于本惯例所指的发运日之后的二十一个日历日内交单，但是在任何情况下都不得迟于信用证的截止日。
Translation: c. If a presentation includes one or more original transport documents subject to Articles 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 or 25, such presentation must be made by or on behalf of the beneficiary not later than 21 calendar days after the date of shipment as indicated in these rules, but in any event not later than the expiry date of the credit.

Query_Text_cn: d．单据中的数据，在与信用证、单据本身以及国际标准银行实务参照解读时，无须与该单据本身中的数据、其他要求的单据或信用证中的数据等同一致，但不得矛盾。
Translation: d. Data in a document, when read in context with the credit, the document itself and international standard banking practice, need not be identical to, but must not conflict with, data in that document, any other stipulated document or the credit.

Query_Text_cn: e．除商业发票外，其他单据中的货物、服务或履约行为的描述，如果有的话，可使用与信用证中的描述不矛盾的概括性用语。
Translation: e. Except for commercial invoices, descriptions of goods, services, or performance in other documents, if any, may be expressed in general terms not inconsistent with those in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: f．如果信用证要求提交运输单据、保险单据或者商业发票之外的单据，却未规定出单人或其数据内容，则只要提交的单据内容看似满足所要求单据的功能，且其他方面符合第十四条d款，银行将接受该单据。
Translation: f. If a credit requires presentation of a document other than a transport document, insurance document or commercial invoice, without stipulating by whom the document is to be issued or its data content, banks will accept the document as presented if its content appears to fulfill the function of the required document and otherwise complies with sub-article 14(d).

Query_Text_cn: g．提交的非信用证所要求的单据将被不予理会，并可被退还给交单人。
Translation: g. Documents presented other than those required by the letter of credit will be disregarded and may be returned to the presenter.

Query_Text_cn: h．如果信用证含有一项条件，但未规定用以表明该条件得到满足的单据，银行将视为未作规定并不予理会。
Translation: h. If a credit contains a condition without stipulating the document to indicate compliance with that condition, banks will deem such condition as not stated and will disregard it.

Query_Text_cn: i．单据日期可以早于信用证的开立日期，但不得晚于交单日期。
Translation: i. The document date may be earlier than the issuance date of the credit, but must not be later than the date of presentation.

Query_Text_cn: j．当受益人和申请人的地址出现在任何规定的单据中时，无须与信用证或其他规定单据中所载相同，但必须与信用证中规定的相应地址同在一国。
Translation: j. When the addresses of the beneficiary and the applicant appear in any stipulated documents, they need not be identical to those stated in the credit or other stipulated documents, but must be within the same country as the respective addresses specified in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: 联络细节(传真、电话、电子邮件及类似细节)作为受益人和申请人地址的一部分时将被不予理会。
Translation: Contact details (fax, telephone, email, and the like) will be disregarded when forming part of the address of the beneficiary and applicant.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果申请人的地址和联络细节为第十九、二十、二十一、二十二、二十三、二十四或二十五条规定的运输单据上的收货人或通知方细节的一部分时，应与信用证规定的相同。
Translation: However, if the applicant's address and contact details form part of the consignee or notify party information on the transport document as stipulated in Articles 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, or 25, they shall be identical to those specified in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: k．在任何单据中注明的托运人或发货人无须为信用证的受益人。
Translation: k. The shipper or consignor indicated on any document need not be the beneficiary of the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: l．运输单据可以由任何人出具，无须为承运人、船东、船长或租船人，只要其符合第十九、二十、二十一、二十二、二十三或二十四条的要求。
Translation: l. A transport document may be issued by any person, not necessarily the carrier, shipowner, master or charterer, provided it meets the requirements of Articles 19, 20, 21, 22, 23 or 24.

Query_Text_cn: a．当开证行确定交单相符时，必须承付。
Translation: a. The issuing bank must honor the presentation if it determines that the documents comply.

Query_Text_cn: b．当保兑行确定交单相符时，必须承付或者议付并将单据转递给开证行。
Translation: b. When the confirming bank determines that the documents presented comply, it must honor or negotiate and forward the documents to the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: c．当指定银行确定交单相符并承付或议付时，必须将单据转递给保兑行或开证行。
Translation: c. When the nominated bank determines that a presentation is complying and honors or negotiates, it must forward the documents to the confirming bank or issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: a．当按照指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或者开证行确定交单不符时，可以拒绝承付或议付。
Translation: a. When the nominated bank, the confirming bank (if any), or the issuing bank acting on their instructions determines that the presentation does not comply, it may refuse to honor or negotiate.

Query_Text_cn: b．当开证行确定交单不符时，可以自行决定联系申请人放弃不符点。
Translation: b. When the issuing bank determines that the documents presented are discrepant, it may, at its sole discretion, contact the applicant to waive the discrepancies.

Query_Text_cn: 然而这并不能延长第十四条b款所指的期限。
Translation: However, this does not extend the period referred to in Article 14(b).

Query_Text_cn: c．当按照指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或开证行决定拒绝承付或议付时，必须给予交单人一份单独的拒付通知。
Translation: c. When the nominated bank acting on its nomination, the confirming bank (if any), or the issuing bank decides to refuse to honor or negotiate, it must provide the presenter with a separate notice of refusal.

Query_Text_cn: d)银行将按之前从交单人处获得的指示处理。
Translation: d) The bank will process in accordance with the instructions previously obtained from the presenter.

Query_Text_cn: d．第十六条c款要求的通知必须以电讯方式，如不可能，则以其他快捷方式，在不迟于自交单之翌日起第五个银行工作日结束前发出。
Translation: d. The notice required under Article 16(c) must be given by telecommunication or, if that is not possible, by other expeditious means no later than the close of the fifth banking day following the day of presentation.

Query_Text_cn: e．按照指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或开证行在按照第十六条c款ⅲ项a)或b)发出了通知之后，可以在任何时候将单据退还交单人。
Translation: e. The nominated bank acting on its nomination, the confirming bank, if any, or the issuing bank may, after providing the notice required by sub-article 16 (c)(iii)(a) or (b), return the documents to the presenter at any time.

Query_Text_cn: f．如果开证行或保兑行未能按照本条行事，则无权宣称交单不符。
Translation: f. If the issuing bank or confirming bank fails to act in accordance with this article, it shall be precluded from claiming that the documents do not constitute a complying presentation.

Query_Text_cn: g．当开证行拒绝承付或保兑行拒绝承付或者议付，并且按照本条发出了拒付通知后，有权要求返还已偿付的款项及利息。
Translation: g. When the issuing bank refuses to honor or the confirming bank refuses to honor or negotiate, and has issued a notice of dishonor in accordance with this article, it is entitled to demand the return of the reimbursed amount plus interest.

Query_Text_cn: a．信用证规定的每一种单据须至少提交一份正本。
Translation: a. At least one original of each document stipulated in the letter of credit must be presented.

Query_Text_cn: b．银行应将任何带有看似出单人的原始签名、标记、印戳或标签的单据视为正本单据，除非单据本身表明其非正本。
Translation: b. Banks shall treat any document bearing an original signature, mark, stamp, or label that appears to be issued by the issuer as an original document, unless the document itself indicates that it is not original.

Query_Text_cn: 或者ⅲ．单据声明其为正本单据，除非该声明看似不适用于提交的单据。
Translation: or iii. the document states that it is an original, unless the statement appears not to apply to the document presented.

Query_Text_cn: d．如果信用证要求提交单据的副本，提交正本或副本均可。
Translation: d. If the credit requires presentation of copies of documents, either originals or copies may be presented.

Query_Text_cn: e．如果信用证使用诸如“一式两份(induplicate)”、“两份(intwofold)”、“两套(intwocopras)”等用语要求提交多份单据，则提交至少一份正本，其余使用副本即可满足要求，除非单据本身另有说明。
Translation: e. If the credit employs terms such as "in duplicate," "in twofold," or "in two copies" to require the presentation of multiple documents, the submission of at least one original and the remainder in copies shall suffice, unless otherwise stipulated in the document itself.

Query_Text_cn: 且ⅳ．无须签名。
Translation: And iv. No signature is required.

Query_Text_cn: b．按指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或开证行可以接受金额大于信用证允许金额的商业发票，其决定对有关各方均有约束力，只要该银行对超过信用证允许金额的部分未作承付或者议付。
Translation: b. A nominated bank acting on its nomination, a confirming bank (if any), or the issuing bank may accept a commercial invoice issued for an amount in excess of the amount permitted by the credit, and its decision shall be binding on all parties, provided that the bank has not honored or negotiated for an amount in excess of that permitted by the credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．商业发票上的货物、服务或履约行为的描述应该与信用证中的描述一致。
Translation: c. The description of the goods, services, or performance in the commercial invoice must correspond with that in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: *承运人或其具名代理人，或者*船长或其具名代理人。
Translation: *The carrier or its named agent, or* the master or its named agent.

Query_Text_cn: 承运人、船长或代理人的任何签字，必须标明其承运人、船长或代理人的身份。
Translation: Any signature by the carrier, master or agent must indicate their capacity as carrier, master or agent.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人的任何签字必须标明其系代表承运人还是船长签字。
Translation: Any signature by an agent must indicate whether it is made on behalf of the carrier or the master.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．通过以下方式表明货物已经在信用证规定的地点发送、接管或已装运。
Translation: ii. Evidence that the goods have been dispatched, taken in charge, or loaded on board at the place stipulated in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: *事先印就的文字；__UNDEF__或者*表明货物已经被发送、接管或装运日期的印戳或批注。
Translation: * Pre-printed wording; __UNDEF__, or * indicates the date of dispatch, taking in charge, or shipment by means of a stamp or notation.

Query_Text_cn: 运输单据的出具日期将被视为发送、接管或装运的日期，也即发运的日期。
Translation: The issuance date of the transport document shall be deemed the date of dispatch, taking in charge, or shipment, i.e., the date of dispatch.

Query_Text_cn: 然而如单据以印戳或批注的方式表明了发送、接管或装运日期，该日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: However, if the document indicates the date of dispatch, taking in charge or shipment by means of a stamp or notation, such date shall be deemed to be the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: b)该运输单据载有“预期的”或类似的关于船只、装货港或卸货港的限定语。
Translation: b) The transport document bears the notation "intended" or similar qualification in relation to the vessel, port of loading, or port of discharge.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．为唯一的正本运输单据，或者，如果出具为多份正本，则为运输单据中表明的全套单据。
Translation: iv. Consisting of the sole original transport document or, in case of multiple originals, the full set as indicated on the transport document.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．载有承运条款和条件，或提示承运条款和条件参见别处(简式／背面空白的运输单据)。
Translation: v. Containing the terms and conditions of carriage, or indicating that the terms and conditions of carriage are referenced elsewhere (short form/blank back transport document).

Query_Text_cn: 银行将不审核承运条款和条件的内容。
Translation: The bank will not examine the content of the terms and conditions of carriage.

Query_Text_cn: ⅵ．未表明受租船合同约束。
Translation: vi. Not subject to charter party terms.

Query_Text_cn: b．就本条而言，转运指在从信用证规定的发送、接管或者发运地点至最终目的地的运输过程中从某一运输工具上卸下货物并装上另一运输工具的行为(无论其是否为不同的运输方式)。
Translation: b. For the purpose of this article, transhipment means unloading from one means of conveyance and reloading to another means of conveyance during the carriage from the place of dispatch, taking in charge or shipment to the place of final destination, whether or not involving different modes of transport.

Query_Text_cn: c．ⅰ．运输单据可以表明货物将要或可能被转运，只要全程运输由同一运输单据涵盖。
Translation: c.i. A transport document may indicate that the goods will or may be transshipped, provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same transport document.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．即使信用证禁止转运，注明将要或者可能发生转运的运输单据仍可接受。
Translation: ii. Transport documents indicating that transshipment will or may occur are acceptable even if the credit prohibits transshipment.

Query_Text_cn: *预先印就的文字，或者*已装船批注表明货物的装运日期。
Translation: *Preprinted text, or* an on board notation indicating the date of shipment of the goods.

Query_Text_cn: 提单的出具日期将被视为发运日期，除非提单载有表明发运日期的已装船批注，此时已装船批注中显示的日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: The date of issuance of the bill of lading will be deemed to be the date of shipment unless the bill of lading contains an on board notation indicating the date of shipment, in which case the date stated in the on board notation will be deemed to be the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 如果提单载有“预期船只”或类似的关于船名的限定语，则需以已装船批注明确发运日期以及实际船名。
Translation: If the bill of lading contains the term "intended vessel" or similar qualification in relation to the name of the vessel, an on board notation indicating the date of shipment and the actual name of the vessel is required.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．表明货物从信用证规定的装货港发运至卸货港。
Translation: iii. Indicates that the goods are dispatched from the loading port specified in the credit to the port of discharge.

Query_Text_cn: 如果提单没有表明信用证规定的装货港为装货港，或者其载有“预期的”或类似的关于装货港的限定语，则需以已装船批注表明信用证规定的装货港、发运日期以及实际船名。
Translation: If the bill of lading does not indicate the port of loading stipulated in the credit as the port of loading, or if it bears the notation "intended" or similar qualification in relation to the port of loading, an on-board notation must specify the port of loading as stipulated in the credit, the date of shipment, and the name of the actual vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 即使提单以事先印就的文字表明了货物已装载或装运于具名船只，本规定仍适用。
Translation: This provision applies even if the bill of lading contains pre-printed wording indicating that the goods have been loaded on board or shipped on a named vessel.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．为唯一的正本提单，或如果以多份正本出具，为提单中表明的全套正本。
Translation: iv. The sole original bill of lading or, if issued in more than one original, the full set of originals as indicated on the bill of lading.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．载有承运条款和条件，或提示承运条款和条件参见别处(简式／背面空白的提单)。
Translation: V. Containing the terms and conditions of carriage or making reference to another source containing the terms and conditions of carriage (short form/blank back bill of lading).

Query_Text_cn: b．就本条而言，转运系指在信用证规定的装货港到卸货港之间的运输过程中，将货物从一船卸下并再装上另一船的行为。
Translation: b. For the purpose of this article, transhipment means unloading and reloading from one vessel to another vessel during the carriage from the port of loading to the port of discharge stipulated in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．ⅰ．提单可以表明货物将要或可能被转运，只要全程运输由同一提单涵盖。
Translation: c. i. The bill of lading may indicate that the goods are to or may be transshipped, provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same bill of lading.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ即使信用证禁止转运，注明将要或可能发生转运的提单仍可接受，只要其表明货物由集装箱、拖车或子船运输。
Translation: ii Even if a credit prohibits transhipment, a bill of lading indicating that transhipment will or may take place is acceptable, provided it states that the goods are transported in containers, trailers or LASH barges.

Query_Text_cn: d．提单中声明承运人保留转运权利的条款将被不予理会。
Translation: d. Any clause in the bill of lading stating that the carrier reserves the right to transship shall be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: 不可转让海运单的出具日期将被视为发运日期，除非其上带有已装船批注注明发运日期，此时已装船批注注明的日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: The date of issuance of the non-negotiable sea waybill will be deemed to be the date of shipment unless it bears an on board notation indicating the date of shipment,in which case the date stated in the on board notation will be deemed to be the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 如果不可转让海运单载有“预期船只”或类似的关于船名的限定语，则需要以已装船批注表明发运日期和实际船名。
Translation: If a non-negotiable sea waybill contains the indication "intended vessel" or similar qualification in relation to the name of the vessel, an on board notation indicating the date of shipment and the actual name of the vessel is required.

Query_Text_cn: 如果不可转让海运单未以信用证规定的装货港为装货港，或者如果其载有“预期的”或类似的关于装货港的限定语，则需要以已装船批注表明信用证规定的装货港、发运日期和船名。
Translation: If the non-negotiable sea waybill does not indicate the port of loading stipulated in the credit as the port of loading, or if it bears the notation "intended" or similar qualification in relation to the port of loading, an on-board notation specifying the port of loading as stipulated in the credit, the date of shipment, and the name of the vessel is required.

Query_Text_cn: 即使不可转让海运单以预先印就的文字表明货物已由具名船只装载或装运，本规定也适用。
Translation: This provision shall also apply even if the non-negotiable sea waybill contains a pre-printed notation indicating that the goods have been loaded on board or shipped on a named vessel.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．为唯一的正本不可转让海运单，或如果以多份正本出具，为海运单上注明的全套正本。
Translation: iv. The sole original non-negotiable sea waybill, or if issued in more than one original, the full set of originals as indicated on the sea waybill.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．载有承运条款和条件，或提示承运条款和条件参见别处(简式／背面空白的海运单)。
Translation: v. Containing the terms and conditions of carriage, or indicating that the terms and conditions of carriage are referenced elsewhere (short form/blank back ocean waybill).

Query_Text_cn: c．ⅰ．不可转让海运单可以注明货物将要或可能被转运，只要全程运输由同一海运单涵盖。
Translation: c. i. A non-negotiable sea waybill may indicate that the goods are to or may be transshipped, provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same sea waybill.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．即使信用证禁止转运，注明转运将要或可能发生的不可转让的海运单仍可接受，只要其表明货物装于集装箱、拖船或子船中运输。
Translation: ii. Even if a credit prohibits transshipment, a non-negotiable sea waybill indicating that transshipment will or may take place is acceptable, provided that it states that the goods are shipped in containers, trailers, or LASH barges.

Query_Text_cn: d．不可转让的海运单中声明承运人保留转运权利的条款将被不予理会。
Translation: d. Any clause in a non-negotiable sea waybill stating that the carrier reserves the right to transship shall be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: *船长或其具名代理人，或*船东或其具名代理人，或*租船人或其具名代理人。
Translation:
* the Master or his named agent, or  
* the Shipowner or his named agent, or  
* the Charterer or his named agent.

Query_Text_cn: 船长、船东、租船人或代理人的任何签字必须标明其船长、船东、租船人或代理人的身份。
Translation: Any signature by the master, owner, charterer or agent must be identified as that of the master, owner, charterer or agent.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人签字必须表明其系代表船长、船东还是租船人签字。
Translation: The agent's signature must indicate whether it is made on behalf of the master, shipowner, or charterer.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人代表船东或租船人签字时必须注明船东或租船人的名称。
Translation: When signing as an agent on behalf of the shipowner or charterer, the agent must indicate the name of the shipowner or charterer.

Query_Text_cn: 租船合同提单的出具日期将被视为发运日期，除非租船合同提单载有已装船批注注明发运日期，此时已装船批注上注明的日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: The date of issuance of the charter party bill of lading shall be deemed the date of shipment unless the charter party bill of lading contains an on board notation indicating the date of shipment, in which case the date stated in the on board notation shall be deemed the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 卸货港也可显示为信用证规定的港口范围或地理区域。
Translation: The port of discharge may also be indicated as a range of ports or a geographical area specified in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．为唯一的正本租船合同提单，或如以多份正本出具，为租船合同提单注明的全套正本。
Translation: iv. The sole original charter party bill of lading or, if issued in more than one original, the full set of originals as indicated on the charter party bill of lading.

Query_Text_cn: b．银行将不审核租船合同，即使信用证要求提交租船合同。
Translation: b. Banks will not examine charter party contracts, even if the letter of credit requires their submission.

Query_Text_cn: *承运人，或*承运人的具名代理人。
Translation: *Carrier, or *named agent of the carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 承运人或其代理人的任何签字必须标明其承运人或代理人的身份。
Translation: Any signature by the carrier or its agent must indicate their capacity as carrier or agent.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人签字必须表明其系代表承运人签字。
Translation: The agent's signature must indicate that they are signing on behalf of the carrier.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．表明货物已被收妥待运。
Translation: ii. Indicating that the goods have been received for shipment.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．表明出具日期。
Translation: iii. Indicate the date of issuance.

Query_Text_cn: 该日期将被视为发运日期，除非空运单据载有专门批注注明实际发运日期，此时批注中的日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: This date shall be deemed to be the date of shipment unless the air transport document bears a specific notation indicating the actual date of shipment, in which case the date stated in the notation shall be considered the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 空运单据中其他与航班号和航班日期相关的信息将不被用来确定发运日期。
Translation: Other information in the air transport document relative to the flight number and flight date will not be considered in determining the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．表明信用证规定的起飞机场和目的地机场。
Translation: iv. Indicate the airports of departure and destination as stipulated in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．为开给发货人或托运人的正本，即使信用证规定提交全套正本。
Translation: v. To be issued to the consignor or shipper as the original, even if the letter of credit stipulates the submission of a full set of originals.

Query_Text_cn: ⅵ．载有承运条款和条件，或提示条款和条件参见别处。
Translation: vi. Containing the carrier's terms and conditions, or indicating where such terms and conditions may be found.

Query_Text_cn: b．就本条而言，转运是指在信用证规定的起飞机场到目的地机场的运输过程中，将货物从一飞机卸下再装上另一飞机的行为。
Translation: b. For the purpose of this article, transhipment means unloading from one aircraft and reloading to another aircraft during the carriage from the airport of departure to the airport of destination as stipulated in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．ⅰ．空运单据可以注明货物将要或可能转运，只要全程运输由同一空运单据涵盖。
Translation: c. i. An air transport document may indicate that the goods will or may be transshipped, provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same air transport document.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．即使信用证禁止转运，注明将要或可能发生转运的空运单据仍可接受。
Translation: ii. Even if the credit prohibits transshipment, air transport documents indicating that transshipment will or may occur are still acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: ⅰ．表明承运人名称，并且*由承运人或其具名代理人签署，或者*由承运人或其具名代理人以签字、印戳或批注表明货物收讫。
Translation: i. Indicate the name of the carrier and be *signed by the carrier or a named agent, or *bear a signature, stamp, or notation of receipt of the goods by the carrier or a named agent.

Query_Text_cn: 承运人或其具名代理人的收货签字、印戳或批注必须标明其承运人或代理人的身份。
Translation: The carrier or its named agent's receipt signature, stamp, or notation must clearly indicate its identity as the carrier or agent.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人的收货签字、印戳或批注必须标明代理人系代表承运人签字或行事。
Translation: The agent's signature, stamp, or endorsement upon receipt must clearly indicate that the agent is signing or acting on behalf of the carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 如果铁路运输单据没有指明承运人，可以接受铁路运输公司的任何签字或印戳作为承运人签署单据的证据。
Translation: If a railway transport document does not identify the carrier, any signature or stamp of the railway company will be accepted as evidence of the document being signed by the carrier.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．表明货物在信用证规定地点的发运日期，或者收讫待运或待发送的日期。
Translation: ii. Indicate the date of shipment at the place specified in the credit, or the date of receipt for dispatch or readiness for dispatch.

Query_Text_cn: 运输单据的出具日期将被视为发运日期，除非运输单据上盖有带日期的收货印戳，或注明了收货日期或发运日期。
Translation: The date of issuance of the transport document will be deemed to be the date of shipment unless the document bears a dated reception stamp, or indicates the date of receipt or the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．表明信用证规定的发运地及目的地。
Translation: iii. Indicate the place of shipment and destination as stipulated in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: b．ⅰ．公路运输单据必须看似为开给发货人或托运人的正本，或没有任何标记表明单据开给何人。
Translation: b. i. The road transport document must appear to be the original consigned to the shipper or consignor, or bear no marking indicating to whom the document is issued.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．注明“第二联”的铁路运输单据将被作为正本接受。
Translation: ii. Railway transport documents marked "Duplicate" will be accepted as originals.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．无论是否注明正本字样，铁路或内陆水运单据都被作为正本接受。
Translation: iii. Railway or inland waterway transport documents are accepted as originals, whether marked as such or not.

Query_Text_cn: c．如运输单据上未注明出具的正本数量，提交的份数即视为全套正本。
Translation: c. If the number of originals issued is not stated on the transport document, the number of copies submitted shall be deemed to constitute a full set of originals.

Query_Text_cn: d．就本条而言，转运是指在信用证规定的发运、发送或运送的地点到目的地之间的运输过程中，在同一运输方式中从一运输工具卸下再装上另一运输工具的行为。
Translation: d. For the purpose of this article, transhipment means unloading from one means of conveyance and reloading to another means of conveyance within the same mode of transport during the carriage from the place of shipment, dispatch or carriage to the place of destination as stipulated in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: e．ⅰ．只要全程运输由同一运输单据涵盖，公路、铁路或内陆水运单据可以注明货物将要或可能被转运。
Translation: e. i. Road, rail or inland waterway transport documents may indicate that the goods will or may be transhipped, provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same transport document.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．即使信用证禁止转运，注明将要或可能发生转运的公路、铁路或内陆水运单据仍可接受。
Translation: ii. Road, rail or inland waterway transport documents indicating that transshipment will or may take place are acceptable, even if the credit prohibits transshipment.

Query_Text_cn: 并且ⅱ．表明取件或收件的日期或类似词语。
Translation: and ii. indicate the date of pickup or receipt or similar wording.

Query_Text_cn: 该日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: This date shall be deemed as the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: b．如果要求显示快递费用付讫或预付，快递机构出具的表明快递费由收货人以外的一方支付的运输单据可以满足该项要求。
Translation: b. If the requirement is to show that the freight charges have been paid or prepaid, a transport document issued by a courier service indicating that the courier charges are to be paid by a party other than the consignee will satisfy that requirement.

Query_Text_cn: c．证明货物收讫待运的邮政收据或投邮证明，无论名称如何，必须看似在信用证规定的货物发运地点盖章或签署并注明日期。
Translation: c. A post receipt or certificate of posting, however named, evidencing receipt of goods for transport, must appear to be stamped or signed and dated at the place of shipment specified in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: a．运输单据不得表明货物装于或者将装于舱面。
Translation: a. The transport document must not indicate that the goods are or will be loaded on deck.

Query_Text_cn: 声明货物可能被装于舱面的运输单据条款可以接受。
Translation: Transport document clauses stating that the goods may be carried on deck are acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: b．载有诸如“托运人装载和计数”或“内容据托运人报称”条款的运输单据可以接受。
Translation: b. Transport documents containing terms such as "shipper's load and count" or "said by shipper to contain" are acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: c．运输单据上可以以印戳或其他方式提及运费之外的费用。
Translation: c. Transport documents may indicate additional charges beyond freight by means of stamps or other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条清洁运输单据银行只接受清洁运输单据。
Translation:
Article 27 Clean Transport Document  
A bank will only accept a clean transport document.

Query_Text_cn: 清洁运输单据指未载有明确宣称货物或包装有缺陷的条款或批注的运输单据。
Translation: A clean transport document refers to one that does not bear any clauses or notations expressly declaring a defective condition of the goods or their packaging.

Query_Text_cn: “清洁”一词并不需要在运输单据上出现，即使信用证要求运输单据为“清洁已装船”的。
Translation: The term "clean" need not appear on the transport document, even if the credit requires a "clean on board" transport document.

Query_Text_cn: a．保险单据，例如保险单或预约保险项下的保险证明书或者声明书，必须看似由保险公司或承保人或其代理人或代表出具并签署。
Translation: a. Insurance documents, such as insurance policies or certificates or declarations under an open cover, must appear to be issued and signed by insurance companies or underwriters or their agents or proxies.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人或代表的签字必须表明其系代表保险公司或承保人签字。
Translation: The signature of an agent or representative must indicate that it is made on behalf of the insurance company or underwriter.

Query_Text_cn: b．如果保险单据表明其以多份正本出具，所有正本均须提交。
Translation: b. If the insurance document indicates that it has been issued in multiple originals, all originals must be presented.

Query_Text_cn: c．暂保单将不被接受。
Translation: c. Cover notes will not be accepted.

Query_Text_cn: d．可以接受保险单代替预约保险项下的保险证明书或声明书。
Translation: d. An insurance policy may be accepted in lieu of an insurance certificate or declaration under open cover.

Query_Text_cn: e．保险单据日期不得晚于发运日期，除非保险单据表明保险责任不迟于发运日生效。
Translation: e. The insurance document date must not be later than the shipment date, unless the document indicates that the insurance coverage is effective no later than the shipment date.

Query_Text_cn: f．ⅰ．保险单据必须表明投保金额并以与信用证相同的货币表示。
Translation: f. Insurance documents must indicate the amount of coverage and be denominated in the same currency as the credit.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．信用证对于投保金额为货物价值、发票金额或类似金额的某一比例的要求，将被视为对最低保额的要求。
Translation: ii. A requirement in the credit for insurance coverage to be for a proportion of the value of the goods,of the invoice value or similar is deemed to be the minimum amount of coverage required.

Query_Text_cn: 如果信用证对投保金额未做规定，投保金额须至少为货物的CIF或CIP价格的百分之一百一十。
Translation: If the letter of credit does not specify the insured amount, the coverage must be at least 110% of the CIF or CIP value of the goods.

Query_Text_cn: 如果从单据中不能确定CIF或者CIP价格，投保金额必须基于要求承付或议付的金额，或者基于发票上显示的货物总值来计算，两者之中取金额较高者。
Translation: If the CIF or CIP value cannot be determined from the documents, the amount to be insured must be calculated based on the amount for which honor or negotiation is requested or the gross invoice value of the goods, whichever is greater.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．保险单据须表明承保的风险区间至少涵盖从信用证规定的货物接管地或发运地开始到卸货地或最终目的地为止。
Translation: iii. Insurance documents must indicate that the risks covered are at least between the place of taking in charge or shipment of the goods as stipulated in the credit and the place of discharge or final destination.

Query_Text_cn: g．信用证应规定所需投保的险别及附加险(如有的话)。
Translation: g. The letter of credit shall specify the required insurance coverage and any additional risks (if applicable).

Query_Text_cn: 如果信用证使用诸如“通常风险”或“惯常风险”等含义不确切的用语，则无论是否有漏保之风险。__UNDEF__保险单据将被照样接受。
Translation: If the credit uses vague terms such as "usual risks" or "customary risks," the insurance document will be accepted regardless of whether any risks are not covered.

Query_Text_cn: h．当信用证规定投保“一切险”时，如保险单据载有任何“一切险”批注或条款，无论是否有“一切险”标题，均将被接受，即使其声明任何风险除外。
Translation: h. When a credit requires insurance against "all risks" and an insurance document is presented containing any "all risks" notation or clause, it will be accepted regardless of whether it bears the heading "all risks," even if it indicates the exclusion of certain risks.

Query_Text_cn: i．保险单据可以援引任何除外条款。
Translation: i. Insurance documents may invoke any exclusion clauses.

Query_Text_cn: j．保险单据可以注明受免赔率或免赔额(减除额)约束。
Translation: j. Insurance documents may indicate that the coverage is subject to a franchise or deductible (excess).

Query_Text_cn: a．如果信用证的截止日或最迟交单日适逢接受交单的银行非因第三十六条所述原因而歇业，则截止日或最迟交单日，视何者适用，将顺延至其重新开业的第一个银行工作日。
Translation: a. If the expiry date or the latest date for presentation falls on a day when the bank to which presentation is to be made is closed for reasons other than those referred to in Article 36, the expiry date or the latest date for presentation, as the case may be, will be extended to the first following banking day on which such bank is open.

Query_Text_cn: b．如果在顺延后的第一个银行工作日交单，指定银行必须在其致开证行或保兑行的面函中声明交单是在根据第二十九条a款顺延的期限内提交的。
Translation: b. If presentation is made on the first following banking day, the nominated bank must state in its covering schedule to the issuing bank or confirming bank that the presentation was made within the time limits extended in accordance with sub-article 29 (a).

Query_Text_cn: c．最迟发运日不因第二十九条a款规定的原因而顺延。
Translation: c. The latest shipment date shall not be extended due to the reasons stipulated in Article 29(a).

Query_Text_cn: （1）本国际商会第522号出版物《托收统一规则》1995年修订本，应适用于第二条界定的、并在第四条"托收指示”中列明适用该项规则的所有托收项目，且除非另有明确的相反约定，或与无法规避的某一国家、政府或地方法律及/或法规相抵触，本规则对所有的当事人均具有约束力。
Translation: (1) The Uniform Rules for Collections, 1995 Revision, ICC Publication No. 522, shall apply to all collections as defined in Article 2 where such rules are incorporated into the text of the "collection instruction" referred to in Article 4 and are binding on all parties thereto unless otherwise expressly agreed or contrary to the provisions of a national, state or local law and/or regulation which cannot be departed from.

Query_Text_cn: （2）银行没有义务必须办理某一托收或任何托收指示或以后的相关指示。
Translation: (2) Banks are under no obligation to handle any particular collection or any related instructions subsequently issued in connection with a collection order.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如果银行无论出于何种理由选择不办理它所收到的托收或任何相关的托收指示，应毫不延误地采用电讯，或者如果电讯不可能时，采用其它快捷的工具，通知向其发出托收或指示的当事人。
Translation: (3) If a bank elects, for any reason, not to handle a collection or any related instructions received by it, it must advise the party from whom it received the collection or the instructions by telecommunication or, if that is not possible, by other expeditious means without delay.

Query_Text_cn: 或c.按照其他条款和条件交付单据。
Translation: or c. the documents are presented under any other terms and conditions.

Query_Text_cn: （2）单据是指金融单据及/或商业单据。
Translation: (2) Documents mean financial documents and/or commercial documents.

Query_Text_cn: b.商业单据是指发票、运输单据、所有权单据或其他类似的单据，或者不属于金融单据的任何其他单据。
Translation: b. Commercial documents refer to invoices, transport documents, documents of title, or similar documents, or any other documents that are not financial documents.

Query_Text_cn: （3）光票托收是指不附有商业单据的金融单据项下的托收。
Translation: (3) Clean collection refers to the collection of financial documents unaccompanied by commercial documents.

Query_Text_cn: b.不附有金融单据的商业单据项下的托收。
Translation: b. Collection under commercial documents unaccompanied by financial documents.

Query_Text_cn: d.提示行，即向付款人提示单据的代收行。
Translation: d. Presenting bank, which is the collecting bank that presents the documents to the drawee.

Query_Text_cn: （2）付款人，即根据托收指示向其提示单据的人。
Translation: (2) The drawee, that is the person to whom documents are to be presented in accordance with the collection instruction.

Query_Text_cn: （1）a.所有送往托收的单据必须附有一项托收指示，注明该项托收将遵循《托收统一规则》第522号出版物，并列出完整和明确的指示。
Translation: (1) a. All documents sent for collection must be accompanied by a collection instruction indicating that the collection is subject to Uniform Rules for Collections, Publication No. 522, and giving complete and precise instructions.

Query_Text_cn: c.除非托收指示中另有授权，银行将不理会向其发出托收的任何当事人/银行以外的任何当事人/银行的任何指示。
Translation: c. Unless otherwise authorized in the collection instruction, banks will disregard any instructions from any party/bank other than the remitting party/bank from which they received the collection.

Query_Text_cn: k.发生拒绝付款、拒绝承兑及/或与其他指示不相符的情况时应给出的指示。
Translation: k. Instructions to be given in the event of dishonor by non-payment, non-acceptance, and/or non-compliance with other instructions.

Query_Text_cn: （3）a.托收指示应载明付款人或将要办理提示的场所之完整地址。如果地址不全或有错误，代收银行可尽力查明适当的地址，但其本身不承担任何义务和责任。
Translation: (3) a. The collection instruction must specify the full address of the drawee or of the domicile at which presentation is to be made. If the address is incomplete or incorrect, the collecting bank may, without obligation and responsibility on its part, endeavor to ascertain the proper address.

Query_Text_cn: b.代收银行对因所提供地址不全或有误所造成的任何延误，将不承担任何责任。
Translation: b. The collecting bank shall not be liable for any delay caused by incomplete or incorrect address information provided.

Query_Text_cn: 提示（1）就本规则各项条款而言，提示是指银行按照指示将单据提供给付款人的程序。
Translation: For the purposes of the provisions of these Rules, presentation means the procedure whereby the presenting bank makes documents available to the drawee as instructed.

Query_Text_cn: （2）托收指示应列明付款人将要采取行动的确切期限。诸如"首先、迅速、立即”和类似的表述，不应用于指提示、或付款人赎单或采取任何其他行动的任何期限。如果采用了该类术语，银行将不予理会。
Translation: (2) The collection order should specify the exact period within which the payment is to be made by the drawee. Terms such as "first," "prompt," "immediate," and the like should not be used to indicate the time for payment or for any other action to be taken by the drawee in respect of documents. If such terms are used, banks will disregard them.

Query_Text_cn: （3）单据必须以银行收到时的形式向付款人提示，但经授权银行可以贴附任何必需的印章，并按照说明由向银行发出托收的当事人承担费用，而且银行可以经授权采取任何必要的背书或加盖橡皮戳记、或其他托收业务惯用的和必要的辨认记号或符号。
Translation: (3) Documents must be presented to the drawee in the form received by the collecting bank, except that the bank is authorized to affix any necessary stamps at the expense of the party from whom it received the collection, and may make any necessary endorsements or place any rubber stamps or other customary or necessary identifying marks or symbols on the documents as required for the collection operation.

Query_Text_cn: （4）为了使委托人的指示得以实现，托收行将以委托人所指定的银行作为代收行。在未指定代收行时，托收行将使用自己的任何银行，或者在付款或承兑的国家中、或必须遵守其他条件的国家中选择另外的银行。
Translation: (4) To effect the principal's instructions, the collecting bank shall utilize the bank designated by the principal as the presenting bank. In the absence of such designation, the collecting bank may employ any of its own correspondent banks or select another bank in the country of payment or acceptance, or in the country where other terms must be complied with.

Query_Text_cn: （5）单据和托收指示可以由托收行直接或者通过另一银行作为中间银行寄送给代收行。
Translation: (5) Documents and the collection instruction may be sent directly by the remitting bank to the collecting bank or through another bank as intermediary.

Query_Text_cn: （6）如果托收行未指定某一特定的提示行，代办行可自行选择提示行。
Translation: (6) If the remitting bank has not designated a specific presenting bank, the collecting bank may select a presenting bank at its discretion.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条：即期付款/承兑。
Translation: Article 6: Payment at Sight/Acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 是见单即付的单据，提示行必须立即办理提示付款，不得延误；如果不是即期而是远期付款单据，提示行必须在要求承兑时毫不拖延地提示承兑，在要求付款时，不应晚于适当的到期日办理提示付款。
Translation: It is a document payable at sight, and the presenting bank must promptly present it for payment without delay. If it is not a sight payment document but a time payment one, the presenting bank must present it for acceptance without delay when acceptance is required, and for payment no later than the appropriate maturity date when payment is demanded.

Query_Text_cn: （1）如果托收包含有远期付款的汇票，则其指示不应要求付款才交付商业单据。
Translation: (1) If a collection contains a bill of exchange payable at a future date, the instructions should not require the commercial documents to be delivered only against payment.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如果托收包含有远期付款的汇票，托收指示应说明商业单据是凭承兑（D/A）还是凭付款（D/P）发放给付款人。若无上述说明，商业单据只能是付款放单，而代收行对由于交付单据的任何延误所产生的任何后果将不承担责任。
Translation: (2) If the collection includes a bill of exchange payable at a future date, the collection instruction should specify whether the commercial documents are to be released to the drawee against acceptance (D/A) or against payment (D/P). In the absence of such indication, the documents shall be released only against payment, and the collecting bank will not be responsible for any consequences arising from any delay in the delivery of documents.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如果托收包含有远期付款的汇票，而且托收指示表明应凭付款发放商业单据时，则单据只能凭该项付款才能发放，而代收行对由于交付单据的任何延误所产生的任何结果将不承担责任。
Translation: (3) If the collection includes a bill of exchange payable at a future date and the collection instruction specifies that commercial documents are to be released against payment, the documents shall be released only against such payment, and the collecting bank will not be responsible for any consequences arising from any delay in the delivery of documents.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条：代制单据在托收行指示代收行或者付款人来代制托收中未曾包括的单据（汇票、本票、信托收据、保证书或其他单据）时，这些单据的格式和措辞应由托收行提供，否则，代收行对由代收行及/或付款人所提供任何该种单据的格式和措辞将不承担责任或对其负责。
Translation: Article 8: Where the remitting bank instructs either the collecting bank or the drawee to draw up documents (drafts, promissory notes, trust receipts, letters of guarantee or other documents) not included in the collection, the form and wording of such documents shall be provided by the remitting bank. Otherwise, the collecting bank shall not be liable or accountable for the form and wording of any such documents prepared by the collecting bank and/or the drawee.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条：诚信和合理的谨慎银行将本着诚信的原则、尽合理的谨慎来办理业务。
Translation:
Article 9: Integrity and Reasonable Care  
The Bank shall conduct its business with integrity and exercise reasonable care.

Query_Text_cn: （1）未经银行事先同意，货物不得直接发送到该银行地址、或者以该行作为收货人或者以该行为抬头人。然而，如果未经银行事先同意而将货物直接发送到该银行地址、或者以该行作为收货人或者以该行为抬头人，并请该行凭付款或承兑或凭其他条款将货物交付给付款人，该行将没有提取货物的义务，其风险和责任仍由发货方承担。
Translation: (1) Goods shall not be dispatched directly to the address of the bank or consigned to or to the order of the bank without its prior consent. However, if goods are dispatched directly to the address of the bank or consigned to or to the order of the bank without such prior consent, and the bank is requested to deliver the goods to the drawee against payment or acceptance or upon other terms, the bank shall have no obligation to take delivery of the goods, and all risks and responsibilities shall remain with the party dispatching the goods.

Query_Text_cn: （2）即使接到特别指示，也银行没有义务对与跟单托收有关的货物采取任何行动，包括对货物进行存储和保险。银行只有在个案中、在其同意的限度内，才会采取该类行动。尽管前述第一条（3）段有不同规定，即使代收银行对此没有任何特别的通知，也适用本条规则之规定。
Translation: (2) Even if instructed otherwise, banks are under no obligation to take any action regarding goods relating to documentary collections, including storage and insurance. They will only assume such responsibility in individual cases and to the extent expressly agreed upon. This rule applies notwithstanding any contrary provision in sub-article (3) of the first article above, and even if the collecting bank has not given any specific notification to this effect.

Query_Text_cn: （3）然而，无论银行是否收到指示，银行为保护货物而采取措施时，对有关货物的结局及/或状况及/或对受托保管及/或保护货物的任何第三方的作为及/或不作为概不承担责任。但是，代收行必须毫不延误地将其所采取的措施通知向其发出托收指的银行。
Translation: (3) However, irrespective of whether instructions to that effect have been given, the bank shall not be liable for the consequences and/or conditions of the goods or for the acts and/or omissions of any third parties entrusted with the custody or protection of the goods when taking measures to safeguard them. Nevertheless, the collecting bank must advise without delay the bank from which the collection order was received of any such measures taken.

Query_Text_cn: （4）银行对货物采取任何保护措施所发生的任何费用及/或花销将由向其发出托收的一方承担。
Translation: (4) All expenses and/or charges incurred by the bank in taking any action to protect the goods shall be borne by the party from whom the collection was received.

Query_Text_cn: （5）a.尽管有前开第十条（1）段的规定，如果货物是以代收行作为收货人或抬头人，而且付款人已对该项托收办理了付款、承兑或承诺了其他条件和条款，且代收行因此对货物的发放作了安排时，则应视为托收行已授权代收行如此办理。
Translation: (5)a. Notwithstanding the provisions of sub-article 10(1), where the goods are consigned to or to the order of the collecting bank and the drawee has honoured the collection by payment, acceptance or other terms and conditions, and the collecting bank arranges for the release of the goods accordingly, the remitting bank shall be deemed to have authorized the collecting bank to do so.

Query_Text_cn: b.若代收行按照托收行的指示或按上述第十条（5）a段的规定安排发放货物，托收行应对该代收行所发生的全部损失和花销给予赔偿。
Translation: b. If the collecting bank releases the goods in accordance with the instructions of the remitting bank or pursuant to the provisions of Article 10(5)a above, the remitting bank shall indemnify such collecting bank for all losses and expenses incurred.

Query_Text_cn: （3）一方指示另一方去履行服务，指示方应受到外国法律和惯例施加给被指示方的一切义务和责任的制约，并应就有关义务和责任对受托方承担赔偿责任。
Translation: (3) Where one party instructs the other to perform services, the instructing party shall be bound by all obligations and liabilities imposed on the instructed party under foreign laws and practices, and shall indemnify the instructed party against such obligations and liabilities.

Query_Text_cn: （1）银行必须确定它所收到的单据应与托收指示中所列内容表面相符，如果发现任何单据有短缺或非托收指示所列，银行必须以电讯方式，如电讯不可能时，以其他快捷的方式，通知向从发出指示的一方，不得延误；银行对此没有其他更多的责任。
Translation: (1) The bank must verify that the documents received appear, on their face, to be in conformity with those listed in the collection instruction. Should any documents be found missing or not in accordance with the collection instruction, the bank must notify by telecommunication or, if that is not possible, by other expeditious means without delay the party from whom the collection instruction was received. The bank bears no further responsibility in this regard.

Query_Text_cn: （3）根据第五条（3）段和上述第十二条（1）段和（2）段，银行将按所收到的单据办理提示而无需做更多的审核。
Translation: (3) In accordance with paragraph (3) of Article 5 and paragraphs (1) and (2) of the aforementioned Article 12, the bank shall process the presentation based on the documents received without further examination.

Query_Text_cn: 银行也不对任何单据所表示的货物的描述、数量、重量、质量、状况、包装、交货、价值或存在、或对货物的发运人、承运人、运输代理、收货人或保险人或其他任何人的诚信或作为及/或不作为、清偿力、业绩或信誉承担责任或对其负责。
Translation: The bank also assumes no liability or responsibility for the description, quantity, weight, quality, condition, packing, delivery, value or existence of the goods represented by any documents, or for the good faith, acts and/or omissions, solvency, performance or standing of the consignor, carrier, forwarder, consignee or insurer of the goods or any other person.

Query_Text_cn: （2）银行对由于收到的任何指示需要澄清而引起的延误，将不承担责任或对其负责。
Translation: (2) The bank shall not be liable or responsible for any delays caused by the need for clarification of any instructions received.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条：不可抗力对由于天灾、暴动、骚乱、战争或银行本身不能控制的任何其他原因、任何罢工或停工而使银行营业中断所产生的后果，银行不承担责任或对其负责。
Translation:
Article 15: Force Majeure  
The bank shall not be liable or responsible for any consequences arising from the interruption of its business operations due to acts of God, riots, civil commotions, wars, or any other causes beyond the bank's control, including any strikes or lockouts.

Query_Text_cn: （2）尽管有第一条（3）段的规定，除非另有指示，代收行仅向托收行汇付收妥的款项。
Translation: (2) Notwithstanding the provisions of sub-article (3) of Article 1, the collecting bank shall remit only the collected proceeds to the remitting bank unless otherwise instructed.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条：以当地货币支付如果单据是以付款地国家的货币（当地货币）付款，除托收指示另有规定外，提示行必须凭当地货币的付款，发放单据给付款人，只要该种货币按托收指示规定的方式能够随时处理。
Translation:
Article 17: Payment in Local Currency  
If the documents are payable in the currency of the country of payment (local currency), unless otherwise specified in the collection instruction, the presenting bank must release the documents to the drawee against payment in local currency, provided that such currency is immediately disposable in the manner specified in the collection instruction.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条：用外币付款如果单据是以付款地国家以外的货币（外汇）付款，除托收指示中另用规定外，提示行必须凭指定的外币付款，发放单据给付款人，只要该外币按托收指示规定能够立即汇出。
Translation:
Article 18: Payment in Foreign Currency  
Where the documents are payable in a currency (foreign currency) other than that of the place of payment, unless otherwise specified in the collection instruction, the presenting bank may release the documents to the drawee against payment in the designated foreign currency only if such currency is immediately remittable in accordance with the instructions in the collection order.

Query_Text_cn: （1）光票托收时，只有在付款地现行法律准许部分付款的条件和限度内，才能接受部分付款。只有在全部货款已收妥的情况下，才能将金融单据发放给付款人。
Translation: (1) In the case of clean collection, partial payment may only be accepted to the extent and under the conditions permitted by the prevailing laws at the place of payment. Financial documents shall be released to the drawee only after the full amount has been collected.

Query_Text_cn: （2）跟单托收时，只有在托收指示有特别授权的情况下，才能接受部分付款。然而，除非另有指示，提示行只能在全部货款已收妥后才能将单据交与付款人，并对由此所引起的延迟交单所产生的后果不承担责任。
Translation: (2) In the case of documentary collection, partial payments may be accepted only if specifically authorized in the collection instruction. However, unless otherwise instructed, the presenting bank may release documents to the drawee only after full payment has been received and shall not be liable for any consequences arising from any delay in the delivery of documents.

Query_Text_cn: （3）在任何情况下，部分付款只有在符合第十七条或第十八条中的相应规定时将会被接受。如果接受部分付款，将按照第十六条的规定办理。
Translation: (3) In no case shall partial payment be accepted unless it complies with the relevant provisions under Article 17 or 18. Where partial payment is accepted, it shall be processed in accordance with the provisions of Article 16.

Query_Text_cn: （1）如果托收指示中规定必须收取利息，但付款人拒付该项利息时，提示行可根据具体情况在不收取利息的情况下凭付款或承兑或其他条款和条件交付单据，除非适用第二十条（3）段之规定。
Translation: (1) If the collection instruction specifies that interest is to be collected but the drawee refuses to pay such interest, the presenting bank may deliver the documents against payment or acceptance or on other terms and conditions without collecting the interest, unless sub-article 20(c) applies.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如果要求收取利息，托收指示中应明确规定利率、计息期和计息基础。
Translation: (2) If interest is to be collected, the collection instruction must specify the rate of interest, the interest period, and the basis for interest calculation.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如托收指示中明确地指明利息不得放弃，但付款人拒付该利息，提示行则不交付单据，并对由此所引起的延迟交单所产生的后果不承担责任。当利息已被拒付时，提示行必须以电讯，当不可能时可用其他便捷的方式，通知向其发出托收指示的银行，不得延误。
Translation: (3) If the collection instruction expressly states that interest may not be waived and the drawee refuses to pay such interest, the presenting bank shall not deliver documents and shall not be responsible for any consequences arising out of any delay in the delivery of documents. When payment of interest has been refused, the presenting bank must inform by telecommunication or, if that is not possible, by other expeditious means without delay the bank from which the collection instruction was received.

Query_Text_cn: （1）如果托收指示中规定收取手续费及/或费用须由付款人承担，而后者拒付时，提示行可以根据具体情况，在不收取手续费及/或费用的情况下凭付款或承兑或其他条款和条件交付单据，除非适用第二十一条（2）段之规定。当放弃以这种方式支付托收手续费及/或费用时，该项费用应由发出托收的一方承担，并可从货款中扣减。
Translation: (1) If the collection instruction specifies that collection charges and/or expenses are to be for account of the drawee and the drawee refuses to pay them, the presenting bank may deliver the documents against payment or acceptance or on other terms and conditions without collecting charges and/or expenses, unless sub-article 21(2) applies. When collection charges and/or expenses are so waived, they shall be for the account of the party from whom the collection was received and may be deducted from the proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如果托收指示中明确指明手续费和（或）费用不得放弃而付款人又拒付该项费用时，提示行将不交付单据，并对由此所引起的延误所产生的后果不承担责任。当该项费用已被拒付时，提示行必须以电讯，当不可能时可用其他便捷的方式，通知向其发出托收指示的银行，不得延误。
Translation: (2) If the collection instruction specifically states that interest, collection charges and/or expenses may not be waived and the drawee refuses to pay such charges, the presenting bank will not deliver documents and will not be responsible for any consequences arising out of any delay in the delivery of documents. When such charges have been refused, the presenting bank must inform without delay the bank from which the collection instruction was received by telecommunication or, if that is not possible, by other expeditious means.

Query_Text_cn: （3）在任何情况下，若托收指示中清楚地规定或根据本规则具体规定，支付款项及/或费用及/或托收手续费应由委托人承担，代收行应有权从向其发出托收指示的银行立即收回所支出的有关支付款、费用和手续费，而托收行不管该托收结果如何，应有权向委托人立即收回它所付出的任何金额，连同它自己的支付款、费用和手续费。
Translation: (3) In any case, where the collection instruction expressly stipulates or this Rule specifically provides that disbursements and/or expenses and/or collection charges are to be for account of the principal, the collecting bank shall be entitled to recover promptly from the bank from which the collection instruction was received the amount of any disbursements, expenses and charges incurred, and the remitting bank shall have the right to recover promptly from the principal any amount so paid out by it, together with its own disbursements, expenses and charges, regardless of the outcome of the collection.

Query_Text_cn: （4）银行对向其发出托收指示的一方保留要求事先支付手续费及/或费用的权利，以补偿其拟执行任何指示的费用支出，在未收到该项款项期间，有保留不执行该项指示的权利。
Translation: (4) The bank reserves the right to demand advance payment of commissions and/or expenses from the party issuing the collection instruction to cover the costs of executing any instructions. Pending receipt of such payment, the bank reserves the right to withhold execution of the said instructions.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条：承兑提示行有责任确保汇票承兑形式看来是完整和正确的，但是，对任何签字的真实性或签署承兑的任何签字人的权限不负责任。
Translation: Article 22: The presenting bank is responsible for ensuring that the form of the acceptance appears to be complete and correct, but it is not responsible for the authenticity of any signature or the authority of any signatory to sign the acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条：本票和其他凭证提示行对在本票、收据或其他凭证上任何签字的真实性或签字人的权限不负责任。
Translation: Article 23: The presenting bank assumes no responsibility for the genuineness of any signature or the authority of any signatory on a promissory note, receipt, or other instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条：拒绝证书托收指示对发生拒绝付款或拒绝承兑时的有关拒绝证书应有具体的指示（或代之以其他法律手续）。如无此项具体指示，与托收有关的各银行在遭到拒绝付款或拒绝承兑时，无义务作出拒绝证书（或代之以其他法律手续）。银行由于办理拒绝证书或其他法律手续而发生的手续费及/或其他费用概由向其发出托收指示的一方承担。
Translation:
Article 24: Protest for Non-Payment or Non-Acceptance  
The collection instruction should give specific instructions regarding protest (or other legal process in lieu thereof) in the event of non-payment or non-acceptance. In the absence of such specific instructions, the banks concerned with the collection have no obligation to issue a protest (or take other legal process) upon any refusal to pay or accept. The bank issuing such protest (or taking other legal process) shall be entitled to reimbursement from the party from whom the collection instruction was received for all expenses and/or charges incurred in connection therewith.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条：需要时的代理如果委托人指定一名代表作为拒绝付款及/或拒绝承兑时的代理人，托收指示中应清楚地、详尽地指明该代理人的权限。如无此项指示，银行对需要时的代理人的指示可以不受理。
Translation:
Article 25: Case-of-Need  

If the principal nominates a representative to act as a case-of-need in the event of non-payment and/or non-acceptance, the collection instruction must clearly and precisely specify the powers of such case-of-need. In the absence of such instructions, banks will not accept any instructions from the case-of-need.

Query_Text_cn: （1）通知方式代收行对向对其发出托收指示的银行送交的所有通知和信息，必须载明必要的详细内容，在任何情况下，都应包括后者在托收指示中列明的编号。
Translation:
(1) Method of Advice  
All notices and information dispatched by the collecting bank to the bank from which the collection instruction was received must bear appropriate details, including, in all cases, the latter's reference number as stated in the collection instruction.

Query_Text_cn: （2）通知的方法：托收行有责任就各种通知的具体方法向代收行发出指示，不同通知详见本款（3）a，（3）b和（3）c段的内容。如无该项指示，代收行将自行选择通知方法，寄送有关通知，而其费用应由向其发出托收指示的银行承担。
Translation: (2) Method of Advice: The remitting bank is responsible for instructing the collecting bank regarding the specific methods of advice, with different advices detailed in sub-paragraphs (3)a, (3)b, and (3)c of this section. In the absence of such instructions, the collecting bank may choose the method of advice at its discretion for dispatching the relevant notifications, the expenses of which shall be borne by the bank from which the collection order was received.

Query_Text_cn: （3）a.付款通知代收行必须毫无延误地将付款通知交发给向其发出托收指示的银行，详细列明有关金额或收妥金额、扣减的手续费及/或支付款及/或费用（如适当）、以及资金的处理方式。
Translation: (3) a. Payment Advice The collecting bank must without delay send a payment advice to the bank from which the collection instruction was received, detailing the amount collected, charges and/or disbursements and/or expenses deducted (where applicable), and the method of disposal of funds.

Query_Text_cn: b.承兑通知代收行必须无延误地将承兑通知发送向其发出托收指示的银行。
Translation:
b. Acceptance Advice  
The collecting bank must without delay dispatch an acceptance advice to the bank from which the collection instruction was received.

Query_Text_cn: c.拒绝付款或拒绝承兑的通知提示行应尽力查明拒绝付款或拒绝承兑的原因，并相应地通知向其发出托收指示的银行，不得延误。提示行应毫无延误地将拒绝付款及/或拒绝承兑的通知发送给向其发出托收指示的银行。收到该通知后，托收行必须就进一步处理单据发出适当的指示。如在发出拒绝付款及/或拒绝承兑通知后60天内，提示行未收到该项指示，可将单据退回向其发出托收指示的银行，而提示行方面不承担任何其他责任。
Translation:
c. Notice of Dishonor or Non-Acceptance  
The presenting bank must endeavor to ascertain the reasons for dishonor or non-acceptance and promptly notify the bank from which it received the collection instruction accordingly. The presenting bank must dispatch, without delay, the notice of dishonor and/or non-acceptance to the bank from which it received the collection instruction. Upon receipt of such notice, the remitting bank must give appropriate instructions for further handling of the documents. If no such instructions are received by the presenting bank within 60 days after dispatching the notice of dishonor and/or non-acceptance, the documents may be returned to the bank from which the collection instruction was received, without any further responsibility on the part of the presenting bank.

Query_Text_cn: 规则一一般性义务（一）当事者收到申请仲裁予以登记之通知书后，应参照公约第四章第二节的规定，尽快成立仲裁庭。
Translation: Rule 1 General Obligations (1) Upon receipt of the notice of registration of the request for arbitration, the parties shall constitute the arbitral tribunal as soon as possible in accordance with the provisions of Section 2 of Chapter IV of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （二）除非仲裁申请书已经包括了当事者就有关仲裁员人数和他们的任命方式所达成的协议，否则当事者应尽快将此种情况通知秘书长。
Translation: (2) Unless the notice of arbitration includes the parties' agreement on the number of arbitrators and the method of their appointment, the parties shall promptly inform the Secretary-General of such matters.

Query_Text_cn: （三）除当事者就各名仲裁员之任命达成协议外，只有双方争议当事者所任命之相同人数的仲裁员中争议当事国国民或者其国民是当事者之国家的国民不会形成具有以上国籍之仲裁员的多数，一方当事者才可任命以上国家之国民。
Translation: (3) Unless the parties agree otherwise regarding the appointment of each arbitrator, a party may appoint a national of the aforementioned State only if, among an equal number of arbitrators appointed by both disputing parties, the nationals of the disputing State or of the State whose nationals are parties would not constitute a majority of arbitrators with the aforementioned nationality.

Query_Text_cn: （四）在任何解决争议的先前程序中担任过调解员或仲裁员之人员均不得被任命为仲裁庭成员。
Translation: (4) No person who has served as a mediator or arbitrator in any prior proceedings for the resolution of the dispute may be appointed as a member of the arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: （1）申请方在进行申请仲裁登记后的十日内，应向他方当事者建议任命独任仲裁员或特定奇数仲裁员以及确定其任命的方式。
Translation: (1) Within ten days after filing the application for arbitration registration, the applicant shall propose to the other party the appointment of a sole arbitrator or an odd-numbered panel of arbitrators and the method for their appointment.

Query_Text_cn: （3）申请方在收到具有类似建议之答复后的二十日内，应通知他方当事者其是否接受此种建议。
Translation: (3) The applicant shall, within twenty days upon receipt of a reply containing such a proposal, notify the other party whether it accepts the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: （二）上款规定之通信应以书面形式作成或及时予以书面确认，并且应通过秘书长送达，或当事者间直接送达，将副本送交秘书长。
Translation: (2) The communications referred to in the preceding paragraph shall be made in writing or promptly confirmed in writing, and shall be transmitted through the Secretary-General or directly between the parties, with a copy sent to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 当事者应将达成协议之内容及时通知秘书长。
Translation: The parties concerned shall promptly notify the Secretary-General of the contents of the agreement reached.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在予以申请仲裁登记后的六十日内，如还未就其他程序达成协议，任何一方当事者可随时通知秘书长其选择公约第三十七条第二款第二项规定之任命方式。
Translation: (3) Within sixty days after the registration of the request for arbitration, if no agreement has been reached on any other procedure, either party may at any time notify the Secretary-General of its choice of the appointment method specified in Article 37(2)(b) of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 此后秘书长应及时通知他方当事者仲裁庭将依上述公约条款成立。
Translation: Thereafter, the Secretary-General shall promptly notify the other party that the arbitral tribunal is to be constituted in accordance with the aforementioned provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （3）原当事者在收到包含有此种建议之答复后，应及时通知他方当事者其是否同意任命由他方当事者所提议作为仲裁庭庭长之仲裁员。
Translation: (3) Upon receiving a response containing such a proposal, the original party shall promptly notify the other party whether it agrees to appoint the arbitrator proposed by the other party as the presiding arbitrator of the arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在规则规定之信函应以书面形式作成或及时予以书面确认，并且应通过秘书长送达，或双方当事者间送达，将副本送交秘书长。
Translation: (2) Any correspondence required under these Rules shall be in writing or promptly confirmed in writing, and shall be served through the Secretary-General or directly between the parties, with a copy transmitted to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 规则四行政理事会主席任命仲裁员（一）如仲裁庭未在秘书长送达准予登记通知书后的九十日内或未在当事者另行约定的期间内成立，任何一方当事者可通过秘书长向行政理事会主席提交书面申请，请求任命尚未任命之一名或数名仲裁员，并指定一名仲裁员为仲裁庭庭长。
Translation:
Rule 4: Appointment of Arbitrators by the Chairman of the Administrative Council  
(1) If the arbitral tribunal has not been constituted within 90 days after the notice of registration is communicated by the Secretary-General, or within such other period as the parties may agree, either party may, through the Secretary-General, address a written request to the Chairman of the Administrative Council to appoint the arbitrator or arbitrators not yet appointed and to designate an arbitrator as the presiding arbitrator of the tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: （二）如双方当事者已经达成协议由仲裁员推选仲裁庭庭长而未选出，则应适当适用上款之规定。
Translation: (2) If the parties have agreed that the arbitrators shall appoint the presiding arbitrator and such appointment has not been made,the provisions of the preceding paragraph shall apply mutatis mutandis.

Query_Text_cn: （三）秘书长应立即申请书副本送达他方当事者。
Translation: (3) The Secretary-General shall promptly transmit certified copies of the application to the other party.

Query_Text_cn: （四）主席应参照公约第三十八条和第四十条第一款，在尽量与双方当事者磋商后，并且于收到申请书后的三十日内同意此项申请。
Translation: (4) The Chairman shall, in accordance with Article 38 and paragraph 1 of Article 40 of the Convention, approve such application after consulting as far as possible with both parties and within thirty days of receiving the application.

Query_Text_cn: （五）秘书长应及时通知双方当事者有关主席作出的任命或指定。
Translation: (5) The Secretary-General shall promptly notify both parties of any appointment or designation made by the Chairman.

Query_Text_cn: 规则五任命之接受（一）有关一方或双方当事者应将各名仲裁员之任命通知秘书长，并应说明任命之方式。
Translation:
Rule 5 Acceptance of Appointments  
(1) The party or parties concerned shall notify the Secretary-General of the appointment of each arbitrator and shall indicate the method of such appointment.

Query_Text_cn: （二）秘书长一旦收到当事者或行政理事会主席有关任命仲裁员之通知后，即应寻求被任命者之接受。
Translation: (2) Upon receipt of a notice of the appointment of an arbitrator from either party or the Chairman of the Administrative Council, the Secretary-General shall promptly seek the appointee's acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如仲裁员在十五日内未接受任命，秘书长应及时通知双方当事者，如该仲裁员系主席任命者，还应通知主席，并且邀请他们依先前方式任命另一人为仲裁员。
Translation: (3) If the arbitrator fails to accept appointment within fifteen days, the Secretary-General shall promptly notify both parties and, where the arbitrator was appointed by the Chairman, also notify the Chairman, inviting them to appoint another person as arbitrator in the same manner as before.

Query_Text_cn: 规则六仲裁庭之成立（一）秘书长通知双方当事者全体仲裁员均已接受任命之日，应视为仲裁庭已经组成并且仲裁程序已经开始。
Translation:
Article 6 Constitution of the Tribunal  
(1) The Tribunal shall be deemed to be constituted and the proceeding to have begun on the date the Secretary-General notifies the parties that all the arbitrators have accepted their appointment.

Query_Text_cn: “据本人所知，我没有理由推辞在解决投资争议的国际中心成立的有关……和……之间争议的仲裁庭内任职。
Translation: "To the best of my knowledge, there is no reason for me to decline to serve on the arbitral tribunal constituted by the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes in the dispute between...and..."

Query_Text_cn: ”“我对由于本人参加本仲裁程序而知之所有情事及仲裁庭作出的任何裁决之内容，将保守秘密。
Translation: "I shall maintain confidentiality regarding all matters disclosed to me through my participation in this arbitration proceeding, as well as the contents of any award rendered by the arbitral tribunal."

Query_Text_cn: ”“我将依准据法，在双方当事者间公正裁判，并且除解决投资争议公约和依其制订的条例、规则之规定外，将不接受来自任何方面的有关仲裁的指示或报酬。
Translation: "I shall adjudicate impartially between the parties in accordance with the applicable law and, except as provided in the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes and the regulations and rules made thereunder, shall not accept any instruction or remuneration concerning the arbitration from any source."

Query_Text_cn: ”“在此附上有关本人过去和现在职业以及与当事者双方的其他关系（如系存在）之声明书。
Translation: "Enclosed herewith is a statement concerning my past and present occupations, as well as any other relationships (if any exist) with the parties involved."

Query_Text_cn: ”在仲裁庭第一次开庭结束时，任何未签署声明书之仲裁员应被视为已经辞职。
Translation: "At the conclusion of the first hearing of the arbitral tribunal, any arbitrator who has not signed the declaration shall be deemed to have resigned."

Query_Text_cn: 规则七仲裁员之撤换仲裁庭成立前，各方当事者可随时撤换任何其所指定的仲裁员，并且双方当事者可合意撤换任何仲裁员，以上撤换程序应根据规则一、规则五和规则六执行之。
Translation:
Rule 7: Removal of Arbitrators  
Prior to the constitution of the arbitral tribunal, either party may at any time remove any arbitrator it has appointed. The parties may also jointly agree to remove any arbitrator. Such removal shall be effected in accordance with the procedures set forth in Rule 1, Rule 5, and Rule 6.

Query_Text_cn: 规则八仲裁员无行为能力或辞职（一）如仲裁员失去行为能力或不能履行职责，应适用规则九所规定的有关仲裁员资格不合之程序。
Translation:
Rule 8: Incapacity or Resignation of Arbitrator  
(a) If an arbitrator becomes incapacitated or fails to act, the procedures set forth in Rule 9 concerning the disqualification of an arbitrator shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （二）仲裁员可通过向其他仲裁庭成员和秘书长提交辞呈方式辞职。
Translation: (2) An arbitrator may resign by submitting a resignation letter to the other members of the arbitral tribunal and the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 如仲裁员系一方当事者任命者，仲裁庭应及时考虑其辞职之理由，并决定是否同意其辞职。
Translation: If an arbitrator was appointed by one party, the arbitral tribunal shall promptly consider the reasons for resignation and decide whether to accept it.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭应及时将其决定通知秘书长。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall promptly notify the Secretary-General of its decision.

Query_Text_cn: 规则九仲裁员之资格不合（一）根据公约第五十七条，提议仲裁员资格不合之当事者应在仲裁宣布终结前的期间向秘书长及时提交建议，说明理由。
Translation: Rule 9 Disqualification of Arbitrators (1) In accordance with Article 57 of the Convention, a party proposing the disqualification of an arbitrator shall promptly submit its proposal to the Secretary-General, stating the reasons therefor, no later than the conclusion of the arbitration proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: （2）通知建议的他方当事者。
Translation: (2) Notify the other party concerned as recommended.

Query_Text_cn: （三）一旦发生此种情况，与建议有关之仲裁员可立即向仲裁庭或行政理事会主席作出说明。
Translation: (3) In the event of such a situation, the arbitrator concerned may immediately make a statement to the arbitral tribunal or the Chairman of the Administrative Council.

Query_Text_cn: （四）除非建议涉及到仲裁庭之大多数成员，其他成员应在有关仲裁员不参加的情况下对建议及时审议和投票。
Translation: (4) Unless the proposal involves a majority of the arbitral tribunal,other members shall deliberate and vote on the proposal in a timely manner without the participation of the arbitrator concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 如赞成票与反对票相等，他们应通过秘书长及时将建议、有关仲裁员作出之说明以及他们未作成决定之情况通知行政理事会主席。
Translation: In the event of an equality of votes, they shall promptly notify the Chairman of the Administrative Council through the Secretary-General of the recommendation, any statement made by the arbitrator concerned, and their failure to reach a decision.

Query_Text_cn: （五）主席必须在收到建议后的二十日内就仲裁员资格不合之建议作出决定。
Translation: (5) The Chair shall make a decision on the challenge to an arbitrator's qualifications within twenty days of receiving the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: （六）对建议之决定作出后，仲裁程序才可继续进行。
Translation: (6) The arbitral proceedings may continue only after a decision on the proposal has been made.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十仲裁庭空缺之程序（一）秘书长应将仲裁员资格不合、死亡、无行为能力或辞职以及仲裁庭准予辞职（如其发生），立即通知双方当事者，并如系必要，通知行政理事会主席。
Translation:
Rule 10: Filling Vacancies on the Tribunal  
(1) The Secretary-General shall promptly notify both parties, and where necessary the Chairman of the Administrative Council, of any disqualification, death, incapacity, or resignation of an arbitrator, as well as the Tribunal's approval of such resignation (if applicable).

Query_Text_cn: （二）秘书长通知仲裁庭产生空缺后至补缺完了前，仲裁应中止或继续中止。
Translation: (2) Upon the Secretary-General's notification of a vacancy in the arbitral tribunal, the arbitration shall be suspended or remain suspended until the vacancy is filled.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十一仲裁庭之补缺（一）除第二款另有规定外，由仲裁员资格不合、死亡、行为能力或辞职而产生的空缺应通过其被任命时相同方法及时填补之。
Translation:
Article 11 Filling of Vacancies on the Arbitral Tribunal  
(1) Subject to paragraph (2), any vacancy arising from the disqualification, death, incapacity, or resignation of an arbitrator shall be promptly filled by the same method pursuant to which the original appointment was made.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如在秘书长通知空缺后的三十日内，新的任命没有作出并且没有被接受时，根据任何一方当事者之请求，填补任何其他空缺。
Translation: (2) If a new appointment is not made and accepted within thirty days after the Secretary-General notifies the vacancy, any other vacancy shall be filled upon the request of either party.

Query_Text_cn: （三）补缺之程序应适用规则一、规则四第四款、第五款，并适当适用规则六第二款。
Translation: (c) The procedures for filling vacancies shall apply Rule 1 and paragraphs 4 and 5 of Rule 4, with appropriate application of paragraph 2 of Rule 6.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十二补缺后仲裁程序之恢复一旦补缺完毕，仲裁庭应继续进行因空缺而中止之仲裁程序。
Translation:
Rule 12 Resumption of Proceedings after Replacement  

Once the vacancy has been filled, the arbitral tribunal shall resume the arbitral proceedings that were suspended due to the vacancy.

Query_Text_cn: 但如口头辩论已经开始，新任仲裁员可要求其重新进行。
Translation: However, if oral hearings have already commenced, the newly appointed arbitrator may require them to be repeated.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十三仲裁庭之开庭期（一）仲裁庭应在成立后的六十日内或双方同意之相应期间首次开庭，仲裁庭庭长应在与仲裁庭成员和秘书长磋商后，指定开庭日期。
Translation:
Rule 13 Hearings of the Arbitral Tribunal  
(1) The arbitral tribunal shall hold its first hearing within 60 days after its constitution or within any other period agreed by the parties. The presiding arbitrator shall, after consulting with the members of the arbitral tribunal and the Secretary-General, fix the date of the hearing.

Query_Text_cn: 如由于双方当事者达成协议由仲裁庭成员推选产生庭长，而仲裁庭成立后还未选出庭长，秘书长应指定开庭日期。
Translation: If the parties have agreed that the presiding arbitrator is to be elected by the members of the arbitral tribunal and no such election has been made after the constitution of the arbitral tribunal, the Secretary-General shall fix the time limit therefor.

Query_Text_cn: 在以上两种情形下，均应尽量与双方当事者磋商。
Translation: In both of the above scenarios, efforts should be made to consult with both parties involved.

Query_Text_cn: （二）仲裁庭尽量与秘书长及双方当事者磋商后，应确定后续开庭日期。
Translation: (2) The arbitral tribunal shall, after consulting as far as possible with the Secretary-General and the parties, fix the dates for subsequent hearings.

Query_Text_cn: （三）仲裁程序应在中心所在地或依照公约第六十三条由双方当事者协议之其他地点进行。
Translation: (3) The arbitral proceedings shall be conducted at the seat of the Centre or at any other place agreed by the parties pursuant to Article 63 of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 双方当事者如果同意仲裁程序在中心或者中心作了必要安排之仲裁机构以外地点进行，应与秘书长协商，并请求仲裁庭批准。
Translation: If both parties agree to conduct the arbitration proceedings at a location other than the Centre or an arbitral institution for which the Centre has made the necessary arrangements, they shall consult with the Secretary-General and seek approval from the arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 如未获批准，仲裁程序应在中心所在地进行。
Translation: If approval is not obtained, the arbitration proceedings shall take place at the location of the center.

Query_Text_cn: （四）秘书长应在适当期间内，将仲裁庭开庭的日期和地点通知仲裁庭成员和双方当事者。
Translation: (4) The Secretary-General shall notify the members of the Tribunal and the parties of the date and place of the Tribunal's hearing within an appropriate period.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十四仲裁庭之开庭（一）庭长应主持仲裁庭之审理和评议。
Translation:
Rule 14 Hearings of the Tribunal  
(1) The President shall preside over the hearings and deliberations of the Tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: （二）除双方当事者另有协议外，仲裁庭多数成员出庭应是仲裁庭开庭这必要条件。
Translation: (2) Unless otherwise agreed by the parties, the presence of a majority of the arbitral tribunal shall constitute a necessary condition for the hearing of the arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: （三）仲裁庭庭长应确定开庭日期和开庭时间。
Translation: (3) The presiding arbitrator shall determine the date and time of the hearing.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十五仲裁庭之评议（一）仲裁庭之评议应秘密进行并应保守秘密。
Translation:
Rule 15 Deliberations of the Arbitral Tribunal  
(1) The deliberations of the arbitral tribunal shall be conducted in private and remain confidential.

Query_Text_cn: （二）只有仲裁庭成员才可参加仲裁庭评议。
Translation: (2) Only members of the arbitral tribunal may participate in the deliberations of the tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 除仲裁庭作出其他决定外，他人不得参加。
Translation: Unless the arbitral tribunal decides otherwise, no other person may participate.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十六仲裁庭之决定（一）仲裁庭之决定由全体成员之多数票决定之。
Translation:
Rule 16 Decisions of the Tribunal  
(1) Decisions of the Tribunal shall be made by a majority vote of all its members.

Query_Text_cn: 弃权应作为否决票计算之。
Translation: Abstentions shall be counted as negative votes.

Query_Text_cn: （二）除以上规则有其他规定或仲裁庭作出其他决定外，仲裁庭可通过成员间通信方式作出任何决定，但以与全体成员协商为限。
Translation: (2) Unless otherwise provided in these Rules or decided by the arbitral tribunal, the arbitral tribunal may make any decision by means of communication among its members, provided that all members are consulted.

Query_Text_cn: 这种决定应得到仲裁庭庭长之确认。
Translation: Such decision shall be confirmed by the presiding arbitrator of the tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十七庭长之无行为能力仲裁庭庭长一旦丧失行为能力，其职责应由仲裁庭其他成员之一履行之，其顺序依秘书长收到仲裁员接受任职通知书之先后确定之。
Translation:
Rule 17  
Incapacity of the President  

In the event of the President being unable to act, his functions shall be performed by one of the other members of the Tribunal, following the order of precedence determined by the date on which the Secretary-General received the notification of the arbitrator's acceptance of his appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十八当事者之代理（一）各方当事者可由代理人或律师代理或协助之。该当事者将代理人、律师的姓名及权限通知秘书长。秘书长应及时通知仲裁庭和他方当事者。
Translation:
Article 18 Representation of the Parties  

(1) Each party may be represented or assisted by agents or counsel. The party shall communicate the name and authority of such agents or counsel to the Secretary-General, who shall promptly inform the arbitral tribunal and the other party.

Query_Text_cn: （二）本规则之条文采用当事者之表述包括：授权代表当事者之代理人、律师。
Translation: (2) The provisions of these Rules shall apply to the expressions of the parties, including their authorized agents and attorneys acting on their behalf.

Query_Text_cn: 规则十九程序性决议仲裁庭应按进行仲裁程序之要求，作出决议。
Translation: Rule 19 Procedural Decisions The arbitral tribunal shall make decisions as required for the conduct of the arbitral proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 规则二十审前程序事务之协商（一）仲裁庭成立后，庭长应尽快查明双方当事者关于程序问题的意见。
Translation:
Rule 20 Pre-Hearing Procedural Matters (1) Consultation  
After the constitution of the tribunal, the president shall promptly ascertain the views of the parties regarding procedural matters.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，他可要求与双方当事者会谈。
Translation: To this end,he may request a meeting with both parties.

Query_Text_cn: （7）保存审理记录之方式。
Translation: (7) The method for preserving trial records.

Query_Text_cn: （二）仲裁庭在仲裁程序中，应适用双方当事者有关程序问题的任何协议，但公约或行政和财务条例另有规定者除外。
Translation: (2) The arbitral tribunal shall apply any agreement between the parties regarding procedural matters, unless otherwise provided by the Convention or the Administrative and Financial Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 规则二十一预审会议（一）根据秘书长要求或仲裁庭庭长决定，仲裁庭与双方当事者可举行预审会议，交换文件及确定无争议之事实，以便简化仲裁程序。
Translation: Rule 21 Pre-Hearing Conference (1) At the request of the Secretary-General or upon the decision of the President of the Tribunal, the Tribunal may hold a pre-hearing conference with the parties to exchange documents and identify uncontested facts for the purpose of streamlining the arbitral proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: （二）根据当事者请求，仲裁庭与当事者或经授权之合法代理人可举行预审会议，审查争议事项，以便达成和解。
Translation: (2) At the request of the parties, the arbitral tribunal may hold pre-hearing conferences with the parties or their duly authorized legal representatives to review the matters in dispute with a view to reaching an amicable settlement.

Query_Text_cn: 规则二十二工作语言（一）双方当事者可达成协议，在仲裁中使用一种或两种语言，但如达成协议之语言不是中心之正式语言，以仲裁庭在与秘书长协商后予以批准为限。
Translation:
Article 22 Working Language  
(1) The parties may agree upon the use of one or two languages in the arbitration, provided that if the agreed language is not an official language of the Centre, such agreement is subject to approval by the arbitral tribunal after consultation with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 如双方当事者未就任何非正式语言达成协议，当事者为此，可各自选择一种正式语言（即英语、法语和西班牙语）。
Translation: If the parties have not agreed on any informal language, each party may choose one official language (namely English, French, or Spanish) for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: （二）如双方当事者选择两种工作语言，任何文件可以其中之一作成。
Translation: (2) If the parties choose two working languages, any document may be prepared in either of them.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭可使用其中任何一种语言，但仲裁庭有此项要求，则以在提供笔译和口译的条件下为限。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal may use either language, but such use by the arbitral tribunal shall be subject to the provision of written translation and oral interpretation if so required.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭应以此两种语言作成决定和裁决以及保存记录，两种文本有相同效力。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall render its decisions and awards and maintain records in both languages, with both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 多于人数两份。
Translation: Two copies more than the number of persons.

Query_Text_cn: 规则二十四证明文件证明文件通常应与其有关的文件一同提交，并且必须在规定的期限内提交。
Translation:
Rule 24 Supporting Documents  
Supporting documents shall normally be submitted together with the relevant documents and must be filed within the prescribed time limit.

Query_Text_cn: 规则二十五错误之改正经他方当事者之同意或仲裁庭之许可，任何文件或证明文件中的错误可在裁决作出前予以改正。
Translation:
Article 25 Correction of Errors  
With the consent of the other party or the permission of the arbitral tribunal, any error in a document or evidentiary material may be corrected before the award is rendered.

Query_Text_cn: 规则二十六期限（一）为完成仲裁程序各步骤之需要，仲裁庭应以指定日期之方式确定期限。
Translation: Rule 26 Time Limits (1) For the purposes of completing the various steps of the arbitral proceedings, the arbitral tribunal shall fix time limits by specifying calendar dates.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭可将此种权力授予庭长。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal may delegate such authority to its presiding arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: （二）仲裁庭可延长其确定的任何期限。
Translation: (2) The arbitral tribunal may extend any time limit it has determined.

Query_Text_cn: 如仲裁庭不在开庭期，此种权力应由庭长行使。
Translation: If the arbitral tribunal is not in session, such power shall be exercised by the presiding arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: （三）有效期限届满后，不得为任何法律行为。除非在特殊情况下并给予他方当事者陈述意见的机会后，仲裁庭才能作出相反的裁定。
Translation: (3) Upon the expiration of the validity period, no legal acts shall be performed. The arbitral tribunal may only rule otherwise under exceptional circumstances and after affording the other party an opportunity to present its views.

Query_Text_cn: 规则二十七弃权一方当事者未遵守其知道或应当知道之行政和财务条例、本规则及任何其他规则之规定、或仲裁所适用之协议、仲裁庭裁定，并且未及时陈述其主张，应视为--依公约第四十五条--放弃了提出异议之权利。
Translation:
Rule 27 Waiver  
A party which fails to comply with any administrative or financial regulations of which it was or should have been aware, with any provision of these Rules or any other applicable rules, with any agreement relevant to the arbitration, or with any order of the arbitral tribunal, and which fails to state its objection promptly, shall be deemed—in accordance with Article 45 of the Convention—to have waived its right to object.

Query_Text_cn: （2）应由一方当事者完全承担或按特定比例分担之有关仲裁费用（由秘书长确定之）。
Translation: (2) The costs of the arbitration (as determined by the Secretary-General) shall be borne entirely by one party or apportioned in specific proportions.

Query_Text_cn: （二）仲裁程序终结后，各方当事者应及时向仲裁庭提交由合理产生或其担负之费用结算表，秘书长应及时向仲裁庭提交各方当事者向中心支付款项之总数以及中心在仲裁中支出之全部费用的帐目。
