Query_Text_cn: 第四十条生效1.本协定应于1983年7月1日或其后任一日期确定生效，如届时有占本协定附件一所列净出口额至少85%的三国政府以及占本协定附件二所列净进口额至少65%的二十国政府已依据第三十七条第2款(1)项签署本协定，或已交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书。
Translation:
Article 40 Entry into Force  
1. This Agreement shall enter into force on 1 July 1983 or any subsequent date determined thereafter, provided that by such date at least three governments accounting for no less than 85% of the net exports listed in Annex I to this Agreement and at least twenty governments accounting for no less than 65% of the net imports listed in Annex II to this Agreement have either signed the Agreement pursuant to Article 37(2)(1) or deposited their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本协定应于1983年7月1日或其后任一日期暂时生效，如届时有占本协定附件一所列净出口额至少85%的三国政府以及占本协定附件二所列净进口额至少65%的20国政府已依据第三十七条第2款(1)项签署本协定，或已交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书，或已根据第三十九条通知保管人将暂时适用本协定。
Translation: 2. This Agreement shall enter into force provisionally on 1 July 1983 or any date thereafter, provided that by such date at least three governments accounting for no less than 85 percent of the total net exports specified in Annex I to this Agreement and at least 20 governments accounting for no less than 65 percent of the total net imports specified in Annex II to this Agreement have either signed the Agreement pursuant to paragraph 2(1) of Article XXXVII, or deposited instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, or notified the depositary under Article XXXIX of their provisional application of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如果到1984年1月1日尚未达到本条第1或第2款所规定的生效条件，联合国秘书长应邀请已依据第三十七条第2款(1)项签署本协定，或已交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书，或已通知保管人将暂时适用本协定的各政府，在实际可行的最早日期举行会议，并决定本协定的全部或一部在它们之间暂时或确定生效。
Translation: 3. If the conditions for entry into force set forth in paragraph 1 or 2 of this Article have not been met by 1 January 1984, the Secretary-General of the United Nations shall convene, at the earliest practicable date, a conference of the governments that have signed this Agreement pursuant to Article 37, paragraph 2(1), or have deposited instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, or have notified the depositary of their provisional application of this Agreement. The conference shall decide whether to bring this Agreement, in whole or in part, into force provisionally or definitively among those governments.

Query_Text_cn: 在本协定按照本款暂时生效期间，决定本协定的全部或一部在它们之间暂时生效的各政府，应为临时成员。
Translation: During the period when this Agreement is provisionally in force under this paragraph, each government that has decided to have this Agreement, in whole or in part, provisionally in force between them shall be a provisional member.

Query_Text_cn: 这些政府可召开会议审查形势，并决定本协定是否应在它们之间确定生效，或继续暂时生效，或予以终止。
Translation: These governments may convene meetings to review the situation and determine whether this agreement should enter into force definitively among them, continue to apply provisionally, or be terminated.

Query_Text_cn: 4.对在本协定生效后交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书的任何政府，本协定应于交存上述文书之日起对该政府生效。
Translation: 4. For any government that deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession after the entry into force of this Agreement, the Agreement shall enter into force for that government on the date of deposit of such instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 5.联合国秘书长应在本协定生效后尽早召开理事会第一届会议。
Translation: 5. The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall convene the first session of the Council as early as possible after the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十一条加入1.本协定应按照理事会订立的条件，对所有国家的政府开放加入。
Translation:
Article 41 Accession  
1.This Agreement shall be open for accession by the governments of all countries under terms to be established by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 上述条件应包括一项交存加入书的时限，但对于在加入条件所订时限内未能交存加入书的政府，理事会可准许延长期限。
Translation: The aforementioned conditions shall include a time limit for the deposit of instruments of accession, but the Council may grant an extension to governments that fail to deposit their instruments within the prescribed time limit set forth in the accession conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.加入应于向保管人交存加入书时生效。
Translation: 2. Accession shall take effect upon the deposit of the instrument of accession with the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条修正案1.理事会得以特别表决，向各成员建议对本协定的修正案。
Translation:
Article 42 Amendment  
1. The Council may, by special vote, recommend amendments to this Agreement to the members.

Query_Text_cn: 2.理事会应规定各成员在某一日期之前将它们接受修正案情通知保管人。
Translation: 2. The Council shall specify a date by which members shall notify the depositary of their acceptance of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 3.修正案应在保管人从至少2/3出口成员并拥有出口成员表决票数至少85%的成员，和从至少2/3进口成员并拥有进口成员表决票数至少85%的成员收到接受通知书90日后生效。
Translation: 3. The amendment shall enter into force 90 days after the depositary has received instruments of acceptance from at least two-thirds of the exporting members which hold at least 85% of the votes of the exporting members, and from at least two-thirds of the importing members which hold at least 85% of the votes of the importing members.

Query_Text_cn: 4.保管人通知理事会修正案已符合生效条件后，虽有本条第2款关于理事会规定日期，成员仍可通知保管人接受修正案，但此种通知必须在修正案生效前发出。
Translation: 4. Notwithstanding the date specified by the Council under paragraph 2 of this Article, a member may notify the depositary of its acceptance of an amendment after being informed by the depositary that the amendment has met the requirements for entry into force, provided that such notification is made before the amendment enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 5.到修正案生效之日尚未通知接受该修正案的任一成员，自该日起停止为本协定的当事方，除非该成员能向理事会说明由于完成其宪法或体制程序上的困难，无法及时提出接受通知，并经理事会决定延长该成员接受修正案的时限，该成员在通知其接受修正案前应不受该修正案的约束。
Translation: 5. Any member that has not notified its acceptance of the amendment by the date the amendment enters into force shall cease to be a party to this Agreement from that date, unless such member demonstrates to the Council that it was unable to submit its notification of acceptance in time due to difficulties in completing its constitutional or institutional procedures, and the Council decides to extend the period for that member to accept the amendment. Until such member notifies its acceptance of the amendment, it shall not be bound by the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 6.如果理事会按照本条第2款规定的日期已到，而修正案尚未符合生效所需要的条件，则应视为被撤回。
Translation: 6. If the date specified by the Council in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article has arrived and the amendment has not yet met the conditions required for entry into force, it shall be deemed withdrawn.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条退出1.成员可在本协定生效后随时向保管人提出关于退出的书面通知，退出本协定。
Translation:
Article 43 Withdrawal  
1. A Member may withdraw from this Agreement at any time after its entry into force by providing written notice of withdrawal to the Depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 该成员应同时将它所采取的行动通知理事会。
Translation: The member shall also notify the Council of the action it has taken.

Query_Text_cn: 2.退出应在保管人收到通知书90日后开始生效。
Translation: 2. The withdrawal shall take effect 90 days after the depositary receives the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条除名如果理事会认为，任一成员没有履行它在本协定的义务，而且进一步认为，此种违约行为对本协定的实施有重大危害，则理事会可以特别表决将该成员从本协定除名。
Translation:
Article 44 Expulsion  

If the Council determines that any member has failed to fulfill its obligations under this Agreement and further considers that such breach significantly jeopardizes the implementation of this Agreement, the Council may, by special vote, expel the member from this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应立即将此事通知保管人。
Translation: The Council shall promptly notify the depositary of this matter.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会做出决定一年后，该成员应停止为本协定的当事方。
Translation: One year after the decision by the Council, the member shall cease to be a party to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 或(3)根据第四十四条从本协定除名。
Translation: or (3) be removed from this Agreement under Article 44.

Query_Text_cn: 2.理事会应保有停止为本协定当事方的成员向行政帐户缴付的任何分摊额。
Translation: 2. The Council shall retain the authority to suspend any assessed contributions to the administrative account from a member that is a party to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.根据本条规定得到适当退款的成员无权分享本组织清理帐目或其他资产所得的收益。
Translation: 3. A member that has received an appropriate refund under this Article shall not be entitled to share in the proceeds of the liquidation of the accounts or other assets of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 该成员也不应对本组织在退款后所发生的任何亏损承担责任。
Translation: The member shall not be liable for any losses incurred by the organization after the refund.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条有效期、延长和终止1.本协定应在自生效之日起五年期间内有效，除非理事会以特别表决决定延长或重新谈判本协定或予以终止。
Translation:
Article 46 Duration, Extension and Termination  
1. This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of five years from the date of its entry into force, unless the Council decides by special vote to extend, renegotiate or terminate it.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在本条第1款中所指的五年期间届满前，理事会可以特别表决决定将本协定作不超过两年的延长抑或重新谈判本协定。
Translation: 2. The Council may, by special vote before the end of the five-year period referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, decide either to extend this Agreement for a period of not more than two years or to renegotiate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如在本条第1款中所指的五年期间届满前，代替本协定的新协定进行的谈判尚未结束，则理事会可以特别表决延长本协定，延长期由理事会决定。
Translation: 3. If negotiations for a new agreement to replace this agreement have not been concluded by the end of the five-year period referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, the Council may, by special vote, extend this agreement for such period as it may determine.

Query_Text_cn: 4.如在本条第1款中所指的五年期间届满前，代替本协定的新协定已经谈成，但尚未确定生效或暂时生效，则理事会可以特别表决延长本协定，直至新协定暂时生效或确定生效时为止。
Translation: 4.If,before the expiry of the five-year period referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article,a new agreement to replace this Agreement has been negotiated but has not yet entered into force or been applied provisionally,the Council may,by special vote,extend this Agreement until the new agreement enters into force provisionally or definitively.

Query_Text_cn: 期望进一步推进一个多世纪之前建立的并在许多条约中被郑重确认的有关内水水道航行的国际制度的发展。
Translation: It is expected to further advance the development of the international regime governing navigation on inland waterways, which was established over a century ago and has been solemnly affirmed in numerous treaties.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条各缔约国声明，他们接受本公约所附的于1921年4月19日在巴塞罗那会议上通过的国际性可航水道制度规约。
Translation: Article 1 The Contracting Parties declare that they accept the Statute on the Regime of Navigable Waterways of International Concern annexed to this Convention, which was adopted at the Barcelona Conference on April 19, 1921.

Query_Text_cn: 此规约应被视为本公约的一个组成部分。
Translation: This protocol shall be deemed an integral part of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 从而，他们在此声明，依照本公约的规定，并根据本公约所确立的条件，接受此规约的各项义务和保证。
Translation: Accordingly, they hereby declare, in accordance with the provisions of this Convention and subject to the conditions established therein, their acceptance of the obligations and undertakings set forth in this Statute.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条本公约在任何情况下都不影响1919年6月28日在凡尔赛签订的和平条约或其他相应条约的规定所产生的权利和义务，而只要此种权利和义务涉及已签署此种条约或从中受益的国家。
Translation:
Article 2  
In no case shall the present Convention affect the rights and obligations arising from the provisions of the Treaty of Peace signed at Versailles on 28 June 1919 or other corresponding treaties, insofar as such rights and obligations concern States that have signed or benefited from such treaties.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条本公约的法文本和英文本具有同等效力，应载有今天的日期，并应开放到1921年12月1日止，以供签署。
Translation:
Article 3  
The French and English texts of this Convention shall be equally authentic, bear today's date, and remain open for signature until December 1, 1921.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条本公约须经批准。
Translation: Article 4 This Convention is subject to ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应交存国际联盟秘书长。该秘书长应将收到批准书事宜通知国际联盟其他成员和准许签署本公约的国家。
Translation: The instrument of ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the League of Nations, who shall notify all members of the League and the States signatories to the present Convention of such deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书存于秘书处档案库。
Translation: The instrument of approval is deposited in the archives of the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 为了遵守《国际联盟盟约》第18条的规定，秘书长应在接到第一份批准书后立即对本公约进行登记。
Translation: In order to comply with the provisions of Article 18 of the Covenant of the League of Nations, the Secretary-General shall register this Convention immediately upon receipt of the first instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条在1921年12月1日之前未签署本公约的国际联盟成员，可以加入本公约。
Translation: Article 5 Members of the League of Nations that have not signed this Convention before December 1, 1921, may accede to it.

Query_Text_cn: 上述规定亦适用于非国际联盟成员的国家。国际联盟理事会可正式决定向它们通告本公约。
Translation: The above provisions shall also apply to States which are not Members of the League of Nations. The Council of the League may formally decide to communicate this Convention to them.

Query_Text_cn: 加入本公约应通知国际联盟秘书长。该秘书长应将该加入事宜及通知加入日期告知有关国家。
Translation: Accession to the present Convention shall be notified to the Secretary-General of the League of Nations. The said Secretary-General shall inform all the States concerned of such accession and of the date on which it was notified.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条本公约在由五个国家批准之前，不得生效。
Translation: Article 6 This Convention shall not enter into force until it has been ratified by five States.

Query_Text_cn: 生效日期为国际联盟秘书长收到第五份批准书后第九十天。
Translation: The effective date shall be the ninetieth day following the receipt by the Secretary-General of the League of Nations of the fifth instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，本公约应在秘书长收到各国批准书或加入通知起九十天后对其生效。
Translation: Thereafter, the present Convention shall enter into force for each State ninety days after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification or accession with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约生效之时，秘书长应向根据和平条约必须加入本公约的非国际联盟成员的国家寄送经核证无误的本公约副本。
Translation: At the time this Convention comes into force, the Secretary-General shall transmit certified copies thereof to non-member States of the League of Nations which are required by the Peace Treaty to accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条国际联盟秘书长应保留一份特别记录，载明已签署、批准、加入或退出本公约的国家。
Translation: Article 7 The Secretary-General of the League of Nations shall maintain a special register recording the states that have signed, ratified, acceded to, or withdrawn from the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 此记录应随时对联盟各成员公开，并应根据理事会的指示，尽可能经常公布。
Translation: This record shall be made available at all times to all members of the Union and shall be published as frequently as possible in accordance with the directions of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条除本公约第2条另有规定外，任何缔约国可以在本公约对其生效五年期满后退出本公约。
Translation: Article 8 Subject to the provisions of Article 2 of this Convention, any Contracting Party may denounce this Convention upon the expiration of five years from the date on which it enters into force for that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 退出本公约应向国际联盟秘书长递交书面通知。
Translation: Withdrawal from this Convention shall be effected by a written notification addressed to the Secretary-General of the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 该秘书长应将此种通知的副本分送所有其他缔约国，并告知他们收到上述通知的日期。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall transmit copies of such notifications to all other Contracting States and inform them of the date of receipt thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 退出本公约应自通知秘书长之日起一年后生效，且仅对递交通知的国家有效。
Translation: Withdrawal from this Convention shall take effect one year after the date of receipt of the notification by the Secretary-General and shall apply only to the State which has given such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 在没有相反协议的情况下，退出本公约不得影响在退出之前对工作计划所作的约定。
Translation: In the absence of a contrary agreement, withdrawal from this Convention shall not affect commitments made under the work program prior to such withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条修正本公约的要求，可由三分之一的缔约国在任何时候提出。
Translation: Article 9: Amendments to this Convention may be proposed at any time by one-third of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 上述全权代表，特签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned plenipotentiaries, being duly authorized thereto, have signed this Convention in witness whereof.

Query_Text_cn: 1921年4月20日订于巴塞罗那，共一份，应存放于国际联盟档案库。
Translation: Done at Barcelona, this twentieth day of April, one thousand nine hundred and twenty-one, in a single copy which shall be deposited in the archives of the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条在适用本规约时，下列水域被声明为国际性可航水道。
Translation:
Article 1  
The following waters are declared as international navigable waterways for the purposes of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 1.分隔或流经不同国家的天然通海可航水道中各个天然通海可航部分，以及与分隔或流经不同国家的天然可航水道相连的其他天然通海可航水道的任何部分。
Translation: 1. Any naturally navigable parts of international straits that separate or traverse different states, as well as any naturally navigable sections of other international waterways connected to such straits.

Query_Text_cn: （e）国际性可航水道，包括国际性可航水道支流所分隔或流经的不同国家，被称为"沿岸国”。
Translation: (e) International navigable waterways, including their tributaries that separate or flow through different countries, are referred to as "riparian states."

Query_Text_cn: 2.处于国家主权或权力之下的天然或人工水道或其他的部分，并在这种国家单方面的法令中，或在经征得尤其是此种国家同意而达成的协议中，被明确声明为应受有关国际性可航水道的公约确立的制度的约束。
Translation: 2. Natural or artificial waterways or parts thereof under the sovereignty or jurisdiction of a state, which are explicitly declared in unilateral acts of such state or in agreements concluded with its consent—particularly that of the said state—to be subject to the regime established by the conventions concerning international navigable waterways.

Query_Text_cn: （b）处于国家主权或权力之下的可航水道，根据此种国家单方面的法令或经征得尤其是此种国家同意而成成的协议，在此后可列入这种类型的可航水道。
Translation: (b) Navigable waterways under national sovereignty or jurisdiction may be subsequently included in this category by unilateral decree of such states or through agreements concluded with their consent, particularly that of the states concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条除第5条和第17条另有规定外，各缔约国对悬挂其他任何一个缔约国国旗的船舶，在上述规定的处于其主权或权力之下的那部分可航水域，均应实行航行自由。
Translation: Article 3 Except as otherwise provided in Articles 5 and 17, each Contracting Party shall grant freedom of navigation to vessels flying the flag of any other Contracting Party in the navigable waters under its sovereignty or jurisdiction as specified above.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条在实行上述航行自由时，所有缔约国的国民、财产和船旗，在各方面均应在完全平等的基础上予以对待。
Translation: Article 4 In the exercise of the aforementioned freedom of navigation, the nationals, property, and flags of all Contracting Parties shall be treated on a footing of complete equality in all respects.

Query_Text_cn: 与此相似，对沿岸国和非沿岸国的国民、财产和船旗，亦不得有任何区别。
Translation: Similarly, there shall be no distinction between the nationals, property, and flags of coastal and non-coastal states.

Query_Text_cn: 进而，在此种可航水道上，任何公司或个人都不享有专属航行权。
Translation: Furthermore, no company or individual holds exclusive navigation rights on such navigable waterways.

Query_Text_cn: 在实行上述航行自由时，不得以船舶的始发地、目的地或运输方向为由，采取任何区别对待。
Translation: In exercising the aforementioned freedom of navigation, no discrimination may be exercised against ships on the grounds of their place of origin, destination, or direction of transport.

Query_Text_cn: 1.沿岸国有权保留其本国船舶在处于其主权或权力之下的港口登船或装船，并在处于其主权或权力之下的另一港口离船或卸船的旅客或货物运输。
Translation: 1. Coastal states have the right to reserve the transportation of passengers or goods for their national vessels embarking or loading at ports under their sovereignty or jurisdiction and disembarking or unloading at another port under their sovereignty or jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 未保留上述本国船舶运输权利的国家，可以拒绝就此种运输给予保留该权利的同一水道的其他沿岸国以平等待遇的利益。
Translation: Countries that have not reserved the aforementioned right of national vessel transportation may deny the benefits of equal treatment in such transportation to other riparian states of the same waterway that have retained such rights.

Query_Text_cn: 在第2条所指的可航水道上，航行法令应只允许沿岸国保留旅客、或者本国出产或本国所有的货物在当地的运输权利。
Translation: On the navigable waterways referred to in Article 2, the Navigation Act shall only permit riparian states to reserve the right of local transport for passengers, or goods produced or owned within their own territories.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，在任何情况下，如在以前的航行法令中已确定了更大的航行自由，则不应削减此种自由。
Translation: However, in no case shall such freedom be diminished where greater freedom of navigation has been established under previous navigation laws.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果国际性可航水道的天然水系不包括第2条所指类型的水道，而只是分隔或流经两个国家，则这两个国家有权通过协议保留由本国船舶运输在该天然水系内一港登船或装船而在该水系内另一港离船或卸船的旅客或货物，除非这一运输发生在不处于同一国家主权或权力之下的两个港口之间，并在上述任何一个国家内不发生转运，而且涉及海上航行或不属于上述水系内的国际性可航水道上的航行。
Translation: 2. If an international navigable waterway of a natural water system does not fall under the types referred to in Article 2 but merely separates or flows through two states, these two states shall have the right, by agreement, to reserve the transport of passengers or goods embarked or loaded at one port within such natural water system and disembarked or unloaded at another port within the same system for vessels of their own nationalities, unless such transport occurs between ports not under the sovereignty or jurisdiction of the same state, involves no transshipment in either of the aforementioned states, and entails maritime navigation or navigation on international navigable waterways outside the said water system.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条各缔约国对第1条所指的并处于其主权或权力之下的可航水道或部分可航水道，保持其颁布规定和采取必要措施的现行权利，以维持境内治安，实施有关海关、公共卫生、动植物病害预防、出境和入境移民以及违禁品进出口的法律和规章。但是，这种规定和措施必须是合理的，必须绝对平等地适用于任何缔约国（包括颁布这种规定和采取这种措施的国家）的国民、财产和船旗，并在无充分理由情况下，不得妨碍航行自由。
Translation: Article 6: Each Contracting Party retains its existing rights to promulgate regulations and take necessary measures regarding navigable waterways or sections thereof referred to in Article 1 that are under its sovereignty or jurisdiction, for the maintenance of public order within its territory, and the enforcement of laws and regulations concerning customs, public health, prevention of animal and plant diseases, emigration and immigration, as well as the import and export of prohibited goods. However, such regulations and measures must be reasonable, applied with absolute equality to the nationals, property, and flags of all Contracting Parties (including the Party promulgating such regulations or adopting such measures), and shall not, without sufficient justification, impede freedom of navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条在国际性可航水道或其入口的任何地点，除属于因提供服务而收费性质的税款，以及单纯为了以合理方式，弥补维持和改进水道及其入口的可航性所需费用，或者支付为航行利益所产生的费用而收取税款外，不得征收其他性质的税款。
Translation: Article 7: No dues of any kind shall be levied at any location along international navigable waterways or their entrances, except for charges of a service-rendering nature, or taxes imposed solely to reasonably cover the costs of maintaining and improving the navigability of the waterway and its entrances, or to defray expenses incurred for the benefit of navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 这种税款应根据此种费用确定，并且，税款的费率应在港口公布。
Translation: Such duties shall be determined on the basis of such charges, and the rates shall be published at the port.

Query_Text_cn: 就这些税款的费率和实施方法两者而言，征收方式应使详细查对货物成为不必要，从而尽可能便利国际运输，除非有诈骗或违反规定的嫌疑。
Translation: As for the rates and methods of levying these duties,the mode of collection should render detailed examination of goods unnecessary so as to facilitate international transport as much as possible,unless there is suspicion of fraud or violation of regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条船舶、旅客和货物在国际性可航水道上过境时，如涉及海关手续，应受《巴塞罗那过境自由规约》中确定的条件的制约。
Translation: Article 8: The transit of vessels, passengers, and cargo on international navigable waterways involving customs formalities shall be subject to the conditions established by the Barcelona Statute on Freedom of Transit.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如果某一国际性可航水道系两国之间的边界，则在过境之中的船舶、旅客的货物免办任何海关手续，除非有切实可行的正当理由，并且在不妨碍便利航行的情况下，应在界海某一地点办理海关手续。
Translation: (b) If an international navigable waterway constitutes a boundary between two states, vessels in transit, along with their passengers and cargo, shall be exempt from all customs formalities unless there are justifiable and practicable grounds for such procedures. In such cases, customs formalities shall be conducted at a designated location along the boundary waters, provided that this does not impede the convenience of navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 在国际性可航水道上，船舶和旅客的过境，以及货物在不转运情况下的过境，不得引起任何税款的征收，而不论此种征收是巴塞罗那规约基于过境自由所根本上的，还是该规约第3条所准许的。
Translation: On international navigable waterways, the transit of vessels and passengers, as well as the transit of goods without transshipment, shall not give rise to the imposition of any dues, whether such dues are fundamentally based on the freedom of transit under the Barcelona Statute or permitted by Article 3 thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，确实因监督所需的海关官员的食宿，可责成由过境船舶承担。
Translation: However, the cost of accommodation and meals for customs officers required for supervision may indeed be charged to the transiting vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条除第5条和第17条另有规定外，所有缔约国的国民、财产和船旗，在所有位于国际性可航水道内的港口，在使用港口的各个方面，包括港口税款及费用，享有与港口的主权和权力所属的沿岸国的国民、财产和船旗平等的待遇。
Translation: Article 9 Except as otherwise provided in Articles 5 and 17, the nationals, property, and flags of all Contracting Parties shall enjoy equal treatment with those of the riparian state exercising sovereignty or authority over the ports in all ports situated on international navigable waterways, in all aspects of port use, including port dues and charges.

Query_Text_cn: 本款所指的财产系产自、来自或运往一个或其他缔约国的财产。
Translation: The property referred to in this Article shall be property originating from, coming from, or destined for one or more Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 位于国际性可航水道的港口设施，以及这些港口的助航设施，在合理和与航行自由充分相适应的范围内，不得拒绝公众使用。
Translation: Port facilities located on international navigable waterways, as well as the navigational aids of these ports, shall not be denied to public use within reasonable limits and to the fullest extent compatible with the freedom of navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 在对通过上述港口的进出口货物征收海关或其他类似关税、地方税或消费税、或杂费时，不得因已完成运输或将完成运输的船舶的挂旗不同区别对待，不论船舶所挂的是本国旗，还是任何其他缔约国的旗帜。
Translation: In levying customs duties or other similar charges, local taxes or consumption taxes, or miscellaneous fees on imports and exports passing through the aforementioned ports, no distinction shall be made based on the flag of the vessel that has completed or will complete the transport, whether it flies the national flag or the flag of any other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 如经证明，某一船舶的所有人故意歧视处于主权或权力之下的港口所属国的国民，包括其控制的公司，则该国可取消该船舶享受前款规定的利益。
Translation: If it is proven that the owner of a vessel has intentionally discriminated against nationals of the country to which the port belongs, including companies under its control, that country may revoke the benefits granted to the vessel under the preceding paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 如果没有特殊发问证明在经济上有必要作出例外，则国家对港口货物所征关税的税率不得高于边境其他关卡对相同种类、来源和目的地的货物所征的关税。
Translation: Unless special circumstances demonstrate an economic necessity for exceptions, the tariff rates imposed by the state on port cargo shall not exceed those levied at other border checkpoints for goods of the same type, origin, and destination.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国提供给通过其他陆地或水路，或者在其他港口的货物进出口的便利条件，应同样提供给在相同条件下通过上述可航水域或港口的货物进出口。
Translation: The facilities granted by a Contracting State to the import and export of goods through other land or water routes, or through other ports, shall be equally applicable to the import and export of goods under the same conditions through the aforementioned navigable waters or ports.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条1.各沿岸国一方面应避免采取影响水道可航性或减少航行便利条件的一切措施，另一方面应负责尽快采取一切必要步骤以消除任何可能出现的航行障碍物和危险物。
Translation:
Article 10  
1. Each riparian State shall, on the one hand, refrain from adopting any measures that may affect the navigability of the waterway or reduce the conditions facilitating navigation and, on the other hand, be responsible for taking all necessary steps as promptly as possible to remove any navigational obstructions or hazards that may arise.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果此种航行水道需要经常维修，各沿岸国应如同对待其它义务一样，随时考虑到航行条件以及水道所经地区的经济状况，在其境内尽快为此采取必要步骤和实施维修。
Translation: 2. If such navigable channels require regular maintenance, the riparian states shall, as with other obligations, take into account at all times the navigational conditions and the economic circumstances of the regions through which the channels pass, and shall promptly take the necessary steps within their respective territories to carry out such maintenance.

Query_Text_cn: 除另有相反协议，任何沿岸国有权在提出正当的理由后，要求其他沿岸国合理分担维修费用。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, any riparian state has the right to request other riparian states to reasonably share maintenance costs upon presenting justifiable grounds.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如果某一沿岸国要求另一沿岸国(包括有领土利益的国家)为改善水道的可航性而进行必要的工程，并且同意承担工程经费和合理分担额外维修费用，则被要求的另一沿岸国不能拒绝，除非它根据其境内的实际可航性条件，或根据其他利益，尤其是如保持正常水况、灌溉需要、水力利用或建立其他更有利的交通路线的必要，提出合法理由予以反对。
Translation: 3. If a riparian state requests another riparian state (including states with territorial interests) to undertake necessary works to improve the navigability of a waterway and agrees to bear the cost of the works and reasonably share additional maintenance expenses, the requested state may not refuse unless it raises legitimate objections based on actual navigability conditions within its territory or other interests, particularly such as maintaining normal water conditions, irrigation needs, hydroelectric utilization, or the necessity of establishing more advantageous alternative transportation routes.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，只要拟实施的工作所在地国家以其重大利益为理由而提出反对，就不得着手该项工作。这是不言而喻的。
Translation: However, it goes without saying that no such work shall be undertaken if the state where the work is to be performed objects on the grounds of its essential interests.

Query_Text_cn: 关于改善工程，如应承担该项工作的国家授权由提出此要求的国家代其进行，亦可被免除该项义务。
Translation: Regarding improvement works, the obligation may also be waived if the state responsible for such works delegates them to the requesting state through national authorization.

Query_Text_cn: 如由非具有领土利益的国家承担工作建设或分担建设费用，则这种安排不得损害具有领土利益的国家对工作的监督和行政控制的权利，或其对可航水道的主权或权力。
Translation: If the construction of works is undertaken or the cost thereof is shared by states without territorial interests, such arrangements shall not prejudice the right of states with territorial interests to supervise and administer the works, or their sovereignty or authority over the navigable waterway.

Query_Text_cn: 5.本条规定适用于第2条所指的水道，但应遵守确定国际委员会对工程的权力和责任的条约、公约或航行条例的规定。
Translation: 5. This provision applies to the waterways referred to in Article 2, subject to the provisions of treaties, conventions, or navigation regulations that define the powers and responsibilities of international commissions regarding such works.

Query_Text_cn: (b)根据下述第22条的规定，对于委员会的决定所引起的任何争议，一概可以以这些决定越权或违反调整可航水道的国际公约为理由，要求予以解决，如以其他理由要求根据上述规定解决争议，此种要求只能由具有领土利益的国家提出。
Translation: (b) In accordance with the provisions of Article 22 below, any dispute arising from decisions of the Commission may be submitted for resolution on the grounds that such decisions exceed its competence or violate international conventions governing navigable waterways. Requests for dispute resolution based on other grounds under the aforementioned provisions may only be made by states with territorial interests.

Query_Text_cn: 该委员会的决定应与本条的规定相一致。
Translation: The decision of the committee shall be consistent with the provisions of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 6.虽有本条第1款的规定，如无相反的协议，某一沿岸国可以在征得所有沿岸国同意或所有国际委员会成员国同意后，全部或部分关闭第2条所指的可航水道的通航。
Translation: 6.Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article, in the absence of an agreement to the contrary, a riparian State may, with the consent of all riparian States or all members of an international commission, close navigation in whole or in part on the navigable waterways referred to in Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 作为特殊情况，如果某一不属于第2条所指的国际性可航水道通航的重要性很小，而且某一沿岸国能证明其他用途的经济利益明显大于通航，则该国可以关闭该水道的通航。
Translation: As a special case, if the navigational significance of an international waterway not covered under Article 2 is minimal and a riparian state can demonstrate that its economic benefits from other uses substantially outweigh navigation, that state may close the waterway to navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 在此种情况下，只有在事先通告一年后，并且任何其他沿岸国未按第22条的规定控告，才能实施关闭通航。
Translation: Under such circumstances, the closure of navigation may only be implemented after a one-year prior notice and provided that no other riparian state has raised an objection in accordance with the provisions of Article 22.

Query_Text_cn: 如有必要，判决中应规定实施关闭通航的条件。
Translation: Where necessary, the judgment shall specify the conditions for implementing the closure of navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 7.如果某一国际性可航水道有几条支流通海，而且全部入海口在同一国境内，则本条第1、2和3款的规定仅适用于被认为是提供自由入海口所必需的主要支流。
Translation: 7. If an international navigable waterway has several branches to the sea and all its mouths are situated within the territory of a single State, the provisions of paragraphs 1, 2, and 3 of this Article shall apply only to the principal branch deemed necessary to provide free access to the sea.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条如果某一国际性水道上有一个或几个沿岸国不是本规约的缔约国，则每一缔约国根据第10条的规定所应承担的财政义务，不得超过假如所有沿岸国均为缔约国时所应分担的款额。
Translation:
Article 11  
If one or more riparian States of an international watercourse are not parties to the present Statute, the financial obligations of each party under Article 10 shall not exceed the amount that would be due if all riparian States were parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条如在特别协议或条约，例如现行的有关海关、治安措施和卫生预防的公约中没有相反的规定，各沿岸国负责对处于其主权或权力之下的国际性可航水道进行管理。
Translation: Article 12 In the absence of contrary provisions in special agreements or treaties, such as existing conventions concerning customs, police measures, and sanitary precautions, each riparian state shall be responsible for the administration of international navigable waterways under its sovereignty or jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 各沿岸国有权力和责任公布此种水道的航行规则并监督其实施。
Translation: Each coastal state has the right and responsibility to promulgate navigation rules for such waterways and oversee their implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 这些规则的制定和实施，应便于根据本规约的规定行使航行自由。
Translation: The formulation and implementation of these rules should facilitate the exercise of freedom of navigation in accordance with the provisions of this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 有关证明、检控和惩处航行违法行为的程序规则，应力求尽快使案件得到处理。
Translation: The procedural rules concerning the verification, prosecution, and punishment of navigation violations shall aim to expedite case resolution as promptly as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，各缔约国均承认，沿岸国对可航水道的管理，尤其是在不同的地区情况所许可的范围内，对整个可航水道实施统一的航行规定达成谅解，是非常需要的。
Translation: However, all Contracting Parties recognize that it is highly desirable for the riparian states to manage navigable waterways, particularly by reaching an understanding on the implementation of uniform navigation regulations for the entire navigable waterway, to the extent permitted by varying regional conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条所指的可航水道上的公共拖航或其他形式的拖曳服务，为便利通航，经沿岸国或国际委员会成员国一致同意，可采用垄断形式。
Translation: Public towing or other forms of towing services on the navigable waterways referred to in Article 2 may, for the facilitation of navigation, be operated as a monopoly upon unanimous agreement by the riparian states or member states of the international commission.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条在本规约生效前，缔约国之间缔结且已生效的有关可航水道的条约、公约或协议，对其签字国而言，不因本规约的生效而废除。
Translation: Article 13 Treaties, conventions, or agreements concerning navigable waterways concluded and in effect between Contracting Parties prior to the entry into force of this Statute shall not be abrogated by its entry into force for the signatory states.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，缔约国之间应保证不适用上述条约、公约或协议中与本规约的原则相抵触的规定。
Translation: However, States Parties shall ensure that the provisions of such treaties, conventions or agreements that are inconsistent with the principles of this Statute are not applied among them.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条如第12条所指的任何特别协议或条约已经或将委托某一国际委员会行使某些职权，且该委员会具有非沿岸国的代表，则该委员会有义务根据第10条的规定，完全考虑航行利益。该委员会应被视为《国际联盟盟约》第24条所指的组织之一。
Translation: Article 14 If any special agreement or treaty referred to in Article 12 has conferred or shall confer upon an international commission powers which include representation of non-riparian States, such commission shall be bound to take into consideration the interests of navigation in accordance with the provisions of Article 10. Such commission shall be regarded as one of the organizations referred to in Article 24 of the Covenant of the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 从而，它应直接同联盟及其机构交换一切有用的情况，并向国际联盟提交年度报告。
Translation: Consequently, it shall directly exchange all useful information with the League and its agencies, and submit annual reports to the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: (d)如航行条例中没有关于征税的特别规定，委员会有权依照本规约第7条的规定核准此种税款和费用的征收。
Translation: (d) Where the navigation regulations contain no specific provisions regarding taxation, the Committee shall have the authority to approve the imposition of such taxes and fees in accordance with the provisions of Article 7 of this Statute.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条本规约不规范战时交战国和中立国的权利和义务。
Translation: Article 15 This Convention does not regulate the rights and obligations of belligerent and neutral states during wartime.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，在此种权利和义务许可的范围内，本规约在战时应继续有效。
Translation: However, within the limits of such rights and obligations, this Covenant shall remain in force during wartime.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条本规约不加给缔约国与其作为国际联盟成员的权利和责任相违背的义务。
Translation:
Article 16  
The present Covenant does not impose upon the Contracting Parties any obligations inconsistent with their rights and responsibilities as Members of the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条如果没有任何相反的由具有领土利益的国家参加或可能参加的协定，本规约与军舰或履行治安或行政职能的船舶，或者总的来说，行使任何公共权力的船舶的航行，不发生关系。
Translation:
Article 17  
This Statute shall not apply to the navigation of warships or vessels performing police or administrative functions, or in general, exercising any public authority, unless there is any agreement to the contrary in which States with a territorial interest are or may be participants.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条各缔约国保证不通过协议或从其他任何方式，给予非缔约国在国际性可航水道上，如同缔约国之间一样，与本规约规定相违背的待遇。
Translation: Article 18: Each Contracting State undertakes not to accord to non-Contracting States, through agreements or by any other means, treatment on international navigable waterways that is inconsistent with the provisions of this Statute, as is granted among Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 第19条缔约国遇有影响国家安全或重大利益的紧急情况，被迫采取一般或特殊性质的措施时，可以在特殊情况下，并在尽可能短的时间内，背离上述各条的规定，但必须在最大可能的限度内维持航行自由的原则，尤其是沿岸缔约国和海上之间的交通。
Translation:
Article 19  
In the event of an emergency affecting national security or vital interests, a Contracting State may, under exceptional circumstances and for the shortest possible duration, deviate from the provisions of the foregoing articles by taking measures of a general or specific nature. However, such measures must uphold, to the greatest extent possible, the principle of freedom of navigation, particularly the traffic between the coastal Contracting State and the high seas.

Query_Text_cn: 本规约亦不要求禁止在将来给予此种更大的便利。
Translation: This Convention also does not require the prohibition of granting such greater facilities in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 第21条按照《国际联盟盟约》第23条第(e)款，由于受到1914年-1918年战争的破坏造成严重经济状况而有充分理由在其全部或部分领土上不适用本规约中任何规定的任何缔约国，应视为暂时免除适用此种规定的义务。但是，必须在最大可能的限度由遵守航行自由原则。
Translation: Article 21 Any Contracting Party which, by reason of the severe economic conditions resulting from the damage caused by the 1914-1918 war, has valid grounds for not applying any provision of the present Statute in all or part of its territory, shall be deemed to be temporarily exempted from the obligation to apply such provision. However, the principle of freedom of navigation must be observed to the fullest possible extent.

Query_Text_cn: 第22条在不影响第10条第5款规定的情况下，有关本规约的解释或适用方面国家之间不能直接解决的争议，应提交常设国际法庭解决，除非根据特别协议或一般仲裁规定，应采取仲裁或其他方式的步骤解决争议。
Translation:
Article 22  
Without prejudice to the provisions of paragraph 5 of Article 10, any dispute between States concerning the interpretation or application of this Statute that cannot be settled directly shall be referred to the Permanent Court of International Justice for resolution, unless the parties agree to settle it by arbitration or other means in accordance with a special agreement or general arbitration provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 有关的程序应以《常设国际法庭规约》第40条确定的方式公开进行。
Translation: The relevant proceedings shall be conducted publicly in the manner determined by Article 40 of the Statute of the Permanent Court of International Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，为尽可能友好地解决争议，缔约国保证在求助于任何司法程序之前，在不妨碍理事会和大会的权力和行动权利的情况下，将该争议提交国际联盟为解决通行与过境问题所设立的、作为联盟成员咨询和技术组织的机构，征求咨询意见。
Translation: However, with a view to settling disputes as amicably as possible, the Contracting Parties undertake to submit them, before resorting to any judicial procedure and without prejudice to the powers and right of action of the Council and of the Assembly, to the advisory and technical organization of the League of Nations for communications and transit, established by the League, for the purpose of obtaining an advisory opinion.

Query_Text_cn: 在紧急情况下，可以提出初步意见，建议采取临时性措施，以着重恢复在引起争议的行动或事件发生之前存在的航行自由便利。
Translation: In emergency situations, preliminary opinions may be proposed to recommend interim measures aimed at restoring the freedom and convenience of navigation that existed prior to the disputed action or incident.

Query_Text_cn: 第23条只要可航水道流经或划定的地区或飞地与其流经的领土相比，面积小、人口少，且已形成在整个航路上作为例外的独立的部分或非河流所属国的拓居地，则该可航水道不应认为具有国际性。
Translation: Article 23: A navigable waterway shall not be considered international if the area or enclave through which it flows or is demarcated is small in size and sparse in population compared to the territory it traverses, and has historically formed an independent segment or settlement not belonging to the riparian state as an exception along the entire navigation route.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条如果某一国际性可航水道上仅有两个沿岸国，其中之一为本规约缔约国，另一个为非缔约国，并且该水道将两国隔开相当距离，且该非缔约国的政府在本规约签署之时尚未得到该缔约国的承认，则在该两国就该水道建立对缔约国提供适当安全保障的行政管理和海关制度而达成协议之前，本规约不适用于该水道。
Translation:
Article 24  
If an international navigable waterway involves only two riparian states, one being a Contracting Party to the present Statute and the other a non-Contracting Party, and if such waterway separates the two states by a considerable distance, and if the government of the non-Contracting Party was not recognized by the Contracting Party at the time of the signing of the present Statute, then the Statute shall not apply to such waterway until the two states conclude an agreement establishing an administrative and customs regime that provides adequate security guarantees for the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第25条本规约不得解释为调整一个主权国家所属的或处于其保护之下的领地之间的权利和义务，而不论这些领地是否单独为国际联盟的成员。
Translation:
Article 25  
The present Covenant shall not be interpreted as affecting the rights and obligations of territories belonging to or under the protection of a sovereign state, whether such territories are individually Members of the League of Nations or not.

Query_Text_cn: 前言缔约各国认识到在集装箱的装卸、堆放和运输过程中，高度保障人身安全的需要。注意到便利集装箱国际运输的必要性。承认，在这一方面，制定国际共同的安全要求是有益的。认为，为达到以上目的最好是缔结一个公约。决定正式提出有关集装箱结构上的要求，以保证在正常营运中集装箱的装卸、堆码和运输的安全。
Translation:
Preamble  
The Contracting Parties,  
Recognizing the need to ensure a high level of safety in the handling, stacking, and transport of containers,  
Noting the necessity to facilitate the international transport of containers,  
Acknowledging that the establishment of common international safety requirements in this regard is beneficial,  
Considering that the conclusion of a convention is the most appropriate means to achieve these objectives,  
Have resolved to formally prescribe structural requirements for containers to ensure their safety during handling, stacking, and transport under normal operating conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条本公约的一般义务各缔约国保证实施本公约及其附件的规定,该附件应为本公约不可分割的一部分。
Translation:
Article 1 General Obligations under the Convention  
Each State Party undertakes to implement the provisions of this Convention and its Annex, which shall constitute an integral part thereof.

Query_Text_cn: (4)四个外底角所围闭的面积应为下列二者之一：①至少为14平方米(150平方英尺),或②如装有顶角配件,则至少为7平方米(75平方英尺)；“集装箱”一词既不包括车辆,也不包括包装；但是,集装箱在底盘车上运输时,则连同底盘车包括在内。
Translation: (4) The area enclosed by the four outer bottom corners shall be either: (i) at least 14 square meters (150 square feet), or (ii) at least 7 square meters (75 square feet) if top corner fittings are provided. The term "container" excludes vehicles and packaging; however, when a container is transported on a chassis, it includes the chassis.

Query_Text_cn: 2.“角配件”是指为了装卸,堆码和(或)系固目的而在集装箱顶部和(或)底部上安装的一种表面有孔的支撑配件。
Translation: 2. "Corner fitting" refers to a load-bearing fitting with apertures installed at the top and/or bottom of a container for purposes of handling, stacking, and/or securing.

Query_Text_cn: 3.“主管机关”是指有权批准集箱的缔约国政府。
Translation: 3. "Competent authority" means the government of a Contracting State authorized to approve container assemblies.

Query_Text_cn: 4.“获得批准”是指被主管机关批准。
Translation: 4. "Approval obtained" refers to the approval granted by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 5.“批准”是指主管机关作出的决定,即某种定型设计或某个集装箱在本公约条款范围内是安全的。
Translation: 5. "Approval" means a decision by the competent authority that a given type of design or container is safe within the terms of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 6.“国际运输”是指位于两个国家领土上的起运地和目的地之间的运输。
Translation: 6. "International transport" refers to the transportation between the place of departure and the place of destination located in the territories of two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 而本公约至少适用其中一国。两国间运输业务的一部分在一个适用本公约的国家领土内进行时,本公约也应适用。
Translation: This Convention applies where at least one of the countries involved is a Contracting State. It shall also apply when part of the transport operations between two countries is performed in the territory of a State where the Convention is in force.

Query_Text_cn: 7.“货物”是指物品、器皿、商品和用集装箱装运的各种物件。
Translation: 7. "Goods" refer to articles, utensils, commodities, and various objects transported in containers.

Query_Text_cn: 8.“新集装箱”是指在本公约生效时或生效后开始制造的集装箱。
Translation: 8. "New container" means a container the construction of which was commenced on or after the date of entry into force of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 9.“现有集装箱”是指不属于新集装箱的集装箱。
Translation: 9. "Existing container" means a container that is not a new container.

Query_Text_cn: 10.“箱主”是指各缔约国国家法律规定的所有人或承租人或受托人,如双方有协议,该承租人或受托人将承担对集装箱的维修和检验的责任。
Translation: 10. "Owner" refers to the legal owner, lessee, or bailee of a container as defined by the national laws of each Contracting State. Where an agreement exists, the lessee or bailee shall assume responsibility for the maintenance and inspection of the container.

Query_Text_cn: 11.“集装箱的定型设计”是指经主管机关批准的定型设计。
Translation: 11. "Type-approved design of containers" refers to a design approved by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 12.“定型系列集装箱”是指按照批准的定型设计制造的任何集装箱。
Translation: 12. "Type-series container" means any container manufactured in accordance with an approved type design.

Query_Text_cn: 13.“样箱”是指按定型设计系列制成或准备制造的具有代表性的集装箱。
Translation: 13. A "sample container" refers to a representative container manufactured or prepared for production according to the finalized design series.

Query_Text_cn: 14.“最大营运总重量或额定重量”或“R”是指集装箱和所装货物最大的允许总重量。
Translation: 14. "Maximum operating gross weight" or "R" refers to the maximum permissible total weight of a container and its cargo.

Query_Text_cn: 15.“皮重”是指集装箱空载的重量,包括装置的永久性设备。
Translation: 15. "Tare weight" refers to the weight of an empty container, including its permanently attached equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 16.“最大允许载货重量”或“P”是指最大营运总重量或额定重量与皮重之间的差数。
Translation: 16. "Maximum permissible payload" or "P" means the difference between the maximum operational gross weight or rated weight and the tare weight.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条适用范围1.本公约适用于国际运输中所使用的现有或新集装箱,但不包括为空运专门设计的集装箱。
Translation:
Article 3 Scope of Application  
1. This Convention applies to existing and new containers used in international transport, excluding those designed specifically for air transport.

Query_Text_cn: 2.应根据附件一所要求的或是做定型试验或是做单个试验的规定来认可每一个新集装箱。
Translation: 2. Each new container shall be approved either by undergoing prototype testing or individual testing as stipulated in Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 3.每一现有集装箱应在本公约生效之日起五年内,按附件一所做出的有关现有集装箱批准的规定获得批准。
Translation: 3. Each existing container shall be approved in accordance with the provisions for the approval of existing containers set forth in Annex I within five years from the date of entry into force of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条试验、检查、批准和维修1.为了使附件一中各项规定付诸实施,各主管机关应按本公约规定的标准,建立有效的集装箱试验、检查和批准程序。但主管机关可委托给它正式授权的机构来进行这些试验,检查和批准工作。
Translation:
Article 4 Testing, Inspection, Approval and Maintenance  
1. For the implementation of the provisions in Annex I, each Administration shall establish effective procedures for the testing, inspection, and approval of containers in accordance with the standards prescribed by this Convention. However, an Administration may delegate such testing, inspection, and approval to organizations duly authorized by it.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在主管机关将试验、检查和批准工作委托给一个机构时应通知政府间海事协商组织秘书长(以下简称“海协”)以便转知各缔约国。
Translation: 2. When the competent authority delegates the testing, inspection, and approval work to an agency, it shall notify the Secretary-General of the Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization (hereinafter referred to as "IMCO") for transmission to all Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 3.可向任何缔约国的主管机关申请批准。
Translation: 3. Applications for approval may be submitted to the competent authority of any Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 4.集装箱均应按照附件一中的各项规定,保持在安全状态。
Translation: 4. All containers shall be maintained in a safe condition in accordance with the provisions set forth in Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如获得批准的集装箱实际上达不到附件一和附件二的要求,有关主管机关应采取必要的措施,使之达到上述要求,或撤销批准。
Translation: 5. If an approved container fails to meet the requirements of Annexes I and II, the competent authority concerned shall take necessary measures to bring it into compliance with the said requirements or revoke the approval.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条接受批准1.根据本公约的条款,在某一缔约国授权下的批准,均应被其他缔约国在本公约所包括的范围内接受。
Translation:
Article 5 Acceptance of Approvals  
1. Approvals granted under the terms of this Convention by any Contracting Party shall be accepted by the other Contracting Parties within the scope of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 同时也应被认为与他们自己作出的批准同样有效。
Translation: They shall also be deemed as equally valid as the approvals they themselves have granted.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对本公约中规定的集装箱,缔约国不得擅自对此提出任何其他安全结构和试验的要求。但本公约中的任何规定不得妨碍应用国家规章或法律或国际协定中的条款,对专门设计运输危险品或具有独特装置的运输散装液体货物的集装箱或空运的集装箱,在安全结构或试验方面提出补充要求。
Translation: 2. For containers specified in this Convention, Contracting States shall not impose any additional safety structural or testing requirements. However, nothing in this Convention shall preclude the application of provisions in national regulations or laws or international agreements that prescribe supplementary safety structural or testing requirements for containers specially designed for the transport of dangerous goods, those equipped with unique devices for transporting bulk liquid cargoes, or those used in air transport.

Query_Text_cn: “危险品”一词应含有国际协定中赋予它的意义。
Translation: The term "dangerous goods" shall have the meaning assigned to it in international agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条管理1.根据第三条获得批准的每个集装箱,应在缔约国领土内受该缔约国正式授权的官员的管理。
Translation:
Article 6 Management  
1. Each container approved under Article 3 shall be subject to management by an officer duly authorized by the Contracting Party within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 这种管理仅限于证实集装箱上装有按本公约要求的有效的安全合格牌照,除非有重要证据证明该集装箱的现状对安全有明显的危险,在这种情况下,执行管理工作的官员所采取的必要行动,也仅限于保证集装箱在继续投入营运之前恢复到安全状态。
Translation: Such verification shall be limited to ascertaining that the container carries a valid Safety Approval Plate as required by the present Convention, unless there is significant evidence for believing that the condition of the container is such as to create an obvious risk to safety. In that case, the action taken by the officer carrying out the verification shall be limited to ensuring that the container is restored to a safe condition before it continues in service.

Query_Text_cn: 2.当集装箱由于某种缺陷似乎危及安全,而这项缺陷在该集装箱获得批准时可能业已存在,应由发现这种缺陷的缔约国通知负责批准该集装箱的主管机关。
Translation: 2. When a container appears to have a defect that could jeopardize safety and such defect may have existed at the time of its approval, the Contracting Party that identifies the defect shall notify the competent authority responsible for approving the container.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条签字、批准、接受、核准和加入1.本公约于1973年1月15日以前在日内瓦联合国办事处开放,以供签字。
Translation:
Article VII Signature, Ratification, Acceptance, Approval and Accession  

1. This Convention shall be open for signature at the United Nations Office at Geneva until 15 January 1973.

Query_Text_cn: 自此以后自1973年2月1日至1973年12月31日止在伦敦“海协”总部,对联合国所有会员国、任一专门机构的成员或国际原子能机构的成员国,国际法院规约当事国以及联合国大会邀请其成为本公约缔约国的任何其他国家开放,以供签字。
Translation: Thereafter, from February 1, 1973, to December 31, 1973, the Convention shall be open for signature at the Headquarters of the Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization (IMCO) in London by all States Members of the United Nations or members of any specialized agency or of the International Atomic Energy Agency, parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice, and any other State invited by the General Assembly of the United Nations to become a Party to the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条生效1.本公约应自第十份批准、接受、核准或加入文件交存之日起十二个月后生效。
Translation:
Article 8 Entry into Force  
1. This Convention shall enter into force twelve months after the date of deposit of the tenth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 2.凡在第十份批准、接受、核准或加入文件交存后批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的国家,本公约应自该国的批准、接受、核准或加入文件交存之日起十二个月后生效。
Translation: 2. For any State that ratifies, accepts, approves or accedes to this Convention after the deposit of the tenth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, the Convention shall enter into force twelve months after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 3.在一修正案生效后成为本公约缔约国的国家,如未提出异议,应当：(1)被视为是修改后的本公约的缔约国。
Translation: 3. A State which becomes a Party to this Convention after the entry into force of an amendment shall, failing an expression of a different intention, be considered: (1) as a Party to the Convention as amended.

Query_Text_cn: (2)被视为是未经修改的本公约的缔约国,相当于不受修正案约束的公约缔约国。
Translation: (2) Shall be considered as Parties to the unamended Convention and, as such, shall be equivalent to Parties not bound by the amendments.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约中某一部分的修改程序1.可根据缔约国的建议,按本条中规定的任一程序,对本公约进行修改。
Translation:
Article 9 Amendment Procedures for Any Part of This Convention  

1. Amendments to this Convention may be proposed by any Contracting State and adopted through any of the procedures specified in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (1)根据缔约国的要求,对本公约提出的任何修正案都应在海协内予以审议。
Translation: (1) Any amendment to this Convention proposed at the request of a Contracting Party shall be considered within the IMO.

Query_Text_cn: 所有缔约国均应应邀参加“海约”海上安全委员会会议并投票,如果在“海协”海上安全委员会上经出席并投票的三分之二多数通过,该修正案至迟应在提交“海协”大会审议前六个月通知所有“海协”成员国和缔约国。
Translation: All Contracting States shall be invited to participate and vote in the meetings of the Maritime Safety Committee of the "Maritime Convention." If an amendment is adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting in the Maritime Safety Committee of the "Maritime Organization," such amendment shall be communicated to all member states and Contracting States of the "Maritime Organization" at least six months before its submission for consideration by the Assembly of the "Maritime Organization."

Query_Text_cn: 在大会审议修正案时,任何非“海协”成员的缔约国均有权参加和投票。
Translation: During the consideration of amendments by the Conference, any Contracting State which is not a member of IMO shall be entitled to participate and vote.

Query_Text_cn: (2)如经出席大会并投票的三分之二多数通过,且该多数又包括出席并投票的缔约国的三分之二多数,秘书长便应将该修正案通知所有缔约国,供他们接受。
Translation: (2) If adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting, and if that majority includes a two-thirds majority of the States Parties present and voting, the Secretary-General shall communicate the proposed amendment to all States Parties for their acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: (3)该修正案应在三分之二缔约国接受之日起十二个月后生效。
Translation: (3) The amendment shall enter into force twelve months after the date on which it has been accepted by two-thirds of the States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 除在生效前发表声明不接受该修正案的缔约国外,该修正案对所有缔约国均生效。
Translation: The amendment shall enter into force for all Contracting Parties except those which have made a declaration of non-acceptance before its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 根据一个缔约国的要求,并经至少三分之一缔约国的同意,秘书长将召开会议并且应邀请第七条所列的国家出席。
Translation: At the request of one Contracting Party and with the consent of at least one-third of the Contracting Parties, the Secretary-General shall convene a meeting and invite the States listed in Article VII to attend.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条修改附件的特定程序1.由一个缔约国提出对附件的任何修改,都应根据该缔约国的要求在“海协”进行审议。
Translation:
Article 10 Special Procedures for Amending the Annex  
1. Any amendment to the Annex proposed by a Contracting Party shall be considered by the "Organization" at the request of that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 2.所有缔约国均应被邀请出席“海协”海上安全委员会并参加投票,如经所有出席和投票的三分之二多数通过,且该多数又包括出席并投票的缔约国的三分之二多数,秘书长便应将该修正案通知所有的缔约国,供他们接受。
Translation: 2. All Contracting States shall be invited to attend and vote at the Maritime Safety Committee of IMCO. If adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting, provided such majority includes two-thirds of the Contracting States present and voting, the Secretary-General shall communicate the amendment to all Contracting States for their acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 3.该修正案应在海上安全委员会通过时确定其生效日期,除非在海上安全委员会确定的某一先期日期之前有五分之一或五个缔约国(取其二者中较小者)通知秘书长他们反对该修正案。
Translation: 3. The amendment shall enter into force on a date to be determined by the Maritime Safety Committee at the time of its adoption, unless prior to that date, one fifth or five of the Contracting Parties (whichever number is smaller) notify the Secretary-General of their objection to the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 本款中关于由海上安全委员会决定的上述这些日期,都应经出席并投票的三分之二多数通过,且该多数又应包括出席并投票的缔约国的三分之二多数。
Translation: The dates specified in this paragraph, as determined by the Maritime Safety Committee, shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting, provided that such majority includes two-thirds of the Contracting Parties present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 一个缔约国的反对不得约束其他缔约国对适用本公约的集装箱的接受。
Translation: An objection by one Contracting Party shall not bind other Contracting Parties regarding the acceptance of containers covered by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 5.秘书长应将按本公约提出的任何要求和通知以及修正案生效日期,通知所有缔约国和“海协”成员。
Translation: 5. The Secretary-General shall notify all Contracting States and members of IMCO of any requests and communications made under this Convention, as well as the date of entry into force of any amendments.

Query_Text_cn: 6.如附件的修正案业经海上安全委员会审议,但未获通过,任何缔约国均可要求召开会议,第七条中所列的国家应被邀请出席。
Translation: 6. If the amendment annexed has been considered by the Maritime Safety Committee but has not been adopted, any Contracting Party may request the convening of a conference to which the States referred to in Article 7 shall be invited.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长在接到至少有三分之一的其他缔约国同意上述要求的通知后应召开会议,审议该附件的修正案。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall convene a meeting to consider amendments to the annex upon receiving notification that at least one third of the other States Parties support the aforementioned request.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条退出1.任一缔约国经向秘书长交存文件后,可以退出本公约。
Translation:
Article 11 Withdrawal  
A State Party may withdraw from this Convention by depositing an instrument to that effect with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 退出本公约应自向秘书长交存该通知文件之日起一年后生效。
Translation: Withdrawal from this Convention shall take effect one year after the date of receipt by the Secretary-General of the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 2.凡已通知反对附件的修正案的缔约国均可退出本公约,这种退出应自该修正案生效之日起生效。
Translation: 2. Any Contracting State that has notified its objection to an amendment to the Annex may denounce this Convention, and such denunciation shall take effect from the date on which the amendment enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条终止在任何连续的十二个月期间内,如缔约国的数目少于五个时,本公约应失效。
Translation:
Article 12 Termination  
This Convention shall cease to be in force if the number of Contracting States falls below five during any continuous twelve-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条解决争端1.两个或两个以上的缔约国在对本公约的解释或实施方面的任何争端,如不能用谈判或其他的方法解决,经其中一个缔约国提出要求后,应提交由下述人员组成的仲裁庭。
Translation:
Article 13 Settlement of Disputes  
1. Any dispute between two or more Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention, if not resolved by negotiation or other means, shall be submitted to an arbitral tribunal composed as follows upon the request of one of the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 争端的每一方应指定一名仲裁人,然后双方仲裁人应指定一名做为主席的第三仲裁人。
Translation: Each party to the dispute shall appoint one arbitrator, and the two arbitrators thus appointed shall jointly designate a third arbitrator as the presiding arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在接到要求后三个月内,双方中的一方未能指定一名仲裁人,或双方仲裁人未能选出主席,任何一方可以要求秘书长指定一名仲裁人或仲裁庭的主席。
Translation: If, within three months after receipt of the request, either party fails to appoint an arbitrator or the two arbitrators fail to agree on the chairman, either party may request the Secretary-General to designate an arbitrator or the chairman of the arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 4.仲裁庭就其自身的程序、开会地点以及对向其提出的任何争议做出决定时,应以多数票通过。
Translation: 4. The arbitral tribunal shall make decisions on its own procedures, meeting locations, and any disputes submitted to it by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 5.在争端的双方之间如对裁决书的解释和执行发生任何争执,可以由任意一方向做出这一判决的仲裁庭提出,并要求给予裁决。
Translation: 5. In the event of any dispute between the parties regarding the interpretation or implementation of the arbitral award, either party may submit the matter to the arbitral tribunal that rendered the award and request a ruling.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条保留1.除对有关第一条至第六条,第十三条和本条以及附件的规定的保留以外,本公约应允许保留。但这些保留应以书面形式提出,如果是在交存批准、接受、核准或加入文件之前提出的,则应在该文件中予以证实。
Translation:
Article 14 Reservations  

1. Except for reservations concerning the provisions of Articles 1 to 6, Article 13, this Article, and the Annexes, the Convention shall permit reservations. However, such reservations must be made in writing and, if submitted prior to the deposit of the instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, shall be confirmed in that instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长应将此类保留通知给第七条中所述的所有国家。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall communicate such reservations to all States referred to in Article VII.

Query_Text_cn: 3.按第一款规定提出保留的任一缔约国,可随时通知秘书长撤销其保留。
Translation: 3. Any Contracting State which has made a reservation under paragraph 1 may at any time withdraw that reservation by notification to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: (5)按第十二条规定的本公约的终止。
Translation: (5) Termination of this Convention as provided in Article XII.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条有效的文本本公约原本应交存于秘书长，其中中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文文本都具有同等效力。
Translation:
Article 16  
The original of this Convention, of which the Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish texts are equally authentic, shall be deposited with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条安全合格牌照1.依照本附件附录的规定，安全合格牌照应永久地装置在每一获得批准的集装箱在靠近为官方使用而颁发的其他批准牌照旁的明显而又不易损坏的部位上。
Translation:
Article 1 Safety Approval Plate  
1. In accordance with the provisions of the appendix to this annex, a Safety Approval Plate shall be permanently affixed to every approved container at a readily visible place adjacent to any other approval plate issued for official purposes, where it would not be easily damaged.

Query_Text_cn: “CSC安全合格”批准国和批准证明书出厂日期（年，月）集装箱制造厂产品号，如为号码不详的现有集装箱，则由主管机关指定号码。最大营运总重量（公斤和磅）对1.8g①的允许堆码重量（公斤、磅）横向推拉试验负荷数值（公斤、磅）g是重力加速度的符号。
Translation:
"CSC Safety Approval" Approved Country and Date of Manufacture (Year, Month)  
Container Manufacturer Product Number, or if the number is unknown for existing containers, a number assigned by the competent authority.  
Maximum Operating Gross Weight (kg and lbs)  
Allowable Stacking Weight for 1.8g (kg, lbs)  
Racking Test Load Value (kg, lbs)  
Note: "g" denotes the symbol for gravitational acceleration.

Query_Text_cn: （2）在牌照上应留有空白处，以便依照本条第三款和附件二6、7二项试验的要求加上端壁和（或）侧壁强度值（系数）。
Translation: (2) Spaces shall be left blank on the license plate to allow for adding the end-wall and/or side-wall strength values (coefficients) as required by paragraph 3 of this Article and items 6 and 7 of Annex II for testing purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 在牌照上还应留有填写第一次以及以后的维修、检查日期（年、月）的空白处。
Translation: The license should also include blank spaces for recording the dates (year and month) of the first and subsequent maintenance inspections.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如主管机关认为新集装箱在安全方面已满足本公约的要求，并且，此类集装箱端壁和（或）侧壁强度数价（系数）设计为大于或小于附件二中规定的数值，则应将数值在安全合格牌照上注明。
Translation: 3. If the Administration is satisfied that a new container complies with the safety requirements of the present Convention in all respects, and where the end-wall and/or the side-wall strength factor(s) of the container are designed to be greater or less than those required by Annex II, such factor(s) shall be indicated on the Safety Approval Plate.

Query_Text_cn: 4.安全合格牌照的存在并不排除展示这样的标记或其它现行规定所要求的其他资料的必要性。
Translation: 4. The existence of a safety compliance license does not preclude the necessity of displaying such markings or other information required by current regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条维修1.箱主应负责维修集装箱，使其处于安全状态。
Translation:
Article 2 Maintenance  
1. The box owner shall be responsible for maintaining the container in a safe condition.

Query_Text_cn: 2.获得批准的集装箱的箱主，应依照有关缔约国批准或规定的程序，在适合营运条件的一定间隔期限，对集装箱进行检验或使之接受检验。
Translation: 2. The owner of an approved container shall, in accordance with procedures approved or prescribed by the relevant Contracting Party, conduct or have conducted inspections of the container at intervals appropriate to operating conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 安全合格牌照上应当标明，新集装箱应在某一日期（年、月）以前进行第一次检验的日期。
Translation: The safety approval plate shall indicate the date (year and month) before which the new container is to undergo its first inspection.

Query_Text_cn: 3.集装箱在某一日期（年、日）以前作重新检验的日期应在安全合格牌照上或可能靠近安全合格牌照处清晰地标明，并应以批准或规定有专门维修程序的缔约国所能接受的方式标明。
Translation: 3. The date for the next re-inspection of the container by a specified date (year, month) shall be clearly marked on or adjacent to the Safety Approval Plate and shall be indicated in a manner acceptable to the Contracting Party that approved or prescribed the specific maintenance program.

Query_Text_cn: 4.从出厂日期到第一次检验日期的间隔期不得超过五年。
Translation: 4. The interval between the date of manufacture and the date of the first inspection shall not exceed five years.

Query_Text_cn: 集装箱的相继检验和现有集装箱的重新检验的间隔期，不得超过24个月。
Translation: The interval between successive inspections of containers and the re-inspection of existing containers shall not exceed 24 months.

Query_Text_cn: 所有检验都应确定该集装箱是否具有可能危及人身安全的缺陷。
Translation: All inspections shall determine whether the container has any defects that may endanger personal safety.

Query_Text_cn: 5.本规则中有关缔约国是指在箱主定居或设有总部的领土上的缔约国而言。
Translation: 5. For the purposes of these Rules, the term "Contracting State" refers to the State in whose territory the container owner is domiciled or has its headquarters.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条新集装箱的批准根据本公约规定，为达到安全合格的目的，所有新集装箱都应符合附件二规定的要求。
Translation:
Article 3 Approval of New Containers  
For the purpose of safety approval, all new containers shall comply with the requirements set out in Annex II to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条定型设计的批准对于提出申请批准的集装箱，主管机关应审查其设计并亲自观察样箱的试验，以保证集装箱符合附件二规定的要求。
Translation:
Article 4 Approval of prototype designs  
For containers submitted for approval, the competent authority shall examine the design and witness the testing of a prototype to ensure that the container meets the requirements set forth in Annex II.

Query_Text_cn: 当主管机关认为满意后，应将该集装箱符合本公约的要求一事以书面形式通知申请人。并且，该书面通知应授权制造厂在定型设计系列的每个集装箱上装置安全合格牌照。
Translation: When the competent authority is satisfied, it shall notify the applicant in writing that the container meets the requirements of this Convention. Such written notification shall authorize the manufacturer to affix the safety approval plate to each container of the type-approved series.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条按定型设计批准的规定1.按定型设计系列制造的集装箱，在向主管机关提出批准申请时，应连同将获得认可的定型设计集装箱的设计说明书，图纸以及主管机关可能所需要的其他资料，一并送审。
Translation:
Article 5 Provisions for Approval by Design Type  
1. For containers manufactured according to a series of approved design types, the application for approval submitted to the competent authority shall be accompanied by the design specifications, drawings of the container design type to be approved, and any other documents the competent authority may require.

Query_Text_cn: 2.申请人应说明由制造厂对申请批准的定型设计集装箱规定产品号码。
Translation: 2. The applicant shall specify the product number assigned by the manufacturer to the approved type design container.

Query_Text_cn: （3）只在定型设计系列的每个集装箱上装置安全合格牌照，而不装置在其他集装箱上。
Translation: (3) Only affix safety approval plates to each container within the type-design series, and not to other containers.

Query_Text_cn: （4）保存一份按定型设计制造的集装箱的记录，该记录中至少应包括认可的制造厂产品号码、交付日期和货主的姓名及地址。
Translation: (4) Maintain a record of containers manufactured to the approved design, which shall at least include the manufacturer's identification number, date of delivery, and the name and address of the owner.

Query_Text_cn: 4.主管机关可以批准按认可了的定型设计的修改来生产集装箱，如果他认为这些修改在定型设计批准过程中不会影响实验的效果。
Translation: 4. The competent authority may approve the production of containers based on modifications to the approved prototype design, provided it deems that such modifications would not affect the test results during the prototype design approval process.

Query_Text_cn: 5.除非主管机关满意地认为制造厂已制定内部生产管理条例，保证其所制造的集装箱与获得批准的样箱相符，否则，主管机关不应在定型设计批准的基础上授权制造厂装置安全合格牌照。
Translation: 5. The competent authority shall not authorize the manufacturer to affix safety approval plates on the basis of type design approval unless it is satisfied that the manufacturer has established internal production control procedures to ensure that the containers produced conform to the approved prototype.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条生产过程中的检验为保证同一定型设计系列的集装箱按着获得批准的设计进行生产，主管机关应在该定型设计系列集装箱生产过程中的任一阶段，对其认为必要的部件进行检验和试验。
Translation:
Article 6 Inspection During Production  
To ensure that containers of an approved type are manufactured in conformity with the design approved, the Administration shall require such inspections and tests during production of any type series container as it deems necessary for any components.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条通知主管机关在按获得批准的定型设计制造的每一新系列集装箱开始生产以前，制造厂必须通知主管机关。
Translation:
Article 7 Notification to the Competent Authority  
Prior to commencing production of each new series of containers manufactured in accordance with an approved type design, the manufacturer must notify the Competent Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条单个集装箱的批准经过检验和当场试验，如主管机关满意，认为该集装箱符合本公约的要求时，对单个集装箱可予批准。
Translation:
Article 8 Approval of Individual Containers  
When the competent authority is satisfied, after inspection and on-the-spot testing, that an individual container complies with the requirements of this Convention, such container may be approved.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关满意时应将此项批准以书面形式通知申请人，该书面通知应授权申请人在集装箱上装置安全合格牌照。
Translation: The competent authority shall, when satisfied, notify the applicant in writing of such approval, which written notice shall authorize the applicant to affix the safety approval plate to the container.

Query_Text_cn: （4）①该类集装箱在海运和（或）内陆运输中安全营运至少两年以上的证明，或②使主管机关满意的证明，即集装箱系列按定型设计制造，而该项设计已经过试验，除有关端壁和侧壁强度试验的技术要求外，均已符合附件规定的技术条件，或③集装箱制造达到标准的证明。而这些标准，除端壁和侧壁的强度试验的技术要求外，被主管机关认为是相等于附件二规定的技术条件。
Translation: (4) (i) Proof that such container has been operated safely in maritime and/or inland transport for a period of at least two years, or (ii) Evidence satisfactory to the Administration that the container series is constructed to a prototype design which has been tested and found to comply with the technical conditions set forth in the Annex, except those relating to the end-wall and side-wall strength tests, or (iii) Evidence that the container was constructed to standards which, in the opinion of the Administration, were equivalent to the technical conditions set forth in the Annex, except those relating to the end-wall and side-wall strength tests.

Query_Text_cn: 如给予批准，在按本规则第二条对有关集装箱进行检验后，该书面通知应使箱主有权在该集装箱上装置安全合格牌照。
Translation: If approval is granted, the written notification shall authorize the owner to affix the safety approval plate to the container after it has been inspected in accordance with Article 2 of these Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对不能依照本规则第九条第一款规定申请批准的现有集装箱，可根据本附件第一或第三章规定提请批准。
Translation: 2. For existing containers that cannot be approved in accordance with the provisions of Article 9(1) of these Rules, approval may be sought under the provisions of Chapter I or III of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 附件二关于端壁和侧壁强度的要求，不适用于该类集装箱。
Translation: Annex II The requirements for end-wall and side-wall strength do not apply to this type of container.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关如对该类集装箱已被使用一事感到满意，可以放弃提交图纸和试验的要求，但仍需要进行必要的举吊和箱底强度试验。
Translation: The competent authority may waive the requirement for submission of drawings and testing if satisfied that such containers have been in use, provided that necessary lifting and floor strength tests are still conducted.

Query_Text_cn: 按下列格式制备的安全合格牌照应采用永久、耐腐、防火的长方形牌子，其尺寸不得小于200毫米×100毫米。
Translation: The safety compliance license prepared in the following format shall be made of a permanent, corrosion-resistant, and fireproof rectangular plate with dimensions no less than 200mm×100mm.

Query_Text_cn: “CSC安全合格”字母不得小于8毫米（高度）其他字体和号码不得小于5毫米（高度），并应在牌面上刻印成凸凹或用其他永久而清晰的方式标示出来。
Translation: The letters "CSC Safety Approval" shall be no less than 8 millimeters in height, while other characters and numbers shall be no less than 5 millimeters in height. They must be embossed or marked in a permanent and legible manner on the plate.

Query_Text_cn: 2.出厂日期（年、月）。
Translation: 2. Date of manufacture (year, month).

Query_Text_cn: 3.集装箱制造厂产品号码，或如现有集装箱的号码不详，则标上由主管机关指定的号码。
Translation: 3. The product number of the container manufacturing plant, or if the number of the existing container is unknown, the number designated by the competent authority shall be marked.

Query_Text_cn: 4.最大营运总重量（公斤和磅）。
Translation: 4. Maximum operating weight (kilograms and pounds).

Query_Text_cn: 5.对1.8g的允许堆码重量（公斤和磅）。
Translation: 5. Allowable stacking weight for 1.8g (in kilograms and pounds).

Query_Text_cn: 6.横向推拉试验负荷数值（公斤和磅）。
Translation: 6.Lateral push-pull test load values (kilograms and pounds).

Query_Text_cn: 7.只有在端壁的设计承担负荷小于或大于最大允许载货重量的0.4倍即0.4P时，侧壁强度才能在安全合格牌照上加以注明。
Translation: 7. The sidewall strength can only be indicated on the safety compliance plate when the design load-bearing capacity of the end walls is less than or greater than 0.4 times the maximum permissible payload, i.e., 0.4P.

Query_Text_cn: 8.只有在端壁的设计承担负荷小于或大于最大允许载货物重量的0.6倍即0.6P时，侧壁强度才能在安全合格牌照上加以注明。
Translation: 8. The sidewall strength may only be indicated on the safety compliance plate when the design load-bearing capacity of the end walls is less than or greater than 0.6 times the maximum permissible payload, i.e., 0.6P.

Query_Text_cn: 9.如牌照用来做维修检验时间证明时，须填写新集装箱第一次维修检验日期（年、月）。
Translation: 9. When the license is used as proof of maintenance inspection time, the date (year and month) of the first maintenance inspection of the new container must be filled in.

Query_Text_cn: 集装箱结构的安全要求和试验导言在提出本附件的要求时，在集装箱营运的各个方面，不言而喻，由于集装箱的移动、放置、堆码和载货集装箱的重量所产生的力以及外力，都不得超过集装箱的设计强度。
Translation: Safety Requirements and Testing for Container Structures Introduction In formulating the requirements of this annex, it is understood that in all aspects of container operation, the forces arising from the movement, positioning, stacking, and the weight of loaded containers, as well as external forces, shall not exceed the design strength of the container.

Query_Text_cn: （1）对集装箱须如此加以限制，使加之于它的力不超过其设计所能承担的力。
Translation: (1) Containers shall be so restricted as to ensure that the forces imposed on them do not exceed their design load capacity.

Query_Text_cn: （2）在集装箱内堆装货物时，应根据运输上推荐的办法操作，以便使货物对作用在集装箱上的力不超过其设计所能承担的力。
Translation: (2) When stowing cargo in containers, the recommended methods for transportation should be followed to ensure that the forces exerted on the container by the cargo do not exceed its designed load-bearing capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 制造1.凡以任何合适材料制成的集装箱，能满意地完成下列试验而未造成任何永久性变形或不正常状态，以致无法按设计要求使用的，都应视为是安全的。
Translation: Manufacture 1. Any container constructed of suitable materials that satisfactorily passes the following tests without sustaining any permanent deformation or abnormal condition rendering it incapable of being used as intended shall be deemed safe.

Query_Text_cn: 2.考虑到角配件的尺寸，位置和配合公差在举吊和系固系统中所起的作用，应对他们进行查核。
Translation: 2. Given the role of corner fittings in terms of dimensions, positioning, and fit tolerances within lifting and securing systems, they should be verified.

Query_Text_cn: 3.当集装箱备有仅供空箱使用的专门装置时，应将此项限制在集装箱上标明。
Translation: 3. When a container is equipped with special devices for empty use only, such restrictions shall be clearly marked on the container.

Query_Text_cn: 试验负荷和施加的力试验程序1举吊具有规定的内载负荷的集装箱，应在不施加显著加速力的状态下举吊。
Translation: Test Load and Applied Force Test Procedure 1: Lifting a container with the specified internal load shall be performed without applying significant acceleration forces.

Query_Text_cn: ①从顶角配件举吊：均布负荷，长度大于3，000毫米（10英尺）（公称）的集装使集装箱和箱应将举吊力垂直作用在四个顶角配件上。试验负荷的长度等于或小于3，000毫米（10英尺）（公称）总重等于的集装箱应将举吊力作用在四个顶角配件2R。上，使每根吊索与垂直方向之间的角度为30°。
Translation: ①Lifting from top corner fittings: For containers with uniformly distributed loads and a length exceeding 3,000 mm (10 ft) (nominal), the lifting forces shall be applied vertically at all four top corner fittings. For containers with a test load length equal to or less than 3,000 mm (10 ft) (nominal) and a total weight of 2R, the lifting forces shall be applied at all four top corner fittings such that each sling forms a 30° angle with the vertical.

Query_Text_cn: 按试验程序集装箱应在这种情况下施加举吊力，即使吊栏内规定的具仅作用在四个底角配件上。
Translation: According to the test procedure, the container shall be subjected to the lifting force under such conditions that the lifting devices specified in the lifting spreader act only on the four bottom corner fittings.

Query_Text_cn: 方式举吊施加的举吊力应于水平方向成如下角度：2R总重量。
Translation: The lifting force applied by the lifting method should form the following angle with the horizontal direction: 2R total weight.

Query_Text_cn: 均布负荷使集装箱应放在与它处在同一水平面的横条集装箱和试上，横条应置于每一个用来举吊重载集装箱验负荷的总的叉槽的中心。横条的宽度应于用来作业的重量等于货叉相同，横条并应伸入叉槽长度的75%1.25R。
Translation: The uniformly distributed load shall be applied to the container by means of a beam placed on the same horizontal plane as the test load for lifting loaded containers. The beam shall be positioned at the center of each fork arm slot used for the test. The width of the beam shall be equal to that of the fork intended for operation, and the beam shall extend into the fork arm slot to a length of 75% or 1.25R.

Query_Text_cn: 按试验程序集装箱应放在与它处于同一水平面的垫块规定的方式上，在每一夹钳臂位置底下放一垫块。
Translation: According to the test procedure, the container shall be placed on the blocks in the prescribed manner on the same level as the container, with one block positioned beneath each clamp arm location.

Query_Text_cn: 垫块举吊1.25R的尺寸应于用来作业的夹钳臂的举吊部位面积总重量。积相同。
Translation: The size of the lifting pad 1.25R should correspond to the total weight of the lifting area of the clamp arm used for operation. The volume remains the same.

Query_Text_cn: ③其他方法：均布负荷使如果所设计的集装箱不属于（1）或（2）①集装箱和试和②的任何方法在其重载的状况下举吊，也验负荷的总应进行代表这种适用方法的加速度状况的内重量等于载负荷和施加外力的试验。1.25R。施加的外力：按试验程序规定的方式举吊1.25R总重量。
Translation: ③ Other methods: Uniformly distributed load. If the container is not designed to be lifted under conditions (1) or (2)①, any method of testing the container under its loaded condition shall be conducted to represent the acceleration conditions applicable to that method, with the total test load equal to the cargo weight plus applied external forces equivalent to 1.25R.
