Query_Text_cn: (3)[保护的互不依赖性]任何缔约方均不得以未向其他国家或政府间机构提交保护同一品种的申请，或这种申请已被拒绝或保护期满为由，拒授品种权或限制其期限。
Translation: (3) [Independence of Protection] No Contracting Party shall deny or limit the grant of a breeder's right or restrict its duration on the grounds that no application for protection of the same variety has been filed with another country or intergovernmental organization, or that such an application has been refused or that protection has expired.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条优先权(1)[优先权及其期限]凡已正式向缔约方之一提交保护某一品种的申请("首次申请”)的育种家，出于为获得同一品种权而向其他缔约方提交申请("二次申请”)时，均享有为期12个月的优先权。
Translation: Article 11 Priority (1) [Priority and its period] Any breeder who has duly filed an application for the protection of a variety with one of the Contracting Parties ("first application") shall enjoy a priority period of 12 months for filing applications ("subsequent applications") with other Contracting Parties for the purpose of obtaining rights to the same variety.

Query_Text_cn: 这个期限从提交首次申请之日算起，二次申请的当日不计在内。
Translation: This period is calculated from the date of the initial application submission, with the day of the second application excluded.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[要求享受优先权]育种家为从优先权获益，在提交二次申请时有权要求享有首次申请后的优先权。
Translation: (2) [Claim for Priority] To benefit from priority, the breeder shall have the right to claim the priority of the first application when filing a second application.

Query_Text_cn: 受理二次申请的机构可以要求育种家在一定时间内(从提交二次申请之日起不少于3个月)提供有关文件和样品或其他证据，证明两次申请的真实文本，和同一品种。
Translation: The authority handling the second application may require the breeder to provide, within a specified period (not less than three months from the date of filing the second application), relevant documents, samples, or other evidence to substantiate the authenticity of both applications and the identity of the variety.

Query_Text_cn: (3)[文件和材料]允许育种家在优先权期满后两年之内，或在首次申请被拒或撤销后的一定时间内，向二次申请受理方提供依法需要的信息、文件或材料，以满足第十二条所指的审查要求。
Translation: (3) [Documents and Materials] Permit breeders to provide the information, documents, or materials required by law to the secondary application recipient within two years after the expiration of the priority period or within a specified period after the first application is rejected or withdrawn, so as to meet the examination requirements referred to in Article 12.

Query_Text_cn: (4)[本期限内发生的事件](1)款中所规定的期限内发生的事件，例如另提申请或首次申请主体品种的公开或利用，不能成为拒受二次申请的理由。
Translation: (4) [Events Occurring During This Period] Events occurring within the period specified in paragraph (1), such as the filing of another application or the disclosure or use of the subject variety of the initial application, shall not constitute grounds for rejecting a subsequent application.

Query_Text_cn: 这类事件也不应产生第三方之权利。
Translation: Such incidents shall not give rise to any rights of third parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条申请的审查决定授予品种权之前，应就其是否符合第五至九条规定进行审查。
Translation: Before granting the variety rights for an application under Article 12, a review shall be conducted to determine its compliance with the provisions of Articles 5 to 9.

Query_Text_cn: 审查过程中，受理方可自行种植该品种或进行其它必要试验，委托他人进行种植或其它必要试验，或考察业已完成的种植或其它试验的结果。
Translation: During the examination process, the receiving party may cultivate the variety or conduct other necessary tests on its own, commission others to carry out cultivation or other necessary tests, or review the results of already completed cultivation or other tests.

Query_Text_cn: 为进行审查，受理方可以要求育种家提供一切必要的信息、文件或材料。
Translation: For the purpose of examination, the receiving party may require the breeder to furnish all necessary information, documents, or materials.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条临时性保护各缔约方应采取措施，在提交或公开申报品种权的申请至正式批准之前的期限内，保护育种家的权益。
Translation:
Article 13 Provisional Protection  
Each Contracting Party shall take measures to protect the rights of breeders during the period between the filing or disclosure of an application for variety rights and the formal grant thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 这类措施应有如下效力，凡在此期间从事根据第十四条规定待申请批准后应由育种家本人授权的有关活动的当事人，至少应给予品种权持有人公平的报偿。
Translation: Such measures shall have the effect that any party engaging during this period in activities requiring the breeder's authorization under Article 14 shall at least be liable to pay the holder of the variety right equitable remuneration.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方可规定这类措施只适用于育种家已告知其申请的有关人员。
Translation: Contracting parties may stipulate that such measures shall apply only to persons whom the breeder has informed of the application.

Query_Text_cn: (i)生产或繁殖；(ii)为繁殖而进行的调整；(iii)提供销售；(iv)销售或其它交易；(v)出口；(vi)进口；(vii)出于上述(i)至(vi)的目的而提供存货。
(b)育种家可有权附加条件或限制。
Translation: (b) The breeder may have the right to impose conditions or restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[有关收获材料的活动]依照第15和16条，从事(1)款(a)中(i)至(vii)各项活动，涉及由未经授权使用受保护品种的繁殖材料获得的收获材料(包括整株和部分植株)时，应得到育种家授权，但育种家有正当机会能行使其权力的繁殖材料则例外。
Translation: (2) [Activities concerning harvested material] In accordance with Articles 15 and 16, engaging in any of the activities under (1)(a)(i) to (vii) involving harvested material (including entire plants and parts of plants) obtained through the unauthorized use of propagating material of the protected variety shall require the authorization of the breeder, unless the breeder has had reasonable opportunity to exercise his rights in relation to the said propagating material.

Query_Text_cn: (3)[与某些产品有关的活动]依照第15和16条，各缔约方可作出规定，从事(1)款(a)中(i)至(vii)各项活动，在涉及用(2)款中所指由未经授权使用的受保护品种的收获材料直接制作的产品时，应得到育种家授权，育种家能控制该收获材料的情况例外。
Translation: (3) [Activities related to certain products] In accordance with Articles 15 and 16, each Contracting Party may provide that the carrying out of the activities referred to in items (i) to (vii) of subparagraph (a) of paragraph (1) in respect of products made directly from harvested material of the protected variety referred to in paragraph (2) through unauthorized use shall require the authorization of the breeder, except where the breeder has had no reasonable opportunity to exercise his right in relation to the said harvested material.

Query_Text_cn: (4)[其它活动]依照第15和16条，各缔约方可作出规定，除(1)款(a)中(i)至(vii)各项外，从事其它活动也应得到育种家授权。
Translation: (4) [Other Activities] In accordance with Articles 15 and 16, Contracting Parties may provide that, in addition to the acts referred to in subparagraph (a)(i) to (vii) of paragraph (1), other activities shall also require the authorization of the breeder.

Query_Text_cn: (5)[派生品种和某些其它品种](a)上述(1)至(4)款规定也适用下列各项：(i)受保护品种的派生品种，但受保护品种本身不是派生品种；(ii)根据第七条规定，与受保护品种没有明显区别的品种；(viii)需要反复利用受保护品种进行繁育的品种。
Translation: (5) [Derived Varieties and Certain Other Varieties] (a) The provisions of paragraphs (1) to (4) above shall also apply to the following: (i) derived varieties of the protected variety, except where the protected variety itself is a derived variety; (ii) varieties which are not clearly distinguishable from the protected variety in accordance with Article 7; (viii) varieties whose production requires the repeated use of the protected variety.

Query_Text_cn: (b)满足下列条件时，一品种即为另一品种("原始品种”)的派生系，即(a)(i)中所指派生品种：(i)直接从原始品种选出或从该原始品种的派生品种中选出的品种，能够表达由原始品种基因型或基因型组合控制的基本种特性；(ii)与原始品种有明显区别；(iii)除派生型状有差异外，由原始品种基因型或基因型组合控制的基本种特性的表达与原始品种相同。
Translation: (b) A variety is considered a derivative of another variety ("the initial variety"), i.e., a derivative variety as referred to in (a)(i), when it fulfills the following conditions: (i) it is obtained directly from the initial variety or from a derivative variety of the initial variety, expressing the essential characteristics resulting from the genotype or combination of genotypes of the initial variety; (ii) it is clearly distinguishable from the initial variety; and (iii) except for differences resulting from the derivative characteristics, it conforms to the expression of the essential characteristics resulting from the genotype or combination of genotypes of the initial variety.

Query_Text_cn: (c)通过选择天然或诱变株、体细胞无性变异味，从原始品种中选变异单株、回交或经遗传工程转化等途径获得派生品种。
Translation: (c) Derived varieties are obtained through the selection of natural or mutant strains, somaclonal variation, selection of variant individuals from the original variety, backcrossing, or genetic engineering transformation.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条品种权的例外(1)[强制性例外]品种权不适用于下列各项：(i)私人的非商业性活动；(ii)试验性活动；(iii)培育其他新品种活动，依照第14条(5)款实施的除外，第14条(1)至(4)款所指与该新品种有关的活动。
(2)[非强制性例外]尽管有第14条款规定，但各缔约方仍可在不影响育种家合法权益的情况下，在适当的范围内，对任何品种的品种权予以限制，允许农民用自种自收形式，繁殖受保护品种或第14条(5)款(a)，(i)或(ii)所指品种，以供自用。
Translation: (2) [Optional Exception] Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 14, each Contracting Party may, within reasonable limits and without prejudice to the legitimate interests of the breeder, restrict the breeder's right in relation to any variety in order to permit farmers to use for propagating purposes, on their own holdings, the product of the harvest which they have obtained by planting, on their own holdings, the protected variety or a variety covered by Article 14(5)(a)(i) or (ii).

Query_Text_cn: 第16条品种权的终止(1)[权利终止]受保护品种的材料或第14条(5)款所指品种的材料，或任何从该材料衍生的材料，已由育种家本人或经其同意在有关缔约方领土内出售之后，不受品种权制约，除非这类活动：(i)涉及该品种的进一步繁殖，或(ii)涉及品种材料出口，使其繁殖，而进口国并不保护该品种所在的植物属或种。出口材料用于最终消费的情况例外。
Translation:
Article 16 Termination of the Breeder's Right  
(1) [Termination of Right] The material of the protected variety or the material of the variety referred to in Article 14(5), or any material derived therefrom, shall no longer be subject to the breeder's right after it has been sold or otherwise marketed by the breeder or with his consent in the territory of the Contracting Party concerned, unless such acts:  
(i) involve further propagation of the variety, or  
(ii) involve an export of material of the variety enabling the propagation of the variety, where the imported country does not protect varieties of the plant genus or species to which the variety belongs. This provision shall not apply to the export of material for final consumption purposes.

Query_Text_cn: (2)["材料”的含义]以(1)款的宗旨的品种"材料”的含义如下：(i)任何种类的繁殖材料；(ii)收获材料，包括整株和部分植株；(iii)直接由收获材料制成的产品。
Translation: (2) [Definition of "Material"] For the purpose of paragraph (1), the term "Material" shall mean: (i) propagating material of any kind; (ii) harvested material, including whole plants and parts of plants; (iii) products made directly from harvested material.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条行使品种权的限制条件(1)[公共利益]除公共利益及本公约明文规定外，任何缔约方不得以其它理由限制自由行使品种权。
Translation:
Article 17 Restrictions on the Exercise of Breeders' Rights  
(1) [Public Interest] Except for reasons of public interest and as expressly provided for in this Convention, no Contracting Party may restrict the free exercise of breeders' rights on any other grounds.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[公平报偿]如果这类限制具有授权第三方从事需经育种家认可的活动的效力，有关缔约方应采取一切必需措施，确保育种家得到公平报偿。
Translation: (2) [Equitable Remuneration] Where such restrictions have the effect of authorizing third parties to perform acts requiring the breeder's consent, the Contracting Party concerned shall take all measures necessary to ensure that the breeder receives equitable remuneration.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条管理商业性活动的措施任何缔约方在其领土内实行的管理品种材料的生产、检验和销售或进出口活动的措施，不应对品种权构成干扰。
Translation:
Article 18 Measures Regulating Commercial Activities  
Any measures implemented by a Contracting Party within its territory to regulate the production, inspection, marketing, or import and export of protected variety materials shall not interfere with the rights conferred by the breeder's right.

Query_Text_cn: 任何情况下这类措施均不应妨碍本公约条款的实施。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall such measures impede the implementation of the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第19条品种权期限（1）[保护期限]品种权有一定期限。
Translation: Article 19 Duration of Variety Rights (1) [Term of Protection] Variety rights shall be granted for a limited duration.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[最短期限]自批准之日起不少于20年，对于树木和藤本植物，这个期限不少于25年。
Translation: (2) [Minimum Duration] Not less than 20 years from the date of approval, and for trees and vines, this period shall not be less than 25 years.

Query_Text_cn: 名称的使用]（a）品种名称应按属命名。
Translation: [Use of Names] (a) Variety denominations shall be assigned in accordance with the genus.

Query_Text_cn: （b）除（4）款另有规定外，各缔约方应确保注册的品种名称，用于该品种时不受干扰，即使是在该品种权期满之后。
Translation: (b) Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (4), each Contracting Party shall ensure that the registered denomination of a variety is not interfered with when used in connection with that variety, even after the expiration of the breeder's right.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[名称特性]名称应具有验明品种的能力。
Translation: (2) [Naming Characteristics] The name should have the ability to identify the variety.

Query_Text_cn: 名称不应仅用数字表示，已成为惯例的情况除外。
Translation: Names should not consist solely of numerals, except where established by convention.

Query_Text_cn: 要力戒名称引起误解，或在品种特性、价值或种别或育种家身分方面造成混淆。
Translation: Efforts should be made to avoid names that are misleading or likely to cause confusion concerning the characteristics, value, or identity of the variety or the breeder.

Query_Text_cn: 尤其是名称必须异于各缔约方领土内相同物种或亲缘种现存品种的名称。
Translation: In particular, the name must be distinct from those of existing varieties of the same species or related species within the territories of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[名称注册]育种家须将品种名称提交注册机构，如提交的名称不符合（2）款规定，注册机构有权拒受并要求育种家在规定时限内提出一个新名。
Translation: (3) [Name Registration] Breeders must submit the variety name to the registration authority. If the submitted name does not comply with the provisions of paragraph (2), the registration authority has the right to reject it and require the breeder to propose a new name within a specified time limit.

Query_Text_cn: 品种名称的注册起始日期与品种权的批准日期相同。
Translation: The registration commencement date of the variety name is the same as the approval date of the variety right.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[第三方居先权]第三方居先权受保护。
Translation: (4) [Third-Party Preemptive Rights] Third-party preemptive rights are protected.

Query_Text_cn: 符合（7）款规定的一方，因居先权而被禁止使用一个品种的名称，但又有义务必须使用时，注册机构将要求育种家为其品种取一个新的名称。
Translation: A party that meets the provisions of paragraph (7) but is prohibited from using a variety name due to prior rights, yet is obligated to use it, shall be required by the registration authority to assign a new name to the variety by the breeder.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[名称相同要求]向所有缔约方提交的同一品种的名称必须相同。
Translation: (5) [Uniform Naming Requirement] The same variety name must be submitted uniformly to all Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 除在其领土不适用者外，各缔约方将按提交的名称注册。
Translation: Except where inapplicable in their territories, each Contracting Party shall register the names as submitted.

Query_Text_cn: 出现不适用情况时，有关缔约方将要求育种家另外提交新名称。
Translation: In cases where the name is not suitable, the relevant contracting party shall require the breeder to submit an alternative new name.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[缔约方当局之间的信息交流]缔约一方当局应保证向所有其他缔约方当局通报有关品种命名，尤其是命名的提交、注册和取消等有关事宜。
Translation: (6) [Exchange of Information Between Authorities of the Contracting Parties] Each authority of a Contracting Party shall ensure the communication to the authorities of all other Contracting Parties of information concerning the denomination of varieties, in particular regarding the submission, registration, and cancellation of such denominations.

Query_Text_cn: 收到通报的任何一方，可用信函把对注册名称的意见告知对方。
Translation: Any party receiving the notification may communicate its views on the registered name to the other party by letter.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[使用品种名称的义务]凡在一个缔约方境内从事销售受保护品种的繁育材料者，均有义务使用该品种名称，即使是在该品种保护期满之后也应如此。符合（4）款规定，受居先权限制者例外。
Translation: (7) [Obligation to Use the Denomination of the Variety] Any person engaged in the sale of propagating material of a protected variety within the territory of a Contracting Party shall be obligated to use the denomination of that variety, even after the expiration of the protection period for the variety. This obligation shall not apply where prior rights prevent such use in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (4).

Query_Text_cn: （8）[品种名称标识]品种在销售时，除使用注册名称外，允许带有商标、商品名或其它类似标识，但品种名称必须易于识别。
Translation: (8) [Variety Name Identification] When a variety is sold, in addition to its registered name, it may bear a trademark, trade name, or other similar identifier, provided the variety name remains clearly distinguishable.

Query_Text_cn: 第21条品种权的无效(1)[无效的原因]遇有下列情况，缔约方将宣布其授予的品种权无效。(i)批准时不符合第6或7条规定；(ii)主要根据育种家本人提供的信息和有关文件进行审批，但在批准时不符合第8或9条规定，或(iii)把品种权错授他人，但移交给被授予的有资格者除外。
Translation:
Article 21 Nullity of the Breeder's Right  
(1) [Grounds for Nullity] Each Contracting Party shall declare null and void a breeder's right granted by it if:  
(i) it was established that the conditions laid down in Article 6 or 7 were not complied with at the time of the grant of the right;  
(ii) it was established that the right was granted on the basis of incorrect information supplied by the breeder, where the conditions laid down in Article 8 or 9 were not complied with at the time of the grant of the right; or  
(iii) the right was granted to a person who is not entitled to it, unless it is transferred to the person who is so entitled.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[排除其它原因](除)(1)款所述理由外，不得以其它理由宣布品种权无效。
Translation: (2) [Exclusion of Other Grounds] No variety right shall be declared invalid on any grounds other than those specified in paragraph (1).

Query_Text_cn: 第22条品种权的取消（1）[取消的理由]（a）不再符合第8或9条规定时，各缔约方可取消其授予的品种权。
Translation:
Article 22 Nullity of the Breeder's Right  
(1) [Reasons for Nullity]  
(a) Each Contracting Party may declare null and void the breeder's right it has granted if it is established that the conditions laid down in Article 8 or 9 are no longer fulfilled.

Query_Text_cn: （b）此外，在规定期限内发生下列情况，缔约方可取消其授予的品种权。（i）育种家未能提供用以证明保存该品种的必要资料、文件或材料；（ii）育种家未能交付使其品种权维持有效的必要费用，或（iii）授予品种权之后，品种名称被取消，而育种家未能提交合适的新名称。
Translation: (b) Additionally, within the specified period, the Contracting Party may revoke the breeder's right granted under the following circumstances: (i) the breeder fails to provide the necessary information, documents, or materials to verify the maintenance of the variety; (ii) the breeder fails to pay the required fees to keep the breeder's right in force; or (iii) after the grant of the breeder's right, the denomination of the variety is canceled, and the breeder fails to propose a suitable new denomination.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[排除其它理由]除（1）款所述理由外，不得以其它理由取消品种权。
Translation: (2) [Exclusion of Other Grounds] Except for the reasons specified in paragraph (1), the variety rights shall not be canceled on any other grounds.

Query_Text_cn: 第23条成员所有缔约方均为本联盟成员。
Translation: Article 23: All contracting parties that are members shall be members of this Union.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条法律地位和办公地点(1)[法人资格]本联盟具法人资格。
Translation:
Article 24 Legal Status and Office Location  
(1) [Legal Personality] The Union shall possess legal personality.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[法律行为能力]在不违背各方法律的前提下，本联盟在各缔约方境内享有实现本会目标和发挥自身作用的法律行为能力。
Translation: (2) [Legal Capacity] Without prejudice to the laws of each Party, the Alliance shall possess the legal capacity necessary to achieve its objectives and perform its functions within the territories of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: (3)[地点]本联盟及常设机构设在日内瓦。
Translation: (3)[Location] The Union and its permanent bodies shall have their seat in Geneva.

Query_Text_cn: (4)[总部协定]本联盟与瑞士联邦签有总部协定。
Translation: (4) [Headquarters Agreement] The Union has concluded a Headquarters Agreement with the Swiss Confederation.

Query_Text_cn: 第25条机构本协会的常设机构为理事会和联盟办公室。
Translation:
Article 25 Institutions  
The standing bodies of this Association shall be the Council and the Alliance Office.

Query_Text_cn: 第26条理事会（1）[组成]理事会由会员代表组成，每个联盟会员指派一名代表和一名候补代表参加理事会。
Translation: Article 26 The Council (1) [Composition] The Council shall be composed of representatives of the members,with each alliance member appointing one representative and one alternate to serve on the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 代表或候补代表可携助手或顾问。
Translation: Representatives or alternate representatives may be accompanied by assistants or advisers.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[官员]理事会设一名理事长和一名第一副理事长，还可设若干名副理事长。
Translation: (2) [Officials] The Council shall have one Chairperson and one First Vice-Chairperson, and may also have several Vice-Chairpersons.

Query_Text_cn: 理事长因故不能主持工作时，其职责由第一副理事长接替。
Translation: When the Chairperson is unable to perform their duties for any reason, the First Vice-Chairperson shall assume the responsibilities.

Query_Text_cn: 理事长任期三年。
Translation: The term of office for the chairman is three years.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[理事会议]理事会议由理事长召集，例行会议每年一次。
Translation: (3) [Council Meetings] Council meetings shall be convened by the Chairperson, with regular sessions held annually.

Query_Text_cn: 三个月内有三分之一会员提出要求，理事长将召开理事会议。
Translation: If one-third of the members submit requests within three months, the chairman shall convene a board meeting.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[观察员]非本联盟成员国可以观察员每份应邀参加理事会议，其他观察员和有关专家也可应邀参加这类会议。
Translation: (4) [Observer] Non-member states of the Union may be invited to attend Council meetings as observers, and other observers and relevant experts may also be invited to participate in such meetings.

Query_Text_cn: （x）作出有关决议，确保本联盟充分发挥作用。
Translation: (x) Adopt relevant resolutions to ensure the full functioning of this alliance.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[表决权]（a）本联盟每一成员为主权国，在理事会中各有一票表决权。
Translation: (6) [Voting Rights] (a) Each member of this Alliance, being a sovereign state, shall have one vote in the Council.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如果缔约方是一个政府间组织，在讨论与其有关的事项时，该缔约方可代作为其成员的本联盟成员国行使表决权。
Translation: (b) If a Contracting Party is an intergovernmental organization, it may exercise the right to vote on behalf of its member States of the Union in matters concerning it.

Query_Text_cn: 当这类组织的成员国自行行使其表决权时，这类组织将不再行使其成员国的表决权，反之亦然。
Translation: When the member states of such organizations exercise their voting rights independently, these organizations shall no longer exercise the voting rights of their member states, and vice versa.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[多数]理事会决议一般只需简单多数票通过即为有效，涉及本条（5）款（ii），（vi）和（vii）以及第28条（3）款，29条（5）款（b）和（38）条（1）款的理事会决议，需经四分之三票数通过方为有效。
Translation: (7) [Majority] Council resolutions shall generally be deemed valid if adopted by a simple majority vote. However, resolutions concerning subparagraphs (ii), (vi), and (vii) of paragraph (5) of this Article, as well as Article 28(3), Article 29(5)(b), and Article 38(1), shall require a three-fourths majority vote to be valid.

Query_Text_cn: 缺席者不占票数席位。
Translation: Absentees do not count toward the quorum.

Query_Text_cn: 第27条办公室（1）[办公室的任务和方向]联盟办公室应执行理事会委托的全部责任和任务，并在秘书长的指导下进行工作。
Translation:
Article 27 Office  
(1) [Tasks and Orientation of the Office]  
The Union Office shall carry out all responsibilities and tasks entrusted by the Council and shall operate under the guidance of the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 他负有执行理事会决定的责任。
Translation: He is responsible for implementing the decisions of the Executive Council.

Query_Text_cn: 他把联盟预算提交理事会审批，并负责执行。
Translation: He submitted the alliance budget to the council for approval and was responsible for its implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 他向理事会汇报联盟的行政管理、开展的活动及财务状况。
Translation: He reported to the council on the alliance's administration, activities conducted, and financial status.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[职员]根据第26条（5）（iii）中的条款，为了有效地完成联盟办公室任务，所需任命和雇用的职员，其条件应符合行政管理和财务制度的规定。
Translation: (3) [Staff] In accordance with the provisions of Article 26(5)(iii), the appointment and employment of staff necessary for the effective performance of the functions of the Alliance Office shall be subject to the conditions laid down in the administrative and financial regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第28条语言（1）[办公室使用语言]联盟办公室将用英语、法语、德语和西班牙语履行其职责。
Translation: Article 28 Language (1) [Office Working Languages] The Union offices shall perform their functions in English, French, German and Spanish.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[某些会议中使用的语言]理事会和修定会开会时间用上述四种语言。
Translation: (2) [Language used in certain meetings] The Council and the Revision Committee shall conduct their meetings in the aforementioned four languages.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[增添使用的语言]理事会可以决定增用语种。
Translation: (3) [Additional languages used] The Council may decide to add languages for use.

Query_Text_cn: 第29条财务（1）[收入]联盟开支将来自以下几项：（i）每年各联盟成员国的捐助；（ii）服务所收报酬；（iii）各项杂收。
Translation: Article 29 Finance (1) [Revenue] The expenditures of the Alliance shall be covered by the following sources: (i) annual contributions from each member state of the Alliance; (ii) remuneration received for services; and (iii) miscellaneous income.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[捐助单位]（a）每个联盟成员国在每年捐资总额中所分摊的份额将由从联盟成员国捐资中花费的总额和适合于（3）节中情况的捐助单位数目来决定。
Translation: (2) [Contributing Units] (a) The share of each Union member state in the total annual contributions shall be determined by the total amount expended from the contributions of Union member states and the number of contributing units applicable under the circumstances set forth in paragraph (3).

Query_Text_cn: 份额将按（4）节计算。
Translation: The share shall be calculated in accordance with section (4).

Query_Text_cn: 每一成员所分摊的份额]（a）任何1961/1972年法规或1978年法规缔约方的联盟成员国，自受本公约约束之日起，其捐助的单位数即与其上述日期以前的数相同。
Translation: The share contributed by each member] (a) For any member of the Union which is a party to the 1961/1972 Acts or the 1978 Act, the number of units of contribution shall, from the date on which it is bound by this Convention, be the same as the number applicable to it before that date.

Query_Text_cn: （b）任何其它联盟成员国在加入联盟时应向秘书长说明适合于它的捐资单位数。
Translation: (b) Any other member state of the Union shall, upon joining the Union, notify the Secretary-General of the number of contribution units appropriate for it.

Query_Text_cn: （c）任何联盟成员国任何时候都可向秘书长声明与（a）或者（b）节数目不同的捐资单位。
Translation: (c) Any member state of the Union may at any time declare to the Secretary-General a number of contribution units different from those specified in paragraph (a) or (b).

Query_Text_cn: 如果是在公历年的前6个月做的声明，该声明将从该公历年年初生效，否则将推迟到下一公历年的年初生效。
Translation: If the declaration is made within the first six months of a calendar year, it shall take effect from the beginning of that calendar year; otherwise, it shall be deferred to the beginning of the next calendar year.

Query_Text_cn: 份额的计算]（a）在每一预算期间，按以上期各联盟成员国捐资中花费的总和除以这些联盟成员国应捐资单位数目的总和而得到每一捐助单位相应承担的份额。
Translation: [Calculation of Shares] (a) For each budgetary period, the share corresponding to each contributory unit shall be determined by dividing the total amount expended from the contributions of all Union member states in the preceding period by the aggregate number of contributory units assigned to these member states.

Query_Text_cn: （b）每个联盟成员国捐助的数额应为每一捐助单位承担的份额乘以那个联盟成员国应捐资单位数。
Translation: (b) The contribution of each country of the Union shall be an amount equal to the share per unit multiplied by the number of units attributed to that country.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[拖欠捐资][a]如果拖欠捐款的任何联盟成员国，所欠款数等于或超过了前一整年应捐助的数额，该成员国不能享有在理事会中的投票决定权，（b）节情况除外。
Translation: (5) [Arrears in Contributions] (a) If any Member State of the Alliance is in arrears in the payment of its contributions to an extent that equals or exceeds the amount due for the preceding full year, it shall have no vote in the Council, except as provided in paragraph (b).

Query_Text_cn: 停止投票决定权并不等于免除了这个联盟成员国对该公约承担的责任，也不等于剥夺其它任何权力。
Translation: The suspension of voting rights does not relieve the member state of its obligations under the Convention, nor does it deprive it of any other rights.

Query_Text_cn: （b）欠资的联盟成员国只要向理事会证实拖欠的款项是由于额外的和不可避免的原因，理事会可允许该成员国继续行使其投票表决权。
Translation: (b) The Council may permit a member state in arrears to continue exercising its voting rights, provided that the member state demonstrates to the Council that the outstanding payments are due to exceptional and unavoidable circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[审计帐目]审计帐目应按行政和财务规定由某个联盟成员国进行，该联盟成员国应由理事会指派，并得到该成员国的同意。
Translation: (6) [Audit of Accounts] The audit of accounts shall be conducted in accordance with administrative and financial regulations by a member state of the Union designated by the Council and with the consent of that member state.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[政府间机构的捐助]任何政府间组织缔约方，可不履行捐资的义务。
Translation: (7) [Contributions from intergovernmental institutions] Any Party that is a government organization shall not be obligated to make financial contributions.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果其愿意捐资，将按1至4节中的条款实施。
Translation: However, if they are willing to make a donation, the provisions in Sections 1 to 4 shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （iii）保证通过定期出版物将以下有关的信息告知公众：——申请和授予育种家的权益，以及——名称的提议与核准。
Translation:
(iii) Ensure that the public is informed through regular publications of the following relevant information:  
— Applications for and grants of breeders' rights, and  
— Proposals and approvals of denominations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[依照法律]每个国家或政府间机构，在按实际情况交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，必须依照自己的法律，站在使本公约的条款生效的位置上，这点务必给予充分理解。
Translation: (2) [In accordance with the law] It must be fully understood that each State or intergovernmental organization, when depositing its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession in accordance with the actual circumstances, shall do so in conformity with its own laws and in a position to give effect to the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第31条本公约缔约国与受早期条例约束的缔约方之间的关系（1）[受本公约约束的国家之间的关系]受本公约和任何早期条例约束的联盟成员国之间，唯有本公约适用。
Translation:
Article 31 Relations Between Contracting Parties to This Convention and Parties Bound by Earlier Acts  

(1) [Relations Between States Bound by This Convention] This Convention alone shall apply in relations between countries of the Union bound both by this Convention and by any earlier Acts.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[与不受本公约约束国家的可能关系]任何不受本公约约束的联盟成员国，可以通知秘书长，表明它与只受本公约约束的每个联盟成员国之间的关系，按其受约束的最新条例处理。
Translation: (2) [Possible Relations with States Not Bound by This Convention] Any member country of the Union not bound by this Convention may notify the Director General that it will apply, in its relations with each member country of the Union bound only by this Convention, the provisions of the most recent Act by which it is bound.

Query_Text_cn: 从该通知书的日期满一个月起，和直到发通知书的该成员国受本公约约束之日止，上述成员国按其受约束的最新条例建立它与只受本公约约束的每个联盟成员国之间的关系，而对前者来说，后者仍按本公约。
Translation: From the date one month after the issuance of the notification and until the date on which the notifying Member State becomes bound by this Convention, the said Member State shall establish its relations with each Member State of the Union bound solely by this Convention in accordance with the latest provisions by which it is bound, while for the latter, the former shall remain governed by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第32条特殊协定联盟各成员国有保留在它们之间缔结品种保护特殊协定的权力，但这种协定与本公约条款不相冲突。
Translation:
Article 32 Special Agreements  
Member States of the Union reserve the right to conclude among themselves special agreements for the protection of varieties, provided such agreements do not conflict with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第33条签字本公约进行公开签字，任何国家从它签字之日起，就成为一个联盟成员。
Translation: The Convention of Article 33 shall be open for signature, and any state shall become a member of the alliance from the date of its signature.

Query_Text_cn: 签字日期持续到1992年3月31日。
Translation: The signing period continues until March 31, 1992.

Query_Text_cn: 加入（1）[国家和一些政府间的机构]（a）任何国家，正如本条款规定，可以成为本公约的缔约方。
Translation: Accession (1) [States and certain intergovernmental organizations] (a) Any State may become a Party to this Convention as provided in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （b）任何政府间的机构，只要按本条款规定，又具备下列条件，可以成为本公约的缔约方：（i）具有按本公约处理问题的能力；（ii）在授予和保护育种家权益方面有自己的法规约束其成员国，以及（iii）依照自己内部的程序，有加入本公约的充分权威。
Translation: (b) Any intergovernmental organization may become a Contracting Party to this Convention, provided that it meets the following conditions in accordance with the provisions of this Article: (i) it has competence in respect of matters governed by this Convention; (ii) it has its own legislation binding its member states on the grant and protection of breeders' rights; and (iii) it has the full authority, in accordance with its internal procedures, to accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[同意加入书]在本公约上签字的国家，在交存本公约的批准书、接受书或核准书之后将成为本公约的缔约方。
Translation: (2) [Instrument of Accession] Any State that has signed this Convention shall become a Contracting Party by depositing its instrument of ratification, acceptance or approval of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 尚未在本公约上签字的国家和政府间机构通过交存本公约的接受书而成为本公约的一方。
Translation: States and intergovernmental organizations that have not signed this Convention may become parties to it by depositing an instrument of acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书、接受方、核准书或接受书应交存秘书长。
Translation: The instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[理事会的意见]尚未成为本联盟成员的国家和政府间机构，在交存接受书之前，应就其法律与该公约的条款是否一致，征询理事会的意见。
Translation: (3) [Opinion of the Council] States and intergovernmental organizations that are not yet members of the Union shall, before depositing their instruments of acceptance, seek the opinion of the Council on the conformity of their laws with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果其结果是正面意见，可以交存加入书。
Translation: If the outcome is positive, the instrument of accession may be deposited.

Query_Text_cn: 第35条保留权（1）[原则]不允许对本公约有保留权，根据（2）节者除外。
Translation:
Article 35 Reservations  
(1) [Principle] No reservations to this Convention shall be permitted, except as provided in paragraph (2).

Query_Text_cn: （2）[可能的例外]（a）尽管有第3条（1）的条款，在成为本公约的缔约方时，已是1978年条例缔约方，以及通过工业产权而不是育种家权益将无性繁育的品种加以保护的国家，将有权继续其原有保护而无需采用本公约对这些品种的保护。
Translation: (2) [Possible Exceptions] (a) Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3(1), any country which, at the time of becoming a Party to this Convention, is a party to the 1978 Act and which protects varieties reproduced asexually by industrial property rights rather than breeders' rights shall have the right to continue such protection without applying the provisions of this Convention to those varieties.

Query_Text_cn: （b）在具有运用上述权利的国家，在交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，应通知秘书长。
Translation: (b) In countries where the exercise of the above rights is applicable, the Secretary-General shall be notified at the time of depositing the instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 该国在任何时候都可以撤销上述通知。
Translation: The country may revoke the aforementioned notice at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 需出版的资料（1）[最初的通知]当按实际情况交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，任何国家或政府间机构应通知秘书长：（i）保障育种家权益的法规；以及（ii）受保护目录表上的植物属和种，自受本公约约束之日起将按本公约的条款进行保护。
Translation: Documents required for publication (1) [Initial notification] At the time of depositing its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, as the case may be, any State or intergovernmental organization shall notify the Secretary-General of: (i) the legislation ensuring the protection of breeders' rights; and (ii) the list of plant genera and species protected by such legislation, which shall be protected under the terms of this Convention from the date on which it becomes bound by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[改变的通告]每一缔约方应立即向秘书长通告：（i）保障育种家权益法规的任何变更情况；以及（ii）将适用本公约的范围扩大至另外一些植物属和种。
Translation: (2) [Notification of Changes] Each Contracting Party shall promptly notify the Secretary-General of: (i) any changes in its laws and regulations concerning the protection of breeders' rights; and (ii) the extension of the application of this Convention to additional genera and species.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[信息出版]秘书长将根据来自每一缔约方的信息，出版下列信息资料：（i）保障育种家权益的法规及其改变情况，和（ii）在（1）节（ii）中提及的植物属和种目录表和在（2）节（ii）中提及的扩大应用范围。
Translation: (3) [Information Publication] The Secretary shall publish, based on information received from each Contracting Party, the following materials: (i) laws and regulations for the protection of breeders' rights and any amendments thereto, and (ii) the list of plant genera and species referred to in paragraph (1)(ii) and the extended applications mentioned in paragraph (2)(ii).

Query_Text_cn: 早期条例的终止（1）[开始生效]本公约在有五个国家存交批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书后一个月即开始生效，但至少要有三个所说的文件是由1961/1972年条例或1978年条例缔约国存交的。
Translation: Termination of Earlier Regulations (1) [Entry into Force] This Convention shall enter into force one month after five States have deposited their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, provided that at least three of the said instruments are deposited by States parties to the 1961/1972 Regulations or the 1978 Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[继后生效]（1）节中未包括的任何国家或政府间机构，在它按实际情况交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日一个月后，即将受本公约的约束。
Translation: (2) [Subsequent Entry into Force] Any State or intergovernmental organization not covered under paragraph (1) shall become bound by this Convention one month after the date on which it deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, as the case may be.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[1978年条例的终止]根据（1）节在本公约生效后，就不再按1978年的条例交存加入书，除了按联合国大会的惯例作为发展中国家者，至1995年12月31日前还可交存此类文件，其它国家可至1993年12月31日，即使本公约在该日期之前已生效，仍可交存此类文件。
Translation: (3) [Termination of the 1978 Regulations] Following subsection (1), no instruments of accession shall be deposited under the 1978 Regulations after the entry into force of this Convention, except that developing countries, as classified by the practice of the United Nations General Assembly, may deposit such instruments until 31 December 1995, and other States may do so until 31 December 1993, even if this Convention has entered into force prior to those dates.

Query_Text_cn: 第38条本公约的修正（1）[大会]本公约可由联盟成员国大会修正。
Translation:
Article 38 Amendments to the Convention  
(1) [Assembly] This Convention may be amended by the Assembly of the member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 召集这样的会议由理事会决定。
Translation: The convening of such meetings is determined by the council.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[法定数与多数]只有在至少有半数成员国出席的情况下，大会议程才有效。
Translation: (2) [Quorum and Majority] The agenda of the General Assembly shall be valid only if at least half of the member states are present.

Query_Text_cn: 对所作的任何修改，要有3/4的多数联盟成员国出席并投票的情况下才能作出决定。
Translation: Any amendments made shall require a decision by a three-fourths majority of the Alliance member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 第39条退约（1）[通告]任何缔约方都可通告秘书长退出本公约。
Translation:
Article 39 Withdrawal  
(1) [Notification] Any Contracting Party may withdraw from this Convention by notification addressed to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长将立即把收到的通告告知联盟的各个成员。
Translation: The Secretary-General will promptly notify all members of the alliance upon receipt of the notification.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[早期条约]退出本公约的通告被认为也是构成退出该缔约方受约束的任何早期条约的通告。
Translation: (2) [Earlier Treaties] A notification of withdrawal from the present Convention shall be deemed to constitute also a notification of withdrawal from any earlier treaty by which the withdrawing Party is bound.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[有效日期]秘书长收到通告当年的下一公历年度末退约即生效。
Translation: (3) [Effective Date] The withdrawal shall take effect at the end of the next calendar year following the year in which the Secretary-General receives the notification.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[获有的权力]在退约开始生效之日之前，将不影响某一品种从本公约或者任何早期条例获得的任何权益。
Translation: (4) [Acquired Rights] No rights acquired under this Convention or any earlier statute regarding a particular variety shall be affected by the commencement of the denunciation's effect prior to the date on which it takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第40条保护现有的权益本公约将不限制根据缔约方之法律或早期条约，或除本公约以外联盟成员之间缔结的任何条约而获得的现有育种家的权利。
Translation:
Article 40 Protection of Existing Rights  
This Convention shall not limit any existing breeders' rights acquired under the laws of Contracting Parties, earlier treaties, or any agreements concluded among Union members outside this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第41条本公约的原始文本和官方文本（1）[原始文本]本公约将以英语、法语和德语各签署一份原始文本，在各文本中如有差异，以法语文本为准。
Translation:
Article 41 Original and Official Texts of the Convention  
(1) [Original Text] This Convention shall be signed in one original copy each in English, French, and German. In case of any divergence between the texts, the French text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 原始文本将由秘书长存档。
Translation: The original text will be archived by the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[官方文本]在与有关政府协商之后，秘书长将用阿拉伯文、荷兰文、意大利文、日文和西班牙文以及由理事会指定的其它文种制成官方文本。
Translation: (2) [Official Text] After consultation with the governments concerned, the Secretary-General shall prepare the official text in Arabic, Dutch, Italian, Japanese and Spanish, as well as in such other languages as the Council may designate.

Query_Text_cn: 第42条保存人的作用（1）[传送副本]秘书长将把本公约的真实副本传送给所有的采纳本公约参加外交会议的国家和政府间的机构，或根据要求，传送给其它的国家和政府间的机构。
Translation: Article 42 Role of the Depositary (1) [Transmission of Copies] The Secretary-General shall transmit certified true copies of this Convention to all States and intergovernmental organizations that have adopted it at the diplomatic conference or, upon request, to other States and intergovernmental organizations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[登记]秘书长将向联合国秘书处登记本公约。
Translation: (2) [Registration] The Secretary-General shall register this Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 为了以有效的电信业务促进各国人民之间的和平关系、国际合作和经济、社会的发展，各缔约国政府的全权代表在充分承认每个国家均有主权管制其电信和注意到电信对维护各国的和平和社会、经济发展起着越来越重要作用的同时，同意制订本公约，作为国际电信联盟的基本法规。
Translation: In order to promote peaceful relations, international cooperation, and economic and social development among peoples through efficient telecommunication services, the plenipotentiaries of the Contracting Governments, fully recognizing the sovereign right of each State to regulate its telecommunications and noting the increasingly important role of telecommunications in maintaining peace and fostering socio-economic development, have agreed to adopt this Convention as the fundamental instrument of the International Telecommunication Union.

Query_Text_cn: 5.c)既未列入附件一，又非联合国会员的主权国家而申请为电联会员并在取得三分之二电联会员同意后按第四十六条规定加入本公约者。
Translation: 5.c) Sovereign states not listed in Annex 1 and not members of the United Nations that apply for ITU membership and, upon securing approval from two-thirds of the ITU membership, accede to this Convention in accordance with Article 46.

Query_Text_cn: 6.2.对于第5款的规定，如在两届全权代表大会之间有通过外交途径并经由电联所在国提出入会申请者时，秘书长应征询各电联会员的意见。
Translation: 6.2. With respect to the provisions of No. 5, if an application for membership is submitted through diplomatic channels via the country in which the Union has its seat between two plenipotentiary conferences, the Secretary-General shall seek the opinions of all Member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 如会员在征询提出后四个月内未予答复，应作弃权论。
Translation: If a member fails to respond within four months after the inquiry is raised, it shall be deemed as abstention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条会员的权利和义务7.1.电联会员应享有公约所规定的权利，并应履行公约所规定的义务。
Translation:
Article 2 Rights and Obligations of Members  
7.1. ITU Member States shall enjoy the rights stipulated in the Convention and shall fulfill the obligations prescribed therein.

Query_Text_cn: 11.c)根据第117和179款的规定，每一会员在所有以通信方式进行的征询中，也享有一个表决权。
Translation: 11.c) In accordance with the provisions of Articles 117 and 179, each Member shall also have one vote in all consultations conducted by correspondence.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条电联的会址12.电联的会址设在日内瓦。
Translation:
Article 3 – Seat of the Union  
12. The seat of the Union shall be at Geneva.

Query_Text_cn: 14.a)维护和扩大所有电联会员之间的国际合作，以改进和合理使用各种电信，以及在电信领域内促进并提供对发展中国家的技术援助。
Translation: 14.a) To maintain and extend international cooperation among all ITU Members for the improvement and rational use of telecommunications, as well as to promote and provide technical assistance to developing countries in the field of telecommunications.

Query_Text_cn: 16.c)协调各国的行动，以达上述目的。
Translation: 16.c) Coordinate the actions of countries to achieve the above objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 24.g)对各种电信问题进行研究，制订规则，通过决议，编拟建议和意见，以及收集、出版与电信有关的资料。
Translation: 24.g) To conduct studies on various telecommunication issues, formulate regulations, adopt resolutions, draft recommendations and opinions, as well as collect and publish materials related to telecommunications.

Query_Text_cn: 33.d)国际电报电话咨询委员会(报话咨委会)。
Translation: 33.d) International Telegraph and Telephone Consultative Committee (CCITT).

Query_Text_cn: 第六条全权代表大会34.1.全权代表大会由代表会员国的代表团组成。
Translation:
Article 6 Plenipotentiary Conference  
34.1 The Plenipotentiary Conference shall be composed of delegations representing Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 该大会通常五年召开一次，在任何情况下，两届连续的全权代表大会的间隔不得超过六年。
Translation: The conference is normally held every five years, and in no case shall the interval between two successive plenipotentiary conferences exceed six years.

Query_Text_cn: 47.l)处理必需处理的任何其他电信问题。
Translation: 47.l) Address any other telecommunications issues that require resolution.

Query_Text_cn: 51.2.行政大会通常应为审议特种电信问题而召开，只可讨论列入议程的问题，其决定必须在所有情况下符合公约的规定。
Translation: 51.2. Administrative Conferences shall normally be convened to consider specific telecommunications issues and may discuss only those questions placed on their agendas. Their decisions must in all cases be in conformity with the provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 行政大会在通过决议和决定时应考虑到可以预知的财务影响，并应设法避免通过那些可能引起开支超过全权代表大会规定的经费最高限额的决议和决定。
Translation: When adopting resolutions and decisions, the Plenipotentiary Conference shall take into account the foreseeable financial implications and shall endeavor to avoid adopting resolutions and decisions that might give rise to expenditures exceeding the upper limits of credits set by the Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 55.c)大会权限内任何其他世界性问题。
Translation: 55(c) Any other matters of world concern within the competence of the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 56.(2)区域性行政大会的议程仅限于区域性的特种电信问题，包括向国际频率登记委员会颁发的关于其在该区域活动而与其他区域的利益不相抵触的指示在内。
Translation: 56.(2) The agenda of regional administrative conferences shall be confined to specific regional telecommunication issues, including instructions to the International Frequency Registration Board concerning its activities in the region, provided they are not incompatible with the interests of other regions.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，这种大会的决定必须在所有情况下符合各种行政规则的规定。
Translation: Moreover, the decisions of such conferences must comply with all applicable administrative regulations under any circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条行政理事会57.1.(1)行政理事会由全权代表大会选出的四十一个电联会员组成，选举时需适当注意世界所有区域公平分配理事会的席位。
Translation:
Article 8  
The Council  

57.1.(1) The Council shall consist of forty-one Member States of the Union elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference with due regard to the need for equitable distribution of Council seats among all regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 除遇有一般规则所述的出缺外，选入行政理事会的电联会员应任职到全权代表大会选出新的行政理事会之日为止，并有连选连任的资格。
Translation: Except in the case of vacancies as provided for in the general rules, a Member of the Union elected to the Council shall remain in office until the date on which the new Council is elected by the next plenipotentiary conference and shall be eligible for re-election.

Query_Text_cn: 58.(2)理事会的每一理事国应指派一人出席理事会，此人可由一名或几名顾问协助。
Translation: 58.(2) Each member of the Council shall designate one person to represent it therein, who may be assisted by one or more advisers.

Query_Text_cn: 59.2.行政理事会应采用自行制订的议事规则。
Translation: 59.2. The Executive Council shall adopt its own rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 60.3.在两届全权代表大会之间，行政理事会在全权代表大会所授予的权限内代行其职权。
Translation: 60.3. Between two Plenipotentiary Conferences, the Administrative Council shall act on behalf of the Plenipotentiary Conference within the limits of the powers delegated to it by the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 61.4.(1)行政理事会应采取一切步骤，促进各会员履行公约和各种行政规则的规定以及全权代表大会的决定，并在必要时，促进其履行电联其他大会和会议的决定；行政理事会应执行全权代表大会所指派的任务。
Translation: 61.4.(1) The Administrative Council shall take all steps to promote the fulfillment by Member States of the provisions of the Convention, the Administrative Regulations, and the decisions of the Plenipotentiary Conference, and, where necessary, to facilitate compliance with the decisions of other ITU conferences and assemblies. It shall also carry out any tasks assigned to it by the Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 62.(2)行政理事会应根据电联的宗旨每年确定技术援助政策。
Translation: 62.(2) The Administrative Council shall determine the technical assistance policy annually in accordance with the purposes of the ITU.

Query_Text_cn: 63.(3)行政理事会应确保对电联的工作进行有效的协调，并对电联各常设机构进行有效的财政监督。
Translation: 63.(3) The Administrative Council shall ensure the efficient coordination of the Union's work and exercise effective financial control over its permanent organs.

Query_Text_cn: 64.(4)行政理事会应借助其掌握的一切手段，特别是通过电联参加联合国的有关计划，并根据电联的宗旨(其中一条宗旨是以一切可能的手段促进电信的发展)，促进旨在向发展中国家提供技术合作的国际合作。
Translation: 64.(4) The Administrative Council shall promote international cooperation aimed at providing technical cooperation to developing countries, utilizing all available means at its disposal, in particular through the ITU's participation in relevant United Nations programs, and in accordance with the purposes of the Union (one of which is to foster the development of telecommunications by all possible means).

Query_Text_cn: 第九条总秘书处65.1.(1)总秘书处由秘书长领导，秘书长由一名副秘书长协助。
Translation:
Article 9 General Secretariat  
65.1.(1) The General Secretariat shall be headed by a Secretary-General, who shall be assisted by a Deputy Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 66.(2)秘书长和副秘书长在当选时所确定的日期就职，通常任职到下届全权代表大会所确定的日期为止。
Translation: 66.(2) The Secretary-General and Deputy Secretary-General shall assume office on the date determined at the time of their election and shall normally hold office until the date fixed by the next Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长和副秘书长只有一次连选连任的资格。
Translation: The Secretary-General and Deputy Secretary-General are eligible for only one re-election.

Query_Text_cn: 67.(3)秘书长应采取一切必要措施，以确保电联资金的节省使用。他应对行政理事会负责电联在行政和财务方面的全部活动。
Translation: 67.(3) The Secretary-General shall take all necessary measures to ensure the economical use of the Union's funds. He shall be responsible to the Administrative Council for all the administrative and financial activities of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 副秘书长应对秘书长负责。
Translation: The Deputy Secretary-General shall be accountable to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 68.2.(1)如果秘书长的职位出缺，应由副秘书长接替并任职到下届全权代表大会所确定的日期为止。
Translation: 68.2.(1) In the event of a vacancy in the office of Secretary-General, the Deputy Secretary-General shall assume the duties until the date determined by the next Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 根据第66款规定，该副秘书长有当选秘书长的资格。
Translation: According to Article 66, the Deputy Secretary-General is eligible for election as Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 在副秘书长接替秘书长的情况下，副秘书长的职位应从接替之日起视为出缺并应按第69款的规定办理。
Translation: In the event that an Under-Secretary-General assumes the position of Secretary-General, the post of Under-Secretary-General shall be deemed vacant from the date of assumption and shall be filled in accordance with the provisions of Article 69.

Query_Text_cn: 69.(2)如果在距下届全权代表大会召开日期的一百八十天以前遇有副秘书长的职位出缺，行政理事会应任命一名接替人在剩余的任期内任职。
Translation: 69.(2) If the office of Deputy Secretary-General becomes vacant more than one hundred and eighty days prior to the date of the next Plenipotentiary Conference, the Administrative Council shall appoint a successor to serve for the remainder of the term.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应任命一名秘书长。
Translation: The Council shall appoint a Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这一出缺是距下届全权代表大会召开日期的一百八十天以前发生的，则还应任命一名副秘书长。
Translation: If the vacancy occurs more than one hundred and eighty days before the date of the next Plenipotentiary Conference, a Deputy Secretary-General shall also be appointed.

Query_Text_cn: 由行政理事会任命的官员在其前任官员的剩余任期内任职，他们在全权代表大会上有当选为秘书长和(或)副秘书长的资格。
Translation: Officials appointed by the Administrative Council serve for the remaining term of their predecessors and are eligible to be elected as Secretary-General and/or Deputy Secretary-General at the Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 71.3.秘书长是电联的合法代表。
Translation: 71.3. The Secretary-General is the legal representative of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 72.4.副秘书长应协助秘书长履行职责并执行秘书长交办的特别任务。
Translation: 72.4. The Under-Secretary-General shall assist the Secretary-General in the performance of his functions and carry out such special tasks as the Secretary-General may entrust to him.

Query_Text_cn: 在秘书长缺席时，副秘书长履行秘书长的职责。
Translation: In the absence of the Secretary-General, the Deputy Secretary-General shall perform the duties of the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条国际频率登记委员会73.1.国际频率登记委员会(频登会)由全权代表大会选举的五名具有独立性的委员组成。
Translation:
Article 10  
The International Frequency Registration Board (IFRB)  
73.1 The International Frequency Registration Board (IFRB) shall consist of five independent members elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 这些委员应从电联会员国提名的候选人中选出，选举的方式须保证全世界各区域公平分配名额。
Translation: These members shall be elected from among candidates nominated by ITU Member States, with the method of election ensuring equitable distribution among all regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 每一电联会员只能提名本国国民一人作为候选人。
Translation: Each ITU member may nominate only one of its nationals as a candidate.

Query_Text_cn: 74.2.国际频率登记委员会委员应在当选时所确定的日期就职并任职到下届全权代表大会所确定的日期为止。
Translation: 74.2. Members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall assume office on the date fixed for their election and shall hold office until the date fixed by the next Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 75.3.国际频率登记委员会委员不应代表各自国家或某一区域，而应以国际公共托管物的管理人身份进行工作。
Translation: 75.3. Members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall serve not as representatives of their respective countries or of a region, but as custodians of an international public trust.

Query_Text_cn: 在筹备无线电大会时应考虑行政理事会的有关指示。
Translation: The relevant instructions of the Administrative Council should be taken into account in preparing for the Radio Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 82.f)保持与其履行职责有关的重要记录。
Translation: 82.f) Maintain important records relevant to the performance of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 一般而言，此种研究不应涉及经济问题，但在比较各种技术方案时，可以考虑经济因素。
Translation: Generally, such research should not involve economic issues, but economic factors may be considered when comparing different technical solutions.

Query_Text_cn: 但根据第83款属无线电咨委会职权范围的有关无线电通信的技术或操作问题除外。
Translation: However, technical or operational matters concerning radiocommunications falling under the competence of the Radio Regulations Board pursuant to No. 83 are excluded.

Query_Text_cn: 85.(3)每一咨委会在进行研究时，应适当注意研究与发展中国家在区域及国际范围内建立、发展和促进电信直接有关的问题和编写这方面的建议。
Translation: 85.(3) Each advisory body shall, in its studies, give due consideration to issues directly related to the establishment, development, and enhancement of telecommunications in developing countries at both regional and international levels, as well as to the formulation of recommendations thereon.

Query_Text_cn: 88.b)经认可的私营电信机构而表示愿意参加这些委员会的工作并经认可它的会员核准者。
Translation: 88.b) Accredited private telecommunications entities that express willingness to participate in the work of these committees and obtain approval from their recognized members.

Query_Text_cn: 92.c)由全权代表大会选举并根据第323款的规定任命的主任。
Translation: 92.c) The Director elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference and appointed in accordance with the provisions of No. 323.

Query_Text_cn: 93.4.应设立一个世界性计划委员会及若干个由各国际咨询委员会的全体会议联合批准的区域性计划委员会。
Translation: 93.4. A global planning committee and several regional planning committees shall be established, subject to joint approval by the plenary sessions of the respective international advisory committees.

Query_Text_cn: 这些计划委员会应拟订一项国际电信网路总计划，以利国际电信业务的协调发展，并应将各项与发展中国家有特殊关系且属各咨询委员会研究范围内的问题提交各国际咨询委员会研究。
Translation: These planning committees shall formulate a general plan for international telecommunication networks to facilitate the coordinated development of international telecommunication services. They shall also refer to the international consultative committees for study any issues within their purview that are of particular relevance to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 94.5.区域性计划委员会可与希望合作的区域性组织进行密切合作。
Translation: 94.5. Regional planning committees may work closely with regional organizations willing to cooperate.

Query_Text_cn: 95.6.国际咨询委员会的工作细则载明在一般规则内。
Translation: 95.6. The working procedures of the International Advisory Committee are specified in the general regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条协调委员会96.1.协调委员会由秘书长、副秘书长、国际咨询委员会主任和国际频率登记委员会主席、副主席组成。
Translation:
Article 12 The Coordination Committee  
12.1 The Coordination Committee shall consist of the Secretary-General, the Deputy Secretaries-General, the Director of the International Consultative Committee, and the Chairman and Vice-Chairman of the International Frequency Registration Board.

Query_Text_cn: 协调委员会由秘书长主持，在秘书长缺席时，由副秘书长主持。
Translation: The Coordination Committee is chaired by the Secretary-General and,in the absence of the Secretary-General,by the Deputy Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 97.2.协调委员会在涉及一个以上常设机构的行政、财务、技术合作事宜和对外关系及新闻宣传方面向秘书长提出咨询意见并给予实际协助。
Translation: 97.2. The Coordinating Committee provides advisory opinions and practical assistance to the Secretary-General on administrative, financial, technical cooperation matters involving more than one permanent body, as well as on external relations and public information.

Query_Text_cn: 协调委员会在审议时须时时充分考虑到公约的规定、行政理事会的决定和电联的整体利益。
Translation: The Coordination Committee shall at all times take full account of the provisions of the Convention, the decisions of the Administrative Council, and the overall interests of the ITU in its deliberations.

Query_Text_cn: 98.3.协调委员会还应审议根据公约委托审议的其他事项和行政理事会向其提出的任何事项，并在审议后通过秘书长向行政理事会提出报告。
Translation: 98.3. The Coordinating Committee shall also consider other matters referred to it for consideration under the Convention and any matters submitted to it by the Administrative Council, and shall, after such consideration, submit reports thereon to the Administrative Council through the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条电联的选任官员和职员99.1.(1)电联的选任官员和职员在履行职责时，不得寻求或接受任何政府或电联以外任何其他当局的指示，并应杜绝与其国际官员身份不符的任何行为。
Translation:
Article 13 Elected Officials and Staff of the ITU  
99.1.(1) Elected officials and staff of the ITU shall not seek or accept instructions from any government or any authority external to the ITU in the performance of their duties. They shall refrain from any action incompatible with their status as international officials.

Query_Text_cn: 100.(2)每一会员应尊重电联选任官员和职员的绝对国际性，不得设法影响其工作的执行。
Translation: 100.(2) Each Member shall respect the exclusively international character of the officials and staff of the Union and shall refrain from any attempt to influence them in the discharge of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 101.(3)电联的选任官员或任何职员，除作为其职责外，不得以任何方式参加与电信有关的企业，或享有其他任何财务权益。
Translation: 101.(3) No elected official or any staff member of the ITU shall participate in any capacity in a telecommunications-related enterprise or hold any other financial interest, except in the performance of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，"财务权益”一词不得解释为继续享受由先前的受雇或服务所产生的离职后的福利。
Translation: However, the term "financial interest" shall not be construed to include post-employment benefits or other deferred compensation arising from prior employment or service.

Query_Text_cn: 102.(4)为保证电联有效的工作，任何有本国国民当选为秘书长、副秘书长、频率登记委员会的委员或某一国际咨询委员会的主任的会员国应尽可能避免在两届全权代表大会之间召回该人员。
Translation: 102.(4) To ensure the efficient functioning of the ITU, any Member State whose national is elected as Secretary-General, Deputy Secretary-General, a member of the Radio Regulations Board, or the chairman of an international consultative committee shall, to the extent possible, refrain from recalling such personnel between two plenipotentiary conferences.

Query_Text_cn: 103.2.秘书长、副秘书长、国际咨询委员会的主任和国际频率登记委员会的委员都应是电联各不同会员国的国民。
Translation: 103.2 The Secretary-General, the Deputy Secretary-General, the Director of the International Consultative Committee, and the members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall be nationals of different Member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 在选举时应适当考虑第104款所述的原则和世界各区域的按地域公平分配。
Translation: Due consideration should be given to the principles set forth in Article 104 and the equitable geographical distribution among the world's regions during elections.

Query_Text_cn: 104.3.在招聘职员和确定服务条件时，应首先考虑使电联在工作效率、能力、道德诸方面获得具有最高标准的人员，并应适当注意在尽可能广泛的地域内招聘职员的重要性。
Translation: 104.3. In recruiting staff and determining conditions of service, primary consideration shall be given to securing for the Union personnel of the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity, with due regard to the importance of recruiting staff on as wide a geographical basis as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条大会和其他会议工作的安排和讨论的进行105.1.大会以及国际咨询委员会的全体会议和一般会议在涉及其工作的安排和讨论的进行时应采用一般规则内所载的议事规则。
Translation:
Article 14  
Arrangement of Work and Conduct of Discussions at Conferences and Other Meetings  

105.1. The General Conference, as well as the plenary meetings and general sessions of the International Advisory Committee, shall apply the rules of procedure contained in the General Rules concerning the arrangement of their work and the conduct of discussions.

Query_Text_cn: 106.2.大会、行政理事会和国际咨询委员会的全体会议及一般会议可以采用其认为必需的议事规则以外的规则。
Translation: 106.2. The Assembly, the Administrative Council, and the International Consultative Committee may adopt such rules of procedure for the plenary meetings and ordinary meetings as they deem necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种附加议事规则必须与公约相一致，全体会议和研究组所通过的附加议事规则应以决议的形式刊布在全体会议的文件内。
Translation: However, such additional rules of procedure must be consistent with the Convention. Any additional rules of procedure adopted by the Plenipotentiary Conference and study groups shall be published in the form of resolutions within the documents of the Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 110.c)向发展中国家提供的技术合作和援助的费用。
Translation: 110.c) Costs of technical cooperation and assistance provided to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 111.2.电联的经费开支应由其会员所缴纳的会费支付。
Translation: 111.2 The expenses of the ITU shall be borne by its Members through the contributions they pay.

Query_Text_cn: 40单位等级4单位等级35单位等级3单位等级30单位等级2单位等级25单位等级11/2单位等级20单位等级1单位等级18单位等级1/2单位等级15单位等级1/4单位等级13单位等级1/8单位等级(只适用于联合国所列10单位等级的最不发达国家和行政理事会所8单位等级确定的其他国家)5单位等级112.3.除第111款所列的会费等级以外，任何会员可以选择高于40的会费单位数。
Translation: 40 unit grade 4 unit grade 35 unit grade 3 unit grade 30 unit grade 2 unit grade 25 unit grade 1 1/2 unit grade 20 unit grade 1 unit grade 18 unit grade 1/2 unit grade 15 unit grade 1/4 unit grade 13 unit grade 1/8 unit grade (applicable only to least developed countries listed by the United Nations under the 10 unit grade and other countries designated by the Administrative Council under the 8 unit grade) 5 unit grade 112.3. In addition to the contribution grades listed in paragraph 111, any member may opt for a contribution unit number higher than 40.

Query_Text_cn: 113.4.会员可以自由选择其摊付电联经费开支的会费等级。
Translation: 113.4. Members are free to choose their contribution class for sharing the Union's expenses.

Query_Text_cn: 114.5.在本公约有效期内，按照公约选择的会费等级不得降低。
Translation: 114.5. During the validity period of this Convention, the selected contribution scale shall not be downgraded.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如遇发生自然灾害而必须实施国际援助计划这类特殊情况时，行政理事会在某一会员提出申请并证明不能保持其原来选择等级的会费时，可以核准该会员降低会费单位等级。
Translation: However, in exceptional circumstances such as natural disasters necessitating international aid programs, the Administrative Council may approve a member's request to reduce its assessed contribution level upon application and demonstration of inability to maintain its originally selected scale.

Query_Text_cn: 115.6.第50款所述区域性行政大会的费用应由有关区域所有会员，以及必要时由参加大会的其他区域的会员，根据各自认担的会费单位等级摊付。
Translation: 115.6. The costs of regional administrative conferences referred to in No. 50 shall be borne by all Members of the region concerned and, where necessary, by Members of other regions participating in such conferences, in accordance with their respective contributory unit classes.

Query_Text_cn: 116.7.会员应预付根据行政理事会所核准的预算算出的每年应摊会费。
Translation: 116.7. Members shall pay in advance their annual assessed contributions as calculated in accordance with the budget approved by the Administrative Council.

Query_Text_cn: 117.8.对电联欠款的会员在其欠款额等于或大于其两个年度应付会费的总额时，应丧失其按第10、11两款所规定的表决权。
Translation: 117.8. A member in arrears to the ITU shall lose its voting rights as stipulated in paragraphs 10 and 11 when the amount of its arrears equals or exceeds the total of its contributions due for two fiscal years.

Query_Text_cn: 118.9.关于经认可的私营电信机构、科学或工业组织和国际组织认担会费的规定，载明在一般规则内。
Translation: 118.9. Provisions concerning the assessment of contributions for recognized private operating agencies, scientific or industrial organizations, and international organizations are set forth in the General Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条语言119.1.(1)电联的正式语言是中文、西班牙文、阿拉伯文、英文、法文和俄文。
Translation:
Article 16 Languages  
119.1.(1) The official languages of the ITU are Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, English, French and Russian.

Query_Text_cn: 120.(2)电联的工作语言是西班牙文、英文和法文。
Translation: 120.(2) The working languages of the ITU are Spanish, English, and French.

Query_Text_cn: 121.(3)如遇争议，应以法文本为准。
Translation: 121.(3) In case of dispute, the French text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 122.2.(1)全权代表大会和行政大会的各种最后定稿的文件、最后法规、议定书、决议、建议和意见应以电联的各种正式语言拟具，各语种文本的形式和内容应当相同。
Translation: 122.2.(1) The final documents, final Acts, protocols, resolutions, recommendations, and opinions of Plenipotentiary Conferences and Administrative Conferences shall be drawn up in the official languages of the Union, with each language version being identical in form and content.

Query_Text_cn: 123.(2)上述大会的所有其他文件应以电联的工作语言印发。
Translation: 123.(2) All other documents of the aforementioned conference shall be issued in the working languages of the ITU.

Query_Text_cn: 124.3.(1)行政规则所规定的电联正式公务文件应以六种正式语言印发。
Translation: 124.3.(1) Official ITU service documents prescribed by administrative regulations shall be issued in the six official languages.

Query_Text_cn: 125.(2)以任何正式语言书写的向大会和国际咨询委员会会议提交的提案和文稿应用电联的工作语言转达给各会员。
Translation: 125.(2) Proposals and documents submitted to the conference and meetings of the International Consultative Committee in any official language shall be communicated to all members in the working languages of the ITU.

Query_Text_cn: 126.(3)秘书长在履行职责过程中所编制的供普遍分发的所有其他文件应以三种工作语言拟具。
Translation: 126.(3) All other documents prepared by the Secretary-General in the course of discharging his/her responsibilities for general distribution shall be drafted in the three working languages.

Query_Text_cn: 127.4.(1)在电联大会、国际咨询委员会全体会议、由全体会议核准并列入工作计划的所有研究组会议和行政理事会会议上，应使用六种正式语言之间互相传译的有效系统。
Translation: 127.4.(1) At ITU conferences, plenary meetings of international consultative committees, all study group meetings approved by the plenary and included in the work program, as well as sessions of the Administrative Council, an effective system of mutual interpretation among the six official languages shall be employed.

Query_Text_cn: 128.(2)在国际咨询委员会的其他会议上，应用工作语言进行讨论，但要求将某一种工作语言传译的会员应至少在九十天前通知他们将参加会议。
Translation: 128.(2) At other meetings of the International Advisory Committee, discussions shall be conducted in the working languages, provided that members requiring interpretation into a particular working language shall notify their participation at least ninety days in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 129.(3)如果大会或会议的全体与会者一致同意，则可用少于上文所提到的语言进行讨论。
Translation: 129.(3) If all participants of the assembly or conference unanimously agree, discussions may be conducted in fewer languages than those mentioned above.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条电联的法律权能130.电联在其每一会员的领土上享有为行使其职责和实现其宗旨所必需的法律权能。
Translation:
Article 17 Legal Capacity of the ITU  

130. The ITU shall possess on the territory of each of its Members such legal capacity as may be necessary for the exercise of its functions and the fulfillment of its purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条公众使用国际电信业务的权利131.各会员承认公众有使用国际公众通信业务进行通信的权利。
Translation:
Article 18 Right of the Public to Use International Telecommunication Services  
131. Member States recognize the right of the public to correspond by means of the international public correspondence service.

Query_Text_cn: 各类通信的服务、资费和保障对于所有用户均应相同，不得有任何优先或优待。
Translation: All communication services, tariffs, and guarantees must be equal for all users, with no preferential treatment or privileges granted.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条电信的停止传递132.1.各会员对于可能危及国家安全、违反国家法律、妨害公共治安或有伤风化的私务电报保留停止传递的权利，但须立即将停止传递这类电报或这类电报一部分的情况通知原发报局。如这种通知可能危及国家安全，则不在此限。
Translation:
Article 19 Suspension of Telecommunications  

132.1. Members reserve the right to suspend the transmission of private telecommunications that may endanger national security, contravene national laws, disrupt public order, or offend public morals. However, the originating administration must be promptly notified of such suspension, whether in whole or in part, unless such notification would itself jeopardize national security.

Query_Text_cn: 133.2.各会员对于可能危及国家安全、违反国家法律、妨害公共治安或有伤风化的任何其他私务电信，也保留予以截断的权利。
Translation: 133.2. Members also reserve the right to intercept any other private telecommunications that may endanger national security, violate national laws, disrupt public order, or offend public morals.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条业务的中止134.每一会员保留无限期地中止国际电信业务的权利，或则中止其全部业务，或则仅中止某些通信联络和(或)某几种通信的发送，接收或经转；但必须立即将这类行动通过秘书长通知每一其他会员。
Translation:
Article 20  
Suspension of Services  
134. Each Member reserves the right to suspend international telecommunication services indefinitely, either wholly or partially, by discontinuing certain correspondences and/or the transmission, reception, or transit of certain types of communications. However, such actions must be immediately notified to every other Member through the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条责任135.各会员对国际电信业务的用户，尤其在赔偿损失的要求方面，不承担任何责任。
Translation:
Article 21 Liability  

135. No Member shall be liable to users of international telecommunication services, particularly with regard to claims for damages.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条电信的保密136.1.各会员同意采取与其所使用的电信系统相适应的一切可能措施，以确保国际通信的机密。
Translation:
Article 22 Secrecy of Telecommunications  

136.1. Members agree to take all possible measures compatible with the telecommunication systems they employ to ensure the secrecy of international correspondence.

Query_Text_cn: 137.2.但是，各会员保留将这种国际间的通信通知有关当局的权利，以保证其国内法律的实施或其所缔结的国际公约的履行。
Translation: 137.2. However, each Member reserves the right to notify the relevant authorities of such international communications to ensure compliance with its domestic laws or the international conventions it has concluded.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条电信设备和电路的建立、操作和保护138.1.各会员应采取必要步骤，保证在最优良的技术条件下建立为迅速和不间断地交换国际电信所必需的电路和设备。
Translation:
Article 23 Establishment, Operation and Protection of Telecommunication Equipment and Circuits  
138.1. Members shall take such steps as may be necessary to ensure the establishment, under the best technical conditions, of the circuits and equipment necessary to carry on the rapid and uninterrupted exchange of international telecommunications.

Query_Text_cn: 139.2.对于这些电路和设备，必须尽可能用经实际操作经验证明属于最好的方法和程序进行操作，必须经常保持其正常的工作状态并使之随着科学技术的进展而得到改进。
Translation: 139.2. For these circuits and equipment, it is imperative to operate them using methods and procedures proven by practical experience to be the best, maintain their normal working condition regularly, and ensure continuous improvement in line with advancements in science and technology.

Query_Text_cn: 140.3.各会员应在其管辖权限内保护这些电路和设备。
Translation: 140.3. Each Member shall protect these circuits and equipment within its jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 141.4.除另有专门协议制定其他规定外，每一会员应采取必要步骤，以保证维护其所控制的那部分国际电信电路。
Translation: 141.4. Unless otherwise provided by special agreements, each Member shall take the necessary steps to ensure the maintenance of the portion of the international telecommunication circuit under its control.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条违反规定的通知142.为便于实施本公约第四十四条的规定，各会员应保证互相通知违反本公约和行政规则及其各种附属规则规定的事例。
Translation:
Article 24 Notification of Infringements  

142. To facilitate the implementation of the provisions of Article 44 of this Convention, Members shall ensure mutual notification of instances of infringement of this Convention, the Administrative Regulations, and their associated annexes.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条有关生命安全电信的优先权143.国际电信业务对于有关海上、陆上、空中或外层空间生命安全的一切电信以及世界卫生组织非常紧急的疫情电信，必须给予绝对优先权。
Translation:
Article 25 Priority of Telecommunications Concerning Safety of Life  

143. International telecommunication services shall accord absolute priority to all telecommunications concerning the safety of life at sea, on land, in the air, or in outer space, as well as to epidemic telecommunications of extreme urgency issued by the World Health Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条政务电报和政务电话的优先权144.如发报人要求优先权时，政务电报可在不违反本公约第二十五和三十六条规定的情况下，享有先于其他电报的优先权。
Translation:
Article 26 Priority of Government Telegrams and Government Telephone Calls  

144. Government telegrams may, at the request of the sender and without contravening the provisions of Articles 25 and 36 of this Convention, be given priority over other telegrams.

Query_Text_cn: 政务电话如经特别要求时，也可在可行范围内给予先于其他电话的优先权。
Translation: Government hotlines may also be given priority over other calls within feasible limits if specifically requested.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条密语145.1.政务电报和公务公电在所有通信联络中均可用密语书写。
Translation: Article 27 Cipher 145.1. Government telegrams and official dispatches may be written in cipher for all communication purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 146.2.在所有国家之间均可受理密语私务电报；但是，预先经由秘书长通知不受理密语私务电报的国家不在此例。
Translation: 146.2. Private code telegrams are admissible between all countries, except those that have notified the Secretary-General in advance of their non-acceptance of such telegrams.

Query_Text_cn: 147.3.凡不受理发自或发往其本国境内的密语私务电报的会员必须准许密语私务电报过境，但遇有第二十条所规定的业务中止情况时除外。
Translation: 147.3. Any Member that does not accept private secret language telegrams originating from or destined for its own territory must permit the transit of such telegrams, except in cases of service suspension as stipulated in Article 20.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条资费和免费业务148.有关电信资费和准用免费业务的各种情况的规定载明在本公约各种附属行政规则内。
Translation:
Article 28 Tariffs and Free Services  
148. Provisions concerning telecommunications tariffs and the conditions applicable to free services are set forth in the various annexes to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如未缔结这种协议且未按第三十一条规定订立特别协定时，则按照行政规则进行结算。
Translation: In the absence of such an agreement and without a special arrangement under Article 31, settlement shall be made in accordance with administrative rules.

Query_Text_cn: ——国际货币基金组织的货币单位，或——金法郎，这两种货币单位在行政规则内已有说明，其适用规定载明在电报电话规则附件一内。
Translation: The monetary unit of the International Monetary Fund, or the gold franc—both of these monetary units are specified in the administrative regulations, with their applicable provisions detailed in Annex 1 of the Telegraph and Telephone Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条特别协议151.各会员为本身、为经其认可的私营电信机构以及其他经正式核准的电信机构保留可以订立不涉及一般会员的电信事务的特别协议的权利。
Translation:
Article 31 Special Arrangements  
151. Members reserve the right to enter into special agreements on telecommunications matters that do not concern Members generally, whether for themselves, for recognized private operating agencies, or for other duly authorized telecommunications entities.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种协议在涉及因它的实施而可能对其他国家无线电业务造成有害干扰时，不得与本公约或其各种附属行政规则的条款相抵触。
Translation: However, such agreements shall not be in conflict with the provisions of this Convention or its associated Administrative Regulations when they involve harmful interference that may affect the radio services of other countries due to their implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条区域性大会、协议和组织152.为解决可在区域范围内处理的电信问题，各会员保留可以召开区域性大会、订立区域性协议和成立区域性组织的权利。
Translation:
Article 32 Regional Conferences, Agreements and Organizations  

152. To address telecommunication issues that can be resolved at a regional level, Member States retain the right to convene regional conferences, establish regional agreements, and form regional organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种协议不得与本公约相抵触。
Translation: However, such agreements shall not be incompatible with this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，须尽早采用最新的技术发展成果。
Translation: To this end, it is imperative to promptly adopt the latest technological advancements.

Query_Text_cn: 154.在使用空间无线电业务的频带时，各会员应注意，无线电频率和地球同步卫星轨道是有限的自然资源，必须有效而节省地予以使用，以使各国或国家集团可以依照无线电规则的规定并考虑到发展中国家和个别国家的地理位置的特殊需要，公平地使用无线电频率和地球同步卫星轨道。
Translation: 154. When utilizing frequency bands allocated to space radiocommunication services, Member States shall bear in mind that radio frequencies and the geostationary satellite orbit are limited natural resources which must be used efficiently and economically so that countries or groups of countries may have equitable access to both, in accordance with the provisions of the Radio Regulations, taking into account the special needs of developing countries and the geographical situation of particular countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条相互间的通信155.1.在移动业务中开放无线电通信的电台，在其正常工作范围内，不论其采用何种无线电系统，均应负有互相交换无线电通信的义务。
Translation:
Article 34 Intercommunication  

155.1. In the mobile service, stations open to radio communication shall be obligated to exchange radio communications with each other within their normal operating range, irrespective of the radio system employed.

Query_Text_cn: 156.2.然而，为不致阻碍科学进展起见，第155款的规定不应阻止使用不能同其他系统进行通信的无线电系统，但是这种系统之所以不能同其他系统进行通信必须是由于其特性所致，而不是因为采用了专用于阻碍相互间通信的装置的结果。
Translation: 156.2. However, in order not to impede scientific progress, the provisions of No. 155 shall not prevent the use of radio systems that cannot communicate with other systems, provided that such inability results from their inherent characteristics rather than the adoption of devices specifically designed to prevent intercommunication.

Query_Text_cn: 157.3.虽有第155款的规定，但仍可根据这种业务的用途或与所采用的系统无关的其他情况，指定某一电台开放有限制的国际电信业务。
Translation: 157.3. Notwithstanding the provisions of No. 155, a station may be authorized to operate a restricted international telecommunication service based on the intended use of such service or other circumstances unrelated to the system employed.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条有害干扰158.1.所有电台，不论其用途如何，在建立和使用时均不得对其他会员，或对经认可的私营电信机构，或对其他经正式核准开办无线电业务并按照无线电规则经营的电信机构的无线电业务或通信造成有害干扰。
Translation:
Article 35 Harmful Interference  
158.1. All stations, regardless of their purpose, must be established and operated in such a manner as not to cause harmful interference to the radio services or communications of other Member States, recognized private operating agencies, or other duly authorized entities operating radio services in accordance with the Radio Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 159.2.每一会员应负责要求经其认可的私营电信机构和其他经正式核准开办无线电业务的电信机构遵守第158款的规定。
Translation: 159.2 Each member shall be responsible for requiring compliance with the provisions of No. 158 by private telecommunications agencies recognized by it and by other telecommunications agencies duly authorized to operate radio services.

Query_Text_cn: 160.3.此外，各会员公认，宜应采取一切实际可行的步骤使各种电气装置和设备的运转不致对第158款所述的无线电业务或通信造成有害干扰。
Translation: 160.3. In addition, Members recognize that all practicable steps should be taken to prevent the operation of electrical apparatus and devices from causing harmful interference to the radio services or communications referred to in No. 158.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条遇险呼叫和通信161.无线电台对于遇险呼叫和通信，不论其发自何处，均有义务绝对优先地予以接收和答复，并立即采取必要的行动。
Translation:
Article 36 Distress Calls and Communications  
161. All radio stations are obligated to give absolute priority to receiving and responding to distress calls and communications, regardless of their origin, and must take immediate necessary action.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条虚假的或欺骗性的遇险信号、紧急信号、安全信号或识别信号162.各会员同意采取必要的步骤，以阻止发送或转发虚假的或欺骗性的遇险信号、紧急信号、安全信号或识别信号，并共同协作从各自国家寻找和查明发送这种信号的电台。
Translation:
Article 37  
False or deceptive distress, urgency, safety or identification signals  

162. Member States agree to take the necessary steps to prevent the transmission or retransmission of false or deceptive distress, urgency, safety, or identification signals, and to cooperate in locating and identifying the stations responsible for transmitting such signals within their respective territories.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条国防业务使用的设备163.1.各会员对于本国陆、海、空军的军用无线电设备保留其完全的自由权。
Translation:
Article 38 Equipment for National Defense Services  

163.1. Members retain complete freedom with respect to radio equipment used by their land, sea, and air military forces.

Query_Text_cn: 164.2.但是，这种设备必须按照其业务性质，尽可能遵守有关遇险时给予援助和采取防止有害干扰的措施的法定条款以及行政规则内关于应使用的发射方式和频率的条款。
