Translation: 164.2. However, such equipment must comply, to the greatest extent practicable given its operational nature, with the statutory provisions concerning assistance in distress and measures against harmful interference, as well as the administrative regulations stipulating the emission types and frequencies to be employed.

Query_Text_cn: 165.3.此外，如果这种军用设备参加公众通信业务或本公约各种附属行政规则所规定的其他业务，则通常必须遵守这类业务所适用的管制性条款。
Translation: 165.3. Additionally, if such military equipment participates in public communication services or other services specified in the various subsidiary administrative regulations of this Convention, it must generally comply with the regulatory provisions applicable to such services.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条与联合国的关系166.1.联合国与国际电信联盟之间的关系在这两个组织缔结的协定中有明文规定，该协定的文本载于本公约附件三内。
Translation:
Article 39 Relationship with the United Nations  
166.1. The relationship between the United Nations and the International Telecommunication Union is defined in the Agreement concluded between these two organizations, the text of which is contained in Annex 3 to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 167.2.根据上述协定第十六条规定，联合国办理电信业务的部门享有本公约及其各种附属行政规则所规定的权利并承担其所规定的义务。
Translation: 167.2. In accordance with Article XVI of the aforementioned Agreement, the departments of the United Nations responsible for telecommunications operations shall enjoy the rights and assume the obligations stipulated in this Convention and its various subsidiary administrative regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 因而，上述部门有权以顾问身份参加电联的一切大会，包括国际咨询委员会的会议。
Translation: Therefore, the aforementioned departments are entitled to participate in all ITU conferences, including meetings of the International Consultative Committee, in an advisory capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条与各国际组织的关系168.为促进国际间电信事务的全面协调，电联应与在利益上、活动上有联系的各国际组织进行合作。
Translation:
Article 40 Relations with International Organizations  
168. In order to promote comprehensive coordination of international telecommunication matters, the Union shall cooperate with international organizations having related interests and activities.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十一条基本条款和一般规则169.如公约第一部分(基本条款，第1至194款)与公约第二部分(一般规则，第201至643款)的条款有矛盾之处时，应以前者为准。
Translation:
Article 41 Fundamental Provisions and General Rules  
169. In case of any inconsistency between the provisions of Part I of the Convention (Fundamental Provisions, Articles 1 to 194) and Part II (General Rules, Articles 201 to 643), the former shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条行政规则170.1.公约的条款系由管制电信的使用并对全体会员均有约束力的各种行政规则加以补充。
Translation:
Article 42 Administrative Regulations  
170.1. The provisions of the Convention are supplemented by administrative regulations which govern the use of telecommunications and are binding on all Members.

Query_Text_cn: 171.2.按照第四十五条规定批准本公约或按照第四十六条规定加入本公约意味着必然接受在批准或加入时有效的各种行政规则。
Translation: 171.2. Approval of this Convention in accordance with Article 45 or accession to it in accordance with Article 46 shall entail automatic acceptance of the administrative provisions in force at the time of approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 172.3.各会员应将其核准相关行政大会对这类规则所作的修订通知秘书长，再由秘书长将收到此种核准通知书的情况立即转告各会员。
Translation: 172.3. Each Member shall notify the Secretary-General of its approval of any revisions to such rules made by the relevant Administrative Conference, whereupon the Secretary-General shall promptly inform all Members of the receipt of such notification of approval.

Query_Text_cn: 173.4.如公约与行政规则的条款有矛盾之处时，应以公约为准。
Translation: 173.4. In case of any discrepancy between the provisions of the Convention and the Administrative Rules, the Convention shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条现行行政规则的有效性174.第170款所述的行政规则系在本公约签署时有效的各种行政规则。
Translation:
Article 43 Validity of Existing Administrative Rules  

174. The administrative rules referred to in Article 170 are those in force at the time of signing this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 这类行政规则应视为附属于本公约的，即使按照第53款规定对之进行部分修订，仍应继续有效，直到相关的世界性行政大会制订的新规则生效并作为本公约附件予以取代时为止。
Translation: Such administrative regulations shall be considered as annexed to this Convention and shall remain in force, even if partially amended under the provisions of Article 53, until new regulations adopted by the competent world administrative conference enter into force and replace them as annexes to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条公约和规则的执行175.1.各会员在其所建立或经营的、参与国际业务或可能对其他国家无线电业务造成有害干扰的所有电信局和电台内，均有义务遵守本公约和各种行政规则的规定，但是，根据第三十八条规定免除这项义务的业务除外。
Translation:
Article 44 Implementation of the Convention and Regulations  

175.1. Member States are obliged to ensure compliance with the provisions of this Convention and the Administrative Regulations in all telecommunications offices and stations established or operated by them that engage in international services or may cause harmful interference to radio services of other countries, except for services exempted from this obligation under Article 38.

Query_Text_cn: 176.2.各会员还有义务采取必要的步骤，责令所有经其批准而建立和经营电信、并参与国际业务或经营可能对其他国家无线电业务造成有害干扰的电台的私营电信机构遵守本公约和各种行政规则的规定。
Translation: 176.2. Each Member shall also undertake to take the necessary steps to require private operating agencies, which are authorized by it to establish and operate telecommunications and which engage in international services or operate stations capable of causing harmful interference to the radio services of other countries, to comply with the provisions of this Convention and the Administrative Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条公约的批准177.1.本公约应由各签字国政府根据各该国家的现行宪法条例予以批准。
Translation:
Article 45 Ratification of the Convention  

1. This Convention shall be ratified by the signatory governments in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应当尽快地通过外交途径并经由电联所在国政府转交秘书长收存。
Translation: The instrument of approval shall be transmitted as soon as possible through diplomatic channels to the Secretary-General for deposit, via the government of the country in which the ITU is located.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须将每份批准书的交存通知各会员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify all Members of the deposit of each instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 178.2.(1)自本公约生效之日起两年内，签字国政府即使没有按照第177款规定交存批准书，仍可享有第8至11款所赋予电联会员的权力。
Translation: 178.2.(1) Within two years from the date of entry into force of this Convention, a signatory government, even if it has not deposited an instrument of ratification in accordance with Article 177, shall enjoy the rights conferred on Member States of the Union by Articles 8 to 11.

Query_Text_cn: 但表决权以外的其他权利不受影响。
Translation: However,other rights apart from voting rights shall not be affected.

Query_Text_cn: 180.3.在本公约按照第五十二条规定生效后，每份批准书自交存秘书长之日起生效。
Translation: 180.3. After the entry into force of this Convention in accordance with Article 52, each instrument of ratification shall take effect on the date of its deposit with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 181.4.本公约并不因为一个或几个签字国政府不予批准而对业已批准的各国政府减少效力。
Translation: 181.4. The present Convention shall not lose its effect for the governments that have ratified it by reason of the failure of one or several signatory governments to ratify.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条公约的加入182.1.非本公约签字国的政府可以随时按照第一条规定加入本公约。
Translation:
Article 46 Accession to the Convention  

1. Any government not a signatory to this Convention may accede to it at any time in accordance with the provisions of Article 1.

Query_Text_cn: 183.2.加入证书应当通过外交途径并经由电联所在国政府转交秘书长收存。
Translation: 183.2. Instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General through diplomatic channels and transmitted via the government of the country where the ITU is located.

Query_Text_cn: 除在证书内另有说明外，证书应自交存之日起生效。
Translation: Unless otherwise stated in the certificate, it shall enter into force upon the date of deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须在收到每份加入证书后通知各会员，并将该加入证书的证明无误的副本送交每一会员一份。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify all Members of the receipt of each instrument of accession and shall transmit certified copies thereof to each Member.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条公约的宣告废除184.1.每一业已批准或加入本公约的会员有权宣告废除本公约。废除公约的通知书应当通过外交途径并经由电联所在国政府转交秘书长。
Translation:
Article 47 Denunciation of the Convention  

184.1. Any Member which has ratified or acceded to this Convention shall have the right to denounce it. The denunciation shall be notified through diplomatic channels to the Secretary-General via the government of the country in which the Union has its seat.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须将这种情况通知其他会员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify the other Members accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 185.2.废除公约应自秘书长收到废除公约通知书之日起届满一年后生效。
Translation: 185.2. The denunciation shall take effect upon the expiration of one year following the date of receipt of the notification of denunciation by the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条国际电信公约(1973年，马拉加—托雷莫里诺斯)的废止186.在各缔约国政府之间的关系方面，本公约废止并取代国际电信公约(1973年，马拉加—托雷莫里诺斯)。
Translation:
Article 48: Abrogation of the International Telecommunication Convention (Malaga-Torremolinos, 1973)  

186. In relations between the governments of the Member States, this Convention abrogates and replaces the International Telecommunication Convention (Malaga-Torremolinos, 1973).

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条与非缔约国的关系187.每一会员为其本身和为经认可的私营电信机构保留其可以与非本公约缔约国订定关于受理来往电信业务的条件的权利。
Translation:
Article 49 Relations with Non-Member States  

187. Each Member reserves the right to determine, for itself and for recognized private operating agencies, the conditions under which telecommunications services are exchanged with non-Member States of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果从非缔约国领土发出的电信业务为某一会员所接受，该会员必须予以传递；并且只要该电信业务在某一会员的电信电路上传递，则应适用本公约和各种行政规则内必须遵行的条款以及通常的资费。
Translation: If a telecommunication service originating from the territory of a non-Member State is accepted by a Member, the Member must transmit it; and as long as the telecommunication service is transmitted over the telecommunication circuits of a Member, the applicable provisions of this Convention and the mandatory provisions of the Administrative Regulations, as well as the usual tariffs, shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十条争议的解决188.1.各会员可以通过外交途径，或按照它们之间为解决国际争端所订立的双边或多边条约内规定的程序，或用相互商定的任何其他方法解决它们之间关于本公约或第四十二条所述各种规则的解释和执行问题的争议。
Translation:
Article 50 Settlement of Disputes  

188.1. Members may settle disputes between them concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention or the rules referred to in Article 42 through diplomatic channels, in accordance with procedures provided for in bilateral or multilateral treaties concluded among them for the settlement of international disputes, or by any other mutually agreed means.

Query_Text_cn: 189.2.如果不采用上述解决方法中的任何一种，则作为争端一方的任何会员可以根据情况将该项争议按照一般规则或任选附加议定书所规定的程序提付仲裁。
Translation: 189.2. If none of the aforementioned solutions is adopted, any member party to the dispute may, as the case may be, submit the dispute to arbitration in accordance with the procedures set forth in the general rules or the optional additional protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 192.b）第四十二条所述各种规则内所解释的其他名词具有各该规则所指定的意义。
Translation: b) Other terms interpreted in the various rules referred to in Article 42 shall have the meanings assigned to them in those respective rules.

Query_Text_cn: 国际劳工组织大会，经国际劳工局理事会召集，于1999年6月1日在日内瓦举行其第87届会议，并考虑到需要通过新的文书，把禁止和消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动作为包括国际合作和援助在内的国家和国际行动的主要优先目标，以便补充依然是童工劳动方面基本文书的1973年准予就业最低年龄公约和建议书，并考虑到立即采取全面行动切实消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动，既要关注免费基础教育的重要性，又要关注需要使有关儿童脱离所有此类工作以及为其康复和社会融合提供援助，还要同时解决其家庭需要问题，并忆及1996年第83届国际劳工大会上通过的关于消除童工劳动的决议，并认识到童工劳动在很大程度上是由于贫困造成的，长期的解决办法有赖于经济的持续增长带来的社会进步，特别是在消除贫困和普及教育方面，并忆及联合国大会于1989年11月20日通过的《儿童权利公约》，并忆及1998年第86届国际劳工大会上通过的《国际劳工组织关于工作中基本原则和权利的宣言及其后续措施》，并忆及某些最恶劣形式的童工劳动已涵盖在其他国际文书中，特别是1930年《强迫劳动公约》和联合国1956年《废止奴隶制、奴隶贩卖及类似奴隶制的制度与习俗补充公约》，并经决定采纳本届会议议程第四项关于童工劳动的若干提议，并经确定这些提议应采取一项国际公约的形式，于1999年6月17日通过以下公约，引用时得称之为1999年《禁止和立即行动消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动公约》。
Translation: The General Conference of the International Labour Organization, having been convened at Geneva by the Governing Body of the International Labour Office and having met in its 87th Session on 1 June 1999, and considering the need to adopt new instruments for the prohibition and elimination of the worst forms of child labour, as the main priority for national and international action, including international cooperation and assistance, to complement the Convention and the Recommendation concerning Minimum Age for Admission to Employment, 1973, which remain fundamental instruments on child labour, and considering that the effective elimination of the worst forms of child labour requires immediate and comprehensive action, taking into account the importance of free basic education and the need to remove the children concerned from all such work and to provide for their rehabilitation and social integration while addressing the needs of their families, and recalling the resolution concerning the elimination of child labour adopted by the International Labour Conference at its 83rd Session in 1996, and recognizing that child labour is to a great extent caused by poverty and that the long-term solution lies in sustained economic growth leading to social progress, in particular poverty alleviation and universal education, and recalling the Convention on the Rights of the Child adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on 20 November 1989, and recalling the ILO Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work and its Follow-up, adopted by the International Labour Conference at its 86th Session in 1998, and recalling that some of the worst forms of child labour are covered by other international instruments, in particular the Forced Labour Convention, 1930, and the United Nations Supplementary Convention on the Abolition of Slavery, the Slave Trade, and Institutions and Practices Similar to Slavery, 1956, and having decided upon the adoption of certain proposals with regard to child labour, which is the fourth item on the agenda of the session, and having determined that these proposals shall take the form of an international Convention, adopts this seventeenth day of June of the year one thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine the following Convention, which may be cited as the Worst Forms of Child Labour Convention, 1999.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条凡批准本公约的会员国应立即采取有效的措施，以保证将禁止和消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动作为一项紧迫事务。
Translation: Article 1 Each Member which ratifies this Convention shall take immediate and effective measures to secure the prohibition and elimination of the worst forms of child labour as a matter of urgency.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条就本公约而言，“儿童”一词适用于18岁以下的所有人员。
Translation: Article 2 For the purposes of the present Convention, a child means every human being below the age of 18 years.

Query_Text_cn: (d)在可能对儿童健康、安全或道德有伤害性的环境中工作。
Translation: (d) Working in environments that may be harmful to children's health, safety, or morals.

Query_Text_cn: 1、第三条(d)项所指的工作类型应由国家法律或条例，或是主管当局，在同有关雇主组织和工人组织磋商之后，考虑有关国际标准，特别是1999年《禁止和立即行动消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动建议书》第3款、第4款的情况，然后确定。
Translation: 1. The types of work referred to in Article 3(d) shall be determined by national laws or regulations or by the competent authority, after consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned, taking into consideration relevant international standards, in particular paragraphs 3 and 4 of the Worst Forms of Child Labour Recommendation, 1999.

Query_Text_cn: 2、主管当局在同有关雇主组织和工人组织磋商之后，应查明所确定的工作类型存在场所。
Translation: 2. The competent authority shall, after consultation with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations, identify the workplaces where the types of work so determined are performed.

Query_Text_cn: 3、根据本条第1款确定的工作类型一览表，应同有关雇主组织和工人组织磋商，进行定期审查并视需要予以修订。
Translation: 3. The list of types of work determined in accordance with paragraph 1 of this Article shall be subject to periodic review and, where necessary, revision in consultation with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条凡批准本公约的会员国在同雇主组织和工人组织磋商之后，应建立或指定适当机构，监督实施使本公约发生效力的各项条款。
Translation: Article 5 Each Member which ratifies this Convention shall, in consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned, establish or designate appropriate bodies to supervise the application of the measures taken to give effect to the provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 1、凡批准本公约的会员国应将制定和实施行动计划，作为优先目标，以消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动。
Translation: 1. Each Member which ratifies this Convention shall take immediate and effective measures to secure the prohibition and elimination of the worst forms of child labour as a matter of urgency.

Query_Text_cn: 2、制定和实施此类行动计划，应同有关政府机构以及雇主组织和工人组织进行磋商，凡适宜时，考虑其他有关群体的意见。
Translation: 2. The formulation and implementation of such action plans shall be carried out in consultation with relevant government agencies as well as employers' and workers' organizations, taking into account the views of other concerned groups where appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 1、凡批准本公约的会员国应采取一切必要措施，包括规定和执行刑事制裁或其他必要制裁，以保证有效实施和强制执行使本公约发生效力的各项条款。
Translation: 1. Each Member which ratifies this Convention shall take all necessary measures, including the provision and enforcement of penal sanctions or other appropriate sanctions, to ensure the effective application and enforcement of the provisions giving effect to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (e)考虑女童的特殊情况。
Translation: (e) Take into account the special circumstances of girls.

Query_Text_cn: 3、凡批准本公约的会员国应指定主管当局，负责实施使本公约发生效力的各项条款。
Translation: 3. Each Member which ratifies this Convention shall designate the competent authority responsible for the implementation of the provisions giving effect to the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条凡批准本公约的会员国应采取适宜步骤，通过加强国际合作和／或援助，包括支持社会与经济发展、消除贫困计划与普及教育，以相互帮助，落实本公约的条款。
Translation: Article 8 Each Member which ratifies this Convention shall take appropriate steps to assist each other by enhancing international cooperation and/or assistance, including support for social and economic development, poverty eradication programmes and universal education, for the implementation of the provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约的正式批准书应送请国际劳工局长登记。
Translation: Article 9 The formal instruments of ratification of this Convention shall be communicated to the Director-General of the International Labour Office for registration.

Query_Text_cn: 1、本公约应仅对其批准书已经国际劳工局长登记的国际劳工组织会员国有约束力。
Translation: 1. This Convention shall be binding only upon those Members of the International Labour Organization whose ratifications have been registered with the Director-General of the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 2、本公约自两个会员国的批准书已经国际劳工局长登记之日起12个月后生效。
Translation: 2. This Convention shall come into force 12 months after the date on which the ratifications of two member States have been registered with the Director-General of the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 3、此后，对于任何会员国，本公约应自其批准书已经登记之日起12个月后生效。
Translation: 3. Thereafter, this Convention shall enter into force for each Member State 12 months after the date of registration of its instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 1、凡批准本公约的会员国，自本公约初次生效之日起满10年后得向国际劳工局长通知解约，并请其登记。
Translation: 1. Any Member which has ratified this Convention may denounce it after the expiration of ten years from the date on which the Convention first comes into force, by an act communicated to the Director-General of the International Labour Office for registration.

Query_Text_cn: 1、国际劳工局长应将国际劳工组织各会员国所送达的一切批准书和解约通知书的登记情况，通知本组织的全体会员国。
Translation: 1. The Director-General of the International Labour Office shall notify all Members of the International Labour Organisation of the registration of all ratifications and denunciations communicated to him by the Members of the Organisation.

Query_Text_cn: 2、国际劳工局长在将所送达的第二份批准书的登记情况通知本组织全体会员国时，应提请本组织务会员国注意本公约开始生效的日期。
Translation: 2. Upon registering the second instrument of ratification received, the Director-General of the International Labour Office shall notify all Member States of the Organization of the date on which this Convention shall come into force, drawing their attention to its effective commencement.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条国际劳工局长应将他按照以上各条规定所登记的一切批准书和解约通知书的详细情况，按照《联合国宪章》第102条的规定，送请联合国秘书长进行登记。
Translation: Article 13 The Director-General of the International Labour Office shall communicate to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations full particulars of all ratifications and acts of denunciation registered by him in accordance with the provisions of the preceding Articles.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条国际劳工局理事会在必要时，应将本公约的实施情况向大会提出报告，并审查应否将本公约的全部或部分修订问题列入大会议程。
Translation: Article 14 The Governing Body of the International Labour Office shall, when necessary, submit a report on the working of this Convention to the General Conference and shall consider the advisability of placing on the agenda of the Conference the question of its revision in whole or in part.

Query_Text_cn: (b)自新修订公约生效之日起，本公约应即停止接受会员国的批准。
Translation: (b) Upon the entry into force of the newly amended Convention, the present Convention shall cease to be open to ratification by Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条本公约的英文本和法文本同等作准。
Translation: Article 16 The English and French texts of this Convention are equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 中国和澳大利亚高度重视气候变化问题,愿加强合作共同应对气候变化挑战。
Translation: China and Australia attach great importance to climate change and are willing to enhance cooperation to jointly address the challenges posed by climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 双方重申对于《联合国气候变化框架公约》(简称《公约》)和《京都议定书》的承诺,再次强调发达国家应根据“共同但有区别的责任”原则和各自能力以及“巴厘路线图”,在2012年后继续率先减少温室气体排放,并协助发展中国家提高应对气候变化的能力。
Translation: Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) and the Kyoto Protocol, reiterating that developed countries should continue to take the lead in reducing greenhouse gas emissions after 2012 in accordance with the principle of "common but differentiated responsibilities" and respective capabilities, as well as the Bali Roadmap, and assist developing countries in enhancing their capacity to address climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳双方认识到应加强谈判以实现“巴厘路线图”规定的时间表,双方将在即将举行的相关双边和多边论坛中密切合作,支持《公约》下的谈判。
Translation: China and Australia recognize the need to enhance negotiations to achieve the timeline set out in the Bali Roadmap. Both sides will work closely in upcoming relevant bilateral and multilateral forums to support negotiations under the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳双方在气候变化方面有许多共同点。
Translation: China and Australia share many commonalities in addressing climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 双方的伙伴关系和合作将集中于比较优势和共同利益,从而为全球应对气候变化的努力做出贡献。
Translation: The partnership and cooperation between the two sides will focus on comparative advantages and shared interests, thereby contributing to global efforts to address climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意通过加强部长级政策对话,以及开发执行协助双方应对气候变化的互惠互利的实质性项目强化务实合作,促进更紧密气候变化合作。
Translation: The two sides agreed to enhance practical cooperation and foster closer collaboration on climate change by strengthening ministerial-level policy dialogues and developing mutually beneficial substantive projects that assist both parties in addressing climate challenges.

Query_Text_cn: 基于两国开展更紧密气候变化合作的精神,双方重申对中澳洁净煤技术联合协调小组工作的支持。
Translation: In the spirit of closer climate change cooperation between the two countries, both sides reaffirmed their support for the work of the China-Australia Joint Coordination Group on Clean Coal Technology.

Query_Text_cn: 两国认为减少毁林排放应作为未来应对气候变化行动的一个方面,重申对中国于2007年9月在悉尼亚太经合组织会议上倡议发起的亚太森林恢复和可持续管理网络的支持。
Translation: The two countries recognize that reducing emissions from deforestation should be an aspect of future actions to address climate change and reaffirm their support for the Asia-Pacific Network for Sustainable Forest Management and Rehabilitation, an initiative proposed by China at the APEC meeting in Sydney in September 2007.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳双方与其他各方在《公约》第13次缔约方会议上共同努力,达成了关于未来应对气候变化国际框架的“巴厘路线图”。
Translation: China and Australia,along with other parties,worked together at the 13th Conference of the Parties to the Convention to reach the "Bali Roadmap" for the future international framework on climate change response.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将在《公约》和《京都议定书》的指导下,继续共同努力推动气候变化谈判和相关国际合作。
Translation: The two sides will continue to work together under the guidance of the Convention and the Kyoto Protocol to advance climate change negotiations and related international cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 为此,双方同意在现有气候变化机制基础上,举行年度部长级会议,加强双方在气候变化方面的经常性政策对话、合作和协调。
Translation: To this end, both sides agree to build upon existing climate change mechanisms by convening annual ministerial meetings to enhance regular policy dialogue, cooperation, and coordination on climate change between them.

Query_Text_cn: 第一次部长级会议将由澳方于2008年下半年举办。
Translation: The first ministerial meeting will be hosted by Australia in the second half of 2008.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳拥有成功的双边气候变化伙伴关系,这一伙伴关系汇聚了双方工业、科学和相关政府部门的资源和专家。
Translation: Australia and China share a successful bilateral climate change partnership, which brings together resources and expertise from industries, scientific communities, and relevant government departments on both sides.

Query_Text_cn: 双方重申对已达成的合作项目的承诺,同意进一步扩展务实项目活动,尤其是在能力建设、可再生能源技术、能效、甲烷回收利用、气候变化和农业、土地利用、土地利用变化和林业、适应气候变化和气候变化科学等方面。
Translation: Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to the agreed cooperative projects and agreed to further expand practical project activities, particularly in areas such as capacity building, renewable energy technologies, energy efficiency, methane recovery and utilization, climate change and agriculture, land use, land-use change and forestry, climate change adaptation, and climate science.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳将合作开发低排放技术,协助两国在发展经济的同时尽可能减少温室气体排放,并满足两国对清洁发电技术不断增长的需要。
Translation: China and Australia will collaborate on developing low-emission technologies to assist both nations in minimizing greenhouse gas emissions while fostering economic growth, as well as meeting their increasing demand for clean power generation technologies.

Query_Text_cn: 两国对目前双方在亚太清洁发展和气候伙伴计划、中澳洁净煤技术联合协调小组和双边气候变化伙伴关系有关领域内开展的合作表示欢迎。
Translation: Both countries welcomed the current cooperation between them in areas related to the Asia-Pacific Partnership on Clean Development and Climate, the China-Australia Joint Coordination Group on Clean Coal Technology, and the bilateral climate change partnership.

Query_Text_cn: 中方欢迎澳方再次重申将向中澳洁净煤技术联合协调小组投入2000万澳元的承诺。
Translation: China welcomes Australia's reaffirmation of its commitment to invest AUD 20 million in the China-Australia Joint Coordination Group on Clean Coal Technology.

Query_Text_cn: 应中华人民共和国国务院总理温家宝的邀请,丹麦王国首相安诺斯·福格·拉斯穆森阁下于2008年10月20至25日来华出席第七届亚欧首脑会议并对中国进行正式访问。
Translation: At the invitation of Premier Wen Jiabao of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, His Excellency Anders Fogh Rasmussen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Denmark, paid an official visit to China and attended the Seventh Asia-Europe Meeting from October 20 to 25, 2008.

Query_Text_cn: 访问期间,胡锦涛主席会见了拉斯穆森首相,温家宝总理同拉斯穆森首相举行了会谈。
Translation: During the visit, President Hu Jintao met with Prime Minister Rasmussen, and Premier Wen Jiabao held talks with him.

Query_Text_cn: 双方领导人回顾了两国自1950年建交以来双边关系的长足发展及在政治、经济、文化、教育、科技等领域富有成果的合作,认为双边关系得到稳步提升,政治互信和相互尊重日益增强,经贸合作不断拓展。
Translation: The leaders of both sides reviewed the significant progress in bilateral relations since the establishment of diplomatic ties in 1950 and the fruitful cooperation in political, economic, cultural, educational, and scientific-technological fields. They acknowledged the steady enhancement of bilateral relations, the growing political mutual trust and mutual respect, and the continuous expansion of economic and trade cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 双方一致认为,在双边、多边和全球事务上开展合作符合两国共同利益。
Translation: Both sides agreed that cooperation on bilateral, multilateral and global affairs serves the common interests of the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 一、双方同意加强双边政治和经济对话。
Translation: 1. Both sides agreed to enhance bilateral political and economic dialogue.

Query_Text_cn: 保持高层互访势头,加强两国政府、立法机构和地方政府间不同形式、不同级别的友好往来,增进相互了解,建立实质性合作。
Translation: Maintain the momentum of high-level exchanges, strengthen friendly interactions in various forms and at different levels between the governments, legislative bodies, and local authorities of the two countries, enhance mutual understanding, and establish substantive cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 促进两国外交部间加强政治对话,开展更为密切的磋商与合作,继续保持副部级政治磋商机制,力争在北京和哥本哈根轮流举行年度会晤。
Translation: Promote enhanced political dialogue between the foreign ministries of the two countries, conduct closer consultations and cooperation, maintain the vice-ministerial political consultation mechanism, and strive to hold annual meetings alternately in Beijing and Copenhagen.

Query_Text_cn: 在有关交往、双边磋商和会见中,双方可探讨加强合作的新途径,包括政府领导人或外交部长在双边或多边场合进行会晤。
Translation: During relevant exchanges, bilateral consultations, and meetings, both sides may explore new avenues to enhance cooperation, including meetings between government leaders or foreign ministers in bilateral or multilateral settings.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将共同努力,推动在2010年通过适当的高层互访等方式庆祝两国建交60周年。
Translation: Both sides will work together to celebrate the 60th anniversary of diplomatic relations in 2010 through appropriate high-level exchanges and other means.

Query_Text_cn: 丹麦重申坚定奉行一个中国政策,不支持台湾加入仅限主权国家参加的国际组织,不与台湾进行官方往来。
Translation: Denmark reiterates its firm adherence to the One-China policy, does not support Taiwan's participation in international organizations limited to sovereign states, and refrains from official engagement with Taiwan.

Query_Text_cn: 中方对丹方这一原则立场表示赞赏。
Translation: China appreciates Denmark's principled stance on this matter.

Query_Text_cn: 丹方表达了希望通过建设性对话和平解决台湾问题的愿望。
Translation: The Chinese side expressed the hope to peacefully resolve the Taiwan issue through constructive dialogue.

Query_Text_cn: 中方重申了在台湾问题上的原则立场。
Translation: China reiterated its principled stance on the Taiwan issue.

Query_Text_cn: 双方均对中欧关系的良好发展感到高兴,愿继续为深化中欧全面战略伙伴关系做出贡献。
Translation: Both sides expressed satisfaction with the sound development of China-EU relations and are willing to continue contributing to the deepening of the comprehensive strategic partnership between China and the EU.

Query_Text_cn: 丹麦确认,愿基于2004年中欧领导人会晤发表的联合声明和欧洲理事会随后的结论,继续朝着促成欧盟解除对华军售禁令的方向前进。
Translation: Denmark confirms its willingness to continue working towards the EU lifting its arms embargo on China, based on the Joint Statement issued during the 2004 China-EU Summit and the subsequent conclusions of the European Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、中丹两国均完全支持公平、公正、建立在规则基础之上的多边国际体系,支持联合国在处理全球事务,以及通过协商与谈判寻求政治解决国际争端中发挥核心作用。
Translation: II. Both China and Denmark fully support a fair, just and rules-based multilateral international system, and recognize the central role of the United Nations in addressing global affairs and seeking political solutions to international disputes through consultation and negotiation.

Query_Text_cn: 双方支持联合国进行合理、必要的改革。
Translation: Both sides support reasonable and necessary reforms of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 鉴此,双方将加强在联合国、亚欧会议、中欧关系领域及其他多边和地区机制内的合作。
Translation: In view of this, the two sides will strengthen cooperation within the framework of the United Nations, the Asia-Europe Meeting, China-EU relations, and other multilateral and regional mechanisms.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意在联合国及其维和任务框架内加强经验交流。
Translation: Both sides agreed to enhance experience-sharing within the framework of the United Nations and its peacekeeping missions.

Query_Text_cn: 三、双方一致谴责任何形式以及任何人、在任何时间、出于任何目的所策划的恐怖主义活动。
Translation: III. Both sides unequivocally condemn all forms of terrorist activities, planned by anyone, at any time, and for any purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 双方决定加强在反恐领域的磋商与交流,重申联合国应在打击恐怖主义中发挥主导作用。反对在反恐问题上将恐怖主义与特定的民族、宗教挂钩。
Translation: The two sides decided to enhance consultation and exchanges in the field of counterterrorism and reaffirmed that the United Nations should play a leading role in combating terrorism. They opposed associating terrorism with any specific ethnicity or religion in counterterrorism efforts.

Query_Text_cn: 四、双方领导人均表示愿在防扩散领域加强交流与合作。
Translation: IV. Both leaders expressed their willingness to enhance exchanges and cooperation in the field of non-proliferation.

Query_Text_cn: 五、双方重申了关于促进和保护人权的承诺,继续重视在平等和相互尊重的基础上开展人权交流与合作。
Translation: V. The two sides reaffirmed their commitment to promoting and protecting human rights and agreed to continue to value human rights exchanges and cooperation on the basis of equality and mutual respect.

Query_Text_cn: 双方均强调在人权领域采取实质性步骤的重要性。
Translation: Both sides emphasized the importance of taking substantive steps in the field of human rights.

Query_Text_cn: 六、双方承诺继续支持非洲的持续发展。
Translation: VI. Both sides are committed to continuing their support for Africa's sustainable development.

Query_Text_cn: 中丹将在支持非洲发展方面加强交流,以探讨更有效地开展对非合作。
Translation: China and Denmark will enhance exchanges on supporting Africa's development to explore more effective ways of cooperation with the continent.

Query_Text_cn: 双方表示将全力支持实现千年发展目标和全球可持续发展。
Translation: Both sides expressed their full commitment to supporting the achievement of the Millennium Development Goals and global sustainable development.

Query_Text_cn: 七、双方同意继续在气候变化、能源、环境、研究、创新和教育领域加强合作。
Translation: VII. Both sides agreed to continue strengthening cooperation in the fields of climate change, energy, environment, research, innovation, and education.

Query_Text_cn: 互利伙伴关系》行动计划中的优先领域来实现这一目标。
Translation: This goal will be achieved through the priority areas outlined in the Action Plan for the Mutually Beneficial Partnership.

Query_Text_cn: 中方对丹方关于加强合作的建议表示赞赏。
Translation: China appreciates Denmark's proposal to enhance cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 双方均强调应对气候变化的重要性,支持《联合国气候变化框架公约》作为全球应对气候变化的主渠道,在“共同但有区别的责任”等原则基础上,共同推动在2009年哥本哈根联合国气候变化框架公约第15次缔约方会议上达成各方接受的结果并通过一项决定。
Translation: Both sides emphasized the importance of addressing climate change and supported the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) as the primary channel for global climate action. They agreed to work together toward achieving an acceptable outcome and adopting a decision at the 15th Conference of the Parties to the UNFCCC in Copenhagen in 2009, based on principles such as "common but differentiated responsibilities."

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意将在各个级别保持密切联系,加强合作,力争实现这一目标。
Translation: Both sides agreed to maintain close contact at all levels and enhance cooperation to strive for the achievement of this goal.

Query_Text_cn: 丹麦支持中国风能行业的发展,将在2009年启动一个旨在支持中国发展可再生能源国家规划的项目,包括可再生能源中心的组建,以及通过中丹研发部门和私营部门的合作转让和开发新的、创新型的可再生能源技术。
Translation: Denmark supports the development of China's wind energy sector and will launch a project in 2009 aimed at assisting China in formulating its national renewable energy plan. This includes the establishment of a renewable energy center, as well as the transfer and development of new and innovative renewable energy technologies through collaboration between Chinese and Danish research institutions and private enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 两国领导人共同见证了中丹在可再生能源领域总额1亿丹麦克朗的新项目意向书的签字仪式。
Translation: The leaders of both countries jointly witnessed the signing ceremony of letters of intent for new renewable energy projects between China and Denmark, totaling 100 million Danish kroner.

Query_Text_cn: 在环境领域,双方将加强在水污染防治、空气污染防治以及废物管理领域的合作。
Translation: In the environmental sector, the two sides will enhance cooperation in water pollution prevention and control, air pollution prevention and control, as well as waste management.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意加强在高等教育、研究和创新领域的合作,共同提高两国促进经济社会发展的竞争力和知识水平。
Translation: The two sides agreed to enhance cooperation in higher education, research, and innovation to jointly elevate their competitiveness and knowledge base in promoting economic and social development.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将根据2007年9月签订的《关于加强中丹科技合作的谅解备忘录》,通过支持建立研究伙伴关系、鼓励科研人才交流实现这一目标。
Translation: The two sides will achieve this goal by supporting the establishment of research partnerships and encouraging exchanges of scientific personnel, in accordance with the Memorandum of Understanding on Strengthening China-Denmark Science and Technology Cooperation signed in September 2007.

Query_Text_cn: 两国领导人共同见证了中科院与丹麦科技创新部签订的《关于建立“中丹教育与研究中心”的谅解备忘录》。
Translation: The leaders of both countries jointly witnessed the signing of the Memorandum of Understanding on the Establishment of the "China-Denmark Education and Research Center" between the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science.

Query_Text_cn: 八、双方将继续深化和扩大经贸互利合作,充分利用并不断改善中丹经贸联委会以及其他现有的磋商与合作机制,加强在贸易、投资和技术等领域的对话,鼓励两国企业界特别是中小企业间的交流与合作。
Translation: VIII. Both sides will continue to deepen and expand mutually beneficial economic and trade cooperation, fully utilize and continuously improve the China-Denmark Joint Economic and Trade Commission and other existing consultation and cooperation mechanisms, enhance dialogue in trade, investment, technology and other fields, and encourage exchanges and cooperation between the business communities of the two countries, especially small and medium-sized enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将在发展经贸关系的同时,支持企业积极承担社会责任。
Translation: Both sides will support businesses in actively fulfilling their social responsibilities while developing economic and trade relations.

Query_Text_cn: 丹麦支持中国希望尽早得到欧盟承认其完全市场经济地位的愿望,并将在双方找到达成这一决定的合适框架时积极促成此事。
Translation: Denmark supports China's aspiration to obtain full market economy status from the EU as early as possible and will actively facilitate this process once both sides identify an appropriate framework for reaching such a decision.

Query_Text_cn: 中方对丹麦一贯支持自由贸易、反对贸易保护主义的立场表示赞赏。
Translation: China appreciates Denmark's consistent support for free trade and opposition to trade protectionism.

Query_Text_cn: 九、双方将扩大在文化和旅游领域的合作,支持两国人民之间的接触与交流。
Translation: IX. Both sides will expand cooperation in the fields of culture and tourism, supporting contacts and exchanges between the peoples of the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 一、应中华人民共和国主席胡锦涛的邀请，巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国总统佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫于2006年2月19日至23日对中华人民共和国进行国事访问。
Translation: I. At the invitation of President Hu Jintao of the People's Republic of China, President Pervez Musharraf of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan paid a state visit to China from February 19 to 23, 2006.

Query_Text_cn: 二、胡锦涛主席同穆沙拉夫总统举行了正式会谈。
Translation: II. President Hu Jintao held official talks with President Pervez Musharraf.

Query_Text_cn: 中国全国人大常委会委员长吴邦国、国务院总理温家宝和全国政协主席贾庆林分别会见了穆沙拉夫总统。
Translation: Chairman Wu Bangguo of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, Premier Wen Jiabao of the State Council, and Chairman Jia Qinglin of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference met with President Musharraf respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 两国领导人在亲切、友好的气氛中，就进一步加强和发展中巴战略合作伙伴关系及共同关心的国际和地区问题深入交换了意见，达成广泛共识。
Translation: The leaders of the two countries held cordial and friendly discussions on further strengthening and developing the China-Pakistan strategic cooperative partnership, as well as international and regional issues of mutual interest, reaching extensive consensus.

Query_Text_cn: 三、访问期间，穆沙拉夫总统在中国社会科学院向中国部分知名学者作了演讲，参加了与中国企业界人士的座谈会，出席了庆祝中巴建交55周年特别活动。
Translation: 3. During the visit, President Musharraf delivered a speech to prominent Chinese scholars at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, participated in a symposium with Chinese business leaders, and attended a special event celebrating the 55th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and Pakistan.

Query_Text_cn: 穆沙拉夫总统及其代表团还访问了四川省成都市。
Translation: President Musharraf and his delegation also visited Chengdu City in Sichuan Province.

Query_Text_cn: 四、两国领导人满意地回顾了中巴关系55年的发展历程，一致认为，中巴友谊深入人心，真诚友好、互利合作、相互信任、相互支持已成为中巴关系的显着特征。
Translation: IV. The two leaders reviewed with satisfaction the 55-year development of China-Pakistan relations and agreed that the China-Pakistan friendship is deeply rooted in the hearts of the people, with sincerity, mutual benefit, trust and support becoming the defining features of bilateral ties.

Query_Text_cn: 无论国际、地区及两国国内形势如何变化，中巴全天候友谊经受住了时间的考验，不断发扬光大。
Translation: No matter how the international, regional, and domestic landscapes of both countries evolve, the all-weather friendship between China and Pakistan has stood the test of time and continues to flourish.

Query_Text_cn: 双方认为，当前国际和地区形势正在发生重大而深刻的变化，两国加强睦邻友好、开展互利合作、深化战略关系符合两国和两国人民的根本利益，有利于本地区的和平与发展。
Translation: Both sides believe that the international and regional landscape is undergoing major and profound changes. Strengthening good-neighborliness and friendship, pursuing mutually beneficial cooperation, and deepening the strategic relationship between the two countries serve the fundamental interests of both nations and their peoples, and contribute to peace and development in the region.

Query_Text_cn: 双方强调，进一步巩固和发展睦邻友好、互利合作的中巴战略合作伙伴关系，是两国外交政策的既定方针，两国将继续采取积极措施不断深化和充实中巴关系的内涵。
Translation: Both sides emphasized that further consolidating and developing the China-Pakistan strategic cooperative partnership of good-neighborliness, friendship, and mutual benefit is an established policy of both countries' foreign policies. The two sides will continue to take active measures to deepen and enrich the substance of China-Pakistan relations.

Query_Text_cn: 五、双方对2003年11月两国元首发表的《中华人民共和国和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国关于双边合作发展方向的联合宣言》得到顺利实施，以及对《中华人民共和国和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国睦邻友好合作条约》的签订并生效表示满意。
Translation: V. Both sides expressed satisfaction with the smooth implementation of the Joint Declaration on the Direction of Bilateral Cooperation between the People's Republic of China and the Islamic Republic of Pakistan issued by the two heads of state in November 2003, as well as with the signing and entry into force of the Treaty of Good-Neighborliness, Friendship and Cooperation between the People's Republic of China and the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意，两国领导人将保持高层互访和接触，就重大国际和地区问题以及双边关系举行经常性的磋商与协调，为促进两国以及本地区的稳定与繁荣做出不懈努力。
Translation: The two sides agreed that their leaders will maintain high-level visits and contacts, conduct regular consultations and coordination on major international and regional issues as well as bilateral relations, and make unremitting efforts to promote stability and prosperity in both countries and the region.

Query_Text_cn: 六、穆沙拉夫总统代表巴基斯坦政府和人民感谢中国政府和人民在巴基斯坦发生地震灾害后所提供的紧急物资和人道主义援助，认为中方的无私援助体现了巴中之间患难与共的真挚情意。
Translation: VI. President Musharraf, on behalf of the Government and people of Pakistan, expressed gratitude to the Chinese Government and people for the emergency supplies and humanitarian assistance provided after the earthquake disaster in Pakistan. He stated that China's selfless aid reflects the sincere bond of sharing weal and woe between Pakistan and China.

Query_Text_cn: 胡锦涛主席表示中方将积极参与巴灾区重建，帮助灾区人民早日重建家园。
Translation: President Hu Jintao stated that China would actively participate in the reconstruction of the disaster-stricken areas in Pakistan to help the affected people rebuild their homes at an early date.

Query_Text_cn: 七、双方决心以庆祝建交55周年为契机，把中巴关系推向更新、更高的水平。
Translation: VII. The two sides are determined to take the opportunity of the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations to elevate China-Brazil relations to a new and higher level.

Query_Text_cn: 双方商定在今年内举办“文化周”、“电影周”、媒体互访、学术交流等活动。
Translation: The two sides agreed to hold a series of activities within this year, including "Cultural Weeks," "Film Weeks," media exchanges, and academic interactions.

Query_Text_cn: 八、双方决心进一步加强各领域的互利合作，认为经贸合作不仅是中巴睦邻友好合作关系的重要组成部分，也是中巴两国共同利益的纽带。
Translation: VIII. The two sides are determined to further strengthen mutually beneficial cooperation in all fields. They believe that economic and trade cooperation is not only an important part of the good-neighborly and friendly cooperative relations between China and Pakistan, but also a bond of common interests between the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意继续探讨扩大和深化两国经贸合作的新途径和新方式，实现共同发展，造福于两国和两国人民。
Translation: The two sides agreed to continue exploring new pathways and approaches to expand and deepen bilateral economic and trade cooperation, achieving common development for the benefit of both countries and their peoples.

Query_Text_cn: 九、双方对实施中巴自贸区“早期收获计划”表示满意，同意加快“自由贸易协定”谈判进程。
Translation: IX. Both sides expressed satisfaction with the implementation of the "Early Harvest Program" under the China-Pakistan Free Trade Area and agreed to accelerate the negotiation process for the "Free Trade Agreement."

Query_Text_cn: 双方重视利用喀喇昆仑公路促进两国陆路贸易，并愿采取措施提供便利。
Translation: Both sides attach importance to leveraging the Karakoram Highway to enhance bilateral overland trade and are willing to take measures to facilitate it.

Query_Text_cn: 十、双方还对中国帮助巴基斯坦开发各类经济项目取得进展深感满意。这些项目包括瓜达港、山达克铜金矿、杜达铅锌矿等。
Translation: 10. Both sides also expressed great satisfaction with the progress made in China's assistance to Pakistan in developing various economic projects, including the Gwadar Port, Saindak Copper-Gold Mine, and Duddar Lead-Zinc Mine.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意鼓励企业间的合作，包括建立合资企业，支持早日启动扩大经济和贸易领域合作的联合研究。
Translation: Both sides agreed to encourage cooperation between enterprises, including the establishment of joint ventures, and support the early launch of joint research to expand collaboration in economic and trade fields.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意两国金融机构成立中巴联合投资公司。
Translation: Both sides agreed to establish a China-Pakistan joint investment company by financial institutions of the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 双方还原则同意合作改扩建中巴喀喇昆仑公路。
Translation: The two sides also agreed in principle to cooperate on the renovation and expansion of the China-Pakistan Karakoram Highway.

Query_Text_cn: 双方特别强调重视农业合作，尤其是农产品加工业、农药、滴水灌溉和渔业方面的合作。
Translation: Both sides particularly emphasized the importance of agricultural cooperation, especially in areas such as agro-processing, pesticides, drip irrigation, and fisheries.

Query_Text_cn: 双方还签署了关于扩大和深化双边经济贸易合作的框架协议。
Translation: The two sides also signed a framework agreement on expanding and deepening bilateral economic and trade cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 十一、双方同意加强能源领域合作，并签署了内容广泛的《中巴能源领域合作框架协议》。
Translation: 11. The two sides agreed to enhance cooperation in the energy sector and signed the China-Pakistan Framework Agreement on Energy Cooperation with extensive coverage.

Query_Text_cn: 巴方表示对修建炼油厂、天然气终端、油气储备和转运设施有兴趣。
Translation: The Pakistani side expressed interest in building oil refineries, natural gas terminals, and oil and gas storage and transshipment facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 中方欢迎上述提议，并同意协助巴发展油气产业。
Translation: China welcomes the above proposal and agrees to assist Pakistan in developing its oil and gas industry.

Query_Text_cn: 十二、双方对恰希玛核电站一期工程的运行以及二期的开工和建设表示满意，同意继续加强在和平利用核能方面的合作。
Translation: 12. The two sides expressed satisfaction with the operation of the first phase of the Chashma Nuclear Power Plant and the commencement and construction of the second phase, and agreed to continue strengthening cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy.

Query_Text_cn: 十三、双方十分重视进一步扩大社会领域合作，包括卫生、人力资源开发、教育、职业培训等领域。
Translation: 13. The two sides attach great importance to further expanding cooperation in social fields, including health, human resources development, education and vocational training.

Query_Text_cn: 十四、双方同意加强在高科技领域的合作，包括和平利用空间技术的合作。
Translation: 14. The two sides agreed to enhance cooperation in the high-tech sector, including the peaceful use of space technology.

Query_Text_cn: 双方还同意有关地球、海洋和空间科学的学术机构之间开展更紧密的联系，推动相关技术在工农业领域的应用。
Translation: Both sides also agreed to foster closer ties between academic institutions in earth, ocean and space sciences, and promote the application of related technologies in industrial and agricultural sectors.

Query_Text_cn: 双方还同意开展在地震、地质和南极等领域的科研合作。
Translation: The two sides also agreed to conduct scientific research cooperation in fields such as seismology, geology, and Antarctica.

Query_Text_cn: 十五、中方重申尊重巴基斯坦的独立、主权和领土完整，赞赏并支持巴基斯坦为促进南亚和平与稳定、扞卫国家主权和独立所做的一切努力。
Translation: 15. China reiterates its respect for Pakistan’s independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity, and appreciates and supports all efforts by Pakistan to promote peace and stability in South Asia and uphold its national sovereignty and independence.

Query_Text_cn: 巴方重申继续坚定奉行一个中国的政策，承认中华人民共和国政府是代表全中国的唯一合法政府，台湾是中国领土不可分割的一部分。
Translation: The Pakistani side reaffirms its continued and steadfast adherence to the One-China policy, recognizing the government of the People's Republic of China as the sole legal government representing the whole of China, and Taiwan as an inalienable part of China's territory.

Query_Text_cn: 巴方反对“台湾独立”，完全支持中国的和平统一大业。
Translation: Pakistan opposes "Taiwan independence" and fully supports China's peaceful reunification cause.

Query_Text_cn: 十六、双方全面讨论了国际和地区形势，重申坚决反对一切形式的恐怖主义，反对大规模杀伤性武器及其运载工具的扩散，努力维护国际和平与稳定。
Translation: 16. The two sides had an in-depth discussion on the international and regional situation. They reaffirmed their firm opposition to all forms of terrorism and to the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction and their means of delivery, and their commitment to upholding international peace and stability.

Query_Text_cn: 双方一致认为，联合国改革旨在维护联合国的权威和团结，应当优先重视发展问题。
Translation: Both sides agreed that the reform of the United Nations aims to uphold its authority and unity, with priority given to addressing development issues.

Query_Text_cn: 安理会改革应充分考虑广大会员国的利益，通过广泛和深入协商，找到各方均能接受的解决办法。
Translation: The Security Council reform should fully accommodate the interests of the broad membership and identify a solution acceptable to all through extensive and in-depth consultations.

Query_Text_cn: 十七、巴方欢迎中国成为“南亚区域合作联盟”（SAARC）的观察员。
Translation: 17. Pakistan welcomes China's accession as an observer to the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC).

Query_Text_cn: 中方欢迎巴基斯坦成为“上海合作组织”（SCO）的观察员，并邀请巴方出席今年6月在上海举行的“上海合作组织”峰会。
Translation: China welcomes Pakistan's status as an observer to the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) and has invited Pakistan to attend the SCO Summit to be held in Shanghai in June this year.

Query_Text_cn: 双方表示支持亚洲区域合作进程，并认为需要促进不同地区间的合作。
Translation: Both sides expressed support for the process of regional cooperation in Asia and recognized the need to promote collaboration among different regions.

Query_Text_cn: 十八、访问期间，双方分别签署了《中华人民共和国政府和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国政府关于扩大和深化双边经济贸易合作的协定》、《中华人民共和国国防部和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国国防部合作框架协议》、《中华人民共和国国家发展和改革委员会和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国石油和自然资源部关于能源领域合作框架协议》、《中华人民共和国劳动和社会保障部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国劳动、人力和海外巴侨部在职业培训领域的合作谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国交通部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国交通部关于改造喀喇昆仑公路的合作谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国农业部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国食品、农业和畜牧业部关于渔业合作的谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国农业部与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国食品、农业和畜牧业部关于在农药管理领域开展合作的谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国商务部和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国商务部关于启动双边经贸合作五年规划联合研究的谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国卫生部和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国卫生部卫生领域合作谅解备忘录》、《关于中华人民共和国国家人口和计划生育委员会与巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国人口福利部之间合作的备忘录》、《中华人民共和国地震局和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国气象局关于在地震研究领域合作的谅解备忘录》、《中华人民共和国中国气象局和巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国巴基斯坦气象局气象科技合作谅解备忘录》、《中国进出口银行与巴基斯坦经济事务和统计部关于中华人民共和国政府向巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国政府提供3亿美元优惠出口买方信贷的总协议》。
Translation: 18. Query_Text_cn: 十九、穆沙拉夫总统邀请胡锦涛主席今年访问巴基斯坦并参加庆祝建交55周年活动。
Translation: 19. President Musharraf invited President Hu Jintao to visit Pakistan this year and attend the celebrations marking the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 胡锦涛主席对此表示感谢。
Translation: President Hu Jintao expressed his gratitude for this.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国与孟加拉人民共和国联合声明（2010年3月19日）应中华人民共和国国务院总理温家宝的邀请，孟加拉人民共和国政府总理谢赫·哈西娜于二0一0年三月十七日至二十一日对中国进行正式访问。
Translation: Joint Statement of the People's Republic of China and the People's Republic of Bangladesh (March 19, 2010) At the invitation of H.E. Wen Jiabao, Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, H.E. Sheikh Hasina, Prime Minister of the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, paid an official visit to China from March 17 to 21, 2010.

Query_Text_cn: 访问期间，国家主席胡锦涛和全国人大常委会委员长吴邦国会见了哈西娜总理，温家宝总理同哈西娜总理举行了会谈。
Translation: During the visit, President Hu Jintao and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Wu Bangguo met with Prime Minister Hasina, while Premier Wen Jiabao held talks with her.

Query_Text_cn: 两国领导人就中孟关系以及共同关心的国际和地区问题深入交换意见并达成共识，同意进一步推动双边关系发展，合作应对全球性挑战。
Translation: The leaders of the two countries had an in-depth exchange of views and reached consensus on China-Bangladesh relations as well as international and regional issues of mutual interest. They agreed to further advance bilateral relations and cooperate in addressing global challenges.

Query_Text_cn: 一、双方回顾了中孟建交35年来两国关系发展历程，高度评价两国在政治、经济、社会、文化等各领域开展的富有成果的合作。
Translation: I. The two sides reviewed the development of bilateral relations over the 35 years since the establishment of diplomatic ties between China and Bangladesh, and spoke highly of the fruitful cooperation in various fields including politics, economy, society and culture.

Query_Text_cn: 双方一致认为，中孟两国人民之间的友好关系源远流长，两国历届领导人为推动中孟关系发展作出了重要贡献。
Translation: Both sides agreed that the friendly relations between the peoples of China and Bangladesh have a long history, and successive leaders of the two countries have made important contributions to advancing the development of bilateral relations.

Query_Text_cn: 双方认为，进一步巩固和加强两国友好合作，符合中孟两国的根本利益和两国人民的共同愿望，有利于本地区乃至世界的和平与发展。
Translation: Both sides believe that further consolidating and strengthening the friendly cooperation between the two countries serves the fundamental interests of China and Bangladesh as well as the common aspirations of their peoples, and contributes to peace and development in the region and beyond.

Query_Text_cn: 双方决定，从战略高度出发，本着长期友好、平等互利的原则，建立和发展中孟更加紧密的全面合作伙伴关系。
Translation: The two sides decided to establish and develop a closer comprehensive partnership of cooperation between China and Bangladesh from a strategic perspective and in the spirit of long-term friendship and mutual benefit on the basis of equality.

Query_Text_cn: 双方注意到2010年10月4日是中孟建交35周年纪念日，同意将在北京和达卡分别举行形式多样的纪念活动，以庆祝中孟建交35周年为契机，推动两国业已存在的友好关系进一步发展。
Translation: The two sides noted that October 4, 2010 marks the 35th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Bangladesh. They agreed to hold various commemorative activities in Beijing and Dhaka respectively to celebrate this occasion and further advance the existing friendly relations between the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 二、双方同意，保持两国高层互访和接触，加强两国政府各部门、议会、政党、军队及民间团体之间的友好交往，促进两国地方政府间的交流与合作。
Translation: II. The two sides agreed to maintain mutual visits and contacts between their top leaders, strengthen friendly exchanges between various departments, legislatures, political parties, militaries, and non-governmental groups of the two countries, and promote exchanges and cooperation between local governments.

Query_Text_cn: 加强两国外交磋商、经贸联委会、农业联委会等合作机制。
Translation: Strengthen bilateral cooperation mechanisms such as diplomatic consultations, joint economic and trade commissions, and joint agricultural commissions.

Query_Text_cn: 三、双方深信，经贸合作是中孟全面合作伙伴关系的重要组成部分。
Translation: III. Both sides firmly believe that economic and trade cooperation constitutes a vital component of the comprehensive partnership between China and Bangladesh.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意，在平等互利的基础上，进一步加强在贸易、投资、农业、交通、基础设施建设等领域的合作。
Translation: Both sides agreed to further enhance cooperation in trade, investment, agriculture, transportation, infrastructure construction, and other fields on the basis of equality and mutual benefit.

Query_Text_cn: （一）双方将采取积极措施扩大双边贸易，努力缓解贸易不平衡问题。
Translation: 1) The two sides will take proactive measures to expand bilateral trade and endeavor to mitigate trade imbalances.

Query_Text_cn: 中方将向更多孟商品提供关税优惠，继续开展双边投资贸易促进活动。
Translation: China will grant tariff preferences to more Bangladeshi products and continue to promote bilateral investment and trade activities.

Query_Text_cn: 孟方表示，将推动孟企业积极参加2010年上海世博会和在中国举行的商品交易会等活动，促进孟对华出口。
Translation: The Bangladeshi side expressed its commitment to encouraging Bangladeshi enterprises to actively participate in events such as the 2010 Shanghai World Expo and trade fairs held in China, so as to boost Bangladesh's exports to China.

Query_Text_cn: （二）中方承诺将继续向孟加拉国提供力所能及的援助，支持孟经济社会发展。
Translation: (2) China pledges to continue providing assistance within its capacity to Bangladesh in support of its economic and social development.

Query_Text_cn: 孟方对此表示衷心感谢。
Translation: The Bangladeshi side expressed heartfelt gratitude for this.

Query_Text_cn: 双方签署了《中华人民共和国政府和孟加拉人民共和国政府经济技术合作协定》、《中华人民共和国政府和孟加拉人民共和国政府关于提供优惠贷款的框架协议》、《中国政府同意承担在孟加拉国卡兹尔特克承建中孟友谊七桥的换文》。
Translation: The two sides signed the Agreement on Economic and Technical Cooperation between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, the Framework Agreement on the Provision of Concessional Loans between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, and the Exchange of Notes on the Chinese Government's Agreement to Undertake the Construction of the Seventh China-Bangladesh Friendship Bridge at Kazirtek in Bangladesh.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意加紧工作，落实中孟友谊展览中心等项目相关技术问题。
Translation: The two sides agreed to intensify efforts to address technical issues related to projects such as the China-Bangladesh Friendship Exhibition Center.

Query_Text_cn: （三）双方鼓励和支持各自企业进行双向投资和互利合作，为双方企业开展工程项目和劳务合作创造便利条件。
Translation: (3) Both sides encourage and support their respective enterprises in conducting two-way investment and mutually beneficial cooperation, and will create favorable conditions for their enterprises to carry out project contracting and labor cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 孟方欢迎中国企业积极参与孟加拉国能源、通讯、交通、工业、基础设施等领域建设。
Translation: The Bangladeshi side welcomes Chinese enterprises' active participation in the construction of energy, telecommunications, transportation, industrial, and infrastructure sectors in Bangladesh.

Query_Text_cn: 中方鼓励和支持有实力、资质好的中资企业赴孟探讨和开展上述领域的投资合作，并尽力为双方商定的合作项目提供便利和融资支持。
Translation: China encourages and supports capable and qualified Chinese enterprises to explore and engage in investment cooperation with Bangladesh in the aforementioned sectors, and will make every effort to facilitate and provide financing support for mutually agreed cooperation projects.

Query_Text_cn: 此次访问期间，中国石油天然气集团公司与孟加拉国油气矿产公司及孟加拉国石油公司签署了《石油天然气领域合作谅解备忘录》。
Translation: During this visit, China National Petroleum Corporation signed a Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Oil and Gas Sector with Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation and Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation.

Query_Text_cn: （四）双方同意加强两国交通联系，继续探讨建设连接中国和孟加拉国公路的可能性。
Translation: (IV) The two sides agreed to enhance transport connectivity between the two countries and continue exploring the possibility of building a highway linking China and Bangladesh.

Query_Text_cn: 加强两国农业科技与管理人员的交流，进一步探讨扩大农业合作的具体途径和方式。
Translation: Strengthen exchanges between agricultural scientists and management personnel of the two countries, and further explore specific pathways and methods to expand agricultural cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: （六）鉴于开展雅鲁藏布江/布拉马普特拉河水文报汛和防洪减灾领域的合作对孟防洪减灾十分必要，双方同意在该领域进行持续合作。
Translation: (6) Recognizing that cooperation in hydrological data-sharing and flood disaster mitigation on the Yarlung Zangbo/Brahmaputra River is essential for Bangladesh's flood prevention efforts, both sides agree to sustain collaboration in this area.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意根据2005年中孟两国水利部关于加强在防洪和水资源领域合作换函的精神，继续加强在水资源管理、水文报汛和防洪减灾领域的合作。
Translation: Both sides agreed to continue strengthening cooperation in water resources management, hydrological forecasting, and flood prevention and disaster reduction, in line with the spirit of the 2005 exchange of letters between the water resources ministries of China and Bangladesh on enhancing collaboration in flood control and water resources.

Query_Text_cn: 应孟方要求，中方同意向孟提供疏浚河道和人员培训方面的援助。
Translation: At Bangladesh's request, China has agreed to provide assistance in river dredging and personnel training.

Query_Text_cn: （七）孟方表示希望中方在不久的将来为其发射一颗通讯卫星。
Translation: (7) The Bangladeshi side expressed its hope that China would launch a communications satellite for it in the near future.

Query_Text_cn: 中方表示愿在该领域同孟方开展合作。
Translation: China expressed its willingness to cooperate with Bangladesh in this field.

Query_Text_cn: 四、为纪念两国建交35周年，双方同意进一步加强两国在人文领域的交流与合作，增进两国人民之间的相互理解和友谊。
Translation: IV. In commemoration of the 35th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries, both sides agreed to further strengthen exchanges and cooperation in cultural and people-to-people fields, enhancing mutual understanding and friendship between their peoples.

Query_Text_cn: （一）中国人民对外友好协会与孟中人民友好协会将于2010年共同举办“中孟友好光明行”活动，由中国医疗专家赴孟为孟白内障患者提供免费治疗。
Translation: (i) The Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries and the Bangladesh-China People's Friendship Association will jointly organize the "China-Bangladesh Friendship Brightness Action" in 2010, during which Chinese medical experts will provide free treatment for Bangladeshi cataract patients.

Query_Text_cn: （二）中方将继续为孟方提供政府奖学金名额，同时也欢迎孟加拉国学生通过其他渠道和项目来华深造。
Translation: (2) China will continue to provide Bangladeshi students with government scholarship quotas and welcomes them to pursue further studies in China through other channels and programs.

Query_Text_cn: 中方同意考虑每年向孟方提供中国政府奖学金，供孟青年外交官来华学习。
Translation: China agrees to consider providing the Bangladeshi side with Chinese government scholarships annually for young Bangladeshi diplomats to study in China.

Query_Text_cn: 应孟方要求，中方同意考虑视情逐步增加向孟提供的奖学金名额。
Translation: At the request of Bangladesh, China has agreed to consider gradually increasing the number of scholarships offered to Bangladeshi students based on actual circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将进一步加强在汉语教学、人力资源培训等领域的交流与合作。
Translation: The two sides will further enhance exchanges and cooperation in areas such as Chinese language teaching and human resources training.

Query_Text_cn: （三）双方将积极扩大在文化、新闻、卫生、体育、旅游等领域的交流与合作，推动两国媒体、智库、学者、友好团体、妇女组织、艺术团、运动员、青年等的交流。
Translation: (3) The two sides will actively expand exchanges and cooperation in such fields as culture, press, health, sports and tourism, and promote exchanges between media outlets, think tanks, scholars, friendship associations, women's organizations, art troupes, athletes and youth of the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 五、双方同意考虑商签双边领事协定。双方将通过外交渠道进行探讨。
Translation: V. Both sides agreed to consider negotiating and signing a bilateral consular agreement. The two sides will conduct discussions through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意适时建立双边领事磋商机制，以便共同探讨双方关心的签证等领事问题。
Translation: The two sides agreed to establish a bilateral consular consultation mechanism at an appropriate time to jointly address consular issues of mutual concern, such as visa matters.

Query_Text_cn: 六、双方同意继续加强两国军队和执法部门的交流与合作，维护各自国家的安全和稳定，并促进本地区的和平与稳定。
Translation: VI. Both sides agreed to further enhance exchanges and cooperation between their militaries and law enforcement agencies to safeguard the security and stability of their respective countries and promote peace and stability in the region.

Query_Text_cn: 七、中方重申，尊重孟加拉国的独立、主权和领土完整，支持孟加拉国为维护国家稳定和促进社会发展所作的努力。
Translation: VII. The Chinese side reiterates its respect for Bangladesh's independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity and supports Bangladesh's efforts to safeguard national stability and promote social development.

Query_Text_cn: 孟方重申，世界上只有一个中国，中华人民共和国政府是代表全中国的唯一合法政府，台湾和西藏是中国领土不可分割的一部分。
Translation: The Bangladeshi side reaffirmed that there is only one China in the world, the government of the People's Republic of China is the sole legal government representing the whole of China, and that Taiwan and Tibet are inalienable parts of China's territory.

Query_Text_cn: 孟方重申支持中方为维护国家主权、统一和领土完整所作的努力。
Translation: The Bangladeshi side reiterated its support for China's efforts to safeguard national sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity.

Query_Text_cn: 八、双方同意继续加强在区域合作中的沟通与协调。
Translation: 8. The two sides agreed to continue strengthening communication and coordination in regional cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 中方赞赏孟方为推动南亚区域合作所作的积极努力。
Translation: China appreciates Bangladesh's positive efforts in promoting regional cooperation in South Asia.

Query_Text_cn: 孟方支持中国与南盟加强合作的努力。
Translation: Bangladesh supports China's efforts to enhance cooperation with SAARC.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意继续积极参与和推进孟中印缅地区经济合作进程。
Translation: Both sides agreed to continue actively participating in and advancing the economic cooperation process in the Bangladesh-China-India-Myanmar region.

Query_Text_cn: 九、双方认为，中孟在应对国际金融危机、气候变化、能源和粮食安全以及其他涉及发展中国家诉求和挑战的重大国际问题上立场相同或相近。
Translation: IX. Both sides believe that China and Bangladesh share similar or identical positions on major international issues such as addressing the global financial crisis, climate change, energy and food security, as well as other matters concerning the demands and challenges of developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意，继续就此保持密切协调与配合，维护中孟两国和广大发展中国家的共同利益。
Translation: The two sides agreed to continue close coordination and cooperation in this regard to uphold the common interests of China, Bangladesh and the broader developing world.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意于年内适时举行气候变化问题磋商。
Translation: The two sides agreed to hold consultations on climate change at an appropriate time within the year.

Query_Text_cn: 中方将支持孟加拉国加强应对气候变化的能力。
Translation: China will support Bangladesh in enhancing its capacity to address climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 十、哈西娜总理对访华期间受到的热情友好接待深表感谢，诚挚地邀请中国领导人在双方方便的时候正式访问孟加拉国。
Translation: 10. Prime Minister Hasina expressed her deep gratitude for the warm and friendly hospitality extended during her visit to China and sincerely invited Chinese leaders to pay an official visit to Bangladesh at a mutually convenient time.

Query_Text_cn: 中国领导人对此表示感谢，并愉快地接受了邀请。
Translation: The Chinese leader expressed gratitude and gladly accepted the invitation.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国和塔吉克斯坦共和国关于进一步发展睦邻友好合作关系的联合声明应塔吉克斯坦共和国总统埃莫马利·拉赫蒙邀请，中华人民共和国主席胡锦涛于2008年8月26日至27日对塔吉克斯坦共和国进行了国事访问。
Translation:
Joint Statement of the People's Republic of China and the Republic of Tajikistan on Further Developing Good-Neighborly and Friendly Cooperation  

At the invitation of President Emomali Rahmon of the Republic of Tajikistan, President Hu Jintao of the People's Republic of China paid a state visit to the Republic of Tajikistan from August 26 to 27, 2008.

Query_Text_cn: 一、中华人民共和国和塔吉克斯坦共和国（以下简称“双方”）一致认为，2007年1月15日两国元首签署的《中华人民共和国和塔吉克斯坦共和国睦邻友好合作条约》具有重要的历史和现实意义，为中塔关系长期稳定健康发展奠定了坚实的法律基础。
Translation: I. The People's Republic of China and the Republic of Tajikistan (hereinafter referred to as "the two sides") agree that the Treaty of Good-Neighborliness, Friendship and Cooperation between the People's Republic of China and the Republic of Tajikistan, signed by the heads of state of the two countries on January 15, 2007, is of great historical and practical significance, and has laid a solid legal foundation for the long-term, stable and healthy development of China-Tajikistan relations.

Query_Text_cn: 双方决心恪守条约确定的方针和原则，认真落实两国建交以来签署的所有双边政治文件，推动中塔睦邻友好合作关系不断向前发展。
Translation: Both sides are determined to adhere to the principles and guidelines set forth in the treaty, fully implement all bilateral political documents signed since the establishment of diplomatic relations, and promote the continuous advancement of the good-neighborly friendship and cooperative relations between China and Tajikistan.

Query_Text_cn: 二、两国元首高度评价中塔睦邻友好合作关系发展现状，认为两国各领域合作快速发展，给两国人民带来实际利益。
Translation: II. The two heads of state spoke highly of the current state of China-Tajikistan good-neighborly, friendly and cooperative relations. They noted that the rapid growth of bilateral cooperation in various fields has brought tangible benefits to the two peoples.

Query_Text_cn: 双方强调，将保持经常性的高层互访，就双边关系和国际局势的重大问题及时交换意见。
Translation: Both sides emphasized the importance of maintaining regular high-level exchanges and promptly exchanging views on major issues concerning bilateral relations and the international situation.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将进一步密切两国政府和各部门之间的联系，扩大和深化两国政治、经贸、安全、人文等各领域的交流与合作，不断提升中塔睦邻友好合作关系水平。
Translation: The two sides will further strengthen the ties between their governments and various departments, expand and deepen exchanges and cooperation in political, economic, trade, security, cultural, and other fields, and continuously elevate the level of China-Tajikistan good-neighborly and friendly cooperative relations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、双方将进一步支持中国全国人民代表大会与塔吉克斯坦议会以及各专门委员会和友好小组间的交流与合作，不断完善双边关系法律基础，巩固传统友谊，加深两国人民的相互理解。
Translation: 3. The two sides will further support exchanges and cooperation between the National People's Congress of China and the Parliament of Tajikistan, as well as between their specialized committees and friendship groups, with a view to continuously improving the legal foundation of bilateral relations, consolidating traditional friendship, and deepening mutual understanding between the two peoples.

Query_Text_cn: 四、双方重申，中塔国界划定具有重要意义。
Translation: IV. Both sides reaffirmed the significance of the demarcation of the China-Tajikistan boundary.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将严格遵守两国签订的所有关于边界问题的协定和文件，并决心在两国边境地区保持永久和平和世代友好。
Translation: Both sides shall strictly abide by all agreements and documents signed between the two countries concerning the boundary issue and are determined to maintain lasting peace and friendship between generations in the border areas.

Query_Text_cn: 五、双方表示，将继续在涉及彼此国家主权和领土完整的重大问题上相互支持。
Translation: V. Both sides expressed their commitment to continuing mutual support on major issues concerning each other's national sovereignty and territorial integrity.

Query_Text_cn: 塔方重申坚定奉行一个中国政策，承认中华人民共和国政府是代表全中国的唯一合法政府，台湾是中国领土不可分割的一部分。
Translation: The Tajik side reaffirmed its firm commitment to the one-China policy, recognizing the government of the People's Republic of China as the sole legal government representing the whole of China, and Taiwan as an inalienable part of China's territory.

Query_Text_cn: 不与台湾建立和开展任何形式的官方关系和往来。
Translation: We do not establish or conduct any form of official relations or exchanges with Taiwan.

Query_Text_cn: 塔方支持中国政府为实现国家统一所做的一切努力，认为台湾问题是中国的内政，外部势力无权干涉。
Translation: The Tajik side supports all efforts made by the Chinese government to achieve national reunification and considers the Taiwan issue as China's internal affair, in which no external forces have the right to interfere.

Query_Text_cn: 中方对塔方这一原则立场表示高度赞赏，重申支持塔方为维护国家独立、主权和领土完整以及为维护国内稳定、发展民族经济所做的努力。
Translation: The Chinese side highly appreciates this principled position of the Tajik side and reiterates its support for the efforts made by the Tajik side to safeguard national independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity and maintain domestic stability and develop the national economy.

Query_Text_cn: 六、双方认为，打击“东突”恐怖势力是国际反恐斗争的重要组成部分。
Translation: VI. Both sides believe that combating the "East Turkistan" terrorist forces is an important part of the international fight against terrorism.

Query_Text_cn: 双方表示将根据《中华人民共和国和塔吉克斯坦共和国关于打击恐怖主义、分裂主义和极端主义的合作协定》和《打击恐怖主义、分裂主义和极端主义上海公约》的规定，继续在安全领域开展密切合作，采取有力措施，共同打击包括“东突”恐怖势力在内的一切形式的恐怖主义，以维护两国和本地区的和平、安宁与稳定。
Translation: Both sides expressed their commitment to continue close cooperation in the field of security in accordance with the Agreement on Cooperation Between the People's Republic of China and the Republic of Tajikistan on Combating Terrorism,Separatism and Extremism and the Shanghai Convention on Combating Terrorism,Separatism and Extremism. They pledged to take robust measures to jointly combat all forms of terrorism,including the "East Turkestan" terrorist forces,so as to safeguard peace,security and stability in both countries and the region.

Query_Text_cn: 七、双方认为，毒品犯罪严重威胁地区各国的社会稳定和国家安全，将进一步加强协调与配合，采取有效措施打击包括毒品生产、非法贩运在内的各种形式的毒品犯罪活动。
Translation:
VII，这是根据您的要求翻译的英文版本：

VII. The two sides consider drug crimes a serious threat to social stability and national security of countries in the region, and will further strengthen coordination and cooperation to take effective measures in combating drug-related crimes in all forms, including drug production and illicit trafficking.

Query_Text_cn: 八、中方高度评价并感谢塔方在汶川特大地震灾害后表达的同情和慰问以及向中方提供资金和物资援助，帮助灾区人民抗震救灾和灾后重建。
Translation: VIII. China highly commends and appreciates the sympathy and condolences expressed by Tajikistan and the financial and material assistance it provided to China after the Wenchuan earthquake. This support helped the people in the disaster-stricken areas with earthquake relief and post-disaster reconstruction.

Query_Text_cn: 九、塔方对中国成功举办2008年北京奥运会表示祝贺，认为这是中国为推动国际奥林匹克事业发展、推动建设和谐世界做出的巨大贡献。
Translation: IX. The Tajik side congratulated China on the successful hosting of the Beijing Olympic Games in 2008, and considered it a significant contribution by China to advancing the development of international Olympic endeavors and promoting the building of a harmonious world.

Query_Text_cn: 十、双方认为，加强双边经贸合作对全面推进两国关系发展具有重要意义。
Translation: X. Both sides believe that strengthening bilateral economic and trade cooperation is of great significance to the comprehensive advancement of bilateral relations.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意加强两国政府间经贸合作委员会的工作，进一步优化贸易结构，促进经济技术合作，改善贸易投资环境，在平等互利的基础上扩大在交通、通信、采矿和加工、农业、基础设施建设等领域的合作。
Translation: The two sides agreed to enhance the work of the intergovernmental economic and trade cooperation committee, further optimize the trade structure, promote economic and technological cooperation, improve the trade and investment environment, and expand cooperation in transportation, communications, mining and processing, agriculture, infrastructure construction, and other fields on the basis of equality and mutual benefit.

Query_Text_cn: 十一、双方将继续挖掘公路交通运输和过境运输合作潜力，提高口岸接运能力，在公路、铁路和航空运输方面相互提供便利。
Translation: 11. The two sides will continue to tap the potential of cooperation in road transport and transit transportation, enhance the capacity of port transshipment, and provide mutual facilitation in road, rail and air transport.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将在平等互利基础上实行鼓励边境贸易的政策，促进边境地区的务实合作。
Translation: The two sides will implement policies to encourage border trade on the basis of equality and mutual benefit, promoting practical cooperation in border areas.

Query_Text_cn: 十二、双方将根据各自法律为在对方国家从事投资贸易活动和经济技术合作创造便利条件，保护对方国家公民的人身、财产安全和合法权益。
Translation: 12. Both sides shall, in accordance with their respective laws, create favorable conditions for investment, trade activities, and economic and technological cooperation in each other's country, and protect the personal and property safety as well as the lawful rights and interests of each other's citizens.

Query_Text_cn: 十三、双方将进一步扩大教育、文化、科技、新闻、旅游、体育、卫生、社会保障等领域的交流与合作，支持两国高等院校、科研机构、青年和民间友好组织之间的交流与合作。
Translation: 13. The two sides will further expand exchanges and cooperation in education, culture, science and technology, news, tourism, sports, health, social security and other fields, and support exchanges and cooperation between higher education institutions, research institutes, youth and non-governmental friendship organizations of the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 十四、双方认为，当前，上海合作组织发展势头良好，已成为在互信、互利基础上深化成员国睦邻关系的重要平台，对促进中亚地区稳定、推动成员国共同发展发挥着重要的建设性作用。
Translation: 14. The two sides believe that the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) is enjoying a sound momentum of growth and has become an important platform for deepening good-neighborly relations among member states on the basis of mutual trust and mutual benefit. It plays an important and constructive role in promoting stability in Central Asia and common development of member states.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将继续共同努力，不断深化上海合作组织框架内安全、经济和人文等领域的务实合作。
Translation: Both sides will continue to work together to deepen practical cooperation in security, economy, and cultural exchanges within the framework of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 十五、双方强调，中亚国家有独特的历史文化传统，国际社会应尊重中亚各国人民根据本国国情自主选择的发展道路。
Translation: 15. The two sides stressed that Central Asian countries have unique historical and cultural traditions, and the international community should respect the development paths independently chosen by the people of Central Asian countries in light of their national conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 中亚各国的稳定与安全、经济的持续发展和社会的不断进步，符合本地区各国人民的共同意愿和根本利益。
Translation: The stability and security of Central Asian countries, along with their sustained economic development and continuous social progress, align with the common aspirations and fundamental interests of the peoples in the region.

Query_Text_cn: 中方高度评价塔方为促进中亚地区安全、稳定与发展所做的努力。
Translation: China highly commends Tajikistan's efforts to promote security, stability, and development in the Central Asian region.

Query_Text_cn: 十六、双方指出，双方在一系列重大国际和地区问题上立场相同或相近，强调将进一步加强两国在联合国及其他国际组织框架内的合作。
Translation: 16. The two sides noted that they share the same or similar positions on a series of major international and regional issues, and stressed the need to further strengthen bilateral cooperation within the framework of the United Nations and other international organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将恪守《联合国宪章》的宗旨和原则以及其他公认的国际法准则，并在此基础上推动建立互信、互利、平等、协作的新安全架构。
Translation: Both sides will adhere to the purposes and principles of the UN Charter and other universally recognized norms of international law, and on this basis, promote the establishment of a new security architecture featuring mutual trust, mutual benefit, equality, and coordination.

Query_Text_cn: 双方主张通过和平方式解决国际争端，充分发挥联合国在维护世界和平与安全方面的主导作用，尊重世界文明多样性和发展模式多样化，推动建设持久和平、共同繁荣的和谐世界。
Translation: Both sides advocate for the peaceful resolution of international disputes, fully leveraging the leading role of the United Nations in maintaining world peace and security. They respect the diversity of world civilizations and development models, and are committed to building a harmonious world of lasting peace and shared prosperity.

Query_Text_cn: 十七、中华人民共和国主席胡锦涛对塔吉克斯坦共和国总统埃莫马利·拉赫蒙和塔吉克斯坦共和国政府给予中方代表团的热情友好接待表示感谢，并邀请塔吉克斯坦共和国总统埃莫马利·拉赫蒙对中华人民共和国进行正式友好访问。
Translation: 17. H.E. Hu Jintao, President of the People's Republic of China, expressed his gratitude to H.E. Emomali Rahmon, President of the Republic of Tajikistan, and the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan for the warm and friendly hospitality extended to the Chinese delegation. He also extended an invitation to H.E. Emomali Rahmon, President of the Republic of Tajikistan, to pay an official and friendly visit to the People's Republic of China.

Query_Text_cn: 拉赫蒙总统愉快地接受了邀请。
Translation: President Rahmon gladly accepted the invitation.

Query_Text_cn: 访问日期将通过外交渠道商定。
Translation: The date of the visit will be determined through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 3、保证根据本公约所进行的收养得到缔约国的承认。
Translation: 3. Ensure that adoptions conducted under this Convention are recognized by the Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条1、本公约适用于惯常居住在一缔约国（原住国）的儿童在该国被惯常居住在另一缔约国（收养国）的夫妻或个人收养以后，或者为在原住国或收养国进行此收养的目的，已经、正在或将要被移送到收养国的案件。
Translation: Article 2(1) This Convention applies where a child habitually resident in one Contracting State (the State of origin) has been, is being, or is to be moved to another Contracting State (the receiving State) either after having been adopted in the State of origin by spouses or an individual habitually resident in the receiving State, or for the purposes of such an adoption in the State of origin or the receiving State.

Query_Text_cn: 2、本公约仅适用于产生永久性的父母-子女关系的收养。
Translation: 2. This Convention applies only to adoptions that create a permanent parent-child relationship.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条如果在儿童年满18岁之前，第17条3项中提到的同意仍未作出，则本公约停止适用。
Translation: Article 3: If the consent referred to in Article 17(3) has not been given before the child reaches the age of 18, the Convention shall cease to apply.

Query_Text_cn: 且（4）此项同意不是以给付任何形式的报酬或补偿所导致的。
Translation: and (4) such consent is not induced by the provision of any form of remuneration or compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 且3、已经确认该儿童已经或将被批准进入并长期居住在该国。
Translation: and 3, it has been confirmed that the child has been or will be approved for entry and long-term residence in that country.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条1、每一缔约国应指定一个中央机关，负责本公约对该机关所规定的任务。
Translation:
Article 6
