Query_Text_cn: 在评估一项数据电文的证据力时，应考虑到生成、储存或传递该数据电文的办法的可靠性，保持信息完整性的办法的可靠性，用以鉴别发端人的办法，以及任何其他相关因素。
Translation: In assessing the evidential weight of a data message, regard shall be had to the reliability of the method by which it was generated, stored or transmitted, the reliability of the method used to ensure the integrity of the information, the method used to identify the originator, and any other relevant factor.

Query_Text_cn: 和（c）如果有的话，留存可据以查明数据电文的来源和目的地以及该电文被发送或接收的日期和时间的任何信息。
Translation: and (c) where applicable, any information enabling the identification of the origin and destination of the data message as well as the date and time when it was sent or received.

Query_Text_cn: （2）按第（1）款规定留存文件、记录或信息的义务不及于只是为了使电文能够发送或接收而使用的任何信息。
Translation: (2) The obligation to retain documents, records, or information under paragraph (1) does not apply to any information used solely for the purpose of enabling the dispatch or receipt of messages.

Query_Text_cn: （3）任何人均可通过使用任何其他人的服务来满足第（1）款所述的要求，但要满足第（1）款（a）、（b）和（c）项所列条件。
Translation: (3) Any person may satisfy the requirements under subsection (1) by using the services of any other person, provided that the conditions set out in paragraphs (a), (b), and (c) of subsection (1) are met.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条合同的订立和有效性（1）就合同的订立而言，除非当事各方另有协议，一项要约以及对要约的承诺均可通过数据电文的手段表示。
Translation:
Article 11 Formation and Validity of the Contract  

(1) In the context of contract formation, unless the parties have agreed otherwise, an offer and the acceptance of an offer may be expressed by means of data messages.

Query_Text_cn: 如使用了一项数据电文来订立合同，则不得仅仅以使用了数据电文为理由而否定该合同的有效性或可执行性。
Translation: If a data message is used in the formation of a contract, that contract shall not be denied validity or enforceability solely on the grounds that a data message was used.

Query_Text_cn: （2）本条的规定不适用于下述情况：__UNDEF__[---]。
Translation: (2) The provisions of this Article do not apply to the following circumstances: __UNDEF__[---].

Query_Text_cn: 第12条当事各方对数据电文的承认（1）就一项数据电文的发端人和收件人之间而言，不得仅仅以意旨的声明或其他陈述彩数据电文形式为理由而否定其法律效力、有效性或可执行性。
Translation: Article 12 Recognition by Parties of Data Messages (1) As between the originator and the addressee of a data message, a declaration of will or other statement shall not be denied legal effect, validity or enforceability solely on the grounds that it is in the form of a data message.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条数据电文的归属（1）一项数据电文，如果是由发端人自己发送，即为该发端人的数据电文。
Translation: Article 13 Attribution of Data Messages (1) A data message is that of the originator if it was sent by the originator itself.

Query_Text_cn: 或（b）由发端人设计程序或他人代为设计程序的一个自动动作的信息系统发送。
Translation: or (b) sent by an automated information system programmed by the originator or on their behalf.

Query_Text_cn: 或（b）收件人收到的数据电文是由某一人的行为而产生的，该人由于与发端人或与发端人之任何代理人的关系，得以动用本应由发端人用来鉴定数据电文确属源自其本人的某一方法。
Translation: or (b) the addressee received the data message from a person who, by virtue of a relationship with the originator or any agent of the originator, had access to a method used by the originator to identify the data message as its own.

Query_Text_cn: 或（c）如属第（3）款（b）项所述的情况，自收件人只要适当加以注意或使用任何商定程序便知道或理应知道该数据电文并非发端人的数据电文的任何时间起。
Translation: or (c) if the case falls under subparagraph (b) of paragraph (3), from the time when the addressee knew or ought to have known, had it exercised reasonable care or used any agreed procedure, that the data message was not that of the originator.

Query_Text_cn: （5）凡一项数据电文确属发端人的数据电文或视为发端人的数据电文，或收件人有权按此推断行事，则就发端人与收件人之间而言，收件人有权将所收到的数据电文视为发端人所要发送的电文，并按此推断行事。
Translation: (5) Where a data message is that of the originator or is deemed to be that of the originator, or the addressee is entitled to act on that assumption, then as between the originator and the addressee, the addressee is entitled to regard the data message received as being what the originator intended to send, and to act on that assumption.

Query_Text_cn: 当收件兴要适当加以注意或使用任何商定程序便知道或理应知道所收到的数据电文在传送中出现错误，即无此种权利。
Translation: If the addressee has reason to know or should have known that the data message received contains an error in transmission and fails to exercise due diligence or apply any agreed procedure to address it, such right shall not arise.

Query_Text_cn: （6）收件人有权将其收到的每一份数据电文都视为一份单独的数据电文并按此推断行事，除非它重复另一数据电文，而收件人只要加以适当注意或使用任何商定程序便知道或理应知道数据电文是一份复本。
Translation: (6) The addressee has the right to treat each data message received as a separate data message and to act accordingly, unless it is a duplicate of another data message that the addressee knows or should reasonably know is a duplicate through proper attention or the use of any agreed procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条确认收讫（1）本条第（2）至（4）款适用于发端人发送一项数据电文之时或之前，或通过该数据电文，要求或与收件人商定该数据电文需确认收文讫的情况。
Translation: Article 14 Acknowledgement of receipt (1) Paragraphs (2) to (4) of this article apply where, at or before the time when the originator sends the data message, or by means of that data message, the originator has requested or has agreed with the addressee that receipt of the data message is to be acknowledged.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如发端人未与收件人商定以某种特定形式或某种特定方法确认收讫，可通过足以向发端人表明该数据电文已经收到的（a）收件人任何自动化传递或其他方式的传递，或（b）收件人的任何行为，来确认收讫。
Translation: (2) Where the originator has not agreed with the addressee that the acknowledgment of receipt will be given in a particular form or by a particular method, an acknowledgment may be given by (a) any communication by the addressee, automated or otherwise, or (b) any conduct of the addressee, sufficient to indicate to the originator that the data message has been received.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如发端人已声明数据电文须以收到该项确认为条件，则在收到确认之前，数据电文可视为从未发送。
Translation: (3) Where the originator has stated that the data message is conditional upon receipt of the acknowledgment, the data message is treated as though it has never been sent until the acknowledgment is received.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如在（a）项所规定的时限内仍未收到该项确认，发端人可在通知收件人之后，将数据电文为从未发送，或行使其所拥有的其他权利。
Translation: (b) If such confirmation is not received within the time specified in subparagraph (a), the originator may, after notifying the addressee, treat the data message as never having been sent or exercise any other rights it may have.

Query_Text_cn: （5）如发端人收到收件人的收讫确认，即可推定有关数据电文已由收件人收到。
Translation: (5) If the originator receives the recipient's acknowledgment of receipt, it may be presumed that the relevant data message has been received by the recipient.

Query_Text_cn: 这种推断并不含有该数据电文与所收电文相符的意思。
Translation: This inference does not imply that the data message corresponds to the message received.

Query_Text_cn: （6）如所收到的收讫确认指出有关数据电文符合商定的或在适用标准在规定的技术要求时，即可推定这些要求业已满足。
Translation: (6) Where the acknowledgment of receipt states that the electronic data message complies with the agreed or applicable standard technical requirements, it may be presumed that those requirements have been satisfied.

Query_Text_cn: （7）除涉及数据电文的发送或接收外，本条无意处理源自该数据电文或其收讫确认的法律后果。
Translation: (7) Except as otherwise provided in the dispatch or receipt of the data message, this article is not intended to deal with the legal consequences that may arise from the data message itself or from the acknowledgment of its receipt.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条发出和收到数据电文的时间和地点（1）除非发端人与收件人另有协议，一项数据电文的发出时间以它进入发端人或代表发端人发送数据电文的人控制范围之外的某一信息系统的时间为准。
Translation:
Article 15 Time and place of dispatch and receipt of data messages 
(1) Unless otherwise agreed between the originator and the addressee, the dispatch of a data message occurs when it enters an information system outside the control of the originator or of the person who sent the data message on behalf of the originator.

Query_Text_cn: （c）如收件人并未指定某一信息系统，则以数据电文进入收件人的任一信息系统的时间为收到时间。
Translation: (c) Where the addressee has not designated a specific information system, the time of receipt shall be the time when the electronic message enters any of the addressee's information systems.

Query_Text_cn: （3）即使设置信息系统的地点有同于根据第（4）款规定所视为的收到数据电文的地点，第（2）款的规定仍然适用。
Translation: (3) The provisions of paragraph (2) shall apply even if the place where the information system is located is different from the place where the data message is deemed to be received under paragraph (4).

Query_Text_cn: （4）除非发端人与收件人另有协议，数据电文应以发端人设有营业地的地点视为其发出地点，而以收件人设有营业地的地点视为其收到地点。
Translation: (4) Unless the originator and the addressee have otherwise agreed, a data message is deemed to be dispatched at the place where the originator has its place of business, and is deemed to be received at the place where the addressee has its place of business.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如发端人或收件人没有营业地，则以其惯常居住地为准。
Translation: (b) If the originator or the addressee does not have a place of business, reference shall be made to their habitual residence.

Query_Text_cn: （5）本条的规定不适合用于下述情况：__UNDEF__[---]。
Translation: (5) The provisions of this Article shall not apply to the following circumstances: __UNDEF__[---].

Query_Text_cn: （g）获取或转移合同权利和义务。
Translation: (g) Acquisition or transfer of contractual rights and obligations.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条运输单据（1）在本条第（3）款的限制下，如法律要求以书面形式或用书面文件来执行第16条秘述的任何行动，则如果使用一项或多项数据电文来执行有关行动，即满足了该项要求。
Translation:
Article 17 Transport Documents  

(1) Subject to paragraph (3) of this Article, where the law requires that any action referred to in Article 16 be carried out in writing or by using a paper document, that requirement is met if the action is carried out by using one or more data messages.

Query_Text_cn: （2）无论本条第（1）款所述在求是否采取一项义务的形式，也无论法律是不是仅仅规定了不以书面形式或不用书面文件执行有关行动的后果，该款均将适用。
Translation: (2) Paragraph (1) of this Article applies whether the requirement therein referred to is in the form of an obligation or whether the law simply provides consequences for failing to conduct the relevant action in writing or without a written document.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如需将一项权利授予一人而不授予任何其他人，或使一项义务由一人而不是任何其他人获得，又如法律要求，为了做到这一点，必须传送或使用一份书面文件，向该人移交权利或义务，同如果使用了一项或多项数据电文移交有关权利或义务，只要采用了一种可靠的方法使这种数据电文独特唯一，即满足了该项要求。
Translation: (3) Where it is necessary to vest a right in one person and no other person or to impose an obligation on one person and no other person, and if the law requires, for this purpose, the transfer or use of a written document to pass the right or obligation to that person, then if the right or obligation is passed by means of one or more data messages, this requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied provided that a reliable method is used to render such data messages unique and non-replicable.

Query_Text_cn: （4）为本条第（3）款的目的，应根据移交权利或义务的目的并参照所有各种情况，包括任何相关协议，评定所要求的可靠性标准。
Translation: (4) For the purposes of paragraph (3) of this Article, the required standard of reliability shall be assessed by reference to the purpose for which the rights or obligations are transferred and in light of all circumstances, including any relevant agreements.

Query_Text_cn: （5）如果用一项或多项数据电文来实施第16条（f）项和（g）项所述的任何行动，除非数据电文的使用已被书面文件的使用所终止和替代，否则用来实施任何这种行动的书面文件均属无效。
Translation: (5) If one or more data messages are used to perform any of the actions referred to in paragraphs (f) and (g) of Article 16, any written document used to execute such action shall be void unless the use of the data message has been terminated and replaced by the use of a written document.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下发出的书面文件应含有一项关于终止使用数据电文的陈述。
Translation: The written document issued under such circumstances shall contain a statement regarding the termination of the use of data messages.

Query_Text_cn: 用书面文件替代数据电文不得影响有关当事各方的权利或义务。
Translation: The substitution of written documents for data messages shall not affect the rights or obligations of the relevant parties.

Query_Text_cn: （6）如一项法律规则强制适用于作成书面文件或以书面文件为证据的货运合同，则不得以一份此种合同系以一项或多项数据电文而有是以一份书面文件作为证据为而使该项规则不适用于由此电文作为证据的合同。
Translation: (6) Where a legal rule requires that a contract of carriage be in writing or evidenced in writing, such rule shall not cease to apply to a contract so evidenced by reason of the fact that the contract is evidenced by one or more data messages instead of being evidenced by a written document.

Query_Text_cn: （7）本条的规定不适用于下述情况：__UNDEF__[---]。
Translation: (7) The provisions of this article shall not apply to the following circumstances: __UNDEF__[---].

Query_Text_cn: “本法适用于第2条第（1）款所界定的涉及国际商业的数据电文。
Translation: "This Law applies to data messages involving international commerce as defined in Article 2(1)."

Query_Text_cn: ”本法并不废止旨在保护消费者利益的任何法律规则。
Translation: "This Act does not repeal any legal provisions aimed at protecting consumer interests."

Query_Text_cn: “本法适用于以一项数据电文为形式的任何种类的信息，但下述情况除外：__UNDEF__[…]。
Translation: "This Law applies to information of any kind in the form of a data message, except in the following cases: __UNDEF__[…]."

Query_Text_cn: ”对“商业”一词应作广义解释，使其包括不论是契约性或非契约性的一切商业性质的关系所引起的种种事项。
Translation: The term "commercial" shall be given a wide interpretation so as to cover matters arising from all relationships of a commercial nature, whether contractual or not.

Query_Text_cn: 空中、海上、铁路或公路的客、货运输。
Translation: Passenger and freight transportation by air, sea, rail, or road.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条适用范围（1）本法适用于国际商事仲裁，但须服从在本国与其他任何一国或多国之间有效力的任何协定。
Translation:
Article 1 Scope of Application  
(1) This Law applies to international commercial arbitration, subject to any agreement in force between this State and any other State or States.

Query_Text_cn: （2）本法之规定，除第8、9、35及36条外，只适用于仲裁地点在本国领土内的情况。
Translation: (2) The provisions of this Law, except for Articles 8, 9, 35, and 36, shall apply only where the place of arbitration is in the territory of this State.

Query_Text_cn: 或（c）当事各方明确地同意，仲裁协议的标的与一个以上的国家有关。
Translation: or (c) the parties have expressly agreed that the subject matter of the arbitration agreement relates to more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: 货物或旅客的天空、海上、铁路或公路的载运。
Translation: Transportation of goods or passengers by air, sea, rail, or road.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如当事一方没有营业地点，则以其惯常住所为准。
Translation: (b) If a party does not have a place of business, reference is to be made to its habitual residence.

Query_Text_cn: （5）本法不得影响规定某些争议不可以交付仲裁或只有根据非本法规定的规定才可以交付仲裁的本国其他任何法律。
Translation: (5) This Law shall not affect the provisions of any other law of this country which stipulates that certain disputes may not be submitted to arbitration or may only be submitted to arbitration in accordance with provisions other than those of this Law.

Query_Text_cn: 条文标题仅供索引，不作解释条文之用。
Translation: Article headings are for reference only and shall not be used for interpretation purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 对“商事”一词应作广义解释，使其包括不论是契约性或非契约性的一切商事性质的关系所引起的种种事情。
Translation: The term "commercial" shall be given a broad interpretation, covering all matters arising from all relationships of a commercial nature, whether contractual or not.

Query_Text_cn: （f）本法的规定，除第25条（a）项和第32条（2）款（a）项外，提到申诉时，也适用于反诉，提到答辩时．也适用于对这种反诉的答辩。
Translation: (f) The provisions of this Law, except for Article 25(a) and Article 32(2)(a), shall apply to counterclaims when referring to claims, and to defenses against such counterclaims when referring to defenses.

Query_Text_cn: （b）信件应被视为已于以上述方式投递之日收到。
Translation: (b) The letter shall be deemed received on the day it is delivered in the manner specified above.

Query_Text_cn: （2）本条各项规定不适用于法院诉讼程序中的信件。
Translation: (2) The provisions of this Article shall not apply to correspondence in judicial proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条放弃提出异议的权利当事一方如知道本法中当事各方可以背离的任何规定或仲裁协议规定的任何要求未得到遵守，但仍继续进行仲裁而没有不过分迟延地或在为此订有时限的情况下没有在此时限以内对此种不遵守事情提出异议，则应视为已放弃其提出异议的权利。
Translation:
Article 4 Waiver of Right to Object  

If a party, aware of any non-compliance with a provision of this Law from which the parties may derogate or of any requirement under the arbitration agreement, proceeds with the arbitration without promptly objecting to such non-compliance within the stipulated time limit (if any) or without undue delay, such party shall be deemed to have waived its right to object.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条法院干预的限度由本法管辖的事情，任何法院均不得干预，除非本法有此规定。
Translation:
Article 5 Limits of Court Intervention  
No court shall intervene in matters governed by this Law except where so provided for herein.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条履行协助和监督仲裁的某种职责的法院或其他机构第11条第（3）和第（4）款、第13条第（3）款、第14条和第34条第（2）款所指的职责应由…………[实施本示范法的每个国家具体指明履行这些职责的一个法院或一个以上的法院或其他有权力的机构。__UNDEF__]履行。
Translation: Article 6 Court or other authority for certain functions of arbitration assistance and supervision The functions referred to in article 11, paragraphs (3) and (4), article 13, paragraph (3), article 14 and article 34, paragraph (2), shall be performed by… [Each State enacting this Model Law specifies the court, courts or, where referred to therein, other authority competent to perform these functions.]

Query_Text_cn: 第7条仲裁协议的定义和形式（1）“仲裁协议”是指当事各方同意将在他们之间确定的不论是契约性或非契约性的法律关系上已经发生或可能发生的一切或某些争议提交仲裁的协议。
Translation:
Article 7 Definition and Form of Arbitration Agreement  
(1) An "arbitration agreement" is an agreement by the parties to submit to arbitration all or certain disputes which have arisen or which may arise between them in respect of a defined legal relationship, whether contractual or non-contractual.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁协议可以采取合同中的仲裁条款形式或单独的协议形式。
Translation: An arbitration agreement may take the form of an arbitration clause in a contract or a separate agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （2）仲裁协议应是书面的。
Translation: (2) The arbitration agreement shall be in writing.

Query_Text_cn: 协议如载于当事各方签字的文件中，或载于往来的书信、电传、电报或提供协议记录的其他电讯手段中，或在申诉书和答辩书的交换中当事一方声称有协议而当事他方不否认，即为书面协议。
Translation: An agreement is deemed to be in writing if it is contained in a document signed by the parties, or in an exchange of letters, telexes, telegrams, or other means of telecommunication which provide a record of the agreement, or in the exchange of statements of claim and defense in which the existence of the agreement is alleged by one party and not denied by the other.

Query_Text_cn: 在合同中提出参照载有仲裁条款的一项文件即构成仲裁协议，如果该合同是书面的而且这种参照足以使该仲裁条款构成该合同的一部分的话。
Translation: A reference in a contract to a document containing an arbitration clause constitutes an arbitration agreement, provided that the contract is in writing and the reference is such as to make that clause part of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条仲裁协议和向法院提出的实质性申诉（1）向法院提起仲裁协议标的的诉讼时，如当事一方在不迟于其就争议实质提出第一次申述的时候要求仲裁，法院应让当事各方付诸仲裁，除非法院发现仲裁协议无效、不能实行或不能履行。
Translation:
Article 8 Arbitration Agreement and Substantive Claim before Court  
(1) When an action is brought before a court concerning a subject matter covered by an arbitration agreement, if a party requests arbitration no later than the time of its first statement on the substance of the dispute, the court shall refer the parties to arbitration unless it finds the arbitration agreement null and void, inoperative, or incapable of being performed.

Query_Text_cn: （2）在本条第（1）款提及的诉讼已提起时，仍然可以开始或继续进行仲裁程序，并可作出裁决，同时等待法院对该问题的判决。
Translation: (2) When legal proceedings under paragraph (1) of this Article have been initiated, arbitration proceedings may nevertheless be commenced or continued, and an award may be rendered, pending the court's determination on the matter.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条仲裁协议和法院的临时措施在仲裁程序进行前或进行期间内，当事一方请求法院采取临时保护措施和法院准予采取这种措施，均与仲裁协议不相抵触。
Translation:
Article 9 Arbitration Agreement and Interim Measures by Court  
It is not incompatible with an arbitration agreement for a party to request, before or during arbitral proceedings, an interim measure of protection from a court and for a court to grant such measure.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条仲裁员人数（1）当事各方可以自由确定仲裁员的人数。
Translation:
Article 10 Number of Arbitrators  
(1) The parties are free to determine the number of arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如未作此确定，则仲裁员的人数应为三名。
Translation: (2) If no such determination is made, the number of arbitrators shall be three.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条仲裁员的指定（1）除非当事各方另有协议，否则不应以所属国籍为理由排除任何人作为仲裁员。
Translation:
Article 11 Appointment of Arbitrators  
(1) No person shall be precluded from acting as an arbitrator by reason of nationality unless otherwise agreed by the parties.

Query_Text_cn: （2）当事各方可以自由地就指定一名或数名仲裁员的程序达成协议，但须服从本条第（4）和第（5）款的规定。
Translation: (2) The parties are free to agree on a procedure for appointing the arbitrator or arbitrators, subject to the provisions of paragraphs (4) and (5) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如未达成这种协议。
Translation: (3) If no such agreement is reached.

Query_Text_cn: （b）在独任仲裁员的仲裁中，如果当事各方不能就仲裁员达成协议，则经当事一方请求，应由第6条规定的法院或其他机构指定。
Translation: (b) In arbitration with a sole arbitrator, if the parties are unable to agree on the arbitrator, the arbitrator shall, upon the request of either party, be appointed by the court or other authority specified in Article 6.

Query_Text_cn: （4）如果，根据当事各方协议的指定程序。
Translation: (4) If, in accordance with the designated procedures agreed upon by the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 或（c）第三者，包括机构，未履行根据这种程序交托给它的任何职责，则当事任何一方均可请求第6条规定的法院或其他机构采取必要措施，除非指定程序的协议订有确保能指定仲裁员的其他方法。
Translation: or (c) a third party, including an institution, fails to perform any function entrusted to it under such procedure, any party may request the court or other authority specified in Article 6 to take the necessary measures, unless the agreement on the appointment procedure provides other means for securing the appointment.

Query_Text_cn: （5）就本条第（3）或第（4）款交托给第6条规定的法院或其他机构的事情所作出的决定，不容上诉。
Translation: (5) No appeal shall lie from a decision of the court or other authority referred to in Article 6 on a matter referred to it under paragraph (3) or (4) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 该法院或其他机构在指定仲裁员时应适当顾及当事各方协议的仲裁员需要具备的任何资格，并适当顾及可能确保能指定独立和公正的仲裁员的种种考虑，而且在指定独任仲裁员或第三名仲裁员时，还应考虑到指定一名所属国籍与当事各方均不相同的仲裁员的可取性。
Translation: In appointing an arbitrator,the court or other authority shall have due regard to any qualifications required of the arbitrator by the agreement of the parties and to such considerations as are likely to secure the appointment of an independent and impartial arbitrator and,in the case of a sole or third arbitrator,shall take into account as well the advisability of appointing an arbitrator of a nationality other than those of the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条提出异议的理由（1）某人被询有关他可能被指定为仲裁员的事情时，他应将可能会对他的公正性或独立性引起正当的怀疑的任何情况说清楚。
Translation:
Article 12 Grounds for Challenge  
(1) When a person is approached in connection with his possible appointment as an arbitrator, he shall disclose any circumstances likely to give rise to justifiable doubts as to his impartiality or independence.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁员从被指定之时起以至在整个仲裁程序进行期间，应不迟延地向当事各方说清楚任何这类情况，除非他已将这类情况告知当事各方。
Translation: From the time of appointment and throughout the arbitral proceedings, an arbitrator shall disclose without delay any such circumstances to the parties unless they have already been informed of them.

Query_Text_cn: （2）只有存在对仲裁员的公正性或独立性引起正当的怀疑的情况或他不具备当事各方商定的资格时，才可以对仲裁员提出异议。
Translation: (2) A challenge to an arbitrator may be made only if circumstances exist that give rise to justifiable doubts as to his impartiality or independence, or if he does not possess qualifications agreed to by the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 当事一方只有根据作出指定之后才得知的理由才可以对他所指定的或他参加指定的仲裁员提出异议。
Translation: A party may challenge an arbitrator whom he has appointed or in whose appointment he has participated only for reasons of which he becomes aware after the appointment has been made.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条提出异议的程序（1）当事各方可以自由地就对仲裁员提出异议的程序达成协议，但须服从本条第（3）款的规定。
Translation:
Article 13 Challenge Procedure  
(1) The parties are free to agree on a procedure for challenging an arbitrator, subject to the provisions of paragraph (3) of this article.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如未达成这种协议，拟对仲裁员提出异议的当事一方，应在他得知仲裁庭组成或得知第12条第（2）款所指的任何情况后十五天内，向仲裁庭提出书面陈述，说明提出异议的理由。
Translation: (2) If no such agreement is reached, a party intending to challenge an arbitrator shall, within fifteen days after becoming aware of the constitution of the arbitral tribunal or after learning of any circumstance referred to in Article 12(2), submit a written statement to the arbitral tribunal stating the reasons for the challenge.

Query_Text_cn: 除非被提出异议的仲裁员辞职或当事他方同意所提出的异议，否则仲裁庭应就所提出的异议作出决定。
Translation: Unless the challenged arbitrator withdraws or the other party agrees to the challenge, the arbitral tribunal shall decide on the challenge.

Query_Text_cn: 在等待对该请求作出决定的同时，仲裁庭包括被提出异议的仲裁员可以继续进行仲裁程序和作出裁决。
Translation: While awaiting a decision on the challenge, the arbitral tribunal, including the challenged arbitrator, may continue the arbitral proceedings and make an award.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条未行事或不能行事（1）如果仲裁员在法律上或事实上不能履行他的职责或由于其他原因未能不过分迟延地行事，他的任命即告终止，如果他辞职或当事各方就终止他的任命达成协议的话。
Translation:
Article 14 Failure or Impossibility to Act  
(1) The mandate of an arbitrator shall terminate if he becomes de jure or de facto unable to perform his functions or for other reasons fails to act without undue delay. Such termination shall occur upon his resignation or if the parties agree to the termination of his appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 但如对上述任何原因仍有争论，当事任何一方均可以请求第6条规定的法院或其他机构就终止其任命一事作出决定，该决定不容上诉。
Translation: However, if any dispute arises concerning the aforementioned grounds, either party may request the court or other authority specified in Article 6 to decide on the termination of the appointment, and such decision shall be final and not subject to appeal.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如果按照本条或第13条第（2）款的规定，一名仲裁员辞职或当事一方同意终止对一名仲裁员的任命，这并不暗示接受本条或第12条第（2）款所指的任何理由的有效性。
Translation: (2) If an arbitrator resigns or a party agrees to the termination of the mandate of an arbitrator pursuant to this Article or under paragraph (2) of Article 13, this does not imply acceptance of the validity of any ground referred to in this Article or paragraph (2) of Article 12.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条指定替代仲裁员因根据第13条或第14条的规定或因仲裁员由于任何其他原因而辞职或因当事各方协议解除仲裁员的任命而终止仲裁员的任命或在任何其他情况下终止仲裁员的任命时，应按照原来适用于指定被替换的仲裁员的规则指定替代仲裁员。
Translation:
Article 15 Designation of Substitute Arbitrator  
In the event of the termination of an arbitrator's appointment due to resignation under Article 13 or 14, resignation for any other reason, or the parties' agreement to revoke the arbitrator's appointment, or in any other circumstance leading to the termination of the arbitrator's appointment, a substitute arbitrator shall be designated in accordance with the rules originally applicable to the appointment of the arbitrator being replaced.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条仲裁庭对自己的管辖权作出裁定的权力（1）仲裁庭可以对它自己的管辖权包括对仲裁协议的存在或效力的任何异议，作出裁定。
Translation:
Article 16 Competence of arbitral tribunal to rule on its jurisdiction  
(1) The arbitral tribunal may rule on its own jurisdiction, including any objections with respect to the existence or validity of the arbitration agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，构成合同的一部分的仲裁条款应视为独立于其他合同条款以外的一项协议。
Translation: For this purpose, the arbitration clause forming part of the contract shall be deemed an agreement independent of the other terms of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭作出的关于合同无效的决定，不应在法律上导致仲裁条款的无效。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal's decision declaring the contract invalid shall not entail the invalidity of the arbitration clause in law.

Query_Text_cn: （2）有关仲裁庭无权管辖的抗辩不得在提出答辩书之后提出。
Translation: (2) Any objection to the jurisdiction of the arbitral tribunal must be raised no later than the submission of the statement of defense.

Query_Text_cn: 当事一方已指定或参与指定仲裁员的事实，不得阻止该当事一方提出这种抗辩。
Translation: The fact that a party has appointed or participated in the appointment of an arbitrator shall not preclude that party from raising such an objection.

Query_Text_cn: 有关仲裁庭超越其权力范围的抗辩，应在仲裁程序过程中提出越权的事情后立即提出。
Translation: Any objection that the arbitral tribunal has exceeded its authority shall be raised as soon as the matter alleged to be beyond its scope of authority occurs during the arbitral proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 在这两种情况下，仲裁庭如认为推迟提出抗辩有正当理由，均可准许待后提出抗辩。
Translation: In either case, the arbitral tribunal may permit such a plea to be presented later if it considers the delay justified.

Query_Text_cn: （3）仲裁庭可以根据案情将本条第（2）款所指的抗辩作为一个初步问题裁定或在裁决中裁定。
Translation: (3) The arbitral tribunal may decide on the plea referred to in paragraph (2) of this article either as a preliminary question or in an award on the merits.

Query_Text_cn: 如果仲裁庭作为一个初步问题裁定它有管辖权，当事任何一方均可以在收到裁定通知后三十天内要求第6条规定的法院对这一问题作出决定。
Translation: If the arbitral tribunal rules on its jurisdiction as a preliminary question, either party may request the court specified in Article 6 to decide the matter within thirty days after receiving notice of that ruling.

Query_Text_cn: 该决定不容上诉；__UNDEF__在等待对这种要求作出决定的同时，仲裁庭可以继续进行仲裁程序和作出裁决。
Translation:
The decision shall not be subject to appeal;  

Pending the decision on such a request, the arbitral tribunal may continue the arbitral proceedings and make an award.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条仲裁庭命令采取临时措施的权力除非当事各方另有协议，仲裁庭经当事一方请求，可以命令当事任何一方就争议的标的采取仲裁庭可能认为有必要的任何临时性保全措施。
Translation:
Article 17 Power of Arbitral Tribunal to Order Interim Measures  
Unless otherwise agreed by the parties, the arbitral tribunal may, at the request of a party, order any interim measures it deems necessary in respect of the subject matter of the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭可以要求当事任何一方提供有关此种措施的适当的担保。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal may require either party to provide appropriate security for such measures.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条对当事各方平等相待应对当事各方平等相待，应给予当事每一方充分的机会陈述其案情。
Translation:
Article 18  
Equal Treatment of the Parties  
All parties shall be treated equally and each party shall be afforded a full opportunity to present its case.

Query_Text_cn: 第19条程序规则的确定（1）以服从本法的规定为准，当事各方可以自由地就仲裁庭进行仲裁所应遵循的程序达成协议。
Translation:
Determination of Rules of Procedure (Article 19)  
(1) Subject to the provisions of this Law, the parties are free to agree on the procedure to be followed by the arbitral tribunal in conducting the proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如未达成这种协议，仲裁庭可以在本法的规定的限制下，按照它认为适当的方式进行仲裁。
Translation: (2) In the absence of such agreement, the arbitral tribunal may conduct the arbitration in such manner as it considers appropriate, subject to the provisions of this Law.

Query_Text_cn: 授予仲裁庭的权力包括确定任何证据的可采性、相关性、实质性和重要性的权力。
Translation: The powers conferred upon the arbitral tribunal include the authority to determine the admissibility, relevance, materiality, and weight of any evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 第20条仲裁地点（1）当事各方可以自由地就仲裁地点达成协议。
Translation:
Article 20 Place of Arbitration  
(1) The parties are free to agree on the place of arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 如未达成这种协议，仲裁地点应由仲裁庭确定，要照顾到案件的情况。__UNDEF__包括当事各方的方便。
Translation: If no such agreement is reached, the place of arbitration shall be determined by the arbitral tribunal, taking into account the circumstances of the case, including the convenience of the parties.

Query_Text_cn: （2）虽有本条第（1）款的规定，除非当事各方另有协议，仲裁庭可以在它认为适当的任何地点聚会，以便在它的成员间进行磋商，听取证人、专家或当事各方的意见或检查货物、其他财产或文件。
Translation: (2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1) of this article, and unless otherwise agreed by the parties, the arbitral tribunal may meet at any place it considers appropriate for consultation among its members, for hearing witnesses, experts or the parties, or for inspection of goods, other property or documents.

Query_Text_cn: 第21条仲裁程序的开始除非当事各方另有协议，特定争议的仲裁程序，于应诉人收到将该争议提交仲裁的请求之日开始。
Translation:
Article 21 Commencement of Arbitral Proceedings  

Unless otherwise agreed by the parties, the arbitral proceedings in respect of a particular dispute commence on the date on which the respondent receives the request for that dispute to be referred to arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 第22条语文（1）当事各方可以自由地就仲裁程序中要使用的一种或数种语文达成协议。
Translation:
Article 22 Language of Arbitration  
(1) The parties are free to agree upon the language or languages to be used in the arbitral proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 如未达成这种协议，仲裁庭应确定仲裁程序中要使用的一种或数种语文。
Translation: In the absence of such agreement, the arbitral tribunal shall determine the language or languages to be used in the arbitral proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 除非其中另有规定，这种协议或确定应适用于当事一方的任何书面陈述、仲裁庭的任何开庭、任何裁决、决定或其他信件。
Translation: Unless otherwise provided therein, such agreement or determination shall apply to any written statements by a party, any hearing by the arbitral tribunal, any award, decision or other communication.

Query_Text_cn: （2）仲裁庭可以命令任何文件证据附具当事各方协议的或仲裁庭确定的一种或数种语文的译本。
Translation: (2) The arbitral tribunal may order that any documentary evidence shall be accompanied by a translation into such language or languages as agreed by the parties or determined by the arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 第23条申诉书和答辩书（1）在当事各方协议的或仲裁庭确定的期间内，申诉人应申述支持其申诉的种种事实、争论之点以及所寻求的救济或补救，应诉人应逐项作出答辩，除非当事各方对这种申述和答辩所要求的项目另有协议。
Translation:
Article 23 Statement of Claim and Defense  
(1) Within the period of time agreed by the parties or determined by the arbitral tribunal, the claimant shall state the facts supporting its claim, the points at issue, and the relief or remedy sought, while the respondent shall respond to these points item by item, unless the parties have otherwise agreed on the required elements of such statements and defenses.

Query_Text_cn: 当事各方可以随同他们的申诉书和答辩书提交他们认为有关的一切文件，也可以附注说明他们将要提交的文件或其他证据。
Translation: The parties concerned may submit with their statements of claim or defense all documents they consider relevant or add a reference to the documents or other evidence they intend to submit.

Query_Text_cn: （2）除非当事各方另有协议，在仲裁程序进行中。__UNDEF__当事任何一方均可以修改或补充其申诉书或答辩书，除非仲裁庭考虑到提出已迟而认为不宜允许提出这种改动。
Translation: (2) Unless otherwise agreed by the parties, any party may amend or supplement its claim or defense during the arbitral proceedings, unless the arbitral tribunal considers it inappropriate to allow such amendment having regard to the delay in making it.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条开庭和书面审理程序（1）除当事各方有任何相反协议外，仲裁庭应决定是否进行口头审理，以便提出证据或进行口头辩论，或者是否应以文件和其他材料为基础进行仲裁程序。
Translation: Article 24 Hearing and Written Proceedings (1) Unless the parties have agreed otherwise, the arbitral tribunal shall decide whether to hold oral hearings for the presentation of evidence or for oral argument, or whether the proceedings shall be conducted on the basis of documents and other materials.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，除非当事各方商定不开庭，仲裁庭应在进行仲裁程序的适当阶段开庭审理，如果当事一方如此要求的话。
Translation: However, unless the parties have agreed that no hearings shall be held, the arbitral tribunal shall hold such hearings at an appropriate stage of the proceedings, if so requested by a party.

Query_Text_cn: （3）当事一方向仲裁庭提供的一切陈述书、文件或其他资料均应送交当事他方。
Translation: (3) All statements, documents, or other information provided to the arbitral tribunal by one party shall be communicated to the other party.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭可能据以作出决定的任何专家报告或证据性文件也应送交当事各方。
Translation: Any expert reports or evidentiary documents on which the arbitral tribunal may rely in making its decision shall also be communicated to the parties.

Query_Text_cn: （c）当事任何一方不出庭或不提供文件证据，仲裁庭可以继续进行仲裁程序并根据它所收到的证据作出裁决。
Translation: (c) If any party fails to appear or present documentary evidence, the arbitral tribunal may proceed with the arbitration and render an award based on the evidence before it.

Query_Text_cn: （b）可以要求当事一方向专家提供任何有关的资料，或出示或让他接触任何有关的文件、货物或其他财产，供他检验。
Translation: (b) may require a party to provide the expert with any relevant information or to produce, or grant access to, any relevant documents, goods or other property for inspection.

Query_Text_cn: （2）除非当事各方另有协议，如当事一方有此要求或仲裁庭认为有必要，专家在提出他的书面或口头报告后，应参加开庭，使当事各方有机会向他提出问题并派出专家证人就争论之点作证。
Translation: (2) Unless the parties otherwise agree, the expert shall, after delivery of his written or oral report, participate in a hearing where the parties have the opportunity to put questions to him and to present expert witnesses in order to testify on the points at issue, if requested by a party or deemed necessary by the arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 第27条在获取证据方面的法院协助仲裁庭或当事一方在仲裁庭同意之下，可以请求本国主管法院协助获取证据。
Translation:
Article 27 Court Assistance in Taking Evidence  
The arbitral tribunal or a party with the approval of the arbitral tribunal may request from a competent court of this State assistance in taking evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 该法院可以在其权限范围内并按照其获取证据的规则的规定执行上述请求。
Translation: The court may execute the aforementioned request within its jurisdiction and in accordance with the rules governing the acquisition of evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 第28条适用于争议实体的规则（1）仲裁庭应按照当辜各方选定的适用于争议实体的法律规则对争议作出决定。
Translation:
Article 28 Rules Applicable to the Substance of the Dispute  
(1) The arbitral tribunal shall decide the dispute in accordance with the rules of law chosen by the parties as applicable to the substance of the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 除非另有表明，否则规定适用某一国的法律或法律制度应认为是直接指该国的实体法而不是指该国的法律冲突规则。
Translation: Unless otherwise indicated,any reference in these provisions to the law or legal system of a country shall be construed as directly referring to the substantive law of that country and not to its rules of conflict of laws.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如当事各方没有任何规定，仲裁庭应适用它认为可以适用的法律冲突规则所确定的法律。
Translation: (2) In the absence of any designation by the parties, the arbitral tribunal shall apply the law determined by the conflict of laws rules which it considers applicable.

Query_Text_cn: （3）仲裁庭只有在当事各方明确授权的情况下，才应按照公平合理的原则或作为友好调解人作出决定。
Translation: (3) The arbitral tribunal shall decide as amiable compositeur or ex aequo et bono only if the parties have expressly authorized it to do so.

Query_Text_cn: （4）在一切情形下，仲裁庭均应按照合同的条款作出决定，并应考虑到适用于该项交易的贸易习惯。
Translation: (4) In all cases, the arbitral tribunal shall decide in accordance with the terms of the contract and shall take into account the trade usages applicable to the transaction.

Query_Text_cn: 第29条一组仲裁员作出的决定在有一名以上仲裁员的仲裁程序中，除非当事各方另有协议，仲裁庭的任何决定，均应由其全体成员的多数作出。
Translation:
Article 29  
Decisions by a Panel of Arbitrators  
In arbitral proceedings with more than one arbitrator, any decision of the arbitral tribunal shall be made by a majority of all its members, unless otherwise agreed by the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果有当事各方或仲裁庭全体成员的授权，首席仲裁员可以就程序问题作出决定。
Translation: However, the presiding arbitrator may decide on procedural issues if authorized by all parties or the full arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 第30条和解（1）如果在仲裁程序中当事各方和解解决争议，仲裁庭应终止仲裁程序，而且如果当事各方提出请求而仲裁庭并无异议，则应按和解的条件以仲裁裁决书的形式记录此和解。
Translation:
Article 30 Settlement  
(1) If, during the arbitral proceedings, the parties settle the dispute, the arbitral tribunal shall terminate the proceedings. If requested by the parties and not objected to by the arbitral tribunal, the settlement shall be recorded in the form of an arbitral award on agreed terms.

Query_Text_cn: （2）根据和解的条件作出的裁决应按照第31条的规定作出，并应说明它是一项裁决。
Translation: (2) The decision on agreed terms shall be made in accordance with the provisions of Article 31 and shall state that it is an award.

Query_Text_cn: 这种裁决应与根据案情作出的任何其他裁决具有同等的地位和效力。
Translation: Such a ruling shall have the same status and effect as any other ruling rendered in the case.

Query_Text_cn: 第31条裁决的形式和内容（1）裁头应以书面作出，并应由一名或数名仲裁员签字。
Translation:
Article 31 Form and Contents of Award  
(1) The award shall be made in writing and shall be signed by the arbitrator or arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 在有一名以上仲裁员的仲裁程序中，仲裁庭全体成员的多数签字即可。__UNDEF__但须对任何省去的签字说明原因。
Translation: In arbitral proceedings with more than one arbitrator, the signatures of the majority of the members of the arbitral tribunal shall suffice. However, the reason for any omitted signature shall be stated.

Query_Text_cn: （2）裁决应说明它所根据的理由，除非当事各方协议不要说明理由或该裁决是根据第30条的规定按和解条件作出的裁决。
Translation: (2) The award shall state the reasons upon which it is based, unless the parties have agreed that no reasons are to be given or the award is an award on agreed terms under Article 30.

Query_Text_cn: （3）裁决应写明其日期和按照第20条第（1）款的规定所确定的仲裁地点。
Translation: (3) The award shall state its date and the place of arbitration as determined in accordance with Article 20(1).

Query_Text_cn: 该裁决应视为是在该地点作出的。
Translation: The ruling shall be deemed to have been made at that place.

Query_Text_cn: （4）裁决作出后，经各仲裁员按照本条第（1）款的规定签字的裁决书应送给当事各方各一份。
Translation: (4) After the award is made, a copy signed by the arbitrators in accordance with paragraph (1) of this Article shall be delivered to each of the parties.

Query_Text_cn: （a）申诉人撤回其申诉。
Translation: (a) The complainant withdraws his complaint.

Query_Text_cn: （c）仲裁庭认定仲裁程序在任何其他理由之下均无必要或不可能继续进行。
Translation: (c) The arbitral tribunal determines that the continuation of the proceedings has for any other reason become unnecessary or impossible.

Query_Text_cn: （3）仲裁庭的任务随着仲裁程序的终止而结束。__UNDEF__但须服从第33条和第34条第（4）款的规定。
Translation:
(3) The mandate of the arbitral tribunal terminates with the termination of the arbitral proceedings,
subject to the provisions of articles 33 and 34(4).

Query_Text_cn: （b）如果当事各方有此协议，当事一方可以在通知当事另一方后请求仲裁庭对裁决书的具体一点或一部分做出解释。
Translation: (b) If the parties so agree, a party may, upon notice to the other party, request the arbitral tribunal to interpret a specific point or part of the award.

Query_Text_cn: 如果仲裁庭认为此种请求合理，它应在收到请求后三十天内作出改正或加以解释。
Translation: If the arbitral tribunal considers the request justified, it shall make the correction or give the explanation within thirty days after receipt of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 解释应构成裁决的一部分。
Translation: The interpretation shall form part of the award.

Query_Text_cn: （2）仲裁庭可以在作出裁决之日起三十天内主动改正本条第（1）款（a）项所指的类型的任何错误。
Translation: (2) The arbitral tribunal may, within thirty days from the date of the award, correct on its own initiative any errors of the type referred to in subparagraph (a) of paragraph (1) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （3）除非当事各方另有协议，当事一方在收到裁决书后三十天内可以在通知当事他方后请求仲裁庭对已在仲裁程序中提出但在裁决书中遗漏的申诉事项作出追加裁决。
Translation: (3) Unless otherwise agreed by the parties, any party may, within thirty days after receipt of the arbitral award and upon notice to the other party, request the arbitral tribunal to make an additional award on claims presented in the arbitral proceedings but omitted from the award.

Query_Text_cn: 如果仲裁庭认为其请求合理。__UNDEF__仲裁庭应在六十天内作出追加裁决。
Translation: If the arbitral tribunal considers the request justified, the arbitral tribunal shall make the additional award within sixty days.

Query_Text_cn: （4）如果必要，仲裁庭可以将根据本条第（1）或第（3）款作出的改正、解释或追加裁决的期阮予以延长。
Translation: (4) If necessary, the arbitral tribunal may extend the period within which it shall make a correction, interpretation, or additional award under paragraph (1) or (3) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （5）第31条的规定应适用于裁决的改正或解释并适用于追加裁决。
Translation: (5) The provisions of Article 31 shall apply to the correction or interpretation of the award and to any additional award.

Query_Text_cn: 第34条申请撤销作为对仲裁裁决的唯一的追诉（1）只有按照本条第（2）和第（3）款的规定申请撤销，才可以对仲裁裁决向法院追诉。
Translation:
Article 34 Application for setting aside as exclusive recourse against arbitral award  
(1) Recourse to a court against an arbitral award may be made only by an application for setting aside in accordance with paragraphs (2) and (3) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 或（二）该裁决与本国的公共政策相抵触。
Translation: or (2) the award is in conflict with the public policy of this country.

Query_Text_cn: （3）提出申请的当事一方自收到裁决书之日起，三个月后不得申请撤销；__UNDEF__如根据第33条提出了请求，则从该请求被仲裁庭处理完毕之日起三个月后不得申请撤销。
Translation: (3) The party making the application shall not apply for setting aside after three months have elapsed from the date on which that party received the award;__UNDEF__if a request had been made under article 33, from the date on which that request had been disposed of by the arbitral tribunal, such application shall not be made after three months have elapsed.

Query_Text_cn: （4）法院被请求撤销裁决时，如果适当而且当事一方也要求暂时停止进行撤销程序，则可以在法院确定的一段期间内暂时停止进行，以便给予仲裁庭一个机会重新进行仲裁程序或采取仲裁庭认为能够消除请求撤销裁决的理由的其他行动。
Translation: (4) When so requested by a party,the court,where appropriate and if so requested by a party,may suspend the setting-aside proceedings for a period of time determined by it in order to give the arbitral tribunal an opportunity to resume the arbitral proceedings or to take such other action as in the arbitral tribunal's opinion will eliminate the grounds for setting aside.

Query_Text_cn: 第35条承认和执行（1）仲裁裁决不论在何国境内作出均应承认具有约束力，而且经向主管法院提出书面申请，即应予以执行，但须服从本条和第36条的规定。
Translation:
Article 35 Recognition and Enforcement  
(1) An arbitral award, irrespective of the country in which it was made, shall be recognized as binding and, upon application in writing to the competent court, shall be enforced subject to the provisions of this article and of Article 36.

Query_Text_cn: （2）援用裁决或申请予以执行的当事一方，应提供经正式认证的裁决书正本或经正式认证的裁决书副本以及第7条所指的仲裁协议正本或经正式认证的仲裁协议副本。
Translation: (2) The party relying on an award or applying for its enforcement shall supply the duly authenticated original award or a duly certified copy thereof, and the original arbitration agreement referred to in Article 7 or a duly certified copy thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 如果裁决或协议不是用本国的正式语文作成，则申请执行该裁决的当事一方应提供这些文件译成本国正式语文的经正式认证的文本。
Translation: If the award or agreement is not made in the official language of the country, the party applying for enforcement shall provide a duly certified translation of these documents into the official language of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 或本款所列的条件是想订出一个最高标准。__UNDEF__因此，如果一国保留了即使是更为简单的条件，也不致于与示范法所要取得的协调一致相对抗。__UNDEF__（五）裁决尚未对当事各方具有约束力。
Translation: Or the conditions set out in this paragraph are intended to set maximum standards.__UNDEF__Thus, if a State were to retain even less stringent conditions, this would not be contrary to the harmonization aimed at by the Model Law.__UNDEF__(e) The award is not yet binding on the parties.

Query_Text_cn: （一）根据本国的法律。
Translation: (1) In accordance with the national laws.

Query_Text_cn: 或（二）承认或执行该裁决与本国的公共政策相抵触。
Translation: or (ii) the recognition or enforcement of the award would be contrary to the public policy of this country.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如已向本条第（1）款（a）项（五）目所指的法院申请撤销或中止裁决，被请求承认或执行的法院如认为适当，可以暂停作出决定，而且如经要求承认或执行裁决的当事一方提出申请。
Translation: (2) If an application for the setting aside or suspension of the award has been made to a court referred to in paragraph (1)(a)(v), the court where recognition or enforcement is sought may, if it considers it proper, adjourn its decision and may also, on the application of the party claiming recognition or enforcement of the award.

Query_Text_cn: 还可以命令当事他方提供适当的担保。
Translation: The other party may also be ordered to provide appropriate security.

Query_Text_cn: 贸易法委员会国际商事仲裁示范法系于1985年6月21日由联合国国际贸易法委员会在其第十八届年会闭幕时予以通过。
Translation: The UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration was adopted by the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law at the close of its eighteenth session on 21 June 1985.

Query_Text_cn: 2大会在其1985年12月11日第40号决议中建议“所有国家鉴于统一仲裁程序法的需要和国际商事仲裁实际执行的具体需要，对国际商事仲裁示范法给予适当的考虑。
Translation: In its Resolution 40 of December 11, 1985, the Conference recommended that "all States give due consideration to the Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration, in view of the desirability of uniformity of the law of arbitral procedures and the specific needs of the international commercial arbitration practice."

Query_Text_cn: ”2.示范法为想往中的协调与改进各国的国内法提供了一个良好的令人鼓舞的基础。
Translation: 2. The Model Law provides an encouraging foundation for the desired harmonization and improvement of domestic legislation across countries.

Query_Text_cn: 它涉及仲裁过程的各个阶段，从仲裁协议到仲裁裁决的承认和执行，反映了世界各国对国际仲裁工作的原则与重大问题所取得的协商一致意见。
Translation: It encompasses all stages of the arbitration process, from the arbitration agreement to the recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards, reflecting the consensus reached by countries worldwide on the principles and major issues concerning international arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 它能为世界各个地区及不同法律或经济制度的国家所接受。
Translation: It is acceptable to countries across various regions of the world and under different legal or economic systems.

Query_Text_cn: 3.选择示范法这个形式来作为协调与改进各国法律的手段是因为它能使各国在拟订新的仲裁法时具有灵活性。
Translation: 3. The Model Law was chosen as the means to harmonize and improve national laws because it provides flexibility for states in formulating new arbitration legislation.

Query_Text_cn: 看来似宜尽可能参照示范法，因为这将最有助于达到理想中的协调，最符合以外国当事方及其律师为主的国际仲裁使用者的利益。
Translation: It would seem advisable to follow the Model Law as closely as possible, as this would best facilitate the desired harmonization and best serve the interests of international arbitration users, primarily foreign parties and their counsel.

Query_Text_cn: 正是本着这种精神，采用示范法的第一批法律管辖，即加拿大（联邦一级和几乎所有的省与地区）和塞浦路斯只对它作了很少的改动。__UNDEF__1本说明系由联合国国际贸易法委员会秘书处编写，仅作资料使用，并非对示范法的正式评论。__UNDEF__2示范法的文本载于该届会议的报告附件一（《大会正式记录，第四十届会议，补编第17号》（A）；__UNDEF__并在“贸易法委员会——联合国国际贸易法委员会”（联合国，纽约，1986年；__UNDEF__销售品编号：E.86.V.8）第157页中转载。
Translation: It is in this spirit that the first jurisdictions to adopt the Model Law, namely Canada (at the federal level and in almost all provinces and territories) and Cyprus, made only minor changes to it.__UNDEF__1 This note has been prepared by the Secretariat of the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law for information purposes; it is not an official commentary on the Model Law.__UNDEF__2 The text of the Model Law appears in annex I to the report of that session (Official Records of the General Assembly, Fortieth Session, Supplement No. 17 (A);__UNDEF__ and is reproduced in "UNCITRAL—United Nations Commission on International Trade Law" (United Nations, New York, 1986;__UNDEF__ Sales No. E.86.V.8), p. 157.

Query_Text_cn: 一.示范法的背景4.制订示范法的目的是为了解决与各国仲裁法现状有关的种种关注。
Translation:
I. Background of the Model Law  
4. The purpose of formulating the Model Law is to address various concerns related to the current state of arbitration laws in different countries.

Query_Text_cn: 改进与协调的必要性来自这样一个结论，即国内法常常不适宜于国际案件，它们相互间悬殊很大。
Translation: The necessity for improvement and coordination stems from the conclusion that domestic laws are often unsuitable for international cases and vary significantly among themselves.

Query_Text_cn: A.国内法的不充分性5.对世界各国的仲裁法作的调查表明，它们不但在个别条款与解决办法方面，而且在演变与完善方面也有很大差异。
Translation:
A. Insufficiency of Domestic Laws  
5. A survey of arbitration laws across nations reveals significant disparities not only in specific provisions and solutions but also in their evolution and refinement.

Query_Text_cn: 有些法律可以视为业已过时，其中有些可追溯到19世纪，且往往把仲裁程序与法院诉讼同等起来。
Translation: Some laws can be considered outdated, some of which date back to the 19th century and often equate arbitration procedures with court litigation.

Query_Text_cn: 其他一些法律没有处理所有有关问题，可以说是不完全的。
Translation: Some other laws fail to address all relevant issues and can thus be considered incomplete.

Query_Text_cn: 即使是大多数看上去较新和较全面的那些法律，国内仲裁不是人们在起草时考虑的唯一因素，就是人们考虑的主要因素。
Translation: Even in most of the seemingly newer and more comprehensive laws, domestic arbitration was either the sole factor considered during drafting or the predominant one.

Query_Text_cn: 鉴于即使今天普遍仲裁法裁决的大多数案件仍是纯国内性质的案件，上述做法是可以理解的，但它产生了一个不幸的后果，即把当地的传统观念强加于国际案件，而且往往不能满足现代做法的需要。
Translation: Given that the majority of cases adjudicated under even today's generally applicable arbitration laws remain purely domestic in nature, the above approach is understandable. However, it has the unfortunate consequence of imposing local traditional concepts on international cases, often failing to meet the needs of modern practices.

Query_Text_cn: 6.当事各方在选择一套仲裁规则或“一次性”仲裁协议时所抱的期望可能会落空，特别是因适用法律的强制性规定而落空。
Translation: 6. The expectations of the parties involved in selecting a set of arbitration rules or a "one-off" arbitration agreement may be disappointed, particularly due to mandatory provisions of the applicable law.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，可能会在国内法里发现一些意外的使人失望的限制，它们涉及当事各方将今后的争议有效地提交仲裁的能力、他们自由选择仲裁员的权力，或者他们在按商定的议事规则进行仲裁程序不要法院过分干预中所具有的权益。
Translation: For instance, unexpected and disappointing limitations may be found in domestic laws concerning the parties' ability to effectively submit future disputes to arbitration, their freedom to select arbitrators, or their entitlement to conduct arbitral proceedings according to agreed rules without excessive court intervention.

Query_Text_cn: 造成落空的还可以是非强制性的规定，这些规定可能会将一些不受欢迎的要求强加于那些未作其他规定的粗心大意的当事方。
Translation: Disappointment may also arise from non-mandatory provisions, which could impose undesirable obligations on unwary parties who have made no alternative arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 即使是缺乏非强制性规定也可能会造成困难，因为它们没有回答与仲裁有关但仲裁协议不总为之作出安排的许多程序问题。
Translation: Even the absence of non-mandatory provisions may create difficulties,as they fail to address numerous procedural issues related to arbitration that are not always covered by arbitration agreements.

Query_Text_cn: B.各国国内法之间的差异7.无论是强制性或非强制性规定，还是缺乏有关规定，它们造成的问题或不快后果因各国仲裁程序法大相径庭而变得更加严重。
Translation:
B. Divergences in National Laws  
7. Whether they are mandatory or non-mandatory provisions, or the absence of relevant provisions, the problems or undesirable consequences they create are exacerbated by the significant disparities in national arbitration procedural laws.

Query_Text_cn: 各国法律间的差异往往在国际仲裁中引起人们的关注，因为在这种仲裁中，当事各方中至少有一方，而且常常是当事双方均遇到外国的陌生规定和程序。
Translation: Differences in national laws often draw attention in international arbitration, where at least one party—and frequently both—encounters unfamiliar foreign regulations and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 对这样一个当事方来说，要全面确切地了解适用于仲裁的法律可能是昂贵的、不切合实际的或不可能的。
Translation: For such a party, obtaining a comprehensive and precise understanding of the law applicable to arbitration may be costly, impractical, or impossible.

Query_Text_cn: 8.当地法律的不确定性及其内在的落空风险可能不但会对仲裁程序的进行而且会对仲裁地点的选择产生不利影响。
Translation: 8. The uncertainty of local laws and their inherent risk of frustration may adversely affect not only the conduct of arbitration proceedings but also the choice of arbitration venue.

Query_Text_cn: 当事一方很可能出于这些原因不太愿意或拒绝同意某一地点，而这个地点从实际角度看在其他各方面对所涉案件均很适宜。
Translation: One party may well be reluctant or refuse to agree to a location for these reasons, even though it is otherwise entirely suitable for the case in question from a practical standpoint.

Query_Text_cn: 如果各国能够采用示范法，而这个示范法又易于得到承认，能满足国际商事仲裁的特定需要，并为来自不同国家与法律制度的当事各方均能接受的解决办法提供国际标准，那么仲裁地点的选择范围就可放宽，仲裁程序就能更顺利地进行。
Translation: If countries can adopt a model law that is readily recognized, meets the specific needs of international commercial arbitration, and provides international standards for solutions acceptable to parties from different countries and legal systems, the choice of arbitration venues can be broadened, and arbitration proceedings can proceed more smoothly.

Query_Text_cn: 二.示范法的特点A.国际商事仲裁的特别程序机制9.示范法采用的原则和各项解决办法其目的在于减少或消除上述的关注和困难。
Translation:
II. Features of the Model Law  
A. Special Procedural Mechanisms for International Commercial Arbitration  
9. The principles and solutions adopted in the Model Law aim to mitigate or eliminate the aforementioned concerns and difficulties.

Query_Text_cn: 针对国内法的不充分性和差异，示范法提出了一个适应于国际商事仲裁的特别法律机制，但不影响采用示范法的国家所实施的任何有关条约。
Translation: To address the inadequacies and discrepancies in domestic laws, the Model Law provides a specialized legal framework tailored for international commercial arbitration, without prejudice to any relevant treaties implemented by states adopting the Model Law.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然只对国际案件存在着统一的必要性，但是对于非国际案件，各国也可能感到需要修订和改进仲裁法。__UNDEF__以示范法为基础，为这两类案件颁布现代立法就能满足这一愿望。
Translation: While there is a unifying necessity only for international cases, states may feel inclined to revise and improve their arbitration laws also for non-international cases.__UNDEF__The enactment of modern legislation based on the Model Law for both categories of cases would satisfy that desire.

Query_Text_cn: 1.实质和领土适用范围10.按照示范法的定义如“仲裁协议的当事各方在缔结该协议时，他们的营业地点位于不同的国家”，则仲裁为国际仲裁（第1（3）条）。
Translation:
1. Substance and Territorial Scope  
10. As defined by the Model Law, arbitration is international if "the parties to an arbitration agreement have, at the time of the conclusion of that agreement, their places of business in different States" (Article 1(3)).

Query_Text_cn: 通常视为国际仲裁的绝大多数情况属于这一标准。
Translation: The vast majority of cases generally regarded as international arbitration fall under this standard.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，如仲裁地点、履约地点或争议标的地点位于当事各方营业地点所在国以外，或者如当事各方明确同意仲裁协议的标的与一个以上的国家有关，则仲裁亦为国际仲裁。
Translation: Additionally, arbitration shall also be deemed international if the place of arbitration, the place of performance, or the location of the subject matter of the dispute is outside the country where the parties have their places of business, or if the parties have expressly agreed that the subject matter of the arbitration agreement relates to more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: 11.至于“商事”一词，不能为之作出硬性的定义。
Translation: 11.As for the term "commercial",no rigid definition can be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条载有一个说明，要求“作广义解释，使其包括不论是契约性或非契约性的一切商事性质的关系所引起的种种事情”。
Translation: Article 1 contains a provision requiring that the term "be given a broad interpretation so as to cover matters arising from all relationships of a commercial nature, whether contractual or not."

Query_Text_cn: 该说明随后举例列出了一串拟应视为商事性质的关系，从而强调了所提议的解释范围的广宽性，指出决定性的因素并不取决于国内法可能视之为“商事"的那些情况。
Translation: The explanation then listed a series of relationships that should be regarded as commercial in nature, thereby emphasizing the broad scope of the proposed interpretation and pointing out that the decisive factor does not depend on what domestic laws may consider as "commercial."

Query_Text_cn: 12.适用性的另一方面是人们所谓的领土的适用范围。
Translation: 12. Another aspect of applicability pertains to what is commonly referred to as the territorial scope of application.

Query_Text_cn: 根据第1（2）条，某一国家颁布的示范法将只适用于仲裁地点在该国领土内的情况。
Translation: Under Article 1(2), a model law enacted by a country shall apply only where the place of arbitration is in the territory of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，有一个重要而合理的例外。
Translation: However, there is one important and justified exception.

Query_Text_cn: 关于承认仲裁协定包括其与临时保全措施一致性的第8（1）和9条以及关于承认和执行仲裁裁决的第35和36条是在世界各地均适用的，也即无论仲裁地点是在这个国家还是在那个国家，而且对第8和9条来说，即使仲裁地点尚未确定，它们也均适用。
Translation: Articles 8(1) and 9 concerning the recognition of arbitration agreements, including their consistency with interim measures, as well as Articles 35 and 36 on the recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards, are universally applicable worldwide. This means they apply regardless of whether the place of arbitration is in one country or another. Moreover, for Articles 8 and 9, they remain applicable even if the place of arbitration has not yet been determined.

Query_Text_cn: 13.对示范法中的大多数条款采用严格的领土标准是为了明确肯定，同时也考虑到下述事实。
Translation: 13. The adoption of a strict territorial standard for most provisions of the Model Law is intended to provide clarity and certainty, while also taking into account the following facts.

Query_Text_cn: 绝大多数国家的国内法把仲裁地点用作唯一的标准，在国内法允许当事各方选择非仲裁地点所在国的程序法的情况下，经验表明当事各方实际上很少利用这一规定。
Translation: The domestic laws of the vast majority of countries use the seat of arbitration as the sole criterion. In cases where domestic law permits the parties to choose a procedural law from a country other than that of the arbitral seat, experience shows that parties rarely take advantage of this provision in practice.

Query_Text_cn: 示范法由于其内容比较灵活，进一步减少了这种选择“外国”法律替代仲裁地点（示范）法的必要性，其主要原因之一是它使当事各方在拟订仲裁程序的规则方面享有广泛的自由。
Translation: The Model Law, with its flexible content, further diminishes the necessity of opting for "foreign" laws as alternatives to the arbitration venue (Model) Law. One of its primary advantages is that it grants the parties extensive freedom in formulating the rules governing arbitration proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 这包括他们可以将“外国”法律中的程序规定纳入仲裁协议，条件是这些规定不得与示范法中几条强制性的规定相抵触。
Translation: This includes their ability to incorporate procedural provisions from "foreign" laws into arbitration agreements, provided these provisions do not conflict with the mandatory provisions outlined in the Model Law.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，对第11、13、14、16、27和34条来说，严格的领土标准还具有相当大的实惠，因为这些条款委托各有关国家的法院行使协助与监督仲裁的职责。
Translation: Moreover, for Articles 11, 13, 14, 16, 27, and 34, the strict territorial criterion offers considerable practical benefits, as these provisions entrust the courts of the relevant countries with the responsibility of assisting and supervising arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 法院协助与监督的范围14.近期对仲裁法所作的修正表明，存在着赞同限制法院干预国际商事仲裁的趋势。
Translation:
The Scope of Judicial Assistance and Supervision  
14. Recent amendments to the arbitration law indicate a trend favoring the limitation of court intervention in international commercial arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 鉴于下述事实这看来是合理的：__UNDEF__仲裁协议的当事各方有意识地决定排除法院的管辖权，特别在商事案件中，他们宁可要作为权宜之计的最后定局，也不要旷日持久的法院争斗。
Translation: In view of the following facts, it appears reasonable: the parties to the __UNDEF__ arbitration agreement have consciously decided to exclude the jurisdiction of the courts, especially in commercial cases, preferring a final expedient resolution over protracted court battles.

Query_Text_cn: 15．按照这种精神，示范法设想法院可在下述情况下进行干预。
Translation: 15. In this spirit, the Model Law envisages court intervention in the following circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 第一类情况是仲裁员的指定，对其提出异议和终止其任命（第11、13和14条）、仲裁庭的管辖权（第16条）及仲裁裁决的撤销（第34条）。
Translation: The first category pertains to the appointment of arbitrators, challenges to their appointment and the termination of their mandate (Articles 11, 13 and 14), the jurisdiction of the arbitral tribunal (Article 16), and the setting aside of arbitral awards (Article 34).

Query_Text_cn: 这些情况是第6条所列为了集中统一、专业化和迅速行事而委托某一具体指定的法院，或者对第11、13和14条而言，可能是委托另一权力机构（例如仲裁机构、商会）履行的职责。
Translation: These circumstances refer to the delegation of responsibilities to a specifically designated court under Article 6 for the purposes of centralization, specialization, and expeditious action, or, in the case of Articles 11, 13, and 14, potentially to another authority (such as an arbitration body or chamber of commerce).

Query_Text_cn: 第二类情况是法院协助获取证据（第27条）、承认仲裁协议包括它与法院命令的临时保全措施的一致性（第8和9条）以及承认与执行仲裁裁决（第35和36条）。
Translation: The second category involves court assistance in obtaining evidence (Article 27), recognition of arbitration agreements including their consistency with interim measures ordered by courts (Articles 8 and 9), as well as recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards (Articles 35 and 36).

Query_Text_cn: 16．除了这两类情况，“由本法管辖的事情，”任何法院均不得干预。
Translation: 16. Except for these two categories of cases, "matters governed by this Law," no court shall intervene.

Query_Text_cn: 带有创新性的第5条作出了这一规定，它本身并未表明法院的适宜作用是什么，但它向读者和使用者保证，除了它不管辖的事情（例如仲裁程序的合并、仲裁员和当事各方或仲裁机构间的契约关系、费用和酬金包括押金的确定）外，他在本法中将能找到法院可以干预的所有情况。
Translation: Article 5, with its innovative approach, establishes this provision without explicitly defining the appropriate role of the courts. However, it assures readers and users that, apart from matters outside its jurisdiction (such as the consolidation of arbitral proceedings, contractual relationships between arbitrators and parties or arbitral institutions, and the determination of costs and fees including deposits), they will find in this law all circumstances under which court intervention is permissible.

Query_Text_cn: 特别对外国读者和使用者来说，他们是潜在使用者中的大多数，可以把他们视为任何关于国际商事仲裁的特别法律的基本对象，倘若能够不必脱离本法而去探索，他们将会感到欣慰。
Translation: Particularly for foreign readers and users, who constitute the majority of potential users and can be regarded as the primary audience for any special laws on international commercial arbitration, they would appreciate it if they could explore such matters without having to deviate from this law.

Query_Text_cn: B．仲裁协议17．示范法第二章涉及仲裁协议以及法院对它的承认。
Translation:
B. Arbitration Agreement  
17. Chapter II of the Model Law deals with arbitration agreements and their recognition by courts.

Query_Text_cn: 其中各项条款严密地参照《承认和执行外国仲裁裁决公约》（1958年，纽约）（下称“1958年纽约公约”）第二条，但增添了一些有用的澄清。
Translation: The provisions therein are meticulously aligned with Article 2 of the Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (New York, 1958) (hereinafter referred to as the "1958 New York Convention"), while incorporating some useful clarifications.

Query_Text_cn: 和（f）使有关采购的程序具有透明度，兹颁布如下规定。
Translation: And (f) to ensure transparency in the procedures relating to procurement, the following provisions are hereby promulgated.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条．适用范围（1）本法适用于采购实体进行的所有采购，但本条第（2）款另有规定者除外。
Translation: Article 1. Scope of Application (1) This Law applies to all procurement carried out by procuring entities, except as otherwise provided in paragraph (2) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 或（c）采购条例规定排除在外的某一类型的采购。
Translation: or (c) a type of procurement excluded under the procurement regulations.

Query_Text_cn: （3）若采购实体在征求供应商或承包商参与采购过程之初即声明本法将予适用，本法应在声明的范围内适用于本条第（2）款所述类型的采购。
Translation: (3) If the procuring entity has stated, at the time of inviting suppliers or contractors to participate in the procurement process, that this Law shall apply, it shall apply to the types of procurement referred to in paragraph (2) of this article to the extent so stated.

Query_Text_cn: （i）“货币”包括货币记帐单位。
Translation: (i) "Currency" includes units of monetary account.

Query_Text_cn: 但在所有其他方面，采购事宜仍应受本法的制约。
Translation: However, in all other respects, procurement matters shall remain subject to the provisions of this Law.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条．采购条例…（由颁布国指定受权颁布采购条例的机关或权力机构）受权颁布采购条例，以实现本法的各项目标和实施本法的条款规定。
Translation: Article 4. Procurement Regulations... (The enacting State specifies the authorized body or authority to issue procurement regulations) is authorized to issue procurement regulations to achieve the objectives of this Law and implement its provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条．公众获取法律文本应迅速使公众能够获取本法、采购条例、所有与本法规定的采购有关的、普遍适用的行政规定和命令，以及上述法规一切修正案的文本，并应系统地保存这些文本。
Translation:
Article 5. Public Access to Legal Texts  
The public shall have prompt access to the texts of this Law, procurement regulations, all generally applicable administrative rules and orders related to procurement as stipulated under this Law, as well as all amendments to the aforementioned legal documents, and such texts shall be systematically maintained.

Query_Text_cn: （五）在采购过程开始之前…年期间（由颁布国规定一段时限）内未被判犯有、其董事或主要职员也未被判犯有与其职业行为有关的或与假报或虚报资格骗取采购合同有关的任何刑事犯罪，也未曾在其他方面由于行政部门勒令停业或取消资格程序而被取消资格。
Translation: (f) Within ... years (to be specified by the enacting State) prior to the commencement of the procurement process, neither the supplier or contractor nor any of its directors or senior officers has been convicted of any criminal offence relating to professional conduct or involving fraudulent statements or misrepresentations as to qualifications to enter into procurement contracts, nor has been otherwise disqualified pursuant to administrative suspension or debarment proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: （2）在不损害供应商或承包商保护其知识产权或商业秘密的权利的前提下，采购实体可要求参加采购过程的供应商或承包商提供该实体认为有用的适当书面证据或其他资料，使该实体得以确信该供应商或承包商符合第（1）款（b）项所述的资格标准。
Translation: (2) Without prejudice to the rights of suppliers or contractors to protect their intellectual property or trade secrets, the procuring entity may require suppliers or contractors participating in the procurement process to furnish such appropriate written evidence or other information as the entity considers useful to satisfy itself that the supplier or contractor meets the qualification criteria referred to in paragraph (1)(b).

Query_Text_cn: （3）根据本条确定的任何要求，如有资格预审文件，应在此种文件中及在招标文件或征求建议书、报盘或报价的文件中列出，并应平等地适用于所有供应商或承包商。
Translation: (3) Any requirements established in accordance with this Article shall be set forth in the prequalification documents, where applicable, as well as in the solicitation documents or in the documents requesting proposals, offers or quotations, and shall apply equally to all suppliers or contractors.

Query_Text_cn: 除本条规定者外，采购实体不得对供应商或承包商的资格规定其他标准、要求或程序。
Translation: Except as provided for in this Article, a procuring entity shall not impose any other criteria, requirements or procedures for the qualification of suppliers or contractors.

Query_Text_cn: （4）如有资格预审文件，采购实体应根据此种文件及招标文件或征求建议书、报盘或报价的文件中所列资格标准及程序对供应商或承包商的资格进行评审。
Translation: (4) If there is a prequalification document, the procuring entity shall evaluate the qualifications of suppliers or contractors in accordance with such document and the qualification criteria and procedures specified in the solicitation documents or the request for proposals, offers or quotations.

Query_Text_cn: （5）在第8条第（1）款、第34条第（4）款（d）项和第39条第（2）款的限制下，采购实体不得就供应商或承包商的资格规定任何可能基于国籍不同而歧视供应商或承包商或其中某些或某类供应商或承包商，或并非客观上合理的标准、要求或程序。
Translation: (5) Subject to the provisions of paragraph (1) of article 8, subparagraph (d) of paragraph (4) of article 34 and paragraph (2) of article 39, a procuring entity shall not impose any qualification criterion, requirement or procedure that discriminates, or has the effect of discriminating, against suppliers or contractors or certain categories thereof on grounds of nationality, unless such criterion, requirement or procedure is objectively justified.

Query_Text_cn: （c）除本款（a）项规定的情况外，采购实体不得以供应商或承包商提交的关于资格的资料在非实质性方面失实或不完整为由而取消该供应商或承包商的资格。__UNDEF__如果在采购实体提出要求后，供应商或承包商未能迅速矫正弊端，可取消该供应商或承包商的资格。
Translation: (c) Except as provided for in paragraph (a), a procuring entity shall not disqualify a supplier or contractor on the ground that the information furnished regarding its qualifications is inaccurate or incomplete in a non-material respect. ____UNDEF____ A procuring entity may disqualify a supplier or contractor if it fails to promptly remedy the deficiency upon the procuring entity's request.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条．资格预审程序（1）采购实体可采用资格预审程序，以期在根据第三章、第四章或第五章进行的采购过程中提交投标书、建议书或报盘之前确定合格的供应商或承包商。__UNDEF__第6条的规定应适用于资格预审程序。
Translation: Article 7. Pre-qualification procedures. (1) The procuring entity may engage in pre-qualification procedures with a view towards identifying qualified suppliers or contractors prior to submission of tenders, proposals or offers in the course of procurement conducted in accordance with Chapter III, IV or V. __UNDEF__The provisions of Article 6 shall apply to pre-qualification procedures.

Query_Text_cn: （2）采购实体如采用资格预审程序，应向根据资格预审邀请书要求得到预审文件并支付了预审文件所收取的任何费用的供应商或承包商提供成套资格预审文件。
Translation: (2) Where the procuring entity applies a prequalification procedure, it shall provide a set of prequalification documents to each supplier or contractor that submits a request to participate in response to the invitation to prequalify and that pays the fee charged for the prequalification documents.

Query_Text_cn: 采购实体可对提供的资格预审文件收取费用，此种收费只能是印制和将其寄送供应商或承包商的成本。
Translation: The procuring entity may charge a fee for the provision of prequalification documents, and such a charge shall be limited to the cost of printing and dispatching them to suppliers or contractors.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在根据第四章进行的程序中，第38条（a）、（c）和如果已知的（g）、（p）和（s）项所述资料。
Translation: (2) In the procedures conducted pursuant to Chapter IV, the information specified in Article 38(a), (c), and, where known, (g), (p), and (s).

Query_Text_cn: （4）对于某一供应商或承包商提出的关于澄清资格预审文件的要求，只要是在提交资格预审申请书截止日期之前一段合理时间内为采购实体收到者，采购实体均应作出答复。
Translation: (4) The procuring entity shall respond to any request by a supplier or contractor for clarification of the prequalification documents, provided that such request is received by the procuring entity within a reasonable time prior to the deadline for submission of prequalification applications.

Query_Text_cn: 采购实体的答复应在一段合理的时间内发出，以便使该供应商或承包商能及时提交其资格预审申请书。
Translation: The procuring entity shall respond within a reasonable time to enable the supplier or contractor to submit its application for prequalification in a timely manner.

Query_Text_cn: 对任何要求作出的答复，凡有理由认为其他供应商或承包商也有兴趣获知者，均应同时发送给采购实体已向其提供资格预审文件的所有供应商或承包商，上述答复不得标明由何人提出要求。
Translation: Any response to a request shall be sent simultaneously to all suppliers or contractors that have been provided with the prequalification documents by the procuring entity, provided that such response is deemed to be of potential interest to other suppliers or contractors. The response shall not identify the originator of the request.

Query_Text_cn: （5）采购实体应对每个提交资格预审申请书的供应商或承包商的资格作出决定。
Translation: (5) The procuring entity shall determine the qualifications of each supplier or contractor that submits an application for prequalification.

Query_Text_cn: 在作出该决定时，采购实体只应采用资格预审文件中列明的标准。
Translation: In making this decision, the procuring entity shall apply only the criteria set out in the pre-qualification documents.

Query_Text_cn: （6）采购实体应迅速通知每个提交资格预审申请书的供应商或承包商，告知其是否预审及格，并根据请求，向任何市民大众提供已预审及格的供应商或承包商的名称。
Translation: (6) The procuring entity shall promptly inform each supplier or contractor that has submitted an application for prequalification of whether it has qualified and, upon request, communicate to any interested party the names of suppliers or contractors that have been prequalified.

Query_Text_cn: 只有预审及格的供应商或承包商才有权继续参加采购过程。
Translation: Only pre-qualified suppliers or contractors are entitled to proceed further in the procurement process.

Query_Text_cn: （7）采购实体应根据请求将预审不及格的理由通知有关的供应商或承包商，但采购实体无须为此提出证据或说明它认为存在那些理由的原因。
Translation: (7) The procuring entity shall inform any supplier or contractor that so requests of the reasons for its disqualification from prequalification proceedings, without being required to provide evidence or justification for the existence of those reasons.

Query_Text_cn: （8）采购实体可要求已预审及格的某一供应商或承包商按照原来对该供应商或承包商进行资格预审时使用的同样标准，再度证明其资格。
Translation: (8) A procuring entity may require a supplier or contractor that has been prequalified to demonstrate its qualifications again in accordance with the same criteria used for the original prequalification of that supplier or contractor.

Query_Text_cn: 对于未能根据要求再度证明其资格的任何供应商或承包商，采购实体应取消其资格。
Translation: For any supplier or contractor that fails to re-establish its qualifications as required, the procuring entity shall disqualify it.

Query_Text_cn: 采购实体应迅速通知被要求再度证明其资格的每个供应商或承包商，说明其做法是否已令采购实体满意。
Translation: The procuring entity shall promptly inform each supplier or contractor that is requested to re-establish its qualifications whether it has satisfied the procuring entity's requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条．供应商或承包商的参与（1）供应商或承包商无论其国籍为何，均可参与采购过程，但采购实体出于采购条例规定的理由，或根据其他法律规定，决定根据国籍限制参与采购过程的情况除外。
Translation:
Article 8. Participation of Suppliers or Contractors  
(1) Suppliers or contractors, regardless of their nationality, may participate in procurement proceedings unless the procuring entity decides to restrict participation based on nationality for reasons specified in procurement regulations or other legal provisions.

Query_Text_cn: （2）按照本条第（1）款根据国籍限制参与者的采购实体应在采购过程记录中陈述其所依据的理由和具体情况。
Translation: (2) A procuring entity that restricts participation on the basis of nationality pursuant to paragraph (1) of this Article shall state in the record of the procurement process the reasons and specific circumstances on which it relies.

Query_Text_cn: （3）采购实体应在邀请供应商或承包商参与采购过程之初声明可不分国籍参与采购过程。__UNDEF__此种声明不得在日后再予更改。
Translation: (3) The procuring entity shall state, at the outset of the process of inviting suppliers or contractors to participate, that participation in the procurement process is open to suppliers or contractors regardless of nationality. No such statement may subsequently be modified.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果采购实体决定根据本条第（1）款限制参与，则应向供应商或承包商作出这项声明。
Translation: However, if a procuring entity decides to limit participation under paragraph (1) of this Article, it shall make a declaration to that effect to the suppliers or contractors.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条．通讯的形式（1）本法中凡应由采购实体或行政当局提交给承包商或供应商，或应由供应商或承包商提交给采购实体的文件、通知、决定或其他通讯，均应采用能提供通讯内容记录的形式，但本法其他条款另有规定及采购实体在邀请供应商或承包商参与采购过程之初对形式作出任何其他规定者除外。
Translation:
Article 9. Form of Communications  
(1) Any document, notice, decision, or other communication required by this Law to be submitted by a procuring entity or administrative authority to a contractor or supplier, or by a supplier or contractor to a procuring entity, shall be in a form that provides a record of its contents, unless otherwise stipulated by other provisions of this Law or unless the procuring entity has specified any other form at the outset of inviting suppliers or contractors to participate in the procurement process.

Query_Text_cn: （2）第7条第（4）和（6）款、第12条第（3）款、第31条第（2）款（a）项、第32条第（1）款（d）项、第34条第（1）款、第36条第（1）款、第37条第（3）款、第44条（b）至（f）项和47条第（1）款所述的供应商或承包商与采购实体之间的通讯可采用不提供通讯内容记录的通讯手段进行，但条件是，在进行此种通讯之后应立即以能够提供确认记录的形式向接受通讯的人确认原先的通讯。
Translation: (2) Communications between suppliers or contractors and a procuring entity referred to in paragraph (4) and (6) of article 7, paragraph (3) of article 12, subparagraph (a) of paragraph (2) of article 31, subparagraph (d) of paragraph (1) of article 32, paragraph (1) of article 34, paragraph (1) of article 36, paragraph (3) of article 37, subparagraphs (b) to (f) of article 44 and paragraph (1) of article 47 may be made by means of communications that do not provide a record of the content of the communication, provided that, promptly after the communication is made, the original communication is confirmed to the recipient of the communication in a manner that provides a record of its confirmation.

Query_Text_cn: （3）采购实体不得根据供应商或承包商以何种形式发送或接收文件、通知、决定或其他通讯而对供应商或承包商或对其中某些供应商或承包商有所歧视。
Translation: (3) A procuring entity shall not discriminate against suppliers or contractors, or against certain suppliers or contractors, on the basis of the form in which they send or receive documents, notices, decisions, or other communications.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条．供应商或承包商提供书面证据的规则如采购实体要求供应商或承包商为证明其参与采购过程的资格而提供的书面证据需经公证证明，除本国法律对此类文件的公证所规定的要求外，采购实体不得对公证证明提出任何其他要求。
Translation:
Article 10. Rules on Written Evidence Provided by Suppliers or Contractors  
Where a procuring entity requires suppliers or contractors to provide notarized written evidence to demonstrate their eligibility for participation in the procurement process, the procuring entity may not impose any requirements for the notarization other than those stipulated under national law for the notarization of such documents.

Query_Text_cn: （m）关于澄清资格预审文件或招标文件的任何要求及对之作出答复的概要，以及修改那些文件的概要。
Translation: (m) Any requests for clarification of the prequalification or bidding documents and summaries of responses thereto, as well as summaries of modifications to those documents.

Query_Text_cn: （2）除第33条第（3）款的规定外，斟酌情况，在某项投标书、建议书、报盘或报价被接受之后，或在采购过程已告终止而没有产生采购合同之后，本条第（1）款（a）和（b）项所述的部分记录即应提供给要求得到此种记录的任何人。
Translation: (2) Except as provided in paragraph (3) of article 33, and subject to the circumstances, the portions of the record referred to in subparagraphs (a) and (b) of paragraph (1) of this article shall be made available to any person requesting such records after a tender, proposal, offer or quotation has been accepted or after the procurement process has been terminated without resulting in a procurement contract.

Query_Text_cn: （3）除第33条第（3）款的规定外，在某项投标书、建议书、报盘或报价被接受之后，或在采购过程已告终止而没有产生采购合同之后，本条第（1）款（c）至（g）项及（m）项所述的部分记录即应根据要求提供给已提交投标书、建议书、报盘或报价或已申请资格预审的供应商或承包商。
Translation: (3) Except as provided in paragraph (3) of article 33, after a tender, proposal, offer or quotation has been accepted or the procurement proceedings have been terminated without resulting in a procurement contract, the portions of the records referred to in subparagraphs (c) to (g) and (m) of paragraph (1) of this article shall be made available to suppliers or contractors that submitted tenders, proposals, offers or quotations or applied for pre-qualification, upon request.

Query_Text_cn: 对于（c）至（e）项及（m）项所述的部分记录，主管法庭可在更早阶段下令予以透露。
Translation: For the records described in items (c) to (e) and (m), the presiding court may order their disclosure at an earlier stage.

Query_Text_cn: （b）对投标书、建议书、报盘或报价以及对投标、建议、报盘或报价的价格进行审查、评审和比较的资料，但第（1）款（e）项所述的概要除外。
Translation: (b) Information on the examination, evaluation, and comparison of bids, proposals, offers, or quotations, including their prices, except for the summary referred to in paragraph (1)(e).

Query_Text_cn: （4）采购实体不应仅由于未按本条规定保存采购过程记录而对供应商或承包商的损失负赔偿责任。
Translation: (4) A procuring entity shall not be liable for damages incurred by a supplier or contractor solely due to the failure to maintain records of the procurement process as required under this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条．拒绝全部投标、建议、报盘或报价（1）（经…（颁布国指定的一个审批机关）批准后，而且）在招标文件或在征求建议、报盘或报价的其他文件中有此规定的情况下，采购实体可在接受一项投标、建议、报盘或报价前的任何时候，拒绝全部投标、建议、报盘或报价。
Translation: Article 12. Rejection of All Tenders, Proposals, Offers or Quotations (1) (Subject to the prior approval of... (the approving authority designated by the enacting State), and) where so provided in the solicitation documents or in any other documents requesting tenders, proposals, offers or quotations, the procuring entity may, at any time prior to the acceptance of a tender, proposal, offer or quotation, reject all tenders, proposals, offers or quotations.

Query_Text_cn: 采购实体应根据请求，将其拒绝全部投标、建议、报盘或报价的理由告知提交了投标书、建议书、报盘或报价的任何供应商或承包商，但无须解释那些理由。
