Translation: The procuring entity shall, upon request, inform any supplier or contractor that has submitted a tender, proposal, offer or quotation of the reasons for the rejection of all tenders, proposals, offers or quotations, but is not required to justify those reasons.

Query_Text_cn: （2）采购实体并不应仅仅因其援引本条第（1）款规定而对提交了投标书、建议书、报盘或报价的供应商或承包商而负有赔偿责任。
Translation: (2) A procuring entity shall not incur liability to suppliers or contractors that have submitted tenders, proposals, offers or quotations solely on the ground of invoking the provisions of paragraph (1).

Query_Text_cn: （3）拒绝全部投标、建议、报盘或报价的通知应迅速发交提交了投标书、建议书、报盘或报价的所有供应商或承包商。
Translation: (3) A notice rejecting all tenders, proposals, offers or quotations shall be promptly communicated to all suppliers or contractors that submitted tenders, proposals, offers or quotations.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条．采购合同的生效（1）在招标程序中，接受投标书和采购合同的生效均应按第36条的规定办理。
Translation:
Article 13. Effectiveness of Procurement Contracts  
(1) In the tendering process, the acceptance of bid submissions and the effectiveness of procurement contracts shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Article 36.

Query_Text_cn: （2）在所有其他采购方法中，应在邀请建议、报盘或报价时向各供应商或承包商明示采购合同如何生效。
Translation: (2) In all other procurement methods, suppliers or contractors shall be clearly informed at the time of the invitation for proposals, offers, or quotations on how the procurement contract will come into effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条．授予采购合同的公告（1）采购实体应迅速发布授予采购合同的公告。
Translation: Article 14. Notification of awarding the procurement contract (1) The procuring entity shall promptly publish a notice of the award of the procurement contract.

Query_Text_cn: （2）采购条例可就第（1）款所要求的公告的发布方式作出规定。
Translation: (2) The procurement regulations may prescribe the manner in which the notice required under subsection (1) is to be published.

Query_Text_cn: （3）第（1）款的规定不适用于所授合同价格低于[…]者。
Translation: (3) The provisions of paragraph (1) shall not apply to contracts awarded at a price below [...].

Query_Text_cn: 第15条．供应商或承包商的利诱如果提交了投标书、建议书、报盘或报价的供应商或承包商直接地或间接地提议给予、给予或同意给予采购实体或其他政府当局的任何现任或前任官员或雇员任何形式的酬礼，或提议给予任职机会或任何其他服务或价值，作为利诱，促使采购实体在采购过程中作出某一行为或决定，或采取某一程序，（经…（由颁布国指定的一个审批机关）批准后，）采购实体应拒不接受该供应商或承包商提出的投标书、建议书、报盘或报价。
Translation:
Article 15. Inducement from the supplier or contractor  

If a supplier or contractor that has submitted a tender, proposal, offer, or quotation directly or indirectly offers, gives, or agrees to give any form of gratification—or proposes to provide employment opportunities, any other service, or anything of value—to any current or former official or employee of the procuring entity or another government authority as an inducement to influence the procuring entity’s action, decision, or procedure in the procurement process, (upon approval by…[the designated reviewing authority of the enacting State],) the procuring entity shall reject the tender, proposal, offer, or quotation submitted by that supplier or contractor.

Query_Text_cn: 对该投标书、建议书、报盘或报价的此类拒绝及其原因应载入采购过程的记录之内，并迅速通知该供应商或承包商。
Translation: Such rejection of the tender, proposal, offer, or quotation and the reasons thereof shall be recorded in the procurement process documentation and promptly communicated to the supplier or contractor.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条．关于货物、工程或服务说明的规则（1）任何有关拟采购货物、工程或服务的技术或质量特点的规格、平面图、图样和设计，以及关于试验和试验方法、包装、标志或标签或合格证等要求以及代号和术语，或对于服务的说明，如对供应商和承包商参与采购过程造成障碍，包括基于国籍的障碍，均不得列入或用于资格预审文件、招标文件或征求建议、报盘或报价的文件之中。
Translation:
Article 16. Rules Concerning the Description of Goods, Construction or Services  
(1) No specifications, plans, drawings, or designs related to the technical or quality characteristics of the goods, construction, or services to be procured, nor any requirements concerning tests and testing methods, packaging, marking, labeling, or certification, nor any codes and terminology, or descriptions of services that may create obstacles to the participation of suppliers and contractors in the procurement process, including obstacles based on nationality, shall be included or used in prequalification documents, tender documents, or documents soliciting proposals, offers, or quotations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）任何规格、平面图、图样、设计和要求或对于服务的说明，应尽可能以拟采购货物、工程或服务有关的客观技术和质量特点为依据。
Translation: (2) Any specifications, plans, drawings, designs, requirements, or descriptions of services shall, to the greatest extent possible, be based on objective technical and quality characteristics related to the goods, works, or services to be procured.

Query_Text_cn: 不得要求或提及某特定商标、名称、专利、设计、型号、具体来源或生产者，除非没有充分确切或易懂的其他方式来说明拟采购货物、工程或服务的特点，在这种情况下应写上例如“或与其相当者”这种词语。
Translation: No requirement or reference to a particular trademark, name, patent, design, type, specific origin, or producer shall be made unless there is no sufficiently precise or intelligible way of describing the characteristics of the goods, works, or services to be procured. In such cases, terms such as "or equivalent" shall be included.

Query_Text_cn: （b）在拟定通过采购过程而产生的将予订立的采购合同的规定和条件时，或在拟定资格预审文件、招标文件或征求建议、报盘或报价的其他文件的其他有关内容时，应适当考虑采用已有的标准贸易术语。
Translation: (b) When formulating the provisions and conditions of procurement contracts to be concluded through the procurement process, or when drafting other relevant content in prequalification documents, tender documents, or other documents soliciting proposals, offers, or quotations, due consideration should be given to the adoption of existing standard trade terms.

Query_Text_cn: （a）采购程序根据第8条第（1）款规定只限于国内供应商或承包商参与，或（b）采购实体考虑到拟采购的货物、工程或服务的价值低，断定只有本国的供应商或承包商才会感兴趣。
Translation: (a) The procurement procedure is limited to domestic suppliers or contractors pursuant to the provisions of Article 8(1), or (b) the procuring entity determines that only domestic suppliers or contractors would be interested, taking into account the low value of the goods, works, or services to be procured.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条．采购方法2（1）除本章另有规定外，凡采购货物或工程的采购实体均应通过招标程序进行采购。
Translation: Article 18. Methods of Procurement 2 (1) Subject to the provisions of this Chapter, procuring entities shall procure goods or construction by means of open tendering procedures.

Query_Text_cn: （2）在进行货物或工程的采购中，采购实体只有在遵照第19、20、21或22条的规定的情况下才可使用招标程序以外的某种采购方法。
Translation: (2) In the procurement of goods or works, a procuring entity may use a procurement method other than tendering procedures only in accordance with the provisions of Articles 19, 20, 21, or 22.

Query_Text_cn: 或（b）（经……（颁布国指定的一个审批机关）批准后，）使用第19至22条所述的一种采购方法较为适当，但要满足使用该种方法的条件。
Translation: or (b) use of a procurement method referred to in articles 19 to 22 is, subject to the conditions for the use of such method, more appropriate, (after approval by (an approval authority designated by the enacting State)).

Query_Text_cn: （4）如果采购实体按照第（2）款或第（3）款（a）或（b）项使用某一采购方法，它应在第11条规定的采购记录中列入一项关于使用该种方法所根据的理由和情况的说明。
Translation: (4) If a procuring entity uses a procurement method in accordance with paragraph (2) or subparagraph (a) or (b) of paragraph (3), it shall include in the record of procurement referred to in Article 11 a statement indicating the justification and circumstances relied on for the use of that method.

Query_Text_cn: 或（d）已采用招标程序，但未有人投标，或采购实体根据第12条、第15条或第34条第（3）款的规定拒绝了全部投标，而且采购实体认为再进行新的招标程序也不太可能产生采购合同。
Translation: or (d) tendering procedures have already been used but no tenders were submitted, or the procuring entity has rejected all tenders in accordance with Article 12, 15 or paragraph (3) of Article 34, and the procuring entity considers that new tendering procedures are unlikely to result in a procurement contract.

Query_Text_cn: 或（b）由于某一灾难性事件，急需得到该货物、工程或服务，而采用其他采购方法因耗时太久而不可行。
Translation: or (b) where, due to a catastrophic event, there is an urgent need for the goods, works, or services, and the use of other procurement methods is impracticable due to excessive time constraints.

Query_Text_cn: 或（b）研究和评审大量投标书所需时间和费用与拟采购货物、工程或服务的价值不成比例。
Translation: or (b) the time and cost required to examine and evaluate a substantial number of bids would be disproportionate to the value of the goods, works, or services to be procured.

Query_Text_cn: 第21条．采用邀请报价的条件（1）（经……（由颁布国指定的一个审批机关）批准后，）采购实体可按照第50条规定采用邀请报价的采购方法来采购现成的、并非按采购实体的特定规格特别制造或提供并已有既定市场的货物或服务，只要采购合同的估计值低于采购条例规定的数额。
Translation: Article 21. Conditions for use of request for quotations (1) (Subject to approval by […] (or such other approval authority as the enacting State may designate)), the procuring entity may procure readily available goods or services that are not specially manufactured or provided according to particular specifications of the procuring entity and that have an established market by the method of request for quotations in accordance with article 50, provided that the estimated value of the procurement contract is less than a value prescribed in the procurement regulations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）采购实体不得为了援引本条第（1）款规定而将其采购合同分解成为几个合同。
Translation: (2) A procuring entity shall not structure procurement in separate contracts nor use any other method for the purpose of avoiding the application of paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 或（f）采购实体根据第1条第（3）款，将本法适用于涉及国防或国家安全的采购，并断定单一来源采购为最适当的采购方法。
Translation: or (f) the procuring entity applies this Law to procurement involving national defense or security pursuant to paragraph 3 of Article 1 and determines that single-source procurement is the most appropriate method.

Query_Text_cn: （2）经……（由颁布国指定的一个审批机关）批准后，并在公布周知和提供充分评议机会之后，采购实体如有必要从某一特定供应商或承包商处进行采购以便促进第34条第（4）款（c）（三）项或第39条第（1）款（d）项所述的某一政策，可以进行单一来源采购，但条件是从任何别的供应商或承包商处采购都不能促进该政策。
Translation: (2) After approval by... (an approving authority designated by the enacting State) and following public notification and adequate opportunity for comment, a procuring entity may proceed with single-source procurement if necessary to procure from a particular supplier or contractor in order to promote a policy referred to in subparagraph (c)(iii) of paragraph (4) of article 34 or subparagraph (d) of paragraph (1) of article 39, provided that such policy cannot be promoted through procurement from any other supplier or contractor.

Query_Text_cn: 第23条．国内招标在下述情况的采购过程中：__UNDEF__（a）根据第8条第（1）款只限国内供应商或承包商参加，或（b）于拟采购的货物、工程或服务的价值不高，采购实体断定只有国内供应商或承包商才可能有兴趣提交投标书的采购过程，采购实体无须采用本法第24条第（2）款、第25条第（1）款（h）项、第25条第（1）款（i）项、第25条第（2）款（c）项、第25款第（2）款（d）项、第27条（j）、（k）、（s）项和第32条第（1）款（c）项规定的程序。
Translation:
Article 23. Domestic Tendering. In procurement proceedings where:  
(a) participation is limited under paragraph (1) of Article 8 to domestic suppliers or contractors; or  
(b) owing to the low value of the goods, construction or services to be procured, the procuring entity determines that only domestic suppliers or contractors are likely to be interested in submitting tenders,  

the procuring entity need not apply the procedures prescribed in paragraph (2) of Article 24; subparagraph (h) and (i) of paragraph (1) of Article 25; subparagraph (c) and (d) of paragraph (2) of Article 25; subparagraph (j), (k) and (s) of Article 27; and subparagraph (c) of paragraph (1) of Article 32.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条．征求投标或资格预审申请的程序（1）采购实体应通过在……（由颁布国列明将刊登投标邀请书或资格预审邀请书的官方公报或其他官方出版物）上斟酌情况刊登投标邀请书或资格预审邀请书，征求投标或在适用情况下征求资格预审申请。
Translation: Article 24. Procedures for solicitation of tenders or applications for prequalification (1) To solicit tenders or, where applicable, applications for prequalification, the procuring entity shall publish an invitation to tender or an invitation to prequalify, as the case may be, in...(the enacting State specifies the official gazette or other official publication in which invitations to tender or invitations to prequalify are to be published).

Query_Text_cn: （2）投标邀请书或资格预审邀请书还应以国际贸易惯常使用的一种语文在一份国际广泛发行的报纸或在一份国际广泛发行的有关行业出版物或技术或专业刊物上刊登。
Translation: (2) The invitation to tender or to prequalify shall also be published in one of the languages customary in international trade in an international widely circulated newspaper or in an internationally widely circulated relevant trade publication or technical or professional journal.

Query_Text_cn: （j）提交投标书的地点和截止日期。
Translation: (j) Location and deadline for submission of the bid.

Query_Text_cn: （e）提交资格预审申请书的地点和截止日期。
Translation: (e) Location and deadline for submission of the prequalification application.

Query_Text_cn: 第26条．招标文件的提供采购实体应根据投标邀请书中列明的程序和要求，向供应商或承包商提供招标文件。
Translation:
Article 26. Provision of Tender Documents  
The procuring entity shall provide tender documents to suppliers or contractors in accordance with the procedures and requirements set forth in the invitation to tender.

Query_Text_cn: 如果已进行资格预审程序，采购实体应向已通过资格预审并已支付这类文件所收取的任何费用的每个供应商或承包商提供成套招标文件。
Translation: If prequalification procedures have been conducted, the procuring entity shall provide a set of tender documents to each supplier or contractor that has been prequalified and has paid any fees charged for such documents.

Query_Text_cn: 采购实体对招标文件收取的费用只能是印制和将其寄送供应商或承包商的成本。
Translation: The procuring entity may charge for the tender documents only the cost of their printing and delivery to suppliers or contractors.

Query_Text_cn: 前言本《法律指南》系由联合国国际贸易法委员会（贸易法委员会）编写。
Translation:
Foreword  
This *Legal Guide* has been prepared by the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law (UNCITRAL).

Query_Text_cn: 除委员会成员国代表外，其他许多国家和一些国际政府间组织和非政府组织的代表也积极参与了编写工作。
Translation: In addition to representatives of the member states of the Committee, delegates from many other countries, as well as representatives of several intergovernmental and non-governmental organizations, also actively participated in the drafting process.

Query_Text_cn: 1996年，委员会以秘书处关于建设-运营-移交（BOT）项目的一份说明1为基础，审议了私人融资基础设施项目领域今后可能开展的工作。
Translation: In 1996, the Committee considered possible future work in the field of privately financed infrastructure projects based on a note by the Secretariat on build-operate-transfer (BOT) projects.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会决定编写一份法律指南，并请秘书处草拟该指南的章节。
Translation: The Committee decided to prepare a legal guide and requested the Secretariat to draft the chapters of the guide.

Query_Text_cn: 2委员会第三十届至第三十三届会议审查了草拟的章节。
Translation: The Draft Chapter was reviewed by the Committee at its thirtieth to thirty-third sessions.

Query_Text_cn: 3委员会在2000年6月12日至7月7日于纽约举行的其第三十三届会议上，通过了《法律指南》，编辑上的一些改动留待秘书处负责处理。__UNDEF__并请秘书处确保《法律指南》尽可能得以最广泛地传播。
Translation:
At its thirty-third session held in New York from 12 June to 7 July 2000, the third Committee adopted the Legislative Guide, 
with editorial modifications to be completed by the Secretariat.__UNDEF__The Secretariat was also requested to ensure the widest possible dissemination of the Legislative Guide.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书处的说明”（ACN9424）（《1996年联合国国际贸易法委员会年鉴》（以下称作“贸易法委员会年鉴”）（联合国出版物，出售品编号：__UNDEF__E.98.V.7，第二十七卷），第二部分，第五章）。
Translation: "Note by the Secretariat" (ACN.9/424) (Yearbook of the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law, 1996 (hereinafter referred to as the "UNCITRAL Yearbook") (United Nations Publication, Sales No.: __UNDEF__ E.98.V.7, Volume XXVII), Part Two, Chapter V).

Query_Text_cn: 2见《大会正式记录，第五十一届会议，补编第17号》（A5117），第225-230段（《1996年贸易法委员会年鉴》，第一部分）。
Translation: See Official Records of the General Assembly, Fifty-first Session, Supplement No. 17 (A/51/17), paras. 225-230 (Yearbook of the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law, 1996, Part One).

Query_Text_cn: 同上，《第五十四届会议，补编第17号》（A5417），第12-307段。
Translation: Ditto, “Fifty-fourth Session, Supplement No. 17” (A/54/17), paragraphs 12-307.

Query_Text_cn: 立法建议的目的在于协助建立一个有利于私人融资基础设施项目的立法框架。
Translation: The purpose of the legislative proposal is to assist in establishing a legal framework conducive to private financing of infrastructure projects.

Query_Text_cn: 立法建议后附有说明，针对有关主题领域出现的财政、管理、法律、政策及其他问题进行分析性介绍。
Translation: The legislative proposal is accompanied by explanatory notes that provide an analytical introduction to financial, administrative, legal, policy, and other issues arising in the relevant thematic areas.

Query_Text_cn: 望读者结合所附说明阅读立法建议，说明中提供了有助于加深对立法建议的理解的背景资料。
Translation: Readers are advised to review the legislative proposal alongside the attached explanatory notes, which provide background information to facilitate a deeper understanding of the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 立法建议涉及有关私人融资基础设施项目的专门立法中应予处理的事项。
Translation: The legislative proposal addresses matters that should be addressed in specialized legislation concerning privately financed infrastructure projects.

Query_Text_cn: 正如立法建议说明中所讨论的那样，立法建议并不涉及对私人融资基础设施项目也有影响的其他法律领域。
Translation: As discussed in the legislative proposal's explanatory notes, the proposal does not address other legal areas that also affect privately financed infrastructure projects.

Query_Text_cn: 另外，成功地实施私人融资基础设施项目，除要求建立适宜的立法框架以外，通常还需要采取各种其他措施，例如适宜的行政结构和做法、组织能力、技术专门知识、适当的人力及财力资源和经济稳定性等。
Translation: Moreover, the successful implementation of privately financed infrastructure projects typically requires not only the establishment of an appropriate legislative framework but also various other measures, such as suitable administrative structures and practices, organizational capacity, technical expertise, adequate human and financial resources, and economic stability.

Query_Text_cn: 一．一般性立法和体制框架宪法、立法和体制框架（见第一章，“一般性立法和体制框架”，第2-14段）建议1．关于实施私人融资基础设施项目的宪法、立法和体制框架，应确保项目的透明度、公平性和长期可持续性。
Translation:
I. General Legislative and Institutional Framework  
The constitutional, legislative, and institutional framework (see Chapter I, "General Legislative and Institutional Framework," paragraphs 2–14)  

Recommendation 1:  
The constitutional, legislative, and institutional framework for implementing privately financed infrastructure projects should ensure transparency, fairness, and long-term sustainability.

Query_Text_cn: 应取消对私营部门参与基础设施开发和运营的不合理限制。
Translation: Unreasonable restrictions on private sector participation in infrastructure development and operation should be abolished.

Query_Text_cn: 授予特许权的权力范围（见第一章，“一般性立法和体制框架”，第15-22段）建议2．法律应确定有权授予特许权和签订协议以实施私人融资基础设施项目的所在国公共当局（视情况包括国家、省及地方各级当局）。
Translation:
Scope of Authority to Grant Concessions (see Chapter I, "General Legislative and Institutional Framework," paragraphs 15-22)  

Recommendation 2. The law shall specify the domestic public authorities (including, as applicable, national, provincial, and local levels) empowered to grant concessions and enter into agreements for privately financed infrastructure projects.

Query_Text_cn: 建议3．私人融资基础设施项目可包括新基础设施和系统的建造和运营或现有基础设施和系统的维护、现代化、扩建和运营的特许权。
Translation: Suggestion 3. Privately financed infrastructure projects may include concessions for the construction and operation of new infrastructure and systems, or the maintenance, modernization, expansion, and operation of existing infrastructure and systems.

Query_Text_cn: 建议4．法律应确定可对哪些部门或哪类基础设施授予特许权。
Translation: Suggestion 4: The law should specify which sectors or categories of infrastructure may be granted concessions.

Query_Text_cn: 建议5．法律应具体规定特许权在多大程度上可扩大到分属于各个订约当局管辖的整个区域，其中一个地理分区或一个独立的项目，并根据适用于有关行业部门的法律规则和原则、法规条款、条例和政策，具体规定可否酌情授予享有或不享有独家经营权的特许权。
Translation: Suggestion 5. The law should specify the extent to which concessions may be extended to cover the entire territory under the jurisdiction of each contracting authority, a specific geographical subdivision, or an independent project. It should also define whether concessions may be granted with or without exclusive operating rights, as appropriate, in accordance with the legal rules and principles, regulatory provisions, regulations, and policies applicable to the relevant industry sector.

Query_Text_cn: 可授权若干订约当局联合授予超出单一管辖区的特许权。
Translation: It is permissible to authorize several contracting authorities to jointly grant concessions that exceed the scope of a single jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 行政协调（见第一章，“一般性立法和体制框架”，第23-29段）建议6．应建立体制机制，对负责根据关于有关类型基础设施的建造和运营的法规或管理规定颁发实施私人融资基础设施项目所要求的批准书、执照、许可证或授权书的公共当局开展的活动进行协调。
Translation:
Administrative Coordination (see Chapter I, "General Legislative and Institutional Framework," paragraphs 23-29)  
Recommendation 6. Mechanisms should be established to coordinate the activities of public authorities responsible for issuing approvals, licenses, permits, or authorizations required for privately financed infrastructure projects in accordance with laws or regulatory provisions governing the construction and operation of the relevant types of infrastructure.

Query_Text_cn: 基础设施服务的管理当局（见第一章，“一般性立法和体制框架”第30-53段）建议7．不应将管理基础设施服务的权限交给那些直接或间接为基础设施提供服务的实体。
Translation: The regulatory authority for infrastructure services (see Chapter 1, "General Legislative and Institutional Framework," paragraphs 30-53) Recommendation 7: The authority to regulate infrastructure services should not be granted to entities that directly or indirectly provide such services.

Query_Text_cn: 建议8．管理权限应交给具有充分自主权的职能上独立的机构，以确保其决定是在没有基础设施运营者和公共服务提供者政治干预或不适当压力的情况下作出的。
Translation: Recommendation 8. Regulatory authority should be entrusted to functionally independent bodies with sufficient autonomy to ensure their decisions are made free from political interference or undue pressure by infrastructure operators and public service providers.

Query_Text_cn: 建议9．应公布管理程序规则。
Translation: Recommendation 9: The rules of administrative procedures should be made public.

Query_Text_cn: 管理上的决定应说明所依据的理由，并应通过出版物或其他手段使有关当事方可以查阅。
Translation: Administrative decisions shall state the reasons on which they are based and shall be made accessible to the parties concerned through publication or other means.

Query_Text_cn: 建议10．法律应确立具有透明度的程序，使特许公司可据以要求独立、公正的机构对某项管理上的决定进行审查，包括法庭审查，法律还应列出可据以进行这种审查的理由。
Translation: Recommendation 10. The law should establish transparent procedures enabling concession companies to request an independent and impartial body to review an administrative decision, including judicial review, and should specify the grounds on which such review may be conducted.

Query_Text_cn: 建议11．应酌情建立专门程序，处理公共服务提供者之间对声称违反有关行业部门的法律和条例而发生的争端。
Translation: Recommendation 11: Special procedures should be established as appropriate to address disputes among public service providers arising from alleged violations of laws and regulations pertaining to the relevant sector.

Query_Text_cn: 二．项目风险和政府支助项目风险和风险分担（见第二章，“项目风险和政府支助”，第8-29段）建议12．不应对订约当局在适合项目需要的情况下商定风险分担方法的能力加以法规或管理上的不必要限制。
Translation:
II. Project Risks and Government Support  
Project Risks and Risk Allocation (see Chapter II, "Project Risks and Government Support," paragraphs 8-29)  

Recommendation 12. Contracting authorities should not be subject to unnecessary regulatory or administrative restrictions on their ability to negotiate risk allocation methods appropriate to the project's needs.

Query_Text_cn: 政府支助（见第二章，“项目风险和政府支助”，第30-60段）建议13．法律应明确指明所在国的哪些公共当局可为实施私人融资基础设施项目提供财政或经济支助，以及授权其提供哪类支助。
Translation:
Government Support (see Chapter II, "Project Risks and Government Support," paragraphs 30-60)  
Recommendation 13. The law should clearly specify which public authorities in the host country may provide financial or economic support for privately financed infrastructure projects, as well as the types of support they are authorized to offer.

Query_Text_cn: 三．特许公司的选定一般性考虑（见第三章，“特许公司的选定”，第1-33段）建议14．法律应规定须通过适合私人融资基础设施项目具体需要的具有透明度和高效率的竞争程序来选定特许公司。
Translation:
III. General Considerations for the Selection of Concession Companies (see Chapter III, "Selection of Concession Companies," paragraphs 1-33)  
Recommendation 14. The law shall stipulate that concession companies must be selected through a competitive process that is transparent, efficient, and tailored to the specific requirements of privately financed infrastructure projects.

Query_Text_cn: （c）具备适宜的管理和组织能力、可靠性和经验，包括以往运营公共基础设施的经验。
Translation: (c) Possess appropriate management and organizational capabilities, reliability, and experience, including prior experience in operating public infrastructure.

Query_Text_cn: 建议16．应允许投标人组成联营集团提交标书，但是，不论是直接参加还是通过子公司参加，预选选定的联营集团的每一成员只能参加一个投标联营集团。

The procedure for soliciting bids (see Chapter III,"Selection of the Concessionaire," paragraphs 51-84)  
Procedures for soliciting bids in one or two stages  
Recommendation 18. After the pre-selection process, the contracting authority shall invite the pre-selected bidders to submit their final bids.

Query_Text_cn: 建议19．尽管如此，如果订约当局无法以足够详细和精确的方式拟订项目技术规格或性能指标及合同条件以便于最后投标书的拟定，订约当局可利用两阶段程序向预选选定的投标人征求投标书。
Translation: Suggestion 19. Nevertheless, where the contracting authority is unable to define the technical specifications or performance requirements of the project and the contractual terms with sufficient detail and precision to enable the preparation of final tenders, it may resort to a two-stage procedure by inviting tenders from pre-selected candidates.

Query_Text_cn: （c）在审查了收到的投标书之后，订约当局可审查并酌情修订最初的项目技术规格和合同条款，然后再发出最后征求投标书通告。
Translation: (c) After reviewing the bids received, the contracting authority may examine and, where appropriate, revise the initial technical specifications of the project and the terms of the contract before issuing the final call for tenders.

Query_Text_cn: （d）评价投标书的标准，对每项这类标准所给予的相对比重，以及在评价投标书时运用这些标准的方式。
Translation: (d) The criteria for evaluating bids, the relative weight accorded to each such criterion, and the manner in which these criteria are applied in bid evaluation.

Query_Text_cn: 澄清和修改建议21．订约当局可以主动也可以因投标者的澄清要求而通过在提交投标书截止日期之前的合理时间内发出增补通告的方式对最后征求投标书通告进行修改。
Translation: Clarifications and Modifications 21. The contracting authority may, either on its own initiative or at the request of a tenderer, modify the final tender notice by issuing an addendum within a reasonable period before the deadline for submission of tenders.

Query_Text_cn: （d）投标书提供的社会和经济发展潜力。
Translation: (d) The socio-economic development potential presented in the bid.

Query_Text_cn: （f）拟议合同条款的接受程度。
Translation: (f) Acceptance of the proposed contract terms.

Query_Text_cn: 投标书的提交、开启、比较和评价建议24．订约当局可根据征求投标书通告中所列标准确立拟在投标书中体现的质量、技术、财务和商业方面的最低限度。
Translation: Submission,Opening,Comparison and Evaluation of Tenders 24. The contracting authority may establish minimum levels of quality,technical,financial and commercial aspects to be reflected in the tenders based on the criteria set out in the notice inviting tenders.

Query_Text_cn: 未达到最低限度的投标书应视为不符合要求。
Translation: Bids that fail to meet the minimum requirements shall be deemed non-compliant.

Query_Text_cn: 建议25．不论是否采用了预选程序，订约当局都可保留要求投标人再次证明其根据征求投标书通告所列标准和程序或预选文件（视情况而定）所具备的资格的权利。
Translation: Recommendation 25. Whether or not a pre-selection procedure has been used, the contracting authority may reserve the right to require tenderers to demonstrate again their qualifications in accordance with the criteria and procedures set out in the notice calling for tenders or in the pre-selection documents, as the case may be.

Query_Text_cn: 如果采用了预选程序，标准应与预选程序所采用的标准一样。
Translation: If a preselection procedure is adopted, the criteria should be the same as those used in the preselection procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 最后谈判和授予项目建议26．订约当局应按照征求投标书通告所列评价标准排出所有符合要求的投标书的名次，并邀请名列榜首的投标人进行项目协议的最后谈判。
Translation:
Final Negotiation and Award of Project Proposal  

26. The contracting authority shall rank all compliant tenders according to the evaluation criteria set out in the notice inviting tenders and invite the top-ranked tenderer to finalize negotiations on the project agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 最后谈判不得涉及最后征求投标书通告中指明的不可谈判的合同条款。
Translation: The final negotiations shall not involve any non-negotiable contract terms specified in the notice for final solicitation of bids.

Query_Text_cn: 建议27.如果订约当局认为与被邀请的投标人的谈判显然不会达成项目协议，订约当局应通知该投标人它将终止谈判，然后按照排名先后邀请其他投标人进行谈判，直至达成项目协议或否决所有其余的投标书。
Translation: Recommendation 27. If the contracting authority determines that negotiations with an invited tenderer are clearly unlikely to result in a project agreement, it shall notify the tenderer that it will terminate the negotiations and then invite other tenderers in order of ranking to negotiate until a project agreement is reached or all remaining tenders are rejected.

Query_Text_cn: （g）由于令人信服的公众利益原因而由更高当局授权作为这类例外的其他情形。
Translation: (g) Other circumstances authorized as such exceptions by a higher authority due to compelling public interest reasons.

Query_Text_cn: （c）除建议28（c）所述情形外，订约当局应安排公布授予特许权的通知，说明采用不经竞争程序而授予特许权做法的具体情况和原因。
Translation: (c) Except for the circumstances described in Recommendation 28(c), the contracting authority shall arrange for the publication of a notice of the award of the concession, specifying the particulars and reasons for resorting to the award of concessions without a competitive procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 非邀约投标书（见第三章，“特许公司的选定”，第97-117段）建议30．作为立法建议14-27所述挑选程序的例外，可授权订约当局根据依法确立的处理非邀约投标书的具体程序来处理非邀约投标书，但条件是此类投标书不涉及已由订约当局开始或宣布了筛选程序的项目。
Translation:
Unsolicited bids (see Chapter III, "Selection of the Concessionaire", paragraphs 97-117)  
Recommendation 30. As an exception to the selection procedures outlined in legislative recommendations 14-27, contracting authorities may be authorized to handle unsolicited bids under specific procedures established by law for this purpose, provided that such bids do not relate to projects for which the contracting authority has already initiated or announced a selection procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 确定非邀约投标书可接受性的程序建议31．在收到并初步审查非邀约投标书后，订约当局应在合理的短时间内通知投标人该项目是否符合潜在的公共利益。
Translation:
Procedural Recommendations for Determining the Acceptability of Unsolicited Bids  

31. Upon receipt and preliminary review of an unsolicited bid, the contracting authority shall notify the bidder within a reasonably short period whether the project aligns with potential public interest.

Query_Text_cn: 如果认为项目符合公共利益，订约当局应请投标人提交足够详细的正式投标书，以使订约当局能够恰当地评价其构想或技术，确定投标书是否符合法律规定的条件，以及是否有可能按拟议项目的规模顺利得以实施。
Translation: If the project is deemed to serve the public interest, the contracting authority shall request bidders to submit sufficiently detailed formal tenders to enable the authority to properly evaluate their concepts or technologies, determine whether the tenders meet the legally prescribed conditions, and assess the feasibility of successful implementation on the proposed project scale.

Query_Text_cn: 建议32．投标人应保留对整个程序期间提交的所有文件的所有权，如果投标书被拒绝，这些文件均应退还投标人。
Translation: Suggestion 32. The bidder shall retain ownership of all documents submitted during the entire process, and if the bid is rejected, all such documents shall be returned to the bidder.

Query_Text_cn: 处理不涉及专利概念或专利技术的非邀约投标书的程序建议33．如果订约当局认为不利用非邀约投标书提出者拥有专属权的工艺、设计、方法或工程概念也可取得项目的预期产出，或者所提出的概念或技术并非真正独特或新颖，订约当局应启动上文建议14-27所述的筛选程序。
Translation: Proposal 33 for handling unsolicited bids that do not involve patentable concepts or patented technologies. If the contracting authority determines that the expected project outcomes can be achieved without utilizing processes, designs, methods, or engineering concepts exclusively owned by the submitter of the unsolicited bid, or if the proposed concepts or technologies are not genuinely unique or novel, the contracting authority shall initiate the screening procedures outlined in Proposals 14-27 above.

Query_Text_cn: 应邀请非邀约投标书提出者参加这类程序，并可因其提交投标书而给予某种形式的奖赏。
Translation: Non-invited bidders should be invited to participate in such procedures and may be awarded some form of compensation for their submission of bids.

Query_Text_cn: 处理涉及专利概念或专利技术的非邀约投标书的程序建议34．如果看来不利用非邀约投标书提出者拥有专属权的工艺、设计、方法或工程概念即无法实现项目的预期产出，则订约当局应设法获得非邀约投标书的比较要素。
Translation:
Proposed Procedures for Handling Unsolicited Proposals Involving Patent Concepts or Technologies  
34. If it appears that the intended outputs of the project cannot be achieved without utilizing processes, designs, methods, or engineering concepts exclusively owned by the submitter of the unsolicited proposal, the contracting authority shall endeavor to obtain the comparative elements of the unsolicited proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，订约当局应公布关于该投标书的主要产出要素的说明，并邀请其他有兴趣的当事方在一合理期限内提交备选或可予比较的投标书。
Translation: To this end, the contracting authority shall publish a description of the key output elements of that bid and invite other interested parties to submit alternative or comparable bids within a reasonable time frame.

Query_Text_cn: 建议35．如果未收到备选投标书，订约当局可开始与非邀约投标书提出者进行谈判，但须经上一级当局的批准。
Translation: Proposal 35. In the absence of alternative tenders, the contracting authority may initiate negotiations with non-invited tenderers, subject to approval by the higher-level authority.

Query_Text_cn: 如果收到备选投标书，订约当局则应根据立法建议29（a）-（c）的规定，邀请所有投标人参加谈判。
Translation: If alternative tenders are received, the contracting authority shall invite all tenderers to participate in negotiations in accordance with the provisions of legislative proposals 29(a)-(c).

Query_Text_cn: 保密（见第三章，“特许公司的选定”第118段）建议36．订约当局与投标人之间的谈判应当保密，谈判一方未经他方的同意，不得向任何其他人透露与谈判有关的任何技术、价格或其他商业资料。
Translation:
Confidentiality (see Chapter III, "Selection of Concession Companies," paragraph 118)  
Recommendation 36. Negotiations between the contracting authority and bidders shall be confidential. Neither party shall disclose any technical, pricing, or other commercial information related to the negotiations to any third party without the consent of the other party.

Query_Text_cn: 授予项目的通知（见第三章，“特许公司的选定”第119段）建议37．订约当局应安排发布项目授予通知。
Translation: Notification of Project Award (see Chapter III, "Selection of Concession Companies," paragraph 119) Recommendation 37. The contracting authority shall arrange for the publication of the project award notice.

Query_Text_cn: 通知中应列明特许公司的名称，并应摘要介绍项目协议的基本条款。
Translation: The notice shall specify the name of the concession company and summarize the key terms of the project agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 筛选和授予程序的记录（见第三章，“特许公司的选定”，第120-126段）建议38．订约当局应保持与筛选和授予程序有关的主要信息的适当记录。
Translation:
Records of the selection and award procedures (see Chapter III, "Selection of the concessionaire", paragraphs 120-126)  
Recommendation 38. Contracting authorities shall maintain appropriate records of the key information relating to the selection and award procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 法律应对公民查阅权作出规定。
Translation: Laws should stipulate citizens' right to access information.

Query_Text_cn: 审查程序（见第三章，“特许公司的选定”，第127-131段）建议39．投标人声称因订约当局违反了法律对订约当局所规定的责任而致使投标人遭受或可能遭受损失或伤害的，可以要求根据所在国的法律审查订约当局的行为。
Translation:
Review Procedures (see Chapter III, "Selection of Concession Companies", paragraphs 127-131)  
Recommendation 39. A bidder who claims to have suffered or is likely to suffer loss or damage due to a contracting authority's breach of its legal obligations may request a review of the contracting authority's actions in accordance with the laws of the country concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 建议40．法律可列明拟在项目协议中规定的核心条款，其中可包括下文建议41-68所述的条款。
Translation: Suggestion 40. The law may specify the core terms to be stipulated in the project agreement, which may include the provisions set out in Suggestions 41-68 below.

Query_Text_cn: 建议41．除非另有规定，项目协议受所在国法律的管辖。
Translation: Recommendation 41. Unless otherwise stipulated, the project agreement shall be governed by the laws of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 订约当局应可选择是否要求中标人建立一个将所在地设在订约当局本国的独立法律实体。
Translation: The contracting authority shall have the option to require the successful tenderer to establish an independent legal entity domiciled in the country of the contracting authority.

Query_Text_cn: 建议43．项目协议应明确规定项目公司的最低资本数额和获得订约当局批准项目公司章程和附则及其重大变动的程序。
Translation: Recommendation 43. The project agreement shall clearly stipulate the minimum capital amount of the project company and the procedures for obtaining the contracting authority's approval of the project company's articles of association and bylaws, as well as any material amendments thereto.

Query_Text_cn: 项目协议应酌情明文规定哪些资产为公共财产，哪些资产为特许公司私有财产。
Translation: The project agreement shall expressly specify, as appropriate, which assets constitute public property and which are the private property of the concession company.

Query_Text_cn: 以及哪些资产在项目协议期满或终止后可由特许公司自由转移或处理。
Translation: and which assets can be freely transferred or disposed of by the concession company upon the expiration or termination of the project agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 建议45．订约当局应帮助特许公司获得为运营、建造或维护该设施所必需的与项目场地有关的权利。
Translation: Article 45. The contracting authority shall assist the concession company in obtaining the rights related to the project site that are necessary for the operation, construction, or maintenance of the facility.

Query_Text_cn: 法律可根据建造、运营和维护有关设施的需要而授权特许公司进入或穿越第三方地产，或在第三方地产上作业或安装。
Translation: The law may authorize concession companies to enter or traverse third-party properties, or to conduct operations or installations thereon, as necessary for the construction, operation, and maintenance of relevant facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 法律应使特许公司能够对利用该设施或该设施所提供的服务而收取服务费或使用费。
Translation: The law shall enable the concession company to charge service fees or usage fees for utilizing the facility or the services provided by the facility.

Query_Text_cn: 项目协议应规定调整这些服务费或使用费的方法和公式。
Translation: The project agreement shall specify the methods and formulas for adjusting these service fees or usage charges.

Query_Text_cn: 建议47．如果特许公司收取的服务费或使用费受某一管理机构的外部控制，法律应规定对服务费调整公式进行定期特别修订的各种机制。
Translation: Proposal 47. If the service fees or usage charges collected by the concession company are subject to external control by a regulatory authority, the law should establish various mechanisms for periodic special revisions to the fee adjustment formula.

Query_Text_cn: 建议48．订约当局应有权力视情况同意向特许公司直接付款，以替代或补充应由用户支付的服务费，或承诺采购固定数量的货物或服务。
Translation: 48. Contracting authorities should have the power to agree, where appropriate, to make direct payments to concession companies in lieu of or in addition to service fees payable by users, or to commit to purchasing a fixed quantity of goods or services.

Query_Text_cn: 特许公司应负责筹集建造及运营基础设施所需要的资金，为此，特许公司应有权以其任何财产的物权担保、项目公司的股份抵押、特许权产生的收益和应收款抵押或以其他合适的担保来为项目所需要的任何融资作担保，但不得影响可能禁止对公共财产建立物权担保的任何法律规定。
Translation: The concession company shall be responsible for raising the funds required for the construction and operation of the infrastructure. To this end, the concession company shall have the right to secure any financing needed for the project by establishing real rights guarantees over any of its assets, pledging shares of the project company, mortgaging revenues and receivables generated from the concession, or providing other appropriate guarantees, without prejudice to any legal provisions that may prohibit the creation of real rights over public property.

Query_Text_cn: 未经订约当局同意，不得向第三方转让特许权。
Translation: The concession rights shall not be transferred to a third party without the consent of the contracting authority.

Query_Text_cn: 项目协议应规定在哪些情况下订约当局可同意特许权的转让，包括由新的特许公司接受项目协议规定的所有义务，并证明新的特许公司具备提供该项服务所必需的技术及财务能力。
Translation: The project agreement shall specify the circumstances under which the contracting authority may consent to the transfer of the concession, including the assumption by the new concession company of all obligations under the project agreement and the demonstration that the new concession company possesses the necessary technical and financial capacity to provide the service.

Query_Text_cn: 特许公司控股权益的转让可能需经订约当局的同意，但另有规定的除外。
Translation: The transfer of controlling interests in a concession company may require the consent of the contracting authority, unless otherwise stipulated.

Query_Text_cn: 项目协议应规定订约当局审查和批准施工计划和技术规格的程序、订约当局监督建造或改进基础设施的权利、订约当局在哪些情况下可令改变施工技术规格，以及有关设施、其设备和配件的测试和最后检查、批准和验收的程序。
Translation: The project agreement shall specify the procedures for the contracting authority to review and approve construction plans and technical specifications, the contracting authority's right to supervise the construction or improvement of infrastructure, the circumstances under which the contracting authority may require changes to construction technical specifications, as well as the procedures for testing, final inspection, approval, and acceptance of the relevant facilities, their equipment, and components.

Query_Text_cn: （d）酌情一视同仁地为其他服务提供者利用特许公司运营的任何公共基础设施网络而提供机会。
Translation: (d) Provide opportunities for other service providers to utilize any public infrastructure networks operated by the concessionaire on a non-discriminatory basis as appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: （b）特许公司运作情况的监测程序以及按订约当局或管理机构认为适宜的方式采取合理行动的程序，从而确保根据适用法律和合同要求妥善经营基础设施并提供各项服务。
Translation: (b) Monitoring procedures for the operation of the concession company and the process for taking reasonable actions as deemed appropriate by the contracting authority or regulatory body, ensuring the proper management of infrastructure and provision of services in compliance with applicable laws and contractual requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 建议55．特许公司应有权颁布并执行设施使用的规则，但须经订约当局或管理机构批准。
Translation: Article 55. The concession company shall have the right to issue and enforce rules for the use of the facilities, subject to approval by the contracting authority or regulatory body.

Query_Text_cn: 建议56．订约当局可保留审查和批准特许公司拟签订的重大合同的权利，特别是审查和批准拟与特许公司本身的股东或有关人员签订的合同的权利。
Translation: Article 56. The contracting authority may reserve the right to examine and approve major contracts to be concluded by the concession company, in particular the right to examine and approve contracts to be concluded with the concession company's own shareholders or related persons.

Query_Text_cn: 在正常情况下，订约当局不应拒不批准，除非合同中载有与项目协议不一致的条款，或明显违背公共利益或公法性质的强制规则。
Translation: Under normal circumstances, the contracting authority should not withhold approval unless the contract contains terms inconsistent with the project agreement or clearly violates public interest or mandatory rules of a public law nature.

Query_Text_cn: 建议57．特许公司及其放款人、保险人和其他订约伙伴应可自由选择适用于管辖彼此之间合同关系的法律，但所作选择将违反所在国公共政策的情况除外。
Translation: Article 57. The concession company and its lenders, insurers, and other contracting partners shall be free to choose the law applicable to govern their contractual relations, except where such choice would contravene the public policy of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: （c）立法发生变化或经济、财务状况发生其他变化以致于需比原设想付出大得多的努力方可履约时特许公司有权得到的赔偿。
Translation: (c) Compensation to which the concessionaire is entitled when legislative changes or other economic and financial conditions necessitate significantly greater efforts to fulfill the contract than originally anticipated.

Query_Text_cn: （e）订约当局和特许公司在对方违约的情况下可采用的补救方法。
Translation: (e) Remedies available to the contracting authority and the concession company in the event of default by the other party.

Query_Text_cn: 建议59．项目协议应规定在哪些情况下订约当局可临时接管有关设施的运营，以便在特许公司严重违约时确保有效、不间断地提供服务。
Translation: Suggestion 59. The project agreement shall stipulate the circumstances under which the contracting authority may temporarily take over the operation of the relevant facilities to ensure effective and uninterrupted service provision in the event of a material breach by the concessionaire.

Query_Text_cn: 建议60．如果特许公司在提供所需服务方面严重违约，或发生其他具体规定的事件从而有合理理由终止项目协议，应授权订约当局与放款人签订协议，经订约当局同意后，指定一个新的特许公司根据现有项目协议履约。
Translation: Recommendation 60. The contracting authority should be empowered to enter into an agreement with lenders to designate a new concession company to perform under the existing project agreement, subject to the contracting authority's consent, if the concession company commits a material default in providing the required services or if other specified events occur that provide reasonable grounds for terminating the project agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 五．项目协议的期限、展期和终止项目协议的期限和展期（见第五章，“项目协议的期限、展期和终止”第2-8段）建议61．项目协议应明确规定特许权的期限。
Translation:
V. Term, Extension and Termination of the Project Agreement  
The term and extension of the project agreement (see Chapter V, "Term, Extension and Termination of the Project Agreement," paragraphs 2-8)  

Recommendation 61. The project agreement shall clearly specify the duration of the concession.

Query_Text_cn: （c）订约当局提出项目协议中原先未预见到的要求后造成额外费用，而特许公司无法在项目协议正常期限内收回这些费用，因此要使特许公司能够收回这些费用。

Translation:
Introduction  
1. The roles played by the public and private sectors in infrastructure development have undergone significant historical changes.

In many countries, these services were provided by private companies operating under government licenses or franchises.

Query_Text_cn: 当时建造了许多私人筹资的道路或运河项目，国际项目融资获得迅速发展，包括发行国际性债券，用以筹集铁路或其他主要基础设施的资金。
Translation: At that time, numerous privately funded road or canal projects were constructed, and international project financing experienced rapid development, including the issuance of international bonds to raise capital for railways or other major infrastructure projects.

Query_Text_cn: 基础设施运营者的生产资料通常被收归国有，兼并和收购减少了竞争。
Translation: The means of production of infrastructure operators are typically nationalized, while mergers and acquisitions reduce competition.

Query_Text_cn: 这一时期内，世界经济的开放程度也有所减退。
Translation: During this period, the openness of the global economy also declined.

Query_Text_cn: 只有较少的国家对基础设施部门实行私人运营，通常没有什么竞争，甚至完全无竞争可言。

Query_Text_cn: 许多国家的宪法把公共部门兴办基础设施事业的优先权视为神圣不可侵犯。
Translation: The constitutions of many countries regard the priority of public sector involvement in infrastructure development as sacrosanct.

Query_Text_cn: 3．当前出现的相反趋势，亦即私营部门参与基础设施部门并相互竞争的趋势，始于八十年代初期，推动这种趋势的有一般性因素，也有一些因国而异的具体因素。
Translation: 3. The current opposite trend, namely the participation of the private sector in infrastructure and competition among them, began in the early 1980s. This trend has been driven by general factors as well as country-specific ones.

Query_Text_cn: 以及有私人参与和竞争的基础设施获得成功的国际经验也越来越多。

Query_Text_cn: 71.投标人的预选示范条文第6条.预选的目的和程序（见《立法指南》第三章，第34-50段）1.订约当局应当参与预选程序，以便确定适合于实施所设想的基础设施项目的合格投标人。
Translation: 71. Model Provision 6 on Prequalification of Bidders. Purpose and Procedures of Prequalification (see Chapter III of the Legislative Guide, paragraphs 34-50) 1. The contracting authority shall engage in prequalification procedures to identify qualified bidders suitable for carrying out the envisaged infrastructure project.

Query_Text_cn: 2.应当根据[颁布国指明其法律中关于公布有关参加供应商和承包商资格预审程序的邀请书的规定]公布关于参加预选程序的邀请书。
Translation: 2. The invitation to participate in the prequalification procedure shall be published in accordance with [the enacting State to specify provisions in its laws regarding the publication of invitations concerning participation in the prequalification procedures for suppliers and contractors].

Query_Text_cn: （e）预选文件的邀约方式和地点。
Translation: (e) Method and location for solicitation of pre-selection documents.

Query_Text_cn: 5.对于本示范条文未予规定的事项，应当根据[颁布国指明其政府采购法中关于如何进行供应商和承包商资格预审程序的规定]进行预选程序。
Translation: 5. For matters not stipulated in these model provisions, the pre-selection procedure shall be conducted in accordance with [the enacting State to specify the provisions in its government procurement law on how to conduct the pre-qualification procedures for suppliers and contractors].

Query_Text_cn: 11示范条文第7条.预选标准（见《立法指南》建议15和第三章，第34-40、43和44段）为了有资格参加筛选程序，有兴趣的投标人必须符合预选文件中规定的订约当局认为适合特定程序的客观合理标准。
Translation: Article 7 of the Model Provisions. Pre-selection criteria (see recommendation 15 and chapter III, paragraphs 34-40, 43 and 44 of the Legislative Guide) To qualify for the pre-selection procedure, interested bidders must meet objective and reasonable criteria specified in the pre-selection documents that the contracting authority deems appropriate for the particular procedure.

Query_Text_cn: （c）具备适宜的管理和组织能力，可靠性和经验，包括以往运营公共基础设施的经验。
Translation: (c) Possess appropriate management and organizational capabilities, reliability, and experience, including prior experience in operating public infrastructure.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第8条.联营集团的参加（见《立法指南》，建议16和第三章，第41和42段）1.订约当局在最初邀请投标人参加筛选程序时，应当允许这些投标人组成投标联营集团。__UNDEF__要求投标联营集团成员根据示范条文第7条表明其资格而提供的资料应当既涉及整个联营集团，又涉及联营集团的各个参加者。
Translation: Model Provision Article 8. Participation of Consortia (see Legislative Guide, recommendations 16 and chapter III, paragraphs 41 and 42) 1. When first inviting bidders to take part in a pre-selection procedure, the contracting authority shall allow those bidders to form bidding consortiums. __UNDEF__ The information to be furnished by members of the bidding consortium, pursuant to model provision 7, as evidence of their qualifications shall relate to the consortium as a whole as well as to each individual participant therein.

Query_Text_cn: 2.除非[…[颁布国指明有关当局]另有授权和]预选文件中另有说明，否则，无论是直接参加还是间接参加，联营集团的每一成员只能同时参加一个联营集团。
Translation: 2. Unless otherwise authorized by [the relevant authority designated by the enacting State] and specified in the pre-selection documents, each member of a consortium may participate in only one consortium at a time, whether directly or indirectly.

Query_Text_cn: 13违反这项规则的，导致联营集团和个别成员均被取消资格。
Translation: Violation of this rule will result in the disqualification of both the consortium and its individual members.

Query_Text_cn: 3.在审议投标联营集团的资格时，订约当局应当考虑联营集团成员各自的能力，并评估联营集团成员的能力综合起来是否足以满足项目各个阶段的需要。
Translation: 3. When assessing the qualifications of a bidding consortium, the contracting authority shall take into account the individual capacities of the consortium members and evaluate whether their combined capabilities are sufficient to meet the requirements of all project phases.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第9条.预选决定（（关于第2款）见《立法指南》建议17，另见第三章，第47-50段）1.订约当局应当就提交预选申请书的每一投标人的资格作出决定。
Translation: Model Provision 9. Pre-selection decisions ((with respect to paragraph 2) see legislative guide recommendation 17, and also chapter III, paragraphs 47-50) 1. The contracting authority shall make a decision on the qualifications of each tenderer that has submitted a pre-selection application.

Query_Text_cn: 订约当局在作出这项决定时只应当采用预选文件中规定的标准。
Translation: The contracting authority shall apply only the criteria set out in the pre-selection documents when making this decision.

Query_Text_cn: 随后，订约当局应当邀请预选选定的所有投标人根据示范条文第10条至第17条提交投标书。
Translation: Subsequently, the contracting authority shall invite all pre-selected bidders to submit their tenders in accordance with Articles 10 to 17 of the Model Provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.虽有第1款的规定，订约当局可以保留预选程序结束时仅请数目有限的14最符合预选标准的投标人提交投标书的权利，但是须事先在预选文件中就此作适当的说明。
Translation: 2. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1, the contracting authority may reserve the right to invite only a limited number of 14 bidders who best meet the pre-selection criteria to submit tenders upon the conclusion of the pre-selection procedure, provided that this is duly stated in the pre-selection documents.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，订约当局应当根据评估投标人资格时所采用的标准给那些符合预选标准的投标人定级，并拟定在预选程序结束后将邀请其提交投标书的投标人名单。
Translation: To this end, the contracting authority shall rank the candidates which meet the selection criteria in accordance with the standards applied for the evaluation of the qualifications of tenderers and draw up the list of candidates who will be invited to submit tenders once the selection procedure has been completed.

Query_Text_cn: 订约当局在拟定该简短名单时应当仅仅采用预选文件中规定的定级方法。
Translation: When drawing up the shortlist, the contracting authority shall apply only the selection criteria set out in the pre-selection documents.

Query_Text_cn: 2.招标程序示范条文第10条.招标的单阶段和两阶段程序（（关于第1款）见《立法指南》建议18，（关于第2和3款）见建议19，另见第三章，第51-58段）1.订约当局应当提供一套招标书和有关文件，根据示范条文第11条印发给支付这些文件任何费用的每一个预选选定的投标人。
Translation: 2. Model Procurement Provisions Article 10. Single-stage and two-stage tendering procedures ((with reference to paragraph 1) see Legislative Guide recommendation 18, (with reference to paragraphs 2 and 3) see recommendation 19, and also chapter III, paragraphs 51-58) 1. The contracting authority shall provide a set of tender documents and supporting documents in accordance with Article 11 of the Model Provisions, to be issued to each pre-selected tenderer who pays any required fee for the documents.

Query_Text_cn: 2.虽有上述规定，如果订约当局认为无法为便利最后投标书的拟定而在招标书中以足够详细和精确的方式说明项目的性质，例如项目的技术规格、性能指标、财务安排或合同条款，订约当局可以使用两阶段程序向预选选定的投标人招标。
Translation: 2. Notwithstanding the foregoing provisions, if the contracting authority considers that the nature of the project, such as its technical specifications, performance indicators, financial arrangements or contractual terms, cannot be described in the tender documents with sufficient detail and precision to facilitate the preparation of final bids, the contracting authority may employ a two-stage procedure to invite tenders from pre-selected bidders.

Query_Text_cn: 15（b）订约当局可以召开会议并与任何投标人进行讨论，澄清与初始招标书或投标人提交的初始投标书和所附文件有关的问题。
Translation: 15(b) The contracting authority may convene meetings and hold discussions with any tenderer to clarify issues related to the initial tender documents or the initial tender submissions and accompanying documents provided by the tenderer.

Query_Text_cn: （c）在对所收到的投标书研究之后，订约当局可以审查并酌情修订初始招标书，删除或修改初始项目技术规格、性能指标、财务安排或项目其他特点包括主要合同条款的任何方面，以及初始招标书中所载的评价和比较投标书及确定中标人的任何标准，并且增加特点或标准。
Translation: (c) After reviewing the received bids, the contracting authority may examine and, at its discretion, amend the initial tender documents by deleting or modifying any aspects of the technical specifications, performance indicators, financial arrangements, or other project features—including key contract terms—as well as any criteria set forth in the initial tender for evaluating and comparing bids and determining the winning bidder, and may introduce additional features or criteria.

Query_Text_cn: 订约当局应当在根据示范条文第26条保持的筛选程序记录中说明修订招标书的理由。
Translation: The contracting authority shall state the reasons for the amendment of the tender documents in the records of the screening procedure maintained in accordance with Article 26 of the Model Provisions.

Query_Text_cn: （d）在程序的第二阶段，订约当局应当请投标人根据示范条文第11条至第17条就单独一套项目技术规格、性能指标或合同条款提交最后投标书。
Translation: (d) In the second stage of the procedure, the contracting authority shall request the participants to submit their final tenders on the basis of a single set of technical specifications, performance characteristics or contractual terms in accordance with Articles 11 to 17 of the Model Provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 以及在评价和否决投标书时采用这些标准和最低限度的方式。
Translation: and to apply these criteria and minimum approaches in evaluating and rejecting bids.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第12条.投标担保（见《立法指南》第三章，第62段）1.招标书应当载列对所需投标担保的出具人以及担保的性质、形式、数额和其他主要条款和条件的要求。
Translation: Model Provision 12. Bid security (see chapter III, paragraph 62, of the Legislative Guide) 1. The solicitation documents shall set forth the requirements as to the person from whom the bid security is to be obtained, and the nature, form, amount and other principal terms and conditions of the required bid security.

Query_Text_cn: （e）未能在投标书被接受后提供履行特许权合同的担保或者履行招标书中规定的签署项目合同的任何其他前提条件。
Translation: (e) Failure to provide the guarantee for the performance of the concession contract after the bid is accepted or to fulfill any other prerequisite stipulated in the bidding documents for the execution of the project contract.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第13条.澄清和修改（见《立法指南》建议21和第三章，第71和72段）订约当局可以主动也可以应投标人的澄清要求而审查和酌情修订示范条文第11条中的招标书的任何方面。
Translation: Article 13. Clarifications and modifications (see recommendation 21 and chapter III, paragraphs 71 and 72, of the Legislative Guide) The contracting authority may review and, as appropriate, revise any aspect of the solicitation referred to in article 11 of the Model Provisions, either on its own initiative or in response to a request by a bidder for clarification.

Query_Text_cn: 任何这种删除、修改或增补应当在提交投标书截止日期前的合理时间内以与招标书相同的方式通知投标人。
Translation: Any such deletion, modification or addition shall be notified to bidders in the same manner as the tender documents within a reasonable time prior to the deadline for submission of bids.

Query_Text_cn: （d）服务质量和确保服务连续性的措施。
Translation: (d) Measures for service quality and ensuring service continuity.

Query_Text_cn: （g）投标书提供的社会和经济发展潜力。
Translation: (g) The socio-economic development potential presented in the bid.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第15条.投标书的比较和评价（见《立法指南》建议24和第三章，第78-82段）1.订约当局应当根据招标书中规定的评价标准、每项此种标准所具有的相对加权和评价程序，比较和评价每份投标书。
Translation:
Model Provision 15. Comparison and evaluation of tenders (see recommendation 24 and chapter III, paragraphs 78-82, of the Legislative Guide)  

1. The contracting authority shall compare and evaluate each tender in accordance with the evaluation criteria, the relative weighting of each such criterion and the evaluation procedures set forth in the solicitation documents.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为了第1款的目的，订约当局可以设立质量、技术、财务和商业方面的最低限度。
Translation: 2. For the purpose of paragraph 1, the contracting authority may establish minimum requirements in terms of quality, technical, financial, and commercial aspects.

Query_Text_cn: 未达到最低限度的投标书应当视为不符合要求。
Translation: Bids that fail to meet the minimum requirements shall be deemed non-compliant.

Query_Text_cn: 22示范条文第16条.再次证明符合资格标准（见《立法指南》建议25和第三章，第78-82段）订约当局可以要求预选选定的任何投标人根据预选中使用的同样标准再次证明其资格。__UNDEF__经要求而不能再次证明其资格的任何投标人，订约当局应取消其资格。__UNDEF__23示范条文第17条.最后谈判（（关于第1款）见《立法指南》建议26；__UNDEF__（关于第2款）见建议27；__UNDEF__另见第三章，第83和84段）1.订约当局应当根据评估标准排列所有符合要求的投标书的名次，并邀请名列榜首的投标人进行特许权合同的最后谈判。__UNDEF__最后谈判不得涉及最后招标书中指明的不可谈判的任何合同条款。
Translation:
Article 22, Model Provision 16. Reconfirmation of Qualification Criteria (See Legislative Guide recommendation 25 and Chapter III, paragraphs 78-82)  
The contracting authority may require any pre-selected tenderer to reconfirm its qualifications in accordance with the same criteria used in the pre-selection.  

Any tenderer failing to reconfirm its qualifications upon request shall be disqualified by the contracting authority.  

Article 23, Model Provision 17. Final Negotiations ((Regarding Paragraph 1) See Legislative Guide recommendation 26;  
(Regarding Paragraph 2) See recommendation 27;  
See also Chapter III, paragraphs 83 and 84)  
1. The contracting authority shall rank all compliant tenders in accordance with the evaluation criteria and invite the top-ranked tenderer to final negotiations for the concession contract.  

Final negotiations shall not involve any contract terms specified as non-negotiable in the final tender documents.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果订约当局认为与被邀请的投标人的谈判显然不会达成特许权合同，订约当局应当将其终止谈判的意图通知该投标人，并让该投标人有合理的时间提出其最佳和最后报价。
Translation: 2. If the contracting authority considers that negotiations with the invited tenderer are unlikely to result in the concession contract, it shall notify the tenderer of its intention to terminate the negotiations and allow the tenderer a reasonable period to submit its best and final offer.

Query_Text_cn: 如果订约当局认为不能接受投标书，订约当局应当终止与该有关投标人的谈判。
Translation: If the contracting authority deems the bid unacceptable, it shall terminate negotiations with the relevant bidder.

Query_Text_cn: 订约当局应当按照排名先后邀请其他投标人进行谈判，直到达成特许权合同或者否决所有其余的投标书。
Translation: The contracting authority shall invite other bidders to negotiate in order of ranking until a concession contract is concluded or all remaining bids are rejected.

Query_Text_cn: 订约当局不得在依照本款规定终止与一投标人谈判后恢复与该投标人的谈判。
Translation: The contracting authority shall not resume negotiations with a tenderer whose participation in the procurement procedure has been terminated pursuant to this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 26（g）由于令人信服的公共利益原因而由[颁布国指明有关当局]授权作为例外的其他情形。
Translation: 26(g) Other exceptional cases authorized by [the competent authority designated by the enacting State] for compelling reasons of public interest.

Query_Text_cn: （c）确定据以评价投标书和排列名次的评价标准。
Translation: (c) Establish the evaluation criteria for assessing bids and determining the ranking order.

Query_Text_cn: 4.非邀约投标书30示范条文第20条.非邀约投标书的可采性（见《立法指南》建议30和第三章，第97-109段）作为示范条文第6条至第17条的例外，订约当局31有权依照示范条文第21条至第23条中所列的程序考虑非邀约投标书，但此类投标书须不涉及业已对其启动或宣布筛选程序的项目。
Translation: 4. Article 20 of the UNCITRAL Model Provision 30 on Non-Solicited Bids: Admissibility of Non-Solicited Bids (see Legislative Guide recommendation 30 and chapter III, paragraphs 97-109) As an exception to the provisions of articles 6 to 17 of the Model Provisions, a contracting authority31 may consider non-solicited bids in accordance with the procedures set out in articles 21 to 23 of the Model Provisions, provided that such bids do not relate to a project for which a selection procedure has been initiated or announced.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第21条.确定非邀约投标书可采性的程序（（关于第1和2款）见《立法指南》建议31，（关于第3款）见建议32，另见第三章，第110-112段）1.在收到并初步审查非邀约投标书后，订约当局应当迅速通知投标人该项目是否被认为可能符合公共利益。
Translation: Model Provision 21. Procedure for determining admissibility of an unsolicited proposal ((With respect to paragraphs 1 and 2, see recommendation 31 of the Legislative Guide; with respect to paragraph 3, see recommendation 32; see also chapter III, paragraphs 110–112)) 1. Upon receipt and preliminary review of an unsolicited proposal, the contracting authority shall promptly notify the proponent whether the project is considered to potentially serve the public interest.

Query_Text_cn: 322.如果根据第1款认为该项目可能符合公共利益，订约当局应当请投标人就拟议的项目尽可能提供更多的此阶段可能提供的资料，以便使订约当局能够对投标人的资格33以及项目的技术可行性和经济可行性进行恰当的评价，并确定项目能否按订约当局可以接受的条款以所拟议的方式得到顺利实施。
Translation: 322. If the project is deemed to potentially serve the public interest under Paragraph 1, the contracting authority shall request the bidder to provide as much information as possible at this stage regarding the proposed project. This will enable the contracting authority to properly assess the bidder's qualifications, the technical and economic feasibility of the project, and determine whether the project can be smoothly implemented in the proposed manner under terms acceptable to the contracting authority.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，投标人应当提交技术和经济可行性研究报告、环境影响研究报告以及关于投标书中设想的概念或技术的令人满意的资料。
Translation: For this purpose, the bidder shall submit a technical and economic feasibility study report, an environmental impact study report, and satisfactory information on the concepts or technologies envisaged in the bid.

Query_Text_cn: 3.订约当局在审议非邀约投标书时，应当尊重投标书中载列的、引起的或者提及的知识产权、商业秘密或者其他专属权利。
Translation: 3. When evaluating unsolicited bids, the contracting authority shall respect the intellectual property rights, trade secrets, or other proprietary rights stated in, arising from, or referred to in the bid.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，除了评价该投标书之外，订约当局不得使用由投标人本人或他人代表投标人就其非邀约投标书提供的资料，但经投标人同意的除外。
Translation: Therefore, apart from evaluating the tender, the contracting authority shall not use any information provided by the tenderer or on behalf of the tenderer regarding its unsolicited tender, unless agreed by the tenderer.

Query_Text_cn: 除非当事各方另有约定，订约当局如果否决该投标书，应当向投标人退还投标人在整个程序期间提交和编写的文件原件及其任何副本。
Translation: Unless the parties concerned agree otherwise, the contracting authority shall return to the tenderer the original documents and any copies thereof submitted or prepared by the tenderer during the entire procedure if it rejects the tender.

Query_Text_cn: 或者（b）订约当局认为所提出的概念或技术并非真正独特或新颖。
Translation: or (b) the contracting authority considers that the proposed concept or technology is not genuinely unique or innovative.

Query_Text_cn: 2.应当请该投标人参加订约当局依照第1款启动的筛选程序，并且考虑到投标书的编写和提交，可以以订约当局在招标书中所述的方式给予奖励或类似的好处。
Translation: 2. The bidder shall be invited to participate in the screening procedure initiated by the contracting authority pursuant to paragraph 1, and may be granted awards or similar benefits in the manner specified by the contracting authority in the tender documents, taking into account the preparation and submission of the bid.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第23条.涉及知识产权、商业秘密或专属权的非邀约投标书（（关于第1和第2款）见《立法指南》建议34，（关于第3和第4款）见建议35，另见第三章，第115-117段）1.如果订约当局确定示范条文第22条第1款（a）项和（b）项的条件不能满足，订约当局不必依照示范条文第6条至第17条进行筛选程序。
Translation:
Article 23. Unsolicited proposals involving intellectual property rights, trade secrets or exclusive rights ((with respect to paragraphs 1 and 2, see recommendation 34 of the Legislative Guide; with respect to paragraphs 3 and 4, see recommendation 35; see also chapter III, paragraphs 115–117))  

1. If the contracting authority determines that the conditions set forth in subparagraphs (a) and (b) of paragraph 1 of article 22 of the Model Provisions cannot be met, the contracting authority is not required to conduct a selection procedure in accordance with articles 6 to 17 of the Model Provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，订约当局仍然可以根据本条示范条文第2款至第4款中所列规定设法获得非邀约投标书的比较要素。
Translation: However, the contracting authority may still seek to obtain comparable elements for unsolicited tenders in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 2 to 4 of this model provision.

Query_Text_cn: 342.如果订约当局打算获得非邀约投标书的比较要素，订约当局应当公布关于该投标书主要产出要素的说明，并邀请其他有兴趣的当事方在[一段合理期限][颁布国指明一段时间]内提交投标书。
Translation: 342. If the contracting authority intends to obtain comparable elements of an unsolicited bid, it shall publish a description of the bid's key output elements and invite other interested parties to submit bids within [a reasonable period][a period specified by the enacting State].

Query_Text_cn: 3.如果在[一段合理期限][上文第2款规定的时间]内没有收到对依照本条示范条文第2款印发的邀请书的任何投标书，订约当局可以同原始投标人进行谈判。
Translation: 3. If no tenders are received in response to the invitation issued under paragraph 2 of this Article within [a reasonable period][the time specified in paragraph 2 above], the contracting authority may enter into negotiations with the original tenderer.

Query_Text_cn: 4.如果订约当局收到了对依照第2款印发的邀请书的投标书，订约当局应当根据示范条文第19条中载列的规定邀请这些投标人参加谈判。
Translation: 4. If the contracting authority receives tenders in response to the invitation issued under paragraph 2, it shall invite those tenderers to negotiations in accordance with the provisions set out in Article 19 of the Model Provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 如果订约当局收到的投标书数量足够多而且表面看来符合基础设施的需要，订约当局应当要求依照示范条文第10条至第17条提交投标书，但须给予提交非邀约投标书者根据示范条文第22条第2款可以给予的任何奖励或其他好处。
Translation: If the contracting authority receives a sufficient number of tenders that appear on their face to meet the infrastructure needs, it shall require the submission of tenders in accordance with Articles 10 to 17 of the Model Provisions, provided that any incentives or other benefits that may be granted under paragraph 2 of Article 22 of the Model Provisions are given to those submitting unsolicited tenders.

Query_Text_cn: 5.杂项规定示范条文第24条.保密性（见《立法指南》建议36和第三章，第118段）订约当局在处理投标书时应当避免将其意向披露给竞标人。
Translation: 5. Miscellaneous Provisions Model Article 24. Confidentiality (see Legislative Guide recommendation 36 and chapter III, paragraph 118) Contracting authorities shall avoid disclosing their intentions to bidders when handling tenders.

Query_Text_cn: 订约当局依照示范条文第10条第3款、第17条、第18条、第19条或第23条第3款和第4款与一投标人进行的任何讨论、通信和谈判均应当保密。
Translation: Any discussions, correspondence or negotiations between the contracting authority and a tenderer pursuant to Article 10(3), Article 17, Article 18, Article 19 or Article 23(3) and (4) of the Model Provisions shall be confidential.

Query_Text_cn: 除非法律或者法院命令有要求或招标书准许，谈判一方未经另一方同意，不得向任何其他人披露与依照上述规定进行的讨论、通信和谈判有关的任何技术、价格或其他资料。__UNDEF__除依照示范条文第18条（c）项授予的特许权合同外，订约当局应当根据[颁布国指明其关于采购程序的法律中管辖公布合同授予通告的规定]安排公布合同授予通告。__UNDEF__通告应当列明特许公司的名称并摘要介绍特许权合同的基本条款。
Translation:
Unless required by law or court order or permitted by the bidding documents, neither party to the negotiation may disclose any technical, pricing, or other information related to discussions, correspondence, or negotiations conducted in accordance with the above provisions to any other party without the consent of the other.  

Except for concession contracts granted under Article 18(c) of the Model Provisions, the contracting authority shall arrange for the publication of a contract award notice in accordance with [the enacting State shall specify the provisions of its procurement legislation governing the publication of contract award notices].  

The notice shall specify the name of the concession company and summarize the key terms of the concession contract.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第26条.筛选和授标程序的记录（见《立法指南》建议38和第三章，第120-126段）订约当局应当根据[颁布国指明其关于公共采购的法律中管辖采购程序记录的规定]保持与筛选和授标程序有关的资料的适当记录。
Translation: Model Provision 26. Records of selection and award proceedings (see recommendation 38 and chapter III, paragraphs 120-126, of the Legislative Guide) The contracting authority shall maintain adequate records of the information relating to the selection and award proceedings in accordance with [the enacting State to indicate provisions in its public procurement laws governing record-keeping in procurement proceedings].

Query_Text_cn: 35示范条文第27条.审查程序（见《立法指南》建议39和第三章，第127-131段）投标人声称因订约当局违反了法律对订约当局所规定的责任而致使投标人遭受或可能遭受损失或伤害的，可以要求根据[颁布国指明其法律中管辖审查采购程序中所作决定的规定]审查订约当局的作为或不作为。
Translation:
Article 27. Review procedures (see recommendation 39 and chapter III, paragraphs 127-131, of the Legislative Guide)  
A tenderer that claims to have suffered or to be likely to suffer loss or injury as a result of a breach by the contracting authority of a duty imposed on it by law may seek review of an act or omission of the contracting authority under [the enacting State to specify provisions in its law governing review of decisions taken in the course of procurement proceedings].

Query_Text_cn: （s）当事各方对机密资料的权利和义务（见示范条文第24条）。
Translation: (s) Rights and obligations of the parties concerned regarding confidential information (see Model Clause 24).

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第29条.管辖法律（见《立法指南》建议41和第四章，第5-8段）除非特许权合同另有规定，特许权合同由[本颁布国]法律管辖。
Translation:
Model Provision 29. Governing Law (see legislative recommendation 41 and chapter IV, paragraphs 5-8 of the Legislative Guide)  

Unless otherwise provided in the concession contract, the concession contract shall be governed by the laws of [the enacting State].

Query_Text_cn: 38示范条文第30条.特许公司的组建（见《立法指南》建议42和43及第四章，第12-18段）订约当局可要求中标人根据[本颁布国]法律组建一个法律实体，但需酌情在预选文件或招标书中加以说明。
Translation: Article 38. Model provision 30. Formation of the concession company (see recommendations 42 and 43 and chapter IV, paragraphs 12-18, of the Legislative Guide) The contracting authority may require the successful bidder to form a legal entity under the laws of [the enacting State], provided that this requirement is specified, as appropriate, in the pre-selection documents or the solicitation documents.

Query_Text_cn: 特许权合同应当按招标书的规定，载明对此类法律实体的最低限度资本以及对其章程和细则获得订约当局批准的程序和对其章程和细则作重大更改的程序的任何要求。
Translation: The concession contract shall specify, in accordance with the tender documents, any requirements regarding the minimum capital of such legal entities and the procedures for obtaining the approval of the contracting authority for their statutes and bylaws, as well as for any substantial amendments thereto.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第31条.资产的所有权39（见《立法指南》建议44和第四章，第20-26段）特许权合同应当酌情指明哪些资产是或应当是公共财产，哪些资产是或应当是特许公司的私有财产。
Translation: Model Provision 31. Ownership of assets39(See Legislative Guide, recommendation 44 and chap. IV, paras. 20-26)The concession contract should, as appropriate, specify which assets are or are to be public property and which assets are or are to be the private property of the concession company.

Query_Text_cn: 以及（c）在特许权合同期满或终止时特许公司可保留或处分的任何可能的资产。
Translation: and (c) any possible assets that the concession company may retain or dispose of upon the expiration or termination of the concession contract.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第32条.获得对项目场地的相关权利（见《立法指南》建议45和第四章，第27-29段）1.订约当局或其他根据法律规定和特许权合同设立的公共当局应当向特许公司提供或酌情协助特许公司获得实施项目所需项目场地的相关权利，包括项目场地的所有权。
Translation:
Model Provision 32. Obtaining rights relating to the project site (see recommendation 45 and chap. IV, paras. 27-29, of the Legislative Guide)  
1. The contracting authority or other public authority established under the law and the concession contract shall provide to the concession company or, as appropriate, assist the concession company in obtaining the rights relating to the project site required for the implementation of the project, including ownership of the project site.

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第33条.地役权40（见《立法指南》建议45和第四章，第30段）备选案文A1.根据法律规定和特许权合同设立的订约当局或其他公共当局，应当依照[颁布国指明本颁布国关于公用事业公司和基础设施运营人依法享有的地役权和其他类似权利的法律规定]，向特许公司提供或酌情协助其享有酌情并视实施项目的需要而进入或穿过第三方的地产或在第三方的地产上施工或安设装置的权利。
Translation:
Model Provision 33. Easements (see recommendation 45 and chap. IV, para. 30, of the Legislative Guide)  

Variant A  
1. The contracting authority or other public authority established by law or under the concession contract shall, in accordance with [the enacting State to specify the legal provisions applicable in the enacting State concerning easements and other similar rights enjoyed by public utility companies and infrastructure operators under the law], provide to the concession company or assist it in obtaining, as appropriate, the right to enter or cross third-party property or to carry out works or install equipment on third-party property, as may be necessary for the implementation of the project.

Query_Text_cn: 备选案文B1.依照[颁布国指明本颁布国关于公用事业公司和基础设施运营人依法享有的地役权和其他类似权利的法律规定]，特许公司应当拥有酌情并视实施项目的需要而进入或穿过第三方的地产或在第三方的地产上施工或安设装置的权利。
Translation: Draft alternative B1. In accordance with [the enacting State to specify the legal provisions of this enacting State concerning easements and other similar rights legally enjoyed by public utility companies and infrastructure operators], the concession company shall have the right, at its discretion and as necessary for project implementation, to enter or cross third-party properties or to construct or install facilities thereon.

Query_Text_cn: 2.实施项目所需要的任何地役权，应当依照[颁布国指明关于为公共利益而设置地役权的法律规定]设置。
Translation: 2. Any easements required for the implementation of the project shall be established in accordance with [the enacting State specifies the legal provisions concerning the establishment of easements for public interest purposes].

Query_Text_cn: 示范条文第34条.财务安排（见《立法指南》建议46、47和48及第四章，第33-51段）1.特许公司应当有权依照特许权合同对利用设施或其服务征收、接受或收取服务费和使用费。__UNDEF__特许权合同应当[依照主管管理机构制定的规则]就这些服务费或使用费的确定和调整方法及公式作出规定。
Translation:
Article 34. Financial arrangements (see legislative recommendations 46, 47 and 48 and chap. IV, paras. 33-51)
1. The concession company shall have the right to impose and collect service charges or user fees for the use of the facility or its services in accordance with the concession contract. [In accordance with rules established by the regulatory authority,] the concession contract shall specify the method and formula for determining and adjusting such service charges or user fees.

Query_Text_cn: 412.订约当局应当有权同意作为使用设施或其服务的服务费或使用费的替代或补充向特许公司直接付款。
Translation: 412. The contracting authority shall have the right to agree to direct payments to the concession company as an alternative or supplement to service fees or usage charges for the facilities or their services.

Query_Text_cn: 2．请秘书长作出安排，尽可能广泛分发国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则。
Translation: 2. Requests the Secretary-General to make arrangements for the widest possible distribution of the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules.

Query_Text_cn: 1《大会正式记录，第三十一届会议，补编第17号》（A／31／17），第五章，c节。
Translation: 1 Official Records of the General Assembly, Thirty-first Session, Supplement No. 17 (A/31/17), Chapter V, Section C.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条1．凡合同当事各方已书面同意*与该合同有关的争议的争议应根据《联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则》提交仲裁，则此类争议应按照本《规则》进行解决，但须服从当事各方以书面协议对本《规则》作出的修正。__UNDEF__*示范仲裁条款凡由于本合同而引起的或与本合同有关的，或由于本合同的违约、终止或无效而引起的或与本合同的违约、终止或无效有关的任何争议、争端或索赔，均应按照现行有效的《联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则》进行仲裁解决。__UNDEF__注——当事各方可能愿意考虑增列：__UNDEF__（a）指派当局应为…（机构名称或人名）；__UNDEF__（b）仲裁员人数应为…（一名或三名）；__UNDEF__（c）仲裁地点应为…（城市或国家）；__UNDEF__（d）仲裁程序中使用的语文（一种或数种）应为…。
Translation:
Article 1  
1. Where the parties to a contract have agreed in writing* that disputes in relation to that contract shall be referred to arbitration under the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules, then such disputes shall be settled in accordance with these Rules subject to such modification as the parties may agree in writing.  
__UNDEF__  
*Model arbitration clause  
Any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this contract, or the breach, termination or invalidity thereof, shall be settled by arbitration in accordance with the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules as at present in force.  
__UNDEF__  
Note—Parties may wish to consider adding:  
__UNDEF__  
(a) The appointing authority shall be… (name of institution or person);  
__UNDEF__  
(b) The number of arbitrators shall be… (one or three);  
__UNDEF__  
(c) The place of arbitration shall be… (town or country);  
__UNDEF__  
(d) The language(s) to be used in the arbitral proceedings shall be… .

Query_Text_cn: 2．仲裁应遵守本规则，但本《规则》任一条款与适用于仲裁的而当事各方又不能背离的法律规定相抵触时，该法律规定应优先适用。
Translation: 2. The arbitration shall be conducted in accordance with these Rules. However, where any provision of these Rules is in conflict with a mandatory provision of the law applicable to the arbitration from which the parties cannot derogate, that mandatory provision shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条1．为了本《规则》的目的，任何通知，包括通知书、函电或建议，凡经当面递交受信人或投递到其惯常住处、营业所或通讯地址或经过合理的查询之后所有这些地址均无法找到而投递到为人所知的受信人最后的住处或营业所，则应视为已经收到。
Translation:
Article 2  
1. For the purposes of these Rules, any notice, including a notice, letter, or proposal, shall be deemed to have been received if it is delivered in person to the addressee or sent to their habitual residence, place of business, or mailing address, or, after reasonable inquiry, if none of these addresses can be found, to the addressee's last-known residence or place of business.

Query_Text_cn: 该通知应于按上述方式递送之日视为业已收到。
Translation: The notice shall be deemed to have been received on the day it is delivered in the manner specified above.

Query_Text_cn: 2．为了计算本《规则》规定的时间，这种时间应自收到通知、通知书、函电或建议之日的次日起算。
Translation: 2. For the purpose of calculating the time limits prescribed in these Rules, such time shall commence on the day following the date when the notice, notification, communication or proposal is received.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这种时间的最后一天在受信人的住处或营业所所在地是法定假日或非营业日，则这种时间延至其后的第一个营业日。
Translation: If the last day of such period is a legal holiday or non-business day at the place of residence or business of the recipient, such period shall be extended to the first business day thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种时间过程内的法定假日或非营业日应在计算时间时包括在内。
Translation: Statutory holidays or non-business days occurring during such time periods shall be included in the calculation.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条1．发起提交仲裁的当事一方（以下称为“申诉人”）应给予当事他方（以下称为“被诉人”）一项仲裁通知。
Translation:
Article 3  
1. The party initiating arbitration (hereinafter referred to as the "Claimant") shall provide the other party (hereinafter referred to as the "Respondent") with a notice of arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 2．仲裁程序应视为于被诉人收到仲裁通知之日开始。
Translation: 2. The arbitral proceedings shall be deemed to commence on the date on which the respondent receives the notice of arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: （g）如当事各方事先未就仲裁员人数达成协议，则提出关于仲裁员人数（即一名或三名）的建议。
Translation: (g) If the parties have not agreed on the number of arbitrators in advance, a proposal shall be made regarding the number of arbitrators (i.e., one or three).

Query_Text_cn: （c）第十八条所指的申诉书。
Translation: (c) The petition referred to in Article 18.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条当事各方可以由他们所选定的人员代表或协助。
Translation: Article 4 The parties may be represented or assisted by persons of their choice.

Query_Text_cn: 这种通知必须说明是为了代表的目的还是为了协助的目的而作出这种选定。
Translation: Such notice must specify whether the selection is made for the purpose of representation or assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条当事各方如事先未约定仲裁员人数（即一名或三名），而且在被诉人收到仲裁通知后十五天内当事各方未就只应指定一名仲裁员达成协议，则应指定三名仲裁员。
Translation: Article 5 If the parties have not agreed upon the number of arbitrators (i.e., one or three) and fail to reach an agreement within fifteen days after the respondent receives the notice of arbitration that there shall be only one arbitrator, three arbitrators shall be appointed.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如当事各方未就指派当局达成协议，则可提出一个或数个机构的名称，或一人或数人的姓名，由其中之一担任指派当局。
Translation: (b) If the parties fail to agree on the appointing authority, one or more institutions or one or more persons may be proposed, any one of whom shall serve as the appointing authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2．如在当事一方收到按照第l款提出的建议之后三十天内当事各方未就独任仲裁员的选定达成协议，则应由当事各方所协议的指派当局指定独任仲裁员。
Translation: 2. If the parties have not agreed upon the choice of a sole arbitrator within thirty days after receipt by one of them of a proposal made in accordance with paragraph 1, the sole arbitrator shall be appointed by the appointing authority agreed upon by the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如当事各方未就指派当局达成协议，或所协议的指派当局在收到当事一方的请求后六十天内拒绝行动或未指定仲裁员，则当事任何一方均可以请求海牙常设仲裁法院秘书长指定一个指派当局。
Translation: If the parties fail to agree on an appointing authority, or if the agreed appointing authority refuses to act or fails to appoint an arbitrator within sixty days after receiving a request from one of the parties, either party may request the Secretary-General of the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague to designate an appointing authority.
