Translation: VI. The application of the provisions set forth in paragraphs 1 to 5 of this Article shall be governed by Chapters I to III of Annex I to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 该附件第三章为专门用于医疗队和医务运输工具所指定的信号，除该章所规定外，不应用于识别该章所规定的医疗队和医务运输工具以外的任何其他目的。
Translation: The signals specified in Chapter III of this Annex are exclusively reserved for medical units and transports. They shall not be used for any purpose other than identifying the medical units and transports as defined in that chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 七、本条并不核准超出第一公约第四十四条的规定外在平时更广泛地使用特殊标志。
Translation: VII. This Article does not authorize the more extensive use of the distinctive emblem in peacetime than is prescribed in Article 44 of the First Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 八、各公约和本议定书关于监督特殊标志的使用和关于防止和取缔其任何滥用的规定，应适用于特殊信号。
Translation: VIII. The provisions of the Conventions and of this Protocol regarding the supervision of the use of distinctive emblems and the prevention and repression of any misuse thereof shall apply equally to distinctive signals.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条中立国家和其他非冲突各方的国家中立国家和其他非冲突各方的国家应对在其领土内收留或拘禁的受本部规定保护的人，或对其所发现的冲突各方的任何死者，适用本议定书的有关规定。
Translation:
Article 19 Neutral and other States not parties to the conflict  
Neutral and other States not parties to the conflict shall apply the relevant provisions of this Protocol to persons protected by this Part who may be received or interned within their territory, as well as to any dead of the parties to the conflict whom they may find.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条对报复的禁止对本部所保护的人和物体的报复，是禁止的。
Translation:
Article 20 Prohibition of Reprisals  
Reprisals against persons and objects protected under this Part are prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条医务车辆医务车辆应受流动医疗队依据各公约和本议定书所受的同样尊重和保护。
Translation:
Article 21 Medical Vehicles  
Medical vehicles shall be respected and protected in the same manner as mobile medical units under the Conventions and this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: (一)第二公约第二十二条、第二十四条、第二十五条和第二十七条所述的船舶，(二)其救生艇和小艇，(三)其人员和船员，和(四)船上伤者、病者和遇船难者的规定，在这些船舶运载不属于第二公约第十三条所载任何一类的平民伤者、病者和遇船难者的情形下，也应适用。
Translation: (a) The provisions of the Second Convention relating to vessels described in Articles 22, 24, 25 and 27 thereof, (b) their lifeboats and small craft, (c) their personnel and crews, and (d) the wounded, sick and shipwrecked on board, shall also apply in cases where such vessels are transporting civilian wounded, sick and shipwrecked who do not fall within any of the categories mentioned in Article 13 of the Second Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但这类平民不应将其交给非其所属的任何一方或在海上将其拿捕。
Translation: However, such civilians should not be handed over to any party to which they do not belong or be captured at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 这类平民如果在其所属以外的冲突一方权力下，应包括在第四公约和本议定书的规定范围内。
Translation: Such civilians, if in the power of a Party to the conflict other than the one to which they belong, shall be covered by the provisions of the Fourth Convention and this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 二、各公约对第二公约第二十五条所述船舶所提供的保护，应扩展于(一)中立国家或其他非该冲突一方的国家，或(二)公正的国际人道主义组织，为了人道主义目的向冲突一方提供的医院船，但在上述任何一种情形下，均须符合该条所列的要求。
Translation:
II. The protection provided by the respective Conventions to vessels referred to in Article 25 of the Second Convention shall extend to:  
(a) hospital ships made available to a party to the conflict by neutral or other States not parties to the conflict, or  
(b) hospital ships made available to a party to the conflict by impartial international humanitarian organizations for humanitarian purposes,  
provided, in either case, that the requirements set forth in that Article are complied with.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第二公约第二十七条所述的小艇，即使未发出该条所规定的通知，也应受保护。
Translation: III. Small craft referred to in Article 27 of the Second Convention shall be protected even if the notification provided for in that Article has not been made.

Query_Text_cn: 而关于任何其他足以便利识别和认出这类小艇的有关细节，请冲突各方彼此通知。
Translation: As for any other details that may facilitate the identification and recognition of such boats, the conflicting parties shall notify each other accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条其他医务船艇一、本议定书第二十二条和第二公约第三十八条所指以外的医务船艇，不论在海上或在其他水域内，均应受流动医疗队依据各公约和本议定书所受的同样尊重和保护。
Translation:
Article 23 Other medical ships and craft  
1. Medical ships and craft other than those referred to in Article 22 of this Protocol and in Article 38 of the Second Convention shall, whether at sea or in other waters, be respected and protected in the same way as mobile medical units under the Conventions and this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 由于这种保护只有在这类船艇能被识别和认出的条件下才能有效，因而这类船艇应以特殊标志标明，并尽可能遵从第二公约第四十三条第二款的规定。
Translation: Since such protection can be effective only if these vessels can be identified and recognized as such, they should be marked with a distinctive emblem and comply, as far as possible, with the provisions of Article 43, paragraph 2, of the Second Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款所指的船艇应仍受战争法规的拘束。
Translation: II. The vessels referred to in paragraph 1 shall remain subject to the laws of war.

Query_Text_cn: 任何有可能立即强制执行其命令的水面战舰，得命令这类船艇停航，或命令其驶离，或使其航驶一定航线，而这类船艇应服从每一项这类命令。
Translation: Any surface warship capable of immediately enforcing its orders may command such vessels to stop, depart, or follow a designated course, and such vessels shall comply with each such command.

Query_Text_cn: 这类船艇，只要为船上伤者、病者和遇船难者所需，即不得以任何其他方式改变其医务使命。
Translation: Such vessels shall not be diverted from their medical mission in any other manner as long as they are required for the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked on board.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第一款所规定的保护，仅应在第二公约第三十四条和第三十五条所列的条件下停止。
Translation: 3. The protection provided under paragraph 1 shall cease only under the conditions set forth in Articles 34 and 35 of the Second Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 明显地拒绝服从按照第二款所发出的命令，应是第二公约第三十四条所规定的害敌行为。
Translation: A clear refusal to obey an order issued pursuant to paragraph 2 shall constitute an act harmful to the enemy as defined in Article 34 of Geneva Convention II.

Query_Text_cn: 四、冲突一方得尽可能在医务船艇，特别是超过2000总吨的船舶出航前，将其名称、形状、预定出航时间、航线和估计的速度通知任何敌方，并得提供任何其他便于识别和认出的情报。
Translation: IV. A party to the conflict shall, whenever possible, notify the opposing party of the name, description, intended departure time, route, and estimated speed of hospital ships, particularly those exceeding 2,000 gross tons, prior to their sailing, and shall provide any other information that may facilitate their identification and recognition.

Query_Text_cn: 敌方应表明收到这项情报。
Translation: The adversary should acknowledge receipt of this intelligence.

Query_Text_cn: 五、第二公约第三十七条的规定应适用于这类船艇上的医务和宗教人员。
Translation: V. The provisions of Article 37 of the Second Convention shall apply to medical and religious personnel on such craft.

Query_Text_cn: 六、第二公约的规定应适用于这类船艇上属于第二公约第十三条和本议定书第四十四条所指各类的伤者、病者和遇船难者。
Translation: VI. The provisions of the Second Convention shall apply to the wounded, sick and shipwrecked belonging to the categories referred to in Article 13 of the Second Convention and Article 44 of this Protocol who are on board such craft.

Query_Text_cn: 这类平民如果在其所属一方以外的冲突一方权力下，应包括在第四公约和本议定书的规定的范围内。
Translation: Such civilians, if in the power of a party to the conflict other than the one to which they belong, shall be covered by the provisions of the Fourth Convention and this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条对医务飞机的保护在本部规定的拘束下，医务飞机应受尊重和保护。
Translation:
Article 24 Protection of Medical Aircraft  

Subject to the provisions of this Part, medical aircraft shall be respected and protected.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条敌方未控制的地区内医务飞机在友方部队所实际控制的陆地地区内或其上空，或在敌方所未实际控制的海域内或其上空，对冲突一方医务飞机的尊重和保护，不依赖于与敌方订立的任何协定。
Translation: Article 25: The respect and protection of medical aircraft in areas not controlled by the adversary, whether over land areas actually controlled by friendly forces or over sea areas not actually controlled by the adversary, shall not depend on any agreement with the opposing party.

Query_Text_cn: 但为更安全起见，在这些地区内操纵医务飞机的冲突一方，得按第二十九条所规定，通知敌方，特别是在该飞机飞行进入敌方地对空武器系统射程时，更须通知。
Translation: However, as an additional precaution, a Party to the conflict operating medical aircraft in these areas shall notify the adverse Party, as required in Article 29, particularly when such aircraft are flying within range of enemy surface-to-air weapon systems.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条接触或类似地带内医务飞机一、在友方部队所实际控制的接触地带的一些部分内和其上空，以及在实际控制权未明显确立的地区内或其上空，只有按第二十九条所规定，冲突各方主管军事当局之间事先取得协议，医务飞机才能得到充分有效的保护。
Translation:
Article 26 Medical Aircraft in Contact or Similar Zones  

1. In those parts of the contact zone which are physically controlled by friendly forces and in their airspace, as well as in areas where control is not clearly established, medical aircraft shall be fully and effectively protected only if prior agreement has been obtained between the competent military authorities of the Parties to the conflict, as provided for in Article 29.

Query_Text_cn: 在没有这种协议的情形下，医务飞机虽其操纵须自冒风险，但在其已被认出是医务飞机后，仍应受尊重。
Translation: In the absence of such an agreement, medical aircraft, though operating at their own risk, shall nevertheless be respected once they have been recognized as such.

Query_Text_cn: 二、"接触地带”是指敌对部队的先头部分彼此接触，特别是该部分已直接暴露于地面火力下的任何陆地地区。
Translation: II. The "contact zone" refers to any land area where the forward elements of opposing forces are in contact with each other, particularly where those elements are directly exposed to ground fire.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条敌方控制的地区内医务飞机一、冲突一方的医务飞机在敌方所实际控制的陆地地区或海域上空飞行时，应继续受保护，但须事先取得该敌方的主管当局对这项飞行的同意。
Translation:
Article 27 Medical Aircraft in Areas Controlled by the Enemy  

1. The medical aircraft of a Party to the conflict shall continue to be protected while flying over land or sea areas physically controlled by the enemy, provided that prior consent to such flights has been obtained from the competent authority of that enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 二、由于航行错误或因影响飞行安全的紧急状态而在未取得第一款所规定的同意或违反该项同意的情形下飞行于敌方所实际控制的地区上空的医务飞机，应尽力使其能被识别，并应将情况通知敌方。
Translation: II. Medical aircraft flying over areas physically controlled by the enemy due to navigational error or emergency conditions affecting flight safety, without obtaining the consent specified in paragraph 1 or in violation of such consent, shall make every effort to identify themselves and notify the enemy of the situation.

Query_Text_cn: 一旦这类医务飞机为敌方所认出，该方应尽一切合理努力，立即发出第三十条第一款所指的着陆或降落水面的命令，或采取保障其本身利益的其他措施，并在上述任何一种情形下，应在对该飞机进行攻击前，允许该飞机有遵从命令的时间。
Translation: Once such medical aircraft are recognized by the adverse Party, that Party shall make all reasonable efforts to immediately issue the order to land or to alight on water referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 30, or to take other measures to safeguard its own interests, and in any of these cases shall allow the aircraft time for compliance before resorting to an attack.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条对医务飞机运用的限制一、禁止冲突各方利用其医务飞机，以图从敌方取得任何军事利益。
Translation:
Article 28 Restrictions on the Use of Medical Aircraft  

1. The Parties to the conflict are prohibited from using their medical aircraft in an attempt to acquire any military advantage from the adversary.

Query_Text_cn: 医务飞机的存在不应被利用，以图使军事目标不受攻击。
Translation: The presence of medical aircraft shall not be used in an attempt to render military objectives immune from attack.

Query_Text_cn: 二、医务飞机不应被利用，以收集或传送情报资料，并不应携带旨在用于这项目的的任何器材。
Translation: II. Medical aircraft shall not be used to collect or transmit intelligence data and shall not carry any equipment intended for such purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 禁止医务飞机运载任何不包括在第八条第六款的定义内的任何人或货物。
Translation: Medical aircraft are prohibited from carrying any persons or cargo not included in the definition under Article 8, paragraph 6.

Query_Text_cn: 飞机运载机上人员的个人物品或目的仅在便利航行、通讯或识别的装备，不应视为属于禁止之列。
Translation: Personal belongings of personnel on board an aircraft or equipment solely intended to facilitate navigation, communication, or identification shall not be deemed as prohibited items.

Query_Text_cn: 三、医务飞机不应携带任何武器，但取自飞机上伤者、病者和遇船难者而尚未送交主管部门的轻兵器及弹药，以及使船上医务人员能自卫和保卫在其照顾下的伤者、病者和遇船难者所需的个人轻武器除外。
Translation: III. Medical aircraft shall carry no armaments except small arms and ammunition taken from the wounded, sick and shipwrecked on board and not yet handed over to the proper authority, and such personal light weapons as may be necessary to enable the medical personnel to defend themselves and the wounded, sick and shipwrecked in their charge.

Query_Text_cn: 四、在进行第二十六条和第二十七条所指的飞行时，医务飞机除与敌方事先达成协议外，不应用以搜寻伤者、病者和遇船难者。
Translation: IV. Medical aircraft shall not be used to search for the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked unless pursuant to prior agreement with the enemy, when carrying out flights referred to in Articles 26 and 27.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条关于医务飞机的通知和协议一、第二十五条所规定的通知或为取得第二十六条、第二十七条、第二十八条第四款或第三十一条所规定的事先协议而提出的请求，应说明医务飞机的计划数目、其飞行计划和识别方法，并应被理解为含有每次飞行均将遵照第二十八条的规定的意思。
Translation:
Article 29 Notifications and Agreements Concerning Medical Aircraft  

1. Notifications under Article 25 or requests for prior agreements under Articles 26, 27, paragraph 4 of Article 28, or Article 31 shall specify the number of medical aircraft planned, their flight plans, and means of identification, and shall be understood to imply that each flight will comply with the provisions of Article 28.

Query_Text_cn: 二、收到第二十五条所规定的通知的一方，应立即表明收到该通知。
Translation: II. The party receiving the notice under Article 25 shall immediately acknowledge receipt thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 或(三)提出对该请求的合理的替代建议。
Translation: or (3) propose reasonable alternative suggestions regarding the request.

Query_Text_cn: 该方还得提议，在所涉时间内禁止或限制在该地区内的其他飞行。
Translation: The party also proposed prohibiting or restricting other flights in the area during the relevant period.

Query_Text_cn: 提出请求的一方，如果接受替代建议，应将其接受通知他方。
Translation: The requesting party shall notify the other party of its acceptance if it agrees to the alternative proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 四、各方应采取必要措施，以保证能迅速地发出通知和取得协议。
Translation: IV. All parties shall take necessary measures to ensure prompt notification and agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 五、各方还应采取必要措施，迅速向有关军事单位传播任何该通知和协议的内容，并将有关医务飞机所使用的识别方法指示该军事单位。
Translation: V. All parties shall also take necessary measures to promptly disseminate the contents of such notifications and agreements to relevant military units, and instruct these units on the identification methods applicable to the medical aircraft in question.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条医务飞机的降落和检查一、对在敌方所实际控制的地区上空或在实际控制权未明显确立的地区上空飞行的医务飞机，得按适当情况命令其着陆或降落水面，以便按照下列各款进行检查。
Translation:
Article 30 Landing and Inspection of Medical Aircraft  

1. Medical aircraft flying over areas physically controlled by an adverse party or over regions where control is not clearly established may be ordered to land or alight on water, as appropriate, for inspection in accordance with the following provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 医务飞机应服从任何这类命令。
Translation: Medical aircraft shall comply with any such orders.

Query_Text_cn: 二、这类飞机，不论因被命令或基于其他原因而着陆或降落水面，仅得因确定第三款和第四款所指的事项而受检查。
Translation: II. Such aircraft, whether ordered to land or alighting on water for any other reason, shall be subject to inspection solely for the purpose of verifying the matters referred to in paragraphs III and IV.

Query_Text_cn: 任何这种检查应立即开始，并应从速进行。
Translation: Any such inspection shall commence forthwith and be conducted expeditiously.

Query_Text_cn: 检查一方对于伤者和病者，除为检查所需外，不应要求将其移离飞机。
Translation: The inspecting party shall not require the removal of the wounded and sick from the aircraft, except when necessary for the inspection.

Query_Text_cn: 该方无论如何应保证伤者和病者的状况不因检查或移离而受不利的影响。
Translation: The party shall in any case ensure that the condition of the wounded and sick is not adversely affected by the examination or removal.

Query_Text_cn: (一)是第八条第十款的意义内的医务飞机，(二)不违反第二十八条所规定的条件，而且(三)在需要事先协议的情形下，其飞行并非事先没有协议或并不破坏事先协议的规定，该飞机和属于敌方或属于中立国家或其他非冲突一方的其他国家的机上人员，应准其立即继续飞行。
Translation: (a) medical aircraft within the meaning of Article 8, paragraph 10; (b) not in violation of the conditions stipulated in Article 28; and (c) in cases where prior agreement is required, their flight is not undertaken without such agreement or does not breach the terms of the prior agreement, such aircraft and their personnel belonging to the enemy or to neutral or other non-belligerent states shall be permitted to proceed without delay.

Query_Text_cn: (一)不是第八条第十款的意义内的医务飞机，(二)违反第二十八条所规定的条件，或(三)在需要事先协议的情形下，其飞行并无事先协议或破坏事先协议的规定；对该飞机得予拿捕。
对机上人员应按照各公约和本议定书的有关规定给予待遇。
Translation: Persons on board shall be treated in accordance with the relevant provisions of the respective conventions and this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 曾被派为常设医务飞机的任何飞机，被拿捕后仅得用为医务飞机。
Translation: Any aircraft previously designated as a permanent medical aircraft, upon capture, may only be used as a medical aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条中立国家或其他非冲突各方的国家一、除有事先协议外，医务飞机不应在中立国家或其他非冲突一方的国家的领土上空飞行，或在该领土内降落。
Translation:
Article 31 Neutral or Other Non-Conflict States  
1. Medical aircraft shall not fly over the territory of a neutral or other non-conflict state, or land therein, except by prior agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 但在有事先协议的情形下，医务飞机在其全部飞行中以及在该领土内任何停留期间，则均应受尊重。
Translation: However, in cases where prior agreement exists, medical aircraft shall be respected throughout their entire flight and during any stay in that territory.

Query_Text_cn: 然而该医务飞机仍应服从着陆或在适当情况下降落水面的任何命令。
Translation: However, the medical aircraft shall comply with any orders to land or, if appropriate, to alight on water.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果医务飞机由于航行错误或因影响飞行安全的紧急状态而在没有协议或背离协议规定的情形下飞行于中立国家或其他非冲突一方的国家的领土上空，该飞机应尽力发出飞行的通知，并使自己能被识别。
Translation: II. If a medical aircraft flies over the territory of a neutral or other State not a party to the conflict due to navigational error or because of an emergency affecting the safety of the flight, without agreement or in deviation from the terms of such agreement, it shall make every effort to give notice of the flight and to identify itself.

Query_Text_cn: 一旦这类医务飞机被认出，该国应尽一切合理努力，立即发出第三十条第一款所指的着陆或降落水面的命令，或采取保障其本身的利益的其他措施，并在上述任何一种情形下，应在对该飞机进行攻击前，允许该飞行有遵从命令的时间。
Translation: Once such medical aircraft are recognized, the country concerned shall make every reasonable effort to immediately issue the landing or alighting on water order referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 30, or to take other measures to safeguard its own interests. In any of these cases, it shall allow the aircraft time to comply with the order before resorting to an attack.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如果医务飞机依据协议或在第二款所载的情况下，不论因被命令着陆或降落水面或基于其他原因，而在中立国家或其他非冲突一方的国家的领土内着陆或降落水面，该飞机应受检查，以确定其在事实上是否医务飞机。
Translation: 3. If a medical aircraft lands or alights on water in the territory of a neutral or other State not a Party to the conflict, whether pursuant to an agreement or in the circumstances mentioned in paragraph 2, whether ordered to do so or for other reasons, it shall be subject to inspection for the purpose of ascertaining whether it is in fact a medical aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 检查应立即开始，并应从速进行。
Translation: The inspection should commence immediately and proceed expeditiously.

Query_Text_cn: 对属于操纵飞机的一方的伤者和病者，除其移离飞机为检查所需外，检查一方不应要求其移离飞机。
Translation: The Detaining Power shall not require that wounded or sick who are detained be so removed unless their removal is essential for the security of the Detaining Power.

Query_Text_cn: 检查一方无论如何应保证伤者和病者的状况不因检查或移离而受不利的影响。
Translation: The inspecting party shall in any case ensure that the condition of the wounded and sick is not adversely affected by the inspection or removal.

Query_Text_cn: 如果检查表明，该飞机在事实上是医务飞机，则该飞机及其机上人员，除按照适用于武装冲突的国际法规则必须予以拘留外，应准其恢复飞行，并应给予继续飞行的合理便利。
Translation: If the inspection reveals that the aircraft is in fact a medical aircraft, it shall be permitted to resume its flight, along with its personnel, and shall be granted reasonable facilities for continuing its flight, unless detention is required under the rules of international law applicable in armed conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 如果检查表明，飞机不是医务飞机，对该飞机应予拿捕，机上人员应按照第四款的规定享受待遇。
Translation: If the inspection reveals that the aircraft is not a medical aircraft, it shall be subject to capture, and the persons on board shall be treated in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 4.

Query_Text_cn: 四、经地方当局同意，在中立国家或其他非冲突一方的国家领土内，并非临时地从医务飞机下来的伤者、病者和遇船难者，除该国和冲突各方之间另有协议外，如果适用于武装冲突的国际法规则有此要求，则应由该国予以拘留，使其不能再从事敌对行动。
Translation: IV. Wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons who are not temporarily disembarked from medical aircraft in the territory of a neutral or other non-belligerent state, with the consent of the local authorities, shall, unless otherwise agreed between that state and the parties to the conflict, be detained by that state if so required by the rules of international law applicable in armed conflict, in such a manner that they cannot again take part in hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 医院治疗和拘禁的费用应由这类人所属的国家负担。
Translation: The costs of medical treatment and detention in hospitals shall be borne by the countries to which such persons belong.

Query_Text_cn: 五、中立国家或其他非冲突各方的国家，应对冲突所有各方同样适用关于医务飞机在其领土上空通过或在其领土内着陆的任何条件和限制。
Translation: V. Neutral or other non-belligerent states shall apply equally to all parties to the conflict any conditions and restrictions on the passage of medical aircraft over their territory or on their landing therein.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条一般原则在执行本段的规定时，缔约各方、冲突各方和各公约和本议定书所载的国际人道主义组织的活动，主要应受家庭了解其亲属命运的权利的推动。
Translation:
Article 32 General Principle  
In implementing the provisions of this Section, the activities of the High Contracting Parties, the Parties to the conflict, and the international humanitarian organizations referred to in the Conventions and this Protocol shall be prompted primarily by the right of families to know the fate of their relatives.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条失踪的人一、一旦情况许可，并至迟从实际战斗结束时开始，冲突各方应即搜寻经敌方报告为失踪的人。
Translation:
Article 33 Missing Persons  

1. As soon as circumstances permit, and at the latest from the end of active hostilities, each Party to the conflict shall search for persons reported missing by an adverse Party.

Query_Text_cn: 该敌方应发送有关这类人的一切情报，以便利搜寻。
Translation: The opposing party shall transmit all intelligence concerning such individuals to facilitate their apprehension.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在最大可能范围内便利、并于需要时进行搜寻这类人的工作，以及如果这类人由于敌对行动或占领而在其他情况下死亡，将其有关情报记录下来的工作。
Translation: (2) To facilitate, to the greatest extent possible, the search for such persons when necessary, and to record relevant information concerning them if they have died as a result of hostilities or occupation under other circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按照第一款已报告为失踪的人的有关情报以及获得这种情报的请求，应直接或通过保护国或红十字国际委员会中央查访局或各国红十字会(红新月会、红狮与太阳会)发送。
Translation: III. Information concerning persons reported missing pursuant to paragraph 1, as well as requests for such information, shall be transmitted either directly or through the Protecting Power or the Central Tracing Agency of the International Committee of the Red Cross or the National Red Cross (Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun) Societies.

Query_Text_cn: 在未通过红十字国际委员会及其中央查访局发送情报的情形下，冲突一方也应保证向中央查访局提供该项情报。
Translation: In the absence of information transmitted through the International Committee of the Red Cross and its Central Tracing Agency, each party to the conflict shall ensure that such information is provided to the Central Tracing Agency.

Query_Text_cn: 四、冲突各方应努力商定关于搜寻、识别和收回战地上死者的工作组的安排，并于适当时，包括关于在敌方控制地区内执行这项任务时由敌方人员伴随工作组的安排。
Translation: 4. The parties to the conflict shall endeavor to agree on arrangements for working groups tasked with searching for, identifying, and recovering the dead from the battlefield, and where appropriate, including provisions for such teams to be accompanied by enemy personnel when operating in areas under enemy control.

Query_Text_cn: 这类工作组在专门履行这项职责时，应受尊重和保护。
Translation: Such working groups should be respected and protected when performing this specific duty.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条死者尸体一、基于与占领有关的原因死亡或因占领或敌对行动而在拘留中死亡的人的尸体，以及不是基于敌对行动的原因而死亡的所在地国家的国民的人的尸体，均应受尊重，所有这类人的墓地，如果依据各公约和本议定书不受更优惠的考虑，应按照第四公约第一百三十条的规定，受尊重、维护并予以标明。
Translation:
Article 34 Remains of the Dead  

1. The remains of persons who have died for reasons related to occupation or who have died in detention as a result of occupation or hostilities, as well as those of nationals of the country in which they died not as a result of hostilities, shall be respected. All such gravesites, unless entitled to more favorable consideration under the Conventions and this Protocol, shall be respected, maintained, and marked in accordance with Article 130 of the Fourth Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （三）便利在本国请求下，或除该国反对外，在最近亲属请求下，送还死者的尸体和个人用品。
Translation: (3) To facilitate the repatriation of the deceased's remains and personal effects upon request by the country of origin or, unless objected to by that country, upon request by the next of kin.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在未订立第二款第二项或第三项所规定的协定的情形下，如果死者本国不愿自己支付费用以安排这类墓地的维护，墓地所在地的缔约一方得建议将死者尸体送还其本国。
Translation: III. In the absence of an agreement as provided for in paragraph 2, subparagraph (b) or (c), if the deceased's country of origin is unwilling to bear the costs of maintaining such graves, the Contracting Party in whose territory the graves are situated may propose the repatriation of the remains to the country of origin.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这项建议未被接受，缔约一方得在提出建议满五年后，并在向死者本国发出适当通知后，采取其本国关于坟墓的法律所规定的安排。
Translation: If this proposal is not accepted, either Contracting Party may, after five years from the date of the proposal and upon giving due notice to the deceased's home country, implement the arrangements prescribed by its domestic laws concerning graves.

Query_Text_cn: “五、缔约国一方居民转让其在缔约国另一方居民公司资本中的股份、参股或其他权利取得的收益，如果取得该收益的人在该转让行为前12个月内，曾经直接或间接参与拥有该公司至少25%的资本，可以在缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: "5. Gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of shares, participations or other rights in the capital of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State if the alienator, at any time during the 12-month period preceding such alienation, owned directly or indirectly at least 25% of the capital of that company."

Query_Text_cn: “六、转让第一款至第五款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国征税。
Translation: "VI. Gains derived from the alienation of any property other than that referred to in paragraphs I to V shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident."

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换可以预见与执行本协定的规定相关的情报，或与执行缔约国双方或其地方当局征收的各种税收的国内法律相关的情报，以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限。
Translation: 1. The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall exchange such information as is foreseeably relevant for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or for the administration or enforcement of their domestic tax laws concerning taxes of every kind imposed by either Contracting State or its local authorities, insofar as the taxation under those laws is not contrary to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方政府应通过外交换函，确认已履行为本议定书生效所必需的国内法律程序。
Translation: The Governments of both Contracting Parties shall confirm through an exchange of diplomatic notes that they have completed the domestic legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在毛里求斯，本议定书生效之日后7月1日或以后开始的所得年度中取得的所得。
Translation: (2) In Mauritius, income derived in income years commencing on or after July 1 following the date of entry into force of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书应随协定长期有效。
Translation: This Protocol shall remain in force for the same duration as the Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经正式授权，已在本议定书上签字为证。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, duly authorized, have signed this Protocol in witness thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书于二零零六年九月五日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文和英文写成。
Translation: This Protocol is signed in Beijing on September 5, 2006, in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 如在文本解释上有分歧，应以英文本为准。
Translation: In case of any discrepancy in the interpretation of the text, the English version shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: (22)“1994年《商标法条约》”指1994年10月27日于日内瓦签订的《商标法条约》。
Translation: (22) "The Trademark Law Treaty of 1994" refers to the Trademark Law Treaty concluded in Geneva on October 27, 1994.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条本条约适用的商标一、[商标的性质]任何缔约方法律规定可以作为商标注册的标志所构成的商标均应适用本条约。
Translation:
Article 2   Trademarks to Which the Treaty Applies  
1. [Nature of Marks] This Treaty shall apply to trademarks consisting of signs that can be registered as trademarks under the law of any Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[商标的种类](一)本条约应适用于与商品有关的商标(商品商标)或与服务有关的商标(服务商标),或与商品和服务均有关的商标。
Translation: II. [Types of Marks] (1) This Treaty shall apply to marks relating to goods (trademarks) or to services (service marks), or to both goods and services.

Query_Text_cn: (二)本条约不应适用于集体商标、证明商标和保证商标。
Translation: (2) This Treaty shall not apply to collective marks, certification marks and guarantee marks.

Query_Text_cn: (16)缔约方法律要求提交的有意使用该商标的声明。
Translation: (16) A declaration of intent to use the trademark as required by the laws of the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: (二)按照缔约方法律的要求,申请人可以提交实际使用商标的声明和相关证据,作为对本款第(一)项(16)目所指有意使用商标的声明的替代或补充。
Translation: (2) In accordance with the requirements of the laws of the Contracting Parties, the applicant may submit a declaration of actual use of the trademark and relevant evidence as a substitute for or supplement to the declaration of intent to use the trademark referred to in subparagraph (1)(16) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (三)任何缔约方均可以要求,提交注册申请须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting Party may require that a fee be paid to the trademark office upon the filing of an application for registration.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[一件申请多类注册]同一申请可以涉及多项商品或服务,无论其在《尼斯分类》中同属一个类别还是分属多个类别。
Translation: II. [Single Application for Multiple Classes] A single application may cover multiple goods or services, regardless of whether they belong to a single class or multiple classes under the Nice Classification.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[实际使用]任何缔约方均可以要求,已经按照本条第一款第(一)项第(16)目的规定提交有意使用商标声明的,申请人须在法律规定的期限(应不少于本条约《实施细则》规定的最短期限)内,按该法律的要求向商标主管机关提交商标实际使用的证据。
Translation: III. [Actual Use] Any Contracting Party may require that an applicant who has submitted a declaration of intent to use a trademark under Article 1(1)(a)(16) shall furnish to the trademark office evidence of actual use of the trademark within the period prescribed by law, which shall not be less than the minimum period specified in the Regulations under this Treaty, in accordance with the requirements of that law.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[禁止其他要求]除本条第一款、第三款及本条约第八条所提及的要求外,任何缔约方不得就申请另行规定其他要求。
Translation: IV. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] No Party shall impose requirements other than those specified in paragraph 1 and paragraph 3 of this Article and Article VIII of this Treaty on any application.

Query_Text_cn: (4)提交该商标已在其他缔约方获得注册,或已在非缔约方的《巴黎公约》成员国获得注册的证据。__UNDEF__申请人要求适用《巴黎公约》第六条之五规定的除外。
Translation: (4) Submit evidence that the trademark has been registered in other contracting parties or in a member state of the Paris Convention that is not a contracting party, unless the applicant requests the application of the provisions of Article 6ter of the Paris Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关在审查过程中对申请中的任何说明或项目的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: V. [Evidence] Any Contracting Party may require that, where the trademark office has reasonable doubts during the examination process regarding the veracity of any statement or item in an application, the applicant shall furnish relevant evidence to the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: (2)应提供其在缔约方规定的领土内的一个地址作为其地址。
Translation: (2) An address within the territory of the Contracting Party as specified by that Party shall be provided as its address.

Query_Text_cn: (二)符合缔约方根据本款第(一)项所适用的要求的代理人,向商标主管机关采取的或与之相关的任何代理行为,应具有与委托该代理人的申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人所采取的或与之相关的行为同样的效力。
Translation: (2) Any act performed by or in relation to the trademark office by an agent who meets the requirements applicable to the Contracting Party under paragraph (1) of this Article shall have the same effect as an act performed by or in relation to the applicant, registrant, or other interested party who appointed the agent.

Query_Text_cn: 送达地址](一)任何缔约方均可以要求,在其境内既无住所又无真实有效的工商营业所的申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人,向商标主管机关办理任何业务,必须委托代理人办理。
Translation: [Address for Service] (1) Any Contracting Party may require that an applicant, a registered holder or any other interested party who has neither a domicile nor a real and effective industrial or commercial establishment in its territory be represented by an agent before the trademark office for any procedure.

Query_Text_cn: (二)如果缔约方未要求按照本款第(一)项规定指定代理人,则该缔约方可以要求,在其境内既无住所又无真实有效的工商营业所的申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人,向商标主管机关办理任何业务,必须在其境内有送达地址。
Translation: (2) Where a Party does not require the appointment of an agent under paragraph (1), it may require that an applicant, a registration holder or any other interested party who neither has a domicile nor a real and effective industrial or commercial establishment in its territory must have an address for service in that territory for the purpose of any procedure before the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[委托书](一)如果缔约方允许或要求申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人通过代理人向商标主管机关办理有关业务,则该缔约方可以要求须以专函的形式(以下称为“委托书”)委托代理人,并视情况注明申请人、注册持有人或其他相关人的名称。
Translation: III. [Power of Attorney] (1) If a Contracting Party permits or requires an applicant, a registration holder, or any other interested party to conduct relevant procedures with the trademark office through an agent, such Contracting Party may require that the agent be appointed by a separate document (hereinafter referred to as a "power of attorney"), which shall, as the case may be, indicate the name of the applicant, the registration holder, or any other relevant party.

Query_Text_cn: (二)委托书可以涉及委托人指定的一件或多件申请或注册,也可以涉及委托人现有的和将来的全部申请或注册,但委托人声明的例外情况除外。
Translation: (2) The power of attorney may relate to one or more applications or registrations designated by the appointing party, or to all existing and future applications or registrations of the appointing party, except where exceptions are declared by the appointing party.

Query_Text_cn: (三)委托书可以将代理人的权力限制在一定范围。
Translation: (3) A power of attorney may limit the agent's authority to a specified scope.

Query_Text_cn: 任何缔约方均可以要求,赋予代理人撤回申请或放弃注册的权力,必须在委托书中明确规定。
Translation: Any contracting party may require that the power of an agent to withdraw an application or to abandon a registration must be expressly stipulated in the power of attorney.

Query_Text_cn: (四)缔约方商标主管机关可以规定,如果某人在向商标主管机关递交的文函中自称为代理人,但商标主管机关在收到文函时没有收到所要求提供的委托书的,可以要求其在规定期限(应不少于本条约《实施细则》规定的最短期限)内将委托书递交商标主管机关。
Translation: (iv) The trademark authority of a Contracting Party may stipulate that if a person claims to be an agent in a document submitted to the trademark authority but the authority has not received the required power of attorney at the time of receiving the document, it may require the person to submit the power of attorney to the authority within a specified period (which shall not be less than the minimum period prescribed in the Regulations under this Treaty).

Query_Text_cn: 任何缔约方均可以规定,未能在规定期限内将委托书递交商标主管机关的,该人递交的该文函无效。
Translation: Any contracting party may stipulate that any document submitted by a person shall be invalid if the power of attorney is not filed with the trademark office within the specified time limit.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[委托书的提及]任何缔约方均可以要求,代理人就所代理的业务向商标主管机关递交的任何文函,均须提及其据以代理该业务的委托书。
Translation: IV. [Mention of Power of Attorney] Any Contracting Party may require that any document submitted to the trademark office by a representative in connection with a represented matter must mention the power of attorney on which the representation is based.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[禁止其他要求]除本条第三款、第四款及本条约第八条所提及的要求外,任何缔约方不得就上述条款所指事项另行规定其他要求。
Translation: V. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Except for the requirements specified in Paragraph 3 and Paragraph 4 of this Article and Article VIII of this Treaty, no Party shall impose any additional requirements on the matters referred to in the aforementioned provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对本条第三款、第四款所指任何文函内容的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: VI. [Evidence] Any Contracting Party may require that, where the trademark office has reasonable doubts as to the authenticity of any document referred to in paragraph 3 or 4 of this Article, evidence to that effect be furnished to the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: (6)在适用本条约第三条第一款第(一)项第(16)目或第(二)项时,缔约方法律要求提交的本条约第三条第一款第(一)项第(16)目所指的声明,或本条约第三条第一款第(二)项所指的声明和证据。
Translation: (6) In the application of subparagraph (1)(16) or subparagraph (2) of paragraph 1 of Article 3 of this Treaty, the declarations referred to in subparagraph (1)(16) of paragraph 1 of Article 3 of this Treaty or the declarations and evidence referred to in subparagraph (2) of paragraph 1 of Article 3 of this Treaty, as required by the laws of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方均可以规定,以商标主管机关收到本款第(一)项所提及的部分而非全部说明和项目的日期,或以收到不符合本条约第八条第二款的语言要求的说明和项目的日期为申请日期。
Translation: (2) Any Contracting Party may provide that the date of filing shall be the date on which the Office receives some but not all of the indications or elements referred to in paragraph (1), or the date on which the Office receives indications or elements that do not comply with the language requirements under Article 8(2).

Query_Text_cn: 二、[准许的附加要求](一)缔约方可以规定,在缴纳费用之前不得确定申请日期。
Translation: II. [Permissive Additional Requirements] (1) A Party may stipulate that the filing date shall not be determined until the required fees have been paid.

Query_Text_cn: (二)缔约方只有在加入本条约时就适用本款第(一)项要求的,才可以适用这一要求。
Translation: (2) A Party may apply the requirement under paragraph (1) only if it does so upon accession to this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[更正和期限]本条第一款和第二款下的更正方式和期限应在本条约《实施细则》中予以确定。
Translation: III. [Corrections and Time Limits] The methods and time limits for corrections under Paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall be specified in the Implementing Regulations of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[禁止其他要求]除本条第一款和第二款规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就申请日期另行规定其他要求。
Translation: IV. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] No Party shall impose requirements other than those specified in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article regarding the application date.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一件申请多类注册同一件申请中含有《尼斯分类》中多个类别的商品或服务的,该申请应按同一注册办理。
Translation:
Article 6: Single Application for Multi-Class Registration  
If a single application includes goods or services categorized under multiple classes of the Nice Classification, the application shall be processed as one single registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条申请和注册的分解一、[申请的分解](一)涉及多项商品或服务的任何申请(以下称为“原申请”),可以(1)至少在商标主管机关对该商标能否注册作出决定之前,(2)在对商标主管机关作出的注册决定进行任何异议程序期间,(3)在对商标主管机关作出的注册决定进行任何上诉程序期间,由申请人或经申请人请求将其分为两件或多件申请(以下称为“分申请”),分别就“原申请”中所涉及的商品或服务提出申请。
“分申请”应保留“原申请”的申请日期及优先权(如果有)。
Translation: "Divisional applications" shall retain the filing date and priority (if any) of the "original application."

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方在不违反本款第(一)项规定的前提下,均可以就申请的分解作出规定,包括费用的缴纳等。
Translation: (2) Without prejudice to the provisions of subparagraph (1) of this paragraph, any Contracting Party may prescribe provisions concerning the division of an application, including the payment of fees.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[注册的分解]本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应适用于注册的分解事宜。
Translation: 2. [Division of Registration] The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall apply mutatis mutandis to the division of registration.

Query_Text_cn: 此种分解无论是(1)在第三方就注册的有效性向商标主管机关提出任何争议的程序期间,还是(2)在对商标主管机关就争议作出的决定进行任何上诉的程序期间,均应允许进行。__UNDEF__但是,如果缔约方法律允许第三方在商标获得注册之前对商标的注册提出异议,则缔约方可以排除注册分解的可能性。
Translation: This type of division shall be permitted (1) during any proceeding in which a third party challenges the validity of the registration before the trademark office, or (2) during any appeal proceeding against a decision of the trademark office regarding such a challenge.__UNDEF__However, if the law of a Contracting Party allows a third party to oppose the registration of a trademark before it is granted, the Contracting Party may exclude the possibility of division of the registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条文函一、[传送方式和文函形式]任何缔约方均可以选定文函的传送方式,并确定是否接受书面形式、电子形式或其他形式的文函。
Translation:
Article 8 Correspondence  

1. [Transmission Methods and Form of Correspondence] Any Contracting Party may choose the method of transmission for correspondence and determine whether to accept correspondence in written form, electronic form, or any other form.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[文函语言](一)任何缔约方均可以要求,任何文函必须使用商标主管机关所接受的语言。
Translation: II. [Language of Documents] (1) Any contracting party may require that any document be in a language accepted by the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: 商标主管机关允许使用多种语言的,可以要求申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人选择使用该商标主管机关规定的任何一种语言,但不得要求同一文函的说明或项目使用多种语言。
Translation: Where the trademark office permits the use of multiple languages, it may require the applicant, registrant, or other interested party to choose any one language specified by the trademark office, but shall not require the use of multiple languages for the same document or item.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方不得要求,对文函的任何译文出具证明、公证、鉴定、法律认证或其他证明材料,本条约另有规定的除外。
Translation: (2) No Contracting Party may require that any translation of a document be certified, notarized, authenticated, legalized, or accompanied by any other formality, except as provided in this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: (三)缔约方未要求文函使用商标主管机关所接受的语言的,商标主管机关可以要求该文函须由官方译员或代理人译成该商标主管机关接受的语言,并在合理期限内提交。
Translation: (3) Where a Contracting Party does not require the use of a language accepted by the trademark office for documents, the trademark office may require that such documents be translated into a language accepted by the office by an official translator or representative and submitted within a reasonable time limit.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[书面文函的签字](一)任何缔约方均可以要求,书面文函应由申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人签字。
Translation: III. [Signatures on Written Communications] (1) Any Contracting Party may require that written communications be signed by the applicant, the holder, or any other interested person.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方对书面文函有签字要求的,应接受符合本条约《实施细则》有关规定的任何签字。
Translation: Where a Contracting Party requires a signature for written communications, it shall accept any signature that complies with the relevant provisions of the Regulations under this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方不得要求,对任何签字出具证明、公证、鉴定、法律认证或其他证明材料,缔约方法律对放弃注册时的签字有此规定的除外。
Translation: (2) No Contracting Party shall require any certification, notarization, authentication, legalization or other documentary evidence for any signature, except where its law provides for the waiver of registration requirements regarding signatures.

Query_Text_cn: (三)尽管有本款第(二)项的规定,任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对任何书面文函的签字的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: (3) Notwithstanding subparagraph (2), any Contracting Party may require that, where the trademark office has reasonable doubts about the authenticity of any signature on a written communication, evidence to that effect be furnished to the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[以电子方式提交或以电子手段传送的文函]缔约方允许以电子形式提交或以电子方式传送文函的,可以要求任何此种文函均应符合本条约《实施细则》的有关规定。
Translation: 4. [Electronic Submission or Transmission of Communications] Where a Contracting Party permits the submission or transmission of communications in electronic form, it may require that any such communication comply with the relevant provisions of the Regulations under this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[文函的递交]递交文函时,凡内容符合本条约《实施细则》规定的相关国际书式范本(如果有)的,任何缔约方均应予以接受。
Translation: V. [Submission of Documents] When submitting documents, any Party shall accept those that conform to the relevant international standard forms (if any) specified in the Implementing Regulations of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[禁止其他要求]除本条规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就本条第一款至第五款内容另行规定其他要求。
Translation: VI. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] No Party shall impose any requirements other than those specified in paragraphs 1 to 5 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 七、[与代理人之间的通信手段]本条中的任何规定均不适用于申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人与其代理人之间的通信手段。
Translation: VII. [Means of Communication with Representatives] Nothing in this Article shall apply to the means of communication between an applicant, a registration holder, or any other interested party and their representative.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条商品或服务的分类一、[注明商品或服务]商标主管机关核准的每件注册和发布的公告,凡涉及申请或注册并注明商品或服务的,均应注明商品或服务的名称,应按《尼斯分类》中的类别分组,并在每组前标明所属类别的编号,按类别顺序排列。
Translation:
Article 9 Classification of Goods or Services  

1. [Specification of Goods or Services] For each registration approved by the trademark authority and its published announcement, where the trademark application or registration involves specified goods or services, the names of the goods or services shall be indicated. These shall be grouped according to the classes of the Nice Classification, with the class number marked before each group, and listed in the order of the class sequence.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[同一类别或不同类别的商品或服务](一)商品或服务,不得因为商标主管机关在任何注册或公告中将其列入《尼斯分类》的同一类别,而被认为互相类似。
Translation:
II. [Goods or Services of the Same or Different Classes]  
(1) Goods or services shall not be regarded as similar to each other on the ground that, in any registration or publication by the trademark office, they appear in the same class of the Nice Classification.

Query_Text_cn: (二)商品或服务,不得因为商标主管机关在任何注册或公告中将其列入《尼斯分类》的不同类别,而被认为互相不类似。
Translation: (2) Goods or services shall not be regarded as dissimilar from each other on the ground that, in any registration or publication by the trademark office, they are classified in different classes of the Nice Classification.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条变更名称或地址一、[变更注册持有人名称或地址](一)任何缔约方均应准许,注册持有人未变而其名称或地址发生变更的,该注册持有人可以以文函形式向商标主管机关提交变更商标注册簿登记的申请,申请中应注明相关商标的注册号及申请变更登记的内容。
Translation:
Article 10 Change of Name or Address  
I. [Change of the Name or Address of the Registered Holder]  
(1) Any contracting party shall permit the registered holder, if their name or address has changed while the identity of the holder remains unchanged, to submit an application for amending the record in the trademark register to the trademark office in writing. The application shall indicate the registration number of the relevant trademark and the details of the change requested.

Query_Text_cn: (三)任何缔约方均可以要求,提交变更登记申请须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting Party may require that a request for the recordal of a change be subject to the payment of a fee to the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: (四)变更涉及多件注册的,如果注明所有相关商标的注册号,则只须提交一件申请。
Translation: (4) Where the change involves multiple registrations, only one application needs to be submitted if the registration numbers of all relevant trademarks are indicated.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[变更申请人名称或地址]变更涉及一件或多件申请的,或同时涉及一件或多件申请和一件或多件注册的,本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应予适用。__UNDEF__但是,如果相关申请号尚未公布或尚不为申请人或其代理人知晓,变更申请则应按本条约《实施细则》的有关规定注明该相关申请。
Translation: II. [Change of Name or Address of Applicant] Where the change relates to one or more applications, or to one or more applications and one or more registrations, the first paragraph of this Article shall apply mutatis mutandis. However, if the relevant application number(s) has/have not yet been published or is/are not yet known to the applicant or his representative, the request for change shall indicate the relevant application(s) in accordance with the provisions of the Regulations under this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[变更代理人名称、地址或送达地址]本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应适用于代理人(如果有)名称或地址以及送达地址(如果有)的任何变更。
Translation: III. [Change of Agent's Name, Address, or Service Address] The provisions of Paragraph 1 of this Article shall apply mutatis mutandis to any change in the name or address of the agent (if any) and the service address (if any).

Query_Text_cn: 四、[禁止其他要求]除本条第一款至第三款及本条约第八条规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就本条所指的申请另行规定其他要求,尤其不得要求提交任何有关变更的证明。
Translation: IV. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Apart from the requirements stipulated in paragraphs 1 to 3 of this Article and Article VIII of this Treaty, no Party shall impose any additional requirements concerning the applications referred to in this Article, particularly any requirement to submit proof of any change.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对变更申请中的任何说明的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: V. [Evidence] Any Contracting Party may require that, where the trademark office has reasonable doubts about the veracity of any statement in the application for a change, evidence to that effect be furnished to the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条变更所有权一、[变更注册所有权](一)任何缔约方均应准许,注册持有人发生变更的,该持有人或新获得所有权的人(以下称为“新所有人”)可以以文函形式向商标主管机关提交变更商标注册簿登记的申请,申请中应注明相关商标的注册号及申请变更登记的内容。
Translation:
Article 11 Change in Ownership  

I. [Recording the Change in Ownership]  

(1) Each Contracting Party shall provide that where there is a change in the person of the holder, the holder or the person who acquired the ownership (hereinafter referred to as "the new owner") may file an application with the trademark office to record the change in the register of trademarks in writing. The application shall indicate the registration number of the trademark concerned and the particulars of the change to be recorded.

Query_Text_cn: (三)任何缔约方均可以要求,因企业合并而发生所有权变更的,变更申请中须对此予以说明,并附送一份由主管部门签发的证明该项合并的文件的复印件,例如商业登记簿摘录的复印件,还可以要求提供由文件签发部门、公证机构或任何其他政府主管部门出具的有关该复印件真实性的证明。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting Party may require that, in case of a change in ownership resulting from a merger of enterprises, the application for change shall indicate such fact and be accompanied by a copy of a document issued by the competent authority evidencing the merger, such as an extract from a commercial register, and may also require proof of the authenticity of such copy issued by the authority which issued the document, a notary or any other competent government authority.

Query_Text_cn: (四)任何缔约方均可以要求,因合同或企业合并而发生所有权变更的,如果共同注册持有人中有一人或多人发生变更但非全部都发生变更的,所有权未发生变更的任何共同注册持有人,均须以签字文件的形式就该所有权变更明确表示同意。
Translation: (iv) Any Contracting Party may require that, in the case of a change of ownership resulting from a contract or a merger, where the change relates to some but not all of the co-registered holders, any co-registered holder whose ownership has not changed shall expressly consent to the change of ownership in a signed document.

Query_Text_cn: (五)任何缔约方均可以要求,对于并非因合同或企业合并引起,而是因实施法律或法院判决等其他原因引起的所有权变更,变更申请中须对此予以说明,并附送一份证明该项变更的文件的复印件,还可以要求提供由文件签发部门、公证机构或任何其他政府主管部门出具的证明该文件真实性的证明。
Translation: (v) Any Contracting Party may require that, in respect of a change in ownership not resulting from a contract or a merger but from another ground, such as a court decision or the operation of law, the request indicate that ground and be accompanied by a copy of a document evidencing that change and may also require that the document be certified by the authority which issued the document, by a notary or by any other competent public authority as being in conformity with the original.

Query_Text_cn: (七)任何缔约方均可以要求,提交变更申请须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: (7) Any contracting party may require that a fee be paid to the trademark office for the submission of an application for amendment.

Query_Text_cn: (八)变更涉及多件注册的,如果每件注册的注册持有人和新所有人均相同,并且申请中注明所有相关商标的注册号,则只须提交一件申请。
Translation: (viii) Where the change involves multiple registrations, a single application shall suffice if the registrant and the new owner are the same for each registration, and the application indicates the registration numbers of all relevant trademarks.

Query_Text_cn: (九)所有权变更不涉及注册的所有商品或服务,且可适用的法律允许对此种变更予以登记的,商标主管机关应就所有权变更所涉及的商品或服务单独设立一件注册。
Translation: (IX) Where the change in ownership does not concern all the goods or services covered by the registration and the applicable law permits the recording of such change, the Office shall create a separate registration referring to the goods or services in respect of which the ownership has changed.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[申请的所有权变更]变更涉及一件或多件申请的,或同时涉及一件或多件申请和一件或多件注册的,本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应予适用。__UNDEF__但是,如果相关申请号尚未公布或尚不为申请人及其代理人知晓,变更申请则应按本条约《实施细则》的有关规定注明该相关申请。
Translation: II. [Change in the Ownership of an Application] Where a change concerns one or more applications or concerns both one or more applications and one or more registrations, paragraph (1) shall apply, mutatis mutandis. However, where the relevant application numbers have not yet been issued or are not yet known to the applicant or his representative, the request for change shall indicate the relevant application in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Regulations under this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: (4)说明原注册持有人已将其企业或有关商誉全部或部分转让给新所有人并提供相关证据。
Translation: (4) State that the original registrant has transferred all or part of its business or relevant goodwill to the new owner and provide supporting evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对变更申请中或本条所指的任何文件中的任何说明的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据,或在适用本条第一款第(三)项或第(五)项时,须按该项规定进一步提供相关证据。
Translation: IV. [Evidence] Any Contracting Party may require that, where the trademark office has reasonable grounds to doubt the veracity of any indication in the application for alteration or in any document referred to in this Article, evidence be furnished to the trademark office or, where applicable under paragraph (1)(iii) or (v), that additional evidence be furnished as required therein.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条更正错误一、[更正注册方面的错误](一)任何缔约方均应准许,对于向商标主管机关提交的申请或其他申请中所出现的并反映在商标主管机关的商标注册簿或任何公告中的错误,注册持有人可以以文函方式申请更正,申请中应注明相关商标的注册号、须更正的错误以及须登记的更正。
Translation:
Article 12 Correction of Errors  

1. [Correction of Errors in Registration]  
  (1) Each Contracting Party shall provide that the holder of a registration may request, in writing, the correction of any error in an application or other document submitted to the trademark office that is reflected in the trademark register or any publication of the trademark office. The request shall indicate the registration number of the trademark concerned, the error to be corrected, and the correction to be entered.

Query_Text_cn: (3)注册持有人有送达地址的,该送达地址。
Translation: (3) The address for service where the registered holder has one.

Query_Text_cn: (四)更正涉及同一人的多件注册的,如果各件注册的错误和须更正的内容均相同,而且在申请中注明所有相关注册的注册号,则只须提交一件申请。
Translation: (4) For corrections involving multiple registrations of the same person, if the errors and required corrections are identical across all registrations and the application specifies all relevant registration numbers, only one application needs to be submitted.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[更正申请方面的错误]更正涉及一件或多件申请的,或同时涉及一件或多件申请和一件或多件注册的,本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应予适用。__UNDEF__但是,如果相关申请号尚未公布或尚不为申请人或其代理人知晓,更正申请则应按本条约《实施细则》的有关规定注明该相关申请。
Translation: II. [Correction of Errors in Applications] If the correction concerns one or more applications, or simultaneously one or more applications and one or more registrations, the first paragraph of this Article shall apply mutatis mutandis. However, if the relevant application number(s) has not yet been published or is not yet known to the applicant or their representative, the request for correction shall indicate the relevant application in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Regulations under this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[禁止其他要求]除本条第一款、第二款及本条约第八条规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就本条所指的申请另行规定其他要求。
Translation: III. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Except for the requirements specified in Paragraph 1 and Paragraph 2 of this Article and Article VIII of this Treaty, no Party shall impose any additional requirements on applications referred to in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对申请更正的错误是否确系错误产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: IV. [Evidence] Any contracting party may require that, where the trademark office has reasonable doubts as to whether an error for which correction is requested is indeed an error, relevant evidence shall be provided to the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[商标主管机关造成的错误]缔约方商标主管机关应依职权或根据请求,更正其自身造成的错误,不收取任何费用。
Translation: V. [Errors by the Trademark Office] Each Party's trademark authority shall, ex officio or upon request, correct errors attributable to it without charge.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[无法更正的错误]任何缔约方,对于其法律规定无法更正的错误,均无义务适用本条第一款、第二款及第五款的规定。
Translation: VI. [Non-Correctable Errors] No Party shall be obliged to apply the provisions of paragraphs 1, 2, and 5 of this Article to errors that cannot be corrected under its legal provisions.

Query_Text_cn: (8)缔约方允许除注册持有人或其代理人之外的第三人提出续展申请且该人已提交申请的,该第三人的名称和地址。
Translation: (8) Where a Contracting Party allows a third party other than the registered holder or its representative to file a renewal application and such person has submitted the application, the name and address of that third party.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方均可以要求,提交续展申请须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: (2) Any Contracting Party may require that an application for renewal be subject to payment of a fee to the Office.

Query_Text_cn: 已经缴纳首期注册费用或任一续展期费用的,商标主管机关不得再收取该期限内的注册维持费用。
Translation: Where the initial registration fee or any renewal fee has been paid, the trademark office shall not charge any maintenance fee for the same period.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本项的规定,与提交商标使用声明或证据有关的费用,不应被视为注册维持费用,不受本项规定的影响。
Translation: According to the provisions of this section, fees related to the submission of a declaration or evidence of trademark use shall not be regarded as fees for the maintenance of registration and shall not be affected by the provisions of this section.

Query_Text_cn: (三)任何缔约方均可以要求,续展申请须在其法律规定的期限(应不少于本条约《实施细则》所规定的最短期限)内提交商标主管机关,并缴纳本条第(二)项所指的相关费用。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting Party may require that an application for renewal be submitted to the Office within the period prescribed by its law, which shall be no less than the minimum period prescribed in the Regulations under this Treaty, and that the fees referred to in paragraph (2) be paid.

Query_Text_cn: (3)有关该商标使用的声明或证据。
Translation: (3) Statement or evidence regarding the use of the trademark.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对续展申请中的说明或项目的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须在该续展申请的审查过程中向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: III. [Evidence] Any Contracting Party may require that, where the trademark office has reasonable grounds to doubt the veracity of any indication or element in a renewal application, the applicant must furnish relevant evidence to the trademark office during the examination of such renewal application.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[禁止实质审查]任何缔约方的商标主管机关均不得因为续展而对注册进行实质审查。
Translation: IV. [Prohibition of Substantive Examination] The trademark authority of any Party shall not conduct substantive examination of a registration on the grounds of renewal.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[有效期]首次注册和每次续展的有效期均为十年。
Translation: V. [Validity Period] The initial registration and each renewal shall be valid for ten years.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条未遵守期限时的救济措施一、[期限届满前的救济措施]缔约方可以规定,向商标主管机关办理有关申请或注册的某一业务期限,凡在期限届满前向商标主管机关提出申请要求延长该期限的,均可予以延长。
Translation:
Article 14 Remedies for Non-Observation of Time Limits  

1. [Remedies Before Expiration of Time Limit] A Contracting Party may provide that, for any proceeding before the Office in respect of an application or registration, a request for extension of a time limit may be granted if submitted to the Office before the expiration of the time limit.

Query_Text_cn: (3)商标主管机关认为未能遵守期限,但已作出在具体情况下应作的努力的,或根据缔约方的规定,未能遵守期限并非出于故意的,恢复申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人对申请或注册的权利。
Translation: (3) Where the trademark authority determines that the failure to comply with the time limit was accompanied by due diligence under the circumstances, or where, in accordance with the provisions of a Party, such failure was unintentional, the rights of the applicant, registrant, or other interested party in respect of the application or registration shall be reinstated.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[例外]对于《实施细则》中规定的例外情况,不得要求任何缔约方提供本条第二款提及的任何救济措施。
Translation: III. [Exceptions] No Party shall be required to provide any of the remedies referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article for exceptions specified in the Implementing Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[费用]任何缔约方均可以要求,申请本条第一款和第二款所提及的任何救济措施均须缴纳费用。
Translation: IV. [Fees] Any Contracting Party may require that a fee be paid in connection with any request for the remedies referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[禁止其他要求]除本条和本条约第八条规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就本条第二款所提及的任何救济措施另行规定其他要求。
Translation: V. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] No Party shall impose any additional requirements other than those stipulated in this Article and Article VIII of this Treaty with respect to any remedial measures referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条遵守《巴黎公约》的义务任何缔约方均应遵守《巴黎公约》中有关商标的规定。
Translation:
Article 15 Obligation to Comply with the Paris Convention  

Any Contracting Party shall comply with the provisions of the Paris Convention relating to trademarks.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条服务商标任何缔约方均应允许注册服务商标并对服务商标适用《巴黎公约》中有关商标的规定。
Translation:
Article 16 Service Marks  
Each Party shall permit the registration of service marks and shall apply to such marks the provisions of the Paris Convention concerning trademarks.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条使用许可备案的申请一、[有关备案申请的要求]缔约方法律规定商标使用许可须报其商标主管机关备案的,该缔约方可以要求备案申请须：__UNDEF__(1)按照《实施细则》规定的要求提交；__UNDEF__(2)附送《实施细则》规定的补充文件。
Translation:
Article 17 Application for Recordal of a License  
1. [Requirements Concerning the Application for Recordal] Where the law of a Contracting Party provides for the recordal of a license with its trademark Office, that Contracting Party may require that the application for recordal:  
(1) be submitted in accordance with the requirements prescribed in the Regulations;  
(2) be accompanied by the supporting documents prescribed in the Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[费用]任何缔约方均可以规定,申请使用许可备案须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: II. [Fees] Any contracting party may require that a request for recordal of a license be subject to payment of a fee to the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[涉及多件注册的一件申请]使用许可涉及多件注册的,如果所有注册的持有人和被许可人均相同,申请中注明所有相关注册的注册号,并且按照《实施细则》的规定注明所有注册的许可范围,则只须提交一件申请。
Translation:
III. [Single Application Involving Multiple Registrations]  
Where a license of use involves multiple registrations, a single application shall suffice provided that the holders of all registrations and the licensees are identical, the application specifies the registration numbers of all relevant registrations, and the scope of license for all registrations is indicated in accordance with the provisions of the Implementing Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: (3)关于使用许可合同中财务条款的说明。
Translation: (3) Explanation of Financial Terms in the License Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (二)除在商标注册簿中进行使用许可备案外,本款第(一)项,对于缔约方法律规定的任何信息公开义务,均不构成影响。
Translation: (2) Apart from the recordal of a license in the trademark register, paragraph (1) of this Article shall not affect any obligation of disclosure of information provided for in the law of a Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对使用许可备案申请中或《实施细则》提及的任何文件中的任何说明的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: V. [Evidence] Any Contracting Party may require that, where the trademark office has reasonable doubts about the veracity of any statement in an application for recordal of a license or in any document referred to in the Regulations, evidence to that effect be furnished to the trademark office.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[与注册申请有关的使用许可备案申请]缔约方法律允许对注册申请进行使用许可备案的,本条第一款至第五款在细节上作必要修改后,应适用于此种使用许可备案的申请。
Translation: VI. [Applications for Recordation of License Related to Registration Applications] Where the laws of a Contracting Party permit recordation of a license with respect to an application for registration, paragraphs 1 to 5 of this Article shall apply mutatis mutandis to applications for such recordation of license.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条变更或撤销使用许可备案的申请一、[有关申请的要求]缔约方法律规定使用许可须报其商标主管机关备案的,该缔约方可以要求,变更或撤销使用许可备案的申请须：__UNDEF__(1)按照《实施细则》规定的要求提交；__UNDEF__(2)附送《实施细则》规定的补充文件。
Translation:
Article 18 Application for modifying or canceling recordal of license  
1. [Requirements concerning application] Where a Contracting Party requires recordal of a license with its trademark office in accordance with its applicable law, that Contracting Party may require that an application for modifying or canceling such recordal must:  
__UNDEF__(1) comply with the requirements prescribed in the Regulations;  
__UNDEF__(2) be accompanied by the supporting documents specified in the Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[其他要求]第十七条第二款至第六款在细节上作必要修改后,应适用于变更或撤销使用许可备案的申请。
Translation: II. [Other Requirements] The provisions of paragraphs 2 to 6 of Article 17 shall apply, mutatis mutandis, to applications for modification or cancellation of recordation of license for use.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条未就使用许可备案的影响一、[注册和保护的有效性]未就使用许可向缔约方的商标主管机关或任何其他机构备案的,不得影响被许可商标注册的有效性或该商标应受的保护。
Translation:
Article 19 Consequences of Non-Recordal of License  

1. [Validity of Registration and Protection] The validity of the registration of a licensed trademark or the protection to which the trademark is entitled shall not be affected by the failure to record the license with the trademark office or any other authority of a Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[被许可人的某些权利]凡缔约方法律规定被许可人享有参与注册持有人提起的商标侵权诉讼,或通过此种诉讼从对被许可商标的侵权中获得损害赔偿的权利的,不得再将使用许可备案作为被许可人享有该权利的条件。
Translation: II. [Certain Rights of Licensees] Where the law of a Contracting Party provides that a licensee has the right to participate in infringement proceedings initiated by the holder of a registration or to obtain damages resulting from an infringement of the licensed trademark through such proceedings, the recording of a license shall not be required as a condition for the licensee to enjoy such rights.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[对未备案使用许可商标的使用]凡缔约方法律规定在涉及商标确权、维持或执法的诉讼程序中,被许可人对商标的使用可以视同为注册持有人对该商标的使用的,不得再将使用许可备案作为视同使用的条件。
Translation: III. [Use of Unregistered Licensed Trademarks] Where the laws of a Contracting Party provide that, in proceedings related to the establishment, maintenance, or enforcement of trademark rights, the use of a trademark by a licensee may be deemed as use by the registered holder, the registration of the license shall not be required as a condition for such deemed use.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条对使用许可的说明缔约方法律要求对商标被许可使用这一情况予以说明的,如果全部或者部分不符合该要求,不得影响被许可商标注册的有效性或该商标应受的保护,也不得影响本条约第十九条第三款的适用。
Translation:
Article 20 Statement of Use of the Mark 
Where any contracting party’s law requires an indication that a mark is registered as a licensed mark, the validity of the registration or the protection resulting therefrom shall not be impaired, and the application of Article 19 (3) shall not be affected, by the failure to comply fully or partially with that requirement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条对拟驳回的意见陈述对于依据本条约第三条提出的申请以及依据本条约第七条、第十条至第十四条、第十七条和第十八条提出的申请,商标主管机关拟驳回时未给予申请人或提出各项申请者(视具体情况而定)在合理期限内陈述意见的机会的,不得完全或部分驳回。
Translation:
Article 21 Statements in Case of Intended Refusal  
No application under Article 3 of this Treaty, or under Articles 7, 10 to 14, 17, and 18, shall be refused totally or partially without giving the applicant, or the person filing the application (as the case may be) the opportunity to make observations on the intended refusal within a reasonable time limit set by the trademark Office.

Query_Text_cn: 就第十四条而言,申请救济措施的人已有机会对相关决定所依据的事实陈述意见的,不得再次要求商标主管机关给予其陈述意见的机会。
Translation: With respect to Article 14, the applicant for relief measures shall not be entitled to another opportunity to present observations on the facts underlying the relevant decision if they have already been given such an opportunity before the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: (3)任何行政要求、事项或程序。
Translation: (3) Any administrative requirement, matter, or procedure.

Query_Text_cn: (二)《实施细则》也应包括《国际书式范本》。
Translation: (2) The Implementing Rules shall also include the International Book Form.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[《实施细则》的修改]除本条第三款规定以外,对《实施细则》的任何修正均须获得所投票数的四分之三。
Translation: II. [Amendments to the Implementing Rules] Except as provided in paragraph 3 of this Article, any amendment to the Implementing Rules shall require a three-fourths majority of the votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: (三)确定是否达成一致同意时,应只考虑实际投票数。
Translation: (3) In determining whether consensus has been reached, only the actual votes cast shall be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[本《条约》与《实施细则》之间相抵触的]本《条约》的规定与《实施细则》的规定发生抵触时,应以前者为准。
Translation: IV. In the event of any inconsistency between the provisions of this Treaty and those of the Implementing Regulations, the former shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条大会一、[组成](一)缔约方应设立大会。
Translation:
Article 23 Conference of the Parties

1. [Composition]  
(a) The Parties shall establish a Conference of the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: (二)每一缔约方应在大会中有一名代表,该代表可以由副代表、顾问和专家辅助。
Translation: (2) Each Party shall be represented at the Conference by one representative, who may be accompanied by alternate representatives, advisers and experts.

Query_Text_cn: 每一代表只能代表一个缔约方。
Translation: Each representative may represent only one Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (4)为执行本条约的规定履行其他适当职责。
Translation: (4) To perform such other appropriate functions as are required for the implementation of the provisions of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[法定人数](一)大会成员国的半数构成法定人数。
Translation:
III. [Quorum]  
(a) One half of the Member States of the Assembly shall constitute a quorum.

Query_Text_cn: (二)尽管有本款第(一)项的规定,如果在任何一次大会会议上,出席会议的大会成员国的数目不足大会成员国的半数,但达到或超过三分之一,大会可以作出决定。
Translation: (2) Notwithstanding the provisions of subparagraph (1), the Conference may decide at any session, provided that the number of Conference members present is less than half but equal to or more than one third of the total membership of the Conference.

Query_Text_cn: （五）“非独占使用许可”指不禁止注册持有人使用商标，也不禁止注册持有人许可其他人使用的使用许可。
Translation: (v) "Non-exclusive license" means a license that does not prohibit the trademark holder from using the trademark, nor does it prevent the holder from licensing others to use it.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[《条约》中定义的缩略语]条约第一条所定义的缩略语，其含义与本《实施细则》中的相同。
Translation: II. [Abbreviations Defined in the Treaty] The abbreviations defined in Article I of the Treaty shall have the same meanings in these Implementing Regulations as therein.

Query_Text_cn: （1）该人为自然人的，须注明的名称应为该人的姓或主姓和一个或几个名或副名，或根据该人的选择，注明该人惯用的一个或几个姓名。
Translation: (1) Where the person is a natural person, the name to be specified shall be the surname or principal surname and one or more given names or secondary names of that person, or, at the person's option, one or more customary names used by that person.

Query_Text_cn: （2）该人为法人的，须注明的名称应为该法人的正式全称。
Translation: (2) Where the person is a legal person, the name to be indicated shall be the official full name of such legal person.

Query_Text_cn: （二）任何缔约方均应接受，须注明名称的代理人为公司或合伙企业时，注明该公司或合伙企业的惯用名称，即为已注明名称。
Translation: (2) Each Contracting Party shall accept that the indication of the name of an agent, when it is a company or partnership, by the customary name of such company or partnership constitutes the indication of the name.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[地址]（一）任何缔约方均可以要求，须注明某人地址时，注明的地址须满足快速邮寄的习惯要求，并且一定要包括所有相关的行政单位名称，直至（并包括）房屋或建筑物编号（如果有）。
Translation: II. [Address] (1) Any Contracting Party may require that, when an address is to be indicated, it shall be furnished in a manner that satisfies the customary requirements for prompt postal delivery and shall, in any case, include all relevant administrative unit names up to and including the house or building number, if any.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约方可以要求，以地址不同的两人或多人的名义向缔约方商标主管机关提交文函的，文函中须注明一个单一地址作为通信地址。
Translation: (2) A Contracting Party may require that where a communication is filed with the Office of the Contracting Party in the names of two or more persons with different addresses, the communication shall indicate a single address as the address for correspondence.

Query_Text_cn: （三）注明的地址可以包括电话号码、传真号码、电子邮件地址以及用于通信的不同于本款第（一）项所注明的地址。
Translation: (3) The address indicated may include telephone numbers, fax numbers, email addresses, and addresses for correspondence that differ from those specified in paragraph (1) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （四）本款第（一）项和第（三）项在细节上作必要修改后应适用于送达地址。
Translation: (4) Subparagraphs (1) and (3) of this paragraph shall apply mutatis mutandis to the address for service.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[其他确认方式]任何缔约方均可以要求，在向商标主管机关提交的文函中，须注明申请人、注册持有人、代理人或利害关系人在该商标主管机关的登记号或其他确认方式（如果有）。
Translation: III. [Other Means of Identification] Any Contracting Party may require that any communication addressed to the Office of the trademark must indicate the registration number or other means of identification, if any, of the applicant, the holder, the representative or the interested party in the records of the Office of the trademark.

Query_Text_cn: 但除以电子形式提交申请的外，任何缔约方均不得以不符合此种要求为由拒收文函。
Translation: However, no Party shall refuse to accept a communication on the grounds that it does not comply with such requirements, except for applications submitted electronically.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[使用的字体]任何缔约方均可以要求，第一款至第三款所注明的任何内容须以商标主管机关使用的字体表示。
Translation: IV. [Typeface Used] Any Contracting Party may require that any of the indications referred to in paragraphs 1 to 3 be in the typeface used by the Office.

Query_Text_cn: 细则三关于申请的细则一、[标准字符]如果缔约方商标主管机关以某种字符（字母和数字）作为标准字符使用，而申请人在申请书中声明希望以商标主管机关所使用的标准字符注册和公告商标的，则该商标主管机关应以该种标准字符对商标进行注册和公告。
Translation:
Rule 3  
Details Regarding Applications  

1. [Standard Characters] If the trademark authority of a Contracting Party uses certain characters (letters and numerals) as standard characters, and the applicant declares in the application the intention to register and publish the trademark in the standard characters used by the said authority, then the trademark authority shall register and publish the trademark in those standard characters.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[指定颜色的商标]商标主管机关可以要求，申请人在申请书中声明希望指定颜色作为商标的显著特点的，申请书中须注明所指定的一种或多种颜色的名称或代码，并注明每种颜色所占商标的主要部分。
Translation: II. [Trademarks in Specified Colors] The trademark authority may require that, where an applicant declares in the application the intention to designate color(s) as a distinctive feature of the trademark, the application shall specify the name or code of one or more colors designated and indicate the proportion of each color in the principal parts of the trademark.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如果申请书中声明希望以该缔约方商标主管机关所使用的标准字符对商标进行注册和公告的，所要求提交的黑白商标图样不得多于一份。
Translation: (2) If the application declares that the trademark is to be registered and published in the standard characters used by the trademark office of the contracting party, no more than one black-and-white trademark specimen shall be required.

Query_Text_cn: （二）任何缔约方，对于申请人在申请书中声明希望指定颜色作为商标的显著特点的，所要求提交的黑白商标图样不得多于五份，彩色商标图样亦不得多于五份。
Translation: (2) Any Contracting Party shall not require more than five copies of the black and white trademark representations or five copies of the color trademark representations, where the applicant has declared in the application that color is to be a distinctive feature of the mark.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[立体商标]（一）在申请书中声明商标为立体商标的，商标图样中应当包括一份平面的绘制图样或摄制图样。
Translation:
IV. [Three-Dimensional Trademarks]  
(1) Where the application declares the trademark to be a three-dimensional trademark, the trademark representation shall include a two-dimensional drawing or photograph.

Query_Text_cn: （二）按本款第（一）项规定提交的图样，根据申请人的选择，可以包括该商标的一个视图，也可以包括该商标的多个不同视图。
Translation: (2) The submitted representation under paragraph (1) of this Article may, at the applicant's option, consist of either a single view of the mark or multiple distinct views thereof.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如果商标主管机关认为申请人按本款第（一）项规定提交的图样不足以体现该立体商标的特点，可以通知申请人在通知书所规定的合理期限内提交该商标的六个以下（含六个）不同的视图或对该商标的文字说明。
Translation: (3) If the trademark authority considers that the drawings submitted by the applicant in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (1) of this Article are insufficient to reflect the characteristics of the three-dimensional trademark, it may notify the applicant to submit no more than six (inclusive) different views of the trademark or a written description of the trademark within a reasonable period specified in the notice.

Query_Text_cn: （四）如果商标主管机关认为本款第（三）项所指的不同视图或文字说明仍不足以体现该立体商标的特点，可以通知申请人在通知书所规定的合理期限内提交该商标的一份样本。
Translation: (4) If the trademark authority considers that the different views or descriptions referred to in paragraph (3) of this Article are still insufficient to demonstrate the characteristics of the three-dimensional trademark, it may notify the applicant to submit a sample of the trademark within a reasonable period specified in the notice.

Query_Text_cn: （五）第三款第（一）项第（1）目和第（二）项在细节上作必要修改后应予适用。
Translation: (5) Subparagraph (1) of item (i) and item (ii) of paragraph 3 shall apply mutatis mutandis.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[全息图商标、动作商标、颜色商标、位置商标]任何缔约方均可以要求，申请书中声明商标为全息图商标、动作商标、颜色商标或位置商标的，须按其法律规定提交该商标的一份或多份图样，以及有关该商标的细节。
Translation: V. [Hologram Marks,Motion Marks,Color Marks,and Position Marks] Any Contracting Party may require that,where the application declares that the mark is a hologram mark,motion mark,color mark,or position mark,the applicant shall submit one or more reproductions of the mark and details concerning the mark,in accordance with its law.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[含有非可视性标志的商标]任何缔约方均可以要求，申请书中声明商标含有非可视性标志的，须按其法律规定提交该商标的一份或多份表现物、关于该商标类型的说明，以及有关该商标的细节。
Translation: VI. [Trademarks Containing Non-Visible Signs] Any Contracting Party may require that where the application declares that the trademark contains a non-visible sign, the applicant shall submit one or more representations of the trademark, a description of the type of trademark, and details concerning the trademark, as prescribed by its law.

Query_Text_cn: 七、[商标的音译]根据条约第三条第一款第（一）项第（13）目的规定，凡构成商标的内容或商标所含有的内容不是以商标主管机关所使用的字体表示的，或表示数目的数字也非商标主管机关所使用的数字的，可以要求提交按商标主管机关所使用的字体和数字的音译。
Translation: VII. [Transliteration of Marks] In accordance with the provisions of Article 3(1)(i)(13), where the elements of which a mark is composed or which the mark contains are not in characters used by the Office, or where the numerals are not numerals used by the Office, the Office may require the filing of a transliteration of such elements or numerals in characters or numerals used by the Office.

Query_Text_cn: 八、[商标的意译]根据条约第三条第一款第（一）项第（14）目的规定，凡构成商标的或商标含有的一个或多个字不是以商标主管机关所接受的语言或所接受的多种语言之一表示的，可以要求将该字译为该商标主管机关所接受的语言或所接受的多种语言之一。
Translation: 8. [Translation of Marks] In accordance with the provisions of Article 3(1)(i)(14) of the Treaty, where one or more words constituting or included in a mark are not in a language accepted by the Office or in one of the languages accepted by the Office, the Office may require that the word or words be translated into a language accepted by the Office or into one of the languages accepted by the Office.

Query_Text_cn: 九、[商标实际使用证据的提交期限]条约第三条第三款所指的期限，应自缔约方商标主管机关受理申请之日起计算，不少于六个月。
Translation: 9. [Time Limit for Submission of Evidence of Actual Use of a Trademark] The time limit referred to in paragraph 3 of Article 3 of the Treaty shall be counted from the date of acceptance of the application by the trademark office of the Contracting Party and shall be no less than six months.

Query_Text_cn: 如果符合缔约方法律规定的条件，申请人或注册持有人有权要求延长该期限，每次至少可以延长六个月，总共至少可以延长两年半。
Translation: Where the conditions prescribed by the laws of the Contracting Parties are met, the applicant or holder of the registration shall have the right to request an extension of the time limit, each extension being for a period of at least six months, with a total extension of at least two and a half years.

Query_Text_cn: 细则四关于代理和送达地址的细则一、[委托代理人时的地址]委托代理人的，缔约方应将该代理人的地址视为送达地址。
Translation:
Supplementary Provision 4: Provisions on Agents and Service Addresses  

1. [Address When Appointing an Agent] If a party appoints an agent, the address of such agent shall be deemed as the service address for that party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[未委托代理人时的地址]申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人未委托代理人但已经提供一个缔约方境内地址作为其地址的，该缔约方应将该地址视为送达地址。
Translation: II. [Address in the Absence of an Appointed Representative] Where an applicant, registered holder, or other interested party has not appointed a representative but has provided an address within the territory of a Contracting Party as their address, that Contracting Party shall consider such address as the service address.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[期限]条约第四条第三款第（四）项所指的期限，应自相关缔约方商标主管机关收到该条所指的文函之日起计算。__UNDEF__文函当事人地址在缔约方境内的，该期限应不少于一个月；__UNDEF__当事人地址在缔约方境外的，该期限应不少于两个月。
Translation: III. [Time Limits] The time limit referred to in Article 4(3)(iv) shall be calculated from the date on which the Office of the relevant Party receives the document referred to in that Article.__UNDEF__Where the parties’ addresses are within the territory of a Party, the time limit shall not be less than one month;__UNDEF__where the parties’ addresses are outside the territory of a Party, the time limit shall not be less than two months.
